The application is already fronted by CloudFront, and the ALB intermittently returns HTTP 502 because targets return malformed/invalid HTTP headers. The requirement is not to fail over the whole site, but to show visitors a custom page when that intermittent 502 occurs, with the least operational overhead.

**Correct answers: A and E.**

- **A. Create an S3 bucket, enable static website hosting, and upload the custom error pages.**  
  A static S3-hosted page is a low-operations location for the error object. CloudFront documentation notes that a custom error page is an object such as an HTML file that CloudFront can return instead of its default error message. It also explains that if custom error pages are stored in a different location, the distribution needs a cache behavior/path that routes requests for those custom error pages to the origin that contains them. See [Create a custom error page for specific HTTP status codes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-custom-error-pages.html) and [Custom error pages and error caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesErrorPages.html).

- **E. Configure a CloudFront custom error response/custom error page.**  
  CloudFront can return a custom object to the viewer when an S3 or custom origin returns an HTTP 4xx or 5xx status code. The supported custom error status codes include **502**, which matches the ALB Bad Gateway error in the question. This solves the problem at the CloudFront layer and affects only requests that receive the configured error code, rather than redirecting all users or changing ALB rules. The CloudFront console supports adding this under the distribution's **Error Pages** tab by creating a custom error response. See [Create a custom error page for specific HTTP status codes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-custom-error-pages.html), [Configure error response behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/custom-error-pages-procedure.html), and [Custom error pages and error caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesErrorPages.html).

The ALB symptom also matches the stated root cause: AWS documentation lists **HTTP 502: Bad gateway** causes for Application Load Balancers, including when the target response is malformed or contains invalid HTTP headers. See [Troubleshoot your Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-troubleshooting.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect.** It uses CloudWatch and Lambda to dynamically modify ALB forwarding rules when health checks fail. This is significantly more operationally complex than configuring a CloudFront custom error response. It also changes ALB routing behavior globally rather than simply substituting a custom page for intermittent 502 responses.

- **C is incorrect.** Route 53 DNS failover can route traffic based on health checks, but that is not appropriate for an intermittent per-request 502 that succeeds on immediate refresh. DNS failover would redirect broader traffic to a fallback target until health checks recover and DNS caches expire; it would not selectively replace only the ALB-generated 502 response for affected requests. Route 53 documentation describes DNS failover as routing DNS queries based on resource health, which is a different mechanism from per-response error handling. See [Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html).

- **D is incorrect.** Like B, this introduces Lambda automation to modify ALB forwarding rules and is operationally heavier. In addition, `Elb.InternalError` is not the described root cause; the scenario identifies malformed HTTP headers returned to the ALB, which ALB troubleshooting documentation maps to HTTP 502 behavior.

Therefore, the least-operational-overhead solution is to host the custom error page in S3 and configure CloudFront to return that page for HTTP 502 errors from the ALB origin.

zh.question: 一家零售公司正在 AWS 上运行其电子商务应用程序。该应用程序在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该公司使用 Amazon RDS DB 实例作为数据库后端。Amazon CloudFront 配置了一个指向 ALB 的源站。静态内容会被缓存。Amazon Route 53 用于托管所有公有区域。应用程序更新后，ALB 偶尔会返回 502 状态码（Bad Gateway）错误。根本原因是返回给 ALB 的 HTTP 标头格式错误。当解决方案架构师在错误发生后立即重新加载网页时，网页可以成功返回。在公司处理该问题期间，解决方案架构师需要向访问者提供自定义错误页面，而不是标准的 ALB 错误页面。哪组步骤可以在运营开销最少的情况下满足此要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将该 S3 存储桶配置为托管静态网页。将自定义错误页面上传到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，如果 ALB 运行状况检查响应 Target.FailedHealthChecks 大于 0，则调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数以修改 ALB 上的转发规则，使其指向可公开访问的 Web 服务器。
options.C: 通过添加运行状况检查来修改现有 Amazon Route 53 记录。如果运行状况检查失败，则配置一个回退目标。修改 DNS 记录，使其指向可公开访问的网页。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，如果 ALB 运行状况检查响应 Elb.InternalError 大于 0，则调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数以修改 ALB 上的转发规则，使其指向可公开访问的 Web 服务器。
options.E: 通过配置 CloudFront 自定义错误页面来添加自定义错误响应。修改 DNS 记录，使其指向可公开访问的网页。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序已经由 CloudFront 置于前端，且 ALB 间歇性返回 HTTP 502，原因是目标返回了格式错误/无效的 HTTP 标头。要求不是对整个站点进行故障转移，而是在发生这种间歇性 502 时向访问者显示自定义页面，并且运营开销最少。

**正确答案：A 和 E。**

- **A. 创建 S3 存储桶，启用静态网站托管，并上传自定义错误页面。**  
  托管在 S3 上的静态页面是一个低运维的错误对象存放位置。CloudFront 文档指出，自定义错误页面是一个对象，例如 HTML 文件，CloudFront 可以返回该对象来替代其默认错误消息。文档还说明，如果自定义错误页面存储在不同位置，则分配需要一个缓存行为/路径，将对这些自定义错误页面的请求路由到包含它们的源站。请参阅[为特定 HTTP 状态码创建自定义错误页面](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-custom-error-pages.html)和[自定义错误页面和错误缓存](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesErrorPages.html)。

- **E. 配置 CloudFront 自定义错误响应/自定义错误页面。**  
  当 S3 或自定义源站返回 HTTP 4xx 或 5xx 状态码时，CloudFront 可以向查看器返回一个自定义对象。受支持的自定义错误状态码包括 **502**，这与题目中的 ALB Bad Gateway 错误相匹配。这会在 CloudFront 层解决问题，并且只影响收到已配置错误码的请求，而不是重定向所有用户或更改 ALB 规则。CloudFront 控制台支持在分配的 **Error Pages** 选项卡下通过创建自定义错误响应来添加此配置。请参阅[为特定 HTTP 状态码创建自定义错误页面](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-custom-error-pages.html)、[配置错误响应行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/custom-error-pages-procedure.html)和[自定义错误页面和错误缓存](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesErrorPages.html)。

ALB 的症状也与所述根本原因一致：AWS 文档列出了 Application Load Balancers 出现 **HTTP 502: Bad gateway** 的原因，其中包括目标响应格式错误或包含无效 HTTP 标头。请参阅[排查 Application Load Balancers 问题](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-troubleshooting.html)。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B 不正确。** 它使用 CloudWatch 和 Lambda 在运行状况检查失败时动态修改 ALB 转发规则。与配置 CloudFront 自定义错误响应相比，这在运营上复杂得多。它还会全局更改 ALB 路由行为，而不是仅为间歇性 502 响应替换自定义页面。

- **C 不正确。** Route 53 DNS 故障转移可以根据运行状况检查路由流量，但这并不适用于立即刷新即可成功的间歇性、按请求发生的 502。DNS 故障转移会将更广泛的流量重定向到回退目标，直到运行状况检查恢复且 DNS 缓存过期；它不会只针对受影响请求选择性替换 ALB 生成的 502 响应。Route 53 文档将 DNS 故障转移描述为根据资源运行状况路由 DNS 查询，这是一种不同于按响应处理错误的机制。请参阅[配置 DNS 故障转移](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)。

- **D 不正确。** 与 B 一样，这会引入 Lambda 自动化来修改 ALB 转发规则，运营开销更大。此外，`Elb.InternalError` 不是所描述的根本原因；该场景指出是返回给 ALB 的 HTTP 标头格式错误，ALB 故障排查文档将其映射到 HTTP 502 行为。

因此，运营开销最少的解决方案是在 S3 中托管自定义错误页面，并配置 CloudFront 在 ALB 源站返回 HTTP 502 错误时返回该页面。

en.question: A company has many AWS accounts and uses AWS Organizations to manage all of them. A solutions architect must implement a solution that the company can use to share a common network across multiple accounts. The company’s infrastructure team has a dedicated infrastructure account that has a VPC. The infrastructure team must use this account to manage the network. Individual accounts cannot have the ability to manage their own networks. However, individual accounts must be able to create AWS resources within subnets. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect perform to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a transit gateway in the infrastructure account.
options.B: Enable resource sharing from the AWS Organizations management account.
options.C: Create VPCs in each AWS account within the organization in AWS Organizations. Configure the VPCs to share the same CIDR range and subnets as the VPC in the infrastructure account. Peer the VPCs in each individual account with the VPC in the infrastructure account.
options.D: Create a resource share in AWS Resource Access Manager in the infrastructure account. Select the specific AWS Organizations OU that will use the shared network. Select each subnet to associate with the resource share.
options.E: Create a resource share in AWS Resource Access Manager in the infrastructure account. Select the specific AWS Organizations OU that will use the shared network. Select each prefix list to associate with the resource share.

en.explanation:
The company needs a **single, centrally managed VPC/network** in the infrastructure account, while allowing workloads in other AWS accounts to launch resources into selected subnets. This is the VPC subnet sharing pattern with AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM), not a multi-VPC connectivity pattern.

Correct answers: **B and D**.

- **B. Enable resource sharing from the AWS Organizations management account.** AWS RAM sharing with an organization or OU must first be enabled for AWS Organizations. The AWS RAM documentation states that to share resources within an organization, you must first enable sharing with AWS Organizations, and that this procedure can be performed only while signed in to the organization's management account. This enables RAM to share resources with an entire organization or OU without invitations. See [Sharing your AWS resources - Enable resource sharing within AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html).
- **D. Create a resource share in AWS RAM in the infrastructure account, select the OU, and associate the subnets.** The VPC owner account owns the subnets and creates the RAM resource share for those subnets. AWS documents that VPC subnet sharing allows multiple AWS accounts to create application resources such as EC2, RDS, Redshift, and Lambda resources into shared, centrally managed VPCs, and that the account that owns the VPC shares one or more subnets with participant accounts in the same AWS Organization. See [Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html). AWS RAM also lists **Amazon VPC subnets** as shareable resources, with the use case of creating and managing subnets centrally while allowing multiple AWS accounts to launch application resources into centrally managed VPCs. See [Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Create a transit gateway in the infrastructure account.** A transit gateway is used to route traffic between multiple VPCs and/or on-premises networks through a centralized gateway. The question does not require connecting separate VPCs; it requires accounts to create resources in subnets of the infrastructure account's VPC. VPC subnet sharing directly satisfies this. AWS also notes that only the VPC owner can attach a transit gateway to a shared VPC subnet, but this is not required for the stated subnet-sharing use case. See [Responsibilities and permissions for owners and participants](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-share-limitations.html).
- **C. Create VPCs in each account with the same CIDR and subnets and peer them.** This contradicts the requirement that individual accounts cannot manage their own networks. It also introduces multiple VPCs and overlapping CIDR ranges, which is not the VPC sharing model. The desired model is to reduce separately managed VPCs by sharing subnets from the centrally managed VPC.
- **E. Share prefix lists instead of subnets.** Managed prefix lists are shareable, but sharing prefix lists allows accounts to reference centrally managed CIDR lists in security groups or route tables; it does not allow participant accounts to launch AWS resources into the infrastructure account's VPC subnets. The required shareable resource is **subnets**, not prefix lists. The RAM shareable resources documentation distinguishes prefix lists from subnets and describes subnet sharing as the feature that lets accounts launch resources into centrally managed VPCs. See [Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html).

zh.question: 一家公司有许多 AWS 账户，并使用 AWS Organizations 管理所有账户。解决方案架构师必须实施一种解决方案，使公司能够在多个账户之间共享一个通用网络。公司的基础设施团队有一个专用的基础设施账户，其中有一个 VPC。基础设施团队必须使用此账户来管理网络。各个账户不能具备管理自己网络的能力。但是，各个账户必须能够在子网中创建 AWS 资源。解决方案架构师应执行哪组操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在基础设施账户中创建一个 transit gateway。
options.B: 从 AWS Organizations 管理账户启用资源共享。
options.C: 在 AWS Organizations 中组织内的每个 AWS 账户中创建 VPC。将这些 VPC 配置为与基础设施账户中的 VPC 共享相同的 CIDR 范围和子网。将每个单独账户中的 VPC 与基础设施账户中的 VPC 建立对等连接。
options.D: 在基础设施账户中的 AWS Resource Access Manager 中创建资源共享。选择将使用共享网络的特定 AWS Organizations OU。选择每个要与资源共享关联的子网。
options.E: 在基础设施账户中的 AWS Resource Access Manager 中创建资源共享。选择将使用共享网络的特定 AWS Organizations OU。选择每个要与资源共享关联的前缀列表。

zh.explanation:
公司需要在基础设施账户中使用一个**单一、集中管理的 VPC/网络**，同时允许其他 AWS 账户中的工作负载在选定子网中启动资源。这是使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 的 VPC 子网共享模式，而不是多 VPC 连接模式。

正确答案：**B 和 D**。

- **B. 从 AWS Organizations 管理账户启用资源共享。** 要与组织或 OU 进行 AWS RAM 共享，必须首先为 AWS Organizations 启用共享。AWS RAM 文档说明，要在组织内共享资源，必须先启用与 AWS Organizations 的共享，并且此过程只能在登录组织的管理账户时执行。这样 RAM 就可以与整个组织或 OU 共享资源，而无需邀请。请参阅 [Sharing your AWS resources - Enable resource sharing within AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html)。
- **D. 在基础设施账户中的 AWS RAM 中创建资源共享，选择 OU，并关联子网。** VPC 拥有者账户拥有子网，并为这些子网创建 RAM 资源共享。AWS 文档说明，VPC 子网共享允许多个 AWS 账户将 EC2、RDS、Redshift 和 Lambda 资源等应用程序资源创建到共享的、集中管理的 VPC 中，并且拥有 VPC 的账户会与同一 AWS Organization 中的参与账户共享一个或多个子网。请参阅 [Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)。AWS RAM 还将 **Amazon VPC subnets** 列为可共享资源，其使用场景是在集中创建和管理子网的同时，允许多个 AWS 账户将应用程序资源启动到集中管理的 VPC 中。请参阅 [Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)。

为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. 在基础设施账户中创建 transit gateway。** transit gateway 用于通过集中式网关在多个 VPC 和/或本地网络之间路由流量。题目并不要求连接独立的 VPC；它要求账户在基础设施账户 VPC 的子网中创建资源。VPC 子网共享可以直接满足这一点。AWS 还指出，只有 VPC 拥有者才能将 transit gateway 附加到共享 VPC 子网，但这对于题目所述的子网共享用例并非必需。请参阅 [Responsibilities and permissions for owners and participants](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-share-limitations.html)。
- **C. 在每个账户中创建具有相同 CIDR 和子网的 VPC，并将它们建立对等连接。** 这与各个账户不能管理自己网络的要求相矛盾。它还引入了多个 VPC 和重叠的 CIDR 范围，这不是 VPC 共享模型。期望的模型是通过从集中管理的 VPC 共享子网，减少单独管理的 VPC。
- **E. 共享 prefix lists 而不是子网。** 托管 prefix lists 是可共享的，但共享 prefix lists 允许账户在安全组或路由表中引用集中管理的 CIDR 列表；它不允许参与账户将 AWS 资源启动到基础设施账户的 VPC 子网中。所需的可共享资源是**子网**，而不是 prefix lists。RAM 可共享资源文档区分了 prefix lists 和子网，并将子网共享描述为允许账户将资源启动到集中管理的 VPC 中的功能。请参阅 [Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)。

en.question: A company wants to use a third-party software-as-a-service (SaaS) application. The third-party SaaS application is consumed through several API calls. The third-party SaaS application also runs on AWS inside a VPC. The company will consume the third-party SaaS application from inside a VPC. The company has internal security policies that mandate the use of private connectivity that does not traverse the internet. No resources that run in the company VPC are allowed to be accessed from outside the company’s VPC. All permissions must conform to the principles of least privilege. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint. Connect this endpoint to the endpoint service that the third-party SaaS application provides. Create a security group to limit the access to the endpoint. Associate the security group with the endpoint.
options.B: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the third-party SaaS application and the company VPC. Configure network ACLs to limit access across the VPN tunnels.
options.C: Create a VPC peering connection between the third-party SaaS application and the company VPUpdate route tables by adding the needed routes for the peering connection.
options.D: Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service. Ask the third-party SaaS provider to create an interface VPC endpoint for this endpoint service. Grant permissions for the endpoint service to the specific account of the third-party SaaS provider.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company is the **consumer** of a third-party SaaS application that runs in another VPC on AWS. The requirements are:

- Private connectivity that **does not traverse the internet**.
- The SaaS provider must not be able to access resources inside the company VPC.
- Access must follow least privilege.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Create an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint. Connect this endpoint to the endpoint service that the third-party SaaS application provides. Create a security group to limit the access to the endpoint. Associate the security group with the endpoint.**

This matches the standard AWS PrivateLink SaaS consumer pattern. AWS documentation states that for SaaS products powered by AWS PrivateLink, **the service provider creates an endpoint service and grants customers access**, while **the service consumer creates an interface VPC endpoint** in the consumer VPC to connect to that endpoint service ([Access SaaS products through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-saas.html)).

AWS also states that PrivateLink establishes private connectivity to services hosted by other AWS accounts and supported AWS Marketplace services, and that you do **not** need an internet gateway, NAT device, Direct Connect connection, or Site-to-Site VPN to communicate with the service. Traffic stays within the AWS network, reducing the attack surface ([Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)).

Using a security group on the interface endpoint also supports least privilege because the endpoint network interfaces can be restricted to allow only the required traffic between company resources and the endpoint.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Site-to-Site VPN with network ACLs

A Site-to-Site VPN is not the best fit. The requirement explicitly says the connectivity must not traverse the internet. AWS PrivateLink specifically avoids the need for Site-to-Site VPN and keeps connectivity private within AWS for this use case ([Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)). Also, VPN creates broader network-level connectivity between environments, which is less aligned with least privilege than exposing only a specific endpoint service through PrivateLink.

### C. VPC peering connection

VPC peering would create network connectivity between the company VPC and the SaaS provider VPC. That is broader than necessary and can expose routing paths between VPCs, which conflicts with the requirement that no resources in the company VPC be accessed from outside the company VPC. It also depends on route table configuration and non-overlapping CIDR blocks. PrivateLink is designed specifically to privately consume a service without giving the provider broad network-level access to the consumer VPC.

### D. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service and ask the SaaS provider to create an interface endpoint

This reverses the roles. In this scenario, the third-party SaaS provider owns the service, so the provider should create the **endpoint service**. The company is the **consumer**, so the company should create the **interface VPC endpoint**. AWS documentation describes exactly this provider/consumer model for SaaS access through PrivateLink ([Access SaaS products through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-saas.html)).

## Conclusion

Option **A** is correct because it uses AWS PrivateLink in the intended SaaS consumer pattern: the SaaS provider exposes an endpoint service, and the company creates an interface VPC endpoint with security group controls for private, least-privilege access.

zh.question: 一家公司想要使用第三方软件即服务（SaaS）应用程序。该第三方 SaaS 应用程序通过多个 API 调用来使用。该第三方 SaaS 应用程序也在 AWS 上的一个 VPC 内运行。该公司将从一个 VPC 内部使用该第三方 SaaS 应用程序。该公司有内部安全策略，要求使用不经过互联网的私有连接。公司 VPC 中运行的任何资源都不允许从公司 VPC 外部访问。所有权限都必须遵循最小权限原则。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint。将此端点连接到第三方 SaaS 应用程序提供的 endpoint service。创建一个安全组以限制对该端点的访问。将该安全组与该端点关联。
options.B: 在第三方 SaaS 应用程序和公司 VPC 之间创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。配置网络 ACL 以限制通过 VPN 隧道的访问。
options.C: 在第三方 SaaS 应用程序和公司 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接。通过添加对等连接所需的路由来更新路由表。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS PrivateLink endpoint service。要求第三方 SaaS 提供商为此 endpoint service 创建一个 interface VPC endpoint。向第三方 SaaS 提供商的特定账户授予 endpoint service 权限。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司是运行在 AWS 上另一个 VPC 中的第三方 SaaS 应用程序的**使用方**。要求如下：

- 使用**不经过互联网**的私有连接。
- SaaS 提供商不得能够访问公司 VPC 内部的资源。
- 访问必须遵循最小权限原则。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 创建一个 AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint。将此端点连接到第三方 SaaS 应用程序提供的 endpoint service。创建一个安全组以限制对该端点的访问。将该安全组与该端点关联。**

这符合标准的 AWS PrivateLink SaaS 使用方模式。AWS 文档指出，对于由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的 SaaS 产品，**服务提供商创建 endpoint service 并授予客户访问权限**，而**服务使用方在使用方 VPC 中创建 interface VPC endpoint**，以连接到该 endpoint service（[Access SaaS products through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-saas.html)）。

AWS 还指出，PrivateLink 可为其他 AWS 账户托管的服务以及受支持的 AWS Marketplace 服务建立私有连接，并且你**不**需要 internet gateway、NAT device、Direct Connect connection 或 Site-to-Site VPN 即可与该服务通信。流量保留在 AWS 网络内，从而减少攻击面（[Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。

在 interface endpoint 上使用安全组也支持最小权限，因为可以限制端点网络接口，只允许公司资源与该端点之间所需的流量。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. Site-to-Site VPN with network ACLs

Site-to-Site VPN 不是最合适的选择。要求明确说明连接不得经过互联网。对于此用例，AWS PrivateLink 明确避免了对 Site-to-Site VPN 的需求，并将连接保持在 AWS 内部的私有网络中（[Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。此外，VPN 会在环境之间创建更广泛的网络级连接，相比于通过 PrivateLink 仅暴露特定 endpoint service，这与最小权限原则的契合度较低。

### C. VPC peering connection

VPC peering 会在公司 VPC 和 SaaS 提供商 VPC 之间创建网络连接。这比所需范围更广，并且可能暴露 VPC 之间的路由路径，与公司 VPC 中任何资源不得从公司 VPC 外部访问的要求相冲突。它还依赖路由表配置和不重叠的 CIDR 块。PrivateLink 专门设计用于私有地使用某个服务，而不会授予提供商对使用方 VPC 的广泛网络级访问权限。

### D. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service and ask the SaaS provider to create an interface endpoint

这反转了角色。在此场景中，第三方 SaaS 提供商拥有该服务，因此提供商应创建 **endpoint service**。公司是**使用方**，因此公司应创建 **interface VPC endpoint**。AWS 文档正是以这种提供方/使用方模型来描述通过 PrivateLink 访问 SaaS（[Access SaaS products through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-saas.html)）。

## 结论

选项 **A** 正确，因为它按照预期的 SaaS 使用方模式使用 AWS PrivateLink：SaaS 提供商公开 endpoint service，公司创建带有安全组控制的 interface VPC endpoint，以实现私有且符合最小权限原则的访问。

en.question: A company needs to implement a patching process for its servers. The on-premises servers and Amazon EC2 instances use a variety of tools to perform patching. Management requires a single report showing the patch status of all the servers and instances. Which set of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager to manage patches on the on-premises servers and EC2 instances. Use Systems Manager to generate patch compliance reports.
options.B: Use AWS OpsWorks to manage patches on the on-premises servers and EC2 instances. Use Amazon QuickSight integration with OpsWorks to generate patch compliance reports.
options.C: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to apply patches by scheduling an AWS Systems Manager patch remediation job. Use Amazon Inspector to generate patch compliance reports.
options.D: Use AWS OpsWorks to manage patches on the on-premises servers and EC2 instances. Use AWS X-Ray to post the patch status to AWS Systems Manager OpsCenter to generate patch compliance reports.

en.explanation:
The company wants one patching process and one patch-status report across both on-premises servers and Amazon EC2 instances. This is a hybrid fleet management and patch-compliance reporting requirement.

**Correct answer: A. Use AWS Systems Manager to manage patches on the on-premises servers and EC2 instances. Use Systems Manager to generate patch compliance reports.**

AWS Systems Manager is designed to manage **managed nodes**, including EC2 instances and machines in hybrid/multicloud environments. The Systems Manager setup documentation states that a managed node is any machine configured for Systems Manager in a hybrid and multicloud environment, and specifically notes setup for both **Amazon EC2 instances and your own computing resources**. [AWS Systems Manager managed node setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-setting-up-nodes.html)

Within Systems Manager, **Patch Manager** automates patching of managed nodes. AWS documentation describes Patch Manager benefits including centralized patching control, scan-only reporting of missing patches, scan-and-install patching, and comprehensive compliance reporting. It also states that Patch Manager can generate detailed reports on patch compliance status, including reports sent to Amazon S3 in CSV format. [AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)

Systems Manager also has a specific Patch Manager capability for **patch compliance reports**. The documentation says that patch compliance reports are generated from successful patching operations and can be used regardless of whether patching is performed through Quick Setup patch policies, maintenance windows, or on-demand Patch now operations. [Working with patch compliance reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-compliance-reports.html)

Therefore, Systems Manager Patch Manager provides both required functions: centralized patch management for EC2 and on-premises servers, and a single patch compliance reporting mechanism.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Use AWS OpsWorks and Amazon QuickSight integration with OpsWorks** — OpsWorks is primarily a configuration management/application lifecycle service based around Chef/Puppet-style automation. The option also assumes a native OpsWorks-to-QuickSight patch compliance reporting path, which is not the appropriate AWS-native patch management and compliance solution. Systems Manager Patch Manager is the service specifically built for this requirement.

- **C. Use EventBridge to schedule Systems Manager patch remediation and Amazon Inspector for reports** — EventBridge can schedule automation, and Systems Manager can perform patching, but Amazon Inspector is not the correct service for a unified patch compliance report. Inspector is an automated vulnerability scanning service that produces vulnerability findings for resources such as EC2, containers, and Lambda, rather than serving as the Systems Manager patch baseline compliance reporting mechanism. [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

- **D. Use AWS OpsWorks and AWS X-Ray with Systems Manager OpsCenter** — X-Ray is for application tracing and performance analysis, not server patch status collection or patch compliance reporting. OpsCenter is for operational work items, not the primary mechanism for generating fleet-wide patch compliance reports. This option combines services that do not directly satisfy the patching and reporting requirements.

Because the requirement is unified patching and patch compliance reporting for EC2 and on-premises servers, **A is the best answer**.

zh.question: 一家公司需要为其服务器实施补丁流程。本地服务器和 Amazon EC2 实例使用多种工具来执行补丁修补。管理层要求提供一份单一报告，显示所有服务器和实例的补丁状态。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 管理本地服务器和 EC2 实例上的补丁。使用 Systems Manager 生成补丁合规性报告。
options.B: 使用 AWS OpsWorks 管理本地服务器和 EC2 实例上的补丁。使用 Amazon QuickSight 与 OpsWorks 的集成来生成补丁合规性报告。
options.C: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则通过调度 AWS Systems Manager 补丁修复作业来应用补丁。使用 Amazon Inspector 生成补丁合规性报告。
options.D: 使用 AWS OpsWorks 管理本地服务器和 EC2 实例上的补丁。使用 AWS X-Ray 将补丁状态发布到 AWS Systems Manager OpsCenter，以生成补丁合规性报告。

zh.explanation:
该公司希望在本地服务器和 Amazon EC2 实例之间实现一个补丁流程，并获得一份补丁状态报告。这是一个混合机群管理和补丁合规性报告要求。

**正确答案：A. 使用 AWS Systems Manager 管理本地服务器和 EC2 实例上的补丁。使用 Systems Manager 生成补丁合规性报告。**

AWS Systems Manager 旨在管理**托管节点**，包括 EC2 实例以及混合/多云环境中的计算机。Systems Manager 设置文档说明，托管节点是指在混合和多云环境中为 Systems Manager 配置的任何计算机，并特别提到可为 **Amazon EC2 instances and your own computing resources** 进行设置。[AWS Systems Manager managed node setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-setting-up-nodes.html)

在 Systems Manager 中，**Patch Manager** 可自动修补托管节点。AWS 文档描述了 Patch Manager 的优势，包括集中式补丁控制、仅扫描报告缺失补丁、扫描并安装补丁以及全面的合规性报告。文档还说明，Patch Manager 可以生成有关补丁合规性状态的详细报告，包括以 CSV 格式发送到 Amazon S3 的报告。[AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)

Systems Manager 还具有专门用于**补丁合规性报告**的 Patch Manager 功能。文档说明，补丁合规性报告由成功的补丁操作生成，并且无论补丁是通过 Quick Setup 补丁策略、维护时段还是按需 Patch now 操作执行，都可以使用这些报告。[Working with patch compliance reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-compliance-reports.html)

因此，Systems Manager Patch Manager 提供了两个所需功能：针对 EC2 和本地服务器的集中式补丁管理，以及单一的补丁合规性报告机制。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 使用 AWS OpsWorks 和 Amazon QuickSight 与 OpsWorks 的集成** — OpsWorks 主要是一项基于 Chef/Puppet 风格自动化的配置管理/应用程序生命周期服务。该选项还假定存在原生的 OpsWorks 到 QuickSight 的补丁合规性报告路径，而这并不是合适的 AWS 原生补丁管理和合规性解决方案。Systems Manager Patch Manager 才是专门为此要求构建的服务。

- **C. 使用 EventBridge 调度 Systems Manager 补丁修复并使用 Amazon Inspector 生成报告** — EventBridge 可以调度自动化，Systems Manager 可以执行补丁修补，但 Amazon Inspector 并不是用于统一补丁合规性报告的正确服务。Inspector 是一种自动化漏洞扫描服务，可为 EC2、容器和 Lambda 等资源生成漏洞发现结果，而不是作为 Systems Manager 补丁基线合规性报告机制。[What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

- **D. 使用 AWS OpsWorks 和 AWS X-Ray 与 Systems Manager OpsCenter** — X-Ray 用于应用程序跟踪和性能分析，而不是用于收集服务器补丁状态或补丁合规性报告。OpsCenter 用于运营工作项，而不是生成机群范围补丁合规性报告的主要机制。此选项组合的服务无法直接满足补丁和报告要求。

由于要求是为 EC2 和本地服务器提供统一的补丁修补和补丁合规性报告，**A 是最佳答案**。

en.question: A company is running an application on several Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The load on the application varies throughout the day, and EC2 instances are scaled in and out on a regular basis. Log files from the EC2 instances are copied to a central Amazon S3 bucket every 15 minutes. The security team discovers that log files are missing from some of the terminated EC2 instances. Which set of actions will ensure that log files are copied to the central S3 bucket from the terminated EC2 instances?

options.A: Create a script to copy log files to Amazon S3, and store the script in a file on the EC2 instance. Create an Auto Scaling lifecycle hook and an Amazon EventBridge rule to detect lifecycle events from the Auto Scaling group. Invoke an AWS Lambda function on the autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING transition to send ABANDON to the Auto Scaling group to prevent termination, run the script to copy the log files, and terminate the instance using the AWS SDK.
options.B: Create an AWS Systems Manager document with a script to copy log files to Amazon S3. Create an Auto Scaling lifecycle hook and an Amazon EventBridge rule to detect lifecycle events from the Auto Scaling group. Invoke an AWS Lambda function on the autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING transition to call the AWS Systems Manager API SendCommand operation to run the document to copy the log files and send CONTINUE to the Auto Scaling group to terminate the instance.
options.C: Change the log delivery rate to every 5 minutes. Create a script to copy log files to Amazon S3, and add the script to EC2 instance user data. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to detect EC2 instance termination. Invoke an AWS Lambda function from the EventBridge rule that uses the AWS CLI to run the user-data script to copy the log files and terminate the instance.
options.D: Create an AWS Systems Manager document with a script to copy log files to Amazon S3. Create an Auto Scaling lifecycle hook that publishes a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. From the SNS notification, call the AWS Systems Manager API SendCommand operation to run the document to copy the log files and send ABANDON to the Auto Scaling group to terminate the instance.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application runs on EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group and instances are regularly terminated during scale-in. Logs are copied to S3 only every 15 minutes, so an instance can be terminated before its latest logs are uploaded. The solution must pause the Auto Scaling termination long enough to run a final log-copy action, then allow termination to proceed.

## Correct answer: B

**B is correct** because it uses the standard Auto Scaling lifecycle-hook pattern for pre-termination work:

1. Add an Auto Scaling lifecycle hook for the `autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING` transition.
2. Use EventBridge to detect the lifecycle event and invoke Lambda.
3. Have Lambda call Systems Manager Run Command / `SendCommand` to run an SSM document on the terminating instance that copies the logs to the S3 bucket.
4. After the copy completes, call `CompleteLifecycleAction` with `CONTINUE` so Auto Scaling can finish terminating the instance.

AWS documentation states that lifecycle hooks let you perform custom actions during Auto Scaling lifecycle events and provide time before the instance transitions to the next state. It specifically gives the scale-in example where a termination lifecycle hook pauses the instance, sends an EventBridge notification, and lets you invoke Lambda or retrieve logs before the instance is fully terminated ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)).

AWS also documents that EC2 Auto Scaling events are delivered to EventBridge in near real time and that EventBridge rules can invoke Lambda while instances are launching or terminating ([Use EventBridge to handle Auto Scaling events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/automating-ec2-auto-scaling-with-eventbridge.html)).

Finally, Auto Scaling lifecycle actions should be completed with `CONTINUE` after the custom action succeeds; AWS documents using `complete-lifecycle-action --lifecycle-action-result CONTINUE` so the Auto Scaling group can continue launching or terminating the instance ([Complete a lifecycle action in an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/completing-lifecycle-hooks.html)). Systems Manager Run Command supports running shell commands or scripts on managed EC2 instances by using SSM documents such as `AWS-RunShellScript` and the `send-command` operation ([Walkthrough: Use the AWS CLI with Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-cli.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

This option incorrectly says to send `ABANDON` to prevent termination. For a **terminating** instance, AWS documentation says both `ABANDON` and `CONTINUE` allow the instance to terminate, but `ABANDON` stops remaining actions such as other lifecycle hooks, while `CONTINUE` allows remaining lifecycle hooks to complete ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)). Therefore, `ABANDON` does not prevent termination. Also, merely storing a script on the instance does not provide a reliable remote execution mechanism from Lambda unless additional orchestration is provided.

### C. Incorrect

Reducing log-copy frequency from 15 minutes to 5 minutes reduces the potential loss window but does **not guarantee** that logs are copied before termination. Also, EC2 user data is not an appropriate mechanism for running an on-demand script at termination time; user data is normally executed during instance launch/bootstrap, not when an EventBridge termination event occurs. Most importantly, this option does not use an Auto Scaling lifecycle hook to pause termination.

### D. Incorrect

Using an SSM document is appropriate, and lifecycle hooks can publish notifications, but this option sends `ABANDON`. On a termination lifecycle hook, `ABANDON` still allows the instance to terminate and stops remaining lifecycle actions; the correct post-copy result should be `CONTINUE` ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)). The option also omits a clear compute component, such as Lambda, to process the SNS notification and call Systems Manager and Auto Scaling APIs.

## Conclusion

The best solution is **B**: use an Auto Scaling termination lifecycle hook, detect the lifecycle event with EventBridge, invoke Lambda, use Systems Manager `SendCommand` to run the log-copy document on the instance, and then send `CONTINUE` to complete the lifecycle action.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Application Load Balancer 后方的 Auto Scaling 组中的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。应用程序的负载全天都会变化，EC2 实例会定期扩缩容。EC2 实例中的日志文件每 15 分钟复制到一个中央 Amazon S3 存储桶。安全团队发现，某些已终止的 EC2 实例缺少日志文件。哪一组操作可以确保从已终止的 EC2 实例将日志文件复制到中央 S3 存储桶？

options.A: 创建一个脚本来将日志文件复制到 Amazon S3，并将该脚本存储在 EC2 实例上的文件中。创建一个 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩和一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以检测来自 Auto Scaling 组的生命周期事件。在 autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING 转换时调用 AWS Lambda 函数，向 Auto Scaling 组发送 ABANDON 以阻止终止，运行脚本复制日志文件，并使用 AWS SDK 终止实例。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Systems Manager 文档，其中包含将日志文件复制到 Amazon S3 的脚本。创建一个 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩和一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以检测来自 Auto Scaling 组的生命周期事件。在 autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING 转换时调用 AWS Lambda 函数，调用 AWS Systems Manager API SendCommand 操作来运行该文档以复制日志文件，并向 Auto Scaling 组发送 CONTINUE 以终止实例。
options.C: 将日志传送频率更改为每 5 分钟一次。创建一个脚本来将日志文件复制到 Amazon S3，并将该脚本添加到 EC2 实例用户数据中。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则来检测 EC2 实例终止。从 EventBridge 规则调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 AWS CLI 运行用户数据脚本来复制日志文件并终止实例。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Systems Manager 文档，其中包含将日志文件复制到 Amazon S3 的脚本。创建一个 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩，将消息发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。根据 SNS 通知，调用 AWS Systems Manager API SendCommand 操作来运行该文档以复制日志文件，并向 Auto Scaling 组发送 ABANDON 以终止实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例上，并且实例在缩容期间会定期终止。日志仅每 15 分钟复制到 S3 一次，因此实例可能会在其最新日志上传之前被终止。解决方案必须暂停 Auto Scaling 终止足够长的时间，以运行最终的日志复制操作，然后允许终止继续进行。

## 正确答案：B

**B 正确**，因为它使用了用于终止前工作的标准 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩模式：

1. 为 `autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING` 转换添加 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩。
2. 使用 EventBridge 检测生命周期事件并调用 Lambda。
3. 让 Lambda 调用 Systems Manager Run Command / `SendCommand`，在正在终止的实例上运行 SSM 文档，将日志复制到 S3 存储桶。
4. 复制完成后，调用 `CompleteLifecycleAction` 并使用 `CONTINUE`，以便 Auto Scaling 可以完成实例终止。

AWS 文档说明，生命周期挂钩允许你在 Auto Scaling 生命周期事件期间执行自定义操作，并在实例转换到下一个状态之前提供时间。它特别给出了缩容示例：终止生命周期挂钩会暂停实例，发送 EventBridge 通知，并允许你在实例完全终止之前调用 Lambda 或检索日志（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。

AWS 还记录了 EC2 Auto Scaling 事件会近乎实时地传送到 EventBridge，并且 EventBridge 规则可以在实例启动或终止时调用 Lambda（[Use EventBridge to handle Auto Scaling events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/automating-ec2-auto-scaling-with-eventbridge.html)）。

最后，自定义操作成功后，应使用 `CONTINUE` 完成 Auto Scaling 生命周期操作；AWS 文档说明使用 `complete-lifecycle-action --lifecycle-action-result CONTINUE`，以便 Auto Scaling 组可以继续启动或终止实例（[Complete a lifecycle action in an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/completing-lifecycle-hooks.html)）。Systems Manager Run Command 支持使用 SSM 文档（例如 `AWS-RunShellScript`）和 `send-command` 操作在托管 EC2 实例上运行 shell 命令或脚本（[Walkthrough: Use the AWS CLI with Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-cli.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 不正确

此选项错误地说发送 `ABANDON` 以阻止终止。对于**正在终止**的实例，AWS 文档说明 `ABANDON` 和 `CONTINUE` 都会允许实例终止，但 `ABANDON` 会停止其余操作（例如其他生命周期挂钩），而 `CONTINUE` 允许其余生命周期挂钩完成（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。因此，`ABANDON` 不会阻止终止。此外，仅仅将脚本存储在实例上，并不能提供从 Lambda 可靠远程执行该脚本的机制，除非提供额外的编排。

### C. 不正确

将日志复制频率从 15 分钟降低到 5 分钟可以减少潜在丢失窗口，但**不能保证**日志在终止前被复制。此外，EC2 用户数据并不是在终止时按需运行脚本的合适机制；用户数据通常在实例启动/bootstrap 期间执行，而不是在发生 EventBridge 终止事件时执行。最重要的是，此选项没有使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩来暂停终止。

### D. 不正确

使用 SSM 文档是合适的，生命周期挂钩也可以发布通知，但此选项发送 `ABANDON`。在终止生命周期挂钩中，`ABANDON` 仍允许实例终止并停止其余生命周期操作；复制后的正确结果应为 `CONTINUE`（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。该选项还遗漏了一个明确的计算组件（例如 Lambda）来处理 SNS 通知并调用 Systems Manager 和 Auto Scaling API。

## 结论

最佳解决方案是 **B**：使用 Auto Scaling 终止生命周期挂钩，通过 EventBridge 棔测生命周期事件，调用 Lambda，使用 Systems Manager `SendCommand` 在实例上运行日志复制文档，然后发送 `CONTINUE` 以完成生命周期操作。

en.question: A company is using multiple AWS accounts. The DNS records are stored in a private hosted zone for Amazon Route 53 in Account A. The company’s applications and databases are running in Account B. A solutions architect will deploy a two-tier application in a new VPC. To simplify the configuration, the db.example.com CNAME record set for the Amazon RDS endpoint was created in a private hosted zone for Amazon Route 53. During deployment, the application failed to start. Troubleshooting revealed that db.example.com is not resolvable on the Amazon EC2 instance. The solutions architect confirmed that the record set was created correctly in Route 53. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the database on a separate EC2 instance in the new VPC. Create a record set for the instance’s private IP in the private hosted zone.
options.B: Use SSH to connect to the application tier EC2 instance. Add an RDS endpoint IP address to the /etc/resolv.conf file.
options.C: Create an authorization to associate the private hosted zone in Account A with the new VPC in Account B.
options.D: Create a private hosted zone for the example com domain in Account B. Configure Route 53 replication between AWS accounts.
options.E: Associate a new VPC in Account B with a hosted zone in Account A. Delete the association authorization in Account A.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application EC2 instance is in a new VPC in **Account B**, while the `db.example.com` record is in a Route 53 **private hosted zone** in **Account A**. A private hosted zone answers DNS queries only for resources in VPCs that are associated with that hosted zone. AWS documentation states that to get an answer from a private hosted zone, the EC2 instance must be running in one of the associated VPCs; otherwise the private hosted zone is not used for resolution ([Working with private hosted zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zones-private.html)).

Because the hosted zone and the VPC are in different AWS accounts, the required cross-account association process is:

1. In the account that created the hosted zone, authorize the VPC association.
2. In the account that created the VPC, associate the VPC with the hosted zone.
3. Recommended: delete the association authorization after the association is complete. AWS notes that deleting the authorization does not affect the association; it only prevents reassociating the VPC later without repeating the authorization process ([Associating an Amazon VPC and a private hosted zone that you created with different AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zone-private-associate-vpcs-different-accounts.html)).

Therefore, the correct answers are **C and E**.

## Correct options

### C. Create an authorization to associate the private hosted zone in Account A with the new VPC in Account B.

Correct. Since the private hosted zone is in Account A and the VPC is in Account B, Account A must first authorize the association of Account B's VPC with the private hosted zone.

### E. Associate a new VPC in Account B with a hosted zone in Account A. Delete the association authorization in Account A.

Correct. After authorization, Account B must perform the actual VPC-to-hosted-zone association. Afterward, deleting the authorization is the AWS-recommended cleanup step and does not remove the working association.

## Incorrect options

### A. Deploy the database on a separate EC2 instance in the new VPC. Create a record set for the instance’s private IP in the private hosted zone.

Incorrect. The problem is not that Amazon RDS cannot be represented in DNS; the problem is that the VPC in Account B is not associated with the private hosted zone in Account A. Replacing RDS with a database on EC2 would not address the cross-account private hosted zone association issue and would unnecessarily change the architecture.

### B. Use SSH to connect to the application tier EC2 instance. Add an RDS endpoint IP address to the `/etc/resolv.conf` file.

Incorrect. `/etc/resolv.conf` configures DNS resolver behavior, not static hostname-to-IP mappings for application records. Additionally, manually hardcoding RDS endpoint IP information is not reliable because RDS endpoint resolution can change and this does not solve private hosted zone access for the VPC.

### D. Create a private hosted zone for the `example.com` domain in Account B. Configure Route 53 replication between AWS accounts.

Incorrect. Route 53 does not require creating a duplicate private hosted zone or configuring cross-account hosted zone replication for this scenario. The supported approach is to associate the existing private hosted zone in Account A with the VPC in Account B using cross-account authorization and association.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用多个 AWS 账户。DNS 记录存储在账户 A 中 Amazon Route 53 的私有托管区域内。该公司的应用程序和数据库运行在账户 B 中。解决方案架构师将在一个新的 VPC 中部署一个双层应用程序。为了简化配置，已在 Amazon Route 53 的私有托管区域中为 Amazon RDS 端点创建了 db.example.com CNAME 记录集。在部署期间，应用程序启动失败。故障排查显示，在 Amazon EC2 实例上无法解析 db.example.com。解决方案架构师确认该记录集已在 Route 53 中正确创建。解决方案架构师应采取哪两个步骤组合来解决此问题？（选择两个。）

options.A: 在新 VPC 中的单独 EC2 实例上部署数据库。为该实例的私有 IP 在私有托管区域中创建记录集。
options.B: 使用 SSH 连接到应用程序层 EC2 实例。将 RDS 端点 IP 地址添加到 /etc/resolv.conf 文件。
options.C: 创建授权，以将账户 A 中的私有托管区域与账户 B 中的新 VPC 关联。
options.D: 在账户 B 中为 example com 域创建私有托管区域。配置 AWS 账户之间的 Route 53 复制。
options.E: 将账户 B 中的新 VPC 与账户 A 中的托管区域关联。删除账户 A 中的关联授权。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

应用程序 EC2 实例位于**账户 B**中的新 VPC，而 `db.example.com` 记录位于**账户 A**中的 Route 53 **私有托管区域**中。私有托管区域只会为与该托管区域关联的 VPC 中的资源应答 DNS 查询。AWS 文档说明，要从私有托管区域获得应答，EC2 实例必须运行在其中一个关联的 VPC 中；否则，私有托管区域不会用于解析（[使用私有托管区域](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zones-private.html)）。

由于托管区域和 VPC 位于不同的 AWS 账户中，所需的跨账户关联流程是：

1. 在创建托管区域的账户中，授权 VPC 关联。
2. 在创建 VPC 的账户中，将 VPC 与托管区域关联。
3. 建议：在关联完成后删除关联授权。AWS 指出，删除授权不会影响关联；它只会阻止以后在不重复授权流程的情况下重新关联该 VPC（[关联使用不同 AWS 账户创建的 Amazon VPC 和私有托管区域](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zone-private-associate-vpcs-different-accounts.html)）。

因此，正确答案是 **C 和 E**。

## 正确选项

### C. Create an authorization to associate the private hosted zone in Account A with the new VPC in Account B.

正确。由于私有托管区域位于账户 A，而 VPC 位于账户 B，账户 A 必须首先授权将账户 B 的 VPC 与该私有托管区域关联。

### E. Associate a new VPC in Account B with a hosted zone in Account A. Delete the association authorization in Account A.

正确。授权后，账户 B 必须执行实际的 VPC 到托管区域关联。之后，删除授权是 AWS 推荐的清理步骤，并且不会移除已生效的关联。

## 错误选项

### A. Deploy the database on a separate EC2 instance in the new VPC. Create a record set for the instance’s private IP in the private hosted zone.

错误。问题并不是 Amazon RDS 不能在 DNS 中表示；问题是账户 B 中的 VPC 未与账户 A 中的私有托管区域关联。用 EC2 上的数据库替换 RDS 无法解决跨账户私有托管区域关联问题，并且会不必要地改变架构。

### B. Use SSH to connect to the application tier EC2 instance. Add an RDS endpoint IP address to the `/etc/resolv.conf` file.

错误。`/etc/resolv.conf` 配置的是 DNS 解析器行为，而不是应用程序记录的静态主机名到 IP 映射。此外，手动硬编码 RDS 端点 IP 信息并不可靠，因为 RDS 端点解析可能会变化，而且这并不能解决该 VPC 对私有托管区域的访问问题。

### D. Create a private hosted zone for the `example.com` domain in Account B. Configure Route 53 replication between AWS accounts.

错误。对于此场景，Route 53 不需要创建重复的私有托管区域，也不需要配置跨账户托管区域复制。受支持的方法是使用跨账户授权和关联，将账户 A 中现有的私有托管区域与账户 B 中的 VPC 关联。

en.question: A company used Amazon EC2 instances to deploy a web fleet to host a blog site. The EC2 instances are behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and are configured in an Auto Scaling group. The web application stores all blog content on an Amazon EFS volume. The company recently added a feature for bloggers to add video to their posts, attracting 10 times the previous user traffic. At peak times of day, users report buffering and timeout issues while attempting to reach the site or watch videos. Which is the MOST cost-efficient and scalable deployment that will resolve the issues for users?

options.A: Reconfigure Amazon EFS to enable maximum I/O.
options.B: Update the blog site to use instance store volumes for storage. Copy the site contents to the volumes at launch and to Amazon S3 at shutdown.
options.C: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Point the distribution to an S3 bucket, and migrate the videos from EFS to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for all site contents, and point the distribution at the ALB.

en.explanation:
The workload is an EC2/ALB/Auto Scaling web fleet whose shared blog content is on EFS. The new problem is specifically caused by large video content and a 10x traffic increase, producing buffering and timeouts. The most scalable and cost-efficient fix is to offload the video objects from the EC2/EFS application path to object storage and deliver them through a CDN.

**Correct answer: C. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Point the distribution to an S3 bucket, and migrate the videos from EFS to Amazon S3.**

Amazon S3 is the right storage service for video objects: AWS describes S3 as providing “scalable object storage” and allowing customers to “store and retrieve any amount of data from anywhere on the web” ([Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html)). CloudFront is the right delivery layer: a CloudFront distribution can use an Amazon S3 bucket as an origin, and CloudFront caches copies of files in edge locations/points of presence so content is delivered quickly from locations close to viewers ([CloudFront: How you set up CloudFront to deliver content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). Moving the videos to S3 and serving them via CloudFront removes the heavy static media workload from EC2/EFS/ALB, improves viewer latency, reduces origin load, and is more cost-efficient than scaling file-system and compute delivery for video traffic.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Reconfigure Amazon EFS to enable maximum I/O.** Max I/O is not the best solution for video delivery. AWS states that General Purpose mode has the lowest per-operation latency and that Max I/O is for highly parallel workloads that can tolerate higher latencies; AWS also recommends General Purpose for all file systems because Max I/O has higher per-operation latencies ([Amazon EFS performance modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)). Even if EFS throughput were improved, users would still be pulling large video content through the application fleet instead of through a CDN/object-storage architecture.

- **B. Update the blog site to use instance store volumes for storage. Copy the site contents to the volumes at launch and to Amazon S3 at shutdown.** Instance store is not shared across the Auto Scaling fleet and is ephemeral, so it is a poor fit for durable, shared blog/video content. It also does not provide CDN edge caching and would complicate synchronization between instances. This is neither the most scalable nor the most cost-efficient approach.

- **D. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for all site contents, and point the distribution at the ALB.** CloudFront can use a custom HTTP origin such as an EC2-based web server/ALB path, but if the videos remain on EFS behind the ALB, cache misses and new content still require the EC2/EFS origin path. This improves delivery for cached responses but does not address the underlying storage and origin scalability/cost issue for large video objects as effectively as S3 + CloudFront. The question asks for the **most cost-efficient and scalable** deployment, which is to store videos as S3 objects and use CloudFront for delivery.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例部署了一个 Web 实例集群来托管博客站点。EC2 实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面，并配置在 Auto Scaling 组中。该 Web 应用程序将所有博客内容存储在 Amazon EFS 卷上。该公司最近增加了一项功能，允许博主在帖子中添加视频，吸引了之前 10 倍的用户流量。在一天中的高峰时段，用户报告在尝试访问站点或观看视频时出现缓冲和超时问题。哪种部署方式最具成本效益且可扩展，能够为用户解决这些问题？

options.A: 重新配置 Amazon EFS 以启用最大 I/O。
options.B: 更新博客站点以使用实例存储卷进行存储。在启动时将站点内容复制到这些卷，并在关闭时复制到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将该分配指向 S3 存储桶，并将视频从 EFS 迁移到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 为所有站点内容设置 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将该分配指向 ALB。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载是一个 EC2/ALB/Auto Scaling Web 实例集群，其共享博客内容位于 EFS 上。新问题具体是由大型视频内容和 10 倍流量增长引起的，导致缓冲和超时。最具可扩展性且最具成本效益的修复方法，是将视频对象从 EC2/EFS 应用路径卸载到对象存储，并通过 CDN 交付。

**正确答案：C. 配置 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将该分配指向 S3 存储桶，并将视频从 EFS 迁移到 Amazon S3。**

Amazon S3 是用于视频对象的正确存储服务：AWS 将 S3 描述为提供“可扩展的对象存储”，并允许客户“从 Web 上的任何位置存储和检索任意数量的数据”([Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html))。CloudFront 是正确的交付层：CloudFront 分配可以使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为源站，并且 CloudFront 会在边缘站点/接入点缓存文件副本，因此内容可以从靠近观看者的位置快速交付 ([CloudFront: How you set up CloudFront to deliver content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html))。将视频移动到 S3 并通过 CloudFront 提供服务，可以将繁重的静态媒体工作负载从 EC2/EFS/ALB 中移除，改善观看者延迟，降低源站负载，并且比扩展文件系统和计算层来交付视频流量更具成本效益。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 重新配置 Amazon EFS 以启用最大 I/O。** Max I/O 不是视频交付的最佳解决方案。AWS 表示，General Purpose 模式具有最低的单操作延迟，而 Max I/O 适用于可容忍较高延迟的高度并行工作负载；AWS 还建议所有文件系统使用 General Purpose，因为 Max I/O 具有更高的单操作延迟 ([Amazon EFS performance modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html))。即使 EFS 吞吐量得到提升，用户仍然会通过应用实例集群拉取大型视频内容，而不是通过 CDN/对象存储架构。

- **B. 更新博客站点以使用实例存储卷进行存储。在启动时将站点内容复制到这些卷，并在关闭时复制到 Amazon S3。** 实例存储不会在 Auto Scaling 实例集群之间共享，并且是临时性的，因此不适合持久、共享的博客/视频内容。它也不提供 CDN 边缘缓存，并且会使实例之间的同步复杂化。这既不是最可扩展的方法，也不是最具成本效益的方法。

- **D. 为所有站点内容设置 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将该分配指向 ALB。** CloudFront 可以使用自定义 HTTP 源站，例如基于 EC2 的 Web 服务器/ALB 路径，但如果视频仍然保留在 ALB 后面的 EFS 上，缓存未命中和新内容仍然需要经过 EC2/EFS 源站路径。这会改善已缓存响应的交付，但不如 S3 + CloudFront 那样有效地解决大型视频对象的底层存储以及源站可扩展性/成本问题。题目要求的是**最具成本效益且可扩展**的部署，即将视频作为 S3 对象存储并使用 CloudFront 进行交付。

en.question: A company with global offices has a single 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection to a single AWS Region. The company’s on-premises network uses the connection to communicate with the company’s resources in the AWS Cloud. The connection has a single private virtual interface that connects to a single VPC. A solutions architect must implement a solution that adds a redundant Direct Connect connection in the same Region. The solution also must provide connectivity to other Regions through the same pair of Direct Connect connections as the company expands into other Regions. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Provision a Direct Connect gateway. Delete the existing private virtual interface from the existing connection. Create the second Direct Connect connection. Create a new private virtual interface on each connection, and connect both private virtual interfaces to the Direct Connect gateway. Connect the Direct Connect gateway to the single VPC.
options.B: Keep the existing private virtual interface. Create the second Direct Connect connection. Create a new private virtual interface on the new connection, and connect the new private virtual interface to the single VPC.
options.C: Keep the existing private virtual interface. Create the second Direct Connect connection. Create a new public virtual interface on the new connection, and connect the new public virtual interface to the single VPC.
options.D: Provision a transit gateway. Delete the existing private virtual interface from the existing connection. Create the second Direct Connect connection. Create a new private virtual interface on each connection, and connect both private virtual interfaces to the transit gateway. Associate the transit gateway with the single VPC.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company currently has one 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection with one private virtual interface (VIF) directly providing private connectivity to a single VPC in one AWS Region. The required design must:

1. Add a redundant Direct Connect connection in the same Region.
2. Allow future connectivity to VPCs in other AWS Regions by using the same pair of Direct Connect connections.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Provision a Direct Connect gateway. Delete the existing private virtual interface from the existing connection. Create the second Direct Connect connection. Create a new private virtual interface on each connection, and connect both private virtual interfaces to the Direct Connect gateway. Connect the Direct Connect gateway to the single VPC.**

This is the best answer because a **Direct Connect gateway** is designed for using Direct Connect to reach VPCs across Regions. AWS states that a Direct Connect gateway is a **globally available resource** and that you can connect to any Region globally by using it, except China Regions. The Direct Connect gateway documentation also gives a scenario where one Direct Connect connection in one Region is used to access VPCs in two different Regions through the Direct Connect gateway and private VIF connectivity ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)).

For VPC connectivity through a Direct Connect gateway, each VPC uses a virtual private gateway association, and private VIFs are created on the Direct Connect connection to the Direct Connect gateway. AWS documents that associating a virtual private gateway with a Direct Connect gateway enables connectivity between a Direct Connect connection and VPCs across different accounts and Regions, and that private virtual interfaces are created on the Direct Connect connection to the Direct Connect gateway so that multiple VPCs can share the same Direct Connect connection ([Direct Connect virtual private gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/virtualgateways.html)).

Creating a second Direct Connect connection and placing a private VIF on each connection to the Direct Connect gateway gives the required Direct Connect path redundancy. Replacing the existing VIF is necessary in the context of the answer because the existing VIF is attached for the current single-VPC design; the target design requires private VIFs that terminate on the Direct Connect gateway.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Keep the existing private VIF and create a new private VIF on the new connection to the single VPC

This can provide another Direct Connect path to the **same VPC in the same Region**, but it does not satisfy the requirement to provide connectivity to **other Regions through the same pair of Direct Connect connections**. A private VIF directly attached for a single VPC design is regional/single-VPC oriented, while the multi-Region expansion requirement points to a Direct Connect gateway. AWS specifically documents Direct Connect gateway use for VPC connectivity across different Regions ([Direct Connect virtual private gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/virtualgateways.html)).

### C. Create a public VIF on the new connection and connect it to the single VPC

A public VIF is not used to connect privately to a VPC. AWS describes the VIF types as follows: a **private virtual interface** is used to access an Amazon VPC using private IP addresses, while a **public virtual interface** accesses AWS public services using public IP addresses ([Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)). Therefore, a public VIF would not meet the requirement for private VPC connectivity and redundancy.

### D. Provision a transit gateway and connect private VIFs directly to the transit gateway

This option is incorrect as written. AWS documents that a **transit virtual interface**, not a private VIF, is used to access one or more Amazon VPC Transit Gateways associated with Direct Connect gateways ([Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)). A transit gateway is also a Regional networking construct; using only a transit gateway in the single Region does not by itself provide the requested multi-Region Direct Connect access through the same pair of connections. For Direct Connect integration with transit gateways, the supported pattern involves a Direct Connect gateway association, not private VIFs connected directly to a transit gateway.

## Conclusion

Option **A** is correct because a Direct Connect gateway is the AWS-native construct for connecting Direct Connect private connectivity to VPCs across Regions, and creating private VIFs from each of the two Direct Connect connections to that Direct Connect gateway provides the required redundant Direct Connect connectivity and future multi-Region expansion path.

zh.question: 一家拥有全球办公室的公司有一条连接到单个 AWS 区域的 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。该公司的本地网络使用该连接与公司在 AWS 云中的资源通信。该连接有一个私有虚拟接口，连接到单个 VPC。解决方案架构师必须实施一个解决方案，在同一区域中添加一条冗余的 Direct Connect 连接。随着公司扩展到其他区域，该解决方案还必须通过同一对 Direct Connect 连接提供到其他区域的连接。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 预置一个 Direct Connect gateway。从现有连接中删除现有的私有虚拟接口。创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接。在每条连接上创建一个新的私有虚拟接口，并将两个私有虚拟接口都连接到 Direct Connect gateway。将 Direct Connect gateway 连接到单个 VPC。
options.B: 保留现有的私有虚拟接口。创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接。在新连接上创建一个新的私有虚拟接口，并将新的私有虚拟接口连接到单个 VPC。
options.C: 保留现有的私有虚拟接口。创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接。在新连接上创建一个新的公有虚拟接口，并将新的公有虚拟接口连接到单个 VPC。
options.D: 预置一个 transit gateway。从现有连接中删除现有的私有虚拟接口。创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接。在每条连接上创建一个新的私有虚拟接口，并将两个私有虚拟接口都连接到 transit gateway。将 transit gateway 与单个 VPC 关联。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司目前有一条 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接，并有一个私有虚拟接口 (VIF)，直接为一个 AWS 区域中的单个 VPC 提供私有连接。所需设计必须：

1. 在同一区域中添加一条冗余的 Direct Connect 连接。
2. 允许将来使用同一对 Direct Connect 连接连接到其他 AWS 区域中的 VPC。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 预置一个 Direct Connect gateway。从现有连接中删除现有的私有虚拟接口。创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接。在每条连接上创建一个新的私有虚拟接口，并将两个私有虚拟接口都连接到 Direct Connect gateway。将 Direct Connect gateway 连接到单个 VPC。**

这是最佳答案，因为 **Direct Connect gateway** 旨在用于通过 Direct Connect 访问跨区域的 VPC。AWS 声明 Direct Connect gateway 是一种**全局可用资源**，你可以使用它连接到全球任何区域（中国区域除外）。Direct Connect gateway 文档还给出了一个场景：在一个区域中的一条 Direct Connect 连接通过 Direct Connect gateway 和私有 VIF 连接访问两个不同区域中的 VPC（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。

对于通过 Direct Connect gateway 的 VPC 连接，每个 VPC 使用一个 virtual private gateway 关联，并在 Direct Connect 连接上创建到 Direct Connect gateway 的私有 VIF。AWS 文档说明，将 virtual private gateway 与 Direct Connect gateway 关联可在 Direct Connect 连接与跨不同账户和区域的 VPC 之间启用连接，并且在 Direct Connect 连接上创建到 Direct Connect gateway 的私有虚拟接口，以便多个 VPC 可以共享同一条 Direct Connect 连接（[Direct Connect virtual private gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/virtualgateways.html)）。

创建第二条 Direct Connect 连接，并在每条连接上放置一个到 Direct Connect gateway 的私有 VIF，可以提供所需的 Direct Connect 路径冗余。在该答案的上下文中，替换现有 VIF 是必要的，因为现有 VIF 是为当前单 VPC 设计而附加的；目标设计需要终止在 Direct Connect gateway 上的私有 VIF。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 保留现有的私有 VIF，并在新连接上创建一个到单个 VPC 的新私有 VIF

这可以为**同一区域中的同一个 VPC**提供另一条 Direct Connect 路径，但它不满足通过**同一对 Direct Connect 连接**提供到**其他区域**连接的要求。直接为单 VPC 设计附加的私有 VIF 面向区域/单 VPC，而多区域扩展要求指向 Direct Connect gateway。AWS 明确记录了 Direct Connect gateway 用于跨不同区域的 VPC 连接（[Direct Connect virtual private gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/virtualgateways.html)）。

### C. 在新连接上创建公有 VIF 并将其连接到单个 VPC

公有 VIF 不用于私有连接到 VPC。AWS 对 VIF 类型的描述如下：**private virtual interface** 用于使用私有 IP 地址访问 Amazon VPC，而 **public virtual interface** 使用公有 IP 地址访问 AWS 公有服务（[Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)）。因此，公有 VIF 无法满足私有 VPC 连接和冗余的要求。

### D. 预置 transit gateway，并将私有 VIF 直接连接到 transit gateway

此选项按其表述是不正确的。AWS 文档说明，用于访问一个或多个与 Direct Connect gateways 关联的 Amazon VPC Transit Gateways 的是 **transit virtual interface**，而不是 private VIF（[Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)）。transit gateway 也是一种区域性网络构造；仅在单个区域中使用 transit gateway，本身并不能通过同一对连接提供所要求的多区域 Direct Connect 访问。对于 Direct Connect 与 transit gateways 的集成，受支持的模式涉及 Direct Connect gateway 关联，而不是将 private VIF 直接连接到 transit gateway。

## 结论

选项 **A** 正确，因为 Direct Connect gateway 是 AWS 原生构造，用于将 Direct Connect 私有连接连接到跨区域的 VPC，并且从两条 Direct Connect 连接中的每一条创建到该 Direct Connect gateway 的私有 VIF，可以提供所需的冗余 Direct Connect 连接和未来多区域扩展路径。

en.question: A company has a web application that allows users to upload short videos. The videos are stored on Amazon EBS volumes and analyzed by custom recognition software for categorization. The website contains static content that has variable traffic with peaks in certain months. The architecture consists of Amazon EC2 instances running in an Auto Scaling group for the web application and EC2 instances running in an Auto Scaling group to process an Amazon SQS queue. The company wants to re-architect the application to reduce operational overhead using AWS managed services where possible and remove dependencies on third-party software. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon ECS containers for the web application and Spot instances for the Auto Scaling group that processes the SQS queue. Replace the custom software with Amazon Rekognition to categorize the videos.
options.B: Store the uploaded videos in Amazon EFS and mount the file system to the EC2 instances for the web application. Process the SQS queue with an AWS Lambda function that calls the Amazon Rekognition API to categorize the videos.
options.C: Host the web application in Amazon S3. Store the uploaded videos in Amazon S3. Use S3 event notification to publish events to the SQS queue. Process the SQS queue with an AWS Lambda function that calls the Amazon Rekognition API to categorize the videos.
options.D: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to launch EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web application and launch a worker environment to process the SQS queue. Replace the custom software with Amazon Rekognition to categorize the videos.

en.explanation:
The company wants to replace an EC2/EBS-based video upload and processing architecture with AWS managed services, reduce operational overhead, and remove custom recognition software. The correct answer is **C**.

**Option C is correct** because it most completely moves the architecture to managed and serverless AWS services:

- The website has static content with variable traffic. Amazon S3 can host a static website, and AWS states that static webpages can include static content and client-side scripts ([Hosting a static website using Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). This removes the need to run and scale EC2 instances for the static web tier.
- Storing uploaded videos in Amazon S3 replaces EBS volumes with durable managed object storage.
- Amazon S3 Event Notifications can publish notifications for new object created events and can send those notifications to Amazon SQS queues ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). This provides a managed way to enqueue video-processing work when users upload videos.
- AWS Lambda can process messages from an Amazon SQS queue by using an event source mapping ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). This removes the EC2 Auto Scaling group that currently processes the queue.
- Amazon Rekognition Video analyzes videos stored in S3 and can detect labels and other information in videos ([Working with stored video analysis operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/video.html)). This replaces the custom recognition software with an AWS managed service.

Together, S3, S3 Event Notifications, SQS, Lambda, and Rekognition provide the lowest-operational-overhead design among the options.

**Option A is incorrect** because it still uses compute infrastructure for the application and queue processing. ECS containers and Spot Instances can reduce some cost or deployment effort, but they do not remove the operational overhead of managing compute capacity for the web tier and workers. The option also does not move the uploaded videos from EBS to S3 or use native S3 upload events.

**Option B is incorrect** because it keeps EC2 instances for the web application and stores the videos in Amazon EFS. Although Lambda and Rekognition reduce processing overhead, Amazon Rekognition Video is designed to process videos stored in Amazon S3, not EFS. This option therefore does not align the storage and recognition workflow as well as option C and does not reduce operational overhead as much.

**Option D is incorrect** because Elastic Beanstalk simplifies application deployment but still uses EC2-based environments and Auto Scaling for the web and worker tiers. It replaces the recognition software with Rekognition, but it does not eliminate as much infrastructure management as the S3, SQS, Lambda, and Rekognition architecture in option C.

Therefore, the best solution is **C**.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Web 应用程序，允许用户上传短视频。这些视频存储在 Amazon EBS 卷上，并由自定义识别软件进行分析以便分类。该网站包含静态内容，其流量会变化，并在某些月份出现峰值。该架构包括：在 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例用于 Web 应用程序，以及在 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 EC2 实例用于处理 Amazon SQS 队列。该公司希望尽可能使用 AWS 托管服务重新架构该应用程序，以减少运营开销，并消除对第三方软件的依赖。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 对 Web 应用程序使用 Amazon ECS 容器，并对处理 SQS 队列的 Auto Scaling 组使用 Spot 实例。使用 Amazon Rekognition 替换自定义软件来对视频进行分类。
options.B: 将上传的视频存储在 Amazon EFS 中，并将该文件系统挂载到 Web 应用程序的 EC2 实例上。使用调用 Amazon Rekognition API 的 AWS Lambda 函数处理 SQS 队列，以对视频进行分类。
options.C: 在 Amazon S3 中托管 Web 应用程序。将上传的视频存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 S3 事件通知将事件发布到 SQS 队列。使用调用 Amazon Rekognition API 的 AWS Lambda 函数处理 SQS 队列，以对视频进行分类。
options.D: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 为 Web 应用程序在 Auto Scaling 组中启动 EC2 实例，并启动一个 worker 环境来处理 SQS 队列。使用 Amazon Rekognition 替换自定义软件来对视频进行分类。

zh.explanation:
该公司希望将基于 EC2/EBS 的视频上传和处理架构替换为 AWS 托管服务，减少运营开销，并移除自定义识别软件。正确答案是 **C**。

**选项 C 正确**，因为它最完整地将架构迁移到托管且无服务器的 AWS 服务：

- 该网站包含静态内容，且流量会变化。Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站，AWS 表示静态网页可以包含静态内容和客户端脚本（[使用 Amazon S3 托管静态网站](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。这消除了为静态 Web 层运行和扩展 EC2 实例的需要。
- 将上传的视频存储在 Amazon S3 中，用持久的托管对象存储替代 EBS 卷。
- Amazon S3 Event Notifications 可以针对新对象创建事件发布通知，并可以将这些通知发送到 Amazon SQS 队列（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。这提供了一种托管方式，可在用户上传视频时将视频处理工作加入队列。
- AWS Lambda 可以通过使用事件源映射来处理来自 Amazon SQS 队列的消息（[将 Lambda 与 Amazon SQS 结合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。这移除了当前处理队列的 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。
- Amazon Rekognition Video 可以分析存储在 S3 中的视频，并可以检测视频中的标签和其他信息（[使用存储视频分析操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/video.html)）。这用 AWS 托管服务替代了自定义识别软件。

综合来看，S3、S3 Event Notifications、SQS、Lambda 和 Rekognition 在这些选项中提供了运营开销最低的设计。

**选项 A 不正确**，因为它仍然为应用程序和队列处理使用计算基础设施。ECS 容器和 Spot Instances 可以降低一些成本或部署工作量，但它们并没有消除为 Web 层和 worker 管理计算容量的运营开销。该选项也没有将上传的视频从 EBS 移至 S3，也没有使用原生 S3 上传事件。

**选项 B 不正确**，因为它保留了用于 Web 应用程序的 EC2 实例，并将视频存储在 Amazon EFS 中。虽然 Lambda 和 Rekognition 降低了处理开销，但 Amazon Rekognition Video 设计用于处理存储在 Amazon S3 中的视频，而不是 EFS。因此，与选项 C 相比，该选项没有很好地使存储和识别工作流保持一致，也没有同样程度地减少运营开销。

**选项 D 不正确**，因为 Elastic Beanstalk 简化了应用程序部署，但仍然为 Web 和 worker 层使用基于 EC2 的环境和 Auto Scaling。它使用 Rekognition 替换了识别软件，但与选项 C 中的 S3、SQS、Lambda 和 Rekognition 架构相比，它并没有消除同等程度的基础设施管理。

因此，最佳解决方案是 **C**。

en.question: A company has a serverless application comprised of Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda functions. The current deployment process of the application code is to create a new version number of the Lambda function and run an AWS CLI script to update. If the new function version has errors, another CLI script reverts by deploying the previous working version of the function. The company would like to decrease the time to deploy new versions of the application logic provided by the Lambda functions, and also reduce the time to detect and revert when errors are identified. How can this be accomplished?

options.A: Create and deploy nested AWS CloudFormation stacks with the parent stack consisting of the AWS CloudFront distribution and API Gateway, and the child stack containing the Lambda function. For changes to Lambda, create an AWS CloudFormation change set and deploy; if errors are triggered, revert the AWS CloudFormation change set to the previous version.
options.B: Use AWS SAM and built-in AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the new Lambda version, gradually shift traffic to the new version, and use pre-traffic and post-traffic test functions to verify code. Rollback if Amazon CloudWatch alarms are triggered.
options.C: Refactor the AWS CLI scripts into a single script that deploys the new Lambda version. When deployment is completed, the script tests execute. If errors are detected, revert to the previous Lambda version.
options.D: Create and deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack that consists of a new API Gateway endpoint that references the new Lambda version. Change the CloudFront origin to the new API Gateway endpoint, monitor errors and if detected, change the AWS CloudFront origin to the previous API Gateway endpoint.

en.explanation:
The application already uses Lambda versions and manual CLI scripts to update or revert. The requirement is to **deploy Lambda application logic faster** and also **detect and roll back bad deployments faster**. The AWS-native feature that directly addresses this for serverless Lambda deployments is AWS SAM's integration with AWS CodeDeploy.

**Correct answer: B. Use AWS SAM and built-in AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the new Lambda version, gradually shift traffic to the new version, and use pre-traffic and post-traffic test functions to verify code. Rollback if Amazon CloudWatch alarms are triggered.**

AWS documentation states that AWS SAM comes built-in with CodeDeploy to provide gradual Lambda deployments. With minimal configuration, SAM can publish new Lambda versions, create aliases, gradually shift traffic to the new version, define pre-traffic and post-traffic test functions, and automatically roll back when CloudWatch alarms are triggered. The documentation also notes that if pre-traffic or post-traffic tests fail, or if a CloudWatch alarm is triggered, CodeDeploy rolls back the deployment. This exactly matches the requirement to speed up deployment while reducing detection and rollback time through automated validation and rollback. See [Deploying serverless applications gradually with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/automating-updates-to-serverless-apps.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Nested CloudFormation stacks and change sets**: CloudFormation change sets are useful for previewing infrastructure changes, but this option does not provide Lambda traffic shifting, pre/post deployment validation hooks, or automatic rollback based on CloudWatch alarms for function-level deployment health. It also frames rollback as reverting a change set, which is not the same as automated Lambda safe deployment with aliases and CodeDeploy.

- **C. Refactor CLI scripts into a single script**: This improves scripting convenience but keeps the company on a custom manual deployment model. It does not provide managed canary/linear traffic shifting, Lambda alias-based safe deployments, integrated pre-traffic/post-traffic hooks, or automatic rollback from CloudWatch alarms. It is less reliable and less operationally efficient than SAM with CodeDeploy.

- **D. Create a new API Gateway endpoint and change the CloudFront origin**: This shifts the deployment mechanism to CloudFront/API Gateway infrastructure changes rather than solving Lambda version deployment safely. Changing CloudFront origins can be slower and operationally heavier, and this option does not provide CodeDeploy's Lambda traffic shifting, validation hooks, or automatic rollback based on alarms.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer because it uses the purpose-built AWS SAM and CodeDeploy safe deployment mechanism for Lambda functions.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个无服务器应用程序，由 Amazon CloudFront、Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数组成。该应用程序代码当前的部署流程是创建 Lambda 函数的新版本号，并运行 AWS CLI 脚本进行更新。如果新函数版本出现错误，则另一个 CLI 脚本会通过部署该函数之前可用的版本来回滚。公司希望缩短部署由 Lambda 函数提供的新版本应用程序逻辑所需的时间，并且在发现错误时也缩短检测和回滚的时间。如何实现这一目标？

options.A: 创建并部署嵌套 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，其中父堆栈包含 AWS CloudFront 分配和 API Gateway，子堆栈包含 Lambda 函数。对于 Lambda 的更改，创建 AWS CloudFormation 变更集并部署；如果触发错误，则将 AWS CloudFormation 变更集回滚到以前的版本。
options.B: 使用 AWS SAM 和内置的 AWS CodeDeploy 部署新的 Lambda 版本，逐步将流量转移到新版本，并使用流量前和流量后测试函数来验证代码。如果触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，则回滚。
options.C: 将 AWS CLI 脚本重构为单个脚本，用于部署新的 Lambda 版本。部署完成后，脚本测试将执行。如果检测到错误，则回滚到以前的 Lambda 版本。
options.D: 创建并部署一个 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，其中包含引用新 Lambda 版本的新 API Gateway 端点。将 CloudFront 源更改为新的 API Gateway 端点，监控错误；如果检测到错误，则将 AWS CloudFront 源更改回以前的 API Gateway 端点。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序已经使用 Lambda 版本和手动 CLI 脚本进行更新或回滚。需求是**更快地部署 Lambda 应用程序逻辑**，并且**更快地检测并回滚有问题的部署**。直接解决无服务器 Lambda 部署这一需求的 AWS 原生功能，是 AWS SAM 与 AWS CodeDeploy 的集成。

**正确答案：B。使用 AWS SAM 和内置的 AWS CodeDeploy 部署新的 Lambda 版本，逐步将流量转移到新版本，并使用流量前和流量后测试函数来验证代码。如果触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，则回滚。**

AWS 文档说明，AWS SAM 内置 CodeDeploy，可提供渐进式 Lambda 部署。通过最少的配置，SAM 可以发布新的 Lambda 版本、创建别名、逐步将流量转移到新版本、定义流量前和流量后测试函数，并在触发 CloudWatch 警报时自动回滚。文档还指出，如果流量前或流量后测试失败，或者触发 CloudWatch 警报，CodeDeploy 会回滚部署。这完全符合通过自动验证和回滚来加快部署，同时减少检测和回滚时间的需求。请参阅 [使用 AWS SAM 逐步部署无服务器应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/automating-updates-to-serverless-apps.html)。

其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. 嵌套 CloudFormation 堆栈和变更集**：CloudFormation 变更集对于预览基础设施更改很有用，但此选项不提供 Lambda 流量转移、部署前/部署后验证挂钩，或基于 CloudWatch 警报的函数级部署运行状况自动回滚。它还将回滚描述为回滚变更集，这与使用别名和 CodeDeploy 进行自动化 Lambda 安全部署并不相同。

- **C. 将 CLI 脚本重构为单个脚本**：这提高了脚本使用便利性，但仍让公司停留在自定义手动部署模型上。它不提供托管的 Canary/线性流量转移、基于 Lambda 别名的安全部署、集成的流量前/流量后挂钩，或由 CloudWatch 警报触发的自动回滚。与 SAM 结合 CodeDeploy 相比，它的可靠性和运营效率较低。

- **D. 创建新的 API Gateway 端点并更改 CloudFront 源**：这将部署机制转移到 CloudFront/API Gateway 基础设施更改，而不是安全地解决 Lambda 版本部署问题。更改 CloudFront 源可能更慢且运营负担更重，并且此选项不提供 CodeDeploy 的 Lambda 流量转移、验证挂钩或基于警报的自动回滚。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为它使用了专为 Lambda 函数设计的 AWS SAM 和 CodeDeploy 安全部署机制。

en.question: A company is planning to store a large number of archived documents and make the documents available to employees through the corporate intranet. Employees will access the system by connecting through a client VPN service that is attached to a VPC. The data must not be accessible to the public.
