The documents that the company is storing are copies of data that is held on physical media elsewhere. The number of requests will be low. Availability and speed of retrieval are not concerns of the company. Which solution will meet these requirements at the LOWEST cost?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket to use the S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) storage class as default. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Create an S3 interface endpoint. Configure the S3 bucket to allow access only through that endpoint.
options.B: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that runs a web server. Attach an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to store the archived data in the EFS One Zone-Infrequent Access (EFS One Zone-IA) storage class Configure the instance security groups to allow access only from private networks.
options.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that runs a web server Attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to store the archived data. Use the Cold HDD (sc1) volume type. Configure the instance security groups to allow access only from private networks.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket to use the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class as default. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Create an S3 interface endpoint. Configure the S3 bucket to allow access only through that endpoint.

en.explanation:
The company needs a low-cost private store for many archived documents that employees can access from the corporate network through Client VPN into a VPC. The documents are secondary copies, request volume is low, and high availability is not required. The best answer is **A**.

**A. Create an S3 bucket that uses S3 One Zone-IA, use an S3 endpoint, and restrict access to that endpoint — Correct.**

Amazon S3 is the lowest-cost and simplest fit among the options because it avoids running EC2 instances or managing file/block storage for mostly static archived documents. **S3 One Zone-IA** is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and still provides millisecond access. AWS states that S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone, making it less expensive than S3 Standard-IA, and recommends it when the data can be re-created if the Availability Zone fails. That matches this scenario because the documents are copies of data stored elsewhere and availability is not a concern ([Amazon S3 storage classes for infrequently accessed objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

The private-access requirement can be met by using an S3 VPC endpoint and a bucket policy condition such as `aws:SourceVpce` to deny access unless requests come through the specified endpoint. AWS provides an example bucket policy that restricts access to a bucket only from a specific VPC endpoint ([Restricting access to a specific VPC endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)). This allows the documents to be made available to employees connected through the VPC path while preventing public access.

**B. EC2 web server with EFS One Zone-IA — Incorrect.**

EFS One Zone-IA can reduce file-storage cost compared with standard multi-AZ EFS options, but this design still requires an EC2 instance running a web server and an EFS file system. For static archived documents with low request volume, this adds unnecessary compute cost and operational overhead compared with storing the objects directly in S3 One Zone-IA.

**C. EC2 web server with EBS Cold HDD (sc1) — Incorrect.**

EBS sc1 is a low-cost block storage type, but the solution still requires a continuously running EC2 instance and attached block storage. It also introduces instance management, scaling, and availability considerations. For a large collection of static archived documents, S3 One Zone-IA is a more cost-effective and simpler object-storage solution.

**D. S3 bucket with S3 Glacier Deep Archive — Incorrect.**

S3 Glacier Deep Archive is designed for very low-cost long-term archiving, but it is not suitable when employees need to directly retrieve documents through an intranet site. AWS states that S3 Glacier Deep Archive data is archived and **not available for real-time access** ([Amazon S3 storage classes for rarely accessed objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). Archived objects must first be restored, and users must wait until a temporary copy becomes available before the object can be accessed ([Restoring archived objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/archival-storage.html)). Because the requirement is to make the documents available to employees, S3 One Zone-IA is the better low-cost storage class than S3 Glacier Deep Archive for this access pattern.

Therefore, **Option A** meets the private-access and lowest-cost requirements while keeping the archived document copies immediately retrievable when employees request them.

zh.question: 一家公司计划存储大量归档文档，并通过公司内联网向员工提供这些文档。员工将通过连接到附加到 VPC 的客户端 VPN 服务来访问该系统。数据不得向公众开放。该公司存储的文档是其他地方物理介质上所保存数据的副本。请求数量将很低。可用性和检索速度不是公司关注的问题。哪种解决方案能够以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将 S3 存储桶配置为默认使用 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 存储类。为该 S3 存储桶配置网站托管。创建一个 S3 接口终端节点。配置该 S3 存储桶仅允许通过该终端节点访问。
options.B: 启动一个运行 Web 服务器的 Amazon EC2 实例。附加一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，以在 EFS One Zone-Infrequent Access (EFS One Zone-IA) 存储类中存储归档数据。配置实例安全组，仅允许来自私有网络的访问。
options.C: 启动一个运行 Web 服务器的 Amazon EC2 实例。附加一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷来存储归档数据。使用 Cold HDD (sc1) 卷类型。配置实例安全组，仅允许来自私有网络的访问。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将 S3 存储桶配置为默认使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 存储类。为该 S3 存储桶配置网站托管。创建一个 S3 接口终端节点。配置该 S3 存储桶仅允许通过该终端节点访问。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一个低成本的私有存储，用于保存大量归档文档，并让员工能够从公司网络通过 Client VPN 进入 VPC 后进行访问。这些文档是辅助副本，请求量很低，并且不需要高可用性。最佳答案是 **A**。

**A. 创建一个使用 S3 One Zone-IA 的 S3 存储桶，使用 S3 终端节点，并将访问限制为只能通过该终端节点 — 正确。**

Amazon S3 是这些选项中成本最低且最简单的选择，因为它避免了为了大多为静态的归档文档而运行 EC2 实例或管理文件/块存储。**S3 One Zone-IA** 专为长期存在、很少访问的数据而设计，同时仍提供毫秒级访问。AWS 说明，S3 One Zone-IA 只在一个可用区中存储数据，因此比 S3 Standard-IA 更便宜，并建议在数据可在可用区故障时重新创建的情况下使用它。这与本场景相匹配，因为这些文档是存储在其他地方的数据副本，并且可用性不是关注点（[Amazon S3 storage classes for infrequently accessed objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

私有访问要求可以通过使用 S3 VPC endpoint 以及类似 `aws:SourceVpce` 的存储桶策略条件来满足，以拒绝任何未通过指定终端节点发出的请求。AWS 提供了一个示例存储桶策略，用于将对存储桶的访问限制为只能来自特定 VPC endpoint（[Restricting access to a specific VPC endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)）。这允许向通过 VPC 路径连接的员工提供文档，同时防止公共访问。

**B. 带有 EFS One Zone-IA 的 EC2 Web 服务器 — 错误。**

与标准多 AZ EFS 选项相比，EFS One Zone-IA 可以降低文件存储成本，但该设计仍需要一个运行 Web 服务器的 EC2 实例和一个 EFS 文件系统。对于请求量很低的静态归档文档，与直接将对象存储在 S3 One Zone-IA 中相比，这会增加不必要的计算成本和运维开销。

**C. 带有 EBS Cold HDD (sc1) 的 EC2 Web 服务器 — 错误。**

EBS sc1 是一种低成本块存储类型，但该解决方案仍需要一个持续运行的 EC2 实例和附加的块存储。它还引入了实例管理、扩展和可用性方面的考虑。对于大量静态归档文档，S3 One Zone-IA 是一种更具成本效益且更简单的对象存储解决方案。

**D. 使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的 S3 存储桶 — 错误。**

S3 Glacier Deep Archive 专为成本极低的长期归档而设计，但当员工需要通过内联网网站直接检索文档时，它并不适合。AWS 说明，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 数据已归档，**不可用于实时访问**（[Amazon S3 storage classes for rarely accessed objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。归档对象必须先还原，用户必须等待临时副本可用后才能访问对象（[Restoring archived objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/archival-storage.html)）。由于要求是向员工提供这些文档，因此对于这种访问模式，S3 One Zone-IA 是比 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 更合适的低成本存储类。

因此，**选项 A** 满足私有访问和最低成本要求，同时在员工请求时仍能让这些归档文档副本立即可检索。

en.question: A company is using an on-premises Active Directory service for user authentication. The company wants to use the same authentication service to sign in to the company’s AWS accounts, which are using AWS Organizations. AWS Site-to-Site VPN connectivity already exists between the on-premises environment and all the company’s AWS accounts. The company’s security policy requires conditional access to the accounts based on user groups and roles. User identities must be managed in a single location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to connect to Active Directory by using SAML 2.0. Enable automatic provisioning by using the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) v2.0 protocol. Grant access to the AWS accounts by using attribute-based access controls (ABACs).
options.B: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) by using IAM Identity Center as an identity source. Enable automatic provisioning by using the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) v2.0 protocol. Grant access to the AWS accounts by using IAM Identity Center permission sets.
options.C: In one of the company’s AWS accounts, configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to use a SAML 2.0 identity provider. Provision IAM users that are mapped to the federated users. Grant access that corresponds to appropriate groups in Active Directory. Grant access to the required AWS accounts by using cross-account IAM users.
options.D: In one of the company’s AWS accounts, configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to use an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider. Provision IAM roles that grant access to the AWS account for the federated users that correspond to appropriate groups in Active Directory. Grant access to the required AWS accounts by using cross-account IAM roles.

en.explanation:
The company has AWS Organizations and wants workforce users who already exist in on-premises Active Directory to sign in to multiple AWS accounts, while keeping identities managed centrally and applying access rules based on groups/roles/attributes. The AWS-native service for centralized workforce access across an organization is IAM Identity Center.

**Correct answer: A**

IAM Identity Center is designed to connect existing workforce identity providers/directories and provide access to AWS accounts. AWS documentation states that IAM Identity Center lets you connect an existing identity provider and synchronize users and groups, and that it provides **one place to assign permissions to multiple AWS accounts** and **one point of federation** for AWS account access ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)). For AWS Organizations, AWS recommends using an **organization instance** of IAM Identity Center because it supports all IAM Identity Center features and provides central management capabilities ([IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)).

For identities that come from an external IdP, IAM Identity Center redirects authentication to that IdP and grants AWS account access based on policies configured in IAM Identity Center. AWS documentation also says users and groups can be provisioned into IAM Identity Center with SCIM before AWS account/application assignments are made ([External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)). IAM Identity Center supports SAML 2.0 federation and SCIM v2.0 synchronization of users and groups from an IdP ([SCIM profile and SAML 2.0 implementation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/scim-profile-saml.html)). In addition, IAM Identity Center supports **attributes for access control (ABAC)**, which addresses the requirement for conditional access based on user-related attributes such as group/role-derived attributes ([Enable attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/enable-abac.html)).

In practice, AWS account access in IAM Identity Center is implemented through permission sets: a permission set is assigned to a user or group in one or more AWS accounts, and IAM Identity Center creates and manages corresponding IAM roles in those accounts ([Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)). Option A is therefore the best match because it uses IAM Identity Center, federates to the existing identity system, synchronizes users/groups, and can apply attribute-based access control centrally across the organization.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

* **B. IAM Identity Center as the identity source** — This would create/manage users in the IAM Identity Center directory rather than using the company’s on-premises Active Directory as the single location for identity management. That violates the requirement to use the same authentication service and manage identities in one existing location. The documentation distinguishes the default Identity Center directory from using Active Directory or an external IdP as the identity source ([Confirm your identity sources in IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/confirm-identity-source.html)).

* **C. IAM SAML provider plus provisioned IAM users and cross-account IAM users** — This is not the recommended centralized multi-account workforce access pattern for AWS Organizations. IAM Identity Center provides the central account-assignment model for multiple AWS accounts. Also, federated users should assume roles; creating IAM users mapped to federated users and using “cross-account IAM users” is not the right design and would duplicate identities instead of keeping them centrally managed.

* **D. IAM OIDC provider plus cross-account roles** — OIDC federation is not the appropriate direct pattern for using an on-premises Active Directory authentication service for AWS Organizations workforce access. It also lacks IAM Identity Center’s centralized organization-level account assignment, SCIM/group synchronization, and ABAC-oriented access-management capabilities. Cross-account roles can work for some federation scenarios, but this option does not meet the centralized identity and access-management requirements as well as IAM Identity Center.

Therefore, **A** is the best answer among the choices.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用本地 Active Directory 服务进行用户身份验证。该公司希望使用相同的身份验证服务登录公司的 AWS 账户，这些账户正在使用 AWS Organizations。本地环境与公司所有 AWS 账户之间已经存在 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。公司的安全策略要求根据用户组和角色对账户进行条件访问。用户身份必须在单一位置进行管理。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)，使用 SAML 2.0 连接到 Active Directory。使用 System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) v2.0 协议启用自动预置。使用基于属性的访问控制 (ABACs) 授予对 AWS 账户的访问权限。
options.B: 配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)，使用 IAM Identity Center 作为身份源。使用 System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) v2.0 协议启用自动预置。使用 IAM Identity Center 权限集授予对 AWS 账户的访问权限。
options.C: 在公司的一个 AWS 账户中，配置 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 以使用 SAML 2.0 身份提供商。预置映射到联合身份用户的 IAM 用户。授予与 Active Directory 中适当组相对应的访问权限。使用跨账户 IAM 用户授予对所需 AWS 账户的访问权限。
options.D: 在公司的一个 AWS 账户中，配置 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 以使用 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 身份提供商。预置 IAM 角色，为与 Active Directory 中适当组相对应的联合身份用户授予对 AWS 账户的访问权限。使用跨账户 IAM 角色授予对所需 AWS 账户的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
该公司使用 AWS Organizations，并希望已存在于本地 Active Directory 中的员工用户能够登录多个 AWS 账户，同时保持集中管理身份，并根据组/角色/属性应用访问规则。用于在组织内集中管理员工访问的 AWS 原生服务是 IAM Identity Center。

**正确答案：A**

IAM Identity Center 旨在连接现有员工身份提供商/目录，并提供对 AWS 账户的访问权限。AWS 文档指出，IAM Identity Center 允许你连接现有身份提供商并同步用户和组，并且它为 AWS 账户访问提供**一个向多个 AWS 账户分配权限的位置**以及**一个联合身份入口点**（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。对于 AWS Organizations，AWS 建议使用 IAM Identity Center 的**组织实例**，因为它支持所有 IAM Identity Center 功能，并提供集中管理能力（[IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)）。

对于来自外部 IdP 的身份，IAM Identity Center 会将身份验证重定向到该 IdP，并根据 IAM Identity Center 中配置的策略授予 AWS 账户访问权限。AWS 文档还说明，可以在进行 AWS 账户/应用程序分配之前，通过 SCIM 将用户和组预置到 IAM Identity Center（[External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)）。IAM Identity Center 支持 SAML 2.0 联合身份验证以及通过 SCIM v2.0 从 IdP 同步用户和组（[SCIM profile and SAML 2.0 implementation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/scim-profile-saml.html)）。此外，IAM Identity Center 支持**用于访问控制的属性 (ABAC)**，这满足了基于用户相关属性（例如由组/角色派生的属性）进行条件访问的要求（[Enable attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/enable-abac.html)）。

在实践中，IAM Identity Center 中的 AWS 账户访问是通过权限集实现的：权限集会分配给一个或多个 AWS 账户中的用户或组，而 IAM Identity Center 会在这些账户中创建并管理相应的 IAM 角色（[Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)）。因此，选项 A 最匹配，因为它使用 IAM Identity Center，与现有身份系统联合，同步用户/组，并且可以在整个组织中集中应用基于属性的访问控制。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

* **B. IAM Identity Center 作为身份源** — 这会在 IAM Identity Center 目录中创建/管理用户，而不是使用公司的本地 Active Directory 作为身份管理的单一位置。这违反了使用相同身份验证服务并在一个现有位置管理身份的要求。文档区分了默认 Identity Center 目录与使用 Active Directory 或外部 IdP 作为身份源（[Confirm your identity sources in IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/confirm-identity-source.html)）。

* **C. IAM SAML provider 加预置 IAM 用户和跨账户 IAM 用户** — 这不是适用于 AWS Organizations 的推荐集中式多账户员工访问模式。IAM Identity Center 为多个 AWS 账户提供集中式账户分配模型。此外，联合身份用户应承担角色；创建映射到联合身份用户的 IAM 用户并使用“跨账户 IAM 用户”不是正确的设计，并且会复制身份，而不是保持集中管理。

* **D. IAM OIDC provider 加跨账户角色** — 对于使用本地 Active Directory 身份验证服务进行 AWS Organizations 员工访问，OIDC 联合身份验证不是适当的直接模式。它还缺少 IAM Identity Center 的组织级集中式账户分配、SCIM/组同步以及面向 ABAC 的访问管理能力。跨账户角色可用于某些联合身份场景，但此选项无法像 IAM Identity Center 那样满足集中式身份和访问管理要求。

因此，在这些选项中，**A** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A software company has deployed an application that consumes a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda functions, and an Amazon DynamoDB table. The application is showing an increase in the number of errors during PUT requests. Most of the PUT calls come from a small number of clients that are authenticated with specific API keys. A solutions architect has identified that a large number of the PUT requests originate from one client. The API is noncritical, and clients can tolerate retries of unsuccessful calls. However, the errors are displayed to customers and are causing damage to the API’s reputation. What should the solutions architect recommend to improve the customer experience?

options.A: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff and irregular variation in the client application. Ensure that the errors are caught and handled with descriptive error messages.
options.B: Implement API throttling through a usage plan at the API Gateway level. Ensure that the client application handles code 429 replies without error.
options.C: Turn on API caching to enhance responsiveness for the production stage. Run 10-minute load tests. Verify that the cache capacity is appropriate for the workload.
options.D: Implement reserved concurrency at the Lambda function level to provide the resources that are needed during sudden increases in traffic.

en.explanation:
The application is seeing more errors on `PUT` requests, and the traffic analysis shows that most problematic requests come from a small set of clients identified by API keys, especially one client. The best recommendation is therefore to control that client's request rate at the API front door and make the client treat throttling as a retryable condition rather than as a customer-visible application error.

**Correct answer: B. Implement API throttling through a usage plan at the API Gateway level. Ensure that the client application handles code 429 replies without error.**

API Gateway usage plans are designed for this exact pattern: a usage plan uses **API keys to identify API clients** and can set request-rate throttling and quotas for those keys. AWS documentation states that usage plans can set the target request rate at which throttling starts and that throttling/quota limits apply to requests for individual API keys aggregated across stages in the usage plan ([Usage plans and API keys for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)).

API Gateway also documents **per-client throttling limits** for clients that use API keys associated with a usage plan, and says that when request submissions exceed rate/burst limits, API Gateway starts throttling and clients can receive **`429 Too Many Requests`** responses. The docs further state that clients can resubmit failed requests in a rate-limiting manner after catching these exceptions ([Throttle requests to your REST APIs for better throughput in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)). This fits the scenario because the API is noncritical and clients can tolerate retries, but customer-visible errors must be reduced.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff and irregular variation in the client application.**  
Retry logic with jitter is generally useful, and client-side handling is still needed. However, this option does not address the root cause: one or a few API-key-authenticated clients are sending too many `PUT` requests. If the backend is already being overwhelmed, adding retries without an upstream throttle can increase load and worsen the error rate. Option B both limits the noisy client and requires the client to handle `429` responses cleanly.

**C. Turn on API caching to enhance responsiveness for the production stage.**  
API Gateway caching is not the right solution for a spike in `PUT` requests. AWS documentation notes that when stage caching is enabled with default method-level caching, it is turned on for **`GET` methods**, and when caching is enabled within a stage's cache settings, only `GET` methods are cached by default ([Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)). `PUT` operations normally modify state and are not an appropriate caching target for reducing write pressure.

**D. Implement reserved concurrency at the Lambda function level.**  
Lambda reserved concurrency reserves a portion of the account concurrency pool for a function and also affects concurrency available to other functions ([Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)). It does not specifically identify or rate-limit the offending API-key client, and it does not directly prevent excessive `PUT` writes from one client from overloading downstream processing or DynamoDB writes. It could even cap the Lambda function and cause additional throttling if set incorrectly.

Therefore, **B** is the most targeted and customer-experience-focused solution: throttle the high-volume client through an API Gateway usage plan and make the client handle `429 Too Many Requests` responses as retryable rather than customer-visible errors.

zh.question: 一家软件公司部署了一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表来调用 REST API。该应用程序在 PUT 请求期间显示错误数量增加。大多数 PUT 调用来自少数使用特定 API 密钥进行身份验证的客户端。解决方案架构师发现，大量 PUT 请求来自一个客户端。该 API 不是关键 API，客户端可以容忍对不成功调用进行重试。但是，这些错误会显示给客户，并正在损害该 API 的声誉。解决方案架构师应建议什么来改善客户体验？

options.A: 在客户端应用程序中实现带指数退避和不规则变化的重试逻辑。确保捕获错误，并使用描述性错误消息进行处理。
options.B: 在 API Gateway 级别通过使用计划实现 API 限流。确保客户端应用程序能够无错误地处理代码 429 响应。
options.C: 开启 API 缓存以提高生产阶段的响应能力。运行 10 分钟负载测试。验证缓存容量是否适合该工作负载。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数级别实现预留并发，以提供流量突然增加期间所需的资源。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序在 `PUT` 请求上看到更多错误，流量分析显示，大多数有问题的请求来自一小组由 API 密钥标识的客户端，尤其是其中一个客户端。因此，最佳建议是在 API 前端入口控制该客户端的请求速率，并让客户端将限流视为可重试条件，而不是显示给客户的应用程序错误。

**正确答案：B. 在 API Gateway 级别通过使用计划实现 API 限流。确保客户端应用程序能够无错误地处理代码 429 响应。**

API Gateway 使用计划正是为这种模式而设计的：使用计划使用 **API 密钥来识别 API 客户端**，并可以为这些密钥设置请求速率限流和配额。AWS 文档说明，使用计划可以设置开始限流的目标请求速率，并且限流/配额限制适用于使用计划中跨阶段聚合的单个 API 密钥请求（[Usage plans and API keys for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)）。

API Gateway 还记录了针对使用与使用计划关联的 API 密钥的客户端的**每客户端限流限制**，并说明当请求提交超过速率/突发限制时，API Gateway 会开始限流，客户端可能会收到 **`429 Too Many Requests`** 响应。文档进一步说明，客户端可以在捕获这些异常后，以速率受限的方式重新提交失败请求（[Throttle requests to your REST APIs for better throughput in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)）。这符合场景，因为该 API 不是关键 API，客户端可以容忍重试，但必须减少客户可见的错误。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 在客户端应用程序中实现带指数退避和不规则变化的重试逻辑。**  
带 jitter 的重试逻辑通常很有用，并且仍然需要客户端侧处理。然而，此选项没有解决根本原因：一个或少数几个使用 API 密钥身份验证的客户端发送了过多 `PUT` 请求。如果后端已经不堪重负，在没有上游限流的情况下增加重试可能会增加负载并恶化错误率。选项 B 既限制了嘈杂客户端，又要求客户端干净地处理 `429` 响应。

**C. 开启 API 缓存以提高生产阶段的响应能力。**  
对于 `PUT` 请求激增，API Gateway 缓存不是正确的解决方案。AWS 文档指出，当使用默认方法级缓存启用阶段缓存时，会为 **`GET` 方法**开启缓存；并且当在阶段的缓存设置中启用缓存时，默认只缓存 `GET` 方法（[Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)）。`PUT` 操作通常会修改状态，不适合作为用于降低写入压力的缓存目标。

**D. 在 Lambda 函数级别实现预留并发。**  
Lambda reserved concurrency 会为某个函数预留账户并发池的一部分，并且也会影响其他函数可用的并发（[Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)）。它不能专门识别有问题的 API-key 客户端或对其进行速率限制，也不能直接防止一个客户端过多的 `PUT` 写入导致下游处理或 DynamoDB 写入过载。如果设置不当，它甚至可能限制 Lambda 函数并导致额外限流。

因此，**B** 是最有针对性且以客户体验为中心的解决方案：通过 API Gateway 使用计划对高流量客户端进行限流，并让客户端将 `429 Too Many Requests` 响应作为可重试条件处理，而不是作为客户可见的错误。

en.question: A company is running a data-intensive application on AWS. The application runs on a cluster of hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances. A shared file system also runs on several EC2 instances that store 200 TB of data. The application reads and modifies the data on the shared file system and generates a report. The job runs once monthly, reads a subset of the files from the shared file system, and takes about 72 hours to complete. The compute instances scale in an Auto Scaling group, but the instances that host the shared file system run continuously. The compute and storage instances are all in the same AWS Region. A solutions architect needs to reduce costs by replacing the shared file system instances. The file system must provide high performance access to the needed data for the duration of the 72-hour run. Which solution will provide the LARGEST overall cost reduction while meeting these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the data from the existing shared file system to an Amazon S3 bucket that uses the S3 Intelligent- Tiering storage class. Before the job runs each month, use Amazon FSx for Lustre to create a new file system with the data from Amazon S3 by using lazy loading. Use the new file system as the shared storage for the duration of the job. Delete the file system when the job is complete.
options.B: Migrate the data from the existing shared file system to a large Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with Multi-Attach enabled. Attach the EBS volume to each of the instances by using a user data script in the Auto Scaling group launch template. Use the EBS volume as the shared storage for the duration of the job. Detach the EBS volume when the job is complete
options.C: Migrate the data from the existing shared file system to an Amazon S3 bucket that uses the S3 Standard storage class. Before the job runs each month, use Amazon FSx for Lustre to create a new file system with the data from Amazon S3 by using batch loading. Use the new file system as the shared storage for the duration of the job. Delete the file system when the job is complete.
options.D: Migrate the data from the existing shared file system to an Amazon S3 bucket. Before the job runs each month, use AWS Storage Gateway to create a file gateway with the data from Amazon S3. Use the file gateway as the shared storage for the job. Delete the file gateway when the job is complete.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The workload is a monthly, 72-hour, data-intensive/HPC-style job that needs a shared, high-performance file system only while the compute fleet is running. The existing always-on EC2-based shared file system stores 200 TB, but each monthly job reads only a subset of that data. The largest cost reduction comes from moving the durable data store to low-cost Amazon S3 and creating the high-performance file system only for the job window.

Option **A** best matches this pattern:

* Amazon FSx for Lustre is designed for workloads where storage speed matters, including HPC and other fast data-processing workloads. AWS states that FSx for Lustre provides sub-millisecond latencies, up to multiple TBps of throughput, and up to millions of IOPS ([FSx for Lustre overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)).
* FSx for Lustre integrates with Amazon S3. When linked to an S3 bucket, it can present S3 objects as files, imports file listings/metadata, and can write file system data back to S3 by using data repository features/tasks ([FSx for Lustre and S3 data repository integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html), [data repositories overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/overview-dra-data-repo.html)).
* S3 Intelligent-Tiering is intended to optimize costs for data with unknown or changing access patterns, automatically moving objects to lower-cost tiers without performance impact or operational overhead, and without retrieval fees for the low-latency access tiers ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). This fits a 200 TB dataset where only a subset is accessed each month.
* Creating the FSx for Lustre file system only before the monthly job and deleting it afterward avoids paying for the high-performance file system during the rest of the month.

Therefore, **A** provides durable low-cost storage in S3 plus temporary high-performance shared file access during the 72-hour processing window.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. EBS Multi-Attach

This is not suitable for hundreds of EC2 instances. EBS Multi-Attach volumes can be attached to **up to 16 Nitro-based instances in the same Availability Zone**, and Multi-Attach is supported only for Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes. AWS also warns that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers; a clustered file system is required for resiliency and reliability ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). This does not meet the scale or shared file system requirements and would not be the lowest-cost approach for 200 TB.

### C. FSx for Lustre with S3 Standard and batch loading

This uses the right high-performance file system, but it is less cost-optimized than A. The job reads only a subset of the 200 TB each month. Batch/preloading the dataset into FSx would increase time and cost by loading data that might not be used. S3 Standard also does not provide the automatic storage cost optimization of S3 Intelligent-Tiering for data with changing or unknown access patterns ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

### D. S3 File Gateway

S3 File Gateway can be deployed in AWS on EC2 and provides NFS/SMB access to S3 objects, but AWS states that it is **not designed to act as a full enterprise NAS replacement** and that using S3 as the durable backend adds overhead to each I/O operation, so comparing File Gateway performance to an existing NAS or file server is not equivalent ([S3 File Gateway throughput guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)). For hundreds of EC2 instances running a data-intensive application that requires high-performance shared storage for 72 hours, FSx for Lustre is the better fit. File Gateway might reduce storage cost, but it does not best satisfy the high-performance shared file system requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上运行一个数据密集型应用程序。该应用程序在由数百个 Amazon EC2 实例组成的集群上运行。一个共享文件系统也运行在多个 EC2 实例上，用于存储 200 TB 数据。该应用程序会读取并修改共享文件系统上的数据，并生成报告。该作业每月运行一次，从共享文件系统读取一部分文件，完成大约需要 72 小时。计算实例在 Auto Scaling 组中扩缩容，但托管共享文件系统的实例会持续运行。计算实例和存储实例都位于同一个 AWS Region。解决方案架构师需要通过替换共享文件系统实例来降低成本。该文件系统必须在 72 小时运行期间为所需数据提供高性能访问。哪种解决方案在满足这些要求的同时，将提供最大的总体成本降低？

options.A: 将数据从现有共享文件系统迁移到使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类的 Amazon S3 存储桶。每月作业运行之前，使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 通过 lazy loading 从 Amazon S3 中的数据创建一个新的文件系统。在作业持续期间，将新的文件系统用作共享存储。作业完成后删除该文件系统。
options.B: 将数据从现有共享文件系统迁移到启用了 Multi-Attach 的大型 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。使用 Auto Scaling 组启动模板中的用户数据脚本，将 EBS 卷附加到每个实例。在作业持续期间，将 EBS 卷用作共享存储。作业完成后分离 EBS 卷。
options.C: 将数据从现有共享文件系统迁移到使用 S3 Standard 存储类的 Amazon S3 存储桶。每月作业运行之前，使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 通过 batch loading 从 Amazon S3 中的数据创建一个新的文件系统。在作业持续期间，将新的文件系统用作共享存储。作业完成后删除该文件系统。
options.D: 将数据从现有共享文件系统迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。每月作业运行之前，使用 AWS Storage Gateway 基于 Amazon S3 中的数据创建一个文件网关。将该文件网关用作作业的共享存储。作业完成后删除该文件网关。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

该工作负载是一个每月运行一次、持续 72 小时的数据密集型/HPC 风格作业，只在计算资源群运行时才需要共享的高性能文件系统。现有基于 EC2 且始终运行的共享文件系统存储 200 TB 数据，但每月作业只读取其中一个子集。最大的成本降低来自将持久数据存储迁移到低成本 Amazon S3，并且只在作业窗口期间创建高性能文件系统。

选项 **A** 最符合这种模式：

* Amazon FSx for Lustre 专为存储速度很重要的工作负载而设计，包括 HPC 和其他快速数据处理工作负载。AWS 表示，FSx for Lustre 可提供亚毫秒级延迟、最高多个 TBps 的吞吐量以及最高数百万 IOPS（[FSx for Lustre 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。
* FSx for Lustre 与 Amazon S3 集成。当链接到 S3 存储桶时，它可以将 S3 对象呈现为文件，导入文件列表/元数据，并可使用数据存储库功能/任务将文件系统数据写回 S3（[FSx for Lustre 和 S3 数据存储库集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)，[数据存储库概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/overview-dra-data-repo.html)）。
* S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在为访问模式未知或变化的数据优化成本，可在不影响性能、无需运营开销的情况下自动将对象移动到成本更低的层，并且低延迟访问层不收取检索费用（[S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。这适用于一个 200 TB 的数据集，其中每月只访问一个子集。
* 仅在每月作业之前创建 FSx for Lustre 文件系统，并在之后删除它，可以避免在当月其余时间为高性能文件系统付费。

因此，**A** 提供了 S3 中的持久低成本存储，以及 72 小时处理窗口期间的临时高性能共享文件访问。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. EBS Multi-Attach

这不适用于数百个 EC2 实例。EBS Multi-Attach 卷最多可以附加到同一 Availability Zone 中的 **16 个基于 Nitro 的实例**，并且 Multi-Attach 仅支持 Provisioned IOPS SSD 卷。AWS 还警告，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并不是为多个服务器同时访问而设计的；需要集群文件系统才能实现弹性和可靠性（[EBS Multi-Attach 限制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。这不满足规模或共享文件系统要求，并且对于 200 TB 来说也不是最低成本的方法。

### C. FSx for Lustre with S3 Standard and batch loading

这使用了正确的高性能文件系统，但成本优化程度低于 A。作业每月只读取 200 TB 中的一个子集。将数据集批量/预加载到 FSx 会通过加载可能不会被使用的数据而增加时间和成本。对于访问模式变化或未知的数据，S3 Standard 也不提供 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 的自动存储成本优化（[S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

### D. S3 File Gateway

S3 File Gateway 可以部署在 AWS 上的 EC2 中，并提供对 S3 对象的 NFS/SMB 访问，但 AWS 表示它**并非设计为完整企业 NAS 替代品**，并且使用 S3 作为持久后端会为每个 I/O 操作增加开销，因此将 File Gateway 性能与现有 NAS 或文件服务器性能进行比较并不等价（[S3 File Gateway 吞吐量指导](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)）。对于运行数据密集型应用程序且需要 72 小时高性能共享存储的数百个 EC2 实例，FSx for Lustre 更适合。File Gateway 可能会降低存储成本，但它不能最好地满足高性能共享文件系统要求。

en.question: A company is developing a new service that will be accessed using TCP on a static port. A solutions architect must ensure that the service is highly available, has redundancy across Availability Zones, and is accessible using the DNS name my.service.com, which is publicly accessible. The service must use fixed address assignments so other companies can add the addresses to their allow lists. Assuming that resources are deployed in multiple Availability Zones in a single Region, which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon EC2 instances with an Elastic IP address for each instance. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and expose the static TCP port. Register EC2 instances with the NLB. Create a new name server record set named my.service.com, and assign the Elastic IP addresses of the EC2 instances to the record set. Provide the Elastic IP addresses of the EC2 instances to the other companies to add to their allow lists.
options.B: Create an Amazon ECS cluster and a service definition for the application. Create and assign public IP addresses for the ECS cluster. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and expose the TCP port. Create a target group and assign the ECS cluster name to the NLCreate a new A record set named my.service.com, and assign the public IP addresses of the ECS cluster to the record set. Provide the public IP addresses of the ECS cluster to the other companies to add to their allow lists.
options.C: Create Amazon EC2 instances for the service. Create one Elastic IP address for each Availability Zone. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and expose the assigned TCP port. Assign the Elastic IP addresses to the NLB for each Availability Zone. Create a target group and register the EC2 instances with the NLB. Create a new A (alias) record set named my.service.com, and assign the NLB DNS name to the record set.
options.D: Create an Amazon ECS cluster and a service definition for the application. Create and assign public IP address for each host in the cluster. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and expose the static TCP port. Create a target group and assign the ECS service definition name to the ALB. Create a new CNAME record set and associate the public IP addresses to the record set. Provide the Elastic IP addresses of the Amazon EC2 instances to the other companies to add to their allow lists.

en.explanation:
The service is a publicly accessible, static-port **TCP** service deployed across multiple Availability Zones, and partner companies must be able to allow-list **fixed IP addresses**. This points to an **internet-facing Network Load Balancer (NLB)** with static Elastic IP addresses assigned per Availability Zone, and a Route 53 alias record for the friendly DNS name.

**Correct answer: C**

Option C meets all requirements:

- An NLB is appropriate for TCP traffic. AWS documents that Network Load Balancer listeners support **TCP** and ports **1–65535** ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- An internet-facing NLB can be deployed across multiple Availability Zones. AWS states that selecting multiple AZs with registered targets in each selected zone increases application fault tolerance ([Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)).
- For fixed allow-listable addresses, AWS documents that with an internet-facing NLB, you can select an **Elastic IP address for each Availability Zone**, which provides the load balancer with **static IP addresses** ([Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)).
- Route 53 should point `my.service.com` to the load balancer by using an **A alias** record. AWS documents that to route domain traffic to an ELB load balancer, you create a Route 53 **alias record**, and for an NLB choose **Alias to Network Load Balancer** with record type **A – IPv4 address** ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)).

Therefore, EC2 instances behind an NLB, one Elastic IP per AZ assigned to the NLB, and a Route 53 A alias record to the NLB DNS name is the correct design.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **A**: This creates Elastic IPs for the individual EC2 instances and then creates an NLB, but the DNS record is associated with the EC2 instance IPs rather than the NLB. That bypasses the NLB and does not use the NLB’s health-based routing and multi-AZ load-balancing front end. It also says to create a **name server (NS) record** for `my.service.com`, which is not the correct record type for routing application traffic to IP addresses. Route 53 A records route to IPv4 addresses, while NS records identify name servers or delegate DNS authority ([Supported DNS record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)).
- **B**: Public IP addresses assigned to ECS cluster resources are not a suitable fixed-address front end for partner allow lists, and the option does not assign Elastic IPs to the NLB. It also incorrectly describes assigning an ECS cluster name to the NLB/target group. The fixed public entry point should be the NLB with static IPs per AZ, not public IPs on ECS hosts or tasks.
- **D**: An Application Load Balancer is not the correct load balancer for a generic static-port TCP service. ALB listeners support **HTTP and HTTPS**, not arbitrary TCP listeners ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)). The option also says to create a CNAME record and associate public IP addresses to it, but CNAME records map a DNS name to another DNS name, not to IP addresses ([Supported DNS record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一项新服务，该服务将使用 TCP 通过一个静态端口访问。解决方案架构师必须确保该服务具有高可用性、跨可用区冗余，并且可以通过公开可访问的 DNS 名称 my.service.com 访问。该服务必须使用固定地址分配，以便其他公司可以将这些地址添加到其允许列表中。假设资源部署在单个区域内的多个可用区中，哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该服务创建 Amazon EC2 实例。为每个实例分配一个 Elastic IP 地址。创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，并公开静态 TCP 端口。将 EC2 实例注册到 NLB。创建一个名为 my.service.com 的新名称服务器记录集，并将 EC2 实例的 Elastic IP 地址分配给该记录集。将 EC2 实例的 Elastic IP 地址提供给其他公司，以便添加到其允许列表中。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon ECS 集群以及该应用程序的服务定义。为 ECS 集群创建并分配公有 IP 地址。创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，并公开 TCP 端口。创建一个目标组，并将 ECS 集群名称分配给 NLB。创建一个名为 my.service.com 的新 A 记录集，并将 ECS 集群的公有 IP 地址分配给该记录集。将 ECS 集群的公有 IP 地址提供给其他公司，以便添加到其允许列表中。
options.C: 为该服务创建 Amazon EC2 实例。为每个可用区创建一个 Elastic IP 地址。创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，并公开分配的 TCP 端口。为每个可用区将 Elastic IP 地址分配给 NLB。创建一个目标组，并将 EC2 实例注册到 NLB。创建一个名为 my.service.com 的新 A（别名）记录集，并将 NLB DNS 名称分配给该记录集。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon ECS 集群以及该应用程序的服务定义。为集群中的每台主机创建并分配公有 IP 地址。创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并公开静态 TCP 端口。创建一个目标组，并将 ECS 服务定义名称分配给 ALB。创建一个新的 CNAME 记录集，并将公有 IP 地址关联到该记录集。将 Amazon EC2 实例的 Elastic IP 地址提供给其他公司，以便添加到其允许列表中。

zh.explanation:
该服务是一个部署在多个可用区中的、公开可访问的静态端口 **TCP** 服务，并且合作伙伴公司必须能够将**固定 IP 地址**加入允许列表。这指向使用一个面向互联网的 **Network Load Balancer (NLB)**，为每个可用区分配静态 Elastic IP 地址，并为友好的 DNS 名称创建 Route 53 别名记录。

**正确答案：C**

选项 C 满足所有要求：

- NLB 适用于 TCP 流量。AWS 文档说明 Network Load Balancer 侦听器支持 **TCP** 以及端口 **1–65535**（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- 面向互联网的 NLB 可以部署在多个可用区中。AWS 表示，在每个选定区域中选择多个 AZ 并注册目标可以提高应用程序容错能力（[Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)）。
- 对于可加入允许列表的固定地址，AWS 文档说明，对于面向互联网的 NLB，你可以为每个可用区选择一个 **Elastic IP 地址**，这会为负载均衡器提供**静态 IP 地址**（[Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)）。
- Route 53 应使用 **A alias** 记录将 `my.service.com` 指向该负载均衡器。AWS 文档说明，要将域流量路由到 ELB 负载均衡器，需要创建 Route 53 **alias record**；对于 NLB，应选择 **Alias to Network Load Balancer**，记录类型为 **A – IPv4 address**（[Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)）。

因此，在 NLB 后面运行 EC2 实例、为每个 AZ 分配一个 Elastic IP 到 NLB，并创建指向 NLB DNS 名称的 Route 53 A alias 记录，是正确的设计。

**其他选项为何不正确**

- **A**：该选项为各个 EC2 实例创建 Elastic IP，然后创建 NLB，但 DNS 记录关联的是 EC2 实例 IP，而不是 NLB。这会绕过 NLB，无法使用 NLB 基于健康状态的路由以及多 AZ 负载均衡前端。它还说为 `my.service.com` 创建一个**名称服务器 (NS) 记录**，这不是将应用程序流量路由到 IP 地址的正确记录类型。Route 53 A 记录路由到 IPv4 地址，而 NS 记录用于标识名称服务器或委派 DNS 权限（[Supported DNS record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)）。
- **B**：分配给 ECS 集群资源的公有 IP 地址并不适合作为合作伙伴允许列表的固定地址前端，并且该选项没有将 Elastic IP 分配给 NLB。它还错误地描述了将 ECS 集群名称分配给 NLB/目标组。固定的公共入口点应该是每个 AZ 具有静态 IP 的 NLB，而不是 ECS 主机或任务上的公有 IP。
- **D**：Application Load Balancer 不是通用静态端口 TCP 服务的正确负载均衡器。ALB 侦听器支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，而不是任意 TCP 侦听器（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。该选项还说创建 CNAME 记录并将公有 IP 地址关联到该记录，但 CNAME 记录是将一个 DNS 名称映射到另一个 DNS 名称，而不是映射到 IP 地址（[Supported DNS record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)）。

en.question: A company uses an on-premises data analytics platform. The system is highly available in a fully redundant configuration across 12 servers in the company’s data center. The system runs scheduled jobs, both hourly and daily, in addition to one-time requests from users. Scheduled jobs can take between 20 minutes and 2 hours to finish running and have tight SLAs. The scheduled jobs account for 65% of the system usage. User jobs typically finish running in less than 5 minutes and have no SLA. The user jobs account for 35% of system usage. During system failures, scheduled jobs must continue to meet SLAs. However, user jobs can be delayed. A solutions architect needs to move the system to Amazon EC2 instances and adopt a consumption-based model to reduce costs with no long-term commitments. The solution must maintain high availability and must not affect the SLAs. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Split the 12 instances across two Availability Zones in the chosen AWS Region. Run two instances in each Availability Zone as On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Run four instances in each Availability Zone as Spot Instances.
options.B: Split the 12 instances across three Availability Zones in the chosen AWS Region. In one of the Availability Zones, run all four instances as On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Run the remaining instances as Spot Instances.
options.C: Split the 12 instances across three Availability Zones in the chosen AWS Region. Run two instances in each Availability Zone as On-Demand Instances with a Savings Plan. Run two instances in each Availability Zone as Spot Instances.
options.D: Split the 12 instances across three Availability Zones in the chosen AWS Region. Run three instances in each Availability Zone as On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Run one instance in each Availability Zone as a Spot Instance.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company is moving a highly available 12-server analytics platform to EC2. The important split is:

- **Scheduled jobs:** 65% of usage, tight SLAs, must continue during failures.
- **User jobs:** 35% of usage, no SLA, can be delayed.
- The company wants a **consumption-based model** with **no long-term commitments**.

For the SLA-sensitive scheduled workload, the solution needs enough reliable EC2 capacity. AWS documentation states that **On-Demand Capacity Reservations** reserve EC2 capacity in a specific Availability Zone and are recommended for workloads with strict capacity requirements. For immediate Capacity Reservations, there is **no term commitment**, and they can be modified or cancelled at any time ([EC2 Capacity Reservations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-capacity-reservations.html)). For the non-SLA user workload, Spot Instances are appropriate because they use spare EC2 capacity at significant discounts, but they are interruptible and best suited for workloads that can be flexible or interrupted ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)).

## Correct answer: D

**D. Split the 12 instances across three Availability Zones. Run three instances in each Availability Zone as On-Demand Instances with Capacity Reservations. Run one instance in each Availability Zone as a Spot Instance.**

This provides:

- **9 On-Demand instances with Capacity Reservations** across three AZs, which covers about 75% of the 12-instance platform. This is enough guaranteed capacity for the scheduled jobs that account for 65% of system usage.
- **3 Spot Instances** for the flexible user jobs, which account for 35% of usage and can be delayed.
- **Three-AZ distribution**, improving availability and avoiding concentration of guaranteed capacity in a single AZ.
- **No long-term commitment**, because immediate On-Demand Capacity Reservations do not require a term commitment and can be cancelled, unlike Savings Plans.

This is the most cost-effective valid option because it uses guaranteed capacity only for the SLA-sensitive majority of the workload and uses lower-cost Spot capacity for the interruptible/non-SLA portion.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Two AZs, two On-Demand Capacity Reservations per AZ and four Spot Instances per AZ

This option provides only **4 guaranteed On-Demand instances** out of 12. That is about 33% of the platform capacity, which is not enough for scheduled jobs that account for 65% of usage and have tight SLAs. The remaining 8 instances are Spot Instances, which can be interrupted when EC2 needs the capacity back ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)). Relying on Spot for SLA-sensitive scheduled jobs would risk missed SLAs.

### B. Three AZs, all four On-Demand Capacity Reservations in one AZ and the rest Spot

Although this option uses three AZs, all guaranteed capacity is placed in **one Availability Zone**. If that AZ has a problem, the SLA-sensitive scheduled workload loses its reserved On-Demand capacity. The remaining capacity is Spot, which is interruptible and not suitable as the primary capacity layer for tight-SLA jobs. This design does not provide appropriate high availability for the scheduled workload.

### C. Three AZs, two On-Demand Instances with a Savings Plan per AZ and two Spot Instances per AZ

This option is invalid because the requirement explicitly says **no long-term commitments**. AWS documentation states that Savings Plans provide savings in exchange for a commitment to a specified amount of compute usage for a **one-year or three-year period** ([Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)). The EC2 pricing documentation also describes Savings Plans as requiring a 1- or 3-year usage commitment ([EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)).

Additionally, this option provides only **6 On-Demand instances** for SLA-sensitive work, which is only 50% of the original platform capacity and below the 65% scheduled-job usage requirement.

## Conclusion

Option **D** best satisfies all requirements: high availability across three AZs, enough guaranteed capacity for the scheduled SLA-bound workload, Spot capacity for flexible user jobs, and no long-term commitment.

zh.question: 一家公司使用本地数据分析平台。该系统在公司数据中心内的 12 台服务器上采用完全冗余配置，具有高可用性。除了用户的一次性请求外，系统还运行按计划执行的作业，包括每小时作业和每日作业。计划作业完成运行需要 20 分钟到 2 小时，并且有严格的 SLA。计划作业占系统使用量的 65%。用户作业通常在不到 5 分钟内完成运行，并且没有 SLA。用户作业占系统使用量的 35%。在系统故障期间，计划作业必须继续满足 SLA。但是，用户作业可以延迟。解决方案架构师需要将系统迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例，并采用基于消耗量的模型，以便在没有长期承诺的情况下降低成本。该解决方案必须保持高可用性，并且不得影响 SLA。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 12 个实例分布在所选 AWS 区域中的两个可用区。将每个可用区中的两个实例作为带有 Capacity Reservations 的 On-Demand Instances 运行。将每个可用区中的四个实例作为 Spot Instances 运行。
options.B: 将 12 个实例分布在所选 AWS 区域中的三个可用区。在其中一个可用区中，将全部四个实例作为带有 Capacity Reservations 的 On-Demand Instances 运行。将其余实例作为 Spot Instances 运行。
options.C: 将 12 个实例分布在所选 AWS 区域中的三个可用区。将每个可用区中的两个实例作为采用 Savings Plan 的 On-Demand Instances 运行。将每个可用区中的两个实例作为 Spot Instances 运行。
options.D: 将 12 个实例分布在所选 AWS 区域中的三个可用区。将每个可用区中的三个实例作为带有 Capacity Reservations 的 On-Demand Instances 运行。将每个可用区中的一个实例作为 Spot Instance 运行。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司正在将一个高可用的 12 台服务器分析平台迁移到 EC2。重要的负载划分是：

- **计划作业：** 占使用量 65%，SLA 严格，必须在故障期间继续运行。
- **用户作业：** 占使用量 35%，没有 SLA，可以延迟。
- 公司希望采用**基于消耗量的模型**，并且**没有长期承诺**。

对于对 SLA 敏感的计划工作负载，解决方案需要足够可靠的 EC2 容量。AWS 文档说明，**On-Demand Capacity Reservations** 会在特定可用区中预留 EC2 容量，并建议用于具有严格容量要求的工作负载。对于即时 Capacity Reservations，**没有期限承诺**，并且可以随时修改或取消（[EC2 Capacity Reservations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-capacity-reservations.html)）。对于没有 SLA 的用户工作负载，Spot Instances 是合适的，因为它们以显著折扣使用空闲 EC2 容量，但它们是可中断的，最适合能够灵活运行或被中断的工作负载（[Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)）。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 将 12 个实例分布在三个可用区。将每个可用区中的三个实例作为带有 Capacity Reservations 的 On-Demand Instances 运行。将每个可用区中的一个实例作为 Spot Instance 运行。**

这提供了：

- 跨三个 AZ 的 **9 个带有 Capacity Reservations 的 On-Demand instances**，覆盖 12 实例平台约 75% 的容量。这为占系统使用量 65% 的计划作业提供了足够的有保障容量。
- 用于灵活用户作业的 **3 个 Spot Instances**，这些作业占使用量 35%，并且可以延迟。
- **三 AZ 分布**，提高可用性并避免有保障容量集中在单个 AZ 中。
- **没有长期承诺**，因为即时 On-Demand Capacity Reservations 不需要期限承诺并且可以取消，这不同于 Savings Plans。

这是最具成本效益的有效选项，因为它只为对 SLA 敏感的大部分工作负载使用有保障的容量，并为可中断/无 SLA 的部分使用成本更低的 Spot 容量。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 两个 AZ，每个 AZ 两个 On-Demand Capacity Reservations 和四个 Spot Instances

此选项在 12 个实例中只提供 **4 个有保障的 On-Demand instances**。这约占平台容量的 33%，不足以支撑占使用量 65% 且有严格 SLA 的计划作业。其余 8 个实例是 Spot Instances，当 EC2 需要收回容量时它们可能会被中断（[Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)）。依赖 Spot 来运行对 SLA 敏感的计划作业会有错过 SLA 的风险。

### B. 三个 AZ，全部四个 On-Demand Capacity Reservations 位于一个 AZ，其余为 Spot

尽管此选项使用了三个 AZ，但所有有保障容量都放在**一个可用区**中。如果该 AZ 出现问题，对 SLA 敏感的计划工作负载就会失去其预留的 On-Demand 容量。其余容量是 Spot，它是可中断的，不适合作为严格 SLA 作业的主要容量层。此设计无法为计划工作负载提供适当的高可用性。

### C. 三个 AZ，每个 AZ 两个采用 Savings Plan 的 On-Demand Instances 和两个 Spot Instances

此选项无效，因为要求明确说明**没有长期承诺**。AWS 文档说明，Savings Plans 通过承诺在**一年或三年期限**内使用指定数量的计算资源来提供节省（[Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。EC2 定价文档也将 Savings Plans 描述为需要 1 年或 3 年使用承诺（[EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。

此外，此选项只为对 SLA 敏感的工作提供 **6 个 On-Demand instances**，仅占原始平台容量的 50%，低于 65% 的计划作业使用量要求。

## 结论

选项 **D** 最好地满足所有要求：跨三个 AZ 的高可用性、为受 SLA 约束的计划工作负载提供足够的有保障容量、为灵活的用户作业提供 Spot 容量，并且没有长期承诺。

en.question: A security engineer determined that an existing application retrieves credentials to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database from an encrypted file in Amazon S3. For the next version of the application, the security engineer wants to implement the following application design changes to improve security: The database must use strong, randomly generated passwords stored in a secure AWS managed service. The application resources must be deployed through AWS CloudFormation. The application must rotate credentials for the database every 90 days. A solutions architect will generate a CloudFormation template to deploy the application. Which resources specified in the CloudFormation template will meet the security engineer’s requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Generate the database password as a secret resource using AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function resource to rotate the database password. Specify a Secrets Manager RotationSchedule resource to rotate the database password every 90 days.
options.B: Generate the database password as a SecureString parameter type using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an AWS Lambda function resource to rotate the database password. Specify a Parameter Store RotationSchedule resource to rotate the database password every 90 days.
options.C: Generate the database password as a secret resource using AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function resource to rotate the database password. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule resource to trigger the Lambda function password rotation every 90 days.
options.D: Generate the database password as a SecureString parameter type using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Specify an AWS AppSync DataSource resource to automatically rotate the database password every 90 days.

en.explanation:
The application currently reads database credentials from an encrypted S3 file. The new design requires a strong randomly generated database password, storage in an AWS managed secrets service, CloudFormation-based deployment, and automatic rotation every 90 days with the least operational overhead.

**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Secrets Manager is the purpose-built AWS managed service for storing secrets such as database credentials. In CloudFormation, `AWS::SecretsManager::Secret` creates an encrypted secret, and its `GenerateSecretString` property specifies how to generate a password for the secret, including random password generation rather than embedding credentials in the template ([AWS::SecretsManager::Secret](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-secretsmanager-secret.html)).

For rotation, CloudFormation provides `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule`, which configures the rotation schedule and Lambda rotation function for a secret. The documentation explicitly states that this resource configures the rotation schedule and Lambda rotation function, supports `RotationLambdaARN`, and includes `RotationRules` for the rotation configuration. The examples show CloudFormation configuring a secret rotation schedule with a Lambda function and a rate expression ([AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-secretsmanager-rotationschedule.html)). A 90-day requirement can be implemented with the rotation rules, for example by using an appropriate schedule expression such as `rate(90 days)` or equivalent scheduling configuration. This directly satisfies the requirements while using native Secrets Manager rotation integration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect.** Systems Manager Parameter Store can store encrypted `SecureString` parameters, but the proposed `Parameter Store RotationSchedule` CloudFormation resource is not the native rotation mechanism described for Secrets Manager. Parameter Store documentation describes secure parameter storage and related features, but not an equivalent automatic password rotation schedule resource for database credentials. Secrets Manager has the CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` resource for this purpose.

- **C is incorrect.** Secrets Manager plus Lambda could rotate credentials, but using an EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke custom rotation logic adds operational overhead and bypasses the native Secrets Manager rotation schedule integration. The CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` resource already manages the rotation schedule for the secret and Lambda rotation function, so adding EventBridge is unnecessary.

- **D is incorrect.** Systems Manager Parameter Store does not provide the required native secret rotation schedule for database passwords, and `AWS::AppSync::DataSource` is unrelated to rotating RDS database credentials. AppSync data sources are for connecting AppSync resolvers to data sources, not for managing or rotating database passwords.

Therefore, **A** is the best answer because it uses Secrets Manager secret generation and Secrets Manager-managed rotation configuration through CloudFormation, minimizing custom scheduling and operational work.

zh.question: 一名安全工程师确定，某现有应用程序从 Amazon S3 中的加密文件检索用于 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库的凭证。对于应用程序的下一个版本，安全工程师希望实施以下应用程序设计变更以提高安全性：数据库必须使用强随机生成的密码，并将其存储在安全的 AWS 托管服务中。应用程序资源必须通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署。应用程序必须每 90 天轮换一次数据库凭证。解决方案架构师将生成一个 CloudFormation 模板来部署该应用程序。在 CloudFormation 模板中指定哪些资源可以在运营开销最少的情况下满足安全工程师的要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager 将数据库密码生成为一个 secret 资源。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数资源来轮换数据库密码。指定一个 Secrets Manager RotationSchedule 资源，每 90 天轮换一次数据库密码。
options.B: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 将数据库密码生成为 SecureString 参数类型。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数资源来轮换数据库密码。指定一个 Parameter Store RotationSchedule 资源，每 90 天轮换一次数据库密码。
options.C: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager 将数据库密码生成为一个 secret 资源。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数资源来轮换数据库密码。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则资源，每 90 天触发 Lambda 函数进行密码轮换。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 将数据库密码生成为 SecureString 参数类型。指定一个 AWS AppSync DataSource 资源，每 90 天自动轮换一次数据库密码。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序当前从加密的 S3 文件读取数据库凭证。新设计要求使用强随机生成的数据库密码，将其存储在 AWS 托管的密钥服务中，基于 CloudFormation 进行部署，并以最少的运营开销每 90 天自动轮换一次。

**正确答案：A。**

AWS Secrets Manager 是专为存储数据库凭证等 secret 而构建的 AWS 托管服务。在 CloudFormation 中，`AWS::SecretsManager::Secret` 会创建一个加密 secret，其 `GenerateSecretString` 属性指定如何为该 secret 生成密码，包括随机生成密码，而不是在模板中嵌入凭证（[AWS::SecretsManager::Secret](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-secretsmanager-secret.html)）。

对于轮换，CloudFormation 提供 `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule`，用于为 secret 配置轮换计划和 Lambda 轮换函数。文档明确说明，此资源会配置轮换计划和 Lambda 轮换函数，支持 `RotationLambdaARN`，并包含用于轮换配置的 `RotationRules`。示例展示了 CloudFormation 如何使用 Lambda 函数和 rate 表达式配置 secret 轮换计划（[AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-secretsmanager-rotationschedule.html)）。90 天的要求可以通过轮换规则实现，例如使用适当的计划表达式，如 `rate(90 days)` 或等效的计划配置。这直接满足要求，同时使用原生 Secrets Manager 轮换集成。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B 不正确。** Systems Manager Parameter Store 可以存储加密的 `SecureString` 参数，但所提议的 `Parameter Store RotationSchedule` CloudFormation 资源并不是 Secrets Manager 所描述的原生轮换机制。Parameter Store 文档描述了安全参数存储及相关功能，但没有用于数据库凭证的等效自动密码轮换计划资源。Secrets Manager 为此提供 CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` 资源。

- **C 不正确。** Secrets Manager 加 Lambda 可以轮换凭证，但使用 EventBridge 计划规则来调用自定义轮换逻辑会增加运营开销，并绕过原生 Secrets Manager 轮换计划集成。CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::RotationSchedule` 资源已经为 secret 和 Lambda 轮换函数管理轮换计划，因此添加 EventBridge 是不必要的。

- **D 不正确。** Systems Manager Parameter Store 不提供数据库密码所需的原生 secret 轮换计划，而 `AWS::AppSync::DataSource` 与轮换 RDS 数据库凭证无关。AppSync 数据源用于将 AppSync 解析器连接到数据源，而不是用于管理或轮换数据库密码。

因此，**A** 是最佳答案，因为它通过 CloudFormation 使用 Secrets Manager secret 生成和 Secrets Manager 管理的轮换配置，从而最大限度减少自定义计划和运营工作。

en.question: A company is storing data in several Amazon DynamoDB tables. A solutions architect must use a serverless architecture to make the data accessible publicly through a simple API over HTTPS. The solution must scale automatically in response to demand. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure this API with direct integrations to DynamoDB by using API Gateway’s AWS integration type.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with direct integrations to Dynamo DB by using API Gateway’s AWS integration type.
options.C: Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with integrations to AWS Lambda functions that return data from the DynamoDB tables.
options.D: Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure this accelerator with AWS Lambda@Edge function integrations that return data from the DynamoDB tables.
options.E: Create a Network Load Balancer. Configure listener rules to forward requests to the appropriate AWS Lambda functions.

en.explanation:
## Understanding the requirement

The company wants to expose data in DynamoDB tables through a **public HTTPS API**, using a **serverless architecture** that **scales automatically**. The two valid patterns are:

- API Gateway REST API directly integrated with DynamoDB by using an AWS service integration.
- API Gateway HTTP API integrated with Lambda functions, where Lambda accesses DynamoDB.

## Correct answers: A and C

### A. Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure this API with direct integrations to DynamoDB by using API Gateway’s AWS integration type.

This is correct. API Gateway REST APIs support AWS service integrations. The AWS documentation includes a REST API tutorial in which the integration request is configured with:

- integration type: **AWS service**
- AWS service: **DynamoDB**
- action: **PutItem**
- an execution role that allows API Gateway to interact with DynamoDB

This demonstrates that a REST API can directly call DynamoDB without Lambda, using IAM permissions and mapping templates. See the official tutorial for REST API integrations with AWS services and DynamoDB: [Tutorial: Modify the integration request and response for integrations to AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-data-transformations-in-api-gateway.html).

API Gateway REST APIs can also be public HTTPS endpoints; the API Gateway comparison table shows REST APIs support Regional and edge-optimized endpoint types, while private REST APIs are only one optional endpoint type. See [Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html).

### C. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with integrations to AWS Lambda functions that return data from the DynamoDB tables.

This is correct. API Gateway HTTP APIs support Lambda integrations, and AWS provides an official tutorial for creating a serverless CRUD HTTP API where API Gateway routes requests to Lambda, Lambda interacts with DynamoDB, and API Gateway returns the response to the caller. See [Tutorial: Create a CRUD HTTP API with Lambda and DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html).

This meets the requirements because API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB are managed/serverless services and scale automatically in response to demand.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with direct integrations to DynamoDB by using API Gateway’s AWS integration type.

This is incorrect. HTTP APIs do support some AWS service integrations, but only through supported **first-class integration subtypes**. The official subtype reference lists supported HTTP API AWS service actions such as EventBridge, SQS, AppConfig, Kinesis, and Step Functions. DynamoDB is not listed as a supported HTTP API first-class integration subtype. See [Integration subtype reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-develop-integrations-aws-services-reference.html).

Therefore, for HTTP APIs, the supported DynamoDB pattern in the official documentation is HTTP API → Lambda → DynamoDB, not a direct HTTP API → DynamoDB integration.

### D. Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure this accelerator with AWS Lambda@Edge function integrations that return data from the DynamoDB tables.

This is incorrect. AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator endpoints can be Network Load Balancers, Application Load Balancers, EC2 instances, or Elastic IP addresses. Lambda@Edge is not a Global Accelerator endpoint type. See [Endpoints for standard accelerators in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints.html).

Also, Lambda@Edge is associated with CloudFront, not Global Accelerator, and this option does not describe a simple API Gateway-style HTTPS API.

### E. Create a Network Load Balancer. Configure listener rules to forward requests to the appropriate AWS Lambda functions.

This is incorrect. The Lambda-as-a-load-balancer-target pattern is documented for **Application Load Balancers**, not Network Load Balancers. AWS documentation specifically describes using Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer: [Use Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html).

In addition, a Network Load Balancer is not the appropriate managed API service for exposing a simple public HTTPS API backed by Lambda and DynamoDB. API Gateway is the serverless API front end designed for this use case.

## Final answer

**A and C** are the solutions that meet the requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司将数据存储在多个 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。解决方案架构师必须使用无服务器架构，通过 HTTPS 上的简单 API 公开访问这些数据。该解决方案必须能够根据需求自动扩展。哪些解决方案满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API。使用 API Gateway 的 AWS 集成类型，将此 API 配置为与 DynamoDB 直接集成。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。使用 API Gateway 的 AWS 集成类型，将此 API 配置为与 Dynamo DB 直接集成。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。将此 API 配置为与 AWS Lambda 函数集成，这些函数从 DynamoDB 表返回数据。
options.D: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个加速器。将此加速器配置为与 AWS Lambda@Edge 函数集成，这些函数从 DynamoDB 表返回数据。
options.E: 创建一个 Network Load Balancer。配置侦听器规则，将请求转发到相应的 AWS Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 理解要求

该公司希望通过一个**公共 HTTPS API** 公开 DynamoDB 表中的数据，并使用**无服务器架构**，且该架构能够**自动扩展**。两种有效模式是：

- 使用 AWS 服务集成，将 API Gateway REST API 直接与 DynamoDB 集成。
- 将 API Gateway HTTP API 与 Lambda 函数集成，由 Lambda 访问 DynamoDB。

## 正确答案：A 和 C

### A. 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API。使用 API Gateway 的 AWS 集成类型，将此 API 配置为与 DynamoDB 直接集成。

这是正确的。API Gateway REST APIs 支持 AWS 服务集成。AWS 文档包含一个 REST API 教程，其中集成请求配置为：

- 集成类型：**AWS service**
- AWS 服务：**DynamoDB**
- 操作：**PutItem**
- 允许 API Gateway 与 DynamoDB 交互的执行角色

这表明 REST API 可以使用 IAM 权限和映射模板直接调用 DynamoDB，而无需 Lambda。请参阅有关 REST API 与 AWS 服务和 DynamoDB 集成的官方教程：[Tutorial: Modify the integration request and response for integrations to AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-data-transformations-in-api-gateway.html)。

API Gateway REST APIs 也可以是公共 HTTPS 端点；API Gateway 比较表显示 REST APIs 支持 Regional 和 edge-optimized 端点类型，而私有 REST APIs 只是一种可选端点类型。请参阅 [Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)。

### C. 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。将此 API 配置为与 AWS Lambda 函数集成，这些函数从 DynamoDB 表返回数据。

这是正确的。API Gateway HTTP APIs 支持 Lambda 集成，并且 AWS 提供了一个官方教程，用于创建无服务器 CRUD HTTP API，其中 API Gateway 将请求路由到 Lambda，Lambda 与 DynamoDB 交互，API Gateway 将响应返回给调用方。请参阅 [Tutorial: Create a CRUD HTTP API with Lambda and DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)。

这满足要求，因为 API Gateway、Lambda 和 DynamoDB 都是托管/无服务器服务，并且会根据需求自动扩展。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。使用 API Gateway 的 AWS 集成类型，将此 API 配置为与 DynamoDB 直接集成。

这是不正确的。HTTP APIs 确实支持一些 AWS 服务集成，但只能通过受支持的**一等集成子类型**实现。官方子类型参考列出了受支持的 HTTP API AWS 服务操作，例如 EventBridge、SQS、AppConfig、Kinesis 和 Step Functions。DynamoDB 未列为受支持的 HTTP API 一等集成子类型。请参阅 [Integration subtype reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-develop-integrations-aws-services-reference.html)。

因此，对于 HTTP APIs，官方文档中受支持的 DynamoDB 模式是 HTTP API → Lambda → DynamoDB，而不是直接的 HTTP API → DynamoDB 集成。

### D. 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个加速器。将此加速器配置为与 AWS Lambda@Edge 函数集成，这些函数从 DynamoDB 表返回数据。

这是不正确的。AWS Global Accelerator 标准加速器端点可以是 Network Load Balancers、Application Load Balancers、EC2 实例或 Elastic IP 地址。Lambda@Edge 不是 Global Accelerator 端点类型。请参阅 [Endpoints for standard accelerators in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints.html)。

此外，Lambda@Edge 与 CloudFront 关联，而不是与 Global Accelerator 关联，并且此选项没有描述 API Gateway 风格的简单 HTTPS API。

### E. 创建一个 Network Load Balancer。配置侦听器规则，将请求转发到相应的 AWS Lambda 函数。

这是不正确的。Lambda 作为负载均衡器目标的模式记录在 **Application Load Balancers** 中，而不是 Network Load Balancers。AWS 文档专门描述了使用 Lambda 函数作为 Application Load Balancer 目标：[Use Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)。

此外，Network Load Balancer 不是用于公开由 Lambda 和 DynamoDB 支持的简单公共 HTTPS API 的合适托管 API 服务。API Gateway 是为此用例设计的无服务器 API 前端。

## 最终答案

**A 和 C** 是满足这些要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company has registered 10 new domain names. The company uses the domains for online marketing. The company needs a solution that will redirect online visitors to a specific URL for each domain. All domains and target URLs are defined in a JSON document. All DNS records are managed by Amazon Route 53. A solutions architect must implement a redirect service that accepts HTTP and HTTPS requests. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational effort? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a dynamic webpage that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure the webpage to use the JSON document in combination with the event message to look up and respond with a redirect URL.
options.B: Create an Application Load Balancer that includes HTTP and HTTPS listeners.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the JSON document in combination with the event message to look up and respond with a redirect URL.
options.D: Use an Amazon API Gateway API with a custom domain to publish an AWS Lambda function.
options.E: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy a Lambda@Edge function.
options.F: Create an SSL certificate by using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Include the domains as Subject Alternative Names.

en.explanation:
The company needs a low-operations redirect service for 10 Route 53-managed marketing domains. The service must accept both HTTP and HTTPS requests and choose the correct redirect target by using a JSON mapping of domains to destination URLs.

The correct choices are **C, E, and F**.

**C. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the JSON document in combination with the event message to look up and respond with a redirect URL.**  
The redirect decision needs application logic. A Lambda function can inspect the request information, such as the `Host` header, use the JSON document to find the target URL for that domain, and return an HTTP redirect response. AWS provides a Lambda@Edge example that generates an HTTP redirect by returning a `302` status code with a `Location` header, and notes that Lambda@Edge can generate HTTP responses for viewer request and origin request events ([CloudFront Lambda@Edge generated response examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-examples.html)).

**E. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy a Lambda@Edge function.**  
CloudFront provides a managed public entry point for the marketing domains over HTTP and HTTPS, and Lambda@Edge lets the redirect logic run at CloudFront edge locations. This avoids managing web servers, EC2 instances, or a regional application stack for a simple redirect service. Route 53 can route the domains to the CloudFront distribution by using alias records; Route 53 documentation states that when using a Route 53 domain name with a CloudFront distribution, you create an alias record that points to the distribution ([Route 53: routing traffic to a CloudFront distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)).

**F. Create an SSL certificate by using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Include the domains as Subject Alternative Names.**  
HTTPS for custom CloudFront domain names requires a trusted TLS certificate that covers the alternate domain names. CloudFront checks the certificate Subject Alternative Name (SAN), and the alternate domain name must be covered by the SAN. CloudFront also allows only one certificate to be attached to a distribution at a time, so a single ACM certificate that includes the required domains as SANs is appropriate ([CloudFront alternate domain name requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/CNAMEs.html)). For CloudFront, AWS recommends using ACM to provision and manage certificates, and the ACM certificate must be requested in the US East (N. Virginia) Region ([CloudFront: get an SSL/TLS certificate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-procedures.html)).

The other options are incorrect:

**A. Create a dynamic webpage that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance.**  
This could perform redirects, but it requires operating EC2 instances, patching, scaling, monitoring, and designing for high availability. That is more operational effort than a managed CloudFront and Lambda@Edge design.

**B. Create an Application Load Balancer that includes HTTP and HTTPS listeners.**  
An Application Load Balancer can accept HTTP and HTTPS, but it is only an entry point. It would still require backend redirect logic and introduces regional load balancer and networking configuration. For this use case, CloudFront with Lambda@Edge is the lower-operational-effort managed edge solution.

**D. Use an Amazon API Gateway API with a custom domain to publish an AWS Lambda function.**  
API Gateway with Lambda can publish serverless APIs, but this requirement is not to expose an API; it is to redirect visitors for multiple marketing domains over HTTP and HTTPS. CloudFront is the better fit as the public web entry point for custom domains, with Lambda@Edge generating the redirect response directly.

zh.question: 一家公司注册了 10 个新域名。该公司将这些域名用于在线营销。公司需要一种解决方案，将在线访问者重定向到每个域名对应的特定 URL。所有域名和目标 URL 都在一个 JSON 文档中定义。所有 DNS 记录都由 Amazon Route 53 管理。解决方案架构师必须实施一个接受 HTTP 和 HTTPS 请求的重定向服务。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤组合，才能以最少的运营工作量满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的动态网页。配置该网页结合使用 JSON 文档和事件消息来查找并响应重定向 URL。
options.B: 创建一个包含 HTTP 和 HTTPS 侦听器的 Application Load Balancer。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数结合使用 JSON 文档和事件消息来查找并响应重定向 URL。
options.D: 使用带有自定义域名的 Amazon API Gateway API 来发布 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.E: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。部署一个 Lambda@Edge 函数。
options.F: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建 SSL 证书。将这些域名作为 Subject Alternative Names 包含在内。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一个低运营工作量的重定向服务，用于 10 个由 Route 53 管理的营销域名。该服务必须接受 HTTP 和 HTTPS 请求，并使用域名到目标 URL 的 JSON 映射来选择正确的重定向目标。

正确选项是 **C、E 和 F**。

**C. 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数结合使用 JSON 文档和事件消息来查找并响应重定向 URL。**  
重定向决策需要应用程序逻辑。Lambda 函数可以检查请求信息，例如 `Host` 标头，使用 JSON 文档查找该域名的目标 URL，并返回 HTTP 重定向响应。AWS 提供了一个 Lambda@Edge 示例，通过返回带有 `Location` 标头的 `302` 状态码来生成 HTTP 重定向，并指出 Lambda@Edge 可以为查看器请求和源站请求事件生成 HTTP 响应（[CloudFront Lambda@Edge 生成响应示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-examples.html)）。

**E. 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。部署一个 Lambda@Edge 函数。**  
CloudFront 为营销域名提供通过 HTTP 和 HTTPS 访问的托管公共入口点，而 Lambda@Edge 允许重定向逻辑在 CloudFront 边缘站点运行。这样可以避免为了一个简单的重定向服务而管理 Web 服务器、EC2 实例或区域应用程序堆栈。Route 53 可以使用别名记录将域名路由到 CloudFront 分配；Route 53 文档指出，当将 Route 53 域名与 CloudFront 分配一起使用时，需要创建一条指向该分配的别名记录（[Route 53：将流量路由到 CloudFront 分配](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)）。

**F. 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建 SSL 证书。将这些域名作为 Subject Alternative Names 包含在内。**  
自定义 CloudFront 域名的 HTTPS 需要一个受信任的 TLS 证书，该证书覆盖备用域名。CloudFront 会检查证书 Subject Alternative Name (SAN)，并且备用域名必须由 SAN 覆盖。CloudFront 还一次只允许将一个证书附加到一个分配，因此使用一个包含所需域名作为 SAN 的 ACM 证书是合适的（[CloudFront 备用域名要求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/CNAMEs.html)）。对于 CloudFront，AWS 建议使用 ACM 预置和管理证书，并且 ACM 证书必须在美国东部（弗吉尼亚北部）区域请求（[CloudFront：获取 SSL/TLS 证书](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-procedures.html)）。

其他选项不正确：

**A. 创建一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的动态网页。**  
这可以执行重定向，但需要运行 EC2 实例、修补、扩展、监控并设计高可用性。相比托管的 CloudFront 和 Lambda@Edge 设计，这需要更多运营工作量。

**B. 创建一个包含 HTTP 和 HTTPS 侦听器的 Application Load Balancer。**  
Application Load Balancer 可以接受 HTTP 和 HTTPS，但它只是一个入口点。它仍然需要后端重定向逻辑，并引入区域负载均衡器和网络配置。对于此用例，CloudFront 与 Lambda@Edge 是运营工作量更低的托管边缘解决方案。

**D. 使用带有自定义域名的 Amazon API Gateway API 来发布 AWS Lambda 函数。**  
API Gateway 与 Lambda 可以发布无服务器 API，但此要求不是公开 API；而是通过 HTTP 和 HTTPS 为多个营销域名重定向访问者。CloudFront 更适合作为自定义域名的公共 Web 入口点，并由 Lambda@Edge 直接生成重定向响应。

en.question: A company that has multiple AWS accounts is using AWS Organizations. The company’s AWS accounts host VPCs, Amazon EC2 instances, and containers. The company’s compliance team has deployed a security tool in each VPC where the company has deployments. The security tools run on EC2 instances and send information to the AWS account that is dedicated for the compliance team. The company has tagged all the compliance-related resources with a key of “costCenter” and a value or “compliance”.
