The company wants to identify the cost of the security tools that are running on the EC2 instances so that the company can charge the compliance team’s AWS account. The cost calculation must be as accurate as possible. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: In the management account of the organization, activate the costCenter user-defined tag. Configure monthly AWS Cost and Usage Reports to save to an Amazon S3 bucket in the management account. Use the tag breakdown in the report to obtain the total cost for the costCenter tagged resources.
options.B: In the member accounts of the organization, activate the costCenter user-defined tag. Configure monthly AWS Cost and Usage Reports to save to an Amazon S3 bucket in the management account. Schedule a monthly AWS Lambda function to retrieve the reports and calculate the total cost for the costCenter tagged resources.
options.C: In the member accounts of the organization activate the costCenter user-defined tag. From the management account, schedule a monthly AWS Cost and Usage Report. Use the tag breakdown in the report to calculate the total cost for the costCenter tagged resources.
options.D: Create a custom report in the organization view in AWS Trusted Advisor. Configure the report to generate a monthly billing summary for the costCenter tagged resources in the compliance team’s AWS account.

en.explanation:
The company needs an organization-wide, accurate chargeback view for EC2-based security tools that are already tagged `costCenter=compliance` across multiple AWS accounts. The right solution is to activate that user-defined cost allocation tag from the AWS Organizations management account and use billing/CUR data delivered to S3 to break down costs by that tag.

**Correct answer: A**

AWS documentation states that for user-defined cost allocation tags, **only an AWS Organizations management account** (or a standalone account) has access to the cost allocation tags manager in the Billing and Cost Management console. After user-defined tags are created and applied, they must be activated for cost allocation tracking; then they appear in cost allocation reports and can be used to track AWS costs ([Using user-defined cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/custom-tags.html)).

For monthly cost allocation reporting, AWS documentation says that selected tag keys become additional report columns, and that if you own the management account in an organization, the cost allocation report includes all usage, costs, and tags for member accounts. It also says AWS stores billing reports in an Amazon S3 bucket that you create and own ([Using the monthly cost allocation report](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/configurecostallocreport.html)). AWS CUR documentation also confirms that Cost and Usage Reports are delivered to a specified S3 bucket and contain detailed cost and usage columns, and that resource tag keys appear in CUR tag columns only if they have been enabled as cost allocation tags in the Billing console ([What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html), [Resource tags columns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/table-dictionary-cur2-resource-tags.html)).

Therefore, activating `costCenter` in the **management account**, configuring monthly reports to an S3 bucket, and using the tag breakdown/report columns to total `costCenter=compliance` resource costs is the most accurate option provided.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B.** Incorrect because it says to activate the user-defined tag in the **member accounts**. In an AWS Organizations setup, the cost allocation tags manager is available to the management account, not member accounts, for organization-wide tag activation.
* **C.** Incorrect for the same reason: it activates the tag in member accounts. The report from the management account can include member account usage and tags, but the cost allocation tag activation should be managed from the management account.
* **D.** Incorrect because AWS Trusted Advisor custom reports are not the appropriate mechanism for detailed resource-level billing chargeback by user-defined cost allocation tags. Trusted Advisor is not a replacement for CUR/cost allocation reports for accurate tagged resource cost calculation, and this option also narrows the report to the compliance team’s account even though the tagged EC2 security tools run across multiple accounts/VPCs.

zh.question: 一家拥有多个 AWS 账户的公司正在使用 AWS Organizations。该公司的 AWS 账户托管 VPC、Amazon EC2 实例和容器。公司的合规团队已在公司部署所在的每个 VPC 中部署了一个安全工具。这些安全工具运行在 EC2 实例上，并将信息发送到专用于合规团队的 AWS 账户。公司已为所有与合规相关的资源添加了标签，键为“costCenter”，值为“compliance”。公司希望识别在 EC2 实例上运行的安全工具的成本，以便向合规团队的 AWS 账户进行计费。成本计算必须尽可能准确。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 在组织的管理账户中，激活 costCenter 用户定义标签。配置每月 AWS Cost and Usage Reports，将其保存到管理账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用报告中的标签明细来获取带有 costCenter 标签的资源的总成本。
options.B: 在组织的成员账户中，激活 costCenter 用户定义标签。配置每月 AWS Cost and Usage Reports，将其保存到管理账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。安排每月运行一次 AWS Lambda 函数来检索报告，并计算带有 costCenter 标签的资源的总成本。
options.C: 在组织的成员账户中激活 costCenter 用户定义标签。从管理账户计划每月生成 AWS Cost and Usage Report。使用报告中的标签明细来计算带有 costCenter 标签的资源的总成本。
options.D: 在 AWS Trusted Advisor 的组织视图中创建自定义报告。配置该报告，为合规团队 AWS 账户中带有 costCenter 标签的资源生成每月账单摘要。

zh.explanation:
公司需要一个覆盖整个组织且准确的内部计费视图，用于统计基于 EC2 的安全工具成本；这些工具已在多个 AWS 账户中标记为 `costCenter=compliance`。正确的解决方案是从 AWS Organizations 管理账户激活该用户定义的成本分配标签，并使用交付到 S3 的账单/CUR 数据，按该标签拆分成本。

**正确答案：A**

AWS 文档说明，对于用户定义的成本分配标签，**只有 AWS Organizations 管理账户**（或独立账户）可以访问 Billing and Cost Management 控制台中的成本分配标签管理器。在创建并应用用户定义标签后，必须激活它们以进行成本分配跟踪；然后它们才会出现在成本分配报告中，并可用于跟踪 AWS 成本（[使用用户定义的成本分配标签](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/custom-tags.html)）。

对于每月成本分配报告，AWS 文档指出，所选标签键会成为额外的报告列；如果你拥有组织中的管理账户，成本分配报告会包含成员账户的所有用量、成本和标签。文档还说明，AWS 会将账单报告存储在你创建并拥有的 Amazon S3 存储桶中（[使用每月成本分配报告](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/configurecostallocreport.html)）。AWS CUR 文档还确认，Cost and Usage Reports 会交付到指定的 S3 存储桶，并包含详细的成本和使用情况列；资源标签键只有在 Billing 控制台中启用为成本分配标签后，才会出现在 CUR 标签列中（[什么是 AWS Cost and Usage Reports？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)、[资源标签列](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/table-dictionary-cur2-resource-tags.html)）。

因此，在**管理账户**中激活 `costCenter`、配置每月报告到 S3 存储桶，并使用标签明细/报告列汇总 `costCenter=compliance` 资源成本，是所给选项中最准确的方案。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

* **B.** 不正确，因为它要求在**成员账户**中激活用户定义标签。在 AWS Organizations 设置中，用于组织范围标签激活的成本分配标签管理器可由管理账户使用，而不是成员账户。
* **C.** 不正确，原因相同：它在成员账户中激活标签。来自管理账户的报告可以包含成员账户的用量和标签，但成本分配标签激活应由管理账户管理。
* **D.** 不正确，因为 AWS Trusted Advisor 自定义报告不是按用户定义成本分配标签进行详细资源级账单分摊的合适机制。Trusted Advisor 不能替代 CUR/成本分配报告来准确计算已标记资源的成本，而且该选项还将报告范围限制在合规团队的账户中，尽管带标签的 EC2 安全工具运行在多个账户/VPC 中。

en.question: A company has 50 AWS accounts that are members of an organization in AWS Organizations. Each account contains multiple VPCs. The company wants to use AWS Transit Gateway to establish connectivity between the VPCs in each member account. Each time a new member account is created, the company wants to automate the process of creating a new VPC and a transit gateway attachment. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: From the management account, share the transit gateway with member accounts by using AWS Resource Access Manager.
options.B: From the management account, share the transit gateway with member accounts by using an AWS Organizations SCP.
options.C: Launch an AWS CloudFormation stack set from the management account that automatically creates a new VPC and a VPC transit gateway attachment in a member account. Associate the attachment with the transit gateway in the management account by using the transit gateway ID.
options.D: Launch an AWS CloudFormation stack set from the management account that automatically creates a new VPC and a peering transit gateway attachment in a member account. Share the attachment with the transit gateway in the management account by using a transit gateway service-linked role.
options.E: From the management account, share the transit gateway with member accounts by using AWS Service Catalog.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company has many AWS accounts in AWS Organizations and wants centralized AWS Transit Gateway connectivity for VPCs in member accounts. It also wants the creation of a new VPC and its transit gateway attachment to be automated whenever new member accounts are added.

## Correct answers: A and C

### A. Share the transit gateway with member accounts by using AWS Resource Access Manager

This is correct. AWS Transit Gateway supports cross-account operation by sharing the transit gateway with other AWS accounts through AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM). The Amazon VPC Transit Gateway documentation states that a transit gateway works across AWS accounts and that you can use AWS RAM to share the transit gateway with other accounts; after sharing, the other account owner can attach VPCs to the shared transit gateway ([Transit gateways in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)).

AWS RAM also supports sharing resources across AWS Organizations. When using Organizations, AWS RAM can share with all accounts in the organization or with OUs without enumerating each account, and principals in the organization can gain access without invitations after sharing with Organizations is enabled ([Sharing your AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html)).

### C. Use a CloudFormation StackSet to create the VPC and VPC transit gateway attachment in member accounts

This is correct. CloudFormation StackSets with service-managed permissions can deploy stacks to accounts managed by AWS Organizations, and the management account can initiate those StackSet operations. StackSets can target the organization or OUs, and automatic deployment can be enabled for accounts added in the future ([Create CloudFormation StackSets with service-managed permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)).

The CloudFormation resource `AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment` creates a VPC attachment and requires `TransitGatewayId`, `VpcId`, and `SubnetIds`, which matches the requirement to create a VPC transit gateway attachment in the member account and associate it with the shared transit gateway by ID ([AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ec2-transitgatewayvpcattachment.html)).

## Incorrect options

### B. Share the transit gateway by using an AWS Organizations SCP

This is incorrect. Service control policies define permission guardrails for accounts in an organization; they do not share AWS resources. Transit Gateway sharing is done with AWS RAM, not SCPs.

### D. Create a peering transit gateway attachment and use a service-linked role

This is incorrect. A transit gateway peering attachment is used to connect two transit gateways, commonly across Regions or accounts, not to attach a VPC to a transit gateway. The requirement is to attach newly created VPCs in member accounts to the central transit gateway. The CloudFormation VPC attachment resource is the appropriate attachment type.

### E. Share the transit gateway by using AWS Service Catalog

This is incorrect. AWS Service Catalog can distribute approved products and portfolios, but it is not the native resource-sharing mechanism for Transit Gateway. The documented mechanism for sharing a transit gateway across accounts is AWS RAM.

## Conclusion

Use AWS RAM to share the central transit gateway with the organization/member accounts, and use CloudFormation StackSets with automatic deployment to create the VPC and `AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment` in new member accounts. Therefore, the correct combination is **A and C**.

zh.question: 一家公司有 50 个 AWS 账户，这些账户都是 AWS Organizations 中某个组织的成员。每个账户包含多个 VPC。该公司希望使用 AWS Transit Gateway 在每个成员账户中的 VPC 之间建立连接。每次创建新的成员账户时，该公司都希望自动化创建新 VPC 和中转网关挂载的过程。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 从管理账户中，使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 与成员账户共享 transit gateway。
options.B: 从管理账户中，使用 AWS Organizations SCP 与成员账户共享 transit gateway。
options.C: 从管理账户启动一个 AWS CloudFormation stack set，在成员账户中自动创建新的 VPC 和 VPC transit gateway attachment。使用 transit gateway ID 将该挂载与管理账户中的 transit gateway 关联。
options.D: 从管理账户启动一个 AWS CloudFormation stack set，在成员账户中自动创建新的 VPC 和 peering transit gateway attachment。使用 transit gateway service-linked role 将该挂载与管理账户中的 transit gateway 共享。
options.E: 从管理账户中，使用 AWS Service Catalog 与成员账户共享 transit gateway。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司在 AWS Organizations 中有许多 AWS 账户，并希望为成员账户中的 VPC 提供集中式 AWS Transit Gateway 连接。它还希望每当添加新的成员账户时，都能自动创建新的 VPC 及其 transit gateway attachment。

## 正确答案：A 和 C

### A. 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 与成员账户共享 transit gateway

这是正确的。AWS Transit Gateway 支持通过 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 与其他 AWS 账户共享 transit gateway，从而实现跨账户操作。Amazon VPC Transit Gateway 文档说明，transit gateway 可跨 AWS 账户工作，并且你可以使用 AWS RAM 与其他账户共享 transit gateway；共享后，其他账户所有者可以将 VPC 挂载到共享的 transit gateway（[AWS Transit Gateway 中的 Transit gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)）。

AWS RAM 还支持跨 AWS Organizations 共享资源。使用 Organizations 时，AWS RAM 可以与组织中的所有账户或 OU 共享，而无需逐一列举每个账户；在启用与 Organizations 共享后，组织中的主体无需邀请即可获得访问权限（[共享你的 AWS 资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html)）。

### C. 使用 CloudFormation StackSet 在成员账户中创建 VPC 和 VPC transit gateway attachment

这是正确的。具有服务托管权限的 CloudFormation StackSets 可以将堆栈部署到由 AWS Organizations 管理的账户，并且管理账户可以发起这些 StackSet 操作。StackSets 可以以组织或 OU 为目标，并且可以为将来添加的账户启用自动部署（[使用服务托管权限创建 CloudFormation StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)）。

CloudFormation 资源 `AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment` 会创建 VPC attachment，并且需要 `TransitGatewayId`、`VpcId` 和 `SubnetIds`，这与在成员账户中创建 VPC transit gateway attachment 并通过 ID 将其与共享的 transit gateway 关联的要求相匹配（[AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ec2-transitgatewayvpcattachment.html)）。

## 错误选项

### B. 使用 AWS Organizations SCP 共享 transit gateway

这是错误的。服务控制策略用于为组织中的账户定义权限护栏；它们不用于共享 AWS 资源。Transit Gateway 共享是通过 AWS RAM 完成的，而不是通过 SCP。

### D. 创建 peering transit gateway attachment 并使用 service-linked role

这是错误的。transit gateway peering attachment 用于连接两个 transit gateway，通常跨区域或跨账户使用，而不是将 VPC 挂载到 transit gateway。需求是将成员账户中新创建的 VPC 挂载到中央 transit gateway。CloudFormation VPC attachment 资源才是合适的挂载类型。

### E. 使用 AWS Service Catalog 共享 transit gateway

这是错误的。AWS Service Catalog 可以分发经批准的产品和产品组合，但它不是 Transit Gateway 的原生资源共享机制。文档中用于跨账户共享 transit gateway 的机制是 AWS RAM。

## 结论

使用 AWS RAM 将中央 transit gateway 与组织/成员账户共享，并使用启用自动部署的 CloudFormation StackSets 在新的成员账户中创建 VPC 和 `AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment`。因此，正确的组合是 **A 和 C**。

en.question: An enterprise company wants to allow its developers to purchase third-party software through AWS Marketplace. The company uses an AWS Organizations account structure with full features enabled, and has a shared services account in each organizational unit (OU) that will be used by procurement managers. The procurement team’s policy indicates that developers should be able to obtain third-party software from an approved list only and use Private Marketplace in AWS Marketplace to achieve this requirement. The procurement team wants administration of Private Marketplace to be restricted to a role named procurement-manager-role, which could be assumed by procurement managers. Other IAM users, groups, roles, and account administrators in the company should be denied Private Marketplace administrative access. What is the MOST efficient way to design an architecture to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM role named procurement-manager-role in all AWS accounts in the organization. Add the PowerUserAccess managed policy to the role. Apply an inline policy to all IAM users and roles in every AWS account to deny permissions on the AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess managed policy.
options.B: Create an IAM role named procurement-manager-role in all AWS accounts in the organization. Add the AdministratorAccess managed policy to the role. Define a permissions boundary with the AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess managed policy and attach it to all the developer roles.
options.C: Create an IAM role named procurement-manager-role in all the shared services accounts in the organization. Add the AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess managed policy to the role. Create an organization root-level SCP to deny permissions to administer Private Marketplace to everyone except the role named procurement- manager-role. Create another organization root-level SCP to deny permissions to create an IAM role named procurement-manager-role to everyone in the organization.
options.D: Create an IAM role named procurement-manager-role in all AWS accounts that will be used by developers. Add the AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess managed policy to the role. Create an SCP in Organizations to deny permissions to administer Private Marketplace to everyone except the role named procurement-manager- role. Apply the SCP to all the shared services accounts in the organization.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company wants developers to use AWS Marketplace, but only through an approved catalog controlled by Private Marketplace. The key requirement is not to give developers broad Marketplace administration. Instead, Private Marketplace administration must be limited to a specifically named IAM role, `procurement-manager-role`, in the shared services accounts used by procurement managers, and all other IAM principals and account administrators in member accounts must be prevented from administering Private Marketplace.

AWS documentation states that Private Marketplace administrative actions require the IAM permissions in the `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess` managed policy, and that Private Marketplace administration is restricted to the organization management account or a member account registered as a delegated administrator ([Private Marketplace for administrators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/buyerguide/for-administrators.html)). The managed policy itself is described as providing “full access to all administrative actions for an AWS Private Marketplace” ([AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess.html)).

AWS Organizations SCPs are appropriate as an organization-wide guardrail because SCPs define the maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts, and an explicit deny in an SCP prevents use of the permission even if an account administrator attaches `AdministratorAccess` to a principal ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

## Correct answer: C

Option C is the most efficient design:

- Create `procurement-manager-role` only in the shared services accounts where procurement managers operate.
- Attach `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess` to that role so it has the required Private Marketplace administrative permissions.
- Use an organization root-level SCP to deny Private Marketplace administrative permissions to everyone except the allowed role name. Applying the guardrail at the root efficiently covers all member accounts below the root.
- Add a second root-level SCP that denies creation of another IAM role named `procurement-manager-role`. This prevents account administrators or other users from bypassing the exception by creating a same-named role in an unauthorized account.

This aligns with the requirement to centralize procurement administration in shared services accounts while preventing other users, roles, groups, and account administrators in member accounts from obtaining Private Marketplace administrative access.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

`PowerUserAccess` is not the correct permission model for Private Marketplace administration. The documented administrative policy is `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess`, not generic power-user access. Also, applying inline deny policies to all users and roles in every account is operationally inefficient and fragile. It does not reliably protect against account administrators creating new principals or modifying policies later.

### B. Incorrect

This option attaches `AdministratorAccess` to the procurement role and uses a permissions boundary on developer roles. A permissions boundary limits only the principals to which it is attached; it does not create an organization-wide guardrail for all IAM users, groups, roles, and account administrators. It also does not prevent other administrators from creating or modifying roles with Private Marketplace administrative permissions.

### D. Incorrect

This option creates the procurement role in developer accounts rather than in the shared services accounts used by procurement managers. That expands the administrative footprint unnecessarily. More importantly, it applies the SCP only to the shared services accounts, which would not deny Private Marketplace administrative access throughout all developer/member accounts. The requirement is organization-wide restriction, so the guardrail must be applied broadly, such as at the organization root.

## Note

In an actual implementation, the shared services accounts that perform Private Marketplace administration would also need to be valid Private Marketplace delegated administrator accounts where applicable. AWS documents that management accounts can delegate Private Marketplace administrative permissions to designated member accounts, and delegated administrator accounts can perform tasks such as creating experiences, associating audiences, and adding or removing products ([AWS Marketplace Private Marketplace and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-private-marketplace.html)).

zh.question: 一家企业公司希望允许其开发人员通过 AWS Marketplace 购买第三方软件。该公司使用已启用所有功能的 AWS Organizations 账户结构，并且在每个组织单位（OU）中都有一个共享服务账户，供采购经理使用。采购团队的策略指出，开发人员只能从已批准的列表中获取第三方软件，并使用 AWS Marketplace 中的 Private Marketplace 来实现此要求。采购团队希望将 Private Marketplace 的管理权限限制给名为 procurement-manager-role 的角色，该角色可由采购经理代入。公司中的其他 IAM 用户、组、角色和账户管理员都应被拒绝 Private Marketplace 管理访问权限。设计满足这些要求的架构时，最高效的方法是什么？

options.A: 在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中创建名为 procurement-manager-role 的 IAM 角色。向该角色添加 PowerUserAccess 托管策略。对每个 AWS 账户中的所有 IAM 用户和角色应用内联策略，以拒绝 AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess 托管策略上的权限。
options.B: 在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中创建名为 procurement-manager-role 的 IAM 角色。向该角色添加 AdministratorAccess 托管策略。使用 AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess 托管策略定义权限边界，并将其附加到所有开发人员角色。
options.C: 在组织中的所有共享服务账户中创建名为 procurement-manager-role 的 IAM 角色。向该角色添加 AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess 托管策略。创建一个组织根级别的 SCP，以拒绝除名为 procurement- manager-role 的角色之外的所有人管理 Private Marketplace 的权限。再创建另一个组织根级别的 SCP，以拒绝组织中所有人创建名为 procurement-manager-role 的 IAM 角色的权限。
options.D: 在将由开发人员使用的所有 AWS 账户中创建名为 procurement-manager-role 的 IAM 角色。向该角色添加 AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess 托管策略。创建一个 Organizations 中的 SCP，以拒绝除名为 procurement-manager- role 的角色之外的所有人管理 Private Marketplace 的权限。将该 SCP 应用于组织中的所有共享服务账户。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司希望开发人员使用 AWS Marketplace，但只能通过由 Private Marketplace 控制的已批准目录使用。关键要求不是授予开发人员广泛的 Marketplace 管理权限。相反，Private Marketplace 管理必须仅限于共享服务账户中一个特定命名的 IAM 角色 `procurement-manager-role`，这些共享服务账户由采购经理使用，并且必须阻止成员账户中的所有其他 IAM 主体和账户管理员管理 Private Marketplace。

AWS 文档说明，Private Marketplace 管理操作需要 `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess` 托管策略中的 IAM 权限，并且 Private Marketplace 管理仅限于组织管理账户或注册为委派管理员的成员账户（[Private Marketplace for administrators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/buyerguide/for-administrators.html)）。该托管策略本身被描述为提供“对 AWS Private Marketplace 的所有管理操作的完全访问权限”（[AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess.html)）。

AWS Organizations SCP 适合作为组织范围内的 guardrail，因为 SCP 定义成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可用权限的最大范围，并且 SCP 中的显式拒绝会阻止权限使用，即使账户管理员将 `AdministratorAccess` 附加到某个主体也是如此（[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

## 正确答案：C

选项 C 是最高效的设计：

- 仅在采购经理操作所在的共享服务账户中创建 `procurement-manager-role`。
- 将 `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess` 附加到该角色，使其拥有所需的 Private Marketplace 管理权限。
- 使用组织根级别 SCP 拒绝除允许的角色名称之外的所有人拥有 Private Marketplace 管理权限。在根级别应用 guardrail 可高效覆盖根以下的所有成员账户。
- 添加第二个根级别 SCP，拒绝创建另一个名为 `procurement-manager-role` 的 IAM 角色。这可防止账户管理员或其他用户通过在未经授权的账户中创建同名角色来绕过例外。

这符合在共享服务账户中集中采购管理，同时阻止成员账户中的其他用户、角色、组和账户管理员获得 Private Marketplace 管理访问权限的要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 不正确

`PowerUserAccess` 不是 Private Marketplace 管理的正确权限模型。文档化的管理策略是 `AWSPrivateMarketplaceAdminFullAccess`，而不是通用的 power-user 访问权限。此外，将内联拒绝策略应用到每个账户中的所有用户和角色，运维上效率低且脆弱。它无法可靠防止账户管理员之后创建新主体或修改策略。

### B. 不正确

此选项将 `AdministratorAccess` 附加到采购角色，并在开发人员角色上使用权限边界。权限边界仅限制其所附加到的主体；它不会为所有 IAM 用户、组、角色和账户管理员创建组织范围的 guardrail。它也不能阻止其他管理员创建或修改具有 Private Marketplace 管理权限的角色。

### D. 不正确

此选项在开发人员账户中而不是采购经理使用的共享服务账户中创建采购角色。这会不必要地扩大管理范围。更重要的是，它仅将 SCP 应用于共享服务账户，这不会在所有开发人员/成员账户范围内拒绝 Private Marketplace 管理访问权限。要求是组织范围的限制，因此 guardrail 必须广泛应用，例如应用在组织根级别。

## 注意

在实际实施中，执行 Private Marketplace 管理的共享服务账户在适用情况下还需要是有效的 Private Marketplace 委派管理员账户。AWS 文档说明，管理账户可以将 Private Marketplace 管理权限委派给指定的成员账户，而委派管理员账户可以执行创建体验、关联受众以及添加或移除产品等任务（[AWS Marketplace Private Marketplace and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-private-marketplace.html)）。

options.A: Create an explicit deny statement for each AWS service that should be constrained.
options.B: Remove the FullAWSAccess SCP from the developers account’s OU.
options.C: Modify the FullAWSAccess SCP to explicitly deny all services.
options.D: Add an explicit deny statement using a wildcard to the end of the SCP.

en.explanation:
The company wants the developers OU to function as an allow list: developers should be able to use only Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, and Amazon DynamoDB, and no other AWS services.

**Correct answer: B. Remove the FullAWSAccess SCP from the developers account’s OU.**

AWS Organizations service control policies (SCPs) define the maximum available permissions for accounts in an organization. AWS Organizations attaches the AWS managed SCP **FullAWSAccess** to every root, OU, and account by default, and that policy allows all services and actions. The AWS documentation explains that you can replace **FullAWSAccess** with an SCP that allows only a specific set of services, so services that are not explicitly allowed are not available. It also shows that allow-list SCPs can be used at the OU level to restrict accounts in that OU to only the permitted services ([AWS Organizations SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)).

In this scenario, the custom SCP allows only:

- `ec2:*`
- `s3:*`
- `dynamodb:*`

However, if **FullAWSAccess** remains attached to the developers OU, it continues to allow all AWS services at that level. To make the custom allow-list SCP effective for the developers OU, the solutions architect should remove, effectively replace, **FullAWSAccess** from that OU so that only the explicitly allowed services remain within the developers’ maximum permissions.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create an explicit deny statement for each AWS service that should be constrained.**  
  This is not the best approach. A deny list would require the company to identify and maintain deny statements for every AWS service that developers should not use, including future services. The documented allow-list strategy is to replace **FullAWSAccess** with an SCP that allows only the required services.

- **C. Modify the FullAWSAccess SCP to explicitly deny all services.**  
  **FullAWSAccess** is an AWS managed SCP, and the goal is not to modify it. Also, an explicit deny for all services would override allows and would block EC2, S3, and DynamoDB as well.

- **D. Add an explicit deny statement using a wildcard to the end of the SCP.**  
  A wildcard explicit deny such as denying `*` would deny all actions, including the allowed EC2, S3, and DynamoDB actions. SCP policy evaluation is not based on statement order; an explicit deny takes precedence wherever it appears in the policy.

Therefore, the required action is to remove the default **FullAWSAccess** SCP from the developers OU so that the custom allow-list SCP restricts developers to EC2, S3, and DynamoDB only.

options.A: 为每个应受限制的 AWS 服务创建显式拒绝语句。
options.B: 从开发人员账户所在 OU 中移除 FullAWSAccess SCP。
options.C: 修改 FullAWSAccess SCP，以显式拒绝所有服务。
options.D: 在 SCP 末尾添加使用通配符的显式拒绝语句。

zh.explanation:
该公司希望开发人员 OU 作为允许列表运行：开发人员应该只能使用 Amazon EC2、Amazon S3 和 Amazon DynamoDB，不能使用任何其他 AWS 服务。

**正确答案：B. 从开发人员账户所在 OU 中移除 FullAWSAccess SCP。**

AWS Organizations 服务控制策略 (SCPs) 定义了组织中账户可用权限的最大范围。AWS Organizations 默认会将 AWS 托管 SCP **FullAWSAccess** 附加到每个根、OU 和账户，并且该策略允许所有服务和操作。AWS 文档说明，可以用仅允许特定服务集的 SCP 替换 **FullAWSAccess**，这样未被显式允许的服务将不可用。文档还展示了允许列表 SCP 可在 OU 级别使用，以将该 OU 中的账户限制为只能使用被允许的服务（[AWS Organizations SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)）。

在此场景中，自定义 SCP 仅允许：

- `ec2:*`
- `s3:*`
- `dynamodb:*`

但是，如果 **FullAWSAccess** 仍附加到开发人员 OU，它会继续在该级别允许所有 AWS 服务。为了使自定义允许列表 SCP 对开发人员 OU 生效，解决方案架构师应从该 OU 中移除（实际上是替换）**FullAWSAccess**，以便只有显式允许的服务仍保留在开发人员的最大权限范围内。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 为每个应受限制的 AWS 服务创建显式拒绝语句。**  
  这不是最佳方法。拒绝列表要求公司为开发人员不应使用的每个 AWS 服务（包括未来服务）识别并维护拒绝语句。文档记录的允许列表策略是用仅允许所需服务的 SCP 替换 **FullAWSAccess**。

- **C. 修改 FullAWSAccess SCP，以显式拒绝所有服务。**  
  **FullAWSAccess** 是 AWS 托管 SCP，目标也不是修改它。此外，对所有服务的显式拒绝会覆盖允许，并且也会阻止 EC2、S3 和 DynamoDB。

- **D. 在 SCP 末尾添加使用通配符的显式拒绝语句。**  
  使用通配符的显式拒绝（例如拒绝 `*`）会拒绝所有操作，包括已允许的 EC2、S3 和 DynamoDB 操作。SCP 策略评估不基于语句顺序；显式拒绝无论出现在策略中的哪个位置都会优先。

因此，所需操作是从开发人员 OU 中移除默认的 **FullAWSAccess** SCP，以便自定义允许列表 SCP 将开发人员限制为只能使用 EC2、S3 和 DynamoDB。

en.question: A company is hosting a monolithic REST-based API for a mobile app on five Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets of a VPC. Mobile clients connect to the API by using a domain name that is hosted on Amazon Route 53. The company has created a Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy with the IP addresses of all the EC2 instances. Recently, the app has been overwhelmed by large and sudden increases to traffic. The app has not been able to keep up with the traffic. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution so that the app can handle the new and varying load. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Separate the API into individual AWS Lambda functions. Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API with Lambda integration for the backend. Update the Route 53 record to point to the API Gateway API.
options.B: Containerize the API logic. Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Run the containers in the cluster by using Amazon EC2. Create a Kubernetes ingress. Update the Route 53 record to point to the Kubernetes ingress.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group. Place all the EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to perform scaling actions that are based on CPU utilization. Create an AWS Lambda function that reacts to Auto Scaling group changes and updates the Route 53 record.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the API. Move the EC2 instances to private subnets in the VPC. Add the EC2 instances as targets for the ALB. Update the Route 53 record to point to the ALB.

en.explanation:
The company is exposing a monolithic REST API directly from five public EC2 instances by using Route 53 multivalue answer routing. The application now receives sudden, variable traffic spikes and needs a solution that can handle the load with the least ongoing operational overhead.

The correct answer is **A. Separate the API into individual AWS Lambda functions, configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API with Lambda integration for the backend, and update the Route 53 record to point to the API Gateway API.**

AWS Lambda is designed to run code without managing servers. AWS states that Lambda runs code on high-availability infrastructure and manages server and operating system maintenance, capacity provisioning, automatic scaling, and logging; the customer is responsible only for the code ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). This directly addresses the need to handle variable traffic while minimizing operational work. Amazon API Gateway is also a suitable managed front end for REST APIs backed by Lambda. API Gateway supports Lambda proxy and non-proxy integrations, and with Lambda proxy integration API Gateway configures much of the integration request and response handling for the Lambda backend ([API Gateway Lambda integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)). The existing domain can be repointed to the API Gateway API by using API Gateway custom domain/DNS configuration ([API Gateway custom domain names](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-custom-domains.html)).

Refactoring the monolithic API into Lambda functions requires development effort, but the question asks for the solution with the **least operational overhead**. After implementation, API Gateway and Lambda remove the need to operate and scale an EC2 fleet for the API.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Containerize the API and run it on Amazon EKS with EC2 worker nodes** is not the least operational overhead. This approach introduces Kubernetes cluster administration, EC2 worker node management, container deployment operations, ingress management, scaling configuration, and patching responsibilities. It can support scalable workloads, but it adds significantly more ongoing operational complexity than a serverless API Gateway and Lambda architecture.

- **C. Create an Auto Scaling group and use a Lambda function to update Route 53 records** is operationally fragile and unnecessary. Although an Auto Scaling group can add EC2 capacity, dynamically updating DNS records as instances scale in and out is not an ideal request-routing mechanism. Route 53 multivalue answer routing returns multiple values such as IP addresses and can check resource health, but AWS explicitly states that it is **not a substitute for a load balancer** ([Route 53 multivalue answer routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)). DNS caching and custom automation would add operational overhead and make scaling behavior less reliable.

- **D. Create an Application Load Balancer in front of the API and move the EC2 instances to private subnets** is an architectural improvement, but it does not fully meet the requirement. Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across multiple targets, monitors target health, and scales load balancer capacity automatically ([What is Elastic Load Balancing?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)). However, this option still uses the same EC2-based backend and does not add Auto Scaling or otherwise increase compute capacity. It improves traffic distribution and security posture, but it does not provide the lowest operational overhead and does not by itself solve the need to handle sudden increases in backend load.

Therefore, **option A** best meets the requirement because API Gateway with Lambda provides a managed, serverless REST API architecture that automatically scales for variable traffic while minimizing ongoing infrastructure operations.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 的公有子网中的五个 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个用于移动应用的单体式 REST API。移动客户端通过托管在 Amazon Route 53 上的域名连接到该 API。该公司创建了一个 Route 53 多值应答路由策略，其中包含所有 EC2 实例的 IP 地址。最近，该应用受到大量且突发增长的流量冲击。该应用无法跟上流量增长。解决方案架构师需要实施一种解决方案，使该应用能够处理新的且不断变化的负载。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 API 拆分为单独的 AWS Lambda 函数。配置一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API，并为后端设置 Lambda 集成。更新 Route 53 记录，使其指向 API Gateway API。
options.B: 将 API 逻辑容器化。创建一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。使用 Amazon EC2 在该集群中运行容器。创建一个 Kubernetes ingress。更新 Route 53 记录，使其指向 Kubernetes ingress。
options.C: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组。将所有 EC2 实例放入该 Auto Scaling 组中。配置 Auto Scaling 组，使其根据 CPU 利用率执行扩展操作。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于响应 Auto Scaling 组的变化并更新 Route 53 记录。
options.D: 在 API 前面创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 EC2 实例移动到 VPC 中的私有子网。将 EC2 实例添加为 ALB 的目标。更新 Route 53 记录，使其指向 ALB。

zh.explanation:
该公司使用 Route 53 多值应答路由，直接从五个公有 EC2 实例暴露一个单体式 REST API。该应用现在收到突发且可变的流量峰值，需要一种能够以最少持续运营开销处理负载的解决方案。

正确答案是 **A. 将 API 拆分为单独的 AWS Lambda 函数，为后端配置一个带 Lambda 集成的 Amazon API Gateway REST API，并更新 Route 53 记录，使其指向 API Gateway API。**

AWS Lambda 旨在让用户无需管理服务器即可运行代码。AWS 说明，Lambda 在高可用性基础设施上运行代码，并管理服务器和操作系统维护、容量预置、自动扩展和日志记录；客户只需负责代码（[什么是 AWS Lambda？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。这直接满足了处理可变流量并尽量减少运营工作的需求。Amazon API Gateway 也是适合由 Lambda 支持的 REST API 的托管前端。API Gateway 支持 Lambda 代理和非代理集成，并且通过 Lambda 代理集成，API Gateway 会为 Lambda 后端配置大量集成请求和响应处理（[API Gateway Lambda 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)）。可以使用 API Gateway 自定义域名/DNS 配置，将现有域名重新指向 API Gateway API（[API Gateway 自定义域名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-custom-domains.html)）。

将单体式 API 重构为 Lambda 函数需要开发工作，但问题问的是具有 **最少运营开销** 的解决方案。实施后，API Gateway 和 Lambda 消除了为该 API 运营和扩展 EC2 实例组的需要。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 将 API 容器化，并使用 EC2 工作节点在 Amazon EKS 上运行** 不是运营开销最少的方案。这种方法引入了 Kubernetes 集群管理、EC2 工作节点管理、容器部署操作、ingress 管理、扩展配置和补丁责任。它可以支持可扩展工作负载，但与 serverless 的 API Gateway 和 Lambda 架构相比，会显著增加持续运营复杂性。

- **C. 创建 Auto Scaling 组，并使用 Lambda 函数更新 Route 53 记录** 在运营上很脆弱且没有必要。虽然 Auto Scaling 组可以增加 EC2 容量，但随着实例扩缩而动态更新 DNS 记录并不是理想的请求路由机制。Route 53 多值应答路由会返回多个值（例如 IP 地址）并可以检查资源运行状况，但 AWS 明确指出它 **不能替代负载均衡器**（[Route 53 多值应答路由](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)）。DNS 缓存和自定义自动化会增加运营开销，并降低扩展行为的可靠性。

- **D. 在 API 前面创建 Application Load Balancer，并将 EC2 实例移动到私有子网** 是一种架构改进，但并不能完全满足要求。Elastic Load Balancing 会在多个目标之间分配传入流量、监控目标运行状况，并自动扩展负载均衡器容量（[什么是 Elastic Load Balancing？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。但是，此选项仍使用相同的基于 EC2 的后端，并没有添加 Auto Scaling 或以其他方式增加计算容量。它改善了流量分配和安全态势，但并不提供最低运营开销，也不能单独解决处理后端负载突增的需求。

因此，**选项 A** 最符合要求，因为 API Gateway 与 Lambda 提供了托管的、serverless 的 REST API 架构，可以针对可变流量自动扩展，同时最大限度地减少持续的基础设施运营。

en.question: A company has created an OU in AWS Organizations for each of its engineering teams. Each OU owns multiple AWS accounts. The organization has hundreds of AWS accounts. A solutions architect must design a solution so that each OU can view a breakdown of usage costs across its AWS accounts. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) for each OU by using AWS Resource Access Manager. Allow each team to visualize the CUR through an Amazon QuickSight dashboard.
options.B: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) from the AWS Organizations management account. Allow each team to visualize the CUR through an Amazon QuickSight dashboard.
options.C: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) in each AWS Organizations member account. Allow each team to visualize the CUR through an Amazon QuickSight dashboard.
options.D: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) by using AWS Systems Manager. Allow each team to visualize the CUR through Systems Manager OpsCenter dashboards.

en.explanation:
The company uses AWS Organizations with many accounts grouped into OUs. The requirement is to provide each OU/team with visibility into cost and usage across the AWS accounts that belong to that OU. The most appropriate design is to centralize the Cost and Usage Report (CUR) at the Organizations management account and then expose filtered/segmented views in Amazon QuickSight.

**Correct answer: B. Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) from the AWS Organizations management account. Allow each team to visualize the CUR through an Amazon QuickSight dashboard.**

AWS consolidated billing is designed for this centralized view: the Organizations management account pays the charges for member accounts and can track charges across multiple accounts and download combined cost and usage data. The Billing documentation also states that if you have access to the management account, you can see a combined view of AWS charges incurred by member accounts and get cost reports for each member account ([Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)). A centrally created CUR contains detailed cost and usage data and can be delivered to S3; AWS CUR is the most comprehensive cost and usage dataset and can be configured for analytics integrations ([What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)). Amazon QuickSight is also an AWS-supported way to visualize billing and cost management data through a cost and usage dashboard powered by QuickSight ([Creating a cost and usage dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-create-dashboard.html)).

With this pattern, the organization creates a single authoritative CUR in the management/payer account and builds QuickSight dashboards that filter or group costs by linked account and by an account-to-OU/team mapping. This satisfies the requirement for each OU to view the breakdown of usage costs across its AWS accounts without creating hundreds of separate reports.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create a CUR for each OU by using AWS Resource Access Manager.**  
  AWS Resource Access Manager is not the service used to create Cost and Usage Reports. CURs are billing/data export artifacts delivered to S3, not resources created or partitioned per OU through RAM. Also, CUR is not created “for an OU” through RAM.

- **C. Create a CUR in each AWS Organizations member account.**  
  A member account can create a CUR only for that member account’s own cost and usage data, not for an OU-wide set of accounts. The CUR documentation explicitly states that a member account report includes only that member account’s cost and usage data ([Using Cost and Usage Reports for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-consolidated-billing.html)). This would require many separate reports and would not directly provide each OU with a consolidated breakdown across all of its accounts.

- **D. Create a CUR by using AWS Systems Manager and visualize through OpsCenter dashboards.**  
  AWS Systems Manager/OpsCenter is for operational issue management, not creating AWS billing Cost and Usage Reports or providing cost analytics dashboards. CUR creation and billing dashboards belong to AWS Billing/Data Exports and QuickSight, not Systems Manager.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中为每个工程团队创建了一个 OU。每个 OU 拥有多个 AWS 账户。该组织有数百个 AWS 账户。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，使每个 OU 都可以查看其 AWS 账户的使用成本明细。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 为每个 OU 创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)。允许每个团队通过 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板可视化 CUR。
options.B: 从 AWS Organizations 管理账户创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)。允许每个团队通过 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板可视化 CUR。
options.C: 在每个 AWS Organizations 成员账户中创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)。允许每个团队通过 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板可视化 CUR。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)。允许每个团队通过 Systems Manager OpsCenter 控制面板可视化 CUR。

zh.explanation:
该公司使用 AWS Organizations，并将许多账户分组到 OU 中。要求是为每个 OU/团队提供其所属 AWS 账户的成本和使用情况可见性。最合适的设计是在 Organizations 管理账户中集中创建 Cost and Usage Report (CUR)，然后在 Amazon QuickSight 中公开经过筛选/分段的视图。

**正确答案：B. 从 AWS Organizations 管理账户创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR)。允许每个团队通过 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板可视化 CUR。**

AWS 合并账单专为这种集中式视图而设计：Organizations 管理账户为成员账户支付费用，并且可以跟踪多个账户的费用以及下载合并的成本和使用情况数据。Billing 文档还说明，如果你有权访问管理账户，则可以查看成员账户产生的 AWS 费用的合并视图，并获取每个成员账户的成本报告（[Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)）。集中创建的 CUR 包含详细的成本和使用情况数据，并可交付到 S3；AWS CUR 是最全面的成本和使用情况数据集，并且可以配置用于分析集成（[What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)）。Amazon QuickSight 也是 AWS 支持的一种方式，可通过由 QuickSight 提供支持的成本和使用情况控制面板来可视化账单和成本管理数据（[Creating a cost and usage dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-create-dashboard.html)）。

采用这种模式，组织会在管理/付款方账户中创建一个单一权威的 CUR，并构建 QuickSight 控制面板，按关联账户以及账户到 OU/团队的映射对成本进行筛选或分组。这满足了每个 OU 查看其 AWS 账户使用成本明细的要求，而无需创建数百个单独报告。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 为每个 OU 创建 CUR。**  
  AWS Resource Access Manager 不是用于创建 Cost and Usage Reports 的服务。CUR 是交付到 S3 的账单/数据导出工件，不是通过 RAM 按 OU 创建或分区的资源。此外，CUR 也不是通过 RAM “为 OU” 创建的。

- **C. 在每个 AWS Organizations 成员账户中创建 CUR。**  
  成员账户只能为该成员账户自身的成本和使用情况数据创建 CUR，而不能为 OU 范围内的一组账户创建 CUR。CUR 文档明确说明，成员账户报告仅包含该成员账户的成本和使用情况数据（[Using Cost and Usage Reports for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-consolidated-billing.html)）。这将需要许多单独的报告，并且无法直接为每个 OU 提供其所有账户的合并明细。

- **D. 使用 AWS Systems Manager 创建 CUR，并通过 OpsCenter 控制面板可视化。**  
  AWS Systems Manager/OpsCenter 用于运营问题管理，而不是创建 AWS 账单 Cost and Usage Reports 或提供成本分析控制面板。CUR 创建和账单控制面板属于 AWS Billing/Data Exports 和 QuickSight，而不是 Systems Manager。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company is storing data on premises on a Windows file server. The company produces 5 GB of new data daily. The company migrated part of its Windows-based workload to AWS and needs the data to be available on a file system in the cloud. The company already has established an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on- premises network and AWS. Which data migration strategy should the company use?

options.A: Use the file gateway option in AWS Storage Gateway to replace the existing Windows file server, and point the existing file share to the new file gateway.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to schedule a daily task to replicate data between the on-premises Windows file server and Amazon FSx.
options.C: Use AWS Data Pipeline to schedule a daily task to replicate data between the on-premises Windows file server and Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to schedule a daily task to replicate data between the on-premises Windows file server and Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).

en.explanation:
The company has an on-premises **Windows file server**, generates only **5 GB of new data per day**, already has network connectivity to AWS through **Direct Connect**, and needs the data available on a **cloud file system** for migrated Windows-based workloads. The best fit is a scheduled file-level migration/replication from the on-premises SMB/Windows file share to **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**.

**Correct answer: B. Use AWS DataSync to schedule a daily task to replicate data between the on-premises Windows file server and Amazon FSx.**

AWS DataSync is designed for this kind of migration and replication. AWS documents DataSync use cases including migrating active datasets into AWS storage and replicating data to Amazon EFS or **Amazon FSx** for a standby file system ([DataSync use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)). DataSync can transfer files between on-premises storage systems and AWS storage services, including **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** ([on-premises transfers with DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)). For FSx for Windows File Server specifically, DataSync connects by using the **SMB protocol**, which matches a Windows file server workload ([DataSync transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)). DataSync also supports scheduled tasks; the documentation states that you can configure a task schedule to periodically transfer data between storage locations, using cron or rate expressions ([DataSync task scheduling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Storage Gateway File Gateway** — A generic File Gateway, specifically Amazon S3 File Gateway, presents NFS/SMB file shares backed by **Amazon S3 objects**, not by a Windows-compatible cloud file system such as FSx for Windows File Server. AWS describes S3 File Gateway as providing a file interface into Amazon S3 and allowing files to be stored and retrieved as S3 objects through NFS or SMB ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). The question asks for a **data migration strategy** to make Windows file server data available on a file system in the cloud, and option A also does not specify Amazon FSx File Gateway or Amazon FSx as the target cloud file system.

- **C. AWS Data Pipeline to Amazon EFS** — AWS Data Pipeline is not the right migration service for Windows file server replication to a managed file system. It is now in maintenance mode and unavailable to new customers, and the documentation describes it as a workflow service for data movement/transformation rather than the managed file migration service DataSync is for file transfers ([AWS Data Pipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datapipeline/latest/DeveloperGuide/what-is-datapipeline.html)). Also, Amazon EFS uses NFS rather than SMB and is not the best match for Windows-based workloads.

- **D. AWS DataSync to Amazon EFS** — DataSync can transfer to EFS, but EFS is an NFS file system. AWS describes mounting EFS through NFSv4.0/NFSv4.1 and recommends current-generation Linux NFS clients ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). For migrated **Windows-based** workloads and data from a Windows file server, **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** is the more appropriate target because it supports SMB and Windows file semantics.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer: schedule AWS DataSync to replicate the on-premises Windows file server data to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server over the existing Direct Connect connectivity.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地的 Windows 文件服务器上存储数据。该公司每天产生 5 GB 新数据。该公司已将部分基于 Windows 的工作负载迁移到 AWS，并且需要这些数据可在云中的文件系统上使用。该公司已经在本地网络与 AWS 之间建立了 AWS Direct Connect 连接。该公司应使用哪种数据迁移策略？

options.A: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway 中的 file gateway 选项替换现有 Windows 文件服务器，并将现有文件共享指向新的 file gateway。
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 计划每日任务，在本地 Windows 文件服务器和 Amazon FSx 之间复制数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Data Pipeline 计划每日任务，在本地 Windows 文件服务器和 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 之间复制数据。
options.D: 使用 AWS DataSync 计划每日任务，在本地 Windows 文件服务器和 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 之间复制数据。

zh.explanation:
该公司有一个本地 **Windows 文件服务器**，每天仅产生 **5 GB 新数据**，已经通过 **Direct Connect** 与 AWS 建立网络连接，并且需要这些数据可在**云文件系统**上供已迁移的基于 Windows 的工作负载使用。最合适的方案是从本地 SMB/Windows 文件共享到 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 进行计划的文件级迁移/复制。

**正确答案：B。使用 AWS DataSync 计划每日任务，在本地 Windows 文件服务器和 Amazon FSx 之间复制数据。**

AWS DataSync 专为此类迁移和复制而设计。AWS 文档列出了 DataSync 的使用案例，包括将活动数据集迁移到 AWS 存储，以及将数据复制到 Amazon EFS 或 **Amazon FSx** 作为备用文件系统（[DataSync 使用案例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。DataSync 可以在本地存储系统和 AWS 存储服务之间传输文件，包括 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**（[使用 DataSync 进行本地传输](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)）。对于 FSx for Windows File Server，DataSync 具体使用 **SMB protocol** 进行连接，这与 Windows 文件服务器工作负载相匹配（[DataSync transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)）。DataSync 还支持计划任务；文档说明你可以配置任务计划，使用 cron 或 rate 表达式在存储位置之间定期传输数据（[DataSync 任务计划](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)）。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Storage Gateway File Gateway** — 通用的 File Gateway，特别是 Amazon S3 File Gateway，提供由 **Amazon S3 对象**支持的 NFS/SMB 文件共享，而不是由 Windows 兼容的云文件系统（例如 FSx for Windows File Server）支持。AWS 将 S3 File Gateway 描述为提供进入 Amazon S3 的文件接口，并允许通过 NFS 或 SMB 将文件作为 S3 对象存储和检索（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。题目要求的是一种**数据迁移策略**，使 Windows 文件服务器数据可在云中的文件系统上使用，而选项 A 也没有指定 Amazon FSx File Gateway 或 Amazon FSx 作为目标云文件系统。

- **C. AWS Data Pipeline 到 Amazon EFS** — AWS Data Pipeline 不是将 Windows 文件服务器复制到托管文件系统的合适迁移服务。它现在处于维护模式，并且不对新客户开放；文档将其描述为用于数据移动/转换的工作流服务，而不是像 DataSync 那样用于文件传输的托管文件迁移服务（[AWS Data Pipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datapipeline/latest/DeveloperGuide/what-is-datapipeline.html)）。此外，Amazon EFS 使用 NFS 而不是 SMB，并不是基于 Windows 的工作负载的最佳匹配。

- **D. AWS DataSync 到 Amazon EFS** — DataSync 可以传输到 EFS，但 EFS 是 NFS 文件系统。AWS 描述了通过 NFSv4.0/NFSv4.1 挂载 EFS，并建议使用当前代的 Linux NFS 客户端（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。对于已迁移的**基于 Windows**的工作负载以及来自 Windows 文件服务器的数据，**Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 是更合适的目标，因为它支持 SMB 和 Windows 文件语义。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案：通过现有 Direct Connect 连接，计划使用 AWS DataSync 将本地 Windows 文件服务器数据复制到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。

en.question: A company’s solutions architect is reviewing a web application that runs on AWS. The application references static assets in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. The company needs resiliency across multiple AWS Regions. The company already has created an S3 bucket in a second Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure the application to write each object to both S3 buckets. Set up an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone with a record set by using a weighted routing policy for each S3 bucket. Configure the application to reference the objects by using the Route 53 DNS name.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy objects from the S3 bucket in us-east-1 to the S3 bucket in the second Region. Invoke the Lambda function each time an object is written to the S3 bucket in us-east-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin group that contains the two S3 buckets as origins.
options.C: Configure replication on the S3 bucket in us-east-1 to replicate objects to the S3 bucket in the second Region. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin group that contains the two S3 buckets as origins.
options.D: Configure replication on the S3 bucket in us-east-1 to replicate objects to the S3 bucket in the second Region. If failover is required, update the application code to load S3 objects from the S3 bucket in the second Region.

en.explanation:
The application serves static assets from an S3 bucket in `us-east-1` and needs resilience across multiple AWS Regions. The key is to keep the assets available in a second Region and route users to a working origin with minimal manual operation.

**Correct answer: C.**

Option C combines two managed capabilities:

* **Amazon S3 replication / Cross-Region Replication (CRR)**: AWS documentation states that S3 CRR is used to copy objects across S3 buckets in different AWS Regions, and that replication can keep objects stored over multiple AWS Regions. This avoids custom copy logic or application changes for object replication. See [Replicating objects within and across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html).
* **CloudFront origin groups for origin failover**: CloudFront origin groups let you configure primary and secondary origins. AWS documentation states that you choose origins, set priority, choose HTTP status codes as failover criteria, and CloudFront fails over to the secondary origin when it receives one of the configured status codes. See [Optimize high availability with CloudFront origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html).

Together, S3 replication automatically keeps the second-Region bucket populated, and CloudFront provides a single distribution endpoint with managed failover between the two S3 origins. This meets the multi-Region resiliency requirement with the least operational overhead among the choices.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is operationally heavier. It requires the application to write each object to both buckets, creating custom dual-write logic and potential consistency/error-handling issues. Route 53 weighted routing also does not provide the same simple CloudFront content delivery and origin failover behavior for static assets.
* **B** uses CloudFront origin groups, but it introduces a custom Lambda function that must be developed, invoked, monitored, and maintained to copy objects. S3 replication is the native managed feature for this requirement, so this is more operational overhead than C.
* **D** uses S3 replication correctly, but failover requires updating application code to load objects from the second-Region bucket. That is manual or custom failover logic and is higher operational overhead than using CloudFront origin failover.

zh.question: 一家公司的解决方案架构师正在审查一个在 AWS 上运行的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序引用了 us-east-1 区域中一个 Amazon S3 存储桶里的静态资产。公司需要跨多个 AWS 区域的弹性。公司已经在第二个区域创建了一个 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置应用程序将每个对象写入两个 S3 存储桶。设置一个 Amazon Route 53 公有托管区域，并使用加权路由策略为每个 S3 存储桶创建记录集。配置应用程序使用 Route 53 DNS 名称引用对象。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将对象从 us-east-1 中的 S3 存储桶复制到第二个区域中的 S3 存储桶。每次有对象写入 us-east-1 中的 S3 存储桶时调用该 Lambda 函数。设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并配置一个包含这两个 S3 存储桶作为源站的源站组。
options.C: 在 us-east-1 中的 S3 存储桶上配置复制，将对象复制到第二个区域中的 S3 存储桶。设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并配置一个包含这两个 S3 存储桶作为源站的源站组。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中的 S3 存储桶上配置复制，将对象复制到第二个区域中的 S3 存储桶。如果需要故障转移，则更新应用程序代码，从第二个区域中的 S3 存储桶加载 S3 对象。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序从 `us-east-1` 中的 S3 存储桶提供静态资产，并需要跨多个 AWS 区域的弹性。关键是要让资产在第二个区域中保持可用，并以最少的手动操作将用户路由到可工作的源站。

**正确答案：C。**

选项 C 结合了两项托管功能：

* **Amazon S3 replication / Cross-Region Replication (CRR)**：AWS 文档说明，S3 CRR 用于在不同 AWS 区域中的 S3 存储桶之间复制对象，并且复制可以使对象存储在多个 AWS 区域中。这避免了为对象复制编写自定义复制逻辑或修改应用程序。请参阅 [Replicating objects within and across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)。
* **CloudFront origin groups for origin failover**：CloudFront 源站组允许你配置主源站和辅助源站。AWS 文档说明，你可以选择源站、设置优先级、选择 HTTP 状态码作为故障转移条件，当 CloudFront 收到某个已配置的状态码时，它会故障转移到辅助源站。请参阅 [Optimize high availability with CloudFront origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)。

结合使用时，S3 复制会自动让第二个区域的存储桶保持有内容，而 CloudFront 提供单一分配端点，并在两个 S3 源站之间提供托管故障转移。这在各选项中以最低的运营开销满足了多区域弹性要求。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

* **A** 的运营负担更重。它要求应用程序将每个对象写入两个存储桶，从而产生自定义双写逻辑以及潜在的一致性/错误处理问题。Route 53 加权路由也无法为静态资产提供同样简单的 CloudFront 内容分发和源站故障转移行为。
* **B** 使用了 CloudFront 源站组，但引入了必须开发、调用、监控和维护的自定义 Lambda 函数来复制对象。S3 复制是满足此需求的原生托管功能，因此这比 C 带来更多运营开销。
* **D** 正确使用了 S3 复制，但故障转移需要更新应用程序代码，以便从第二个区域的存储桶加载对象。这属于手动或自定义故障转移逻辑，运营开销高于使用 CloudFront 源站故障转移。

en.question: A company is hosting a three-tier web application in an on-premises environment. Due to a recent surge in traffic that resulted in downtime and a significant financial impact, company management has ordered that the application be moved to AWS. The application is written in .NET and has a dependency on a MySQL database. A solutions architect must design a scalable and highly available solution to meet the demand of 200,000 daily users. Which steps should the solutions architect take to design an appropriate solution?

options.A: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to create a new application with a web server environment and an Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. The environment should launch a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon Route 53 alias record to route traffic from the company’s domain to the NLB.
options.B: Use AWS CloudFormation to launch a stack containing an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group spanning three Availability Zones. The stack should launch a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster with a Retain deletion policy. Use an Amazon Route 53 alias record to route traffic from the company’s domain to the ALB.
options.C: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to create an automatically scaling web server environment that spans two separate Regions with an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each Region. Create a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster with a cross-Region read replica. Use Amazon Route 53 with a geoproximity routing policy to route traffic between the two Regions.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to launch a stack containing an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of an Amazon ECS cluster of Spot instances spanning three Availability Zones. The stack should launch an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance with a Snapshot deletion policy. Use an Amazon Route 53 alias record to route traffic from the company’s domain to the ALB.

en.explanation:
The question asks for a scalable and highly available AWS design for a migrated three-tier .NET web application that depends on MySQL and must handle significant traffic. The best answer is **B**.

**Why B is correct**

- An **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** is the right front-end load balancer for a web application. AWS states that an ALB distributes incoming application traffic across targets such as EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones, increasing application availability, and Elastic Load Balancing scales as incoming traffic changes over time ([ALB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)).
- An **EC2 Auto Scaling group across three Availability Zones** provides scalable compute and AZ-level resilience. AWS recommends spanning Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer so traffic is distributed across those AZs; if one AZ becomes unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ ([EC2 Auto Scaling across AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)).
- **Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ** is compatible with the MySQL dependency and provides a highly available database tier. Aurora stores copies of cluster data across multiple AZs, synchronously replicates writes across six storage nodes, and can fail over to an Aurora Replica if the primary instance fails ([Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)).
- A **CloudFormation `Retain` deletion policy** is appropriate for protecting the database resource from accidental stack deletion. CloudFormation documentation states that `DeletionPolicy: Retain` keeps the resource when the stack is deleted ([CloudFormation DeletionPolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html)).
- A **Route 53 alias record to the ALB** is valid and appropriate. AWS documentation states that to route domain traffic to an ELB load balancer, you create a Route 53 alias record that points to the load balancer, and ELB can be Classic, Application, or Network Load Balancer ([Route 53 routing to ELB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **A is incorrect.** Although Elastic Beanstalk and RDS MySQL Multi-AZ can support a web application, the option places a **Network Load Balancer** in front of the web tier. For an HTTP/HTTPS three-tier web application, an **Application Load Balancer** is normally the better fit because it operates at the application layer and supports application request routing. Option B also provides a stronger database choice with Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ and explicit infrastructure-as-code control.

- **C is incorrect.** It over-engineers the solution with two Regions and geoproximity routing when the requirement is scalable and highly available service for 200,000 daily users, not explicit multi-Region disaster recovery. The wording also suggests a single Elastic Beanstalk web server environment spanning two Regions, which is not how Elastic Beanstalk environments are normally deployed. In addition, a cross-Region Aurora read replica is primarily useful for DR/read scaling; it does not by itself make both Regions equivalent active write Regions for a typical MySQL-backed application.

- **D is incorrect.** Running the ECS cluster entirely on **Spot Instances** is not the best choice for a highly available production web tier because Spot capacity can be unavailable or interrupted. The database choice is also weaker: a single Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance with a Snapshot deletion policy does not provide the same HA database architecture as the Aurora Multi-AZ cluster in option B. The Snapshot deletion policy is about preserving a backup on deletion, not runtime high availability.

Therefore, **B** is the most appropriate scalable and highly available design.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地环境中托管一个三层 Web 应用程序。由于最近流量激增导致停机并造成重大财务影响，公司管理层已下令将该应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序使用 .NET 编写，并依赖 MySQL 数据库。解决方案架构师必须设计一个可扩展且高度可用的解决方案，以满足 200,000 名日活用户的需求。解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤来设计合适的解决方案？

options.A: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 创建一个带有 Web 服务器环境和 Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ DB 实例的新应用程序。该环境应在跨多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组前面启动一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。使用 Amazon Route 53 别名记录将流量从公司的域名路由到 NLB。
options.B: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 启动一个堆栈，其中包含位于跨三个可用区的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组前面的 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该堆栈应启动 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群的 Multi-AZ 部署，并使用 Retain 删除策略。使用 Amazon Route 53 别名记录将流量从公司的域名路由到 ALB。
options.C: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 创建一个跨两个不同区域的自动扩展 Web 服务器环境，并在每个区域中配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。创建 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群的 Multi-AZ 部署，并配置跨区域只读副本。使用 Amazon Route 53 和地理邻近路由策略在两个区域之间路由流量。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 启动一个堆栈，其中包含位于跨三个可用区的 Spot 实例 Amazon ECS 集群前面的 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该堆栈应启动一个带有 Snapshot 删除策略的 Amazon RDS MySQL DB 实例。使用 Amazon Route 53 别名记录将流量从公司的域名路由到 ALB。

zh.explanation:
该题要求为一个迁移到 AWS 的三层 .NET Web 应用程序设计可扩展且高度可用的方案。该应用依赖 MySQL，并且必须处理大量流量。最佳答案是 **B**。

**为什么 B 正确**

- **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** 是 Web 应用程序合适的前端负载均衡器。AWS 表示，ALB 会将传入的应用程序流量分发到多个可用区中的目标（例如 EC2 实例），从而提高应用程序可用性；并且 Elastic Load Balancing 会随着传入流量随时间变化而扩展（[ALB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。
- 跨三个可用区的 **EC2 Auto Scaling 组**提供可扩展的计算能力和 AZ 级别的弹性。AWS 建议让 Auto Scaling 组跨多个可用区，并附加负载均衡器，以便流量分布到这些 AZ；如果某个 AZ 变得不正常，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[EC2 Auto Scaling across AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。
- **Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ** 与 MySQL 依赖兼容，并提供高度可用的数据库层。Aurora 会在多个 AZ 中存储集群数据副本，在六个存储节点间同步复制写入，并且在主实例失败时可故障转移到 Aurora Replica（[Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)）。
- **CloudFormation `Retain` 删除策略**适用于保护数据库资源，避免因意外删除堆栈而丢失。CloudFormation 文档说明，`DeletionPolicy: Retain` 会在堆栈删除时保留资源（[CloudFormation DeletionPolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html)）。
- 指向 ALB 的 **Route 53 别名记录**是有效且合适的。AWS 文档说明，要将域名流量路由到 ELB 负载均衡器，需要创建指向该负载均衡器的 Route 53 别名记录；ELB 可以是 Classic、Application 或 Network Load Balancer（[Route 53 routing to ELB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **A 不正确。** 虽然 Elastic Beanstalk 和 RDS MySQL Multi-AZ 可以支持 Web 应用程序，但该选项在 Web 层前面放置了 **Network Load Balancer**。对于 HTTP/HTTPS 三层 Web 应用程序，**Application Load Balancer** 通常更合适，因为它在应用层运行并支持应用程序请求路由。选项 B 还通过 Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ 和显式基础设施即代码控制提供了更强的数据库选择。

- **C 不正确。** 当需求只是为 200,000 名日活用户提供可扩展且高度可用的服务，而不是明确要求多区域灾难恢复时，该选项使用两个区域和地理邻近路由，属于过度设计。其措辞还暗示单个 Elastic Beanstalk Web 服务器环境跨两个区域，而这并不是 Elastic Beanstalk 环境通常的部署方式。此外，跨区域 Aurora 只读副本主要用于 DR/读取扩展；它本身并不会使两个区域对于典型的 MySQL 支持的应用程序而言成为等价的主动写入区域。

- **D 不正确。** 完全在 **Spot Instances** 上运行 ECS 集群并不是高度可用生产 Web 层的最佳选择，因为 Spot 容量可能不可用或被中断。数据库选择也较弱：带 Snapshot 删除策略的单个 Amazon RDS MySQL DB 实例无法提供与选项 B 中 Aurora Multi-AZ 集群相同的 HA 数据库架构。Snapshot 删除策略关注的是在删除时保留备份，而不是运行时高可用性。

因此，**B** 是最合适的可扩展且高度可用的设计。

en.question: A company is using AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. For security purposes, the company requires the creation of an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that enables integration with a third-party alerting system in all the Organizations member accounts. A solutions architect used an AWS CloudFormation template to create the SNS topic and stack sets to automate the deployment of CloudFormation stacks. Trusted access has been enabled in Organizations. What should the solutions architect do to deploy the CloudFormation StackSets in all AWS accounts?

options.A: Create a stack set in the Organizations member accounts. Use service-managed permissions. Set deployment options to deploy to an organization. Use CloudFormation StackSets drift detection.
options.B: Create stacks in the Organizations member accounts. Use self-service permissions. Set deployment options to deploy to an organization. Enable the CloudFormation StackSets automatic deployment.
options.C: Create a stack set in the Organizations management account. Use service-managed permissions. Set deployment options to deploy to the organization. Enable CloudFormation StackSets automatic deployment.
options.D: Create stacks in the Organizations management account. Use service-managed permissions. Set deployment options to deploy to the organization. Enable CloudFormation StackSets drift detection.

en.explanation:
The company needs to deploy the same CloudFormation-defined SNS topic into all AWS Organizations member accounts, and also cover accounts that may be added later. This is a CloudFormation StackSets with AWS Organizations use case.

**Correct answer: C. Create a stack set in the Organizations management account. Use service-managed permissions. Set deployment options to deploy to the organization. Enable CloudFormation StackSets automatic deployment.**

AWS CloudFormation StackSets is designed to create, update, or delete stacks across multiple accounts and Regions from a single operation using an administrator account ([CloudFormation StackSets overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)). For Organizations integration, AWS documents that StackSets with **service-managed permissions** can be initiated by the organization's management account or a delegated administrator, and the StackSet can target the **entire organization** or specific OUs. The console workflow explicitly says to choose **Service-managed permissions**, then under deployment targets choose **Deploy to organization** to deploy to all accounts in the organization ([Create StackSets with service-managed permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)).

Enabling **automatic deployment** is also appropriate because CloudFormation can automatically deploy stacks to new AWS Organizations accounts when they are added to the target organization or OU ([automatic deployments for StackSets in AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-manage-auto-deployment.html)). This satisfies the requirement to deploy the SNS topic across all member accounts with low operational overhead.

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Create a stack set in the Organizations member accounts... Use drift detection.**  
  This is wrong because centralized deployment across the organization should be initiated from the Organizations management account or delegated administrator, not individually from member accounts. Also, **drift detection** identifies out-of-band changes; it does not deploy the StackSet to all current and future accounts.

- **B. Create stacks in the Organizations member accounts. Use self-service permissions...**  
  This is wrong because the required construct is a **StackSet**, not individual stacks. Self-managed/self-service-style permissions require manual IAM role setup and are not the service-managed Organizations integration described in the question. It also does not represent the lowest-operational-overhead Organizations-wide deployment model.

- **D. Create stacks in the Organizations management account... Enable drift detection.**  
  This is wrong because creating ordinary stacks in the management account would create the SNS topic only in that account, not across all member accounts. Also, drift detection is not a deployment mechanism and does not ensure deployment to existing or newly added accounts.

Therefore, **C** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Organizations 管理多个 AWS 账户。出于安全目的，该公司要求在所有 Organizations 成员账户中创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便与第三方告警系统集成。解决方案架构师使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板创建 SNS 主题，并使用堆栈集自动部署 CloudFormation 堆栈。Organizations 中已启用可信访问。解决方案架构师应如何在所有 AWS 账户中部署 CloudFormation StackSets？

options.A: 在 Organizations 成员账户中创建一个堆栈集。使用服务托管权限。将部署选项设置为部署到组织。使用 CloudFormation StackSets 漂移检测。
options.B: 在 Organizations 成员账户中创建堆栈。使用自助服务权限。将部署选项设置为部署到组织。启用 CloudFormation StackSets 自动部署。
options.C: 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建一个堆栈集。使用服务托管权限。将部署选项设置为部署到组织。启用 CloudFormation StackSets 自动部署。
options.D: 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建堆栈。使用服务托管权限。将部署选项设置为部署到组织。启用 CloudFormation StackSets 漂移检测。

zh.explanation:
公司需要将同一个由 CloudFormation 定义的 SNS 主题部署到所有 AWS Organizations 成员账户中，并且还要覆盖以后可能添加的账户。这是 CloudFormation StackSets 与 AWS Organizations 结合使用的场景。

**正确答案：C. 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建一个堆栈集。使用服务托管权限。将部署选项设置为部署到组织。启用 CloudFormation StackSets 自动部署。**

AWS CloudFormation StackSets 旨在使用管理员账户，通过单次操作在多个账户和区域中创建、更新或删除堆栈（[CloudFormation StackSets 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)）。对于 Organizations 集成，AWS 文档说明，使用 **服务托管权限** 的 StackSets 可以由组织的管理账户或委派管理员发起，并且 StackSet 可以面向 **整个组织** 或特定 OU。控制台工作流明确说明选择 **Service-managed permissions**，然后在部署目标下选择 **Deploy to organization**，以部署到组织中的所有账户（[使用服务托管权限创建 StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)）。

启用 **自动部署** 也很合适，因为当新的 AWS Organizations 账户被添加到目标组织或 OU 时，CloudFormation 可以自动将堆栈部署到这些账户（[AWS Organizations 中 StackSets 的自动部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-manage-auto-deployment.html)）。这满足了以低运营开销在所有成员账户中部署 SNS 主题的要求。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

- **A. 在 Organizations 成员账户中创建一个堆栈集……使用漂移检测。**  
  这是错误的，因为跨组织的集中部署应从 Organizations 管理账户或委派管理员发起，而不是分别从成员账户发起。此外，**漂移检测** 用于识别带外更改；它不会将 StackSet 部署到所有当前和未来账户。

- **B. 在 Organizations 成员账户中创建堆栈。使用自助服务权限……**  
  这是错误的，因为所需的构造是 **StackSet**，而不是单个堆栈。自管理/自助服务式权限需要手动设置 IAM 角色，并不是题目中描述的服务托管 Organizations 集成。它也不代表最低运营开销的组织范围部署模型。

- **D. 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建堆栈……启用漂移检测。**  
  这是错误的，因为在管理账户中创建普通堆栈只会在该账户中创建 SNS 主题，而不会跨所有成员账户创建。此外，漂移检测不是部署机制，也不能确保部署到现有账户或新添加的账户。

因此，**C** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its workloads from on premises to AWS. The workloads run on Linux and Windows. The company has a large on-premises infrastructure that consists of physical machines and VMs that host numerous applications. The company must capture details about the system configuration, system performance, running processes, and network connections of its on-premises workloads. The company also must divide the on-premises applications into groups for AWS migrations. The company needs recommendations for Amazon EC2 instance types so that the company can run its workloads on AWS in the most cost-effective manner. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Application Discovery Agent on the physical machines and VMs.
options.B: Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Systems Manager Agent on the physical machines and VMs.
options.C: Group servers into applications for migration by using AWS Systems Manager Application Manager.
options.D: Group servers into applications for migration by using AWS Migration Hub.
options.E: Generate recommended instance types and associated costs by using AWS Migration Hub.
options.F: Import data about server sizes into AWS Trusted Advisor. Follow the recommendations for cost optimization.

en.explanation:
The company is planning a large on-premises-to-AWS migration and needs three things: detailed discovery data from Linux and Windows physical/virtual servers, grouping of servers into applications for migration planning, and cost-effective Amazon EC2 instance recommendations.

**Correct answers: A, D, and E.**

- **A. Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Application Discovery Agent on the physical machines and VMs.**  
  This is the correct discovery mechanism for the required data. The AWS Application Discovery Agent is installed on on-premises servers and VMs, and AWS documentation states that it collects system specifications/configuration, time-series utilization or performance data, network connections, and process data. The documentation also explicitly says this data helps map IT assets and dependencies and determine the cost of running servers in AWS ([AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)).

- **D. Group servers into applications for migration by using AWS Migration Hub.**  
  AWS Migration Hub supports grouping servers as applications. The documented workflow is to select servers in the Migration Hub console and choose **Group as application**, either creating a new application or adding servers to an existing one ([Group servers as applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/gs-new-user-migration.html)). This matches the requirement to divide on-premises applications into groups for AWS migrations.

- **E. Generate recommended instance types and associated costs by using AWS Migration Hub.**  
  AWS Migration Hub provides Amazon EC2 instance recommendations. It analyzes server specifications, CPU, and memory utilization data, then recommends the least expensive EC2 instance type that can handle the workload and returns recommendations with per-hour pricing. It also allows preferences such as Region, billing options, instance type exclusions, and CPU/RAM sizing methods to optimize recommendations and associated costs ([Amazon EC2 instance recommendations in AWS Migration Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/ec2-recommendations.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Assess the existing applications by installing AWS Systems Manager Agent on the physical machines and VMs.**  
  Systems Manager Agent can be used to manage systems, including hybrid/on-premises managed nodes, but the question requires detailed migration discovery data: system configuration, performance time series, running processes, and network connections. The AWS Application Discovery Agent is the AWS migration discovery component documented for collecting exactly those data types, so B is not the best fit.
