AWS documentation states that you can send production email through Amazon SES using either the SMTP interface or the SES API, and the SMTP interface is specifically for SMTP-enabled applications and software ([Using the Amazon SES SMTP interface to send email](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)).
* SES requires encrypted SMTP connections and supports STARTTLS. STARTTLS works on port **25**, which aligns with the legacy application's current port usage if the application can be configured for STARTTLS ([Connecting to an Amazon SES SMTP endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-connect.html)).
* SES SMTP authentication requires **Amazon SES SMTP credentials**. The documentation states that an SMTP user name and password are required and that SMTP credentials are not identical to AWS access keys or console credentials ([Using the Amazon SES SMTP interface to send email](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html), [Obtaining Amazon SES SMTP credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)).

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Configure the application to connect to Amazon SES by using TLS Wrapper. Create an IAM role that has ses:SendEmail and ses:SendRawEmail permissions. Attach the IAM role to an Amazon EC2 instance.**

This is incorrect for two reasons. First, TLS Wrapper for SES SMTP uses ports **465 or 2465**, not port 25. STARTTLS is the SES TLS method that supports port 25 ([Connecting to an Amazon SES SMTP endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-connect.html)). Second, SMTP authentication to SES is performed with SES SMTP credentials, not by attaching an IAM role to the EC2 instance. SES SMTP credentials are required for the SMTP interface ([Obtaining Amazon SES SMTP credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)).

**C. Configure the application to use the SES API to send email messages. Create an IAM role that has ses:SendEmail and ses:SendRawEmail permissions. Use the IAM role as a service role for Amazon SES.**

This is incorrect because the question states that the application can use **SMTP only**. The SES API is a different sending method and would require changing the application away from SMTP. The SES documentation distinguishes between sending through the SMTP interface and sending through the SES API ([Using the Amazon SES SMTP interface to send email](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)). Also, “use the IAM role as a service role for Amazon SES” is not the required authentication pattern for an SMTP-only application sending through the SES SMTP endpoint.

**D. Configure the application to use AWS SDKs to send email messages. Create an IAM user for Amazon SES. Generate API access keys. Use the access keys to authenticate with Amazon SES.**

This is incorrect because using AWS SDKs means using the SES API, not the SMTP interface. The application is constrained to SMTP only. Additionally, SES SMTP credentials are different from AWS access keys, so simply generating API access keys is not the correct authentication method for SES SMTP ([Using the Amazon SES SMTP interface to send email](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html), [Obtaining Amazon SES SMTP credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近使用 replatforming 策略完成了从本地数据中心到 AWS Cloud 的迁移。迁移的服务器之一正在运行一个旧版 Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) 服务，某个关键应用程序依赖该服务。该应用程序向公司的客户发送出站电子邮件。旧版 SMTP 服务器不支持 TLS 加密，并使用 TCP 端口 25。该应用程序只能使用 SMTP。公司决定使用 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES)，并停用旧版 SMTP 服务器。公司已创建并验证了 SES 域。公司已提高 SES 限额。公司应如何修改应用程序以从 Amazon SES 发送电子邮件？

options.A: 将应用程序配置为使用 TLS Wrapper 连接到 Amazon SES。创建一个具有 ses:SendEmail 和 ses:SendRawEmail 权限的 IAM 角色。将该 IAM 角色附加到 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.B: 将应用程序配置为使用 STARTTLS 连接到 Amazon SES。获取 Amazon SES SMTP 凭证。使用这些凭证向 Amazon SES 进行身份验证。
options.C: 将应用程序配置为使用 SES API 发送电子邮件。创建一个具有 ses:SendEmail 和 ses:SendRawEmail 权限的 IAM 角色。将该 IAM 角色用作 Amazon SES 的服务角色。
options.D: 将应用程序配置为使用 AWS SDKs 发送电子邮件。为 Amazon SES 创建 IAM 用户。生成 API 访问密钥。使用这些访问密钥向 Amazon SES 进行身份验证。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序**只能使用 SMTP**发送电子邮件，因此迁移目标必须是 Amazon SES **SMTP interface**，而不是 SES API 或 AWS SDKs。Amazon SES SMTP 连接还要求 TLS 加密，并且 SES 支持两种 TLS 连接机制：**STARTTLS** 和 **TLS Wrapper**。对于 STARTTLS，SMTP 客户端连接到 **端口 25、587 或 2587** 上的 SES SMTP endpoint，然后将连接升级到 TLS。TLS Wrapper 使用不同的端口，即 **465 或 2465**。Amazon SES SMTP 还要求 SMTP 用户名和密码；这些 SMTP 凭证不同于普通的 AWS 访问密钥。

**正确答案：B。将应用程序配置为使用 STARTTLS 连接到 Amazon SES。获取 Amazon SES SMTP 凭证。使用这些凭证向 Amazon SES 进行身份验证。**

这精确符合要求：

* 应用程序仍然基于 SMTP，这由 Amazon SES 通过 SMTP interface 支持。AWS 文档指出，你可以通过 SMTP interface 或 SES API 使用 Amazon SES 发送生产电子邮件，并且 SMTP interface 专门用于支持 SMTP 的应用程序和软件（[使用 Amazon SES SMTP interface 发送电子邮件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)）。
* SES 要求加密的 SMTP 连接并支持 STARTTLS。STARTTLS 可在端口 **25** 上工作，如果应用程序可以配置为使用 STARTTLS，这与旧版应用程序当前的端口使用情况一致（[连接到 Amazon SES SMTP endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-connect.html)）。
* SES SMTP 身份验证要求使用 **Amazon SES SMTP 凭证**。文档指出需要 SMTP 用户名和密码，并且 SMTP 凭证不等同于 AWS 访问密钥或控制台凭证（[使用 Amazon SES SMTP interface 发送电子邮件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)，[获取 Amazon SES SMTP 凭证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)）。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 将应用程序配置为使用 TLS Wrapper 连接到 Amazon SES。创建一个具有 ses:SendEmail 和 ses:SendRawEmail 权限的 IAM 角色。将该 IAM 角色附加到 Amazon EC2 实例。**

这有两个原因是不正确的。首先，用于 SES SMTP 的 TLS Wrapper 使用端口 **465 或 2465**，而不是端口 25。STARTTLS 才是支持端口 25 的 SES TLS 方法（[连接到 Amazon SES SMTP endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-connect.html)）。其次，对 SES 进行 SMTP 身份验证是使用 SES SMTP 凭证完成的，而不是通过将 IAM 角色附加到 EC2 实例来完成。SMTP interface 需要 SES SMTP 凭证（[获取 Amazon SES SMTP 凭证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)）。

**C. 将应用程序配置为使用 SES API 发送电子邮件。创建一个具有 ses:SendEmail 和 ses:SendRawEmail 权限的 IAM 角色。将该 IAM 角色用作 Amazon SES 的服务角色。**

这是不正确的，因为题目说明应用程序**只能使用 SMTP**。SES API 是一种不同的发送方法，需要将应用程序从 SMTP 改为其他方式。SES 文档区分了通过 SMTP interface 发送和通过 SES API 发送（[使用 Amazon SES SMTP interface 发送电子邮件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)）。此外，“将 IAM 角色用作 Amazon SES 的服务角色”不是仅支持 SMTP 的应用程序通过 SES SMTP endpoint 发送时所需的身份验证模式。

**D. 将应用程序配置为使用 AWS SDKs 发送电子邮件。为 Amazon SES 创建 IAM 用户。生成 API 访问密钥。使用这些访问密钥向 Amazon SES 进行身份验证。**

这是不正确的，因为使用 AWS SDKs 意味着使用 SES API，而不是 SMTP interface。该应用程序受限于只能使用 SMTP。此外，SES SMTP 凭证不同于 AWS 访问密钥，因此仅生成 API 访问密钥并不是 SES SMTP 的正确身份验证方法（[使用 Amazon SES SMTP interface 发送电子邮件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-smtp.html)，[获取 Amazon SES SMTP 凭证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html)）。

en.question: A company recently acquired several other companies. Each company has a separate AWS account with a different billing and reporting method. The acquiring company has consolidated all the accounts into one organization in AWS Organizations. However, the acquiring company has found it difficult to generate a cost report that contains meaningful groups for all the teams. The acquiring company’s finance team needs a solution to report on costs for all the companies through a self- managed application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report for the organization. Define tags and cost categories in the report. Create a table in Amazon Athena. Create an Amazon QuickSight dataset based on the Athena table. Share the dataset with the finance team.
options.B: Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report for the organization. Define tags and cost categories in the report. Create a specialized template in AWS Cost Explorer that the finance department will use to build reports.
options.C: Create an Amazon QuickSight dataset that receives spending information from the AWS Price List Query API. Share the dataset with the finance team.
options.D: Use the AWS Price List Query API to collect account spending information. Create a specialized template in AWS Cost Explorer that the finance department will use to build reports.

en.explanation:
The company has consolidated multiple acquired companies' AWS accounts into a single AWS Organizations organization. The requirement is to build meaningful, organization-wide cost reporting for teams through a **self-managed reporting/analytics application**.

**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) are the right source of detailed billing data. AWS documentation states that, with AWS Organizations, a management account can generate exports containing data for **all accounts in the organization**, while member accounts only contain their own data ([Using Data Exports with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-organizations.html)). CUR data is delivered to S3 and can be configured for integration with analytics tools; AWS documents that reports can be queried using **Amazon Athena** and integrated with QuickSight-style reporting workflows ([What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)).

For meaningful grouping, **cost allocation tags** and **AWS Cost Categories** are appropriate. Cost allocation tags let you organize and track AWS costs at a detailed level and group costs by business categories such as cost centers, applications, or owners ([Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). AWS Cost Categories are specifically designed to map AWS costs to internal business structures, such as teams or business units, and the resulting cost category values appear as columns in AWS CUR ([Organizing costs using AWS Cost Categories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/manage-cost-categories.html)).

Therefore, creating an organization-level CUR, adding tags and cost categories, querying the CUR with Athena, and exposing the results through a QuickSight dataset best satisfies the need for flexible, self-managed cost reporting.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect.** Although CUR, tags, and cost categories are appropriate, the option relies on a “specialized template in AWS Cost Explorer.” Cost Explorer is an AWS-managed cost analysis tool with preconfigured/customizable views and API access, but it is not the best fit for a self-managed reporting application over CUR data, and the option does not provide the Athena/QuickSight analytics layer requested by the scenario ([Analyzing your costs and usage with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)).
- **C is incorrect.** The AWS Price List Query API is for finding AWS product pricing information, products, rates, and attributes. It does **not** provide actual account-level usage or spend data for reporting historical costs ([Finding services and products using AWS Price List Query API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/using-price-list-query-api.html)).
- **D is incorrect.** This option has the same fundamental issue as C: the Price List Query API provides pricing catalog data, not actual organizational spend or usage. It also relies on Cost Explorer templates rather than a self-managed reporting data pipeline based on CUR.

zh.question: 一家公司最近收购了其他几家公司。每家公司都有一个单独的 AWS 账户，并且采用不同的计费和报告方法。收购方公司已将所有账户整合到 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内。但是，收购方公司发现很难生成一份包含所有团队有意义分组的成本报告。收购方公司的财务团队需要一个解决方案，以便通过一个自管理应用程序报告所有公司的成本。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该组织创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report。在报告中定义标签和成本类别。在 Amazon Athena 中创建一个表。基于 Athena 表创建一个 Amazon QuickSight 数据集。与财务团队共享该数据集。
options.B: 为该组织创建 AWS Cost and Usage Report。在报告中定义标签和成本类别。在 AWS Cost Explorer 中创建一个专门模板，供财务部门用于构建报告。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon QuickSight 数据集，用于从 AWS Price List Query API 接收支出信息。与财务团队共享该数据集。
options.D: 使用 AWS Price List Query API 收集账户支出信息。在 AWS Cost Explorer 中创建一个专门模板，供财务部门用于构建报告。

zh.explanation:
该公司已将多家被收购公司的 AWS 账户整合到一个 AWS Organizations 组织中。要求是通过一个**自管理的报告/分析应用程序**为团队构建有意义的、组织范围内的成本报告。

**正确答案：A。**

AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) 是详细账单数据的正确来源。AWS 文档说明，在使用 AWS Organizations 时，管理账户可以生成包含**组织中所有账户**数据的导出，而成员账户只包含其自身数据（[Using Data Exports with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-organizations.html)）。CUR 数据会交付到 S3，并且可以配置为与分析工具集成；AWS 文档说明，报告可以使用 **Amazon Athena** 查询，并与 QuickSight 风格的报告工作流集成（[What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)）。

为了实现有意义的分组，**成本分配标签**和 **AWS Cost Categories** 是合适的。成本分配标签允许你在详细级别组织和跟踪 AWS 成本，并按成本中心、应用程序或所有者等业务类别对成本进行分组（[Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。AWS Cost Categories 专门用于将 AWS 成本映射到内部业务结构，例如团队或业务部门，并且生成的成本类别值会作为 AWS CUR 中的列出现（[Organizing costs using AWS Cost Categories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/manage-cost-categories.html)）。

因此，创建组织级 CUR，添加标签和成本类别，使用 Athena 查询 CUR，并通过 QuickSight 数据集公开结果，最能满足灵活、自管理成本报告的需求。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B 不正确。** 虽然 CUR、标签和成本类别是合适的，但该选项依赖于 AWS Cost Explorer 中的“专门模板”。Cost Explorer 是 AWS 托管的成本分析工具，具有预配置/可自定义视图和 API 访问能力，但它并不是基于 CUR 数据构建自管理报告应用程序的最佳选择，而且该选项没有提供场景所需的 Athena/QuickSight 分析层（[Analyzing your costs and usage with AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。
- **C 不正确。** AWS Price List Query API 用于查找 AWS 产品定价信息、产品、费率和属性。它**不**提供用于报告历史成本的实际账户级用量或支出数据（[Finding services and products using AWS Price List Query API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/using-price-list-query-api.html)）。
- **D 不正确。** 此选项与 C 存在相同的根本问题：Price List Query API 提供的是定价目录数据，而不是实际的组织支出或用量。它还依赖 Cost Explorer 模板，而不是基于 CUR 的自管理报告数据管道。

en.question: A company runs an IoT platform on AWS. IoT sensors in various locations send data to the company’s Node.js API servers on Amazon EC2 instances running behind an Application Load Balancer. The data is stored in an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance that uses a 4 TB General Purpose SSD volume. The number of sensors the company has deployed in the field has increased over time, and is expected to grow significantly. The API servers are consistently overloaded and RDS metrics show high write latency. Which of the following steps together will resolve the issues permanently and enable growth as new sensors are provisioned, while keeping this platform cost-efficient? (Choose two.)

options.A: Resize the MySQL General Purpose SSD storage to 6 TB to improve the volume’s IOPS.
options.B: Re-architect the database tier to use Amazon Aurora instead of an RDS MySQL DB instance and add read replicas.
options.C: Leverage Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Lambda to ingest and process the raw data.
options.D: Use AWS X-Ray to analyze and debug application issues and add more API servers to match the load.
options.E: Re-architect the database tier to use Amazon DynamoDB instead of an RDS MySQL DB instance.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The current design sends growing IoT sensor traffic to Node.js API servers on EC2 behind an ALB, then writes directly to an RDS MySQL database. The symptoms are:

* API servers are consistently overloaded.
* RDS shows high write latency.
* Sensor count is expected to grow significantly.
* The solution must be permanent, scalable, and cost-efficient.

The best approach is to decouple high-volume ingestion/processing from the API tier and use a database designed for very high-scale, low-latency writes.

## Correct answers: C and E

### C. Leverage Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Lambda to ingest and process the raw data

Kinesis Data Streams is designed for rapid and continuous data intake and real-time processing. AWS documentation states that producers can push data directly into streams, avoiding batching on application servers, and that Kinesis provides durable and elastic intake pipelines. It also gives an example where a Kinesis application processes data and updates a DynamoDB table ([Kinesis Data Streams: What can I do / Benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)).

Lambda integrates directly with Kinesis Data Streams: Lambda reads stream records in batches and invokes functions to process them. Through shards, batching, enhanced fan-out, and parallelization factor, the processing layer can scale with stream volume ([Using Lambda to process records from Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)).

This offloads ingestion and processing from the EC2 API servers and creates a scalable, serverless, event-driven path for the sensor data.

### E. Re-architect the database tier to use Amazon DynamoDB instead of an RDS MySQL DB instance

DynamoDB is a better long-term fit for high-volume IoT telemetry if the data can be modeled by known access patterns. AWS describes DynamoDB as serverless, fully managed, and purpose-built for single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. On-demand capacity provides pay-as-you-go read/write pricing and automatically scales table capacity up or down with zero administration ([DynamoDB characteristics and use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)).

AWS also explicitly contrasts relational databases with DynamoDB for web-scale workloads and lists Internet of Things (IoT) as an optimal DynamoDB workload. DynamoDB can handle very large data volumes and large numbers of users, including tens or hundreds of thousands of reads and writes per second ([Choosing between relational SQL and NoSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SQLtoNoSQL.WhyDynamoDB.html)).

For continuously arriving sensor records, DynamoDB removes the RDS write bottleneck and provides scalable, low-latency writes with cost-efficient capacity modes.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Resize the MySQL General Purpose SSD storage to 6 TB to improve the volume’s IOPS

Increasing storage might improve baseline IOPS for some General Purpose SSD configurations, but it only treats the storage symptom and does not permanently address the architectural problem: a rapidly growing stream of IoT writes being pushed through overloaded API servers into a relational database. AWS notes that General Purpose storage is for workloads that are not latency or performance sensitive, and General Purpose volumes can experience much longer latency than Provisioned IOPS volumes ([RDS storage types: General Purpose SSD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)). This is a scaling tweak, not a permanent growth architecture.

### B. Re-architect the database tier to use Amazon Aurora instead of an RDS MySQL DB instance and add read replicas

Aurora is higher-performance than standard MySQL-compatible databases and can deliver up to five times the throughput of MySQL for some workloads ([What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)). However, the option specifically includes adding read replicas. Read replicas are for scaling read-heavy workloads; AWS describes their use case as scaling beyond a single DB instance for **read-heavy** workloads and directing excess read traffic to replicas ([Amazon RDS read replicas overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

The stated database symptom is high **write** latency, not read pressure. Aurora could be an improvement, but adding read replicas does not resolve the core write bottleneck as permanently or cost-efficiently as using DynamoDB for IoT-scale write ingestion.

### D. Use AWS X-Ray to analyze and debug application issues and add more API servers to match the load

X-Ray can help diagnose issues, and adding API servers can temporarily absorb more traffic. But this keeps the same synchronous EC2-to-RDS ingestion pattern and does not remove the database write bottleneck. It also increases EC2 fleet cost as sensor volume grows. The question asks for a permanent, scalable, cost-efficient architecture, which points to Kinesis/Lambda for ingestion and DynamoDB for storage rather than simply scaling out overloaded servers.

## Final answer

**C and E** are the best combination: Kinesis Data Streams with Lambda provides scalable ingestion and processing, and DynamoDB provides scalable, low-latency, cost-efficient storage for high-volume IoT sensor data.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个 IoT 平台。位于不同地点的 IoT 传感器将数据发送到公司的 Node.js API 服务器，这些服务器运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并位于 Application Load Balancer 后面。数据存储在一个 Amazon RDS MySQL 数据库实例中，该实例使用 4 TB General Purpose SSD 卷。随着时间推移，公司已部署到现场的传感器数量不断增加，并预计会显著增长。API 服务器持续过载，并且 RDS 指标显示写入延迟很高。以下哪些步骤结合起来可以永久解决这些问题，并在配置新传感器时支持增长，同时保持该平台的成本效益？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 MySQL General Purpose SSD 存储大小调整为 6 TB，以提高该卷的 IOPS。
options.B: 重新设计数据库层，使用 Amazon Aurora 替代 RDS MySQL 数据库实例，并添加只读副本。
options.C: 利用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 和 AWS Lambda 来摄取和处理原始数据。
options.D: 使用 AWS X-Ray 分析和调试应用程序问题，并添加更多 API 服务器以匹配负载。
options.E: 重新设计数据库层，使用 Amazon DynamoDB 替代 RDS MySQL 数据库实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

当前设计将不断增长的 IoT 传感器流量发送到 ALB 后面 EC2 上的 Node.js API 服务器，然后直接写入 RDS MySQL 数据库。症状是：

* API 服务器持续过载。
* RDS 显示高写入延迟。
* 传感器数量预计会显著增长。
* 解决方案必须是永久性的、可扩展的，并且成本高效。

最佳方法是将高容量摄取/处理与 API 层解耦，并使用专为超大规模、低延迟写入而设计的数据库。

## 正确答案：C 和 E

### C. 利用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 和 AWS Lambda 来摄取和处理原始数据

Kinesis Data Streams 专为快速且连续的数据摄取和实时处理而设计。AWS 文档指出，生产者可以将数据直接推送到流中，避免在应用程序服务器上进行批处理，并且 Kinesis 提供持久且弹性的摄取管道。它还给出了一个示例，其中 Kinesis 应用程序处理数据并更新 DynamoDB 表（[Kinesis Data Streams：我能做什么 / 优势](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。

Lambda 可直接与 Kinesis Data Streams 集成：Lambda 按批次读取流记录并调用函数进行处理。通过分片、批处理、增强型扇出和并行化因子，处理层可以随流量规模扩展（[使用 Lambda 处理来自 Kinesis 的记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)）。

这会从 EC2 API 服务器卸载摄取和处理工作，并为传感器数据创建一个可扩展、无服务器、事件驱动的路径。

### E. 重新设计数据库层，使用 Amazon DynamoDB 替代 RDS MySQL 数据库实例

如果数据可以根据已知访问模式进行建模，DynamoDB 更适合高容量 IoT 遥测的长期需求。AWS 将 DynamoDB 描述为无服务器、完全托管，并且专为任意规模下的个位数毫秒级性能而构建。按需容量提供按用量付费的读/写定价，并可在零管理的情况下自动向上或向下扩展表容量（[DynamoDB 特征和使用案例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。

AWS 还明确将关系型数据库与 DynamoDB 在 Web 规模工作负载方面进行对比，并将 Internet of Things (IoT) 列为 DynamoDB 的最佳工作负载。DynamoDB 可以处理非常大的数据量和大量用户，包括每秒数万或数十万次读取和写入（[在关系型 SQL 和 NoSQL 之间选择](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SQLtoNoSQL.WhyDynamoDB.html)）。

对于持续到达的传感器记录，DynamoDB 消除了 RDS 写入瓶颈，并通过成本高效的容量模式提供可扩展、低延迟的写入。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 将 MySQL General Purpose SSD 存储大小调整为 6 TB，以提高该卷的 IOPS

增加存储容量可能会提高某些 General Purpose SSD 配置的基准 IOPS，但它只是处理存储症状，并不能永久解决架构问题：快速增长的 IoT 写入流量通过过载的 API 服务器推送到关系型数据库。AWS 指出，General Purpose 存储适用于对延迟或性能不敏感的工作负载，并且 General Purpose 卷可能会比 Provisioned IOPS 卷出现更长的延迟（[RDS 存储类型：General Purpose SSD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。这只是扩展调整，而不是永久增长架构。

### B. 重新设计数据库层，使用 Amazon Aurora 替代 RDS MySQL 数据库实例，并添加只读副本

Aurora 比标准 MySQL 兼容数据库具有更高性能，并且在某些工作负载下可提供高达 MySQL 五倍的吞吐量（[什么是 Amazon Aurora？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。但是，该选项明确包括添加只读副本。只读副本用于扩展读取密集型工作负载；AWS 将其用例描述为针对 **读取密集型** 工作负载扩展到超出单个数据库实例，并将多余的读取流量导向副本（[Amazon RDS 只读副本概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

题目中说明的数据库症状是高 **写入** 延迟，而不是读取压力。Aurora 可能是一种改进，但添加只读副本无法像为 IoT 规模写入摄取使用 DynamoDB 那样，以永久且成本高效的方式解决核心写入瓶颈。

### D. 使用 AWS X-Ray 分析和调试应用程序问题，并添加更多 API 服务器以匹配负载

X-Ray 可以帮助诊断问题，添加 API 服务器可以临时吸收更多流量。但这仍然保留相同的同步 EC2 到 RDS 摄取模式，并没有消除数据库写入瓶颈。随着传感器数量增长，它还会增加 EC2 机群成本。题目要求的是永久、可扩展且成本高效的架构，因此应指向用于摄取的 Kinesis/Lambda 和用于存储的 DynamoDB，而不是简单地横向扩展过载服务器。

## 最终答案

**C 和 E** 是最佳组合：Kinesis Data Streams 与 Lambda 提供可扩展的摄取和处理，而 DynamoDB 为高容量 IoT 传感器数据提供可扩展、低延迟且成本高效的存储。

en.question: A company is building an electronic document management system in which users upload their documents. The application stack is entirely serverless and runs on AWS in the eu-central-1 Region. The system includes a web application that uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution for delivery with Amazon S3 as the origin. The web application communicates with Amazon API Gateway Regional endpoints. The API Gateway APIs call AWS Lambda functions that store metadata in an Amazon Aurora Serverless database and put the documents into an S3 bucket. The company is growing steadily and has completed a proof of concept with its largest customer. The company must improve latency outside of Europe. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the S3 bucket. Ensure that the web application uses the Transfer Acceleration signed URLs.
options.B: Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Attach the accelerator to the CloudFront distribution.
options.C: Change the API Gateway Regional endpoints to edge-optimized endpoints.
options.D: Provision the entire stack in two other locations that are spread across the world. Use global databases on the Aurora Serverless cluster.
options.E: Add an Amazon RDS proxy between the Lambda functions and the Aurora Serverless database.

en.explanation:
The application is hosted in **eu-central-1** and already uses CloudFront for the static web application. The latency problem for users outside Europe is mainly on two paths: uploading document payloads to the centralized S3 bucket and calling Regional API Gateway APIs in Europe. The best combination of actions is **A and C**.

**A. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the S3 bucket. Ensure that the web application uses the Transfer Acceleration signed URLs.**

This is correct. Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration is designed for fast transfers over long distances between clients and an S3 bucket. AWS describes it as optimizing transfer speeds from across the world by using globally distributed CloudFront edge locations and routing data to S3 over an optimized network path. The documentation specifically lists the use case where customers upload to a centralized bucket from all over the world ([Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).

Using signed URLs with the accelerated S3 endpoint allows the web application to send large document uploads directly to S3 through the accelerated path, instead of forcing distant users to send the full document payload through the API and Lambda stack in eu-central-1. This directly addresses upload latency for users outside Europe.

**C. Change the API Gateway Regional endpoints to edge-optimized endpoints.**

This is correct. API Gateway edge-optimized endpoints are intended for geographically distributed clients. AWS states that an edge-optimized API endpoint typically routes requests to the nearest CloudFront Point of Presence, which can help when clients are geographically distributed. By contrast, a Regional API endpoint is intended for clients in the same Region ([API Gateway endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-endpoint-types.html)).

Changing the Regional API Gateway endpoints to edge-optimized endpoints improves the API access path for users outside Europe while keeping the Lambda functions and database in eu-central-1.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

**B. Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Attach the accelerator to the CloudFront distribution.**

This is incorrect because a CloudFront distribution is not a supported endpoint resource for AWS Global Accelerator. The documented endpoint resource types include resources such as Application Load Balancers, Network Load Balancers, EC2 instances, and Elastic IP addresses, not CloudFront distributions ([Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html)). In addition, CloudFront already uses AWS edge locations for content delivery, so placing Global Accelerator in front of CloudFront is not the correct pattern.

**D. Provision the entire stack in two other locations that are spread across the world. Use global databases on the Aurora Serverless cluster.**

This is not the best fit for the stated requirement. Aurora Global Database provides a primary Region and read-only secondary Regions. Writes are issued to the primary DB cluster, while secondary Regions are used primarily for low-latency reads and disaster recovery ([Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). This application writes document metadata during uploads, so adding read-only secondary database clusters does not remove the write-path dependency on the primary Region. This option is also a much larger multi-Region redesign and does not specify the required global traffic-routing changes for the full application stack.

**E. Add an Amazon RDS proxy between the Lambda functions and the Aurora Serverless database.**

This is incorrect for the latency requirement. RDS Proxy is useful for connection pooling, multiplexing, handling connection surges, and reducing database connection overhead for serverless and event-driven applications such as Lambda-backed APIs ([RDS Proxy usage scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)). However, it does not reduce the geographic network latency experienced by users outside Europe when uploading documents or calling APIs hosted in eu-central-1.

Therefore, the correct answers are **A and C**: use **S3 Transfer Acceleration with signed URLs** for global document uploads and use **edge-optimized API Gateway endpoints** for globally distributed API clients.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个电子文档管理系统，用户可以在其中上传文档。该应用程序堆栈完全是无服务器的，并在 AWS 的 eu-central-1 区域中运行。该系统包括一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon CloudFront 分配进行交付，并以 Amazon S3 作为源站。Web 应用程序与 Amazon API Gateway Regional endpoints 通信。API Gateway APIs 调用 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数将元数据存储在 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库中，并将文档放入 S3 存储桶。该公司正在稳步增长，并且已经与其最大的客户完成了概念验证。该公司必须改善欧洲以外地区的延迟。哪组操作组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。确保 Web 应用程序使用 Transfer Acceleration 签名 URL。
options.B: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个加速器。将该加速器附加到 CloudFront 分配。
options.C: 将 API Gateway Regional endpoints 更改为 edge-optimized endpoints。
options.D: 在全球范围内分布的另外两个位置预置整个堆栈。在 Aurora Serverless 集群上使用 global databases。
options.E: 在 Lambda 函数和 Aurora Serverless 数据库之间添加 Amazon RDS proxy。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序托管在 **eu-central-1**，并且已经使用 CloudFront 为静态 Web 应用程序提供服务。欧洲以外用户的延迟问题主要出现在两条路径上：将文档负载上传到集中式 S3 存储桶，以及调用位于欧洲的 Regional API Gateway APIs。最佳操作组合是 **A 和 C**。

**A. 在 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。确保 Web 应用程序使用 Transfer Acceleration 签名 URL。**

这是正确的。Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 专为客户端与 S3 存储桶之间的长距离快速传输而设计。AWS 将其描述为通过使用全球分布的 CloudFront 边缘站点，并通过优化的网络路径将数据路由到 S3，从而优化来自世界各地的传输速度。该文档明确列出了客户从世界各地上传到集中式存储桶的使用场景（[Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。

将签名 URL 与加速的 S3 端点结合使用，可让 Web 应用程序通过加速路径将大型文档直接上传到 S3，而不是迫使远距离用户通过 eu-central-1 中的 API 和 Lambda 堆栈发送完整的文档负载。这直接解决了欧洲以外用户的上传延迟问题。

**C. 将 API Gateway Regional endpoints 更改为 edge-optimized endpoints。**

这是正确的。API Gateway edge-optimized endpoints 面向地理位置分散的客户端。AWS 表示，edge-optimized API endpoint 通常会将请求路由到最近的 CloudFront Point of Presence，这在客户端地理位置分散时会有所帮助。相比之下，Regional API endpoint 面向位于同一区域中的客户端（[API Gateway endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-endpoint-types.html)）。

将 Regional API Gateway endpoints 更改为 edge-optimized endpoints，可以在保持 Lambda 函数和数据库位于 eu-central-1 的同时，改善欧洲以外用户的 API 访问路径。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

**B. 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个加速器。将该加速器附加到 CloudFront 分配。**

这是不正确的，因为 CloudFront 分配不是 AWS Global Accelerator 支持的端点资源。文档中列出的端点资源类型包括 Application Load Balancers、Network Load Balancers、EC2 实例和 Elastic IP 地址等资源，而不包括 CloudFront 分配（[Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html)）。此外，CloudFront 已经使用 AWS 边缘站点进行内容交付，因此将 Global Accelerator 放在 CloudFront 前面并不是正确模式。

**D. 在全球范围内分布的另外两个位置预置整个堆栈。在 Aurora Serverless 集群上使用 global databases。**

这并不是最适合所述要求的方案。Aurora Global Database 提供一个主区域和只读的辅助区域。写入会发送到主 DB 集群，而辅助区域主要用于低延迟读取和灾难恢复（[Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。此应用程序会在上传期间写入文档元数据，因此添加只读的辅助数据库集群并不会消除写入路径对主区域的依赖。此选项也是规模大得多的多区域重新设计，并且没有说明完整应用程序堆栈所需的全球流量路由变更。

**E. 在 Lambda 函数和 Aurora Serverless 数据库之间添加 Amazon RDS proxy。**

对于延迟要求，这是不正确的。RDS Proxy 对于连接池、复用、处理连接激增，以及降低无服务器和事件驱动型应用程序（例如 Lambda 支持的 API）的数据库连接开销非常有用（[RDS Proxy usage scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)）。但是，它不会降低欧洲以外用户在上传文档或调用托管于 eu-central-1 的 API 时遇到的地理网络延迟。

因此，正确答案是 **A 和 C**：使用 **S3 Transfer Acceleration with signed URLs** 进行全球文档上传，并对全球分布的 API 客户端使用 **edge-optimized API Gateway endpoints**。

en.question: An adventure company has launched a new feature on its mobile app. Users can use the feature to upload their hiking and rafting photos and videos anytime. The photos and videos are stored in Amazon S3 Standard storage in an S3 bucket and are served through Amazon CloudFront. The company needs to optimize the cost of the storage. A solutions architect discovers that most of the uploaded photos and videos are accessed infrequently after 30 days. However, some of the uploaded photos and videos are accessed frequently after 30 days. The solutions architect needs to implement a solution that maintains millisecond retrieval availability of the photos and videos at the lowest possible cost. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition image objects and video objects from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
options.C: Replace Amazon S3 with an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.D: Add a Cache-Control: max-age header to the S3 image objects and S3 video objects. Set the header to 30 days.

en.explanation:
The workload stores user-uploaded photos and videos in S3 and serves them through CloudFront. The key requirements are to **reduce S3 storage cost**, handle **mixed/unknown access patterns after 30 days** (most objects become infrequent, but some remain frequent), and maintain **millisecond retrieval**.

**Correct answer: A. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering on the S3 bucket.**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed for changing or unknown access patterns. AWS documentation states that objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering start in the Frequent Access tier, and if an object is not accessed for **30 consecutive days**, it automatically moves to the **Infrequent Access tier**. Both the Frequent Access and Infrequent Access tiers provide **low-latency and high-throughput performance**. The same documentation also notes that the Archive Instant Access tier provides millisecond access, while the optional Archive Access and Deep Archive Access tiers should be enabled only for asynchronously accessed data because restore is required. Therefore, using S3 Intelligent-Tiering without enabling the optional asynchronous archive tiers lets frequently accessed objects remain in a frequent tier, moves infrequently accessed objects to lower-cost tiers, and preserves millisecond retrieval for the media objects ([AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.**  
  This would reduce storage cost, but it does **not** meet the millisecond retrieval requirement. AWS documentation states that S3 Glacier Deep Archive is archival, is not available for real-time access, and requires a restore request before access. Standard retrieval typically restores within 12 hours, and bulk retrieval within 48 hours; the comparison table lists S3 Glacier Deep Archive retrieval as **9 to 48 hours**, not milliseconds ([AWS S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

- **C. Replace Amazon S3 with Amazon EFS mounted on EC2 instances.**  
  This changes the storage architecture from highly scalable object storage to a file system for EC2-based workloads. It does not directly optimize S3 object storage cost for CloudFront-served media, and it introduces EC2/EFS operational overhead. It also does not solve the mixed access-pattern problem as directly as S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

- **D. Add a `Cache-Control: max-age` header set to 30 days.**  
  Cache-Control affects how content is cached by CloudFront/viewers and can reduce repeated origin requests, but it does not change the underlying **S3 storage class** or reduce the storage cost of objects stored in S3 Standard. AWS CloudFront documentation shows Cache-Control headers being used to control cache behavior in responses, not as an S3 storage cost optimization mechanism ([CloudFront Cache-Control header example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/example_cloudfront_functions_add_cache_control_header_section.html)).

Therefore, **S3 Intelligent-Tiering** is the best fit because it automatically optimizes storage cost across changing access patterns while maintaining low-latency/millisecond access for active and infrequently accessed objects.

zh.question: 一家探险公司在其移动应用上推出了一项新功能。用户可以随时使用该功能上传他们的徒步和漂流照片及视频。这些照片和视频存储在一个 S3 存储桶中的 Amazon S3 Standard 存储中，并通过 Amazon CloudFront 提供服务。公司需要优化存储成本。一名解决方案架构师发现，大多数上传的照片和视频在 30 天后访问频率较低。然而，有些上传的照片和视频在 30 天后仍被频繁访问。该解决方案架构师需要实施一种解决方案，以尽可能低的成本保持照片和视频的毫秒级检索可用性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。
options.B: 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在 30 天后将图像对象和视频对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 将 Amazon S3 替换为挂载在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。
options.D: 向 S3 图像对象和 S3 视频对象添加 Cache-Control: max-age 标头。将该标头设置为 30 天。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载将用户上传的照片和视频存储在 S3 中，并通过 CloudFront 提供服务。关键要求是**降低 S3 存储成本**，处理**30 天后的混合/未知访问模式**（大多数对象变为低频访问，但有些仍保持频繁访问），并保持**毫秒级检索**。

**正确答案：A. 在 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering 专为变化或未知的访问模式而设计。AWS 文档指出，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中的对象最初位于 Frequent Access 层，如果某个对象连续 **30 天**未被访问，它会自动移动到 **Infrequent Access 层**。Frequent Access 和 Infrequent Access 层都提供**低延迟和高吞吐量性能**。同一文档还指出，Archive Instant Access 层提供毫秒级访问，而可选的 Archive Access 和 Deep Archive Access 层只应为异步访问的数据启用，因为需要还原。因此，在不启用可选异步归档层的情况下使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，可以让频繁访问的对象保留在频繁访问层，将低频访问对象移动到成本更低的层，并为媒体对象保留毫秒级检索能力（[AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。**  
  这会降低存储成本，但**不**满足毫秒级检索要求。AWS 文档指出，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是归档存储，不能用于实时访问，并且访问前需要发起还原请求。标准检索通常在 12 小时内还原，批量检索在 48 小时内还原；对比表中列出的 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 检索时间为 **9 到 48 小时**，而不是毫秒级（[AWS S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

- **C. 将 Amazon S3 替换为挂载在 EC2 实例上的 Amazon EFS。**  
  这会将存储架构从高度可扩展的对象存储更改为面向基于 EC2 的工作负载的文件系统。它不能直接优化通过 CloudFront 提供服务的媒体的 S3 对象存储成本，并且会引入 EC2/EFS 运营开销。它也不能像 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 那样直接解决混合访问模式问题。

- **D. 添加设置为 30 天的 `Cache-Control: max-age` 标头。**  
  Cache-Control 影响 CloudFront/查看器缓存内容的方式，并且可以减少重复的源站请求，但它不会改变底层 **S3 存储类**，也不会降低存储在 S3 Standard 中的对象的存储成本。AWS CloudFront 文档展示了 Cache-Control 标头用于控制响应中的缓存行为，而不是作为 S3 存储成本优化机制（[CloudFront Cache-Control header example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/example_cloudfront_functions_add_cache_control_header_section.html)）。

因此，**S3 Intelligent-Tiering** 是最佳选择，因为它可以在不断变化的访问模式下自动优化存储成本，同时为活跃和低频访问的对象保持低延迟/毫秒级访问。

en.question: A company uses Amazon S3 to store files and images in a variety of storage classes. The company's S3 costs have increased substantially during the past year. A solutions architect needs to review data trends for the past 12 months and identity the appropriate storage class for the objects. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Download AWS Cost and Usage Reports for the last 12 months of S3 usage. Review AWS Trusted Advisor recommendations for cost savings.
options.B: Use S3 storage class analysis. Import data trends into an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to analyze storage trends.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens. Upgrade the default dashboard to include advanced metrics for storage trends.
options.D: Use Access Analyzer for S3. Download the Access Analyzer for S3 report for the last 12 months. Import the .csv file to an Amazon QuickSight dashboard.

en.explanation:
The requirement is to review **S3 data trends for the past 12 months** and determine the appropriate storage class for objects to reduce S3 costs. The key differentiator is the need for **12 months of historical storage/activity trends**, not just a point-in-time cost report or a limited Standard-to-Standard-IA analysis.

**Correct answer: C. Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens. Upgrade the default dashboard to include advanced metrics for storage trends.**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens is designed for storage analytics: it provides visibility into object-storage usage and activity, identifies cost-optimization opportunities, and includes an interactive dashboard to visualize insights and trends. The dashboard can drill down by organization, account, Region, **storage class**, bucket, prefix, or Storage Lens group. AWS also states that Storage Lens metrics are retained for 15 months, but query availability depends on the metrics tier: free metrics are queryable for 14 days, while **advanced metrics are queryable for 15 months**. Therefore, upgrading the dashboard to advanced metrics satisfies the need to review the past 12 months of trends. See [Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html).

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Download AWS Cost and Usage Reports and review Trusted Advisor recommendations — Incorrect.**  
Cost and Usage Reports can show billing and usage charges, and Trusted Advisor can provide cost-savings checks, but this does not provide S3 object-level or storage-class-level storage/activity trend analytics for deciding the appropriate storage class over 12 months. This option is cost-reporting focused, not S3 storage analytics focused.

**B. Use S3 Storage Class Analysis and import trends into QuickSight — Incorrect.**  
S3 Storage Class Analysis does analyze access patterns and can export daily data for BI tools. However, AWS explicitly states that Storage Class Analysis is intended to help determine when to transition less frequently accessed **STANDARD** storage to **STANDARD_IA**, and that it **only provides recommendations for Standard to Standard-IA classes**. The company already uses a variety of storage classes and needs a broader 12-month trend review. Storage Class Analysis is therefore too narrow compared with S3 Storage Lens advanced metrics. See [Amazon S3 analytics – Storage Class Analysis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/analytics-storage-class.html).

**D. Use Access Analyzer for S3 and import the CSV into QuickSight — Incorrect.**  
IAM Access Analyzer for S3 is for reviewing buckets that allow external/public or cross-account access and downloading findings for auditing. It is not a storage usage, activity trend, cost optimization, or storage class selection tool. See [Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html).

Therefore, the best solution is **C** because S3 Storage Lens with advanced metrics provides the required historical trend visibility for up to 15 months and supports storage-class-level cost optimization analysis.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 在多种存储类别中存储文件和图像。在过去一年中，该公司的 S3 成本大幅增加。解决方案架构师需要查看过去 12 个月的数据趋势，并确定对象适合的存储类别。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 下载过去 12 个月 S3 使用情况的 AWS Cost and Usage Reports。查看 AWS Trusted Advisor 的成本节省建议。
options.B: 使用 S3 storage class analysis。将数据趋势导入 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板以分析存储趋势。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens。升级默认控制面板，以包含用于存储趋势的高级指标。
options.D: 使用 Access Analyzer for S3。下载过去 12 个月的 Access Analyzer for S3 报告。将 .csv 文件导入 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板。

zh.explanation:
要求是查看**过去 12 个月的 S3 数据趋势**，并确定对象适合的存储类别，以降低 S3 成本。关键区别在于需要**12 个月的历史存储/活动趋势**，而不仅仅是某个时间点的成本报告或范围有限的 Standard 到 Standard-IA 分析。

**正确答案：C. 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens。升级默认控制面板，以包含用于存储趋势的高级指标。**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens 专为存储分析而设计：它提供对象存储使用情况和活动的可见性，识别成本优化机会，并包含交互式控制面板以可视化洞察和趋势。该控制面板可以按组织、账户、区域、**存储类别**、存储桶、前缀或 Storage Lens 组进行下钻。AWS 还说明，Storage Lens 指标会保留 15 个月，但查询可用性取决于指标层级：免费指标可查询 14 天，而**高级指标可查询 15 个月**。因此，将控制面板升级到高级指标可以满足查看过去 12 个月趋势的需求。请参阅 [Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html)。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 下载 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 并查看 Trusted Advisor 建议 — 不正确。**  
Cost and Usage Reports 可以显示账单和使用费用，Trusted Advisor 可以提供成本节省检查，但这并不能提供 S3 对象级别或存储类别级别的存储/活动趋势分析，用于在 12 个月范围内决定适当的存储类别。此选项侧重于成本报告，而不是 S3 存储分析。

**B. 使用 S3 Storage Class Analysis 并将趋势导入 QuickSight — 不正确。**  
S3 Storage Class Analysis 确实会分析访问模式，并且可以为 BI 工具导出每日数据。但是，AWS 明确说明 Storage Class Analysis 旨在帮助确定何时将访问频率较低的 **STANDARD** 存储转换为 **STANDARD_IA**，并且它**只提供 Standard 到 Standard-IA 类别的建议**。该公司已经使用多种存储类别，并且需要更广泛的 12 个月趋势回顾。因此，与 S3 Storage Lens 高级指标相比，Storage Class Analysis 范围过于狭窄。请参阅 [Amazon S3 analytics – Storage Class Analysis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/analytics-storage-class.html)。

**D. 使用 Access Analyzer for S3 并将 CSV 导入 QuickSight — 不正确。**  
IAM Access Analyzer for S3 用于查看允许外部/公开或跨账户访问的存储桶，并下载审计发现结果。它不是存储使用情况、活动趋势、成本优化或存储类别选择工具。请参阅 [Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)。

因此，最佳解决方案是 **C**，因为带高级指标的 S3 Storage Lens 提供所需的最长 15 个月历史趋势可见性，并支持存储类别级别的成本优化分析。

en.question: A company has its cloud infrastructure on AWS. A solutions architect needs to define the infrastructure as code. The infrastructure is currently deployed in one AWS Region. The company’s business expansion plan includes deployments in multiple Regions across multiple AWS accounts. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudFormation templates. Add IAM policies to control the various accounts, Deploy the templates across the multiple Regions.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations. Deploy AWS CloudFormation templates from the management account Use AWS Control Tower to manage deployments across accounts.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations and AWS CloudFormation StackSets. Deploy a Cloud Formation template from an account that has the necessary IAM permissions.
options.D: Use nested stacks with AWS CloudFormation templates. Change the Region by using nested stacks.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company wants to move from infrastructure that is currently deployed in one Region to **infrastructure as code deployed consistently across multiple AWS Regions and multiple AWS accounts**. The key requirement is centralized, repeatable deployment of CloudFormation-defined infrastructure across both account and Region boundaries.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Use AWS Organizations and AWS CloudFormation StackSets. Deploy a CloudFormation template from an account that has the necessary IAM permissions.**

This is the best fit. AWS CloudFormation StackSets is specifically designed for this use case: it extends CloudFormation stacks so that you can **create, update, or delete stacks across multiple AWS accounts and AWS Regions with a single operation**. AWS documentation states that, using an administrator account, you define and manage a CloudFormation template and use it to provision stacks into selected target accounts across specified Regions ([Managing stacks across accounts and Regions with StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)).

AWS Organizations also integrates with StackSets for service-managed permissions. The documentation explains that StackSets can deploy across accounts and Regions using AWS Organizations trusted access, and that the management account or delegated administrator accounts can create and manage service-managed StackSets for the organization ([Activate trusted access for StackSets with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-activate-trusted-access.html)).

Therefore, Organizations plus CloudFormation StackSets directly satisfies the requirement for IaC across multiple accounts and Regions.

## Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Use AWS CloudFormation templates. Add IAM policies to control the various accounts. Deploy the templates across the multiple Regions.**

CloudFormation templates are appropriate for infrastructure as code, and CloudFormation can be reused to provision infrastructure repeatedly across Regions ([What is CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). However, this option does not provide the centralized multi-account, multi-Region deployment mechanism that StackSets provides. Manually deploying templates and adding IAM policies is less scalable and does not meet the organizational deployment requirement as directly as StackSets.

**B. Use AWS Organizations. Deploy AWS CloudFormation templates from the management account. Use AWS Control Tower to manage deployments across accounts.**

AWS Organizations is relevant for managing multiple AWS accounts, but the option does not include CloudFormation StackSets, which is the CloudFormation feature built to deploy stacks across multiple accounts and Regions in a single operation. AWS Control Tower helps set up and govern a multi-account environment, but this question is specifically about defining and deploying infrastructure as code across accounts and Regions. StackSets is the required CloudFormation deployment mechanism.

**D. Use nested stacks with AWS CloudFormation templates. Change the Region by using nested stacks.**

Nested stacks are used to split large or repeated CloudFormation configurations into reusable template components. The documentation describes nested stacks as a way to reference dedicated templates from other templates and create a hierarchy of stacks ([Split a template into reusable pieces using nested stacks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html)). They are not a mechanism for deploying the same infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and Regions. Changing Regions by using nested stacks does not address the multi-account deployment requirement.

## Conclusion

The correct solution is **C: Use AWS Organizations and AWS CloudFormation StackSets** because StackSets is purpose-built to deploy CloudFormation-defined infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and multiple AWS Regions from an appropriately permissioned administrator or delegated administrator account.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上拥有其云基础设施。一名解决方案架构师需要将该基础设施定义为代码。该基础设施目前部署在一个 AWS 区域中。公司的业务扩展计划包括在多个 AWS 账户的多个区域中进行部署。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板。添加 IAM 策略以控制各个账户，并在多个区域中部署这些模板。
options.B: 使用 AWS Organizations。从管理账户部署 AWS CloudFormation 模板。使用 AWS Control Tower 管理跨账户部署。
options.C: 使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS CloudFormation StackSets。从具有必要 IAM 权限的账户部署 CloudFormation 模板。
options.D: 在 AWS CloudFormation 模板中使用嵌套堆栈。通过使用嵌套堆栈更改区域。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司希望从目前部署在一个区域中的基础设施，迁移到**以基础设施即代码的方式在多个 AWS 区域和多个 AWS 账户中一致部署的基础设施**。关键要求是跨账户和区域边界集中、可重复地部署由 CloudFormation 定义的基础设施。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS CloudFormation StackSets。从具有必要 IAM 权限的账户部署 CloudFormation 模板。**

这是最合适的选择。AWS CloudFormation StackSets 专门为此用例而设计：它扩展了 CloudFormation 堆栈，使你能够通过**单个操作在多个 AWS 账户和 AWS 区域中创建、更新或删除堆栈**。AWS 文档指出，使用管理员账户，你可以定义和管理 CloudFormation 模板，并使用它在指定区域中的选定目标账户内预置堆栈（[Managing stacks across accounts and Regions with StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)）。

AWS Organizations 还与 StackSets 集成以实现服务托管权限。文档解释说，StackSets 可以使用 AWS Organizations 可信访问跨账户和区域进行部署，并且管理账户或委派管理员账户可以为组织创建和管理服务托管的 StackSets（[Activate trusted access for StackSets with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-activate-trusted-access.html)）。

因此，Organizations 加 CloudFormation StackSets 直接满足跨多个账户和区域实现 IaC 的要求。

## 其他选项不正确的原因

**A. 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板。添加 IAM 策略以控制各个账户。在多个区域中部署这些模板。**

CloudFormation 模板适用于基础设施即代码，并且 CloudFormation 可以重复用于在多个区域中预置基础设施（[What is CloudFormation?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。但是，此选项没有提供 StackSets 所提供的集中式多账户、多区域部署机制。手动部署模板并添加 IAM 策略的可扩展性较差，也不像 StackSets 那样直接满足组织级部署要求。

**B. 使用 AWS Organizations。从管理账户部署 AWS CloudFormation 模板。使用 AWS Control Tower 管理跨账户部署。**

AWS Organizations 与管理多个 AWS 账户相关，但该选项未包含 CloudFormation StackSets，而 CloudFormation StackSets 是专为通过单个操作跨多个账户和区域部署堆栈而构建的 CloudFormation 功能。AWS Control Tower 可帮助设置和治理多账户环境，但本题专门关注的是跨账户和区域定义并部署基础设施即代码。StackSets 才是所需的 CloudFormation 部署机制。

**D. 在 AWS CloudFormation 模板中使用嵌套堆栈。通过使用嵌套堆栈更改区域。**

嵌套堆栈用于将大型或重复的 CloudFormation 配置拆分为可复用的模板组件。文档将嵌套堆栈描述为一种从其他模板引用专用模板并创建堆栈层次结构的方式（[Split a template into reusable pieces using nested stacks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html)）。它们不是用于在多个 AWS 账户和区域中部署相同基础设施的机制。通过使用嵌套堆栈更改区域并不能解决多账户部署要求。

## 结论

正确解决方案是 **C：使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS CloudFormation StackSets**，因为 StackSets 专为从具有适当权限的管理员或委派管理员账户跨多个 AWS 账户和多个 AWS 区域部署 CloudFormation 定义的基础设施而构建。

en.question: A company has its cloud infrastructure on AWS. A solutions architect needs to define the infrastructure as code. The infrastructure is currently deployed in one AWS Region. The company’s business expansion plan includes deployments in multiple Regions across multiple AWS accounts. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudFormation templates. Add IAM policies to control the various accounts, Deploy the templates across the multiple Regions.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations. Deploy AWS CloudFormation templates from the management account Use AWS Control Tower to manage deployments across accounts.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations and AWS CloudFormation StackSets. Deploy a Cloud Formation template from an account that has the necessary IAM permissions.
options.D: Use nested stacks with AWS CloudFormation templates. Change the Region by using nested stacks.

en.explanation:
The scenario asks for an infrastructure-as-code approach that can expand from a single Region to **multiple AWS Regions across multiple AWS accounts**.

**Correct answer: C. Use AWS Organizations and AWS CloudFormation StackSets. Deploy a CloudFormation template from an account that has the necessary IAM permissions.**

AWS CloudFormation **StackSets** is specifically designed for this use case. The official documentation states that StackSets extends CloudFormation by allowing you to create, update, or delete stacks **across multiple accounts and AWS Regions with a single operation**, using an administrator account to define and manage the template and provision stacks into selected target accounts and Regions ([AWS CloudFormation StackSets documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)).

Using AWS Organizations with StackSets is also appropriate because StackSets with service-managed permissions can target an entire organization or specific OUs, and operations can be initiated from the management account or delegated administrator accounts, subject to the IAM permissions of the principal used ([StackSets with service-managed permissions considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)). This directly matches the requirement to deploy infrastructure as code across multiple accounts and Regions.

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Use AWS CloudFormation templates. Add IAM policies to control the various accounts. Deploy the templates across the multiple Regions.**  
  Plain CloudFormation templates can define infrastructure, but this option does not provide the centralized multi-account, multi-Region deployment capability that StackSets provides. IAM policies alone do not orchestrate template deployment across accounts and Regions.

- **B. Use AWS Organizations. Deploy AWS CloudFormation templates from the management account. Use AWS Control Tower to manage deployments across accounts.**  
  AWS Organizations is relevant for account structure, and Control Tower can help govern a multi-account environment, but this option does not identify the CloudFormation feature intended for multi-account, multi-Region stack deployment. StackSets is the purpose-built CloudFormation mechanism for this requirement.

- **D. Use nested stacks with AWS CloudFormation templates. Change the Region by using nested stacks.**  
  Nested stacks are for splitting reusable CloudFormation configurations into separate templates and creating a hierarchy of stacks. The documentation describes nested stacks as a way to organize repeated or complex configurations by referencing dedicated templates using `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` ([nested stacks documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html)). They are not a mechanism for deploying the same infrastructure across multiple accounts and Regions.

Therefore, **C** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上拥有其云基础设施。解决方案架构师需要将该基础设施定义为代码。该基础设施目前部署在一个 AWS 区域中。公司的业务扩展计划包括在多个 AWS 账户的多个区域中进行部署。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板。添加 IAM 策略来控制各个账户，将模板部署到多个区域。
options.B: 使用 AWS Organizations。从管理账户部署 AWS CloudFormation 模板。使用 AWS Control Tower 管理跨账户部署。
options.C: 使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS CloudFormation StackSets。从具有必要 IAM 权限的账户部署 CloudFormation 模板。
options.D: 使用包含 AWS CloudFormation 模板的嵌套堆栈。通过使用嵌套堆栈更改区域。

zh.explanation:
该场景要求采用一种基础设施即代码方法，能够从单个区域扩展到**跨多个 AWS 账户的多个 AWS 区域**。

**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS CloudFormation StackSets。从具有必要 IAM 权限的账户部署 CloudFormation 模板。**

AWS CloudFormation **StackSets** 专门为此用例而设计。官方文档说明，StackSets 扩展了 CloudFormation，允许你通过一次操作在**多个账户和 AWS 区域中**创建、更新或删除堆栈，使用管理员账户定义和管理模板，并将堆栈预置到选定的目标账户和区域中（[AWS CloudFormation StackSets documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)）。

将 AWS Organizations 与 StackSets 结合使用也是合适的，因为采用服务托管权限的 StackSets 可以面向整个组织或特定 OU，并且可以从管理账户或委派管理员账户发起操作，具体取决于所使用主体的 IAM 权限（[StackSets with service-managed permissions considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)）。这直接符合跨多个账户和区域以基础设施即代码方式部署基础设施的要求。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

- **A. 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板。添加 IAM 策略来控制各个账户。将模板部署到多个区域。**  
  普通 CloudFormation 模板可以定义基础设施，但此选项没有提供 StackSets 所提供的集中式多账户、多区域部署能力。仅靠 IAM 策略无法编排跨账户和区域的模板部署。

- **B. 使用 AWS Organizations。从管理账户部署 AWS CloudFormation 模板。使用 AWS Control Tower 管理跨账户部署。**  
  AWS Organizations 与账户结构相关，Control Tower 可以帮助治理多账户环境，但此选项没有指出用于多账户、多区域堆栈部署的 CloudFormation 功能。StackSets 是专为此需求构建的 CloudFormation 机制。

- **D. 使用包含 AWS CloudFormation 模板的嵌套堆栈。通过使用嵌套堆栈更改区域。**  
  嵌套堆栈用于将可复用的 CloudFormation 配置拆分为单独的模板，并创建堆栈层次结构。文档将嵌套堆栈描述为一种通过使用 `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` 引用专用模板来组织重复或复杂配置的方法（[nested stacks documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html)）。它们不是用于跨多个账户和区域部署相同基础设施的机制。

因此，**C** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company plans to refactor a monolithic application into a modern application design deployed on AWS. The CI/CD pipeline needs to be upgraded to support the modern design for the application with the following requirements: • It should allow changes to be released several times every hour. • It should be able to roll back the changes as quickly as possible. Which design will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a CI/CD pipeline that incorporates AMIs to contain the application and their configurations. Deploy the application by replacing Amazon EC2 instances.
options.B: Specify AWS Elastic Beanstalk to stage in a secondary environment as the deployment target for the CI/CD pipeline of the application. To deploy, swap the staging and production environment URLs.
options.C: Use AWS Systems Manager to re-provision the infrastructure for each deployment. Update the Amazon EC2 user data to pull the latest code artifact from Amazon S3 and use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to point to the new environment.
options.D: Roll out the application updates as part of an Auto Scaling event using prebuilt AMIs. Use new versions of the AMIs to add instances. and phase out all instances that use the previous AMI version with the configured termination policy during a deployment event.

en.explanation:
The question asks for a CI/CD deployment design that supports very frequent releases and the fastest practical rollback. This is essentially asking for a blue/green deployment pattern where the new version is deployed and tested separately, then production traffic is switched with minimal disruption; rollback is the reverse traffic switch.

**Correct answer: B. Specify AWS Elastic Beanstalk to stage in a secondary environment as the deployment target for the CI/CD pipeline. To deploy, swap the staging and production environment URLs.**

AWS Elastic Beanstalk explicitly supports blue/green deployments by deploying the new application version to a separate environment, testing it there, and then swapping the environment CNAMEs. The AWS documentation states that this redirects traffic to the new version instantly and avoids the availability impact of in-place updates. The documented procedure is to clone or launch a new environment, deploy the new application version to that environment, test it, and then choose **Swap environment URLs**. Elastic Beanstalk then swaps the CNAME records of the old and new environments, redirecting traffic from the old version to the new version. This directly matches the requirement for frequent releases and very fast rollback: if the new version has a problem, the environments can be swapped back. See [Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Deploy by replacing EC2 instances with AMI-based versions** — AMI-based deployments can be useful for immutable infrastructure, but replacing instances is slower than swapping traffic between two already-running environments. It also requires instance launch, health checks, and capacity replacement for every release, which is not ideal for releases several times per hour or for the fastest rollback.

- **C. Use Systems Manager to re-provision infrastructure for each deployment and Route 53 weighted routing** — Weighted routing can support traffic shifting, but this option includes re-provisioning infrastructure for each deployment and relying on EC2 user data to pull artifacts. That is a more manual and slower deployment mechanism than Elastic Beanstalk's managed blue/green environment swap. It also adds operational complexity that is unnecessary when Elastic Beanstalk provides the required deployment pattern directly.

- **D. Roll out updates through Auto Scaling events using new AMIs and terminate old AMI instances** — This is closer to an immutable rollout, but it depends on Auto Scaling replacement behavior and phasing out old instances. It is not as fast as a URL/CNAME swap between two validated environments, and rollback would likely require another scaling/replacement event or preserving and reintroducing prior instances. This does not meet the requirement to roll back as quickly as possible.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer because Elastic Beanstalk blue/green deployments with environment URL swapping provide a managed, low-downtime deployment mechanism and rapid rollback path.

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个单体应用程序重构为部署在 AWS 上的现代应用程序设计。CI/CD 管道需要升级，以支持该应用程序的现代设计，并满足以下要求：• 应允许每小时发布多次变更。• 应能够尽可能快速地回滚变更。哪种设计能满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署一个 CI/CD 管道，将 AMI 纳入其中以包含应用程序及其配置。通过替换 Amazon EC2 实例来部署应用程序。
options.B: 指定 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在辅助环境中进行暂存，作为应用程序 CI/CD 管道的部署目标。部署时，交换暂存环境和生产环境的 URL。
options.C: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 为每次部署重新预置基础设施。更新 Amazon EC2 用户数据，以从 Amazon S3 拉取最新的代码构件，并使用 Amazon Route 53 加权路由指向新环境。
options.D: 使用预构建的 AMI，将应用程序更新作为 Auto Scaling 事件的一部分推出。使用新版本的 AMI 添加实例，并在部署事件期间通过配置的终止策略逐步淘汰所有使用先前 AMI 版本的实例。

zh.explanation:
该题要求一种 CI/CD 部署设计，能够支持非常频繁的发布以及实践中最快的回滚。这本质上是在询问蓝/绿部署模式：新版本被单独部署并测试，然后以最小中断切换生产流量；回滚则是反向切换流量。

**正确答案：B。指定 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在辅助环境中进行暂存，作为 CI/CD 管道的部署目标。部署时，交换暂存环境和生产环境的 URL。**

AWS Elastic Beanstalk 明确支持蓝/绿部署：将新的应用程序版本部署到单独的环境，在那里进行测试，然后交换环境 CNAME。AWS 文档说明，这会立即将流量重定向到新版本，并避免就地更新对可用性的影响。文档中的流程是克隆或启动一个新环境，将新的应用程序版本部署到该环境，进行测试，然后选择 **Swap environment URLs**。随后 Elastic Beanstalk 会交换旧环境和新环境的 CNAME 记录，将流量从旧版本重定向到新版本。这直接符合频繁发布和非常快速回滚的要求：如果新版本有问题，可以将环境交换回来。请参阅 [Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **A. 通过用基于 AMI 的版本替换 EC2 实例来部署** — 基于 AMI 的部署对于不可变基础设施可能很有用，但替换实例比在两个已运行环境之间切换流量更慢。它还要求每次发布都进行实例启动、运行状况检查和容量替换，不适合每小时多次发布，也不适合最快速回滚。

- **C. 使用 Systems Manager 为每次部署重新预置基础设施，并使用 Route 53 加权路由** — 加权路由可以支持流量切换，但该选项包括为每次部署重新预置基础设施，并依赖 EC2 用户数据拉取构件。相比 Elastic Beanstalk 托管的蓝/绿环境交换，这是一种更手动且更慢的部署机制。它还增加了不必要的运维复杂性，因为 Elastic Beanstalk 已直接提供所需的部署模式。

- **D. 使用新 AMI 通过 Auto Scaling 事件推出更新并终止旧 AMI 实例** — 这更接近不可变发布，但它依赖 Auto Scaling 替换行为以及逐步淘汰旧实例。它不如在两个已验证环境之间进行 URL/CNAME 交换那么快，并且回滚可能需要另一次扩缩容/替换事件，或者保留并重新引入先前的实例。这不满足尽可能快速回滚的要求。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为使用 Elastic Beanstalk 蓝/绿部署并交换环境 URL，可提供托管的低停机部署机制和快速回滚路径。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect is designing VPC infrastructure in an AWS Region where the application needs to access an Amazon Aurora DB Cluster. The EC2 instances are all associated with the same security group. The DB cluster is associated with its own security group. The solutions architect needs to add rules to the security groups to provide the application with least privilege access to the DB Cluster. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add an inbound rule to the EC2 instances' security group. Specify the DB cluster's security group as the source over the default Aurora port.
options.B: Add an outbound rule to the EC2 instances' security group. Specify the DB cluster's security group as the destination over the default Aurora port.
options.C: Add an inbound rule to the DB cluster's security group. Specify the EC2 instances' security group as the source over the default Aurora port.
options.D: Add an outbound rule to the DB cluster's security group. Specify the EC2 instances' security group as the destination over the default Aurora port.
options.E: Add an outbound rule to the DB cluster's security group. Specify the EC2 instances' security group as the destination over the ephemeral ports.

en.explanation:
The application runs on EC2 instances and initiates database connections to an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. To meet **least privilege**, the security groups should allow only the required traffic direction and port: EC2 instances must be allowed to send traffic to the DB security group on the Aurora database port, and the DB security group must allow inbound database traffic from the EC2 security group.

**Correct answers: B and C.**

- **B. Add an outbound rule to the EC2 instances' security group. Specify the DB cluster's security group as the destination over the default Aurora port.**  
  This is required for least privilege if the EC2 security group outbound rules are being restricted. AWS VPC security group rules control outbound traffic allowed to leave associated resources, and an outbound rule can use another security group as the destination. AWS states that when a security group is referenced in an outbound rule, instances associated with the rule's security group can send outbound traffic to private IPs of instances/network interfaces associated with the referenced security group over the specified protocol and port ([Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). Amazon RDS automatic EC2 connectivity similarly creates an EC2-side security group with an outbound rule targeting the RDS database security group, allowing the EC2 instance to send traffic to the database ([RDS EC2 connectivity overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/ec2-rds-connect.html)).

- **C. Add an inbound rule to the DB cluster's security group. Specify the EC2 instances' security group as the source over the default Aurora port.**  
  This allows the Aurora DB cluster to receive database connections from only the EC2 instances that are members of the EC2 security group. AWS's database server rule examples say to specify as the source a security group ID for the group of instances that access the database, and list default database ports including MySQL/Aurora port 3306 and PostgreSQL port 5432 ([Database server rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)). The RDS EC2 connectivity documentation also describes creating an RDS-side security group with an inbound rule whose source is the EC2 instance's VPC security group ([RDS EC2 connectivity overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/ec2-rds-connect.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect.** An inbound rule on the EC2 instances' security group from the DB cluster security group over the Aurora port would allow the DB side to initiate inbound connections to EC2 on a database port. The application-to-database connection is initiated from EC2 to Aurora, so this does not grant the required initial access to the DB cluster and is not least privilege.

- **D is incorrect.** An outbound rule on the DB cluster security group to the EC2 security group over the Aurora port would allow the database to initiate outbound traffic to EC2 on the database port. The DB cluster does not need to initiate the application connection to EC2.

- **E is incorrect.** An outbound rule on the DB cluster security group to EC2 ephemeral ports is unnecessary for normal client-initiated database connections. Security group rules are connection tracked, and the question asks for least-privilege application access to the DB cluster, which is satisfied by EC2 outbound to the DB port plus DB inbound from EC2 on that port—not by allowing database-initiated outbound traffic to EC2 ephemeral ports.

Although newly created security groups include a default allow-all outbound rule, AWS explicitly notes that this rule can be removed and replaced with more specific outbound rules; least privilege therefore favors the specific EC2 outbound rule in option B rather than relying on unrestricted outbound access ([Security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。解决方案架构师正在一个 AWS 区域中设计 VPC 基础设施，该应用程序需要访问 Amazon Aurora DB Cluster。所有 EC2 实例都关联到同一个安全组。该 DB cluster 关联到自己的安全组。解决方案架构师需要向这些安全组添加规则，以向应用程序提供对 DB Cluster 的最小权限访问。以下哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 向 EC2 实例的安全组添加一条入站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 DB cluster 的安全组指定为源。
options.B: 向 EC2 实例的安全组添加一条出站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 DB cluster 的安全组指定为目标。
options.C: 向 DB cluster 的安全组添加一条入站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 EC2 实例的安全组指定为源。
options.D: 向 DB cluster 的安全组添加一条出站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 EC2 实例的安全组指定为目标。
options.E: 向 DB cluster 的安全组添加一条出站规则。将 EC2 实例的安全组指定为临时端口上的目标。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序运行在 EC2 实例上，并向 Amazon Aurora DB cluster 发起数据库连接。为了满足**最小权限**，安全组应只允许所需的流量方向和端口：EC2 实例必须被允许在 Aurora 数据库端口上向 DB 安全组发送流量，并且 DB 安全组必须允许来自 EC2 安全组的入站数据库流量。

**正确答案：B 和 C。**

- **B. 向 EC2 实例的安全组添加一条出站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 DB cluster 的安全组指定为目标。**  
  如果正在限制 EC2 安全组的出站规则，这对于最小权限是必需的。AWS VPC 安全组规则控制允许离开关联资源的出站流量，并且出站规则可以使用另一个安全组作为目标。AWS 说明，当在出站规则中引用安全组时，与该规则的安全组关联的实例可以通过指定协议和端口，向与被引用安全组关联的实例/网络接口的私有 IP 发送出站流量（[Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。Amazon RDS 自动 EC2 连接同样会创建一个 EC2 侧安全组，其中包含以 RDS 数据库安全组为目标的出站规则，允许 EC2 实例向数据库发送流量（[RDS EC2 connectivity overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/ec2-rds-connect.html)）。

- **C. 向 DB cluster 的安全组添加一条入站规则。在默认 Aurora 端口上，将 EC2 实例的安全组指定为源。**  
  这允许 Aurora DB cluster 只接收来自属于 EC2 安全组成员的 EC2 实例的数据库连接。AWS 的数据库服务器规则示例说明，应将访问数据库的实例组的安全组 ID 指定为源，并列出默认数据库端口，包括 MySQL/Aurora 端口 3306 和 PostgreSQL 端口 5432（[Database server rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)）。RDS EC2 连接文档也描述了创建一个 RDS 侧安全组，其中包含一条入站规则，其源是 EC2 实例的 VPC 安全组（[RDS EC2 connectivity overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/ec2-rds-connect.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 不正确。** 在 EC2 实例的安全组上添加一条来自 DB cluster 安全组、通过 Aurora 端口的入站规则，会允许 DB 侧在数据库端口上向 EC2 发起入站连接。应用程序到数据库的连接是从 EC2 发起到 Aurora 的，因此这不会授予对 DB cluster 所需的初始访问权限，也不符合最小权限。

- **D 不正确。** 在 DB cluster 安全组上添加一条到 EC2 安全组、通过 Aurora 端口的出站规则，会允许数据库在数据库端口上向 EC2 发起出站流量。DB cluster 不需要向 EC2 发起应用程序连接。

- **E 不正确。** 对于正常的客户端发起的数据库连接，不需要在 DB cluster 安全组上添加一条到 EC2 临时端口的出站规则。安全组规则会进行连接跟踪，而且题目要求的是对 DB cluster 的最小权限应用程序访问，这通过 EC2 到 DB 端口的出站规则加上 DB 允许来自 EC2 的该端口入站规则即可满足，而不是通过允许数据库发起到 EC2 临时端口的出站流量来满足。

虽然新创建的安全组包含一条默认允许所有出站流量的规则，但 AWS 明确指出可以删除该规则并替换为更具体的出站规则；因此，最小权限更倾向于选项 B 中的特定 EC2 出站规则，而不是依赖不受限制的出站访问（[Security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to change its internal cloud billing strategy for each of its business units. Currently, the cloud governance team shares reports for overall cloud spending with the head of each business unit. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage the separate AWS accounts for each business unit. The existing tagging standard in Organizations includes the application, environment, and owner. The cloud governance team wants a centralized solution so each business unit receives monthly reports on its cloud spending. The solution should also send notifications for any cloud spending that exceeds a set threshold. Which solution is the MOST cost-effective way to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Budgets in each account and configure budget alerts that are grouped by application, environment, and owner. Add each business unit to an Amazon SNS topic for each alert. Use Cost Explorer in each account to create monthly reports for each business unit.
options.B: Configure AWS Budgets in the organization's management account and configure budget alerts that are grouped by application, environment, and owner. Add each business unit to an Amazon SNS topic for each alert. Use Cost Explorer in the organization's management account to create monthly reports for each business unit.
options.C: Configure AWS Budgets in each account and configure budget alerts that are grouped by application, environment, and owner. Add each business unit to an Amazon SNS topic for each alert. Use the AWS Billing and Cost Management dashboard in each account to create monthly reports for each business unit.
options.D: Enable AWS Cost and Usage Reports in the organization's management account and configure reports grouped by application, environment. and owner. Create an AWS Lambda function that processes AWS Cost and Usage Reports, sends budget alerts, and sends monthly reports to each business unit's email list.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has multiple AWS accounts under AWS Organizations, with each business unit in separate accounts and existing cost-allocation tagging standards (`application`, `environment`, `owner`). The cloud governance team wants a **centralized** and **cost-effective** way to provide monthly spending reporting and threshold-based notifications.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Configure AWS Budgets in the organization's management account and configure budget alerts that are grouped by application, environment, and owner. Add each business unit to an Amazon SNS topic for each alert. Use Cost Explorer in the organization's management account to create monthly reports for each business unit.**

This is the best answer because it centralizes cost monitoring and reporting in the AWS Organizations management account:

* AWS Budgets can track costs and usage and send notifications when costs approach or exceed defined thresholds. The documentation states that cost budgets can set spending limits and receive alerts, and that notifications can be sent to email, Amazon SNS topics, or both ([AWS Budgets overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)).
* Budgets can be created in the management account, and a management account can create a budget that tracks a specific member account's cost ([AWS Budgets overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)).
* Budget scope supports filters, including **Linked account** and **Tag** filters. Tags can be used to organize and track resource costs at a detailed level, provided the tags are activated as cost allocation tags ([Budget filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create-filters.html)).
* AWS Budgets supports Amazon SNS alerts, and SNS topics can be used for budget notifications ([Creating an Amazon SNS topic for budget notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-sns-policy.html)).
* The Organizations management account has full access to Billing and Cost Management information for both the management account and member accounts, and can view all costs in Cost Explorer ([Cost Explorer access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-access.html)).
* Cost Explorer is appropriate for monthly reporting because it can view and analyze costs and usage, supports monthly historical analysis, and the UI is free of charge ([Cost Explorer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)). Cost Explorer reports can also be customized and saved ([Cost Explorer reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-reports.html)).

Therefore, using AWS Budgets and Cost Explorer centrally from the Organizations management account avoids per-account configuration overhead and is the most cost-effective operational model.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Configure AWS Budgets and Cost Explorer in each account

This would work functionally for individual accounts, but it is not the most cost-effective or centralized solution. It requires the governance team to configure and maintain budgets, SNS alerts, and Cost Explorer reports separately in every business-unit account. Since the management account can view all costs and create budgets that track member account costs, duplicating this setup across accounts adds unnecessary administrative overhead.

### C. Use AWS Budgets in each account and the Billing and Cost Management dashboard in each account
