Importantly, when `Terminate` is suspended, **`ReplaceUnhealthy` is inactive but `HealthCheck` is not**. This means instances can still be marked unhealthy, but Auto Scaling will not terminate/replace them while `Terminate` remains suspended ([AWS docs: How suspended processes affect other processes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/understand-how-suspending-processes-affects-other-processes.html)). That preserves the failing instance for analysis.

Then, because Session Manager is already configured and the SSM Agent is running, the architect can start a Session Manager session to the managed EC2 instance. AWS documentation confirms that Session Manager can be used to start a session with a managed node, and after connection the user can run bash commands on Linux instances ([AWS docs: Start a session](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-working-with-sessions-start.html)).

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Suspend the Auto Scaling group’s `HealthCheck` scaling process. Use Session Manager to log in to an instance that is marked as unhealthy.**

Suspending `HealthCheck` stops Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling from marking instances unhealthy based on EC2 or Elastic Load Balancing health checks ([AWS docs: How suspended processes affect other processes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/understand-how-suspending-processes-affects-other-processes.html)). That is not ideal here because the architect needs to identify and inspect instances that are failing. It also does not directly address the core problem: instances that have already been marked unhealthy are being terminated. Suspending `Terminate` is the direct control that prevents those terminations while preserving health-check visibility.

**B. Enable EC2 instance termination protection. Use Session Manager to log in to an instance that is marked as unhealthy.**

EC2 termination protection is not the correct mechanism for Auto Scaling health check replacement. AWS documentation notes that even Auto Scaling **instance scale-in protection** does not protect instances from health check replacement, and that EC2 termination protection does **not** prevent Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling from terminating instances ([AWS docs: Use instance scale-in protection to control instance termination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-instance-protection.html)). Therefore, this option would not reliably keep the unhealthy Auto Scaling instance alive for troubleshooting.

**C. Set the termination policy to `OldestInstance` on the Auto Scaling group. Use Session Manager to log in to an instance that is marked as unhealthy.**

A termination policy affects which instance Auto Scaling selects for termination in eligible termination events, but it does not stop health check replacement. AWS documentation explicitly states that unhealthy instances can still be terminated regardless of a custom termination policy ([AWS docs: Design your applications to gracefully handle instance termination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/gracefully-handle-instance-termination.html)). Setting `OldestInstance` does not preserve the unhealthy instance for inspection.

### Conclusion

The architect should suspend the Auto Scaling group’s **`Terminate`** process, allow health checks to continue identifying unhealthy instances, and use Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to one of those unhealthy Linux instances for troubleshooting.

**Answer: D**

zh.question: 一家大型公司正在运行一个热门 Web 应用程序。该应用程序运行在私有子网中 Auto Scaling 组内的多台 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例上。一个 Application Load Balancer 将目标指向该私有子网中 Auto Scaling 组内的实例。AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 已配置，并且 AWS Systems Manager Agent 正在所有 EC2 实例上运行。该公司最近发布了应用程序的新版本。现在，一些 EC2 实例被标记为不正常并被终止。因此，应用程序正在以降低后的容量运行。解决方案架构师尝试通过分析从应用程序收集的 Amazon CloudWatch 日志来确定根本原因，但日志没有得出结论。解决方案架构师应如何访问 EC2 实例以排查该问题？

options.A: 暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 HealthCheck 扩缩流程。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。
options.B: 启用 EC2 实例终止保护。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。
options.C: 在 Auto Scaling 组上将终止策略设置为 OldestInstance。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。
options.D: 暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 Terminate 流程。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。

zh.explanation:
### 题目在问什么

应用程序实例位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中。发布新版本后，一些实例未通过健康检查，Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会在架构师检查它们之前终止/替换这些实例。Systems Manager Session Manager 已经配置好，并且 SSM Agent 正在运行，因此访问方法已经可用；关键是让 Auto Scaling 暂停终止不正常实例足够长的时间，以便对其进行故障排查。

### 正确答案：D

**D. 暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 `Terminate` 流程。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。**

这是最佳答案，因为暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 **`Terminate`** 流程可以阻止 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 因 Auto Scaling 管理的原因尝试终止实例。AWS 文档说明，`Terminate` 流程会在组缩容时，或在 Auto Scaling 出于其他原因选择终止实例时移除实例，包括**未通过健康检查**（[AWS docs: Suspend and resume Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling processes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-suspend-resume-processes.html)）。AWS 还说明，暂停 `Terminate` 会阻止 Auto Scaling 因任何原因尝试终止实例，但显式的用户发起的 `TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup` API 调用除外（[AWS docs: Design your applications to gracefully handle instance termination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/gracefully-handle-instance-termination.html)）。

重要的是，当 `Terminate` 被暂停时，**`ReplaceUnhealthy` 处于非活动状态，但 `HealthCheck` 不会**。这意味着实例仍然可以被标记为不正常，但在 `Terminate` 保持暂停期间，Auto Scaling 不会终止/替换它们（[AWS docs: How suspended processes affect other processes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/understand-how-suspending-processes-affects-other-processes.html)）。这样可以保留发生故障的实例以供分析。

然后，由于 Session Manager 已经配置好并且 SSM Agent 正在运行，架构师可以启动到该托管 EC2 实例的 Session Manager 会话。AWS 文档确认，Session Manager 可用于与托管节点启动会话，连接后用户可以在 Linux 实例上运行 bash 命令（[AWS docs: Start a session](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-working-with-sessions-start.html)）。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 `HealthCheck` 扩缩流程。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。**

暂停 `HealthCheck` 会阻止 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 基于 EC2 或 Elastic Load Balancing 健康检查将实例标记为不正常（[AWS docs: How suspended processes affect other processes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/understand-how-suspending-processes-affects-other-processes.html)）。这在这里并不理想，因为架构师需要识别并检查正在失败的实例。它也没有直接解决核心问题：已经被标记为不正常的实例正在被终止。暂停 `Terminate` 才是直接阻止这些终止操作、同时保留健康检查可见性的控制措施。

**B. 启用 EC2 实例终止保护。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。**

EC2 终止保护并不是处理 Auto Scaling 健康检查替换的正确机制。AWS 文档指出，即使是 Auto Scaling **实例缩容保护**也不能保护实例免于健康检查替换，并且 EC2 终止保护**不会**阻止 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 终止实例（[AWS docs: Use instance scale-in protection to control instance termination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-instance-protection.html)）。因此，此选项不能可靠地让不正常的 Auto Scaling 实例保持运行以便进行故障排查。

**C. 在 Auto Scaling 组上将终止策略设置为 `OldestInstance`。使用 Session Manager 登录到被标记为不正常的实例。**

终止策略会影响 Auto Scaling 在符合条件的终止事件中选择哪个实例进行终止，但它不会停止健康检查替换。AWS 文档明确说明，无论自定义终止策略如何，不正常实例仍可能被终止（[AWS docs: Design your applications to gracefully handle instance termination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/gracefully-handle-instance-termination.html)）。设置 `OldestInstance` 不会保留不正常实例以供检查。

### 结论

架构师应暂停 Auto Scaling 组的 **`Terminate`** 流程，让健康检查继续识别不正常实例，并使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 连接到其中一台不正常的 Linux 实例进行故障排查。

**答案：D**

en.question: A company wants to deploy an AWS WAF solution to manage AWS WAF rules across multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are managed under different OUs in AWS Organizations. Administrators must be able to add or remove accounts or OUs from managed AWS WAF rule sets as needed. Administrators also must have the ability to automatically update and remediate noncompliant AWS WAF rules in all accounts. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Firewall Manager to manage AWS WAF rules across accounts in the organization. Use an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store parameter to store account numbers and OUs to manage. Update the parameter as needed to add or remove accounts or OUs. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to identify any changes to the parameter and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to update the security policy in the Firewall Manager administrative account.
options.B: Deploy an organization-wide AWS Config rule that requires all resources in the selected OUs to associate the AWS WAF rules. Deploy automated remediation actions by using AWS Lambda to fix noncompliant resources. Deploy AWS WAF rules by using an AWS CloudFormation stack set to target the same OUs where the AWS Config rule is applied.
options.C: Create AWS WAF rules in the management account of the organization. Use AWS Lambda environment variables to store account numbers and OUs to manage. Update environment variables as needed to add or remove accounts or OUs. Create cross-account IAM roles in member accounts. Assume the roles by using AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) in the Lambda function to create and update AWS WAF rules in the member accounts.
options.D: Use AWS Control Tower to manage AWS WAF rules across accounts in the organization. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to store account numbers and OUs to manage. Update AWS KMS as needed to add or remove accounts or OUs. Create IAM users in member accounts. Allow AWS Control Tower in the management account to use the access key and secret access key to create and update AWS WAF rules in the member accounts.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs centralized management of AWS WAF rules across multiple AWS accounts in AWS Organizations, with flexible inclusion/removal of accounts or OUs and automatic remediation of noncompliant WAF configurations. This is the native use case for **AWS Firewall Manager**, not for custom cross-account scripts or Config/CloudFormation-only deployments.

AWS documentation states that Firewall Manager simplifies administration across multiple accounts for protections including **AWS WAF**, and that after you set up protections once, the service automatically applies them across accounts and resources as new accounts/resources are added ([AWS Firewall Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/fms-chapter.html)). Firewall Manager policies support AWS WAF policies, and the policy settings allow administrators to either view noncompliance or **automatically remediate noncompliant resources** ([Using AWS Firewall Manager policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/working-with-policies.html)).

Firewall Manager policy scope can be set for all accounts or a subset of accounts in AWS Organizations, including specific account numbers and **AWS Organizations OUs** ([policy scope](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/policy-scope.html)). The Firewall Manager `Policy` API supports `IncludeMap` and `ExcludeMap` with valid keys `ACCOUNT` and `ORG_UNIT`, and an OU selection includes accounts in child OUs and accounts added later. The same API also has `RemediationEnabled`, which indicates whether the policy is automatically applied to new resources ([Firewall Manager Policy API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fms/2018-01-01/APIReference/API_Policy.html)).

Option A also uses Parameter Store and EventBridge to automate changes to the Firewall Manager policy scope. Systems Manager Parameter Store can emit EventBridge events on parameter create/update/delete operations, and EventBridge rules can invoke targets based on those events ([Parameter Store EventBridge notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/sysman-paramstore-cwe.html)). This supports a low-operational-overhead mechanism for administrators to update a maintained account/OU list and have automation update the Firewall Manager policy.

## Correct answer

**A. Use AWS Firewall Manager with Parameter Store, EventBridge, and Lambda.**

This option uses the AWS-native centralized service for managing AWS WAF across an AWS Organizations environment. Firewall Manager supports account and OU scoping, automatic application to in-scope accounts/resources, and remediation of noncompliant resources. Parameter Store plus EventBridge/Lambda provides a lightweight way to update the Firewall Manager policy scope when administrators add or remove accounts or OUs.

## Why the other options are incorrect

**B. AWS Config rule + Lambda remediation + CloudFormation StackSets**  
This could partially detect and remediate missing WAF associations, and StackSets can deploy resources across OUs. However, it recreates much of what Firewall Manager already provides natively. It requires custom Config rules/remediation logic and CloudFormation lifecycle management for WAF rules. It is therefore more operationally complex than using Firewall Manager, which is specifically designed for centralized WAF policy management and remediation across Organizations.

**C. Custom Lambda with cross-account IAM roles**  
This is a custom cross-account automation solution. It requires role creation and maintenance in every member account, STS assume-role logic, Lambda code to create/update WAF rules, error handling, and ongoing account/OU synchronization. This is significantly more operational overhead than Firewall Manager.

**D. AWS Control Tower + AWS KMS + IAM users/access keys**  
AWS Control Tower is not the service for centrally managing AWS WAF rules. KMS is not used to store account and OU management lists in this manner, and creating IAM users with long-term access keys in member accounts is an anti-pattern and adds security and operational risk. This option does not provide the required native WAF policy remediation capability.

## Conclusion

The best answer is **A** because AWS Firewall Manager is purpose-built to centrally manage AWS WAF policies across AWS Organizations accounts and OUs, can automatically apply/remediate policies, and the Parameter Store/EventBridge/Lambda automation provides flexible account/OU updates with minimal operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司希望部署一个 AWS WAF 解决方案，以跨多个 AWS 账户管理 AWS WAF 规则。这些账户在 AWS Organizations 中由不同的 OU 管理。管理员必须能够根据需要从托管的 AWS WAF 规则集中添加或移除账户或 OU。管理员还必须能够自动更新并修复所有账户中不合规的 AWS WAF 规则。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 管理组织中跨账户的 AWS WAF 规则。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 参数存储要管理的账户编号和 OU。根据需要更新该参数以添加或移除账户或 OU。使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则识别对该参数的任何更改，并调用 AWS Lambda 函数来更新 Firewall Manager 管理账户中的安全策略。
options.B: 部署一个组织范围的 AWS Config 规则，要求所选 OU 中的所有资源关联 AWS WAF 规则。使用 AWS Lambda 部署自动修复操作以修复不合规资源。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSet 部署 AWS WAF 规则，并以应用 AWS Config 规则的相同 OU 为目标。
options.C: 在组织的管理账户中创建 AWS WAF 规则。使用 AWS Lambda 环境变量存储要管理的账户编号和 OU。根据需要更新环境变量以添加或移除账户或 OU。在成员账户中创建跨账户 IAM 角色。在 Lambda 函数中使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 代入这些角色，以在成员账户中创建和更新 AWS WAF 规则。
options.D: 使用 AWS Control Tower 管理组织中跨账户的 AWS WAF 规则。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 存储要管理的账户编号和 OU。根据需要更新 AWS KMS 以添加或移除账户或 OU。在成员账户中创建 IAM 用户。允许管理账户中的 AWS Control Tower 使用访问密钥和秘密访问密钥在成员账户中创建和更新 AWS WAF 规则。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要在 AWS Organizations 中跨多个 AWS 账户集中管理 AWS WAF 规则，并且需要能够灵活纳入/移除账户或 OU，还需要自动修复不合规的 WAF 配置。这是 **AWS Firewall Manager** 的原生用例，而不是自定义跨账户脚本或仅使用 Config/CloudFormation 部署的用例。

AWS 文档指出，Firewall Manager 简化了跨多个账户的保护管理，包括 **AWS WAF**；并且在你设置一次保护后，该服务会在添加新账户/资源时自动将其应用到账户和资源上（[AWS Firewall Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/fms-chapter.html)）。Firewall Manager 策略支持 AWS WAF 策略，并且策略设置允许管理员查看不合规情况或**自动修复不合规资源**（[Using AWS Firewall Manager policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/working-with-policies.html)）。

Firewall Manager 策略范围可以设置为 AWS Organizations 中的所有账户或一部分账户，包括特定账户编号和 **AWS Organizations OU**（[policy scope](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/policy-scope.html)）。Firewall Manager `Policy` API 支持带有有效键 `ACCOUNT` 和 `ORG_UNIT` 的 `IncludeMap` 和 `ExcludeMap`，选择某个 OU 会包括子 OU 中的账户以及之后添加的账户。同一 API 还具有 `RemediationEnabled`，用于指示是否将策略自动应用于新资源（[Firewall Manager Policy API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fms/2018-01-01/APIReference/API_Policy.html)）。

选项 A 还使用 Parameter Store 和 EventBridge 来自动化对 Firewall Manager 策略范围的更改。Systems Manager Parameter Store 可以在参数创建/更新/删除操作时发出 EventBridge 事件，而 EventBridge 规则可以基于这些事件调用目标（[Parameter Store EventBridge notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/sysman-paramstore-cwe.html)）。这支持一种低运营开销机制，使管理员可以更新维护的账户/OU 列表，并让自动化更新 Firewall Manager 策略。

## 正确答案

**A. 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 以及 Parameter Store、EventBridge 和 Lambda。**

此选项使用 AWS 原生的集中式服务，用于在 AWS Organizations 环境中跨账户管理 AWS WAF。Firewall Manager 支持账户和 OU 范围设定，能够自动应用到范围内的账户/资源，并修复不合规资源。Parameter Store 加 EventBridge/Lambda 提供了一种轻量方式，可在管理员添加或移除账户或 OU 时更新 Firewall Manager 策略范围。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. AWS Config 规则 + Lambda 修复 + CloudFormation StackSets**  
这可以部分检测并修复缺失的 WAF 关联，StackSets 也可以跨 OU 部署资源。但是，它重新实现了 Firewall Manager 已经原生提供的大部分功能。它需要自定义 Config 规则/修复逻辑，以及 WAF 规则的 CloudFormation 生命周期管理。因此，相比使用专为跨 Organizations 集中管理和修复 WAF 策略而设计的 Firewall Manager，它的运营复杂性更高。

**C. 使用跨账户 IAM 角色的自定义 Lambda**  
这是一个自定义跨账户自动化解决方案。它需要在每个成员账户中创建和维护角色、STS 代入角色逻辑、用于创建/更新 WAF 规则的 Lambda 代码、错误处理以及持续的账户/OU 同步。与 Firewall Manager 相比，这会显著增加运营开销。

**D. AWS Control Tower + AWS KMS + IAM 用户/访问密钥**  
AWS Control Tower 不是用于集中管理 AWS WAF 规则的服务。KMS 不会以这种方式用于存储账户和 OU 管理列表，而在成员账户中创建带有长期访问密钥的 IAM 用户是一种反模式，会增加安全和运营风险。此选项不提供所需的原生 WAF 策略修复能力。

## 结论

最佳答案是 **A**，因为 AWS Firewall Manager 专为跨 AWS Organizations 账户和 OU 集中管理 AWS WAF 策略而构建，可以自动应用/修复策略，并且 Parameter Store/EventBridge/Lambda 自动化可在最小运营开销下提供灵活的账户/OU 更新。

en.question: A solutions architect is auditing the security setup or an AWS Lambda function for a company. The Lambda function retrieves, the latest changes from an Amazon Aurora database. The Lambda function and the database run in the same VPC. Lambda environment variables are providing the database credentials to the Lambda function. The Lambda function aggregates data and makes the data available in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS). The data must not travel across the Internet. If any database credentials become compromised, the company needs a solution that minimizes the impact of the compromise. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the Aurora DB cluster. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access the database by using IAM database authentication. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
options.B: Enable IAM database authentication on the Aurora DB cluster. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access the database by using IAM database authentication. Enforce HTTPS on the connection to Amazon S3 during data transfers.
options.C: Save the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set up password rotation on the credentials in Parameter Store. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access Parameter Store. Modify the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from Parameter Store. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
options.D: Save the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up password rotation on the credentials in Secrets Manager. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access Secrets Manager. Modify the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager. Enforce HTTPS on the connection to Amazon S3 during data transfers.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The Lambda function runs in the same VPC as an Amazon Aurora database, reads database changes, and writes aggregated data to an SSE-KMS encrypted S3 bucket. The solution must satisfy two key requirements:

1. **Data must not travel across the Internet**, especially the Lambda-to-S3 path from a VPC-attached Lambda function.
2. **If database credentials are compromised, minimize the impact** of that compromise.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Enable IAM database authentication on the Aurora DB cluster. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access the database by using IAM database authentication. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.**

This is the best fit for both requirements:

- **IAM database authentication removes the need for static database passwords in Lambda environment variables.** AWS documentation states that with IAM database authentication, you do not need to use a password when connecting; instead, you use an authentication token. The token is generated on request and has a **15-minute lifetime**, and credentials are managed externally through IAM rather than stored in the database/application configuration ([IAM database authentication for MariaDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)). This minimizes the impact of credential compromise because there are no long-lived database passwords stored in Lambda environment variables.
- **A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 keeps S3 traffic on the AWS network.** AWS documentation for S3 VPC endpoints states that a gateway endpoint is specified in a route table to access Amazon S3 from a VPC over the AWS network, and that with gateway or interface endpoints, network traffic remains on the AWS network ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). This addresses the “data must not travel across the Internet” requirement.

Therefore, option A satisfies both the credential-compromise impact requirement and the private data path requirement.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. IAM database authentication + enforce HTTPS to S3

IAM database authentication is appropriate, but merely enforcing HTTPS to S3 **does not ensure that traffic avoids the Internet**. HTTPS encrypts traffic in transit, but the question specifically requires that data must not travel across the Internet. A VPC endpoint is the relevant mechanism to keep S3 traffic on the AWS network ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

### C. Store credentials in Parameter Store with rotation + S3 gateway endpoint

The S3 gateway endpoint part is correct, but this option is weaker and partly flawed for credentials:

- Parameter Store is useful for configuration values and can store encrypted `SecureString` parameters, but AWS documentation specifically describes it as suitable for lightweight encrypted configuration values that **do not require rotation or other advanced secret lifecycle capabilities**. It recommends Secrets Manager for credentials that require automatic rotation ([AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)).
- The option still relies on database credentials rather than replacing them with short-lived IAM authentication tokens.

So C does not minimize the impact as effectively as IAM database authentication, and its stated rotation mechanism is not the right AWS service capability.

### D. Secrets Manager rotation + enforce HTTPS to S3

Secrets Manager is appropriate for managing and rotating secrets; AWS documentation confirms that Secrets Manager supports automatic rotation for secrets, including rotation that updates both the secret and the database or service ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). However, this option fails the networking requirement:

- Enforcing HTTPS protects data in transit but does **not** ensure the data path avoids the Internet.
- The question requires that data must not travel across the Internet, which is addressed by using a VPC endpoint for S3, not merely HTTPS ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

Thus, D is less complete than A because it omits the S3 VPC endpoint requirement.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在审计某公司一个 AWS Lambda 函数的安全设置。该 Lambda 函数从 Amazon Aurora 数据库检索最新变更。Lambda 函数和数据库在同一个 VPC 中运行。Lambda 环境变量向 Lambda 函数提供数据库凭证。Lambda 函数聚合数据，并将数据提供到一个配置了使用 AWS KMS 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。数据不得经由 Internet 传输。如果任何数据库凭证遭到泄露，公司需要一种能够最大限度降低泄露影响的解决方案。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Aurora DB 集群上启用 IAM 数据库身份验证。更改 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色，以允许该函数使用 IAM 数据库身份验证访问数据库。在 VPC 中部署一个用于 Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 端点。
options.B: 在 Aurora DB 集群上启用 IAM 数据库身份验证。更改 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色，以允许该函数使用 IAM 数据库身份验证访问数据库。在向 Amazon S3 传输数据期间强制使用 HTTPS 连接。
options.C: 将数据库凭证保存在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。在 Parameter Store 中为凭证设置密码轮换。更改 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色，以允许该函数访问 Parameter Store。修改 Lambda 函数以从 Parameter Store 检索凭证。在 VPC 中部署一个用于 Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 端点。
options.D: 将数据库凭证保存在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。在 Secrets Manager 中为凭证设置密码轮换。更改 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色，以允许该函数访问 Secrets Manager。修改 Lambda 函数以从 Secrets Manager 检索凭证。在向 Amazon S3 传输数据期间强制使用 HTTPS 连接。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

Lambda 函数与 Amazon Aurora 数据库运行在同一个 VPC 中，读取数据库变更，并将聚合后的数据写入一个启用了 SSE-KMS 加密的 S3 存储桶。该解决方案必须满足两个关键要求：

1. **数据不得经由 Internet 传输**，尤其是从附加到 VPC 的 Lambda 函数到 S3 的路径。
2. **如果数据库凭证遭到泄露，需要最大限度降低**该泄露的影响。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 在 Aurora DB 集群上启用 IAM 数据库身份验证。更改 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色，以允许该函数使用 IAM 数据库身份验证访问数据库。在 VPC 中部署一个用于 Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 端点。**

这最符合这两个要求：

- **IAM 数据库身份验证消除了在 Lambda 环境变量中使用静态数据库密码的需要。** AWS 文档说明，使用 IAM 数据库身份验证时，连接时无需使用密码；而是使用身份验证令牌。该令牌按请求生成，并且具有 **15 分钟有效期**，凭证通过 IAM 在外部进行管理，而不是存储在数据库/应用程序配置中（[适用于 MariaDB、MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 的 IAM 数据库身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)）。这最大限度降低了凭证泄露的影响，因为 Lambda 环境变量中没有存储长期有效的数据库密码。
- **用于 Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 端点可使 S3 流量保留在 AWS 网络上。** AWS 关于 S3 VPC 端点的文档说明，网关端点在路由表中指定，用于通过 AWS 网络从 VPC 访问 Amazon S3，并且使用网关端点或接口端点时，网络流量会保留在 AWS 网络上（[Amazon S3 的 VPC 端点类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。这解决了“数据不得经由 Internet 传输”的要求。

因此，选项 A 同时满足凭证泄露影响要求和私有数据路径要求。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### B. IAM 数据库身份验证 + 强制对 S3 使用 HTTPS

IAM 数据库身份验证是合适的，但仅强制对 S3 使用 HTTPS **并不能确保流量避开 Internet**。HTTPS 会加密传输中的流量，但题目明确要求数据不得经由 Internet 传输。VPC 端点才是将 S3 流量保留在 AWS 网络上的相关机制（[Amazon S3 的 VPC 端点类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

### C. 将凭证存储在 Parameter Store 中并轮换 + S3 网关端点

S3 网关端点部分是正确的，但此选项在凭证方面较弱且部分有缺陷：

- Parameter Store 适用于配置值，并且可以存储加密的 `SecureString` 参数，但 AWS 文档明确将其描述为适用于**不需要轮换或其他高级密钥生命周期功能**的轻量级加密配置值。对于需要自动轮换的凭证，文档建议使用 Secrets Manager（[AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)）。
- 该选项仍然依赖数据库凭证，而不是用短期 IAM 身份验证令牌替代它们。

因此，C 不如 IAM 数据库身份验证那样有效地最大限度降低影响，并且其所述的轮换机制不是正确的 AWS 服务能力。

### D. Secrets Manager 轮换 + 强制对 S3 使用 HTTPS

Secrets Manager 适合管理和轮换密钥；AWS 文档确认，Secrets Manager 支持对密钥进行自动轮换，包括同时更新密钥以及数据库或服务的轮换（[轮换 AWS Secrets Manager 密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。但是，此选项未能满足网络要求：

- 强制使用 HTTPS 可以保护传输中的数据，但**不能**确保数据路径避开 Internet。
- 题目要求数据不得经由 Internet 传输，这应通过使用 S3 的 VPC 端点来解决，而不是仅仅使用 HTTPS（[Amazon S3 的 VPC 端点类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

因此，D 不如 A 完整，因为它省略了 S3 VPC 端点要求。

en.question: A large mobile gaming company has successfully migrated all of its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect is reviewing the environment to ensure that it was built according to the design and that it is running in alignment with the Well-Architected Framework. While reviewing previous monthly costs in Cost Explorer, the solutions architect notices that the creation and subsequent termination of several large instance types account for a high proportion of the costs. The solutions architect finds out that the company’s developers are launching new Amazon EC2 instances as part of their testing and that the developers are not using the appropriate instance types. The solutions architect must implement a control mechanism to limit the instance types that only the developers can launch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a desired-instance-type managed rule in AWS Config. Configure the rule with the instance types that are allowed. Attach the rule to an event to run each time a new EC2 instance is launched.
options.B: In the EC2 console, create a launch template that specifies the instance types that are allowed. Assign the launch template to the developers’ IAM accounts.
options.C: Create a new IAM policy. Specify the instance types that are allowed. Attach the policy to an IAM group that contains the IAM accounts for the developers
options.D: Use EC2 Image Builder to create an image pipeline for the developers and assist them in the creation of a golden image.

en.explanation:
The scenario asks for a **preventive control** that applies only to developers and stops them from launching expensive or inappropriate Amazon EC2 instance types during testing.

**Correct answer: C. Create a new IAM policy. Specify the instance types that are allowed. Attach the policy to an IAM group that contains the IAM accounts for the developers.**

AWS documentation states that EC2 permissions are controlled with IAM identity-based policies attached to users, groups, or roles, and that these policies can allow or deny specific EC2 API actions and include conditions. The EC2 User Guide specifically notes that, for supported EC2 actions, you can grant permission to launch instances **only of a specific type** and only under specified conditions ([Identity-based policies for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-policies-for-amazon-ec2.html)). Another EC2 permissions page gives the same example: you can grant users permission to launch instances, but only of a specific type and only using a specific AMI ([Granting required permissions for Amazon EC2 resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/devguide/ec2-api-permissions.html)). The Service Authorization Reference for EC2 lists service-specific condition keys, including `ec2:InstanceType`, for use in IAM permission policies ([Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)).

Therefore, an IAM policy attached to the developers' IAM group can allow `ec2:RunInstances` only when `ec2:InstanceType` matches the approved list, or explicitly deny `RunInstances` when it does not. This is enforceable across the console, CLI, SDKs, and APIs.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Config desired-instance-type rule** — AWS Config is primarily a compliance evaluation mechanism here, not the required preventive launch control. The `desired-instance-type` managed rule checks whether existing EC2 instances are of specified instance types and marks an instance `NON_COMPLIANT` if it is not in the parameter list ([desired-instance-type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/desired-instance-type.html)). That detects noncompliance after the instance exists; it does not stop developers from launching the instance.

- **B. EC2 launch template assigned to developers' IAM accounts** — A launch template can standardize instance launch parameters, but simply creating one does not prevent developers from bypassing it with the EC2 console, CLI, SDK, or API unless IAM permissions are also used to enforce its use. The option does not provide an IAM enforcement mechanism and does not meet the requirement to limit what developers can launch.

- **D. EC2 Image Builder golden image pipeline** — EC2 Image Builder helps create and maintain standardized AMIs/images. It does not control the EC2 instance types developers are allowed to launch. It addresses image standardization, not cost control through allowed instance types.

Thus, **C** is the only option that provides a direct, preventive, identity-scoped control for developers.

zh.question: 一家大型移动游戏公司已成功将其所有本地基础设施迁移到 AWS Cloud。解决方案架构师正在审查该环境，以确保它是按照设计构建的，并且其运行符合 Well-Architected Framework。在 Cost Explorer 中查看之前的月度成本时，解决方案架构师注意到，创建并随后终止的几个大型实例类型占据了很高比例的成本。解决方案架构师发现，公司的开发人员正在启动新的 Amazon EC2 实例作为测试的一部分，并且开发人员没有使用合适的实例类型。解决方案架构师必须实施一种控制机制，以限制只有开发人员可以启动的实例类型。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Config 中创建一个 desired-instance-type 托管规则。使用允许的实例类型配置该规则。将该规则附加到一个事件，以便每次启动新的 EC2 实例时运行。
options.B: 在 EC2 控制台中，创建一个启动模板，指定允许的实例类型。将该启动模板分配给开发人员的 IAM 账户。
options.C: 创建一个新的 IAM policy。指定允许的实例类型。将该 policy 附加到包含开发人员 IAM 账户的 IAM group。
options.D: 使用 EC2 Image Builder 为开发人员创建一个镜像管道，并协助他们创建黄金镜像。

zh.explanation:
该场景要求一种**预防性控制**，该控制仅适用于开发人员，并阻止他们在测试期间启动昂贵或不合适的 Amazon EC2 实例类型。

**正确答案：C. 创建一个新的 IAM policy。指定允许的实例类型。将该 policy 附加到包含开发人员 IAM 账户的 IAM group。**

AWS 文档说明，EC2 权限通过附加到用户、组或角色的 IAM identity-based policies 进行控制，并且这些 policies 可以允许或拒绝特定的 EC2 API 操作并包含条件。EC2 User Guide 特别指出，对于受支持的 EC2 操作，你可以授予权限，使其**仅能启动特定类型**的实例，并且仅在指定条件下启动（[Identity-based policies for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-policies-for-amazon-ec2.html)）。另一个 EC2 权限页面给出了相同示例：你可以授予用户启动实例的权限，但只能启动特定类型的实例，并且只能使用特定 AMI（[Granting required permissions for Amazon EC2 resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/devguide/ec2-api-permissions.html)）。EC2 的 Service Authorization Reference 列出了服务特定的条件键，包括 `ec2:InstanceType`，可在 IAM 权限策略中使用（[Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)）。

因此，附加到开发人员 IAM group 的 IAM policy 可以仅在 `ec2:InstanceType` 匹配批准列表时允许 `ec2:RunInstances`，或者在不匹配时显式拒绝 `RunInstances`。这在控制台、CLI、SDK 和 API 中都是可强制执行的。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. AWS Config desired-instance-type rule** — 在这里，AWS Config 主要是一种合规性评估机制，而不是所需的预防性启动控制。`desired-instance-type` 托管规则会检查现有 EC2 实例是否属于指定的实例类型，如果实例不在参数列表中，则将其标记为 `NON_COMPLIANT`（[desired-instance-type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/desired-instance-type.html)）。这会在实例已存在后检测到不合规；它不会阻止开发人员启动该实例。

- **B. 分配给开发人员 IAM 账户的 EC2 launch template** — launch template 可以标准化实例启动参数，但仅创建一个模板并不能阻止开发人员通过 EC2 控制台、CLI、SDK 或 API 绕过它，除非还使用 IAM 权限来强制其使用。该选项未提供 IAM 强制执行机制，也不满足限制开发人员可启动内容的要求。

- **D. EC2 Image Builder golden image pipeline** — EC2 Image Builder 有助于创建和维护标准化 AMIs/images。它不控制开发人员被允许启动的 EC2 实例类型。它解决的是镜像标准化问题，而不是通过允许的实例类型进行成本控制。

因此，**C** 是唯一一个为开发人员提供直接的、预防性的、基于身份范围的控制的选项。

en.question: A company is developing and hosting several projects in the AWS Cloud. The projects are developed across multiple AWS accounts under the same organization in AWS Organizations. The company requires the cost for cloud infrastructure to be allocated to the owning project. The team responsible for all of the AWS accounts has discovered that several Amazon EC2 instances are lacking the Project tag used for cost allocation. Which actions should a solutions architect lake to resolve the problem and prevent it from happening in the future? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS Config rule in each account to find resources with missing tags.
options.B: Create an SCP in the organization with a deny action for ec2:RunInstances if the Project tag is missing.
options.C: Use Amazon Inspector in the organization to find resources with missing tags.
options.D: Create an IAM policy in each account with a deny action for ec2:RunInstances if the Project tag is missing.
options.E: Create an AWS Config aggregator for the organization to collect a list of EC2 instances with the missing Project tag.
options.F: Use AWS Security Hub to aggregate a list of EC2 instances with the missing Project tag.

en.explanation:
The company has multiple AWS accounts in one AWS Organizations organization and needs two things: (1) identify existing EC2 instances that are missing the `Project` cost-allocation tag across accounts, and (2) prevent future launches without that tag. The correct choices are **A, B, and E**.

## Correct answers

### A. Create an AWS Config rule in each account to find resources with missing tags
AWS Config has a managed rule, **required-tags**, that “checks if your resources have the tags that you specify,” and its supported resource types include **`AWS::EC2::Instance`**. The documentation also states that this rule can be used to “find resources in your account” that were not launched with desired tags, but that the rule itself “does not prevent you from creating resources with incorrect tags.” Therefore, Config rules are appropriate for detecting existing noncompliant EC2 instances, but another control is needed to prevent future noncompliance. See [required-tags - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html).

### B. Create an SCP in the organization with a deny action for `ec2:RunInstances` if the `Project` tag is missing
Because the accounts are in AWS Organizations, an SCP is the right organization-wide preventive guardrail. SCPs set the maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts, and an explicit deny in an SCP prevents affected principals from performing the action even if their IAM policies otherwise allow it. AWS Organizations documentation also recommends considering SCPs to set guardrails around resource creation requests when account administrators can otherwise create untagged resources. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) and [tag policy best practices: consider creating an SCP to set guardrails around resource creation requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-best-practices.html).

### E. Create an AWS Config aggregator for the organization to collect a list of EC2 instances with the missing `Project` tag
An AWS Config aggregator provides centralized visibility across multiple accounts and Regions. The documentation says that when creating an aggregator, you can select source accounts individually or choose **Add my organization** to aggregate data from all accounts in the organization. This lets the central team collect and view compliance results from the per-account Config rules in one place. See [Creating Aggregators for AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/aggregated-create.html).

## Incorrect answers

### C. Use Amazon Inspector in the organization to find resources with missing tags
Amazon Inspector is an automated vulnerability scanning service for workloads such as EC2 instances, container images, and Lambda functions. It is not the right service for organization-wide tag compliance detection. See [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html).

### D. Create an IAM policy in each account with a deny action for `ec2:RunInstances` if the `Project` tag is missing
A deny condition in IAM can be used in some tag-based access-control designs, but this option is not the best organizational solution here. It requires policy deployment and maintenance in every account and can be affected by account-level administration. Since all accounts are under AWS Organizations, an SCP is the intended centralized preventive guardrail across member accounts.

### F. Use AWS Security Hub to aggregate a list of EC2 instances with the missing `Project` tag
Security Hub is for cloud security posture management and security findings aggregation, not for inventorying EC2 instances that lack cost-allocation tags. AWS Config is the appropriate service for configuration and compliance evaluation of resource tags. See [Introduction to AWS Security Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub-v2.html).

**Answer: A, B, E**

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中开发并托管多个项目。这些项目在 AWS Organizations 中同一组织下的多个 AWS 账户中开发。公司要求将云基础设施成本分配给所属项目。负责所有 AWS 账户的团队发现，多个 Amazon EC2 实例缺少用于成本分配的 Project 标签。解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来解决该问题并防止将来再次发生？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在每个账户中创建 AWS Config 规则，以查找缺少标签的资源。
options.B: 在组织中创建一个 SCP，如果缺少 Project 标签，则对 ec2:RunInstances 使用拒绝操作。
options.C: 在组织中使用 Amazon Inspector 查找缺少标签的资源。
options.D: 在每个账户中创建一个 IAM policy，如果缺少 Project 标签，则对 ec2:RunInstances 使用拒绝操作。
options.E: 为组织创建一个 AWS Config aggregator，以收集缺少 Project 标签的 EC2 实例列表。
options.F: 使用 AWS Security Hub 聚合缺少 Project 标签的 EC2 实例列表。

zh.explanation:
该公司在一个 AWS Organizations 组织中拥有多个 AWS 账户，并且需要两件事：(1) 跨账户识别现有 EC2 实例中缺少 `Project` 成本分配标签的实例；(2) 防止将来在没有该标签的情况下启动实例。正确选项是 **A、B 和 E**。

## 正确答案

### A. 在每个账户中创建 AWS Config 规则，以查找缺少标签的资源
AWS Config 有一个托管规则 **required-tags**，它会“检查你的资源是否具有你指定的标签”，其支持的资源类型包括 **`AWS::EC2::Instance`**。文档还说明，此规则可用于“查找你账户中”未使用所需标签启动的资源，但该规则本身“不会阻止你创建带有错误标签的资源”。因此，Config 规则适用于检测现有的不合规 EC2 实例，但还需要另一项控制来防止未来发生不合规。请参阅 [required-tags - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)。

### B. 在组织中创建一个 SCP，如果缺少 `Project` 标签，则对 `ec2:RunInstances` 使用拒绝操作
由于这些账户位于 AWS Organizations 中，SCP 是合适的组织范围预防性防护机制。SCP 为成员账户中的 IAM users 和 roles 设置最大可用权限，并且 SCP 中的显式拒绝会阻止受影响的主体执行该操作，即使其 IAM policies 另有允许也是如此。AWS Organizations 文档还建议，当账户管理员可能以其他方式创建未打标签资源时，应考虑使用 SCP 为资源创建请求设置防护栏。请参阅 [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 和 [tag policy best practices: consider creating an SCP to set guardrails around resource creation requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-best-practices.html)。

### E. 为组织创建一个 AWS Config aggregator，以收集缺少 `Project` 标签的 EC2 实例列表
AWS Config aggregator 可在多个账户和区域之间提供集中可见性。文档说明，在创建 aggregator 时，可以单独选择源账户，或选择 **Add my organization** 来聚合组织中所有账户的数据。这使中央团队能够在一个位置收集并查看来自每个账户 Config 规则的合规性结果。请参阅 [Creating Aggregators for AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/aggregated-create.html)。

## 错误答案

### C. 在组织中使用 Amazon Inspector 查找缺少标签的资源
Amazon Inspector 是一项自动化漏洞扫描服务，适用于 EC2 实例、容器映像和 Lambda 函数等工作负载。它不是用于组织范围标签合规性检测的合适服务。请参阅 [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)。

### D. 在每个账户中创建一个 IAM policy，如果缺少 `Project` 标签，则对 `ec2:RunInstances` 使用拒绝操作
在某些基于标签的访问控制设计中，可以在 IAM 中使用拒绝条件，但此选项不是此处最佳的组织级解决方案。它需要在每个账户中部署和维护策略，并且可能受到账户级管理的影响。由于所有账户都位于 AWS Organizations 下，SCP 才是跨成员账户的预期集中式预防性防护机制。

### F. 使用 AWS Security Hub 聚合缺少 `Project` 标签的 EC2 实例列表
Security Hub 用于云安全态势管理和安全发现结果聚合，而不是用于清点缺少成本分配标签的 EC2 实例。AWS Config 是对资源标签进行配置和合规性评估的合适服务。请参阅 [Introduction to AWS Security Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub-v2.html)。

**答案：A、B、E**

en.question: A company has an on-premises monitoring solution using a PostgreSQL database for persistence of events. The database is unable to scale due to heavy ingestion and it frequently runs out of storage. The company wants to create a hybrid solution and has already set up a VPN connection between its network and AWS. The solution should include the following attributes: • Managed AWS services to minimize operational complexity. • A buffer that automatically scales to match the throughput of data and requires no ongoing administration. • A visualization tool to create dashboards to observe events in near-real time. • Support for semi-structured JSON data and dynamic schemas. Which combination of components will enable the company to create a monitoring solution that will satisfy these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform events.
options.B: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform events.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster to receive events. Use Amazon QuickSight to read from the database and create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
options.D: Configure Amazon Elasticsearch Service (Amazon ES) to receive events. Use the Kibana endpoint deployed with Amazon ES to create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
options.E: Configure an Amazon Neptune DB instance to receive events. Use Amazon QuickSight to read from the database and create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company is replacing an on-premises PostgreSQL-based monitoring/event persistence system that cannot handle heavy ingestion or storage growth. The target architecture must use managed AWS services, include a scalable low-administration buffer, transform semi-structured JSON events, and provide near-real-time dashboards.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform events.

Amazon Data Firehose is the best fit for the buffering and delivery layer because it is a fully managed streaming delivery service. AWS states that Firehose delivers real-time streaming data to destinations including Amazon OpenSearch Service, and that with Firehose you do not need to write applications or manage resources; you configure producers to send data to Firehose and it automatically delivers the data to the destination. Firehose also has explicit buffering concepts: it buffers incoming streaming data by size or time before delivery. See [What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html).

Firehose also supports transformation with Lambda before delivery. The documentation states that Firehose can invoke a Lambda function to transform incoming source data and deliver the transformed data to destinations. See [Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html).

This directly matches the requirement for a managed buffer that requires minimal administration, plus processing/transformation of incoming event data.

### D. Configure Amazon Elasticsearch Service / Amazon OpenSearch Service to receive events and use Kibana / OpenSearch Dashboards for near-real-time dashboards.

The exam uses the older names “Amazon Elasticsearch Service” and “Kibana.” The current service and UI names are Amazon OpenSearch Service and OpenSearch Dashboards, but the architectural pattern is the same.

OpenSearch Service is appropriate for indexing/searching event data and creating observability dashboards. AWS documents that Amazon OpenSearch Service integrates with Kinesis services for loading streaming data and includes data visualization using OpenSearch Dashboards. See [Features of Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/what-is.html).

AWS also documents that Firehose supports OpenSearch Service as a delivery destination and can use Lambda transforms before loading the data. See [Loading streaming data from Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations-fh.html).

For visualization, OpenSearch Service provides Dashboards with every domain. The Dashboards endpoint is `domain-endpoint/_dashboards/` for OpenSearch domains, and for legacy Elasticsearch domains the endpoint is `domain-endpoint/_plugin/kibana`. See [Using OpenSearch Dashboards with Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/dashboards.html).

Therefore, Firehose + Lambda + OpenSearch Service/Dashboards satisfies the managed ingestion, buffering, transformation, semi-structured event indexing, and near-real-time dashboard requirements.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform events.

Kinesis Data Streams can be used for real-time streaming and can integrate with Lambda/OpenSearch. However, it is not the best answer for this scenario because the question emphasizes **a buffer that automatically scales to match throughput and requires no ongoing administration**. Kinesis Data Streams has capacity modes. In provisioned mode, you must specify the number of shards and manage shard capacity; each shard provides a fixed unit of throughput. AWS documents that in provisioned mode you specify the number of shards and can increase or decrease the number of shards as needed. See [Kinesis Data Streams terminology and concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html).

Although Kinesis Data Streams on-demand mode reduces shard management, the answer choice does not specify on-demand mode, and Firehose is the more purpose-built, lower-administration delivery/buffering service for streaming events into OpenSearch.

### C. Configure an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster and use Amazon QuickSight.

This continues to rely on a relational PostgreSQL database pattern for event persistence, which is the pattern that is already failing due to ingestion and storage pressure. Aurora PostgreSQL is managed, but it does not provide the same purpose-built streaming buffer and event indexing/search/dashboarding workflow as Firehose plus OpenSearch Service. QuickSight can provide BI dashboards, but this option does not provide the requested automatically scaling streaming buffer or a search/observability tool optimized for semi-structured JSON event data and dynamic schemas.

### E. Configure an Amazon Neptune DB instance and use Amazon QuickSight.

Amazon Neptune is a graph database service, not a general-purpose log/event ingestion and observability store for semi-structured JSON monitoring events. This option also does not provide the required scalable streaming buffer. QuickSight is not the intended built-in near-real-time observability dashboarding tool for Neptune event ingestion in this scenario. OpenSearch Service with Dashboards is the better match.

## Final answer

**A and D**

zh.question: 一家公司有一个本地监控解决方案，使用 PostgreSQL 数据库来持久化事件。由于大量摄取，数据库无法扩展，并且经常耗尽存储空间。公司希望创建一个混合解决方案，并且已经在其网络和 AWS 之间建立了 VPN 连接。该解决方案应包括以下属性：• 使用托管式 AWS 服务以最大限度降低运营复杂性。• 一个可自动扩展以匹配数据吞吐量且无需持续管理的缓冲区。• 一个可视化工具，用于创建仪表板以近实时观察事件。• 支持半结构化 JSON 数据和动态架构。哪组组件组合将使公司能够创建满足这些要求的监控解决方案？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 来缓冲事件。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来处理和转换事件。
options.B: 创建 Amazon Kinesis data stream 来缓冲事件。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来处理和转换事件。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群来接收事件。使用 Amazon QuickSight 从数据库读取数据并创建近实时可视化和仪表板。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Elasticsearch Service (Amazon ES) 来接收事件。使用随 Amazon ES 部署的 Kibana 端点创建近实时可视化和仪表板。
options.E: 配置 Amazon Neptune DB 实例来接收事件。使用 Amazon QuickSight 从数据库读取数据并创建近实时可视化和仪表板。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司正在替换一个基于本地 PostgreSQL 的监控/事件持久化系统，该系统无法处理大量摄取或存储增长。目标架构必须使用托管式 AWS 服务，包括一个低管理成本且可扩展的缓冲区，转换半结构化 JSON 事件，并提供近实时仪表板。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 来缓冲事件。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来处理和转换事件。

Amazon Data Firehose 最适合作为缓冲和传送层，因为它是一项完全托管的流式传送服务。AWS 说明，Firehose 可将实时流数据传送到包括 Amazon OpenSearch Service 在内的目标，并且使用 Firehose 时无需编写应用程序或管理资源；你只需配置生产者将数据发送到 Firehose，它就会自动将数据传送到目标。Firehose 还具有明确的缓冲概念：它会在传送前按大小或时间缓冲传入的流数据。请参阅 [What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)。

Firehose 还支持在传送前使用 Lambda 进行转换。文档说明，Firehose 可以调用 Lambda 函数来转换传入的源数据，并将转换后的数据传送到目标。请参阅 [Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)。

这直接符合对托管式缓冲区的要求，该缓冲区需要最少管理，并且还可对传入事件数据进行处理/转换。

### D. 配置 Amazon Elasticsearch Service / Amazon OpenSearch Service 来接收事件，并使用 Kibana / OpenSearch Dashboards 创建近实时仪表板。

本考试使用旧名称“Amazon Elasticsearch Service”和“Kibana”。当前的服务和 UI 名称是 Amazon OpenSearch Service 和 OpenSearch Dashboards，但架构模式相同。

OpenSearch Service 适用于对事件数据进行索引/搜索并创建可观测性仪表板。AWS 文档说明，Amazon OpenSearch Service 与 Kinesis 服务集成以加载流数据，并包括使用 OpenSearch Dashboards 进行数据可视化。请参阅 [Features of Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/what-is.html)。

AWS 还说明，Firehose 支持将 OpenSearch Service 作为传送目标，并且可以在加载数据之前使用 Lambda 转换。请参阅 [Loading streaming data from Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations-fh.html)。

对于可视化，OpenSearch Service 为每个域提供 Dashboards。对于 OpenSearch 域，Dashboards 端点是 `domain-endpoint/_dashboards/`；对于旧版 Elasticsearch 域，端点是 `domain-endpoint/_plugin/kibana`。请参阅 [Using OpenSearch Dashboards with Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/dashboards.html)。

因此，Firehose + Lambda + OpenSearch Service/Dashboards 满足托管式摄取、缓冲、转换、半结构化事件索引和近实时仪表板要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 创建 Amazon Kinesis data stream 来缓冲事件。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来处理和转换事件。

Kinesis Data Streams 可用于实时流处理，并且可以与 Lambda/OpenSearch 集成。但是，它不是此场景的最佳答案，因为题目强调的是**一个可自动扩展以匹配吞吐量且无需持续管理的缓冲区**。Kinesis Data Streams 有容量模式。在预置模式下，你必须指定分片数量并管理分片容量；每个分片提供固定单位的吞吐量。AWS 文档说明，在预置模式下，你需要指定分片数量，并可根据需要增加或减少分片数量。请参阅 [Kinesis Data Streams terminology and concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)。

虽然 Kinesis Data Streams on-demand 模式减少了分片管理，但答案选项并未指定 on-demand 模式，而 Firehose 是更专门用于将流事件传送/缓冲到 OpenSearch 的低管理成本服务。

### C. 配置 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群并使用 Amazon QuickSight。

这仍然依赖关系型 PostgreSQL 数据库模式来进行事件持久化，而该模式已经由于摄取和存储压力而失败。Aurora PostgreSQL 是托管式的，但它不提供像 Firehose 加 OpenSearch Service 那样专为流式缓冲以及事件索引/搜索/仪表板工作流而构建的能力。QuickSight 可以提供 BI 仪表板，但此选项没有提供所需的可自动扩展的流式缓冲区，也没有提供针对半结构化 JSON 事件数据和动态架构优化的搜索/可观测性工具。

### E. 配置 Amazon Neptune DB 实例并使用 Amazon QuickSight。

Amazon Neptune 是图数据库服务，不是用于半结构化 JSON 监控事件的一般用途日志/事件摄取和可观测性存储。此选项也没有提供所需的可扩展流式缓冲区。在此场景中，QuickSight 不是用于 Neptune 事件摄取的预期内置近实时可观测性仪表板工具。OpenSearch Service 与 Dashboards 更匹配。

## 最终答案

**A 和 D**

en.question: A team collects and routes behavioral data for an entire company. The company runs a Multi-AZ VPC environment with public subnets, private subnets, and in internet gateway. Each public subnet also contains a NAT gateway. Most of the company’s applications read from and write to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Most of the workloads run in private subnets. A solutions architect must review the infrastructure. The solution architect needs to reduce costs and maintain the function of the applications. The solutions architect uses Cost Explorer and notices that the cost in the EC2-Other category is consistently high. A further review shows that NatGateway-Bytes charges are increasing the cost in the EC2-Other category. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable VPC Flow Logs. Use Amazon Athena to analyze the logs for traffic that can be removed. Ensure that security groups are blocking traffic that is responsible for high costs.
options.B: Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams to the VPC. Ensure that applications have the correct IAM permissions to use the interface VPC endpoint.
options.C: Enable VPC Flow Logs and Amazon Detective. Review Detective findings for traffic that is not related to Kinesis Data Streams. Configure security groups to block that traffic.
options.D: Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams to the VPC. Ensure that the VPC endpoint policy allows traffic from the applications.

en.explanation:
The company’s applications in private subnets are sending large volumes of Kinesis Data Streams traffic through NAT gateways, and Cost Explorer shows increasing `NatGateway-Bytes` charges. The requirement is to reduce cost while preserving the applications’ ability to read from and write to Kinesis.

**Correct answer: D. Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams to the VPC. Ensure that the VPC endpoint policy allows traffic from the applications.**

AWS explicitly recommends creating VPC endpoints when most NAT gateway traffic is going to AWS services that support interface or gateway endpoints, because NAT gateways charge for each GB processed. The NAT gateway pricing documentation states that you are charged per hour and per GB processed, and that if most traffic through the NAT gateway is to AWS services that support endpoints, you should consider creating an interface or gateway endpoint for those services ([Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)).

Kinesis Data Streams supports **interface VPC endpoints**. AWS states that after creating an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams, traffic from VPC resources can flow through the interface endpoint, and no changes are needed to streams, producers, or consumers ([Use interface VPC endpoints for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/vpc.html)). This keeps Kinesis traffic private inside the AWS network path and avoids sending that traffic through the NAT gateway.

Option D is the best wording because, after adding the endpoint, the endpoint policy must allow the required Kinesis actions/resources for the application traffic. AWS documents that VPC endpoint policies can be attached to Kinesis Data Streams interface endpoints and can restrict or allow access to Kinesis streams through the endpoint, used together with IAM policies ([Control access to VPC endpoints for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/vpc.html)). The applications are already reading from and writing to Kinesis, so their IAM permissions to call Kinesis are presumably already in place; the new configuration concern is ensuring the endpoint policy does not prevent the existing application traffic.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Enable VPC Flow Logs and use Athena; block high-cost traffic with security groups.**  
This might help identify traffic patterns, but it does not directly solve the stated root cause: large Kinesis traffic volumes being processed by NAT gateways. Blocking traffic could also break applications. The cost-optimized fix is to route supported AWS service traffic through a VPC endpoint instead of the NAT gateway.

**B. Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams; ensure applications have the correct IAM permissions to use the interface VPC endpoint.**  
This contains the main cost-saving action—adding the Kinesis interface endpoint—but the permission focus is less precise. Applications need IAM permissions to perform Kinesis actions, but those applications already function today. IAM permissions do not “use” the interface endpoint in the same way an endpoint policy controls what traffic/actions are allowed through that endpoint. The endpoint policy is the relevant new access control to verify after creating the VPC endpoint.

**C. Enable VPC Flow Logs and Amazon Detective; review findings and block unrelated traffic.**  
This is an investigation/security-analysis approach, not the direct cost-optimization solution. Amazon Detective is not needed to reduce NAT gateway data processing charges, and blocking traffic based on findings does not address the high-volume legitimate Kinesis traffic that is causing the NAT charges.

Therefore, **D** is the most appropriate solution: create a Kinesis Data Streams interface VPC endpoint and ensure the endpoint policy allows the applications’ required Kinesis access.

zh.question: 某团队负责收集并路由整个公司的行为数据。该公司运行一个 Multi-AZ VPC 环境，其中包含公有子网、私有子网和一个 Internet Gateway。每个公有子网还包含一个 NAT Gateway。公司的大多数应用程序都会读取和写入 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。大多数工作负载在私有子网中运行。解决方案架构师必须审查该基础设施。解决方案架构师需要在保持应用程序功能的同时降低成本。解决方案架构师使用 Cost Explorer，发现 EC2-Other 类别的成本一直很高。进一步审查显示，NatGateway-Bytes 费用正在增加 EC2-Other 类别的成本。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 VPC Flow Logs。使用 Amazon Athena 分析日志，找出可以移除的流量。确保安全组阻止导致高成本的流量。
options.B: 向 VPC 添加用于 Kinesis Data Streams 的接口 VPC 端点。确保应用程序具有使用该接口 VPC 端点的正确 IAM 权限。
options.C: 启用 VPC Flow Logs 和 Amazon Detective。查看 Detective 发现结果，找出与 Kinesis Data Streams 无关的流量。配置安全组以阻止该流量。
options.D: 向 VPC 添加用于 Kinesis Data Streams 的接口 VPC 端点。确保 VPC 端点策略允许来自应用程序的流量。

zh.explanation:
私有子网中的公司应用程序正在通过 NAT Gateway 发送大量 Kinesis Data Streams 流量，而 Cost Explorer 显示 `NatGateway-Bytes` 费用不断增加。要求是在保持应用程序读取和写入 Kinesis 能力的同时降低成本。

**正确答案：D。向 VPC 添加用于 Kinesis Data Streams 的接口 VPC 端点。确保 VPC 端点策略允许来自应用程序的流量。**

AWS 明确建议，当通过 NAT Gateway 的大部分流量都发往支持接口端点或网关端点的 AWS 服务时，应创建 VPC 端点，因为 NAT Gateway 会按处理的每 GB 收费。NAT Gateway 定价文档指出，会按小时和处理的每 GB 收费，并且如果通过 NAT Gateway 的大多数流量都是发往支持端点的 AWS 服务，则应考虑为这些服务创建接口端点或网关端点（[Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)）。

Kinesis Data Streams 支持 **接口 VPC 端点**。AWS 表示，在为 Kinesis Data Streams 创建接口 VPC 端点后，来自 VPC 资源的流量可以通过该接口端点流动，并且不需要对流、生产者或使用者进行更改（[Use interface VPC endpoints for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/vpc.html)）。这会使 Kinesis 流量在 AWS 网络路径内保持私有，并避免通过 NAT Gateway 发送该流量。

选项 D 的表述最佳，因为添加端点后，端点策略必须允许应用程序流量所需的 Kinesis 操作/资源。AWS 文档说明，可以将 VPC 端点策略附加到 Kinesis Data Streams 接口端点，并且可以限制或允许通过该端点访问 Kinesis 流，该策略与 IAM 策略配合使用（[Control access to VPC endpoints for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/vpc.html)）。这些应用程序已经在读取和写入 Kinesis，因此它们调用 Kinesis 的 IAM 权限大概已经存在；新的配置关注点是确保端点策略不会阻止现有应用程序流量。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 启用 VPC Flow Logs 并使用 Athena；使用安全组阻止高成本流量。**  
这可能有助于识别流量模式，但并不能直接解决所述根本原因：大量 Kinesis 流量由 NAT Gateway 处理。阻止流量还可能破坏应用程序。成本优化的修复方法是通过 VPC 端点路由受支持的 AWS 服务流量，而不是通过 NAT Gateway。

**B. 为 Kinesis Data Streams 添加接口 VPC 端点；确保应用程序具有使用该接口 VPC 端点的正确 IAM 权限。**  
这包含了主要的节省成本措施——添加 Kinesis 接口端点——但权限关注点不够精确。应用程序需要 IAM 权限来执行 Kinesis 操作，但这些应用程序目前已经能够正常工作。IAM 权限并不是以端点策略控制允许哪些流量/操作通过该端点的同样方式来“使用”接口端点。创建 VPC 端点后，需要验证的相关新访问控制是端点策略。

**C. 启用 VPC Flow Logs 和 Amazon Detective；查看发现结果并阻止无关流量。**  
这是一种调查/安全分析方法，而不是直接的成本优化解决方案。降低 NAT Gateway 数据处理费用不需要 Amazon Detective，并且基于发现结果阻止流量并不能解决导致 NAT 费用的高容量合法 Kinesis 流量。

因此，**D** 是最合适的解决方案：创建 Kinesis Data Streams 接口 VPC 端点，并确保端点策略允许应用程序所需的 Kinesis 访问。

en.question: A retail company has an on-premises data center in Europe. The company also has a multi-Region AWS presence that includes the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 Regions. The company wants to be able to route network traffic from its on-premises infrastructure into VPCs in either of those Regions. The company also needs to support traffic that is routed directly between VPCs in those Regions. No single points of failure can exist on the network. The company already has created two 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connections from its on-premises data center. Each connection goes into a separate Direct Connect location in Europe for high availability. These two locations are named DX-A and DX-B, respectively. Each Region has a single AWS Transit Gateway that is configured to route all inter-VPC traffic within that Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a private VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a private VIF from the DX-B connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit gateways with the Direct Connect gateway. Peer the transit gateways with each other to support cross-Region routing.
options.B: Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Associate the eu- west-1 transit gateway with this Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-8 connection into a separate Direct Connect gateway. Associate the us-east-1 transit gateway with this separate Direct Connect gateway. Peer the Direct Connect gateways with each other to support high availability and cross-Region routing.
options.C: Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-B connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit gateways with this Direct Connect gateway. Configure the Direct Connect gateway to route traffic between the transit gateways.
options.D: Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-B connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit gateways with this Direct Connect gateway. Peer the transit gateways with each other to support cross-Region routing.

en.explanation:
The company needs a highly available hybrid network from the European data center into VPCs behind transit gateways in **eu-west-1** and **us-east-1**, and it also needs **direct cross-Region VPC-to-VPC routing** between those Regions. The existing two Direct Connect connections are in separate Direct Connect locations, so the design should use both connections for resilience.

**Correct answer: D**

Option D is the best solution because:

* To connect an AWS Direct Connect connection to a transit gateway, AWS requires a **transit virtual interface** to a **Direct Connect gateway**. The Direct Connect documentation states: “To connect your Direct Connect connection to the transit gateway, you must create a transit interface for your connection” and specify the Direct Connect gateway ([Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)).
* A Direct Connect gateway can be associated with transit gateways and can connect Direct Connect over transit VIFs to VPCs or VPNs attached to those transit gateways. AWS documents that you “associate a Direct Connect gateway with the transit gateway” and “create a transit virtual interface” for the Direct Connect connection to the Direct Connect gateway ([Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)).
* A **single Direct Connect gateway is not a single point of failure** in this context. AWS describes a Direct Connect gateway as a globally available resource that operates outside the data traffic path and “avoids creating a single point of failure”; high availability is built in, so multiple Direct Connect gateways are not required ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). The redundancy comes from the two Direct Connect connections in separate locations, each with a transit VIF to the same Direct Connect gateway.
* For direct cross-Region routing between VPCs attached to different regional transit gateways, the transit gateways should be **peered**. AWS states that you can peer intra-Region and inter-Region transit gateways and “route traffic between them,” and that routing requires routes pointing to the peering attachment ([Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)).

Therefore, creating transit VIFs from both DX-A and DX-B to the same Direct Connect gateway, associating both regional transit gateways with that Direct Connect gateway, and peering the transit gateways satisfies both hybrid connectivity and cross-Region VPC routing requirements.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Incorrect.** This option uses **private VIFs** from Direct Connect to the Direct Connect gateway. Private VIFs are used with virtual private gateways/Direct Connect gateway VPC access patterns, but for connecting Direct Connect to a **transit gateway**, AWS requires a **transit virtual interface** ([Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)).

**B. Incorrect.** This option creates separate Direct Connect gateways and says to peer the Direct Connect gateways. Direct Connect gateways are globally available and high availability is inherently built in, so multiple Direct Connect gateways are not needed to avoid a single point of failure ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). Also, the required cross-Region VPC-to-VPC routing should be done by **transit gateway peering**, not by “peering” Direct Connect gateways.

**C. Incorrect.** This option correctly uses transit VIFs and associates both transit gateways with the Direct Connect gateway, but it says to configure the Direct Connect gateway to route traffic between the transit gateways. A Direct Connect gateway is for connecting Direct Connect transit VIFs to associated transit gateways; AWS states that it supports communication between attached transit virtual interfaces and associated transit gateways ([Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)). For direct inter-Region transit-gateway-to-transit-gateway routing, AWS provides **transit gateway peering**, which explicitly supports routing traffic between peered transit gateways ([Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)).

zh.question: 一家零售公司在欧洲有一个本地数据中心。该公司还在 AWS 中拥有多区域部署，其中包括 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 区域。公司希望能够将来自本地基础设施的网络流量路由到这两个区域中任一区域的 VPC。公司还需要支持在这些区域的 VPC 之间直接路由的流量。网络中不能存在单点故障。公司已经从其本地数据中心创建了两条 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。每条连接都接入欧洲的一个独立 Direct Connect 站点以实现高可用性。这两个站点分别命名为 DX-A 和 DX-B。每个区域都有一个 AWS Transit Gateway，该网关配置为路由该区域内的所有 VPC 间流量。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 DX-A 连接创建一个 private VIF 到 Direct Connect gateway。从 DX-B 连接创建一个 private VIF 到同一个 Direct Connect gateway 以实现高可用性。将 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 transit gateway 都关联到该 Direct Connect gateway。将这些 transit gateway 彼此对等连接，以支持跨区域路由。
options.B: 从 DX-A 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到 Direct Connect gateway。将 eu-west-1 transit gateway 与此 Direct Connect gateway 关联。从 DX-8 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到单独的 Direct Connect gateway。将 us-east-1 transit gateway 与这个单独的 Direct Connect gateway 关联。将这些 Direct Connect gateway 彼此对等连接，以支持高可用性和跨区域路由。
options.C: 从 DX-A 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到 Direct Connect gateway。从 DX-B 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到同一个 Direct Connect gateway 以实现高可用性。将 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 transit gateway 都关联到此 Direct Connect gateway。配置该 Direct Connect gateway 在这些 transit gateway 之间路由流量。
options.D: 从 DX-A 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到 Direct Connect gateway。从 DX-B 连接创建一个 transit VIF 到同一个 Direct Connect gateway 以实现高可用性。将 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 transit gateway 都关联到此 Direct Connect gateway。将这些 transit gateway 彼此对等连接，以支持跨区域路由。

zh.explanation:
公司需要从欧洲数据中心到 **eu-west-1** 和 **us-east-1** 中 transit gateway 后面的 VPC 的高可用混合网络，并且还需要这些区域之间的 **直接跨区域 VPC 到 VPC 路由**。现有的两条 Direct Connect 连接位于不同的 Direct Connect 站点，因此设计应使用这两条连接来实现弹性。

**正确答案：D**

选项 D 是最佳解决方案，因为：

* 要将 AWS Direct Connect 连接连接到 transit gateway，AWS 要求通过 **transit virtual interface** 连接到 **Direct Connect gateway**。Direct Connect 文档说明：“To connect your Direct Connect connection to the transit gateway, you must create a transit interface for your connection”，并指定 Direct Connect gateway（[Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)）。
* Direct Connect gateway 可以与 transit gateway 关联，并且可以通过 transit VIFs 将 Direct Connect 连接到附加到这些 transit gateway 的 VPC 或 VPN。AWS 文档说明，你要 “associate a Direct Connect gateway with the transit gateway”，并为到 Direct Connect gateway 的 Direct Connect 连接 “create a transit virtual interface”（[Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)）。
* 在此上下文中，**单个 Direct Connect gateway 不是单点故障**。AWS 将 Direct Connect gateway 描述为一个全局可用资源，它在数据流量路径之外运行，并且 “avoids creating a single point of failure”；高可用性是内置的，因此不需要多个 Direct Connect gateway（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。冗余来自两个不同站点中的 Direct Connect 连接，每条连接都有一个到同一 Direct Connect gateway 的 transit VIF。
* 对于附加到不同区域 transit gateway 的 VPC 之间的直接跨区域路由，应将这些 transit gateway **对等连接**。AWS 说明你可以对等连接同区域和跨区域 transit gateway，并在它们之间 “route traffic”，而路由需要指向 peering attachment 的路由（[Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)）。

因此，从 DX-A 和 DX-B 到同一个 Direct Connect gateway 创建 transit VIF，将两个区域 transit gateway 都与该 Direct Connect gateway 关联，并对等连接这些 transit gateway，可以同时满足混合连接和跨区域 VPC 路由要求。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 不正确。** 此选项使用从 Direct Connect 到 Direct Connect gateway 的 **private VIFs**。Private VIF 用于 virtual private gateway/Direct Connect gateway VPC 访问模式，但对于将 Direct Connect 连接到 **transit gateway**，AWS 要求使用 **transit virtual interface**（[Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)）。

**B. 不正确。** 此选项创建单独的 Direct Connect gateway，并说要对等连接 Direct Connect gateway。Direct Connect gateway 是全局可用的，并且高可用性是内置的，因此不需要多个 Direct Connect gateway 来避免单点故障（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。此外，所需的跨区域 VPC 到 VPC 路由应通过 **transit gateway peering** 完成，而不是通过“对等连接”Direct Connect gateway。

**C. 不正确。** 此选项正确使用 transit VIF，并将两个 transit gateway 都与 Direct Connect gateway 关联，但它说要配置 Direct Connect gateway 在这些 transit gateway 之间路由流量。Direct Connect gateway 用于将 Direct Connect transit VIF 连接到关联的 transit gateway；AWS 说明它支持附加的 transit virtual interface 与关联的 transit gateway 之间的通信（[Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)）。对于直接的跨区域 transit-gateway-to-transit-gateway 路由，AWS 提供 **transit gateway peering**，它明确支持在对等连接的 transit gateway 之间路由流量（[Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)）。

en.question: A company is running an application in the AWS Cloud. The company's security team must approve the creation of all new IAM users. When a new IAM user is created, all access for the user must be removed automatically. The security team must then receive a notification to approve the user. The company has a multi-Region AWS CloudTrail trail in the AWS account. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule. Define a pattern with the detail- type value set to AWS API Call via CloudTrail and an eventName of CreateUser.
options.B: Configure CloudTrail to send a notification for the CreateUser event to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.C: Invoke a container that runs in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate technology to remove access.
options.D: Invoke an AWS Step Functions state machine to remove access.
options.E: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the security team.
options.F: Use Amazon Pinpoint to notify the security team.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company already has a multi-Region CloudTrail trail. The requirement is to detect creation of an IAM user, automatically remove the user’s access, and then notify the security team for approval.

## Correct answers: A, D, E

**A. Create an EventBridge rule that matches `AWS API Call via CloudTrail` and `CreateUser`.**  
This is the correct detection mechanism. AWS documents that CloudTrail sends API-call events to the default EventBridge event bus, and that the `detail-type` for public AWS service API requests is **`AWS API Call via CloudTrail`**. Therefore, an EventBridge event pattern can match the IAM `CreateUser` API event and trigger automation. See [AWS service events delivered via AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-service-event-cloudtrail.html).

**D. Invoke an AWS Step Functions state machine to remove access.**  
This is the correct automation/orchestration choice among the options. EventBridge can invoke **Step Functions state machines** as rule targets; AWS lists “Step Functions state machine (ASYNC)” as an available EventBridge target. See [Event bus targets in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html). Step Functions can automate processes and call AWS services/APIs through service integrations, including AWS SDK integrations that provide access to AWS service API actions. See [What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html). A state machine could call IAM APIs or invoke another task to remove/disable any access such as access keys, login profile, group membership, or attached policies.

**E. Use Amazon SNS to notify the security team.**  
SNS is the appropriate notification service. Amazon SNS supports topic subscriptions, including email subscriptions, and subscribed email endpoints can receive messages after confirmation. See [Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html). EventBridge can also target an SNS topic directly, as AWS lists “Amazon SNS topic” as an EventBridge target in the EventBridge targets documentation.

## Why the other options are incorrect

**B. Configure CloudTrail to send a notification for the `CreateUser` event to SNS.**  
This is not the right mechanism for event-specific automation. CloudTrail SNS notifications are for notification when CloudTrail publishes new log files to the S3 bucket, not for directly notifying on a single API action such as `CreateUser`. The CloudTrail documentation states that CloudTrail sends a notification when log files are written to the S3 bucket and that the message contains the S3 bucket and object key for the log file. See [Configuring Amazon SNS notifications for CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html). EventBridge is the service intended to match the API event and route it to automation targets.

**C. Invoke a container on ECS with Fargate to remove access.**  
Although custom code in a container could theoretically call IAM APIs, this is not the best or intended answer here. The requirement is event-driven security automation. Step Functions is the better fit because it can be invoked by EventBridge and can orchestrate AWS API calls or tasks without introducing container lifecycle and operational overhead. The question’s required combination is detection with EventBridge, automation with Step Functions, and notification with SNS.

**F. Use Amazon Pinpoint to notify the security team.**  
Amazon Pinpoint is not the appropriate service for this operational/security approval notification use case. SNS is the standard AWS pub/sub notification service for sending alerts to subscribed endpoints such as email addresses or other systems.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个应用程序。该公司的安全团队必须批准所有新 IAM 用户的创建。当创建新的 IAM 用户时，必须自动移除该用户的所有访问权限。然后安全团队必须收到通知以批准该用户。该公司在 AWS 账户中有一个多区域 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。哪组步骤的组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则。定义一个模式，将 detail-type 值设置为 AWS API Call via CloudTrail，并将 eventName 设置为 CreateUser。
options.B: 配置 CloudTrail，将 CreateUser 事件的通知发送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
options.C: 调用一个在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中使用 AWS Fargate 技术运行的容器来移除访问权限。
options.D: 调用 AWS Step Functions 状态机来移除访问权限。
options.E: 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知安全团队。
options.F: 使用 Amazon Pinpoint 通知安全团队。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司已经有一个多区域 CloudTrail 跟踪。要求是检测 IAM 用户的创建，自动移除该用户的访问权限，然后通知安全团队进行审批。

## 正确答案：A、D、E

**A. 创建一个匹配 `AWS API Call via CloudTrail` 和 `CreateUser` 的 EventBridge 规则。**  
这是正确的检测机制。AWS 文档说明，CloudTrail 会将 API 调用事件发送到默认 EventBridge 事件总线，并且公共 AWS 服务 API 请求的 `detail-type` 是 **`AWS API Call via CloudTrail`**。因此，EventBridge 事件模式可以匹配 IAM `CreateUser` API 事件并触发自动化。请参阅 [AWS service events delivered via AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-service-event-cloudtrail.html)。

**D. 调用 AWS Step Functions 状态机来移除访问权限。**
