在这些选项中，这是正确的自动化/编排选择。EventBridge 可以调用 **Step Functions state machines** 作为规则目标；AWS 将“Step Functions state machine (ASYNC)”列为可用的 EventBridge 目标。请参阅 [Event bus targets in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)。Step Functions 可以通过服务集成自动化流程并调用 AWS 服务/API，包括提供 AWS 服务 API 操作访问权限的 AWS SDK 集成。请参阅 [What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)。状态机可以调用 IAM API，或调用另一个任务来移除/禁用任何访问方式，例如访问密钥、登录配置文件、组成员身份或附加的策略。

**E. 使用 Amazon SNS 通知安全团队。**  
SNS 是合适的通知服务。Amazon SNS 支持主题订阅，包括电子邮件订阅；订阅的电子邮件端点在确认后可以接收消息。请参阅 [Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)。EventBridge 也可以直接以 SNS 主题为目标，因为 AWS 在 EventBridge 目标文档中将“Amazon SNS topic”列为 EventBridge 目标。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. 配置 CloudTrail 将 `CreateUser` 事件的通知发送到 SNS。**  
这不是用于特定事件自动化的正确机制。CloudTrail SNS 通知是在 CloudTrail 将新的日志文件发布到 S3 存储桶时发送的通知，而不是针对单个 API 操作（例如 `CreateUser`）直接发送通知。CloudTrail 文档说明，CloudTrail 在日志文件写入 S3 存储桶时发送通知，并且消息包含日志文件的 S3 存储桶和对象键。请参阅 [Configuring Amazon SNS notifications for CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html)。EventBridge 才是用于匹配 API 事件并将其路由到自动化目标的服务。

**C. 调用 ECS 上使用 Fargate 的容器来移除访问权限。**  
虽然容器中的自定义代码理论上可以调用 IAM API，但这不是这里最佳或预期的答案。要求是事件驱动的安全自动化。Step Functions 更适合，因为它可以由 EventBridge 调用，并且可以编排 AWS API 调用或任务，而不会引入容器生命周期和运维开销。该题要求的组合是使用 EventBridge 进行检测、使用 Step Functions 进行自动化、使用 SNS 进行通知。

**F. 使用 Amazon Pinpoint 通知安全团队。**  
Amazon Pinpoint 不适合这种运营/安全审批通知用例。SNS 是标准的 AWS 发布/订阅通知服务，用于向电子邮件地址或其他系统等订阅端点发送告警。

en.question: A company wants to migrate to AWS. The company wants to use a multi-account structure with centrally managed access to all accounts and applications. The company also wants to keep the traffic on a private network. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required at login, and specific roles are assigned to user groups. The company must create separate accounts for development. staging, production, and shared network. The production account and the shared network account must have connectivity to all accounts. The development account and the staging account must have access only to each other. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take 10 meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy a landing zone environment by using AWS Control Tower. Enroll accounts and invite existing accounts into the resulting organization in AWS Organizations.
options.B: Enable AWS Security Hub in all accounts to manage cross-account access. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail to force MFA login.
options.C: Create transit gateways and transit gateway VPC attachments in each account. Configure appropriate route tables.
options.D: Set up and enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Create appropriate permission sets with required MFA for existing accounts.
options.E: Enable AWS Control Tower in all accounts to manage routing between accounts. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail to force MFA login.
options.F: Create IAM users and groups. Configure MFA for all users. Set up Amazon Cognoto user pools and Identity pools to manage access to accounts and between accounts.

en.explanation:
The company needs three capabilities: (1) a governed multi-account AWS environment for dev, staging, production, and shared network accounts; (2) centralized workforce access with MFA and group/role-based permissions; and (3) private network connectivity with routing isolation rules between accounts/VPCs.

Correct answers: **A, C, and D**.

- **A. Deploy a landing zone environment by using AWS Control Tower. Enroll accounts and invite existing accounts into the resulting organization in AWS Organizations.**  
  This meets the multi-account governance requirement. AWS Control Tower is designed to set up and govern a secure multi-account AWS environment and orchestrates AWS Organizations, AWS Service Catalog, and IAM Identity Center to build a landing zone. Its landing zone is described as a well-architected multi-account environment containing OUs, accounts, users, and resources. See [What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html).

- **C. Create transit gateways and transit gateway VPC attachments in each account. Configure appropriate route tables.**  
  This addresses private network connectivity and segmentation. AWS Transit Gateway acts as a Regional virtual router for traffic between VPCs and other networks, and VPCs are connected by transit gateway attachments. Transit Gateway route tables can be used to route traffic between attachments, and AWS documentation explicitly notes that you can create additional route tables to isolate subsets of attachments. This supports a design where production and shared network VPC attachments can route to all accounts, while development and staging route only to each other. See [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html) and [Connect your VPC to other VPCs and networks using a transit gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/extend-tgw.html).

- **D. Set up and enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Create appropriate permission sets with required MFA for existing accounts.**  
  This meets centralized access, group-based role assignment, and MFA requirements. IAM Identity Center provides a single place to assign permissions to groups of users in multiple AWS accounts, and account access is granted to users or groups through permission sets. IAM Identity Center also supports configuring MFA for user sign-in when using supported identity sources. See [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html), [Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html), and [Configure MFA in IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/mfa-configure.html).

Incorrect options:

- **B. Enable AWS Security Hub in all accounts to manage cross-account access. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail to force MFA login.**  
  Security Hub is for security posture management and findings aggregation, not for centralized AWS account access management or enforcing MFA login. CloudTrail records API activity; it does not itself force MFA authentication. This option also does not create the required multi-account landing zone or private network connectivity.

- **E. Enable AWS Control Tower in all accounts to manage routing between accounts. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail to force MFA login.**  
  Control Tower governs and provisions multi-account environments, but it is not a network routing service. Routing between VPCs/accounts is handled by networking services such as Transit Gateway and VPC route tables. CloudTrail also does not enforce MFA login.

- **F. Create IAM users and groups. Configure MFA for all users. Set up Amazon Cognito user pools and identity pools to manage access to accounts and between accounts.**  
  IAM users/groups are not the recommended centralized workforce SSO model for multi-account AWS access, and Amazon Cognito is primarily for application user identity, not centralized administrative access to AWS accounts across an organization. This option also does not provide the required private VPC-to-VPC routing segmentation.

Therefore, the best combination is **A, C, and D**.

zh.question: 一家公司希望迁移到 AWS。该公司希望使用多账户结构，并集中管理对所有账户和应用程序的访问。该公司还希望将流量保留在私有网络上。登录时需要多重身份验证（MFA），并将特定角色分配给用户组。该公司必须为开发、预发布、生产和共享网络创建单独的账户。生产账户和共享网络账户必须能够连接到所有账户。开发账户和预发布账户只能彼此访问。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Control Tower 部署 landing zone 环境。将账户注册到 AWS Organizations 中生成的组织，并邀请现有账户加入该组织。
options.B: 在所有账户中启用 AWS Security Hub 以管理跨账户访问。通过 AWS CloudTrail 收集发现结果以强制 MFA 登录。
options.C: 在每个账户中创建 transit gateway 和 transit gateway VPC attachment。配置适当的路由表。
options.D: 设置并启用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。为现有账户创建适当的权限集，并要求 MFA。
options.E: 在所有账户中启用 AWS Control Tower 以管理账户之间的路由。通过 AWS CloudTrail 收集发现结果以强制 MFA 登录。
options.F: 创建 IAM 用户和组。为所有用户配置 MFA。设置 Amazon Cognoto 用户池和身份池，以管理对账户以及账户之间的访问。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要三项能力：(1) 为开发、预发布、生产和共享网络账户提供受治理的多账户 AWS 环境；(2) 通过 MFA 以及基于组/角色的权限实现集中式员工访问；(3) 在账户/VPC 之间通过路由隔离规则实现私有网络连接。

正确答案：**A、C 和 D**。

- **A. 使用 AWS Control Tower 部署 landing zone 环境。将账户注册到 AWS Organizations 中生成的组织，并邀请现有账户加入该组织。**  
  这满足多账户治理要求。AWS Control Tower 旨在设置和治理安全的多账户 AWS 环境，并编排 AWS Organizations、AWS Service Catalog 和 IAM Identity Center 来构建 landing zone。其 landing zone 被描述为包含 OU、账户、用户和资源的良好架构多账户环境。请参阅 [What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)。

- **C. 在每个账户中创建 transit gateway 和 transit gateway VPC attachment。配置适当的路由表。**  
  这解决了私有网络连接和分段问题。AWS Transit Gateway 充当 VPC 与其他网络之间流量的区域级虚拟路由器，VPC 通过 transit gateway attachment 连接。Transit Gateway 路由表可用于在 attachment 之间路由流量，AWS 文档明确指出，你可以创建额外的路由表来隔离 attachment 子集。这支持一种设计：生产和共享网络 VPC attachment 可以路由到所有账户，而开发和预发布只彼此路由。请参阅 [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html) 和 [Connect your VPC to other VPCs and networks using a transit gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/extend-tgw.html)。

- **D. 设置并启用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。为现有账户创建适当的权限集，并要求 MFA。**  
  这满足集中式访问、基于组的角色分配和 MFA 要求。IAM Identity Center 提供一个统一位置，可向多个 AWS 账户中的用户组分配权限，并且通过权限集向用户或组授予账户访问权限。IAM Identity Center 还支持在使用受支持的身份源时为用户登录配置 MFA。请参阅 [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)、[Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html) 和 [Configure MFA in IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/mfa-configure.html)。

错误选项：

- **B. 在所有账户中启用 AWS Security Hub 以管理跨账户访问。通过 AWS CloudTrail 收集发现结果以强制 MFA 登录。**  
  Security Hub 用于安全态势管理和发现结果聚合，而不是集中式 AWS 账户访问管理或强制 MFA 登录。CloudTrail 记录 API 活动；它本身不会强制 MFA 身份验证。此选项也没有创建所需的多账户 landing zone 或私有网络连接。

- **E. 在所有账户中启用 AWS Control Tower 以管理账户之间的路由。通过 AWS CloudTrail 收集发现结果以强制 MFA 登录。**  
  Control Tower 负责治理和预置多账户环境，但它不是网络路由服务。VPC/账户之间的路由由 Transit Gateway 和 VPC 路由表等网络服务处理。CloudTrail 也不会强制 MFA 登录。

- **F. 创建 IAM 用户和组。为所有用户配置 MFA。设置 Amazon Cognito 用户池和身份池，以管理对账户以及账户之间的访问。**  
  IAM 用户/组并不是多账户 AWS 访问的推荐集中式员工 SSO 模型，而 Amazon Cognito 主要用于应用程序用户身份，而不是跨组织集中管理对 AWS 账户的管理访问。此选项也未提供所需的私有 VPC 到 VPC 路由分段。

因此，最佳组合是 **A、C 和 D**。

en.question: A company runs its application in the eu-west-1 Region and has one account for each of its environments: development, testing, and production. All the environments are running 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by using stateful Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS for MySQL databases. The databases are between 500 GB and 800 GB in size. The development team and testing team work on business days during business hours, but the production environment operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The company wants to reduce costs. All resources are tagged with an environment tag with either development, testing, or production as the key. What should a solutions architect do to reduce costs with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs once every day. Configure the rule to invoke one AWS Lambda function that starts or slops instances based on me tag, day, and time.
options.B: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the evening. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that stops instances based on the tag. Create a second EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the morning. Configure the second rule lo invoke another Lambda function that starts instances based on the tag.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the evening, Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that terminates, instances based on the lag. Create a second EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the morning. Configure the second rule lo invoke another Lambda function that restores the instances from their last backup based on the tag.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every hour. Configure the rule to invoke one AWS Lambda function that terminates or restores instances from their last backup based on the tag. day, and time.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has separate development, testing, and production accounts/environments. Development and testing are needed only during business hours on business days, while production must remain available 24/7. The goal is to reduce cost with the **least operational effort** while preserving the state of EC2 instances and RDS for MySQL databases.

## Correct answer: B

**B is correct** because it uses scheduled EventBridge rules to stop non-production resources in the evening and start them again in the morning, based on the `environment` tag. This matches the business-hours usage pattern and avoids affecting production resources.

Official AWS documentation supports this approach:

* For EC2, stopping an instance preserves attached EBS root and data volumes and their data, while instance-hour charges stop. AWS states that attached EBS volumes and data persist when an EC2 instance is stopped, and that you are not charged for usage of a stopped instance, although EBS storage charges continue ([EC2 stop/start behavior and costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)).
* For RDS, AWS specifically lists **cost optimization for non-production databases** and **daily development** as common use cases for stopping DB instances. While stopped, an RDS DB instance is not charged for DB instance hours, although storage and backup charges continue ([Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)).
* EventBridge scheduled rules can run on a regular schedule using cron or rate expressions and can target AWS services, including invoking Lambda functions ([Creating a scheduled rule in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html)).

Using two simple schedules and two simple Lambda functions is operationally straightforward:

1. Evening business-day schedule: stop development and testing EC2/RDS resources based on tags.
2. Morning business-day schedule: start those same tagged resources.
3. Production resources are excluded by their `production` tag and remain running.

This preserves state and avoids the time, risk, and complexity of terminating and restoring large 500–800 GB databases.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. One daily EventBridge rule with one Lambda function

This is not the best fit because a rule that runs **once per day** cannot both stop resources in the evening and start them in the morning unless the schedule or function design is changed beyond what the option states. A single daily invocation would perform only one action at one time of day. The option also pushes day/time decision logic into one Lambda function, making the automation more complex than two clear scheduled actions.

### C. Terminate instances and restore them from backup

This is operationally worse and riskier. Termination/restoration is unnecessary for stateful EC2 instances and large RDS databases. AWS documentation shows that stopping is the intended mechanism for temporary non-production cost optimization for both EC2 and RDS. For RDS, AWS explicitly says stopping and starting is faster and more efficient than creating a snapshot, deleting the DB instance, and restoring the snapshot later ([RDS stop use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)). Restoring 500–800 GB databases every business morning would add significant startup time and operational risk.

### D. Hourly terminate/restore automation

This has the same termination/restore problems as option C, but with even more unnecessary operational complexity. Running hourly logic to decide whether to terminate or restore resources is excessive for a simple business-hours schedule. It also introduces avoidable risk to stateful workloads and large databases.

## Conclusion

The best answer is **B**. Scheduled stop/start automation for tagged development and testing resources reduces compute and database instance-hour costs while preserving state and minimizing operational effort.

zh.question: 一家公司在 eu-west-1 区域运行其应用程序，并且为每个环境分别拥有一个账户：开发、测试和生产。所有环境都使用有状态的 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库，每周 7 天、每天 24 小时运行。数据库大小在 500 GB 到 800 GB 之间。开发团队和测试团队在工作日的工作时间工作，但生产环境每周 7 天、每天 24 小时运行。公司希望降低成本。所有资源都带有环境标签，标签键为 development、testing 或 production。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的运营工作量降低成本？

options.A: 创建一个每天运行一次的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据标签、日期和时间来启动或停止实例。
options.B: 创建一个在每个工作日晚上运行的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据标签停止实例。创建第二个在每个工作日早上运行的 EventBridge 规则。配置第二个规则调用另一个 Lambda 函数，根据标签启动实例。
options.C: 创建一个在每个工作日晚上运行的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据标签终止实例。创建第二个在每个工作日早上运行的 EventBridge 规则。配置第二个规则调用另一个 Lambda 函数，根据标签从最近一次备份还原实例。
options.D: 创建一个每小时运行一次的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据标签、日期和时间终止实例或从最近一次备份还原实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司拥有独立的开发、测试和生产账户/环境。开发和测试只需要在工作日的工作时间使用，而生产必须保持 24/7 可用。目标是在保留 EC2 实例和 RDS for MySQL 数据库状态的同时，以**最少的运营工作量**降低成本。

## 正确答案：B

**B 是正确的**，因为它使用计划的 EventBridge 规则，在晚上停止非生产资源，并在早上再次启动这些资源，依据的是 `environment` 标签。这与工作时间的使用模式相匹配，并避免影响生产资源。

AWS 官方文档支持这种方法：

* 对于 EC2，停止实例会保留附加的 EBS 根卷和数据卷及其数据，同时实例小时费用会停止。AWS 表示，当 EC2 实例停止时，附加的 EBS 卷和数据会保留，并且不会对已停止实例的使用收费，但 EBS 存储费用仍会继续产生（[EC2 stop/start behavior and costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)）。
* 对于 RDS，AWS 明确将**非生产数据库的成本优化**和**日常开发**列为停止数据库实例的常见用例。RDS 数据库实例停止期间，不会按数据库实例小时收费，但存储和备份费用仍会继续产生（[Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。
* EventBridge 计划规则可以使用 cron 或 rate 表达式按常规计划运行，并且可以将 AWS 服务作为目标，包括调用 Lambda 函数（[Creating a scheduled rule in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html)）。

使用两个简单的计划和两个简单的 Lambda 函数在运营上很直接：

1. 工作日晚上计划：根据标签停止开发和测试 EC2/RDS 资源。
2. 工作日早上计划：启动这些相同的带标签资源。
3. 生产资源通过其 `production` 标签被排除，并保持运行。

这会保留状态，并避免终止和还原大型 500–800 GB 数据库所需的时间、风险和复杂性。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 一个每日 EventBridge 规则和一个 Lambda 函数

这不是最佳匹配，因为**每天一次**运行的规则无法既在晚上停止资源，又在早上启动资源，除非对计划或函数设计进行超出该选项描述范围的更改。单次每日调用只能在一天中的某个时间执行一个操作。该选项还把日期/时间判断逻辑放进一个 Lambda 函数中，使自动化比两个明确的计划操作更复杂。

### C. 终止实例并从备份还原

这在运营上更差且风险更高。对于有状态 EC2 实例和大型 RDS 数据库，终止/还原是不必要的。AWS 文档表明，停止是针对 EC2 和 RDS 进行临时非生产成本优化的预期机制。对于 RDS，AWS 明确表示，停止和启动比创建快照、删除数据库实例并稍后还原快照更快且更高效（[RDS stop use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。每个工作日早上还原 500–800 GB 数据库会增加显著的启动时间和运营风险。

### D. 每小时终止/还原自动化

这与选项 C 存在相同的终止/还原问题，但还增加了更多不必要的运营复杂性。对于一个简单的工作时间计划，每小时运行逻辑来决定是终止还是还原资源是过度的。它还会给有状态工作负载和大型数据库带来可避免的风险。

## 结论

最佳答案是 **B**。针对带标签的开发和测试资源进行计划停止/启动自动化，可以在保留状态并最大限度减少运营工作量的同时，降低计算和数据库实例小时成本。

en.question: A company is building a software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution on AWS. The company has deployed an Amazon API Gateway REST API with AWS Lambda integration in multiple AWS Regions and in the same production account. The company offers tiered pricing that gives customers the ability to pay for the capacity to make a certain number of API calls per second. The premium tier offers up to 3,000 calls per second, and customers are identified by a unique API key. Several premium tier customers in various Regions report that they receive error responses of 429 Too Many Requests from multiple API methods during peak usage hours. Logs indicate that the Lambda function is never invoked. What could be the cause of the error messages for these customers?

options.A: The Lambda function reached its concurrency limit.
options.B: The Lambda function its Region limit for concurrency.
options.C: The company reached its API Gateway account limit for calls per second.
options.D: The company reached its API Gateway default per-method limit for calls per second.

en.explanation:
The scenario describes a SaaS API implemented as API Gateway REST APIs with Lambda integrations, deployed in multiple Regions in one production AWS account. Customers are identified by API keys and premium customers can generate up to 3,000 calls per second. During peak periods, multiple premium customers receive `429 Too Many Requests`, and the Lambda function is never invoked. That points to throttling at API Gateway before the integration request is sent to Lambda.

**Correct answer: C. The company reached its API Gateway account limit for calls per second.**

API Gateway has account-level throttling limits that apply **across all APIs in an account in a specified Region**. The documentation states that, by default, API Gateway limits the steady-state RPS and burst **across all APIs within an AWS account, per Region**, and returns `429 Too Many Requests` when the burst/rate behavior is exceeded ([Throttle requests to your REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)). The API Gateway quotas page lists the default throttle quota as **10,000 RPS per account, per Region** across API Gateway API types, with burst capacity ([Amazon API Gateway quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/limits.html)).

Because several premium-tier customers can each send up to 3,000 RPS, only a few customers in the same Region can collectively exceed the regional account-level API Gateway quota. API Gateway would then throttle requests and return `429` before invoking the Lambda integration, which matches the logs showing that Lambda is never invoked. The same symptom can occur independently in multiple Regions because the quota is per account **per Region**.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. The Lambda function reached its concurrency limit.** Incorrect. If the request never invokes the Lambda function, the observed throttling is occurring before Lambda. The question explicitly says the Lambda function is never invoked, which is consistent with API Gateway throttling, not Lambda execution concurrency throttling.

- **B. The Lambda function reached its Region limit for concurrency.** Incorrect for the same reason as A. A Lambda regional concurrency issue would be a Lambda-side capacity issue, but the logs show the requests are stopped before Lambda invocation.

- **D. The company reached its API Gateway default per-method limit for calls per second.** Incorrect. API Gateway can have per-client, per-method, per-stage, and account-level throttling, and API Gateway applies configured per-client/per-method limits before account-level throttling ([Throttle requests to your REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)). However, the question does not describe a configured per-method throttle that is lower than the premium tier. The key facts are that errors occur for several premium customers, across multiple methods, during peak usage, and before Lambda invocation. That points to aggregate account-level API Gateway throttling rather than a single method-level throttle.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个软件即服务（SaaS）解决方案。该公司已在多个 AWS 区域中、同一个生产账户内，部署了一个集成 AWS Lambda 的 Amazon API Gateway REST API。该公司提供分层定价，让客户能够为每秒可发起一定数量 API 调用的容量付费。高级层级最高提供每秒 3,000 次调用，并且通过唯一的 API 密钥识别客户。位于不同区域的多个高级层级客户报告称，在峰值使用时段，他们从多个 API 方法收到 429 Too Many Requests 错误响应。日志表明 Lambda 函数从未被调用。对于这些客户而言，这些错误消息的原因可能是什么？

options.A: Lambda 函数达到了其并发限制。
options.B: Lambda 函数达到了其区域并发限制。
options.C: 该公司达到了 API Gateway 账户级每秒调用数限制。
options.D: 该公司达到了 API Gateway 默认的每方法每秒调用数限制。

zh.explanation:
该场景描述了一个 SaaS API，它以 API Gateway REST API 的形式实现，并与 Lambda 集成，部署在一个生产 AWS 账户中的多个区域。客户通过 API 密钥识别，高级客户最高可以产生 3,000 次/秒的调用。在峰值期间，多个高级客户收到 `429 Too Many Requests`，并且 Lambda 函数从未被调用。这表明在集成请求发送到 Lambda 之前，API Gateway 发生了限流。

**正确答案：C。该公司达到了 API Gateway 账户级每秒调用数限制。**

API Gateway 具有账户级限流限制，适用于**指定区域中一个账户内的所有 API**。文档说明，默认情况下，API Gateway 会限制**每个区域内一个 AWS 账户中所有 API**的稳态 RPS 和突发容量，并在超过突发/速率行为时返回 `429 Too Many Requests`（[Throttle requests to your REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)）。API Gateway 配额页面列出的默认限流配额是 API Gateway API 类型范围内**每个账户、每个区域 10,000 RPS**，并带有突发容量（[Amazon API Gateway quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/limits.html)）。

由于多个高级层级客户每个都可以发送最高 3,000 RPS，同一区域内只需少数几个客户就可以共同超过区域性的账户级 API Gateway 配额。随后 API Gateway 会在调用 Lambda 集成之前对请求进行限流并返回 `429`，这与日志显示 Lambda 从未被调用相匹配。由于配额是每个账户**每个区域**计算的，因此相同症状也可能在多个区域中独立发生。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Lambda 函数达到了其并发限制。** 不正确。如果请求从未调用 Lambda 函数，则观察到的限流发生在 Lambda 之前。题目明确说明 Lambda 函数从未被调用，这与 API Gateway 限流一致，而不是 Lambda 执行并发限流。

- **B. Lambda 函数达到了其区域并发限制。** 不正确，原因与 A 相同。Lambda 区域并发问题会是 Lambda 端的容量问题，但日志显示请求在调用 Lambda 之前就被停止了。

- **D. 该公司达到了 API Gateway 默认的每方法每秒调用数限制。** 不正确。API Gateway 可以具有每客户端、每方法、每阶段和账户级限流，并且 API Gateway 会在账户级限流之前应用已配置的每客户端/每方法限制（[Throttle requests to your REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)）。但是，题目并未描述配置了低于高级层级的每方法限流。关键事实是：错误发生在多个高级客户、多个方法中，发生于峰值使用期间，并且发生在 Lambda 调用之前。这指向聚合的账户级 API Gateway 限流，而不是单一方法级限流。

en.question: A financial company is planning to migrate its web application from on premises to AWS. The company uses a third-party security tool to monitor the inbound traffic to the application. The company has used the security tool for the last 15 years, and the tool has no cloud solutions available from its vendor. The company's security team is concerned about how to integrate the security tool with AWS technology. The company plans to deploy the application migration to AWS on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances will run in an Auto Scaling group in a dedicated VPC. The company needs to use the security tool to inspect all packets that come in and out of the VPC. This inspection must occur in real time and must not affect the application's performance. A solutions architect must design a target architecture on AWS that is highly available within an AWS Region. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the security tool on EC2 instances m a new Auto Scaling group in the existing VPC
options.B: Deploy the web application behind a Network Load Balancer
options.C: Deploy an Application Load Balancer in front of the security tool instances
options.D: Provision a Gateway Load Balancer for each Availability Zone to redirect the traffic to the security tool
options.E: Provision a transit gateway to facilitate communication between VPCs.

en.explanation:
The company is migrating an EC2-based web application into a dedicated VPC and must continue using an existing third-party security appliance to inspect all traffic entering and leaving the VPC. The architecture must provide real-time packet inspection, high availability in the Region, and minimal impact on application performance.

The correct choices are **A and D**.

**A. Deploy the security tool on EC2 instances in a new Auto Scaling group in the existing VPC** is correct. Because the vendor has no cloud-native offering, the security tool must be deployed as software or a virtual appliance on EC2 instances. Placing those instances in an Auto Scaling group provides a scalable, replaceable appliance fleet. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can attach target groups for Application Load Balancers, Network Load Balancers, and **Gateway Load Balancers**, and can use Elastic Load Balancing health checks to replace unhealthy instances ([Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)).

**D. Provision a Gateway Load Balancer for each Availability Zone to redirect the traffic to the security tool** is correct. Gateway Load Balancer is the AWS service designed for inline third-party appliance inspection. AWS describes Gateway Load Balancers as enabling deployment, scaling, and management of virtual appliances such as firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and deep packet inspection systems. Gateway Load Balancer operates at OSI Layer 3, listens for all IP packets across all ports, and combines a transparent network gateway with traffic distribution to appliance targets ([What is a Gateway Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)). Deploying the inspection path across Availability Zones supports high availability within the Region.

The other options are not the best fit:

**B. Deploy the web application behind a Network Load Balancer** is incorrect. A Network Load Balancer can load balance application traffic at Layer 4, but it is not the service specifically designed to transparently redirect all inbound and outbound VPC packets through a fleet of third-party inspection appliances. The requirement is packet inspection by the security tool, not merely load balancing the web application.

**C. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in front of the security tool instances** is incorrect. An Application Load Balancer is for application-layer HTTP/HTTPS load balancing. It is not appropriate for transparent inspection of all IP packets across all ports. Gateway Load Balancer is the load balancer type designed for this kind of third-party virtual appliance and deep packet inspection architecture.

**E. Provision a transit gateway to facilitate communication between VPCs** is incorrect. AWS Transit Gateway is a network transit hub used to interconnect VPCs and on-premises networks ([What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)). The question describes a single dedicated VPC for the migrated application and does not require interconnecting multiple VPCs. Transit Gateway also does not deploy or scale the existing security tool. The required design is to run the tool on EC2 appliance instances and steer traffic through them with Gateway Load Balancer.

zh.question: 一家金融公司计划将其 Web 应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。该公司使用第三方安全工具来监控进入应用程序的入站流量。该公司在过去 15 年中一直使用该安全工具，并且该工具的供应商没有可用的云解决方案。公司的安全团队担心如何将该安全工具与 AWS 技术集成。公司计划在 Amazon EC2 实例上将应用程序迁移部署到 AWS。EC2 实例将在专用 VPC 中的 Auto Scaling 组中运行。公司需要使用该安全工具检查进出该 VPC 的所有数据包。此检查必须实时进行，并且不得影响应用程序性能。解决方案架构师必须在 AWS 上设计一个在 AWS 区域内高度可用的目标架构。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在现有 VPC 中的新 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例上部署该安全工具
options.B: 将 Web 应用程序部署在 Network Load Balancer 后面
options.C: 在安全工具实例前面部署 Application Load Balancer
options.D: 为每个 Availability Zone 预置一个 Gateway Load Balancer，以将流量重定向到该安全工具
options.E: 预置 transit gateway 以促进 VPC 之间的通信。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在将基于 EC2 的 Web 应用程序迁移到专用 VPC 中，并且必须继续使用现有第三方安全设备来检查进入和离开该 VPC 的所有流量。该架构必须提供实时数据包检查、在该区域内的高可用性，并且对应用程序性能的影响最小。

正确选项是 **A 和 D**。

**A. Deploy the security tool on EC2 instances in a new Auto Scaling group in the existing VPC** 是正确的。由于供应商没有云原生产品，该安全工具必须作为软件或虚拟设备部署在 EC2 实例上。将这些实例放入 Auto Scaling 组中，可以提供可扩展、可替换的设备机群。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 可以为 Application Load Balancers、Network Load Balancers 和 **Gateway Load Balancers** 附加目标组，并且可以使用 Elastic Load Balancing 运行状况检查来替换不健康的实例（[Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)）。

**D. Provision a Gateway Load Balancer for each Availability Zone to redirect the traffic to the security tool** 是正确的。Gateway Load Balancer 是 AWS 为内联第三方设备检查而设计的服务。AWS 将 Gateway Load Balancer 描述为可用于部署、扩展和管理虚拟设备，例如防火墙、入侵检测和防御系统以及深度数据包检查系统。Gateway Load Balancer 在 OSI 第 3 层运行，侦听所有端口上的所有 IP 数据包，并将透明网络网关与到设备目标的流量分发结合起来（[What is a Gateway Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)）。跨 Availability Zones 部署检查路径可支持在该区域内实现高可用性。

其他选项不是最佳选择：

**B. Deploy the web application behind a Network Load Balancer** 是错误的。Network Load Balancer 可以在第 4 层对应用程序流量进行负载均衡，但它并不是专门设计用于将所有入站和出站 VPC 数据包透明地重定向到第三方检查设备机群的服务。该要求是由安全工具进行数据包检查，而不仅仅是对 Web 应用程序进行负载均衡。

**C. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in front of the security tool instances** 是错误的。Application Load Balancer 用于应用层 HTTP/HTTPS 负载均衡。它不适合对所有端口上的所有 IP 数据包进行透明检查。Gateway Load Balancer 才是为这种第三方虚拟设备和深度数据包检查架构设计的负载均衡器类型。

**E. Provision a transit gateway to facilitate communication between VPCs** 是错误的。AWS Transit Gateway 是一种网络传输枢纽，用于互连 VPC 和本地网络（[What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。题目描述的是迁移后的应用程序使用单个专用 VPC，并不要求互连多个 VPC。Transit Gateway 也不会部署或扩展现有安全工具。所需设计是在 EC2 设备实例上运行该工具，并使用 Gateway Load Balancer 将流量引导通过这些实例。

en.question: A company has purchased appliances from different vendors. The appliances all have IoT sensors. The sensors send status information in the vendors' proprietary formats to a legacy application that parses the information into JSON. The parsing is simple, but each vendor has a unique format. Once daily, the application parses all the JSON records and stores the records in a relational database for analysis. The company needs to design a new data analysis solution that can deliver faster and optimize costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Connect the IoT sensors to AWS IoT Core. Set a rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to parse the information and save a .csv file to Amazon. S3 Use AWS Glue to catalog the files. Use Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight for analysis.
options.B: Migrate the application server to AWS Fargate, which will receive the information from IoT sensors and parse the information into a relational format. Save the parsed information to Amazon Redshlft for analysis.
options.C: Create an AWS Transfer for SFTP server. Update the IoT sensor code to send the information as a .csv file through SFTP to the server. Use AWS Glue to catalog the files. Use Amazon Athena for analysis.
options.D: Use AWS Snowball Edge to collect data from the IoT sensors directly to perform local analysis. Periodically collect the data into Amazon Redshift to perform global analysis.

en.explanation:
The company currently does daily batch parsing into a relational database. The new design should ingest IoT sensor status data faster, handle simple vendor-specific parsing, and reduce cost for analytics.

**Correct answer: A.**

AWS IoT Core is the best fit for ingesting device messages. AWS documentation states that devices and applications can access AWS IoT through device SDKs, LoRaWAN, HTTP/HTTPS APIs, SDKs, and related interfaces, making it the IoT-native ingestion layer for sensor data ([AWS IoT Core: How your devices and apps access AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)). AWS IoT rules can then route messages to downstream AWS services. The IoT rule actions documentation specifically lists actions to **invoke Lambda** and to **store messages in S3** ([AWS IoT rule actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rule-actions.html)). The Lambda rule action documentation confirms that an AWS IoT rule can invoke a Lambda function asynchronously and pass the MQTT message as input ([AWS IoT Lambda rule action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/lambda-rule-action.html)).

This matches the requirement well: Lambda can perform the simple vendor-specific parsing, write normalized CSV data to Amazon S3, AWS Glue can catalog the files, and Athena can query the S3 data. Athena is serverless, queries data directly in S3 with standard SQL, returns results in seconds, scales automatically, and charges only for queries run ([What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). AWS Glue supports automatically discovering data and inferring schema information into the AWS Glue Data Catalog, which fits cataloging the S3 files for analytics ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)). This serverless data lake approach is faster than once-daily batch processing and avoids always-on database or application infrastructure.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. Migrate the application server to AWS Fargate and store data in Amazon Redshift** — This preserves the legacy application pattern rather than using an IoT-native ingestion pipeline. Fargate plus Redshift can work technically, but it is not the most cost-optimized option for simple parsing and ad hoc analysis compared with serverless IoT Core, Lambda, S3, Glue, and Athena. Redshift also introduces cluster/serverless warehouse cost and administration considerations that are unnecessary for this use case.
* **C. Use AWS Transfer for SFTP and update sensors to send CSV files** — This requires changing sensor code and uses an SFTP file-transfer pattern rather than IoT message ingestion. It also does not address near-real-time ingestion as directly as IoT Core rules. The scenario says sensors currently send proprietary status messages; requiring every sensor to produce CSV over SFTP adds device-side changes and operational friction.
* **D. Use Snowball Edge for local collection and periodic Redshift loading** — Snowball Edge is for edge computing and data transfer use cases, especially when connectivity or large-scale transfer is a concern. The question asks for faster analytics and cost optimization for ongoing IoT sensor status data. Periodic collection into Redshift would still be batch-oriented and is not the lowest-cost or fastest architecture for this scenario.

Therefore, **A** is the best answer because it uses managed/serverless IoT ingestion, event-driven parsing, low-cost S3 storage, Glue cataloging, and serverless Athena/QuickSight analytics.

zh.question: 一家公司从不同供应商处购买了设备。这些设备都配有 IoT 传感器。传感器以供应商专有格式将状态信息发送到一个旧版应用程序，该应用程序会将信息解析为 JSON。解析过程很简单，但每个供应商都有唯一的格式。应用程序每天一次解析所有 JSON 记录，并将记录存储在关系数据库中以供分析。公司需要设计一种新的数据分析解决方案，能够更快地交付结果并优化成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 IoT 传感器连接到 AWS IoT Core。设置规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来解析信息，并将 .csv 文件保存到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS Glue 对文件进行编目。使用 Amazon Athena 和 Amazon QuickSight 进行分析。
options.B: 将应用程序服务器迁移到 AWS Fargate，该服务器将接收来自 IoT 传感器的信息，并将信息解析为关系格式。将解析后的信息保存到 Amazon Redshift 以供分析。
options.C: 创建 AWS Transfer for SFTP 服务器。更新 IoT 传感器代码，通过 SFTP 将信息作为 .csv 文件发送到服务器。使用 AWS Glue 对文件进行编目。使用 Amazon Athena 进行分析。
options.D: 使用 AWS Snowball Edge 直接从 IoT 传感器收集数据以执行本地分析。定期将数据收集到 Amazon Redshift 中以执行全局分析。

zh.explanation:
该公司目前每天批量解析一次数据，并写入关系数据库。新的设计应更快地摄取 IoT 传感器状态数据，处理简单的供应商特定解析，并降低分析成本。

**正确答案：A。**

AWS IoT Core 最适合用于摄取设备消息。AWS 文档指出，设备和应用程序可以通过设备 SDK、LoRaWAN、HTTP/HTTPS API、SDK 以及相关接口访问 AWS IoT，因此它是面向传感器数据的 IoT 原生摄取层（[AWS IoT Core: How your devices and apps access AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)）。AWS IoT 规则随后可以将消息路由到下游 AWS 服务。IoT 规则操作文档明确列出了用于**调用 Lambda** 和**将消息存储在 S3 中**的操作（[AWS IoT rule actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rule-actions.html)）。Lambda 规则操作文档确认，AWS IoT 规则可以异步调用 Lambda 函数，并将 MQTT 消息作为输入传递（[AWS IoT Lambda rule action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/lambda-rule-action.html)）。

这很好地匹配了需求：Lambda 可以执行简单的供应商特定解析，将标准化的 CSV 数据写入 Amazon S3，AWS Glue 可以对文件进行编目，Athena 可以查询 S3 数据。Athena 是无服务器的，可以使用标准 SQL 直接查询 S3 中的数据，在数秒内返回结果，自动扩展，并且仅对运行的查询收费（[What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。AWS Glue 支持自动发现数据并将架构信息推断到 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中，这适合对用于分析的 S3 文件进行编目（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。这种无服务器数据湖方法比每天一次的批处理更快，并避免了始终运行的数据库或应用程序基础设施。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B. 将应用程序服务器迁移到 AWS Fargate，并将数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 中** — 这保留了旧版应用程序模式，而不是使用 IoT 原生摄取管道。Fargate 加 Redshift 在技术上可行，但与无服务器的 IoT Core、Lambda、S3、Glue 和 Athena 相比，对于简单解析和即席分析来说，它不是最具成本优化的选项。Redshift 还会引入集群/无服务器数据仓库成本和管理方面的考虑，而这些对于此用例并非必要。
* **C. 使用 AWS Transfer for SFTP，并更新传感器以发送 CSV 文件** — 这需要更改传感器代码，并使用 SFTP 文件传输模式，而不是 IoT 消息摄取。它也不像 IoT Core 规则那样直接解决近实时摄取。场景中说传感器当前发送专有状态消息；要求每个传感器通过 SFTP 生成 CSV，会增加设备端更改和运营摩擦。
* **D. 使用 Snowball Edge 进行本地收集，并定期加载到 Redshift** — Snowball Edge 适用于边缘计算和数据传输用例，尤其是在存在连接性或大规模传输问题时。题目要求针对持续的 IoT 传感器状态数据实现更快的分析和成本优化。定期收集到 Redshift 仍然是面向批处理的，并不是此场景中成本最低或最快的架构。

因此，**A** 是最佳答案，因为它使用托管/无服务器 IoT 摄取、事件驱动解析、低成本 S3 存储、Glue 编目以及无服务器 Athena/QuickSight 分析。

en.question: A company is migrating some of its applications to AWS. The company wants to migrate and modernize the applications quickly after it finalizes networking and security strategies. The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection in a central network account. The company expects to have hundreds of AWS accounts and VPCs in the near future. The corporate network must be able to access the resources on AWS seamlessly and also must be able to communicate with all the VPCs. The company also wants to route its cloud resources to the internet through its on- premises data center. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a Direct Connect gateway in the central account. In each of the accounts, create an association proposal by using the Direct Connect gateway and the account ID for every virtual private gateway.
options.B: Create a Direct Connect gateway and a transit gateway in the central network account. Attach the transit gateway to the Direct Connect gateway by using a transit VIF.
options.C: Provision an internet gateway. Attach the internet gateway to subnets. Allow internet traffic through the gateway.
options.D: Share the transit gateway with other accounts. Attach VPCs to the transit gateway.
options.E: Provision VPC peering as necessary.
options.F: Provision only private subnets. Open the necessary route on the transit gateway and customer gateway to allow outbound internet traffic from AWS to flow through NAT services that run in the data center.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs a scalable multi-account/multi-VPC network design. It already has AWS Direct Connect in a central network account, expects hundreds of accounts and VPCs, needs on-premises-to-all-VPC connectivity, and specifically wants AWS workloads to reach the internet through the on-premises data center rather than directly through AWS internet gateways.

The correct combination is **B, D, and F**.

## Correct answers

### B. Create a Direct Connect gateway and a transit gateway in the central network account. Attach the transit gateway to the Direct Connect gateway by using a transit VIF.

This is the scalable hybrid connectivity pattern. AWS documentation states that a Direct Connect gateway can be associated with **a transit gateway when you have multiple VPCs in the same Region**. It also states that to connect a Direct Connect connection to a transit gateway, you create a **transit virtual interface** and specify the Direct Connect gateway to connect to ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html), [Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)).

Using a transit gateway avoids creating and managing individual Direct Connect/private virtual interface or virtual private gateway relationships for hundreds of VPCs.

### D. Share the transit gateway with other accounts. Attach VPCs to the transit gateway.

This meets the multi-account and multi-VPC requirement. AWS Transit Gateway is designed as a hub that interconnects VPCs and on-premises networks. The documentation says you can attach one or more VPCs and a Direct Connect gateway to a transit gateway, and that a transit gateway works across AWS accounts. You can use AWS RAM to share the transit gateway with other accounts, after which those account owners can attach their VPCs to it ([What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html), [Transit gateways in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)).

This is the appropriate hub-and-spoke model for hundreds of VPCs across many accounts.

### F. Provision only private subnets. Open the necessary route on the transit gateway and customer gateway to allow outbound internet traffic from AWS to flow through NAT services that run in the data center.

The requirement says cloud resources must route to the internet through the on-premises data center. Therefore, the VPC subnets should not be public subnets with direct internet gateway routing. Instead, private subnet route tables should send default or internet-bound routes toward the transit gateway, and the transit gateway route tables should forward that traffic over the Direct Connect path to the on-premises network, where NAT services provide internet egress.

AWS documentation confirms that transit gateway route tables are used to configure routing between attachments, including VPC and Direct Connect gateway attachments, and can contain static or propagated routes that determine the next hop ([Transit gateway route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)). This supports routing AWS outbound internet traffic through the Direct Connect/transit gateway path to the data center.

## Incorrect answers

### A. Create a Direct Connect gateway in the central account. In each account, create an association proposal by using the Direct Connect gateway and the account ID for every virtual private gateway.

This uses virtual private gateways on individual VPCs rather than a transit gateway hub. It is not the best scalable design for hundreds of accounts and VPCs. AWS documentation distinguishes the use cases: a Direct Connect gateway can be associated with a **transit gateway when you have multiple VPCs**, or with individual virtual private gateways ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). For this scenario, transit gateway is the intended scalable aggregation point.

Also, a Direct Connect gateway with virtual private gateway associations is primarily for on-premises-to-VPC connectivity and does not provide the same centralized VPC-to-VPC transit routing model as AWS Transit Gateway.

### C. Provision an internet gateway. Attach the internet gateway to subnets. Allow internet traffic through the gateway.

This contradicts the requirement to route cloud resources to the internet through the on-premises data center. An internet gateway enables VPC resources in public subnets to communicate directly with the internet. AWS documentation states that a subnet with a route to an internet gateway is a public subnet, while a subnet without such a route is private ([Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). That is not the desired egress path here.

### E. Provision VPC peering as necessary.

VPC peering does not scale well for hundreds of VPCs and accounts because it creates many point-to-point relationships. The requirement calls for seamless communication across many VPCs and centralized on-premises connectivity. AWS Transit Gateway is the managed hub service for interconnecting VPCs and on-premises networks ([What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)).

## Conclusion

**B, D, and F** together provide the required scalable hybrid network: Direct Connect gateway plus transit gateway for on-premises connectivity, shared transit gateway VPC attachments for many accounts, and private-subnet routing through the transit gateway to on-premises NAT for centralized internet egress.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其部分应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望在确定网络和安全策略后，快速迁移并现代化这些应用程序。该公司已在一个中央网络账户中设置了 AWS Direct Connect 连接。公司预计在不久的将来会拥有数百个 AWS 账户和 VPC。企业网络必须能够无缝访问 AWS 上的资源，并且还必须能够与所有 VPC 通信。该公司还希望通过其本地数据中心将云资源路由到互联网。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在中央账户中创建 Direct Connect 网关。在每个账户中，使用 Direct Connect 网关和每个虚拟专用网关的账户 ID 创建关联提案。
options.B: 在中央网络账户中创建 Direct Connect 网关和 transit gateway。使用 transit VIF 将 transit gateway 附加到 Direct Connect 网关。
options.C: 预置 internet gateway。将 internet gateway 附加到子网。允许互联网流量通过该网关。
options.D: 与其他账户共享 transit gateway。将 VPC 附加到 transit gateway。
options.E: 根据需要预置 VPC peering。
options.F: 仅预置私有子网。在 transit gateway 和 customer gateway 上打开必要的路由，以允许来自 AWS 的出站互联网流量流经在数据中心运行的 NAT 服务。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要一个可扩展的多账户/多 VPC 网络设计。它已经在中央网络账户中拥有 AWS Direct Connect，预计会有数百个账户和 VPC，需要本地到所有 VPC 的连接，并且明确希望 AWS 工作负载通过本地数据中心访问互联网，而不是直接通过 AWS internet gateway。

正确组合是 **B、D 和 F**。

## 正确答案

### B. 在中央网络账户中创建 Direct Connect 网关和 transit gateway。使用 transit VIF 将 transit gateway 附加到 Direct Connect 网关。

这是可扩展的混合连接模式。AWS 文档说明，当你在同一 Region 中有多个 VPC 时，Direct Connect 网关可以与 **transit gateway** 关联。文档还说明，要将 Direct Connect 连接连接到 transit gateway，需要创建 **transit virtual interface**，并指定要连接到的 Direct Connect 网关（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)，[Create a transit virtual interface to the Direct Connect gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-transit-vif-for-gateway.html)）。

使用 transit gateway 可以避免为数百个 VPC 创建和管理单独的 Direct Connect/private virtual interface 或 virtual private gateway 关系。

### D. 与其他账户共享 transit gateway。将 VPC 附加到 transit gateway。

这满足了多账户和多 VPC 的要求。AWS Transit Gateway 被设计为一个互连 VPC 和本地网络的中心枢纽。文档说明，你可以将一个或多个 VPC 以及 Direct Connect 网关附加到 transit gateway，并且 transit gateway 可跨 AWS 账户工作。你可以使用 AWS RAM 与其他账户共享 transit gateway，之后这些账户的所有者可以将其 VPC 附加到该网关（[What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)，[Transit gateways in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)）。

对于跨许多账户的数百个 VPC，这是合适的 hub-and-spoke 模型。

### F. 仅预置私有子网。在 transit gateway 和 customer gateway 上打开必要的路由，以允许来自 AWS 的出站互联网流量流经在数据中心运行的 NAT 服务。

要求说明云资源必须通过本地数据中心路由到互联网。因此，VPC 子网不应是具有直接 internet gateway 路由的公有子网。相反，私有子网路由表应将默认路由或发往互联网的路由发送到 transit gateway，而 transit gateway 路由表应通过 Direct Connect 路径将该流量转发到本地网络，由那里的 NAT 服务提供互联网出口。

AWS 文档确认，transit gateway route tables 用于配置附件之间的路由，包括 VPC 和 Direct Connect gateway 附件，并且可以包含决定下一跳的静态路由或传播路由（[Transit gateway route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)）。这支持通过 Direct Connect/transit gateway 路径将 AWS 出站互联网流量路由到数据中心。

## 错误答案

### A. 在中央账户中创建 Direct Connect 网关。在每个账户中，使用 Direct Connect 网关和每个虚拟专用网关的账户 ID 创建关联提案。

这使用各个 VPC 上的虚拟专用网关，而不是 transit gateway 枢纽。对于数百个账户和 VPC，这不是最佳的可扩展设计。AWS 文档区分了使用场景：Direct Connect 网关可以在你有多个 VPC 时与 **transit gateway** 关联，也可以与各个虚拟专用网关关联（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。对于此场景，transit gateway 是预期的可扩展聚合点。

此外，具有虚拟专用网关关联的 Direct Connect 网关主要用于本地到 VPC 的连接，并不提供与 AWS Transit Gateway 相同的集中式 VPC 到 VPC 传递路由模型。

### C. 预置 internet gateway。将 internet gateway 附加到子网。允许互联网流量通过该网关。

这与通过本地数据中心将云资源路由到互联网的要求相矛盾。internet gateway 使公有子网中的 VPC 资源能够直接与互联网通信。AWS 文档说明，具有到 internet gateway 路由的子网是公有子网，而没有此类路由的子网是私有子网（[Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。这不是此处所需的出口路径。

### E. 根据需要预置 VPC peering。

VPC peering 对于数百个 VPC 和账户来说扩展性不佳，因为它会创建许多点对点关系。该要求需要跨许多 VPC 的无缝通信以及集中式本地连接。AWS Transit Gateway 是用于互连 VPC 和本地网络的托管中心服务（[What is AWS Transit Gateway for Amazon VPC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。

## 结论

**B、D 和 F** 共同提供所需的可扩展混合网络：Direct Connect gateway 加 transit gateway 用于本地连接，共享 transit gateway VPC attachments 用于多个账户，以及通过 transit gateway 到本地 NAT 的私有子网路由，用于集中式互联网出口。

en.question: A company has hundreds of AWS accounts. The company recently implemented a centralized internal process for purchasing new Reserved Instances and modifying existing Reserved Instances. This process requires all business units that want to purchase or modify Reserved Instances to submit requests to a dedicated team for procurement. Previously, business units directly purchased or modified Reserved Instances in their own respective AWS accounts autonomously. A solutions architect needs to enforce the new process in the most secure way possible. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled.
options.B: Use AWS Config to report on the attachment of an IAM policy that denies access to the ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the ec2:ModifyReservedInstances action.
options.C: In each AWS account, create an IAM policy that denies the ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the ec2:ModifyReservedInstances action.
options.D: Create an SCP that denies the ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the ec2:ModifyReservedInstances action. Attach the SCP to each OU of the organization.
options.E: Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations that uses the consolidated billing feature.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has many AWS accounts and wants to prevent individual business units from independently purchasing or modifying Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. The new process requires procurement through a dedicated team, so the solution must centrally enforce a deny guardrail across accounts in the most secure and scalable way.

## Correct answers: A and D

**A. Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled.**

This is required because AWS Organizations policies, including SCPs, are available when **all features are enabled**. AWS documentation states that policies in Organizations can be used when all features are enabled, and SCPs are an Organizations policy type that provides central control over the maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in the organization ([Managing organization policies with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies.html)).

**D. Create an SCP that denies the `ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering` action and the `ec2:ModifyReservedInstances` action. Attach the SCP to each OU of the organization.**

An SCP is the right enforcement mechanism because it centrally sets a permissions guardrail across member accounts. AWS documentation explains that SCPs specify the **maximum available permissions** for IAM users and roles in an organization, and that if an SCP explicitly denies an action, users or roles in affected accounts cannot perform that action even if an administrator attaches an IAM policy such as `AdministratorAccess` ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

The two EC2 actions named in the option are the relevant Reserved Instance operations:

- `PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering` purchases a Reserved Instance for an account ([PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.html)).
- `ModifyReservedInstances` modifies Reserved Instance configuration, such as Availability Zone, instance count, or instance type ([ModifyReservedInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ModifyReservedInstances.html)).

Therefore, denying these actions with an SCP at the OU level prevents business-unit member accounts from bypassing the centralized procurement process. SCPs also affect the member account root user, making this more secure than account-local IAM controls. Note that SCPs do not affect the management account, which is consistent with having a central team operate from a designated central/management context if required.

## Why the other options are incorrect

**B. Use AWS Config to report on the attachment of an IAM policy that denies access to the actions.**

AWS Config can detect or report configuration state, but reporting is not enforcement. This option would only identify whether a particular IAM policy is attached; it would not prevent a business unit from purchasing or modifying Reserved Instances.

**C. In each AWS account, create an IAM policy that denies the actions.**

An IAM deny policy inside each account is less secure and less scalable than an SCP. Account administrators could potentially change local IAM policies, and IAM policies do not provide an organization-wide guardrail in the same way that SCPs do. SCPs can block the actions even when an account administrator grants broad permissions such as `AdministratorAccess`.

**E. Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations that uses the consolidated billing feature.**

Consolidated billing helps centralize payment and billing across accounts, but it does not provide permission guardrails. For SCP-based enforcement, the organization must have all features enabled, not merely consolidated billing. This option does not prevent business units from invoking the EC2 Reserved Instance purchase or modification APIs.

## Final answer

**A and D**

zh.question: 一家公司拥有数百个 AWS 账户。该公司最近实施了一个集中式内部流程，用于购买新的 Reserved Instances 和修改现有的 Reserved Instances。该流程要求所有想要购买或修改 Reserved Instances 的业务部门都必须向一个专门团队提交采购请求。此前，各业务部门会在各自的 AWS 账户中自主直接购买或修改 Reserved Instances。解决方案架构师需要以尽可能安全的方式强制执行这个新流程。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 确保所有 AWS 账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中已启用所有功能的一个组织。
options.B: 使用 AWS Config 报告是否附加了拒绝访问 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 操作和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 操作的 IAM policy。
options.C: 在每个 AWS 账户中，创建一个拒绝 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 操作和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 操作的 IAM policy。
options.D: 创建一个拒绝 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 操作和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 操作的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到组织的每个 OU。
options.E: 确保所有 AWS 账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中使用 consolidated billing 功能的一个组织。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司拥有许多 AWS 账户，并希望阻止各个业务部门独立购买或修改 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances。新流程要求通过专门团队进行采购，因此解决方案必须以最安全且可扩展的方式，在各账户之间集中强制执行拒绝类护栏。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

**A. 确保所有 AWS 账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中已启用所有功能的一个组织。**

这是必需的，因为 AWS Organizations 策略（包括 SCP）在**启用所有功能**时可用。AWS 文档指出，当启用所有功能时，可以使用 Organizations 中的策略，而 SCP 是一种 Organizations 策略类型，可对组织中 IAM users 和 roles 的最大可用权限提供集中控制（[Managing organization policies with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies.html)）。

**D. 创建一个拒绝 `ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering` 操作和 `ec2:ModifyReservedInstances` 操作的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到组织的每个 OU。**

SCP 是正确的强制执行机制，因为它可以在成员账户之间集中设置权限护栏。AWS 文档说明，SCP 指定组织中 IAM users 和 roles 的**最大可用权限**，并且如果 SCP 显式拒绝某个操作，则受影响账户中的 users 或 roles 即使被管理员附加了诸如 `AdministratorAccess` 之类的 IAM policy，也无法执行该操作（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

选项中命名的两个 EC2 操作是相关的 Reserved Instance 操作：

- `PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering` 为账户购买一个 Reserved Instance（[PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.html)）。
- `ModifyReservedInstances` 修改 Reserved Instance 配置，例如 Availability Zone、实例数量或实例类型（[ModifyReservedInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ModifyReservedInstances.html)）。

因此，在 OU 级别使用 SCP 拒绝这些操作，可以防止业务部门的成员账户绕过集中式采购流程。SCP 还会影响成员账户的 root user，因此这比账户本地的 IAM 控制更安全。请注意，SCP 不影响管理账户；如果需要由中央团队从指定的中央/管理上下文中操作，这一点与之相符。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. 使用 AWS Config 报告是否附加了拒绝访问这些操作的 IAM policy。**

AWS Config 可以检测或报告配置状态，但报告并不是强制执行。此选项只会识别是否附加了某个特定 IAM policy；它不会阻止业务部门购买或修改 Reserved Instances。

**C. 在每个 AWS 账户中，创建一个拒绝这些操作的 IAM policy。**

每个账户内部的 IAM deny policy 不如 SCP 安全，也不如 SCP 可扩展。账户管理员可能会更改本地 IAM policies，而 IAM policies 无法像 SCP 那样提供组织范围的护栏。即使账户管理员授予诸如 `AdministratorAccess` 之类的广泛权限，SCP 也可以阻止这些操作。

**E. 确保所有 AWS 账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中使用 consolidated billing 功能的一个组织。**

Consolidated billing 有助于集中各账户的付款和账单，但它不提供权限护栏。对于基于 SCP 的强制执行，组织必须启用所有功能，而不仅仅是 consolidated billing。此选项不会阻止业务部门调用 EC2 Reserved Instance 购买或修改 API。

## 最终答案

**A 和 D**

en.question: A company is running a critical application that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL database to store data. The RDS DB instance is deployed in Multi-AZ mode. A recent RDS database failover test caused a 40-second outage to the application. A solutions architect needs to design a solution to reduce the outage time to less than 20 seconds. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached in front of the database
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in front of the database
options.C: Use RDS Proxy in front of the database.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL.
options.E: Create an Amazon Aurora Replica.
options.F: Create an RDS for MySQL read replica

en.explanation:
The application is already using an RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance, but a failover test caused about 40 seconds of outage. The requirement is to reduce application-visible outage to **less than 20 seconds**, so the solution must reduce both the database failover time and client reconnection/DNS-delay impact.

**Correct answers: C, D, E**

- **C. Use RDS Proxy in front of the database — Correct.** AWS states that RDS Proxy helps applications tolerate database failures by automatically routing traffic to a new database instance while preserving application connections. It also bypasses DNS caches and can reduce failover times for Aurora Multi-AZ databases by up to 66% ([High availability for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)). This directly addresses application outage caused by failover and DNS/client reconnection behavior.
- **D. Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL — Correct.** Standard RDS Multi-AZ DB instance failover is typically **60–120 seconds**, though actual time depends on database activity and recovery conditions ([RDS Multi-AZ DB instance failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)). Aurora is designed for faster recovery and has failover features that minimize the time the database is unavailable for writes ([High availability for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)). Migrating to Aurora MySQL is therefore the database platform change needed to reach a sub-20-second target when combined with RDS Proxy and a failover target.
- **E. Create an Amazon Aurora Replica — Correct.** Aurora Replicas are not only for read scaling; AWS explicitly says they increase availability because, if the writer becomes unavailable, Aurora automatically promotes one of the reader instances as the new writer ([Replication with Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). AWS also recommends creating one or more Aurora Replicas in different Availability Zones for high-availability scenarios, and notes that promoting an Aurora Replica is much faster than recreating the primary instance. Without an Aurora Replica, the cluster is unavailable while the DB instance recovers.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached in front of the database — Incorrect.** ElastiCache is a distributed in-memory data store/cache service used to improve caching performance ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)). It can reduce read latency or absorb some read traffic, but it does not reduce the RDS/Aurora writer failover time, does not promote a database instance, and does not solve write-path outage during database failover.
- **B. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in front of the database — Incorrect.** For the same reason as Memcached, Redis/Redis OSS in ElastiCache is a caching layer, not a database failover mechanism. It does not address the primary database endpoint transition or application reconnection behavior during an RDS MySQL failover.
- **F. Create an RDS for MySQL read replica — Incorrect.** RDS read replicas are primarily for read scaling, serving read traffic when the source is unavailable, reporting, or disaster recovery. AWS documents that RDS read replicas use asynchronous replication and can be promoted to standalone instances for disaster recovery ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). They are not automatic, low-latency failover targets for the existing RDS MySQL Multi-AZ writer in the way Aurora Replicas are within an Aurora cluster, and they would not reliably reduce application outage below 20 seconds.

Therefore, the best combination is to **migrate to Aurora MySQL, create an Aurora Replica as a fast failover target, and place RDS Proxy in front of the database**: **C, D, and E**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在运行一个关键应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库来存储数据。该 RDS 数据库实例以 Multi-AZ 模式部署。最近一次 RDS 数据库故障转移测试导致应用程序中断了 40 秒。解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案，将中断时间减少到少于 20 秒。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在数据库前使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached
options.B: 在数据库前使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis
options.C: 在数据库前使用 RDS Proxy。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL。
options.E: 创建一个 Amazon Aurora Replica。
options.F: 创建一个 RDS for MySQL 只读副本

zh.explanation:
该应用程序已经在使用 RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ 数据库实例，但一次故障转移测试造成了约 40 秒的中断。要求是将应用程序可感知的中断减少到 **少于 20 秒**，因此解决方案必须同时减少数据库故障转移时间以及客户端重新连接/DNS 延迟的影响。

**正确答案：C、D、E**

- **C. 在数据库前使用 RDS Proxy — 正确。** AWS 表示，RDS Proxy 通过在保留应用程序连接的同时自动将流量路由到新的数据库实例，帮助应用程序容忍数据库故障。它还会绕过 DNS 缓存，并且可以将 Aurora Multi-AZ 数据库的故障转移时间减少多达 66%（[Amazon Aurora 的高可用性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)）。这直接解决了由故障转移以及 DNS/客户端重新连接行为导致的应用程序中断。
- **D. 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL — 正确。** 标准 RDS Multi-AZ 数据库实例故障转移通常需要 **60–120 秒**，不过实际时间取决于数据库活动和恢复条件（[RDS Multi-AZ 数据库实例故障转移](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。Aurora 设计用于更快恢复，并具有可最大限度缩短数据库不可用于写入时间的故障转移功能（[Amazon Aurora 的高可用性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)）。因此，迁移到 Aurora MySQL 是数据库平台层面的必要变更，与 RDS Proxy 和故障转移目标结合使用时，才能达到低于 20 秒的目标。
- **E. 创建一个 Amazon Aurora Replica — 正确。** Aurora Replicas 不仅用于读取扩展；AWS 明确说明它们可以提高可用性，因为如果写入器不可用，Aurora 会自动将其中一个读取器实例提升为新的写入器（[使用 Amazon Aurora 进行复制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。AWS 还建议在不同可用区中创建一个或多个 Aurora Replicas 以满足高可用性场景，并指出提升 Aurora Replica 比重新创建主实例快得多。如果没有 Aurora Replica，集群在数据库实例恢复期间将不可用。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 在数据库前使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached — 不正确。** ElastiCache 是一种分布式内存中数据存储/缓存服务，用于提高缓存性能（[什么是 Amazon ElastiCache？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。它可以降低读取延迟或吸收部分读取流量，但不会减少 RDS/Aurora 写入器故障转移时间，不会提升数据库实例，也不能解决数据库故障转移期间写入路径的中断。
- **B. 在数据库前使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis — 不正确。** 与 Memcached 的原因相同，ElastiCache 中的 Redis/Redis OSS 是缓存层，而不是数据库故障转移机制。它不能解决 RDS MySQL 故障转移期间主数据库端点切换或应用程序重新连接行为的问题。
- **F. 创建一个 RDS for MySQL 只读副本 — 不正确。** RDS 只读副本主要用于读取扩展、在源不可用时提供读取流量、报表或灾难恢复。AWS 文档说明，RDS 只读副本使用异步复制，并且可以提升为独立实例用于灾难恢复（[使用数据库实例只读副本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。它们不是现有 RDS MySQL Multi-AZ 写入器的自动低延迟故障转移目标，无法像 Aurora 集群内的 Aurora Replicas 那样工作，并且不能可靠地将应用程序中断减少到 20 秒以下。

因此，最佳组合是 **迁移到 Aurora MySQL，创建 Aurora Replica 作为快速故障转移目标，并在数据库前放置 RDS Proxy**：**C、D 和 E**。

en.question: An AWS partner company is building a service in AWS Organizations using its organization named org1. This service requires the partner company to have access to AWS resources in a customer account, which is in a separate organization named org2. The company must establish least privilege security access using an API or command line tool to the customer account. What is the MOST secure way to allow org1 to access resources in org2?

options.A: The customer should provide the partner company with their AWS account access keys to log in and perform the required tasks.
options.B: The customer should create an IAM user and assign the required permissions to the IAM user. The customer should then provide the credentials to the partner company to log in and perform the required tasks.
options.C: The customer should create an IAM role and assign the required permissions to the IAM role. The partner company should then use the IAM role’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN) when requesting access to perform the required tasks.
options.D: The customer should create an IAM role and assign the required permissions to the IAM role. The partner company should then use the IAM role’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN), including the external ID in the IAM role’s trust policy, when requesting access to perform the required tasks.

en.explanation:
The scenario asks how a partner company in one AWS Organization should securely access resources in a customer's account in a different AWS Organization, using API/CLI access and least privilege.

**Correct answer: D.**

The customer should create an **IAM role** in the customer account, attach only the permissions required for the partner's task, and configure the role trust policy so the partner's AWS account can assume it **only when the correct `sts:ExternalId` is supplied**. AWS documentation describes this exact third-party access pattern: do not give the third party IAM user long-term credentials; instead use an IAM role and temporary security credentials. The third party calls `sts:AssumeRole` with the role ARN and the `ExternalId`, and the role trust policy checks that external ID before allowing access. AWS states that external IDs are used for third-party access to address and prevent the confused deputy problem, and recommends one external ID per customer/account in multi-tenant third-party environments ([Access to AWS accounts owned by third parties](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)).

This also aligns with IAM best practices to use temporary credentials with roles rather than long-lived credentials, and to grant only permissions required for the task as least privilege ([Security best practices in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Customer provides account access keys** — Incorrect and highly insecure. This shares long-term credentials, likely broad account access, and does not support clean delegation, rotation, auditing, or least privilege. AWS specifically recommends not giving a third party IAM user long-term credentials for this scenario.
- **B. Customer creates an IAM user and shares credentials** — Incorrect. Although permissions could be scoped, this still creates and shares long-term IAM user credentials. AWS recommends an IAM role with temporary credentials for third-party access instead of IAM user access keys.
- **C. Customer creates an IAM role and partner uses the role ARN** — Partially correct but not the most secure. A cross-account IAM role is the right mechanism, but without requiring an external ID in the trust policy, the setup is vulnerable to the cross-account confused deputy problem in a third-party/multi-customer scenario.
- **D. Customer creates an IAM role with permissions and requires an external ID in the trust policy** — Correct. This provides least-privilege role permissions, temporary credentials through STS, and confused-deputy protection using `sts:ExternalId`.

zh.question: 一家 AWS 合作伙伴公司正在 AWS Organizations 中使用其名为 org1 的组织构建一项服务。该服务要求合作伙伴公司能够访问客户账户中的 AWS 资源，而该客户账户位于另一个名为 org2 的独立组织中。公司必须使用 API 或命令行工具，以最小权限安全访问客户账户。允许 org1 访问 org2 中资源的最安全方式是什么？

options.A: 客户应向合作伙伴公司提供其 AWS 账户访问密钥，以便登录并执行所需任务。
options.B: 客户应创建一个 IAM 用户，并为该 IAM 用户分配所需权限。然后，客户应向合作伙伴公司提供凭证，以便登录并执行所需任务。
options.C: 客户应创建一个 IAM 角色，并为该 IAM 角色分配所需权限。然后，合作伙伴公司应在请求访问以执行所需任务时使用该 IAM 角色的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)。
options.D: 客户应创建一个 IAM 角色，并为该 IAM 角色分配所需权限。然后，合作伙伴公司应在请求访问以执行所需任务时使用该 IAM 角色的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)，并在 IAM 角色的信任策略中包含外部 ID。

zh.explanation:
该场景询问一个 AWS Organization 中的合作伙伴公司，如何使用 API/CLI 访问并以最小权限安全地访问另一个 AWS Organization 中客户账户的资源。

**正确答案：D。**

客户应在客户账户中创建一个 **IAM 角色**，仅附加合作伙伴任务所需的权限，并配置该角色的信任策略，使合作伙伴的 AWS 账户**只有在提供正确的 `sts:ExternalId` 时**才能代入该角色。AWS 文档描述了这种确切的第三方访问模式：不要向第三方提供 IAM 用户长期凭证；而是使用 IAM 角色和临时安全凭证。第三方使用角色 ARN 和 `ExternalId` 调用 `sts:AssumeRole`，角色信任策略会在允许访问之前检查该 external ID。AWS 表示，external ID 用于第三方访问，以解决并防止 confused deputy problem，并建议在多租户第三方环境中为每个客户/账户使用一个 external ID（[第三方拥有的 AWS 账户访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。

这也符合 IAM 最佳实践：使用角色的临时凭证，而不是长期凭证，并按照最小权限原则仅授予任务所需的权限（[IAM 中的安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 客户提供账户访问密钥** — 不正确且非常不安全。这会共享长期凭证，可能授予广泛的账户访问权限，并且不支持清晰的委派、轮换、审计或最小权限。AWS 明确建议在此场景中不要向第三方提供 IAM 用户长期凭证。
- **B. 客户创建 IAM 用户并共享凭证** — 不正确。尽管权限可以限定范围，但这仍然会创建并共享长期 IAM 用户凭证。AWS 建议使用带临时凭证的 IAM 角色进行第三方访问，而不是使用 IAM 用户访问密钥。
- **C. 客户创建 IAM 角色，合作伙伴使用角色 ARN** — 部分正确，但不是最安全的。跨账户 IAM 角色是正确机制，但如果不在信任策略中要求 external ID，在第三方/多客户场景中，该设置容易受到跨账户 confused deputy problem 的影响。
- **D. 客户创建具有权限的 IAM 角色，并在信任策略中要求 external ID** — 正确。这提供了最小权限角色权限、通过 STS 获取的临时凭证，以及使用 `sts:ExternalId` 的 confused-deputy 防护。

en.question: A delivery company needs to migrate its third-party route planning application to AWS. The third party supplies a supported Docker image from a public registry. The image can run in as many containers as required to generate the route map. The company has divided the delivery area into sections with supply hubs so that delivery drivers travel the shortest distance possible from the hubs to the customers. To reduce the time necessary to generate route maps, each section uses its own set of Docker containers with a custom configuration that processes orders only in the section's area. The company needs the ability to allocate resources cost-effectively based on the number of running containers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on Amazon EC2. Use the Amazon EKS CLI to launch the planning application in pods by using the --tags option to assign a custom tag to the pod.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on AWS Fargate. Use the Amazon EKS CLI to launch the planning application. Use the AWS CLI tag-resource API call to assign a custom tag to the pod.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2. Use the AWS CLI with run-tasks set to true to launch the planning application by using the --tags option to assign a custom tag to the task.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on AWS Fargate. Use the AWS CLI run-task command and set enableECSManagedTags to true to launch the planning application. Use the --tags option to assign a custom tag to the task.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs to run many copies of a third-party Docker image, with separate groups of containers for different delivery sections, and needs cost-effective resource allocation based on the number of running containers with the **least operational overhead**. The answer must therefore favor a managed/serverless container runtime and a straightforward way to tag the running container workload for categorization/cost allocation.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an Amazon ECS cluster on AWS Fargate. Use the AWS CLI `run-task` command and set `enableECSManagedTags` to true to launch the planning application. Use the `--tags` option to assign a custom tag to the task.**

This is the best fit because:

* **AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS removes server and EC2 cluster management.** AWS states that Fargate lets you run containers without managing servers or clusters of EC2 instances, and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). This directly addresses least operational overhead.
* **ECS tasks can be tagged.** Amazon ECS documentation says you can tag new or existing tasks, services, task definitions, or clusters, and lists `run-task` / `RunTask` as a way to specify tags when running one or more tasks ([Adding tags to Amazon ECS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tag-resources-console.html)).
* **The ECS `RunTask` API supports both `enableECSManagedTags` and `tags`.** The `RunTask` API request syntax includes `enableECSManagedTags`, `launchType`, and `tags`; the `launchType` value `FARGATE` runs tasks on AWS Fargate On-Demand infrastructure, and the `tags` parameter applies metadata to the task ([RunTask API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/APIReference/API_RunTask.html)).

This enables each delivery section's tasks to be launched with custom tags such as `Section=NorthHub` or `Hub=HubA`, while Fargate provides per-task serverless capacity without managing EC2 instances.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EKS on Amazon EC2 with `--tags` to assign a custom tag to the pod

This has two problems:

* **Higher operational overhead:** EKS on EC2 requires operating Kubernetes worker-node capacity, whereas the requirement asks for the least operational overhead.
* **Incorrect tagging target:** Amazon EKS supports AWS tags for **clusters, managed node groups, and Fargate profiles**. EKS tags are separate from Kubernetes labels/annotations, and Fargate profile tags do not propagate to Pods ([EKS tagging resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-using-tags.html)). Therefore, using an AWS CLI/`eksctl` `--tags` option to assign AWS tags directly to a Kubernetes pod is not the right mechanism.

### B. EKS on Fargate with `tag-resource` to assign a custom tag to the pod

EKS on Fargate reduces EC2 node management, but it still introduces Kubernetes operational complexity that is not needed for this simple container workload. More importantly, the tagging mechanism is wrong: EKS `TagResource` applies to EKS resources such as clusters, managed node groups, and Fargate profiles, not to Kubernetes Pods as AWS taggable resources. The EKS documentation explicitly notes that Fargate profile tags do not propagate to Pods ([EKS tagging resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-using-tags.html)).

### C. ECS on Amazon EC2 with `run-tasks` and `--tags`

ECS is a better orchestration choice than EKS for this requirement, and ECS tasks can be tagged. However, using **Amazon EC2 capacity** adds operational overhead because the company would need to provision, scale, patch, and manage the underlying EC2 container instances. Fargate is the lower-overhead choice because AWS manages the underlying compute infrastructure ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

## Conclusion

The correct answer is **D** because ECS on Fargate provides the simplest managed container runtime for this Docker-based batch-style workload, supports running tasks on demand, and supports task-level tagging through `RunTask` with `tags` and `enableECSManagedTags`.
