The AWS Glue documentation states that Glue crawlers can automatically infer schema information and populate the AWS Glue Data Catalog, and that AWS Glue jobs can be invoked on demand or based on an event. Glue also supports sensitive data processing as part of data pipelines and automatically scales resources based on workload ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)).

The crawler/custom classifier part of option C is also appropriate. AWS Glue crawlers can run custom classifiers to infer the format and schema of custom data feeds, then write the resulting table metadata to the Data Catalog ([Using crawlers to populate the Data Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html)). This makes the design easier to expand when additional partner feeds or formats are added.

The Lambda trigger is also valid because Amazon S3 can send object-created event notifications to Lambda functions when new objects are delivered ([Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)). The Lambda function can start the Glue job for the newly delivered file.

Finally, AWS Glue can write the transformed output directly to S3 in JSON format. The Glue documentation shows using `write_dynamic_frame.from_options` with `connection_type="s3"` and `format="json"` to write JSON output to an S3 path ([Using the JSON format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-json-home.html)).

Therefore, option C satisfies the transformation, masking, JSON output, S3-to-S3 processing, and future extensibility requirements with the least operational complexity.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Multiple Lambda functions with SQS and temporary S3 output

This option unnecessarily decomposes a file-level ETL job into several Lambda/SQS stages. It introduces operational complexity: one Lambda extracts records, another processes individual SQS messages, and a final Lambda must somehow know when the queue is empty before performing JSON transformation. That is fragile for batch ETL and does not naturally support schema discovery or future feed formats. It is also less suitable for whole-file transformations such as merging fields and producing consolidated JSON output.

### B. Lambda, SQS, and a Fargate container

This option also treats the problem as per-record queue processing rather than managed ETL. Fargate could process records, but the design is more complex than necessary and lacks the Glue Data Catalog/crawler/custom-classifier capability that helps with schema management and extensibility. Scaling a container to a single instance based on SQS depth is not as direct or purpose-built as using AWS Glue ETL for S3-based data transformation.

### D. Glue crawler plus Athena query to start EMR ETL job

This option is unnecessarily complex and internally awkward. Athena is for querying data, not for orchestrating EMR ETL jobs on file delivery. EMR can run large-scale Hadoop/Spark workloads, but for this moderate, recurring S3-based ETL use case, AWS Glue provides a more serverless, managed, and directly integrated ETL solution. Option D adds EMR cluster management and cost/operational overhead without a requirement for specialized EMR capabilities.

## Conclusion

The correct solution is **C** because AWS Glue provides the managed ETL, schema discovery, custom classifier support, event-based job execution, S3 integration, JSON output support, and extensibility required by the scenario.

zh.question: 一家金融服务公司定期从其信用卡服务合作伙伴接收数据馈送。大约每 15 分钟会发送 5,000 条记录，数据为明文，通过 HTTPS 直接传送到启用了服务器端加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该馈送包含敏感的信用卡主账号（PAN）数据。公司需要在将数据发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以进行额外内部处理之前，自动遮蔽 PAN。公司还需要删除并合并特定字段，然后将记录转换为 JSON 格式。此外，未来很可能会添加额外的馈送，因此任何设计都需要易于扩展。哪些解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在文件交付时调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数提取每条记录并将其写入 Amazon SQS 队列。当 SQS 队列中有新消息到达时，调用另一个 Lambda 函数来处理记录，并将结果写入 Amazon S3 中的临时位置。当 SQS 队列为空后，调用最终的 Lambda 函数，将记录转换为 JSON 格式，并将结果发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以供内部处理。
options.B: 在文件交付时调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数提取每条记录并将其写入 Amazon SQS 队列。配置 AWS Fargate 容器应用程序，使其在 SQS 队列包含消息时自动扩展到单个实例。让该应用程序处理每条记录，并将记录转换为 JSON 格式。当队列为空时，将结果发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以供内部处理，并缩减 AWS Fargate 实例。
options.C: 根据数据馈送格式创建 AWS Glue 爬网程序和自定义分类器，并构建匹配的表定义。在文件交付时调用 AWS Lambda 函数以启动 AWS Glue ETL 作业，根据处理和转换要求转换整条记录。将输出格式定义为 JSON。完成后，让 ETL 作业将结果发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以供内部处理。
options.D: 根据数据馈送格式创建 AWS Glue 爬网程序和自定义分类器，并构建匹配的表定义。在文件交付时执行 Amazon Athena 查询，以启动 Amazon EMR ETL 作业，根据处理和转换要求转换整条记录。将输出格式定义为 JSON。完成后，将结果发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以供内部处理，并缩减 EMR 集群。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司每 15 分钟将一个**批处理风格的文件馈送**接收到 Amazon S3 中，并且必须先执行多个 ETL 风格的操作，然后再写入另一个 S3 存储桶：

- 遮蔽敏感的信用卡 PAN 数据
- 删除并合并字段
- 将输出转换为 JSON
- 保持设计可扩展，以支持未来的馈送和格式

## 正确答案：C

**C. 根据数据馈送格式创建 AWS Glue 爬网程序和自定义分类器，并构建匹配的表定义。在文件交付时调用 AWS Lambda 函数以启动 AWS Glue ETL 作业，根据处理和转换要求转换整条记录。将输出格式定义为 JSON。完成后，让 ETL 作业将结果发送到另一个 S3 存储桶以供内部处理。**

这是最合适的选择，因为该工作负载是托管 ETL/数据准备问题，而不是按记录进行的应用程序处理问题。

AWS Glue 旨在**发现、准备、转换和清理数据**。AWS Glue 文档指出，Glue 爬网程序可以自动推断架构信息并填充 AWS Glue Data Catalog，并且 AWS Glue 作业可以按需或基于事件调用。Glue 还支持将敏感数据处理作为数据管道的一部分，并会根据工作负载自动扩展资源（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。

选项 C 中的爬网程序/自定义分类器部分也很合适。AWS Glue 爬网程序可以运行自定义分类器来推断自定义数据馈送的格式和架构，然后将生成的表元数据写入 Data Catalog（[Using crawlers to populate the Data Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html)）。当添加其他合作伙伴馈送或格式时，这使设计更易于扩展。

Lambda 触发器也是有效的，因为当新对象被交付时，Amazon S3 可以向 Lambda 函数发送对象创建事件通知（[Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。Lambda 函数可以为新交付的文件启动 Glue 作业。

最后，AWS Glue 可以将转换后的输出以 JSON 格式直接写入 S3。Glue 文档展示了使用 `write_dynamic_frame.from_options` 并设置 `connection_type="s3"` 和 `format="json"`，将 JSON 输出写入 S3 路径（[Using the JSON format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-json-home.html)）。

因此，选项 C 以最低的运维复杂性满足转换、遮蔽、JSON 输出、S3 到 S3 处理以及未来可扩展性的要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用 SQS 和临时 S3 输出的多个 Lambda 函数

此选项不必要地将文件级 ETL 作业拆分为多个 Lambda/SQS 阶段。它引入了运维复杂性：一个 Lambda 提取记录，另一个处理单个 SQS 消息，而最终的 Lambda 必须以某种方式知道队列何时为空，才能执行 JSON 转换。这对于批处理 ETL 来说很脆弱，并且不自然支持架构发现或未来的馈送格式。它也不太适合整文件转换，例如合并字段并生成合并后的 JSON 输出。

### B. Lambda、SQS 和 Fargate 容器

此选项同样将问题视为按记录进行的队列处理，而不是托管 ETL。Fargate 可以处理记录，但该设计比必要的更复杂，并且缺少有助于架构管理和可扩展性的 Glue Data Catalog/爬网程序/自定义分类器能力。根据 SQS 深度将容器扩展到单个实例并不像使用 AWS Glue ETL 进行基于 S3 的数据转换那样直接或专门适配。

### D. Glue 爬网程序加 Athena 查询以启动 EMR ETL 作业

此选项不必要地复杂，而且内部逻辑也不自然。Athena 用于查询数据，而不是在文件交付时编排 EMR ETL 作业。EMR 可以运行大规模 Hadoop/Spark 工作负载，但对于这种中等规模、周期性的基于 S3 的 ETL 用例，AWS Glue 提供了更无服务器、更托管且更直接集成的 ETL 解决方案。选项 D 增加了 EMR 集群管理以及成本/运维开销，却没有对专用 EMR 能力的需求。

## 结论

正确解决方案是 **C**，因为 AWS Glue 提供了该场景所需的托管 ETL、架构发现、自定义分类器支持、基于事件的作业执行、S3 集成、JSON 输出支持以及可扩展性。

en.question: A company wants to use AWS to create a business continuity solution in case the company's main on- premises application fails. The application runs on physical servers that also run other applications. The on-premises application that the company is planning to migrate uses a MySQL database as a data store. All the company's on-premises applications use operating systems that are compatible with Amazon EC2. Which solution will achieve the company's goal with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Install the AWS Replication Agent on the source servers, including the MySQL servers. Set up replication for all servers. Launch test instances for regular drills. Cut over to the test instances to fail over the workload in the case of a failure event.
options.B: Install the AWS Replication Agent on the source servers, including the MySQL servers. Initialize AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery in the target AWS Region. Define the launch settings. Frequently perform failover and fallback from the most recent point in time.
options.C: Create AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication servers and a target Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster to host the database. Create a DMS replication task to copy the existing data to the target DB cluster. Create a local AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) change data capture (CDC) task to keep the data synchronized. Install the rest of the software on EC2 instances by starting with a compatible base AMI.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway on premises. Mount volumes on all on-premises servers. Install the application and the MySQL database on the new volumes. Take regular snapshots. Install all the software on EC2 Instances by starting with a compatible base AMI. Launch a Volume Gateway on an EC2 instance. Restore the volumes from the latest snapshot. Mount the new volumes on the EC2 instances in the case of a failure event.

en.explanation:
The company needs a **business continuity / disaster recovery (DR)** solution in AWS for an on-premises application running on EC2-compatible operating systems, including the MySQL server that stores the application data. The key requirement is **least operational overhead**, not a selective database-only migration.

**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) is designed for this scenario. The AWS documentation states that Elastic Disaster Recovery minimizes downtime and data loss for **on-premises and cloud-based applications** using affordable storage, minimal compute, and point-in-time recovery. It replicates source servers to a staging area, lets you configure replication and launch settings, and can launch recovery instances in AWS for drills or recovery. It also automatically converts servers to boot and run natively on AWS when recovery or drill instances are launched ([What is Elastic Disaster Recovery?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/what-is-drs.html)).

The documented DRS workflow aligns closely with option B: initialize AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery in the target Region, install the AWS Replication Agent on each source server, wait for initial sync, launch drill instances, confirm readiness, initiate failover, and later fail back ([Getting started with AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)). AWS also documents that failover launches recovery instances from the most recent data or a selected point-in-time snapshot ([Performing a failover with Elastic Disaster Recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback-preparing-failover.html)). The agent must be installed on each source server that will be protected by DRS ([Installing the AWS Replication Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/agent-installation.html)).

Therefore, installing the AWS Replication Agent on the application and MySQL source servers, initializing DRS in the target Region, defining launch settings, and regularly validating failover/failback readiness provides the lowest-overhead DR solution.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Incorrect.** This option resembles part of the DRS setup, but it says to “cut over to the test instances” during failure. In DRS, test/drill instances are for non-disruptive validation and should not be treated as the actual failover target. The documented recovery process is to initiate recovery and launch recovery instances from the most recent or selected point-in-time snapshot, then redirect traffic to those recovery instances ([Performing a failover with Elastic Disaster Recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback-preparing-failover.html)). Option A also omits initializing DRS and configuring launch settings.

**C. Incorrect.** AWS DMS is for database and data store migration/replication. The DMS documentation says AWS DMS migrates relational databases, data warehouses, NoSQL databases, and other data stores, and can replicate ongoing changes to keep sources and targets synchronized ([What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). That helps with the MySQL database but does not provide a full application/server DR solution, and it requires building and maintaining separate EC2 application servers from AMIs. It also introduces more operational work than DRS.

**D. Incorrect.** Storage Gateway Volume Gateway snapshots could support a backup-and-restore style approach, but this option requires moving applications and MySQL onto gateway volumes, managing snapshots, building EC2 instances, deploying another Volume Gateway on EC2, restoring volumes, and mounting them during an outage. This has substantially more operational overhead and slower recovery than AWS DRS, which continuously replicates servers and launches recovery instances directly.

**Conclusion:** Option **B** best matches AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery’s intended use case and provides the least operational overhead for on-premises application DR to AWS.

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 AWS 创建业务连续性解决方案，以便在公司的主要本地应用程序发生故障时使用。该应用程序运行在物理服务器上，这些服务器还运行其他应用程序。公司计划迁移的本地应用程序使用 MySQL 数据库作为数据存储。公司所有本地应用程序使用的操作系统都与 Amazon EC2 兼容。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销实现公司的目标？

options.A: 在源服务器（包括 MySQL 服务器）上安装 AWS Replication Agent。为所有服务器设置复制。启动测试实例以进行定期演练。在发生故障事件时，切换到测试实例以对工作负载进行故障转移。
options.B: 在源服务器（包括 MySQL 服务器）上安装 AWS Replication Agent。在目标 AWS 区域中初始化 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery。定义启动设置。经常从最近的时间点执行故障转移和故障恢复。
options.C: 创建 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 复制服务器和目标 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群来托管数据库。创建 DMS 复制任务，将现有数据复制到目标数据库集群。创建本地 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 变更数据捕获 (CDC) 任务，以保持数据同步。从兼容的基础 AMI 开始，在 EC2 实例上安装其余软件。
options.D: 在本地部署 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway。在所有本地服务器上挂载卷。将应用程序和 MySQL 数据库安装到新卷上。定期创建快照。从兼容的基础 AMI 开始，在 EC2 实例上安装所有软件。在 EC2 实例上启动 Volume Gateway。从最新快照还原卷。在发生故障事件时，将新卷挂载到 EC2 实例上。

zh.explanation:
公司需要在 AWS 中为运行在与 EC2 兼容的操作系统上的本地应用程序提供一个**业务连续性 / 灾难恢复 (DR)** 解决方案，其中包括存储应用程序数据的 MySQL 服务器。关键要求是**最少的运营开销**，而不是仅针对数据库的选择性迁移。

**正确答案：B。**

AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) 专为此类场景而设计。AWS 文档说明，Elastic Disaster Recovery 通过经济实惠的存储、最少的计算资源和时间点恢复，最大限度减少**本地和基于云的应用程序**的停机时间和数据丢失。它将源服务器复制到暂存区域，允许你配置复制和启动设置，并可在 AWS 中启动恢复实例以进行演练或恢复。当启动恢复实例或演练实例时，它还会自动转换服务器，使其能够在 AWS 上原生启动和运行（[什么是 Elastic Disaster Recovery？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/what-is-drs.html)）。

文档中的 DRS 工作流程与选项 B 非常一致：在目标区域中初始化 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery，在每台源服务器上安装 AWS Replication Agent，等待初始同步，启动演练实例，确认就绪状态，发起故障转移，之后再故障恢复（[AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 入门](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)）。AWS 还记录了故障转移会从最新数据或所选时间点快照启动恢复实例（[使用 Elastic Disaster Recovery 执行故障转移](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback-preparing-failover.html)）。必须在将由 DRS 保护的每台源服务器上安装该代理（[安装 AWS Replication Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/agent-installation.html)）。

因此，在应用程序和 MySQL 源服务器上安装 AWS Replication Agent，在目标区域中初始化 DRS，定义启动设置，并定期验证故障转移/故障恢复就绪状态，可以提供运营开销最低的 DR 解决方案。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 不正确。** 此选项类似于 DRS 设置的一部分，但它说在故障期间“切换到测试实例”。在 DRS 中，测试/演练实例用于非破坏性验证，不应被视为实际的故障转移目标。文档中的恢复流程是发起恢复，并从最新或所选时间点快照启动恢复实例，然后将流量重定向到这些恢复实例（[使用 Elastic Disaster Recovery 执行故障转移](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback-preparing-failover.html)）。选项 A 还遗漏了初始化 DRS 和配置启动设置。

**C. 不正确。** AWS DMS 用于数据库和数据存储的迁移/复制。DMS 文档说明，AWS DMS 可以迁移关系数据库、数据仓库、NoSQL 数据库以及其他数据存储，并可以复制持续变更以保持源和目标同步（[什么是 AWS Database Migration Service？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。这有助于 MySQL 数据库，但不能提供完整的应用程序/服务器 DR 解决方案，并且需要从 AMI 构建和维护单独的 EC2 应用程序服务器。与 DRS 相比，它还会引入更多运营工作。

**D. 不正确。** Storage Gateway Volume Gateway 快照可以支持备份和还原风格的方法，但此选项需要将应用程序和 MySQL 迁移到网关卷上、管理快照、构建 EC2 实例、在 EC2 上部署另一个 Volume Gateway、还原卷，并在中断期间挂载这些卷。这比 AWS DRS 具有高得多的运营开销，并且恢复速度更慢；AWS DRS 会持续复制服务器并直接启动恢复实例。

**结论：** 选项 **B** 最符合 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 的预期使用场景，并为本地应用程序到 AWS 的 DR 提供最少的运营开销。

en.question: A company is subject to regulatory audits of its financial information. External auditors who use a single AWS account need access to the company's AWS account. A solutions architect must provide the auditors with secure, read-only access to the company's AWS account. The solution must comply with AWS security best practices. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: In the company's AWS account, create resource policies for all resources in the account to grant access to the auditors' AWS account. Assign a unique external ID to the resource policy.
options.B: In the company's AWS account, create an IAM role that trusts the auditors' AWS account. Create an IAM policy that has the required permissions. Attach the policy to the role. Assign a unique external ID to the role's trust policy.
options.C: In the company's AWS account, create an IAM user. Attach the required IAM policies to the IAM user. Create API access keys for the IAM user. Share the access keys with the auditors.
options.D: In the company's AWS account, create an IAM group that has the required permissions. Create an IAM user in the company's account for each auditor. Add the IAM users to the IAM group.

en.explanation:
The company needs to give an external audit firm, which already has its own AWS account, secure read-only access to the company account. The best-practice pattern is cross-account access by assuming an IAM role, not creating company-side users or sharing long-term credentials.

**Correct answer: B.** In the company's AWS account, create an IAM role that trusts the auditors' AWS account, attach a least-privilege/read-only permissions policy to the role, and require a unique external ID in the role trust policy. AWS documentation explains that for cross-account access you create a role in the destination account, specify the originating account as a trusted entity, and define what the trusted entities can do through the role permissions. The result is access by using temporary credentials ([IAM cross-account role tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)). For third-party access, AWS specifically recommends using an external ID in the role trust policy so the third party can assume the role only when acting on the customer's behalf, helping prevent the confused deputy problem ([External IDs for third party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)). Attaching only the required read-only permissions also aligns with the IAM best practice to grant least privilege ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Resource policies for all resources** — This is not practical or comprehensive because not every AWS service/resource supports resource-based policies, and managing policies for every resource is error-prone. An external ID is intended for an IAM role trust policy used with `AssumeRole`, not as a general solution for arbitrary resource policies. Cross-account IAM roles are the standard pattern for this scenario.
* **C. IAM user with access keys shared with auditors** — This creates and shares long-term credentials in the company's AWS account. AWS best practices recommend relying on temporary credentials where possible rather than long-term access keys ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). It also creates credential rotation, revocation, and accountability risks.
* **D. IAM users in the company's account for each auditor** — This still creates company-managed IAM users for external human users instead of using role-based cross-account access with temporary credentials. It is less secure and more operationally burdensome than allowing the auditors' AWS account to assume a least-privilege role with an external ID.

Therefore, **B** is the solution that meets the security and regulatory audit access requirements while following AWS best practices.

zh.question: 一家公司需要接受对其财务信息的监管审计。使用单个 AWS 账户的外部审计员需要访问该公司的 AWS 账户。解决方案架构师必须为审计员提供对公司 AWS 账户的安全只读访问权限。该解决方案必须符合 AWS 安全最佳实践。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公司的 AWS 账户中，为该账户中的所有资源创建资源策略，以授予审计员的 AWS 账户访问权限。为资源策略分配一个唯一的外部 ID。
options.B: 在公司的 AWS 账户中，创建一个信任审计员 AWS 账户的 IAM 角色。创建一个具有所需权限的 IAM 策略。将该策略附加到该角色。为该角色的信任策略分配一个唯一的外部 ID。
options.C: 在公司的 AWS 账户中，创建一个 IAM 用户。将所需的 IAM 策略附加到该 IAM 用户。为该 IAM 用户创建 API 访问密钥。与审计员共享这些访问密钥。
options.D: 在公司的 AWS 账户中，创建一个具有所需权限的 IAM 组。在公司的账户中为每位审计员创建一个 IAM 用户。将这些 IAM 用户添加到 IAM 组。

zh.explanation:
公司需要向一家外部审计机构提供对公司账户的安全只读访问权限，而该机构已经拥有自己的 AWS 账户。最佳实践模式是通过代入 IAM 角色进行跨账户访问，而不是在公司侧创建用户或共享长期凭证。

**正确答案：B。** 在公司的 AWS 账户中，创建一个信任审计员 AWS 账户的 IAM 角色，将最小权限/只读权限策略附加到该角色，并在角色信任策略中要求唯一的外部 ID。AWS 文档说明，对于跨账户访问，需要在目标账户中创建角色，将来源账户指定为受信任实体，并通过角色权限定义受信任实体可以执行的操作。结果是使用临时凭证进行访问（[IAM 跨账户角色教程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)）。对于第三方访问，AWS 特别建议在角色信任策略中使用外部 ID，使第三方只有在代表客户执行操作时才能代入该角色，从而帮助防止混淆代理问题（[用于第三方访问的外部 ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。仅附加所需的只读权限也符合 IAM 授予最小权限的最佳实践（[IAM 安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A. 为所有资源配置资源策略** — 这不实际，也不全面，因为并非每个 AWS 服务/资源都支持基于资源的策略，而且为每个资源管理策略容易出错。外部 ID 适用于与 `AssumeRole` 配合使用的 IAM 角色信任策略，而不是任意资源策略的通用解决方案。跨账户 IAM 角色是此场景的标准模式。
* **C. 与审计员共享访问密钥的 IAM 用户** — 这会在公司的 AWS 账户中创建并共享长期凭证。AWS 最佳实践建议尽可能依赖临时凭证，而不是长期访问密钥（[IAM 安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。它还会带来凭证轮换、撤销和问责风险。
* **D. 在公司账户中为每位审计员创建 IAM 用户** — 这仍然是为外部人类用户创建由公司管理的 IAM 用户，而不是使用基于角色的跨账户访问和临时凭证。与允许审计员的 AWS 账户使用外部 ID 代入最小权限角色相比，它安全性较低，运维负担也更重。

因此，**B** 是既能满足安全和监管审计访问要求，又遵循 AWS 最佳实践的解决方案。

en.question: A company has a latency-sensitive trading platform that uses Amazon DynamoDB as a storage backend. The company configured the DynamoDB table to use on-demand capacity mode. A solutions architect needs to design a solution to improve the performance of the trading platform. The new solution must ensure high availability for the trading platform. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency?

options.A: Create a two-node DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure an application to read and write data by using DAX.
options.B: Create a three-node DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure an application to read data by using DAX and to write data directly to the DynamoDB table.
options.C: Create a three-node DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure an application to read data directly from the DynamoDB table and to write data by using DAX.
options.D: Create a single-node DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure an application to read data by using DAX and to write data directly to the DynamoDB table.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The platform uses DynamoDB in on-demand capacity mode and is latency-sensitive. The question asks for a solution that improves performance, maintains high availability, and provides the **least latency**.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Create a three-node DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure an application to read data by using DAX and to write data directly to the DynamoDB table.**

DAX is designed to reduce DynamoDB read latency by serving eventually consistent reads from an in-memory cache. AWS documentation states that DAX can provide microsecond response times for eventually consistent reads and is useful for reducing read latency against DynamoDB ([Evaluating the suitability of DAX](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/evaluate-dax-suitability.html)).

For high availability, AWS recommends at least **three DAX nodes in different Availability Zones** for production workloads. This ensures the cluster has more than one node remaining even if a node or Availability Zone fails ([DAX cluster sizing: Planning availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)). AWS also states that to achieve high availability for an application, you should provision a DAX cluster with at least three nodes across multiple Availability Zones ([DAX consistency: cluster nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)).

For writes, using DAX adds an extra network hop. AWS explicitly notes that for latency-sensitive applications, writing through DAX is slightly slower than writing directly to DynamoDB, and write latency can be reduced by writing directly to DynamoDB instead, known as a write-around strategy ([DAX consistency: Strategies for writes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)). Therefore, the least-latency pattern is:

- **Reads through DAX** for low-latency cached reads.
- **Writes directly to DynamoDB** to avoid the extra DAX hop.
- **Three DAX nodes** for high availability.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Two-node DAX cluster, read and write using DAX

This option has two problems:

1. A two-node DAX cluster does not meet the recommended production high-availability design. AWS recommends at least three nodes across different Availability Zones for production/high availability ([DAX cluster sizing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)).
2. Writing through DAX adds an extra network hop, making writes slightly slower than writing directly to DynamoDB for latency-sensitive applications ([DAX consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)).

### C. Three-node DAX cluster, read directly from DynamoDB and write using DAX

This reverses the optimal access pattern. Reading directly from DynamoDB does not use DAX's microsecond read latency benefits. Also, writing through DAX adds an extra network hop compared with writing directly to DynamoDB. AWS describes DAX read operations as cache-serving operations for `GetItem`, `BatchGetItem`, `Query`, and `Scan`, while write-through operations must write successfully to both DynamoDB and DAX ([DAX: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.concepts.html)).

### D. Single-node DAX cluster, read using DAX and write directly to DynamoDB

This uses the correct low-latency read/write access pattern, but it does not meet the high-availability requirement. A single-node cluster has no tolerance for failure, and AWS recommends at least three DAX nodes in different Availability Zones for production workloads ([DAX cluster sizing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)).

## Conclusion

Option **B** best satisfies both requirements: it uses DAX for low-latency reads, writes directly to DynamoDB to minimize write latency, and uses a three-node DAX cluster to meet high availability expectations.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个对延迟敏感的交易平台，使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为存储后端。该公司将 DynamoDB 表配置为使用按需容量模式。一名解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案来提升交易平台的性能。新解决方案必须确保交易平台的高可用性。哪种解决方案能以最低延迟满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个双节点 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序使用 DAX 读取和写入数据。
options.B: 创建一个三节点 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序使用 DAX 读取数据，并将数据直接写入 DynamoDB 表。
options.C: 创建一个三节点 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序直接从 DynamoDB 表读取数据，并使用 DAX 写入数据。
options.D: 创建一个单节点 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序使用 DAX 读取数据，并将数据直接写入 DynamoDB 表。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该平台使用按需容量模式的 DynamoDB，并且对延迟敏感。题目要求一个能够提升性能、保持高可用性并提供**最低延迟**的解决方案。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 创建一个三节点 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序使用 DAX 读取数据，并将数据直接写入 DynamoDB 表。**

DAX 旨在通过从内存缓存提供最终一致性读取来降低 DynamoDB 读取延迟。AWS 文档指出，DAX 可以为最终一致性读取提供微秒级响应时间，并且有助于降低针对 DynamoDB 的读取延迟（[Evaluating the suitability of DAX](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/evaluate-dax-suitability.html)）。

为了实现高可用性，AWS 建议生产工作负载至少使用**位于不同 Availability Zones 中的三个 DAX 节点**。这可确保即使一个节点或 Availability Zone 发生故障，集群仍有不止一个节点可用（[DAX cluster sizing: Planning availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)）。AWS 还指出，为了实现应用程序的高可用性，应预置一个至少包含三个节点、跨多个 Availability Zones 的 DAX 集群（[DAX consistency: cluster nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)）。

对于写入，使用 DAX 会增加一次额外的网络跳转。AWS 明确指出，对于对延迟敏感的应用程序，通过 DAX 写入会比直接写入 DynamoDB 稍慢，而通过直接写入 DynamoDB（称为 write-around 策略）可以降低写入延迟（[DAX consistency: Strategies for writes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)）。因此，最低延迟模式是：

- **通过 DAX 读取**，实现低延迟缓存读取。
- **直接写入 DynamoDB**，避免额外的 DAX 跳转。
- **三个 DAX 节点**，实现高可用性。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 双节点 DAX 集群，使用 DAX 读取和写入

此选项有两个问题：

1. 双节点 DAX 集群不符合推荐的生产高可用性设计。AWS 建议生产/高可用性场景至少使用跨不同 Availability Zones 的三个节点（[DAX cluster sizing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)）。
2. 通过 DAX 写入会增加一次额外的网络跳转，使得对于对延迟敏感的应用程序而言，写入比直接写入 DynamoDB 稍慢（[DAX consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)）。

### C. 三节点 DAX 集群，直接从 DynamoDB 读取并使用 DAX 写入

这颠倒了最佳访问模式。直接从 DynamoDB 读取无法利用 DAX 的微秒级读取延迟优势。此外，与直接写入 DynamoDB 相比，通过 DAX 写入会增加一次额外的网络跳转。AWS 将 DAX 读取操作描述为针对 `GetItem`、`BatchGetItem`、`Query` 和 `Scan` 的缓存服务操作，而 write-through 操作必须同时成功写入 DynamoDB 和 DAX（[DAX: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.concepts.html)）。

### D. 单节点 DAX 集群，使用 DAX 读取并直接写入 DynamoDB

此选项使用了正确的低延迟读/写访问模式，但不满足高可用性要求。单节点集群没有故障容忍能力，AWS 建议生产工作负载至少使用位于不同 Availability Zones 中的三个 DAX 节点（[DAX cluster sizing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-cluster-sizing.html)）。

## 结论

选项 **B** 最能同时满足两个要求：它使用 DAX 进行低延迟读取，直接写入 DynamoDB 以最小化写入延迟，并使用三节点 DAX 集群来满足高可用性预期。

en.question: A company has migrated an application from on premises to AWS. The application frontend is a static website that runs on two Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application backend is a Python application that runs on three EC2 instances behind another ALB. The EC2 instances are large, general purpose On-Demand Instances that were sized to meet the on-premises specifications for peak usage of the application. The application averages hundreds of thousands of requests each month. However, the application is used mainly during lunchtime and receives minimal traffic during the rest of the day. A solutions architect needs to optimize the infrastructure cost of the application without negatively affecting the application availability. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Change all the EC2 instances to compute optimized instances that have the same number of cores as the existing EC2 instances.
options.B: Move the application frontend to a static website that is hosted on Amazon S3.
options.C: Deploy the application frontend by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Use the same instance type for the nodes.
options.D: Change all the backend EC2 instances to Spot Instances.
options.E: Deploy the backend Python application to general purpose burstable EC2 instances that have the same number of cores as the existing EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application was lifted and shifted with EC2 instances sized for on-premises peak usage, but the actual AWS workload is highly variable: high activity mainly during lunchtime and minimal traffic for the rest of the day. The goal is cost optimization **without reducing availability**.

The best combination is **B and E**.

## Correct answers

### B. Move the application frontend to a static website that is hosted on Amazon S3

The frontend is described as a **static website**. Running two EC2 instances and an ALB for static content is unnecessary operational and compute cost. Amazon S3 is explicitly designed to host static websites: AWS documentation states that you can use Amazon S3 to host a static website, and that static webpages can include static content and client-side scripts ([Amazon S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).

This reduces the need for frontend EC2 instances and the frontend ALB while preserving availability and scalability for static content. The static frontend can still call the Python backend through its backend ALB by using client-side JavaScript/API calls.

### E. Deploy the backend Python application to general purpose burstable EC2 instances that have the same number of cores as the existing EC2 instances

The backend has variable usage: high demand during lunchtime and low demand for the rest of the day. AWS describes burstable performance instances as suitable for general purpose workloads that are not busy on average and do not need sustained high CPU performance. T instances provide baseline CPU performance with the ability to burst above baseline, and AWS says they are a cost-effective way to run broad general purpose applications with low-to-moderate CPU usage ([EC2 burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances.html)).

Because the workload has periodic spikes rather than sustained peak usage, moving from large general purpose On-Demand Instances to general purpose burstable instances can reduce cost while still allowing CPU bursts during lunchtime.

## Incorrect answers

### A. Change all the EC2 instances to compute optimized instances that have the same number of cores as the existing EC2 instances

Compute optimized instances are intended for compute-intensive workloads. The scenario does not indicate that the application is CPU-bound; it indicates that the instances were oversized to match on-premises peak specifications and are underutilized for most of the day. Keeping the same number of cores on compute optimized instances does not address the primary cost issue and could increase or fail to reduce cost.

### C. Deploy the application frontend by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Use the same instance type for the nodes

Elastic Beanstalk can simplify application deployment and management, but using the same EC2 instance type for a static frontend still keeps compute capacity running for content that can be served directly from object storage. It does not meaningfully optimize cost compared with moving the static frontend to S3.

### D. Change all the backend EC2 instances to Spot Instances

Spot Instances can reduce EC2 cost, but they can be interrupted. AWS documentation states that a Spot Instance interruption notice is issued two minutes before EC2 stops or terminates the instance, and applications using Spot should be architected to be fault tolerant ([Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html)).

Changing **all** backend instances to Spot Instances could negatively affect backend availability if capacity is reclaimed. A mixed strategy might be viable in some architectures, but that is not what the option says. Therefore, D does not satisfy the requirement to avoid negatively affecting availability.

## Final answer

**B and E**

zh.question: 一家公司已将一个应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。该应用程序前端是一个静态网站，运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的两个 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序后端是一个 Python 应用程序，运行在另一个 ALB 后面的三个 EC2 实例上。这些 EC2 实例是大型通用型按需实例，其规格是根据该应用程序在本地环境峰值使用量的要求来确定的。该应用程序每月平均处理数十万次请求。但是，该应用程序主要在午餐时间使用，全天其余时间流量很少。解决方案架构师需要优化该应用程序的基础设施成本，同时不对应用程序可用性产生负面影响。哪两项步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将所有 EC2 实例更改为与现有 EC2 实例具有相同核心数的计算优化型实例。
options.B: 将应用程序前端迁移到托管在 Amazon S3 上的静态网站。
options.C: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署应用程序前端。对节点使用相同的实例类型。
options.D: 将所有后端 EC2 实例更改为 Spot Instances。
options.E: 将后端 Python 应用程序部署到与现有 EC2 实例具有相同核心数的通用型可突增 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序采用直接迁移方式，使用按本地峰值使用量确定规格的 EC2 实例，但实际 AWS 工作负载高度可变：主要在午餐时间活动量较高，而当天其余时间流量很少。目标是在**不降低可用性**的情况下进行成本优化。

最佳组合是 **B 和 E**。

## 正确答案

### B. 将应用程序前端迁移到托管在 Amazon S3 上的静态网站

前端被描述为一个**静态网站**。为静态内容运行两个 EC2 实例和一个 ALB 会产生不必要的运营和计算成本。Amazon S3 明确设计为可托管静态网站：AWS 文档指出，你可以使用 Amazon S3 托管静态网站，并且静态网页可以包含静态内容和客户端脚本（[Amazon S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。

这可以减少对前端 EC2 实例和前端 ALB 的需求，同时保留静态内容的可用性和可扩展性。静态前端仍然可以通过客户端 JavaScript/API 调用，经由其后端 ALB 调用 Python 后端。

### E. 将后端 Python 应用程序部署到与现有 EC2 实例具有相同核心数的通用型可突增 EC2 实例

后端使用量可变：午餐时间需求较高，其余时间需求较低。AWS 将可突增性能实例描述为适用于平均而言不繁忙且不需要持续高 CPU 性能的通用工作负载。T 实例提供基准 CPU 性能，并能够突增到基准以上，AWS 表示它们是运行低到中等 CPU 使用率的广泛通用应用程序的一种经济高效方式（[EC2 burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances.html)）。

由于该工作负载是周期性峰值而不是持续峰值使用，从大型通用型按需实例迁移到通用型可突增实例可以降低成本，同时仍允许在午餐时间进行 CPU 突增。

## 错误答案

### A. 将所有 EC2 实例更改为与现有 EC2 实例具有相同核心数的计算优化型实例

计算优化型实例适用于计算密集型工作负载。该场景并未表明应用程序受 CPU 限制；它表明这些实例为匹配本地峰值规格而过度配置，并且在一天中的大部分时间里利用率不足。在计算优化型实例上保持相同核心数并不能解决主要成本问题，甚至可能增加成本或无法降低成本。

### C. 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署应用程序前端。对节点使用相同的实例类型

Elastic Beanstalk 可以简化应用程序部署和管理，但对静态前端使用相同的 EC2 实例类型，仍然会为可直接从对象存储提供的内容保持计算容量运行。与将静态前端迁移到 S3 相比，它并不能显著优化成本。

### D. 将所有后端 EC2 实例更改为 Spot Instances

Spot Instances 可以降低 EC2 成本，但它们可能会被中断。AWS 文档指出，Spot Instance 中断通知会在 EC2 停止或终止实例前两分钟发出，并且使用 Spot 的应用程序应构建为具备容错能力（[Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html)）。

将**所有**后端实例更改为 Spot Instances，如果容量被回收，可能会对后端可用性产生负面影响。在某些架构中，混合策略可能可行，但该选项并不是这么说的。因此，D 不满足避免对可用性产生负面影响的要求。

## 最终答案

**B 和 E**

en.question: A company is running an event ticketing platform on AWS and wants to optimize the platform's cost- effectiveness. The platform is deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 and is backed by an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company is developing new application features to run on Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate. The platform experiences infrequent high peaks in demand. The surges in demand depend on event dates. Which solution will provide the MOST cost-effective setup for the platform?

options.A: Purchase Standard Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that the EKS cluster uses in its baseline load. Scale the cluster with Spot Instances to handle peaks. Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the database to meet predicted peak load for the year.
options.B: Purchase Compute Savings Plans for the predicted medium load of the EKS cluster. Scale the cluster with On-Demand Capacity Reservations based on event dates for peaks. Purchase 1-year No Upfront Reserved Instances for the database to meet the predicted base load. Temporarily scale out database read replicas during peaks.
options.C: Purchase EC2 Instance Savings Plans for the predicted base load of the EKS cluster. Scale the cluster with Spot Instances to handle peaks. Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the database to meet the predicted base load. Temporarily scale up the DB instance manually during peaks.
options.D: Purchase Compute Savings Plans for the predicted base load of the EKS cluster. Scale the cluster with Spot Instances to handle peaks. Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the database to meet the predicted base load. Temporarily scale up the DB instance manually during peaks.

en.explanation:
The platform has a steady baseline load on Amazon EKS with EC2 worker nodes, will add new Amazon EKS workloads on AWS Fargate, and has infrequent but predictable demand spikes around event dates. The most cost-effective design is to discount only the steady baseline, use low-cost interruptible capacity for burst compute, and avoid reserving database capacity for peaks that occur only occasionally.

**Correct answer: D. Purchase Compute Savings Plans for the predicted base load of the EKS cluster. Scale the cluster with Spot Instances to handle peaks. Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the database to meet the predicted base load. Temporarily scale up the DB instance manually during peaks.**

This is the best fit because:

* **Compute Savings Plans are the right commitment for the EKS baseline.** AWS states that Compute Savings Plans apply to EC2 usage regardless of instance family, size, Region, operating system, or tenancy, and also apply to **Fargate** usage. AWS also states that Compute and EC2 Instance Savings Plans apply to the EC2 instances that are part of Amazon EKS clusters, although the EKS service charges themselves are not covered. This makes Compute Savings Plans more flexible than EC2-only commitments for a platform that uses both EKS on EC2 and EKS on Fargate ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
* **Spot Instances are the most cost-effective burst option for EKS peaks.** Amazon EKS managed node groups can use Spot capacity, and AWS describes Spot Instances as spare EC2 capacity that offers steep discounts off On-Demand prices. EKS can use Spot managed node groups to optimize compute node costs, especially for stateless, fault-tolerant, flexible workloads ([Amazon EKS managed node group capacity types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)).
* **RDS Reserved DB Instances should cover the steady database baseline, not infrequent peaks.** Amazon RDS supports reserved DB instance purchases by term and offering type, including upfront offerings ([Purchasing reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.WorkingWith.html)). Buying the reservation for the baseline avoids paying all year for peak database capacity that is needed only occasionally.
* **Manual DB scaling is suitable for predictable event-date peaks.** Amazon RDS allows modifying a DB instance, including changing settings such as the DB instance class. Changes can be applied immediately or deferred to a maintenance window, although some changes can cause downtime and must be planned ([Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)). Because the peaks depend on known event dates, temporary scale-up can be scheduled.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A is incorrect** because EC2 Standard Reserved Instances are less flexible than Compute Savings Plans for this scenario. The company is adding EKS workloads on Fargate, and Compute Savings Plans cover both EC2 and Fargate usage. Option A also reserves the RDS database for predicted peak load for the year, which is wasteful when peaks are infrequent.
* **B is incorrect** because it uses Compute Savings Plans for a predicted **medium** load instead of the baseline, increasing the risk of overcommitting. It also uses On-Demand Capacity Reservations for peaks. Capacity Reservations provide capacity assurance, but AWS states that they are charged at the equivalent On-Demand rate whether the reserved capacity is used or not ([Capacity Reservation pricing and billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/capacity-reservations-pricing-billing.html)). That is not the most cost-effective burst approach. In addition, read replicas help scale read-heavy workloads; RDS read replicas are read-only copies used to offload read queries ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). The question does not state that the ticketing peak is only read-heavy; ticket purchases are likely to include write activity.
* **C is incorrect** because EC2 Instance Savings Plans are tied to a specific EC2 instance family in a chosen Region. They do not provide the same flexibility as Compute Savings Plans and do not cover Fargate usage in the same way. Since the platform includes current EKS-on-EC2 workloads and new EKS-on-Fargate workloads, Compute Savings Plans are the better cost-optimization commitment.

Therefore, **option D** provides the most cost-effective setup by committing only to predictable baseline usage, using Spot Instances for infrequent compute surges, and scaling the RDS database temporarily for known peak periods.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个活动票务平台，并希望优化该平台的成本效益。该平台部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上，使用 Amazon EC2，并由一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例提供后端支持。该公司正在开发新的应用程序功能，这些功能将在 Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate 上运行。该平台会经历不频繁的高需求峰值。需求激增取决于活动日期。哪种解决方案将为该平台提供最具成本效益的设置？

options.A: 为 EKS 集群在基准负载中使用的 EC2 实例购买 Standard Reserved Instances。使用 Spot Instances 扩展集群以处理峰值。为数据库购买 1 年期 All Upfront Reserved Instances，以满足全年预测的峰值负载。
options.B: 为 EKS 集群预测的中等负载购买 Compute Savings Plans。根据活动日期，为峰值使用 On-Demand Capacity Reservations 扩展集群。为数据库购买 1 年期 No Upfront Reserved Instances，以满足预测的基础负载。在峰值期间临时横向扩展数据库只读副本。
options.C: 为 EKS 集群预测的基础负载购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plans。使用 Spot Instances 扩展集群以处理峰值。为数据库购买 1 年期 All Upfront Reserved Instances，以满足预测的基础负载。在峰值期间手动临时纵向扩展数据库实例。
options.D: 为 EKS 集群预测的基础负载购买 Compute Savings Plans。使用 Spot Instances 扩展集群以处理峰值。为数据库购买 1 年期 All Upfront Reserved Instances，以满足预测的基础负载。在峰值期间手动临时纵向扩展数据库实例。

zh.explanation:
该平台在使用 EC2 工作节点的 Amazon EKS 上有稳定的基线负载，将在 AWS Fargate 上添加新的 Amazon EKS 工作负载，并且在活动日期前后会出现不频繁但可预测的需求峰值。最具成本效益的设计是只对稳定基线进行折扣承诺，为突发计算使用低成本的可中断容量，并避免为仅偶尔发生的峰值预留数据库容量。

**正确答案：D。为 EKS 集群预测的基础负载购买 Compute Savings Plans。使用 Spot Instances 扩展集群以处理峰值。为数据库购买 1 年期 All Upfront Reserved Instances，以满足预测的基础负载。在峰值期间手动临时纵向扩展数据库实例。**

这是最合适的选择，原因如下：

* **Compute Savings Plans 是 EKS 基线的正确承诺方式。** AWS 表示，Compute Savings Plans 适用于 EC2 使用量，不受实例系列、大小、Region、操作系统或租赁方式影响，并且也适用于 **Fargate** 使用量。AWS 还表示，Compute 和 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 适用于作为 Amazon EKS 集群一部分的 EC2 实例，但 EKS 服务费用本身不在覆盖范围内。对于同时使用 EKS on EC2 和 EKS on Fargate 的平台而言，这使 Compute Savings Plans 比仅限 EC2 的承诺更灵活（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
* **Spot Instances 是 EKS 峰值最具成本效益的突发选项。** Amazon EKS managed node groups 可以使用 Spot 容量，AWS 将 Spot Instances 描述为备用 EC2 容量，可相对于 On-Demand 价格提供大幅折扣。EKS 可以使用 Spot managed node groups 来优化计算节点成本，尤其适用于无状态、容错、灵活的工作负载（[Amazon EKS managed node group capacity types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。
* **RDS Reserved DB Instances 应覆盖稳定的数据库基线，而不是不频繁的峰值。** Amazon RDS 支持按期限和报价类型购买 reserved DB instance，包括预付款报价（[Purchasing reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.WorkingWith.html)）。为基线购买预留可避免为仅偶尔需要的峰值数据库容量全年付费。
* **手动 DB 扩展适用于可预测的活动日期峰值。** Amazon RDS 允许修改 DB instance，包括更改 DB instance class 等设置。更改可以立即应用，也可以推迟到维护时段，尽管某些更改可能导致停机并且必须规划（[Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)）。由于峰值取决于已知活动日期，因此可以安排临时纵向扩展。

其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A 不正确**，因为在此场景中，EC2 Standard Reserved Instances 不如 Compute Savings Plans 灵活。公司正在添加 EKS on Fargate 工作负载，而 Compute Savings Plans 覆盖 EC2 和 Fargate 使用量。选项 A 还为全年预测的峰值负载预留 RDS 数据库，当峰值不频繁时这是一种浪费。
* **B 不正确**，因为它为预测的**中等**负载而不是基线使用 Compute Savings Plans，增加了过度承诺的风险。它还为峰值使用 On-Demand Capacity Reservations。Capacity Reservations 提供容量保障，但 AWS 表示，无论是否使用预留容量，它们都按等效的 On-Demand 费率收费（[Capacity Reservation pricing and billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/capacity-reservations-pricing-billing.html)）。这不是最具成本效益的突发方法。此外，read replicas 有助于扩展读密集型工作负载；RDS read replicas 是用于卸载读取查询的只读副本（[Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。题目并未说明票务峰值仅为读密集型；购票很可能包含写入活动。
* **C 不正确**，因为 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 绑定到所选 Region 中的特定 EC2 实例系列。它们不提供与 Compute Savings Plans 相同的灵活性，也不以同样方式覆盖 Fargate 使用量。由于该平台包括当前 EKS-on-EC2 工作负载和新的 EKS-on-Fargate 工作负载，Compute Savings Plans 是更好的成本优化承诺方式。

因此，**选项 D** 通过仅对可预测的基线使用量做出承诺、为不频繁的计算激增使用 Spot Instances，并在已知高峰期临时扩展 RDS 数据库，提供了最具成本效益的设置。

en.question: A company has deployed an application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. The application uses Amazon Aurora for the database layer. An Amazon CloudFront distribution serves web requests and includes the Elastic Beanstalk domain name as the origin server. The distribution is configured with an alternate domain name that visitors use when they access the application. Each week, the company takes the application out of service for routine maintenance. During the time that the application is unavailable, the company wants visitors to receive an informational message instead of a CloudFront error message. A solutions architect creates an Amazon S3 bucket as the first step in the process. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take next to meet the requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Upload static informational content to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a new CloudFront distribution. Set the S3 bucket as the origin.
options.C: Set the S3 bucket as a second origin in the original CloudFront distribution. Configure the distribution and the S3 bucket to use an origin access identity (OAI).
options.D: During the weekly maintenance, edit the default cache behavior to use the S3 origin. Revert the change when the maintenance is complete.
options.E: During the weekly maintenance, create a cache behavior for the S3 origin on the new distribution. Set the path pattern to \ Set the precedence to 0. Delete the cache behavior when the maintenance is complete.
options.F: During the weekly maintenance, configure Elastic Beanstalk to serve traffic from the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application is accessed through an existing CloudFront distribution that already has the visitor-facing alternate domain name. During maintenance, the company wants all visitors to see a static informational message rather than CloudFront errors from the unavailable Elastic Beanstalk origin.

The best approach among the choices is to use the existing CloudFront distribution, add the S3 bucket as another origin, store the maintenance content in that bucket, and temporarily route the default cache behavior to the S3 origin during maintenance.

## Correct answers: A, C, D

### A. Upload static informational content to the S3 bucket

Correct. The S3 bucket must contain the static maintenance or informational page that CloudFront will serve while the Elastic Beanstalk environment is unavailable. CloudFront documentation also describes using a separate location such as an S3 bucket for custom error/maintenance-style pages, with cache behavior routing to the origin that contains those pages: [Store objects and custom error pages in different locations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/custom-error-pages-different-locations.html).

### C. Set the S3 bucket as a second origin in the original CloudFront distribution. Configure the distribution and the S3 bucket to use an origin access identity (OAI)

Correct. The company should continue using the original CloudFront distribution because that distribution already has the alternate domain name that users access. CloudFront cache behaviors can route requests to an existing origin or origin group; the `Origin or origin group` setting identifies where CloudFront sends matching requests, including the default cache behavior: [Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html).

Using OAI keeps the S3 bucket from being publicly accessible while still allowing CloudFront to retrieve the static objects. AWS documentation states that a CloudFront OAI can be granted access to files in an S3 bucket and that viewers should not be able to use S3 URLs to access files outside CloudFront: [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html). Although current AWS guidance recommends origin access control (OAC) for new designs, OAI is explicitly supported and is the mechanism provided in this answer choice.

### D. During the weekly maintenance, edit the default cache behavior to use the S3 origin. Revert the change when the maintenance is complete

Correct. The default cache behavior has the path pattern `*`, which applies to all requests that do not match a more specific behavior. AWS documentation states that the default cache behavior forwards all requests to the configured origin and that the origin setting determines where CloudFront routes matching requests: [Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html). Therefore, temporarily changing the default cache behavior to the S3 origin causes normal visitor requests to receive the static informational content. After maintenance, the cache behavior can be changed back to the Elastic Beanstalk origin.

## Incorrect options

### B. Create a new CloudFront distribution. Set the S3 bucket as the origin

Incorrect. The existing distribution already has the alternate domain name that visitors use. Creating a separate distribution would require additional DNS and certificate considerations and would not automatically serve traffic for the existing application domain. The requirement can be met by adding the S3 bucket as another origin in the existing distribution.

### E. During the weekly maintenance, create a cache behavior for the S3 origin on the new distribution. Set the path pattern to `*`. Set the precedence to 0. Delete the cache behavior when the maintenance is complete

Incorrect. This depends on a new distribution from option B, which is unnecessary and does not preserve the existing visitor-facing distribution configuration. Also, the default cache behavior already has the `*` path pattern and cannot be changed; CloudFront applies the default cache behavior when no other cache behavior matches: [Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html). Temporarily updating the existing distribution's default behavior is the more direct fit among the options.

### F. During the weekly maintenance, configure Elastic Beanstalk to serve traffic from the S3 bucket

Incorrect. Elastic Beanstalk is the application origin and is being taken out of service for maintenance. The routing decision for viewer requests is being made by CloudFront. The correct place to switch visitors to static maintenance content is the CloudFront distribution, not the Elastic Beanstalk environment.

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 上部署了一个应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon Aurora 作为数据库层。一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配用于提供 Web 请求，并将 Elastic Beanstalk 域名包含为源服务器。该分配配置了一个备用域名，访问者在访问应用程序时使用该域名。每周，公司都会让应用程序停止服务以进行例行维护。在应用程序不可用期间，公司希望访问者收到一条信息提示，而不是 CloudFront 错误消息。解决方案架构师创建了一个 Amazon S3 存储桶作为该流程的第一步。解决方案架构师接下来应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 将静态信息内容上传到 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 创建一个新的 CloudFront 分配。将 S3 存储桶设置为源。
options.C: 在原始 CloudFront 分配中将 S3 存储桶设置为第二个源。配置该分配和 S3 存储桶以使用源访问身份（OAI）。
options.D: 在每周维护期间，编辑默认缓存行为以使用 S3 源。维护完成后还原该更改。
options.E: 在每周维护期间，在新分配上为 S3 源创建一个缓存行为。将路径模式设置为 \ 将优先级设置为 0。维护完成后删除该缓存行为。
options.F: 在每周维护期间，配置 Elastic Beanstalk 从 S3 存储桶提供流量。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序通过现有 CloudFront 分配进行访问，该分配已经具有面向访问者的备用域名。在维护期间，公司希望所有访问者看到静态信息提示，而不是来自不可用 Elastic Beanstalk 源的 CloudFront 错误。

在这些选项中，最佳方法是使用现有 CloudFront 分配，将 S3 存储桶添加为另一个源，将维护内容存储在该存储桶中，并在维护期间临时将默认缓存行为路由到 S3 源。

## 正确答案：A、C、D

### A. 将静态信息内容上传到 S3 存储桶

正确。S3 存储桶必须包含静态维护或信息页面，CloudFront 将在 Elastic Beanstalk 环境不可用时提供该页面。CloudFront 文档还描述了使用单独位置（例如 S3 存储桶）存储自定义错误/维护样式页面，并通过缓存行为路由到包含这些页面的源：[Store objects and custom error pages in different locations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/custom-error-pages-different-locations.html)。

### C. 在原始 CloudFront 分配中将 S3 存储桶设置为第二个源。配置该分配和 S3 存储桶以使用源访问身份（OAI）

正确。公司应继续使用原始 CloudFront 分配，因为该分配已经具有用户访问的备用域名。CloudFront 缓存行为可以将请求路由到现有源或源组；`Origin or origin group` 设置标识 CloudFront 将匹配请求发送到的位置，包括默认缓存行为：[Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html)。

使用 OAI 可以防止 S3 存储桶被公开访问，同时仍允许 CloudFront 检索静态对象。AWS 文档说明，可以授予 CloudFront OAI 对 S3 存储桶中文件的访问权限，并且查看者不应能够使用 S3 URL 在 CloudFront 之外访问文件：[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)。尽管当前 AWS 指南建议在新设计中使用源访问控制（OAC），但 OAI 受到明确支持，并且是此答案选项中提供的机制。

### D. 在每周维护期间，编辑默认缓存行为以使用 S3 源。维护完成后还原该更改

正确。默认缓存行为的路径模式是 `*`，它适用于所有不匹配更具体行为的请求。AWS 文档说明，默认缓存行为会将所有请求转发到配置的源，并且源设置决定 CloudFront 将匹配请求路由到哪里：[Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html)。因此，临时将默认缓存行为更改为 S3 源会使普通访问者请求收到静态信息内容。维护后，可以将缓存行为改回 Elastic Beanstalk 源。

## 错误选项

### B. 创建一个新的 CloudFront 分配。将 S3 存储桶设置为源

错误。现有分配已经具有访问者使用的备用域名。创建单独的分配将需要额外的 DNS 和证书考虑，并且不会自动为现有应用程序域提供流量。通过在现有分配中将 S3 存储桶添加为另一个源即可满足要求。

### E. 在每周维护期间，在新分配上为 S3 源创建一个缓存行为。将路径模式设置为 `*`。将优先级设置为 0。维护完成后删除该缓存行为

错误。这依赖于选项 B 中的新分配，而新分配是不必要的，并且不能保留现有面向访问者的分配配置。此外，默认缓存行为已经具有 `*` 路径模式且无法更改；当没有其他缓存行为匹配时，CloudFront 会应用默认缓存行为：[Cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html)。在这些选项中，临时更新现有分配的默认行为是更直接的匹配。

### F. 在每周维护期间，配置 Elastic Beanstalk 从 S3 存储桶提供流量

错误。Elastic Beanstalk 是应用程序源，并且将因维护而停止服务。查看者请求的路由决策由 CloudFront 做出。将访问者切换到静态维护内容的正确位置是 CloudFront 分配，而不是 Elastic Beanstalk 环境。

en.question: A company gives users the ability to upload images from a custom application. The upload process invokes an AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the image in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application invokes the Lambda function by using a specific function version ARN. The Lambda function accepts image processing parameters by using environment variables. The company often adjusts the environment variables of the Lambda function to achieve optimal image processing output. The company tests different parameters and publishes a new function version with the updated environment variables after validating results. This update process also requires frequent changes to the custom application to invoke the new function version ARN. These changes cause interruptions for users. A solutions architect needs to simplify this process to minimize disruption to users. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Directly modify the environment variables of the published Lambda function version. Use the SLATEST version to test image processing parameters.
options.B: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store the image processing parameters. Modify the Lambda function to retrieve the image processing parameters from the DynamoDB table.
options.C: Directly code the image processing parameters within the Lambda function and remove the environment variables. Publish a new function version when the company updates the parameters.
options.D: Create a Lambda function alias. Modify the client application to use the function alias ARN. Reconfigure the Lambda alias to point to new versions of the function when the company finishes testing.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application currently invokes a specific **published Lambda function version ARN**. The company frequently changes Lambda environment variables, tests them, and publishes a new function version. Because each published version has a unique qualified ARN, the application must be changed repeatedly to call the new version, causing user disruption.

The requirement is to minimize this disruption with the **least operational overhead**.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create a Lambda function alias. Modify the client application to use the function alias ARN. Reconfigure the Lambda alias to point to new versions of the function when the company finishes testing.**

This is the intended use case for Lambda aliases. AWS documentation states that a Lambda alias is a pointer to a function version that can be updated, and that users can access the function version by using the alias ARN. When a new version is deployed, the alias can be updated to use the new version ([Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)).

This means the application is changed once to invoke the alias ARN, such as `function:ImageProcessor:prod`. After that, the company can continue testing environment variable changes, publish new versions, and simply update the alias to point to the validated version. No repeated client application updates are required.

This also aligns with Lambda version behavior: published versions are immutable snapshots of code and configuration, and environment variables are locked for a published version ([Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html), [Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)). Therefore, using an alias provides a stable invocation target while preserving versioned, tested configurations.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Directly modify the environment variables of the published Lambda function version. Use the `$LATEST` version to test image processing parameters.

This is incorrect because published Lambda versions are immutable. AWS states that after a version is published, Lambda locks the code and most settings, and environment variables are locked for that version ([Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html), [Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)). You can change environment variables on the unpublished version, but not directly on an already published version.

### B. Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store the image processing parameters. Modify the Lambda function to retrieve the image processing parameters from the DynamoDB table.

This could externalize the parameters, but it introduces additional architecture, code changes, table management, permissions, and runtime reads. The question asks for the **least operational overhead**. Lambda aliases solve the specific issue directly: keeping a stable client-facing ARN while allowing the backend version to change.

### C. Directly code the image processing parameters within the Lambda function and remove the environment variables. Publish a new function version when the company updates the parameters.

This is worse operationally. Hardcoding parameters requires code changes and republishing whenever parameters change. It also does not solve the core problem if the application continues to invoke specific version ARNs; each new version would still have a unique qualified ARN, requiring application changes. AWS documentation confirms that each Lambda function version has a unique qualified ARN and that published versions are immutable ([Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)).

## Conclusion

The best solution is **D**. A Lambda alias provides a stable ARN for the application while allowing operations teams to redirect traffic to newly validated Lambda versions without modifying the client application each time.

zh.question: 一家公司允许用户从一个自定义应用程序上传图像。上传过程会调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数处理图像并将其存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该应用程序通过使用特定的函数版本 ARN 来调用 Lambda 函数。Lambda 函数使用环境变量接收图像处理参数。公司经常调整 Lambda 函数的环境变量，以获得最佳图像处理输出。公司会测试不同的参数，并在验证结果后使用更新后的环境变量发布新的函数版本。此更新过程还需要频繁更改自定义应用程序，以调用新的函数版本 ARN。这些更改会给用户造成中断。解决方案架构师需要简化此流程，以尽量减少对用户的干扰。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 直接修改已发布的 Lambda 函数版本的环境变量。使用 SLATEST 版本测试图像处理参数。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储图像处理参数。修改 Lambda 函数以从 DynamoDB 表中检索图像处理参数。
options.C: 将图像处理参数直接编码到 Lambda 函数中，并移除环境变量。当公司更新参数时，发布新的函数版本。
options.D: 创建一个 Lambda 函数别名。修改客户端应用程序以使用函数别名 ARN。当公司完成测试后，重新配置 Lambda 别名，使其指向函数的新版本。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序目前调用一个特定的 **已发布 Lambda 函数版本 ARN**。公司频繁更改 Lambda 环境变量、进行测试，并发布新的函数版本。由于每个已发布版本都有唯一的限定 ARN，应用程序必须反复更改以调用新版本，从而造成用户中断。

要求是以 **最少的运营开销** 最大限度地减少这种干扰。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 创建一个 Lambda 函数别名。修改客户端应用程序以使用函数别名 ARN。当公司完成测试后，重新配置 Lambda 别名，使其指向函数的新版本。**

这是 Lambda 别名的预期使用场景。AWS 文档说明，Lambda 别名是指向函数版本的指针，可以更新，并且用户可以使用别名 ARN 访问该函数版本。当部署新版本时，可以更新别名以使用新版本（[Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)）。

这意味着应用程序只需更改一次，以调用别名 ARN，例如 `function:ImageProcessor:prod`。此后，公司可以继续测试环境变量更改、发布新版本，并且只需更新别名，使其指向已验证的版本。无需反复更新客户端应用程序。

这也符合 Lambda 版本行为：已发布版本是代码和配置的不可变快照，并且环境变量会针对已发布版本被锁定（[Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)、[Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)）。因此，使用别名可以提供稳定的调用目标，同时保留经过版本化和测试的配置。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 直接修改已发布的 Lambda 函数版本的环境变量。使用 `$LATEST` 版本测试图像处理参数。

这是不正确的，因为已发布的 Lambda 版本是不可变的。AWS 说明，版本发布后，Lambda 会锁定代码和大多数设置，并且环境变量会针对该版本被锁定（[Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)、[Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)）。你可以更改未发布版本上的环境变量，但不能直接更改已发布版本上的环境变量。

### B. 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储图像处理参数。修改 Lambda 函数以从 DynamoDB 表中检索图像处理参数。

这可以将参数外部化，但会引入额外的架构、代码更改、表管理、权限和运行时读取。题目要求 **最少的运营开销**。Lambda 别名可以直接解决这个具体问题：在允许后端版本变化的同时，保持面向客户端的 ARN 稳定。

### C. 将图像处理参数直接编码到 Lambda 函数中，并移除环境变量。当公司更新参数时，发布新的函数版本。

这在运营上更糟。硬编码参数要求每次参数更改时都进行代码更改并重新发布。如果应用程序继续调用特定版本 ARN，它也无法解决核心问题；每个新版本仍会有唯一的限定 ARN，需要更改应用程序。AWS 文档确认，每个 Lambda 函数版本都有唯一的限定 ARN，并且已发布版本是不可变的（[Manage Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)）。

## 结论

最佳解决方案是 **D**。Lambda 别名为应用程序提供稳定的 ARN，同时允许运维团队将流量重定向到新验证的 Lambda 版本，而无需每次都修改客户端应用程序。

en.question: A global media company is planning a multi-Region deployment of an application. Amazon DynamoDB global tables will back the deployment to keep the user experience consistent across the two continents where users are concentrated. Each deployment will have a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company manages public DNS internally. The company wants to make the application available through an apex domain. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Migrate public DNS to Amazon Route 53. Create CNAME records for the apex domain to point to the ALB. Use a geolocation routing policy to route traffic based on user location.
options.B: Place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the ALMigrate public DNS to Amazon Route 53. Create a CNAME record for the apex domain to point to the NLB’s static IP address. Use a geolocation routing policy to route traffic based on user location.
options.C: Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator with multiple endpoint groups that target endpoints in appropriate AWS Regions. Use the accelerator’s static IP address to create a record in public DNS for the apex domain.
options.D: Create an Amazon API Gateway API that is backed by AWS Lambda in one of the AWS Regions. Configure a Lambda function to route traffic to application deployments by using the round robin method. Create CNAME records for the apex domain to point to the API's URL.

en.explanation:
The application will run in multiple AWS Regions with public ALBs, and DynamoDB global tables handle data replication. The remaining requirement is global traffic entry through an **apex/root domain** while the company keeps DNS managed internally. The least-effort solution must therefore work with a non-Route 53 DNS provider and avoid CNAME-at-apex limitations.

**Correct answer: C. Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator with multiple endpoint groups that target endpoints in appropriate AWS Regions. Use the accelerator’s static IP address to create a record in public DNS for the apex domain.**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for global internet applications. The AWS documentation states that a standard accelerator directs traffic over the AWS global network to endpoints in the nearest Region to the client, and that Global Accelerator supports endpoints in multiple AWS Regions. It also provides static IP addresses that remain assigned to the accelerator, and endpoints can include **Application Load Balancers** in one or multiple Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Because the company manages public DNS internally, it can create an apex-domain **A record** that points to the Global Accelerator static IP addresses, without migrating DNS to Route 53 and without using a CNAME at the apex.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect.** It requires migrating public DNS to Route 53, which is more effort than using Global Accelerator static IPs with the existing DNS provider. More importantly, the option says to create **CNAME records for the apex domain**. Route 53 documentation explicitly states that you can't create a CNAME record with the same name as the hosted zone, also called the zone apex ([Route 53 alias vs. CNAME records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-choosing-alias-non-alias.html)). A Route 53 alias record could be used at the apex, but that is not what this option says.

- **B is incorrect.** This also requires migrating DNS to Route 53 and uses a CNAME for the apex domain, which is not supported. Additionally, a CNAME points to another DNS name, not directly to a static IP address. Adding an NLB in front of the ALB adds unnecessary components and operational effort compared with Global Accelerator, which can directly use ALBs as regional endpoints.

- **D is incorrect.** This introduces API Gateway and Lambda solely for traffic routing, which is unnecessary and adds latency, complexity, and custom routing logic. It also uses CNAME records for the apex domain, which is not supported. A single-Region API Gateway/Lambda router also does not match the intended multi-Region, health-aware, location-aware routing behavior that Global Accelerator provides natively.

Therefore, **C** best meets the requirements with the least effort.

zh.question: 一家全球媒体公司正在规划一个应用程序的多区域部署。该部署将由 Amazon DynamoDB global tables 支撑，以在用户集中的两个大洲之间保持一致的用户体验。每个部署都将具有一个公有 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该公司在内部管理公有 DNS。公司希望通过 apex domain 提供该应用程序。哪种解决方案能够以最少的工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 将公有 DNS 迁移到 Amazon Route 53。为 apex domain 创建 CNAME 记录，使其指向 ALB。使用地理位置路由策略根据用户位置路由流量。
options.B: 在 AL 前面放置一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将公有 DNS 迁移到 Amazon Route 53。为 apex domain 创建一条 CNAME 记录，使其指向 NLB 的静态 IP 地址。使用地理位置路由策略根据用户位置路由流量。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator accelerator，其中包含多个 endpoint groups，目标指向相应 AWS 区域中的 endpoints。使用 accelerator 的静态 IP 地址在公有 DNS 中为 apex domain 创建记录。
options.D: 创建一个由某个 AWS 区域中的 AWS Lambda 支持的 Amazon API Gateway API。配置一个 Lambda 函数，使用轮询方法将流量路由到应用程序部署。为 apex domain 创建 CNAME 记录，使其指向 API 的 URL。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序将在多个 AWS 区域中运行，并使用公有 ALB，DynamoDB global tables 负责数据复制。剩余要求是通过 **apex/root domain** 作为全局流量入口，同时公司继续在内部管理 DNS。因此，最省力的解决方案必须能够与非 Route 53 DNS 提供商配合使用，并避免 apex 处的 CNAME 限制。

**正确答案：C. 创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator accelerator，其中包含多个 endpoint groups，目标指向相应 AWS 区域中的 endpoints。使用 accelerator 的静态 IP 地址在公有 DNS 中为 apex domain 创建记录。**

AWS Global Accelerator 专为全球互联网应用程序而设计。AWS 文档指出，standard accelerator 会通过 AWS 全球网络将流量引导到距离客户端最近的区域中的 endpoints，并且 Global Accelerator 支持多个 AWS 区域中的 endpoints。它还提供保持分配给 accelerator 的静态 IP 地址，并且 endpoints 可以包括一个或多个区域中的 **Application Load Balancers**（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。由于该公司在内部管理公有 DNS，因此可以创建一个 apex-domain **A record**，指向 Global Accelerator 静态 IP 地址，而无需将 DNS 迁移到 Route 53，也无需在 apex 使用 CNAME。

其他选项错误的原因：

- **A 是错误的。** 它要求将公有 DNS 迁移到 Route 53，这比使用 Global Accelerator 静态 IP 并配合现有 DNS 提供商需要更多工作。更重要的是，该选项要求为 **apex domain 创建 CNAME 记录**。Route 53 文档明确指出，不能创建与托管区域同名的 CNAME 记录，该名称也称为 zone apex（[Route 53 alias vs. CNAME records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-choosing-alias-non-alias.html)）。Route 53 alias record 可以在 apex 使用，但这不是该选项所描述的内容。

- **B 是错误的。** 这同样需要将 DNS 迁移到 Route 53，并为 apex domain 使用 CNAME，而这是不受支持的。此外，CNAME 指向另一个 DNS 名称，而不是直接指向静态 IP 地址。与 Global Accelerator 相比，在 ALB 前面添加 NLB 会增加不必要的组件和运维工作量，而 Global Accelerator 可以直接使用 ALB 作为区域 endpoints。

- **D 是错误的。** 这仅为流量路由引入 API Gateway 和 Lambda，这是不必要的，并且会增加延迟、复杂性和自定义路由逻辑。它还为 apex domain 使用 CNAME 记录，而这是不受支持的。单区域 API Gateway/Lambda 路由器也不符合 Global Accelerator 原生提供的多区域、健康感知、位置感知路由行为。

因此，**C** 能以最少的工作量最好地满足要求。

en.question: A company is developing a new serverless API by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company integrated the Lambda functions with API Gateway to use several shared libraries and custom classes. A solutions architect needs to simplify the deployment of the solution and optimize for code reuse. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the shared libraries and custom classes into a Docker image. Store the image in an S3 bucket. Create a Lambda layer that uses the Docker image as the source. Deploy the API's Lambda functions as Zip packages. Configure the packages to use the Lambda layer.
options.B: Deploy the shared libraries and custom classes to a Docker image. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Create a Lambda layer that uses the Docker image as the source. Deploy the API's Lambda functions as Zip packages. Configure the packages to use the Lambda layer.
options.C: Deploy the shared libraries and custom classes to a Docker container in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) by using the AWS Fargate launch type. Deploy the API's Lambda functions as Zip packages. Configure the packages to use the deployed container as a Lambda layer.
options.D: Deploy the shared libraries, custom classes, and code for the API's Lambda functions to a Docker image. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Configure the API's Lambda functions to use the Docker image as the deployment package.

en.explanation:
The company is building multiple API Gateway–integrated Lambda functions that need shared libraries and custom classes. The key is to choose a deployment model that both simplifies packaging and supports reuse of the common code.

**Correct answer: D.**

AWS Lambda supports two deployment package types: **container images** and **.zip file archives**. For a Lambda container-image deployment, you build the image and upload it to **Amazon ECR**, then create or update the Lambda function using that ECR image URI. The AWS documentation states that to create a Lambda function from a container image, you build the image and upload it to an Amazon ECR repository, then specify the repository URI when creating the function ([Create a Lambda function using a container image](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)). Option D packages the shared libraries, custom classes, and Lambda function code into a Docker image in ECR and configures the functions to use that image as the deployment package. This is a valid Lambda deployment model and simplifies deployment because the dependencies and application code are built into the image.

This is also consistent with the Lambda layers limitation. Lambda layers are useful for sharing dependencies, but AWS documentation states that layers can be used **only with Lambda functions deployed as .zip file archives**. For functions defined as container images, you package the preferred runtime and all code dependencies when creating the container image ([Managing Lambda dependencies with layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect.** A Lambda layer is a **.zip file archive**, not a Docker image. AWS documents that the first step to creating a layer is bundling the layer content into a `.zip` archive ([Packaging your layer content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/packaging-layers.html)). Also, storing a Docker image in S3 and using it as a Lambda layer source is not a supported Lambda layer pattern.

- **B is incorrect.** Although storing a Lambda container image in Amazon ECR is valid for container-image functions, the option incorrectly says to create a **Lambda layer that uses the Docker image as the source** and then attach it to zip-based Lambda functions. Lambda layers are zip archives, and layers are only for functions deployed as zip archives; a Docker image in ECR is not used as a Lambda layer source ([Managing Lambda dependencies with layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)).

- **C is incorrect.** Running a Docker container in Amazon ECS/Fargate does not make that container usable as a Lambda layer. Lambda layers are packaged as `.zip` archives and are attached to zip-based Lambda functions, not sourced from running ECS tasks or containers ([Packaging your layer content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/packaging-layers.html)).

Therefore, **D** is the only technically valid option that uses Lambda container-image deployment with ECR and packages the shared code and function code together for simplified deployment and reuse.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 开发一个新的无服务器 API。该公司已将 Lambda 函数与 API Gateway 集成，以使用多个共享库和自定义类。解决方案架构师需要简化该解决方案的部署，并优化代码复用。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将共享库和自定义类部署到 Docker 镜像中。将该镜像存储在 S3 存储桶中。创建一个使用该 Docker 镜像作为源的 Lambda layer。将该 API 的 Lambda 函数作为 Zip 包部署。配置这些包使用该 Lambda layer。
options.B: 将共享库和自定义类部署到 Docker 镜像中。将该镜像上传到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)。创建一个使用该 Docker 镜像作为源的 Lambda layer。将该 API 的 Lambda 函数作为 Zip 包部署。配置这些包使用该 Lambda layer。
options.C: 使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型，将共享库和自定义类部署到 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中的 Docker 容器。将该 API 的 Lambda 函数作为 Zip 包部署。配置这些包使用已部署的容器作为 Lambda layer。
options.D: 将共享库、自定义类以及该 API 的 Lambda 函数代码部署到 Docker 镜像中。将该镜像上传到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)。配置该 API 的 Lambda 函数使用该 Docker 镜像作为部署包。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在构建多个与 API Gateway 集成的 Lambda 函数，这些函数需要共享库和自定义类。关键是选择一种既能简化打包又支持复用公共代码的部署模型。

**正确答案：D。**

AWS Lambda 支持两种部署包类型：**容器镜像**和 **.zip 文件归档**。对于 Lambda 容器镜像部署，你需要构建镜像并将其上传到 **Amazon ECR**，然后使用该 ECR 镜像 URI 创建或更新 Lambda 函数。AWS 文档说明，要从容器镜像创建 Lambda 函数，需要构建镜像并将其上传到 Amazon ECR 存储库，然后在创建函数时指定该存储库 URI（[使用容器镜像创建 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)）。选项 D 将共享库、自定义类和 Lambda 函数代码打包到 ECR 中的 Docker 镜像里，并配置函数使用该镜像作为部署包。这是一种有效的 Lambda 部署模型，并且可以简化部署，因为依赖项和应用程序代码都内置在镜像中。

这也符合 Lambda layers 的限制。Lambda layers 有助于共享依赖项，但 AWS 文档说明，layers **只能用于以 .zip 文件归档形式部署的 Lambda 函数**。对于定义为容器镜像的函数，你需要在创建容器镜像时打包首选运行时和所有代码依赖项（[使用 layers 管理 Lambda 依赖项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 不正确。** Lambda layer 是一个 **.zip 文件归档**，不是 Docker 镜像。AWS 文档说明，创建 layer 的第一步是将 layer 内容打包到 `.zip` 归档中（[打包你的 layer 内容](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/packaging-layers.html)）。此外，将 Docker 镜像存储在 S3 中并将其用作 Lambda layer 源并不是受支持的 Lambda layer 模式。

- **B 不正确。** 虽然将 Lambda 容器镜像存储在 Amazon ECR 中对于容器镜像函数是有效的，但该选项错误地说要创建一个**使用 Docker 镜像作为源的 Lambda layer**，然后将其附加到基于 zip 的 Lambda 函数。Lambda layers 是 zip 归档，且 layers 仅用于以 zip 归档形式部署的函数；ECR 中的 Docker 镜像不会用作 Lambda layer 源（[使用 layers 管理 Lambda 依赖项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)）。

- **C 不正确。** 在 Amazon ECS/Fargate 中运行 Docker 容器并不会使该容器可用作 Lambda layer。Lambda layers 以 `.zip` 归档形式打包，并附加到基于 zip 的 Lambda 函数，而不是来自正在运行的 ECS 任务或容器（[打包你的 layer 内容](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/packaging-layers.html)）。

因此，**D** 是唯一在技术上有效的选项，它使用 ECR 进行 Lambda 容器镜像部署，并将共享代码和函数代码一起打包，以实现简化部署和复用。

en.question: A manufacturing company is building an inspection solution for its factory. The company has IP cameras at the end of each assembly line. The company has used Amazon SageMaker to train a machine learning (ML) model to identify common defects from still images. The company wants to provide local feedback to factory workers when a defect is detected. The company must be able to provide this feedback even if the factory’s internet connectivity is down.
