This minimizes operational overhead compared with running MongoDB on EC2. See [Amazon DocumentDB welcome documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html).

- **E. Use AWS Step Functions state machines with AWS Lambda tasks to prepare the reports and write the reports to Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront with an S3 origin to serve the reports** — Correct. The periodic jobs run for **120–600 seconds**, which fits within the Lambda maximum timeout of **900 seconds / 15 minutes** documented by AWS. Step Functions can orchestrate Lambda tasks; the Step Functions documentation shows a `Task` state invoking a Lambda function. Periodic execution can be handled with EventBridge Scheduler, which can start Step Functions executions on a recurring rate or cron schedule. Writing generated reports to S3 and serving them through CloudFront removes the need for an always-running web server. CloudFront supports Amazon S3 bucket origins and origin access control for securing S3 origins. See [Lambda timeout configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html), [Invoke Lambda with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html), [Using EventBridge Scheduler to start a Step Functions state machine execution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html), and [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Use AWS Lambda functions to connect to the IoT devices** — Incorrect. Lambda is not a managed MQTT broker or persistent IoT device connectivity layer. AWS IoT Core is the purpose-built managed service for devices publishing MQTT messages. Using Lambda to connect directly to devices would add custom connection-management logic and operational complexity.

- **C. Write the metadata to a self-managed MongoDB database on an Amazon EC2 instance** — Incorrect. This preserves database administration responsibilities such as patching, scaling, backups, high availability design, and monitoring. Amazon DocumentDB is the lower-operational-overhead MongoDB-compatible managed option.

- **F. Use an Amazon EKS cluster with Amazon EC2 instances to prepare the reports. Use an ingress controller in the EKS cluster to serve the reports** — Incorrect. EKS on EC2 introduces cluster, node, container, ingress, scaling, and patching operations. For periodic jobs that complete within Lambda's 15-minute maximum and static report serving, Step Functions + Lambda + S3 + CloudFront is significantly more serverless and lower overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在本地环境中运行的 IoT 平台。该平台由一台服务器组成，该服务器使用 MQTT 协议连接到 IoT 设备。该平台至少每 5 分钟从设备收集一次遥测数据。该平台还将设备元数据存储在 MongoDB 集群中。安装在本地计算机上的一个应用程序运行周期性作业，以聚合和转换遥测数据与设备元数据。该应用程序创建报表，用户通过运行在同一本地计算机上的另一个 Web 应用程序查看这些报表。周期性作业需要 120-600 秒运行完成。但是，Web 应用程序始终在运行。公司正在将该平台迁移到 AWS，并且必须减少该技术栈的运维开销。哪组步骤的组合能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数连接到 IoT 设备
options.B: 配置 IoT 设备发布到 AWS IoT Core
options.C: 将元数据写入 Amazon EC2 实例上的自托管 MongoDB 数据库
options.D: 将元数据写入 Amazon DocumentDB（兼容 MongoDB）
options.E: 使用带有 AWS Lambda 任务的 AWS Step Functions 状态机来准备报表并将报表写入 Amazon S3。使用以 S3 为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 来提供报表
options.F: 使用包含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群来准备报表。使用 EKS 集群中的 ingress controller 来提供报表

zh.explanation:
该公司正在将本地 IoT/MQTT 摄取平台、兼容 MongoDB 的元数据存储、周期性报表生成作业以及始终运行的报表 Web 服务迁移到 AWS。关键要求是**最少运维开销**，因此最佳选择是托管/无服务器服务，而不是自托管服务器或 Kubernetes。

**正确答案：B、D 和 E。**

- **B. 配置 IoT 设备发布到 AWS IoT Core** — 正确。AWS IoT Core 是专为设备连接和消息传递而设计的 AWS 托管服务。AWS IoT 文档指出，设备可以使用 AWS IoT Device SDKs 向 AWS IoT 发送消息以及从 AWS IoT 接收消息，并且 AWS IoT Core 支持 MQTT 连接。这用托管的 IoT 摄取层替代了本地 MQTT 服务器。请参阅 [What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html) 和 [MQTT - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/mqtt.html)。

- **D. 将元数据写入 Amazon DocumentDB（兼容 MongoDB）** — 正确。现有的元数据存储是 MongoDB。Amazon DocumentDB 是一项**完全托管**的兼容 MongoDB 的数据库服务；AWS 表示，它可以轻松设置、操作和扩展兼容 MongoDB 的数据库，并允许应用程序使用相同的 MongoDB 驱动程序和工具。与在 EC2 上运行 MongoDB 相比，这可以最大限度地减少运维开销。请参阅 [Amazon DocumentDB welcome documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html)。

- **E. 使用带有 AWS Lambda 任务的 AWS Step Functions 状态机来准备报表并将报表写入 Amazon S3。使用以 S3 为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 来提供报表** — 正确。周期性作业运行 **120–600 秒**，符合 AWS 记录的 Lambda 最大超时时间 **900 秒 / 15 分钟**。Step Functions 可以编排 Lambda 任务；Step Functions 文档展示了调用 Lambda 函数的 `Task` 状态。可以使用 EventBridge Scheduler 处理周期性执行，它可以按重复 rate 或 cron 计划启动 Step Functions 执行。将生成的报表写入 S3 并通过 CloudFront 提供服务，可以消除对始终运行的 Web 服务器的需求。CloudFront 支持 Amazon S3 存储桶源站以及用于保护 S3 源站的源访问控制。请参阅 [Lambda timeout configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)、[Invoke Lambda with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)、[Using EventBridge Scheduler to start a Step Functions state machine execution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html) 和 [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用 AWS Lambda 函数连接到 IoT 设备** — 不正确。Lambda 不是托管的 MQTT broker，也不是持久 IoT 设备连接层。AWS IoT Core 是专为设备发布 MQTT 消息而构建的托管服务。使用 Lambda 直接连接到设备会增加自定义连接管理逻辑和运维复杂性。

- **C. 将元数据写入 Amazon EC2 实例上的自托管 MongoDB 数据库** — 不正确。这会保留数据库管理职责，例如修补、扩展、备份、高可用性设计和监控。Amazon DocumentDB 是运维开销更低的兼容 MongoDB 的托管选项。

- **F. 使用包含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon EKS 集群来准备报表。使用 EKS 集群中的 ingress controller 来提供报表** — 不正确。EC2 上的 EKS 会引入集群、节点、容器、ingress、扩展和修补运维。对于可在 Lambda 15 分钟最大时限内完成的周期性作业以及静态报表服务，Step Functions + Lambda + S3 + CloudFront 明显更加无服务器，且开销更低。

en.question: A global manufacturing company plans to migrate the majority of its applications to AWS. However, the company is concerned about applications that need to remain within a specific country or in the company's central on-premises data center because of data regulatory requirements or requirements for latency of single-digit milliseconds. The company also is concerned about the applications that it hosts in some of its factory sites, where limited network infrastructure exists. The company wants a consistent developer experience so that its developers can build applications once and deploy on premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid architecture. The developers must be able to use the same tools, APIs, and services that are familiar to them. Which solution will provide a consistent hybrid experience to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate all applications to the closest AWS Region that is compliant. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the central on-premises data center and AWS. Deploy a Direct Connect gateway.
options.B: Use AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices for the applications that have data regulatory requirements or requirements for latency of single-digit milliseconds. Retain the devices on premises. Deploy AWS Wavelength to host the workloads in the factory sites.
options.C: Install AWS Outposts for the applications that have data regulatory requirements or requirements for latency of single-digit milliseconds. Use AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized devices to host the workloads in the factory sites.
options.D: Migrate the applications that have data regulatory requirements or requirements for latency of single-digit milliseconds to an AWS Local Zone. Deploy AWS Wavelength to host the workloads in the factory sites.

en.explanation:
The company needs a **consistent hybrid AWS experience** for workloads that must remain in-country or in the central on-premises data center, and also needs a way to run workloads at factory sites that have limited network infrastructure. The key requirements are local/on-premises deployment, low latency, data-residency support, and use of familiar AWS tools, APIs, and services.

**Correct answer: C. Install AWS Outposts for the applications that have data regulatory requirements or requirements for latency of single-digit milliseconds. Use AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized devices to host the workloads in the factory sites.**

AWS Outposts is designed for exactly this kind of central data center or regulated on-premises use case. The AWS documentation states that Outposts is a fully managed service that **extends AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and tools to customer premises**, allowing customers to build and run applications on premises using the same programming interfaces as in AWS Regions, while using local compute and storage for lower latency and local data processing needs ([AWS Outposts documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)). This satisfies the requirement for a consistent developer experience and for workloads that must remain in a specific location.

For the factory sites with limited network infrastructure, Snowball Edge Compute Optimized devices are appropriate because Snowball Edge provides onboard storage and compute, can process data locally, run edge-computing workloads, and transfer data to or from AWS ([Snowball Edge documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). The documentation also states that Snowball Edge devices support EC2-compatible instance types, and Compute Optimized devices use the `sbe-c` instance type for running compute instances locally ([EC2-compatible compute on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/using-ec2.html)). This fits sites where network connectivity is constrained and local edge compute is needed.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect.** Migrating all applications to the closest compliant AWS Region with Direct Connect does not keep applications in the company’s on-premises data center, and it does not guarantee single-digit millisecond latency to local systems. It also does not address the factory sites with limited network infrastructure.

* **B is incorrect.** Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices are mainly positioned for high-capacity storage and data movement, not the best fit for compute-heavy application hosting compared with Compute Optimized devices. Also, AWS Wavelength is for applications that need low latency to mobile devices and end users by placing AWS compute and storage at the edge of communications service provider networks ([AWS Wavelength documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wavelength/latest/developerguide/what-is-wavelength.html)). That does not match the factory-site requirement with limited network infrastructure.

* **D is incorrect.** AWS Local Zones can help with low-latency access from specific geographic locations, but they are still AWS-operated infrastructure in selected metro areas, not infrastructure installed in the company’s own central data center. This option also uses AWS Wavelength for factory sites, which is aimed at carrier/mobile edge use cases rather than disconnected or limited-connectivity industrial sites.

Therefore, **Outposts for the central regulated/low-latency on-premises workloads plus Snowball Edge Compute Optimized for factory edge sites** provides the most consistent hybrid AWS experience.

zh.question: 一家全球制造公司计划将其大部分应用程序迁移到 AWS。但是，该公司担心有些应用程序由于数据监管要求，或对个位数毫秒级延迟的要求，需要保留在特定国家/地区或公司的中央本地数据中心内。该公司还担心其托管在部分工厂站点中的应用程序，这些站点的网络基础设施有限。该公司希望获得一致的开发人员体验，使开发人员能够一次构建应用程序，并在本地、云中或混合架构中部署。开发人员必须能够使用他们熟悉的相同工具、API 和服务。哪种解决方案将提供一致的混合体验以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有应用程序迁移到最近的合规 AWS Region。在中央本地数据中心和 AWS 之间设置 AWS Direct Connect 连接。部署 Direct Connect gateway。
options.B: 对具有数据监管要求或个位数毫秒级延迟要求的应用程序使用 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将这些设备保留在本地。部署 AWS Wavelength 以在工厂站点托管工作负载。
options.C: 为具有数据监管要求或个位数毫秒级延迟要求的应用程序安装 AWS Outposts。使用 AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 设备在工厂站点托管工作负载。
options.D: 将具有数据监管要求或个位数毫秒级延迟要求的应用程序迁移到 AWS Local Zone。部署 AWS Wavelength 以在工厂站点托管工作负载。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要为必须保留在所在国家/地区或中央本地数据中心内的工作负载提供**一致的混合 AWS 体验**，并且还需要一种方式在网络基础设施有限的工厂站点运行工作负载。关键要求是本地/本地部署、低延迟、数据驻留支持，以及使用熟悉的 AWS 工具、API 和服务。

**正确答案：C. 为具有数据监管要求或个位数毫秒级延迟要求的应用程序安装 AWS Outposts。使用 AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 设备在工厂站点托管工作负载。**

AWS Outposts 正是为这种中央数据中心或受监管的本地使用场景而设计的。AWS 文档指出，Outposts 是一项完全托管的服务，可**将 AWS 基础设施、服务、API 和工具扩展到客户场所**，允许客户使用与 AWS Regions 中相同的编程接口在本地构建和运行应用程序，同时使用本地计算和存储来满足更低延迟和本地数据处理需求（[AWS Outposts documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)）。这满足了一致开发人员体验的要求，也满足了必须保留在特定位置的工作负载要求。

对于网络基础设施有限的工厂站点，Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 设备是合适的，因为 Snowball Edge 提供板载存储和计算，可以在本地处理数据、运行边缘计算工作负载，并将数据传输到 AWS 或从 AWS 传输数据（[Snowball Edge documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。文档还指出，Snowball Edge 设备支持与 EC2 兼容的实例类型，并且 Compute Optimized 设备使用 `sbe-c` 实例类型在本地运行计算实例（[EC2-compatible compute on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/using-ec2.html)）。这适合网络连接受限且需要本地边缘计算的站点。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A 不正确。** 使用 Direct Connect 将所有应用程序迁移到最近的合规 AWS Region，并不能将应用程序保留在公司的本地数据中心内，也不能保证到本地系统的个位数毫秒级延迟。它也没有解决网络基础设施有限的工厂站点问题。

* **B 不正确。** Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备主要定位于高容量存储和数据移动，与 Compute Optimized 设备相比，并不是托管计算密集型应用程序的最佳选择。此外，AWS Wavelength 适用于需要通过将 AWS 计算和存储放置在通信服务提供商网络边缘，来为移动设备和最终用户提供低延迟的应用程序（[AWS Wavelength documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wavelength/latest/developerguide/what-is-wavelength.html)）。这与网络基础设施有限的工厂站点要求不匹配。

* **D 不正确。** AWS Local Zones 可以帮助从特定地理位置实现低延迟访问，但它们仍然是 AWS 在选定都市区域运营的基础设施，而不是安装在公司自有中央数据中心内的基础设施。此选项还将 AWS Wavelength 用于工厂站点，而 Wavelength 面向的是运营商/移动边缘使用场景，而不是断开连接或连接受限的工业站点。

因此，**将 Outposts 用于中央受监管/低延迟本地工作负载，并将 Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 用于工厂边缘站点**，能够提供最一致的混合 AWS 体验。

en.question: A company is updating an application that customers use to make online orders. The number of attacks on the application by bad actors has increased recently. The company will host the updated application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The company will use Amazon DynamoDB to store application data. A public Application Load Balancer (ALB) will provide end users with access to the application. The company must prevent attacks and ensure business continuity with minimal service interruptions during an ongoing attack. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. Add a custom header and random value on the CloudFront domain. Configure the ALB to conditionally forward traffic if the header and value match.
options.B: Deploy the application in two AWS Regions. Configure Amazon Route 53 to route to both Regions with equal weight.
options.C: Configure auto scaling for Amazon ECS tasks Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
options.D: Configure Amazon ElastiCache to reduce overhead on DynamoDB.
options.E: Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL that includes an appropriate rule group. Associate the web ACL with the Amazon CloudFront distribution.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application will run on ECS behind a public ALB and is seeing an increase in attacks. The requirement is not merely regional high availability; it is to **prevent attacks** and maintain service continuity with minimal interruption during an active attack, in the most cost-effective way.

The best pattern is to put **CloudFront + AWS WAF** in front of the ALB and prevent clients from bypassing CloudFront to reach the ALB directly.

## Correct answers: A and E

### A. Create a CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin, add a custom header, and configure the ALB to forward only matching requests

This is correct. AWS documents this exact pattern for restricting access to an Application Load Balancer through CloudFront. CloudFront can add a custom HTTP header to origin requests, and AWS specifically recommends using randomly generated header names and values in production and treating them as secure credentials. Then the ALB listener can be configured to forward only requests containing that header and return a fixed `403` response for all other requests. AWS states that after this configuration, requests through CloudFront reach the application, while requests sent directly to the ALB return `403` Access denied ([Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)).

This prevents attackers from bypassing CloudFront and AWS WAF by sending traffic directly to the public ALB DNS name. That is important because option E associates WAF with CloudFront, so direct ALB access would otherwise avoid the WAF inspection path.

### E. Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL with an appropriate rule group and associate it with the CloudFront distribution

This is correct. AWS WAF can protect CloudFront distributions and origin servers by blocking requests before they reach the servers. The CloudFront documentation says one-click AWS WAF protection can create a web ACL, configure rules for common web threats, and attach the web ACL to the CloudFront distribution. It also notes that these protections can block threat IPs, protect against common OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and defend against malicious actors discovering application vulnerabilities ([Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html)).

AWS WAF documentation also confirms that a web ACL can be associated with CloudFront distributions and that AWS WAF inspects web requests based on the rules in the web ACL ([Using AWS WAF with Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html)). AWS Managed Rules such as the Core Rule Set provide protection against a broad range of common web application vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and XSS patterns, while Known Bad Inputs blocks request patterns associated with exploitation and vulnerability discovery ([AWS Managed Rules baseline rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/aws-managed-rule-groups-baseline.html)).

Together, A and E are cost-effective because they use managed edge protection and request filtering before malicious requests reach the ECS service, rather than scaling or duplicating the application stack to absorb attack traffic.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Deploy the application in two Regions and configure Route 53 equal-weight routing

This improves multi-Region availability, but it does not directly prevent web attacks. Equal-weight routing sends traffic to both Regions, so malicious requests could simply be distributed across both deployments. It is also significantly more expensive and operationally complex than using CloudFront and AWS WAF in front of the existing ALB. For this question's emphasis on preventing attacks and cost-effectiveness, multi-Region active-active deployment is not the best answer.

### C. Configure ECS task auto scaling and create a DAX cluster

ECS auto scaling can help with legitimate increases in compute demand, and DAX can reduce DynamoDB read latency for suitable workloads. However, neither is a primary attack-prevention control. Scaling the ECS tasks may actually increase cost during an attack without blocking malicious traffic. DAX is also not justified unless the workload has a DynamoDB read-heavy access pattern that benefits from caching.

### D. Configure ElastiCache to reduce overhead on DynamoDB

ElastiCache can be useful for application-level caching, but it is not a direct mitigation for application-layer attacks against the public endpoint. The application already stores data in DynamoDB; adding ElastiCache does not block malicious HTTP requests, prevent ALB bypass, or provide WAF-style protection.

## Conclusion

The most cost-effective combination is:

- **A**: Use CloudFront with a secret custom origin header and configure the ALB to accept only CloudFront-originated requests.
- **E**: Attach AWS WAF protections to the CloudFront distribution to block malicious web requests at the edge before they reach the application.

zh.question: 一家公司正在更新一个供客户在线下单的应用程序。最近，恶意行为者对该应用程序的攻击次数有所增加。公司将在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群上托管更新后的应用程序。公司将使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储应用程序数据。一个面向公众的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 将为最终用户提供对应用程序的访问。公司必须阻止攻击，并在攻击持续进行期间以最少的服务中断确保业务连续性。哪一组步骤组合能够以最低成本满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个以 ALB 作为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。在 CloudFront 域上添加自定义标头和随机值。配置 ALB 在标头和值匹配时有条件地转发流量。
options.B: 在两个 AWS 区域中部署应用程序。配置 Amazon Route 53 以相等权重路由到两个区域。
options.C: 为 Amazon ECS 任务配置自动扩缩。创建一个 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。
options.D: 配置 Amazon ElastiCache 以减少 DynamoDB 的开销。
options.E: 部署一个包含适当规则组的 AWS WAF web ACL。将该 web ACL 与 Amazon CloudFront 分配关联。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序将在公共 ALB 后面的 ECS 上运行，并且遭遇的攻击正在增加。要求不仅仅是区域级高可用性；而是要以最具成本效益的方式**阻止攻击**，并在主动攻击期间以最少中断维持服务连续性。

最佳模式是在 ALB 前面放置 **CloudFront + AWS WAF**，并防止客户端绕过 CloudFront 直接访问 ALB。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. 创建以 ALB 作为源站的 CloudFront 分配，添加自定义标头，并配置 ALB 仅转发匹配的请求

这是正确的。AWS 文档记录了这种通过 CloudFront 限制访问 Application Load Balancer 的确切模式。CloudFront 可以向源站请求添加自定义 HTTP 标头，AWS 特别建议在生产环境中使用随机生成的标头名称和值，并将其视为安全凭证。然后可以配置 ALB 侦听器仅转发包含该标头的请求，并对所有其他请求返回固定的 `403` 响应。AWS 表示，完成此配置后，通过 CloudFront 的请求会到达应用程序，而直接发送到 ALB 的请求会返回 `403` Access denied（[Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)）。

这可以防止攻击者通过直接向公共 ALB DNS 名称发送流量来绕过 CloudFront 和 AWS WAF。这一点很重要，因为选项 E 将 WAF 与 CloudFront 关联，因此直接访问 ALB 否则会避开 WAF 检查路径。

### E. 部署具有适当规则组的 AWS WAF web ACL，并将其与 CloudFront 分配关联

这是正确的。AWS WAF 可以通过在请求到达服务器之前阻止请求来保护 CloudFront 分配和源站服务器。CloudFront 文档说明，一键式 AWS WAF 保护可以创建 web ACL，配置针对常见 Web 威胁的规则，并将 web ACL 附加到 CloudFront 分配。文档还指出，这些保护可以阻止威胁 IP，防护常见的 OWASP Top 10 漏洞，并防御恶意行为者发现应用程序漏洞（[Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html)）。

AWS WAF 文档还确认，web ACL 可以与 CloudFront 分配关联，并且 AWS WAF 会根据 web ACL 中的规则检查 Web 请求（[Using AWS WAF with Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html)）。AWS Managed Rules（例如 Core Rule Set）可针对广泛的常见 Web 应用程序漏洞提供保护，包括 OWASP Top 10 风险和 XSS 模式，而 Known Bad Inputs 会阻止与利用和漏洞发现相关的请求模式（[AWS Managed Rules baseline rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/aws-managed-rule-groups-baseline.html)）。

A 和 E 结合起来具有成本效益，因为它们使用托管的边缘防护和请求过滤，在恶意请求到达 ECS 服务之前进行拦截，而不是通过扩缩或复制应用程序栈来吸收攻击流量。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 在两个区域中部署应用程序，并配置 Route 53 相等权重路由

这提高了多区域可用性，但并不能直接阻止 Web 攻击。相等权重路由会将流量发送到两个区域，因此恶意请求可能只是被分发到两个部署中。与在现有 ALB 前使用 CloudFront 和 AWS WAF 相比，它也显著更昂贵且运维复杂度更高。针对本题强调的阻止攻击和成本效益，多区域主动-主动部署不是最佳答案。

### C. 配置 ECS 任务自动扩缩并创建 DAX 集群

ECS 自动扩缩可以帮助应对合法的计算需求增长，DAX 可以降低适合工作负载的 DynamoDB 读取延迟。但是，两者都不是主要的攻击预防控制措施。在攻击期间扩展 ECS 任务可能实际上会在不阻止恶意流量的情况下增加成本。除非工作负载具有能从缓存获益的 DynamoDB 读密集访问模式，否则 DAX 也没有正当理由。

### D. 配置 ElastiCache 以减少 DynamoDB 的开销

ElastiCache 对应用程序级缓存可能有用，但它并不是针对公共端点的应用层攻击的直接缓解措施。该应用程序已经将数据存储在 DynamoDB 中；添加 ElastiCache 不会阻止恶意 HTTP 请求、防止 ALB 绕过，也不会提供 WAF 式保护。

## 结论

最具成本效益的组合是：

- **A**：使用带有秘密自定义源站标头的 CloudFront，并配置 ALB 仅接受来自 CloudFront 的请求。
- **E**：将 AWS WAF 保护附加到 CloudFront 分配，以便在恶意 Web 请求到达应用程序之前，在边缘阻止这些请求。

en.question: A company runs a web application on AWS. The web application delivers static content from an Amazon S3 bucket that is behind an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The application serves dynamic content by using an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that distributes requests to a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. The application uses a domain name setup in Amazon Route 53. Some users reported occasional issues when the users attempted to access the website during peak hours. An operations team found that the ALB sometimes returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors. The company wants to display a custom error message page when these errors occur. The page should be displayed immediately for this error code. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Set up a Route 53 failover routing policy. Configure a health check to determine the status of the ALB endpoint and to fail over to the failover S3 bucket endpoint.
options.B: Create a second CloudFront distribution and an S3 static website to host the custom error page. Set up a Route 53 failover routing policy. Use an active-passive configuration between the two distributions.
options.C: Create a CloudFront origin group that has two origins. Set the ALB endpoint as the primary origin. For the secondary origin, set an S3 bucket that is configured to host a static website Set up origin failover for the CloudFront distribution. Update the S3 static website to incorporate the custom error page.
options.D: Create a CloudFront function that validates each HTTP response code that the ALB returns. Create an S3 static website in an S3 bucket. Upload the custom error page to the S3 bucket as a failover. Update the function to read the S3 bucket and to serve the error page to the end users.

en.explanation:
The application already uses CloudFront in front of the site. The issue is intermittent HTTP **503 Service Unavailable** responses from the ALB during peak hours, and the requirement is to show a custom page immediately when that error occurs with the least operational overhead.

**Correct answer: C**

CloudFront origin failover is designed for this. AWS documentation says that an origin group has a primary and secondary origin, and you can choose failover HTTP status codes including **503**; when CloudFront receives one of those codes, it fails over to the secondary origin ([CloudFront origin failover: Create an origin group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)). AWS also describes the behavior: when the primary origin returns a configured 4xx or 5xx status code, CloudFront sends the same request to the secondary origin in the origin group ([Request and response behavior for origin groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorOriginGroups.html)).

Therefore, configure the ALB as the **primary origin** and an S3 static website origin as the **secondary origin**, and configure **503** as an origin failover criterion. Hosting the custom error page in S3 is also operationally simple; S3 static website hosting supports configuring an error document ([S3 static website setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)). This solution uses built-in CloudFront and S3 capabilities and responds on the failed request rather than waiting for DNS health-check state changes.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Route 53 failover to an S3 bucket endpoint** — Route 53 DNS failover routes DNS queries based on resource health checks; AWS describes it as checking resource health and responding to DNS queries using only healthy resources ([Route 53 DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)). This is not ideal for occasional per-request 503 responses because DNS failover is not a per-request HTTP response handling mechanism and may not trigger immediately for intermittent ALB errors. It also would fail over the whole domain rather than returning a custom error response for a specific status code.

- **B. Second CloudFront distribution with Route 53 active-passive failover** — This has the same DNS failover limitation as option A and adds unnecessary operational overhead by creating and managing a second distribution and active-passive DNS configuration. The requirement is best met inside the existing CloudFront distribution by using origin groups.

- **D. CloudFront Function that validates ALB response codes and reads S3** — CloudFront Functions are invoked only on viewer request, viewer response, and connection request events, not origin-response events where the ALB's 503 could be handled before viewer delivery ([CloudFront Functions overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cloudfront-functions.html)). In addition, AWS states that CloudFront does not invoke edge functions for viewer response events when the origin returns HTTP status code 400 or higher ([edge function HTTP status code restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-function-restrictions-all.html)). So a CloudFront Function cannot reliably inspect and replace an ALB-origin 503 in the way described. The option also implies reading from S3 in the function, which would be more operationally complex than built-in origin failover.

The vote distribution is strongly in favor of C, and the highly voted comments align with the documented CloudFront origin group behavior.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序通过 Amazon CloudFront 分配后面的 Amazon S3 存储桶交付静态内容。该应用程序使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 提供动态内容，ALB 将请求分发到 Auto Scaling 组中的一组 Amazon EC2 实例。该应用程序使用在 Amazon Route 53 中设置的域名。一些用户报告说，在高峰时段尝试访问网站时偶尔会遇到问题。运维团队发现 ALB 有时会返回 HTTP 503 Service Unavailable 错误。公司希望在这些错误发生时显示自定义错误消息页面。对于此错误代码，应立即显示该页面。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 Route 53 故障转移路由策略。配置运行状况检查以确定 ALB 端点的状态，并故障转移到故障转移 S3 存储桶端点。
options.B: 创建第二个 CloudFront 分配和一个 S3 静态网站来托管自定义错误页面。设置 Route 53 故障转移路由策略。在两个分配之间使用主动-被动配置。
options.C: 创建一个具有两个源站的 CloudFront 源站组。将 ALB 端点设置为主源站。对于辅助源站，设置一个配置为托管静态网站的 S3 存储桶。为 CloudFront 分配设置源站故障转移。更新 S3 静态网站以包含自定义错误页面。
options.D: 创建一个 CloudFront 函数，用于验证 ALB 返回的每个 HTTP 响应代码。在 S3 存储桶中创建一个 S3 静态网站。将自定义错误页面上传到 S3 存储桶作为故障转移。更新该函数以读取 S3 存储桶并向最终用户提供错误页面。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序已经在站点前使用 CloudFront。问题是在高峰时段 ALB 间歇性返回 HTTP **503 Service Unavailable** 响应，要求是在发生该错误时以最少的运营开销立即显示自定义页面。

**正确答案：C**

CloudFront 源站故障转移就是为此而设计的。AWS 文档说明，源站组包含一个主源站和一个辅助源站，并且可以选择包括 **503** 在内的故障转移 HTTP 状态码；当 CloudFront 收到其中一个状态码时，它会故障转移到辅助源站（[CloudFront origin failover: Create an origin group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)）。AWS 还描述了其行为：当主源站返回已配置的 4xx 或 5xx 状态码时，CloudFront 会将同一请求发送到源站组中的辅助源站（[Request and response behavior for origin groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorOriginGroups.html)）。

因此，将 ALB 配置为**主源站**，将 S3 静态网站源站配置为**辅助源站**，并将 **503** 配置为源站故障转移条件。在 S3 中托管自定义错误页面在运营上也很简单；S3 静态网站托管支持配置错误文档（[S3 static website setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)）。该解决方案使用内置的 CloudFront 和 S3 功能，并在失败请求上响应，而不是等待 DNS 运行状况检查状态变化。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Route 53 故障转移到 S3 存储桶端点** — Route 53 DNS 故障转移根据资源运行状况检查来路由 DNS 查询；AWS 将其描述为检查资源运行状况，并仅使用健康资源响应 DNS 查询（[Route 53 DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)）。这并不适合偶发的逐请求 503 响应，因为 DNS 故障转移不是逐请求 HTTP 响应处理机制，并且对于间歇性 ALB 错误可能不会立即触发。它还会故障转移整个域，而不是针对特定状态码返回自定义错误响应。

- **B. 使用 Route 53 主动-被动故障转移的第二个 CloudFront 分配** — 这与选项 A 具有相同的 DNS 故障转移限制，并且通过创建和管理第二个分配以及主动-被动 DNS 配置增加了不必要的运营开销。最佳做法是在现有 CloudFront 分配内使用源站组来满足该要求。

- **D. 验证 ALB 响应代码并读取 S3 的 CloudFront Function** — CloudFront Functions 仅在 viewer request、viewer response 和 connection request 事件上调用，而不会在 origin-response 事件上调用；而在 origin-response 事件中，才可以在交付给查看器之前处理 ALB 的 503（[CloudFront Functions overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cloudfront-functions.html)）。此外，AWS 声明，当源站返回 HTTP 状态码 400 或更高时，CloudFront 不会为 viewer response 事件调用边缘函数（[edge function HTTP status code restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-function-restrictions-all.html)）。因此，CloudFront Function 无法以题目描述的方式可靠地检查并替换 ALB 源站的 503。该选项还暗示在函数中从 S3 读取，这会比内置源站故障转移更复杂。

投票分布强烈支持 C，高赞评论也与文档记录的 CloudFront 源站组行为一致。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate an application to AWS. The application runs as a Docker container and uses an NFS version 4 file share. A solutions architect must design a secure and scalable containerized solution that does not require provisioning or management of the underlying infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application containers by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with the Fargate launch type. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for shared storage. Reference the EFS file system ID, container mount point, and EFS authorization IAM role in the ECS task definition.
options.B: Deploy the application containers by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with the Fargate launch type. Use Amazon FSx for Lustre for shared storage. Reference the FSx for Lustre file system ID, container mount point, and FSx for Lustre authorization IAM role in the ECS task definition.
options.C: Deploy the application containers by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with the Amazon EC2 launch type and auto scaling turned on. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for shared storage. Mount the EFS file system on the ECS container instances. Add the EFS authorization IAM role to the EC2 instance profile.
options.D: Deploy the application containers by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with the Amazon EC2 launch type and auto scaling turned on. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes with Multi-Attach enabled for shared storage. Attach the EBS volumes to ECS container instances. Add the EBS authorization IAM role to an EC2 instance profile.

en.explanation:
The application is already containerized and currently depends on an NFSv4 file share. The design must therefore provide (1) container orchestration, (2) no provisioning or management of the underlying compute infrastructure, and (3) shared NFS-compatible file storage.

**Correct answer: A.**

- **Amazon ECS with the Fargate launch type** satisfies the requirement to run containers without managing the underlying infrastructure. AWS documentation states that Fargate lets you run containers with Amazon ECS without managing servers or EC2 clusters, and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).
- **Amazon EFS** is the correct shared file storage service for an NFSv4 workload. Amazon EFS can be mounted through Network File System versions 4.0 and 4.1, and it supports concurrent access from multiple NFS clients ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)).
- ECS task definitions support mounting EFS volumes by specifying the EFS file system ID, volume configuration, and container mount point. The ECS documentation also shows `authorizationConfig` with IAM authorization for EFS and explains that the ECS task IAM role can be used when mounting the EFS file system ([Specify an Amazon EFS file system in an Amazon ECS task definition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specify-efs-config.html)).

Therefore, ECS on Fargate plus EFS is the secure, scalable, managed container solution that preserves the NFSv4 shared storage requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. ECS Fargate with FSx for Lustre** is incorrect. The application requires an NFSv4 file share. Amazon EFS is the AWS service that directly provides NFSv4-compatible shared file storage for this use case. The ECS documentation for task definition storage integration specifically describes EFS volume configuration, file system ID, mount points, and EFS IAM authorization, not an FSx for Lustre authorization role in the ECS task definition.
- **C. ECS with the EC2 launch type and EFS** is incorrect because it uses EC2 container instances. Although EFS is the right storage service, the EC2 launch type requires provisioning, operating, patching, and scaling EC2 instances, which violates the requirement that the solution not require management of the underlying infrastructure. Fargate is the appropriate serverless compute option for ECS.
- **D. ECS with the EC2 launch type and EBS Multi-Attach** is incorrect for two reasons. First, it requires managing EC2 container instances, which violates the infrastructure-management requirement. Second, EBS is block storage, not an NFSv4 shared file system. EBS Multi-Attach does not provide the same managed NFS file share semantics as Amazon EFS.

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序以 Docker 容器形式运行，并使用 NFS 版本 4 文件共享。解决方案架构师必须设计一个安全且可扩展的容器化解决方案，并且不需要预置或管理底层基础设施。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用采用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 部署应用程序容器。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作为共享存储。在 ECS 任务定义中引用 EFS 文件系统 ID、容器挂载点和 EFS 授权 IAM 角色。
options.B: 使用采用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 部署应用程序容器。使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 作为共享存储。在 ECS 任务定义中引用 FSx for Lustre 文件系统 ID、容器挂载点和 FSx for Lustre 授权 IAM 角色。
options.C: 使用采用 Amazon EC2 启动类型并启用自动扩缩的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 部署应用程序容器。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作为共享存储。在 ECS 容器实例上挂载 EFS 文件系统。将 EFS 授权 IAM 角色添加到 EC2 实例配置文件。
options.D: 使用采用 Amazon EC2 启动类型并启用自动扩缩的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 部署应用程序容器。使用启用了 Multi-Attach 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷作为共享存储。将 EBS 卷附加到 ECS 容器实例。将 EBS 授权 IAM 角色添加到 EC2 实例配置文件。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序已经容器化，并且当前依赖 NFSv4 文件共享。因此，该设计必须提供：(1) 容器编排，(2) 无需预置或管理底层计算基础设施，以及 (3) 兼容 NFS 的共享文件存储。

**正确答案：A。**

- **采用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon ECS** 满足无需管理底层基础设施即可运行容器的要求。AWS 文档指出，Fargate 允许您使用 Amazon ECS 运行容器，而无需管理服务器或 EC2 集群，并且无需预置、配置或扩展虚拟机集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。
- **Amazon EFS** 是适用于 NFSv4 工作负载的正确共享文件存储服务。Amazon EFS 可以通过 Network File System 版本 4.0 和 4.1 挂载，并支持来自多个 NFS 客户端的并发访问（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。
- ECS 任务定义支持通过指定 EFS 文件系统 ID、卷配置和容器挂载点来挂载 EFS 卷。ECS 文档还展示了带有 EFS IAM 授权的 `authorizationConfig`，并说明在挂载 EFS 文件系统时可以使用 ECS 任务 IAM 角色（[Specify an Amazon EFS file system in an Amazon ECS task definition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specify-efs-config.html)）。

因此，Fargate 上的 ECS 加 EFS 是一种安全、可扩展的托管容器解决方案，并且保留了 NFSv4 共享存储要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 使用 FSx for Lustre 的 ECS Fargate** 不正确。该应用程序需要 NFSv4 文件共享。Amazon EFS 是 AWS 中直接为此用例提供兼容 NFSv4 的共享文件存储的服务。ECS 任务定义存储集成文档专门描述的是 EFS 卷配置、文件系统 ID、挂载点和 EFS IAM 授权，而不是 ECS 任务定义中的 FSx for Lustre 授权角色。
- **C. 使用 EC2 启动类型和 EFS 的 ECS** 不正确，因为它使用 EC2 容器实例。虽然 EFS 是正确的存储服务，但 EC2 启动类型需要预置、运行、修补和扩展 EC2 实例，这违反了该解决方案不需要管理底层基础设施的要求。Fargate 是适用于 ECS 的无服务器计算选项。
- **D. 使用 EC2 启动类型和 EBS Multi-Attach 的 ECS** 不正确，原因有两个。首先，它需要管理 EC2 容器实例，这违反了基础设施管理要求。其次，EBS 是块存储，而不是 NFSv4 共享文件系统。EBS Multi-Attach 不提供与 Amazon EFS 相同的托管 NFS 文件共享语义。

en.question: A company is running an application in the AWS Cloud. The core business logic is running on a set of Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) distributes traffic to the EC2 instances. Amazon Route 53 record api.example.com is pointing to the ALB. The company's development team makes major updates to the business logic. The company has a rule that when changes are deployed, only 10% of customers can receive the new logic during a testing window. A customer must use the same version of the business logic during the testing window. How should the company deploy the updates to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a second ALB, and deploy the new logic to a set of EC2 instances in a new Auto Scaling group. Configure the ALB to distribute traffic to the EC2 instances. Update the Route 53 record to use weighted routing, and point the record to both of the ALBs.
options.B: Create a second target group that is referenced by the ALDeploy the new logic to EC2 instances in this new target group. Update the ALB listener rule to use weighted target groups. Configure ALB target group stickiness.
options.C: Create a new launch configuration for the Auto Scaling group. Specify the launch configuration to use the AutoScalingRollingUpdate policy, and set the MaxBatchSize option to 10. Replace the launch configuration on the Auto Scaling group. Deploy the changes.
options.D: Create a second Auto Scaling group that is referenced by the ALB. Deploy the new logic on a set of EC2 instances in this new Auto Scaling group. Change the ALB routing algorithm to least outstanding requests (LOR). Configure ALB session stickiness.

en.explanation:
The requirement is a canary-style deployment: during a testing window, only about 10% of customers should receive the new business logic, and once a customer is assigned to old or new logic, that customer must continue using the same version during the window.

**Correct answer: B.**

Create a second target group behind the existing ALB, place the EC2 instances running the new logic in that target group, and configure the ALB listener forward action with **weighted target groups** such as 90/10. AWS documentation for ALB listener rule forward actions states that when multiple target groups are specified, each target group has a weight and requests are distributed based on those weights. The same documentation specifically addresses this scenario: when using weighted target groups, stickiness is not guaranteed by default, so you must enable **target group stickiness** for the rule; with target group stickiness, the ALB sets an `AWSALBTG` cookie and subsequent requests are routed to the target group encoded in that cookie ([ALB listener rule action types: weighted target groups and target group stickiness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)). This satisfies both requirements: 10% traffic to the new version and customer consistency during the test.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Second ALB with Route 53 weighted routing** — Route 53 weighted routing can split DNS responses between resources and is useful for testing new software versions; Route 53 routes based on each record's relative weight ([Route 53 weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)). However, this is DNS-level weighting and does not provide the required per-customer version stickiness for the whole testing window. DNS caching, resolver behavior, and TTLs mean the company cannot reliably ensure each customer continues to use the same business logic version.
* **C. Auto Scaling rolling update with `MaxBatchSize` 10** — This controls how instances are replaced or updated in batches, not how customer traffic is split. It also does not ensure that exactly 10% of customers receive the new logic or that a customer remains pinned to one version during the testing window.
* **D. Second Auto Scaling group, least outstanding requests, and ALB session stickiness** — Least outstanding requests is a target group routing algorithm that sends traffic to targets with the fewest in-progress requests ([ALB target group routing algorithms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)). It is not a canary traffic-splitting mechanism and cannot enforce a 90/10 distribution between old and new business logic. Session stickiness to a target is not the same as weighted target group stickiness between old and new versions.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer because ALB weighted target groups provide the desired traffic percentage, and ALB target group stickiness preserves the customer's assigned version during the testing window.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个应用程序。核心业务逻辑运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的一组 Amazon EC2 实例上。Application Load Balancer (ALB) 将流量分发到这些 EC2 实例。Amazon Route 53 记录 api.example.com 指向该 ALB。公司的开发团队对业务逻辑进行了重大更新。公司规定，在部署变更时，在测试窗口期间只能有 10% 的客户接收新的逻辑。客户在测试窗口期间必须使用同一版本的业务逻辑。公司应如何部署这些更新以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建第二个 ALB，并将新逻辑部署到新 Auto Scaling 组中的一组 EC2 实例。配置该 ALB 以将流量分发到这些 EC2 实例。更新 Route 53 记录以使用加权路由，并将该记录指向两个 ALB。
options.B: 创建第二个由 ALB 引用的目标组。将新逻辑部署到此新目标组中的 EC2 实例。更新 ALB 侦听器规则以使用加权目标组。配置 ALB 目标组粘性。
options.C: 为 Auto Scaling 组创建新的启动配置。指定该启动配置使用 AutoScalingRollingUpdate 策略，并将 MaxBatchSize 选项设置为 10。替换 Auto Scaling 组上的启动配置。部署更改。
options.D: 创建第二个由 ALB 引用的 Auto Scaling 组。在此新 Auto Scaling 组中的一组 EC2 实例上部署新逻辑。将 ALB 路由算法更改为 least outstanding requests (LOR)。配置 ALB 会话粘性。

zh.explanation:
要求是金丝雀风格部署：在测试窗口期间，只有约 10% 的客户应接收新的业务逻辑，并且一旦客户被分配到旧逻辑或新逻辑，该客户在该窗口期间必须继续使用同一版本。

**正确答案：B。**

在现有 ALB 后面创建第二个目标组，将运行新逻辑的 EC2 实例放入该目标组，并使用 **加权目标组**（例如 90/10）配置 ALB 侦听器的转发操作。AWS 关于 ALB 侦听器规则转发操作的文档说明，当指定多个目标组时，每个目标组都有一个权重，请求会根据这些权重进行分发。同一文档还专门说明了此场景：使用加权目标组时，默认不保证粘性，因此必须为该规则启用 **目标组粘性**；启用目标组粘性后，ALB 会设置 `AWSALBTG` cookie，后续请求会路由到该 cookie 中编码的目标组（[ALB 侦听器规则操作类型：加权目标组和目标组粘性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)）。这同时满足两个要求：10% 的流量到新版本，以及测试期间客户一致性。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A. 使用 Route 53 加权路由的第二个 ALB** — Route 53 加权路由可以在资源之间拆分 DNS 响应，并且对测试新软件版本很有用；Route 53 会根据每条记录的相对权重进行路由（[Route 53 加权路由](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)）。但是，这是 DNS 级别的加权，无法提供在整个测试窗口期间所需的按客户版本粘性。DNS 缓存、解析器行为和 TTL 意味着公司无法可靠地确保每个客户继续使用同一版本的业务逻辑。
* **C. 使用 `MaxBatchSize` 10 的 Auto Scaling 滚动更新** — 这控制的是实例如何按批次被替换或更新，而不是客户流量如何拆分。它也不能确保正好 10% 的客户接收新逻辑，或确保客户在测试窗口期间保持固定到一个版本。
* **D. 第二个 Auto Scaling 组、least outstanding requests 和 ALB 会话粘性** — least outstanding requests 是一种目标组路由算法，会将流量发送到正在处理的请求数最少的目标（[ALB 目标组路由算法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。它不是金丝雀流量拆分机制，无法强制在旧业务逻辑和新业务逻辑之间实现 90/10 分发。到目标的会话粘性与旧版本和新版本之间的加权目标组粘性不同。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为 ALB 加权目标组提供所需的流量百分比，而 ALB 目标组粘性会在测试窗口期间保留客户被分配到的版本。

en.question: A large education company recently introduced Amazon Workspaces to provide access to internal applications across multiple universities. The company is storing user profiles on an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. The file system is configured with a DNS alias and is connected to a self- managed Active Directory. As more users begin to use the Workspaces, login time increases to unacceptable levels. An investigation reveals a degradation in performance of the file system. The company created the file system on HDD storage with a throughput of 16 MBps. A solutions architect must improve the performance of the file system during a defined maintenance window. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to create a point-in-time backup of the file system. Restore the backup to a new FSx for Windows File Server file system. Select SSD as the storage type. Select 32 MBps as the throughput capacity. When the backup and restore process is completed, adjust the DNS alias accordingly. Delete the original file system.
options.B: Disconnect users from the file system. In the Amazon FSx console, update the throughput capacity to 32 MBps. Update the storage type to SSD. Reconnect users to the file system.
options.C: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent onto a new Amazon EC2 instance. Create a task. Configure the existing file system as the source location. Configure a new FSx for Windows File Server file system with SSD storage and 32 MBps of throughput as the target location. Schedule the task. When the task is completed, adjust the DNS alias accordingly. Delete the original file system.
options.D: Enable shadow copies on the existing file system by using a Windows PowerShell command. Schedule the shadow copy job to create a point-in-time backup of the file system. Choose to restore previous versions. Create a new FSx for Windows File Server file system with SSD storage and 32 MBps of throughput. When the copy job is completed, adjust the DNS alias. Delete the original file system.

en.explanation:
The company is using Amazon WorkSpaces with user profiles stored on an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. The file system was created with HDD storage and only 16 MBps of throughput capacity, and the increased WorkSpaces usage is causing unacceptable login delays. The requirement is to improve file system performance during a maintenance window with the least administrative effort.

**Correct answer: B. Disconnect users from the file system. In the Amazon FSx console, update the throughput capacity to 32 MBps. Update the storage type to SSD. Reconnect users to the file system.**

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server supports both required changes directly on the existing file system. AWS documentation states that you can change a file system that uses HDD storage to use SSD storage, including through the Amazon FSx console by choosing **Update storage type** and selecting **SSD** ([Updating the storage type of a FSx for Windows file system](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/updating-storage-type.html)). AWS also states that you can increase or decrease an FSx for Windows File Server file system's throughput capacity to manage performance at any time ([Managing throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/managing-throughput-capacity.html)).

This makes option B the least-effort solution because it updates the existing file system in place. Disconnecting users and performing the change during the maintenance window is appropriate because throughput scaling can involve file server replacement behind the scenes, and AWS recommends making throughput changes during idle periods or periods of minimal load ([Managing throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/managing-throughput-capacity.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create a backup, restore to a new SSD file system, update the DNS alias, and delete the original file system.** This approach could achieve the desired storage and throughput configuration, but it is not the least administrative effort. It requires backup and restore operations, creation of a new file system, DNS alias changes, validation, and cleanup. Because Amazon FSx supports in-place HDD-to-SSD updates and in-place throughput changes, this migration process is unnecessary.

- **C. Use AWS DataSync to migrate data to a new FSx for Windows File Server file system.** This adds even more operational overhead than required. The company would need to deploy and manage a DataSync agent, configure source and target locations, create and run a migration task, adjust the DNS alias, validate the migration, and delete the original file system. The existing file system can be updated directly, so DataSync is not needed.

- **D. Enable shadow copies and restore previous versions to a new file system.** Shadow copies are used for point-in-time recovery of files and folders, not for changing the storage type or throughput capacity of an FSx for Windows File Server file system. This option does not directly address the performance configuration issue and introduces unnecessary complexity.

Therefore, **option B** is the best answer because it improves performance by increasing throughput capacity and changing HDD storage to SSD on the existing FSx for Windows File Server file system with the least administrative effort.

zh.question: 一家大型教育公司最近引入了 Amazon WorkSpaces，以便在多所大学之间提供对内部应用程序的访问。该公司将用户配置文件存储在一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统上。该文件系统配置了 DNS 别名，并连接到自管理 Active Directory。随着更多用户开始使用 WorkSpaces，登录时间增加到了不可接受的水平。调查显示文件系统性能下降。该公司在 HDD 存储上创建了该文件系统，吞吐量为 16 MBps。解决方案架构师必须在定义好的维护窗口内提高文件系统性能。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Backup 创建该文件系统的时间点备份。将备份还原到新的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。选择 SSD 作为存储类型。选择 32 MBps 作为吞吐能力。备份和还原过程完成后，相应地调整 DNS 别名。删除原始文件系统。
options.B: 断开用户与文件系统的连接。在 Amazon FSx 控制台中，将吞吐能力更新为 32 MBps。将存储类型更新为 SSD。重新连接用户到文件系统。
options.C: 将 AWS DataSync 代理部署到新的 Amazon EC2 实例上。创建一个任务。将现有文件系统配置为源位置。将具有 SSD 存储和 32 MBps 吞吐量的新 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统配置为目标位置。计划该任务。任务完成后，相应地调整 DNS 别名。删除原始文件系统。
options.D: 使用 Windows PowerShell 命令在现有文件系统上启用卷影副本。计划卷影副本作业以创建该文件系统的时间点备份。选择还原以前的版本。创建一个具有 SSD 存储和 32 MBps 吞吐量的新 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。复制作业完成后，调整 DNS 别名。删除原始文件系统。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在使用 Amazon WorkSpaces，并将用户配置文件存储在 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统上。该文件系统是在 HDD 存储上创建的，吞吐能力只有 16 MBps，而 WorkSpaces 使用量增加导致登录延迟达到不可接受的水平。要求是在维护窗口内以最少的管理工作量提高文件系统性能。

**正确答案：B. 断开用户与文件系统的连接。在 Amazon FSx 控制台中，将吞吐能力更新为 32 MBps。将存储类型更新为 SSD。重新连接用户到文件系统。**

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 支持直接在现有文件系统上进行这两项所需更改。AWS 文档说明，你可以将使用 HDD 存储的文件系统更改为使用 SSD 存储，包括通过 Amazon FSx 控制台选择 **Update storage type** 并选择 **SSD**（[更新 FSx for Windows 文件系统的存储类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/updating-storage-type.html)）。AWS 还说明，你可以随时增加或减少 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统的吞吐能力以管理性能（[管理吞吐能力](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/managing-throughput-capacity.html)）。

这使选项 B 成为工作量最少的解决方案，因为它会就地更新现有文件系统。在维护窗口期间断开用户连接并执行更改是合适的，因为吞吐量扩展可能涉及后台替换文件服务器，AWS 建议在空闲时段或负载最低的时段进行吞吐量更改（[管理吞吐能力](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/managing-throughput-capacity.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 创建备份，还原到新的 SSD 文件系统，更新 DNS 别名，并删除原始文件系统。** 这种方法可以实现所需的存储和吞吐量配置，但不是管理工作量最少的方案。它需要备份和还原操作、创建新文件系统、更改 DNS 别名、验证以及清理。由于 Amazon FSx 支持就地 HDD 到 SSD 更新以及就地吞吐量更改，因此此迁移过程是不必要的。

- **C. 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到新的 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。** 这会增加超出所需的更多操作开销。公司需要部署和管理 DataSync 代理、配置源位置和目标位置、创建并运行迁移任务、调整 DNS 别名、验证迁移并删除原始文件系统。现有文件系统可以直接更新，因此不需要 DataSync。

- **D. 启用卷影副本并将以前的版本还原到新的文件系统。** 卷影副本用于文件和文件夹的时间点恢复，而不是用于更改 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统的存储类型或吞吐能力。此选项并不能直接解决性能配置问题，并且会引入不必要的复杂性。

因此，**选项 B** 是最佳答案，因为它通过在现有 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统上提高吞吐能力并将 HDD 存储更改为 SSD，以最少的管理工作量提升性能。

en.question: A company hosts an application on AWS. The application reads and writes objects that are stored in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The company must modify the application to deploy the application in two AWS Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as an origin. Deploy the application to a second Region Modify the application to use the CloudFront distribution. Use AWS Global Accelerator to access the data in the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a new S3 bucket in a second Region. Set up bidirectional S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) between the original S3 bucket and the new S3 bucket. Configure an S3 Multi-Region Access Point that uses both S3 buckets. Deploy a modified application to both Regions.
options.C: Create a new S3 bucket in a second Region Deploy the application in the second Region. Configure the application to use the new S3 bucket. Set up S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the original S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket.
options.D: Set up an S3 gateway endpoint with the S3 bucket as an origin. Deploy the application to a second Region. Modify the application to use the new S3 gateway endpoint. Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering on the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
The application currently reads and writes objects in one S3 bucket, and the company wants to run the application in two AWS Regions with the least operational overhead. The key requirements are therefore: (1) a data access pattern suitable for multi-Region application deployments, and (2) keeping object data available/synchronized for reads and writes from both Regions.

**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points are designed for this exact pattern. AWS states that S3 Multi-Region Access Points provide **a global endpoint** that applications can use for requests to S3 buckets in **multiple AWS Regions**, and that you can use them to build multi-Region applications with the same architecture used in a single Region. Requests to the global endpoint are automatically routed over the AWS global network to the closest active S3 bucket, and after setup you can read or write data through the Multi-Region Access Point global endpoint. AWS also says to use S3 Cross-Region Replication rules to synchronize data among the buckets in those Regions ([Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)).

Because the application writes objects, one-way replication is not sufficient for active use in two Regions. AWS documentation specifically describes two-way/bi-directional replication as a way to keep data synchronized across Regions during failover and to make applications highly available. It also notes that two-way replication helps ensure that when data is written to the bucket that traffic fails over to, the data is replicated back to the source bucket ([Replicating objects within and across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). Therefore, creating a second bucket, configuring bidirectional CRR, and placing both buckets behind an S3 Multi-Region Access Point provides the most AWS-native, low-operational-overhead solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect.** CloudFront can cache and distribute content, but this option does not create a second regional S3 data store or solve active read/write synchronization between Regions. Also, S3 Multi-Region Access Points already use AWS Global Accelerator internally to route requests to the closest active S3 bucket, so separately adding Global Accelerator to access a single S3 bucket is not the right design for multi-Region S3 reads and writes.
* **C is incorrect.** This creates a second bucket and deploys the application in the second Region, but replication is only from the original bucket to the new bucket. If the application in the second Region writes to the new bucket, those writes are not replicated back to the original bucket. That does not maintain a consistent shared dataset for an application running in both Regions. It also requires the application in each Region to know which bucket endpoint to use instead of using one global Multi-Region Access Point endpoint.
* **D is incorrect.** An S3 gateway endpoint is for private VPC connectivity to S3; it is not an S3 origin, does not provide global routing, and does not replicate data across Regions. S3 Intelligent-Tiering is a storage class/cost optimization feature and does not address multi-Region application access or data synchronization.

Thus, **B** best meets the requirements with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个应用程序。该应用程序读取和写入存储在单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中的对象。公司必须修改该应用程序，以便在两个 AWS 区域中部署该应用程序。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 S3 存储桶作为源。将应用程序部署到第二个区域。修改应用程序以使用 CloudFront 分配。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 访问 S3 存储桶中的数据。
options.B: 在第二个区域中创建一个新的 S3 存储桶。在原始 S3 存储桶和新的 S3 存储桶之间设置双向 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）。配置一个使用这两个 S3 存储桶的 S3 多区域接入点。将修改后的应用程序部署到两个区域。
options.C: 在第二个区域中创建一个新的 S3 存储桶。将应用程序部署到第二个区域。配置应用程序以使用新的 S3 存储桶。设置从原始 S3 存储桶到新的 S3 存储桶的 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）。
options.D: 设置一个 S3 网关端点，并将 S3 存储桶作为源。将应用程序部署到第二个区域。修改应用程序以使用新的 S3 网关端点。在 S3 存储桶上使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序当前在一个 S3 存储桶中读取和写入对象，公司希望以最少的运营开销在两个 AWS 区域中运行该应用程序。因此，关键要求是：（1）适合多区域应用程序部署的数据访问模式；以及（2）保持对象数据可供两个区域进行读取和写入并保持可用/同步。

**正确答案：B。**

Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points 专为这种模式而设计。AWS 表示，S3 Multi-Region Access Points 提供**一个全局端点**，应用程序可以使用该端点向**多个 AWS 区域**中的 S3 存储桶发出请求，并且可以使用它们构建与单区域中相同架构的多区域应用程序。发送到全局端点的请求会通过 AWS 全球网络自动路由到最近的活动 S3 存储桶；完成设置后，可以通过 Multi-Region Access Point 全局端点读取或写入数据。AWS 还表示，应使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication 规则在这些区域中的存储桶之间同步数据（[使用 Multi-Region Access Points 管理多区域流量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)）。

由于应用程序会写入对象，单向复制不足以支持两个区域中的主动使用。AWS 文档专门将双向复制描述为一种在故障转移期间跨区域保持数据同步、并使应用程序高度可用的方法。它还指出，双向复制有助于确保当数据写入流量故障转移到的存储桶时，该数据会被复制回源存储桶（[在区域内和跨区域复制对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。因此，创建第二个存储桶、配置双向 CRR，并将两个存储桶置于 S3 Multi-Region Access Point 之后，提供了最 AWS 原生、低运营开销的解决方案。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

* **A 不正确。** CloudFront 可以缓存和分发内容，但此选项不会创建第二个区域性 S3 数据存储，也无法解决区域之间的主动读/写同步。此外，S3 Multi-Region Access Points 已在内部使用 AWS Global Accelerator 将请求路由到最近的活动 S3 存储桶，因此单独添加 Global Accelerator 来访问单个 S3 存储桶并不是适用于多区域 S3 读写的正确设计。
* **C 不正确。** 该选项会创建第二个存储桶，并在第二个区域中部署应用程序，但复制仅从原始存储桶到新存储桶。如果第二个区域中的应用程序写入新存储桶，这些写入不会复制回原始存储桶。这无法为在两个区域中运行的应用程序维护一致的共享数据集。它还要求每个区域中的应用程序知道要使用哪个存储桶端点，而不是使用一个全局 Multi-Region Access Point 端点。
* **D 不正确。** S3 网关端点用于从 VPC 私有连接到 S3；它不是 S3 源，不提供全局路由，也不会跨区域复制数据。S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是一种存储类别/成本优化功能，不能解决多区域应用程序访问或数据同步问题。

因此，**B** 最能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求。

en.question: An online gaming company needs to rehost its gaming platform on AWS. The company's gaming application requires high performance computing (HPC) processing and has a leaderboard that changes frequently. An Ubuntu instance that is optimized for compute generation hosts a Node.js application for game display. Game state is tracked in an on-premises Redis instance. The company needs a migration strategy that optimizes application performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group of m5.large Amazon EC2 Spot Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. Use an Amazon ElastlCache for Redis cluster to maintain the leaderboard.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group of c5.large Amazon EC2 Spot Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. Use an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster to maintain the leaderboard.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group of c5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. Use an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to maintain the leaderboard.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group of m5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to maintain the leaderboard.

en.explanation:
The company is rehosting an online gaming platform and wants to optimize performance. The application tier is compute-intensive, and the leaderboard changes frequently while currently using Redis on premises. The best migration should therefore use compute-optimized EC2 capacity for the Node.js application and an AWS-managed Redis-compatible in-memory data store for the leaderboard.

**Correct answer: C. Create an Auto Scaling group of c5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. Use an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to maintain the leaderboard.**

- For the application tier, AWS documentation groups EC2 instances by workload fit. **Compute optimized** instances are designed for compute-intensive applications that benefit from high-performance processors and are listed as ideal for **high performance computing (HPC)** and **dedicated gaming servers**. This aligns with choosing the `c5` family over the `m5` general-purpose family. See [Amazon EC2 instance type specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/ec2-instance-type-specifications.html).
- For the leaderboard, Amazon ElastiCache explicitly identifies **Gaming Leaderboards** as a use case. With Redis OSS sorted sets, leaderboard ordering and reranking can be handled in real time by the cluster, which matches a frequently changing game leaderboard. See [Common ElastiCache use cases: Gaming Leaderboards](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html).
- On-Demand Instances are more appropriate than Spot Instances for the primary gaming platform when the question emphasizes application performance and does not state that the workload is interruption-tolerant. AWS documents that Spot Instances can receive interruption notices before EC2 stops or terminates them, so they require fault-tolerant design. See [Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. m5.large Spot Instances + ElastiCache for Redis** — ElastiCache for Redis is the right leaderboard technology, but `m5` is a general-purpose instance family, not the compute-optimized choice for an HPC/gaming compute workload. In addition, Spot Instances can be interrupted, which is not ideal for the main gaming application unless the architecture is explicitly designed for interruption tolerance.
- **B. c5.large Spot Instances + OpenSearch Service** — `c5` is the correct compute-optimized family, but Spot Instances introduce interruption risk. More importantly, OpenSearch is not the best fit for a real-time, frequently changing leaderboard. Redis sorted sets in ElastiCache are specifically designed for this leaderboard pattern.
- **D. m5.large On-Demand Instances + DynamoDB** — On-Demand capacity avoids Spot interruption risk, but `m5` is not the best compute-optimized choice for the HPC/gaming application tier. DynamoDB can support many high-scale applications, but the scenario is migrating an existing Redis-based game state/leaderboard and needs real-time leaderboard ordering; ElastiCache for Redis sorted sets are the AWS-native fit described in AWS documentation.

zh.question: 一家在线游戏公司需要在 AWS 上重新托管其游戏平台。该公司的游戏应用程序需要高性能计算 (HPC) 处理，并且有一个频繁变化的排行榜。一个针对计算密集型工作负载优化的 Ubuntu 实例托管用于游戏显示的 Node.js 应用程序。游戏状态在本地 Redis 实例中跟踪。该公司需要一种能够优化应用程序性能的迁移策略。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个由 m5.large Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 组成的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon ElastlCache for Redis 集群维护排行榜。
options.B: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个由 c5.large Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 组成的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群维护排行榜。
options.C: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个由 c5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 组成的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群维护排行榜。
options.D: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个由 m5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 组成的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表维护排行榜。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在重新托管一个在线游戏平台，并希望优化性能。应用程序层是计算密集型的，排行榜频繁变化，而当前在本地使用 Redis。因此，最佳迁移方案应为 Node.js 应用程序使用计算优化的 EC2 容量，并为排行榜使用 AWS 托管的、兼容 Redis 的内存数据存储。

**正确答案：C。在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个由 c5.large Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 组成的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群维护排行榜。**

- 对于应用程序层，AWS 文档按工作负载适配性对 EC2 实例进行分组。**Compute optimized** 实例专为可受益于高性能处理器的计算密集型应用程序而设计，并被列为非常适合 **high performance computing (HPC)** 和**专用游戏服务器**。这与选择 `c5` 系列而不是 `m5` 通用型系列一致。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 instance type specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/ec2-instance-type-specifications.html)。
- 对于排行榜，Amazon ElastiCache 明确将 **Gaming Leaderboards** 标识为一个使用场景。借助 Redis OSS sorted sets，排行榜排序和重新排名可以由集群实时处理，这与频繁变化的游戏排行榜相匹配。请参阅 [Common ElastiCache use cases: Gaming Leaderboards](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)。
- 当题目强调应用程序性能且未说明工作负载能够容忍中断时，对于主要游戏平台，On-Demand Instances 比 Spot Instances 更合适。AWS 文档说明，Spot Instances 可能会在 EC2 停止或终止它们之前收到中断通知，因此它们需要容错设计。请参阅 [Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. m5.large Spot Instances + ElastiCache for Redis** — ElastiCache for Redis 是正确的排行榜技术，但 `m5` 是通用型实例系列，并不是针对 HPC/游戏计算工作负载的计算优化选择。此外，Spot Instances 可能会被中断，除非架构明确设计为可容忍中断，否则这并不适合主要游戏应用程序。
- **B. c5.large Spot Instances + OpenSearch Service** — `c5` 是正确的计算优化系列，但 Spot Instances 会带来中断风险。更重要的是，OpenSearch 并不是实时、频繁变化排行榜的最佳选择。ElastiCache 中的 Redis sorted sets 是专门为这种排行榜模式设计的。
- **D. m5.large On-Demand Instances + DynamoDB** — On-Demand 容量避免了 Spot 中断风险，但 `m5` 并不是 HPC/游戏应用程序层的最佳计算优化选择。DynamoDB 可以支持许多高规模应用程序，但该场景是在迁移现有基于 Redis 的游戏状态/排行榜，并且需要实时排行榜排序；ElastiCache for Redis sorted sets 才是 AWS 文档中描述的 AWS 原生适配方案。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing an application to accept timesheet entries from employees on their mobile devices. Timesheets will be submitted weekly, with most of the submissions occurring on Friday. The data must be stored in a format that allows payroll administrators to run monthly reports. The infrastructure must be highly available and scale to match the rate of incoming data and reporting requests. Which combination of steps meets these requirements while minimizing operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the application to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances with load balancing across multiple Availability Zones. Use scheduled Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to add capacity before the high volume of submissions on Fridays.
options.B: Deploy the application in a container using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with load balancing across multiple Availability Zones. Use scheduled Service Auto Scaling to add capacity before the high volume of submissions on Fridays.
options.C: Deploy the application front end to an Amazon S3 bucket served by Amazon CloudFront. Deploy the application backend using Amazon API Gateway with an AWS Lambda proxy integration.
options.D: Store the timesheet submission data in Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon QuickSight to generate the reports using Amazon Redshift as the data source.
options.E: Store the timesheet submission data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight to generate the reports using Amazon S3 as the data source.

en.explanation:
The application needs to accept a burst of weekly mobile timesheet submissions, remain highly available, scale with changing demand, and support monthly reporting with minimal operational overhead. The best combination is **C and E**.

**C. Deploy the application front end to an Amazon S3 bucket served by Amazon CloudFront. Deploy the application backend using Amazon API Gateway with an AWS Lambda proxy integration.**

This is the lowest-operations application hosting pattern among the options. Amazon S3 can host static website content, including pages with client-side scripts, which is suitable for a web front end or single-page application accessed from mobile devices and distributed through CloudFront ([Amazon S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). The dynamic timesheet submission logic can be handled by API Gateway and Lambda. API Gateway supports Lambda proxy integration, where request headers, path variables, query strings, request body, and API configuration data are passed to the Lambda function, while API Gateway manages the integration request and response configuration ([API Gateway Lambda proxy integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)). AWS Lambda runs code without managing servers and scales up and down automatically; AWS also lists web applications and mobile backends as Lambda use cases ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). This directly addresses the Friday submission spike without provisioning or scheduling server capacity.

**E. Store the timesheet submission data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight to generate the reports using Amazon S3 as the data source.**

S3 is an appropriate durable storage location for the submitted timesheet data in a queryable format such as JSON, CSV, or Parquet. Amazon Athena can analyze data directly in Amazon S3 by using standard SQL. Athena is serverless, requires no infrastructure to set up or manage, and scales automatically by running queries in parallel ([What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). Amazon QuickSight can create datasets that connect to Athena data and then visualize that data for reporting ([Creating a dataset using Amazon Athena data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html)). This provides monthly payroll reporting without operating a separate analytics platform.

The other options are less suitable:

- **A is incorrect** because EC2 instances, even with load balancing across multiple Availability Zones and scheduled Auto Scaling, require more operational management. The team must manage instances, patching, AMIs, capacity planning, and scaling schedules. This does not minimize operational overhead compared with API Gateway and Lambda.

- **B is incorrect** because Amazon ECS with scheduled Service Auto Scaling can handle variable traffic, but it still introduces container deployment and service capacity management. The option does not specify a fully serverless container approach, and even managed containers add more operational overhead than a Lambda-based backend for a simple submission API.

- **D is incorrect** because Amazon Redshift with QuickSight can support analytics, but it is more infrastructure than necessary for monthly reports over timesheet submissions. S3 with Athena provides direct, serverless querying of data in S3 and better satisfies the requirement to minimize operational overhead.

Therefore, **C and E** provide the highly available, automatically scaling, low-overhead architecture for both timesheet ingestion and monthly reporting.

zh.question: 解决方案架构师正在设计一个应用程序，用于接收员工通过其移动设备提交的工时表条目。工时表将每周提交一次，大多数提交会发生在星期五。数据必须以一种允许薪资管理员运行月度报表的格式存储。基础设施必须具有高可用性，并能够扩展以匹配传入数据和报表请求的速率。哪组步骤组合能够在最大限度降低运营开销的同时满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将应用程序部署到 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances，并在多个 Availability Zones 之间进行负载均衡。使用计划的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 在星期五提交量高峰之前增加容量。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 将应用程序部署在容器中，并在多个 Availability Zones 之间进行负载均衡。使用计划的 Service Auto Scaling 在星期五提交量高峰之前增加容量。
options.C: 将应用程序前端部署到由 Amazon CloudFront 提供服务的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用带有 AWS Lambda 代理集成的 Amazon API Gateway 部署应用程序后端。
options.D: 将工时表提交数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 中。使用 Amazon QuickSight 以 Amazon Redshift 作为数据源生成报表。
options.E: 将工时表提交数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Athena 和 Amazon QuickSight 以 Amazon S3 作为数据源生成报表。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序需要接收每周一次的移动端工时表提交突增，保持高可用性，随需求变化扩展，并以最小运营开销支持月度报表。最佳组合是 **C 和 E**。

**C. 将应用程序前端部署到由 Amazon CloudFront 提供服务的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用带有 AWS Lambda 代理集成的 Amazon API Gateway 部署应用程序后端。**

这是这些选项中运营开销最低的应用程序托管模式。Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站内容，包括带有客户端脚本的页面，这适合通过移动设备访问并通过 CloudFront 分发的 Web 前端或单页应用程序（[Amazon S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。动态的工时表提交逻辑可以由 API Gateway 和 Lambda 处理。API Gateway 支持 Lambda 代理集成，其中请求标头、路径变量、查询字符串、请求正文和 API 配置数据会传递给 Lambda 函数，同时 API Gateway 管理集成请求和响应配置（[API Gateway Lambda proxy integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)）。AWS Lambda 无需管理服务器即可运行代码，并且会自动向上和向下扩展；AWS 还将 Web 应用程序和移动后端列为 Lambda 的使用案例（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。这可以直接应对星期五的提交高峰，而无需预置或计划服务器容量。

**E. 将工时表提交数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Athena 和 Amazon QuickSight 以 Amazon S3 作为数据源生成报表。**

S3 是存放已提交工时表数据的合适持久存储位置，可使用 JSON、CSV 或 Parquet 等可查询格式。Amazon Athena 可以使用标准 SQL 直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据。Athena 是无服务器的，无需设置或管理任何基础设施，并通过并行运行查询自动扩展（[What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。Amazon QuickSight 可以创建连接到 Athena 数据的数据集，然后将该数据可视化用于报表（[Creating a dataset using Amazon Athena data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html)）。这无需运营单独的分析平台即可提供月度薪资报表。

其他选项不太合适：

- **A 不正确**，因为 EC2 实例即使在多个 Availability Zones 之间进行负载均衡并使用计划的 Auto Scaling，也需要更多运营管理。团队必须管理实例、补丁、AMI、容量规划和扩展计划。与 API Gateway 和 Lambda 相比，这并不能最大限度降低运营开销。

- **B 不正确**，因为带有计划的 Service Auto Scaling 的 Amazon ECS 可以处理可变流量，但它仍会引入容器部署和服务容量管理。该选项没有指定完全无服务器的容器方法，并且对于简单的提交 API，即使是托管容器，也比基于 Lambda 的后端增加更多运营开销。

- **D 不正确**，因为 Amazon Redshift 与 QuickSight 可以支持分析，但对于工时表提交的月度报表来说，它所需的基础设施超出了必要范围。S3 与 Athena 可对 S3 中的数据进行直接的无服务器查询，更好地满足最大限度降低运营开销的要求。

因此，**C 和 E** 为工时表摄取和月度报表提供了高可用、自动扩展、低开销的架构。

en.question: A company is storing sensitive data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must log all activities for objects in the S3 bucket and must keep the logs for 5 years. The company's security team also must receive an email notification every time there is an attempt to delete data in the S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail to log S3 data events.
options.B: Configure S3 server access logging for the S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure Amazon S3 to send object deletion events to Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
options.D: Configure Amazon S3 to send object deletion events to an Amazon EventBridge event bus that publishes to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.E: Configure Amazon S3 to send the logs to Amazon Timestream with data storage tiering.
options.F: Configure a new S3 bucket to store the logs with an S3 Lifecycle policy.

en.explanation:
The company needs (1) object-level activity logging for sensitive S3 data, (2) 5-year log retention, and (3) email notification when object deletion is attempted. The best combination is **A, D, and F**.

### Correct options

**A. Configure AWS CloudTrail to log S3 data events.**  
This is the right logging mechanism for object-level auditing. AWS states that CloudTrail captures S3 API calls and that CloudTrail logs provide detailed API tracking for S3 bucket-level and object-level operations. AWS also explicitly recommends CloudTrail for logging bucket-level and object-level actions for S3 resources in its comparison of S3 logging options ([Logging options for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/logging-with-S3.html), [Logging Amazon S3 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-logging.html)). Although CloudTrail S3 data events have a cost, the requirement says **all activities for objects**, which makes CloudTrail data events the more appropriate compliance/audit choice than best-effort server access logs.

**D. Configure Amazon S3 to send object deletion events to an Amazon EventBridge event bus that publishes to an Amazon SNS topic.**  
Amazon S3 event notifications support **object removal events** and can send notifications to **Amazon EventBridge**. S3 also supports SNS as a destination, and SNS can deliver messages to email endpoints through an email subscription ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)). Therefore, routing S3 deletion events through EventBridge to an SNS topic with an email subscription meets the notification requirement.

**F. Configure a new S3 bucket to store the logs with an S3 Lifecycle policy.**  
CloudTrail trails can deliver log files to an S3 bucket, and AWS notes that you can store log files in the bucket as long as needed and define S3 Lifecycle rules to archive or delete log files automatically ([Logging Amazon S3 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-logging.html)). S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to lower-cost storage classes, archive them, and delete them after a defined period, which is the cost-effective way to retain logs for 5 years ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

### Incorrect options

**B. Configure S3 server access logging for the S3 bucket.**  
S3 server access logging is cheaper, but it is not the best fit for the stated requirement to log **all** object activities. AWS documents that server access log delivery is **best effort**: a record might be delivered late, might not be delivered at all, and server logging is not intended to be a complete accounting of all requests ([Logging requests with server access logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerLogs.html)). For sensitive-data auditing where completeness is required, CloudTrail data events are more appropriate.
