AWS Secrets Manager 专为应用程序和数据库密钥而构建。AWS 文档指出，Secrets Manager 可帮助管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证，并允许应用程序动态检索凭证，而不是将其硬编码在应用程序代码中（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。AWS Lambda 文档明确将存储 Amazon RDS 的数据库凭证以及在不更新函数代码的情况下自动轮换凭证列为 Secrets Manager 与 Lambda 配合使用的常见用例（[Use Secrets Manager secrets in Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-secrets-manager.html)）。

Secrets Manager 还支持自动密钥轮换：当密钥被轮换时，Secrets Manager 会更新密钥本身以及数据库或服务中的凭证（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。此外，Secrets Manager 密钥使用 AWS KMS 密钥加密，并且 IAM 策略可以控制哪些用户或服务可以访问密钥；如果使用非默认 KMS 密钥，还必须管理对该 KMS 密钥的权限（[Secrets Manager access control and encryption key permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/auth-and-access.html)）。客户托管 KMS 密钥可以启用自动密钥轮换；AWS KMS 会按计划轮换密钥材料，并使用相应的密钥材料透明地解密旧密文（[Rotate AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)）。

因此，在生产环境中，架构师应将 RDS 凭证存储在 Secrets Manager 中，使用由 IT 安全组控制的客户托管 KMS 密钥加密该 secret，只授予 Lambda 执行角色检索/解密该 secret 所需的权限，并按要求启用轮换。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **A. Systems Manager Parameter Store SecureString** — Parameter Store SecureString 可以使用 KMS 密钥存储加密值，但本题涉及的是供 Lambda 使用的生产数据库凭证和数据库系统。Secrets Manager 是 AWS 专为管理和轮换数据库凭证而设计的服务。当需要凭证生命周期管理和数据库 secret 轮换时，Parameter Store 不太合适。
- **B. 使用默认 Lambda KMS 密钥的 Lambda 环境变量** — 这会将凭证存储在每个函数配置中，并使用 AWS 托管/默认 Lambda 密钥，而不是由 IT 安全团队控制的客户托管密钥。它也不提供数据库凭证生命周期/轮换管理。
- **C. 使用客户托管 KMS 密钥加密的 Lambda 环境变量** — 尽管这使用了客户托管 KMS 密钥，但凭证仍存储在每个 Lambda 函数的配置中。与将 secret 集中存储在 Secrets Manager 中相比，这在运营上更弱，并且不提供 Secrets Manager 的数据库凭证轮换功能。

因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: An online retail company is migrating its legacy on-premises .NET application to AWS. The application runs on load-balanced frontend web servers, load-balanced application servers, and a Microsoft SQL Server database. The company wants to use AWS managed services where possible and does not want to rewrite the application. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to resolve scaling issues and minimize licensing costs as the application scales. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer for the web tier and for the application tier. Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish turned on to replatform the SQL Server database.
options.B: Create images of all the servers by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Deploy Amazon EC2 instances that are based on the on-premises imports. Deploy the instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer for the web tier and for the application tier. Use Amazon DynamoDB as the database tier.
options.C: Containerize the web frontend tier and the application tier. Provision an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Create an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer for the web tier and for the application tier. Use Amazon RDS for SQL Server to host the database.
options.D: Separate the application functions into AWS Lambda functions. Use Amazon API Gateway for the web frontend tier and the application tier. Migrate the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company is migrating a legacy, load-balanced .NET application with separate web and application tiers and a Microsoft SQL Server database. The constraints are:

- use AWS managed services where possible,
- avoid rewriting the application,
- fix scaling problems,
- minimize licensing costs as the workload scales.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Deploy EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups behind Application Load Balancers for the web and application tiers, and use Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish enabled for the database.**

This is the best fit because it addresses both scaling and SQL Server licensing cost while requiring minimal application change.

For the web and application tiers, EC2 Auto Scaling integrated with Elastic Load Balancing is a standard way to scale legacy server-based applications without rewriting them. AWS documentation states that Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming application traffic across EC2 instances, prevents any one instance from being overwhelmed, and that instances launched or terminated by an Auto Scaling group are automatically registered or deregistered with the load balancer. It also notes that Auto Scaling can use ELB metrics such as **Application Load Balancer request count per target** to scale as demand fluctuates ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)).

For the database tier, **Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL** is the key differentiator. AWS documentation says Babelfish extends an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster so that it can accept connections from SQL Server clients, and that applications originally built for SQL Server can work directly with Aurora PostgreSQL with **few code changes** and without changing database drivers. It also supports the SQL Server wire protocol and commonly used SQL Server statements through a TDS listener ([Aurora Babelfish documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/babelfish.html)). This allows the company to replatform away from SQL Server licensing while avoiding a full application rewrite.

This is more cost-effective than continuing to scale SQL Server licensing. RDS for SQL Server supports License Included and Bring Your Own Media licensing models; with License Included, RDS pricing includes the SQL Server software license, and with BYOM the customer must still have valid SQL Server licenses with Software Assurance and License Mobility rights ([RDS for SQL Server licensing documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Concepts.General.Licensing.html)). Moving to Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish reduces dependence on Microsoft SQL Server licensing.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. AWS DMS server images, EC2 behind NLB, DynamoDB

This option is incorrect for multiple reasons.

First, AWS DMS is a database migration service, not a server imaging or application server migration tool. The relevant AWS DMS documentation is about migrating databases to Amazon RDS equivalents, not creating images of all servers ([AWS DMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/data-migrations.html)).

Second, moving a relational SQL Server database to **Amazon DynamoDB** would require a major data model and application access-pattern redesign. DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, and AWS documentation emphasizes that NoSQL design differs from relational design and requires modeling around application access patterns ([DynamoDB NoSQL design documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)). That conflicts with the requirement not to rewrite the application.

### C. Containerize on EKS, NLB, RDS for SQL Server

This option improves some operational aspects, but it is not the most cost-effective for the stated requirements.

Containerizing a legacy .NET application and operating it on EKS can require application packaging, platform, and deployment changes. More importantly, the database remains **Amazon RDS for SQL Server**, so the company still incurs SQL Server licensing costs either through License Included pricing or by bringing eligible licenses. AWS documents that RDS for SQL Server License Included pricing includes the SQL Server software license, while BYOM still requires valid SQL Server licenses with active Software Assurance and License Mobility rights ([RDS for SQL Server licensing documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Concepts.General.Licensing.html)).

Because the question specifically asks to **minimize licensing costs as the application scales**, keeping SQL Server is less cost-effective than replatforming to Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish.

### D. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Athena

This would be a substantial rewrite and re-architecture. Separating the application into Lambda functions and replacing the relational database with S3 plus Athena is not a migration of the existing application with minimal changes. AWS Lambda runs code in functions using the Lambda programming and execution model ([Lambda documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-how-lambda-runs-code.html)), which is fundamentally different from running a legacy multi-tier .NET application on servers. This violates the requirement that the company does not want to rewrite the application.

## Conclusion

Option **A** is the most cost-effective solution because it preserves the legacy web and application tiers with EC2 Auto Scaling and Application Load Balancers, while using Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish to reduce SQL Server licensing dependency with minimal code changes.

zh.question: 一家在线零售公司正在将其旧版本地 .NET 应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序运行在经过负载均衡的前端 Web 服务器、经过负载均衡的应用程序服务器以及 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库上。公司希望尽可能使用 AWS 托管服务，并且不想重写应用程序。解决方案架构师需要实施一种解决方案，以解决扩展问题，并在应用程序扩展时最大限度降低许可成本。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中部署 Amazon EC2 实例，分别用于 Web 层和应用程序层。使用启用了 Babelfish 的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 来重新平台化 SQL Server 数据库。
options.B: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 为所有服务器创建映像。部署基于本地导入的 Amazon EC2 实例。将这些实例部署在 Network Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中，分别用于 Web 层和应用程序层。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库层。
options.C: 将 Web 前端层和应用程序层容器化。预置 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。为 Web 层和应用程序层创建位于 Network Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 托管数据库。
options.D: 将应用程序功能拆分为 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon API Gateway 作为 Web 前端层和应用程序层。将数据迁移到 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

该公司正在迁移一个旧版的、经过负载均衡的 .NET 应用程序，该应用程序具有独立的 Web 层和应用程序层，以及 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库。约束条件是：

- 尽可能使用 AWS 托管服务，
- 避免重写应用程序，
- 解决扩展问题，
- 在工作负载扩展时最大限度降低许可成本。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中部署 EC2 实例，用于 Web 层和应用程序层，并为数据库使用启用了 Babelfish 的 Aurora PostgreSQL。**

这是最佳匹配，因为它同时解决了扩展和 SQL Server 许可成本问题，同时只需要最少的应用程序更改。

对于 Web 层和应用程序层，将 EC2 Auto Scaling 与 Elastic Load Balancing 集成，是在不重写旧版基于服务器的应用程序的情况下进行扩展的标准方式。AWS 文档指出，Elastic Load Balancing 会在 EC2 实例之间分发传入的应用程序流量，防止任何单个实例不堪重负，并且由 Auto Scaling 组启动或终止的实例会自动向负载均衡器注册或注销。文档还指出，Auto Scaling 可以使用 ELB 指标（例如 **Application Load Balancer request count per target**）在需求波动时进行扩展（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。

对于数据库层，**Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL** 是关键差异点。AWS 文档说明，Babelfish 扩展了 Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群，使其能够接受来自 SQL Server 客户端的连接，并且最初为 SQL Server 构建的应用程序可以在 **少量代码更改** 的情况下直接使用 Aurora PostgreSQL，而无需更改数据库驱动程序。它还通过 TDS listener 支持 SQL Server wire protocol 和常用的 SQL Server 语句（[Aurora Babelfish documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/babelfish.html)）。这使公司能够从 SQL Server 许可重新平台化，同时避免完全重写应用程序。

这比继续扩展 SQL Server 许可更具成本效益。RDS for SQL Server 支持 License Included 和 Bring Your Own Media 许可模型；使用 License Included 时，RDS 定价包含 SQL Server 软件许可，而使用 BYOM 时，客户仍必须拥有具备 Software Assurance 和 License Mobility 权利的有效 SQL Server 许可（[RDS for SQL Server licensing documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Concepts.General.Licensing.html)）。迁移到带 Babelfish 的 Aurora PostgreSQL 可减少对 Microsoft SQL Server 许可的依赖。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. AWS DMS 服务器映像、NLB 后面的 EC2、DynamoDB

此选项错误有多方面原因。

首先，AWS DMS 是数据库迁移服务，而不是服务器映像或应用程序服务器迁移工具。相关 AWS DMS 文档讨论的是将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS 等效目标，而不是创建所有服务器的映像（[AWS DMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/data-migrations.html)）。

其次，将关系型 SQL Server 数据库迁移到 **Amazon DynamoDB** 需要重大的数据模型和应用程序访问模式重新设计。DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库，AWS 文档强调 NoSQL 设计不同于关系型设计，并且需要围绕应用程序访问模式建模（[DynamoDB NoSQL design documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。这与不重写应用程序的要求相冲突。

### C. 在 EKS 上容器化、NLB、RDS for SQL Server

此选项改善了一些运营方面，但对于所述要求而言并不是最具成本效益的方案。

将旧版 .NET 应用程序容器化并在 EKS 上运行，可能需要对应用程序打包、平台和部署进行更改。更重要的是，数据库仍然是 **Amazon RDS for SQL Server**，因此公司仍会通过 License Included 定价或自带符合条件的许可来承担 SQL Server 许可成本。AWS 文档说明，RDS for SQL Server 的 License Included 定价包含 SQL Server 软件许可，而 BYOM 仍要求具备有效 Software Assurance 和 License Mobility 权利的有效 SQL Server 许可（[RDS for SQL Server licensing documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Concepts.General.Licensing.html)）。

由于题目特别要求在应用程序扩展时 **最大限度降低许可成本**，保留 SQL Server 的成本效益低于重新平台化到带 Babelfish 的 Aurora PostgreSQL。

### D. Lambda、API Gateway、S3、Athena

这将是一次重大的重写和重新架构。将应用程序拆分为 Lambda 函数，并用 S3 加 Athena 替代关系型数据库，并不是以最小更改迁移现有应用程序。AWS Lambda 使用 Lambda 编程和执行模型在函数中运行代码（[Lambda documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-how-lambda-runs-code.html)），这与在服务器上运行旧版多层 .NET 应用程序有根本不同。这违反了公司不想重写应用程序的要求。

## 结论

选项 **A** 是最具成本效益的解决方案，因为它通过 EC2 Auto Scaling 和 Application Load Balancer 保留了旧版 Web 层和应用程序层，同时使用带 Babelfish 的 Aurora PostgreSQL，以最少代码更改减少对 SQL Server 许可的依赖。

en.question: A software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider exposes APIs through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB connects to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that is deployed in the us- east-1 Region. The exposed APIs contain usage of a few non-standard REST methods: LINK, UNLINK, LOCK, and UNLOCK. Users outside the United States are reporting long and inconsistent response times for these APIs. A solutions architect needs to resolve this problem with a solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the ALB as the origin.
options.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway edge-optimized API endpoint to expose the APIs. Configure the ALB as the target.
options.C: Add an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure the ALB as the origin.
options.D: Deploy the APIs to two additional AWS Regions: eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-2. Add latency-based routing records in Amazon Route 53.

en.explanation:
The APIs are already exposed through an ALB in one Region, and the problem is long and inconsistent response time for global users. The solution must improve global network performance while preserving the existing non-standard REST methods and minimizing operational overhead.

**Correct answer: C. Add an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure the ALB as the origin.**

Strictly speaking, Global Accelerator terminology is to configure the ALB as an **endpoint**, not an origin. However, this option is clearly referring to placing AWS Global Accelerator in front of the existing ALB. AWS documents that Global Accelerator is used to improve application performance for local and global users, and that standard accelerators use the AWS global network to route traffic based on health, client location, and configured policies. Standard accelerator endpoints can include **Application Load Balancers** in one or multiple Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).

This fits the requirement because it improves latency consistency for international users without redeploying the EKS application or changing the API layer. Global Accelerator operates at the network acceleration layer for the application endpoint, so it does not impose CloudFront/API Gateway HTTP method limitations on the custom methods such as `LINK`, `UNLINK`, `LOCK`, and `UNLOCK`.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the ALB as the origin.**  
  CloudFront can use an ALB/custom origin, but CloudFront cache behavior only allows these viewer HTTP method sets: `GET, HEAD`; `GET, HEAD, OPTIONS`; or `GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT, POST, PATCH, DELETE` ([CloudFront allowed HTTP methods](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html)). The required non-standard methods (`LINK`, `UNLINK`, `LOCK`, `UNLOCK`) are not in the supported list, so CloudFront is not suitable.

* **B. Add an Amazon API Gateway edge-optimized API endpoint to expose the APIs. Configure the ALB as the target.**  
  API Gateway REST APIs support the `ANY` method, but AWS describes `ANY` as covering the supported methods `DELETE`, `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, `PATCH`, `POST`, and `PUT` ([API Gateway method setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-method-settings-method-request.html)). The custom methods in the question are not among these. Also, edge-optimized REST API endpoints use an API Gateway/CloudFront-based front end, which is less appropriate than Global Accelerator for transparently accelerating an existing ALB-backed application with non-standard methods.

* **D. Deploy the APIs to two additional AWS Regions and add latency-based Route 53 records.**  
  Multi-Region deployment with latency-based routing can route users to lower-latency Regions; Route 53 latency routing directs queries to the AWS Region that provides the lowest latency for the user ([Route 53 latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)). However, deploying EKS clusters and APIs in additional Regions introduces significant operational overhead: application deployment, data replication/state management, CI/CD changes, monitoring, failover design, and ongoing regional operations. The question asks for minimal operational overhead, making Global Accelerator the better fit.

zh.question: 一家软件即服务（SaaS）提供商通过 Application Load Balancer（ALB）公开 API。该 ALB 连接到部署在 us-east-1 区域的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（Amazon EKS）集群。公开的 API 包含对一些非标准 REST 方法的使用：LINK、UNLINK、LOCK 和 UNLOCK。美国以外的用户报告这些 API 的响应时间很长且不稳定。解决方案架构师需要使用一种将运营开销降至最低的解决方案来解决此问题。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将 ALB 配置为源站。
options.B: 添加一个 Amazon API Gateway 边缘优化 API 端点来公开这些 API。将 ALB 配置为目标。
options.C: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中添加一个加速器。将 ALB 配置为源站。
options.D: 将这些 API 部署到另外两个 AWS 区域：eu-west-1 和 ap-southeast-2。在 Amazon Route 53 中添加基于延迟的路由记录。

zh.explanation:
这些 API 已经通过一个区域中的 ALB 对外公开，问题是全球用户的响应时间长且不稳定。该解决方案必须在保留现有非标准 REST 方法的同时提升全球网络性能，并最大限度降低运营开销。

**正确答案：C. 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中添加一个加速器。将 ALB 配置为源站。**

严格来说，Global Accelerator 的术语是将 ALB 配置为**端点**，而不是源站。不过，此选项显然指的是将 AWS Global Accelerator 放在现有 ALB 前面。AWS 文档说明，Global Accelerator 用于提升本地和全球用户的应用程序性能，并且标准加速器使用 AWS 全球网络，根据运行状况、客户端位置和配置的策略来路由流量。标准加速器端点可以包括一个或多个区域中的 **Application Load Balancers**（[AWS Global Accelerator 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。

这符合要求，因为它无需重新部署 EKS 应用程序或更改 API 层，即可改善国际用户的延迟一致性。Global Accelerator 在应用程序端点的网络加速层运行，因此不会对 `LINK`、`UNLINK`、`LOCK` 和 `UNLOCK` 等自定义方法施加 CloudFront/API Gateway HTTP 方法限制。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A. 添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将 ALB 配置为源站。**  
  CloudFront 可以使用 ALB/自定义源站，但 CloudFront 缓存行为仅允许以下查看器 HTTP 方法集：`GET, HEAD`；`GET, HEAD, OPTIONS`；或 `GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT, POST, PATCH, DELETE`（[CloudFront 允许的 HTTP 方法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html)）。所需的非标准方法（`LINK`、`UNLINK`、`LOCK`、`UNLOCK`）不在受支持列表中，因此 CloudFront 不适合。

* **B. 添加一个 Amazon API Gateway 边缘优化 API 端点来公开这些 API。将 ALB 配置为目标。**  
  API Gateway REST APIs 支持 `ANY` 方法，但 AWS 将 `ANY` 描述为涵盖受支持的方法 `DELETE`、`GET`、`HEAD`、`OPTIONS`、`PATCH`、`POST` 和 `PUT`（[API Gateway 方法设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-method-settings-method-request.html)）。题目中的自定义方法不在这些方法之列。此外，边缘优化 REST API 端点使用基于 API Gateway/CloudFront 的前端；与 Global Accelerator 相比，它不太适合透明地加速现有的、由 ALB 支撑且使用非标准方法的应用程序。

* **D. 将这些 API 部署到另外两个 AWS 区域，并添加基于延迟的 Route 53 记录。**  
  多区域部署结合基于延迟的路由可以将用户路由到延迟较低的区域；Route 53 延迟路由会将查询定向到为用户提供最低延迟的 AWS 区域（[Route 53 基于延迟的路由](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)）。但是，在其他区域部署 EKS 集群和 API 会引入显著的运营开销：应用程序部署、数据复制/状态管理、CI/CD 变更、监控、故障转移设计以及持续的区域运营。题目要求最小化运营开销，因此 Global Accelerator 是更合适的选择。

en.question: A company runs an IoT application in the AWS Cloud. The company has millions of sensors that collect data from houses in the United States. The sensors use the MQTT protocol to connect and send data to a custom MQTT broker. The MQTT broker stores the data on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The sensors connect to the broker through the domain named iot.example.com. The company uses Amazon Route 53 as its DNS service. The company stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB. On several occasions, the amount of data has overloaded the MQTT broker and has resulted in lost sensor data. The company must improve the reliability of the solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an Auto Scaling group for the MQTT broker. Use the Auto Scaling group as the target for the ALB. Update the DNS record in Route 53 to an alias record. Point the alias record to the ALB. Use the MQTT broker to store the data.
options.B: Set up AWS IoT Core to receive the sensor data. Create and configure a custom domain to connect to AWS IoT Core. Update the DNS record in Route 53 to point to the AWS IoT Core Data-ATS endpoint. Configure an AWS IoT rule to store the data.
options.C: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Set the MQTT broker as the target. Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator. Set the NLB as the endpoint for the accelerator. Update the DNS record in Route 53 to a multivalue answer record. Set the Global Accelerator IP addresses as values. Use the MQTT broker to store the data.
options.D: Set up AWS IoT Greengrass to receive the sensor data. Update the DNS record in Route 53 to point to the AWS IoT Greengrass endpoint. Configure an AWS IoT rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to store the data.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The current design uses a **single EC2-hosted custom MQTT broker** as the ingestion point for millions of sensors. That broker has already been overloaded, causing data loss. The requirement is to improve reliability and scalability for MQTT ingestion and then store the data in DynamoDB.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Set up AWS IoT Core to receive the sensor data. Create and configure a custom domain to connect to AWS IoT Core. Update the DNS record in Route 53 to point to the AWS IoT Core Data-ATS endpoint. Configure an AWS IoT rule to store the data.**

AWS IoT Core is the managed AWS service intended for device connectivity and MQTT message ingestion. AWS documentation states that AWS IoT cloud services connect devices by using MQTT, HTTPS, SDKs, CLI, and APIs, and the MQTT documentation shows devices connecting to AWS IoT using the MQTT protocol and MQTT over WebSocket Secure. This directly replaces the overloaded self-managed MQTT broker with a managed IoT ingestion layer. See [What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html) and [MQTT - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/mqtt.html).

The question also requires retaining the existing device DNS name, `iot.example.com`. AWS IoT Core domain configurations support this migration pattern: the documentation lists use cases including **migrating devices to AWS IoT Core** and **maintaining brand identity through a domain name while migrating application infrastructure to AWS IoT Core**. It also defines the default AWS IoT data endpoint such as `iot:Data-ATS` and customer-managed/custom domains for device connections. See [What is a domain configuration?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-domain-configuration-what-is.html).

Finally, AWS IoT rules can route MQTT messages directly to DynamoDB. The AWS IoT tutorial for storing device data in DynamoDB shows creating an AWS IoT rule whose SQL statement listens for MQTT messages on a topic filter and configures a **DynamoDB** rule action to write message data to a table. See [Tutorial: Storing device data in a DynamoDB table](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-ddb-rule.html).

Therefore, option B is the most reliable and operationally appropriate solution: it removes the single-instance broker bottleneck, uses the managed AWS IoT MQTT ingestion service, preserves the device-facing DNS name through a custom domain, and stores incoming messages in DynamoDB by using an IoT rule.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. ALB + Auto Scaling group for the MQTT broker

This still keeps the company responsible for operating and scaling MQTT broker instances. More importantly, an Application Load Balancer is designed for HTTP/HTTPS listener protocols. The ALB listener documentation states that Application Load Balancer listeners support **HTTP** and **HTTPS** protocols. Native MQTT over TCP is not the right fit for an ALB listener. See [Listeners for your Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html).

Although Auto Scaling can improve capacity, it does not provide the managed IoT message broker, device identity, rules engine, and direct service integration that AWS IoT Core provides.

### C. NLB + Global Accelerator + the same MQTT broker

A Network Load Balancer and Global Accelerator can improve network availability and routing, but this option still uses the **same MQTT broker as the target** and says to use the MQTT broker to store the data. It does not remove the application-level bottleneck or the single-broker failure/overload risk described in the question. Elastic Load Balancing can distribute traffic and improve fault tolerance across multiple targets, but option C registers the existing broker rather than replacing the ingestion layer with a managed scalable service. See [What is Elastic Load Balancing?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html).

### D. AWS IoT Greengrass

AWS IoT Greengrass is not the centralized AWS Cloud MQTT ingestion service for millions of sensors. The Greengrass documentation describes it as an **IoT edge runtime and cloud service** for building, deploying, and managing IoT applications on devices; it enables devices to act locally on generated data, filter/aggregate data near where it is generated, and communicate with AWS IoT Core. See [What is AWS IoT Greengrass?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/greengrass/v2/developerguide/what-is-iot-greengrass.html).

That is an edge-computing solution, not the correct replacement for a cloud-hosted MQTT broker endpoint behind `iot.example.com`. Also, the option's reference to updating Route 53 to an "AWS IoT Greengrass endpoint" is not the typical architecture for centralized device ingestion into AWS.

## Conclusion

The correct answer is **B** because AWS IoT Core provides managed MQTT ingestion, supports custom domain configurations for migrating existing device endpoints, and can route messages to DynamoDB through AWS IoT rules.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个 IoT 应用程序。该公司有数百万个传感器，用于从美国各地的房屋收集数据。这些传感器使用 MQTT 协议连接到自定义 MQTT broker 并发送数据。该 MQTT broker 将数据存储在单个 Amazon EC2 实例上。传感器通过名为 iot.example.com 的域名连接到 broker。该公司使用 Amazon Route 53 作为其 DNS 服务。该公司将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。有几次，数据量使 MQTT broker 过载，并导致传感器数据丢失。该公司必须提高该解决方案的可靠性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 和一个用于 MQTT broker 的 Auto Scaling group。将该 Auto Scaling group 用作 ALB 的目标。将 Route 53 中的 DNS 记录更新为别名记录。将该别名记录指向 ALB。使用 MQTT broker 存储数据。
options.B: 设置 AWS IoT Core 以接收传感器数据。创建并配置自定义域名以连接到 AWS IoT Core。更新 Route 53 中的 DNS 记录，使其指向 AWS IoT Core Data-ATS 端点。配置一条 AWS IoT 规则来存储数据。
options.C: 创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将 MQTT broker 设置为目标。创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器。将 NLB 设置为该加速器的端点。将 Route 53 中的 DNS 记录更新为多值应答记录。将 Global Accelerator IP 地址设置为值。使用 MQTT broker 存储数据。
options.D: 设置 AWS IoT Greengrass 以接收传感器数据。更新 Route 53 中的 DNS 记录，使其指向 AWS IoT Greengrass 端点。配置一条 AWS IoT 规则来调用 AWS Lambda 函数以存储数据。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

当前设计使用一个**托管在单个 EC2 上的自定义 MQTT broker**作为数百万传感器的接入点。该 broker 已经发生过过载，导致数据丢失。要求是提高 MQTT 接入的可靠性和可扩展性，然后将数据存储在 DynamoDB 中。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 设置 AWS IoT Core 以接收传感器数据。创建并配置自定义域名以连接到 AWS IoT Core。更新 Route 53 中的 DNS 记录，使其指向 AWS IoT Core Data-ATS 端点。配置一条 AWS IoT 规则来存储数据。**

AWS IoT Core 是用于设备连接和 MQTT 消息接入的 AWS 托管服务。AWS 文档指出，AWS IoT 云服务使用 MQTT、HTTPS、SDK、CLI 和 API 连接设备，而 MQTT 文档展示了设备如何使用 MQTT 协议以及基于 WebSocket Secure 的 MQTT 连接到 AWS IoT。这可以直接用托管的 IoT 接入层替换过载的自管理 MQTT broker。请参阅 [What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html) 和 [MQTT - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/mqtt.html)。

题目还要求保留现有的设备 DNS 名称 `iot.example.com`。AWS IoT Core 域配置支持这种迁移模式：文档列出的用例包括**将设备迁移到 AWS IoT Core**，以及**在将应用程序基础设施迁移到 AWS IoT Core 时通过域名保持品牌标识**。它还定义了默认 AWS IoT 数据端点（例如 `iot:Data-ATS`）以及用于设备连接的客户管理/自定义域名。请参阅 [What is a domain configuration?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-domain-configuration-what-is.html)。

最后，AWS IoT 规则可以将 MQTT 消息直接路由到 DynamoDB。关于将设备数据存储到 DynamoDB 的 AWS IoT 教程展示了如何创建一条 AWS IoT 规则，其 SQL 语句监听主题筛选器上的 MQTT 消息，并配置一个 **DynamoDB** 规则操作，将消息数据写入表中。请参阅 [Tutorial: Storing device data in a DynamoDB table](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-ddb-rule.html)。

因此，选项 B 是最可靠且在运营上最合适的解决方案：它消除了单实例 broker 瓶颈，使用托管的 AWS IoT MQTT 接入服务，通过自定义域名保留面向设备的 DNS 名称，并使用 IoT 规则将传入消息存储到 DynamoDB 中。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. ALB + 用于 MQTT broker 的 Auto Scaling group

这仍然让公司负责运行和扩展 MQTT broker 实例。更重要的是，Application Load Balancer 是为 HTTP/HTTPS 监听器协议设计的。ALB 监听器文档指出，Application Load Balancer 监听器支持 **HTTP** 和 **HTTPS** 协议。基于 TCP 的原生 MQTT 并不适合 ALB 监听器。请参阅 [Listeners for your Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)。

虽然 Auto Scaling 可以提升容量，但它无法提供 AWS IoT Core 所提供的托管 IoT 消息 broker、设备身份、规则引擎以及直接服务集成。

### C. NLB + Global Accelerator + 相同的 MQTT broker

Network Load Balancer 和 Global Accelerator 可以改善网络可用性和路由，但此选项仍然使用**相同的 MQTT broker 作为目标**，并且说使用 MQTT broker 来存储数据。它没有消除题目中描述的应用层瓶颈或单 broker 故障/过载风险。Elastic Load Balancing 可以在多个目标之间分配流量并提高容错能力，但选项 C 注册的是现有 broker，而不是用托管的可扩展服务替换接入层。请参阅 [What is Elastic Load Balancing?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)。

### D. AWS IoT Greengrass

AWS IoT Greengrass 不是用于数百万传感器的集中式 AWS Cloud MQTT 接入服务。Greengrass 文档将其描述为一种 **IoT edge runtime and cloud service**，用于在设备上构建、部署和管理 IoT 应用程序；它使设备能够在本地对生成的数据采取操作，在数据生成位置附近筛选/聚合数据，并与 AWS IoT Core 通信。请参阅 [What is AWS IoT Greengrass?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/greengrass/v2/developerguide/what-is-iot-greengrass.html)。

这是一个边缘计算解决方案，并不是替换 `iot.example.com` 后面的云托管 MQTT broker 端点的正确方案。此外，该选项提到将 Route 53 更新为指向 “AWS IoT Greengrass endpoint”，这不是将设备集中接入 AWS 的典型架构。

## 结论

正确答案是 **B**，因为 AWS IoT Core 提供托管 MQTT 接入，支持用于迁移现有设备端点的自定义域配置，并且可以通过 AWS IoT 规则将消息路由到 DynamoDB。

en.question: A company has Linux-based Amazon EC2 instances. Users must access the instances by using SSH with EC2 SSH key pairs. Each machine requires a unique EC2 key pair. The company wants to implement a key rotation policy that will, upon request, automatically rotate all the EC2 key pairs and keep the keys in a securely encrypted place. The company will accept less than 1 minute of downtime during key rotation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store all the keys in AWS Secrets Manager. Define a Secrets Manager rotation schedule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate new key pairs. Replace public keys on EC2 instances. Update the private keys in Secrets Manager.
options.B: Store all the keys in Parameter Store, a capability of AWS Systems Manager, as a string. Define a Systems Manager maintenance window to invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate new key pairs. Replace public keys on EC2 instances. Update the private keys in Parameter Store.
options.C: Import the EC2 key pairs into AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure automatic key rotation for these key pairs. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to initiate the key rotation in AWS KMS.
options.D: Add all the EC2 instances to Fleet Manager, a capability of AWS Systems Manager. Define a Systems Manager maintenance window to issue a Systems Manager Run Command document to generate new key pairs and to rotate public keys to all the instances in Fleet Manager.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company must rotate **unique SSH key pairs for Linux EC2 instances**, on request, with the private keys kept in a secure encrypted store and with less than 1 minute of downtime. For Linux EC2 key pairs, AWS documentation states that the key pair consists of a public and private key; the **public key is placed on the Linux instance in `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`**, and users SSH with the corresponding private key. AWS also notes that the private key must be stored securely because anyone who has it can connect to the instance ([Amazon EC2 key pairs and Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-key-pairs.html)).

## Correct answer: A

**A. Store all the keys in AWS Secrets Manager. Define a Secrets Manager rotation schedule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate new key pairs. Replace public keys on EC2 instances. Update the private keys in Secrets Manager.**

This is the best fit because:

* **Secrets Manager is intended to store and rotate secrets.** AWS documentation says Secrets Manager helps manage, retrieve, and rotate secrets throughout their lifecycle, and that you can configure an automatic rotation schedule for secrets ([What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)).
* **Secrets Manager supports Lambda-based custom rotation.** For many secret types, Secrets Manager invokes a Lambda function according to the rotation schedule, and the Lambda function performs the service-specific update work ([Rotation by Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_lambda.html)). For SSH key rotation, that custom Lambda can generate a new key pair, update the instance-side public key, test access, and then mark the new private key version as current in Secrets Manager.
* **It can also support on-request rotation.** The question says rotation must occur “upon request.” Secrets Manager supports immediate rotation for a secret that already has rotation configured, including through the CLI `rotate-secret` command ([Rotate an AWS Secrets Manager secret immediately](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_now.html)).
* **No EC2 stop/start is required.** Since the relevant Linux-side change is replacing the public key entry in `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, the process can be done in place, avoiding instance downtime other than any brief SSH access transition.

Therefore, option A satisfies the secure storage, custom per-instance key generation, rotation orchestration, and low-downtime requirements.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Parameter Store as a string with a maintenance window

Parameter Store can store parameters, and `SecureString` parameters can be encrypted with AWS KMS. However, this option specifically says to store the keys **as a string**, not as a `SecureString`. That does not meet the requirement to keep private keys in a securely encrypted place. Also, Parameter Store is not the purpose-built secret rotation service in this scenario; Secrets Manager provides the rotation workflow and Lambda rotation integration.

### C. Import EC2 key pairs into AWS KMS and use KMS key rotation

This confuses **SSH key pairs** with **KMS keys**. AWS KMS automatic rotation rotates KMS key material, not EC2 SSH key pairs. The AWS KMS documentation states that automatic key rotation applies to symmetric encryption KMS keys whose key material was generated by AWS KMS; it cannot automatically rotate asymmetric KMS keys, HMAC KMS keys, keys with imported key material, or custom key store keys ([Enable automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)). Rotating a KMS key would not update `authorized_keys` on Linux instances or create new SSH private keys for users.

### D. Fleet Manager and Run Command only

Systems Manager Run Command could help execute scripts on instances, but this option does not provide a secure encrypted central store for the generated private keys. It also does not define a Secrets Manager-style lifecycle for storing, versioning, and rotating the private key material. Because the requirement explicitly includes keeping keys in a securely encrypted place, this option is incomplete.

## Final answer

**A** is the correct solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有基于 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例。用户必须使用带有 EC2 SSH 密钥对的 SSH 访问这些实例。每台机器都需要一个唯一的 EC2 密钥对。公司希望实施一项密钥轮换策略，该策略将在收到请求时自动轮换所有 EC2 密钥对，并将密钥保存在安全加密的位置。公司可以接受密钥轮换期间少于 1 分钟的停机时间。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。定义 Secrets Manager 轮换计划，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来生成新的密钥对。替换 EC2 实例上的公钥。更新 Secrets Manager 中的私钥。
options.B: 将所有密钥作为字符串存储在 Parameter Store（AWS Systems Manager 的一项功能）中。定义 Systems Manager 维护时段，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来生成新的密钥对。替换 EC2 实例上的公钥。更新 Parameter Store 中的私钥。
options.C: 将 EC2 密钥对导入 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)。为这些密钥对配置自动密钥轮换。创建 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来启动 AWS KMS 中的密钥轮换。
options.D: 将所有 EC2 实例添加到 Fleet Manager（AWS Systems Manager 的一项功能）中。定义 Systems Manager 维护时段，以发布 Systems Manager Run Command 文档来生成新的密钥对，并将公钥轮换到 Fleet Manager 中的所有实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

公司必须按请求轮换 **Linux EC2 实例的唯一 SSH 密钥对**，并将私钥保存在安全的加密存储中，且停机时间少于 1 分钟。对于 Linux EC2 密钥对，AWS 文档说明密钥对由公钥和私钥组成；**公钥会放置在 Linux 实例的 `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` 中**，用户使用相应的私钥通过 SSH 连接。AWS 还指出，私钥必须安全存储，因为任何拥有私钥的人都可以连接到该实例（[Amazon EC2 key pairs and Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-key-pairs.html)）。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 将所有密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。定义 Secrets Manager 轮换计划，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来生成新的密钥对。替换 EC2 实例上的公钥。更新 Secrets Manager 中的私钥。**

这是最符合要求的方案，因为：

* **Secrets Manager 旨在存储和轮换密钥。** AWS 文档说明，Secrets Manager 可帮助在密钥的整个生命周期内管理、检索和轮换密钥，并且你可以为密钥配置自动轮换计划（[What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。
* **Secrets Manager 支持基于 Lambda 的自定义轮换。** 对于许多密钥类型，Secrets Manager 会根据轮换计划调用 Lambda 函数，而 Lambda 函数会执行特定于服务的更新工作（[Rotation by Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_lambda.html)）。对于 SSH 密钥轮换，该自定义 Lambda 可以生成新的密钥对，更新实例端的公钥，测试访问，然后将新的私钥版本标记为 Secrets Manager 中的当前版本。
* **它也可以支持按请求轮换。** 题目说轮换必须在“upon request”时发生。Secrets Manager 支持对已配置轮换的密钥进行立即轮换，包括通过 CLI `rotate-secret` 命令执行（[Rotate an AWS Secrets Manager secret immediately](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_now.html)）。
* **不需要停止/启动 EC2。** 由于相关的 Linux 端更改是替换 `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` 中的公钥条目，因此该过程可以就地完成，除了短暂的 SSH 访问切换外，可以避免实例停机。

因此，选项 A 满足安全存储、自定义按实例密钥生成、轮换编排以及低停机时间要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. Parameter Store 作为字符串并使用维护时段

Parameter Store 可以存储参数，`SecureString` 参数可以使用 AWS KMS 加密。但是，此选项明确说将密钥**作为字符串**存储，而不是作为 `SecureString`。这不满足将私钥保存在安全加密位置的要求。此外，在此场景中，Parameter Store 不是专门构建的密钥轮换服务；Secrets Manager 提供轮换工作流和 Lambda 轮换集成。

### C. 将 EC2 密钥对导入 AWS KMS 并使用 KMS 密钥轮换

这混淆了 **SSH 密钥对**和 **KMS 密钥**。AWS KMS 自动轮换会轮换 KMS 密钥材料，而不是 EC2 SSH 密钥对。AWS KMS 文档说明，自动密钥轮换适用于其密钥材料由 AWS KMS 生成的对称加密 KMS 密钥；它无法自动轮换非对称 KMS 密钥、HMAC KMS 密钥、具有导入密钥材料的密钥或自定义密钥存储中的密钥（[Enable automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)）。轮换 KMS 密钥不会更新 Linux 实例上的 `authorized_keys`，也不会为用户创建新的 SSH 私钥。

### D. 仅使用 Fleet Manager 和 Run Command

Systems Manager Run Command 可以帮助在实例上执行脚本，但此选项没有为生成的私钥提供安全加密的集中存储。它也没有定义类似 Secrets Manager 的生命周期，用于存储、版本控制和轮换私钥材料。由于要求明确包括将密钥保存在安全加密的位置，因此此选项不完整。

## 最终答案

**A** 是正确的解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to migrate to AWS. The company is running thousands of VMs in a VMware ESXi environment. The company has no configuration management database and has little knowledge about the utilization of the VMware portfolio. A solutions architect must provide the company with an accurate inventory so that the company can plan for a cost-effective migration. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to deploy Migration Evaluator to each VM. Review the collected data in Amazon QuickSight. Identify servers that have high utilization. Remove the servers that have high utilization from the migration list. Import the data to AWS Migration Hub.
options.B: Export the VMware portfolio to a .csv file. Check the disk utilization for each server. Remove servers that have high utilization. Export the data to AWS Application Migration Service. Use AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) to migrate the remaining servers.
options.C: Deploy the Migration Evaluator agentless collector to the ESXi hypervisor. Review the collected data in Migration Evaluator. Identify inactive servers. Remove the inactive servers from the migration list. Import the data to AWS Migration Hub.
options.D: Deploy the AWS Application Migration Service Agent to each VM. When the data is collected, use Amazon Redshift to import and analyze the data. Use Amazon QuickSight for data visualization.

en.explanation:
The company is in an early migration-planning/discovery phase: it has thousands of VMware VMs, no CMDB, and little utilization knowledge. The requirement is an accurate inventory for cost-effective migration with the **least operational overhead**.

**Correct answer: C. Deploy the Migration Evaluator agentless collector, review the collected data, remove inactive servers, and import/view the data in AWS Migration Hub.**

AWS documentation describes Migration Evaluator as a discovery, planning, and recommendation tool. It supports an **agentless** discovery method and can discover virtual servers, server profiles, attached storage, and utilization data such as CPU, storage, IOPS, throughput, and related time-series utilization metrics ([Migration Evaluator - AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-tools/discovery-migration-evaluator.html)). For VMware environments, the Agentless Collector VMware vCenter module is specifically used to collect **server inventory, profile, and utilization data from VMware VMs** ([Setting up the Agentless Collector data collection module for VMware vCenter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/agentless-collector-gs-vcenter.html)). AWS also documents that collected VMware inventory data can be viewed in the **AWS Migration Hub console**, and recommends collecting data for weeks for TCO and migration planning activities ([Viewing VMware data collection details](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/agentless-collector-gs-vcenter-details.html)).

This matches the scenario because it avoids installing agents on thousands of VMs, provides the needed inventory and utilization data, and helps identify inactive/unused servers that should not be migrated, reducing migration cost.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Use Systems Manager Patch Manager to deploy Migration Evaluator to each VM...**  
This is not the least overhead and is conceptually wrong. Migration Evaluator/agentless discovery is intended to avoid per-VM agent installation. Systems Manager Patch Manager is for patching managed instances, not deploying Migration Evaluator for VMware inventory. Also, removing **high-utilization** servers from the migration list is not a valid cost-optimization strategy; high utilization might indicate important workloads that need appropriately sized targets.

**B. Export the VMware portfolio to CSV... use AWS SMS...**  
This is highly manual and does not meet the requirement for accurate utilization-based inventory with least overhead. Manually checking disk utilization for thousands of VMs is operationally expensive and incomplete. The option also says to remove high-utilization servers, which is not an appropriate migration-planning rule. AWS Server Migration Service is not the right discovery/inventory solution for this planning problem.

**D. Deploy the AWS Application Migration Service Agent to each VM... analyze with Redshift and QuickSight.**  
AWS Application Migration Service is primarily for migration/replication, not low-overhead portfolio discovery. Installing an agent on each of thousands of VMs creates substantial operational overhead. Redshift and QuickSight add unnecessary data warehousing and visualization complexity when Migration Evaluator and Migration Hub already provide the needed discovery/planning workflow.

zh.question: 一家公司想要迁移到 AWS。该公司在 VMware ESXi 环境中运行着数千台 VM。该公司没有配置管理数据库，并且对 VMware 组合的利用率了解很少。一名解决方案架构师必须为该公司提供准确的清单，以便该公司能够规划具有成本效益的迁移。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 将 Migration Evaluator 部署到每台 VM。查看 Amazon QuickSight 中收集到的数据。识别利用率高的服务器。将利用率高的服务器从迁移列表中移除。将数据导入 AWS Migration Hub。
options.B: 将 VMware 组合导出为 .csv 文件。检查每台服务器的磁盘利用率。移除利用率高的服务器。将数据导出到 AWS Application Migration Service。使用 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 迁移其余服务器。
options.C: 将 Migration Evaluator agentless collector 部署到 ESXi hypervisor。查看 Migration Evaluator 中收集到的数据。识别不活跃的服务器。将不活跃的服务器从迁移列表中移除。将数据导入 AWS Migration Hub。
options.D: 将 AWS Application Migration Service Agent 部署到每台 VM。收集数据后，使用 Amazon Redshift 导入并分析数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 进行数据可视化。

zh.explanation:
该公司处于早期的迁移规划/发现阶段：它有数千台 VMware VM，没有 CMDB，并且对利用率了解很少。要求是以**最少的运营开销**获得准确清单，用于具有成本效益的迁移。

**正确答案：C。部署 Migration Evaluator agentless collector，查看收集到的数据，移除不活跃的服务器，并将数据导入/查看于 AWS Migration Hub。**

AWS 文档将 Migration Evaluator 描述为一种发现、规划和建议工具。它支持一种 **agentless** 发现方法，并且可以发现虚拟服务器、服务器配置文件、挂载存储，以及 CPU、存储、IOPS、吞吐量和相关时间序列利用率指标等利用率数据（[Migration Evaluator - AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-tools/discovery-migration-evaluator.html)）。对于 VMware 环境，Agentless Collector VMware vCenter 模块专门用于从 VMware VM 收集**服务器清单、配置文件和利用率数据**（[Setting up the Agentless Collector data collection module for VMware vCenter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/agentless-collector-gs-vcenter.html)）。AWS 还记录了收集到的 VMware 清单数据可以在 **AWS Migration Hub console** 中查看，并建议收集数周数据以用于 TCO 和迁移规划活动（[Viewing VMware data collection details](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/agentless-collector-gs-vcenter-details.html)）。

这与场景相匹配，因为它避免在数千台 VM 上安装代理，提供所需的清单和利用率数据，并帮助识别不应迁移的不活跃/未使用服务器，从而降低迁移成本。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 使用 Systems Manager Patch Manager 将 Migration Evaluator 部署到每台 VM...**  
这不是最少开销，并且在概念上是错误的。Migration Evaluator/agentless discovery 旨在避免在每台 VM 上安装代理。Systems Manager Patch Manager 用于为托管实例打补丁，而不是为 VMware 清单部署 Migration Evaluator。此外，从迁移列表中移除**高利用率**服务器并不是有效的成本优化策略；高利用率可能表示重要工作负载，需要适当规格的目标环境。

**B. 将 VMware 组合导出为 CSV... 使用 AWS SMS...**  
这非常手动，并且不满足以最少开销获得基于准确利用率的清单这一要求。手动检查数千台 VM 的磁盘利用率在运营上成本高昂且不完整。该选项还说要移除高利用率服务器，这并不是合适的迁移规划规则。AWS Server Migration Service 不是解决此规划问题的正确发现/清单解决方案。

**D. 将 AWS Application Migration Service Agent 部署到每台 VM... 使用 Redshift 和 QuickSight 分析。**  
AWS Application Migration Service 主要用于迁移/复制，而不是低开销的组合发现。在数千台 VM 中的每一台上安装代理会造成大量运营开销。Redshift 和 QuickSight 增加了不必要的数据仓库和可视化复杂性，而 Migration Evaluator 和 Migration Hub 已经提供了所需的发现/规划工作流。

en.question: A company runs a microservice as an AWS Lambda function. The microservice writes data to an on- premises SQL database that supports a limited number of concurrent connections. When the number of Lambda function invocations is too high, the database crashes and causes application downtime. The company has an AWS Direct Connect connection between the company's VPC and the on-premises data center. The company wants to protect the database from crashes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Write the data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to read from the queue and write to the existing database. Set a reserved concurrency limit on the Lambda function that is less than the number of connections that the database supports.
options.B: Create a new Amazon Aurora Serverless DB cluster. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the existing database to Aurora Serverless. Reconfigure the Lambda function to write to Aurora.
options.C: Create an Amazon RDS Proxy DB instance. Attach the RDS Proxy DB instance to the Amazon RDS DB instance. Reconfigure the Lambda function to write to the RDS Proxy DB instance.
options.D: Write the data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Invoke the Lambda function to write to the existing database when the topic receives new messages. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function to be equal to the number of connections that the database supports.

en.explanation:
The microservice has bursty Lambda invocations, but the downstream target is an **existing on-premises SQL database** with a small concurrent connection limit. The requirement is to protect that database from crashes, not to migrate it or optimize cold starts.

**Correct answer: A.**

Writing requests to **Amazon SQS** decouples the producer side from the database-writing side. The queue absorbs spikes, and the Lambda consumer drains the queue at a controlled rate. AWS Lambda supports using SQS as an event source, and AWS documents that an SQS event source mapping can scale concurrent function instances unless you configure controls; AWS also documents maximum concurrency for SQS event sources and warns to align it with the function's reserved concurrency ([Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)). Most importantly for this option, **reserved concurrency can be used as an upper bound** for a Lambda function: AWS states that reserved concurrency is useful for limiting concurrency to prevent overwhelming downstream resources such as database connections ([Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)), and the reserved concurrency configuration page shows that a function can be assigned a fixed reserved concurrency value ([Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)). Setting that value lower than the database's supported connection count prevents too many concurrent database-writing Lambda executions.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B. Create Aurora Serverless and migrate with DataSync** — This is a database migration, not a protective control for the existing on-premises SQL database. The question emphasizes the existing on-premises database and asks to protect it from crashes. Migrating to Aurora is a much larger architectural change and does not directly satisfy the stated requirement to protect the current database.

- **C. Create an RDS Proxy DB instance and attach it to an Amazon RDS DB instance** — RDS Proxy is designed to pool and share connections for Amazon RDS/Aurora databases; AWS describes RDS Proxy in the Amazon RDS documentation as a proxy that establishes a database connection pool and controls connections to protect a database against oversubscription ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). However, the scenario's database is **on premises**, not an Amazon RDS DB instance, and the option explicitly says to attach the proxy to an Amazon RDS DB instance that does not exist in the scenario.

- **D. SNS with provisioned concurrency** — SNS is a publish/subscribe fanout service, not a buffering/controlled-drain mechanism like SQS. Also, **provisioned concurrency** pre-initializes execution environments to reduce latency; it is not the right control to cap database write concurrency. AWS contrasts provisioned concurrency with reserved concurrency and states that reserved concurrency is the mechanism useful for limiting concurrency to avoid overwhelming downstream resources ([Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). Provisioned concurrency equal to the database connection count could actually keep capacity ready for that many concurrent executions and does not prevent additional concurrency unless paired with reserved concurrency.

Therefore, **A** is the best solution: buffer writes in SQS and throttle database-writing Lambda concurrency with reserved concurrency below the database's connection limit.

zh.question: 一家公司将一个微服务作为 AWS Lambda 函数运行。该微服务将数据写入一个本地 SQL 数据库，该数据库支持的并发连接数有限。当 Lambda 函数调用次数过高时，数据库会崩溃并导致应用程序停机。该公司的 VPC 与本地数据中心之间有一条 AWS Direct Connect 连接。公司希望保护数据库免于崩溃。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 Lambda 函数从队列读取并写入现有数据库。为 Lambda 函数设置一个预留并发限制，使其低于数据库支持的连接数。
options.B: 创建一个新的 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库集群。使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从现有数据库迁移到 Aurora Serverless。重新配置 Lambda 函数以写入 Aurora。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon RDS Proxy 数据库实例。将 RDS Proxy 数据库实例附加到 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。重新配置 Lambda 函数以写入 RDS Proxy 数据库实例。
options.D: 将数据写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。当主题收到新消息时，调用 Lambda 函数将数据写入现有数据库。为 Lambda 函数配置预置并发，使其等于数据库支持的连接数。

zh.explanation:
该微服务存在突发性的 Lambda 调用，但下游目标是一个**现有的本地 SQL 数据库**，其并发连接限制较小。要求是保护该数据库免于崩溃，而不是迁移数据库或优化冷启动。

**正确答案：A。**

将请求写入 **Amazon SQS** 可以将生产者端与数据库写入端解耦。队列可以吸收峰值，而 Lambda 消费者以受控速率消耗队列。AWS Lambda 支持将 SQS 用作事件源，AWS 文档说明，除非配置控制项，否则 SQS 事件源映射可以扩展并发函数实例；AWS 还记录了 SQS 事件源的最大并发，并提醒要使其与函数的预留并发保持一致（[Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)）。对于此选项最重要的是，**预留并发可以用作 Lambda 函数的上限**：AWS 表示，预留并发可用于限制并发，以防止数据库连接等下游资源被压垮（[Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)），并且预留并发配置页面显示，可以为函数分配固定的预留并发值（[Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)）。将该值设置为低于数据库支持的连接数，可以防止出现过多并发的数据库写入 Lambda 执行。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B. 创建 Aurora Serverless 并使用 DataSync 迁移** — 这是数据库迁移，而不是对现有本地 SQL 数据库的保护性控制。题目强调现有的本地数据库，并要求保护它免于崩溃。迁移到 Aurora 是更大的架构变更，并不能直接满足保护当前数据库这一既定要求。

- **C. 创建 RDS Proxy 数据库实例并将其附加到 Amazon RDS 数据库实例** — RDS Proxy 旨在为 Amazon RDS/Aurora 数据库池化和共享连接；AWS 在 Amazon RDS 文档中将 RDS Proxy 描述为一种代理，它建立数据库连接池并控制连接，以保护数据库免受过度订阅的影响（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。但是，该场景中的数据库是**本地部署**的，不是 Amazon RDS 数据库实例，而且该选项明确说要将代理附加到场景中并不存在的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。

- **D. SNS 与预置并发** — SNS 是发布/订阅扇出服务，而不是像 SQS 那样用于缓冲/受控消耗的机制。此外，**预置并发**会预初始化执行环境以降低延迟；它不是限制数据库写入并发的正确控制手段。AWS 对比了预置并发与预留并发，并说明预留并发才是用于限制并发、避免压垮下游资源的机制（[Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。将预置并发设置为等于数据库连接数，实际上可能会为这么多并发执行保持就绪容量，并且除非与预留并发配合使用，否则不会阻止额外并发。

因此，**A** 是最佳解决方案：在 SQS 中缓冲写入，并使用预留并发将数据库写入 Lambda 的并发限制在数据库连接限制以下。

en.question: A company uses a Grafana data visualization solution that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance to monitor the health of the company's AWS workloads. The company has invested time and effort to create dashboards that the company wants to preserve. The dashboards need to be highly available and cannot be down for longer than 10 minutes. The company needs to minimize ongoing maintenance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate to Amazon CloudWatch dashboards. Recreate the dashboards to match the existing Grafana dashboards. Use automatic dashboards where possible.
options.B: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace. Configure a new Amazon CloudWatch data source. Export dashboards from the existing Grafana instance. Import the dashboards into the new workspace.
options.C: Create an AMI that has Grafana pre-installed. Store the existing dashboards in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Create an Auto Scaling group that uses the new AMI. Set the Auto Scaling group's minimum, desired, and maximum number of instances to one. Create an Application Load Balancer that serves at least two Availability Zones.
options.D: Configure AWS Backup to back up the EC2 instance that runs Grafana once each hour. Restore the EC2 instance from the most recent snapshot in an alternate Availability Zone when required.

en.explanation:
The company is running a self-managed Grafana deployment on a single EC2 instance. The key requirements are to preserve existing Grafana dashboards, provide high availability with very short downtime tolerance, and minimize ongoing maintenance. The best fit is to move from self-managed Grafana on EC2 to the managed AWS Grafana service.

**Correct answer: B. Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace, configure CloudWatch as a data source, export/import the dashboards.**

Amazon Managed Grafana is the lowest-operational-overhead option because AWS describes it as a **fully managed** data visualization service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale Grafana. The service manages provisioning, setup, scaling, and maintenance of the logical Grafana servers, so the company does not need to manage EC2 instances, patching, recovery, or Grafana server infrastructure itself ([What is Amazon Managed Grafana?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/what-is-Amazon-Managed-Service-Grafana.html)).

This option also preserves the existing Grafana investment: AWS documentation states that dashboards can be imported into an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace by uploading or pasting dashboard JSON, and selecting the required data source during import ([Importing dashboards](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/v12-dash-importing.html)). Amazon Managed Grafana also supports configuring **CloudWatch** as a data source, including adding the CloudWatch data source and setting authentication/permissions ([Manually add CloudWatch as a data source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/adding--CloudWatch-manual.html)). Therefore, exporting the existing dashboards from the EC2-hosted Grafana instance and importing them into a managed workspace meets the preservation, availability, and low-maintenance requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Migrate to Amazon CloudWatch dashboards and recreate dashboards.** This would require recreating the existing Grafana dashboards, which does not minimize effort and does not directly preserve the company's existing Grafana dashboard investment. It may reduce infrastructure maintenance, but it adds migration/recreation work and changes the dashboard platform.

- **C. Create an AMI, use EFS for dashboards, and run one EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group behind an ALB.** This still uses self-managed Grafana on EC2. The company would still be responsible for OS patching, Grafana upgrades, AMI maintenance, EFS configuration, Auto Scaling configuration, and operational troubleshooting. Also, setting minimum, desired, and maximum capacity to **one** does not provide true multi-instance high availability; an instance replacement can still cause downtime.

- **D. Use AWS Backup hourly and restore the EC2 instance when required.** Backup and restore is a disaster recovery approach, not a high-availability architecture. Restoring an EC2 instance from backup in another Availability Zone is unlikely to guarantee recovery within 10 minutes, especially with hourly backups and manual or semi-manual restore steps. It also keeps the Grafana environment self-managed.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer because it uses a managed Grafana service, supports CloudWatch as a data source, allows dashboard import, and has the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司使用运行在单个 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Grafana 数据可视化解决方案来监控公司 AWS 工作负载的运行状况。该公司投入了时间和精力创建仪表板，并希望保留这些仪表板。仪表板需要具备高可用性，并且停机时间不能超过 10 分钟。该公司需要尽量减少持续维护工作。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 迁移到 Amazon CloudWatch dashboards。重新创建仪表板，使其与现有 Grafana 仪表板匹配。尽可能使用自动仪表板。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区。配置一个新的 Amazon CloudWatch 数据源。从现有 Grafana 实例导出仪表板。将仪表板导入新工作区。
options.C: 创建一个预安装了 Grafana 的 AMI。将现有仪表板存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。创建一个使用新 AMI 的 Auto Scaling 组。将该 Auto Scaling 组的最小、期望和最大实例数设置为 1。创建一个至少服务于两个可用区的 Application Load Balancer。
options.D: 配置 AWS Backup 每小时备份一次运行 Grafana 的 EC2 实例。需要时，从备用可用区中最新的快照还原 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
该公司在单个 EC2 实例上运行自管理的 Grafana 部署。关键要求是保留现有 Grafana 仪表板，提供高可用性并满足非常短的停机容忍时间，同时最大限度减少持续维护。最佳选择是从 EC2 上的自管理 Grafana 迁移到 AWS 托管的 Grafana 服务。

**正确答案：B。创建 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区，将 CloudWatch 配置为数据源，并导出/导入仪表板。**

Amazon Managed Grafana 是运营开销最低的选项，因为 AWS 将其描述为一项**完全托管**的数据可视化服务，使部署、运行和扩展 Grafana 变得容易。该服务管理逻辑 Grafana 服务器的预置、设置、扩展和维护，因此公司无需自行管理 EC2 实例、打补丁、恢复或 Grafana 服务器基础设施（[什么是 Amazon Managed Grafana？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/what-is-Amazon-Managed-Service-Grafana.html)）。

此选项还保留了现有 Grafana 投入：AWS 文档说明，可以通过上传或粘贴仪表板 JSON，并在导入期间选择所需数据源，将仪表板导入 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区（[导入仪表板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/v12-dash-importing.html)）。Amazon Managed Grafana 还支持将 **CloudWatch** 配置为数据源，包括添加 CloudWatch 数据源并设置身份验证/权限（[手动添加 CloudWatch 作为数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/adding--CloudWatch-manual.html)）。因此，从 EC2 托管的 Grafana 实例导出现有仪表板并将其导入托管工作区，可以满足保留、可用性和低维护要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. 迁移到 Amazon CloudWatch dashboards 并重新创建仪表板。** 这需要重新创建现有 Grafana 仪表板，既不能最小化工作量，也不能直接保留公司现有的 Grafana 仪表板投入。它可能会减少基础设施维护，但会增加迁移/重新创建工作，并改变仪表板平台。

- **C. 创建 AMI，使用 EFS 存储仪表板，并在 ALB 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中运行一个 EC2 实例。** 这仍然是在 EC2 上使用自管理 Grafana。公司仍需负责操作系统补丁、Grafana 升级、AMI 维护、EFS 配置、Auto Scaling 配置以及运营故障排查。此外，将最小、期望和最大容量设置为**一**并不能提供真正的多实例高可用性；实例替换仍可能导致停机。

- **D. 每小时使用 AWS Backup，并在需要时还原 EC2 实例。** 备份和还原是一种灾难恢复方法，而不是高可用架构。从另一个可用区的备份还原 EC2 实例不太可能保证在 10 分钟内恢复，尤其是在每小时备份以及手动或半手动还原步骤的情况下。它也仍然让 Grafana 环境保持自管理。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为它使用托管的 Grafana 服务，支持 CloudWatch 作为数据源，允许导入仪表板，并且运营开销最少。

en.question: A company needs to migrate its customer transactions database from on premises to AWS. The database resides on an Oracle DB instance that runs on a Linux server. According to a new security requirement, the company must rotate the database password each year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Convert the database to Amazon DynamoDB by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT). Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function for yearly passtard rotation.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Store the password in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation. Configure a yearly rotation schedule.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to keep and rotate the connection string by using an AWS Lambda function on a yearly schedule.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon Neptune by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT). Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function for yearly password rotation.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company is migrating an on-premises Oracle customer transactions database to AWS and must rotate the database password once each year. The key selection criteria are **Oracle compatibility** and **least operational overhead** for password rotation.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Store the password in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation. Configure a yearly rotation schedule.**

Amazon RDS is the managed relational database service choice for continuing to run Oracle with reduced operational work. AWS documentation confirms that **Amazon RDS supports Oracle Database** editions such as Oracle Database 19c and 21c ([RDS for Oracle releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Concepts.database-versions.html)).

For the password rotation requirement, AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for storing and rotating credentials. Secrets Manager documentation states that rotation periodically updates credentials in both the secret and the database/service, and that automatic rotation can be configured ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). For database secrets, Secrets Manager provides rotation function templates for Amazon RDS and Aurora, including **Amazon RDS Oracle single user** and **Amazon RDS Oracle alternating users** templates ([AWS Secrets Manager rotation function templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/reference_available-rotation-templates.html)).

A yearly schedule is also supportable through a cron-based rotation schedule. Secrets Manager supports `cron()` schedule expressions for rotation, with fields for day/month and a required `*` year field; a schedule such as a specific day in a specific month runs annually. The documentation also notes that Secrets Manager rotation schedules cannot be more than a year apart, which is compatible with an annual rotation requirement ([Rotation schedules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_schedule.html)).

Therefore, **RDS for Oracle + Secrets Manager automatic rotation** meets the migration and security requirements with the least operational overhead.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Convert to DynamoDB, store password in Parameter Store, use CloudWatch/Lambda rotation

This option is wrong for several reasons:

* DynamoDB is a NoSQL key-value/document database, not a direct Oracle relational database target. Converting an Oracle transactions database to DynamoDB would require significant schema and application redesign.
* AWS SCT can help with schema conversion in heterogeneous migrations, but converting an Oracle transactional relational workload to DynamoDB is not the least-overhead path.
* Systems Manager Parameter Store does not provide the same built-in database credential rotation workflow as Secrets Manager. This option adds custom CloudWatch/Lambda operational complexity.

### C. Migrate to Amazon EC2 and use Parameter Store with Lambda rotation

Running Oracle on EC2 would preserve the database engine, but it increases operational overhead because the company would manage the operating system, database software, backups, patching, high availability design, and custom rotation logic. The requirement asks for the **least operational overhead**, so a managed RDS deployment is preferable. Parameter Store plus custom Lambda rotation is also more operationally intensive than Secrets Manager automatic rotation.

### D. Migrate to Neptune and use CloudWatch/Lambda rotation

Amazon Neptune is a graph database service, not an Oracle-compatible relational database target. Migrating an Oracle customer transactions database to Neptune would require a major data model and application redesign. In addition, this option again relies on custom CloudWatch/Lambda password rotation rather than Secrets Manager automatic rotation, so it does not minimize operational overhead.

## Conclusion

The best solution is **B** because it keeps the workload on an Oracle-compatible managed database service and uses AWS Secrets Manager’s automatic rotation capabilities for RDS Oracle credentials.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其客户交易数据库从本地迁移到 AWS。该数据库位于运行在 Linux 服务器上的 Oracle DB 实例中。根据新的安全要求，公司必须每年轮换一次数据库密码。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 将数据库转换为 Amazon DynamoDB。将密码存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来进行每年的密码轮换。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。将密码存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。开启自动轮换。配置每年一次的轮换计划。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 保存连接字符串，并通过按年度计划运行的 AWS Lambda 函数来轮换连接字符串。
options.D: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Neptune。创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来进行每年的密码轮换。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司正在将本地 Oracle 客户交易数据库迁移到 AWS，并且必须每年轮换一次数据库密码。关键选择标准是 **Oracle 兼容性**以及密码轮换的**最少运营开销**。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。将密码存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。开启自动轮换。配置每年一次的轮换计划。**

Amazon RDS 是在减少运维工作的同时继续运行 Oracle 的托管关系数据库服务选择。AWS 文档确认 **Amazon RDS 支持 Oracle Database** 版本，例如 Oracle Database 19c 和 21c（[RDS for Oracle releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Concepts.database-versions.html)）。

对于密码轮换要求，AWS Secrets Manager 专为存储和轮换凭证而设计。Secrets Manager 文档说明，轮换会定期更新密钥以及数据库/服务中的凭证，并且可以配置自动轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。对于数据库密钥，Secrets Manager 为 Amazon RDS 和 Aurora 提供轮换函数模板，包括 **Amazon RDS Oracle single user** 和 **Amazon RDS Oracle alternating users** 模板（[AWS Secrets Manager rotation function templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/reference_available-rotation-templates.html)）。

每年一次的计划也可以通过基于 cron 的轮换计划来支持。Secrets Manager 支持用于轮换的 `cron()` 计划表达式，其中包含日/月字段以及必需的 `*` 年字段；例如特定月份的特定日期这样的计划会每年运行一次。文档还指出，Secrets Manager 轮换计划之间的间隔不能超过一年，这与年度轮换要求兼容（[Rotation schedules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_schedule.html)）。

因此，**RDS for Oracle + Secrets Manager 自动轮换**能够以最少的运营开销满足迁移和安全要求。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 转换为 DynamoDB，将密码存储在 Parameter Store 中，并使用 CloudWatch/Lambda 轮换

此选项错误，原因有以下几点：

* DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 键值/文档数据库，不是直接的 Oracle 关系数据库目标。将 Oracle 交易数据库转换为 DynamoDB 需要重大的架构和应用程序重新设计。
* AWS SCT 可以在异构迁移中帮助进行架构转换，但将 Oracle 事务型关系工作负载转换为 DynamoDB 并不是开销最少的路径。
* Systems Manager Parameter Store 不提供与 Secrets Manager 相同的内置数据库凭证轮换工作流。此选项增加了自定义 CloudWatch/Lambda 的运营复杂性。

### C. 迁移到 Amazon EC2，并将 Parameter Store 与 Lambda 轮换结合使用

在 EC2 上运行 Oracle 可以保留数据库引擎，但会增加运营开销，因为公司需要管理操作系统、数据库软件、备份、补丁、高可用性设计以及自定义轮换逻辑。要求是**最少运营开销**，因此托管式 RDS 部署更合适。Parameter Store 加自定义 Lambda 轮换也比 Secrets Manager 自动轮换需要更多运营工作。

### D. 迁移到 Neptune，并使用 CloudWatch/Lambda 轮换

Amazon Neptune 是图数据库服务，而不是与 Oracle 兼容的关系数据库目标。将 Oracle 客户交易数据库迁移到 Neptune 需要对数据模型和应用程序进行重大重新设计。此外，此选项同样依赖自定义 CloudWatch/Lambda 密码轮换，而不是 Secrets Manager 自动轮换，因此不能最大限度减少运营开销。

## 结论

最佳解决方案是 **B**，因为它将工作负载保留在与 Oracle 兼容的托管数据库服务上，并使用 AWS Secrets Manager 的自动轮换功能来管理 RDS Oracle 凭证。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing an AWS account structure for a company that consists of multiple teams. All the teams will work in the same AWS Region. The company needs a VPC that is connected to the on-premises network. The company expects less than 50 Mbps of total traffic to and from the on- premises network. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that provisions a VPC and the required subnets. Deploy the template to each AWS account.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that provisions a VPC and the required subnets. Deploy the template to a shared services account. Share the subnets by using AWS Resource Access Manager.
options.C: Use AWS Transit Gateway along with an AWS Site-to-Site VPN for connectivity to the on-premises network. Share the transit gateway by using AWS Resource Access Manager.
options.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN for connectivity to the on-premises network.
options.E: Use AWS Direct Connect for connectivity to the on-premises network.

en.explanation:
The company has multiple teams/accounts in one Region, but the requirement is for **a VPC** connected to on-premises, with low total traffic (< 50 Mbps). The most cost-effective design is therefore to avoid creating many VPCs and avoid a transit hub or dedicated circuit when a single shared VPC and one VPN connection can satisfy the requirement.

Correct answers: **B and D**.

- **B. Create the VPC and subnets in a shared services account and share the subnets with AWS RAM.** AWS documentation states that VPC subnet sharing allows multiple AWS accounts to create resources in **shared, centrally managed VPCs**, while still using separate accounts for billing and access control. It also says this model reduces the number of VPCs that must be created and managed and can simplify network topology ([Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)). This directly matches the multi-team/account structure while maintaining one centrally managed VPC.
- **D. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN for on-premises connectivity.** AWS Site-to-Site VPN is specifically used to enable access between a VPC and remote/on-premises devices or networks, using IPsec VPN connections ([What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). The stated traffic is less than 50 Mbps, far below the documented standard VPN tunnel maximum bandwidth of up to 1.25 Gbps ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)). Therefore, a Site-to-Site VPN to the shared VPC is sufficient and cost-effective.

Incorrect options:

- **A. Deploy a VPC and subnets to each AWS account.** This creates multiple VPCs, increasing management overhead and likely requiring either multiple VPN connections or a hub architecture to connect all VPCs to on-premises. That is not the most cost-effective approach when the requirement can be met with one centrally managed shared VPC. AWS explicitly positions VPC subnet sharing as a way to reduce the number of VPCs created and managed ([Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)).
- **C. Use Transit Gateway with Site-to-Site VPN and share the transit gateway.** A transit gateway is useful as a hub to interconnect multiple VPCs and on-premises networks; the Site-to-Site VPN documentation describes a transit gateway as a transit hub for multiple VPCs/on-premises connectivity ([What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). However, because option B avoids multiple VPCs by using a shared VPC, Transit Gateway is unnecessary extra architecture and cost. The VPN quotas page also notes that Transit Gateway is recommended when connecting the same Site-to-Site VPN connection to **multiple VPCs**—which is not needed in the selected shared-VPC design ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)).
- **E. Use AWS Direct Connect.** Direct Connect is unnecessary for the stated bandwidth and cost objective. The requirement is under 50 Mbps, and a standard Site-to-Site VPN tunnel supports far more than that, up to 1.25 Gbps per tunnel according to AWS VPN quotas ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)).

Therefore, the most cost-effective combination is **B + D**: deploy one shared VPC in a shared services account, share subnets to team accounts with AWS RAM, and connect that VPC to on-premises using AWS Site-to-Site VPN.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一家由多个团队组成的公司设计 AWS 账户结构。所有团队都将在同一个 AWS 区域中工作。公司需要一个连接到本地网络的 VPC。公司预计进出本地网络的总流量小于 50 Mbps。哪一组步骤组合能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于预置一个 VPC 和所需的子网。将该模板部署到每个 AWS 账户。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于预置一个 VPC 和所需的子网。将该模板部署到一个共享服务账户。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 共享子网。
options.C: 使用 AWS Transit Gateway 以及 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 来连接本地网络。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 共享 transit gateway。
options.D: 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 来连接本地网络。
options.E: 使用 AWS Direct Connect 来连接本地网络。

zh.explanation:
该公司在一个 Region 中有多个团队/账户，但要求是需要连接到本地的 **一个 VPC**，并且总流量较低（< 50 Mbps）。因此，最具成本效益的设计是避免创建多个 VPC，并且在单个共享 VPC 和一个 VPN 连接即可满足要求时，避免使用传输中心或专用线路。

正确答案：**B 和 D**。

- **B. 在共享服务账户中创建 VPC 和子网，并使用 AWS RAM 共享子网。** AWS 文档指出，VPC 子网共享允许多个 AWS 账户在**共享的、集中管理的 VPC** 中创建资源，同时仍使用单独账户进行计费和访问控制。文档还说明，此模型减少了必须创建和管理的 VPC 数量，并且可以简化网络拓扑（[Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)）。这直接匹配多团队/账户结构，同时保持一个集中管理的 VPC。
- **D. 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 进行本地连接。** AWS Site-to-Site VPN 专门用于通过 IPsec VPN 连接，在 VPC 与远程/本地设备或网络之间启用访问（[What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。题述流量小于 50 Mbps，远低于文档中标准 VPN 隧道最高可达 1.25 Gbps 的最大带宽（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)）。因此，到共享 VPC 的 Site-to-Site VPN 已足够且具备成本效益。

错误选项：

- **A. 将 VPC 和子网部署到每个 AWS 账户。** 这会创建多个 VPC，增加管理开销，并且可能需要多个 VPN 连接或一个中心辐射型架构，才能将所有 VPC 连接到本地。当使用一个集中管理的共享 VPC 即可满足要求时，这不是最具成本效益的方法。AWS 明确将 VPC 子网共享定位为一种减少创建和管理的 VPC 数量的方法（[Share your VPC subnets with other accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)）。
- **C. 使用 Transit Gateway 与 Site-to-Site VPN 并共享 transit gateway。** transit gateway 可用作中心，用于互连多个 VPC 和本地网络；Site-to-Site VPN 文档将 transit gateway 描述为用于多个 VPC/本地连接的传输中心（[What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。但是，由于选项 B 通过使用共享 VPC 避免了多个 VPC，Transit Gateway 就是不必要的额外架构和成本。VPN 配额页面还指出，在将同一个 Site-to-Site VPN connection 连接到**多个 VPC** 时建议使用 Transit Gateway，而在所选的共享 VPC 设计中并不需要这样做（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)）。
- **E. 使用 AWS Direct Connect。** 对于题述带宽和成本目标，Direct Connect 没有必要。要求低于 50 Mbps，而根据 AWS VPN 配额，一个标准 Site-to-Site VPN 隧道支持的带宽远高于此，每条隧道最高可达 1.25 Gbps（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/vpn-limits.html)）。

因此，最具成本效益的组合是 **B + D**：在共享服务账户中部署一个共享 VPC，使用 AWS RAM 将子网共享给团队账户，并使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 将该 VPC 连接到本地。

en.question: A solutions architect at a large company needs to set up network security for outbound traffic to the internet from all AWS accounts within an organization in AWS Organizations. The organization has more than 100 AWS accounts, and the accounts route to each other by using a centralized AWS Transit Gateway. Each account has both an internet gateway and a NAT gateway for outbound traffic to the internet. The company deploys resources only into a single AWS Region. The company needs the ability to add centrally managed rule-based filtering on all outbound traffic to the internet for all AWS accounts in the organization. The peak load of outbound traffic will not exceed 25 Gbps in each Availability Zone. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create a new VPC for outbound traffic to the internet. Connect the existing transit gateway to the new VPC. Configure a new NAT gateway. Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances that run an open-source internet proxy for rule-based filtering across all Availability Zones in the Region. Modify all default routes to point to the proxy's Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Create a new VPC for outbound traffic to the internet. Connect the existing transit gateway to the new VPC. Configure a new NAT gateway. Use an AWS Network Firewall firewall for rule-based filtering. Create Network Firewall endpoints in each Availability Zone. Modify all default routes to point to the Network Firewall endpoints.
options.C: Create an AWS Network Firewall firewall for rule-based filtering in each AWS account. Modify all default routes to point to the Network Firewall firewalls in each account.
options.D: In each AWS account, create an Auto Scaling group of network-optimized Amazon EC2 instances that run an open-source internet proxy for rule-based filtering. Modify all default routes to point to the proxy's Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
