AWS Savings Plans 可为 1 年或 3 年承诺提供折扣，而 **Compute Savings Plans** 是灵活的选项，可应用于 **EC2、Fargate 和 Lambda**。AWS 声明，Compute Savings Plans 可为 EC2 使用量提供更低价格，而不受实例系列、大小、操作系统、租期或区域的影响，并且这也适用于 Fargate 和 Lambda 使用量（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。AWS 还明确列出 Compute Savings Plans 适用于 Amazon EC2、AWS Lambda 和 AWS Fargate 的使用量，而 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仅适用于 EC2 使用量（[Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)）。

对于 AWS Organizations 环境，管理账户级别的建议是正确范围，因为 AWS 在计算管理账户建议时，会考虑组织中所有已启用 RI/Savings Plans 折扣共享的账户的使用量，从而建议可最大化跨账户节省的承诺（[Understanding your recommendation calculations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-rec-calculations.html)）。这符合优化**整个组织的计算使用量**的要求，包括需求不均衡的账户。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 为组织购买 Reserved Instances，以匹配常见 EC2 实例。**  
Reserved Instances 是一种 EC2 定价选项，绑定到特定的 EC2 实例配置，例如实例类型和区域（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。它们不覆盖 Fargate 或 Lambda，因此无法优化此场景中的所有计算使用量。对于 EC2 系列、大小、区域或服务发生变化的情况，它们也不如 Compute Savings Plans 灵活。

**C. 为每个 EC2 使用量较高的成员账户购买 Reserved Instances。**  
这同样只覆盖 EC2，并忽略 Fargate 和 Lambda。此外，基于单个成员账户购买无法利用组织范围的优化。AWS Savings Plans 管理账户建议旨在在启用折扣共享时最大化跨账户节省（[Understanding your recommendation calculations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-rec-calculations.html)）。

**D. 从管理账户为每个成员账户购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。**  
EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仅适用于 EC2 使用量，不适用于 Fargate 或 Lambda（[Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)）。它们也不如 Compute Savings Plans 灵活，因为该场景包含多种计算服务和不可预测的工作负载需求。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为它使用组织范围、管理账户级别的建议，并且是列出的唯一能够覆盖 **EC2、Fargate 和 Lambda** 的承诺类型。

en.question: A company has hundreds of AWS accounts. The company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage all the accounts. The company has turned on all features. A finance team has allocated a daily budget for AWS costs. The finance team must receive an email notification if the organization's AWS costs exceed 80% of the allocated budget. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to track the costs and deliver the notifications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: In the organization's management account, use AWS Budgets to create a budget that has a daily period. Add an alert threshold and set the value to 80%. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the finance team.
options.B: In the organization’s management account, set up the organizational view feature for AWS Trusted Advisor. Create an organizational view report for cost optimization. Set an alert threshold of 80%. Configure notification preferences. Add the email addresses of the finance team.
options.C: Register the organization with AWS Control Tower. Activate the optional cost control (guardrail). Set a control (guardrail) parameter of 80%. Configure control (guardrail) notification preferences. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the finance team.
options.D: Configure the member accounts to save a daily AWS Cost and Usage Report to an Amazon S3 bucket in the organization's management account. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule a daily Amazon Athena query to calculate the organization’s costs. Configure Athena to send an Amazon CloudWatch alert if the total costs are more than 80% of the allocated budget. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the finance team.

en.explanation:
The company needs organization-wide cost tracking against a daily budget and email notification at 80% of that budget. The direct AWS service for this is AWS Budgets, created from the AWS Organizations management account so it can track organization/member-account cost data.

**Correct answer: A**

AWS Budgets supports cost budgets that set spending limits and send alerts when costs approach or exceed a threshold. The AWS documentation states that Budgets can create cost budgets and that optional notifications can be sent to an **Amazon SNS topic**, an email address, or both. It also gives an example of configuring notifications for **80 percent** of the budgeted amount. In an organization using consolidated billing, the management account can create budgets, including budgets that track member-account costs. See [Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html) and [Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html). Therefore, creating a daily cost budget with an 80% alert and SNS/email notification in the management account meets the requirement with the least operational complexity.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **B. Trusted Advisor organizational view** is not the right mechanism for budget threshold notifications. Trusted Advisor provides checks and recommendations, including cost optimization recommendations, and organizational view aggregates Trusted Advisor check results across accounts. It is not designed to enforce or alert on a custom daily organization-wide budget threshold such as 80%. See [AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html) and [Organizational view for AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/organizational-view.html).

- **C. AWS Control Tower guardrails/controls** are for multi-account governance and compliance controls, not daily AWS cost budget tracking and 80% budget email notifications. AWS Control Tower automates multi-account governance and applies controls, but AWS Budgets is the service intended for budget thresholds and notifications. See [What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html).

- **D. Cost and Usage Reports + Athena + EventBridge + CloudWatch** could be engineered to analyze costs, because AWS Cost and Usage Reports can deliver billing data to S3 and be queried with Athena. However, it is unnecessarily complex and does not use the managed AWS Budgets alerting feature that directly satisfies the requirement. See [What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html).

zh.question: 一家公司有数百个 AWS 账户。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织来管理所有账户。该公司已启用所有功能。财务团队为 AWS 成本分配了每日预算。如果该组织的 AWS 成本超过分配预算的 80%，财务团队必须收到电子邮件通知。解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案来跟踪成本并发送通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在组织的管理账户中，使用 AWS Budgets 创建一个周期为每日的预算。添加告警阈值并将值设置为 80%。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知财务团队。
options.B: 在组织的管理账户中，为 AWS Trusted Advisor 设置组织视图功能。创建用于成本优化的组织视图报告。设置 80% 的告警阈值。配置通知首选项。添加财务团队的电子邮件地址。
options.C: 将该组织注册到 AWS Control Tower。激活可选的成本控制（护栏）。将控制（护栏）参数设置为 80%。配置控制（护栏）通知首选项。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知财务团队。
options.D: 配置成员账户，将每日 AWS Cost and Usage Report 保存到组织管理账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon EventBridge 计划每日 Amazon Athena 查询，以计算组织的成本。配置 Athena，以便在总成本超过分配预算的 80% 时发送 Amazon CloudWatch 告警。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知财务团队。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要根据每日预算进行组织范围的成本跟踪，并在达到该预算的 80% 时发送电子邮件通知。用于此目的的直接 AWS 服务是 AWS Budgets，应从 AWS Organizations 管理账户创建，以便跟踪组织/成员账户的成本数据。

**正确答案：A**

AWS Budgets 支持成本预算，可以设置支出限制，并在成本接近或超过阈值时发送告警。AWS 文档说明，Budgets 可以创建成本预算，并且可选通知可以发送到 **Amazon SNS topic**、电子邮件地址，或两者同时发送。文档还给出了为预算金额的 **80 percent** 配置通知的示例。在使用统一账单的组织中，管理账户可以创建预算，包括跟踪成员账户成本的预算。请参阅 [Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html) 和 [Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html)。因此，在管理账户中创建一个带有 80% 告警和 SNS/电子邮件通知的每日成本预算，可以以最低的运维复杂性满足要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **B. Trusted Advisor organizational view** 不是用于预算阈值通知的正确机制。Trusted Advisor 提供检查和建议，包括成本优化建议；组织视图会跨账户聚合 Trusted Advisor 检查结果。它并非设计用于针对自定义的每日组织范围预算阈值（例如 80%）进行强制执行或告警。请参阅 [AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html) 和 [Organizational view for AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/organizational-view.html)。

- **C. AWS Control Tower guardrails/controls** 用于多账户治理和合规性控制，而不是每日 AWS 成本预算跟踪和 80% 预算电子邮件通知。AWS Control Tower 自动化多账户治理并应用控制，但 AWS Budgets 才是用于预算阈值和通知的服务。请参阅 [What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)。

- **D. Cost and Usage Reports + Athena + EventBridge + CloudWatch** 可以被工程化用于分析成本，因为 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 可以将账单数据交付到 S3，并可使用 Athena 查询。但是，这种方法不必要地复杂，并且没有使用直接满足要求的托管 AWS Budgets 告警功能。请参阅 [What are AWS Cost and Usage Reports?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)。

en.question: A company provides auction services for artwork and has users across North America and Europe. The company hosts its application in Amazon EC2 instances in the us-east-1 Region. Artists upload photos of their work as large-size. high-resolution image files from their mobile phones to a centralized Amazon S3 bucket created in the us-east-1 Region. The users in Europe are reporting slow performance for their image uploads. How can a solutions architect improve the performance of the image upload process?

options.A: Redeploy the application to use S3 multipart uploads.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and point to the application as a custom origin.
options.C: Configure the buckets to use S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances and create a scaling policy.

en.explanation:
The application and centralized S3 bucket are in **us-east-1**, but the performance complaint is specifically from users in **Europe** uploading large images. The key issue is therefore upload latency and throughput over a long geographic distance to a centralized S3 bucket.

**Correct answer: C. Configure the buckets to use S3 Transfer Acceleration.**

Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration is designed for exactly this pattern: clients uploading to a centralized bucket from geographically distant locations. AWS documentation states that Transfer Acceleration provides fast transfers over long distances by using globally distributed CloudFront edge locations and routing data to S3 over optimized network paths. The S3 performance guidelines specifically say it is useful for clients that upload to a centralized bucket from all over the world and for transfers across continents ([S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)). The Transfer Acceleration documentation also lists as a reason to use it: “Your customers upload to a centralized general purpose bucket from all over the world” ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). Since the bucket is in us-east-1 and European users are seeing slow uploads, enabling Transfer Acceleration on the bucket and using the accelerated endpoint is the best single option.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Redeploy the application to use S3 multipart uploads.** Multipart upload can improve uploads of large objects by splitting an object into parts and uploading parts separately; AWS documents the multipart upload process for large objects ([multipart upload overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)). However, the question emphasizes that the slowdown is experienced by users in Europe uploading to a centralized bucket in us-east-1. Multipart upload addresses large-object transfer mechanics, but it does not specifically minimize network latency caused by intercontinental distance. Transfer Acceleration is the more targeted solution.

- **B. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and point to the application as a custom origin.** CloudFront distributions are primarily used to cache and accelerate content delivery to users. Pointing CloudFront to the EC2 application as a custom origin would not directly optimize browser/mobile uploads into the centralized S3 bucket. S3 Transfer Acceleration already uses CloudFront edge locations specifically for optimized S3 transfers.

- **D. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances and create a scaling policy.** Auto Scaling would help if EC2 compute capacity were the bottleneck. The problem statement identifies slow image uploads to S3 from Europe, not overloaded EC2 instances. Scaling EC2 instances would not directly improve long-distance S3 upload performance.

Therefore, **C** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司为艺术品提供拍卖服务，用户遍布北美和欧洲。该公司将其应用程序托管在 us-east-1 区域的 Amazon EC2 实例中。艺术家使用手机将其作品照片以大尺寸、高分辨率图像文件的形式上传到在 us-east-1 区域创建的集中式 Amazon S3 存储桶。欧洲用户报告其图像上传性能较慢。解决方案架构师如何提高图像上传过程的性能？

options.A: 重新部署应用程序以使用 S3 分段上传。
options.B: 创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将应用程序指向为自定义源。
options.C: 将存储桶配置为使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。
options.D: 为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组并创建扩展策略。

zh.explanation:
应用程序和集中式 S3 存储桶位于 **us-east-1**，但性能投诉具体来自 **欧洲** 用户上传大型图像。因此，关键问题是到集中式 S3 存储桶的长地理距离导致的上传延迟和吞吐量。

**正确答案：C. 将存储桶配置为使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。**

Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 正是为这种模式而设计的：客户端从地理位置较远的地点上传到集中式存储桶。AWS 文档说明，Transfer Acceleration 通过使用全球分布的 CloudFront 边缘站点，并通过优化的网络路径将数据路由到 S3，从而在长距离传输中提供快速传输。S3 性能指南明确指出，它适用于客户端从世界各地上传到集中式存储桶以及跨洲传输的场景（[S3 性能指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)）。Transfer Acceleration 文档还将以下内容列为使用它的理由：“您的客户从世界各地上传到集中式通用存储桶”（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。由于存储桶位于 us-east-1，且欧洲用户上传缓慢，因此在存储桶上启用 Transfer Acceleration 并使用加速端点是最佳单一选项。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **A. 重新部署应用程序以使用 S3 分段上传。** Multipart upload 可以通过将对象拆分为多个部分并分别上传这些部分来改善大对象上传；AWS 记录了大对象的 multipart upload 流程（[multipart upload 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)）。但是，题目强调的是欧洲用户上传到 us-east-1 中的集中式存储桶时出现速度变慢。Multipart upload 解决的是大对象传输机制，但并不专门最小化由跨洲距离造成的网络延迟。Transfer Acceleration 是更有针对性的解决方案。

- **B. 创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将应用程序指向为自定义源。** CloudFront 分配主要用于缓存内容并加速向用户交付内容。将 CloudFront 指向 EC2 应用程序作为自定义源，并不会直接优化浏览器/移动端上传到集中式 S3 存储桶的过程。S3 Transfer Acceleration 已经专门使用 CloudFront 边缘站点来优化 S3 传输。

- **D. 为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组并创建扩展策略。** 如果 EC2 计算容量是瓶颈，Auto Scaling 会有所帮助。问题陈述指出的是来自欧洲的图像上传到 S3 速度慢，而不是 EC2 实例过载。扩展 EC2 实例不会直接改善长距离 S3 上传性能。

因此，**C** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company wants to containerize a multi-tier web application and move the application from an on- premises data center to AWS. The application includes web. application, and database tiers. The company needs to make the application fault tolerant and scalable. Some frequently accessed data must always be available across application servers. Frontend web servers need session persistence and must scale to meet increases in traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST ongoing operational overhead?

options.A: Run the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for data that is frequently accessed between the web and application tiers. Store the frontend web server session data in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS).
options.B: Run the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache frontend web server session data. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) with Multi-Attach on EC2 instances that are distributed across multiple Availability Zones.
options.C: Run the application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Configure Amazon EKS to use managed node groups. Use ReplicaSets to run the web servers and applications. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system across all EKS pods to store frontend web server session data.
options.D: Deploy the application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Configure Amazon EKS to use managed node groups. Run the web servers and application as Kubernetes deployments in the EKS cluster. Store the frontend web server session data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume that all applications will mount at the time of deployment.

en.explanation:
The application is being containerized and migrated to AWS. The requirements are: scalable/fault-tolerant container orchestration, shared frequently accessed data available to application servers, and durable/scalable session persistence for frontend web servers with the least ongoing operational overhead among the choices.

**Correct answer: D.**

Option D is the best fit because it combines managed Kubernetes worker node lifecycle, Kubernetes-native workload management, a managed session store, and shared file storage:

* **Amazon EKS managed node groups** reduce node operational overhead because AWS documentation states that managed node groups “create and manage Amazon EC2 instances for you,” and their Auto Scaling group is managed by Amazon EKS. The Auto Scaling group can also span the subnets specified for the group, supporting multi-AZ worker placement when configured across subnets ([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)).
* Running the web and application tiers as **Kubernetes Deployments** is the appropriate Kubernetes construct for scalable, self-healing stateless application workloads. Deployments manage ReplicaSets and support rolling updates, so this is preferable to directly managing ReplicaSets as in option C.
* **DynamoDB is appropriate for session storage**. AWS provides a DynamoDB session handler that stores application sessions in a DynamoDB table and abstracts reads/writes through the normal session interface. The documentation also recommends TTL for automatic session cleanup and notes that on-demand capacity can be used to meet variable traffic demand ([DynamoDB session handler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-php/v3/developer-guide/service_dynamodb-session-handler.html)). DynamoDB is fully managed, scalable, and fault tolerant, making it a better session persistence layer than a queue or shared file system.
* **Amazon EFS** is the right shared storage service for data that must be available across application servers/pods. Amazon EKS supports the Amazon EFS CSI driver for persistent volumes, including static and dynamic provisioning for EKS clusters ([Amazon EFS with Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect.** ECS on Fargate would have low operational overhead and EFS is a valid shared file system, but **Amazon SQS is not a session store**. SQS is a message queue for asynchronous message processing; queue messages are consumed and governed by visibility timeouts, which is not the same as persistent keyed session state for web servers. This breaks the session persistence requirement.

* **B is incorrect.** ElastiCache for Redis can be used for session caching, but the storage design is invalid for the stated multi-AZ requirement. Amazon EBS Multi-Attach volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, up to 16 Nitro-based instances, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for concurrent multi-server access without a clustered file system ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). Therefore, this option does not provide the required shared data availability across multiple AZs and has higher operational complexity.

* **C is incorrect.** EKS managed node groups and EFS are generally valid, but the option stores **frontend session data on EFS**. While possible, a shared file system is not the best managed/scalable session persistence mechanism compared with DynamoDB. Also, directly using **ReplicaSets** is less appropriate than using Kubernetes Deployments, which manage ReplicaSets and provide a higher-level operational model for application rollout and scaling.

Therefore, **D** best satisfies the requirements while avoiding the invalid session store in A, the single-AZ EBS Multi-Attach limitation in B, and the less suitable session/storage and workload-management design in C.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将一个多层 Web 应用程序容器化，并将该应用程序从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该应用程序包括 Web 层、应用程序层和数据库层。公司需要使该应用程序具备容错能力并可扩展。一些频繁访问的数据必须始终可供各应用程序服务器使用。前端 Web 服务器需要会话持久性，并且必须能够扩展以应对流量增加。哪种解决方案能够以最少的持续运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上运行该应用程序。对 Web 层和应用程序层之间频繁访问的数据使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。将前端 Web 服务器会话数据存储在 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 中。
options.B: 在 Amazon EC2 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上运行该应用程序。使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 来缓存前端 Web 服务器会话数据。在分布于多个可用区的 EC2 实例上使用带 Multi-Attach 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)。
options.C: 在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上运行该应用程序。配置 Amazon EKS 使用托管节点组。使用 ReplicaSets 运行 Web 服务器和应用程序。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。将该 EFS 文件系统挂载到所有 EKS pod 上，以存储前端 Web 服务器会话数据。
options.D: 在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上部署该应用程序。配置 Amazon EKS 使用托管节点组。将 Web 服务器和应用程序作为 Kubernetes deployments 在 EKS 集群中运行。将前端 Web 服务器会话数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷，所有应用程序将在部署时挂载该卷。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序正在被容器化并迁移到 AWS。要求包括：可扩展/容错的容器编排、可供应用程序服务器使用的共享频繁访问数据，以及在各选项中以最少持续运营开销为前端 Web 服务器提供持久且可扩展的会话持久性。

**正确答案：D。**

选项 D 最符合要求，因为它结合了托管的 Kubernetes 工作节点生命周期、Kubernetes 原生工作负载管理、托管会话存储以及共享文件存储：

* **Amazon EKS managed node groups** 可降低节点运营开销，因为 AWS 文档指出，托管节点组会“为您创建和管理 Amazon EC2 实例”，并且其 Auto Scaling group 由 Amazon EKS 管理。Auto Scaling group 还可以跨为该组指定的子网，在跨子网配置时支持多 AZ 工作节点放置（[Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。
* 将 Web 层和应用程序层作为 **Kubernetes Deployments** 运行，是用于可扩展、自愈的无状态应用程序工作负载的适当 Kubernetes 构造。Deployments 管理 ReplicaSets 并支持滚动更新，因此这比像选项 C 那样直接管理 ReplicaSets 更可取。
* **DynamoDB 适合用于会话存储**。AWS 提供 DynamoDB session handler，可将应用程序会话存储在 DynamoDB 表中，并通过常规会话接口抽象读/写。该文档还建议使用 TTL 进行自动会话清理，并指出可使用按需容量来满足可变流量需求（[DynamoDB session handler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-php/v3/developer-guide/service_dynamodb-session-handler.html)）。DynamoDB 是完全托管、可扩展且容错的，因此相比队列或共享文件系统，它是更好的会话持久层。
* **Amazon EFS** 是适用于必须跨应用程序服务器/pod 可用的数据的共享存储服务。Amazon EKS 支持用于持久卷的 Amazon EFS CSI driver，包括为 EKS 集群进行静态和动态预置（[Amazon EFS with Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A 不正确。** ECS on Fargate 确实具有较低的运营开销，EFS 也是有效的共享文件系统，但 **Amazon SQS 不是会话存储**。SQS 是用于异步消息处理的消息队列；队列消息会被消费，并受可见性超时控制，这与 Web 服务器所需的持久键值会话状态不同。这破坏了会话持久性要求。

* **B 不正确。** ElastiCache for Redis 可用于会话缓存，但其存储设计不符合题目所述的多 AZ 要求。Amazon EBS Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到**同一可用区**中的实例，最多可附加到 16 个基于 Nitro 的实例，并且 XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统如果没有集群文件系统，并不适合多服务器并发访问（[EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。因此，该选项不能在多个 AZ 中提供所需的共享数据可用性，并且运营复杂性更高。

* **C 不正确。** EKS managed node groups 和 EFS 通常是有效的，但该选项将**前端会话数据存储在 EFS 上**。虽然可行，但与 DynamoDB 相比，共享文件系统并不是最佳的托管/可扩展会话持久机制。此外，直接使用 **ReplicaSets** 不如使用 Kubernetes Deployments 合适，后者会管理 ReplicaSets，并为应用程序发布和扩展提供更高级别的运营模型。

因此，**D** 最能满足要求，同时避免了 A 中无效的会话存储、B 中单 AZ EBS Multi-Attach 限制，以及 C 中不太合适的会话/存储和工作负载管理设计。

en.question: A solutions architect is planning to migrate critical Microsoft SQL Server databases to AWS. Because the databases are legacy systems, the solutions architect will move the databases to a modern data architecture. The solutions architect must migrate the databases with near-zero downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Application Migration Service and the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT). Perform an in-place upgrade before the migration. Export the migrated data to Amazon Aurora Serverless after cutover. Repoint the applications to Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rehost the database. Set Amazon S3 as a target. Set up change data capture (CDC) replication. When the source and destination are fully synchronized, load the data from Amazon S3 into an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance.
options.C: Use native database high availability tools. Connect the source system to an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance. Configure replication accordingly. When data replication is finished, transition the workload to an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance.
options.D: Use AWS Application Migration Service. Rehost the database server on Amazon EC2. When data replication is finished, detach the database and move the database to an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance. Reattach the database and then cut over all networking.

en.explanation:
The company needs to migrate critical legacy Microsoft SQL Server databases to AWS with near-zero downtime. The best solution is to continuously synchronize the existing SQL Server databases to the AWS target, then perform a short final cutover.

**Correct answer: C. Use native database high availability tools. Connect the source system to an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance. Configure replication accordingly. When data replication is finished, transition the workload to an Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server DB instance.**

AWS Prescriptive Guidance describes SQL Server transactional replication as a native SQL Server technology that can be used with **Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instances**. Transactional replication takes an initial snapshot, applies it to the subscriber, and then continuously sends subsequent data and schema changes from the publisher to the subscriber. After the databases are synchronized, the migration process is to validate the target, briefly stop activity on the source, allow replication to complete, and cut over to the target SQL Server DB instance. AWS specifically recommends this approach for migrating with minimal downtime by using existing SQL Server replication strategies ([Transactional replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/trans-rep.html)).

Therefore, option C matches the near-zero-downtime requirement because it uses native SQL Server replication to keep the Amazon RDS for SQL Server target synchronized until cutover.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect** because AWS Application Migration Service is a server rehosting approach, and this option adds an in-place upgrade plus a post-cutover export to Amazon Aurora Serverless. Migrating from Microsoft SQL Server to Aurora is a heterogeneous database modernization effort that requires schema and application compatibility work. The described sequence does not provide a direct continuous replication path into the final Aurora target with a short cutover.

- **B is incorrect** because it uses Amazon S3 as an intermediate AWS DMS target and then requires a separate load from S3 into Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server. AWS DMS writes full-load and CDC data to S3 as files, such as CSV or Parquet files; CDC records include operation indicators such as insert, update, and delete markers ([Using Amazon S3 as a target for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html)). That staging pattern is not the same as continuously synchronizing directly into the final RDS database, and the additional load step would increase cutover time.

- **D is incorrect** because rehosting the database server on Amazon EC2 and then detaching and moving the database into RDS is not a near-zero-downtime RDS migration method. Amazon RDS for SQL Server supports native backup and restore by using `.bak` files stored in Amazon S3, which can be used to migrate databases to or from RDS, but this is a backup/restore process rather than a continuous detach-and-reattach replication cutover ([Importing and exporting SQL Server databases using native backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Procedural.Importing.html)).

**Final answer: C.**

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在计划将关键的 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库迁移到 AWS。由于这些数据库是遗留系统，解决方案架构师会将这些数据库迁移到现代数据架构。解决方案架构师必须以接近零停机时间迁移这些数据库。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 和 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)。在迁移前执行就地升级。在割接后将迁移的数据导出到 Amazon Aurora Serverless。将应用程序重新指向 Amazon Aurora。
options.B: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 重新托管数据库。将 Amazon S3 设置为目标。设置变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制。当源和目标完全同步后，将数据从 Amazon S3 加载到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例中。
options.C: 使用原生数据库高可用性工具。将源系统连接到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例。相应地配置复制。数据复制完成后，将工作负载迁移到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例。
options.D: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service。在 Amazon EC2 上重新托管数据库服务器。数据复制完成后，分离数据库并将数据库移动到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例。重新附加数据库，然后割接所有网络。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要以接近零停机时间将关键的遗留 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库迁移到 AWS。最佳解决方案是将现有 SQL Server 数据库持续同步到 AWS 目标，然后执行一次短暂的最终割接。

**正确答案：C。使用原生数据库高可用性工具。将源系统连接到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例。相应地配置复制。数据复制完成后，将工作负载迁移到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server 数据库实例。**

AWS Prescriptive Guidance 将 SQL Server 事务复制描述为一种原生 SQL Server 技术，可与 **Amazon RDS for SQL Server 数据库实例** 配合使用。事务复制会获取初始快照，将其应用到订阅服务器，然后持续将发布服务器上后续的数据和架构更改发送到订阅服务器。数据库同步后，迁移流程是验证目标，短暂停止源端活动，允许复制完成，并割接到目标 SQL Server 数据库实例。AWS 明确建议使用现有 SQL Server 复制策略，通过这种方法以最少停机时间进行迁移（[Transactional replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/trans-rep.html)）。

因此，选项 C 符合接近零停机时间的要求，因为它使用原生 SQL Server 复制来保持 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 目标同步，直到割接。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **A 不正确**，因为 AWS Application Migration Service 是一种服务器重新托管方法，而该选项还增加了就地升级以及割接后导出到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 的步骤。从 Microsoft SQL Server 迁移到 Aurora 是一种异构数据库现代化工作，需要进行架构和应用程序兼容性工作。所描述的流程并未提供到最终 Aurora 目标的直接持续复制路径，也无法实现短暂割接。

- **B 不正确**，因为它使用 Amazon S3 作为中间 AWS DMS 目标，然后需要从 S3 单独加载到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server。AWS DMS 会将全量加载和 CDC 数据作为文件写入 S3，例如 CSV 或 Parquet 文件；CDC 记录包括插入、更新和删除标记等操作指示符（[Using Amazon S3 as a target for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html)）。这种暂存模式不同于直接持续同步到最终 RDS 数据库，额外的加载步骤会增加割接时间。

- **D 不正确**，因为在 Amazon EC2 上重新托管数据库服务器，然后分离并将数据库移动到 RDS，并不是一种接近零停机时间的 RDS 迁移方法。Amazon RDS for SQL Server 支持使用存储在 Amazon S3 中的 `.bak` 文件进行原生备份和还原，可用于将数据库迁移到 RDS 或从 RDS 迁出，但这是备份/还原流程，而不是连续的分离并重新附加式复制割接（[Importing and exporting SQL Server databases using native backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/SQLServer.Procedural.Importing.html)）。

**最终答案：C。**

en.question: A company's solutions architect is analyzing costs of a multi-application environment. The environment is deployed across multiple Availability Zones in a single AWS Region. After a recent acquisition, the company manages two organizations in AWS Organizations. The company has created multiple service provider applications as AWS PrivateLink-powered VPC endpoint services in one organization. The company has created multiple service consumer applications in the other organization. Data transfer charges are much higher than the company expected, and the solutions architect needs to reduce the costs. The solutions architect must recommend guidelines for developers to follow when they deploy services. These guidelines must minimize data transfer charges for the whole environment. Which guidelines meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Resource Access Manager to share the subnets that host the service provider applications with other accounts in the organization.
options.B: Place the service provider applications and the service consumer applications in AWS accounts in the same organization.
options.C: Turn off cross-zone load balancing for the Network Load Balancer in all service provider application deployments.
options.D: Ensure that service consumer compute resources use the Availability Zone-specific endpoint service by using the endpoint's local DNS name.
options.E: Create a Savings Plan that provides adequate coverage for the organization's planned inter- Availability Zone data transfer usage.

en.explanation:
The environment uses AWS PrivateLink endpoint services across multiple Availability Zones. The cost problem is best addressed by keeping traffic in the same Availability Zone as much as possible: first from the service consumer to its interface endpoint network interface, and then from the provider-side Network Load Balancer to its targets. The correct answers are **C and D**.

**C. Turn off cross-zone load balancing for the Network Load Balancer in all service provider application deployments** is correct. For Elastic Load Balancing, AWS states that when cross-zone load balancing is enabled, each load balancer node distributes traffic across registered targets in all enabled Availability Zones. When cross-zone load balancing is disabled, each load balancer node distributes traffic only to targets in its own Availability Zone. AWS also notes that Network Load Balancers have cross-zone load balancing disabled by default and that it can be enabled or disabled after creation ([Elastic Load Balancing: How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). For a PrivateLink endpoint service backed by an NLB, keeping cross-zone load balancing turned off helps prevent a request that reaches a zonal NLB node from being forwarded to a backend target in a different Availability Zone.

**D. Ensure that service consumer compute resources use the Availability Zone-specific endpoint service by using the endpoint's local DNS name** is correct. AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints create Regional and zonal DNS names. The zonal DNS names include the Availability Zone name, and AWS states that if it is better for the use case, resources can send traffic to the service by using the endpoint network interface in the same Availability Zone, through the private zonal endpoint or the endpoint network interface IP address ([AWS PrivateLink: Access AWS services through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-aws-services.html)). This keeps consumer traffic directed to the local endpoint ENI instead of allowing Regional DNS resolution to select an endpoint ENI in another Availability Zone.

These two guidelines directly reduce avoidable inter-AZ traffic. AWS identifies data transfer between Availability Zones in the same Region as regional data transfer usage, which can appear as `DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes` charges ([AWS Data Exports: Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)).

The other options are incorrect:

* **A. Use AWS Resource Access Manager to share the subnets that host the service provider applications with other accounts in the organization** is not the right mechanism. Subnet sharing does not ensure that consumers use same-AZ endpoint ENIs or that provider NLBs route only to same-AZ targets. In addition, AWS documentation states that you cannot create, describe, modify, or delete VPC endpoints in subnets that are shared with you ([AWS PrivateLink: Create an interface endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-interface-endpoint.html)).
* **B. Place the service provider applications and the service consumer applications in AWS accounts in the same organization** does not minimize data transfer by itself. AWS Organizations is an account management and governance service; placing accounts in the same organization does not force PrivateLink traffic to stay within the same Availability Zone or change NLB cross-zone routing behavior.
* **E. Create a Savings Plan that provides adequate coverage for the organization's planned inter-Availability Zone data transfer usage** is not applicable. Savings Plans provide discounts in exchange for a commitment to a specified amount of compute usage, not a deployment design that minimizes inter-AZ data transfer ([Savings Plans: What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)).

Therefore, the best guidelines are to **disable cross-zone load balancing on the provider NLBs** and **have consumers use the local/zonal PrivateLink endpoint DNS names**: **C and D**.

zh.question: 一家公司的解决方案架构师正在分析一个多应用程序环境的成本。该环境部署在单个 AWS 区域中的多个可用区内。最近完成一次收购后，该公司在 AWS Organizations 中管理两个组织。该公司已在一个组织中创建了多个服务提供方应用程序，这些应用程序作为由 AWS PrivateLink 支持的 VPC endpoint services。该公司已在另一个组织中创建了多个服务使用方应用程序。数据传输费用远高于公司的预期，解决方案架构师需要降低成本。解决方案架构师必须建议开发人员在部署服务时遵循的准则。这些准则必须最大限度地减少整个环境的数据传输费用。哪些准则满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 与组织中的其他账户共享托管服务提供方应用程序的子网。
options.B: 将服务提供方应用程序和服务使用方应用程序放置在同一组织中的 AWS 账户内。
options.C: 在所有服务提供方应用程序部署中，关闭 Network Load Balancer 的跨区负载均衡。
options.D: 确保服务使用方计算资源通过使用端点的本地 DNS 名称来使用特定于可用区的 endpoint service。
options.E: 创建一个 Savings Plan，为组织计划的跨可用区数据传输使用量提供足够覆盖。

zh.explanation:
该环境跨多个可用区使用 AWS PrivateLink endpoint services。解决成本问题的最佳方法是尽可能让流量保持在同一可用区内：首先是从服务使用方到其 interface endpoint network interface，然后是从提供方侧 Network Load Balancer 到其目标。正确答案是 **C 和 D**。

**C. 在所有服务提供方应用程序部署中，关闭 Network Load Balancer 的跨区负载均衡** 是正确的。对于 Elastic Load Balancing，AWS 说明，当启用 cross-zone load balancing 时，每个负载均衡器节点会将流量分发到所有已启用可用区中的已注册目标。当禁用 cross-zone load balancing 时，每个负载均衡器节点只会将流量分发到其自身可用区中的目标。AWS 还指出，Network Load Balancers 默认禁用 cross-zone load balancing，并且可以在创建后启用或禁用（[Elastic Load Balancing: How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。对于由 NLB 支持的 PrivateLink endpoint service，保持关闭 cross-zone load balancing 有助于防止到达某个 zonal NLB 节点的请求被转发到不同可用区中的后端目标。

**D. 确保服务使用方计算资源通过使用端点的本地 DNS 名称来使用特定于可用区的 endpoint service** 是正确的。AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints 会创建 Regional 和 zonal DNS 名称。zonal DNS 名称包含可用区名称，并且 AWS 说明，如果更适合该使用场景，资源可以通过同一可用区中的 endpoint network interface，使用私有 zonal endpoint 或 endpoint network interface IP 地址将流量发送到服务（[AWS PrivateLink: Access AWS services through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-access-aws-services.html)）。这会将使用方流量定向到本地 endpoint ENI，而不是允许 Regional DNS 解析选择另一个可用区中的 endpoint ENI。

这两条准则直接减少可避免的跨 AZ 流量。AWS 将同一区域内可用区之间的数据传输标识为区域数据传输使用量，可能显示为 `DataTransfer-Regional-Bytes` 费用（[AWS Data Exports: Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)）。

其他选项不正确：

* **A. 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 与组织中的其他账户共享托管服务提供方应用程序的子网** 不是正确机制。子网共享并不能确保使用方使用同 AZ 的 endpoint ENIs，也不能确保提供方 NLB 只路由到同 AZ 的目标。此外，AWS 文档说明，你不能在共享给你的子网中创建、描述、修改或删除 VPC endpoints（[AWS PrivateLink: Create an interface endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-interface-endpoint.html)）。
* **B. 将服务提供方应用程序和服务使用方应用程序放置在同一组织中的 AWS 账户内** 本身并不能最大限度地减少数据传输。AWS Organizations 是账户管理和治理服务；将账户放在同一组织中并不会强制 PrivateLink 流量停留在同一可用区内，也不会改变 NLB cross-zone routing 行为。
* **E. 创建一个 Savings Plan，为组织计划的跨可用区数据传输使用量提供足够覆盖** 不适用。Savings Plans 通过承诺指定数量的计算使用量来提供折扣，而不是一种用于最大限度减少跨 AZ 数据传输的部署设计（[Savings Plans: What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。

因此，最佳准则是 **在提供方 NLBs 上禁用 cross-zone load balancing**，并且 **让使用方使用本地/zonal PrivateLink endpoint DNS 名称**：**C 和 D**。

en.question: A company has an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server database that writes a nightly 200 GB export to a local drive. The company wants to move the backups to more robust cloud storage on Amazon S3. The company has set up a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and AWS. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway within the VPC that is connected to the Direct Connect connection. Create a new SMB file share. Write nightly database exports to the new SMB file share.
options.B: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Single-AZ file system within the VPC that is connected to the Direct Connect connection. Create a new SMB file share. Write nightly database exports to an SMB file share on the Amazon FSx file system. Enable nightly backups.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ file system within the VPC that is connected to the Direct Connect connection. Create a new SMB file share. Write nightly database exports to an SMB file share on the Amazon FSx file system. Enable nightly backups.
options.D: Create a new S3 bucket. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway within the VPC that is connected to the Direct Connect connection. Create a new SMB file share. Write nightly database exports to the new SMB file share on the volume gateway, and automate copies of this data to an S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company produces a nightly 200 GB SQL Server export as a file and wants to place those backups in robust Amazon S3 storage, using an existing 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. The most cost-effective design should avoid provisioning a full managed Windows file system if the real target is S3 object storage, and should expose a protocol that the on-premises Windows/SQL Server backup process can write to easily.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Create an S3 bucket, deploy AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway, create an SMB file share, and write the nightly exports to that share.**

Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed exactly for this pattern: it provides a file interface to Amazon S3 and lets applications store and retrieve objects in S3 using standard file protocols such as **SMB** and NFS. AWS describes S3 File Gateway as a file system mount on Amazon S3 and states that it is a cost-effective alternative to on-premises storage with local caching and managed transfer to AWS ([AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

This means the SQL Server export job can write to an SMB file share, while the data is stored as objects in S3. Because the company already has Direct Connect, the on-premises environment can reach the gateway/VPC path with high bandwidth. This is simpler and more cost-effective than running FSx for Windows File Server merely as an intermediate backup target.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. FSx for Windows File Server Single-AZ with nightly backups

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server does provide managed Windows file storage and supports SMB file shares. AWS documents FSx as a fully managed Windows file server with SMB support, file systems, backups, throughput capacity, and provisioned storage capacity ([Amazon FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).

However, the requirement is specifically to move backup exports to **Amazon S3** cost-effectively. FSx introduces a managed Windows file system, provisioned capacity/throughput, and backups, which is unnecessary when the desired durable backend is S3. It is a valid SMB file share service, but not the most cost-effective S3-based backup landing solution.

### C. FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ with nightly backups

This has the same issue as option B, with even more cost. Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server is useful for highly available production SMB file workloads, but the question asks for cost-effective storage of nightly export files in S3. A Multi-AZ managed Windows file system plus backups is over-engineered for this backup-to-S3 use case.

### D. Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with SMB file share and copies to S3

This option is technically mismatched. Volume Gateway is not an SMB file-share gateway. AWS states that **Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed storage volumes that you mount as iSCSI devices** from on-premises application servers ([AWS Storage Gateway: What is Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). It supports cached and stored volumes, with data in S3 or snapshots backed up to S3, but it is block storage via iSCSI, not an SMB share.

Therefore, the statement “create a new SMB file share on the volume gateway” is not correct for Volume Gateway. It also adds extra copy automation and complexity, whereas S3 File Gateway directly presents an SMB share backed by S3.

## Conclusion

**Answer A** is the best choice because S3 File Gateway directly exposes an SMB share to the on-premises workload and stores the exported backup files in Amazon S3, satisfying the S3 durability requirement with the least unnecessary infrastructure.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个本地 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库，每晚会将 200 GB 的导出写入本地驱动器。该公司希望将备份迁移到 Amazon S3 上更可靠的云存储中。该公司已在本地数据中心和 AWS 之间建立了 10 Gbps 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket。在与 Direct Connect 连接相连的 VPC 内部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway。创建一个新的 SMB 文件共享。将每晚的数据库导出写入新的 SMB 文件共享。
options.B: 在与 Direct Connect 连接相连的 VPC 内创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Single-AZ 文件系统。创建一个新的 SMB 文件共享。将每晚的数据库导出写入 Amazon FSx 文件系统上的 SMB 文件共享。启用每晚备份。
options.C: 在与 Direct Connect 连接相连的 VPC 内创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ 文件系统。创建一个新的 SMB 文件共享。将每晚的数据库导出写入 Amazon FSx 文件系统上的 SMB 文件共享。启用每晚备份。
options.D: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket。在与 Direct Connect 连接相连的 VPC 内部署一个 AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway。创建一个新的 SMB 文件共享。将每晚的数据库导出写入 volume gateway 上新的 SMB 文件共享，并自动将这些数据复制到 S3 bucket。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司每晚生成一个 200 GB 的 SQL Server 导出文件，并希望使用现有的 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接，将这些备份放入可靠的 Amazon S3 存储中。最高成本效益的设计应避免在真正目标是 S3 对象存储时预置完整的托管 Windows 文件系统，并且应公开一种本地 Windows/SQL Server 备份流程可以轻松写入的协议。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 创建 S3 bucket，部署 AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway，创建 SMB 文件共享，并将每晚导出写入该共享。**

Amazon S3 File Gateway 正是为这种模式而设计：它为 Amazon S3 提供文件接口，并允许应用程序使用 **SMB** 和 NFS 等标准文件协议在 S3 中存储和检索对象。AWS 将 S3 File Gateway 描述为 Amazon S3 上的文件系统挂载，并说明它是一种具有本地缓存和到 AWS 托管传输能力的本地存储成本效益替代方案（[AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。

这意味着 SQL Server 导出作业可以写入 SMB 文件共享，而数据会作为对象存储在 S3 中。由于公司已经有 Direct Connect，本地环境可以通过高带宽访问网关/VPC 路径。这比仅将 FSx for Windows File Server 作为中间备份目标来运行更简单且更具成本效益。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. FSx for Windows File Server Single-AZ 并启用每晚备份

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 确实提供托管 Windows 文件存储并支持 SMB 文件共享。AWS 文档将 FSx 描述为完全托管的 Windows file server，支持 SMB、文件系统、备份、吞吐容量和预置存储容量（[Amazon FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。

但是，要求明确是以具有成本效益的方式将备份导出移动到 **Amazon S3**。FSx 引入了托管 Windows 文件系统、预置容量/吞吐量和备份，当所需的持久后端是 S3 时这些都是不必要的。它是有效的 SMB 文件共享服务，但不是最具成本效益的基于 S3 的备份落地解决方案。

### C. FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ 并启用每晚备份

它与选项 B 有相同的问题，而且成本更高。Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server 适用于高可用的生产 SMB 文件工作负载，但题目要求的是将每晚导出文件以具有成本效益的方式存储在 S3 中。Multi-AZ 托管 Windows 文件系统加备份，对于这种备份到 S3 的用例来说属于过度设计。

### D. Storage Gateway Volume Gateway，使用 SMB 文件共享并复制到 S3

该选项在技术上不匹配。Volume Gateway 不是 SMB 文件共享网关。AWS 表示，**Volume Gateway 提供云支持的存储卷，你可以从本地应用程序服务器将其作为 iSCSI 设备挂载**（[AWS Storage Gateway: What is Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。它支持缓存卷和存储卷，数据位于 S3 中或快照备份到 S3，但它是通过 iSCSI 提供的块存储，而不是 SMB 共享。

因此，“在 volume gateway 上创建新的 SMB 文件共享”这一说法对于 Volume Gateway 来说是不正确的。它还增加了额外的复制自动化和复杂性，而 S3 File Gateway 会直接呈现由 S3 支持的 SMB 共享。

## 结论

**答案 A** 是最佳选择，因为 S3 File Gateway 直接向本地工作负载公开 SMB 共享，并将导出的备份文件存储在 Amazon S3 中，以最少的不必要基础设施满足 S3 持久性要求。

en.question: A company needs to establish a connection from its on-premises data center to AWS. The company needs to connect all of its VPCs that are located in different AWS Regions with transitive routing capabilities between VPC networks. The company also must reduce network outbound traffic costs, increase bandwidth throughput, and provide a consistent network experience for end users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the on-premises data center and a new central VPC. Create VPC peering connections that initiate from the central VPC to all other VPCs.
options.B: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and AWS. Provision a transit VIF, and connect it to a Direct Connect gateway. Connect the Direct Connect gateway to all the other VPCs by using a transit gateway in each Region.
options.C: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the on-premises data center and a new central VPUse a transit gateway with dynamic routing. Connect the transit gateway to all other VPCs.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and AWS. Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between all VPCs in each Region. Create VPC peering connections that initiate from the central VPC to all other VPCs.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs private connectivity from an on-premises data center to AWS and connectivity among many VPCs in different AWS Regions with transitive routing. It also wants lower outbound network costs, higher bandwidth throughput, and a consistent network experience.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Create an AWS Direct Connect connection, provision a transit VIF to a Direct Connect gateway, and associate that Direct Connect gateway with transit gateways in the required Regions.**

This is the best match because:

* AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network path from the customer network to AWS, bypassing internet service providers in the normal network path, which supports a more consistent network experience than internet-based VPN connectivity ([What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
* Direct Connect supports high-speed dedicated connections, including 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps physical interface options, which meets the requirement to increase bandwidth throughput ([What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
* For Direct Connect, AWS documents specific Data Transfer Out billing behavior for private and transit virtual interfaces, and Direct Connect data transfer rates can apply for eligible outbound traffic, which aligns with the requirement to reduce outbound network traffic costs ([Pricing for Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
* A **transit virtual interface** is the correct VIF type when accessing one or more Amazon VPC Transit Gateways associated with Direct Connect gateways ([Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)).
* AWS explicitly documents that a Direct Connect gateway can connect a Direct Connect connection over a transit VIF to VPCs or VPNs attached to a transit gateway, and that a Direct Connect gateway supports communication between attached transit VIFs and associated transit gateways. It also notes the design consideration for multiple transit gateways in different Regions ([Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)).
* A Direct Connect gateway is globally available and can connect to Regions globally, and AWS describes using it to connect VPCs across Regions ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). For VPC-to-VPC routing across Regions, transit gateways can also be peered across Regions and route traffic between them ([Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Site-to-Site VPN to a central VPC plus VPC peering

This does not meet the requirements. Site-to-Site VPN is internet/IPsec-based rather than a dedicated Direct Connect path, so it is not the best choice for higher throughput and consistent network experience. Also, VPC peering is not transitive: AWS states that VPC peering is a one-to-one relationship and that transitive peering relationships are not supported. A central VPC cannot be used as a transit point between other peered VPCs ([How VPC peering connections work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)).

### C. Site-to-Site VPN to a central VPC and a transit gateway

Using a transit gateway is directionally better than VPC peering for hub-and-spoke/transitive VPC routing, but the on-premises connectivity is still Site-to-Site VPN. AWS Site-to-Site VPN supports IPsec VPN connections and has tunnel bandwidth characteristics documented by AWS, including standard 1.25 Gbps tunnels and large bandwidth tunnels up to 5 Gbps when attached to Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN ([What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). The scenario specifically asks to increase bandwidth throughput, reduce outbound network costs, and provide a consistent network experience; Direct Connect is the better fit.

### D. Direct Connect plus Site-to-Site VPN between all VPCs and VPC peering from a central VPC

This option is unnecessarily complex and still relies on VPC peering from a central VPC for VPC-to-VPC connectivity. VPC peering does not support transitive routing, and a central VPC cannot act as a transit point between other VPCs ([How VPC peering connections work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)). Establishing Site-to-Site VPN connections between VPCs in each Region is not the appropriate AWS design for transitive multi-VPC connectivity; transit gateways with Direct Connect gateway integration are the intended architecture.

Therefore, **B** is the solution that best satisfies all stated requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司需要从其本地数据中心建立到 AWS 的连接。该公司需要连接位于不同 AWS 区域的所有 VPC，并在 VPC 网络之间具备传递路由能力。该公司还必须降低网络出站流量成本、提高带宽吞吐量，并为最终用户提供一致的网络体验。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在本地数据中心和新的中心 VPC 之间创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。创建从中心 VPC 发起到所有其他 VPC 的 VPC 对等连接。
options.B: 在本地数据中心和 AWS 之间创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接。预置 transit VIF，并将其连接到 Direct Connect gateway。使用每个区域中的 transit gateway，将 Direct Connect gateway 连接到所有其他 VPC。
options.C: 在本地数据中心和新的中心 VPUse a transit gateway with dynamic routing 之间创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。将 transit gateway 连接到所有其他 VPC。
options.D: 在本地数据中心和 AWS 之间创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接。在每个区域中的所有 VPC 之间建立 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。创建从中心 VPC 发起到所有其他 VPC 的 VPC 对等连接。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要从本地数据中心到 AWS 的私有连接，并且需要在位于不同 AWS 区域的多个 VPC 之间实现具备传递路由的连接。它还希望降低出站网络成本、提高带宽吞吐量，并获得一致的网络体验。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接，预置 transit VIF 到 Direct Connect gateway，并将该 Direct Connect gateway 与所需区域中的 transit gateway 关联。**

这是最佳匹配，因为：

* AWS Direct Connect 提供从客户网络到 AWS 的专用网络路径，绕过正常网络路径中的互联网服务提供商，这相比基于互联网的 VPN 连接可支持更一致的网络体验（[什么是 Direct Connect？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
* Direct Connect 支持高速专用连接，包括 1 Gbps、10 Gbps、100 Gbps 和 400 Gbps 物理接口选项，满足提高带宽吞吐量的要求（[什么是 Direct Connect？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
* 对于 Direct Connect，AWS 记录了私有虚拟接口和传输虚拟接口的特定 Data Transfer Out 计费行为，并且 Direct Connect 数据传输费率可适用于符合条件的出站流量，这与降低出站网络流量成本的要求相符（[Direct Connect 定价](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
* 当访问一个或多个与 Direct Connect gateways 关联的 Amazon VPC Transit Gateways 时，**transit virtual interface** 是正确的 VIF 类型（[Direct Connect 虚拟接口](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)）。
* AWS 明确说明，Direct Connect gateway 可以通过 transit VIF 将 Direct Connect 连接连接到附加到 transit gateway 的 VPC 或 VPN，并且 Direct Connect gateway 支持所附加 transit VIF 与相关联 transit gateway 之间的通信。它还指出了针对不同区域中多个 transit gateway 的设计注意事项（[Direct Connect gateways 和 transit gateway 关联](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)）。
* Direct Connect gateway 可在全球范围内使用，并可连接到全球各区域，AWS 描述了使用它连接跨区域 VPC 的方式（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。对于跨区域的 VPC 到 VPC 路由，transit gateway 也可以跨区域进行对等连接，并在它们之间路由流量（[Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. Site-to-Site VPN 到中心 VPC 加 VPC 对等连接

这不满足要求。Site-to-Site VPN 基于互联网/IPsec，而不是专用的 Direct Connect 路径，因此对于更高吞吐量和一致网络体验而言，它不是最佳选择。此外，VPC 对等连接不是传递性的：AWS 表示 VPC 对等连接是一对一关系，并且不支持传递性对等关系。中心 VPC 不能用作其他对等 VPC 之间的传输点（[VPC 对等连接的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。

### C. Site-to-Site VPN 到中心 VPC 和 transit gateway

对于中心辐射/传递式 VPC 路由，使用 transit gateway 的方向比 VPC 对等连接更好，但本地连接仍然是 Site-to-Site VPN。AWS Site-to-Site VPN 支持 IPsec VPN 连接，并且 AWS 记录了其隧道带宽特征，包括标准 1.25 Gbps 隧道，以及在附加到 Transit Gateway 或 Cloud WAN 时最高 5 Gbps 的大带宽隧道（[什么是 AWS Site-to-Site VPN？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。场景明确要求提高带宽吞吐量、降低出站网络成本并提供一致的网络体验；Direct Connect 更合适。

### D. Direct Connect 加所有 VPC 之间的 Site-to-Site VPN，以及从中心 VPC 发起的 VPC 对等连接

此选项不必要地复杂，并且仍依赖从中心 VPC 发起的 VPC 对等连接来实现 VPC 到 VPC 的连接。VPC 对等连接不支持传递路由，中心 VPC 不能充当其他 VPC 之间的传输点（[VPC 对等连接的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。在每个区域中的 VPC 之间建立 Site-to-Site VPN 连接并不是用于传递式多 VPC 连接的适当 AWS 设计；与 Direct Connect gateway 集成的 transit gateway 才是预期架构。

因此，**B** 是最能满足所有既定要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company is migrating its development and production workloads to a new organization in AWS Organizations. The company has created a separate member account for development and a separate member account for production. Consolidated billing is linked to the management account. In the management account, a solutions architect needs to create an IAM user that can stop or terminate resources in both member accounts. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an IAM user and a cross-account role in the management account. Configure the cross- account role with least privilege access to the member accounts.
options.B: Create an IAM user in each member account. In the management account, create a cross-account role that has least privilege access. Grant the IAM users access to the cross-account role by using a trust policy.
options.C: Create an IAM user in the management account. In the member accounts, create an IAM group that has least privilege access. Add the IAM user from the management account to each IAM group in the member accounts.
options.D: Create an IAM user in the management account. In the member accounts, create cross-account roles that have least privilege access. Grant the IAM user access to the roles by using a trust policy.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company has a management account and two AWS Organizations member accounts (development and production). The requirement is to create **one IAM user in the management account** that can stop or terminate resources in both member accounts, using least-privilege access.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an IAM user in the management account. In the member accounts, create cross-account roles that have least privilege access. Grant the IAM user access to the roles by using a trust policy.**

This is the standard AWS cross-account access pattern. The IAM principal starts in the **originating account** (here, the management account), and the permissions to operate on resources are provided by IAM roles created in each **destination account** (here, the development and production member accounts). AWS documentation states that for cross-account access, you create the role in the **Destination account** and specify the **Originating account** as a trusted entity. The role also defines what the trusted users can do in that destination account ([IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)).

AWS also describes a development/production account scenario where an administrator creates a role in the production account, defines a trust policy that names the other account as the principal, and then users in the other account are granted permission to call `sts:AssumeRole` for that role ([Access for an IAM user in another AWS account that you own](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_aws-accounts.html)).

Therefore, the management-account IAM user should be allowed to assume roles in the development and production member accounts. Each member-account role should have only the permissions required to stop or terminate the relevant resources, following AWS least-privilege guidance to grant only permissions required for the task ([Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create the cross-account role in the management account

This reverses the cross-account role pattern. The role that grants access to resources in another account must be created in the **account that owns those resources**—the destination/member account. A role in the management account would not by itself grant permissions to resources in the development and production accounts.

### B. Create IAM users in each member account and a cross-account role in the management account

This does not meet the requirement because the question specifically says the solutions architect needs to create an IAM user **in the management account**. Creating separate IAM users in each member account increases credential sprawl and is not the recommended cross-account approach. Also, placing the cross-account role in the management account is the wrong direction for accessing resources in the member accounts.

### C. Create IAM groups in the member accounts and add the management-account IAM user to them

IAM users and IAM groups are account-scoped. You cannot add an IAM user from the management account directly to an IAM group in a different member account. Cross-account access should be implemented with IAM roles and `sts:AssumeRole`, not by attempting to place an external-account user into a local IAM group.

## Conclusion

The correct solution is **D**: create the IAM user in the management account, create least-privilege cross-account roles in each member account, and configure trust/assume-role permissions so the management-account user can assume those roles.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其开发和生产工作负载迁移到 AWS Organizations 中的一个新组织。该公司已分别为开发和生产创建了单独的成员账户。整合账单关联到管理账户。在管理账户中，解决方案架构师需要创建一个 IAM 用户，该用户可以在两个成员账户中停止或终止资源。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 在管理账户中创建一个 IAM 用户和一个跨账户角色。为该跨账户角色配置对成员账户的最小权限访问。
options.B: 在每个成员账户中创建一个 IAM 用户。在管理账户中，创建一个具有最小权限访问的跨账户角色。使用信任策略授予 IAM 用户访问该跨账户角色的权限。
options.C: 在管理账户中创建一个 IAM 用户。在成员账户中，创建一个具有最小权限访问的 IAM 组。将管理账户中的 IAM 用户添加到成员账户中的每个 IAM 组。
options.D: 在管理账户中创建一个 IAM 用户。在成员账户中，创建具有最小权限访问的跨账户角色。使用信任策略授予该 IAM 用户访问这些角色的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司有一个管理账户和两个 AWS Organizations 成员账户（开发和生产）。要求是创建**一个位于管理账户中的 IAM 用户**，该用户可以在两个成员账户中停止或终止资源，并使用最小权限访问。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 在管理账户中创建一个 IAM 用户。在成员账户中，创建具有最小权限访问的跨账户角色。使用信任策略授予该 IAM 用户访问这些角色的权限。**

这是标准的 AWS 跨账户访问模式。IAM 主体从**源账户**（此处为管理账户）开始，而对资源进行操作的权限由在每个**目标账户**（此处为开发和生产成员账户）中创建的 IAM 角色提供。AWS 文档说明，对于跨账户访问，需要在**目标账户**中创建角色，并将**源账户**指定为可信实体。该角色还定义了受信任用户可以在该目标账户中执行的操作（[IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)）。

AWS 还描述了一个开发/生产账户场景，其中管理员在生产账户中创建角色，定义一个将另一个账户命名为主体的信任策略，然后授予另一个账户中的用户调用 `sts:AssumeRole` 以使用该角色的权限（[Access for an IAM user in another AWS account that you own](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_aws-accounts.html)）。

因此，应允许管理账户中的 IAM 用户代入开发和生产成员账户中的角色。每个成员账户角色应仅具有停止或终止相关资源所需的权限，遵循 AWS 最小权限指导，仅授予任务所需的权限（[Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 在管理账户中创建跨账户角色

这颠倒了跨账户角色模式。授予对另一个账户中资源访问权限的角色，必须在**拥有这些资源的账户**中创建——也就是目标/成员账户。管理账户中的角色本身不会授予对开发和生产账户中资源的权限。

### B. 在每个成员账户中创建 IAM 用户，并在管理账户中创建跨账户角色

这不符合要求，因为题目明确说明解决方案架构师需要创建一个**位于管理账户中的** IAM 用户。在每个成员账户中创建单独的 IAM 用户会增加凭证分散，不是推荐的跨账户方法。此外，将跨账户角色放在管理账户中，是访问成员账户资源时的错误方向。

### C. 在成员账户中创建 IAM 组，并将管理账户 IAM 用户添加到其中

IAM 用户和 IAM 组都是账户范围内的。你不能将管理账户中的 IAM 用户直接添加到不同成员账户中的 IAM 组。跨账户访问应通过 IAM 角色和 `sts:AssumeRole` 来实现，而不是尝试将外部账户用户放入本地 IAM 组。

## 结论

正确的解决方案是 **D**：在管理账户中创建 IAM 用户，在每个成员账户中创建最小权限跨账户角色，并配置信任/代入角色权限，使管理账户用户能够代入这些角色。

en.question: A company wants to use AWS for disaster recovery for an on-premises application. The company has hundreds of Windows-based servers that run the application. All the servers mount a common share. The company has an RTO of 15 minutes and an RPO of 5 minutes. The solution must support native failover and fallback capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Storage Gateway File Gateway. Schedule daily Windows server backups. Save the data to Amazon S3. During a disaster, recover the on-premises servers from the backup. During tailback, run the on-premises servers on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.B: Create a set of AWS CloudFormation templates to create infrastructure. Replicate all data to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) by using AWS DataSync. During a disaster, use AWS CodePipeline to deploy the templates to restore the on-premises servers. Fail back the data by using DataSync.
options.C: Create an AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) pipeline to stand up a multi-site active-active environment on AWS. Replicate data into Amazon S3 by using the s3 sync command. During a disaster, swap DNS endpoints to point to AWS. Fail back the data by using the s3 sync command.
options.D: Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery to replicate the on-premises servers. Replicate data to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system by using AWS DataSync. Mount the file system to AWS servers. During a disaster, fail over the on-premises servers to AWS. Fail back to new or existing servers by using Elastic Disaster Recovery.

en.explanation:
The company needs a disaster recovery design for **hundreds of Windows servers** that share a common Windows file share, with **RTO 15 minutes**, **RPO 5 minutes**, and built-in failover/failback. The most appropriate and cost-effective pattern is to keep lightweight replication running until a disaster, then launch recovery servers and use a managed Windows file system for the shared SMB data.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery to replicate the on-premises servers. Replicate data to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system by using AWS DataSync. Mount the file system to AWS servers. During a disaster, fail over the on-premises servers to AWS. Fail back to new or existing servers by using Elastic Disaster Recovery.**

This is the best fit because:

- **AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS)** is designed for server-level disaster recovery with continuous block-level replication, recovery orchestration, and automated conversion of source servers so they can boot natively as EC2 instances. AWS documentation states that AWS DRS provides low RPO/RTO, with RPO typically in the **sub-second/seconds range** and RTO typically in minutes, commonly **5–20 minutes** depending on the operating system and environment ([Elastic Disaster Recovery concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/CloudEndure-Concepts.html)). This aligns most closely with the required 5-minute RPO and 15-minute RTO.
- AWS DRS supports both **recovery and failback**. The documentation explains that recovery launches workloads as EC2 instances and that failback can restore recovery instances back to on-premises infrastructure by using the failback mechanisms for on-premises environments ([Using Elastic Disaster Recovery for recovery and failback](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback.html)).
- The application uses a **common Windows share**, so the shared file system in AWS should support Windows SMB semantics. **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** is the correct AWS managed file system for this. AWS DataSync supports FSx for Windows File Server locations and connects to them using the **SMB protocol**, preserving Windows-relevant metadata and ACLs when configured with proper permissions ([Configuring transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)).
- This is cost-effective because DRS avoids running a fully provisioned duplicate active environment until failover, while DataSync and FSx for Windows File Server address the shared Windows file data requirement.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Storage Gateway File Gateway with daily backups to S3

This does not meet the RPO/RTO requirements. Daily backups cannot provide a **5-minute RPO**, and restoring hundreds of Windows servers from backup is unlikely to meet a **15-minute RTO**. It also does not provide the same native failover and failback orchestration as AWS DRS.

### B. CloudFormation + DataSync to Amazon EFS + CodePipeline restore

This is not appropriate for Windows-based servers that mount a common share. Amazon EFS is an NFS file system; the EFS documentation describes mounting through **NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1** and recommends Linux/macOS NFS clients ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). It is not the native Windows SMB file share service. In addition, CloudFormation and CodePipeline would deploy infrastructure, but they do not provide continuous server replication, automated server conversion, or native DR failback comparable to AWS DRS.

### C. Active-active environment with S3 sync

This is not cost-effective for the stated DR use case because it requires maintaining an active-active environment. Also, `s3 sync` to Amazon S3 is not a native Windows shared file system solution and does not preserve the full behavior of a common SMB share for Windows servers. It also lacks native server failover/failback capabilities.

## Conclusion

Option **D** is the only solution that combines:

- continuous server replication and orchestrated recovery with AWS DRS,
- low RPO/RTO characteristics,
- native failover and failback support,
- and a Windows-compatible shared file system using FSx for Windows File Server with DataSync.

Therefore, the correct answer is **D**.

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 AWS 为本地应用程序实现灾难恢复。该公司有数百台基于 Windows 的服务器运行该应用程序。所有服务器都挂载一个公共共享。该公司的 RTO 为 15 分钟，RPO 为 5 分钟。该解决方案必须支持原生故障转移和故障恢复功能。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway File Gateway。计划每日 Windows 服务器备份。将数据保存到 Amazon S3。在灾难期间，从备份中恢复本地服务器。在故障恢复期间，在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行本地服务器。
options.B: 创建一组 AWS CloudFormation 模板来创建基础设施。使用 AWS DataSync 将所有数据复制到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。在灾难期间，使用 AWS CodePipeline 部署模板以恢复本地服务器。使用 DataSync 将数据故障恢复回来。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) 管道，在 AWS 上建立多站点主动-主动环境。使用 s3 sync 命令将数据复制到 Amazon S3。在灾难期间，切换 DNS 端点以指向 AWS。使用 s3 sync 命令将数据故障恢复回来。
options.D: 使用 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 复制本地服务器。使用 AWS DataSync 将数据复制到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将该文件系统挂载到 AWS 服务器。在灾难期间，将本地服务器故障转移到 AWS。使用 Elastic Disaster Recovery 故障恢复到新的或现有的服务器。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要为**数百台 Windows 服务器**设计灾难恢复方案，这些服务器共享一个公共 Windows 文件共享，并要求 **RTO 15 分钟**、**RPO 5 分钟**，以及内置的故障转移/故障恢复。最合适且最具成本效益的模式是保持轻量级复制持续运行，直到发生灾难时再启动恢复服务器，并使用托管 Windows 文件系统承载共享的 SMB 数据。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 使用 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 复制本地服务器。使用 AWS DataSync 将数据复制到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将该文件系统挂载到 AWS 服务器。在灾难期间，将本地服务器故障转移到 AWS。使用 Elastic Disaster Recovery 故障恢复到新的或现有的服务器。**

这是最佳匹配，因为：

- **AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS)** 专为服务器级灾难恢复而设计，提供连续的块级复制、恢复编排，以及源服务器的自动转换，使其能够作为 EC2 实例原生启动。AWS 文档说明，AWS DRS 提供低 RPO/RTO，RPO 通常在**亚秒/秒级范围**，RTO 通常为数分钟，常见为 **5–20 分钟**，具体取决于操作系统和环境（[Elastic Disaster Recovery concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/CloudEndure-Concepts.html)）。这与所需的 5 分钟 RPO 和 15 分钟 RTO 最为匹配。
- AWS DRS 同时支持**恢复和故障恢复**。文档解释说，恢复会将工作负载作为 EC2 实例启动，而故障恢复可以使用面向本地环境的故障恢复机制，将恢复实例还原回本地基础设施（[Using Elastic Disaster Recovery for recovery and failback](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/failback.html)）。
- 该应用程序使用**公共 Windows 共享**，因此 AWS 中的共享文件系统应支持 Windows SMB 语义。**Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 是正确的 AWS 托管文件系统。AWS DataSync 支持 FSx for Windows File Server 位置，并使用 **SMB 协议**连接到这些位置；在配置了适当权限时，可以保留 Windows 相关元数据和 ACL（[Configuring transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)）。
- 这具有成本效益，因为 DRS 避免在故障转移前运行完全预置的重复主动环境，而 DataSync 和 FSx for Windows File Server 则满足共享 Windows 文件数据需求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. Storage Gateway File Gateway with daily backups to S3

这不满足 RPO/RTO 要求。每日备份无法提供 **5 分钟 RPO**，而且从备份中恢复数百台 Windows 服务器也不太可能满足 **15 分钟 RTO**。它也不像 AWS DRS 那样提供同等的原生故障转移和故障恢复编排。

### B. CloudFormation + DataSync to Amazon EFS + CodePipeline restore

这不适用于挂载公共共享的基于 Windows 的服务器。Amazon EFS 是 NFS 文件系统；EFS 文档描述了通过 **NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1** 进行挂载，并建议使用 Linux/macOS NFS 客户端（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。它不是原生 Windows SMB 文件共享服务。此外，CloudFormation 和 CodePipeline 可以部署基础设施，但它们不提供连续服务器复制、自动服务器转换，也不提供可与 AWS DRS 相比的原生 DR 故障恢复。

### C. Active-active environment with S3 sync

对于题目所述的 DR 用例，这不具成本效益，因为它需要维护一个主动-主动环境。此外，`s3 sync` 到 Amazon S3 并不是原生 Windows 共享文件系统解决方案，无法保留 Windows 服务器公共 SMB 共享的完整行为。它也缺少原生服务器故障转移/故障恢复功能。

## 结论

选项 **D** 是唯一同时结合以下能力的解决方案：

- 使用 AWS DRS 进行连续服务器复制和编排式恢复，
- 低 RPO/RTO 特性，
- 原生故障转移和故障恢复支持，
- 以及使用 FSx for Windows File Server 与 DataSync 提供的 Windows 兼容共享文件系统。

因此，正确答案是 **D**。

en.question: A company has built a high performance computing (HPC) cluster in AWS for a tightly coupled workload that generates a large number of shared files stored in Amazon EFS. The cluster was performing well when the number of Amazon EC2 instances in the cluster was 100. However, when the company increased the cluster size to 1.000 EC2 instances, overall performance was well below expectations. Which collection of design choices should a solutions architect make to achieve the maximum performance from the HPC cluster? (Choose three.)

options.A: Ensure the HPC cluster is launched within a single Availability Zone.
options.B: Launch the EC2 instances and attach elastic network interfaces in multiples of four.
options.C: Select EC2 instance types with an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled.
options.D: Ensure the cluster is launched across multiple Availability Zones.
options.E: Replace Amazon EFS with multiple Amazon EBS volumes in a RAID array.
options.F: Replace Amazon EFS with Amazon FSx for Lustre.

en.explanation:
The workload is a tightly coupled HPC cluster that scaled from 100 to 1,000 EC2 instances and uses a shared file system. To maximize performance, the design must optimize both node-to-node network latency/bandwidth and shared storage throughput/latency.

**Correct answers: A, C, F**

- **A. Ensure the HPC cluster is launched within a single Availability Zone — Correct.** For tightly coupled HPC, instances should be placed close together to minimize network latency. AWS documentation for EC2 placement groups states that a **cluster** placement strategy packs instances close together **inside an Availability Zone** and is intended for the low-latency network performance required by tightly coupled HPC applications. Also, EFA traffic cannot cross Availability Zones, which reinforces the need for a single-AZ design when using EFA for HPC communication. See [EC2 placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html) and [EFA limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa.html).

- **C. Select EC2 instance types with an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) enabled — Correct.** EFA is specifically designed to improve inter-instance communication for HPC and ML workloads. AWS states that EFA provides OS-bypass and congestion control through SRD, enabling low-latency, reliable transport and better performance for HPC applications on EC2. This directly addresses the tightly coupled workload scaling problem. See [Elastic Fabric Adapter for HPC workloads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa.html).

- **F. Replace Amazon EFS with Amazon FSx for Lustre — Correct.** Amazon EFS is a general-purpose shared NFS file system, but this scenario describes an HPC workload generating many shared files and needing maximum performance. AWS describes FSx for Lustre as a high-performance Lustre file system for workloads where speed matters, including HPC, and says it provides sub-millisecond latencies, up to multiple TBps of throughput, and up to millions of IOPS. This is a better fit than EFS for high-performance shared HPC storage. See [What is Amazon FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html). EFS has documented per-file-system and per-client performance limits, which can become a bottleneck at large scale. See [Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html).

**Incorrect options:**

- **B. Launch the EC2 instances and attach elastic network interfaces in multiples of four — Incorrect.** There is no AWS HPC best practice that says EC2 instances or ENIs must be launched in multiples of four for maximum HPC performance. EFA-enabled instances and appropriate placement are the relevant network choices. While some instance types support multiple network cards and one EFA per network card, AWS does not prescribe “multiples of four” as a performance design requirement.

- **D. Ensure the cluster is launched across multiple Availability Zones — Incorrect.** Multi-AZ placement improves availability, not maximum tightly coupled HPC performance. For tightly coupled HPC, low-latency communication is more important, and AWS cluster placement groups are explicitly scoped to a single Availability Zone. Additionally, EFA traffic cannot cross Availability Zones, so a multi-AZ design would prevent the desired EFA communication path across all nodes.

- **E. Replace Amazon EFS with multiple Amazon EBS volumes in a RAID array — Incorrect.** EBS volumes are block storage attached to individual EC2 instances. A RAID array of EBS volumes can improve storage performance for a single instance, but it does not provide a managed shared POSIX file system across 1,000 HPC nodes. The scenario requires high-performance shared storage, which is the use case for FSx for Lustre, not EBS RAID.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 中构建了一个高性能计算 (HPC) 集群，用于运行紧密耦合的工作负载，该工作负载会生成大量存储在 Amazon EFS 中的共享文件。当集群中的 Amazon EC2 实例数量为 100 个时，集群运行良好。然而，当公司将集群规模增加到 1,000 个 EC2 实例时，整体性能远低于预期。解决方案架构师应选择哪组设计方案，以实现 HPC 集群的最高性能？（选择三项。）

options.A: 确保 HPC 集群在单个可用区内启动。
options.B: 以四的倍数启动 EC2 实例并附加弹性网络接口。
options.C: 选择启用了 Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) 的 EC2 实例类型。
options.D: 确保集群跨多个可用区启动。
options.E: 将 Amazon EFS 替换为 RAID 阵列中的多个 Amazon EBS 卷。
options.F: 将 Amazon EFS 替换为 Amazon FSx for Lustre。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载是一个紧密耦合的 HPC 集群，从 100 个 EC2 实例扩展到 1,000 个 EC2 实例，并使用共享文件系统。要最大化性能，设计必须同时优化节点间网络延迟/带宽以及共享存储吞吐量/延迟。

**正确答案：A、C、F**

- **A. 确保 HPC 集群在单个可用区内启动 — 正确。** 对于紧密耦合的 HPC，应将实例放置得彼此靠近，以尽量减少网络延迟。AWS 关于 EC2 置放群组的文档指出，**集群**置放策略会将实例紧密打包在**一个可用区内**，用于紧密耦合 HPC 应用程序所需的低延迟网络性能。此外，EFA 流量不能跨可用区，这进一步强化了在使用 EFA 进行 HPC 通信时需要采用单 AZ 设计。请参阅 [EC2 placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html) 和 [EFA limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa.html)。
