- **C. 选择启用了 Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) 的 EC2 实例类型 — 正确。** EFA 专门用于改善 HPC 和 ML 工作负载的实例间通信。AWS 表示，EFA 通过 SRD 提供 OS-bypass 和拥塞控制，从而在 EC2 上为 HPC 应用程序实现低延迟、可靠传输和更好的性能。这直接解决了紧密耦合工作负载的扩展问题。请参阅 [Elastic Fabric Adapter for HPC workloads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/efa.html)。

- **F. 将 Amazon EFS 替换为 Amazon FSx for Lustre — 正确。** Amazon EFS 是通用型共享 NFS 文件系统，但此场景描述的是会生成大量共享文件且需要最高性能的 HPC 工作负载。AWS 将 FSx for Lustre 描述为一种面向速度至关重要的工作负载（包括 HPC）的高性能 Lustre 文件系统，并表示它提供亚毫秒级延迟、最高可达多 TBps 的吞吐量以及最高可达数百万 IOPS。与 EFS 相比，它更适合高性能共享 HPC 存储。请参阅 [What is Amazon FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)。EFS 有已记录的每文件系统和每客户端性能限制，在大规模场景下可能成为瓶颈。请参阅 [Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)。

**错误选项：**

- **B. 以四的倍数启动 EC2 实例并附加弹性网络接口 — 错误。** 没有 AWS HPC 最佳实践要求必须以四的倍数启动 EC2 实例或 ENI 才能获得最高 HPC 性能。启用 EFA 的实例和合适的置放方式才是相关的网络选择。虽然某些实例类型支持多个网卡以及每个网卡一个 EFA，但 AWS 并未规定“以四的倍数”作为性能设计要求。

- **D. 确保集群跨多个可用区启动 — 错误。** 多 AZ 部署提高的是可用性，而不是紧密耦合 HPC 的最高性能。对于紧密耦合的 HPC，低延迟通信更重要，并且 AWS 集群置放群组明确限定在单个可用区内。此外，EFA 流量不能跨可用区，因此多 AZ 设计会阻止所有节点之间使用期望的 EFA 通信路径。

- **E. 将 Amazon EFS 替换为 RAID 阵列中的多个 Amazon EBS 卷 — 错误。** EBS 卷是附加到单个 EC2 实例的块存储。EBS 卷的 RAID 阵列可以提高单个实例的存储性能，但它无法在 1,000 个 HPC 节点之间提供托管的共享 POSIX 文件系统。该场景需要高性能共享存储，这是 FSx for Lustre 的用例，而不是 EBS RAID。

en.question: A company is designing an AWS Organizations structure. The company wants to standardize a process to apply tags across the entire organization. The company will require tags with specific values when a user creates a new resource. Each of the company's OUs will have unique tag values. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an SCP to deny the creation of resources that do not have the required tags. Create a tag policy that includes the tag values that the company has assigned to each OU. Attach the tag policies to the OUs.
options.B: Use an SCP to deny the creation of resources that do not have the required tags. Create a tag policy that includes the tag values that the company has assigned to each OU. Attach the tag policies to the organization's management account.
options.C: Use an SCP to allow the creation of resources only when the resources have the required tags. Create a tag policy that includes the tag values that the company has assigned to each OU. Attach the tag policies to the OUs.
options.D: Use an SCP to deny the creation of resources that do not have the required tags. Define the list of tags. Attach the SCP to the OUs.

en.explanation:
The company needs two complementary controls: (1) block resource creation when required tags are missing, and (2) standardize the allowed tag values differently for each OU.

**Correct answer: A.**

- Use an **SCP with explicit Deny conditions** to prevent creation requests that do not include the required tags. SCPs are permission guardrails and **do not grant permissions**; they define the maximum available permissions. AWS also notes SCP examples commonly use a **deny list strategy** and still require IAM permissions to actually allow actions. IAM global condition keys such as `aws:RequestTag/tag-key` and `aws:TagKeys` can be used to compare tag key/value pairs and required tag keys in requests, which is the mechanism used in deny-based controls for creation/tagging requests. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) and [AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html).
- Use **AWS Organizations tag policies** to define the approved tag keys and allowed tag values. AWS states that tag policies help standardize tags across resources in organization accounts and can specify allowed tag values and enforcement for supported resources. See [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html) and [Tag policy syntax and examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html).
- Because **each OU has unique tag values**, the tag policies that contain those OU-specific values should be attached to the relevant **OUs**. AWS Organizations supports attaching tag policies to a root, OU, or account, and an OU attachment affects accounts under that OU. See [Attaching organization policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect** because attaching the tag policy to the management account does not meet the requirement for **unique tag values per OU**. A single attachment to the management account is not the right target for OU-specific value sets; tag policies should be attached to the OUs that require those distinct values.
- **C is incorrect** because it describes using an SCP to **allow** creation only when tags are present. SCPs do not grant permissions; they only set guardrails/maximum permissions. The practical Organizations pattern is to use explicit **Deny** statements for noncompliant create requests, while IAM policies still grant the underlying permissions.
- **D is incorrect** because it uses only an SCP and does not create tag policies containing the allowed tag values. SCPs can deny missing or invalid request tags, but tag policies are the Organizations feature designed to standardize tag keys and allowed values and to report/enforce tag compliance for supported resources.

Therefore, **A** best satisfies both requirements: deny untagged resource creation and attach OU-specific tag policies to the OUs.

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计 AWS Organizations 结构。该公司希望标准化一个流程，以便在整个组织中应用标签。公司要求用户创建新资源时必须带有特定值的标签。该公司的每个 OU 都将具有唯一的标签值。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 SCP 拒绝创建没有所需标签的资源。创建一个标签策略，其中包含公司分配给每个 OU 的标签值。将标签策略附加到 OU。
options.B: 使用 SCP 拒绝创建没有所需标签的资源。创建一个标签策略，其中包含公司分配给每个 OU 的标签值。将标签策略附加到组织的管理账户。
options.C: 使用 SCP 仅在资源具有所需标签时才允许创建资源。创建一个标签策略，其中包含公司分配给每个 OU 的标签值。将标签策略附加到 OU。
options.D: 使用 SCP 拒绝创建没有所需标签的资源。定义标签列表。将 SCP 附加到 OU。

zh.explanation:
公司需要两个互补的控制措施：(1) 在缺少所需标签时阻止资源创建；以及 (2) 针对每个 OU 以不同方式标准化允许的标签值。

**正确答案：A。**

- 使用带有**显式 Deny 条件的 SCP**，防止不包含所需标签的创建请求。SCP 是权限护栏，**不会授予权限**；它们定义最大可用权限。AWS 还指出，SCP 示例通常使用**拒绝列表策略**，并且仍需要 IAM 权限来实际允许操作。IAM 全局条件键（例如 `aws:RequestTag/tag-key` 和 `aws:TagKeys`）可用于比较请求中的标签键/值对以及所需标签键，这正是基于拒绝的创建/标记请求控制所使用的机制。请参阅 [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 和 [AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)。
- 使用 **AWS Organizations tag policies** 来定义批准的标签键和允许的标签值。AWS 表示，标签策略有助于在组织账户中的资源之间标准化标签，并且可以为受支持的资源指定允许的标签值和强制执行。请参阅 [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html) 和 [Tag policy syntax and examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html)。
- 由于**每个 OU 都有唯一的标签值**，包含这些 OU 特定值的标签策略应附加到相应的 **OU**。AWS Organizations 支持将标签策略附加到根、OU 或账户，并且附加到 OU 会影响该 OU 下的账户。请参阅 [Attaching organization policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B 不正确**，因为将标签策略附加到管理账户无法满足**每个 OU 具有唯一标签值**的要求。对管理账户进行单一附加并不是 OU 特定值集的正确目标；标签策略应附加到需要这些不同值的 OU。
- **C 不正确**，因为它描述的是使用 SCP 仅在存在标签时才**允许**创建。SCP 不会授予权限；它们只设置护栏/最大权限。实际的 Organizations 模式是对不合规的创建请求使用显式 **Deny** 语句，同时 IAM 策略仍授予底层权限。
- **D 不正确**，因为它只使用 SCP，并没有创建包含允许标签值的标签策略。SCP 可以拒绝缺少或无效的请求标签，但标签策略是 Organizations 中专为标准化标签键和允许值，以及为受支持资源报告/强制执行标签合规性而设计的功能。

因此，**A** 最能同时满足这两个要求：拒绝创建未加标签的资源，并将 OU 特定的标签策略附加到 OU。

en.question: A company has more than 10,000 sensors that send data to an on-premises Apache Kafka server by using the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol. The on-premises Kafka server transforms the data and then stores the results as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. Recently, the Kafka server crashed. The company lost sensor data while the server was being restored. A solutions architect must create a new design on AWS that is highly available and scalable to prevent a similar occurrence. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Launch two Amazon EC2 instances to host the Kafka server in an active/standby configuration across two Availability Zones. Create a domain name in Amazon Route 53. Create a Route 53 failover policy. Route the sensors to send the data to the domain name.
options.B: Migrate the on-premises Kafka server to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) that points to the Amazon MSK broker. Enable NLB health checks. Route the sensors to send the data to the NLB.
options.C: Deploy AWS IoT Core, and connect it to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Use an AWS Lambda function to handle data transformation. Route the sensors to send the data to AWS IoT Core.
options.D: Deploy AWS IoT Core, and launch an Amazon EC2 instance to host the Kafka server. Configure AWS IoT Core to send the data to the EC2 instance. Route the sensors to send the data to AWS IoT Core.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company has a large IoT ingestion workload: more than 10,000 sensors publish telemetry using MQTT, the data must be transformed, and the transformed results must be stored in Amazon S3. The failure occurred because the existing on-premises Kafka-based ingestion/transformation path was a single point of failure. The new design should therefore use managed, scalable, highly available AWS services for MQTT ingestion, stream delivery, transformation, and S3 storage.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Deploy AWS IoT Core, connect it to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream, use AWS Lambda for transformation, and route sensors to AWS IoT Core.**

This is the best fit because AWS IoT Core is purpose-built for securely connecting IoT devices to AWS. The AWS IoT Core message broker supports devices publishing and subscribing by using MQTT or MQTT over WebSocket, and the rules engine can route device data to other AWS services for processing and storage, including Lambda and S3-related workflows ([AWS IoT Core services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/aws-iot-how-it-works.html)). AWS IoT Core also supports MQTT QoS levels 0 and 1, with QoS 1 providing at-least-once delivery semantics between the device and the message broker ([MQTT QoS options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/mqtt.html)).

AWS IoT rules can send MQTT message data directly to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream; the IoT Firehose rule action specifies the Firehose delivery stream and uses `PutRecord`/`PutRecordBatch` permissions to write the data ([Firehose rule action for AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/kinesis-firehose-rule-action.html)). Amazon Data Firehose can deliver streaming data to Amazon S3, and if data transformation is enabled, Firehose invokes a specified Lambda function synchronously for buffered batches and then sends the transformed data to the destination ([Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html), [Firehose Lambda data transformation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)).

Therefore, option C provides a managed AWS-native architecture:

`Sensors using MQTT -> AWS IoT Core -> IoT rule -> Firehose -> Lambda transformation -> Amazon S3`

This removes the on-premises Kafka server as a single point of failure and uses managed services that scale for IoT ingestion and S3 delivery.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EC2-hosted Kafka in active/standby across two AZs with Route 53 failover

This improves availability compared with one on-premises server, but it still requires the company to operate Kafka on EC2, manage failover behavior, patching, capacity, storage, and recovery. Active/standby also does not provide the same elasticity or managed ingestion capabilities as AWS IoT Core and Firehose. It is not the most scalable or highly available AWS-native design for MQTT-based sensor ingestion.

### B. Migrate to Amazon MSK and place an NLB in front of the MSK broker

Amazon MSK is a managed Kafka service, but this option does not address the full requirement. The original system transforms data before storing it in S3, while this option does not include a transformation component such as Lambda or a delivery workflow to S3. In addition, simply placing an NLB in front of MSK brokers does not make MQTT device ingestion an AWS IoT architecture. The better fit for MQTT sensors is AWS IoT Core, whose message broker natively supports MQTT and whose rules engine can route messages to services such as Firehose and Lambda.

### D. AWS IoT Core plus one EC2-hosted Kafka server

This uses AWS IoT Core for ingestion, but then reintroduces a single EC2-hosted Kafka server. That creates essentially the same type of failure domain that caused the original data loss. A single EC2 instance is not a highly available or scalable transformation and delivery tier. Option C avoids this by using managed Firehose and Lambda instead of a self-managed Kafka server.

## Conclusion

Option **C** is correct because it uses AWS IoT Core for MQTT ingestion, Amazon Data Firehose for scalable delivery to S3, and Lambda for transformation, eliminating the self-managed Kafka single point of failure.

zh.question: 一家公司有超过 10,000 个传感器，这些传感器使用消息队列遥测传输（Message Queuing Telemetry Transport，MQTT）协议将数据发送到本地 Apache Kafka 服务器。本地 Kafka 服务器会转换数据，然后将结果作为对象存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。最近，Kafka 服务器发生崩溃。公司在服务器恢复期间丢失了传感器数据。解决方案架构师必须在 AWS 上创建一个高度可用且可扩展的新设计，以防止类似事件再次发生。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 启动两个 Amazon EC2 实例，在两个可用区中以主动/备用配置托管 Kafka 服务器。在 Amazon Route 53 中创建一个域名。创建 Route 53 故障转移策略。将传感器路由为向该域名发送数据。
options.B: 将本地 Kafka 服务器迁移到 Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)。创建一个指向 Amazon MSK broker 的 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。启用 NLB 运行状况检查。将传感器路由为向 NLB 发送数据。
options.C: 部署 AWS IoT Core，并将其连接到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据转换。将传感器路由为向 AWS IoT Core 发送数据。
options.D: 部署 AWS IoT Core，并启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例来托管 Kafka 服务器。配置 AWS IoT Core 将数据发送到 EC2 实例。将传感器路由为向 AWS IoT Core 发送数据。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司有一个大规模 IoT 摄取工作负载：超过 10,000 个传感器使用 MQTT 发布遥测数据，数据必须经过转换，并且转换后的结果必须存储在 Amazon S3 中。故障发生的原因是现有基于本地 Kafka 的摄取/转换路径是单点故障。因此，新设计应使用托管、可扩展且高可用的 AWS 服务来完成 MQTT 摄取、流传输、转换和 S3 存储。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 部署 AWS IoT Core，将其连接到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流，使用 AWS Lambda 进行转换，并将传感器路由到 AWS IoT Core。**

这是最合适的方案，因为 AWS IoT Core 专为将 IoT 设备安全连接到 AWS 而构建。AWS IoT Core 消息代理支持设备使用 MQTT 或基于 WebSocket 的 MQTT 进行发布和订阅，规则引擎可以将设备数据路由到其他 AWS 服务进行处理和存储，包括 Lambda 以及与 S3 相关的工作流（[AWS IoT Core services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/aws-iot-how-it-works.html)）。AWS IoT Core 还支持 MQTT QoS 级别 0 和 1，其中 QoS 1 在设备与消息代理之间提供至少一次交付语义（[MQTT QoS options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/mqtt.html)）。

AWS IoT 规则可以将 MQTT 消息数据直接发送到 Amazon Data Firehose 传输流；IoT Firehose 规则操作指定 Firehose 传输流，并使用 `PutRecord`/`PutRecordBatch` 权限写入数据（[Firehose rule action for AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/kinesis-firehose-rule-action.html)）。Amazon Data Firehose 可以将流式数据传输到 Amazon S3，并且如果启用了数据转换，Firehose 会针对缓冲批次同步调用指定的 Lambda 函数，然后将转换后的数据发送到目标位置（[Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)，[Firehose Lambda data transformation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)）。

因此，选项 C 提供了托管的 AWS 原生架构：

`Sensors using MQTT -> AWS IoT Core -> IoT rule -> Firehose -> Lambda transformation -> Amazon S3`

这消除了本地 Kafka 服务器这个单点故障，并使用可扩展的托管服务来处理 IoT 摄取和 S3 传输。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 在两个 AZ 中使用 Route 53 故障转移，以主动/备用方式在 EC2 上托管 Kafka

与单个本地服务器相比，这提高了可用性，但仍然要求公司在 EC2 上运行 Kafka，并管理故障转移行为、补丁、容量、存储和恢复。主动/备用也无法提供与 AWS IoT Core 和 Firehose 相同的弹性或托管摄取能力。对于基于 MQTT 的传感器摄取而言，这不是最具可扩展性或高可用性的 AWS 原生设计。

### B. 迁移到 Amazon MSK，并在 MSK broker 前放置 NLB

Amazon MSK 是托管 Kafka 服务，但此选项没有满足完整要求。原始系统在将数据存储到 S3 之前会转换数据，而此选项不包含 Lambda 等转换组件，也不包含到 S3 的传输工作流。此外，仅仅在 MSK broker 前放置 NLB 并不会使 MQTT 设备摄取成为 AWS IoT 架构。对于 MQTT 传感器，更合适的是 AWS IoT Core，其消息代理原生支持 MQTT，其规则引擎可以将消息路由到 Firehose 和 Lambda 等服务。

### D. AWS IoT Core 加一个 EC2 托管的 Kafka 服务器

这使用 AWS IoT Core 进行摄取，但随后重新引入了一个 EC2 托管的 Kafka 服务器。这实质上创建了与导致最初数据丢失相同类型的故障域。单个 EC2 实例不是高可用或可扩展的转换与传输层。选项 C 通过使用托管的 Firehose 和 Lambda，而不是自管理 Kafka 服务器来避免这一点。

## 结论

选项 **C** 正确，因为它使用 AWS IoT Core 进行 MQTT 摄取，使用 Amazon Data Firehose 将数据可扩展地传输到 S3，并使用 Lambda 进行转换，从而消除了自管理 Kafka 这一单点故障。

en.question: A company recently started hosting new application workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company is using Amazon EC2 instances. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems, and Amazon RDS DB instances. To meet regulatory and business requirements, the company must make the following changes for data backups: • Backups must be retained based on custom daily, weekly, and monthly requirements. • Backups must be replicated to at least one other AWS Region immediately after capture. • The backup solution must provide a single source of backup status across the AWS environment. • The backup solution must send immediate notifications upon failure of any resource backup. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS Backup plan with a backup rule for each of the retention requirements.
options.B: Configure an AWS Backup plan to copy backups to another Region.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to replicate backups to another Region and send notification if a failure occurs.
options.D: Add an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to the backup plan to send a notification for finished jobs that have any status except BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED.
options.E: Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) snapshot lifecycle policy for each of the retention requirements.
options.F: Set up RDS snapshots on each database.

en.explanation:
The company needs a centralized, low-operational-overhead backup solution for EC2-based workloads, EFS file systems, and RDS DB instances with multiple retention tiers, immediate cross-Region copies after backup, consolidated backup status, and failure notifications.

**Correct answers: A, B, and D.**

- **A. Create an AWS Backup plan with a backup rule for each of the retention requirements.**  
  AWS Backup backup plans define when and how resources are backed up and retained. The documentation states that AWS Backup automatically backs up and retains resources according to a backup plan and manages the backup plan lifecycle based on retention settings. Multiple rules/plans can be used to satisfy different daily, weekly, and monthly retention requirements. AWS Backup also supports the relevant resource types in this scenario, including EC2 instances backed by EBS volumes, Amazon EFS file systems, and Amazon RDS DB instances. See [Backup plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/about-backup-plans.html) and [AWS Backup supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html).

- **B. Configure an AWS Backup plan to copy backups to another Region.**  
  AWS Backup supports **Cross-Region backup** and can copy backups to multiple AWS Regions automatically as part of a scheduled backup plan. This directly meets the requirement to replicate backups to at least one other Region immediately after capture without custom automation. See [AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html).

- **D. Add an Amazon SNS topic to the backup plan to send a notification for finished jobs that have any status except `BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED`.**  
  AWS Backup integrates with Amazon SNS for backup activity notifications. The AWS Backup notification documentation lists supported backup job events such as `BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED`, `BACKUP_JOB_SUCCESSFUL`, `BACKUP_JOB_FAILED`, and `BACKUP_JOB_EXPIRED`, and provides examples for failed backup job notifications. Configuring SNS notifications for failed/non-successful backup outcomes satisfies the immediate failure-notification requirement with minimal operational overhead. See [Notification options with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-notifications.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **C. Create an AWS Lambda function to replicate backups to another Region and send notification if a failure occurs.**  
  This is unnecessary custom automation. AWS Backup already provides scheduled Cross-Region copy and integrates with SNS for notifications. Lambda would increase operational overhead and duplicate native AWS Backup capabilities.

- **E. Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager snapshot lifecycle policy for each of the retention requirements.**  
  Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager is focused on automating the lifecycle of Amazon EBS snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs. It does not provide a single centralized backup solution for EC2, EFS, and RDS together, nor does it satisfy the requirement for a consolidated AWS-wide backup status view across these services. See [Amazon EC2 AMI lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ami-lifecycle.html).

- **F. Set up RDS snapshots on each database.**  
  Native RDS snapshots would address only the RDS portion of the environment. They would not cover EC2 and EFS, would not provide a single centralized backup status source across all required services, and would require more per-service operational management than AWS Backup.

zh.question: 一家公司最近开始在 AWS Cloud 中托管新的应用程序工作负载。该公司正在使用 Amazon EC2 实例、Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统以及 Amazon RDS DB 实例。为了满足监管和业务要求，该公司必须对数据备份进行以下更改：• 必须根据自定义的每日、每周和每月要求保留备份。• 备份必须在捕获后立即复制到至少另一个 AWS Region。• 备份解决方案必须在整个 AWS 环境中提供单一的备份状态来源。• 备份解决方案必须在任何资源备份失败时立即发送通知。哪组步骤组合能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Backup 计划，并为每项保留要求创建一条备份规则。
options.B: 配置 AWS Backup 计划，将备份复制到另一个 Region。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将备份复制到另一个 Region，并在发生故障时发送通知。
options.D: 向备份计划添加一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便为状态不是 BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED 的已完成作业发送通知。
options.E: 为每项保留要求创建一个 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 快照生命周期策略。
options.F: 在每个数据库上设置 RDS 快照。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一个集中式、低运维开销的备份解决方案，用于基于 EC2 的工作负载、EFS 文件系统和 RDS DB 实例，并具备多个保留层级、备份后立即进行跨 Region 复制、整合的备份状态以及失败通知。

**正确答案：A、B 和 D。**

- **A. Create an AWS Backup plan with a backup rule for each of the retention requirements.**  
  AWS Backup 备份计划定义资源何时以及如何备份和保留。文档说明，AWS Backup 会根据备份计划自动备份并保留资源，并基于保留设置管理备份计划生命周期。可以使用多条规则/多个计划来满足不同的每日、每周和每月保留要求。AWS Backup 还支持此场景中的相关资源类型，包括由 EBS 卷支持的 EC2 实例、Amazon EFS 文件系统和 Amazon RDS DB 实例。请参阅 [Backup plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/about-backup-plans.html) 和 [AWS Backup supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)。

- **B. Configure an AWS Backup plan to copy backups to another Region.**  
  AWS Backup 支持 **Cross-Region backup**，并且可以作为计划备份的一部分，自动将备份复制到多个 AWS Regions。这可以直接满足备份在捕获后立即复制到至少另一个 Region 的要求，而无需自定义自动化。请参阅 [AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)。

- **D. Add an Amazon SNS topic to the backup plan to send a notification for finished jobs that have any status except `BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED`.**  
  AWS Backup 与 Amazon SNS 集成，用于备份活动通知。AWS Backup 通知文档列出了受支持的备份作业事件，例如 `BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED`、`BACKUP_JOB_SUCCESSFUL`、`BACKUP_JOB_FAILED` 和 `BACKUP_JOB_EXPIRED`，并提供了失败备份作业通知的示例。为失败/非成功的备份结果配置 SNS 通知，可以以最少的运维开销满足即时失败通知要求。请参阅 [Notification options with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-notifications.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **C. Create an AWS Lambda function to replicate backups to another Region and send notification if a failure occurs.**  
  这是不必要的自定义自动化。AWS Backup 已经提供计划性的 Cross-Region copy，并与 SNS 集成以进行通知。Lambda 会增加运维开销，并重复 AWS Backup 的原生功能。

- **E. Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager snapshot lifecycle policy for each of the retention requirements.**  
  Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 主要用于自动化 Amazon EBS 快照和由 EBS 支持的 AMI 的生命周期。它不能为 EC2、EFS 和 RDS 一起提供单一的集中式备份解决方案，也无法满足跨这些服务提供整合的 AWS 范围备份状态视图的要求。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 AMI lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ami-lifecycle.html)。

- **F. Set up RDS snapshots on each database.**  
  原生 RDS 快照只能解决环境中的 RDS 部分。它们不会覆盖 EC2 和 EFS，无法在所有所需服务之间提供单一的集中式备份状态来源，并且相比 AWS Backup 需要更多按服务进行的运维管理。

en.question: A company is developing a gene reporting device that will collect genomic information to assist researchers with collecting large samples of data from a diverse population. The device will push 8 KB of genomic data every second to a data platform that will need to process and analyze the data and provide information back to researchers. The data platform must meet the following requirements: • Provide near-real-time analytics of the inbound genomic data • Ensure the data is flexible, parallel, and durable • Deliver results of processing to a data warehouse Which strategy should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to collect the inbound sensor data, analyze the data with Kinesis clients, and save the results to an Amazon RDS instance.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect the inbound sensor data, analyze the data with Kinesis clients, and save the results to an Amazon Redshift cluster using Amazon EMR.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 to collect the inbound device data, analyze the data from Amazon SQS with Kinesis, and save the results to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.D: Use an Amazon API Gateway to put requests into an Amazon SQS queue, analyze the data with an AWS Lambda function, and save the results to an Amazon Redshift cluster using Amazon EMR.

en.explanation:
### What the question is asking

The platform receives a continuous stream of small genomic records (8 KB every second per device) and must support near-real-time analytics, parallel and durable stream processing, and delivery of processed results to a data warehouse.

### Correct answer: B

**B. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to collect the inbound sensor data, analyze the data with Kinesis clients, and save the results to an Amazon Redshift cluster using Amazon EMR.**

This is the best match for all requirements:

* **Near-real-time ingestion and analytics:** AWS documentation states that Kinesis Data Streams supports rapid, continuous data intake and that records are available for processing in seconds. It also specifically lists **real-time metrics and reporting** and **real-time data analytics** as typical use cases, including parallel processing by multiple Kinesis applications ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)).
* **Flexible, parallel, and durable processing:** Kinesis Data Streams provides durability and elasticity, supports multiple applications consuming the same stream concurrently, and the Kinesis Client Library provides fault-tolerant consumption and scaling support ([Kinesis Data Streams benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)).
* **Processing with EMR:** Amazon EMR can directly read and process Kinesis streams using Hadoop ecosystem tools, and EMR also supports Spark structured streaming with the Kinesis Data Streams connector ([EMR with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/using-other-services-emr.html), [Spark structured streaming Kinesis connector on EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-spark-structured-streaming-kinesis.html)).
* **Data warehouse target:** Amazon Redshift is AWS’s fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse service ([Amazon Redshift overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). Therefore, delivering the processed results to Redshift satisfies the data warehouse requirement.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose ... save the results to an Amazon RDS instance.**

This option fails the **data warehouse** requirement. Amazon RDS is a relational database service, not the AWS data warehouse service. The question explicitly asks to deliver results to a data warehouse, and the AWS data warehouse service in the options is Amazon Redshift. Also, Kinesis Data Streams is a better fit than Firehose when the requirement emphasizes custom near-real-time stream analytics with Kinesis client applications.

**C. Use Amazon S3 to collect the inbound device data, analyze the data from Amazon SQS with Kinesis, and save the results to Amazon Redshift.**

S3 is durable storage, but it is not the best primary ingestion service for second-by-second streaming records requiring near-real-time parallel analytics. The option is also architecturally confused: it says to analyze data “from Amazon SQS with Kinesis,” but Kinesis Data Streams is the streaming ingestion and processing service designed for this pattern. The Kinesis documentation describes producers pushing directly into streams and consumers processing the stream in near real time ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)).

**D. Use API Gateway to put requests into SQS, analyze with Lambda, and save results to Redshift using EMR.**

This design introduces API Gateway and SQS where a purpose-built streaming service is required. SQS is a queueing service, not a parallel durable streaming analytics service equivalent to Kinesis Data Streams. Lambda could process messages, but this option does not provide the same native stream-processing model, multiple parallel stream consumers, and Kinesis Client Library scaling/fault-tolerance support described for Kinesis Data Streams ([Kinesis Data Streams benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). It is less suitable for the stated “flexible, parallel, and durable” streaming analytics requirement.

### Final answer

**B**

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一种基因报告设备，该设备将收集基因组信息，以帮助研究人员从多样化人群中收集大量数据样本。该设备将每秒向一个数据平台推送 8 KB 的基因组数据，该数据平台需要处理和分析这些数据，并将信息返回给研究人员。该数据平台必须满足以下要求：• 对传入的基因组数据提供近实时分析 • 确保数据具备灵活性、并行性和持久性 • 将处理结果交付到数据仓库解决方案架构师应使用哪种策略来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 收集传入的传感器数据，使用 Kinesis 客户端分析数据，并将结果保存到 Amazon RDS 实例。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 收集传入的传感器数据，使用 Kinesis 客户端分析数据，并使用 Amazon EMR 将结果保存到 Amazon Redshift 集群。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 收集传入的设备数据，使用 Kinesis 从 Amazon SQS 分析数据，并将结果保存到 Amazon Redshift 集群。
options.D: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 将请求放入 Amazon SQS 队列，使用 AWS Lambda 函数分析数据，并使用 Amazon EMR 将结果保存到 Amazon Redshift 集群。

zh.explanation:
### 题目在问什么

该平台接收连续的小型基因组记录流（每台设备每秒 8 KB），并且必须支持近实时分析、并行且持久的流处理，以及将处理后的结果交付到数据仓库。

### 正确答案：B

**B. 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 收集传入的传感器数据，使用 Kinesis 客户端分析数据，并使用 Amazon EMR 将结果保存到 Amazon Redshift 集群。**

这是最符合所有要求的选择：

* **近实时摄取和分析：** AWS 文档说明，Kinesis Data Streams 支持快速、连续的数据摄取，并且记录可在数秒内用于处理。它还明确列出 **实时指标和报告** 以及 **实时数据分析** 作为典型使用场景，包括由多个 Kinesis 应用程序进行并行处理（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。
* **灵活、并行且持久的处理：** Kinesis Data Streams 提供持久性和弹性，支持多个应用程序并发消费同一个流，并且 Kinesis Client Library 提供容错消费和扩展支持（[Kinesis Data Streams benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。
* **使用 EMR 进行处理：** Amazon EMR 可以使用 Hadoop 生态系统工具直接读取和处理 Kinesis 流，并且 EMR 还支持通过 Kinesis Data Streams connector 进行 Spark structured streaming（[EMR with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/using-other-services-emr.html)，[Spark structured streaming Kinesis connector on EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-spark-structured-streaming-kinesis.html)）。
* **数据仓库目标：** Amazon Redshift 是 AWS 的完全托管、PB 级云数据仓库服务（[Amazon Redshift overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。因此，将处理后的结果交付到 Redshift 满足数据仓库要求。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose ... 将结果保存到 Amazon RDS 实例。**

此选项不满足 **数据仓库** 要求。Amazon RDS 是关系数据库服务，而不是 AWS 数据仓库服务。题目明确要求将结果交付到数据仓库，而选项中的 AWS 数据仓库服务是 Amazon Redshift。此外，当要求强调使用 Kinesis 客户端应用程序进行自定义近实时流分析时，Kinesis Data Streams 比 Firehose 更合适。

**C. 使用 Amazon S3 收集传入的设备数据，使用 Kinesis 从 Amazon SQS 分析数据，并将结果保存到 Amazon Redshift。**

S3 是持久存储，但对于需要近实时并行分析的逐秒流式记录来说，它不是最佳的主要摄取服务。该选项在架构上也很混乱：它说要“使用 Kinesis 从 Amazon SQS 分析数据”，但 Kinesis Data Streams 才是为这种模式设计的流式摄取和处理服务。Kinesis 文档描述了生产者直接推送到流中、消费者近实时处理该流（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。

**D. 使用 API Gateway 将请求放入 SQS，使用 Lambda 分析，并使用 EMR 将结果保存到 Redshift。**

此设计在需要专门构建的流式传输服务的地方引入了 API Gateway 和 SQS。SQS 是队列服务，不是等同于 Kinesis Data Streams 的并行持久流式分析服务。Lambda 可以处理消息，但该选项没有提供与 Kinesis Data Streams 所描述的相同原生流处理模型、多个并行流消费者，以及 Kinesis Client Library 扩展/容错支持（[Kinesis Data Streams benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。它不太适合题目所述的“灵活、并行且持久”的流分析要求。

### 最终答案

**B**

en.question: A solutions architect needs to define a reference architecture for a solution for three-tier applications with web. application, and NoSQL data layers. The reference architecture must meet the following requirements: • High availability within an AWS Region • Able to fail over in 1 minute to another AWS Region for disaster recovery • Provide the most efficient solution while minimizing the impact on the user experience Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy set to 100/0 across the two selected Regions. Set Time to Live (TTL) to 1 hour.
options.B: Use an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy for failover from the primary Region to the disaster recovery Region. Set Time to Live (TTL) to 30 seconds.
options.C: Use a global table within Amazon DynamoDB so data can be accessed in the two selected Regions.
options.D: Back up data from an Amazon DynamoDB table in the primary Region every 60 minutes and then write the data to Amazon S3. Use S3 cross-Region replication to copy the data from the primary Region to the disaster recovery Region. Have a script import the data into DynamoDB in a disaster recovery scenario.
options.E: Implement a hot standby model using Auto Scaling groups for the web and application layers across multiple Availability Zones in the Regions. Use zonal Reserved Instances for the minimum number of servers and On-Demand Instances for any additional resources.
options.F: Use Auto Scaling groups for the web and application layers across multiple Availability Zones in the Regions. Use Spot Instances for the required resources.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The architecture is for a three-tier web/application/NoSQL application that must be highly available within a Region and fail over to another Region within about 1 minute, while minimizing user impact and being efficient. This points to an active/passive DR design with fast traffic failover, continuously replicated data, and already-running compute capacity in the DR Region.

## Correct answers: B, C, E

### B. Use Route 53 failover routing with a 30-second TTL

Route 53 failover records are designed for active/passive failover: AWS documentation says to choose **Failover** as the routing policy and that failover records require one primary and one secondary record. The same documentation states that when a record is associated with a health check, AWS recommends a TTL of **60 seconds or less** so clients respond quickly to health changes ([Route 53 failover record values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover.html)). A 30-second TTL supports the requirement to fail over in about 1 minute, subject to DNS caching behavior.

### C. Use DynamoDB global tables

DynamoDB global tables are explicitly built for this use case. AWS describes them as a fully managed, multi-Region, multi-active feature that automatically replicates DynamoDB table data across Regions and provides fast local read/write performance. The documentation also states that any replica can serve reads and writes, and that applications can achieve high resilience with low or zero RPO by shifting traffic to another Region if processing is interrupted in one Region ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). This is the correct NoSQL data-layer choice for rapid cross-Region DR.

### E. Implement hot standby with Auto Scaling groups across multiple AZs and use Reserved/On-Demand capacity

A hot standby/warm standby style architecture keeps the recovery environment deployed and ready, minimizing recovery time. AWS DR guidance explains that warm standby is a scaled-down but fully functional copy in another Region and that hot standby is a statically stable configuration with sufficient capacity already provisioned, reducing dependency on scaling during failover. The same AWS guidance states that Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling scales EC2 deployments across Availability Zones within a Region, providing resiliency within that Region, and can be used to scale out the DR Region ([AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)).

Using Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones for the web and application tiers addresses high availability within each Region. Keeping a minimum baseline of reserved capacity and using On-Demand Instances for additional capacity is more dependable than Spot for a DR baseline and is cost-efficient for the always-running minimum capacity.

## Incorrect options

### A. Route 53 weighted routing 100/0 with a 1-hour TTL

Weighted routing with 100/0 can approximate active/passive traffic distribution, but it is not the best choice here because it is not the native Route 53 failover policy. More importantly, a **1-hour TTL** conflicts with the 1-minute failover requirement. AWS notes that longer TTL values cause recursive resolvers to cache records longer, so record changes take longer to take effect; for health-check-based records, AWS recommends a TTL of 60 seconds or less ([Route 53 failover record values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover.html)).

### D. Back up DynamoDB every 60 minutes, replicate to S3, and import during DR

This is a backup-and-restore approach, not a fast failover approach. AWS DR guidance states that backup frequency determines achievable recovery point and that backup/restore can require redeploying infrastructure, configuration, and application code, which can increase recovery times ([AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)). A 60-minute backup cycle also risks up to an hour of data loss and requires restore/import operations during the disaster, so it does not meet the 1-minute failover and minimal user-impact requirements. DynamoDB global tables are the more appropriate managed multi-Region replication option.

### F. Use Spot Instances for required resources

Spot Instances are not appropriate for the required baseline capacity of a highly available DR architecture because they can be interrupted. AWS Auto Scaling documentation states that Amazon EC2 can terminate an individual Spot Instance as availability or price changes ([Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)). Spot can be useful for flexible or non-critical capacity, but relying on Spot for required web/application resources undermines availability and predictable failover.

zh.question: 解决方案架构师需要为一个三层应用程序解决方案定义参考架构，该应用程序包含 Web、应用程序和 NoSQL 数据层。该参考架构必须满足以下要求：• 在一个 AWS 区域内实现高可用性 • 能够在 1 分钟内故障转移到另一个 AWS 区域以进行灾难恢复 • 在尽量减少对用户体验影响的同时提供最高效的解决方案哪些步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Route 53 加权路由策略，在两个选定区域之间设置为 100/0。将生存时间 (TTL) 设置为 1 小时。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Route 53 故障转移路由策略，从主区域故障转移到灾难恢复区域。将生存时间 (TTL) 设置为 30 秒。
options.C: 在 Amazon DynamoDB 中使用全局表，以便可以在两个选定区域中访问数据。
options.D: 每 60 分钟备份主区域中 Amazon DynamoDB 表的数据，然后将数据写入 Amazon S3。使用 S3 跨区域复制将数据从主区域复制到灾难恢复区域。在灾难恢复场景中使用脚本将数据导入 DynamoDB。
options.E: 在各区域的多个可用区中，为 Web 层和应用程序层使用 Auto Scaling 组来实施热备用模型。对最少数量的服务器使用可用区预留实例，并对任何额外资源使用按需实例。
options.F: 在各区域的多个可用区中，为 Web 层和应用程序层使用 Auto Scaling 组。对所需资源使用竞价型实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该架构面向一个三层 Web/应用程序/NoSQL 应用程序，要求在区域内具有高可用性，并在约 1 分钟内故障转移到另一个区域，同时最大限度减少用户影响并保持高效。这指向一种主动/被动 DR 设计，具备快速流量故障转移、持续复制的数据，以及在 DR 区域中已运行的计算容量。

## 正确答案：B、C、E

### B. 使用 Route 53 故障转移路由并设置 30 秒 TTL

Route 53 故障转移记录专为主动/被动故障转移而设计：AWS 文档说明，应选择 **Failover** 作为路由策略，并且故障转移记录需要一个主记录和一个辅助记录。同一文档指出，当记录与运行状况检查关联时，AWS 建议将 TTL 设置为 **60 秒或更短**，以便客户端快速响应运行状况变化（[Route 53 failover record values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover.html)）。30 秒 TTL 支持在约 1 分钟内故障转移的要求，但仍受 DNS 缓存行为影响。

### C. 使用 DynamoDB 全局表

DynamoDB 全局表明确是为此使用场景构建的。AWS 将其描述为一种完全托管、多区域、多主动功能，可自动跨区域复制 DynamoDB 表数据，并提供快速的本地读/写性能。文档还指出，任何副本都可以处理读取和写入，并且如果一个区域中的处理被中断，应用程序可以通过将流量转移到另一个区域来实现低 RPO 或零 RPO 的高弹性（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。这是用于快速跨区域 DR 的正确 NoSQL 数据层选择。

### E. 在多个 AZ 中使用 Auto Scaling 组实施热备用，并使用预留/按需容量

热备用/温备用风格的架构会保持恢复环境已部署并就绪，从而最大限度缩短恢复时间。AWS DR 指南解释说，温备用是在另一个区域中一个缩减规模但功能完整的副本，而热备用是具有已预置足够容量的静态稳定配置，可减少故障转移期间对扩展的依赖。同一 AWS 指南指出，Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会在一个区域内跨可用区扩展 EC2 部署，从而在该区域内提供弹性，并且可用于横向扩展 DR 区域（[AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。

为 Web 层和应用程序层在多个可用区中使用 Auto Scaling 组，可以解决每个区域内的高可用性问题。保持最低基线的预留容量，并对额外容量使用按需实例，比将 Spot 用于 DR 基线更可靠，并且对于始终运行的最低容量来说具有成本效益。

## 错误选项

### A. Route 53 加权路由 100/0，并设置 1 小时 TTL

加权路由 100/0 可以近似实现主动/被动流量分配，但在这里不是最佳选择，因为它不是原生的 Route 53 故障转移策略。更重要的是，**1 小时 TTL** 与 1 分钟故障转移要求冲突。AWS 指出，较长的 TTL 值会使递归解析器缓存记录更久，因此记录更改需要更长时间才会生效；对于基于运行状况检查的记录，AWS 建议 TTL 为 60 秒或更短（[Route 53 failover record values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover.html)）。

### D. 每 60 分钟备份 DynamoDB，复制到 S3，并在 DR 期间导入

这是一种备份和还原方法，而不是快速故障转移方法。AWS DR 指南指出，备份频率决定可实现的恢复点，并且备份/还原可能需要重新部署基础设施、配置和应用程序代码，这会增加恢复时间（[AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。60 分钟备份周期还可能带来最多一小时的数据丢失风险，并且需要在灾难期间执行还原/导入操作，因此无法满足 1 分钟故障转移和最小用户影响的要求。DynamoDB 全局表是更合适的托管式多区域复制选项。

### F. 对所需资源使用 Spot Instances

Spot Instances 不适合作为高可用 DR 架构所需的基线容量，因为它们可能会被中断。AWS Auto Scaling 文档指出，当可用性或价格发生变化时，Amazon EC2 可以终止单个 Spot Instance（[Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。Spot 可用于灵活或非关键容量，但依赖 Spot 来承载所需的 Web/应用程序资源，会削弱可用性和可预测的故障转移。

en.question: A company manufactures smart vehicles. The company uses a custom application to collect vehicle data. The vehicles use the MQTT protocol to connect to the application. The company processes the data in 5- minute intervals. The company then copies vehicle telematics data to on-premises storage. Custom applications analyze this data to detect anomalies. The number of vehicles that send data grows constantly. Newer vehicles generate high volumes of data. The on-premises storage solution is not able to scale for peak traffic, which results in data loss. The company must modernize the solution and migrate the solution to AWS to resolve the scaling challenges. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS IoT Greengrass to send the vehicle data to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Create an Apache Kafka application to store the data in Amazon S3. Use a pretrained model in Amazon SageMaker to detect anomalies.
options.B: Use AWS IoT Core to receive the vehicle data. Configure rules to route data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that stores the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics application that reads from the delivery stream to detect anomalies.
options.C: Use AWS IoT FleetWise to collect the vehicle data. Send the data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Use an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Use the built-in machine learning transforms in AWS Glue to detect anomalies.
options.D: Use Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ to collect the vehicle data. Send the data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Lookout for Metrics to detect anomalies.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: B

The company needs a managed, scalable AWS-native ingestion and analytics pipeline for vehicle telemetry that already uses **MQTT**, stores data durably, and detects anomalies with the least operational overhead.

Option **B** best matches the requirements:

- **AWS IoT Core** is the natural managed ingestion point for MQTT devices. The AWS IoT Core documentation states that AWS IoT Core supports **MQTT** and that its message broker supports devices and clients using MQTT to publish and subscribe to messages ([AWS IoT Core: What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)).
- **AWS IoT rules** can process MQTT topic streams and route device data to AWS services. The rule documentation says rules are analyzed and actions are performed based on the MQTT topic stream, and that rules can process messages from a large number of devices using Amazon Kinesis ([Rules for AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rules.html)). The supported rule actions specifically include **Firehose**, which “sends a message to a Firehose delivery stream,” and **S3**, which stores a message in Amazon S3 ([AWS IoT rule actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rule-actions.html)).
- **Amazon Data Firehose / Kinesis Data Firehose** is fully managed and can deliver real-time streaming data to **Amazon S3**. The documentation says you do not need to write applications or manage resources; Firehose automatically delivers data to the configured destination ([What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). This directly addresses the on-premises storage scaling and data-loss issue.
- **Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL applications** can use a Firehose delivery stream as a streaming source: `KinesisFirehoseInput` identifies a Firehose delivery stream as the streaming source for Kinesis Analytics ([KinesisFirehoseInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/API_KinesisFirehoseInput.html)). It also provides the `RANDOM_CUT_FOREST` function to assign anomaly scores to records in a stream ([Example: Detecting Data Anomalies on a Stream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/app-anomaly-detection.html)).

Therefore, **IoT Core + IoT rules + Firehose to S3 + Kinesis Data Analytics anomaly detection** is the most managed and operationally simple architecture among the choices.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. IoT Greengrass + MSK + custom Kafka app + SageMaker pretrained model
This is unnecessarily complex. AWS IoT Greengrass is an edge runtime, and Amazon MSK plus a custom Kafka application introduces broker and application management overhead. The option also says to use a “pretrained model in SageMaker,” but the question does not provide an existing model or require building an ML hosting pipeline. Compared with a managed IoT Core rule and Firehose-based pipeline, this option has significantly more operational overhead.

### C. IoT FleetWise + Kinesis Data Streams + Firehose + AWS Glue ML transforms
AWS IoT FleetWise is vehicle-focused, but this option is not the best fit for least operational overhead in this scenario. The company already has vehicles using MQTT to a custom application, and AWS IoT Core directly supports MQTT ingestion. AWS IoT FleetWise requires additional FleetWise-specific setup, such as vehicle models, decoder manifests, vehicles, and campaigns; the getting-started tutorial explicitly walks through creating these components ([AWS IoT FleetWise getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot-fleetwise/latest/developerguide/fleetwise-getting-started.html)). In addition, AWS Glue ML transforms are not the best managed streaming anomaly-detection service in the answer set; Kinesis Data Analytics has explicit streaming anomaly detection support with Random Cut Forest.

### D. Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ + Firehose + Lookout for Metrics
Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ is a managed message broker, but it is not the lowest-overhead AWS-native ingestion service for a large fleet of MQTT IoT devices. AWS IoT Core is purpose-built for IoT device connectivity and MQTT ingestion. This option also does not describe the direct IoT rules-based routing path from MQTT messages to Firehose/S3, and it adds a message broker layer that is unnecessary for the stated requirements.

## Note on current documentation
Current AWS documentation notes that **Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL applications** are being discontinued, but within the context of this exam-style question and the available options, option **B** remains the intended and best-supported architecture because it directly matches MQTT ingestion, scalable delivery to S3, and streaming anomaly detection with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司生产智能汽车。该公司使用自定义应用程序收集车辆数据。这些车辆使用 MQTT 协议连接到该应用程序。公司以 5 分钟为间隔处理数据。然后，公司将车辆遥测数据复制到本地存储。自定义应用程序会分析这些数据以检测异常。发送数据的车辆数量持续增长。较新的车辆会生成大量数据。本地存储解决方案无法针对峰值流量进行扩展，导致数据丢失。公司必须对该解决方案进行现代化改造，并将解决方案迁移到 AWS，以解决扩展性挑战。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS IoT Greengrass 将车辆数据发送到 Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)。创建一个 Apache Kafka 应用程序，将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon SageMaker 中的预训练模型来检测异常。
options.B: 使用 AWS IoT Core 接收车辆数据。配置规则，将数据路由到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流，并将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。创建一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 应用程序，从该传输流读取数据以检测异常。
options.C: 使用 AWS IoT FleetWise 收集车辆数据。将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis data stream。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Glue 中的内置机器学习转换来检测异常。
options.D: 使用 Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 收集车辆数据。将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流以存储到 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Lookout for Metrics 检测异常。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：B

该公司需要一个托管的、可扩展的 AWS 原生摄取与分析管道，用于处理已经使用 **MQTT** 的车辆遥测数据，能够持久存储数据，并以最少的运营开销检测异常。

选项 **B** 最符合这些要求：

- **AWS IoT Core** 是 MQTT 设备的自然托管摄取点。AWS IoT Core 文档说明，AWS IoT Core 支持 **MQTT**，并且其消息代理支持使用 MQTT 的设备和客户端发布和订阅消息（[AWS IoT Core: What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)）。
- **AWS IoT rules** 可以处理 MQTT 主题流，并将设备数据路由到 AWS 服务。规则文档说明，会基于 MQTT 主题流分析规则并执行操作，并且规则可以使用 Amazon Kinesis 处理来自大量设备的消息（[Rules for AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rules.html)）。受支持的规则操作明确包括 **Firehose**，它“将消息发送到 Firehose 传输流”，以及 **S3**，它将消息存储在 Amazon S3 中（[AWS IoT rule actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rule-actions.html)）。
- **Amazon Data Firehose / Kinesis Data Firehose** 是完全托管的服务，可以将实时流式数据传送到 **Amazon S3**。文档说明，你无需编写应用程序或管理资源；Firehose 会自动将数据传送到配置的目标（[What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。这直接解决了本地存储扩展和数据丢失问题。
- **Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL applications** 可以使用 Firehose 传输流作为流式源：`KinesisFirehoseInput` 将 Firehose 传输流标识为 Kinesis Analytics 的流式源（[KinesisFirehoseInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/API_KinesisFirehoseInput.html)）。它还提供 `RANDOM_CUT_FOREST` 函数，用于为流中的记录分配异常分数（[Example: Detecting Data Anomalies on a Stream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/app-anomaly-detection.html)）。

因此，**IoT Core + IoT rules + Firehose to S3 + Kinesis Data Analytics anomaly detection** 是这些选项中托管程度最高且运营最简单的架构。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. IoT Greengrass + MSK + custom Kafka app + SageMaker pretrained model
这过于复杂。AWS IoT Greengrass 是一种边缘运行时，Amazon MSK 加上自定义 Kafka 应用程序会引入代理和应用程序管理开销。该选项还说使用 “SageMaker 中的预训练模型”，但题目没有提供现有模型，也没有要求构建 ML 托管管道。与基于托管 IoT Core 规则和 Firehose 的管道相比，此选项的运营开销明显更高。

### C. IoT FleetWise + Kinesis Data Streams + Firehose + AWS Glue ML transforms
AWS IoT FleetWise 面向车辆场景，但在此场景中，它并不是最符合最少运营开销要求的选择。公司已有车辆使用 MQTT 连接到自定义应用程序，而 AWS IoT Core 直接支持 MQTT 摄取。AWS IoT FleetWise 需要额外的 FleetWise 专用设置，例如车辆模型、解码器清单、车辆和活动；入门教程明确演示了如何创建这些组件（[AWS IoT FleetWise getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot-fleetwise/latest/developerguide/fleetwise-getting-started.html)）。此外，在答案集中，AWS Glue ML transforms 并不是最佳的托管流式异常检测服务；Kinesis Data Analytics 明确支持使用 Random Cut Forest 进行流式异常检测。

### D. Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ + Firehose + Lookout for Metrics
Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 是一种托管消息代理，但对于大规模 MQTT IoT 设备车队而言，它并不是运营开销最低的 AWS 原生摄取服务。AWS IoT Core 专为 IoT 设备连接和 MQTT 摄取而构建。此选项也没有描述从 MQTT 消息到 Firehose/S3 的直接基于 IoT 规则的路由路径，并且增加了一个对所述要求并非必要的消息代理层。

## 关于当前文档的说明
当前 AWS 文档指出，**Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL applications** 将被停用，但在这道考试风格题目和可用选项的上下文中，选项 **B** 仍然是预期且支持最充分的架构，因为它直接匹配 MQTT 摄取、可扩展传送到 S3，以及以最少运营开销进行流式异常检测。

en.question: During an audit, a security team discovered that a development team was putting IAM user secret access keys in their code and then committing it to an AWS CodeCommit repository. The security team wants to automatically find and remediate instances of this security vulnerability. Which solution will ensure that the credentials are appropriately secured automatically?

options.A: Run a script nightly using AWS Systems Manager Run Command to search for credentials on the development instances. If found, use AWS Secrets Manager to rotate the credentials
options.B: Use a scheduled AWS Lambda function to download and scan the application code from CodeCommit. If credentials are found, generate new credentials and store them in AWS KMS.
options.C: Configure Amazon Macie to scan for credentials in CodeCommit repositories. If credentials are found, trigger an AWS Lambda function to disable the credentials and notify the user.
options.D: Configure a CodeCommit trigger to invoke an AWS Lambda function to scan new code submissions for credentials. If credentials are found, disable them in AWS IAM and notify the user.

en.explanation:
The scenario is about preventing/remediating leaked long-term IAM user access keys that developers commit to an AWS CodeCommit repository. The required solution should automatically inspect repository changes and take an IAM remediation action when leaked credentials are detected.

**Correct answer: D. Configure a CodeCommit trigger to invoke an AWS Lambda function to scan new code submissions for credentials. If credentials are found, disable them in AWS IAM and notify the user.**

CodeCommit supports repository triggers that integrate with Lambda functions. The AWS CodeCommit documentation states that you can integrate Lambda functions with CodeCommit triggers, and that a trigger can be configured so CodeCommit has permission to invoke the Lambda function ([AWS CodeCommit: Manage triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-notify.html)). This fits the event-driven requirement: when code is pushed/updated in the repository, Lambda can inspect the submitted content for access key patterns and then remediate.

For remediation, IAM access keys can be deactivated. AWS IAM documentation states that after an access key is deactivated, it can no longer be used by API calls, and this can be done through the `UpdateAccessKey` operation/CLI command ([IAM: deactivate an access key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-keys-admin-managed.html)). Therefore, a Lambda function can identify the leaked access key ID, call IAM to deactivate it, and notify the affected user/security team.

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Nightly Systems Manager Run Command scan of development instances** — This scans developer instances, not the CodeCommit repository where the vulnerability is being introduced. It is also delayed until the nightly run. In addition, Secrets Manager rotation is not the right remediation for arbitrary IAM user access keys that have already been committed to source code; the compromised IAM access key should be disabled/deactivated and replaced through a controlled process.

- **B. Scheduled Lambda download/scan and store new credentials in AWS KMS** — A scheduled scan is less immediate than a repository trigger. More importantly, AWS KMS is a key management/encryption service, not a secrets storage service for application credentials. Also, simply generating and storing new credentials does not automatically secure the leaked credentials unless the exposed keys are disabled.

- **C. Configure Amazon Macie to scan CodeCommit repositories** — Macie is designed for sensitive data discovery in **Amazon S3**. The Macie documentation describes discovery of sensitive data by analyzing objects in S3 buckets and maintaining visibility into an organization's S3 data estate ([Amazon Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)). It does not provide a feature to directly scan CodeCommit repositories. Although Macie can detect credential-like data in S3 objects, CodeCommit repositories are not configurable Macie scan targets.

Therefore, **D** is the best solution because it uses CodeCommit-native event integration with Lambda for automatic detection and IAM key deactivation for automatic remediation.

zh.question: 在一次审计中，安全团队发现开发团队将 IAM 用户秘密访问密钥放在代码中，然后提交到 AWS CodeCommit 存储库。安全团队希望自动查找并修复此类安全漏洞实例。哪种解决方案将确保这些凭证自动得到适当保护？

options.A: 每晚使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 运行脚本，在开发实例上搜索凭证。如果发现凭证，则使用 AWS Secrets Manager 轮换这些凭证。
options.B: 使用计划的 AWS Lambda 函数从 CodeCommit 下载并扫描应用程序代码。如果发现凭证，则生成新凭证并将其存储在 AWS KMS 中。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Macie 扫描 CodeCommit 存储库中的凭证。如果发现凭证，则触发 AWS Lambda 函数以禁用这些凭证并通知用户。
options.D: 配置 CodeCommit 触发器以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来扫描新的代码提交中是否包含凭证。如果发现凭证，则在 AWS IAM 中禁用这些凭证并通知用户。

zh.explanation:
该场景是关于防止/修复开发人员提交到 AWS CodeCommit 存储库的长期 IAM 用户访问密钥泄露。所需解决方案应在检测到泄露凭证时自动检查存储库变更并执行 IAM 修复操作。

**正确答案：D. 配置 CodeCommit 触发器以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来扫描新的代码提交中是否包含凭证。如果发现凭证，则在 AWS IAM 中禁用这些凭证并通知用户。**

CodeCommit 支持与 Lambda 函数集成的存储库触发器。AWS CodeCommit 文档指出，你可以将 Lambda 函数与 CodeCommit 触发器集成，并且可以配置触发器，使 CodeCommit 有权限调用该 Lambda 函数（[AWS CodeCommit: Manage triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-notify.html)）。这符合事件驱动的要求：当代码被推送/更新到存储库时，Lambda 可以检查提交内容中是否包含访问密钥模式，然后进行修复。

对于修复，可以停用 IAM 访问密钥。AWS IAM 文档指出，访问密钥停用后，API 调用将无法再使用它，并且可以通过 `UpdateAccessKey` 操作/CLI 命令完成此操作（[IAM: deactivate an access key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-keys-admin-managed.html)）。因此，Lambda 函数可以识别泄露的访问密钥 ID，调用 IAM 将其停用，并通知受影响的用户/安全团队。

### 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 每晚使用 Systems Manager Run Command 扫描开发实例** — 这会扫描开发人员实例，而不是漏洞被引入的 CodeCommit 存储库。它还会延迟到夜间运行时才执行。此外，对于已经提交到源代码中的任意 IAM 用户访问密钥，Secrets Manager 轮换并不是正确的修复方式；应禁用/停用受泄露影响的 IAM 访问密钥，并通过受控流程进行替换。

- **B. 计划 Lambda 下载/扫描并将新凭证存储在 AWS KMS 中** — 计划扫描不如存储库触发器即时。更重要的是，AWS KMS 是密钥管理/加密服务，而不是用于应用程序凭证的秘密存储服务。此外，仅仅生成并存储新凭证并不会自动保护已泄露的凭证，除非禁用暴露的密钥。

- **C. 配置 Amazon Macie 扫描 CodeCommit 存储库** — Macie 旨在发现 **Amazon S3** 中的敏感数据。Macie 文档描述了通过分析 S3 存储桶中的对象来发现敏感数据，并持续了解组织的 S3 数据资产（[Amazon Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。它不提供直接扫描 CodeCommit 存储库的功能。尽管 Macie 可以检测 S3 对象中类似凭证的数据，但 CodeCommit 存储库不是可配置的 Macie 扫描目标。

因此，**D** 是最佳解决方案，因为它使用 CodeCommit 原生事件集成 Lambda 进行自动检测，并使用 IAM 密钥停用进行自动修复。

en.question: A company has a data lake in Amazon S3 that needs to be accessed by hundreds of applications across many AWS accounts. The company's information security policy states that the S3 bucket must not be accessed over the public internet and that each application should have the minimum permissions necessary to function. To meet these requirements, a solutions architect plans to use an S3 access point that is restricted to specific VPCs for each application. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to implement this solution? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an S3 access point for each application in the AWS account that owns the S3 bucket. Configure each access point to be accessible only from the application’s VPC. Update the bucket policy to require access from an access point.
options.B: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in each application's VPC. Configure the endpoint policy to allow access to an S3 access point. Create a VPC gateway attachment for the S3 endpoint.
options.C: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in each application's VPConfigure the endpoint policy to allow access to an S3 access point. Specify the route table that is used to access the access point.
options.D: Create an S3 access point for each application in each AWS account and attach the access points to the S3 bucket. Configure each access point to be accessible only from the application's VPC. Update the bucket policy to require access from an access point.
options.E: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the data lake's VPC. Attach an endpoint policy to allow access to the S3 bucket. Specify the route table that is used to access the bucket.

en.explanation:
The company needs private, least-privilege access to a shared S3 data lake from many applications in many AWS accounts. The proposed design is to use S3 access points that are restricted to specific VPCs, so the implementation must both (1) create and govern the access points correctly and (2) provide private VPC connectivity to S3 with an endpoint policy that permits access through those access points.

**Correct answers: A and C.**

### Why A is correct
Amazon S3 access points are designed for shared datasets: each access point has distinct permissions and network controls, and S3 can restrict an access point so that requests must originate from a specified VPC. The S3 documentation states that access points are named network endpoints attached to a bucket and that each access point can enforce customized permissions and network controls; it also says you can configure an access point to accept requests only from a VPC ([S3 access points overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)).

Creating one access point per application in the AWS account that owns the data lake bucket lets the bucket owner centrally manage the data lake while giving each application a tailored access point policy for least privilege. When creating an access point, you choose the bucket data source and can choose **VPC** as the network origin and specify the VPC ID ([Creating access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/creating-access-points.html)). S3 also documents that a VPC-only access point rejects requests that do not originate from the configured VPC ([Creating access points restricted to a VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)).

Updating the bucket policy is also necessary. S3 access point permissions work together with the underlying bucket policy: for access through an access point to work, both the access point and the bucket must permit the request. AWS recommends delegating bucket access control to access points for use cases that do not require direct bucket access ([Configuring IAM policies for using access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-policies.html)).

### Why C is correct
For resources in an application's VPC to access S3 without traversing the public internet, create an **S3 gateway VPC endpoint** in that application's VPC. AWS states that gateway endpoints let you access Amazon S3 from your VPC without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device, and that after creation the endpoint is added as a target in route tables for S3 traffic ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).

This also matches the requirement to configure route tables and endpoint policy. The VPC documentation says that when creating a gateway endpoint, you select the route tables to be used by the endpoint and can attach a custom endpoint policy. The S3 VPC access point documentation specifically says that, to use an access point with a VPC, you must modify the VPC endpoint policy, and requests through an access point succeed only if the VPC endpoint policy grants access to both the access point and the underlying bucket ([Creating access points restricted to a VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)).

### Why the other options are incorrect

**B is incorrect.** Amazon S3 does support both gateway and interface endpoints, but for normal access from resources inside each application's VPC to S3, a gateway endpoint is the intended no-additional-cost solution. AWS notes that gateway endpoints support private access from a VPC to S3 without an internet gateway or NAT device, while interface endpoints are required for scenarios such as access from on-premises networks, peered VPCs in other Regions, or through a transit gateway ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). The option also mentions creating a “VPC gateway attachment” for the S3 endpoint, which is not the standard configuration step; the gateway endpoint is associated with route tables.

**D is incorrect.** The better design is to create and manage the per-application access points in the bucket-owning data lake account, as in option A. Although S3 can support cross-account access points, AWS states that creating a cross-account access point does not itself grant access; the bucket owner must update the bucket policy to authorize requests from the access point ([Creating access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/creating-access-points.html)). For a centrally owned data lake with hundreds of applications, option D spreads access point creation across many accounts unnecessarily and is not the intended centralized design.

**E is incorrect.** A gateway endpoint must exist in the VPC whose resources need private S3 access. Creating one endpoint in the data lake's VPC would not provide private S3 access for applications running in many other VPCs/accounts. AWS also states that gateway endpoint connections cannot be extended outside a VPC over VPN, VPC peering, transit gateway, or Direct Connect ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).

Therefore, the required combination is: create per-application, VPC-restricted S3 access points controlled by the bucket owner, and create an S3 gateway endpoint in each application's VPC with the appropriate route table and endpoint policy configuration.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon S3 中有一个数据湖，需要被许多 AWS 账户中的数百个应用程序访问。该公司的信息安全策略规定，不能通过公有互联网访问该 S3 存储桶，并且每个应用程序都应只拥有运行所需的最小权限。为了满足这些要求，解决方案架构师计划为每个应用程序使用限制到特定 VPC 的 S3 access point。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项步骤组合来实施此解决方案？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在拥有该 S3 存储桶的 AWS 账户中，为每个应用程序创建一个 S3 access point。将每个 access point 配置为只能从该应用程序的 VPC 访问。更新存储桶策略，要求通过 access point 进行访问。
options.B: 在每个应用程序的 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个 interface endpoint。配置 endpoint policy 以允许访问 S3 access point。为该 S3 endpoint 创建 VPC gateway attachment。
options.C: 在每个应用程序的 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个 gateway endpoint。配置 endpoint policy 以允许访问 S3 access point。指定用于访问该 access point 的路由表。
options.D: 在每个 AWS 账户中为每个应用程序创建一个 S3 access point，并将这些 access point 附加到该 S3 存储桶。将每个 access point 配置为只能从该应用程序的 VPC 访问。更新存储桶策略，要求通过 access point 进行访问。
options.E: 在数据湖的 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个 gateway endpoint。附加 endpoint policy 以允许访问该 S3 存储桶。指定用于访问该存储桶的路由表。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要让许多 AWS 账户中的多个应用程序以私有方式、按最小权限访问共享的 S3 数据湖。拟议设计是使用限制到特定 VPC 的 S3 access points，因此实施方案必须同时做到：(1) 正确创建并治理这些 access points；(2) 通过 endpoint policy 提供到 S3 的私有 VPC 连接，并允许通过这些 access points 进行访问。

**正确答案：A 和 C。**

### 为什么 A 正确
Amazon S3 access points 专为共享数据集而设计：每个 access point 都有独立的权限和网络控制，S3 可以限制 access point，使请求必须源自指定的 VPC。S3 文档说明，access points 是附加到存储桶的命名网络端点，并且每个 access point 都可以强制执行自定义权限和网络控制；文档还说明，你可以将 access point 配置为仅接受来自某个 VPC 的请求（[S3 access points overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)）。

在拥有数据湖存储桶的 AWS 账户中，为每个应用程序创建一个 access point，使存储桶拥有者可以集中管理数据湖，同时为每个应用程序提供定制的 access point policy 以实现最小权限。创建 access point 时，你选择存储桶数据源，并且可以选择 **VPC** 作为网络来源并指定 VPC ID（[Creating access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/creating-access-points.html)）。S3 还记录了，仅限 VPC 的 access point 会拒绝并非源自所配置 VPC 的请求（[Creating access points restricted to a VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)）。

更新存储桶策略也是必要的。S3 access point 权限会与底层存储桶策略共同生效：要使通过 access point 的访问正常工作，access point 和存储桶都必须允许该请求。AWS 建议，对于不需要直接存储桶访问的使用场景，将存储桶访问控制委托给 access points（[Configuring IAM policies for using access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-policies.html)）。

### 为什么 C 正确
要让应用程序 VPC 中的资源在不经过公有互联网的情况下访问 S3，请在该应用程序的 VPC 中创建一个 **S3 gateway VPC endpoint**。AWS 说明，gateway endpoints 让你无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device 即可从 VPC 访问 Amazon S3，并且创建后，该 endpoint 会作为 S3 流量的目标添加到路由表中（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。

这也符合配置路由表和 endpoint policy 的要求。VPC 文档说明，创建 gateway endpoint 时，你要选择该 endpoint 使用的路由表，并且可以附加自定义 endpoint policy。S3 VPC access point 文档明确说明，要将 access point 与 VPC 配合使用，必须修改 VPC endpoint policy，并且通过 access point 发出的请求只有在 VPC endpoint policy 同时授予对该 access point 和底层存储桶的访问权限时才会成功（[Creating access points restricted to a VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)）。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**B 不正确。** Amazon S3 同时支持 gateway endpoint 和 interface endpoint，但对于从每个应用程序 VPC 内的资源正常访问 S3，gateway endpoint 是预期的、无额外费用的解决方案。AWS 指出，gateway endpoints 支持从 VPC 到 S3 的私有访问，而无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device；而 interface endpoints 则用于诸如从本地网络、其他区域中的对等 VPC，或通过 transit gateway 访问等场景（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。该选项还提到为 S3 endpoint 创建“VPC gateway attachment”，这不是标准配置步骤；gateway endpoint 是与路由表关联的。

**D 不正确。** 更好的设计是在拥有存储桶的数据湖账户中创建并管理每个应用程序的 access points，如选项 A 所述。虽然 S3 可以支持跨账户 access points，但 AWS 说明，创建跨账户 access point 本身并不会授予访问权限；存储桶拥有者必须更新存储桶策略，以授权来自该 access point 的请求（[Creating access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/creating-access-points.html)）。对于一个集中拥有、由数百个应用程序使用的数据湖，选项 D 将 access point 创建分散到多个账户中，这是不必要的，也不是预期的集中式设计。

**E 不正确。** gateway endpoint 必须存在于其资源需要私有 S3 访问的 VPC 中。只在数据湖的 VPC 中创建一个 endpoint，无法为运行在许多其他 VPC/账户中的应用程序提供私有 S3 访问。AWS 还说明，gateway endpoint 连接不能通过 VPN、VPC peering、transit gateway 或 Direct Connect 扩展到 VPC 外部（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。

因此，所需组合是：创建由存储桶拥有者控制的、按应用程序划分且限制到 VPC 的 S3 access points，并在每个应用程序的 VPC 中创建 S3 gateway endpoint，同时配置适当的路由表和 endpoint policy。

en.question: A company has developed a hybrid solution between its data center and AWS. The company uses Amazon VPC and Amazon EC2 instances that send application logs to Amazon CloudWatch. The EC2 instances read data from multiple relational databases that are hosted on premises. The company wants to monitor which EC2 instances are connected to the databases in near-real time. The company already has a monitoring solution that uses Splunk on premises. A solutions architect needs to determine how to send networking traffic to Splunk. How should the solutions architect meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable VPC flows logs, and send them to CloudWatch. Create an AWS Lambda function to periodically export the CloudWatch logs to an Amazon S3 bucket by using the pre-defined export function. Generate ACCESS_KEY and SECRET_KEY AWS credentials. Configure Splunk to pull the logs from the S3 bucket by using those credentials.
options.B: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream with Splunk as the destination. Configure a pre-processing AWS Lambda function with a Kinesis Data Firehose stream processor that extracts individual log events from records sent by CloudWatch Logs subscription filters. Enable VPC flows logs, and send them to CloudWatch. Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription that sends log events to the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream.
options.C: Ask the company to log every request that is made to the databases along with the EC2 instance IP address. Export the CloudWatch logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the logs grouped by database name. Export Athena results to another S3 bucket. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to automatically send any new file that is put in the S3 bucket to Splunk.
options.D: Send the CloudWatch logs to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL Applications. Configure a 1-minute sliding window to collect the events. Create a SQL query that uses the anomaly detection template to monitor any networking traffic anomalies in near-real time. Send the result to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream with Splunk as the destination.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs to identify, in near real time, which EC2 instances are making network connections to on-premises relational databases, and it already uses Splunk as the monitoring platform. The most appropriate data source is VPC Flow Logs, because VPC Flow Logs capture information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC, and AWS states that flow logs can be used for monitoring traffic reaching an instance and determining traffic direction to and from network interfaces ([VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)).

## Correct answer: B

Option B creates the right streaming pipeline:

1. Enable VPC Flow Logs and publish them to CloudWatch Logs.
2. Use a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to send log events to Amazon Data Firehose. AWS documents that CloudWatch Logs events can be sent to Firehose using CloudWatch subscription filters ([Send CloudWatch Logs to Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)).
3. Configure Firehose with Splunk as the destination. AWS explicitly supports Splunk destination settings for Firehose ([Configure destination settings for Splunk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)).
4. Use Lambda preprocessing/transformation as needed to extract individual log events from the CloudWatch Logs records. This is appropriate because CloudWatch Logs events are sent to Firehose in compressed gzip format and can contain multiple log events in a Firehose record; Firehose also supports Lambda transformation/preprocessing before delivery ([Send CloudWatch Logs to Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-cloudwatch-logs.html), [Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)).

This meets the near-real-time requirement and directly integrates with the existing Splunk environment.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. CloudWatch export to S3 and Splunk polling

This is a batch-oriented design. Periodically exporting CloudWatch Logs to S3 and having Splunk poll S3 does not provide near-real-time monitoring. It also introduces long-lived access keys, which is generally less desirable than service-integrated delivery using IAM roles and native streaming integrations. The question asks how to send networking traffic to Splunk in near real time, so a direct CloudWatch Logs subscription to Firehose is a better fit.

### C. Application/database request logging with Athena and Lambda

This option does not use the best network-level data source. The requirement is to monitor which EC2 instances are connected to databases, which VPC Flow Logs are designed to capture at the network interface/IP traffic level ([VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)). Exporting logs to S3, querying with Athena, exporting query results, and invoking Lambda is unnecessarily complex and batch-oriented, not near-real-time.

### D. Kinesis Data Streams + Kinesis Data Analytics anomaly detection

This option focuses on anomaly detection, not on delivering VPC network connection records to Splunk so the existing monitoring solution can show which EC2 instances are connected to databases. It also adds unnecessary services and SQL analytics. The requirement is not to detect anomalies; it is to stream networking traffic logs to Splunk. Firehose already supports Splunk as a destination and can receive CloudWatch Logs through subscription filters.

## Conclusion

The best answer is **B** because it uses VPC Flow Logs as the network traffic source, CloudWatch Logs subscription filters for streaming, Amazon Data Firehose for near-real-time delivery, Lambda preprocessing for CloudWatch log record handling, and Splunk as the native Firehose destination.

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据中心和 AWS 之间开发了一个混合解决方案。该公司使用 Amazon VPC 和 Amazon EC2 实例，这些实例将应用程序日志发送到 Amazon CloudWatch。EC2 实例从托管在本地的多个关系数据库读取数据。该公司希望近乎实时地监控哪些 EC2 实例连接到了这些数据库。该公司已经有一个使用本地 Splunk 的监控解决方案。解决方案架构师需要确定如何将网络流量发送到 Splunk。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 VPC Flow Logs，并将其发送到 CloudWatch。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使用预定义的导出功能定期将 CloudWatch 日志导出到 Amazon S3 存储桶。生成 ACCESS_KEY 和 SECRET_KEY AWS 凭证。配置 Splunk 使用这些凭证从 S3 存储桶拉取日志。
options.B: 创建一个以 Splunk 作为目标的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。配置一个预处理 AWS Lambda 函数，并使用 Kinesis Data Firehose 流处理器从 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选条件发送的记录中提取单个日志事件。启用 VPC Flow Logs，并将其发送到 CloudWatch。创建一个 CloudWatch Logs 订阅，将日志事件发送到 Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。
options.C: 要求公司记录对数据库发出的每个请求以及 EC2 实例 IP 地址。将 CloudWatch 日志导出到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Athena 按数据库名称对日志进行分组查询。将 Athena 结果导出到另一个 S3 存储桶。调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将任何放入该 S3 存储桶的新文件自动发送到 Splunk。
options.D: 将 CloudWatch 日志发送到 Amazon Kinesis data stream，并使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL Applications。配置一个 1 分钟滑动窗口来收集事件。创建一个使用异常检测模板的 SQL 查询，以近乎实时地监控任何网络流量异常。将结果发送到以 Splunk 作为目标的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要近乎实时地识别哪些 EC2 实例正在与本地关系数据库建立网络连接，并且它已经使用 Splunk 作为监控平台。最合适的数据源是 VPC Flow Logs，因为 VPC Flow Logs 会捕获有关进出 VPC 中网络接口的 IP 流量信息，并且 AWS 表示，flow logs 可用于监控到达实例的流量，以及确定进出网络接口的流量方向（[VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)）。

## 正确答案：B

选项 B 创建了正确的流式传输管道：

1. 启用 VPC Flow Logs，并将其发布到 CloudWatch Logs。
2. 使用 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选条件将日志事件发送到 Amazon Data Firehose。AWS 文档说明，可以使用 CloudWatch 订阅筛选条件将 CloudWatch Logs 事件发送到 Firehose（[Send CloudWatch Logs to Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)）。
3. 将 Firehose 配置为以 Splunk 作为目标。AWS 明确支持 Firehose 的 Splunk 目标设置（[Configure destination settings for Splunk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。
4. 根据需要使用 Lambda 预处理/转换，从 CloudWatch Logs 记录中提取单个日志事件。这是合适的，因为 CloudWatch Logs 事件会以压缩的 gzip 格式发送到 Firehose，并且一个 Firehose 记录中可能包含多个日志事件；Firehose 也支持在交付前进行 Lambda 转换/预处理（[Send CloudWatch Logs to Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)，[Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)）。

这满足近乎实时要求，并可直接与现有 Splunk 环境集成。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. CloudWatch 导出到 S3 和 Splunk 轮询

这是一种面向批处理的设计。定期将 CloudWatch Logs 导出到 S3，并让 Splunk 轮询 S3，无法提供近乎实时监控。它还引入了长期访问密钥，与使用 IAM roles 和原生流式集成的服务集成交付相比，通常不太理想。题目询问如何近乎实时地将网络流量发送到 Splunk，因此直接使用 CloudWatch Logs 订阅发送到 Firehose 更合适。
