预置容量可以帮助降低可预测/周期性使用的成本，但该选项忽略了重复热键读取模式。当相同项目被频繁读取时，DAX 可以减少对表的读取，这直接解决了应用程序的突发式重复查询问题（[Evaluating the suitability of DAX](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/evaluate-dax-suitability.html)）。因此，与 D 相比，C 不完整。

en.question: A company is creating a centralized logging service running on Amazon EC2 that will receive and analyze logs from hundreds of AWS accounts. AWS PrivateLink is being used to provide connectivity between the client services and the logging service. In each AWS account with a client, an interface endpoint has been created for the logging service and is available. The logging service running on EC2 instances with a Network Load Balancer (NLB) are deployed in different subnets. The clients are unable to submit logs using the VPC endpoint. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)

options.A: Check that the NACL is attached to the logging service subnet to allow communications to and from the NLB subnets. Check that the NACL is attached to the NLB subnet to allow communications to and from the logging service subnets running on EC2 instances.
options.B: Check that the NACL is attached to the logging service subnets to allow communications to and from the interface endpoint subnets. Check that the NACL is attached to the interface endpoint subnet to allow communications to and from the logging service subnets running on EC2 instances.
options.C: Check the security group for the logging service running on the EC2 instances to ensure it allows ingress from the NLB subnets.
options.D: Check the security group for the logging service running on EC2 instances to ensure it allows ingress from the clients.
options.E: Check the security group for the NLB to ensure it allows ingress from the interface endpoint subnets.

en.explanation:
The question is about an AWS PrivateLink **endpoint service** backed by a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Consumers in many AWS accounts have interface endpoints, but requests are not reaching the centralized logging application on EC2 instances. The key is to evaluate the traffic path and the source IP that the backend EC2 instances see.

Correct answers: **A and C**.

AWS PrivateLink endpoint services require the provider to specify a load balancer; the load balancer receives requests from service consumers and routes them to the provider service ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)). For NLB target groups, AWS documents that **client IP preservation has no effect on AWS PrivateLink traffic** and that the source IP address of PrivateLink traffic is always the **private IP address of the Network Load Balancer** ([Client IP preservation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/edit-target-group-attributes.html)). Therefore, the backend logging EC2 instances must allow traffic from the NLB nodes/subnets, not from the original clients or endpoint ENIs.

- **A is correct.** Network ACLs are subnet-level and stateless. AWS states that each subnet is associated with a network ACL, NACL rules are evaluated when traffic enters and leaves a subnet, and NACLs are stateless, so return traffic must also be allowed ([Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)). Because the NLB and logging EC2 instances are deployed in different subnets, the NACLs for both the NLB subnets and the EC2 logging service subnets must allow the required inbound and outbound traffic between those subnets.

- **C is correct.** The security group on the EC2 instances that run the logging service must allow ingress from the NLB. AWS documents that target instances can be configured to accept traffic only from the NLB, and that target security groups must allow traffic from the NLB on the target port and health check port ([NLB security groups: Accept traffic only from the Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)). In this PrivateLink scenario, the EC2 targets see the NLB private IPs as the source, so allowing the NLB subnets/private IPs is required.

Incorrect options:

- **B is incorrect.** This focuses the NACL rules on communication between the logging service subnets and the consumer interface endpoint subnets. For PrivateLink traffic through an NLB endpoint service, the backend targets do not see the interface endpoint subnet IPs as the immediate source; the traffic is delivered through the NLB, and the source at the targets is the NLB private IP. The relevant provider-side NACL path is between the NLB subnets and the EC2 target subnets.

- **D is incorrect.** The EC2 security group should not be based on the original clients as the source in this architecture. AWS explicitly states that for AWS PrivateLink traffic, the source IP address seen by the target is always the private IP address of the NLB, not the original client IP ([Client IP preservation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/edit-target-group-attributes.html)).

- **E is incorrect.** Although Network Load Balancers can now have security groups, this option says to allow ingress from the **interface endpoint subnets**. Current AWS documentation notes that when PrivateLink traffic is subject to NLB inbound security group rules, the source is the **private IP address of the client**, not the endpoint interface ([NLB security group considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)). In any case, the most directly required provider-side checks for the described backend connectivity issue are the EC2 target security group and the NACLs between the NLB and target subnets, not a rule sourced from the interface endpoint subnets.

zh.question: 一家公司正在创建一个运行在 Amazon EC2 上的集中式日志记录服务，该服务将接收并分析来自数百个 AWS 账户的日志。公司正在使用 AWS PrivateLink 在客户端服务和日志记录服务之间提供连接。在每个包含客户端的 AWS 账户中，都已为日志记录服务创建并可用一个接口端点。运行在 EC2 实例上的日志记录服务与 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 部署在不同的子网中。客户端无法使用 VPC 端点提交日志。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项步骤组合来解决此问题？（选择两项。）

options.A: 检查附加到日志记录服务子网的 NACL，确保其允许与 NLB 子网之间的通信。检查附加到 NLB 子网的 NACL，确保其允许与运行在 EC2 实例上的日志记录服务子网之间的通信。
options.B: 检查附加到日志记录服务子网的 NACL，确保其允许与接口端点子网之间的通信。检查附加到接口端点子网的 NACL，确保其允许与运行在 EC2 实例上的日志记录服务子网之间的通信。
options.C: 检查运行在 EC2 实例上的日志记录服务的安全组，确保其允许来自 NLB 子网的入站流量。
options.D: 检查运行在 EC2 实例上的日志记录服务的安全组，确保其允许来自客户端的入站流量。
options.E: 检查 NLB 的安全组，确保其允许来自接口端点子网的入站流量。

zh.explanation:
本题涉及由 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 支持的 AWS PrivateLink **端点服务**。许多 AWS 账户中的消费者都有接口端点，但请求未到达 EC2 实例上的集中式日志记录应用程序。关键是评估流量路径以及后端 EC2 实例看到的源 IP。

正确答案：**A 和 C**。

AWS PrivateLink 端点服务要求提供方指定一个负载均衡器；该负载均衡器接收来自服务消费者的请求，并将其路由到提供方服务（[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。对于 NLB 目标组，AWS 文档说明 **客户端 IP 保留对 AWS PrivateLink 流量无效**，并且 PrivateLink 流量的源 IP 地址始终是 **Network Load Balancer 的私有 IP 地址**（[Client IP preservation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。因此，后端日志记录 EC2 实例必须允许来自 NLB 节点/子网的流量，而不是来自原始客户端或端点 ENI 的流量。

- **A 正确。** Network ACL 是子网级别且无状态的。AWS 说明，每个子网都与一个 network ACL 关联，NACL 规则会在流量进入和离开子网时进行评估，并且 NACL 是无状态的，因此返回流量也必须被允许（[Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)）。由于 NLB 和日志记录 EC2 实例部署在不同子网中，NLB 子网和 EC2 日志记录服务子网的 NACL 都必须允许这些子网之间所需的入站和出站流量。

- **C 正确。** 运行日志记录服务的 EC2 实例上的安全组必须允许来自 NLB 的入站流量。AWS 文档说明，可以将目标实例配置为仅接受来自 NLB 的流量，并且目标安全组必须在目标端口和运行状况检查端口上允许来自 NLB 的流量（[NLB security groups: Accept traffic only from the Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)）。在此 PrivateLink 场景中，EC2 目标看到的源是 NLB 私有 IP，因此需要允许 NLB 子网/私有 IP。

错误选项：

- **B 不正确。** 它将 NACL 规则的重点放在日志记录服务子网与消费者接口端点子网之间的通信上。对于通过 NLB 端点服务的 PrivateLink 流量，后端目标不会将接口端点子网 IP 视为直接源；流量通过 NLB 交付，目标处的源是 NLB 私有 IP。相关的提供方侧 NACL 路径是在 NLB 子网与 EC2 目标子网之间。

- **D 不正确。** 在此架构中，EC2 安全组不应基于原始客户端作为源。AWS 明确说明，对于 AWS PrivateLink 流量，目标看到的源 IP 地址始终是 NLB 的私有 IP 地址，而不是原始客户端 IP（[Client IP preservation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。

- **E 不正确。** 虽然 Network Load Balancers 现在可以拥有安全组，但该选项说的是允许来自 **接口端点子网** 的入站流量。当前 AWS 文档指出，当 PrivateLink 流量受 NLB 入站安全组规则约束时，源是 **客户端的私有 IP 地址**，而不是端点接口（[NLB security group considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)）。无论如何，对于所描述的后端连接问题，最直接需要检查的提供方侧项目是 EC2 目标安全组以及 NLB 与目标子网之间的 NACL，而不是以接口端点子网为源的规则。

en.question: A company has millions of objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The objects are in the S3 Standard storage class. All the S3 objects are accessed frequently. The number of users and applications that access the objects is increasing rapidly. The objects are encrypted with server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). A solutions architect reviews the company’s monthly AWS invoice and notices that AWS KMS costs are increasing because of the high number of requests from Amazon S3. The solutions architect needs to optimize costs with minimal changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket that has server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) as the encryption type. Copy the existing objects to the new S3 bucket. Specify SSE-C.
options.B: Create a new S3 bucket that has server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) as the encryption type. Use S3 Batch Operations to copy the existing objects to the new S3 bucket. Specify SSE-S3.
options.C: Use AWS CloudHSM to store the encryption keys. Create a new S3 bucket. Use S3 Batch Operations to copy the existing objects to the new S3 bucket. Encrypt the objects by using the keys from CloudHSM.
options.D: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class for the S3 bucket. Create an S3 Intelligent-Tiering archive configuration to transition objects that are not accessed for 90 days to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

en.explanation:
The bucket contains millions of frequently accessed S3 Standard objects encrypted with SSE-KMS. Because access is increasing, S3 is making many AWS KMS requests for encrypted object operations, and the question asks for the lowest-overhead way, among the provided choices, to reduce the KMS request cost with minimal application impact.

**Correct answer: B. Create a new bucket with SSE-S3 and use S3 Batch Operations to copy the existing objects specifying SSE-S3.**

Amazon S3 default server-side encryption with **Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)** encrypts objects automatically and is described as being applied to new uploads at **no additional cost**. In contrast, AWS documentation notes that SSE-KMS is chosen when you need more control over keys, and that S3 Bucket Keys can reduce KMS request traffic and costs when continuing to use SSE-KMS. The same S3 documentation explicitly states that configuring a bucket for SSE-KMS can use S3 Bucket Keys to decrease request traffic from S3 to KMS and reduce encryption cost, which confirms that the cost driver in this scenario is the KMS request traffic caused by SSE-KMS ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)).

Changing the objects to **SSE-S3** removes the dependency on AWS KMS for object encryption/decryption operations and therefore eliminates the increasing AWS KMS request charges for these S3 object accesses. For millions of objects, S3 Batch Operations is the operationally appropriate bulk mechanism: AWS states that S3 Batch Operations can perform large-scale operations on lists of objects, including copying objects and updating server-side encryption, and that a single job can operate on billions of objects ([S3 Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)). AWS also documents that Batch Operations can update the server-side encryption type of more than one object with a single request/job workflow ([Update object encryption with Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-update.html)).

A more targeted real-world solution, if it had been offered, would likely be **S3 Bucket Keys**, because AWS says they can reduce SSE-KMS request costs by up to 99% without client application changes. However, that option is not present. Among the listed answers, moving to SSE-S3 with S3 Batch Operations is the best fit for eliminating KMS costs with low operational overhead ([S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-key.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. SSE-C with customer-provided keys** — SSE-C requires the client to provide and manage encryption keys with requests. This would create significant application and key-management changes and operational overhead. It avoids KMS, but it is not minimal change or least overhead.
- **C. CloudHSM keys** — Using CloudHSM would add substantial infrastructure, operational complexity, and cost. Amazon S3 server-side encryption integrates with S3-managed keys and KMS keys; using CloudHSM directly for S3 object encryption is not the simple managed path. This does not meet the least operational overhead requirement.
- **D. S3 Intelligent-Tiering with archive configuration** — The objects are accessed frequently, so archive tiering is inappropriate and could introduce retrieval latency and retrieval costs. It also does not address the KMS request charges caused by SSE-KMS access patterns.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中有数百万个对象。这些对象位于 S3 Standard 存储类中。所有 S3 对象都被频繁访问。访问这些对象的用户和应用程序数量正在快速增加。这些对象使用 AWS KMS 密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）进行加密。一名解决方案架构师查看公司的每月 AWS 账单，发现由于来自 Amazon S3 的请求数量很高，AWS KMS 成本正在上升。解决方案架构师需要在对应用程序做最少更改的情况下优化成本。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 S3 存储桶，将使用客户提供的密钥进行服务器端加密（SSE-C）作为加密类型。将现有对象复制到新的 S3 存储桶。指定 SSE-C。
options.B: 创建一个新的 S3 存储桶，将使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥进行服务器端加密（SSE-S3）作为加密类型。使用 S3 Batch Operations 将现有对象复制到新的 S3 存储桶。指定 SSE-S3。
options.C: 使用 AWS CloudHSM 存储加密密钥。创建一个新的 S3 存储桶。使用 S3 Batch Operations 将现有对象复制到新的 S3 存储桶。使用来自 CloudHSM 的密钥加密对象。
options.D: 对 S3 存储桶使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类。创建一个 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 归档配置，将 90 天未访问的对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

zh.explanation:
该存储桶包含数百万个频繁访问的 S3 Standard 对象，并使用 SSE-KMS 加密。由于访问量正在增加，S3 在加密对象操作中会发起大量 AWS KMS 请求，而题目要求在所给选项中，以最低运维开销、对应用程序影响最小的方式降低 KMS 请求成本。

**正确答案：B。创建一个使用 SSE-S3 的新存储桶，并使用 S3 Batch Operations 复制现有对象，同时指定 SSE-S3。**

Amazon S3 默认服务器端加密使用 **Amazon S3 托管密钥（SSE-S3）** 自动加密对象，并被描述为会在 **无额外费用** 的情况下应用于新上传。相比之下，AWS 文档指出，当你需要对密钥有更多控制时会选择 SSE-KMS，并且在继续使用 SSE-KMS 时，S3 Bucket Keys 可以减少 KMS 请求流量和成本。同一份 S3 文档明确说明，为存储桶配置 SSE-KMS 时可以使用 S3 Bucket Keys 来减少从 S3 到 KMS 的请求流量并降低加密成本，这证实了此场景中的成本驱动因素是 SSE-KMS 导致的 KMS 请求流量（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)）。

将对象更改为 **SSE-S3** 会移除对象加密/解密操作对 AWS KMS 的依赖，因此可以消除这些 S3 对象访问中不断增加的 AWS KMS 请求费用。对于数百万个对象，S3 Batch Operations 是运维上合适的批量机制：AWS 表示，S3 Batch Operations 可以对对象列表执行大规模操作，包括复制对象和更新服务器端加密，并且单个作业可以作用于数十亿个对象（[S3 Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Batch Operations 可以通过单个请求/作业工作流更新多个对象的服务器端加密类型（[Update object encryption with Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-update.html)）。

如果题目提供了该选项，更有针对性的现实解决方案可能是 **S3 Bucket Keys**，因为 AWS 表示它们可以在无需客户端应用程序更改的情况下，将 SSE-KMS 请求成本降低高达 99%。但是，该选项并未出现。在列出的答案中，使用 S3 Batch Operations 迁移到 SSE-S3，是以低运维开销消除 KMS 成本的最佳选择（[S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-key.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. 使用客户提供密钥的 SSE-C** — SSE-C 要求客户端在请求中提供并管理加密密钥。这会带来显著的应用程序和密钥管理更改以及运维开销。它可以避免 KMS，但并不是最小更改或最低开销。
- **C. CloudHSM 密钥** — 使用 CloudHSM 会增加大量基础设施、运维复杂性和成本。Amazon S3 服务器端加密与 S3 托管密钥和 KMS 密钥集成；直接使用 CloudHSM 进行 S3 对象加密并不是简单的托管路径。这不满足最低运维开销要求。
- **D. 带归档配置的 S3 Intelligent-Tiering** — 这些对象被频繁访问，因此归档分层并不合适，并且可能引入检索延迟和检索成本。它也没有解决由 SSE-KMS 访问模式导致的 KMS 请求费用。

en.question: A media storage application uploads user photos to Amazon S3 for processing by AWS Lambda functions. Application state is stored in Amazon DynamoDB tables. Users are reporting that some uploaded photos are not being processed properly. The application developers trace the logs and find that Lambda is experiencing photo processing issues when thousands of users upload photos simultaneously. The issues are the result of Lambda concurrency limits and the performance of DynamoDB when data is saved. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to increase the performance and reliability of the application? (Choose two.)

options.A: Evaluate and adjust the RCUs for the DynamoDB tables.
options.B: Evaluate and adjust the WCUs for the DynamoDB tables.
options.C: Add an Amazon ElastiCache layer to increase the performance of Lambda functions.
options.D: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and reprocessing logic between Amazon S3 and the Lambda functions.
options.E: Use S3 Transfer Acceleration to provide lower latency to users.

en.explanation:
The workload uploads photos to S3 and processes object-created events with Lambda. During bursts of thousands of uploads, two distinct bottlenecks are described: Lambda concurrency limits and DynamoDB performance **when data is saved**. The best solution must both smooth/retry processing and increase DynamoDB write throughput.

**Correct answers: B and D.**

- **B. Evaluate and adjust the WCUs for the DynamoDB tables — Correct.** The question specifically says DynamoDB has performance issues when data is **saved**, which is a write workload. In DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode, AWS defines a **write capacity unit (WCU)** as one write per second for an item up to 1 KB, and notes that you can modify capacity settings or use auto scaling to adjust them. Therefore, evaluating and increasing/auto-scaling WCUs directly addresses throttling or poor performance on saves. See [DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html).

- **D. Add an SQS queue and reprocessing logic between S3 and Lambda — Correct.** S3 event notifications can send new-object events to SQS queues, SNS topics, Lambda functions, or EventBridge, so S3 → SQS is a supported pattern. Lambda can then poll SQS in batches; messages remain in the queue during the visibility timeout and are deleted only after successful processing. If the function errors, messages become visible again for retry, which improves reliability. In addition, Lambda SQS event source mappings support scaling controls such as maximum concurrency, which helps prevent the S3 burst from overwhelming Lambda or downstream DynamoDB. See [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html), and [Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Evaluate and adjust the RCUs for the DynamoDB tables — Incorrect.** RCUs address read throughput. The scenario calls out performance when data is **saved**, which indicates writes, so WCUs are the relevant capacity metric.

- **C. Add an Amazon ElastiCache layer to increase the performance of Lambda functions — Incorrect.** ElastiCache can reduce repeated database reads in some architectures, but it does not solve Lambda concurrency throttling, S3 event burst handling, or DynamoDB write-capacity limitations. There is no indication of a read-heavy cacheable access pattern.

- **E. Use S3 Transfer Acceleration to provide lower latency to users — Incorrect.** S3 Transfer Acceleration can improve upload latency over long distances, but the reported failure happens after upload during Lambda processing and DynamoDB saves. It does not provide queueing, retry, Lambda concurrency control, or DynamoDB write throughput improvements.

zh.question: 一个媒体存储应用程序将用户照片上传到 Amazon S3，以便由 AWS Lambda 函数处理。应用程序状态存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。用户报告说，一些上传的照片没有得到正确处理。应用程序开发人员追踪日志后发现，当数千名用户同时上传照片时，Lambda 会遇到照片处理问题。这些问题是由 Lambda 并发限制以及保存数据时 DynamoDB 的性能导致的。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来提高应用程序的性能和可靠性？（选择两项。）

options.A: 评估并调整 DynamoDB 表的 RCUs。
options.B: 评估并调整 DynamoDB 表的 WCUs。
options.C: 添加 Amazon ElastiCache 层以提高 Lambda 函数的性能。
options.D: 在 Amazon S3 和 Lambda 函数之间添加 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列和重新处理逻辑。
options.E: 使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 为用户提供更低的延迟。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载将照片上传到 S3，并使用 Lambda 处理对象创建事件。在数千次上传的突发期间，题目描述了两个不同的瓶颈：Lambda 并发限制，以及 DynamoDB **保存数据时**的性能。最佳解决方案必须既能平滑处理/重试处理流程，又能提高 DynamoDB 写入吞吐量。

**正确答案：B 和 D。**

- **B. 评估并调整 DynamoDB 表的 WCUs — 正确。** 题目明确说明 DynamoDB 在数据被**保存**时出现性能问题，这是写入工作负载。在 DynamoDB 预置容量模式中，AWS 将一个 **write capacity unit (WCU)** 定义为对最大 1 KB 的项目每秒一次写入，并指出你可以修改容量设置或使用自动扩缩来调整它们。因此，评估并增加/自动扩缩 WCUs 可以直接解决保存时的限流或性能不佳问题。请参阅 [DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html)。

- **D. 在 S3 和 Lambda 之间添加 SQS 队列和重新处理逻辑 — 正确。** S3 事件通知可以将新对象事件发送到 SQS 队列、SNS 主题、Lambda 函数或 EventBridge，因此 S3 → SQS 是受支持的模式。然后 Lambda 可以批量轮询 SQS；消息在可见性超时期间会保留在队列中，并且只有在成功处理后才会被删除。如果函数出错，消息会再次变为可见以便重试，从而提高可靠性。此外，Lambda SQS 事件源映射支持最大并发等扩缩控制，这有助于防止 S3 突发流量压垮 Lambda 或下游 DynamoDB。请参阅 [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)、[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html) 和 [Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 评估并调整 DynamoDB 表的 RCUs — 不正确。** RCUs 解决读取吞吐量问题。该场景指出的是数据被**保存**时的性能问题，这表示写入，因此 WCUs 才是相关的容量指标。

- **C. 添加 Amazon ElastiCache 层以提高 Lambda 函数的性能 — 不正确。** 在某些架构中，ElastiCache 可以减少重复的数据库读取，但它不能解决 Lambda 并发限流、S3 事件突发处理或 DynamoDB 写入容量限制。题目没有表明存在读密集型、可缓存的访问模式。

- **E. 使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 为用户提供更低的延迟 — 不正确。** S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以改善远距离上传延迟，但报告的故障发生在上传之后的 Lambda 处理和 DynamoDB 保存期间。它不提供排队、重试、Lambda 并发控制或 DynamoDB 写入吞吐量改进。

en.question: A company runs an application in an on-premises data center. The application gives users the ability to upload media files. The files persist in a file server. The web application has many users. The application server is overutilized, which causes data uploads to fail occasionally. The company frequently adds new storage to the file server. The company wants to resolve these challenges by migrating the application to AWS. Users from across the United States and Canada access the application. Only authenticated users should have the ability to access the application to upload files. The company will consider a solution that refactors the application, and the company needs to accelerate application development. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the application server to Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the requests. Modify the application to use Amazon S3 to persist the files. Use Amazon Cognito to authenticate users.
options.B: Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the application server to Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the requests. Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to give users the ability to sign in to the application. Modify the application to use Amazon S3 to persist the files.
options.C: Create a static website for uploads of media files. Store the static assets in Amazon S3. Use AWS AppSync to create an API. Use AWS Lambda resolvers to upload the media files to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Cognito to authenticate users.
options.D: Use AWS Amplify to create a static website for uploads of media files. Use Amplify Hosting to serve the website through Amazon CloudFront. Use Amazon S3 to store the uploaded media files. Use Amazon Cognito to authenticate users.

en.explanation:
The company is willing to refactor and specifically wants to accelerate development while reducing operational overhead. The current bottleneck is an overutilized application/file-server upload path and continually growing file-server storage. A serverless/static frontend with direct object storage and managed authentication best fits those goals.

**Correct answer: D. Use AWS Amplify Hosting, Amazon S3, Amazon Cognito, and CloudFront.**

- **Amplify accelerates application development and reduces operational overhead.** AWS documentation describes Amplify Hosting as providing a Git-based workflow for hosting full-stack serverless web applications with continuous deployment, and says it deploys apps to the AWS global content delivery network (CDN) ([AWS Amplify Hosting welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amplify/latest/userguide/welcome.html)). This aligns with fast development and low-operations hosting for users across the US and Canada.
- **S3 solves the storage growth and upload persistence problem.** Amazon S3 is object storage with industry-leading scalability, availability, security, and performance, and can store and protect any amount of data for use cases including websites and mobile applications ([What is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).
- **Amplify can support browser-based uploads directly to S3.** The S3 documentation specifically describes using the AWS Amplify JavaScript library to upload files to Amazon S3, and notes that the Amplify `Storage` module provides a simple browser-based upload mechanism for user content in public or private S3 storage ([Browser-based uploads to Amazon S3 using AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/browser-based-uploads-aws-amplify.html)). This avoids routing uploads through an overloaded application server.
- **Cognito provides managed authentication and authorization.** Amazon Cognito is an identity platform for web and mobile apps and supports user authentication and authorization; user pools authenticate users to apps and identity pools can grant authorized access to AWS resources such as S3 ([What is Amazon Cognito?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html)). The Cognito documentation also states that Amplify is a complete solution for building web and mobile applications and can implement authentication features in front-end apps ([Integrating Cognito with apps: Authentication with AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)).

Therefore, option D provides a refactored, serverless-style solution with managed hosting/CDN, managed authentication, and scalable object storage, with the least operational overhead among the choices.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Application Migration Service + EC2 Auto Scaling + ALB + S3 + Cognito**  
  This improves scalability compared with the on-premises application server and uses S3/Cognito appropriately, but it is still a lift-and-shift EC2-based architecture. The company must operate EC2 instances, Auto Scaling, an ALB, patching, capacity policies, and application runtime infrastructure. Because the company will consider refactoring and wants to accelerate development with the least operational overhead, Amplify-based serverless/static hosting is a better fit.

- **B. Application Migration Service + EC2 Auto Scaling + ALB + IAM Identity Center + S3**  
  This has the same EC2/ALB operational overhead as option A. In addition, IAM Identity Center is primarily for workforce access to AWS accounts and business applications, not the most appropriate customer-facing application authentication mechanism for browser upload access to S3. Cognito is the managed service designed for web/mobile application users and can integrate with Amplify and S3 access patterns.

- **C. Static website + S3 + AppSync + Lambda resolvers + Cognito**  
  This is serverless and uses Cognito, but it adds AppSync and Lambda resolver components unnecessarily for a simple media upload workflow. Media files can be uploaded from the browser to S3 using Amplify Storage, including private user content, without building and operating an AppSync API and Lambda upload path. Compared with D, this adds development and operational complexity and does not leverage Amplify Hosting’s integrated workflow and CDN deployment.

The stated answer **D** is consistent with the requirements and the official AWS documentation.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心运行一个应用程序。该应用程序允许用户上传媒体文件。这些文件持久保存在文件服务器中。该 Web 应用程序有许多用户。应用服务器使用率过高，导致数据上传偶尔失败。该公司经常向文件服务器添加新的存储。公司希望通过将应用程序迁移到 AWS 来解决这些挑战。来自美国和加拿大各地的用户访问该应用程序。只有经过身份验证的用户才应能够访问该应用程序以上传文件。公司会考虑对应用程序进行重构，并且需要加速应用程序开发。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 将应用程序服务器迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发请求。修改应用程序以使用 Amazon S3 持久保存文件。使用 Amazon Cognito 对用户进行身份验证。
options.B: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 将应用程序服务器迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发请求。设置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)，使用户能够登录应用程序。修改应用程序以使用 Amazon S3 持久保存文件。
options.C: 创建一个用于上传媒体文件的静态网站。将静态资产存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS AppSync 创建 API。使用 AWS Lambda 解析器将媒体文件上传到 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Cognito 对用户进行身份验证。
options.D: 使用 AWS Amplify 创建一个用于上传媒体文件的静态网站。使用 Amplify Hosting 通过 Amazon CloudFront 提供网站服务。使用 Amazon S3 存储上传的媒体文件。使用 Amazon Cognito 对用户进行身份验证。

zh.explanation:
该公司愿意重构，并且明确希望加速开发，同时降低运营开销。当前的瓶颈是应用程序/文件服务器上传路径使用率过高，以及文件服务器存储不断增长。采用无服务器/静态前端、直接对象存储和托管身份验证，最符合这些目标。

**正确答案：D. 使用 AWS Amplify Hosting、Amazon S3、Amazon Cognito 和 CloudFront。**

- **Amplify 可加速应用程序开发并降低运营开销。** AWS 文档将 Amplify Hosting 描述为为托管全栈无服务器 Web 应用程序提供基于 Git 的工作流和持续部署，并说明它会将应用程序部署到 AWS 全球内容分发网络 (CDN)（[AWS Amplify Hosting welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amplify/latest/userguide/welcome.html)）。这与为美国和加拿大各地用户提供快速开发和低运维托管的目标一致。
- **S3 解决存储增长和上传持久化问题。** Amazon S3 是对象存储，具有业界领先的可扩展性、可用性、安全性和性能，并且可以存储和保护任意数量的数据，适用于包括网站和移动应用程序在内的使用场景（[What is Amazon S3?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。
- **Amplify 可以支持基于浏览器直接上传到 S3。** S3 文档专门描述了使用 AWS Amplify JavaScript 库将文件上传到 Amazon S3，并指出 Amplify `Storage` 模块为公共或私有 S3 存储中的用户内容提供简单的基于浏览器的上传机制（[Browser-based uploads to Amazon S3 using AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/browser-based-uploads-aws-amplify.html)）。这避免了通过过载的应用程序服务器路由上传。
- **Cognito 提供托管身份验证和授权。** Amazon Cognito 是面向 Web 和移动应用程序的身份平台，支持用户身份验证和授权；用户池对应用程序用户进行身份验证，身份池可以授予对 AWS 资源（如 S3）的授权访问权限（[What is Amazon Cognito?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html)）。Cognito 文档还指出，Amplify 是用于构建 Web 和移动应用程序的完整解决方案，并且可以在前端应用程序中实现身份验证功能（[Integrating Cognito with apps: Authentication with AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)）。

因此，选项 D 提供了一种重构后的无服务器风格解决方案，具有托管式托管/CDN、托管身份验证和可扩展对象存储，在各选项中运营开销最少。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Application Migration Service + EC2 Auto Scaling + ALB + S3 + Cognito**  
  与本地应用程序服务器相比，这提高了可扩展性，并且恰当地使用了 S3/Cognito，但它仍然是基于 EC2 的 lift-and-shift 架构。公司必须运营 EC2 实例、Auto Scaling、ALB、补丁、容量策略和应用程序运行时基础设施。由于公司会考虑重构，并希望以最少的运营开销加速开发，因此基于 Amplify 的无服务器/静态托管更合适。

- **B. Application Migration Service + EC2 Auto Scaling + ALB + IAM Identity Center + S3**  
  这与选项 A 具有相同的 EC2/ALB 运营开销。此外，IAM Identity Center 主要用于员工访问 AWS 账户和业务应用程序，并不是面向客户的应用程序身份验证机制中最适合浏览器上传访问 S3 的方案。Cognito 是专为 Web/移动应用程序用户设计的托管服务，并且可以与 Amplify 和 S3 访问模式集成。

- **C. Static website + S3 + AppSync + Lambda resolvers + Cognito**  
  这是无服务器方案并使用 Cognito，但对于简单的媒体上传工作流，它不必要地增加了 AppSync 和 Lambda 解析器组件。媒体文件可以使用 Amplify Storage 从浏览器上传到 S3，包括私有用户内容，而无需构建和运营 AppSync API 和 Lambda 上传路径。与 D 相比，这增加了开发和运营复杂性，并且没有利用 Amplify Hosting 的集成工作流和 CDN 部署。

所述答案 **D** 与要求和 AWS 官方文档一致。

en.question: A company has an application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances are part of an Auto Scaling group. The application has unpredictable workloads and frequently scales out and in. The company’s development team wants to analyze application logs to find ways to improve the application's performance. However, the logs are no longer available after instances scale in. Which solution will give the development team the ability to view the application logs after a scale-in event?

options.A: Enable access logs for the ALB. Store the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure the EC2 instances to publish logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs by using the unified CloudWatch agent.
options.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use a step scaling policy.
options.D: Instrument the application with AWS X-Ray tracing.

en.explanation:
The application runs on EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. During scale-in, instances are terminated, so any application log files kept only on the instance are lost. The requirement is to preserve and view **application logs** after a scale-in event.

**Correct answer: B. Configure the EC2 instances to publish logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs by using the unified CloudWatch agent.**

AWS documentation states that the CloudWatch agent collects metrics, logs, and traces from Amazon EC2 instances and that it can **collect logs from Amazon EC2 instances**. The same page also states that logs collected by the CloudWatch agent are **processed and stored in Amazon CloudWatch Logs** ([CloudWatch agent documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)). Sending the application log files to CloudWatch Logs decouples log retention from the EC2 instance lifecycle. Therefore, after Auto Scaling terminates an instance during scale-in, the development team can still view the published application logs in CloudWatch Logs. This directly addresses the problem.

AWS also documents that when a scale-in event occurs, the Auto Scaling group terminates one or more instances, and terminating instances cannot be put back into service ([EC2 Auto Scaling instance lifecycle: Scale in](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-lifecycle.html)). This explains why local instance logs are no longer available unless they are exported before termination.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Enable access logs for the ALB. Store the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket.**  
  ALB access logs capture detailed information about **requests sent to the load balancer**, such as request time, client IP address, latencies, request paths, and server responses, and store those access logs in S3 ([ALB access logs documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-access-logs.html)). These are load balancer access logs, not the application logs generated on the EC2 instances. They may help analyze traffic patterns but do not preserve arbitrary application log files from terminated instances.

- **C. Modify the Auto Scaling group to use a step scaling policy.**  
  A step scaling policy changes how the Auto Scaling group scales based on metric thresholds. It does not preserve or export application logs. Since scale-in still terminates instances, changing the scaling policy does not solve the lost-log problem.

- **D. Instrument the application with AWS X-Ray tracing.**  
  X-Ray is used for distributed tracing and request analysis, not for retaining application log files. Instrumentation can help analyze request paths and latency, but it does not automatically preserve EC2-local application logs after instance termination.

Therefore, **B** is the correct solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个部署在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。这些实例属于一个 Auto Scaling 组。该应用程序的工作负载不可预测，并且经常扩展和收缩。公司的开发团队希望分析应用程序日志，以寻找提高应用程序性能的方法。但是，在实例收缩后，日志不再可用。哪种解决方案可以让开发团队在发生收缩事件后查看应用程序日志？

options.A: 为 ALB 启用访问日志。将日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.B: 使用统一的 CloudWatch 代理配置 EC2 实例将日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。
options.C: 修改 Auto Scaling 组以使用步进扩展策略。
options.D: 使用 AWS X-Ray 跟踪对应用程序进行检测。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例上。在收缩期间，实例会被终止，因此仅保存在实例上的任何应用程序日志文件都会丢失。要求是在收缩事件后保留并查看**应用程序日志**。

**正确答案：B. 使用统一的 CloudWatch 代理配置 EC2 实例将日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。**

AWS 文档说明，CloudWatch 代理可从 Amazon EC2 实例收集指标、日志和跟踪，并且它可以**从 Amazon EC2 实例收集日志**。同一页面还说明，由 CloudWatch 代理收集的日志会在 **Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中处理和存储**（[CloudWatch agent documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)）。将应用程序日志文件发送到 CloudWatch Logs 可将日志保留与 EC2 实例生命周期解耦。因此，在 Auto Scaling 在收缩期间终止实例后，开发团队仍然可以在 CloudWatch Logs 中查看已发布的应用程序日志。这直接解决了问题。

AWS 还记录了，当发生收缩事件时，Auto Scaling 组会终止一个或多个实例，并且已终止的实例无法重新投入服务（[EC2 Auto Scaling instance lifecycle: Scale in](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-lifecycle.html)）。这解释了为什么本地实例日志在终止前未导出时将不再可用。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 为 ALB 启用访问日志。将日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。**  
  ALB 访问日志捕获有关**发送到负载均衡器的请求**的详细信息，例如请求时间、客户端 IP 地址、延迟、请求路径和服务器响应，并将这些访问日志存储在 S3 中（[ALB access logs documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-access-logs.html)）。这些是负载均衡器访问日志，而不是 EC2 实例上生成的应用程序日志。它们可能有助于分析流量模式，但不会保留来自已终止实例的任意应用程序日志文件。

- **C. 修改 Auto Scaling 组以使用步进扩展策略。**  
  步进扩展策略会根据指标阈值改变 Auto Scaling 组的扩展方式。它不会保留或导出应用程序日志。由于收缩仍会终止实例，因此更改扩展策略不能解决日志丢失问题。

- **D. 使用 AWS X-Ray 跟踪对应用程序进行检测。**  
  X-Ray 用于分布式跟踪和请求分析，而不是用于保留应用程序日志文件。检测可以帮助分析请求路径和延迟，但它不会在实例终止后自动保留 EC2 本地的应用程序日志。

因此，**B** 是正确的解决方案。

en.question: A company runs an unauthenticated static website (www.example.com) that includes a registration form for users. The website uses Amazon S3 for hosting and uses Amazon CloudFront as the content delivery network with AWS WAF configured. When the registration form is submitted, the website calls an Amazon API Gateway API endpoint that invokes an AWS Lambda function to process the payload and forward the payload to an external API call. During testing, a solutions architect encounters a cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) error. The solutions architect confirms that the CloudFront distribution origin has the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header set to www.example.com. What should the solutions architect do to resolve the error?

options.A: Change the CORS configuration on the S3 bucket. Add rules for CORS to the AllowedOrigin element for www.example.com.
options.B: Enable the CORS setting in AWS WAF. Create a web ACL rule in which the Access-Control-Allow- Origin header is set to www.example.com.
options.C: Enable the CORS setting on the API Gateway API endpoint. Ensure that the API endpoint is configured to return all responses that have the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header set to www.example.com.
options.D: Enable the CORS setting on the Lambda function. Ensure that the return code of the function has the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header set to www.example.com.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A static website at `www.example.com` is served through S3 and CloudFront. When the browser submits the registration form, JavaScript calls an API Gateway endpoint, which is a different origin from the website. The CORS failure occurs on the request from the website origin to the API Gateway API, not on the S3/CloudFront static content origin.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Enable the CORS setting on the API Gateway API endpoint. Ensure that the API endpoint is configured to return all responses that have the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header set to `www.example.com`.**

AWS documentation states that a cross-origin request is one made to a different domain, subdomain, port, or protocol, and that if an API returns a `Cross-Origin Request Blocked` error, you might need to enable CORS. For API Gateway, simple cross-origin POST responses must include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*'` or `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: 'origin'`. For non-simple requests, API Gateway must also handle the preflight `OPTIONS` request and return the required CORS headers. AWS also notes that after creating the preflight response, the API must return the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header for CORS-enabled methods, at least for successful responses; in practice, production APIs commonly need CORS headers on error responses as well to avoid browser-side CORS failures. See [CORS for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-cors.html).

Therefore, the CORS configuration must be applied to the **API Gateway API endpoint** that the browser is calling from `www.example.com`.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Change the CORS configuration on the S3 bucket

This would apply to browser requests made directly to the S3 bucket. The static website content is already being loaded, and the CORS error occurs when the form calls the **API Gateway endpoint**. Changing S3 CORS does not cause API Gateway responses to include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`.

### B. Enable the CORS setting in AWS WAF

AWS WAF is used to inspect and filter web requests. It is not the correct service for configuring API Gateway CORS behavior. The browser requires the target API response and, if applicable, the preflight response to include the correct CORS headers. That is an API Gateway/backend response configuration issue, not a WAF rule issue.

### D. Enable the CORS setting on the Lambda function

Lambda itself does not have a general “enable CORS” setting. There is an important nuance: AWS documentation says that for **Lambda proxy integrations**, the backend Lambda function is responsible for returning the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods`, and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` headers because a proxy integration does not return an integration response. However, option D is phrased incorrectly as enabling a CORS setting on Lambda. The exam’s best answer is to enable/configure CORS on the **API Gateway API endpoint** and ensure the endpoint’s responses include the required header. Depending on the integration type, that API Gateway configuration might require Lambda proxy responses to include the headers, but the service-level CORS configuration belongs to API Gateway.

## Conclusion

The browser is calling API Gateway from a different origin than the static website. Configure CORS on the API Gateway API endpoint and ensure that responses include the appropriate `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` value for the website origin. **Answer C is correct.**

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个未经身份验证的静态网站（www.example.com），其中包含供用户使用的注册表单。该网站使用 Amazon S3 进行托管，并使用 Amazon CloudFront 作为内容分发网络，同时配置了 AWS WAF。当提交注册表单时，网站会调用一个 Amazon API Gateway API 端点，该端点调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理负载并将负载转发到外部 API 调用。在测试期间，一名解决方案架构师遇到了跨源资源共享（CORS）错误。解决方案架构师确认 CloudFront 分配的源站已将 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 标头设置为 www.example.com。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来解决该错误？

options.A: 更改 S3 存储桶上的 CORS 配置。在 CORS 规则中为 www.example.com 添加到 AllowedOrigin 元素。
options.B: 在 AWS WAF 中启用 CORS 设置。创建一条 web ACL 规则，其中 Access-Control-Allow- Origin 标头设置为 www.example.com。
options.C: 在 API Gateway API 端点上启用 CORS 设置。确保 API 端点配置为返回所有带有 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 标头且该标头设置为 www.example.com 的响应。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数上启用 CORS 设置。确保函数的返回代码包含设置为 www.example.com 的 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 标头。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

位于 `www.example.com` 的静态网站通过 S3 和 CloudFront 提供服务。当浏览器提交注册表单时，JavaScript 会调用一个 API Gateway 端点，该端点与网站属于不同源。CORS 失败发生在从网站源到 API Gateway API 的请求上，而不是发生在 S3/CloudFront 静态内容源上。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 在 API Gateway API 端点上启用 CORS 设置。确保 API 端点配置为返回所有带有 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 标头且该标头设置为 `www.example.com` 的响应。**

AWS 文档说明，跨源请求是指发往不同域、子域、端口或协议的请求；如果 API 返回 `Cross-Origin Request Blocked` 错误，则可能需要启用 CORS。对于 API Gateway，简单的跨源 POST 响应必须包含 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*'` 或 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: 'origin'`。对于非简单请求，API Gateway 还必须处理预检 `OPTIONS` 请求并返回所需的 CORS 标头。AWS 还指出，在创建预检响应后，API 必须为启用 CORS 的方法返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 标头，至少对于成功响应是这样；在实践中，生产 API 通常也需要在错误响应上包含 CORS 标头，以避免浏览器端 CORS 失败。请参阅 [API Gateway 中 REST API 的 CORS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-cors.html)。

因此，必须将 CORS 配置应用到浏览器从 `www.example.com` 调用的 **API Gateway API 端点**。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 更改 S3 存储桶上的 CORS 配置

这会应用于浏览器直接向 S3 存储桶发出的请求。静态网站内容已经成功加载，而 CORS 错误发生在表单调用 **API Gateway 端点** 时。更改 S3 CORS 不会让 API Gateway 响应包含 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`。

### B. 在 AWS WAF 中启用 CORS 设置

AWS WAF 用于检查和筛选 Web 请求。它不是配置 API Gateway CORS 行为的正确服务。浏览器要求目标 API 响应以及（如适用）预检响应包含正确的 CORS 标头。这是 API Gateway/后端响应配置问题，而不是 WAF 规则问题。

### D. 在 Lambda 函数上启用 CORS 设置

Lambda 本身没有通用的“启用 CORS”设置。这里有一个重要细节：AWS 文档说明，对于 **Lambda 代理集成**，后端 Lambda 函数负责返回 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`、`Access-Control-Allow-Methods` 和 `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` 标头，因为代理集成不会返回集成响应。但是，选项 D 的表述不正确，因为它说在 Lambda 上启用 CORS 设置。考试的最佳答案是在 **API Gateway API 端点** 上启用/配置 CORS，并确保端点响应包含所需标头。根据集成类型，该 API Gateway 配置可能要求 Lambda 代理响应包含这些标头，但服务级别的 CORS 配置属于 API Gateway。

## 结论

浏览器正从不同于静态网站的源调用 API Gateway。请在 API Gateway API 端点上配置 CORS，并确保响应包含适合网站源的 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 值。**答案 C 正确。**

en.question: A company has many separate AWS accounts and uses no central billing or management. Each AWS account hosts services for different departments in the company. The company has a Microsoft Azure Active Directory that is deployed. A solutions architect needs to centralize billing and management of the company’s AWS accounts. The company wants to start using identity federation instead of manual user management. The company also wants to use temporary credentials instead of long-lived access keys. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new AWS account to serve as a management account. Deploy an organization in AWS Organizations. Invite each existing AWS account to join the organization. Ensure that each account accepts the invitation.
options.B: Configure each AWS account's email address to be aws+@example.com so that account management email messages and invoices are sent to the same place.
options.C: Deploy AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the management account. Connect IAM Identity Center to the Azure Active Directory. Configure IAM Identity Center for automatic synchronization of users and groups.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory in the management account. Share the directory with all other accounts in the organization by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).
options.E: Create AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) permission sets. Attach the permission sets to the appropriate IAM Identity Center groups and AWS accounts.
options.F: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) in each AWS account to use AWS Managed Microsoft AD for authentication and authorization.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company has multiple standalone AWS accounts with no centralized billing/management, already has Microsoft Azure Active Directory (now Microsoft Entra ID), and wants identity federation with temporary credentials rather than manually managed IAM users and long-lived access keys.

The correct combination is **A, C, and E**.

## Correct options

### A. Create a new management account, create an AWS Organization, and invite the existing accounts

This centralizes account management and billing. AWS Organizations supports inviting existing AWS accounts into an organization. AWS documentation states that when an invited account accepts, the **management account becomes responsible for all charges accrued by the member account**, which directly satisfies centralized billing. It also notes that accounts accept invitations to join an organization and become member accounts under the management account ([AWS Organizations: Managing account invitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invites.html)).

### C. Deploy IAM Identity Center and connect it to Azure Active Directory with automatic synchronization

This meets the federation and centralized identity requirement. AWS provides specific guidance for configuring SAML and SCIM between **Microsoft Entra ID** and IAM Identity Center. The documentation explains that SCIM synchronization provisions user information from Microsoft Entra ID into IAM Identity Center and enables automatic provisioning of users and groups ([Configure SAML and SCIM with Microsoft Entra ID and IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/idp-microsoft-entra.html)).

### E. Create IAM Identity Center permission sets and assign them to groups and AWS accounts

IAM Identity Center uses permission sets to define what access federated users or groups have in AWS accounts. AWS documentation for assigning access says to choose AWS accounts, select users or groups, and then select or create permission sets to apply to those users and groups ([Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)).

This also supports the temporary credential requirement. IAM Identity Center users can retrieve **temporary credentials** for assigned roles/permission sets, and the AWS CLI can automatically retrieve and refresh those credentials while the user has an active AWS access portal session ([Getting IAM Identity Center user credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtogetcredentials.html)).

## Incorrect options

### B. Configure each account email address to the same email pattern

Changing account email addresses does not create centralized billing, centralized management, federation, or temporary credentials. AWS Organizations is the service that centralizes billing and management across accounts.

### D. Deploy AWS Managed Microsoft AD and share it with all accounts

The company already has Azure Active Directory/Microsoft Entra ID. The requirement is to use identity federation, not to deploy a new AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory. IAM Identity Center can integrate with Microsoft Entra ID directly through SAML and SCIM, so creating and sharing AWS Managed Microsoft AD is unnecessary.

### F. Configure IAM in each account to use AWS Managed Microsoft AD

This would continue a per-account configuration model and depends on AWS Managed Microsoft AD, which is not required here. It also does not provide the centralized IAM Identity Center permission-set model across AWS Organizations accounts. The better architecture is centralized IAM Identity Center integrated with the existing Microsoft Entra ID identity source.

## Conclusion

**A, C, and E** meet all requirements: AWS Organizations centralizes billing and management, IAM Identity Center federates identities from Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID with SCIM synchronization, and permission sets provide centralized role-based access to AWS accounts using temporary credentials.

zh.question: 一家公司有许多相互独立的 AWS 账户，并且没有使用集中式账单或管理。每个 AWS 账户都托管公司不同部门的服务。该公司已经部署了 Microsoft Azure Active Directory。解决方案架构师需要集中管理公司的 AWS 账户账单和管理。公司希望开始使用身份联合，而不是手动用户管理。公司还希望使用临时凭证，而不是长期访问密钥。以下哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS 账户作为管理账户。在 AWS Organizations 中部署一个组织。邀请每个现有 AWS 账户加入该组织。确保每个账户接受邀请。
options.B: 将每个 AWS 账户的电子邮件地址配置为 aws+@example.com，以便账户管理电子邮件消息和发票发送到同一位置。
options.C: 在管理账户中部署 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。将 IAM Identity Center 连接到 Azure Active Directory。配置 IAM Identity Center 以自动同步用户和组。
options.D: 在管理账户中部署 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 目录。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 将该目录共享给组织中的所有其他账户。
options.E: 创建 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 权限集。将权限集附加到相应的 IAM Identity Center 组和 AWS 账户。
options.F: 在每个 AWS 账户中配置 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)，以使用 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 进行身份验证和授权。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司有多个独立的 AWS 账户，没有集中式账单/管理；已经有 Microsoft Azure Active Directory（现为 Microsoft Entra ID）；并且希望使用身份联合和临时凭证，而不是手动管理的 IAM 用户和长期访问密钥。

正确组合是 **A、C 和 E**。

## 正确选项

### A. 创建新的管理账户，创建 AWS Organization，并邀请现有账户

这可以集中账户管理和账单。AWS Organizations 支持邀请现有 AWS 账户加入组织。AWS 文档说明，当受邀账户接受邀请后，**管理账户将负责成员账户产生的所有费用**，这直接满足集中式账单要求。文档还指出，账户可以接受邀请加入组织，并成为管理账户下的成员账户（[AWS Organizations: Managing account invitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invites.html)）。

### C. 部署 IAM Identity Center，并将其连接到 Azure Active Directory，同时启用自动同步

这满足联合身份和集中式身份要求。AWS 提供了在 **Microsoft Entra ID** 与 IAM Identity Center 之间配置 SAML 和 SCIM 的具体指导。文档解释说，SCIM 同步会将用户信息从 Microsoft Entra ID 预置到 IAM Identity Center，并启用用户和组的自动预置（[Configure SAML and SCIM with Microsoft Entra ID and IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/idp-microsoft-entra.html)）。

### E. 创建 IAM Identity Center 权限集，并将其分配给组和 AWS 账户

IAM Identity Center 使用权限集来定义联合用户或组在 AWS 账户中拥有的访问权限。AWS 关于分配访问权限的文档说明，应选择 AWS 账户、选择用户或组，然后选择或创建权限集以应用于这些用户和组（[Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)）。

这也支持临时凭证要求。IAM Identity Center 用户可以检索分配的角色/权限集的**临时凭证**，并且 AWS CLI 可以在用户拥有有效的 AWS 访问门户会话期间自动检索和刷新这些凭证（[Getting IAM Identity Center user credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtogetcredentials.html)）。

## 错误选项

### B. 将每个账户电子邮件地址配置为相同的电子邮件模式

更改账户电子邮件地址不会创建集中式账单、集中式管理、联合身份或临时凭证。AWS Organizations 才是在多个账户之间集中账单和管理的服务。

### D. 部署 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 并将其共享给所有账户

公司已经有 Azure Active Directory/Microsoft Entra ID。要求是使用身份联合，而不是部署新的 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 目录。IAM Identity Center 可以通过 SAML 和 SCIM 直接与 Microsoft Entra ID 集成，因此创建并共享 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 是不必要的。

### F. 在每个账户中配置 IAM 以使用 AWS Managed Microsoft AD

这会继续采用按账户配置的模式，并依赖 AWS Managed Microsoft AD，而这里并不需要它。它也不会在 AWS Organizations 账户之间提供集中式 IAM Identity Center 权限集模型。更好的架构是集中式 IAM Identity Center，并与现有 Microsoft Entra ID 身份源集成。

## 结论

**A、C 和 E** 满足所有要求：AWS Organizations 集中账单和管理，IAM Identity Center 通过 SCIM 同步从 Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID 联合身份，权限集则使用临时凭证为 AWS 账户提供集中式、基于角色的访问。

en.question: A company wants to manage the costs associated with a group of 20 applications that are infrequently used, but are still business-critical, by migrating to AWS. The applications are a mix of Java and Node.js spread across different instance clusters. The company wants to minimize costs while standardizing by using a single deployment methodology. Most of the applications are part of month-end processing routines with a small number of concurrent users, but they are occasionally run at other times. Average application memory consumption is less than 1 GB. though some applications use as much as 2.5 GB of memory during peak processing. The most important application in the group is a billing report written in Java that accesses multiple data sources and often runs for several hours. Which is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.A: Deploy a separate AWS Lambda function for each application. Use AWS CloudTrail logs and Amazon CloudWatch alarms to verify completion of critical jobs.
options.B: Deploy Amazon ECS containers on Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling configured for memory utilization of 75%. Deploy an ECS task for each application being migrated with ECS task scaling. Monitor services and hosts by using Amazon CloudWatch.
options.C: Deploy AWS Elastic Beanstalk for each application with Auto Scaling to ensure that all requests have sufficient resources. Monitor each AWS Elastic Beanstalk deployment by using CloudWatch alarms.
options.D: Deploy a new Amazon EC2 instance cluster that co-hosts all applications by using EC2 Auto Scaling and Application Load Balancers. Scale cluster size based on a custom metric set on instance memory utilization. Purchase 3-year Reserved Instance reservations equal to the GroupMaxSize parameter of the Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The company has 20 infrequently used but business-critical Java and Node.js applications. The main objectives are:

- minimize cost for mostly idle/month-end workloads,
- standardize deployment across Java and Node.js,
- support applications that can run for several hours,
- handle variable memory use, from under 1 GB average to about 2.5 GB at peak,
- monitor services and infrastructure.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Deploy Amazon ECS containers on Amazon EC2 with Auto Scaling configured for memory utilization of 75%. Deploy an ECS task for each application being migrated with ECS task scaling. Monitor services and hosts by using Amazon CloudWatch.**

This is the most cost-effective and operationally appropriate option.

Amazon ECS provides a standardized container-based deployment model for both Java and Node.js applications. Each application can be packaged as a container image and run as an ECS task or service with its own task definition, including memory settings. This allows the company to co-locate multiple low-utilization applications on a shared ECS-on-EC2 cluster instead of provisioning a separate environment or instance group per application.

ECS also supports service-level memory utilization metrics. AWS documentation states that ECS measures service CPU and memory utilization as a percentage of the resources used by ECS tasks compared with the CPU and memory specified in the service task definition, and reports these metrics to CloudWatch ([Amazon ECS service utilization metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service_utilization.html)). ECS service auto scaling can use target tracking with **ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization**, and service auto scaling increases or decreases the desired task count automatically based on the target metric value ([Create a target tracking scaling policy for Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)).

This fits the workload well because the applications are mostly idle but occasionally need capacity. ECS task scaling and EC2 capacity scaling allow the environment to run only the needed number of tasks and hosts. CloudWatch is also appropriate because ECS provides CPU and memory metrics at cluster and service level, and AWS notes that ECS metrics can be used to monitor resources while EC2 container instances should also be monitored separately ([Monitor Amazon ECS using CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cloudwatch-metrics.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Lambda functions for each application

Lambda is not suitable for the most important billing report because it often runs for several hours. Lambda has a maximum function timeout of **900 seconds, or 15 minutes** ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). A several-hour Java billing report that accesses multiple data sources would exceed this limit. CloudTrail logs are also not the right mechanism to verify completion of application jobs; CloudWatch logs, metrics, or application-level status tracking would be more appropriate.

### C. Elastic Beanstalk for each application

Elastic Beanstalk supports Java and Node.js and can provision EC2 instances, load balancing, health monitoring, and scaling for an application environment ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). However, deploying **each** of the 20 applications as a separate Elastic Beanstalk environment is likely to be less cost-effective for infrequently used applications. Each environment can have its own underlying EC2 capacity, scaling configuration, and operational overhead. This is less efficient than consolidating the applications as containers on a shared ECS cluster with per-application task definitions and scaling.

### D. Shared EC2 cluster with Reserved Instances for GroupMaxSize

A manually co-hosted EC2 cluster is less standardized and less granular than ECS. It does not provide the same per-application container/task isolation, task-level resource definitions, or ECS service scaling. More importantly, purchasing 3-year Reserved Instances equal to the Auto Scaling group's maximum size is a poor fit for infrequently used workloads. The workload is mostly idle and only occasionally active, so reserving capacity for the maximum possible cluster size would likely overcommit spend and reduce cost efficiency. Application Load Balancers also add cost and are not necessarily required for month-end processing jobs with few users.

## Conclusion

Option **B** best satisfies all requirements: it standardizes deployment with containers, supports long-running Java and Node.js workloads, allows per-application task sizing and scaling, consolidates low-utilization applications onto shared EC2 capacity, and uses CloudWatch metrics for monitoring and scaling. Therefore, **B is the most cost-effective solution**.

zh.question: 一家公司希望通过迁移到 AWS 来管理一组 20 个不常使用但仍对业务至关重要的应用程序相关成本。这些应用程序混合使用 Java 和 Node.js，并分布在不同的实例集群中。公司希望在使用单一部署方法进行标准化的同时尽量降低成本。大多数应用程序属于月末处理例程的一部分，并发用户数量很少，但它们偶尔也会在其他时间运行。平均应用程序内存消耗低于 1 GB，不过有些应用程序在峰值处理期间会使用多达 2.5 GB 的内存。该组中最重要的应用程序是一个用 Java 编写的账单报告，它访问多个数据源，并且通常运行数小时。哪种解决方案最具成本效益？

options.A: 为每个应用程序部署一个单独的 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 AWS CloudTrail 日志和 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来验证关键作业是否完成。
options.B: 在 Amazon EC2 上部署 Amazon ECS 容器，并配置 Auto Scaling，使其基于 75% 的内存利用率进行扩展。为每个要迁移的应用程序部署一个 ECS 任务，并配置 ECS 任务扩缩。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控服务和主机。
options.C: 为每个应用程序部署 AWS Elastic Beanstalk，并配置 Auto Scaling，以确保所有请求都有足够资源。使用 CloudWatch 警报监控每个 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署。
options.D: 部署一个新的 Amazon EC2 实例集群，通过 EC2 Auto Scaling 和 Application Load Balancers 共同托管所有应用程序。基于实例内存利用率上设置的自定义指标来扩展集群大小。购买 3 年期 Reserved Instance 预留，其数量等于 Auto Scaling 组的 GroupMaxSize 参数。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

该公司有 20 个不常使用但对业务至关重要的 Java 和 Node.js 应用程序。主要目标是：

- 为大部分时间闲置/月末运行的工作负载尽量降低成本，
- 在 Java 和 Node.js 之间标准化部署，
- 支持可运行数小时的应用程序，
- 处理可变内存使用量，从平均低于 1 GB 到峰值约 2.5 GB，
- 监控服务和基础设施。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 在 Amazon EC2 上部署 Amazon ECS 容器，并配置 Auto Scaling，使其基于 75% 的内存利用率进行扩展。为每个要迁移的应用程序部署一个 ECS 任务，并配置 ECS 任务扩缩。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控服务和主机。**

这是最具成本效益且在运维上最合适的选项。

Amazon ECS 为 Java 和 Node.js 应用程序提供标准化的基于容器的部署模型。每个应用程序都可以打包为容器镜像，并作为 ECS 任务或服务运行，使用自己的任务定义（包括内存设置）。这使公司能够在共享的 ECS-on-EC2 集群上共同放置多个低利用率应用程序，而不是为每个应用程序预置单独的环境或实例组。

ECS 还支持服务级内存利用率指标。AWS 文档说明，ECS 将服务 CPU 和内存利用率衡量为 ECS 任务所使用资源与服务任务定义中指定的 CPU 和内存相比的百分比，并将这些指标报告到 CloudWatch（[Amazon ECS service utilization metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service_utilization.html)）。ECS 服务自动扩缩可以使用带有 **ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization** 的目标跟踪，并且服务自动扩缩会根据目标指标值自动增加或减少所需任务数量（[Create a target tracking scaling policy for Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)）。

这非常适合该工作负载，因为这些应用程序大部分时间闲置，但偶尔需要容量。ECS 任务扩缩和 EC2 容量扩缩允许环境仅运行所需数量的任务和主机。CloudWatch 也很合适，因为 ECS 在集群和服务级别提供 CPU 与内存指标，并且 AWS 指出 ECS 指标可用于监控资源，同时还应单独监控 EC2 容器实例（[Monitor Amazon ECS using CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cloudwatch-metrics.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 为每个应用程序使用 Lambda 函数

Lambda 不适合最重要的账单报告，因为它通常运行数小时。Lambda 的最大函数超时时间为 **900 秒，即 15 分钟**（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。一个访问多个数据源、运行数小时的 Java 账单报告会超过此限制。CloudTrail 日志也不是验证应用程序作业完成情况的正确机制；CloudWatch 日志、指标或应用程序级状态跟踪会更合适。

### C. 为每个应用程序使用 Elastic Beanstalk

Elastic Beanstalk 支持 Java 和 Node.js，并且可以为应用程序环境预置 EC2 实例、负载均衡、运行状况监控和扩展（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。但是，将 20 个应用程序中的**每一个**都部署为单独的 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，对于不常使用的应用程序来说可能成本效益较低。每个环境都可以有自己的底层 EC2 容量、扩展配置和运营开销。这不如将应用程序作为容器整合到共享 ECS 集群中，并使用按应用程序划分的任务定义和扩缩来得高效。

### D. 使用 Reserved Instances for GroupMaxSize 的共享 EC2 集群

手动共同托管的 EC2 集群不如 ECS 标准化，粒度也更粗。它不提供相同的按应用程序容器/任务隔离、任务级资源定义或 ECS 服务扩缩。更重要的是，购买数量等于 Auto Scaling 组最大大小的 3 年期 Reserved Instances，并不适合不常使用的工作负载。该工作负载大部分时间闲置，只是偶尔活跃，因此为最大可能集群规模预留容量很可能导致支出过度承诺，并降低成本效率。Application Load Balancers 也会增加成本，而且对于用户很少的月末处理作业来说不一定需要。

## 结论

选项 **B** 最好地满足所有要求：它使用容器标准化部署，支持长时间运行的 Java 和 Node.js 工作负载，允许按应用程序进行任务规格设置和扩缩，将低利用率应用程序整合到共享 EC2 容量上，并使用 CloudWatch 指标进行监控和扩缩。因此，**B 是最具成本效益的解决方案**。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to review the design of an Amazon EMR cluster that is using the EMR File System (EMRFS). The cluster performs tasks that are critical to business needs. The cluster is running Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances at all times for all task, primary, and core nodes. The EMR tasks run each morning, starting at 1:00 AM. and take 6 hours to finish running. The amount of time to complete the processing is not a priority because the data is not referenced until late in the day. The solutions architect must review the architecture and suggest a solution to minimize the compute costs. Which solution should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Launch all task, primary, and core nodes on Spot Instances in an instance fleet. Terminate the cluster, including all instances, when the processing is completed.
options.B: Launch the primary and core nodes on On-Demand Instances. Launch the task nodes on Spot Instances in an instance fleet. Terminate the cluster, including all instances, when the processing is completed. Purchase Compute Savings Plans to cover the On-Demand Instance usage.
options.C: Continue to launch all nodes on On-Demand Instances. Terminate the cluster, including all instances, when the processing is completed. Purchase Compute Savings Plans to cover the On- Demand Instance usage.
options.D: Launch the primary and core nodes on On-Demand Instances. Launch the task nodes on Spot Instances in an instance fleet. Terminate only the task node instances when the processing is completed. Purchase Compute Savings Plans to cover the On-Demand Instance usage.

en.explanation:
The workload is a scheduled Amazon EMR batch cluster that uses EMRFS/S3-backed storage, runs for about 6 hours each morning, and does not need to keep compute capacity available after processing finishes. The correct recommendation is **B: launch the primary and core nodes on On-Demand Instances, launch task nodes on Spot Instances in an instance fleet, terminate the entire cluster after processing completes, and purchase Compute Savings Plans for the predictable On-Demand usage**.

AWS describes the Amazon EMR primary node as the node that manages the cluster and runs key services such as YARN ResourceManager and HDFS NameNode. Core nodes run HDFS DataNode and processing components, and AWS warns that terminating core nodes can risk data loss. Task nodes, however, add parallel compute capacity and do not store data in HDFS ([Amazon EMR node types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-master-core-task-nodes.html)).

For Spot usage, AWS specifically states that task nodes are often run on Spot Instances, that task nodes do not hold persistent HDFS data, and that launching task instance groups as Spot Instances is a strategic way to expand cluster capacity while minimizing costs. For data-critical workloads where lower cost is important but losing partial work is not acceptable, AWS recommends On-Demand for primary and core nodes and Spot for task nodes ([Amazon EMR Spot Instance best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-instances-guidelines.html)). This matches the business-critical nature of the job while still reducing cost.

The cluster should also be terminated after the 6-hour processing window. Amazon EMR storage documentation explains that HDFS is ephemeral and reclaimed when the cluster ends, while Amazon S3 can be used as the file system for EMR jobs through the `s3://` prefix ([Amazon EMR storage and file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-file-systems.html)). Because the cluster uses EMRFS/S3, the results can remain available in Amazon S3 without leaving the EMR EC2 instances running until later in the day.

Compute Savings Plans are appropriate for the remaining predictable On-Demand usage because AWS states that Savings Plans provide discounts in exchange for a specified hourly compute commitment, and Compute Savings Plans apply to EC2 instance usage across instance family, size, OS, tenancy, and Region ([Savings Plans overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** is incorrect because it uses Spot Instances for all nodes, including primary and core nodes. For a business-critical workload, this introduces unnecessary risk: termination of a Spot primary node can end the cluster, and Spot core node termination can risk HDFS data loss.
* **C** is incorrect because it keeps all nodes on On-Demand Instances. Terminating the cluster and using Savings Plans would reduce some cost, but it misses the opportunity to use lower-cost Spot capacity for task nodes, which are well suited for Spot because they do not store persistent HDFS data.
* **D** is incorrect because it terminates only the task nodes after processing. The primary and core nodes would remain running idle for the rest of the day, increasing compute cost. Since the data is stored through EMRFS/S3 and the cluster is not needed after the job completes, the entire cluster should be terminated.

Therefore, **B** provides the best balance of reliability and cost optimization: On-Demand for critical primary/core capacity, Spot for flexible task capacity, full cluster termination after the batch job, and Savings Plans for the predictable On-Demand compute baseline.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要审查一个使用 EMR File System (EMRFS) 的 Amazon EMR 集群设计。该集群执行对业务需求至关重要的任务。该集群的所有 task、primary 和 core 节点始终都在运行 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances。EMR 任务每天早上运行，从凌晨 1:00 开始，需要 6 小时完成。完成处理所需的时间并不是优先事项，因为数据直到当天较晚时候才会被引用。解决方案架构师必须审查该架构，并建议一种解决方案来最大限度降低计算成本。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种解决方案来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 instance fleet 中将所有 task、primary 和 core 节点都启动在 Spot Instances 上。处理完成后终止集群，包括所有实例。
options.B: 将 primary 和 core 节点启动在 On-Demand Instances 上。将 task 节点启动在 instance fleet 中的 Spot Instances 上。处理完成后终止集群，包括所有实例。购买 Compute Savings Plans 以覆盖 On-Demand Instance 使用量。
options.C: 继续将所有节点启动在 On-Demand Instances 上。处理完成后终止集群，包括所有实例。购买 Compute Savings Plans 以覆盖 On-Demand Instance 使用量。
options.D: 将 primary 和 core 节点启动在 On-Demand Instances 上。将 task 节点启动在 instance fleet 中的 Spot Instances 上。处理完成后仅终止 task 节点实例。购买 Compute Savings Plans 以覆盖 On-Demand Instance 使用量。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载是一个计划运行的 Amazon EMR 批处理集群，使用 EMRFS/S3 支持的存储，每天早上运行约 6 小时，并且在处理完成后不需要继续保持计算容量可用。正确建议是 **B：将 primary 和 core 节点启动在 On-Demand Instances 上，将 task 节点启动在 instance fleet 中的 Spot Instances 上，在处理完成后终止整个集群，并为可预测的 On-Demand 使用量购买 Compute Savings Plans**。

AWS 将 Amazon EMR primary 节点描述为管理集群并运行关键服务（例如 YARN ResourceManager 和 HDFS NameNode）的节点。Core 节点运行 HDFS DataNode 和处理组件，并且 AWS 警告终止 core 节点可能会带来数据丢失风险。但是，Task 节点用于增加并行计算容量，并且不在 HDFS 中存储数据（[Amazon EMR node types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-master-core-task-nodes.html)）。

对于 Spot 使用，AWS 明确说明 task 节点通常在 Spot Instances 上运行，task 节点不保存持久 HDFS 数据，并且将 task instance groups 作为 Spot Instances 启动，是在最大限度降低成本的同时扩展集群容量的战略方式。对于数据关键型工作负载，如果较低成本很重要但不能接受丢失部分工作，AWS 建议 primary 和 core 节点使用 On-Demand，task 节点使用 Spot（[Amazon EMR Spot Instance best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-instances-guidelines.html)）。这符合该作业对业务至关重要的性质，同时仍能降低成本。

该集群还应在 6 小时处理窗口结束后终止。Amazon EMR 存储文档解释说，HDFS 是临时的，并会在集群结束时被回收，而 Amazon S3 可以通过 `s3://` 前缀用作 EMR 作业的文件系统（[Amazon EMR storage and file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-file-systems.html)）。由于该集群使用 EMRFS/S3，结果可以保留在 Amazon S3 中，而无需让 EMR EC2 实例一直运行到当天较晚时候。

Compute Savings Plans 适用于剩余的可预测 On-Demand 使用量，因为 AWS 表示，Savings Plans 通过承诺指定的每小时计算用量来提供折扣，并且 Compute Savings Plans 适用于跨实例系列、大小、操作系统、租期和区域的 EC2 实例使用量（[Savings Plans overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。

其他选项错误的原因：

* **A** 错误，因为它对所有节点都使用 Spot Instances，包括 primary 和 core 节点。对于业务关键型工作负载，这会引入不必要的风险：Spot primary 节点被终止可能导致集群结束，而 Spot core 节点被终止可能带来 HDFS 数据丢失风险。
* **C** 错误，因为它让所有节点都保持在 On-Demand Instances 上。终止集群并使用 Savings Plans 会降低部分成本，但它错过了对 task 节点使用较低成本 Spot 容量的机会；task 节点非常适合 Spot，因为它们不存储持久 HDFS 数据。
* **D** 错误，因为它在处理完成后只终止 task 节点。primary 和 core 节点会在当天剩余时间继续空闲运行，从而增加计算成本。由于数据通过 EMRFS/S3 存储，并且作业完成后不再需要集群，因此应终止整个集群。

因此，**B** 在可靠性和成本优化之间提供了最佳平衡：关键的 primary/core 容量使用 On-Demand，灵活的 task 容量使用 Spot，批处理作业完成后完全终止集群，并为可预测的 On-Demand 计算基线使用 Savings Plans。

en.question: A company has migrated a legacy application to the AWS Cloud. The application runs on three Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across three Availability Zones. One EC2 instance is in each Availability Zone. The EC2 instances are running in three private subnets of the VPC and are set up as targets for an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is associated with three public subnets. The application needs to communicate with on-premises systems. Only traffic from IP addresses in the company's IP address range are allowed to access the on-premises systems. The company’s security team is bringing only one IP address from its internal IP address range to the cloud. The company has added this IP address to the allow list for the company firewall. The company also has created an Elastic IP address for this IP address. A solutions architect needs to create a solution that gives the application the ability to communicate with the on-premises systems. The solution also must be able to mitigate failures automatically. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy three NAT gateways, one in each public subnet. Assign the Elastic IP address to the NAT gateways. Turn on health checks for the NAT gateways. If a NAT gateway fails a health check, recreate the NAT gateway and assign the Elastic IP address to the new NAT gateway.
options.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Assign the Elastic IP address to the NLTurn on health checks for the NLIn the case of a failed health check, redeploy the NLB in different subnets.
options.C: Deploy a single NAT gateway in a public subnet. Assign the Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway. Use Amazon CloudWatch with a custom metric to monitor the NAT gateway. If the NAT gateway is unhealthy, invoke an AWS Lambda function to create a new NAT gateway in a different subnet. Assign the Elastic IP address to the new NAT gateway.
options.D: Assign the Elastic IP address to the ALB. Create an Amazon Route 53 simple record with the Elastic IP address as the value. Create a Route 53 health check. In the case of a failed health check, recreate the ALB in different subnets.

en.explanation:
The application instances are in private subnets and must initiate communication to on-premises systems. The key constraint is that the on-premises firewall allows only **one** IP address from the company range, and the company has created one Elastic IP address for that address. Therefore, the AWS-side egress path must translate outbound traffic from all three private-subnet instances to that single allow-listed address, while also providing automated recovery if the egress component fails.

**Correct answer: C. Deploy one NAT gateway with the Elastic IP address, monitor it with CloudWatch, and use Lambda automation to recreate it in another subnet if unhealthy.**

AWS documents that a NAT gateway lets instances in private subnets connect to services outside the VPC while preventing unsolicited inbound connections, and that a **public NAT gateway** is created in a public subnet and must be associated with an **Elastic IP address** at creation ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)). AWS also states that, for a public NAT gateway, the internet gateway maps the NAT gateway private address to the associated Elastic IP address, and that tests should show the source IP as the NAT gateway Elastic IP ([NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). This satisfies the allow-list requirement because all application egress routed through that NAT gateway appears from the single Elastic IP address.

For failure mitigation, NAT gateway metrics are published to CloudWatch at 1-minute intervals under the `AWS/NATGateway` namespace ([View NAT gateway CloudWatch metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/viewing-metrics.html)). Using CloudWatch alarm/custom metric logic to invoke Lambda to create a replacement NAT gateway in another public subnet and reassociate the Elastic IP is the only option that both preserves the single source IP and automates recovery. AWS also documents that an Elastic IP address is static and can be disassociated from one resource and associated with a different resource, which supports failover automation to the replacement NAT gateway ([Elastic IP address basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/elastic-ip-addresses-eip.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Three NAT gateways, each with the same Elastic IP address** — This does not meet the one-EIP constraint. A public NAT gateway requires an Elastic IP address, but one Elastic IP address cannot be simultaneously used as the public address for three different NAT gateways. Elastic IP documentation describes moving an Elastic IP by disassociating it and associating it with a different resource, not sharing it concurrently across multiple resources ([Elastic IP address basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/elastic-ip-addresses-eip.html)). Also, deploying one NAT gateway per AZ is a common resiliency pattern, but it would require multiple public source IPs if each NAT gateway needs its own Elastic IP.

- **B. Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer** — The ALB is used for inbound application traffic to the EC2 targets. Replacing it with an NLB does not solve outbound source NAT for instances in private subnets. Elastic Load Balancing accepts incoming client traffic and routes it to registered targets; it is not the mechanism for making private instances initiate outbound connections to on-premises systems from a single allow-listed source IP ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

- **D. Assign the Elastic IP address to the ALB and use Route 53** — This is not a valid design for outbound connectivity from private EC2 instances. An internet-facing load balancer has public IP addresses on its nodes and exposes a DNS name; it routes inbound requests to targets using private IP addresses ([Load balancer scheme](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). It does not provide source NAT for the instances’ outbound traffic to on-premises systems, and recreating the ALB would not preserve or control the EC2 instances’ egress source address.

Therefore, **C** is the best answer because it uses the single allow-listed Elastic IP for outbound NAT and adds automated remediation for NAT gateway failure.

zh.question: 一家公司已将一个遗留应用程序迁移到 AWS 云。该应用程序运行在三台 Amazon EC2 实例上，这些实例分布在三个可用区中。每个可用区中有一台 EC2 实例。EC2 实例运行在 VPC 的三个私有子网中，并被设置为与三个公有子网关联的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的目标。该应用程序需要与本地系统通信。只有来自公司 IP 地址范围内 IP 地址的流量才被允许访问本地系统。公司的安全团队只将其内部 IP 地址范围中的一个 IP 地址带到云中。公司已将此 IP 地址添加到公司防火墙的允许列表中。公司还为此 IP 地址创建了一个 Elastic IP 地址。解决方案架构师需要创建一个解决方案，使应用程序能够与本地系统通信。该解决方案还必须能够自动缓解故障。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署三个 NAT gateways，每个公有子网中一个。将 Elastic IP 地址分配给 NAT gateways。为 NAT gateways 开启运行状况检查。如果某个 NAT gateway 未通过运行状况检查，则重新创建该 NAT gateway，并将 Elastic IP 地址分配给新的 NAT gateway。
options.B: 将 ALB 替换为 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将 Elastic IP 地址分配给 NLB。为 NLB 开启运行状况检查。如果运行状况检查失败，则在不同的子网中重新部署 NLB。
