这可以移除现有的公共对象 ACL，但不如 S3 Block Public Access 合适。它需要遍历所有对象，对于大型存储桶可能需要时间，并且本身不能防止将来的对象以公共 ACL 上传。相比之下，`IgnorePublicAcls` 会立即使 S3 忽略存储桶及其包含对象的公共 ACL，而无需更改现有 ACL（[S3 Block Public Access settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)）。

### 结论

最即时且干扰最小的修复措施是在存储桶上启用 S3 Block Public Access，并设置 `IgnorePublicAcls=TRUE`。这会阻止由 ACL 授予的未经身份验证的公共访问，同时保留应用程序的预签名 URL 下载工作流。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate an Amazon RDS for Oracle database to an RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance in another AWS account. A solutions architect needs to design a migration strategy that will require no downtime and that will minimize the amount of time necessary to complete the migration. The migration strategy must replicate all existing data and any new data that is created during the migration. The target database must be identical to the source database at completion of the migration process. All applications currently use an Amazon Route 53 CNAME record as their endpoint for communication with the RDS for Oracle DB instance. The RDS for Oracle DB instance is in a private subnet. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance in the target account. Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database schema from the source database to the target database.
options.B: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to create a new RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance in the target account with the schema and initial data from the source database.
options.C: Configure VPC peering between the VPCs in the two AWS accounts to provide connectivity to both DB instances from the target account. Configure the security groups that are attached to each DB instance to allow traffic on the database port from the VPC in the target account.
options.D: Temporarily allow the source DB instance to be publicly accessible to provide connectivity from the VPC in the target account. Configure the security groups that are attached to each DB instance to allow traffic on the database port from the VPC in the target account.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) in the target account to perform a full load plus change data capture (CDC) migration from the source database to the target database. When the migration is complete, change the CNAME record to point to the target DB instance endpoint.
options.F: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) in the target account to perform a change data capture (CDC) migration from the source database to the target database. When the migration is complete, change the CNAME record to point to the target DB instance endpoint.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company is migrating between **different database engines** (RDS for Oracle to RDS for PostgreSQL) and across **different AWS accounts**. The strategy must copy the existing data and continue replicating new changes during the migration, then cut applications over by updating the existing Route 53 CNAME.

The correct combination is **A, C, and E**.

## Correct answers

### A. Create the target RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance and use AWS SCT to migrate the schema

For a heterogeneous migration such as Oracle to PostgreSQL, the schema must be converted before data migration. AWS Schema Conversion Tool is designed to convert the source database schema into a format compatible with the target Amazon RDS instance. The AWS SCT documentation states that it "automatically convert[s] the database schema of your source database into a format compatible with your target Amazon RDS instance" and provides guidance for objects that cannot be converted automatically ([AWS SCT schema conversion overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)).

This is why the target RDS for PostgreSQL instance should be created first, and then the Oracle schema should be converted and applied to the PostgreSQL target.

### C. Configure VPC peering and security groups for private connectivity

The source RDS for Oracle DB instance is in a private subnet, and the migration is across accounts/VPCs. AWS DMS needs network connectivity from the replication instance to the source and target endpoints. AWS documentation for DMS VPC peering states that VPC peering enables private network connectivity between VPCs so DMS replication instances and database endpoints can communicate "without traversing the public internet." It also specifically notes that when using Amazon RDS, you must configure VPC peering between DMS and RDS if the instances are in different VPCs, and that security groups must allow traffic on the database port from the DMS side to the RDS instance ([VPC peering configuration for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Advanced.Endpoints.vpc.peering.html)).

Therefore, VPC peering plus database-port security group rules is the correct private connectivity design.

### E. Use AWS DMS full load plus CDC, then update the CNAME to the target endpoint

The requirement is to migrate **all existing data** and **any new data created during the migration**. AWS DMS provides a migration task type called **Migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes**, also known as `full-load-and-cdc`. The documentation explains that this mode loads the original data and captures source changes while migration is occurring; after the initial load completes, CDC applies the captured changes to the target and preserves transactional integrity ([Creating an AWS DMS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Tasks.Creating.html)).

AWS DMS also supports Oracle as a source and supports tasks that use full load and CDC for Oracle by using Oracle LogMiner or AWS DMS Binary Reader ([Oracle as an AWS DMS source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.Oracle.html)).

After DMS catches up and validation/cutover is complete, updating the Route 53 CNAME to point to the new RDS for PostgreSQL endpoint minimizes application changes because applications already use the CNAME rather than the raw RDS endpoint.

## Incorrect answers

### B. Use AWS SCT to create a new RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with schema and initial data

This is incorrect because AWS SCT is primarily for **schema conversion**, not for provisioning a new RDS DB instance and loading all initial data as described. The SCT documentation describes converting source schemas into a target-compatible format and optionally integrating with AWS DMS, but it does not replace the need to create the target RDS instance and use AWS DMS for the data migration ([AWS SCT schema conversion overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)).

### D. Temporarily make the source DB instance publicly accessible

This is unnecessary and less secure. The source database is in a private subnet, and AWS DMS supports private cross-VPC connectivity through VPC peering. The DMS VPC peering documentation explicitly describes secure private communication between the replication instance and RDS endpoints without using the public internet ([VPC peering configuration for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Advanced.Endpoints.vpc.peering.html)).

### F. Use AWS DMS CDC-only migration

CDC-only migration replicates only changes from a specified point in the database logs. It does **not** perform the initial load of existing data. The requirement explicitly says the migration must replicate all existing data and all new data created during the migration. AWS DMS documentation distinguishes CDC-only from `full-load-and-cdc`; the latter is the option that migrates existing data and replicates ongoing changes ([Creating an AWS DMS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Tasks.Creating.html)).

## Final answer

**A, C, E**

zh.question: 一家公司计划将 Amazon RDS for Oracle 数据库迁移到另一个 AWS 账户中的 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。解决方案架构师需要设计一种迁移策略，要求无停机，并最大限度地减少完成迁移所需的时间。该迁移策略必须复制所有现有数据，以及迁移期间创建的任何新数据。迁移流程完成时，目标数据库必须与源数据库完全一致。所有应用程序当前都使用 Amazon Route 53 CNAME 记录作为与 RDS for Oracle 数据库实例通信的端点。该 RDS for Oracle 数据库实例位于私有子网中。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在目标账户中创建新的 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 将数据库架构从源数据库迁移到目标数据库。
options.B: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 在目标账户中创建新的 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例，并包含来自源数据库的架构和初始数据。
options.C: 在两个 AWS 账户中的 VPC 之间配置 VPC 对等连接，以便从目标账户连接到两个数据库实例。配置附加到每个数据库实例的安全组，允许来自目标账户中 VPC 的数据库端口流量。
options.D: 临时允许源数据库实例可公开访问，以便从目标账户中的 VPC 建立连接。配置附加到每个数据库实例的安全组，允许来自目标账户中 VPC 的数据库端口流量。
options.E: 在目标账户中使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 执行从源数据库到目标数据库的全量加载加变更数据捕获 (CDC) 迁移。迁移完成后，更改 CNAME 记录，使其指向目标数据库实例端点。
options.F: 在目标账户中使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 执行从源数据库到目标数据库的变更数据捕获 (CDC) 迁移。迁移完成后，更改 CNAME 记录，使其指向目标数据库实例端点。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司正在跨**不同数据库引擎**（RDS for Oracle 到 RDS for PostgreSQL）并跨**不同 AWS 账户**进行迁移。该策略必须复制现有数据，并在迁移期间持续复制新的变更，然后通过更新现有的 Route 53 CNAME 将应用程序切换过去。

正确组合是 **A、C 和 E**。

## 正确答案

### A. 创建目标 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例，并使用 AWS SCT 迁移架构

对于 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 这样的异构迁移，必须先转换架构，然后再进行数据迁移。AWS Schema Conversion Tool 旨在将源数据库架构转换为与目标 Amazon RDS 实例兼容的格式。AWS SCT 文档说明，它会“自动将源数据库的数据库架构转换为与目标 Amazon RDS 实例兼容的格式”，并为无法自动转换的对象提供指导（[AWS SCT schema conversion overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)）。

这就是为什么应先创建目标 RDS for PostgreSQL 实例，然后将 Oracle 架构转换并应用到 PostgreSQL 目标。

### C. 配置 VPC 对等连接和安全组以实现私有连接

源 RDS for Oracle 数据库实例位于私有子网中，并且迁移跨账户/VPC 进行。AWS DMS 需要从复制实例到源端点和目标端点的网络连接。AWS 关于 DMS VPC 对等连接的文档指出，VPC 对等连接可以在 VPC 之间启用私有网络连接，使 DMS 复制实例和数据库端点能够通信，而“无需经过公有互联网”。文档还特别指出，在使用 Amazon RDS 时，如果实例位于不同 VPC 中，则必须在 DMS 与 RDS 之间配置 VPC 对等连接，并且安全组必须允许从 DMS 侧到 RDS 实例的数据库端口流量（[VPC peering configuration for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Advanced.Endpoints.vpc.peering.html)）。

因此，VPC 对等连接加数据库端口安全组规则是正确的私有连接设计。

### E. 使用 AWS DMS 全量加载加 CDC，然后将 CNAME 更新为目标端点

要求是迁移**所有现有数据**以及**迁移期间创建的任何新数据**。AWS DMS 提供一种名为**迁移现有数据并复制持续变更**的迁移任务类型，也称为 `full-load-and-cdc`。文档解释说，此模式会加载原始数据，并在迁移进行期间捕获源端变更；初始加载完成后，CDC 会将捕获到的变更应用到目标并保持事务完整性（[Creating an AWS DMS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Tasks.Creating.html)）。

AWS DMS 还支持 Oracle 作为源，并支持通过 Oracle LogMiner 或 AWS DMS Binary Reader 对 Oracle 使用全量加载和 CDC 的任务（[Oracle as an AWS DMS source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.Oracle.html)）。

在 DMS 追平并完成验证/切换后，更新 Route 53 CNAME 使其指向新的 RDS for PostgreSQL 端点，可以最大限度减少应用程序变更，因为应用程序已经使用 CNAME，而不是原始 RDS 端点。

## 错误答案

### B. 使用 AWS SCT 创建包含架构和初始数据的新 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例

这是错误的，因为 AWS SCT 主要用于**架构转换**，而不是用于预置新的 RDS 数据库实例并按所述加载所有初始数据。SCT 文档描述的是将源架构转换为与目标兼容的格式，并可选择与 AWS DMS 集成，但它不能取代创建目标 RDS 实例并使用 AWS DMS 进行数据迁移的需求（[AWS SCT schema conversion overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)）。

### D. 临时使源数据库实例可公开访问

这是不必要且安全性较低的做法。源数据库位于私有子网中，AWS DMS 支持通过 VPC 对等连接实现私有跨 VPC 连接。DMS VPC 对等连接文档明确描述了复制实例与 RDS 端点之间无需使用公有互联网的安全私有通信（[VPC peering configuration for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Advanced.Endpoints.vpc.peering.html)）。

### F. 使用 AWS DMS 仅 CDC 迁移

仅 CDC 迁移只会从数据库日志中的指定点开始复制变更。它**不会**执行现有数据的初始加载。要求明确说明迁移必须复制所有现有数据以及迁移期间创建的所有新数据。AWS DMS 文档区分了仅 CDC 与 `full-load-and-cdc`；后者才是迁移现有数据并复制持续变更的选项（[Creating an AWS DMS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Tasks.Creating.html)）。

## 最终答案

**A、C、E**

en.question: A company has implemented an ordering system using an event-driven architecture. During initial testing, the system stopped processing orders. Further log analysis revealed that one order message in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue was causing an error on the backend and blocking all subsequent order messages. The visibility timeout of the queue is set to 30 seconds, and the backend processing timeout is set to 10 seconds. A solutions architect needs to analyze faulty order messages and ensure that the system continues to process subsequent messages. Which step should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the backend processing timeout to 30 seconds to match the visibility timeout.
options.B: Reduce the visibility timeout of the queue to automatically remove the faulty message.
options.C: Configure a new SQS FIFO queue as a dead-letter queue to isolate the faulty messages.
options.D: Configure a new SQS standard queue as a dead-letter queue to isolate the faulty messages.

en.explanation:
The scenario describes a poison-pill message in an Amazon SQS **standard** queue: a message repeatedly fails backend processing, becomes visible again after the visibility timeout, and disrupts processing. The requirement is both to **analyze faulty messages** and to let the system continue processing subsequent messages.

**Correct answer: D. Configure a new SQS standard queue as a dead-letter queue to isolate the faulty messages.**

Amazon SQS dead-letter queues are specifically intended for messages that cannot be processed successfully. AWS states that DLQs let you isolate unconsumed messages, examine logs, analyze message contents, diagnose application issues, and later redrive messages if needed ([Using dead-letter queues in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-dead-letter-queues.html)). The source queue can be configured with a redrive policy and `maxReceiveCount`, so after the faulty order message is received and fails enough times, SQS moves it to the DLQ instead of repeatedly returning it to the main queue.

Because the source queue in the question is an SQS **standard** queue, the DLQ must also be a **standard** queue. AWS documentation explicitly says that when configuring a DLQ, the queue type must match the source queue type: a FIFO queue can only use a FIFO DLQ, and a standard queue can only use a standard DLQ ([Configure a dead-letter queue using the Amazon SQS console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-dead-letter-queue.html)). Therefore, option D is the only valid DLQ configuration.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Increase the backend processing timeout to 30 seconds to match the visibility timeout.**  
  The failure is caused by a specific faulty message, not by insufficient processing time. Matching the backend timeout to the visibility timeout does not isolate the poison message or provide a way to analyze it. If the backend still errors, the message will continue to reappear and fail. AWS notes that if a message is not processed and deleted before the visibility timeout expires, it becomes visible again for another processing attempt ([Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)).

- **B. Reduce the visibility timeout of the queue to automatically remove the faulty message.**  
  Visibility timeout does not delete or remove messages. It only controls how long a received message is hidden from other consumers. If the message is not deleted, it becomes visible again. Reducing the visibility timeout would likely make the faulty message reappear faster, not isolate it for analysis.

- **C. Configure a new SQS FIFO queue as a dead-letter queue to isolate the faulty messages.**  
  A DLQ is the right concept, but the queue type is wrong. The existing source queue is a standard queue, and AWS requires a standard queue to use a standard DLQ, not a FIFO DLQ ([Configure a dead-letter queue using the Amazon SQS console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-dead-letter-queue.html)).

Thus, configuring a **standard SQS DLQ** for the existing standard source queue is the correct step.

zh.question: 一家公司使用事件驱动架构实现了一个订单系统。在初始测试期间，系统停止处理订单。进一步的日志分析显示，Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列中的一条订单消息导致后端出错，并阻塞了所有后续订单消息。该队列的可见性超时设置为 30 秒，后端处理超时设置为 10 秒。解决方案架构师需要分析有问题的订单消息，并确保系统继续处理后续消息。解决方案架构师应采取哪一步来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将后端处理超时增加到 30 秒，以匹配可见性超时。
options.B: 缩短队列的可见性超时，以自动移除有问题的消息。
options.C: 配置一个新的 SQS FIFO 队列作为死信队列，以隔离有问题的消息。
options.D: 配置一个新的 SQS 标准队列作为死信队列，以隔离有问题的消息。

zh.explanation:
该场景描述的是 Amazon SQS **标准**队列中的一条 poison-pill 消息：一条消息反复无法通过后端处理，在可见性超时后再次变为可见，并干扰处理流程。要求是既要**分析有问题的消息**，又要让系统继续处理后续消息。

**正确答案：D. 配置一个新的 SQS 标准队列作为死信队列，以隔离有问题的消息。**

Amazon SQS dead-letter queues 专门用于无法成功处理的消息。AWS 说明，DLQ 可让你隔离未消费的消息、检查日志、分析消息内容、诊断应用程序问题，并在需要时稍后重新驱动消息（[Using dead-letter queues in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-dead-letter-queues.html)）。可以为源队列配置重驱动策略和 `maxReceiveCount`，因此当有问题的订单消息被接收并失败足够多次后，SQS 会将其移动到 DLQ，而不是反复将其返回主队列。

由于题目中的源队列是 SQS **标准**队列，因此 DLQ 也必须是**标准**队列。AWS 文档明确说明，在配置 DLQ 时，队列类型必须与源队列类型匹配：FIFO 队列只能使用 FIFO DLQ，标准队列只能使用标准 DLQ（[Configure a dead-letter queue using the Amazon SQS console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-dead-letter-queue.html)）。因此，选项 D 是唯一有效的 DLQ 配置。

其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. 将后端处理超时增加到 30 秒，以匹配可见性超时。**  
  失败是由特定的有问题消息导致的，而不是处理时间不足导致的。将后端超时与可见性超时匹配，并不能隔离 poison 消息，也不能提供分析它的方法。如果后端仍然出错，该消息将继续重新出现并失败。AWS 指出，如果消息在可见性超时到期前未被处理并删除，它会再次变为可见，以供另一次处理尝试（[Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。

- **B. 缩短队列的可见性超时，以自动移除有问题的消息。**  
  可见性超时不会删除或移除消息。它只控制已接收的消息对其他消费者隐藏多长时间。如果消息未被删除，它会再次变为可见。缩短可见性超时很可能会让有问题的消息更快重新出现，而不是将其隔离以便分析。

- **C. 配置一个新的 SQS FIFO 队列作为死信队列，以隔离有问题的消息。**  
  DLQ 这个概念是正确的，但队列类型错误。现有源队列是标准队列，而 AWS 要求标准队列使用标准 DLQ，而不是 FIFO DLQ（[Configure a dead-letter queue using the Amazon SQS console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-dead-letter-queue.html)）。

因此，为现有标准源队列配置一个**标准 SQS DLQ**是正确步骤。

en.question: A company has automated the nightly retraining of its machine learning models by using AWS Step Functions. The workflow consists of multiple steps that use AWS Lambda. Each step can fail for various reasons, and any failure causes a failure of the overall workflow. A review reveals that the retraining has failed multiple nights in a row without the company noticing the failure. A solutions architect needs to improve the workflow so that notifications are sent for all types of failures in the retraining process. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with a subscription of type "Email" that targets the team's mailing list.
options.B: Create a task named "Email" that forwards the input arguments to the SNS topic.
options.C: Add a Catch field to all Task, Map, and Parallel states that have a statement of "ErrorEquals": [ "States.ALL" ] and "Next”: "Email".
options.D: Add a new email address to Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES). Verify the email address.
options.E: Create a task named "Email" that forwards the input arguments to the SES email address.
options.F: Add a Catch field to all Task, Map, and Parallel states that have a statement of "ErrorEquals": [ "States.Runtime" ] and "Next": "Email".

en.explanation:
The workflow is an AWS Step Functions state machine that runs multiple Lambda-based steps. The requirement is to route failures from those workflow states to an email notification mechanism so the team is alerted when nightly retraining fails.

**Correct answers: A, B, C.**

- **A. Create an SNS topic with an Email subscription to the team mailing list.** Amazon SNS supports email subscriptions to topics; the SNS documentation shows creating a subscription with **Protocol = Email** and an email endpoint, and notes that the subscription must be confirmed before messages are delivered. This is the appropriate notification target for team email alerts. See [Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html).
- **B. Create a Step Functions task named `Email` that publishes/forwards the failure input to the SNS topic.** Step Functions has an optimized SNS integration; the documentation shows a `Task` state using `Resource: "arn:aws:states:::sns:publish"` with a `TopicArn` and `Message` to publish to an SNS topic. See [Publish messages to an Amazon SNS topic with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-sns.html).
- **C. Add `Catch` handlers to the relevant states with `ErrorEquals: ["States.ALL"]` and `Next: "Email"`.** Step Functions `Task`, `Map`, and `Parallel` states can define a `Catch` field. When a state reports an error and retries do not resolve it, Step Functions transitions to the state named in the catcher's `Next` field. The reserved error name `States.ALL` is a wildcard that matches error names and is used as the catch-all fallback catcher. See [Handling errors in Step Functions workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-error-handling.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **D. Add and verify an SES email address.** Amazon SES is not required for this workflow. The native notification pattern here is SNS topic + email subscription, and Step Functions can publish directly to SNS.
- **E. Create a task that forwards input to an SES email address.** This does not match the recommended Step Functions notification integration in the choices. The documented Step Functions integration for this use case is publishing to an SNS topic, which then delivers to subscribed email endpoints.
- **F. Use `States.Runtime` in the catcher.** `States.Runtime` is a specific Step Functions runtime error, not a wildcard for all failures. The documentation describes `States.Runtime` as an execution failure caused by runtime processing issues and states that it is not retriable and will always cause the execution to fail. It would not catch the general set of Lambda task failures, timeouts, permission errors, and other state errors. `States.ALL` is the appropriate catch-all matcher among the provided options.

One nuance: the Step Functions documentation notes that `States.ALL` does not catch some terminal/runtime error types such as `States.Runtime` and `States.DataLimitExceeded`. However, within the exam's intended context of catching failures from `Task`, `Map`, and `Parallel` workflow steps and notifying through SNS, **A + B + C** is the best and intended combination.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Step Functions 自动执行其机器学习模型的夜间重新训练。该工作流由多个使用 AWS Lambda 的步骤组成。每个步骤都可能因各种原因失败，并且任何失败都会导致整个工作流失败。一次审查发现，重新训练已连续多个夜晚失败，而公司没有注意到这些失败。解决方案架构师需要改进该工作流，以便针对重新训练过程中的所有类型失败发送通知。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，并配置类型为“Email”的订阅，目标为团队的邮件列表。
options.B: 创建一个名为“Email”的任务，将输入参数转发到 SNS 主题。
options.C: 向所有 Task、Map 和 Parallel 状态添加 Catch 字段，其中包含语句“ErrorEquals”: [ “States.ALL” ] 和 “Next”: “Email”。
options.D: 向 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 添加一个新的电子邮件地址。验证该电子邮件地址。
options.E: 创建一个名为“Email”的任务，将输入参数转发到 SES 电子邮件地址。
options.F: 向所有 Task、Map 和 Parallel 状态添加 Catch 字段，其中包含语句“ErrorEquals”: [ “States.Runtime” ] 和 “Next”: “Email”。

zh.explanation:
该工作流是一个 AWS Step Functions 状态机，运行多个基于 Lambda 的步骤。要求是将这些工作流状态中的失败路由到电子邮件通知机制，以便团队在夜间重新训练失败时收到提醒。

**正确答案：A、B、C。**

- **A. 创建一个 SNS 主题，并为团队邮件列表配置 Email 订阅。** Amazon SNS 支持对主题进行电子邮件订阅；SNS 文档展示了如何创建 **Protocol = Email** 且端点为电子邮件地址的订阅，并指出在消息投递之前必须确认该订阅。这是团队电子邮件告警的合适通知目标。请参阅 [Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)。
- **B. 创建一个名为 `Email` 的 Step Functions 任务，将失败输入发布/转发到 SNS 主题。** Step Functions 具有优化的 SNS 集成；文档展示了一个 `Task` 状态，使用 `Resource: "arn:aws:states:::sns:publish"`，并通过 `TopicArn` 和 `Message` 发布到 SNS 主题。请参阅 [Publish messages to an Amazon SNS topic with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-sns.html)。
- **C. 使用 `ErrorEquals: ["States.ALL"]` 和 `Next: "Email"` 向相关状态添加 `Catch` 处理程序。** Step Functions 的 `Task`、`Map` 和 `Parallel` 状态可以定义 `Catch` 字段。当某个状态报告错误且重试无法解决时，Step Functions 会转换到捕获器的 `Next` 字段中命名的状态。保留错误名称 `States.ALL` 是一个匹配错误名称的通配符，用作捕获所有错误的后备捕获器。请参阅 [Handling errors in Step Functions workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-error-handling.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **D. 添加并验证 SES 电子邮件地址。** 此工作流不需要 Amazon SES。这里的原生通知模式是 SNS 主题 + 电子邮件订阅，并且 Step Functions 可以直接发布到 SNS。
- **E. 创建一个将输入转发到 SES 电子邮件地址的任务。** 这不符合选项中推荐的 Step Functions 通知集成。此用例有文档说明的 Step Functions 集成是发布到 SNS 主题，然后由 SNS 投递到已订阅的电子邮件端点。
- **F. 在捕获器中使用 `States.Runtime`。** `States.Runtime` 是一种特定的 Step Functions 运行时错误，不是针对所有失败的通配符。文档将 `States.Runtime` 描述为由运行时处理问题导致的执行失败，并说明它不可重试且始终会导致执行失败。它无法捕获一般的 Lambda 任务失败、超时、权限错误和其他状态错误。在给定选项中，`States.ALL` 是合适的捕获所有错误的匹配器。

一个细微之处：Step Functions 文档指出，`States.ALL` 不会捕获某些终端/运行时错误类型，例如 `States.Runtime` 和 `States.DataLimitExceeded`。但是，在本题预期的上下文中，即从 `Task`、`Map` 和 `Parallel` 工作流步骤捕获失败并通过 SNS 发送通知，**A + B + C** 是最佳且预期的组合。

en.question: A company plans to deploy a new private intranet service on Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. An AWS Site-to-Site VPN connects the VPC to the company's on-premises network. The new service must communicate with existing on-premises services. The on-premises services are accessible through the use of hostnames that reside in the company.example DNS zone. This DNS zone is wholly hosted on premises and is available only on the company's private network. A solutions architect must ensure that the new service can resolve hostnames on the company.example domain to integrate with existing services. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an empty private zone in Amazon Route 53 for company.example. Add an additional NS record to the company's on-premises company.example zone that points to the authoritative name servers for the new private zone in Route 53.
options.B: Turn on DNS hostnames for the VPC. Configure a new outbound endpoint with Amazon Route 53 Resolver. Create a Resolver rule to forward requests for company.example to the on-premises name servers.
options.C: Turn on DNS hostnames for the VPConfigure a new inbound resolver endpoint with Amazon Route 53 Resolver. Configur&the on-premises DNS server to forward requests for company.example to the new resolver.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager to configure a run document that will install a hosts file that contains any required hostnames. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the document when an instance is entering the running state.

en.explanation:
The service runs on EC2 instances in a VPC and needs to resolve names in `company.example`, a DNS zone that is hosted only on the on-premises network and reachable over the Site-to-Site VPN. Therefore, DNS queries must flow **from the VPC to the on-premises DNS resolvers** for that domain.

**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon Route 53 Resolver supports this exact hybrid DNS pattern. AWS documentation states that when you want to forward DNS queries **from EC2 instances in VPCs to your network**, you create a **Resolver outbound endpoint**, create rules for the domain names to forward, specify the IP addresses of the resolvers on your network, and associate the rules with the VPCs. This matches forwarding `company.example` queries from the VPC to the company’s on-premises name servers over the VPN ([Route 53 Resolver: forward DNS queries from VPCs to your network](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-vpc-to-network.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect.** Creating an empty Route 53 private hosted zone for `company.example` does not make the existing on-premises records available to EC2 instances. It would create an AWS-hosted private zone with no records. Adding an NS record in the on-premises zone pointing to the Route 53 private zone would delegate queries from on premises toward AWS, which is the opposite direction of the requirement. The requirement is for AWS workloads to resolve names that already exist on premises.

- **C is incorrect.** A Route 53 Resolver **inbound** endpoint is used when DNS resolvers on the on-premises network need to forward queries **to Route 53 Resolver in the VPC**. AWS documentation describes inbound endpoints as the mechanism for forwarding DNS queries from your network to Route 53 VPC Resolver ([Route 53 Resolver: forward DNS queries from your network to Resolver endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-network-to-vpc.html)). That is the reverse of this scenario.

- **D is incorrect.** Installing and maintaining hosts files through Systems Manager is not an appropriate DNS integration solution. It is operationally brittle, does not scale well, and does not dynamically reflect changes in the on-premises DNS zone. The requirement is domain resolution for an on-premises hosted DNS zone, which is better met by Route 53 Resolver forwarding rules.

Therefore, **B** is the solution that meets the requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司计划在 VPC 内的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署一项新的私有内联网服务。AWS Site-to-Site VPN 将该 VPC 连接到公司的本地网络。新服务必须与现有的本地服务通信。本地服务可通过位于 company.example DNS 区域中的主机名访问。该 DNS 区域完全托管在本地，并且仅在公司的私有网络中可用。解决方案架构师必须确保新服务可以解析 company.example 域上的主机名，以便与现有服务集成。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon Route 53 中为 company.example 创建一个空的私有区域。向公司的本地 company.example 区域添加一条额外的 NS 记录，指向 Route 53 中新私有区域的权威名称服务器。
options.B: 为 VPC 启用 DNS 主机名。使用 Amazon Route 53 Resolver 配置一个新的出站端点。创建一条 Resolver 规则，将对 company.example 的请求转发到本地名称服务器。
options.C: 为 VPC 启用 DNS 主机名。使用 Amazon Route 53 Resolver 配置一个新的入站解析器端点。配置本地 DNS 服务器，将对 company.example 的请求转发到新的解析器。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 配置一个运行文档，该文档将安装包含所有所需主机名的 hosts 文件。使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在实例进入 running 状态时运行该文档。

zh.explanation:
该服务运行在 VPC 中的 EC2 实例上，并且需要解析 `company.example` 中的名称；这是一个仅托管在本地网络上的 DNS 区域，并且可通过 Site-to-Site VPN 访问。因此，对于该域，DNS 查询必须**从 VPC 流向本地 DNS 解析器**。

**正确答案：B。**

Amazon Route 53 Resolver 支持这种典型的混合 DNS 模式。AWS 文档说明，当你想要将 DNS 查询**从 VPC 中的 EC2 实例转发到你的网络**时，需要创建一个 **Resolver 出站端点**，为要转发的域名创建规则，指定你的网络中解析器的 IP 地址，并将这些规则与 VPC 关联。这与通过 VPN 将来自 VPC 的 `company.example` 查询转发到公司的本地名称服务器相匹配（[Route 53 Resolver: forward DNS queries from VPCs to your network](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-vpc-to-network.html)）。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A 不正确。** 为 `company.example` 创建一个空的 Route 53 私有托管区域，并不会使现有的本地记录可供 EC2 实例使用。它会创建一个没有记录的 AWS 托管私有区域。在本地区域中添加指向 Route 53 私有区域的 NS 记录，会将来自本地的查询委派到 AWS，这与要求的方向相反。该要求是让 AWS 工作负载解析已存在于本地的名称。

- **C 不正确。** 当本地网络上的 DNS 解析器需要将查询**转发到 VPC 中的 Route 53 Resolver** 时，才使用 Route 53 Resolver **入站**端点。AWS 文档将入站端点描述为一种机制，用于将 DNS 查询从你的网络转发到 Route 53 VPC Resolver（[Route 53 Resolver: forward DNS queries from your network to Resolver endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-network-to-vpc.html)）。这与本场景相反。

- **D 不正确。** 通过 Systems Manager 安装和维护 hosts 文件不是合适的 DNS 集成解决方案。它在运维上很脆弱，扩展性不好，并且无法动态反映本地 DNS 区域中的更改。该要求是对本地托管 DNS 区域进行域名解析，使用 Route 53 Resolver 转发规则更能满足要求。

因此，**B** 是满足要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy applications within multiple VPCs that are all attached to a transit gateway. Each VPC that sends traffic to the public internet must send the traffic through a shared services VPC. Each subnet within a VPC uses the default VPC route table, and the traffic is routed to the transit gateway. The transit gateway uses its default route table for any VPC attachment. A security audit reveals that an Amazon EC2 instance that is deployed within a VPC can communicate with an EC2 instance that is deployed in any of the company's other VPCs. A solutions architect needs to limit the traffic between the VPCs. Each VPC must be able to communicate only with a predefined, limited set of authorized VPCs. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the network ACL of each subnet within a VPC to allow outbound traffic only to the authorized VPCs. Remove all deny rules except the default deny rule.
options.B: Update all the security groups that are used within a VPC to deny outbound traffic to security groups that are used within the unauthorized VPCs.
options.C: Create a dedicated transit gateway route table for each VPC attachment. Route traffic only to the authorized VPCs.
options.D: Update the main route table of each VPC to route traffic only to the authorized VPCs through the transit gateway.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: C

The issue is caused by the transit gateway using a shared/default routing domain for all VPC attachments. In AWS Transit Gateway, the transit gateway acts as a Regional layer-3 router, and packets from one attachment are routed to another attachment by matching the destination IP address in the transit gateway route table. AWS documentation shows that when multiple VPC CIDR blocks are propagated into the same default transit gateway route table, each attachment can route packets to the other attachments. This matches the audit finding that an EC2 instance in one VPC can communicate with EC2 instances in any other attached VPC. See [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html).

Option C is the right design: create separate transit gateway route tables and associate each VPC attachment with the appropriate route table, containing only routes to the predefined authorized VPC attachments, plus required shared-services routes. AWS states that transit gateway route tables are used to configure routing for transit gateway attachments and that you can associate a route table with a transit gateway attachment. AWS also states that you can create additional transit gateway route tables to isolate subsets of attachments, and that each attachment can be associated with one route table while routes can be propagated to one or more route tables. Therefore, dedicated transit gateway route tables per VPC attachment provide the required fine-grained, centralized control over which VPCs can communicate. See [Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html) and [How AWS Transit Gateway works: Route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Update network ACLs for each subnet

Network ACLs can allow or deny subnet-level traffic, but they are not the best mechanism for controlling transit gateway routing between many VPCs. They are stateless, evaluated at subnet boundaries, and require both inbound and outbound rule management. This would be operationally complex across multiple VPCs and subnets and would not address the actual cause: all VPC attachments sharing a transit gateway route table that permits reachability. AWS describes network ACLs as subnet-level allow/deny controls, not as the routing-control mechanism for transit gateway attachments. See [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html).

### B. Update security groups to deny outbound traffic

Security groups do not have explicit deny rules; they allow traffic based on rules, and anything not allowed is implicitly denied. The option specifically says to “deny outbound traffic,” which is not how security groups work. Security groups are also resource-level firewalls, so using them to enforce organization-wide VPC-to-VPC routing permissions would be less appropriate than controlling the routes at the transit gateway. AWS documents security groups as controlling allowed inbound and outbound traffic for associated resources. See [Control traffic to your AWS resources using security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html).

### D. Update the main route table of each VPC

VPC route tables determine whether subnet traffic is sent to the transit gateway, but once traffic reaches the transit gateway, the transit gateway route table determines the next-hop attachment. In this scenario, subnets already route traffic to the transit gateway, and the unintended VPC-to-VPC communication is caused by the transit gateway default route table knowing routes to all attached VPCs. Also, because internet-bound traffic must continue to go through the shared services VPC through the transit gateway, broad VPC routes such as a default route to the transit gateway may still be required. The correct control point is the transit gateway route table associated with each VPC attachment, not the main route table in each VPC. AWS notes that when using a transit gateway, you add routes in subnet route tables to send traffic through the transit gateway, but transit gateway route tables route traffic between attachments. See [Manage subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/WorkWithRouteTables.html) and [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 在多个 VPC 中部署应用程序，这些 VPC 都连接到一个 transit gateway。每个向公网互联网发送流量的 VPC 都必须将流量通过一个共享服务 VPC 转发。VPC 内的每个子网都使用默认 VPC 路由表，并且流量会被路由到 transit gateway。transit gateway 对任何 VPC attachment 都使用其默认路由表。一次安全审计发现，部署在某个 VPC 内的 Amazon EC2 实例可以与部署在该公司任何其他 VPC 中的 EC2 实例通信。解决方案架构师需要限制 VPC 之间的流量。每个 VPC 必须只能与预定义的、有限的一组已授权 VPC 通信。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新 VPC 内每个子网的 network ACL，仅允许到已授权 VPC 的出站流量。移除除默认拒绝规则之外的所有拒绝规则。
options.B: 更新 VPC 内使用的所有安全组，以拒绝到未授权 VPC 中使用的安全组的出站流量。
options.C: 为每个 VPC attachment 创建专用的 transit gateway 路由表。仅将流量路由到已授权的 VPC。
options.D: 更新每个 VPC 的主路由表，通过 transit gateway 仅将流量路由到已授权的 VPC。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：C

该问题是由 transit gateway 对所有 VPC attachments 使用共享/默认路由域导致的。在 AWS Transit Gateway 中，transit gateway 充当区域级第 3 层路由器，来自一个 attachment 的数据包会通过在 transit gateway 路由表中匹配目标 IP 地址，被路由到另一个 attachment。AWS 文档显示，当多个 VPC CIDR 块被传播到同一个默认 transit gateway 路由表中时，每个 attachment 都可以将数据包路由到其他 attachments。这与审计发现相符：一个 VPC 中的 EC2 实例可以与任何其他已连接 VPC 中的 EC2 实例通信。请参阅 [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html)。

选项 C 是正确的设计：创建单独的 transit gateway 路由表，并将每个 VPC attachment 与相应的路由表关联，该路由表仅包含到预定义已授权 VPC attachments 的路由，以及所需的共享服务路由。AWS 指出，transit gateway 路由表用于配置 transit gateway attachments 的路由，并且可以将路由表与 transit gateway attachment 关联。AWS 还指出，可以创建额外的 transit gateway 路由表来隔离 attachments 的子集，并且每个 attachment 可以与一个路由表关联，而路由可以传播到一个或多个路由表。因此，为每个 VPC attachment 使用专用的 transit gateway 路由表，可以提供所需的细粒度集中控制，以控制哪些 VPC 可以通信。请参阅 [Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html) 和 [How AWS Transit Gateway works: Route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html)。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 更新每个子网的 network ACLs

Network ACLs 可以允许或拒绝子网级流量，但它们不是控制多个 VPC 之间 transit gateway 路由的最佳机制。它们是无状态的，在子网边界进行评估，并且需要同时管理入站和出站规则。在多个 VPC 和子网中这样做会在运维上非常复杂，并且无法解决实际原因：所有 VPC attachments 共享一个允许可达性的 transit gateway 路由表。AWS 将 network ACLs 描述为子网级允许/拒绝控制，而不是用于 transit gateway attachments 的路由控制机制。请参阅 [Control subnet traffic with network access control lists](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)。

### B. 更新安全组以拒绝出站流量

安全组没有显式拒绝规则；它们根据规则允许流量，未被允许的任何流量都会被隐式拒绝。该选项明确说要“拒绝出站流量”，这不是安全组的工作方式。安全组也是资源级防火墙，因此用它们来强制执行组织范围的 VPC 到 VPC 路由权限，不如在 transit gateway 上控制路由合适。AWS 文档将安全组描述为控制关联资源允许的入站和出站流量。请参阅 [Control traffic to your AWS resources using security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-security-groups.html)。

### D. 更新每个 VPC 的主路由表

VPC 路由表决定子网流量是否被发送到 transit gateway，但一旦流量到达 transit gateway，就由 transit gateway 路由表决定下一跳 attachment。在此场景中，子网已经将流量路由到 transit gateway，而意外的 VPC 到 VPC 通信是由于 transit gateway 默认路由表知道到所有已连接 VPC 的路由导致的。此外，由于发往互联网的流量必须继续通过 transit gateway 经由共享服务 VPC，因此可能仍需要广泛的 VPC 路由，例如到 transit gateway 的默认路由。正确的控制点是与每个 VPC attachment 关联的 transit gateway 路由表，而不是每个 VPC 中的主路由表。AWS 指出，在使用 transit gateway 时，需要在子网路由表中添加路由以通过 transit gateway 发送流量，但 transit gateway 路由表负责在 attachments 之间路由流量。请参阅 [Manage subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/WorkWithRouteTables.html) 和 [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html)。

en.question: A company has a Windows-based desktop application that is packaged and deployed to the users' Windows machines. The company recently acquired another company that has employees who primarily use machines with a Linux operating system. The acquiring company has decided to migrate and rehost the Windows-based desktop application to AWS. All employees must be authenticated before they use the application. The acquiring company uses Active Directory on premises but wants a simplified way to manage access to the application on AWS for all the employees. Which solution will rehost the application on AWS with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Set up and provision an Amazon Workspaces virtual desktop for every employee. Implement authentication by using Amazon Cognito identity pools. Instruct employees to run the application from their provisioned Workspaces virtual desktops.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group of Windows-based Amazon EC2 instances. Join each EC2 instance to the company’s Active Directory domain. Implement authentication by using the Active Directory that is running on premises. Instruct employees to run the application by using a Windows remote desktop.
options.C: Use an Amazon AppStream 2.0 image builder to create an image that includes the application and the required configurations. Provision an AppStream 2.0 On-Demand fleet with dynamic Fleet Auto Scaling policies for running the image. Implement authentication by using AppStream 2.0 user pools. Instruct the employees to access the application by starting browser-based AppStream 2.0 streaming sessions.
options.D: Refactor and containerize the application to run as a web-based application. Run the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate with step scaling policies. Implement authentication by using Amazon Cognito user pools. Instruct the employees to run the application from their browsers.

en.explanation:
### What the question is asking

The company has an existing **Windows desktop application** and now has users on both Windows and Linux client machines. It wants to **rehost** the application on AWS with the **least development effort**, while requiring users to authenticate before accessing it.

### Correct answer: C

**C. Use an Amazon AppStream 2.0 image builder to create an image that includes the application and the required configurations. Provision an AppStream 2.0 On-Demand fleet with dynamic Fleet Auto Scaling policies for running the image. Implement authentication by using AppStream 2.0 user pools. Instruct the employees to access the application by starting browser-based AppStream 2.0 streaming sessions.**

This is the best fit because Amazon AppStream 2.0, now documented as **Amazon WorkSpaces Applications**, is designed specifically for streaming existing desktop applications from AWS without rewriting them. AWS describes it as a **fully managed application streaming service** that gives users access to desktop applications from anywhere, manages the AWS resources required to host and run the applications, and scales automatically. It also states that users can stream applications through an HTML5-capable web browser, which solves the Linux client compatibility problem without changing the Windows application itself ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-appstream.html)).

The image-builder and fleet model also matches the option precisely. AWS defines an **image builder** as a virtual machine used to install, add, and test applications and then create an image. An **image** contains the applications and default settings that users stream, and a **fleet** consists of streaming instances that run the applications or desktops specified ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-concepts.html)).

For access management, AppStream 2.0 user pools are appropriate for a simplified access model: AWS defines a **user pool** as a mechanism to manage users and their assigned stacks ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-concepts.html)). Fleet Auto Scaling is also supported for Always-On and On-Demand fleets, allowing the fleet size to adjust automatically to user demand ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/autoscaling.html)).

Therefore, option C rehosts the Windows desktop application with minimal application changes, supports browser-based access from Linux machines, provides managed streaming infrastructure, supports user authentication, and can scale based on demand.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Amazon WorkSpaces for every employee with Cognito identity pools**

Amazon WorkSpaces provides full virtual desktops, not application streaming. Provisioning a dedicated virtual desktop for every employee is heavier operationally and less targeted than streaming only the required application. Also, Cognito identity pools are primarily for granting AWS credentials to users from identity providers; they are not the natural authentication and access-management mechanism for launching a Windows desktop application in a WorkSpaces desktop environment. This option adds unnecessary desktop management overhead.

**B. Windows EC2 Auto Scaling group joined to on-premises Active Directory with RDP access**

This could technically host the application, but it is not the least-effort managed solution. The company would need to manage Windows EC2 instances, domain joining, RDP access, remote desktop user experience, scaling behavior, security hardening, patching, and application availability. It also requires Linux users to rely on RDP clients. Compared with AppStream 2.0 browser-based application streaming, this is more infrastructure-centric and operationally complex.

**D. Refactor and containerize the application for ECS on Fargate**

This is the opposite of least development effort. Refactoring a Windows desktop application into a web-based containerized application requires significant redesign and redevelopment. ECS on Fargate is appropriate for containerized services, not for simply rehosting an existing Windows desktop application for browser-based end-user access.

### Final answer

**C**

zh.question: 一家公司有一个基于 Windows 的桌面应用程序，该应用程序被打包并部署到用户的 Windows 机器上。该公司最近收购了另一家公司，后者的员工主要使用 Linux 操作系统的机器。收购方公司已决定将这个基于 Windows 的桌面应用程序迁移并重新托管到 AWS。所有员工在使用该应用程序之前都必须经过身份验证。收购方公司在本地使用 Active Directory，但希望以一种简化的方式来管理所有员工对 AWS 上该应用程序的访问。哪种解决方案能以最少的开发工作量在 AWS 上重新托管该应用程序？

options.A: 为每位员工设置并预置一个 Amazon WorkSpaces 虚拟桌面。使用 Amazon Cognito identity pools 实现身份验证。指示员工从其预置的 WorkSpaces 虚拟桌面运行该应用程序。
options.B: 创建一个由基于 Windows 的 Amazon EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling 组。将每个 EC2 实例加入公司的 Active Directory 域。使用在本地运行的 Active Directory 实现身份验证。指示员工使用 Windows 远程桌面运行该应用程序。
options.C: 使用 Amazon AppStream 2.0 image builder 创建一个包含该应用程序和所需配置的镜像。预置一个带有动态 Fleet Auto Scaling 策略的 AppStream 2.0 On-Demand fleet 来运行该镜像。使用 AppStream 2.0 user pools 实现身份验证。指示员工通过启动基于浏览器的 AppStream 2.0 流式会话来访问该应用程序。
options.D: 重构该应用程序并将其容器化，使其作为基于 Web 的应用程序运行。使用 step scaling 策略在 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中运行该应用程序。使用 Amazon Cognito user pools 实现身份验证。指示员工从其浏览器运行该应用程序。

zh.explanation:
### 题目在问什么

该公司有一个现有的 **Windows 桌面应用程序**，现在用户既有 Windows 客户端机器，也有 Linux 客户端机器。它希望以 **最少的开发工作量** 将该应用程序 **重新托管** 到 AWS，同时要求用户在访问之前进行身份验证。

### 正确答案：C

**C. 使用 Amazon AppStream 2.0 image builder 创建一个包含该应用程序和所需配置的镜像。预置一个带有动态 Fleet Auto Scaling 策略的 AppStream 2.0 On-Demand fleet 来运行该镜像。使用 AppStream 2.0 user pools 实现身份验证。指示员工通过启动基于浏览器的 AppStream 2.0 流式会话来访问该应用程序。**

这是最合适的选择，因为 Amazon AppStream 2.0（现在在文档中称为 **Amazon WorkSpaces Applications**）专门用于从 AWS 流式传输现有桌面应用程序，而无需重写这些应用程序。AWS 将其描述为一项 **完全托管的应用程序流式传输服务**，可让用户从任何位置访问桌面应用程序，管理托管和运行应用程序所需的 AWS 资源，并自动扩展。文档还指出，用户可以通过支持 HTML5 的 Web 浏览器流式传输应用程序，这解决了 Linux 客户端兼容性问题，而无需更改 Windows 应用程序本身（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-appstream.html)）。

image-builder 和 fleet 模型也与该选项完全匹配。AWS 将 **image builder** 定义为用于安装、添加和测试应用程序，然后创建镜像的虚拟机。**image** 包含用户流式传输的应用程序和默认设置，而 **fleet** 由运行指定应用程序或桌面的流式传输实例组成（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-concepts.html)）。

对于访问管理，AppStream 2.0 user pools 适合简化的访问模型：AWS 将 **user pool** 定义为一种用于管理用户及其分配的 stacks 的机制（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-concepts.html)）。Always-On 和 On-Demand fleets 也支持 Fleet Auto Scaling，允许 fleet 大小根据用户需求自动调整（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/autoscaling.html)）。

因此，选项 C 能够在最少更改应用程序的情况下重新托管 Windows 桌面应用程序，支持从 Linux 机器进行基于浏览器的访问，提供托管的流式传输基础设施，支持用户身份验证，并且可以根据需求进行扩展。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 为每位员工使用 Amazon WorkSpaces，并使用 Cognito identity pools**

Amazon WorkSpaces 提供的是完整的虚拟桌面，而不是应用程序流式传输。为每位员工预置专用虚拟桌面在运营上更重，并且不如仅流式传输所需应用程序那么有针对性。此外，Cognito identity pools 主要用于向来自身份提供商的用户授予 AWS 凭证；它们并不是在 WorkSpaces 桌面环境中启动 Windows 桌面应用程序的自然身份验证和访问管理机制。此选项增加了不必要的桌面管理开销。

**B. 加入本地 Active Directory、通过 RDP 访问的 Windows EC2 Auto Scaling 组**

这在技术上可以托管该应用程序，但不是工作量最少的托管解决方案。公司需要管理 Windows EC2 实例、域加入、RDP 访问、远程桌面用户体验、扩展行为、安全加固、补丁以及应用程序可用性。它还要求 Linux 用户依赖 RDP 客户端。与 AppStream 2.0 基于浏览器的应用程序流式传输相比，这种方案更偏向基础设施，并且运营上更复杂。

**D. 为 ECS on Fargate 重构并容器化该应用程序**

这与最少开发工作量正好相反。将 Windows 桌面应用程序重构为基于 Web 的容器化应用程序需要大量重新设计和重新开发。ECS on Fargate 适用于容器化服务，而不适用于简单地重新托管现有 Windows 桌面应用程序以供终端用户通过浏览器访问。

### 最终答案

**C**

en.question: A company is collecting a large amount of data from a fleet of IoT devices. Data is stored as Optimized Row Columnar (ORC) files in the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) on a persistent Amazon EMR cluster. The company's data analytics team queries the data by using SQL in Apache Presto deployed on the same EMR cluster. Queries scan large amounts of data, always run for less than 15 minutes, and run only between 5 PM and 10 PM. The company is concerned about the high cost associated with the current solution. A solutions architect must propose the most cost-effective solution that will allow SQL data queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query data.
options.B: Store data in Amazon S3. Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog and Amazon Athena to query data.
options.C: Store data in EMR File System (EMRFS). Use Presto in Amazon EMR to query data.
options.D: Store data in Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift to query data.

en.explanation:
The company currently keeps ORC data on HDFS in a persistent EMR cluster and runs Presto SQL queries only during a limited daily window. The key requirement is **most cost-effective SQL querying** for large data that is already in a columnar format and whose queries run for less than 15 minutes.

**Correct answer: B. Store data in Amazon S3. Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog and Amazon Athena to query data.**

Amazon Athena is the best fit because it can query data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. AWS documentation states that Athena lets you point Athena at data in S3 and run SQL queries, and that Athena SQL is **serverless**, with no infrastructure to set up or manage, and you **pay only for the queries you run** ([What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). This aligns directly with the intermittent query pattern between 5 PM and 10 PM and avoids paying for a persistent EMR or Redshift cluster outside that window.

Athena also works naturally with the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Athena can run SQL queries on data sources registered with the AWS Glue Data Catalog ([Run SQL queries in Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)). When tables are created in Athena, the schema is stored in the AWS Glue Data Catalog and the data remains in Amazon S3 for schema-on-read querying ([Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)). The existing ORC format is also supported by Athena; the supported formats table lists ORC as a supported optimized columnar format with the ORC SerDe ([Choose a SerDe for your data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/supported-serdes.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Store data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to query data.**  
  Redshift Spectrum can query data in S3, but it is not the most cost-effective fit here because it requires Redshift compute. AWS documentation states that to use Redshift Spectrum, you need an **Amazon Redshift cluster** and a SQL client connected to that cluster, and Redshift Spectrum queries incur additional charges ([Getting started with Amazon Redshift Spectrum](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c-getting-started-using-spectrum.html)). Maintaining Redshift capacity for a short daily query window is less cost-effective than serverless Athena for this use case.

- **C. Store data in EMR File System (EMRFS). Use Presto in Amazon EMR to query data.**  
  Moving data from HDFS to S3-backed EMR storage would improve durability and decouple storage from the cluster, but this option still relies on Amazon EMR and Presto. EMR/Hadoop uses file systems such as HDFS and S3A/EMRFS-style S3 access for processing cluster workloads; HDFS is tied to EMR cluster nodes and is best for intermediate data, while S3 integration lets Hadoop applications access S3 ([Working with storage and file systems with Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-file-systems.html)). However, the option still requires EMR compute to run Presto, so it does not eliminate cluster management and compute cost as effectively as Athena.

- **D. Store data in Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift to query data.**  
  Loading the data into Redshift would require a data warehouse and Redshift storage/compute. For a large IoT data lake with intermittent SQL queries, storing raw ORC data in S3 and querying serverlessly is more cost-effective than loading and maintaining the data in Redshift.

Therefore, **B** is the most cost-effective solution because it uses low-cost S3 storage, Glue Data Catalog metadata, and serverless Athena SQL with pay-per-query pricing behavior.

zh.question: 一家公司正在从一批 IoT 设备收集大量数据。数据以 Optimized Row Columnar (ORC) 文件的形式存储在一个持久性 Amazon EMR 集群上的 Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) 中。该公司的数据分析团队使用部署在同一 EMR 集群上的 Apache Presto 中的 SQL 来查询数据。查询会扫描大量数据，运行时间始终少于 15 分钟，并且仅在下午 5 点到晚上 10 点之间运行。公司担心当前解决方案相关的高成本。解决方案架构师必须提出一种最具成本效益、并且允许 SQL 数据查询的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 查询数据。
options.B: 将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Glue Data Catalog 和 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.C: 将数据存储在 EMR File System (EMRFS) 中。使用 Amazon EMR 中的 Presto 查询数据。
options.D: 将数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 中。使用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据。

zh.explanation:
该公司目前将 ORC 数据保存在持久性 EMR 集群中的 HDFS 上，并且只在每天有限的时间窗口内运行 Presto SQL 查询。关键要求是针对已经采用列式格式的大量数据进行**最具成本效益的 SQL 查询**，且查询运行时间少于 15 分钟。

**正确答案：B. 将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Glue Data Catalog 和 Amazon Athena 查询数据。**

Amazon Athena 是最合适的选择，因为它可以使用标准 SQL 直接查询 Amazon S3 中的数据。AWS 文档说明，Athena 允许你将 Athena 指向 S3 中的数据并运行 SQL 查询，并且 Athena SQL 是**无服务器**的，无需设置或管理基础设施，而且你**只需为运行的查询付费**（[什么是 Amazon Athena？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。这与下午 5 点到晚上 10 点之间的间歇性查询模式直接匹配，并避免在该时间窗口之外为持久性 EMR 或 Redshift 集群付费。

Athena 也可以自然地与 AWS Glue Data Catalog 配合使用。Athena 可以对在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中注册的数据源运行 SQL 查询（[在 Amazon Athena 中运行 SQL 查询](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)）。在 Athena 中创建表时，架构会存储在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中，而数据仍保留在 Amazon S3 中，用于 schema-on-read 查询（[在 Athena 中创建表](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。现有的 ORC 格式也受 Athena 支持；受支持格式表将 ORC 列为一种受支持的优化列式格式，并使用 ORC SerDe（[为你的数据选择 SerDe](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/supported-serdes.html)）。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. 将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 查询数据。**  
  Redshift Spectrum 可以查询 S3 中的数据，但它在这里不是最具成本效益的选择，因为它需要 Redshift 计算资源。AWS 文档说明，要使用 Redshift Spectrum，你需要一个 **Amazon Redshift 集群**以及连接到该集群的 SQL 客户端，并且 Redshift Spectrum 查询会产生额外费用（[Amazon Redshift Spectrum 入门](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c-getting-started-using-spectrum.html)）。对于短暂的每日查询窗口，维护 Redshift 容量不如在此用例中使用无服务器 Athena 具有成本效益。

- **C. 将数据存储在 EMR File System (EMRFS) 中。使用 Amazon EMR 中的 Presto 查询数据。**  
  将数据从 HDFS 移至 S3 支持的 EMR 存储会提高持久性，并将存储与集群解耦，但该选项仍依赖 Amazon EMR 和 Presto。EMR/Hadoop 使用 HDFS 和 S3A/EMRFS 风格的 S3 访问等文件系统来处理集群工作负载；HDFS 绑定到 EMR 集群节点，最适合中间数据，而 S3 集成则允许 Hadoop 应用程序访问 S3（[使用 Amazon EMR 处理存储和文件系统](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-file-systems.html)）。但是，该选项仍然需要 EMR 计算资源来运行 Presto，因此它不像 Athena 那样有效地消除集群管理和计算成本。

- **D. 将数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 中。使用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据。**  
  将数据加载到 Redshift 中需要数据仓库以及 Redshift 存储/计算资源。对于具有间歇性 SQL 查询的大型 IoT 数据湖，将原始 ORC 数据存储在 S3 中并以无服务器方式查询，比将数据加载并维护在 Redshift 中更具成本效益。

因此，**B** 是最具成本效益的解决方案，因为它使用低成本的 S3 存储、Glue Data Catalog 元数据以及按查询付费定价模式的无服务器 Athena SQL。

en.question: A large company recently experienced an unexpected increase in Amazon RDS and Amazon DynamoDB costs. The company needs to increase visibility into details of AWS Billing and Cost Management. There are various accounts associated with AWS Organizations, including many development and production accounts. There is no consistent tagging strategy across the organization, but there are guidelines in place that require all infrastructure to be deployed using AWS CloudFormation with consistent tagging. Management requires cost center numbers and project ID numbers for all existing and future DynamoDB tables and RDS instances. Which strategy should the solutions architect provide to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Tag Editor to tag existing resources. Create cost allocation tags to define the cost center and project ID and allow 24 hours for tags to propagate to existing resources.
options.B: Use an AWS Config rule to alert the finance team of untagged resources. Create a centralized AWS Lambda based solution to tag untagged RDS databases and DynamoDB resources every hour using a cross-account role.
options.C: Use Tag Editor to tag existing resources. Create cost allocation tags to define the cost center and project ID. Use SCPs to restrict resource creation that do not have the cost center and project ID on the resource.
options.D: Create cost allocation tags to define the cost center and project ID and allow 24 hours for tags to propagate to existing resources. Update existing federated roles to restrict privileges to provision resources that do not include the cost center and project ID on the resource.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has many AWS Organizations accounts and needs better cost visibility for Amazon RDS and Amazon DynamoDB by ensuring **cost center** and **project ID** tags exist on both:

1. **Existing** RDS instances and DynamoDB tables
2. **Future** RDS instances and DynamoDB tables

The tags also need to be usable for AWS Billing and Cost Management cost reporting.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Use Tag Editor to tag existing resources. Create cost allocation tags to define the cost center and project ID. Use SCPs to restrict resource creation that do not have the cost center and project ID on the resource.**

This option addresses both parts of the requirement:

- **Existing resources:** AWS Billing documentation states that tags can be used to organize resources and that **cost allocation tags** are used to track AWS costs at a detailed level after activation. The same documentation notes that to create and update tags, you can use **AWS Tag Editor**. It also states that cost allocation tags must be activated before they appear in Cost Explorer or cost allocation reports, and that tags can take up to 24 hours to appear in Billing and Cost Management. See [Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html).
- **Future resources:** AWS Organizations **service control policies (SCPs)** define the maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts. SCPs can therefore be used as organization-wide guardrails to deny creation actions when required request tags are missing. AWS IAM global condition keys include `aws:RequestTag/tag-key`, which can compare tag key-value pairs passed in the request, and `aws:TagKeys`, which can compare the tag keys included in a request. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) and [AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html).

Therefore, option C is the best strategy because it remediates existing resources and prevents noncompliant future resource creation across the organization.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

Tag Editor plus cost allocation tags helps with **existing resources** and cost reporting, but it does **not prevent future untagged RDS instances or DynamoDB tables** from being created. The requirement explicitly applies to both existing and future resources.

### B. Incorrect

An AWS Config rule can detect or alert on untagged resources, and a Lambda function could attempt remediation. However, this is reactive, operationally more complex, and does not prevent noncompliant resources from being created in the first place. The requirement is better met with preventive organization-wide guardrails using SCPs.

### D. Incorrect

Creating cost allocation tags and updating federated roles is incomplete and less scalable. It only affects the specific roles that are updated and might not cover all principals, accounts, automation paths, or future accounts in AWS Organizations. SCPs are the appropriate centralized control because they apply maximum permission guardrails to IAM users and roles in member accounts under the organization hierarchy.

zh.question: 一家大型公司最近发现 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon DynamoDB 成本意外增加。该公司需要提高对 AWS Billing and Cost Management 详细信息的可见性。AWS Organizations 下关联了多个账户，包括许多开发账户和生产账户。整个组织没有一致的标签策略，但已有指导原则要求所有基础设施都必须使用带有一致标签的 AWS CloudFormation 进行部署。管理层要求所有现有和未来的 DynamoDB 表以及 RDS 实例都必须具有成本中心编号和项目 ID 编号。解决方案架构师应提供哪种策略来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Tag Editor 为现有资源添加标签。创建成本分配标签以定义成本中心和项目 ID，并等待 24 小时让标签传播到现有资源。
options.B: 使用 AWS Config 规则提醒财务团队存在未加标签的资源。创建一个基于集中式 AWS Lambda 的解决方案，使用跨账户角色每小时为未加标签的 RDS 数据库和 DynamoDB 资源添加标签。
options.C: 使用 Tag Editor 为现有资源添加标签。创建成本分配标签以定义成本中心和项目 ID。使用 SCPs 限制创建资源上没有成本中心和项目 ID 的资源。
options.D: 创建成本分配标签以定义成本中心和项目 ID，并等待 24 小时让标签传播到现有资源。更新现有联合身份角色，以限制其预置资源上不包含成本中心和项目 ID 的资源的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司有许多 AWS Organizations 账户，并且需要通过确保 **成本中心** 和 **项目 ID** 标签同时存在于以下两类资源上，来提高 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon DynamoDB 的成本可见性：

1. **现有** RDS 实例和 DynamoDB 表
2. **未来** RDS 实例和 DynamoDB 表

这些标签还需要可用于 AWS Billing and Cost Management 成本报告。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 使用 Tag Editor 为现有资源添加标签。创建成本分配标签以定义成本中心和项目 ID。使用 SCPs 限制创建资源上没有成本中心和项目 ID 的资源。**

此选项解决了要求的两个部分：

- **现有资源：** AWS Billing 文档指出，标签可用于组织资源，并且 **成本分配标签** 在激活后可用于以详细级别跟踪 AWS 成本。同一文档还指出，要创建和更新标签，可以使用 **AWS Tag Editor**。它还说明，成本分配标签必须先激活，才会显示在 Cost Explorer 或成本分配报告中，并且标签最多可能需要 24 小时才会显示在 Billing and Cost Management 中。请参阅 [Organizing and tracking costs using AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)。
- **未来资源：** AWS Organizations **service control policies (SCPs)** 定义成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可用的最大权限。因此，SCPs 可用作组织范围的护栏，在缺少必需请求标签时拒绝创建操作。AWS IAM 全局条件键包括 `aws:RequestTag/tag-key`，它可以比较请求中传递的标签键值对，以及 `aws:TagKeys`，它可以比较请求中包含的标签键。请参阅 [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 和 [AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)。

因此，选项 C 是最佳策略，因为它可以修复现有资源，并防止在整个组织中创建不合规的未来资源。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 不正确

Tag Editor 加成本分配标签有助于处理 **现有资源** 和成本报告，但它**无法防止未来创建未加标签的 RDS 实例或 DynamoDB 表**。要求明确适用于现有资源和未来资源。

### B. 不正确

AWS Config 规则可以检测未加标签的资源或发出提醒，Lambda 函数也可以尝试修复。但是，这是一种被动方式，运维复杂度更高，而且无法从一开始就阻止不合规资源的创建。使用 SCPs 的预防性组织范围护栏可以更好地满足该要求。

### D. 不正确

创建成本分配标签并更新联合身份角色是不完整且可扩展性较差的做法。它只影响被更新的特定角色，可能无法覆盖 AWS Organizations 中的所有主体、账户、自动化路径或未来账户。SCPs 是适当的集中式控制方式，因为它们会向组织层级下成员账户中的 IAM 用户和角色应用最大权限护栏。

en.question: A company wants to send data from its on-premises systems to Amazon S3 buckets. The company created the S3 buckets in three different accounts. The company must send the data privately without the data traveling across the internet. The company has no existing dedicated connectivity to AWS. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Establish a networking account in the AWS Cloud. Create a private VPC in the networking account. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection with a private VIF between the on-premises environment and the private VPC.
options.B: Establish a networking account in the AWS Cloud. Create a private VPC in the networking account. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection with a public VIF between the on-premises environment and the private VPC.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 interface endpoint in the networking account.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint in the networking account.
options.E: Establish a networking account in the AWS Cloud. Create a private VPC in the networking account. Peer VPCs from the accounts that host the S3 buckets with the VPC in the network account.

en.explanation:
The company needs a new private hybrid path from on-premises systems to Amazon S3 buckets that exist in three different AWS accounts. Because S3 is not deployed inside the bucket-owning accounts' VPCs, the key is to provide private on-premises connectivity into AWS and then use an S3 endpoint type that supports access from on premises.

Correct answers: **A and C**.

- **A. Establish a networking account, create a private VPC, and set up Direct Connect with a private VIF to that VPC.**  
  This provides dedicated private connectivity from the on-premises environment into a VPC. AWS Direct Connect documentation states that a **private virtual interface** is used to access an Amazon VPC using private IP addresses, whereas a public VIF is for AWS public services using public IP addresses ([AWS Direct Connect virtual interface types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). This networking VPC can host the private S3 access point for the on-premises systems.

- **C. Create an Amazon S3 interface endpoint in the networking account.**  
  Amazon S3 supports both gateway endpoints and interface endpoints. AWS documentation states that S3 **interface endpoints** use private IP addresses to route requests to S3 from within a VPC, **on premises**, or from another Region by using VPC peering or Transit Gateway. The same comparison table states that S3 gateway endpoints **do not allow access from on premises**, while interface endpoints do ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). The documentation also describes on-premises applications reaching the S3 interface endpoint through Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN, with AWS PrivateLink moving traffic from the endpoint to S3 over the AWS network.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect.** A Direct Connect **public VIF** is used to access AWS public services using public IP addresses, not to connect to a private VPC. The option's wording says to set up a public VIF "between the on-premises environment and the private VPC," which does not match how Direct Connect VIFs are defined. The required design is private connectivity into the VPC where the S3 interface endpoint resides, which calls for a private VIF.

- **D is incorrect.** An S3 gateway endpoint is for access to S3 from within a VPC over the AWS network, but AWS specifically distinguishes gateway endpoints from interface endpoints by stating that gateway endpoints **do not allow access from on premises**. Since the source systems are on premises, a gateway endpoint alone in the networking account will not meet the requirement.

- **E is incorrect.** VPC peering to accounts that host the buckets does not solve the problem because S3 buckets are regional AWS service resources, not resources inside those accounts' VPCs. Peering bucket-owner VPCs to a networking VPC would not create private access to S3. The appropriate construct for private on-premises S3 access is an S3 interface endpoint in the networking VPC, reached over Direct Connect.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地系统中的数据发送到 Amazon S3 存储桶。该公司在三个不同的账户中创建了这些 S3 存储桶。公司必须以私有方式发送数据，且数据不能经过互联网。该公司目前没有与 AWS 的现有专用连接。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 AWS Cloud 中建立一个网络账户。在该网络账户中创建一个私有 VPC。在本地环境和该私有 VPC 之间设置带有 private VIF 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
options.B: 在 AWS Cloud 中建立一个网络账户。在该网络账户中创建一个私有 VPC。在本地环境和该私有 VPC 之间设置带有 public VIF 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
options.C: 在网络账户中创建一个 Amazon S3 interface endpoint。
options.D: 在网络账户中创建一个 Amazon S3 gateway endpoint。
options.E: 在 AWS Cloud 中建立一个网络账户。在该网络账户中创建一个私有 VPC。将托管 S3 存储桶的账户中的 VPC 与网络账户中的 VPC 建立对等连接。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一条新的私有混合路径，从本地系统连接到位于三个不同 AWS 账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。由于 S3 并不部署在存储桶所属账户的 VPC 内，关键是提供从本地到 AWS 的私有连接，然后使用一种支持从本地访问的 S3 endpoint 类型。

正确答案：**A 和 C**。

- **A. 建立一个网络账户，创建一个私有 VPC，并设置到该 VPC 的带有 private VIF 的 Direct Connect。**  
  这提供了从本地环境到 VPC 的专用私有连接。AWS Direct Connect 文档说明，**private virtual interface** 用于使用私有 IP 地址访问 Amazon VPC，而 public VIF 用于使用公有 IP 地址访问 AWS 公共服务（[AWS Direct Connect virtual interface types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。此网络 VPC 可以为本地系统托管私有 S3 访问点。

- **C. 在网络账户中创建一个 Amazon S3 interface endpoint。**  
  Amazon S3 同时支持 gateway endpoints 和 interface endpoints。AWS 文档说明，S3 **interface endpoints** 使用私有 IP 地址从 VPC 内部、**本地**，或通过 VPC peering 或 Transit Gateway 从另一个区域将请求路由到 S3。同一张对比表说明，S3 gateway endpoints **不允许从本地访问**，而 interface endpoints 允许（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。该文档还描述了本地应用程序通过 Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN 到达 S3 interface endpoint，并由 AWS PrivateLink 通过 AWS 网络将流量从 endpoint 传送到 S3。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确。** Direct Connect **public VIF** 用于使用公有 IP 地址访问 AWS 公共服务，而不是连接到私有 VPC。该选项的措辞是“在本地环境和私有 VPC 之间”设置 public VIF，这与 Direct Connect VIF 的定义方式不符。所需设计是私有连接到 S3 interface endpoint 所在的 VPC，这需要 private VIF。

- **D 不正确。** S3 gateway endpoint 用于从 VPC 内部通过 AWS 网络访问 S3，但 AWS 明确区分 gateway endpoints 与 interface endpoints，并指出 gateway endpoints **不允许从本地访问**。由于源系统位于本地，仅在网络账户中使用 gateway endpoint 无法满足要求。

- **E 不正确。** 与托管存储桶的账户进行 VPC peering 无法解决问题，因为 S3 存储桶是区域性 AWS 服务资源，而不是这些账户 VPC 内的资源。将存储桶所有者的 VPC 与网络 VPC 对等连接不会创建对 S3 的私有访问。用于从本地私有访问 S3 的适当构造，是网络 VPC 中的 S3 interface endpoint，并通过 Direct Connect 访问它。

en.question: A company operates quick-service restaurants. The restaurants follow a predictable model with high sales traffic for 4 hours daily. Sales traffic is lower outside of those peak hours. The point of sale and management platform is deployed in the AWS Cloud and has a backend that is based on Amazon DynamoDB. The database table uses provisioned throughput mode with 100,000 RCUs and 80,000 WCUs to match known peak resource consumption. The company wants to reduce its DynamoDB cost and minimize the operational overhead for the IT staff. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Reduce the provisioned RCUs and WCUs.
options.B: Change the DynamoDB table to use on-demand capacity.
options.C: Enable Dynamo DB auto scaling for the table.
options.D: Purchase 1-year reserved capacity that is sufficient to cover the peak load for 4 hours each day.

en.explanation:
The workload has a **predictable daily traffic pattern**: 4 hours of high point-of-sale activity and lower activity during the remaining hours. The table is currently in **provisioned throughput mode** sized for peak usage all day, so the company pays for a large amount of unused capacity during off-peak hours. The requirement is to reduce cost while minimizing operational overhead.

**Correct answer: C. Enable DynamoDB auto scaling for the table.**

DynamoDB auto scaling is designed for this exact situation in provisioned mode. AWS documentation states that auto scaling manages provisioned throughput by letting you define minimum and maximum RCUs/WCUs and a target utilization, and it adjusts capacity as workload increases or decreases. When workload decreases, auto scaling can decrease throughput so that you do not pay for unused provisioned capacity ([DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode - auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html)). The auto scaling process uses CloudWatch metrics and Application Auto Scaling to dynamically increase or decrease provisioned throughput toward the target utilization ([Managing throughput capacity automatically with DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)).

This is more cost-effective than leaving the table at 100,000 RCUs and 80,000 WCUs for 24 hours, because capacity can scale down outside the 4-hour peak. It also minimizes operational overhead because IT staff do not need to manually adjust capacity every day.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Reduce the provisioned RCUs and WCUs.**  
This might reduce cost, but it risks throttling during the known 4-hour peak unless staff manually raise capacity before the peak and lower it afterward. Manual changes increase operational overhead and do not provide an automated cost-optimization mechanism.

**B. Change the DynamoDB table to use on-demand capacity.**  
On-demand mode simplifies capacity management and charges per request; AWS documentation says it removes the need to specify expected read/write throughput and handles throughput management automatically ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)). However, the question emphasizes **predictable** traffic with known peak capacity. AWS documentation says provisioned mode is suitable when you can reliably forecast capacity requirements, and provisioned mode with auto scaling can reduce unused capacity during low-traffic periods. For a predictable daily pattern with large known peak capacity, provisioned auto scaling is typically the more cost-effective choice than on-demand pricing.

**D. Purchase 1-year reserved capacity that is sufficient to cover the peak load for 4 hours each day.**  
Reserved capacity can provide discounts for provisioned capacity, but it is an agreement to pay for a minimum amount of provisioned throughput for the full term. AWS states that you pay for the entire committed provisioned usage regardless of actual usage ([DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)). Buying reserved capacity for the full peak load would commit the company to paying for peak capacity even during the 20 lower-traffic hours each day, so it does not best address the off-peak waste described in the scenario.

Therefore, **DynamoDB auto scaling** best matches the predictable demand pattern while reducing unused provisioned capacity and minimizing staff effort.

zh.question: 一家公司运营快餐店。这些餐厅遵循可预测的模式，每天有 4 小时的销售高峰流量。在这些高峰时段之外，销售流量较低。销售点和管理平台部署在 AWS Cloud 中，其后端基于 Amazon DynamoDB。数据库表使用预置吞吐量模式，并配置了 100,000 个 RCU 和 80,000 个 WCU，以匹配已知的峰值资源消耗。公司希望降低 DynamoDB 成本，并尽量减少 IT 员工的运维开销。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些要求？

options.A: 减少预置的 RCU 和 WCU。
options.B: 将 DynamoDB 表改为使用按需容量。
options.C: 为该表启用 DynamoDB auto scaling。
options.D: 购买足以覆盖每天 4 小时峰值负载的 1 年期预留容量。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载具有**可预测的每日流量模式**：4 小时的高销售点活动，其余时间活动较低。该表当前处于**预置吞吐量模式**，并按全天峰值使用量配置容量，因此公司在非高峰时段为大量未使用的容量付费。要求是在尽量减少运维开销的同时降低成本。

**正确答案：C. 为该表启用 DynamoDB auto scaling。**

DynamoDB auto scaling 正是为预置模式中的这种情况而设计的。AWS 文档说明，auto scaling 通过允许你定义最小和最大 RCU/WCU 以及目标利用率来管理预置吞吐量，并会随着工作负载增加或减少来调整容量。当工作负载下降时，auto scaling 可以降低吞吐量，使你无需为未使用的预置容量付费（[DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode - auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html)）。auto scaling 过程使用 CloudWatch 指标和 Application Auto Scaling，动态增加或减少预置吞吐量，使其趋近目标利用率（[Managing throughput capacity automatically with DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)）。

这比将表在 24 小时内都保持在 100,000 个 RCU 和 80,000 个 WCU 更具成本效益，因为容量可以在 4 小时峰值之外缩减。它还可以最大限度减少运维开销，因为 IT 员工无需每天手动调整容量。

### 其他选项为什么不正确

**A. 减少预置的 RCU 和 WCU。**  
这可能会降低成本，但除非员工在高峰前手动提高容量并在之后降低容量，否则会在已知的 4 小时峰值期间带来 throttling 风险。手动更改会增加运维开销，并且无法提供自动化的成本优化机制。

**B. 将 DynamoDB 表改为使用按需容量。**  
On-demand mode 简化了容量管理并按请求收费；AWS 文档称，它无需指定预期的读取/写入吞吐量，并会自动处理吞吐量管理（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)）。但是，题目强调的是具有已知峰值容量的**可预测**流量。AWS 文档说明，当你可以可靠预测容量需求时，provisioned mode 是合适的，并且带有 auto scaling 的 provisioned mode 可以在低流量时段减少未使用容量。对于具有大型已知峰值容量的可预测每日模式，provisioned auto scaling 通常比 on-demand pricing 更具成本效益。

**D. 购买足以覆盖每天 4 小时峰值负载的 1 年期预留容量。**  
Reserved capacity 可以为预置容量提供折扣，但它是一项为整个期限内的最低预置吞吐量付费的协议。AWS 表示，无论实际使用量如何，你都需要为全部承诺的预置使用量付费（[DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)）。为完整峰值负载购买预留容量，会使公司即使在每天 20 个较低流量小时内也承诺为峰值容量付费，因此它不能最好地解决该场景中描述的非高峰浪费问题。

因此，**DynamoDB auto scaling** 最符合可预测的需求模式，同时减少未使用的预置容量并最大限度降低员工工作量。

en.question: A company hosts a blog post application on AWS using Amazon API Gateway, Amazon DynamoDB, and AWS Lambda. The application currently does not use API keys to authorize requests. The API model is as follows: GET /posts/{postId}: to get post details GET /users/{userId}: to get user details GET /comments/{commentId}: to get comments details The company has noticed users are actively discussing topics in the comments section, and the company wants to increase user engagement by making the comments appear in real time. Which design should be used to reduce comment latency and improve user experience?

options.A: Use edge-optimized API with Amazon CloudFront to cache API responses.
options.B: Modify the blog application code to request GET/comments/{commentId} every 10 seconds.
options.C: Use AWS AppSync and leverage WebSockets to deliver comments.
options.D: Change the concurrency limit of the Lambda functions to lower the API response time.

en.explanation:
The application currently exposes REST-style `GET` APIs for posts, users, and comments. The requirement is not just to reduce backend response latency for a single request; it is to make newly posted comments appear **in real time** to improve engagement. That requires a server-to-client push pattern, not periodic polling or cached `GET` responses.

**Correct answer: C. Use AWS AppSync and leverage WebSockets to deliver comments.**

AWS AppSync supports real-time application updates through GraphQL subscriptions. When clients invoke subscription operations, AWS AppSync automatically establishes and maintains a secure WebSocket connection, and applications can distribute data in real time to subscribers while AppSync manages connection and scaling requirements.
