The AWS AppSync documentation also states that client libraries use pure WebSockets as the network protocol between the client and service. This matches the comments use case: clients subscribe to comment events for a post, and new comments are pushed immediately rather than waiting for another `GET /comments/{commentId}` call. See [Using subscriptions for real-time data applications in AWS AppSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appsync/latest/devguide/aws-appsync-real-time-data.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Use edge-optimized API with Amazon CloudFront to cache API responses.** Caching can improve performance for repeated `GET` requests, but it does not provide real-time delivery of newly created comments. API Gateway caching is specifically about caching API responses for methods such as `GET`; the documentation notes that enabling stage caching turns on method-level caching for `GET` methods. Cached responses can even make dynamic comment data stale unless carefully invalidated. See [Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html).

- **B. Modify the blog application code to request `GET /comments/{commentId}` every 10 seconds.** This is polling. It may reduce the average time before a client notices a new comment compared with manual refresh, but it is not real time and still has up to 10 seconds of delay. It also increases unnecessary API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB traffic when there are no new comments.

- **D. Change the concurrency limit of the Lambda functions to lower the API response time.** Lambda reserved concurrency controls how many concurrent executions are reserved for a function and affects the concurrency pool available to other functions. It is useful for preventing throttling or isolating capacity, but it does not change the communication model from request/response to real-time push. The documentation describes reserving concurrency units and notes that setting reserved concurrency to 0 intentionally throttles the function. See [Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html).

Therefore, AppSync subscriptions over WebSockets are the best fit for real-time comments.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上使用 Amazon API Gateway、Amazon DynamoDB 和 AWS Lambda 托管一个博客文章应用程序。该应用程序目前不使用 API 密钥来授权请求。API 模型如下：GET /posts/{postId}：获取文章详细信息 GET /users/{userId}：获取用户详细信息 GET /comments/{commentId}：获取评论详细信息。公司注意到用户正在评论区积极讨论话题，公司希望通过让评论实时显示来提高用户参与度。应使用哪种设计来降低评论延迟并改善用户体验？

options.A: 使用 edge-optimized API 和 Amazon CloudFront 来缓存 API 响应。
options.B: 修改博客应用程序代码，每 10 秒请求一次 GET/comments/{commentId}。
options.C: 使用 AWS AppSync，并利用 WebSockets 来传递评论。
options.D: 更改 Lambda 函数的并发限制，以降低 API 响应时间。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序目前为文章、用户和评论公开 REST 风格的 `GET` API。需求不仅仅是降低单个请求的后端响应延迟；而是要让新发布的评论**实时**显示，以提高参与度。这需要服务器到客户端的推送模式，而不是定期轮询或缓存的 `GET` 响应。

**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS AppSync，并利用 WebSockets 来传递评论。**

AWS AppSync 通过 GraphQL subscriptions 支持实时应用程序更新。当客户端调用 subscription 操作时，AWS AppSync 会自动建立并维护安全的 WebSocket 连接，应用程序可以向订阅者实时分发数据，同时由 AppSync 管理连接和扩展要求。AWS AppSync 文档还指出，客户端库使用纯 WebSockets 作为客户端与服务之间的网络协议。这与评论用例相匹配：客户端订阅某篇文章的评论事件，新评论会立即被推送，而不是等待另一次 `GET /comments/{commentId}` 调用。请参阅 [Using subscriptions for real-time data applications in AWS AppSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appsync/latest/devguide/aws-appsync-real-time-data.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用 edge-optimized API 和 Amazon CloudFront 来缓存 API 响应。** 缓存可以提高重复 `GET` 请求的性能，但它不能提供新创建评论的实时传递。API Gateway 缓存专门用于缓存 `GET` 等方法的 API 响应；文档指出，启用阶段缓存会为 `GET` 方法开启方法级缓存。缓存的响应甚至可能使动态评论数据过期，除非进行谨慎的失效处理。请参阅 [Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)。

- **B. 修改博客应用程序代码，每 10 秒请求一次 `GET /comments/{commentId}`。** 这是轮询。与手动刷新相比，它可能会缩短客户端发现新评论的平均时间，但它不是实时的，并且仍然最多有 10 秒的延迟。当没有新评论时，它还会增加不必要的 API Gateway、Lambda 和 DynamoDB 流量。

- **D. 更改 Lambda 函数的并发限制，以降低 API 响应时间。** Lambda reserved concurrency 控制为某个函数预留多少并发执行，并影响其他函数可用的并发池。它有助于防止节流或隔离容量，但它不会将通信模型从请求/响应更改为实时推送。文档描述了预留并发单位，并指出将 reserved concurrency 设置为 0 会故意节流该函数。请参阅 [Configuring reserved concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)。

因此，通过 WebSockets 使用 AppSync subscriptions 最适合实时评论。

en.question: A company manages hundreds of AWS accounts centrally in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company recently started to allow product teams to create and manage their own S3 access points in their accounts. The S3 access points can be accessed only within VPCs, not on the internet. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to enforce this requirement?

options.A: Set the S3 access point resource policy to deny the s3:CreateAccessPoint action unless the s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin condition key evaluates to VPC.
options.B: Create an SCP at the root level in the organization to deny the s3:CreateAccessPoint action unless the s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin condition key evaluates to VPC.
options.C: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to create a new IAM policy in each AWS account that allows the s3:CreateAccessPoint action only if the s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin condition key evaluates to VPC.
options.D: Set the S3 bucket policy to deny the s3:CreateAccessPoint action unless the s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin condition key evaluates to VPC.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has **hundreds of AWS accounts** in AWS Organizations. Product teams are allowed to create their own Amazon S3 access points, but the company must ensure that those access points are **VPC-only**, not internet-accessible.

S3 access points have a **NetworkOrigin** of either `Internet` or `VPC`. AWS documentation states that an access point with network origin `VPC` rejects requests that do not originate from the specified VPC, and that the network origin can be specified **only when the access point is created**; it cannot be changed later ([Creating access points restricted to a virtual private cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)). Therefore, the control must prevent creation of access points whose network origin is not `VPC`.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Create an SCP at the root level in the organization to deny the `s3:CreateAccessPoint` action unless the `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` condition key evaluates to VPC.**

This is the most operationally efficient solution because:

* The organization has **hundreds of accounts**, so a central organization-level guardrail is preferred over per-account or per-resource configuration.
* AWS Organizations service control policies set the **maximum available permissions** for IAM users and roles in member accounts. If an SCP explicitly denies an action at a parent level, users and roles in affected accounts cannot perform that action even if their IAM policies otherwise allow it ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).
* The Amazon S3 authorization reference lists `s3:CreateAccessPoint` as the action for creating an access point and shows that the `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` condition key is available for that action ([Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazons3.html)).

A deny SCP such as the following pattern would enforce the requirement centrally:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": "s3:CreateAccessPoint",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {
      "s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin": "VPC"
    }
  }
}
```

Attached at the organization root, this applies as a guardrail across member accounts, making it the most operationally efficient choice.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Set the S3 access point resource policy to deny `s3:CreateAccessPoint` unless the condition key evaluates to VPC

An access point policy is a resource-based policy attached to an access point and is evaluated for requests made through or against that access point. But the requirement is to control **creation** of access points across hundreds of accounts. The access point does not yet exist before `CreateAccessPoint` succeeds, so relying on each access point's own resource policy is not a practical or centralized way to prevent non-VPC access points from being created. AWS also notes that the network origin is selected during creation and cannot be changed later ([Creating access points restricted to a virtual private cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)).

### C. Use CloudFormation StackSets to create an IAM policy in each account

This is less operationally efficient than a single SCP at the organization root. It requires deploying and maintaining IAM policies in every account. Also, an identity-based policy that allows `s3:CreateAccessPoint` only under certain conditions does not necessarily prevent another identity policy in the account from granting broader permissions unless all identities and permissions are tightly controlled. An SCP is the correct organization-wide maximum-permissions guardrail.

### D. Set the S3 bucket policy to deny `s3:CreateAccessPoint` unless the condition key evaluates to VPC

A bucket policy is attached to an S3 bucket and controls access to that bucket. The action being governed here is creation of an **access point**, and the S3 authorization reference identifies `s3:CreateAccessPoint` with the access point resource type and the `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` condition key ([Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazons3.html)). A bucket policy would not be the most efficient or reliable organization-wide mechanism across hundreds of accounts and buckets.

## Final answer

**B** is correct: use a root-level AWS Organizations SCP to deny creation of S3 access points unless `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` is `VPC`.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中集中管理数百个 AWS 账户。该公司最近开始允许产品团队在其账户中创建和管理自己的 S3 接入点。这些 S3 接入点只能在 VPC 内访问，不能通过互联网访问。强制实施此要求的最具运营效率的方式是什么？

options.A: 将 S3 接入点资源策略设置为拒绝 s3:CreateAccessPoint 操作，除非 s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin 条件键的求值结果为 VPC。
options.B: 在组织的根级别创建一个 SCP，用于拒绝 s3:CreateAccessPoint 操作，除非 s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin 条件键的求值结果为 VPC。
options.C: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 在每个 AWS 账户中创建一个新的 IAM 策略，该策略仅在 s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin 条件键的求值结果为 VPC 时才允许 s3:CreateAccessPoint 操作。
options.D: 将 S3 存储桶策略设置为拒绝 s3:CreateAccessPoint 操作，除非 s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin 条件键的求值结果为 VPC。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司在 AWS Organizations 中拥有**数百个 AWS 账户**。产品团队被允许创建自己的 Amazon S3 接入点，但公司必须确保这些接入点是**仅 VPC**，而不是可通过互联网访问。

S3 接入点具有 `Internet` 或 `VPC` 两种 **NetworkOrigin**。AWS 文档说明，网络来源为 `VPC` 的接入点会拒绝并非来自指定 VPC 的请求，并且网络来源**只能在创建接入点时**指定；之后无法更改（[创建限制为虚拟私有云的接入点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)）。因此，控制措施必须阻止创建网络来源不是 `VPC` 的接入点。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 在组织的根级别创建一个 SCP，用于拒绝 `s3:CreateAccessPoint` 操作，除非 `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` 条件键的求值结果为 VPC。**

这是最具运营效率的解决方案，因为：

* 该组织有**数百个账户**，因此相比逐账户或逐资源配置，更应采用集中式组织级防护栏。
* AWS Organizations 服务控制策略为成员账户中的 IAM 用户和角色设置**最大可用权限**。如果 SCP 在父级别显式拒绝某个操作，则受影响账户中的用户和角色无法执行该操作，即使其 IAM 策略另有允许也是如此（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。
* Amazon S3 授权参考将 `s3:CreateAccessPoint` 列为创建接入点的操作，并显示 `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` 条件键可用于该操作（[Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazons3.html)）。

如下模式的拒绝 SCP 可以集中强制执行该要求：

```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": "s3:CreateAccessPoint",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringNotEquals": {
      "s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin": "VPC"
    }
  }
}
```

附加到组织根时，这会作为防护栏应用于所有成员账户，使其成为最具运营效率的选择。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 将 S3 接入点资源策略设置为拒绝 `s3:CreateAccessPoint`，除非条件键求值结果为 VPC

接入点策略是附加到接入点的基于资源的策略，并会针对通过该接入点或针对该接入点发出的请求进行评估。但该要求是控制跨数百个账户的接入点**创建**。在 `CreateAccessPoint` 成功之前，接入点尚不存在，因此依赖每个接入点自身的资源策略并不是一种实用或集中化的方式来防止创建非 VPC 接入点。AWS 还指出，网络来源是在创建期间选择的，之后无法更改（[创建限制为虚拟私有云的接入点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-vpc.html)）。

### C. 使用 CloudFormation StackSets 在每个账户中创建 IAM 策略

这不如在组织根创建单个 SCP 具有运营效率。它需要在每个账户中部署和维护 IAM 策略。此外，只有在特定条件下才允许 `s3:CreateAccessPoint` 的基于身份的策略，并不一定能阻止账户中的其他身份策略授予更宽泛的权限，除非所有身份和权限都受到严格控制。SCP 才是正确的组织范围最大权限防护栏。

### D. 将 S3 存储桶策略设置为拒绝 `s3:CreateAccessPoint`，除非条件键求值结果为 VPC

存储桶策略附加到 S3 存储桶，并控制对该存储桶的访问。此处被治理的操作是创建**接入点**，并且 S3 授权参考将 `s3:CreateAccessPoint` 与接入点资源类型以及 `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` 条件键关联起来（[Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazons3.html)）。对于数百个账户和存储桶而言，存储桶策略不是最高效或最可靠的组织范围机制。

## 最终答案

**B** 正确：使用根级别 AWS Organizations SCP 来拒绝创建 S3 接入点，除非 `s3:AccessPointNetworkOrigin` 为 `VPC`。

en.question: A solutions architect must update an application environment within AWS Elastic Beanstalk using a blue/green deployment methodology. The solutions architect creates an environment that is identical to the existing application environment and deploys the application to the new environment. What should be done next to complete the update?

options.A: Redirect to the new environment using Amazon Route 53.
options.B: Select the Swap Environment URLs option.
options.C: Replace the Auto Scaling launch configuration.
options.D: Update the DNS records to point to the green environment.

en.explanation:
The scenario asks how to complete a blue/green deployment in AWS Elastic Beanstalk after creating an identical new environment and deploying the updated application to it.

**Correct answer: B. Select the Swap Environment URLs option.**

AWS Elastic Beanstalk documentation explicitly describes blue/green deployment as deploying the new version to a separate environment and then swapping the CNAMEs of the two environments to redirect traffic to the new version. In the documented procedure, after cloning or creating the new environment, deploying the new application version, and testing it, the next step is to choose **Actions** and then **Swap environment URLs**. Elastic Beanstalk then swaps the CNAME records of the old and new environments, redirecting traffic from the old version to the new version instantly. See the AWS documentation for [Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Redirect to the new environment using Amazon Route 53** — This is not the Elastic Beanstalk-native step described for this situation. While DNS routing can be used in some architectures, Elastic Beanstalk provides a specific blue/green deployment mechanism: swapping environment URLs/CNAMEs.
- **C. Replace the Auto Scaling launch configuration** — Auto Scaling launch configuration changes do not redirect user traffic from the old Elastic Beanstalk environment to the new one and are unrelated to completing a blue/green cutover.
- **D. Update the DNS records to point to the green environment** — This is a generic DNS approach, but for Elastic Beanstalk blue/green deployments the documented operation is to use **Swap environment URLs**, which swaps the Elastic Beanstalk CNAME records between environments. Manual DNS updates are not the best answer here.

Therefore, the correct choice is **B**.

zh.question: 解决方案架构师必须使用蓝/绿部署方法更新 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 中的应用程序环境。解决方案架构师创建了一个与现有应用程序环境完全相同的环境，并将应用程序部署到新环境。接下来应执行什么操作来完成更新？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Route 53 重定向到新环境。
options.B: 选择 Swap Environment URLs 选项。
options.C: 替换 Auto Scaling 启动配置。
options.D: 更新 DNS 记录，使其指向绿色环境。

zh.explanation:
该场景询问：在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 中创建了一个相同的新环境并将更新后的应用程序部署到该环境之后，如何完成蓝/绿部署。

**正确答案：B. 选择 Swap Environment URLs 选项。**

AWS Elastic Beanstalk 文档明确将蓝/绿部署描述为：将新版本部署到单独的环境，然后交换两个环境的 CNAME，以将流量重定向到新版本。在文档化的过程中，在克隆或创建新环境、部署新的应用程序版本并进行测试之后，下一步是选择 **Actions**，然后选择 **Swap environment URLs**。Elastic Beanstalk 随后会交换旧环境和新环境的 CNAME 记录，将流量从旧版本立即重定向到新版本。请参阅 AWS 文档：[Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用 Amazon Route 53 重定向到新环境** — 这不是针对这种情况所描述的 Elastic Beanstalk 原生步骤。虽然在某些架构中可以使用 DNS 路由，但 Elastic Beanstalk 提供了特定的蓝/绿部署机制：交换环境 URL/CNAME。
- **C. 替换 Auto Scaling 启动配置** — 更改 Auto Scaling 启动配置不会将用户流量从旧的 Elastic Beanstalk 环境重定向到新环境，并且与完成蓝/绿切换无关。
- **D. 更新 DNS 记录，使其指向绿色环境** — 这是一种通用 DNS 方法，但对于 Elastic Beanstalk 蓝/绿部署，文档化的操作是使用 **Swap environment URLs**，它会在环境之间交换 Elastic Beanstalk CNAME 记录。手动更新 DNS 在此处不是最佳答案。

因此，正确选项是 **B**。

en.question: A company is building an image service on the web that will allow users to upload and search random photos. At peak usage, up to 10,000 users worldwide will upload their images. The will then overlay text on the uploaded images, which will then be published on the company website. Which design should a solutions architect implement?

options.A: Store the uploaded images in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Send application log information about each image to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances that use CloudWatch Logs to determine which images need to be processed. Place processed images in another directory in Amazon EFS. Enable Amazon CloudFront and configure the origin to be the one of the EC2 instances in the fleet.
options.B: Store the uploaded images in an Amazon S3 bucket and configure an S3 bucket event notification to send a message to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Create a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to pull messages from Amazon SNS to process the images and place them in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the SNS message volume to scale out EC2 instances. Enable Amazon CloudFront and configure the origin to be the ALB in front of the EC2 instances.
options.C: Store the uploaded images in an Amazon S3 bucket and configure an S3 bucket event notification to send a message to the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances to pull messages from the SQS queue to process the images and place them in another S3 bucket. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics for queue depth to scale out EC2 instances. Enable Amazon CloudFront and configure the origin to be the S3 bucket that contains the processed images.
options.D: Store the uploaded images on a shared Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume mounted to a fleet of Amazon EC2 Spot instances. Create an Amazon DynamoDB table that contains information about each uploaded image and whether it has been processed. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to scale out EC2 instances. Enable Amazon CloudFront and configure the origin to reference an Elastic Load Balancer in front of the fleet of EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
The scenario requires a highly scalable web image-processing pipeline: many global users upload images, the system must asynchronously apply text overlays, and the processed images must be published efficiently worldwide. The best design is the one that uses durable object storage, decouples upload from processing, scales workers based on backlog, and serves static images through a CDN.

**Correct answer: C**

Option C is the best architecture:

- **Amazon S3 for uploads and processed images** is appropriate for image objects and high-scale web uploads. S3 event notifications support **new object created events** and can send notifications directly to **Amazon SQS queues** ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).
- **Amazon SQS** decouples the upload path from the image-processing workers. EC2 instances can poll the queue, process images independently, and delete messages after successful processing.
- **Scaling EC2 workers based on SQS queue depth** is appropriate because SQS publishes CloudWatch metrics such as `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`, which represents the current processing backlog and can indicate under-provisioned consumers ([Available CloudWatch metrics for Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-available-cloudwatch-metrics.html)).
- **Storing processed images in another S3 bucket** avoids triggering a loop on the upload bucket and separates raw and published content. AWS documentation explicitly warns that writing back to the same bucket that triggers notifications can cause execution loops and recommends using two buckets or prefixes ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).
- **CloudFront with an S3 origin** is ideal for global image delivery. CloudFront distributions can use an Amazon S3 bucket as an origin and cache objects at globally distributed edge locations ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

Therefore, C provides the most scalable, decoupled, and globally performant design.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **A is incorrect.** Amazon EFS and CloudWatch Logs are not the right primitives for this workflow. CloudWatch Logs should not be used as a work queue to determine which images need processing. The design also makes CloudFront use one EC2 instance as the origin, which creates unnecessary coupling and a less scalable/static-content delivery path than using S3 directly as the processed-image origin.

- **B is incorrect.** Although S3 event notifications can publish to SNS, SNS is a pub/sub notification service where publishers send messages to a topic and SNS delivers messages to subscribers such as SQS, Lambda, HTTP/S, email, and others ([What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). EC2 instances do not normally “pull messages from SNS” directly as workers. For worker-based asynchronous processing, SQS is the correct service. This option also stores processed images in EFS and serves them through an ALB/EC2 fleet, which is unnecessarily complex compared with serving processed static images from S3 through CloudFront.

- **D is incorrect.** A shared EBS volume mounted to a fleet of EC2 Spot instances is not an appropriate global image-upload storage layer. The design also uses DynamoDB as a processing-state tracker instead of a queue, and EventBridge is not the natural mechanism for backlog-based worker scaling. Serving processed images through an ELB and EC2 fleet is less suitable than storing static processed objects in S3 and using CloudFront with the S3 bucket as the origin.

The stated answer C is consistent with the documentation and the user vote distribution.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个基于 Web 的图片服务，允许用户上传并搜索随机照片。在峰值使用时，全球最多会有 10,000 名用户上传图片。系统随后会在上传的图片上叠加文本，然后将其发布到公司网站上。解决方案架构师应该实施哪种设计？

options.A: 将上传的图片存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。将每张图片的应用程序日志信息发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建一组 Amazon EC2 实例，使用 CloudWatch Logs 来确定哪些图片需要处理。将处理后的图片放在 Amazon EFS 的另一个目录中。启用 Amazon CloudFront，并将源站配置为该 EC2 实例组中的某一台 EC2 实例。
options.B: 将上传的图片存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并配置 S3 存储桶事件通知以向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 发送消息。创建一组位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例，从 Amazon SNS 拉取消息以处理图片，并将图片放入 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标中的 SNS 消息量来横向扩展 EC2 实例。启用 Amazon CloudFront，并将源站配置为 EC2 实例前面的 ALB。
options.C: 将上传的图片存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并配置 S3 存储桶事件通知以向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列发送消息。创建一组 Amazon EC2 实例，从 SQS 队列拉取消息以处理图片，并将图片放入另一个 S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标中的队列深度来横向扩展 EC2 实例。启用 Amazon CloudFront，并将源站配置为包含处理后图片的 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 将上传的图片存储在挂载到一组 Amazon EC2 Spot 实例的共享 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表，其中包含每张已上传图片的信息以及它是否已被处理。使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则横向扩展 EC2 实例。启用 Amazon CloudFront，并将源站配置为引用该 EC2 实例组前面的 Elastic Load Balancer。

zh.explanation:
该场景需要一个高度可扩展的 Web 图片处理管道：许多全球用户上传图片，系统必须异步应用文本叠加，并且处理后的图片必须高效地发布到全球。最佳设计应使用持久对象存储，将上传与处理解耦，基于积压量扩展工作节点，并通过 CDN 提供静态图片。

**正确答案：C**

选项 C 是最佳架构：

- **Amazon S3 用于上传和处理后的图片**，适合图片对象和大规模 Web 上传。S3 事件通知支持 **新对象创建事件**，并且可以直接向 **Amazon SQS 队列**发送通知（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。
- **Amazon SQS** 将上传路径与图片处理工作节点解耦。EC2 实例可以轮询队列，独立处理图片，并在成功处理后删除消息。
- **基于 SQS 队列深度扩展 EC2 工作节点**是合适的，因为 SQS 会发布 CloudWatch 指标，例如 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`，它表示当前处理积压量，并可表明消费者配置不足（[Available CloudWatch metrics for Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-available-cloudwatch-metrics.html)）。
- **将处理后的图片存储在另一个 S3 存储桶中**可以避免在上传存储桶上触发循环，并将原始内容与已发布内容分离。AWS 文档明确警告，将对象写回触发通知的同一存储桶可能导致执行循环，并建议使用两个存储桶或前缀（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。
- **CloudFront 配合 S3 源站**非常适合全球图片交付。CloudFront 分配可以使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为源站，并在全球分布的边缘站点缓存对象（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

因此，C 提供了最具可扩展性、解耦性和全球性能的设计。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **A 不正确。** Amazon EFS 和 CloudWatch Logs 不是此工作流的合适基础组件。CloudWatch Logs 不应被用作工作队列来确定哪些图片需要处理。该设计还让 CloudFront 使用一台 EC2 实例作为源站，与直接使用 S3 作为处理后图片的源站相比，这会产生不必要的耦合，并且静态内容交付路径的可扩展性较差。

- **B 不正确。** 虽然 S3 事件通知可以发布到 SNS，但 SNS 是一种发布/订阅通知服务，发布者向主题发送消息，SNS 将消息投递给订阅者，例如 SQS、Lambda、HTTP/S、电子邮件等（[What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。EC2 实例通常不会像工作节点一样直接“从 SNS 拉取消息”。对于基于工作节点的异步处理，SQS 才是正确的服务。此选项还将处理后的图片存储在 EFS 中，并通过 ALB/EC2 实例组提供服务，与通过 CloudFront 从 S3 提供处理后的静态图片相比，这过于复杂。

- **D 不正确。** 挂载到一组 EC2 Spot 实例的共享 EBS 卷并不适合作为全球图片上传存储层。该设计还使用 DynamoDB 作为处理状态跟踪器，而不是队列，并且 EventBridge 不是基于积压量进行工作节点扩展的自然机制。通过 ELB 和 EC2 实例组提供处理后的图片，不如将静态处理后对象存储在 S3 中并使用以 S3 存储桶为源站的 CloudFront 合适。

所述答案 C 与文档和用户投票分布一致。

en.question: A company has deployed its database on an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in the us-east-1 Region. The company needs to make its data available to customers in Europe. The customers in Europe must have access to the same data as customers in the United States (US) and will not tolerate high application latency or stale data. The customers in Europe and the customers in the US need to write to the database. Both groups of customers need to see updates from the other group in real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL replica of the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Pause application writes to the RDS DB instance. Promote the Aurora Replica to a standalone DB cluster. Reconfigure the application to use the Aurora database and resume writes. Add eu-west-1 as a secondary Region to the DB cluster. Enable write forwarding on the DB cluster. Deploy the application in eu-west-1. Configure the application to use the Aurora MySQL endpoint in eu-west-1.
options.B: Add a cross-Region replica in eu-west-1 for the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Configure the replica to replicate write queries back to the primary DB instance. Deploy the application in eu-west-1. Configure the application to use the RDS for MySQL endpoint in eu-west-1.
options.C: Copy the most recent snapshot from the RDS for MySQL DB instance to eu-west-1. Create a new RDS for MySQL DB instance in eu-west-1 from the snapshot. Configure MySQL logical replication from us-east-1 to eu-west-1. Enable write forwarding on the DB cluster. Deploy the application in eu-wes&1. Configure the application to use the RDS for MySQL endpoint in eu-west-1.
options.D: Convert the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. Add eu-west-1 as a secondary Region to the DB cluster. Enable write forwarding on the DB cluster. Deploy the application in eu-west-1. Configure the application to use the Aurora MySQL endpoint in eu-west-1.

en.explanation:
The company starts with an **Amazon RDS for MySQL** DB instance in `us-east-1`, but needs a multi-Region architecture in which users in both the US and Europe can write and can see each other’s updates with low latency and without stale reads. The correct solution is **A**.

Option A is correct because it performs the required migration from RDS for MySQL to Aurora MySQL and then uses the Aurora feature set that supports this global access pattern.

AWS documents that an Aurora read replica can be created from a source RDS for MySQL DB instance by choosing **Create Aurora read replica** or by creating an Aurora DB cluster with the RDS for MySQL instance as the replication source. After the migration completes, the Aurora read replica can be promoted to a standalone Aurora DB cluster. Before promotion, AWS instructs you to stop write transactions on the source MySQL DB instance and wait for replica lag to reach 0 to preserve consistency during cutover ([Creating and promoting an Aurora read replica from RDS for MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Migrating.RDSMySQL.Replica.html)).

After the database is running on Aurora MySQL, Aurora Global Database is the appropriate multi-Region architecture. Aurora Global Database spans multiple AWS Regions, with writes handled in the primary Region and replication to secondary Regions typically under a second. It also provides global reads with local latency ([Overview and advantages of Amazon Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). For write requirements from Europe, Aurora global database write forwarding allows secondary clusters to forward SQL write statements to the primary cluster. The primary updates the source of truth and propagates the changes back to all secondary Regions ([Using write forwarding in an Amazon Aurora global database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding.html)). For Aurora MySQL, write forwarding can be enabled when adding or modifying a secondary Region, and the `aurora_replica_read_consistency` setting can be used to control consistency, including `GLOBAL` consistency so queries see committed changes from the primary and other secondary Regions ([Aurora MySQL write forwarding and consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding-ams.html)).

Therefore, option A meets the requirements by first migrating the existing RDS for MySQL database to Aurora MySQL through the documented read-replica-and-promote process, then adding `eu-west-1` as a secondary Region in an Aurora Global Database and enabling write forwarding.

The other options are incorrect:

- **B** is incorrect because an RDS for MySQL cross-Region read replica is not a managed bidirectional write architecture. The option’s statement that the replica can replicate write queries back to the primary is not the RDS for MySQL cross-Region read replica model, and it does not provide Aurora Global Database write forwarding.

- **C** is incorrect because copying a snapshot to `eu-west-1` creates a point-in-time copy, not a continuously synchronized global database. MySQL logical replication would require custom replication design and does not provide the managed Aurora global write-forwarding capability. Also, write forwarding is an Aurora Global Database feature, not a standard RDS for MySQL feature.

- **D** is incorrect because it describes the desired Aurora Global Database end state but skips the documented migration mechanism from RDS for MySQL. The correct approach is not a simple in-place “convert” operation; it is to create an Aurora read replica of the RDS for MySQL DB instance, pause source writes for a consistent cutover, promote the Aurora replica, and then configure Aurora Global Database with write forwarding. Option A includes these required steps.

zh.question: 一家公司已在 `us-east-1` 区域的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例上部署了其数据库。该公司需要向欧洲客户提供其数据。欧洲客户必须能够访问与美国（US）客户相同的数据，并且不能容忍较高的应用程序延迟或过时数据。欧洲客户和美国客户都需要写入数据库。两组客户都需要实时看到另一组客户的更新。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例的 Amazon Aurora MySQL 副本。暂停对 RDS 数据库实例的应用程序写入。将 Aurora Replica 提升为独立数据库集群。重新配置应用程序以使用 Aurora 数据库并恢复写入。将 `eu-west-1` 添加为数据库集群的辅助区域。在数据库集群上启用写入转发。在 `eu-west-1` 部署应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 `eu-west-1` 中的 Aurora MySQL 端点。
options.B: 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例在 `eu-west-1` 添加跨区域副本。配置该副本以将写入查询复制回主数据库实例。在 `eu-west-1` 部署应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 `eu-west-1` 中的 RDS for MySQL 端点。
options.C: 将 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例的最新快照复制到 `eu-west-1`。从该快照在 `eu-west-1` 创建新的 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。配置从 `us-east-1` 到 `eu-west-1` 的 MySQL 逻辑复制。在数据库集群上启用写入转发。在 `eu-wes&1` 部署应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 `eu-west-1` 中的 RDS for MySQL 端点。
options.D: 将 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例转换为 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群。将 `eu-west-1` 添加为数据库集群的辅助区域。在数据库集群上启用写入转发。在 `eu-west-1` 部署应用程序。配置应用程序以使用 `eu-west-1` 中的 Aurora MySQL 端点。

zh.explanation:
该公司一开始在 `us-east-1` 中使用 **Amazon RDS for MySQL** 数据库实例，但需要一个多区域架构，使美国和欧洲的用户都能写入，并且能够以低延迟、无过时读取的方式看到彼此的更新。正确的解决方案是 **A**。

选项 A 正确，因为它执行了从 RDS for MySQL 到 Aurora MySQL 的必要迁移，然后使用支持这种全球访问模式的 Aurora 功能集。

AWS 文档说明，可以通过选择 **Create Aurora read replica**，或通过创建以 RDS for MySQL 实例作为复制源的 Aurora 数据库集群，从源 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例创建 Aurora 只读副本。迁移完成后，可以将 Aurora 只读副本提升为独立的 Aurora 数据库集群。在提升之前，AWS 指示你停止源 MySQL 数据库实例上的写入事务，并等待副本延迟达到 0，以便在切换期间保持一致性（[Creating and promoting an Aurora read replica from RDS for MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Migrating.RDSMySQL.Replica.html)）。

数据库在 Aurora MySQL 上运行之后，Aurora Global Database 是合适的多区域架构。Aurora Global Database 跨越多个 AWS 区域，写入由主区域处理，并且到辅助区域的复制通常低于一秒。它还通过本地延迟提供全球读取（[Overview and advantages of Amazon Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。对于来自欧洲的写入要求，Aurora global database 写入转发允许辅助集群将 SQL 写入语句转发到主集群。主集群更新事实来源，并将更改传播回所有辅助区域（[Using write forwarding in an Amazon Aurora global database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding.html)）。对于 Aurora MySQL，可以在添加或修改辅助区域时启用写入转发，并且可以使用 `aurora_replica_read_consistency` 设置来控制一致性，包括 `GLOBAL` 一致性，使查询能够看到来自主区域和其他辅助区域的已提交更改（[Aurora MySQL write forwarding and consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding-ams.html)）。

因此，选项 A 通过先使用记录在案的只读副本并提升流程，将现有 RDS for MySQL 数据库迁移到 Aurora MySQL，然后在 Aurora Global Database 中添加 `eu-west-1` 作为辅助区域并启用写入转发，从而满足这些要求。

其他选项不正确：

- **B** 不正确，因为 RDS for MySQL 跨区域只读副本不是托管的双向写入架构。该选项声称副本可以将写入查询复制回主数据库，这不是 RDS for MySQL 跨区域只读副本模型，并且它不提供 Aurora Global Database 写入转发。

- **C** 不正确，因为将快照复制到 `eu-west-1` 会创建一个时间点副本，而不是持续同步的全球数据库。MySQL 逻辑复制需要自定义复制设计，并且不提供托管的 Aurora 全球写入转发功能。此外，写入转发是 Aurora Global Database 功能，而不是标准 RDS for MySQL 功能。

- **D** 不正确，因为它描述了期望的 Aurora Global Database 最终状态，但跳过了从 RDS for MySQL 迁移的记录在案机制。正确方法不是简单的就地“convert”操作；而是创建 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例的 Aurora 只读副本，暂停源写入以实现一致切换，提升 Aurora 副本，然后配置带写入转发的 Aurora Global Database。选项 A 包含这些必要步骤。

en.question: A company is serving files to its customers through an SFTP server that is accessible over the internet. The SFTP server is running on a single Amazon EC2 instance with an Elastic IP address attached. Customers connect to the SFTP server through its Elastic IP address and use SSH for authentication. The EC2 instance also has an attached security group that allows access from all customer IP addresses. A solutions architect must implement a solution to improve availability, minimize the complexity of infrastructure management, and minimize the disruption to customers who access files. The solution must not change the way customers connect. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Disassociate the Elastic IP address from the EC2 instance. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to be used for SFTP file hosting. Create an AWS Transfer Family server. Configure the Transfer Family server with a publicly accessible endpoint. Associate the SFTP Elastic IP address with the new endpoint. Point the Transfer Family server to the S3 bucket. Sync all files from the SFTP server to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Disassociate the Elastic IP address from the EC2 instance. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to be used for SFTP file hosting. Create an AWS Transfer Family server. Configure the Transfer Family server with a VPC-hosted, internet-facing endpoint. Associate the SFTP Elastic IP address with the new endpoint. Attach the security group with customer IP addresses to the new endpoint. Point the Transfer Family server to the S3 bucket. Sync all files from the SFTP server to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Disassociate the Elastic IP address from the EC2 instance. Create a new Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to be used for SFTP file hosting. Create an AWS Fargate task definition to run an SFTP server. Specify the EFS file system as a mount in the task definition. Create a Fargate service by using the task definition, and place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the service. When configuring the service, attach the security group with customer IP addresses to the tasks that run the SFTP server. Associate the Elastic IP address with the NLB. Sync all files from the SFTP server to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Disassociate the Elastic IP address from the EC2 instance. Create a multi-attach Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to be used for SFTP file hosting. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with the Elastic IP address attached. Create an Auto Scaling group with EC2 instances that run an SFTP server. Define in the Auto Scaling group that instances that are launched should attach the new multi-attach EBS volume. Configure the Auto Scaling group to automatically add instances behind the NLB. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use the security group that allows customer IP addresses for the EC2 instances that the Auto Scaling group launches. Sync all files from the SFTP server to the new multi-attach EBS volume.

en.explanation:
The company needs to replace a single, internet-facing EC2-based SFTP server with a more available and lower-management solution, while preserving the existing customer connection method: customers connect by SFTP/SSH to the same Elastic IP address, and access should remain restricted to known customer source IP addresses.

**Correct answer: B**

Option B uses **AWS Transfer Family with Amazon S3** and a **VPC-hosted, internet-facing endpoint**. This is the best fit because AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service for transferring files over SFTP into and out of Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS, and it is backed by a redundant, auto-scaling fleet across up to three Availability Zones, improving availability and reducing infrastructure management compared with a single EC2 instance ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)).

The key detail is the endpoint type. The AWS Transfer Family endpoint type matrix states that a **public** endpoint is accessible over the internet but **cannot attach a static IP address** and does **not support source IP allow lists**. In contrast, a **VPC - Internet** endpoint is accessible over the internet, can have **Elastic IP addresses attached**, and can use **security groups attached to the server endpoints** to allow access by source IP address ([Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)). Therefore, option B preserves the customer-facing Elastic IP address and preserves the source-IP-based access control behavior by attaching the existing-style security group to the Transfer Family endpoint.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect** because it uses a publicly accessible Transfer Family endpoint. According to the Transfer Family endpoint matrix, the **Public** endpoint type cannot attach a static IP address, and AWS-provided IP addresses are subject to change. It also does not support source IP allow lists. That fails the requirements to minimize customer disruption by preserving the Elastic IP address and to keep customer IP allow-listing behavior.

- **C is incorrect** because running an SFTP server on AWS Fargate behind an NLB with EFS is more operationally complex than using the managed AWS Transfer Family service. It requires managing containerized SFTP server software, Fargate service configuration, load balancing, user/authentication behavior, and file-system mounts. The question specifically asks to minimize infrastructure management. Also, the option inconsistently says to sync files from the SFTP server to the **S3 bucket**, even though the proposed storage is EFS.

- **D is incorrect** because it continues to require self-managed EC2 SFTP servers, an Auto Scaling group, an NLB, and shared block storage. This does not minimize management complexity compared with AWS Transfer Family. In addition, Amazon EBS Multi-Attach has important constraints: instances must be in the same Availability Zone, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple EC2 instances; a clustered file system is required for production resiliency ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). This makes the design complex and less suitable for highly available managed SFTP hosting.

Therefore, **B** is the only option that provides a managed SFTP service, supports using the existing Elastic IP address, supports customer source-IP restrictions with security groups, and minimizes disruption to customers.

zh.question: 一家公司正在通过一台可通过互联网访问的 SFTP 服务器向客户提供文件。该 SFTP 服务器运行在单个 Amazon EC2 实例上，并附加了一个 Elastic IP 地址。客户通过该 Elastic IP 地址连接到 SFTP 服务器，并使用 SSH 进行身份验证。该 EC2 实例还附加了一个安全组，允许来自所有客户 IP 地址的访问。解决方案架构师必须实施一个解决方案，以提高可用性、最大限度降低基础设施管理复杂性，并最大限度减少访问文件的客户受到的中断。该解决方案不得改变客户的连接方式。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Elastic IP 地址从 EC2 实例解除关联。创建一个用于 SFTP 文件托管的 Amazon S3 存储桶。创建一个 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。将 Transfer Family 服务器配置为具有可公开访问的端点。将 SFTP Elastic IP 地址与新端点关联。将 Transfer Family 服务器指向 S3 存储桶。将所有文件从 SFTP 服务器同步到 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 将 Elastic IP 地址从 EC2 实例解除关联。创建一个用于 SFTP 文件托管的 Amazon S3 存储桶。创建一个 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。将 Transfer Family 服务器配置为具有 VPC 托管的面向互联网的端点。将 SFTP Elastic IP 地址与新端点关联。将包含客户 IP 地址的安全组附加到新端点。将 Transfer Family 服务器指向 S3 存储桶。将所有文件从 SFTP 服务器同步到 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 将 Elastic IP 地址从 EC2 实例解除关联。创建一个新的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，用于 SFTP 文件托管。创建一个 AWS Fargate 任务定义来运行 SFTP 服务器。在任务定义中将 EFS 文件系统指定为挂载。使用该任务定义创建一个 Fargate 服务，并在该服务前面放置一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。配置该服务时，将包含客户 IP 地址的安全组附加到运行 SFTP 服务器的任务。将 Elastic IP 地址与 NLB 关联。将所有文件从 SFTP 服务器同步到 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 将 Elastic IP 地址从 EC2 实例解除关联。创建一个多重挂载 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，用于 SFTP 文件托管。创建一个附加了 Elastic IP 地址的 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。创建一个包含运行 SFTP 服务器的 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组。在 Auto Scaling 组中定义启动的实例应附加新的多重挂载 EBS 卷。配置 Auto Scaling 组以自动将实例添加到 NLB 后面。配置 Auto Scaling 组对其启动的 EC2 实例使用允许客户 IP 地址访问的安全组。将所有文件从 SFTP 服务器同步到新的多重挂载 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要用一个可用性更高、管理成本更低的解决方案来替换单个面向互联网的基于 EC2 的 SFTP 服务器，同时保留现有客户连接方式：客户通过 SFTP/SSH 连接到同一个 Elastic IP 地址，并且访问仍应限制为已知的客户源 IP 地址。

**正确答案：B**

选项 B 使用 **AWS Transfer Family with Amazon S3** 和 **VPC 托管的面向互联网的端点**。这是最佳匹配，因为 AWS Transfer Family 是一项完全托管的服务，用于通过 SFTP 在 Amazon S3 或 Amazon EFS 之间传输文件，并且它由跨最多三个可用区的冗余自动扩缩容队列提供支持，与单个 EC2 实例相比，可提高可用性并减少基础设施管理（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。

关键细节是端点类型。AWS Transfer Family 端点类型矩阵说明，**public** 端点可通过互联网访问，但**不能附加静态 IP 地址**，并且**不支持源 IP 允许列表**。相比之下，**VPC - Internet** 端点可通过互联网访问，可以附加 **Elastic IP 地址**，并且可以使用**附加到服务器端点的安全组**来按源 IP 地址允许访问（[Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。因此，选项 B 保留了面向客户的 Elastic IP 地址，并通过将现有风格的安全组附加到 Transfer Family 端点，保留了基于源 IP 的访问控制行为。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A 不正确**，因为它使用可公开访问的 Transfer Family 端点。根据 Transfer Family 端点矩阵，**Public** 端点类型无法附加静态 IP 地址，并且 AWS 提供的 IP 地址可能会发生变化。它也不支持源 IP 允许列表。这无法满足通过保留 Elastic IP 地址来最大限度减少客户中断以及保持客户 IP 允许列表行为的要求。

- **C 不正确**，因为在 NLB 后面使用 EFS 在 AWS Fargate 上运行 SFTP 服务器，比使用托管的 AWS Transfer Family 服务更具运维复杂性。它需要管理容器化 SFTP 服务器软件、Fargate 服务配置、负载均衡、用户/身份验证行为和文件系统挂载。题目明确要求最大限度降低基础设施管理。此外，该选项前后不一致地说要将文件从 SFTP 服务器同步到 **S3 bucket**，尽管其提出的存储是 EFS。

- **D 不正确**，因为它仍然需要自管理 EC2 SFTP 服务器、Auto Scaling 组、NLB 和共享块存储。与 AWS Transfer Family 相比，这并不能最大限度降低管理复杂性。此外，Amazon EBS Multi-Attach 有重要限制：实例必须位于同一个可用区，并且 XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并不是为多个 EC2 实例同时访问而设计的；生产弹性需要集群文件系统（[EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。这使得该设计复杂，并且不太适合高可用的托管 SFTP 托管。

因此，**B** 是唯一一个提供托管 SFTP 服务、支持使用现有 Elastic IP 地址、支持通过安全组限制客户源 IP，并能最大限度减少客户中断的选项。

en.question: A company ingests and processes streaming market data. The data rate is constant. A nightly process that calculates aggregate statistics takes 4 hours to complete. The statistical analysis is not critical to the business, and data points are processed during the next iteration if a particular run fails. The current architecture uses a pool of Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances with 1-year reservations. These EC2 instances run full time to ingest and store the streaming data in attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. A scheduled script launches EC2 On-Demand Instances each night to perform the nightly processing. The instances access the stored data from NFS shares on the ingestion servers. The script terminates the instances when the processing is complete. The Reserved Instance reservations are expiring. The company needs to determine whether to purchase new reservations or implement a new design. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Update the ingestion process to use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to save data to Amazon S3. Use a scheduled script to launch a fleet of EC2 On-Demand Instances each night to perform the batch processing of the S3 data. Configure the script to terminate the instances when the processing is complete.
options.B: Update the ingestion process to use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to save data to Amazon S3. Use AWS Batch with Spot Instances to perform nightly processing with a maximum Spot price that is 50% of the On-Demand price.
options.C: Update the ingestion process to use a fleet of EC2 Reserved Instances with 3-year reservations behind a Network LoadBalancer. Use AWS Batch with Spot Instances to perform nightly processing with a maximum Spot price that is 50% of the On-Demand price.
options.D: Update the ingestion process to use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to save data to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an AWS Lambda function to run nightly to query Amazon Redshift to generate the daily statistics.

en.explanation:
The company needs a lower-cost replacement for always-on ingestion EC2 instances plus nightly On-Demand batch processing. The key constraints are that the streaming ingest rate is constant, the nightly analysis is not business-critical, and failed runs can be retried or deferred to the next iteration. That makes a serverless streaming storage path plus interruptible batch compute the best fit.

**Correct answer: B.**

Option B replaces the always-running EC2/EBS/NFS ingestion tier with Amazon Data Firehose writing to Amazon S3. AWS documentation states that for Amazon S3 destinations, Firehose delivers streaming data to an S3 bucket, which removes the need to keep ingestion EC2 instances and attached EBS volumes running full time ([Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). S3 is also a natural durable storage location for nightly batch jobs.

For the nightly statistical processing, AWS Batch with EC2 Spot Instances is cost-effective because the job is non-critical and can tolerate interruption or rescheduling. AWS Batch documentation says most AWS Batch customers use Spot Instances because of the savings over On-Demand Instances, and recommends Spot when workloads can tolerate interruptions and job rescheduling ([Amazon EC2 On-Demand or Amazon EC2 Spot - AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/bestpractice5.html)). AWS Batch Spot best practices also describe using retries and checkpointing to handle Spot disruption ([Use Amazon EC2 Spot best practices for AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/bestpractice6.html)). This matches the scenario: if a run fails, data can be processed in the next iteration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** uses Firehose and S3 for ingestion, which is good, but it continues to run the nightly processing on **EC2 On-Demand Instances**. Because the workload is not critical and can tolerate failure or retry, Spot Instances through AWS Batch are more cost-effective than On-Demand compute.
* **C** uses AWS Batch with Spot Instances for processing, but keeps ingestion on a fleet of EC2 Reserved Instances with 3-year reservations behind a Network Load Balancer. This continues to require always-on EC2 capacity, EBS/NFS-style operational overhead, and an additional load balancer instead of using managed streaming delivery to S3. It is less cost-effective and less operationally efficient than Firehose to S3.
* **D** uses Firehose to Amazon Redshift and a Lambda function for nightly analysis. Firehose can deliver to Redshift, but the documentation notes that Firehose first delivers the data to S3 and then issues a Redshift `COPY` command ([Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). Redshift adds an analytics data warehouse cost that is not required for this simple nightly batch requirement. In addition, the existing nightly process takes 4 hours, while Lambda functions have a maximum timeout of 900 seconds, or 15 minutes ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)), making Lambda unsuitable for the stated processing duration.

Therefore, **B** is the most cost-effective design: Firehose stores the streaming data in S3, and AWS Batch uses Spot Instances for interruptible nightly processing.

zh.question: 一家公司摄取并处理流式市场数据。数据速率是恒定的。一个每晚运行、用于计算汇总统计信息的流程需要 4 小时才能完成。统计分析对业务并非关键，如果某次运行失败，数据点会在下一次迭代中处理。当前架构使用一组采用 1 年期预留的 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances。这些 EC2 实例全天候运行，用于摄取流式数据并将其存储在挂载的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。一个计划脚本每晚启动 EC2 On-Demand Instances 来执行夜间处理。这些实例从摄取服务器上的 NFS 共享访问已存储的数据。处理完成后，脚本会终止这些实例。Reserved Instance 预留即将到期。公司需要确定是购买新的预留，还是实施新的设计。哪种解决方案将以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新摄取流程，使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将数据保存到 Amazon S3。使用计划脚本每晚启动一组 EC2 On-Demand Instances 来执行 S3 数据的批处理。配置脚本在处理完成后终止这些实例。
options.B: 更新摄取流程，使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将数据保存到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS Batch 和 Spot Instances 执行夜间处理，并将最高 Spot 价格设置为 On-Demand 价格的 50%。
options.C: 更新摄取流程，使用位于 Network LoadBalancer 后方、采用 3 年期预留的一组 EC2 Reserved Instances。使用 AWS Batch 和 Spot Instances 执行夜间处理，并将最高 Spot 价格设置为 On-Demand 价格的 50%。
options.D: 更新摄取流程，使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将数据保存到 Amazon Redshift。使用 Amazon EventBridge 调度一个 AWS Lambda 函数每晚运行，查询 Amazon Redshift 以生成每日统计信息。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一种成本更低的方案，来替代始终运行的摄取 EC2 实例以及每晚的 On-Demand 批处理。关键约束是：流式摄取速率恒定，夜间分析对业务并非关键，并且失败的运行可以重试或推迟到下一次迭代。因此，无服务器流式存储路径加上可中断的批处理计算是最佳选择。

**正确答案：B。**

选项 B 用写入 Amazon S3 的 Amazon Data Firehose，替代了始终运行的 EC2/EBS/NFS 摄取层。AWS 文档指出，对于 Amazon S3 目标，Firehose 会将流式数据传送到 S3 存储桶，从而无需让摄取 EC2 实例和挂载的 EBS 卷全天候运行（[Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。S3 也是夜间批处理作业的天然持久存储位置。

对于夜间统计处理，使用 AWS Batch 和 EC2 Spot Instances 具有成本效益，因为该作业并非关键，并且可以容忍中断或重新调度。AWS Batch 文档说明，大多数 AWS Batch 客户会使用 Spot Instances，因为与 On-Demand Instances 相比可以节省成本；并且建议在工作负载能够容忍中断和作业重新调度时使用 Spot（[Amazon EC2 On-Demand or Amazon EC2 Spot - AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/bestpractice5.html)）。AWS Batch Spot 最佳实践还说明了如何使用重试和检查点来处理 Spot 中断（[Use Amazon EC2 Spot best practices for AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/bestpractice6.html)）。这与场景相匹配：如果某次运行失败，数据可以在下一次迭代中处理。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

* **A** 使用 Firehose 和 S3 进行摄取，这是好的做法，但它继续在 **EC2 On-Demand Instances** 上运行夜间处理。由于该工作负载并非关键，并且可以容忍失败或重试，因此通过 AWS Batch 使用 Spot Instances 比使用 On-Demand 计算更具成本效益。
* **C** 使用 AWS Batch 和 Spot Instances 进行处理，但将摄取保留在位于 Network Load Balancer 后方、采用 3 年期预留的一组 EC2 Reserved Instances 上。这仍然需要始终运行的 EC2 容量、EBS/NFS 风格的运维开销，以及额外的负载均衡器，而不是使用托管流式传送到 S3。与 Firehose 到 S3 相比，它成本效益更低，运维效率也更低。
* **D** 使用 Firehose 到 Amazon Redshift，并使用 Lambda 函数进行夜间分析。Firehose 可以传送到 Redshift，但文档指出 Firehose 会先将数据传送到 S3，然后发出 Redshift `COPY` 命令（[Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。Redshift 会增加分析数据仓库成本，而这个简单的夜间批处理需求并不需要它。此外，现有夜间流程需要 4 小时，而 Lambda 函数的最大超时时间为 900 秒，即 15 分钟（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)），因此 Lambda 不适合所述处理时长。

因此，**B** 是成本效益最高的设计：Firehose 将流式数据存储在 S3 中，AWS Batch 使用 Spot Instances 进行可中断的夜间处理。

en.question: A company needs to migrate an on-premises SFTP site to AWS. The SFTP site currently runs on a Linux VM. Uploaded files are made available to downstream applications through an NFS share. As part of the migration to AWS, a solutions architect must implement high availability. The solution must provide external vendors with a set of static public IP addresses that the vendors can allow. The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between its on-premises data center and its VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Transfer Family server. Configure an internet-facing VPC endpoint for the Transfer Family server. Specify an Elastic IP address for each subnet. Configure the Transfer Family server to place files into an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. Modify the configuration on the downstream applications that access the existing NFS share to mount the EFS endpoint instead.
options.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family server. Configure a publicly accessible endpoint for the Transfer Family server. Configure the Transfer Family server to place files into an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. Modify the configuration on the downstream applications that access the existing NFS share to mount the EFS endpoint instead.
options.C: Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the existing Linux VM to an Amazon EC2 instance. Assign an Elastic IP address to the EC2 instance. Mount an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to the EC2 instance. Configure the SFTP server to place files in the EFS file system. Modify the configuration on the downstream applications that access the existing NFS share to mount the EFS endpoint instead.
options.D: Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate the existing Linux VM to an AWS Transfer Family server. Configure a publicly accessible endpoint for the Transfer Family server. Configure the Transfer Family server to place files into an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. Modify the configuration on the downstream applications that access the existing NFS share to mount the FSx for Lustre endpoint instead.

en.explanation:
The company is migrating an on-premises SFTP service whose uploaded files are consumed through an NFS share. The target architecture therefore needs a managed SFTP endpoint, static public IP addresses for vendor firewall allow-listing, highly available shared file storage, and low operational overhead.

**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service for transferring files over SFTP into Amazon S3 or **Amazon EFS**. The documentation states that Transfer Family is backed by an auto scaling, redundant fleet and supports up to 3 Availability Zones for connection and transfer requests ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). For the endpoint, the key requirement is static public IPs. The Transfer Family endpoint type matrix says that a **VPC - Internet** endpoint is reachable over the internet and from VPC/VPC-connected environments such as on-premises over Direct Connect, and that you **can attach Elastic IP addresses to the endpoint**; those Elastic IPs do not change. The same matrix states that clients can allow-list the Elastic IP addresses attached to the server ([Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)).

Using Amazon EFS as the Transfer Family storage backend fits the NFS-based downstream integration. Transfer Family can be configured with an Amazon EFS file system for file transfer requests ([Configure an Amazon EFS file system for Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)). A Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more Availability Zones are unavailable ([EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). Existing downstream applications can mount EFS instead of the old NFS share, preserving the shared-file access pattern with minimal server management.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. Public Transfer Family endpoint** — A publicly accessible Transfer Family endpoint is managed and simple, but it does **not** meet the static public IP requirement. The endpoint matrix explicitly says that for the **Public** endpoint type, you cannot attach a static IP address and AWS-provided IP addresses are subject to change; clients should allow the DNS name rather than IP addresses. This fails the vendor allow-listing requirement.
* **C. Migrated Linux VM on EC2** — This preserves the existing server pattern but increases operational overhead. The company would still need to manage the EC2 instance, SFTP software, patching, scaling, and a highly available design. A single EC2 instance with one Elastic IP is also not a highly available SFTP endpoint. Transfer Family plus EFS is the managed, lower-overhead approach.
* **D. Application Migration Service to AWS Transfer Family / FSx for Lustre** — AWS Application Migration Service migrates servers to EC2-based environments, not into an AWS Transfer Family managed server. In addition, FSx for Lustre is not the natural replacement for an NFS share in this scenario, and the option again uses a public Transfer Family endpoint without static IPs. It does not meet the stated requirements.

Therefore, **A** is the solution that satisfies managed SFTP, static public IP addresses, high availability, EFS/NFS-style shared access, and the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将本地 SFTP 站点迁移到 AWS。该 SFTP 站点目前运行在一台 Linux VM 上。上传的文件通过 NFS 共享提供给下游应用程序。作为迁移到 AWS 的一部分，解决方案架构师必须实现高可用性。该解决方案必须向外部供应商提供一组静态公有 IP 地址，以便供应商将其加入允许列表。该公司已在其本地数据中心和 VPC 之间建立了 AWS Direct Connect 连接。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。为该 Transfer Family 服务器配置面向互联网的 VPC 端点。为每个子网指定一个 Elastic IP 地址。配置 Transfer Family 服务器，将文件放入跨多个可用区部署的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。修改访问现有 NFS 共享的下游应用程序的配置，改为挂载 EFS 端点。
options.B: 创建 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。为该 Transfer Family 服务器配置可公开访问的端点。配置 Transfer Family 服务器，将文件放入跨多个可用区部署的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。修改访问现有 NFS 共享的下游应用程序的配置，改为挂载 EFS 端点。
options.C: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 将现有 Linux VM 迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。为该 EC2 实例分配一个 Elastic IP 地址。将 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统挂载到该 EC2 实例。配置 SFTP 服务器，将文件放入 EFS 文件系统中。修改访问现有 NFS 共享的下游应用程序的配置，改为挂载 EFS 端点。
options.D: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 将现有 Linux VM 迁移到 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。为该 Transfer Family 服务器配置可公开访问的端点。配置 Transfer Family 服务器，将文件放入跨多个可用区部署的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统中。修改访问现有 NFS 共享的下游应用程序的配置，改为挂载 FSx for Lustre 端点。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在迁移一个本地 SFTP 服务，其上传的文件通过 NFS 共享被下游应用程序使用。因此，目标架构需要一个托管的 SFTP 端点、用于供应商防火墙允许列表的静态公有 IP 地址、高可用的共享文件存储，以及低运营开销。

**正确答案：A。**

AWS Transfer Family 是一项完全托管的服务，用于通过 SFTP 将文件传输到 Amazon S3 或 **Amazon EFS**。文档指出，Transfer Family 由自动扩缩、冗余的机群提供支持，并且支持最多 3 个可用区来处理连接和传输请求（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。对于端点，关键要求是静态公有 IP。Transfer Family 端点类型矩阵说明，**VPC - Internet** 端点可通过互联网访问，也可从 VPC/VPC 连接的环境（例如通过 Direct Connect 连接的本地环境）访问，并且你**可以将 Elastic IP 地址附加到该端点**；这些 Elastic IP 不会变化。同一矩阵还指出，客户端可以将附加到服务器的 Elastic IP 地址加入允许列表（[Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。

使用 Amazon EFS 作为 Transfer Family 存储后端，符合基于 NFS 的下游集成需求。可以为 Transfer Family 配置 Amazon EFS 文件系统，以处理文件传输请求（[Configure an Amazon EFS file system for Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)）。Regional EFS 文件系统会在多个可用区中冗余存储数据，并且即使一个或多个可用区不可用，也能提供持续可用性（[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。现有下游应用程序可以挂载 EFS 来替代旧的 NFS 共享，在最少服务器管理的情况下保留共享文件访问模式。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **B. 公共 Transfer Family 端点** — 可公开访问的 Transfer Family 端点是托管且简单的，但它**不**满足静态公有 IP 要求。端点矩阵明确说明，对于 **Public** 端点类型，不能附加静态 IP 地址，且 AWS 提供的 IP 地址可能会变化；客户端应允许 DNS 名称而不是 IP 地址。这不满足供应商允许列表要求。
* **C. 迁移到 EC2 上的 Linux VM** — 这保留了现有服务器模式，但会增加运营开销。公司仍然需要管理 EC2 实例、SFTP 软件、补丁、扩缩以及高可用设计。带有一个 Elastic IP 的单个 EC2 实例也不是高可用的 SFTP 端点。Transfer Family 加 EFS 是托管且开销更低的方法。
* **D. Application Migration Service 到 AWS Transfer Family / FSx for Lustre** — AWS Application Migration Service 将服务器迁移到基于 EC2 的环境，而不是迁移到 AWS Transfer Family 托管服务器。此外，在此场景中，FSx for Lustre 并不是 NFS 共享的自然替代方案，并且该选项同样使用没有静态 IP 的公共 Transfer Family 端点。它不满足所述要求。

因此，**A** 是满足托管 SFTP、静态公有 IP 地址、高可用性、EFS/NFS 风格共享访问以及最少运营开销的解决方案。

en.question: A solutions architect has an operational workload deployed on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The VPC architecture spans two Availability Zones (AZ) with a subnet in each that the Auto Scaling group is targeting. The VPC is connected to an on-premises environment and connectivity cannot be interrupted. The maximum size of the Auto Scaling group is 20 instances in service. The VPC IPv4 addressing is as follows: VPC CIDR: 10.0.0.0/23 - AZ1 subnet CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24 - AZ2 subnet CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24 - Since deployment, a third AZ has become available in the Region. The solutions architect wants to adopt the new AZ without adding additional IPv4 address space and without service downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the Auto Scaling group to use the AZ2 subnet only. Delete and re-create the AZ1 subnet using half the previous address space. Adjust the Auto Scaling group to also use the new AZ1 subnet. When the instances are healthy, adjust the Auto Scaling group to use the AZ1 subnet only. Remove the current AZ2 subnet. Create a new AZ2 subnet using the second half of the address space from the original AZ1 subnet. Create a new AZ3 subnet using half the original AZ2 subnet address space, then update the Auto Scaling group to target all three new subnets.
options.B: Terminate the EC2 instances in the AZ1 subnet. Delete and re-create the AZ1 subnet using half the address space. Update the Auto Scaling group to use this new subnet. Repeat this for the second AZ. Define a new subnet in AZ3, then update the Auto Scaling group to target all three new subnets.
options.C: Create a new VPC with the same IPv4 address space and define three subnets, with one for each AZ. Update the existing Auto Scaling group to target the new subnets in the new VPC.
options.D: Update the Auto Scaling group to use the AZ2 subnet only. Update the AZ1 subnet to have half the previous address space. Adjust the Auto Scaling group to also use the AZ1 subnet again. When the instances are healthy, adjust the Auto Scaling group to use the AZ1 subnet only. Update the current AZ2 subnet and assign the second half of the address space from the original AZ1 subnet. Create a new AZ3 subnet using half the original AZ2 subnet address space, then update the Auto Scaling group to target all three new subnets.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The workload runs on EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group (ASG) across two subnets, one in each of two Availability Zones. The VPC CIDR is `10.0.0.0/23`, currently divided into two `/24` subnets:

- AZ1: `10.0.0.0/24`
- AZ2: `10.0.1.0/24`

A third AZ is now available. The architect must add a subnet in that third AZ **without adding IPv4 address space** and **without service downtime**.

The key constraints are:

- A subnet belongs to exactly one Availability Zone; AWS states that each subnet must reside entirely within one AZ and cannot span zones ([Subnets for your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/configure-subnets.html)).
- To reuse an existing subnet CIDR range differently, the existing subnet must be emptied and deleted. AWS documents that a subnet cannot be deleted while it contains network interfaces, and that when the subnet is deleted, its CIDR block returns to the VPC's available IP address pool ([Delete a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-deleting.html)).
- An ASG can be updated to add or remove subnets/AZs; AWS documents adding an AZ by editing the ASG network subnets and removing an AZ by deleting the subnet from the ASG network configuration ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html), [Remove an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-remove-az-console.html)).
- A `/25` subnet is large enough for this workload: AWS allows IPv4 subnet sizes from `/28` through `/16`, and reserves five IPv4 addresses per subnet ([Subnet CIDR blocks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-sizing.html)). A `/25` provides 128 addresses minus 5 reserved = 123 usable addresses, far more than the ASG maximum of 20 instances.

## Correct answer: A

Option A is correct because it performs a staged subnet replacement while keeping the workload running in at least one existing subnet at each step:

1. Temporarily move the ASG to AZ2 only.
2. Once AZ1 is drained, delete the original AZ1 `/24` subnet and recreate a smaller subnet from half of that address space.
3. Add the new AZ1 subnet back to the ASG and wait for healthy instances.
4. Temporarily move the ASG to AZ1 only.
5. Delete/recreate AZ2 using the other half of the original AZ1 space.
6. Create the new AZ3 subnet from part of the original AZ2 space.
7. Update the ASG to use all three subnets.

This works because deleting a subnet returns its CIDR block to the VPC address pool, allowing that address space to be reallocated to new subnets. The ASG subnet updates allow instances to be shifted between AZs during the process, avoiding downtime as long as capacity and health checks are managed correctly.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Incorrect

Option B starts by terminating the EC2 instances in the AZ1 subnet. That is not the safest no-downtime migration pattern. It does not first shift ASG capacity away from the subnet and wait for healthy replacement capacity elsewhere. The requirement is explicitly **without service downtime**, so the ASG should be updated and allowed to replace/rebalance capacity before deleting subnet resources.

### C. Incorrect

Creating a new VPC with the same IPv4 address space does not solve the problem. The existing ASG cannot simply be updated to use subnets in a different VPC. Also, the question states that the existing VPC is connected to an on-premises environment and connectivity cannot be interrupted. Moving to a new VPC with the same CIDR would introduce routing/connectivity complications and would require a migration, not just an ASG subnet update.

### D. Incorrect

Option D is similar in sequence to option A, but it says to **update** existing subnets to use smaller/different CIDR ranges. That is not how IPv4 subnet resizing works in Amazon VPC. AWS documentation describes specifying the subnet IP range when the subnet is created and lists the settings that can be modified after creation; CIDR resizing is not one of those modifiable subnet settings ([Subnets for your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/configure-subnets.html)). To reuse the CIDR space differently, the subnet must be emptied and deleted; AWS states that deleting the subnet returns its CIDR block to the VPC address pool ([Delete a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-deleting.html)).

Therefore, the only option that satisfies all requirements is **A**.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署了一个正在运行的工作负载。VPC 架构跨越两个可用区 (AZ)，每个可用区中都有一个子网，Auto Scaling 组以这些子网为目标。该 VPC 连接到本地环境，并且连接不能中断。Auto Scaling 组的最大大小为 20 个服务中的实例。VPC IPv4 地址如下：VPC CIDR：10.0.0.0/23 - AZ1 子网 CIDR：10.0.0.0/24 - AZ2 子网 CIDR：10.0.1.0/24 - 自部署以来，该 Region 中已有第三个 AZ 可用。解决方案架构师希望在不添加额外 IPv4 地址空间且不停机的情况下采用新的 AZ。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Auto Scaling 组更新为仅使用 AZ2 子网。删除并重新创建 AZ1 子网，使用之前地址空间的一半。调整 Auto Scaling 组，使其也使用新的 AZ1 子网。当实例健康后，调整 Auto Scaling 组为仅使用 AZ1 子网。移除当前 AZ2 子网。使用原始 AZ1 子网地址空间的另一半创建新的 AZ2 子网。使用原始 AZ2 子网地址空间的一半创建新的 AZ3 子网，然后更新 Auto Scaling 组以目标定位所有三个新子网。
options.B: 终止 AZ1 子网中的 EC2 实例。删除并重新创建 AZ1 子网，使用一半地址空间。更新 Auto Scaling 组以使用此新子网。对第二个 AZ 重复此操作。在 AZ3 中定义一个新子网，然后更新 Auto Scaling 组以目标定位所有三个新子网。
options.C: 创建一个具有相同 IPv4 地址空间的新 VPC，并定义三个子网，每个 AZ 一个。更新现有 Auto Scaling 组以目标定位新 VPC 中的新子网。
options.D: 将 Auto Scaling 组更新为仅使用 AZ2 子网。更新 AZ1 子网，使其具有之前地址空间的一半。调整 Auto Scaling 组，使其再次也使用 AZ1 子网。当实例健康后，调整 Auto Scaling 组为仅使用 AZ1 子网。更新当前 AZ2 子网，并分配原始 AZ1 子网地址空间的另一半。使用原始 AZ2 子网地址空间的一半创建新的 AZ3 子网，然后更新 Auto Scaling 组以目标定位所有三个新子网。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该工作负载运行在 Auto Scaling 组 (ASG) 中的 EC2 实例上，跨两个子网，每个子网分别位于两个可用区之一。VPC CIDR 为 `10.0.0.0/23`，当前划分为两个 `/24` 子网：

- AZ1：`10.0.0.0/24`
- AZ2：`10.0.1.0/24`

现在第三个 AZ 已可用。架构师必须在第三个 AZ 中添加一个子网，且**不添加 IPv4 地址空间**并且**不停机**。

关键约束如下：

- 一个子网只属于一个可用区；AWS 声明每个子网必须完全位于一个 AZ 内，不能跨区域 ([Subnets for your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/configure-subnets.html))。
- 若要以不同方式重用现有子网 CIDR 范围，必须清空并删除现有子网。AWS 文档说明，当子网包含网络接口时不能删除；删除子网后，其 CIDR 块会返回到 VPC 的可用 IP 地址池 ([Delete a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-deleting.html))。
- 可以更新 ASG 以添加或移除子网/AZ；AWS 文档说明，可通过编辑 ASG 网络子网来添加 AZ，并通过从 ASG 网络配置中删除子网来移除 AZ ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html), [Remove an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-remove-az-console.html))。
- `/25` 子网足以满足此工作负载：AWS 允许 IPv4 子网大小从 `/28` 到 `/16`，并且每个子网保留五个 IPv4 地址 ([Subnet CIDR blocks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-sizing.html))。一个 `/25` 提供 128 个地址减去 5 个保留地址 = 123 个可用地址，远多于 ASG 最大 20 个实例。

## 正确答案：A

选项 A 正确，因为它执行分阶段的子网替换，同时在每个步骤中保持工作负载至少运行在一个现有子网中：

1. 暂时将 ASG 移动到仅 AZ2。
2. 在 AZ1 清空后，删除原始 AZ1 `/24` 子网，并用该地址空间的一半重新创建一个较小的子网。
3. 将新的 AZ1 子网添加回 ASG，并等待实例健康。
4. 暂时将 ASG 移动到仅 AZ1。
5. 使用原始 AZ1 空间的另一半删除/重新创建 AZ2。
6. 使用原始 AZ2 空间的一部分创建新的 AZ3 子网。
7. 更新 ASG 以使用所有三个子网。

这可行，因为删除子网会将其 CIDR 块返回到 VPC 地址池，从而允许将该地址空间重新分配给新子网。ASG 子网更新允许在此过程中将实例在 AZ 之间转移，只要正确管理容量和运行状况检查，就可以避免停机。

## 其他选项不正确的原因

### B. 不正确

选项 B 一开始就终止 AZ1 子网中的 EC2 实例。这不是最安全的无停机迁移模式。它没有先将 ASG 容量从该子网迁出，并等待其他位置的健康替代容量。要求明确是**不停机**，因此应更新 ASG，并允许其在删除子网资源之前替换/重新平衡容量。

### C. 不正确

创建具有相同 IPv4 地址空间的新 VPC 并不能解决问题。现有 ASG 不能简单地更新为使用不同 VPC 中的子网。此外，题目说明现有 VPC 已连接到本地环境，并且连接不能中断。迁移到具有相同 CIDR 的新 VPC 会引入路由/连接复杂性，并且需要迁移，而不仅仅是 ASG 子网更新。

### D. 不正确

选项 D 的顺序与选项 A 类似，但它说要**更新**现有子网以使用更小/不同的 CIDR 范围。这不是 Amazon VPC 中 IPv4 子网调整大小的工作方式。AWS 文档描述了在创建子网时指定子网 IP 范围，并列出了创建后可以修改的设置；CIDR 调整大小不属于这些可修改的子网设置之一 ([Subnets for your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/configure-subnets.html))。若要以不同方式重用 CIDR 空间，必须清空并删除子网；AWS 声明删除子网会将其 CIDR 块返回到 VPC 地址池 ([Delete a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-deleting.html))。

因此，唯一满足所有要求的选项是 **A**。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage the company's AWS accounts. The company uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy all infrastructure. A finance team wants to build a chargeback model. The finance team asked each business unit to tag resources by using a predefined list of project values. When the finance team used the AWS Cost and Usage Report in AWS Cost Explorer and filtered based on project, the team noticed noncompliant project values. The company wants to enforce the use of project tags for new resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Create a tag policy that contains the allowed project tag values in the organization's management account. Create an SCP that denies the cloudformation:CreateStack API operation unless a project tag is added. Attach the SCP to each OU.
options.B: Create a tag policy that contains the allowed project tag values in each OU. Create an SCP that denies the cloudformation:CreateStack API operation unless a project tag is added. Attach the SCP to each OU.
options.C: Create a tag policy that contains the allowed project tag values in the AWS management account. Create an IAM policy that denies the cloudformation:CreateStack API operation unless a project tag is added. Assign the policy to each user.
options.D: Use AWS Service Catalog to manage the CloudFormation stacks as products. Use a TagOptions library to control project tag values. Share the portfolio with all OUs that are in the organization.

en.explanation:
The company already deploys infrastructure through CloudFormation and wants an organization-wide control so that newly created resources have a `project` tag from an approved set of values for chargeback reporting. The lowest-effort pattern is to define the tagging standard centrally with AWS Organizations tag policies, and add an SCP guardrail so users cannot create untagged CloudFormation stacks.

**Correct answer: A**

AWS Organizations tag policies are designed to standardize tags across accounts in an organization. The documentation states that tag policies can define required case treatment and allowed tag values, and that Organizations is used to manage tag policies from the organization's management account and attach them to organization entities so that the rules take effect ([AWS Organizations tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)). The tag policy can contain the allowed `project` values.

However, tag policies alone do not solve the “missing tag” problem. AWS explicitly notes that resources that have never had tags attached do not show as noncompliant and that account administrators can still create untagged resources; AWS recommends considering an SCP to set guardrails around resource creation requests ([Best practices for tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-best-practices.html)). For CloudFormation, `CreateStack` supports the global tag condition keys `aws:RequestTag/${TagKey}` and `aws:TagKeys`, so an SCP can deny `cloudformation:CreateStack` unless the request includes the `project` tag ([CloudFormation service authorization reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_awscloudformation.html)). CloudFormation stack tags are important here because the `CreateStack` API accepts `Tags`, and CloudFormation propagates stack tags to resources created in the stack ([CreateStack API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStack.html)).

SCPs are also the appropriate organization-level guardrail. AWS states that SCPs set maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts, and if an action is explicitly denied by an applicable SCP, the user or role cannot perform it even with an identity policy that otherwise allows it ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). SCPs can be attached to a root, OU, or account, and an attachment to a root or OU affects all accounts under that target ([Attaching organization policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)). Although attaching at the root could be even simpler if the same rule applies everywhere, option A is still the best listed answer because it centralizes the tag policy in the management account and uses an SCP rather than per-user IAM controls or Service Catalog migration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Incorrect / more effort. AWS Organizations tag policies are created and managed from the organization's management account, not “in each OU.” OUs are policy targets, not accounts where policies are created. This option also implies duplicating policy creation per OU, which is more operational effort than a centralized policy.
- **C:** Incorrect. An IAM policy assigned to each user is not the least effort and is weaker operationally in a multi-account organization. It requires finding and maintaining policies for every relevant identity in every account and can miss roles or future identities. SCPs are the intended organization-wide permissions guardrail.
- **D:** Incorrect. AWS Service Catalog with TagOptions can help standardize tags for provisioned products, but it would require managing CloudFormation stacks as Service Catalog products and sharing portfolios. That is more effort and does not by itself prevent users or automation from creating CloudFormation stacks directly outside Service Catalog unless additional controls are added.

Therefore, **A** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织来管理公司的 AWS 账户。该公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署所有基础设施。财务团队希望构建一个分摊计费模型。财务团队要求每个业务部门使用预定义的项目值列表为资源添加标签。当财务团队在 AWS Cost Explorer 中使用 AWS Cost and Usage Report 并基于项目进行筛选时，发现了一些不合规的项目值。公司希望强制要求新资源使用项目标签。哪种解决方案能以最少的工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 在组织的管理账户中创建一个包含允许的项目标签值的标签策略。创建一个 SCP，除非添加了项目标签，否则拒绝 cloudformation:CreateStack API 操作。将该 SCP 附加到每个 OU。
options.B: 在每个 OU 中创建一个包含允许的项目标签值的标签策略。创建一个 SCP，除非添加了项目标签，否则拒绝 cloudformation:CreateStack API 操作。将该 SCP 附加到每个 OU。
options.C: 在 AWS 管理账户中创建一个包含允许的项目标签值的标签策略。创建一个 IAM policy，除非添加了项目标签，否则拒绝 cloudformation:CreateStack API 操作。将该策略分配给每个用户。
options.D: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 将 CloudFormation 堆栈作为产品进行管理。使用 TagOptions library 控制项目标签值。与组织中的所有 OU 共享 portfolio。

zh.explanation:
该公司已经通过 CloudFormation 部署基础设施，并希望实现组织范围内的控制，确保新创建的资源具有来自已批准值集合的 `project` 标签，以便进行分摊计费报告。工作量最低的模式是使用 AWS Organizations 标签策略集中定义标签标准，并添加 SCP 防护栏，使用户无法创建未加标签的 CloudFormation 堆栈。

**正确答案：A**

AWS Organizations 标签策略旨在跨组织中的账户标准化标签。文档说明，标签策略可以定义所需的大小写处理方式和允许的标签值，并且 Organizations 用于从组织的管理账户管理标签策略，并将其附加到组织实体以使规则生效（[AWS Organizations tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)）。该标签策略可以包含允许的 `project` 值。
