该工作负载是一个位于 ALB 后面的、托管在 ECS 上的 Docker 应用程序，持久数据存储在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 中，容器镜像存储在 Amazon ECR 中。公司需要一种 DR 设计，要求 **RTO ≤ 24 小时** 且 **RPO ≤ 8 小时**，并且要求采用**最具成本效益**的解决方案。

对于这些相对宽松的恢复目标，成本最低的 DR 模式通常是**备份和还原**，而不是维护一个持续运行的辅助环境。AWS 将 DR 选项描述为从低成本、低复杂度的备份，到更复杂的多区域策略不等。在**备份和还原**方法中，数据会备份并复制到恢复区域，基础设施、配置和应用程序代码会在恢复区域中重新部署；AWS 特别建议使用 CloudFormation 等基础设施即代码来快速、可靠地重新部署（[AWS DR 白皮书：云中的灾难恢复选项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 将 Docker 镜像存储在两个区域的 ECR 中。每 8 小时计划一次 RDS 快照，并将快照复制到辅助区域。发生故障时，使用 AWS CloudFormation 在辅助区域中部署 ALB、EC2、ECS 和 RDS 资源，从最新快照还原，并更新 DNS 记录以指向辅助区域中的 ALB。**

这是最具成本效益的选项，因为它遵循**备份和还原 / cold standby** DR 模型：

- **RPO ≤ 8 小时：** 每 8 小时计划一次 RDS 快照意味着最近的恢复点应不超过 8 小时。Amazon RDS 支持跨 AWS 区域复制数据库快照；复制后，快照会保留在目标区域中，并且可以像该区域中的其他快照一样使用（[Amazon RDS：复制数据库快照](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CopySnapshot.html)）。
- **RTO ≤ 24 小时：** 24 小时的 RTO 足以在 DR 事件期间部署 ALB、ECS/EC2 基础设施并执行 RDS 还原。AWS 明确指出，对于备份和还原，必须在恢复区域中重新部署基础设施和应用程序代码，而 CloudFormation 等 IaC 有助于快速且无误地重新部署（[AWS DR 白皮书](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。
- **应用程序镜像可用性：** 将容器镜像保持在辅助区域中可避免等到灾难发生时才移动镜像。Amazon ECR 支持配置私有镜像复制，包括**跨区域复制**（[Amazon ECR：配置私有镜像复制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/registry-settings-configure.html)）。即使是通过预先推送镜像而不是自动复制来实现，与在第二个区域运行完整的计算/数据库基础设施相比，这也是一个低成本的准备步骤。
- **成本优化：** 此解决方案避免为完整的重复环境、warm standby 计算或持续运行的 RDS 只读副本付费。它主要为备份/快照存储、DR 区域中的快照复制/存储、ECR 存储以及重新创建基础设施所需的 CloudFormation 模板付费。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 完整的重复资源加快照和多区域复制

选项 A 不是最具成本效益的。它建议在两个区域中部署相同的 ALB、EC2、ECS 和 RDS 资源，这意味着即使 RTO 高达 24 小时，也要为完整的辅助环境付费。它还将计划快照与数据库复制结合起来，这超出了满足 8 小时 RPO 的需要。持续复制或只读副本更适合较低的 RPO/RTO 目标，但会增加持续成本。题目要求的是**最具成本效益**的设计，因此这属于过度设计。

### C. 每小时 MySQL 备份到 S3 和延迟 ECR 导入

选项 C 比 B 更弱且成本效益更低。它使用每小时数据库备份到 S3 并通过 S3 复制，而不是使用原生的 RDS 快照/跨区域快照复制机制。对于 RDS MySQL 数据库而言，RDS 快照已经支持跨区域复制，因此这种做法带来了不必要的运维复杂性。它还等到灾难发生时才将最新的 Docker 镜像导入辅助区域中的 ECR，这增加了本可避免的恢复步骤。RPO 要求是 8 小时，因此每小时备份也比要求更频繁。

### D. 带有 ALB、EC2 Auto Scaling 和跨区域 RDS 只读副本的 pilot light

选项 D 对于更严格的恢复要求是一种有效的 DR 模式，但对于本题来说并不是最具成本效益的。AWS 将 **pilot light** 描述为一种方法：数据会被复制，核心基础设施会在 DR 区域中预置，并且始终有资源运行以支持复制和恢复就绪状态。AWS 还将 RDS 只读副本列为 pilot light 设计中用于持续跨区域复制的机制（[AWS DR 白皮书](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。

但是，跨区域 RDS 只读副本和预置的 ALB/EC2 资源比复制快照和使用 CloudFormation 重新部署具有更高的持续成本。由于所需的 RTO 为 24 小时，RPO 为 8 小时，因此备份和还原已经足够且更便宜。

## 结论

**答案 B** 以最低成本最能满足 SLA：在 DR 区域中保持容器镜像可用，至少每 8 小时复制一次 RDS 快照，并在灾难期间使用 CloudFormation 重新创建应用程序堆栈，然后更新 DNS。

en.question: A company is migrating its infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. The company must comply with a variety of regulatory standards for different projects. The company needs a multi-account environment. A solutions architect needs to prepare the baseline infrastructure. The solution must provide a consistent baseline of management and security, but it must allow flexibility for different compliance requirements within various AWS accounts. The solution also needs to integrate with the existing on-premises Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) server. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Create an organization in AWS Organizations. Create a single SCP for least privilege access across all accounts. Create a single OU for all accounts. Configure an IAM identity provider for federation with the on-premises AD FS server. Configure a central logging account with a defined process for log generating services to send log events to the central account. Enable AWS Config in the central account with conformance packs for all accounts.
options.B: Create an organization in AWS Organizations. Enable AWS Control Tower on the organization. Review included controls (guardrails) for SCPs. Check AWS Config for areas that require additions. Add OUs as necessary. Connect AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to the on-premises AD FS server.
options.C: Create an organization in AWS Organizations. Create SCPs for least privilege access. Create an OU structure, and use it to group AWS accounts. Connect AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to the on-premises AD FS server. Configure a central logging account with a defined process for log generating services to send log events to the central account. Enable AWS Config in the central account with aggregators and conformance packs.
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations. Enable AWS Control Tower on the organization. Review included controls (guardrails) for SCPs. Check AWS Config for areas that require additions. Configure an IAM identity provider for federation with the on-premises AD FS server.

en.explanation:
The company needs a governed multi-account AWS foundation with a consistent security/management baseline, flexibility for different compliance requirements by account/project, and integration with the existing AD FS-based identity environment, with the **least operational overhead**.

**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Control Tower is purpose-built for this scenario. The AWS documentation describes a Control Tower landing zone as a well-architected **multi-account environment** based on security and compliance best practices, containing OUs, accounts, users, and other resources subject to governance. Control Tower also provides **controls/guardrails** and Account Factory to standardize and automate account provisioning and ongoing governance ([What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)). When a landing zone is set up, Control Tower creates baseline OUs and shared accounts such as Log Archive and Audit, applies mandatory preventive controls, and applies mandatory detective controls ([How AWS Control Tower works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html)).

Option B also preserves flexibility: AWS recommends multiple OUs because accounts often need to be grouped for governance and control, and different applications/projects can require different security profiles and control policies. AWS Control Tower lets you add additional OUs as requirements expand ([AWS multi-account strategy for your AWS Control Tower landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/aws-multi-account-landing-zone.html)). Control Tower integrates with AWS Organizations and IAM Identity Center, and uses AWS Config rules for detective controls ([What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html), [Govern Resource Configurations with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/config.html)).

For identity, IAM Identity Center is the better fit than configuring IAM federation separately in accounts. IAM Identity Center provides a single place to assign permissions to multiple AWS accounts and provides one point of federation to simplify user access to AWS. It can connect an existing identity provider and redirect authentication to that external IdP ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html), [External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)). This matches the requirement to integrate with the existing AD FS identity environment while minimizing administrative effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** This is mostly a manual AWS Organizations design. A single OU and a single least-privilege SCP do not provide the requested flexibility for different compliance requirements across projects/accounts. It also requires manually designing centralized logging and AWS Config coverage, which increases operational overhead compared with Control Tower’s automated landing zone, shared accounts, and baseline controls.

- **C:** This could be built to meet many requirements, but it requires manually creating the OU structure, SCPs, logging process, AWS Config aggregators, and conformance packs. That is more operational overhead than using AWS Control Tower, which automates much of the multi-account landing zone setup and governance baseline.

- **D:** This uses AWS Control Tower, but it omits adding OUs as needed for different compliance requirements. More importantly, it uses an IAM identity provider approach rather than IAM Identity Center. IAM Identity Center is the AWS service designed to centralize workforce access and permission assignments across multiple AWS accounts with one federation point, so it better satisfies the multi-account federation requirement with lower overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其基础设施迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司必须针对不同项目遵守多种监管标准。该公司需要一个多账户环境。解决方案架构师需要准备基线基础设施。该解决方案必须提供一致的管理和安全基线，但必须允许在不同 AWS 账户内针对各种合规性要求保持灵活性。该解决方案还需要与现有的本地 Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) 服务器集成。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。创建一个适用于所有账户的单一 SCP，以实现最小权限访问。为所有账户创建一个单一 OU。配置一个 IAM 身份提供商，用于与本地 AD FS 服务器进行联合身份验证。配置一个集中式日志记录账户，并定义流程，让生成日志的服务将日志事件发送到该集中账户。在集中账户中启用 AWS Config，并为所有账户配置合规包。
options.B: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。在该组织上启用 AWS Control Tower。查看包含的控制措施（护栏）以用于 SCP。检查 AWS Config 中需要补充的区域。根据需要添加 OU。将 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 连接到本地 AD FS 服务器。
options.C: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。创建用于最小权限访问的 SCP。创建 OU 结构，并使用它对 AWS 账户进行分组。将 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 连接到本地 AD FS 服务器。配置一个集中式日志记录账户，并定义流程，让生成日志的服务将日志事件发送到该集中账户。在集中账户中启用 AWS Config，并配置聚合器和合规包。
options.D: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。在该组织上启用 AWS Control Tower。查看包含的控制措施（护栏）以用于 SCP。检查 AWS Config 中需要补充的区域。配置一个 IAM 身份提供商，用于与本地 AD FS 服务器进行联合身份验证。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一个受治理的多账户 AWS 基础环境，具备一致的安全/管理基线，能够按账户/项目针对不同合规性要求保持灵活性，并与现有基于 AD FS 的身份环境集成，同时具有**最少运营开销**。

**正确答案：B。**

AWS Control Tower 正是为这种场景而设计的。AWS 文档将 Control Tower 着陆区描述为一个基于安全和合规最佳实践的、架构良好的**多账户环境**，其中包含受治理约束的 OU、账户、用户和其他资源。Control Tower 还提供**控制措施/护栏**和 Account Factory，用于标准化并自动化账户预置和持续治理（[What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)）。设置着陆区时，Control Tower 会创建基线 OU 以及 Log Archive 和 Audit 等共享账户，应用强制性预防性控制，并应用强制性检测性控制（[How AWS Control Tower works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html)）。

选项 B 也保留了灵活性：AWS 建议使用多个 OU，因为账户通常需要按治理和控制需求进行分组，而且不同应用程序/项目可能需要不同的安全配置文件和控制策略。AWS Control Tower 允许你随着需求扩展添加额外 OU（[AWS multi-account strategy for your AWS Control Tower landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/aws-multi-account-landing-zone.html)）。Control Tower 与 AWS Organizations 和 IAM Identity Center 集成，并使用 AWS Config 规则实现检测性控制（[What Is AWS Control Tower?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)，[Govern Resource Configurations with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/config.html)）。

在身份方面，IAM Identity Center 比在各账户中单独配置 IAM 联合身份验证更合适。IAM Identity Center 提供一个统一位置，用于向多个 AWS 账户分配权限，并提供一个联合身份验证点来简化用户访问 AWS。它可以连接现有身份提供商，并将身份验证重定向到该外部 IdP（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)，[External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)）。这符合与现有 AD FS 身份环境集成并尽量减少管理工作的要求。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A:** 这主要是一个手动的 AWS Organizations 设计。单一 OU 和单一最小权限 SCP 无法为不同项目/账户的不同合规性要求提供所需的灵活性。它还需要手动设计集中式日志记录和 AWS Config 覆盖范围，与 Control Tower 的自动化着陆区、共享账户和基线控制相比，会增加运营开销。

- **C:** 这种方案可以构建出来以满足许多要求，但它需要手动创建 OU 结构、SCP、日志记录流程、AWS Config 聚合器和合规包。这比使用 AWS Control Tower 的运营开销更高，因为 AWS Control Tower 会自动化多账户着陆区设置和治理基线中的大部分工作。

- **D:** 该方案使用 AWS Control Tower，但它省略了根据不同合规性要求按需添加 OU。更重要的是，它使用 IAM 身份提供商方法，而不是 IAM Identity Center。IAM Identity Center 是 AWS 设计用于在多个 AWS 账户之间集中管理员工访问和权限分配的服务，并提供一个联合身份验证点，因此它能以更低开销更好地满足多账户联合身份验证要求。

en.question: An online magazine will launch its latest edition this month. This edition will be the first to be distributed globally. The magazine's dynamic website currently uses an Application Load Balancer in front of the web tier, a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances for web and application servers, and Amazon Aurora MySQL. Portions of the website include static content and almost all traffic is read-only. The magazine is expecting a significant spike in internet traffic when the new edition is launched. Optimal performance is a top priority for the week following the launch. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to reduce system response times for a global audience? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use logical cross-Region replication to replicate the Aurora MySQL database to a secondary Region. Replace the web servers with Amazon S3. Deploy S3 buckets in cross-Region replication mode.
options.B: Ensure the web and application tiers are each in Auto Scaling groups. Introduce an AWS Direct Connect connection. Deploy the web and application tiers in Regions across the world.
options.C: Migrate the database from Amazon Aurora to Amazon RDS for MySQL. Ensure all three of the application tiers – web, application, and database – are in private subnets.
options.D: Use an Aurora global database for physical cross-Region replication. Use Amazon S3 with cross- Region replication for static content and resources. Deploy the web and application tiers in Regions across the world.
options.E: Introduce Amazon Route 53 with latency-based routing and Amazon CloudFront distributions. Ensure the web and application tiers are each in Auto Scaling groups.

en.explanation:
The application is a dynamic website with mostly read-only traffic and some static content, and it expects a short-lived but significant global traffic spike. To reduce response times for a global audience, the architecture should place dynamic serving capacity closer to users, route users to the lowest-latency Region, cache/accelerate content at edge locations, and provide low-latency regional read access to the database and static resources.

## Correct answers: D and E

### D. Use an Aurora global database, S3 Cross-Region Replication, and deploy web/application tiers globally
This is correct because an **Aurora global database** is designed for multi-Region Aurora deployments: it has one primary cluster and up to five read-only secondary clusters in other Regions, and Aurora replicates data to secondary Regions using dedicated infrastructure with typical latency under one second. AWS also states that Aurora global databases use storage block-based replication, matching the option's description of physical/storage-level cross-Region replication. This is appropriate for a read-heavy global workload because regional application stacks can read from nearby secondary Aurora clusters. See [Aurora global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aurora-replication-options/aurora-global-database.html).

Using **S3 Cross-Region Replication** for static content is also appropriate. Amazon S3 replication can asynchronously copy objects between buckets, and Cross-Region Replication copies objects across buckets in different AWS Regions. This helps make static resources available closer to regional application deployments. See [Replicating objects within and across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html).

Deploying the web and application tiers in multiple Regions complements the database and static-content replication by reducing network distance for global users.

### E. Introduce Route 53 latency-based routing and CloudFront, and use Auto Scaling groups
This is correct because **Route 53 latency-based routing** is specifically intended for applications hosted in multiple AWS Regions; it improves performance by serving users from the Region that provides the lowest latency. See [Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html).

**Amazon CloudFront** speeds up delivery of static and dynamic web content through a worldwide network of edge locations. AWS states that requests are routed to the edge location with the lowest latency and that cached content can be delivered immediately, reducing latency and improving data transfer rates. See [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html).

Finally, putting the web and application tiers in **Auto Scaling groups** helps the system handle the launch spike. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling maintains the correct number of EC2 instances for application load and can launch or terminate instances as demand changes. See [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Logical Aurora replication, replace web servers with S3, and S3 CRR
This is not the best solution. The site is dynamic and currently has web and application servers, so replacing the web servers entirely with S3 is not appropriate for dynamic application processing. Also, Aurora global database is the better fit for global Aurora read scaling because it uses dedicated infrastructure and storage block-based replication rather than database-engine logical replication.

### B. Auto Scaling, Direct Connect, and globally deployed tiers
Auto Scaling and multi-Region tiers are useful, but **AWS Direct Connect** does not solve the problem of reducing response times for internet users globally. Direct Connect is for private connectivity between a customer network and AWS, not for accelerating public internet traffic from a worldwide reader audience. This option also lacks CloudFront, latency-based DNS routing, and a global database/read-replication strategy.

### C. Migrate Aurora to RDS for MySQL and use private subnets
This does not address the performance goal. Moving from Aurora to standard RDS for MySQL would not inherently improve global read latency, and placing tiers in private subnets is a security/networking design choice, not a solution for global response-time reduction. It also omits global traffic routing, edge caching, multi-Region application deployment, and database replication for regional reads.

zh.question: 一家在线杂志将在本月发布最新一期。这一期将是首次面向全球发行。该杂志的动态网站目前在 Web 层前使用 Application Load Balancer，使用一组 Amazon EC2 实例作为 Web 和应用程序服务器，并使用 Amazon Aurora MySQL。网站的部分内容包括静态内容，且几乎所有流量都是只读的。该杂志预计在新一期发布时互联网流量会出现显著峰值。在发布后的一周内，最佳性能是首要优先事项。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项步骤组合，以降低全球受众的系统响应时间？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用逻辑跨区域复制将 Aurora MySQL 数据库复制到辅助区域。用 Amazon S3 替换 Web 服务器。以跨区域复制模式部署 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 确保 Web 层和应用程序层各自位于 Auto Scaling 组中。引入 AWS Direct Connect 连接。在全球各地的区域中部署 Web 层和应用程序层。
options.C: 将数据库从 Amazon Aurora 迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL。确保所有三个应用程序层（Web、应用程序和数据库）都位于私有子网中。
options.D: 使用 Aurora global database 进行物理跨区域复制。对静态内容和资源使用 Amazon S3 跨区域复制。在全球各地的区域中部署 Web 层和应用程序层。
options.E: 引入带有基于延迟路由的 Amazon Route 53 和 Amazon CloudFront 分配。确保 Web 层和应用程序层各自位于 Auto Scaling 组中。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序是一个动态网站，流量主要为只读，并包含一些静态内容，而且预计会出现短期但显著的全球流量峰值。为了降低全球受众的响应时间，架构应将动态服务能力部署得更靠近用户，将用户路由到延迟最低的区域，在边缘站点缓存/加速内容，并为数据库和静态资源提供低延迟的区域性读取访问。

## 正确答案：D 和 E

### D. 使用 Aurora global database、S3 Cross-Region Replication，并在全球部署 Web/应用程序层
这是正确的，因为 **Aurora global database** 专为多区域 Aurora 部署而设计：它有一个主集群，以及最多五个位于其他区域的只读辅助集群，并且 Aurora 使用专用基础设施将数据复制到辅助区域，典型延迟低于一秒。AWS 还说明 Aurora global database 使用基于存储块的复制，这与该选项所描述的物理/存储级跨区域复制相匹配。这适合以读取为主的全球工作负载，因为区域应用程序栈可以从附近的辅助 Aurora 集群读取。请参阅 [Aurora global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aurora-replication-options/aurora-global-database.html)。

对静态内容使用 **S3 Cross-Region Replication** 也很合适。Amazon S3 replication 可以在存储桶之间异步复制对象，而 Cross-Region Replication 会跨不同 AWS 区域中的存储桶复制对象。这有助于让静态资源更靠近区域应用程序部署。请参阅 [Replicating objects within and across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)。

在多个区域中部署 Web 层和应用程序层，通过缩短全球用户的网络距离，补充了数据库和静态内容复制方案。

### E. 引入 Route 53 latency-based routing 和 CloudFront，并使用 Auto Scaling 组
这是正确的，因为 **Route 53 latency-based routing** 专门用于托管在多个 AWS 区域中的应用程序；它通过从提供最低延迟的区域为用户提供服务来提升性能。请参阅 [Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)。

**Amazon CloudFront** 通过全球边缘站点网络加速静态和动态 Web 内容的交付。AWS 表示，请求会被路由到延迟最低的边缘站点，并且缓存内容可以立即交付，从而降低延迟并提高数据传输速率。请参阅 [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)。

最后，将 Web 层和应用程序层放入 **Auto Scaling 组** 有助于系统应对发布时的流量峰值。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会为应用程序负载维持正确数量的 EC2 实例，并可随着需求变化启动或终止实例。请参阅 [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 逻辑 Aurora 复制、用 S3 替换 Web 服务器，以及 S3 CRR
这不是最佳解决方案。该站点是动态站点，并且目前有 Web 和应用程序服务器，因此完全用 S3 替换 Web 服务器并不适合动态应用程序处理。此外，Aurora global database 更适合全球 Aurora 读取扩展，因为它使用专用基础设施和基于存储块的复制，而不是数据库引擎逻辑复制。

### B. Auto Scaling、Direct Connect 和全球部署的层
Auto Scaling 和多区域层很有用，但 **AWS Direct Connect** 无法解决降低全球互联网用户响应时间的问题。Direct Connect 用于客户网络与 AWS 之间的私有连接，而不是加速来自全球读者群的公共互联网流量。该选项还缺少 CloudFront、基于延迟的 DNS 路由，以及 global database/读取复制策略。

### C. 将 Aurora 迁移到 RDS for MySQL 并使用私有子网
这并不能解决性能目标。从 Aurora 迁移到标准 RDS for MySQL 并不会从本质上改善全球读取延迟，而将各层放入私有子网是一种安全/网络设计选择，并不是降低全球响应时间的解决方案。它还遗漏了全球流量路由、边缘缓存、多区域应用程序部署，以及用于区域读取的数据库复制。

en.question: An online gaming company needs to optimize the cost of its workloads on AWS. The company uses a dedicated account to host the production environment for its online gaming application and an analytics application. Amazon EC2 instances host the gaming application and must always be available. The EC2 instances run all year. The analytics application uses data that is stored in Amazon S3. The analytics application can be interrupted and resumed without issue. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the online gaming application instances. Use On- Demand Instances for the analytics application.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the online gaming application instances. Use Spot Instances for the analytics application.
options.C: Use Spot Instances for the online gaming application and the analytics application. Set up a catalog in AWS Service Catalog to provision services at a discount.
options.D: Use On-Demand Instances for the online gaming application. Use Spot Instances for the analytics application. Set up a catalog in AWS Service Catalog to provision services at a discount.

en.explanation:
The company has two different compute cost-optimization patterns:

* The **online gaming application** runs on EC2 instances, must always be available, and runs all year. This is steady, predictable EC2 usage, so a commitment-based discount is appropriate.
* The **analytics application** can be interrupted and resumed. This is a good fit for Spot capacity because the workload is interruption-tolerant.

**Correct answer: B. Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the online gaming application instances. Use Spot Instances for the analytics application.**

AWS documentation states that Savings Plans reduce EC2 costs in exchange for a consistent hourly commitment for 1 or 3 years, and EC2 Instance Savings Plans provide savings up to 72% off On-Demand for a specific instance family in a chosen Region ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html), [Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). Because the gaming instances run continuously all year and must be available, using an EC2 Instance Savings Plan is more cost-effective than paying On-Demand rates for that steady baseline usage.

For the analytics workload, Amazon EC2 Spot Instances are designed for spare EC2 capacity and can provide savings of up to 90% compared with On-Demand. AWS recommends Spot Instances for stateless, fault-tolerant, flexible workloads, and notes that Spot Instances can be interrupted with two minutes of notice ([Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)). Since the analytics application can be interrupted and resumed, Spot Instances are the most cost-effective choice.

### Why the other options are incorrect

* **A. Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the gaming application. Use On-Demand Instances for analytics.**  
  The Savings Plan choice for the gaming application is appropriate, but On-Demand Instances are not the most cost-effective option for an analytics workload that can tolerate interruption. Spot Instances are better suited and typically cheaper for this type of workload.

* **C. Use Spot Instances for both applications. Set up AWS Service Catalog to provision services at a discount.**  
  Spot Instances are not appropriate for the gaming application because it must always be available. AWS explicitly says Spot does not guarantee capacity availability and is not suitable for inflexible or fault-intolerant workloads ([Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)). Also, AWS Service Catalog is for creating and managing approved catalogs of IT services, standardization, governance, and self-service provisioning; it is not a purchasing mechanism that provides EC2 discounts ([What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)).

* **D. Use On-Demand Instances for the gaming application. Use Spot Instances for analytics. Set up Service Catalog to provision services at a discount.**  
  Spot is appropriate for analytics, but using On-Demand for a continuously running, predictable gaming workload is less cost-effective than using an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Service Catalog also does not provide pricing discounts; it provides catalog governance and controlled self-service provisioning ([What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家在线游戏公司需要优化其在 AWS 上工作负载的成本。该公司使用一个专用账户来托管其在线游戏应用程序和分析应用程序的生产环境。Amazon EC2 实例托管游戏应用程序，并且必须始终可用。EC2 实例全年运行。分析应用程序使用存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。分析应用程序可以被中断并恢复，而不会产生问题。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为在线游戏应用程序实例购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。对分析应用程序使用 On-Demand Instances。
options.B: 为在线游戏应用程序实例购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。对分析应用程序使用 Spot Instances。
options.C: 对在线游戏应用程序和分析应用程序使用 Spot Instances。在 AWS Service Catalog 中设置目录以折扣方式预置服务。
options.D: 对在线游戏应用程序使用 On-Demand Instances。对分析应用程序使用 Spot Instances。在 AWS Service Catalog 中设置目录以折扣方式预置服务。

zh.explanation:
该公司有两种不同的计算成本优化模式：

* **在线游戏应用程序** 运行在 EC2 实例上，必须始终可用，并且全年运行。这是稳定、可预测的 EC2 使用量，因此适合采用基于承诺的折扣。
* **分析应用程序** 可以被中断并恢复。这非常适合 Spot 容量，因为该工作负载能够容忍中断。

**正确答案：B。为在线游戏应用程序实例购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。对分析应用程序使用 Spot Instances。**

AWS 文档指出，Savings Plans 通过承诺 1 年或 3 年的一致小时用量来降低 EC2 成本，而 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 可针对所选区域中的特定实例系列，相比 On-Demand 最高节省 72%（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)，[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。由于游戏实例全年持续运行且必须可用，因此使用 EC2 Instance Savings Plan 比为这种稳定基线使用量支付 On-Demand 费率更具成本效益。

对于分析工作负载，Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 专为备用 EC2 容量而设计，与 On-Demand 相比最高可节省 90%。AWS 建议将 Spot Instances 用于无状态、容错、灵活的工作负载，并指出 Spot Instances 可能会在提前两分钟通知后被中断（[Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)）。由于分析应用程序可以被中断并恢复，因此 Spot Instances 是最具成本效益的选择。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

* **A。为游戏应用程序购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。对分析使用 On-Demand Instances。**  
  为游戏应用程序选择 Savings Plan 是合适的，但对于能够容忍中断的分析工作负载，On-Demand Instances 并不是最具成本效益的选项。Spot Instances 更适合此类工作负载，并且通常更便宜。

* **C。对两个应用程序都使用 Spot Instances。设置 AWS Service Catalog 以折扣方式预置服务。**  
  Spot Instances 不适合游戏应用程序，因为它必须始终可用。AWS 明确表示 Spot 不保证容量可用性，并且不适用于不灵活或不能容错的工作负载（[Best practices for Amazon EC2 Spot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)）。此外，AWS Service Catalog 用于创建和管理已批准的 IT 服务目录、标准化、治理和自助服务预置；它不是提供 EC2 折扣的购买机制（[What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。

* **D。对游戏应用程序使用 On-Demand Instances。对分析使用 Spot Instances。设置 Service Catalog 以折扣方式预置服务。**  
  Spot 适用于分析，但对于持续运行且可预测的游戏工作负载，使用 On-Demand 不如使用 EC2 Instance Savings Plan 具有成本效益。Service Catalog 也不提供价格折扣；它提供目录治理和受控的自助服务预置（[What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。

en.question: A company runs applications in hundreds of production AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and has a centralized backup operation that uses AWS Backup. The company is concerned about ransomware attacks. To address this concern, the company has created a new policy that all backups must be resilient to breaches of privileged-user credentials in any production account. Which combination of steps will meet this new requirement? (Choose three.)

options.A: Implement cross-account backup with AWS Backup vaults in designated non-production accounts.
options.B: Add an SCP that restricts the modification of AWS Backup vaults.
options.C: Implement AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode.
options.D: Implement least privilege access for the IAM service role that is assigned to AWS Backup.
options.E: Configure the backup frequency, lifecycle, and retention period to ensure that at least one backup always exists in the cold tier.
options.F: Configure AWS Backup to write all backups to an Amazon S3 bucket in a designated non- production account. Ensure that the S3 bucket has S3 Object Lock enabled.

en.explanation:
The company needs a backup design that remains protected even if privileged credentials in a production AWS account are compromised. The correct combination is **A, B, and C**: copy backups to separate accounts, use organization-level guardrails, and make the backup vaults immutable.

**A. Implement cross-account backup with AWS Backup vaults in designated non-production accounts — Correct.**  
AWS Backup supports cross-account backup so that backups can be securely copied to one or more AWS accounts in the same AWS Organizations organization for operational or security reasons. The documentation also notes that if the original backup is deleted, the backup can be copied back from the destination account for restore. The destination account uses an AWS Backup backup vault to store the copied backups. This isolates backup copies from IAM principals in a compromised production account. See [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html).

**B. Add an SCP that restricts the modification of AWS Backup vaults — Correct.**  
Service control policies provide central guardrails that define the maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts. Because the company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled, SCPs can be used to restrict sensitive AWS Backup vault operations across production accounts and protected backup accounts. This helps prevent a compromised privileged user in a member account from modifying backup vault settings or otherwise weakening the backup protection. See [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

**C. Implement AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode — Correct.**  
AWS Backup Vault Lock provides WORM protection for backups in a backup vault. In compliance mode, after the grace period expires, the vault lock cannot be altered or deleted by any user or by AWS, and AWS Backup denies attempts by any user, including the root user, to delete backups or change lifecycle properties before the retention period expires. This directly addresses ransomware resilience and privileged-user compromise. See [AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html).

**D. Implement least privilege access for the IAM service role that is assigned to AWS Backup — Incorrect.**  
Least privilege is a security best practice, but it does not satisfy the requirement by itself. The threat is compromise of privileged-user credentials in production accounts. Limiting the AWS Backup service role does not make existing recovery points immutable, does not isolate backups in another account, and does not prevent a separate privileged principal from changing backup configuration or attempting destructive actions.

**E. Configure the backup frequency, lifecycle, and retention period to ensure that at least one backup always exists in the cold tier — Incorrect.**  
Backup frequency, lifecycle, and cold-tier placement are retention and cost-management settings. They do not prevent a privileged user from deleting recovery points or changing backup settings. Also, AWS Backup documentation states that cross-account backup does not support copies for storage in cold tiers, so this is not the control that meets the stated cross-account ransomware-resilience requirement. See [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html).

**F. Configure AWS Backup to write all backups to an Amazon S3 bucket in a designated non-production account with S3 Object Lock enabled — Incorrect.**  
AWS Backup uses backup plans and backup vaults as its backup management and storage constructs; cross-account AWS Backup copies are written to destination backup vaults, not to arbitrary customer-managed S3 buckets. S3 Object Lock can be useful for S3 object immutability, but it is not the AWS Backup-native destination model for this scenario. See [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html) and [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在数百个生产 AWS 账户中运行应用程序。该公司使用启用了所有功能的 AWS Organizations，并且有一个使用 AWS Backup 的集中式备份操作。该公司担心勒索软件攻击。为了解决这一担忧，该公司制定了一项新策略：所有备份都必须能够抵御任何生产账户中特权用户凭证泄露带来的影响。哪组步骤组合可以满足这一新要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在指定的非生产账户中使用 AWS Backup vaults 实施跨账户备份。
options.B: 添加一个限制修改 AWS Backup vaults 的 SCP。
options.C: 以 compliance mode 实施 AWS Backup Vault Lock。
options.D: 为分配给 AWS Backup 的 IAM service role 实施最小权限访问。
options.E: 配置备份频率、生命周期和保留期，以确保始终至少有一个备份存在于 cold tier 中。
options.F: 配置 AWS Backup，将所有备份写入指定非生产账户中的 Amazon S3 bucket。确保该 S3 bucket 已启用 S3 Object Lock。

zh.explanation:
公司需要一种备份设计，即使生产 AWS 账户中的特权凭证被攻陷，也仍能受到保护。正确组合是 **A、B 和 C**：将备份复制到单独账户，使用组织级防护栏，并使 backup vaults 不可变。

**A. 在指定的非生产账户中使用 AWS Backup vaults 实施跨账户备份 — 正确。**  
AWS Backup 支持跨账户备份，因此可以出于运营或安全原因，将备份安全地复制到同一 AWS Organizations 组织中的一个或多个 AWS 账户。文档还指出，如果原始备份被删除，可以从目标账户将备份复制回来用于还原。目标账户使用 AWS Backup backup vault 来存储复制的备份。这会将备份副本与被攻陷生产账户中的 IAM principals 隔离开来。请参阅 [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html)。

**B. 添加一个限制修改 AWS Backup vaults 的 SCP — 正确。**  
Service control policies 提供集中式防护栏，用于定义成员账户中 IAM users 和 roles 可用权限的上限。由于公司使用启用了所有功能的 AWS Organizations，因此可以使用 SCPs 限制生产账户和受保护备份账户中的敏感 AWS Backup vault 操作。这有助于防止成员账户中被攻陷的特权用户修改 backup vault 设置或以其他方式削弱备份保护。请参阅 [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

**C. 以 compliance mode 实施 AWS Backup Vault Lock — 正确。**  
AWS Backup Vault Lock 为 backup vault 中的备份提供 WORM 保护。在 compliance mode 下，宽限期过后，任何用户或 AWS 都无法更改或删除 vault lock，并且 AWS Backup 会拒绝任何用户（包括 root 用户）在保留期到期前删除备份或更改生命周期属性的尝试。这直接解决了勒索软件弹性和特权用户被攻陷问题。请参阅 [AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)。

**D. 为分配给 AWS Backup 的 IAM service role 实施最小权限访问 — 不正确。**  
最小权限是一项安全最佳实践，但它本身不能满足要求。威胁是生产账户中特权用户凭证被攻陷。限制 AWS Backup service role 不会使现有 recovery points 不可变，不会将备份隔离到另一个账户，也不能阻止其他特权 principal 更改备份配置或尝试破坏性操作。

**E. 配置备份频率、生命周期和保留期，以确保始终至少有一个备份存在于 cold tier 中 — 不正确。**  
备份频率、生命周期和 cold-tier 放置是保留和成本管理设置。它们不能防止特权用户删除 recovery points 或更改备份设置。此外，AWS Backup 文档说明跨账户备份不支持复制到 cold tiers 中存储，因此这不是满足所述跨账户勒索软件弹性要求的控制措施。请参阅 [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html)。

**F. 配置 AWS Backup，将所有备份写入指定非生产账户中启用了 S3 Object Lock 的 Amazon S3 bucket — 不正确。**  
AWS Backup 使用 backup plans 和 backup vaults 作为其备份管理和存储构造；跨账户 AWS Backup 副本会写入目标 backup vaults，而不是写入任意客户管理的 S3 buckets。S3 Object Lock 可用于 S3 对象不可变性，但它不是此场景的 AWS Backup 原生目标模型。请参阅 [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html) 和 [Creating backup copies across AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html)。

en.question: A company needs to aggregate Amazon CloudWatch logs from its AWS accounts into one central logging account. The collected logs must remain in the AWS Region of creation. The central logging account will then process the logs, normalize the logs into standard output format, and stream the output logs to a security tool for more processing. A solutions architect must design a solution that can handle a large volume of logging data that needs to be ingested. Less logging will occur outside normal business hours than during normal business hours. The logging solution must scale with the anticipated load. The solutions architect has decided to use an AWS Control Tower design to handle the multi-account logging process. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet the requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a destination Amazon Kinesis data stream in the central logging account.
options.B: Create a destination Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in the central logging account.
options.C: Create an IAM role that grants Amazon CloudWatch Logs the permission to add data to the Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create a trust policy. Specify the trust policy in the IAM role. In each member account, create a subscription filter for each log group to send data to the Kinesis data stream.
options.D: Create an IAM role that grants Amazon CloudWatch Logs the permission to add data to the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create a trust policy. Specify the trust policy in the IAM role. In each member account, create a single subscription filter for all log groups to send data to the SQS queue.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to normalize the logs in the central logging account and to write the logs to the security tool.
options.F: Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to normalize the logs in the member accounts and to write the logs to the security tool.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company wants centralized log aggregation from multiple AWS accounts, but with log data staying in the AWS Region where it was created. The central logging account must ingest a large and variable volume of CloudWatch Logs, normalize them, and forward them to a security tool.

The best pattern from the available choices is:

**CloudWatch Logs subscription filters in member accounts → cross-account CloudWatch Logs destination backed by Amazon Kinesis Data Streams in the central logging account → Lambda consumer for normalization and forwarding.**

AWS documentation states that CloudWatch Logs subscription filters can send log data to **Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, AWS Lambda, Amazon Data Firehose, or Amazon OpenSearch Service**; SQS is not listed as a supported subscription destination ([CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)). For cross-account subscriptions, AWS documents a receiver account that creates a CloudWatch Logs destination whose target is a Kinesis data stream and whose IAM role grants CloudWatch Logs permission to write to that stream. The same documentation notes that the **log group and the destination must be in the same AWS Region**, which aligns with the requirement that logs remain in the Region of creation ([cross-account subscriptions using Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CrossAccountSubscriptions-Kinesis-Account.html)).

For scalability, CloudWatch Logs documentation recommends sizing the Kinesis stream appropriately and specifically mentions using **Kinesis Data Streams on-demand capacity mode**, which instantly accommodates workloads as they ramp up or down ([CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)). Lambda can then process records from Kinesis Data Streams in batches, making it suitable for normalization and forwarding to the security tool ([Lambda with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)).

## Correct answers

### A. Create a destination Amazon Kinesis data stream in the central logging account.

Correct. A Kinesis data stream is a supported CloudWatch Logs subscription destination. In a centralized multi-account design, the central logging account acts as the recipient account and hosts the destination backed by Kinesis Data Streams. To satisfy the Region constraint, this destination should be created in the same Region as the source log groups, typically one regional destination per required Region.

### C. Create an IAM role that grants Amazon CloudWatch Logs the permission to add data to the Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create a trust policy. Specify the trust policy in the IAM role. In each member account, create a subscription filter for each log group to send data to the Kinesis data stream.

Correct. AWS documentation describes this exact IAM pattern: create a role with a trust policy for the CloudWatch Logs service and attach permissions such as `kinesis:PutRecord` for the target Kinesis stream. The subscription filter then references the Kinesis destination and the role. Cross-account CloudWatch Logs destinations also require the recipient to define the target stream, role ARN, and access policy.

### E. Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to normalize the logs in the central logging account and to write the logs to the security tool.

Correct. After the logs are centralized into Kinesis Data Streams in the logging account, a Lambda function in that same central account can consume records from the stream, normalize the logs, and forward them to the external or downstream security tool. AWS Lambda supports processing Kinesis stream records through event source mappings.

## Incorrect answers

### B. Create a destination Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in the central logging account.

Incorrect. CloudWatch Logs subscription filters do not support Amazon SQS as a direct subscription destination. Supported destinations include Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, Firehose, and OpenSearch Service.

### D. Create an IAM role that grants Amazon CloudWatch Logs the permission to add data to the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create a trust policy. Specify the trust policy in the IAM role. In each member account, create a single subscription filter for all log groups to send data to the SQS queue.

Incorrect. This option is based on SQS, which is not a supported direct CloudWatch Logs subscription destination. Also, the documented role permissions for the Kinesis-based design grant CloudWatch Logs permission to put records into Kinesis, not SQS.

### F. Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to normalize the logs in the member accounts and to write the logs to the security tool.

Incorrect. The requirement is to aggregate logs into a central logging account and then process them there. Running normalization Lambda functions in every member account would decentralize the processing and would not align with the stated central logging account processing requirement.

## Final answer

**A, C, E**

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其 AWS 账户中的 Amazon CloudWatch 日志聚合到一个集中日志记录账户中。收集到的日志必须保留在其创建所在的 AWS 区域中。然后，集中日志记录账户将处理这些日志，将日志规范化为标准输出格式，并将输出日志流式传输到安全工具以进行进一步处理。解决方案架构师必须设计一个能够处理需要摄取的大量日志数据的解决方案。正常业务时间之外产生的日志量将少于正常业务时间内产生的日志量。日志记录解决方案必须能够随预期负载扩展。解决方案架构师已决定使用 AWS Control Tower 设计来处理多账户日志记录流程。解决方案架构师应采取哪几项步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在集中日志记录账户中创建目标 Amazon Kinesis data stream。
options.B: 在集中日志记录账户中创建目标 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM 角色，授予 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 向 Amazon Kinesis data stream 添加数据的权限。创建一个信任策略。在 IAM 角色中指定该信任策略。在每个成员账户中，为每个日志组创建一个订阅筛选条件，以将数据发送到 Kinesis data stream。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 角色，授予 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列添加数据的权限。创建一个信任策略。在 IAM 角色中指定该信任策略。在每个成员账户中，为所有日志组创建一个单一订阅筛选条件，以将数据发送到 SQS 队列。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其在集中日志记录账户中规范化日志，并将日志写入安全工具。
options.F: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其在成员账户中规范化日志，并将日志写入安全工具。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司希望从多个 AWS 账户集中聚合日志，但日志数据需要保留在其创建所在的 AWS 区域中。集中日志记录账户必须摄取大量且可变的 CloudWatch Logs，规范化这些日志，并将其转发到安全工具。

在可用选项中，最佳模式是：

**成员账户中的 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选条件 → 由集中日志记录账户中的 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 支撑的跨账户 CloudWatch Logs 目标 → 用于规范化和转发的 Lambda 消费者。**

AWS 文档指出，CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选条件可以将日志数据发送到 **Amazon Kinesis Data Streams、AWS Lambda、Amazon Data Firehose 或 Amazon OpenSearch Service**；SQS 未列为支持的订阅目标（[CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)）。对于跨账户订阅，AWS 文档说明接收账户会创建一个 CloudWatch Logs 目标，其目标是 Kinesis data stream，并且其 IAM 角色授予 CloudWatch Logs 写入该流的权限。同一文档还指出，**日志组和目标必须位于同一个 AWS 区域**，这与日志保留在创建区域的要求一致（[cross-account subscriptions using Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CrossAccountSubscriptions-Kinesis-Account.html)）。

对于可扩展性，CloudWatch Logs 文档建议适当调整 Kinesis stream 的大小，并特别提到使用 **Kinesis Data Streams on-demand capacity mode**，该模式可以在工作负载增加或减少时立即适应（[CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)）。随后，Lambda 可以批量处理来自 Kinesis Data Streams 的记录，因此适合进行规范化并转发到安全工具（[Lambda with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)）。

## 正确答案

### A. 在集中日志记录账户中创建目标 Amazon Kinesis data stream。

正确。Kinesis data stream 是受支持的 CloudWatch Logs 订阅目标。在集中式多账户设计中，集中日志记录账户充当接收账户，并托管由 Kinesis Data Streams 支撑的目标。为满足区域约束，该目标应创建在与源日志组相同的区域中，通常是每个所需区域一个区域级目标。

### C. 创建一个 IAM 角色，授予 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 向 Amazon Kinesis data stream 添加数据的权限。创建一个信任策略。在 IAM 角色中指定该信任策略。在每个成员账户中，为每个日志组创建一个订阅筛选条件，以将数据发送到 Kinesis data stream。

正确。AWS 文档描述了这种确切的 IAM 模式：创建一个带有针对 CloudWatch Logs 服务的信任策略的角色，并附加诸如目标 Kinesis stream 的 `kinesis:PutRecord` 之类的权限。然后，订阅筛选条件引用 Kinesis 目标和该角色。跨账户 CloudWatch Logs 目标还要求接收方定义目标流、角色 ARN 和访问策略。

### E. 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其在集中日志记录账户中规范化日志，并将日志写入安全工具。

正确。日志集中到日志记录账户中的 Kinesis Data Streams 后，该同一集中账户中的 Lambda 函数可以从该流消费记录，规范化日志，并将其转发到外部或下游安全工具。AWS Lambda 支持通过事件源映射处理 Kinesis stream 记录。

## 错误答案

### B. 在集中日志记录账户中创建目标 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。

错误。CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选条件不支持 Amazon SQS 作为直接订阅目标。支持的目标包括 Kinesis Data Streams、Lambda、Firehose 和 OpenSearch Service。

### D. 创建一个 IAM 角色，授予 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列添加数据的权限。创建一个信任策略。在 IAM 角色中指定该信任策略。在每个成员账户中，为所有日志组创建一个单一订阅筛选条件，以将数据发送到 SQS 队列。

错误。此选项基于 SQS，而 SQS 不是受支持的直接 CloudWatch Logs 订阅目标。此外，基于 Kinesis 的设计中记录的角色权限是授予 CloudWatch Logs 将记录放入 Kinesis 的权限，而不是 SQS。

### F. 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其在成员账户中规范化日志，并将日志写入安全工具。

错误。要求是将日志聚合到集中日志记录账户，然后在那里进行处理。在每个成员账户中运行规范化 Lambda 函数会使处理分散化，并且不符合题目所述的集中日志记录账户处理要求。

## 最终答案

**A, C, E**

en.question: A company is migrating a legacy application from an on-premises data center to AWS. The application consists of a single application server and a Microsoft SQL Server database server. Each server is deployed on a VMware VM that consumes 500 TB of data across multiple attached volumes. The company has established a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection from the closest AWS Region to its on-premises data center. The Direct Connect connection is not currently in use by other services. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to migrate the application with the LEAST amount of downtime? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use an AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) replication job to migrate the database server VM to AWS.
options.B: Use VM Import/Export to import the application server VM.
options.C: Export the VM images to an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device.
options.D: Use an AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) replication job to migrate the application server VM to AWS.
options.E: Use an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance to migrate the database to an Amazon RDS DB instance.

en.explanation:
The application has two different migration needs: the application server should be rehosted as a server, while the SQL Server database should be migrated at the database layer with ongoing replication so the final cutover is as short as possible. The correct answers are **D and E**.

**D. Use an AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) replication job to migrate the application server VM to AWS.**  
For the application tier, a server replication approach is the least-downtime choice among the available options. The application server is a VMware VM, so replicating the VM to AWS before cutover avoids waiting until the outage window to perform a one-time image transfer. AWS documentation for VMware server replication workflows describes selecting discovered vCenter VMs, starting data replication, and then launching test and cutover instances after the source server reaches a ready state ([Replicating servers from vCenter to AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/replicating-vcenter-aws-mgn.html)). In this question, AWS SMS is the listed server-migration service for that application VM replication pattern.

**E. Use an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance to migrate the database to an Amazon RDS DB instance.**  
For the database tier, AWS DMS is the best fit because it can perform a full-load migration and then keep capturing ongoing changes from the source database. AWS DMS documentation states that an AWS DMS task can capture ongoing changes while data is being migrated, or after an initial full-load migration, using ongoing replication/change data capture (CDC) ([Creating tasks for ongoing replication using AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)). AWS DMS also supports Microsoft SQL Server as a source and supports CDC for ongoing migration from SQL Server ([Using a Microsoft SQL Server database as a source for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.html)). The existing unused 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection provides a high-bandwidth private path for the replication traffic before the final cutover.

The other options are not the best choices:

- **A. Use AWS SMS to migrate the database server VM to AWS** is not the best database migration approach. It would rehost the entire SQL Server VM instead of migrating the database into a managed Amazon RDS DB instance with DMS ongoing replication. For least database downtime and modernization to RDS, DMS is the better fit.
- **B. Use VM Import/Export to import the application server VM** is a point-in-time VM image import method. AWS documentation describes VM Import/Export as importing VM images into Amazon EC2 as AMIs, which can then be used to launch instances ([Import a VM to Amazon EC2 as an image using VM Import/Export](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vm-import/latest/userguide/vmimport-image-import.html)). This does not provide continuous replication up to cutover, so it is not the least-downtime option for the application server.
- **C. Export the VM images to an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device** is an offline bulk-transfer approach. Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices are designed with large local storage capacity for data transfer use cases ([AWS Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)). However, shipping devices does not provide continuous application or database replication, and the company already has an unused 10 Gbps Direct Connect connection suitable for online replication.

Therefore, the least-downtime combination is to **replicate the application server VM with AWS SMS** and **migrate the SQL Server database to Amazon RDS with AWS DMS ongoing replication**: **D and E**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个旧版应用程序从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该应用程序由一台应用程序服务器和一台 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库服务器组成。每台服务器都部署在一个 VMware VM 上，并且跨多个附加卷使用 500 TB 数据。该公司已经从距离其本地数据中心最近的 AWS 区域建立了一条 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。该 Direct Connect 连接目前未被其他服务使用。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项步骤组合，以便在停机时间最短的情况下迁移该应用程序？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 复制作业将数据库服务器 VM 迁移到 AWS。
options.B: 使用 VM Import/Export 导入应用程序服务器 VM。
options.C: 将 VM 映像导出到 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。
options.D: 使用 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 复制作业将应用程序服务器 VM 迁移到 AWS。
options.E: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 复制实例将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS DB 实例。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序有两种不同的迁移需求：应用程序服务器应作为服务器重新托管，而 SQL Server 数据库应在数据库层进行迁移，并使用持续复制，以便最终切换尽可能短。正确答案是 **D 和 E**。

**D. 使用 AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) 复制作业将应用程序服务器 VM 迁移到 AWS。**  
对于应用程序层，在可用选项中，采用服务器复制方法是停机时间最短的选择。应用程序服务器是 VMware VM，因此在切换前将该 VM 复制到 AWS，可以避免等到停机窗口才执行一次性映像传输。AWS 关于 VMware 服务器复制工作流的文档描述了如何选择已发现的 vCenter VM、启动数据复制，然后在源服务器达到就绪状态后启动测试实例和切换实例（[Replicating servers from vCenter to AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/replicating-vcenter-aws-mgn.html)）。在本题中，AWS SMS 是列出的服务器迁移服务，用于该应用程序 VM 复制模式。

**E. 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 复制实例将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS DB 实例。**  
对于数据库层，AWS DMS 最合适，因为它可以执行全量加载迁移，然后持续捕获来自源数据库的持续变更。AWS DMS 文档指出，AWS DMS 任务可以在数据迁移期间捕获持续变更，或在初始全量加载迁移后，使用持续复制/变更数据捕获 (CDC)（[Creating tasks for ongoing replication using AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)）。AWS DMS 还支持将 Microsoft SQL Server 作为源，并支持 CDC 以便从 SQL Server 进行持续迁移（[Using a Microsoft SQL Server database as a source for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.html)）。现有未使用的 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接为最终切换前的复制流量提供了一条高带宽的专用路径。

其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A. 使用 AWS SMS 将数据库服务器 VM 迁移到 AWS** 不是最佳数据库迁移方法。它会重新托管整个 SQL Server VM，而不是使用 DMS 持续复制将数据库迁移到托管的 Amazon RDS DB 实例。为了实现最短数据库停机时间并现代化到 RDS，DMS 更合适。
- **B. 使用 VM Import/Export 导入应用程序服务器 VM** 是一种时间点 VM 映像导入方法。AWS 文档将 VM Import/Export 描述为将 VM 映像作为 AMI 导入到 Amazon EC2，然后可用于启动实例（[Import a VM to Amazon EC2 as an image using VM Import/Export](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vm-import/latest/userguide/vmimport-image-import.html)）。这不能提供一直持续到切换的连续复制，因此不是应用程序服务器停机时间最短的选项。
- **C. 将 VM 映像导出到 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备** 是一种离线批量传输方法。Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备具有较大的本地存储容量，专为数据传输用例而设计（[AWS Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。但是，运输设备不能提供持续的应用程序或数据库复制，而且该公司已经有一条未使用的 10 Gbps Direct Connect 连接，适合在线复制。

因此，停机时间最短的组合是使用 **AWS SMS 复制应用程序服务器 VM**，并使用 **AWS DMS 持续复制将 SQL Server 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS**：**D 和 E**。

en.question: A company operates a fleet of servers on premises and operates a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in its organization in AWS Organizations. The company's AWS accounts contain hundreds of VPCs. The company wants to connect its AWS accounts to its on-premises network. AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections are already established to a single AWS account. The company wants to control which VPCs can communicate with other VPCs. Which combination of steps will achieve this level of control with the LEAST operational effort? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a transit gateway in an AWS account. Share the transit gateway across accounts by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).
options.B: Configure attachments to all VPCs and VPNs.
options.C: Setup transit gateway route tables. Associate the VPCs and VPNs with the route tables.
options.D: Configure VPC peering between the VPCs.
options.E: Configure attachments between the VPCs and VPNs.
options.F: Setup route tables on the VPCs and VPNs.

en.explanation:
The company has many VPCs across AWS Organizations accounts and already has Site-to-Site VPN connectivity in one account. The key requirements are to centralize hybrid connectivity and to control VPC-to-VPC communication with the least operational effort. The AWS-native design for this is a centralized AWS Transit Gateway shared to other accounts, with VPC and VPN attachments and transit gateway route tables used to control routing.

**Correct answers: A, B, C**

- **A. Create a transit gateway in an AWS account. Share the transit gateway across accounts by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).**  
  This is correct. AWS Transit Gateway is designed as a hub-and-spoke service for connecting VPCs and on-premises networks. AWS documentation states that Transit Gateway can connect thousands of VPCs and that you can attach hybrid connectivity such as VPN connections to a single gateway, centralizing routing control. The same AWS whitepaper recommends placing the Transit Gateway in a Network Services account and using AWS RAM to share it for VPCs across multiple accounts in the organization ([AWS Transit Gateway - Building a Scalable and Secure Multi-VPC AWS Network Infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). AWS RAM resource sharing is also how participant accounts access a shared transit gateway ([Accept an AWS Transit Gateway resource share](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/share-accept-tgw.html)).

- **B. Configure attachments to all VPCs and VPNs.**  
  This is correct in combination with A and C. Transit Gateway works by attaching spoke networks, such as VPCs and VPNs, to the transit gateway. The AWS whitepaper describes attaching all hybrid connectivity, including VPN, to a single gateway and connecting VPCs through the hub-and-spoke model ([AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). AWS documentation also specifically says that a Site-to-Site VPN attachment can be connected to a transit gateway to connect VPCs and on-premises networks ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN attachments in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpn-attachments.html)). Attaching the relevant VPCs and the VPNs to the TGW is required before TGW route tables can control connectivity among them.

- **C. Set up transit gateway route tables. Associate the VPCs and VPNs with the route tables.**  
  This is correct. Transit gateway route tables are the mechanism that controls which attached networks can route to each other. AWS documentation says to use transit gateway route tables to configure routing for transit gateway attachments, and that route tables direct how traffic is routed between VPCs and VPNs. It also states that VPC, VPN, Direct Connect gateway, peering, and other attachments can be associated with transit gateway route tables ([Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)). By using separate TGW route tables and selective association/propagation/static routes, the company can control which VPCs can communicate with which other VPCs and with on-premises networks.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **D. Configure VPC peering between the VPCs.**  
  This is not the least operational effort for hundreds of VPCs. VPC peering creates point-to-point relationships and does not provide the centralized hub-and-spoke routing control that Transit Gateway provides. For hundreds of VPCs, peering would create significant operational complexity compared with a shared Transit Gateway.

- **E. Configure attachments between the VPCs and VPNs.**  
  This is incorrect wording and an incorrect architecture. You do not create attachments *between* VPCs and VPNs. You attach VPCs and VPNs **to the transit gateway**, then use TGW route tables to control traffic among those attachments. The official documentation describes VPN attachments as being connected to a transit gateway, not directly between VPCs and VPNs ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN attachments in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpn-attachments.html)).

- **F. Set up route tables on the VPCs and VPNs.**  
  VPC route tables must have routes to the transit gateway for traffic to leave the VPC, but this option does not provide the requested centralized control over which VPCs can communicate with other VPCs. The required control point in this scenario is the **transit gateway route table**, because AWS documentation states that TGW route tables configure routing for TGW attachments and route traffic between VPCs and VPNs ([Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)). VPNs also are not managed by “VPN route tables” in the same way described by the option.

Therefore, the best combination is **A, B, and C**.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地运行一组服务器，并在 AWS Organizations 中的组织内运行一组 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司的 AWS 账户包含数百个 VPC。公司希望将其 AWS 账户连接到本地网络。AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接已经建立到单个 AWS 账户。公司希望控制哪些 VPC 可以与其他 VPC 通信。哪组步骤组合可以以最少的运维工作量实现这种控制级别？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在一个 AWS 账户中创建 transit gateway。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 跨账户共享该 transit gateway。
options.B: 配置到所有 VPC 和 VPN 的 attachments。
options.C: 设置 transit gateway route tables。将 VPC 和 VPN 与这些 route tables 关联。
options.D: 在 VPC 之间配置 VPC peering。
options.E: 在 VPC 和 VPN 之间配置 attachments。
options.F: 在 VPC 和 VPN 上设置 route tables。

zh.explanation:
该公司在 AWS Organizations 的多个账户中有许多 VPC，并且已经在一个账户中建立了 Site-to-Site VPN 连接。关键需求是集中化混合连接，并以最少的运维工作量控制 VPC 到 VPC 的通信。AWS 原生的设计是使用一个集中式 AWS Transit Gateway，并将其共享给其他账户；通过 VPC 和 VPN attachments 以及 transit gateway route tables 来控制路由。

**正确答案：A、B、C**

- **A. Create a transit gateway in an AWS account. Share the transit gateway across accounts by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).**  
  这是正确的。AWS Transit Gateway 被设计为用于连接 VPC 和本地网络的 hub-and-spoke 服务。AWS 文档指出，Transit Gateway 可以连接数千个 VPC，并且你可以将 VPN connections 等混合连接附加到单个 gateway，从而集中化路由控制。同一份 AWS 白皮书建议将 Transit Gateway 放在 Network Services 账户中，并使用 AWS RAM 将其共享给组织内多个账户中的 VPC（[AWS Transit Gateway - Building a Scalable and Secure Multi-VPC AWS Network Infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。AWS RAM resource sharing 也是参与账户访问共享 transit gateway 的方式（[Accept an AWS Transit Gateway resource share](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/share-accept-tgw.html)）。

- **B. Configure attachments to all VPCs and VPNs.**  
  这与 A 和 C 结合使用时是正确的。Transit Gateway 的工作方式是将 spoke networks（例如 VPC 和 VPN）attach 到 transit gateway。AWS 白皮书描述了将包括 VPN 在内的所有混合连接附加到单个 gateway，并通过 hub-and-spoke 模型连接 VPC（[AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。AWS 文档还明确说明，Site-to-Site VPN attachment 可以连接到 transit gateway，以连接 VPC 和本地网络（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN attachments in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpn-attachments.html)）。在 TGW route tables 能够控制它们之间的连接之前，需要将相关 VPC 和 VPN attach 到 TGW。

- **C. Set up transit gateway route tables. Associate the VPCs and VPNs with the route tables.**  
  这是正确的。Transit gateway route tables 是控制哪些已附加网络可以相互路由的机制。AWS 文档说明，应使用 transit gateway route tables 为 transit gateway attachments 配置路由，并且 route tables 指示流量如何在 VPC 和 VPN 之间路由。文档还指出，VPC、VPN、Direct Connect gateway、peering 以及其他 attachments 可以与 transit gateway route tables 关联（[Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)）。通过使用单独的 TGW route tables 以及选择性的 association/propagation/static routes，公司可以控制哪些 VPC 可以与哪些其他 VPC 以及本地网络通信。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **D. Configure VPC peering between the VPCs.**  
  对于数百个 VPC，这不是运维工作量最少的方案。VPC peering 创建点对点关系，并不能提供 Transit Gateway 所提供的集中式 hub-and-spoke 路由控制。对于数百个 VPC，与共享 Transit Gateway 相比，peering 会产生显著的运维复杂性。

- **E. Configure attachments between the VPCs and VPNs.**  
  这是措辞错误，也是错误的架构。你不会在 VPC 和 VPN *之间* 创建 attachments。你是将 VPC 和 VPN **attach 到 transit gateway**，然后使用 TGW route tables 控制这些 attachments 之间的流量。官方文档将 VPN attachments 描述为连接到 transit gateway，而不是直接连接在 VPC 和 VPN 之间（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN attachments in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpn-attachments.html)）。

- **F. Set up route tables on the VPCs and VPNs.**  
  VPC route tables 必须有到 transit gateway 的路由，才能让流量离开 VPC，但此选项不能提供所请求的、用于控制哪些 VPC 可以与其他 VPC 通信的集中式控制。在此场景中，所需的控制点是 **transit gateway route table**，因为 AWS 文档指出，TGW route tables 为 TGW attachments 配置路由，并在 VPC 和 VPN 之间路由流量（[Transit gateway route tables in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)）。VPN 也不是以该选项所描述的同样方式通过“VPN route tables”来管理的。

因此，最佳组合是 **A、B 和 C**。

en.question: A company needs to optimize the cost of its application on AWS. The application uses AWS Lambda functions and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) containers that run on AWS Fargate. The application is write-heavy and stores data in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The load on the application is not consistent. The application experiences long periods of no usage, followed by sudden and significant increases and decreases in traffic. The database runs on a memory optimized DB instance that cannot handle the load. A solutions architect must design a solution that can scale to handle the changes in traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Add additional read replicas to the database. Purchase Instance Savings Plans and RDS Reserved Instances.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Aurora DB cluster that has multiple writer instances. Purchase Instance Savings Plans.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Aurora global database. Purchase Compute Savings Plans and RDS Reserved instances.
options.D: Migrate the database to Aurora Serverless v1. Purchase Compute Savings Plans.

en.explanation:
The application tier is already serverless/elastic (Lambda and ECS on Fargate), but the database is a provisioned Aurora MySQL instance that is write-heavy and has long idle periods followed by sudden spikes. The question asks for the most cost-effective way to make the database and compute costs align with this highly variable traffic pattern.

**Correct answer: D. Migrate the database to Aurora Serverless v1. Purchase Compute Savings Plans.**

Aurora Serverless is the best fit for the database requirement because AWS describes Aurora serverless as suitable for **variable workloads** with sudden, unpredictable increases in activity. It automatically scales database capacity up for peak load and scales back down after the surge, so you do not need to provision for peak or average capacity. AWS also states that Aurora serverless is cost-effective during low activity because it avoids overprovisioning and charges for consumed database resources on a per-second basis ([Aurora serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)).

Compute Savings Plans are also appropriate for the application layer because AWS states that Compute Savings Plans apply to **AWS Fargate and AWS Lambda usage** ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html); [Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). Therefore, D addresses both parts of the cost-optimization problem: elastic database capacity for spiky/idle database usage and discounted committed pricing for the Lambda/Fargate compute layer.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Add additional read replicas to the database. Purchase Instance Savings Plans and RDS Reserved Instances.**  
  This workload is described as **write-heavy** and the current memory-optimized DB instance cannot handle the load. Aurora Replicas are reader instances; AWS documents that the primary writer performs data modifications while Aurora Replicas support read operations only ([Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)). Adding read replicas would not solve a write bottleneck. RDS Reserved Instances also imply paying for provisioned capacity, which is less cost-effective for long periods of no usage.

* **B. Migrate the database to an Aurora DB cluster that has multiple writer instances. Purchase Instance Savings Plans.**  
  A standard Aurora DB cluster has **one primary writer DB instance** and reader instances that are read-only ([Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)). This option also does not address the long idle periods cost-effectively, because provisioned writers would still be paid for even when the application has no usage.

* **C. Migrate the database to an Aurora global database. Purchase Compute Savings Plans and RDS Reserved Instances.**  
  Aurora Global Database is designed for globally distributed applications, low-latency global reads, and disaster recovery. AWS states that an Aurora global database has one primary Region where writes occur and read-only secondary Regions; only the primary cluster performs write operations ([Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). This does not solve the core problem of a spiky, write-heavy workload in the most cost-effective way and would add cross-Region database infrastructure and reserved capacity.

Therefore, **D** is the most cost-effective choice among the options.

zh.question: 一家公司需要优化其在 AWS 上的应用程序成本。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数以及在 AWS Fargate 上运行的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 容器。该应用程序写入负载很重，并将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库中。应用程序的负载并不稳定。应用程序会经历长时间无人使用，随后流量突然且显著地增加和减少。该数据库运行在一个内存优化型数据库实例上，但该实例无法处理负载。解决方案架构师必须设计一个能够扩展以应对流量变化的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 向数据库添加额外的只读副本。购买 Instance Savings Plans 和 RDS Reserved Instances。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到具有多个写入器实例的 Aurora 数据库集群。购买 Instance Savings Plans。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Aurora global database。购买 Compute Savings Plans 和 RDS Reserved instances。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 Aurora Serverless v1。购买 Compute Savings Plans。

zh.explanation:
应用层已经是无服务器/弹性的（Lambda 和在 Fargate 上运行的 ECS），但数据库是预置的 Aurora MySQL 实例，该数据库写入负载很重，并且会经历长时间空闲后突然出现峰值。问题要求采用最具成本效益的方式，使数据库和计算成本与这种高度可变的流量模式相匹配。

**正确答案：D. 将数据库迁移到 Aurora Serverless v1。购买 Compute Savings Plans。**

Aurora Serverless 最适合数据库需求，因为 AWS 将 Aurora serverless 描述为适用于具有突发、不可预测活动增长的**可变工作负载**。它会自动将数据库容量向上扩展以应对峰值负载，并在流量激增后向下缩减，因此你无需按峰值或平均容量进行预置。AWS 还说明，Aurora serverless 在低活动期间具有成本效益，因为它避免了过度预置，并按秒对消耗的数据库资源收费（[Aurora serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。

Compute Savings Plans 也适用于应用层，因为 AWS 说明 Compute Savings Plans 适用于 **AWS Fargate and AWS Lambda usage**（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)；[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。因此，D 同时解决了成本优化问题的两个部分：为峰值/空闲数据库使用提供弹性数据库容量，并为 Lambda/Fargate 计算层提供承诺使用折扣定价。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

* **A. 向数据库添加额外的只读副本。购买 Instance Savings Plans 和 RDS Reserved Instances。**  
  该工作负载被描述为**写入负载很重**，并且当前的内存优化型数据库实例无法处理负载。Aurora Replicas 是读取器实例；AWS 文档说明，主写入器执行数据修改，而 Aurora Replicas 仅支持读取操作（[Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)）。添加只读副本无法解决写入瓶颈。RDS Reserved Instances 也意味着要为预置容量付费，对于长时间无人使用的情况而言成本效益较低。

* **B. 将数据库迁移到具有多个写入器实例的 Aurora 数据库集群。购买 Instance Savings Plans。**  
  标准 Aurora 数据库集群有**一个主写入器数据库实例**以及只读的读取器实例（[Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)）。此选项也无法以具有成本效益的方式解决长时间空闲问题，因为即使应用程序无人使用，仍然需要为预置的写入器付费。

* **C. 将数据库迁移到 Aurora global database。购买 Compute Savings Plans 和 RDS Reserved Instances。**  
  Aurora Global Database 专为全球分布式应用程序、低延迟全球读取和灾难恢复而设计。AWS 说明，Aurora global database 有一个发生写入的主 Region 和只读的辅助 Region；只有主集群执行写入操作（[Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。这无法以最具成本效益的方式解决峰值波动大、写入负载重的核心问题，并且会增加跨 Region 数据库基础设施和预留容量。

因此，**D** 是这些选项中最具成本效益的选择。

en.question: A company migrated an application to the AWS Cloud. The application runs on two Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Application data is stored in a MySQL database that runs on an additional EC2 instance. The application's use of the database is read-heavy. The application loads static content from Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that are attached to each EC2 instance. The static content is updated frequently and must be copied to each EBS volume. The load on the application changes throughout the day. During peak hours, the application cannot handle all the incoming requests. Trace data shows that the database cannot handle the read load during peak hours. Which solution will improve the reliability of the application?

options.A: Migrate the application to a set of AWS Lambda functions. Set the Lambda functions as targets for the ALB. Create a new single EBS volume for the static content. Configure the Lambda functions to read from the new EBS volume. Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster.
options.B: Migrate the application to a set of AWS Step Functions state machines. Set the state machines as targets for the ALCreate an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for the static content. Configure the state machines to read from the EFS file system. Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless v2 with a reader DB instance.
options.C: Containerize the application. Migrate the application to an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Use the AWS Fargate launch type for the tasks that host the application. Create a new single EBS volume for the static content. Mount the new EBS volume on the ECS cluster. Configure AWS Application Auto Scaling on the ECS cluster. Set the ECS service as a target for the ALB. Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster.
options.D: Containerize the application. Migrate the application to an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Use the AWS Fargate launch type for the tasks that host the application. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for the static content. Mount the EFS file system to each container. Configure AWS Application Auto Scaling on the ECS cluster. Set the ECS service as a target for the ALB. Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless v2 with a reader DB instance.

en.explanation:
The application has three reliability/scaling problems: variable web/application load, frequently updated shared static content, and a read-heavy MySQL database that cannot handle peak read traffic. The best solution must scale the application tier, provide shared file storage that all scaled-out tasks can access, and scale database read capacity.

**Correct answer: D.**

Option D addresses all bottlenecks:

* **Application tier scaling:** Running the application as containers on **Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate** removes the need to manage EC2 capacity for the application tier. ECS Service Auto Scaling uses Application Auto Scaling to automatically increase or decrease the desired number of ECS tasks, and AWS documentation specifically notes that it can add more tasks “to deal with high demand at peak times” ([Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)).
* **Shared static content:** Amazon ECS task definitions can specify **Amazon EFS volumes** and container mount points, which lets each container mount the same shared file system instead of copying static content to separate EBS volumes ([Specify an Amazon EFS file system in an Amazon ECS task definition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specify-efs-config.html)). This fits frequently updated static content that must be available to all application instances/tasks.
* **Database read scaling and variable load:** **Aurora Serverless v2** automatically scales database compute capacity for writers and readers based on load. The documentation states that each Aurora Serverless writer or reader can scale within the configured capacity range, and readers can process read-only statements such as `SELECT` queries ([Aurora Serverless scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)). Aurora also supports Aurora Replicas/reader instances for read scaling; applications typically connect to the reader endpoint so Aurora can spread read-only connections across replicas ([Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). A reader DB instance therefore directly addresses the trace data showing that read load is the database bottleneck.
* **ALB integration:** ECS services can be targets behind an Application Load Balancer. ALB target groups support instance, IP, and Lambda target types, and the documentation also notes ECS can be configured as an ALB target ([ALB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect.** Lambda can be an ALB target, but Lambda functions cannot mount or read from an Amazon EBS volume as proposed. EBS is block storage attached to EC2 instances, not shared file storage for Lambda functions. Also, this option does not solve the shared static content problem appropriately. Although an RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster can improve availability and may provide some read capacity depending on configuration, the Lambda + EBS architecture is not valid.

* **B is incorrect.** AWS Step Functions state machines are not valid ALB target types. ALB target groups support `instance`, `ip`, and `lambda` target types—not Step Functions ([ALB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). Step Functions orchestrates workflows; it is not a direct replacement for a continuously running web application behind an ALB, and state machines do not mount EFS as application file storage in the way containers can.

* **C is incorrect.** Containerizing on ECS/Fargate and using ECS Service Auto Scaling is good, but using a **single EBS volume** for shared static content is not the right shared-storage design. EBS Multi-Attach has important restrictions: a Multi-Attach volume can attach only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, is limited to certain Provisioned IOPS volume types, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers; AWS recommends a clustered file system for such access ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
