options.A: 设置一个 AWS DataSync 代理，将带有该前缀的数据从源 S3 存储桶复制到目标 S3 存储桶。选择在任务中使用所有可用带宽，并监控任务以确保其处于 TRANSFERRING 状态。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在此状态发生变化时发起警报。
options.B: 在第二个账户中，创建另一个 S3 存储桶，用于接收来自拥有最准确数据的雷达站的数据。为这个新的 S3 存储桶设置一条新的复制规则，以便将其复制与其他雷达站分离。监控到目标的最大复制时间。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在时间超过所需阈值时发起警报。
options.C: 在源 S3 存储桶上启用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration，并将拥有最准确数据的雷达站配置为使用新的端点。监控 S3 目标存储桶的 TotalRequestLatency 指标。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在此状态发生变化时发起警报。
options.D: 在源 S3 存储桶上创建一条新的 S3 复制规则，筛选使用拥有最准确数据的雷达站前缀的键。启用 S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC)。监控到目标的最大复制时间。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在时间超过所需阈值时发起警报。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司已经使用 Amazon S3 replication 将所有对象从源存储桶复制到另一个账户中的目标存储桶。新的要求不是重新设计所有摄取或复制流程，而是要**单独监控某一个雷达站前缀在 30 分钟内的复制完成情况**。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 在源 S3 存储桶上创建一条新的 S3 复制规则，筛选使用拥有最准确数据的雷达站前缀的键。启用 S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC)。监控到目标的最大复制时间。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在时间超过所需阈值时发起警报。**

这是最合适的方案，因为雷达站数据可以通过 S3 键前缀来识别。S3 复制规则可以限定为具有特定前缀的对象；AWS 文档展示了为一条其 `Filter` 使用 `Prefix` 的规则启用复制指标，并说明复制规则可以应用于整个存储桶，也可以应用于具有特定前缀或标签的对象（[Using S3 Replication metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/repl-metrics.html)）。

S3 Replication Time Control 专为围绕复制时间的合规或业务要求而设计。AWS 表示，S3 RTC 有助于满足合规或业务要求，并提供对复制时间的可见性，可在 15 分钟内复制 99.9% 的对象（[Meeting compliance requirements with S3 Replication Time Control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-time-control.html)）。这比所需的 30 分钟监控目标更有保障。

S3 RTC 还会自动包含 S3 Replication metrics。这些指标包括**到目标 Region 的最大复制时间**，复制指标文档将 **Replication Latency** 定义为对于给定复制规则，目标存储桶落后于源存储桶的最大秒数（[Using S3 Replication metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/repl-metrics.html)）。因此，基于前缀的专用规则可让公司只监控关键雷达站的复制延迟，而不是所有雷达站数据的聚合延迟。

对于告警，CloudWatch 警报状态变化可以发送到 Amazon EventBridge。AWS 文档说明，每当警报更改警报状态时，CloudWatch 都会向 EventBridge 发送事件，而 EventBridge 规则可以执行诸如通知你之类的操作（[Alarm events and EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-and-eventbridge.html)）。因此，针对 S3 复制延迟指标的 CloudWatch 警报可以触发基于 EventBridge 的警报。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. AWS DataSync agent replication

DataSync 是不必要的，而且不太合适。该公司已经部署了 S3 replication，要求是针对由前缀标识的一部分对象监控其及时复制情况。DataSync 任务状态（例如 `TRANSFERRING`）无法提供这里所需的 S3 原生的按复制规则合规可见性或 S3 RTC SLA/阈值行为。它还会引入额外的复制机制，而不是使用现有的 S3 复制配置。

### B. 创建另一个目标存储桶和新的复制规则

在目标账户中创建另一个存储桶是不必要的。要求是为了合规将数据复制到现有目标存储桶，并监控一个雷达站的复制完成情况。S3 复制已经支持按前缀限定范围的规则和按规则的复制指标，因此单独的目标存储桶并不能更直接地解决问题，并且会增加可避免的运营复杂性。

### C. 启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration

S3 Transfer Acceleration 可提高向 S3 端点上传/从 S3 端点下载的数据传输性能，但它不提供 S3 存储桶之间复制时间的合规监控。监控目标存储桶的 `TotalRequestLatency` 测量的是 S3 请求延迟，而不是对象从源存储桶到目标存储桶的端到端复制滞后。该要求专门关注 30 分钟内的复制完成情况，这由 S3 RTC 和 S3 复制指标来解决，而不是 Transfer Acceleration。

## 结论

选项 **D** 是正确的，因为它使用雷达站前缀创建有针对性的 S3 复制规则，启用 S3 RTC 以获得有时间边界的复制可见性，监控该规则特定的复制延迟/最大复制时间，并使用 EventBridge 驱动的告警来处理阈值违规。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. This includes thousands of virtualized Linux and Microsoft Windows servers, SAN storage, Java and PHP applications with MySQL, and Oracle databases. There are many dependent services hosted either in the same data center or externally. The technical documentation is incomplete and outdated. A solutions architect needs to understand the current environment and estimate the cloud resource costs after the migration. Which tools or services should the solutions architect use to plan the cloud migration? (Choose three.)

options.A: AWS Application Discovery Service
options.B: AWS SMS
options.C: AWS X-Ray
options.D: AWS Cloud Adoption Readiness Tool (CART)
options.E: Amazon Inspector
options.F: AWS Migration Hub

en.explanation:
The company is in the **assessment and planning** phase of a large migration. The architect must discover an poorly documented on-premises estate, understand dependencies, assess readiness, and estimate AWS run costs. The best three choices are **A, D, and F**.

## Correct answers

**A. AWS Application Discovery Service**

AWS Application Discovery Service is purpose-built for migration assessment of on-premises environments. The Discovery Agent collects system specifications, utilization/performance data, processes, and TCP network connections from on-premises servers and VMs. AWS documentation states that this information can be used to map IT assets and network dependencies, determine the cost of running the servers in AWS, and plan migration. This directly matches the requirements for thousands of Linux/Windows servers and incomplete documentation. See [AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html).

**D. AWS Cloud Adoption Readiness Tool (CART)**

CART is used for cloud adoption/migration readiness assessment. In the AWS migration readiness guidance, AWS describes readiness assessment as a process for understanding an organization's cloud-readiness strengths and weaknesses and building an action plan to close gaps. That is part of planning a large migration, especially when many organizational, operational, security, and platform dependencies exist. See [Evaluating migration readiness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-readiness/welcome.html).

**F. AWS Migration Hub**

AWS Migration Hub is the central place to view discovery and migration planning data. Its EC2 instance recommendation capability estimates the cost of running existing servers in AWS by analyzing server specifications and CPU/memory utilization data, then recommending the least expensive EC2 instance type that can handle the workload and showing per-hour pricing. This directly satisfies the requirement to estimate cloud resource costs after migration. See [Amazon EC2 instance recommendations in AWS Migration Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/ec2-recommendations.html).

## Incorrect answers

**B. AWS SMS**

AWS Server Migration Service was for replicating/migrating on-premises server VMs to AWS, not for discovery, dependency mapping, readiness assessment, or cost estimation. It is not the right planning tool for understanding the current environment and estimating post-migration costs.

**C. AWS X-Ray**

AWS X-Ray provides distributed tracing for instrumented applications. It collects request data, shows downstream calls, and generates trace maps to identify bottlenecks and latency issues. Although it can show application call paths after instrumentation, it is not a broad migration assessment tool for discovering thousands of servers, SAN storage, databases, utilization, and infrastructure dependencies, nor is it used for migration cost estimation. See [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html).

**E. Amazon Inspector**

Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability management service. It continuously scans eligible AWS resources for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure and generates security findings. It does not discover an on-premises migration portfolio, map application dependencies for migration planning, or estimate AWS resource costs. See [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html).

Therefore, the correct set is **A, D, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。这包括数千台虚拟化的 Linux 和 Microsoft Windows 服务器、SAN 存储、使用 MySQL 的 Java 和 PHP 应用程序，以及 Oracle 数据库。许多依赖服务托管在同一数据中心或外部。技术文档不完整且已过时。一名解决方案架构师需要了解当前环境，并估算迁移后的云资源成本。解决方案架构师应使用哪些工具或服务来规划云迁移？（选择三项。）

options.A: AWS Application Discovery Service
options.B: AWS SMS
options.C: AWS X-Ray
options.D: AWS Cloud Adoption Readiness Tool (CART)
options.E: Amazon Inspector
options.F: AWS Migration Hub

zh.explanation:
该公司处于大型迁移的**评估和规划**阶段。架构师必须发现一个文档很差的本地环境、了解依赖关系、评估就绪情况，并估算 AWS 运行成本。最佳的三个选择是 **A、D 和 F**。

## 正确答案

**A. AWS Application Discovery Service**

AWS Application Discovery Service 专为本地环境的迁移评估而构建。Discovery Agent 会从本地服务器和 VM 收集系统规格、利用率/性能数据、进程以及 TCP 网络连接。AWS 文档说明，这些信息可用于映射 IT 资产和网络依赖关系、确定在 AWS 中运行服务器的成本，并规划迁移。这直接符合数千台 Linux/Windows 服务器和文档不完整的需求。请参阅 [AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)。

**D. AWS Cloud Adoption Readiness Tool (CART)**

CART 用于云采用/迁移就绪情况评估。在 AWS 迁移就绪指南中，AWS 将就绪情况评估描述为了解组织云就绪优势和劣势，并制定行动计划来弥补差距的过程。这是大型迁移规划的一部分，尤其是在存在许多组织、运营、安全和平台依赖关系时。请参阅 [Evaluating migration readiness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-readiness/welcome.html)。

**F. AWS Migration Hub**

AWS Migration Hub 是查看发现和迁移规划数据的中心位置。其 EC2 实例建议功能通过分析服务器规格以及 CPU/内存利用率数据，估算在 AWS 中运行现有服务器的成本，然后推荐能够处理该工作负载的成本最低的 EC2 实例类型，并显示每小时定价。这直接满足了估算迁移后云资源成本的要求。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 instance recommendations in AWS Migration Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub/latest/ug/ec2-recommendations.html)。

## 错误答案

**B. AWS SMS**

AWS Server Migration Service 用于将本地服务器 VM 复制/迁移到 AWS，而不是用于发现、依赖关系映射、就绪情况评估或成本估算。它不是用于了解当前环境并估算迁移后成本的合适规划工具。

**C. AWS X-Ray**

AWS X-Ray 为已检测的应用程序提供分布式跟踪。它收集请求数据、显示下游调用，并生成跟踪映射以识别瓶颈和延迟问题。尽管它可以在检测后显示应用程序调用路径，但它不是用于发现数千台服务器、SAN 存储、数据库、利用率和基础设施依赖关系的广泛迁移评估工具，也不用于迁移成本估算。请参阅 [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)。

**E. Amazon Inspector**

Amazon Inspector 是一项漏洞管理服务。它会持续扫描符合条件的 AWS 资源，以查找软件漏洞和意外网络暴露，并生成安全发现结果。它不会发现本地迁移组合、为迁移规划映射应用程序依赖关系，也不会估算 AWS 资源成本。请参阅 [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)。

因此，正确组合是 **A、D 和 F**。

en.question: A solutions architect is reviewing an application's resilience before launch. The application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that is deployed in a private subnet of a VPC. The EC2 instance is provisioned by an Auto Scaling group that has a minimum capacity of 1 and a maximum capacity of 1. The application stores data on an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The VPC has subnets configured in three Availability Zones and is configured with a single NAT gateway. The solutions architect needs to recommend a solution to ensure that the application will operate across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Deploy an additional NAT gateway in the other Availability Zones. Update the route tables with appropriate routes. Modify the RDS for MySQL DB instance to a Multi-AZ configuration. Configure the Auto Scaling group to launch the instances across Availability Zones. Set the minimum capacity and maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group to 3.
options.B: Replace the NAT gateway with a virtual private gateway. Replace the RDS for MySQL DB instance with an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. Configure the Auto Scaling group to launch instances across all subnets in the VPC. Set the minimum capacity and maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group to 3.
options.C: Replace the NAT gateway with a NAT instance. Migrate the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Launch a new EC2 instance in the other Availability Zones.
options.D: Deploy an additional NAT gateway in the other Availability Zones. Update the route tables with appropriate routes. Modify the RDS for MySQL DB instance to turn on automatic backups and retain the backups for 7 days. Configure the Auto Scaling group to launch instances across all subnets in the VPC. Keep the minimum capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group at 1.

en.explanation:
The application currently has single points of failure at every tier: one EC2 instance in one private subnet, an Auto Scaling group fixed at one instance, a single-AZ RDS for MySQL DB instance, and one NAT gateway. The requirement is to ensure the application operates across multiple Availability Zones, so the solution must make the compute, database, and outbound connectivity layers resilient across AZs.

**Correct answer: A**

Option A is correct because it addresses all relevant layers:

* **NAT gateway layer:** AWS states that each NAT gateway is created in a specific Availability Zone and is redundant only within that zone. If resources in multiple AZs share one NAT gateway and that NAT gateway's AZ is unavailable, resources in the other AZs lose internet access. AWS recommends creating a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone and configuring routes so resources use the NAT gateway in the same AZ ([NAT gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-basics.html)).
* **Database layer:** Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments provision and maintain a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone. This protects against DB instance failure and Availability Zone disruption. The documentation specifically includes MySQL among engines that support this Multi-AZ failover model ([Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
* **Compute layer:** EC2 Auto Scaling can span multiple Availability Zones. AWS documentation explains that, for geographic redundancy, you should span the Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs; if one AZ becomes unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ and redistributes instances when the AZ recovers ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). Setting the minimum and maximum capacity to 3, with subnets in three AZs, allows the application instances to run across the three AZs rather than being limited to one instance.

Therefore, A is the only option that makes NAT, RDS, and EC2 Auto Scaling operate across multiple Availability Zones.

**Why the other options are incorrect**

* **B is incorrect.** A virtual private gateway is used for VPN or Direct Connect connectivity to external networks; it is not a replacement for a NAT gateway that provides outbound internet access for instances in private subnets. Replacing RDS MySQL with Aurora MySQL is not required to satisfy the stated requirement, and the NAT layer would not be correctly handled.
* **C is incorrect.** A NAT instance is not an improvement over a NAT gateway for managed AZ resilience and would introduce more operational responsibility. Migrating from MySQL to PostgreSQL is unrelated to the multi-AZ resilience requirement. Manually launching EC2 instances outside the Auto Scaling group also does not provide proper managed Auto Scaling resilience.
* **D is incorrect.** Additional NAT gateways are appropriate, but enabling automatic backups with a 7-day retention period is not the same as RDS Multi-AZ high availability or automatic failover. Also, keeping the Auto Scaling group minimum and maximum at 1 means the compute tier still runs only one instance at a time and does not operate across multiple AZs concurrently.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在应用程序上线前审查其弹性。该应用程序运行在一个 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例部署在 VPC 的私有子网中。该 EC2 实例由一个 Auto Scaling 组预置，该组的最小容量为 1，最大容量为 1。该应用程序将数据存储在一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例上。该 VPC 在三个可用区中配置了子网，并配置了一个 NAT 网关。解决方案架构师需要推荐一种解决方案，以确保应用程序能够跨多个可用区运行。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 在其他可用区中部署额外的 NAT 网关。使用适当的路由更新路由表。将 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例修改为 Multi-AZ 配置。配置 Auto Scaling 组以跨可用区启动实例。将 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量和最大容量设置为 3。
options.B: 将 NAT 网关替换为虚拟私有网关。将 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例替换为 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群。配置 Auto Scaling 组以在 VPC 的所有子网中启动实例。将 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量和最大容量设置为 3。
options.C: 将 NAT 网关替换为 NAT 实例。将 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例迁移到 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。在其他可用区中启动新的 EC2 实例。
options.D: 在其他可用区中部署额外的 NAT 网关。使用适当的路由更新路由表。修改 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例以启用自动备份，并将备份保留 7 天。配置 Auto Scaling 组以在 VPC 的所有子网中启动实例。将 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量和最大容量保持为 1。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序当前在每一层都有单点故障：一个私有子网中的一个 EC2 实例、固定为一个实例的 Auto Scaling 组、单可用区的 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例，以及一个 NAT 网关。要求是确保应用程序跨多个可用区运行，因此解决方案必须让计算层、数据库层和出站连接层都具备跨 AZ 的弹性。

**正确答案：A**

选项 A 正确，因为它解决了所有相关层面：

* **NAT 网关层：** AWS 表示，每个 NAT 网关都在特定可用区中创建，并且只在该可用区内具备冗余。如果多个 AZ 中的资源共享一个 NAT 网关，而该 NAT 网关所在的 AZ 不可用，则其他 AZ 中的资源会失去互联网访问能力。AWS 建议在每个可用区中创建一个 NAT 网关，并配置路由，使资源使用同一 AZ 中的 NAT 网关（[NAT gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-basics.html)）。
* **数据库层：** Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 数据库实例部署会在不同的可用区中预置并维护一个同步备用副本。这可以防范数据库实例故障和可用区中断。文档明确将 MySQL 列为支持这种 Multi-AZ 故障转移模型的引擎之一（[Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
* **计算层：** EC2 Auto Scaling 可以跨多个可用区。AWS 文档说明，为了实现地理冗余，应让 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 AZ；如果某个 AZ 变为不正常，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例，并在该 AZ 恢复后重新分布实例（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。在三个 AZ 中有子网的情况下，将最小容量和最大容量设置为 3，可以使应用程序实例跨三个 AZ 运行，而不是被限制为一个实例。

因此，A 是唯一让 NAT、RDS 和 EC2 Auto Scaling 跨多个可用区运行的选项。

**其他选项为何不正确**

* **B 不正确。** 虚拟私有网关用于通过 VPN 或 Direct Connect 连接到外部网络；它不能替代为私有子网中实例提供出站互联网访问的 NAT 网关。将 RDS MySQL 替换为 Aurora MySQL 并不是满足所述要求所必需的，而且 NAT 层也没有得到正确处理。
* **C 不正确。** 对于托管的 AZ 弹性而言，NAT 实例并不比 NAT 网关更好，并且会带来更多运维责任。从 MySQL 迁移到 PostgreSQL 与多 AZ 弹性要求无关。在 Auto Scaling 组之外手动启动 EC2 实例也无法提供适当的托管 Auto Scaling 弹性。
* **D 不正确。** 添加 NAT 网关是合适的，但启用自动备份并设置 7 天保留期并不等同于 RDS Multi-AZ 高可用性或自动故障转移。此外，将 Auto Scaling 组的最小值和最大值保持为 1，意味着计算层仍然一次只运行一个实例，并不会同时跨多个 AZ 运行。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate its on-premises transaction-processing application to AWS. The application runs inside Docker containers that are hosted on VMs in the company's data center. The Docker containers have shared storage where the application records transaction data. The transactions are time sensitive. The volume of transactions inside the application is unpredictable. The company must implement a low-latency storage solution that will automatically scale throughput to meet increased demand. The company cannot develop the application further and cannot continue to administer the Docker hosting environment. How should the company migrate the application to AWS to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the containers that run the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon S3 to store the transaction data that the containers share.
options.B: Migrate the containers that run the application to AWS Fargate for Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Create a Fargate task definition. Add a volume to the task definition to point to the EFS file system.
options.C: Migrate the containers that run the application to AWS Fargate for Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Create a Fargate task definition. Attach the EBS volume to each running task.
options.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances. Install Docker on the EC2 instances. Migrate the containers to the EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Add a mount point to the EC2 instances for the EFS file system.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company is migrating a Docker-containerized transaction-processing application that currently uses **shared storage**. The target solution must:

- run containers without the company administering the Docker host environment,
- provide shared, persistent storage for multiple containers/tasks,
- support low-latency access for time-sensitive transaction data,
- automatically scale throughput for unpredictable transaction volume.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Migrate the containers to AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS and mount an Amazon EFS file system in the Fargate task definition.**

This is the best fit because **AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS** runs containers without requiring the company to provision, configure, or scale EC2 container hosts. The AWS documentation states that with Fargate, you can run containers “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances,” and no longer need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters for containers ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

For the shared storage requirement, Amazon ECS supports **Amazon EFS volumes** for Fargate tasks. The ECS storage documentation describes Amazon EFS volumes as “simple, scalable, and persistent shared file storage” for ECS tasks that grows and shrinks automatically. It also specifically says EFS supports concurrency and is useful for horizontally scaled containerized applications that need “low latency, high throughput, and read-after-write consistency” ([Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)).

For unpredictable, spiky transaction volume, Amazon EFS supports throughput modes including **Elastic throughput**. The EFS performance documentation says Elastic throughput is recommended for spiky or unpredictable workloads, and that EFS automatically scales throughput performance up or down to meet workload activity ([Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)). This directly matches the requirement to automatically scale throughput for increased demand.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Amazon EKS with Amazon S3

Amazon EKS would still require operating a Kubernetes-based hosting environment, which does not best satisfy the requirement that the company cannot continue administering the Docker hosting environment. More importantly, Amazon S3 is object storage, not a shared POSIX-style file system that containers can mount as shared storage for low-latency transactional writes. The ECS/EFS documentation identifies EFS—not S3—as the appropriate shared file storage option for containers that need concurrency, low latency, high throughput, and read-after-write consistency ([Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)).

### C. AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS with Amazon EBS attached to each task

Fargate is appropriate for removing host administration, but Amazon EBS is not the right shared storage solution for multiple horizontally scaled container tasks. EBS provides block storage for a task, not a shared file system across all running tasks. The ECS storage options distinguish EBS as block storage, while EFS is the persistent shared file storage option that supports concurrency and horizontally scaled containerized applications ([Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)). Therefore, EBS does not satisfy the shared-storage requirement in the same way EFS does.

### D. EC2 instances with Docker and EFS

Using Amazon EFS would satisfy the shared storage requirement, but launching EC2 instances and installing Docker means the company would continue administering the container hosting environment. This violates the requirement that the company cannot continue to administer the Docker hosting environment. Fargate is the managed/serverless container option that removes the need to provision, configure, and scale container host VMs ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

## Conclusion

Option **B** is correct because it combines **AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS** for serverless container hosting with **Amazon EFS** for shared, persistent, low-latency storage whose throughput can automatically scale for unpredictable workloads.

zh.question: 一家公司计划将其本地事务处理应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序在 Docker 容器中运行，这些容器托管在公司数据中心的 VM 上。Docker 容器具有共享存储，应用程序在其中记录事务数据。这些事务对时间敏感。应用程序内的事务量不可预测。公司必须实施一种低延迟存储解决方案，该解决方案将自动扩展吞吐量以满足增长的需求。公司无法进一步开发该应用程序，也无法继续管理 Docker 托管环境。公司应如何将应用程序迁移到 AWS 以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将运行该应用程序的容器迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。使用 Amazon S3 存储容器共享的事务数据。
options.B: 将运行该应用程序的容器迁移到适用于 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 的 AWS Fargate。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。创建一个 Fargate 任务定义。向任务定义添加一个卷，以指向该 EFS 文件系统。
options.C: 将运行该应用程序的容器迁移到适用于 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 的 AWS Fargate。创建一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。创建一个 Fargate 任务定义。将该 EBS 卷附加到每个正在运行的任务。
options.D: 启动 Amazon EC2 实例。在 EC2 实例上安装 Docker。将容器迁移到 EC2 实例。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。为 EC2 实例添加该 EFS 文件系统的挂载点。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

公司正在迁移一个 Docker 容器化的事务处理应用程序，该应用程序当前使用 **共享存储**。目标解决方案必须：

- 运行容器，而无需公司管理 Docker 主机环境，
- 为多个容器/任务提供共享的持久存储，
- 为时间敏感的事务数据支持低延迟访问，
- 针对不可预测的事务量自动扩展吞吐量。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 将容器迁移到适用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate，并在 Fargate 任务定义中挂载 Amazon EFS 文件系统。**

这是最合适的选择，因为 **适用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate** 可以运行容器，而无需公司预置、配置或扩展 EC2 容器主机。AWS 文档说明，使用 Fargate，你可以“无需管理服务器或 Amazon EC2 实例集群”即可运行容器，并且不再需要为容器预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

对于共享存储要求，Amazon ECS 支持用于 Fargate 任务的 **Amazon EFS 卷**。ECS 存储文档将 Amazon EFS 卷描述为适用于 ECS 任务的“简单、可扩展且持久的共享文件存储”，并且可以自动增长和缩减。文档还特别说明，EFS 支持并发，适用于需要“低延迟、高吞吐量和写后读一致性”的横向扩展容器化应用程序（[Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)）。

对于不可预测的突发事务量，Amazon EFS 支持包括 **Elastic throughput** 在内的吞吐量模式。EFS 性能文档说明，Elastic throughput 推荐用于突发或不可预测的工作负载，并且 EFS 会自动向上或向下扩展吞吐量性能以满足工作负载活动（[Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。这直接匹配了为增长的需求自动扩展吞吐量的要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. Amazon EKS 与 Amazon S3

Amazon EKS 仍然需要运行基于 Kubernetes 的托管环境，这并不能最好地满足公司无法继续管理 Docker 托管环境的要求。更重要的是，Amazon S3 是对象存储，而不是容器可以作为共享存储挂载以进行低延迟事务写入的共享 POSIX 风格文件系统。ECS/EFS 文档指出，对于需要并发、低延迟、高吞吐量和写后读一致性的容器，EFS（而不是 S3）才是合适的共享文件存储选项（[Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)）。

### C. 适用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate 与附加到每个任务的 Amazon EBS

Fargate 适合用于消除主机管理，但 Amazon EBS 不是适用于多个横向扩展容器任务的正确共享存储解决方案。EBS 为任务提供块存储，而不是跨所有正在运行任务的共享文件系统。ECS 存储选项将 EBS 区分为块存储，而 EFS 是支持并发和横向扩展容器化应用程序的持久共享文件存储选项（[Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)）。因此，EBS 不能像 EFS 一样满足共享存储要求。

### D. 使用 Docker 和 EFS 的 EC2 实例

使用 Amazon EFS 可以满足共享存储要求，但启动 EC2 实例并安装 Docker 意味着公司将继续管理容器托管环境。这违反了公司无法继续管理 Docker 托管环境的要求。Fargate 是托管/无服务器容器选项，可消除预置、配置和扩展容器主机 VM 的需要（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

## 结论

选项 **B** 正确，因为它结合了用于无服务器容器托管的 **适用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate** 和用于共享、持久、低延迟存储的 **Amazon EFS**，其吞吐量可以针对不可预测的工作负载自动扩展。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company hosts many applications on Windows servers and Linux servers. Some of the servers are physical, and some of the servers are virtual. The company uses several types of databases in its on-premises environment. The company does not have an accurate inventory of its on-premises servers and applications. The company wants to rightsize its resources during migration. A solutions architect needs to obtain information about the network connections and the application relationships. The solutions architect must assess the company’s current environment and develop a migration plan. Which solution will provide the solutions architect with the required information to develop the migration plan?

options.A: Use Migration Evaluator to request an evaluation of the environment from AWS. Use the AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector to import the details into a Migration Evaluator Quick Insights report.
options.B: Use AWS Migration Hub and install the AWS Application Discovery Agent on the servers. Deploy the Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations application data collector. Generate a report by using Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations.
options.C: Use AWS Migration Hub and run the AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector on the servers. Group the servers and databases by using AWS Application Migration Service. Generate a report by using Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations.
options.D: Use the AWS Migration Hub import tool to load the details of the company’s on-premises environment. Generate a report by using Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations.

en.explanation:
The company needs a discovery and assessment approach for a mixed on-premises estate: Windows and Linux, physical and virtual servers, and multiple database types. The key requirements are to build an inventory, capture **network connections and application relationships**, collect utilization data for **rightsizing**, and produce migration strategy recommendations.

**Correct answer: B. Use AWS Migration Hub and install the AWS Application Discovery Agent on the servers. Deploy the Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations application data collector. Generate a report by using Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations.**

AWS Application Discovery Agent is the right discovery mechanism for this scenario because it is installed on on-premises servers and VMs and collects the data needed for dependency mapping and rightsizing. AWS documentation states that the agent collects “system specifications,” “utilization or performance data,” “network connections,” and “process data,” and that this information can be used to map IT assets and network dependencies and help determine AWS running costs and migration planning ([AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)). The same documentation clarifies that the term host includes either a **physical server or a VM**, and the collected data includes TCP network connections, process data, CPU, disk, memory, and network utilization metrics ([AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)).

The Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations application data collector complements this by collecting OS, application, and database-level data. AWS documentation says the collector identifies running applications, performs source code analysis, and analyzes databases, and its collected data includes OS details, whether the server is a VM or physical machine, application type/framework/runtime data, and database type/version ([Strategy Recommendations application data collector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub-strategy/latest/userguide/application-data-collector.html)). This combination provides the required migration assessment and planning report.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect.** Migration Evaluator and an agentless collection approach are not sufficient for the stated requirements. The environment includes physical servers and requires network connection and application relationship details. AWS compares Agentless Collector and Discovery Agent and shows that Agentless Collector does **not** support physical servers, while Discovery Agent does. The comparison also shows the Discovery Agent supports running process collection, while Agentless Collector does not ([What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)).

* **C is incorrect.** The AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector is not run “on the servers” as an installed per-server agent; for VMware discovery it is loaded as an on-premises appliance into vCenter. More importantly, AWS documentation states that Agentless Collector cannot “look inside” VMs to determine running processes or network connections in the same way needed for deeper migration planning, and the comparison table shows it does not support physical servers ([What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)). In addition, AWS Application Migration Service is not the service used to group discovered servers and databases to generate Strategy Recommendations reports.

* **D is incorrect.** Importing data into Migration Hub requires that the company already have details of the on-premises environment. The question explicitly says the company does **not** have an accurate inventory. Also, the AWS comparison table shows that the Migration Hub import/template method provides a single snapshot and does not collect server network connections or running processes, which are required here ([What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)).

Therefore, option **B** is the best fit because it uses the Discovery Agent for physical/virtual server inventory, utilization, process, and network dependency data, and Strategy Recommendations for application/database analysis and migration planning.

zh.question: 一家公司计划迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司在 Windows 服务器和 Linux 服务器上托管了许多应用程序。其中一些服务器是物理服务器，一些服务器是虚拟服务器。该公司在本地环境中使用多种类型的数据库。该公司没有其本地服务器和应用程序的准确清单。该公司希望在迁移期间合理调整资源大小。解决方案架构师需要获取有关网络连接和应用程序关系的信息。解决方案架构师必须评估公司的当前环境并制定迁移计划。哪种解决方案将为解决方案架构师提供制定迁移计划所需的信息？

options.A: 使用 Migration Evaluator 向 AWS 请求对环境进行评估。使用 AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector 将详细信息导入 Migration Evaluator Quick Insights 报告。
options.B: 使用 AWS Migration Hub，并在服务器上安装 AWS Application Discovery Agent。部署 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 应用程序数据收集器。使用 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 生成报告。
options.C: 使用 AWS Migration Hub，并在服务器上运行 AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector。使用 AWS Application Migration Service 对服务器和数据库进行分组。使用 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 生成报告。
options.D: 使用 AWS Migration Hub 导入工具加载公司本地环境的详细信息。使用 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 生成报告。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一种发现和评估方法来处理混合本地资产：Windows 和 Linux、物理服务器和虚拟服务器，以及多种数据库类型。关键要求是建立清单、捕获**网络连接和应用程序关系**、收集用于**合理调整大小**的利用率数据，并生成迁移策略建议。

**正确答案：B。使用 AWS Migration Hub，并在服务器上安装 AWS Application Discovery Agent。部署 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 应用程序数据收集器。使用 Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 生成报告。**

AWS Application Discovery Agent 是此场景中合适的发现机制，因为它安装在本地服务器和 VM 上，并收集依赖关系映射和合理调整大小所需的数据。AWS 文档说明，该代理会收集 “system specifications”、“utilization or performance data”、“network connections” 和 “process data”，并且这些信息可用于映射 IT 资产和网络依赖关系，并帮助确定 AWS 运行成本和迁移规划（[AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)）。同一文档还说明，术语 host 包括**物理服务器或 VM**，收集的数据包括 TCP 网络连接、进程数据、CPU、磁盘、内存和网络利用率指标（[AWS Application Discovery Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/discovery-agent.html)）。

Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations 应用程序数据收集器通过收集操作系统、应用程序和数据库级别的数据来补充这一点。AWS 文档指出，该收集器会识别正在运行的应用程序、执行源代码分析并分析数据库，其收集的数据包括操作系统详细信息、服务器是 VM 还是物理机、应用程序类型/框架/运行时数据，以及数据库类型/版本（[Strategy Recommendations application data collector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/migrationhub-strategy/latest/userguide/application-data-collector.html)）。这种组合提供了所需的迁移评估和规划报告。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A 不正确。** Migration Evaluator 和无代理收集方法不足以满足所述要求。该环境包含物理服务器，并且需要网络连接和应用程序关系详细信息。AWS 对 Agentless Collector 和 Discovery Agent 进行了比较，并显示 Agentless Collector **不**支持物理服务器，而 Discovery Agent 支持。该比较还显示 Discovery Agent 支持收集正在运行的进程，而 Agentless Collector 不支持（[What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)）。

* **C 不正确。** AWS Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector 并不是作为安装在每台服务器上的代理在“服务器上”运行；对于 VMware 发现，它是作为本地设备加载到 vCenter 中。更重要的是，AWS 文档说明 Agentless Collector 无法像更深入的迁移规划所需的那样“查看” VM 内部以确定正在运行的进程或网络连接，并且比较表显示它不支持物理服务器（[What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)）。此外，AWS Application Migration Service 不是用于对已发现的服务器和数据库进行分组以生成 Strategy Recommendations 报告的服务。

* **D 不正确。** 将数据导入 Migration Hub 要求公司已经拥有本地环境的详细信息。题目明确说明该公司**没有**准确的清单。此外，AWS 比较表显示 Migration Hub 导入/模板方法提供的是单次快照，并不会收集服务器网络连接或正在运行的进程，而这些正是此处所需的（[What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)）。

因此，选项 **B** 最合适，因为它使用 Discovery Agent 获取物理/虚拟服务器清单、利用率、进程和网络依赖关系数据，并使用 Strategy Recommendations 进行应用程序/数据库分析和迁移规划。

en.question: A financial services company sells its software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for application compliance to large global banks. The SaaS platform runs on AWS and uses multiple AWS accounts that are managed in an organization in AWS Organizations. The SaaS platform uses many AWS resources globally. For regulatory compliance, all API calls to AWS resources must be audited, tracked for changes, and stored in a durable and secure data store. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a new AWS CloudTrail trail. Use an existing Amazon S3 bucket in the organization's management account to store the logs. Deploy the trail to all AWS Regions. Enable MFA delete and encryption on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a new AWS CloudTrail trail in each member account of the organization. Create new Amazon S3 buckets to store the logs. Deploy the trail to all AWS Regions. Enable MFA delete and encryption on the S3 buckets.
options.C: Create a new AWS CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with versioning turned on to store the logs. Deploy the trail for all accounts in the organization. Enable MFA delete and encryption on the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a new AWS CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Create a new Amazon S3 bucket to store the logs. Configure Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send log- file delivery notifications to an external management system that will track the logs. Enable MFA delete and encryption on the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
### Scenario and requirement
The company has many AWS accounts in AWS Organizations and many AWS resources across Regions. It needs centralized auditing of AWS API activity, change tracking, and durable/secure storage with the **least operational overhead**.

### Correct answer: C
**C. Create a new AWS CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with versioning turned on to store the logs. Deploy the trail for all accounts in the organization. Enable MFA delete and encryption on the S3 bucket.**

This is the best fit because it uses a **CloudTrail organization trail**. AWS documentation states that an organization trail logs events for the management account and **all member accounts** in the organization, and delivers those events to the same destinations such as an S3 bucket. The management account or a delegated administrator can create and manage such trails. CloudTrail also notes that organization trails created in the console are multi-Region organization trails that log events from enabled Regions in each member account, which matches the global AWS resource requirement ([CloudTrail: Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html), [CloudTrail concepts: Organization trails](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-concepts.html)).

Using a **single centralized S3 bucket** also follows CloudTrail security best practices. AWS recommends logging CloudTrail data to a dedicated and centralized S3 bucket, creating an organization trail when using AWS Organizations, and creating a dedicated S3 bucket for the trail. AWS also recommends encryption for CloudTrail logs and enabling MFA delete on the S3 bucket that stores log files to help prevent operations that could compromise the logs ([CloudTrail security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/best-practices-security.html)). S3 MFA delete requires MFA to change bucket versioning state or permanently delete an object version, adding protection for audit logs ([S3 MFA delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)).

Therefore, option C provides organization-wide, multi-Region CloudTrail logging with centralized, durable, encrypted, versioned, MFA-protected storage and minimal administration.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Incorrect**
This creates a trail in the management account and deploys it to all Regions, but it does **not** specify applying the trail to the organization/all accounts. A multi-Region trail for one account captures activity across Regions for that account, but the requirement is to audit API calls across **multiple AWS accounts** in AWS Organizations. Also, using an existing bucket is less aligned with CloudTrail best practice than using a dedicated centralized bucket for audit logs.

**B. Incorrect**
Creating separate CloudTrail trails and S3 buckets in each member account would work only with significant operational overhead. It requires configuring, securing, monitoring, and maintaining trails and buckets across every account and Region. AWS organization trails are designed to provide a uniform logging strategy across all accounts with much less operational burden.

**D. Incorrect**
This option creates a trail in the management account and an S3 bucket, but it does not state that the trail is deployed for all accounts in the organization. Adding SNS notifications to an external management system does not satisfy the core requirement more directly than CloudTrail organization trails with centralized S3 storage. SNS notifications can notify about log file delivery, but they are not needed to durably store and protect the audit log files, and they add operational complexity rather than reducing it.

zh.question: 一家金融服务公司向大型全球银行销售其用于应用程序合规性的 software-as-a-service (SaaS) 平台。该 SaaS 平台运行在 AWS 上，并使用多个 AWS 账户，这些账户在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中进行管理。该 SaaS 平台在全球使用许多 AWS 资源。出于法规合规要求，所有对 AWS 资源的 API 调用都必须被审计、跟踪变更，并存储在持久且安全的数据存储中。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。使用组织管理账户中的现有 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储日志。将该跟踪部署到所有 AWS 区域。在 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete 和加密。
options.B: 在组织的每个成员账户中创建一个新的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。创建新的 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储日志。将该跟踪部署到所有 AWS 区域。在 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete 和加密。
options.C: 在组织的管理账户中创建一个新的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。创建一个启用了版本控制的新 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储日志。为组织中的所有账户部署该跟踪。在 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete 和加密。
options.D: 在组织的管理账户中创建一个新的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。创建一个新的 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储日志。配置 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)，向将跟踪日志的外部管理系统发送日志文件传送通知。在 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete 和加密。

zh.explanation:
### 场景和要求
该公司在 AWS Organizations 中拥有许多 AWS 账户，并且在多个区域中拥有许多 AWS 资源。它需要集中审计 AWS API 活动、跟踪变更，并以**最少的运营开销**进行持久/安全的存储。

### 正确答案：C
**C. 在组织的管理账户中创建一个新的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。创建一个启用了版本控制的新 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储日志。为组织中的所有账户部署该跟踪。在 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete 和加密。**

这是最合适的，因为它使用了 **CloudTrail organization trail**。AWS 文档说明，organization trail 会记录组织中管理账户和**所有成员账户**的事件，并将这些事件传送到相同的目标，例如 S3 存储桶。管理账户或委派管理员可以创建和管理此类跟踪。CloudTrail 还指出，在控制台中创建的 organization trail 是多区域 organization trail，会记录每个成员账户中已启用区域的事件，这符合全球 AWS 资源的要求（[CloudTrail: Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html)，[CloudTrail concepts: Organization trails](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-concepts.html)）。

使用**单个集中式 S3 存储桶**也符合 CloudTrail 安全最佳实践。AWS 建议将 CloudTrail 数据记录到专用且集中的 S3 存储桶，在使用 AWS Organizations 时创建 organization trail，并为该跟踪创建专用 S3 存储桶。AWS 还建议对 CloudTrail 日志进行加密，并在存储日志文件的 S3 存储桶上启用 MFA delete，以帮助防止可能损害日志的操作（[CloudTrail security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/best-practices-security.html)）。S3 MFA delete 要求使用 MFA 才能更改存储桶版本控制状态或永久删除对象版本，从而为审计日志增加保护（[S3 MFA delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)）。

因此，选项 C 提供了组织范围、多区域的 CloudTrail 日志记录，以及集中式、持久、加密、已版本控制、受 MFA 保护的存储，并且管理工作量最小。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 不正确**
此选项在管理账户中创建一个跟踪并将其部署到所有区域，但它**没有**说明将该跟踪应用于组织/所有账户。单个账户的多区域跟踪会捕获该账户跨区域的活动，但要求是审计 AWS Organizations 中**多个 AWS 账户**的 API 调用。此外，与为审计日志使用专用的集中式存储桶相比，使用现有存储桶不太符合 CloudTrail 最佳实践。

**B. 不正确**
在每个成员账户中创建单独的 CloudTrail 跟踪和 S3 存储桶只有在付出大量运营开销的情况下才可行。它需要在每个账户和区域中配置、保护、监控和维护跟踪与存储桶。AWS organization trail 旨在以更低的运营负担在所有账户中提供统一的日志记录策略。

**D. 不正确**
此选项在管理账户中创建一个跟踪和一个 S3 存储桶，但没有说明该跟踪会部署到组织中的所有账户。向外部管理系统添加 SNS 通知，并不比使用集中式 S3 存储的 CloudTrail organization trail 更直接地满足核心要求。SNS 通知可以通知日志文件传送情况，但对于持久存储和保护审计日志文件并不是必需的，并且它会增加运营复杂性，而不是降低复杂性。

en.question: A company is deploying a distributed in-memory database on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The fleet consists of a primary node and eight worker nodes. The primary node is responsible for monitoring cluster health, accepting user requests, distributing user requests to worker nodes, and sending an aggregate response back to a client. Worker nodes communicate with each other to replicate data partitions. The company requires the lowest possible networking latency to achieve maximum performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.
options.B: Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.
options.C: Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.
options.D: Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a spread placement group.

en.explanation:
### Scenario and requirement

The company is deploying a **distributed in-memory database** on EC2: one primary node and eight worker nodes. The workers replicate data partitions with each other, and the primary coordinates requests and returns aggregated responses. The key requirement is **the lowest possible networking latency** and maximum performance between EC2 instances.

### Correct answer: C. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.

A **cluster placement group** is the placement strategy designed for this requirement. AWS states that instances in a cluster placement group are placed in the same high-bisection-bandwidth network segment, and that cluster placement groups are recommended for applications that benefit from **low network latency**, **high network throughput**, or both—especially when most traffic is between instances in the group ([AWS EC2 placement strategies: Cluster placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)).

Because the workload is an **in-memory database**, the instance family should be selected for memory-intensive requirements. AWS EC2 documentation explains that instance types provide different combinations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity and should be selected based on the application requirements; the EC2 instance types documentation also identifies memory optimized families such as R, X, and U families ([AWS EC2 instance types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-types.html)).

Therefore, **memory optimized instances in a cluster placement group** best match both parts of the requirement: memory capacity for an in-memory database and lowest-latency/high-throughput networking between nodes.

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.**  
  Memory optimized instances are appropriate, but a **partition placement group** is primarily for reducing correlated hardware failures by spreading instances across logical partitions with separate racks, power, and network. AWS describes partition placement groups as useful for large distributed and replicated workloads such as HDFS, HBase, and Cassandra, but their purpose is failure-domain isolation and topology awareness—not the lowest possible latency ([AWS EC2 placement strategies: Partition placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)).

- **B. Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.**  
  This is wrong for two reasons. First, the workload is an **in-memory database**, so memory optimized instances are a better fit than compute optimized instances. Second, a partition placement group is not the placement strategy optimized for the lowest possible network latency; a cluster placement group is.

- **D. Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a spread placement group.**  
  A **spread placement group** places instances on distinct hardware to reduce the risk of simultaneous failures. AWS recommends it for a small number of critical instances that should be kept separate, not for applications requiring the lowest inter-instance latency. Additionally, rack-level spread placement groups have a limit of seven running instances per Availability Zone, while this fleet has nine nodes if deployed together in one low-latency group ([AWS EC2 placement strategies: Spread placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)). Compute optimized instances are also not the best match for an in-memory database.

### Final answer

**C. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.**

zh.question: 一家公司正在一组 Amazon EC2 实例上部署分布式内存数据库。该实例组由一个主节点和八个工作节点组成。主节点负责监控集群运行状况、接受用户请求、将用户请求分发给工作节点，并将聚合响应发送回客户端。工作节点彼此通信以复制数据分区。公司要求尽可能低的网络延迟以实现最高性能。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 partition placement group 中启动 memory optimized EC2 instances。
options.B: 在 partition placement group 中启动 compute optimized EC2 instances。
options.C: 在 cluster placement group 中启动 memory optimized EC2 instances。
options.D: 在 spread placement group 中启动 compute optimized EC2 instances。

zh.explanation:
### 场景和要求

该公司正在 EC2 上部署一个 **分布式内存数据库**：一个主节点和八个工作节点。工作节点彼此复制数据分区，主节点协调请求并返回聚合响应。关键要求是在 EC2 实例之间实现 **尽可能低的网络延迟** 和最高性能。

### 正确答案：C. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.

**cluster placement group** 是为此类要求设计的放置策略。AWS 表示，cluster placement group 中的实例会被放置在同一个高双向带宽网络段中，并且建议将 cluster placement group 用于可从 **低网络延迟**、**高网络吞吐量** 或二者同时受益的应用程序，尤其是在大部分流量都发生在组内实例之间时（[AWS EC2 placement strategies: Cluster placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。

由于该工作负载是 **内存数据库**，应选择适合内存密集型需求的实例系列。AWS EC2 文档说明，实例类型提供不同组合的 CPU、内存、存储和网络容量，应根据应用程序需求进行选择；EC2 实例类型文档还列出了 memory optimized 系列，例如 R、X 和 U 系列（[AWS EC2 instance types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-types.html)）。

因此，**cluster placement group 中的 memory optimized instances** 最符合这两部分要求：为内存数据库提供内存容量，并在节点之间提供最低延迟/高吞吐量网络。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

- **A. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.**  
  Memory optimized instances 是合适的，但 **partition placement group** 主要用于通过将实例分散到具有独立机架、电源和网络的逻辑分区中，来降低相关硬件故障的风险。AWS 将 partition placement groups 描述为适用于大型分布式和复制型工作负载（例如 HDFS、HBase 和 Cassandra），但其目的在于故障域隔离和拓扑感知，而不是尽可能低的延迟（[AWS EC2 placement strategies: Partition placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。

- **B. Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.**  
  这有两个错误。首先，该工作负载是 **内存数据库**，因此 memory optimized instances 比 compute optimized instances 更合适。其次，partition placement group 不是针对尽可能低网络延迟优化的放置策略；cluster placement group 才是。

- **D. Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a spread placement group.**  
  **spread placement group** 将实例放置在不同硬件上，以降低同时发生故障的风险。AWS 建议将其用于少量需要彼此隔离的关键实例，而不是用于要求最低实例间延迟的应用程序。此外，机架级 spread placement groups 在每个可用区中最多只能有七个正在运行的实例，而如果该实例组一起部署在一个低延迟组中，则共有九个节点（[AWS EC2 placement strategies: Spread placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。Compute optimized instances 也不是内存数据库的最佳匹配。

### 最终答案

**C. Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.**

en.question: A company maintains information on premises in approximately 1 million.csv files that are hosted on a VM. The data initially is 10 TB in size and grows at a rate of 1 TB each week. The company needs to automate backups of the data to the AWS Cloud. Backups of the data must occur daily. The company needs a solution that applies custom filters to back up only a subset of the data that is located in designated source directories. The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection. Which solution will meet the backup requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use the Amazon S3 CopyObject API operation with multipart upload to copy the existing data to Amazon S3. Use the CopyObject API operation to replicate new data to Amazon S3 daily.
options.B: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup to back up the data to Amazon S3. Schedule the backup plan to run daily.
options.C: Install the AWS DataSync agent as a VM that runs on the on-premises hypervisor. Configure a DataSync task to replicate the data to Amazon S3 daily.
options.D: Use an AWS Snowball Edge device for the initial backup. Use AWS DataSync for incremental backups to Amazon S3 daily.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has about 10 TB of on-premises file data in ~1 million CSV files, growing by 1 TB per week. It needs automated daily copies to AWS, but only for selected subsets in designated source directories, and it already has AWS Direct Connect connectivity. The key selection criteria are: on-premises file transfer, Amazon S3 as the cloud target, daily automation, custom include/exclude filtering, and least operational overhead.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Install the AWS DataSync agent as a VM that runs on the on-premises hypervisor. Configure a DataSync task to replicate the data to Amazon S3 daily.**

AWS DataSync is the best fit because it is designed to automate high-speed data movement between on-premises storage and AWS storage services. The DataSync documentation states that a DataSync agent is needed for transfers between AWS storage services and on-premises storage, and the agent can be deployed as a VM on VMware, KVM, or Hyper-V hypervisors ([DataSync agent requirement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html), [deploying DataSync agents](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/deploy-agents.html)).

DataSync can use Amazon S3 as a transfer source or destination location ([DataSync transfers with Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)). It also supports the important filtering requirement: DataSync lets you apply include and exclude filters to transfer specific files, objects, and folders, including specific source folders such as `/important_folder1|/important_folder2` ([DataSync filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/filtering.html)).

For ongoing backups, DataSync tasks can be configured with task options such as what files to transfer and when the task runs; the service also supports recurring transfers that move only data changed since the last transfer ([DataSync task options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-options.html), [creating a DataSync task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-task-how-to.html)). This meets the daily automation requirement with low operational overhead: after deploying the agent and creating the S3 location and task, DataSync handles the managed transfer process.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Use the S3 CopyObject API operation with multipart upload

This is not appropriate for on-premises VM files. `CopyObject` is an S3 API operation for copying objects within S3, not for discovering and transferring millions of local files from an on-premises VM. Implementing daily file discovery, filtering, incremental detection, multipart upload logic, retries, verification, and scheduling would require significant custom scripting and operational management. It also does not natively satisfy the custom source-directory filtering requirement with least overhead.

### B. Create a backup plan in AWS Backup to back up the data to Amazon S3

AWS Backup is a managed backup service, but it protects supported AWS resources and specific supported applications/resource types. The supported resources list includes resources such as Amazon S3 data, EBS, EFS, FSx, Storage Gateway volumes, and certain VMware environments, but it does not describe a generic on-premises VM file directory as a direct source to be backed up into S3 ([AWS Backup supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). Also, the question requires custom filters to back up only a subset of files in designated directories; DataSync directly supports include/exclude filters for this use case.

### D. Use Snowball Edge for the initial backup and DataSync for daily incremental backups

Snowball Edge can be useful when network transfer is impractical, but this company already has AWS Direct Connect and the initial dataset is 10 TB. Using a physical Snowball Edge device adds procurement, shipping, loading, and import steps. Since DataSync can perform the initial transfer and the recurring daily incremental transfers over the existing network connection, Snowball Edge adds unnecessary operational overhead.

## Conclusion

**DataSync with an on-premises VM agent, an S3 destination, filters, and a scheduled recurring task is the lowest-operational-overhead solution. Therefore, the correct answer is C.**

zh.question: 一家公司在本地维护约 100 万个托管在 VM 上的 .csv 文件中的信息。数据初始大小为 10 TB，并以每周 1 TB 的速度增长。公司需要将数据备份到 AWS Cloud 的过程自动化。数据备份必须每天进行。公司需要一种解决方案，可以应用自定义筛选器，仅备份位于指定源目录中的数据子集。公司已经建立了 AWS Direct Connect 连接。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维开销满足备份要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 CopyObject API 操作并结合分段上传，将现有数据复制到 Amazon S3。使用 CopyObject API 操作每天将新数据复制到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 在 AWS Backup 中创建备份计划，将数据备份到 Amazon S3。计划该备份计划每天运行。
options.C: 将 AWS DataSync 代理安装为运行在本地虚拟机监控程序上的 VM。配置 DataSync 任务，每天将数据复制到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 使用 AWS Snowball Edge 设备进行初始备份。使用 AWS DataSync 每天将增量备份到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司有大约 10 TB 的本地文件数据，包含约 100 万个 CSV 文件，并且每周增长 1 TB。它需要每天自动复制到 AWS，但只复制指定源目录中的选定数据子集，并且已经具备 AWS Direct Connect 连接。关键选择标准是：本地文件传输、将 Amazon S3 作为云端目标、每日自动化、自定义包含/排除筛选，以及最少运维开销。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 将 AWS DataSync 代理安装为运行在本地虚拟机监控程序上的 VM。配置 DataSync 任务，每天将数据复制到 Amazon S3。**

AWS DataSync 最适合此场景，因为它旨在自动化本地存储与 AWS 存储服务之间的高速数据移动。DataSync 文档指出，在 AWS 存储服务与本地存储之间进行传输需要 DataSync 代理，并且该代理可以作为 VM 部署在 VMware、KVM 或 Hyper-V 虚拟机监控程序上（[DataSync agent requirement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html)，[deploying DataSync agents](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/deploy-agents.html)）。

DataSync 可以使用 Amazon S3 作为传输源或目标位置（[DataSync transfers with Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)）。它还支持重要的筛选要求：DataSync 允许你应用包含和排除筛选器，以传输特定文件、对象和文件夹，包括特定源文件夹，例如 `/important_folder1|/important_folder2`（[DataSync filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/filtering.html)）。

对于持续备份，可以为 DataSync 任务配置任务选项，例如要传输哪些文件以及任务何时运行；该服务还支持定期传输，只移动自上次传输以来发生变化的数据（[DataSync task options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-options.html)，[creating a DataSync task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-task-how-to.html)）。这以较低运维开销满足了每日自动化要求：在部署代理并创建 S3 位置和任务后，DataSync 会处理托管传输过程。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用 S3 CopyObject API 操作并结合分段上传

这不适用于本地 VM 文件。`CopyObject` 是用于在 S3 内部复制对象的 S3 API 操作，而不是用于发现并传输本地 VM 上数百万个本地文件。实现每日文件发现、筛选、增量检测、分段上传逻辑、重试、验证和计划需要大量自定义脚本和运维管理。它也无法以最少开销原生满足自定义源目录筛选要求。

### B. 在 AWS Backup 中创建备份计划，将数据备份到 Amazon S3

AWS Backup 是一种托管备份服务，但它保护的是受支持的 AWS 资源以及特定受支持的应用程序/资源类型。受支持资源列表包括 Amazon S3 数据、EBS、EFS、FSx、Storage Gateway 卷以及某些 VMware 环境等资源，但并未将通用的本地 VM 文件目录描述为可直接备份到 S3 的源（[AWS Backup supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。此外，题目要求使用自定义筛选器仅备份指定目录中的文件子集；DataSync 直接支持用于此用例的包含/排除筛选器。

### D. 使用 Snowball Edge 进行初始备份，并使用 DataSync 进行每日增量备份

当网络传输不可行时，Snowball Edge 可能很有用，但该公司已经具备 AWS Direct Connect，并且初始数据集为 10 TB。使用物理 Snowball Edge 设备会增加采购、运输、加载和导入步骤。由于 DataSync 可以通过现有网络连接执行初始传输和定期每日增量传输，因此 Snowball Edge 增加了不必要的运维开销。

## 结论

**使用带有本地 VM 代理、S3 目标、筛选器和计划定期任务的 DataSync，是运维开销最低的解决方案。因此，正确答案是 C。**

en.question: A financial services company has an asset management product that thousands of customers use around the world. The customers provide feedback about the product through surveys. The company is building a new analytical solution that runs on Amazon EMR to analyze the data from these surveys. The following user personas need to access the analytical solution to perform different actions: • Administrator: Provisions the EMR cluster for the analytics team based on the team’s requirements • Data engineer: Runs ETL scripts to process, transform, and enrich the datasets • Data analyst: Runs SQL and Hive queries on the data A solutions architect must ensure that all the user personas have least privilege access to only the resources that they need. The user personas must be able to launch only applications that are approved and authorized. The solution also must ensure tagging for all resources that the user personas create. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create IAM roles for each user persona. Attach identity-based policies to define which actions the user who assumes the role can perform. Create an AWS Config rule to check for noncompliant resources. Configure the rule to notify the administrator to remediate the noncompliant resources.
options.B: Setup Kerberos-based authentication for EMR clusters upon launch. Specify a Kerberos security configuration along with cluster-specific Kerberos options.
options.C: Use AWS Service Catalog to control the Amazon EMR versions available for deployment, the cluster configuration, and the permissions for each user persona.
options.D: Launch the EMR cluster by using AWS CloudFormation, Attach resource-based policies to the EMR cluster during cluster creation. Create an AWS. Config rule to check for noncompliant clusters and noncompliant Amazon S3 buckets. Configure the rule to notify the administrator to remediate the noncompliant resources.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs a governed self-service analytics platform on Amazon EMR for multiple personas: an administrator who provisions clusters, data engineers who run ETL, and data analysts who run SQL/Hive queries. The key requirements are:

- least-privilege access by persona,
- users can launch only approved/authorized applications and configurations,
- EMR versions and cluster configuration must be controlled,
- resources created by users must be tagged.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Use AWS Service Catalog to control the Amazon EMR versions available for deployment, the cluster configuration, and the permissions for each user persona.**

AWS Service Catalog is designed for exactly this kind of governed self-service provisioning. The documentation states that Service Catalog lets organizations create and manage catalogs of **approved IT services** and that end users can deploy **only the approved IT services** they need, under organizational constraints ([What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)).

Service Catalog also supports the persona-based access model required in the question. Administrators create products and portfolios, configure constraints, and manage IAM roles, while end users launch only products to which they have been granted access ([Overview of Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/what-is_concepts.html)). Portfolios can be customized per user type, and permissions, sharing, and constraints help ensure that users launch products configured according to organizational standards.

For least privilege, Service Catalog launch constraints allow an administrator to specify an IAM role that Service Catalog assumes when a user launches, updates, or terminates a product. The documentation explicitly says this lets you restrict end-user permissions to the minimum required for the product rather than giving users direct permissions to the underlying AWS services ([AWS Service Catalog Launch Constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/constraints-launch.html)).

For tagging, Service Catalog provides a TagOption library. TagOptions are associated with portfolios and products, and during product launch Service Catalog aggregates the associated TagOptions and applies them to the provisioned product. The documentation says this helps enforce a consistent taxonomy, proper tagging, and defined user-selectable allowed tags ([AWS Service Catalog TagOption Library](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/tagoptions.html)).

Therefore, Service Catalog can package the approved EMR cluster templates, versions, configurations, launch roles, persona-specific portfolios, constraints, and tagging controls in one governed solution.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. IAM roles plus AWS Config remediation notification

IAM roles and identity-based policies are necessary for least privilege, but by themselves they do not provide a curated catalog of approved EMR cluster configurations, EMR versions, or authorized applications. AWS Config can detect noncompliant resources after creation, but the requirement is to ensure users can launch only approved applications and ensure tagging for resources they create. A post-creation compliance notification does not prevent users from launching unapproved configurations in the first place.

### B. Kerberos-based authentication for EMR clusters

Kerberos is useful for authentication to EMR clusters. The EMR documentation describes Kerberos as a network authentication protocol that allows users and services to authenticate, and EMR can configure Kerberos for applications and components installed on the cluster ([Use Kerberos for authentication with Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-kerberos.html)). However, Kerberos does not provide a catalog of approved EMR versions, approved cluster templates, persona-specific provisioning permissions, or resource tagging enforcement. It addresses authentication, not the broader governance and provisioning requirements.

### D. CloudFormation with resource-based policies and AWS Config

CloudFormation can provision an EMR cluster from a template, but this option does not provide the Service Catalog governance layer: portfolios, product versions, persona-based product access, template constraints, launch constraints, and TagOptions. Also, relying on AWS Config to detect noncompliant clusters or S3 buckets is reactive rather than preventive. The question requires users to launch only approved/authorized applications and ensure tagging at creation time, which is better met by Service Catalog-controlled products and constraints.

zh.question: 一家金融服务公司有一款资产管理产品，全球有数千名客户使用。客户通过调查问卷提供对该产品的反馈。公司正在构建一个运行在 Amazon EMR 上的新分析解决方案，用于分析这些调查数据。以下用户角色需要访问该分析解决方案以执行不同操作：• 管理员：根据分析团队的需求预置 EMR 集群 • 数据工程师：运行 ETL 脚本来处理、转换和丰富数据集 • 数据分析师：对数据运行 SQL 和 Hive 查询解决方案架构师必须确保所有用户角色都只能以最低权限访问其所需的资源。用户角色必须只能启动已批准和授权的应用程序。该解决方案还必须确保对用户角色创建的所有资源进行标记。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个用户角色创建 IAM 角色。附加基于身份的策略，以定义代入该角色的用户可以执行哪些操作。创建 AWS Config 规则来检查不合规资源。将该规则配置为通知管理员修复不合规资源。
options.B: 在启动 EMR 集群时设置基于 Kerberos 的身份验证。指定 Kerberos 安全配置以及特定于集群的 Kerberos 选项。
options.C: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 控制可用于部署的 Amazon EMR 版本、集群配置以及每个用户角色的权限。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 启动 EMR 集群，在创建集群期间将基于资源的策略附加到 EMR 集群。创建 AWS Config 规则来检查不合规集群和不合规的 Amazon S3 存储桶。将该规则配置为通知管理员修复不合规资源。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要一个在 Amazon EMR 上面向多个角色的受治理自助式分析平台：预置集群的管理员、运行 ETL 的数据工程师，以及运行 SQL/Hive 查询的数据分析师。关键要求包括：

- 按角色实现最低权限访问，
- 用户只能启动已批准/授权的应用程序和配置，
- 必须控制 EMR 版本和集群配置，
- 用户创建的资源必须被标记。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 使用 AWS Service Catalog 控制可用于部署的 Amazon EMR 版本、集群配置以及每个用户角色的权限。**

AWS Service Catalog 正是为这种受治理的自助式预置场景而设计的。文档说明，Service Catalog 使组织能够创建和管理**已批准 IT 服务**的目录，并且最终用户只能在组织约束下部署他们需要的**已批准 IT 服务**（[什么是 Service Catalog？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。

Service Catalog 还支持题目所要求的基于角色的访问模型。管理员创建产品和组合、配置约束并管理 IAM 角色，而最终用户只能启动已被授予访问权限的产品（[Service Catalog 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/what-is_concepts.html)）。可以按用户类型自定义组合，并且权限、共享和约束有助于确保用户启动的产品按照组织标准配置。

对于最低权限，Service Catalog 启动约束允许管理员指定一个 IAM 角色，Service Catalog 会在用户启动、更新或终止产品时代入该角色。文档明确说明，这使你能够将最终用户权限限制为产品所需的最低权限，而不是授予用户对底层 AWS 服务的直接权限（[AWS Service Catalog 启动约束](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/constraints-launch.html)）。

对于标记，Service Catalog 提供 TagOption 库。TagOptions 与组合和产品关联，在产品启动期间，Service Catalog 会聚合关联的 TagOptions 并将其应用到预置产品。文档说明，这有助于强制执行一致的分类法、正确的标记以及定义好的用户可选择允许标签（[AWS Service Catalog TagOption 库](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/tagoptions.html)）。

因此，Service Catalog 可以在一个受治理的解决方案中打包已批准的 EMR 集群模板、版本、配置、启动角色、特定于角色的组合、约束和标记控制。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. IAM 角色加 AWS Config 修复通知

IAM 角色和基于身份的策略对于最低权限是必要的，但它们本身并不提供已批准 EMR 集群配置、EMR 版本或授权应用程序的精选目录。AWS Config 可以在创建后检测不合规资源，但要求是确保用户只能启动已批准的应用程序，并确保对其创建的资源进行标记。创建后的合规性通知无法从一开始就阻止用户启动未经批准的配置。

### B. EMR 集群的基于 Kerberos 的身份验证

Kerberos 对 EMR 集群身份验证很有用。EMR 文档将 Kerberos 描述为一种网络身份验证协议，允许用户和服务进行身份验证，并且 EMR 可以为集群上安装的应用程序和组件配置 Kerberos（[将 Kerberos 用于 Amazon EMR 身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-kerberos.html)）。但是，Kerberos 不提供已批准 EMR 版本、已批准集群模板、特定于角色的预置权限或资源标记强制执行的目录。它解决的是身份验证，而不是更广泛的治理和预置要求。

### D. CloudFormation 结合基于资源的策略和 AWS Config

CloudFormation 可以从模板预置 EMR 集群，但此选项不提供 Service Catalog 治理层：组合、产品版本、基于角色的产品访问、模板约束、启动约束和 TagOptions。此外，依赖 AWS Config 检测不合规集群或 S3 存储桶是被动的，而不是预防性的。题目要求用户只能启动已批准/授权的应用程序，并在创建时确保标记，这更适合通过 Service Catalog 控制的产品和约束来满足。

en.question: A software as a service (SaaS) company uses AWS to host a service that is powered by AWS PrivateLink. The service consists of proprietary software that runs on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The instances are in private subnets in multiple Availability Zones in the eu-west-2 Region. All the company's customers are in eu-west-2. However, the company now acquires a new customer in the us-east-1 Region. The company creates a new VPC and new subnets in us-east-1. The company establishes inter-Region VPC peering between the VPCs in the two Regions. The company wants to give the new customer access to the SaaS service, but the company does not want to immediately deploy new EC2 resources in us-east-1. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a PrivateLink endpoint service in us-east-1 to use the existing NLB that is in eu-west-2. Grant specific AWS accounts access to connect to the SaaS service.
options.B: Create an NLB in us-east-1. Create an IP target group that uses the IP addresses of the company's instances in eu-west-2 that host the SaaS service. Configure a PrivateLink endpoint service that uses the NLB that is in us-east-1. Grant specific AWS accounts access to connect to the SaaS service.
options.C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances in eu-west-2. Create an NLB in us-east-1. Associate the NLB that is in us-east-1 with an ALB target group that uses the ALB that is in eu-west-2. Configure a PrivateLink endpoint service that uses the NLB that is in us-east-1. Grant specific AWS accounts access to connect to the SaaS service.
options.D: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the EC2 instances that are in eu-west-2. In us-east-1, create an NLB and an instance target group that includes the shared EC2 instances from eu-west-2. Configure a PrivateLink endpoint service that uses the NLB that is in us-east-1. Grant specific AWS accounts access to connect to the SaaS service.

en.explanation:
The company needs to make an existing AWS PrivateLink-powered SaaS service available to a new customer in `us-east-1` without deploying new EC2 instances there. Because the service instances remain in `eu-west-2` and the company has already established inter-Region VPC peering, the correct solution is to place the PrivateLink-facing load balancer in `us-east-1` and register the existing service instances by private IP address.

**Correct answer: B. Create an NLB in `us-east-1`. Create an IP target group that uses the IP addresses of the company's instances in `eu-west-2` that host the SaaS service. Configure a PrivateLink endpoint service that uses the NLB that is in `us-east-1`. Grant specific AWS accounts access to connect to the SaaS service.**

AWS PrivateLink endpoint services require a Network Load Balancer or Gateway Load Balancer; the load balancer receives requests from service consumers and routes them to the service targets. The PrivateLink documentation also states that an endpoint service is available in the Region where it is created, and the service provider creates/selects a Network Load Balancer for that endpoint service ([Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)).

For the backend target registration, Network Load Balancer target groups support the `ip` target type, where targets are specified by IP address ([Target groups for your Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). AWS specifically states that instances in a peered VPC, including a VPC peered in a different Region, cannot be registered by instance ID, but they **can be registered by IP address** ([Register targets for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/target-group-register-targets.html)). Therefore, a `us-east-1` NLB can use an IP target group containing the private IP addresses of the existing `eu-west-2` EC2 instances, with connectivity provided by the inter-Region VPC peering connection.

The company can then configure the `us-east-1` NLB as the front end for a PrivateLink endpoint service and grant the new customer's AWS account permission to connect. PrivateLink endpoint service permissions are used to allow specific AWS principals to create interface endpoints to the service ([Configure an endpoint service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/configure-endpoint-service.html)). This meets the requirement without deploying new EC2 resources in `us-east-1`.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A is incorrect** because it proposes creating a PrivateLink endpoint service in `us-east-1` that directly uses the existing NLB in `eu-west-2`. An endpoint service is created in a Region and uses load balancer resources for that service configuration; the documented PrivateLink cross-Region model is that a provider can host a service in one Region and make it available in supported Regions, while the consumer selects a service Region when creating the endpoint ([Share your services through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-share-your-services.html)). The option does not describe that model; it describes associating a `us-east-1` endpoint service directly with a `eu-west-2` NLB.

* **C is incorrect** because it adds an ALB in front of the existing instances and then attempts to use that ALB as the target of an NLB in another Region. Although an NLB can use an ALB as a target, AWS requires the NLB and ALB to be in the same VPC and account for this configuration ([Use an Application Load Balancer as a target of a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/application-load-balancer-target.html)). This does not match the cross-Region design in the question and is unnecessary when IP target registration is supported.

* **D is incorrect** because an instance target group registers targets by instance ID. AWS states that when registering targets by instance ID, the instances must be in the same VPC as the Network Load Balancer, and instances in a peered VPC in the same or a different Region cannot be registered by instance ID; they must be registered by IP address instead ([Register targets for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/target-group-register-targets.html)). AWS RAM sharing does not make `eu-west-2` EC2 instances valid instance-ID targets for a `us-east-1` NLB.

zh.question: 一家软件即服务（SaaS）公司使用 AWS 托管一项由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的服务。该服务由在 Network Load Balancer（NLB）后面的三台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的专有软件组成。这些实例位于 eu-west-2 区域中多个可用区的私有子网内。该公司的所有客户都在 eu-west-2。但是，该公司现在在 us-east-1 区域获得了一位新客户。该公司在 us-east-1 中创建了新的 VPC 和新的子网。该公司在两个区域的 VPC 之间建立了跨区域 VPC 对等连接。该公司希望让新客户访问该 SaaS 服务，但不希望立即在 us-east-1 中部署新的 EC2 资源。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 us-east-1 中配置 PrivateLink 端点服务，以使用 eu-west-2 中现有的 NLB。授予特定 AWS 账户访问权限以连接到该 SaaS 服务。
options.B: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 NLB。创建一个 IP 目标组，使用公司在 eu-west-2 中托管该 SaaS 服务的实例的 IP 地址。配置一个 PrivateLink 端点服务，使用位于 us-east-1 中的 NLB。授予特定 AWS 账户访问权限以连接到该 SaaS 服务。
options.C: 在 eu-west-2 中的 EC2 实例前面创建一个 Application Load Balancer（ALB）。在 us-east-1 中创建一个 NLB。将 us-east-1 中的 NLB 与使用 eu-west-2 中 ALB 的 ALB 目标组关联。配置一个 PrivateLink 端点服务，使用位于 us-east-1 中的 NLB。授予特定 AWS 账户访问权限以连接到该 SaaS 服务。
options.D: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager（AWS RAM）共享位于 eu-west-2 中的 EC2 实例。在 us-east-1 中，创建一个 NLB 和一个实例目标组，其中包含来自 eu-west-2 的共享 EC2 实例。配置一个 PrivateLink 端点服务，使用位于 us-east-1 中的 NLB。授予特定 AWS 账户访问权限以连接到该 SaaS 服务。

zh.explanation:
公司需要在不在 `us-east-1` 部署新的 EC2 实例的情况下，让一项现有的由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的 SaaS 服务可供 `us-east-1` 中的新客户使用。由于服务实例仍保留在 `eu-west-2`，并且公司已建立跨区域 VPC 对等连接，因此正确的解决方案是将面向 PrivateLink 的负载均衡器放置在 `us-east-1`，并通过私有 IP 地址注册现有服务实例。

**正确答案：B。在 `us-east-1` 中创建一个 NLB。创建一个 IP 目标组，使用公司在 `eu-west-2` 中托管该 SaaS 服务的实例的 IP 地址。配置一个 PrivateLink 端点服务，使用位于 `us-east-1` 中的 NLB。授予特定 AWS 账户访问权限以连接到该 SaaS 服务。**

AWS PrivateLink 端点服务需要 Network Load Balancer 或 Gateway Load Balancer；负载均衡器接收来自服务使用者的请求，并将其路由到服务目标。PrivateLink 文档还指出，端点服务在其创建所在区域可用，并且服务提供商会为该端点服务创建/选择一个 Network Load Balancer（[Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)）。

对于后端目标注册，Network Load Balancer 目标组支持 `ip` 目标类型，其中目标通过 IP 地址指定（[Target groups for your Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。AWS 明确说明，位于对等 VPC 中的实例（包括位于不同区域中的对等 VPC）不能按实例 ID 注册，但它们**可以按 IP 地址注册**（[Register targets for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/target-group-register-targets.html)）。因此，一个 `us-east-1` NLB 可以使用包含现有 `eu-west-2` EC2 实例私有 IP 地址的 IP 目标组，并由跨区域 VPC 对等连接提供连通性。

然后，公司可以将 `us-east-1` NLB 配置为 PrivateLink 端点服务的前端，并授予新客户的 AWS 账户连接权限。PrivateLink 端点服务权限用于允许特定 AWS 主体创建到该服务的接口端点（[Configure an endpoint service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/configure-endpoint-service.html)）。这满足了无需在 `us-east-1` 部署新的 EC2 资源的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A 不正确**，因为它提议在 `us-east-1` 中创建一个 PrivateLink 端点服务，并直接使用 `eu-west-2` 中现有的 NLB。端点服务在某个区域中创建，并使用该服务配置的负载均衡器资源；文档化的 PrivateLink 跨区域模型是，提供商可以在一个区域托管服务，并使其在受支持的区域中可用，而使用者在创建端点时选择服务区域（[Share your services through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/privatelink-share-your-services.html)）。该选项描述的不是这种模型；它描述的是将 `us-east-1` 端点服务直接与 `eu-west-2` NLB 关联。

* **C 不正确**，因为它在现有实例前面增加了一个 ALB，然后尝试将该 ALB 用作另一区域中 NLB 的目标。虽然 NLB 可以使用 ALB 作为目标，但 AWS 要求在此配置中 NLB 和 ALB 位于同一 VPC 和同一账户（[Use an Application Load Balancer as a target of a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/application-load-balancer-target.html)）。这与题目中的跨区域设计不匹配，并且在支持 IP 目标注册的情况下没有必要。

* **D 不正确**，因为实例目标组按实例 ID 注册目标。AWS 指出，按实例 ID 注册目标时，实例必须与 Network Load Balancer 位于同一 VPC 中；位于同一区域或不同区域的对等 VPC 中的实例不能按实例 ID 注册，而必须改为按 IP 地址注册（[Register targets for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/target-group-register-targets.html)）。AWS RAM 共享不会使 `eu-west-2` EC2 实例成为 `us-east-1` NLB 的有效实例 ID 目标。

en.question: A company needs to monitor a growing number of Amazon S3 buckets across two AWS Regions. The company also needs to track the percentage of objects that are encrypted in Amazon S3.
