**B. From the management account, switch roles to assume the `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` role with the account ID of the new member account. Set up the IAM users as required.**

When AWS Organizations creates a new member account, it automatically creates an IAM role named **`OrganizationAccountAccessRole`** in that member account. AWS documentation states that this role enables users and roles in the management account to exercise full administrative control over the member account, subject to applicable SCPs. It also states that AWS Organizations does **not** create any other users or roles by default besides this role and the root user context for the account.

To access the member account, an IAM principal in the management account must have permission to call `sts:AssumeRole`, and then can switch role into the member account using the account ID and role name. While using the role, actions are performed with the permissions granted by that role, which are administrative by default for `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` in accounts created through Organizations.

Therefore, the correct approach is to sign in as the management account IAM user and **switch role/assume `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`** in the new member account, then create the required IAM users there.

Official documentation support:

- AWS Organizations automatically creates `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` for a newly created member account and gives it full administrative control from the management account: [Creating a member account in an organization with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html).
- To use the role, sign in as a management account user with permission to assume it, then switch role using the member account ID and role name: [Accessing a member account that has OrganizationAccountAccessRole with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_access-cross-account-role.html).
- AWS Organizations does not create other IAM users or roles automatically, and access between accounts requires `sts:AssumeRole`: [Accessing member accounts in an organization with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_access.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Use a 64-character password from the initial Organizations email

This is incorrect. New member accounts created in AWS Organizations do not rely on an emailed 64-character root password for normal administrative access. AWS documentation states that new Organizations member accounts have no root user credentials by default, and root user access is not recommended for everyday administrative tasks. The intended administrative mechanism is the automatically created `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`.

### C. Sign in as the new account root user using the management account root password

This is incorrect. The new member account has its own root identity associated with its account email address; it does not use the management account root password. Also, using root credentials is not the correct or recommended way to administer a newly created Organizations member account.

### D. Sign in using the new account ID and the `Support1` IAM credentials

This is incorrect. The `Support1` IAM user exists in the **management account**, not automatically in the new member account. AWS Organizations does not create IAM users in the new account. The way for `Support1` to administer the new account is to assume the `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`, not to sign in directly to the member account with the same IAM credentials.

## Conclusion

The correct answer is **B** because AWS Organizations creates `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` in newly created member accounts specifically to allow authorized principals from the management account to assume that role and administer the member account.

zh.question: 一家金融公司需要为新的数字钱包应用程序创建一个单独的 AWS 账户。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其账户。解决方案架构师使用管理账户中的 IAM 用户 Support1，使用 [email protected] 作为电子邮件地址创建了一个新的成员账户。解决方案架构师应如何在新的成员账户中创建 IAM 用户？

options.A: 使用发送到 [email protected] 的初始 AWS Organizations 电子邮件中的 64 字符密码，以 AWS 账户根用户凭证登录 AWS Management Console。根据需要设置 IAM 用户。
options.B: 从管理账户切换角色，使用新成员账户的账户 ID 代入 OrganizationAccountAccessRole 角色。根据需要设置 IAM 用户。
options.C: 转到 AWS Management Console 登录页面。选择“使用根账户凭证登录”。使用电子邮件地址 finance [email protected] 和管理账户的根密码登录。根据需要设置 IAM 用户。
options.D: 转到 AWS Management Console 登录页面。使用新成员账户的账户 ID 和 Support1 IAM 凭证登录。根据需要设置 IAM 用户。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和问题

一个新的 AWS Organizations 成员账户由 IAM 用户（`Support1`）从管理账户创建。问题询问解决方案架构师应如何在这个新创建的成员账户中创建 IAM 用户。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 从管理账户切换角色，使用新成员账户的账户 ID 代入 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` 角色。根据需要设置 IAM 用户。**

当 AWS Organizations 创建新的成员账户时，它会在该成员账户中自动创建一个名为 **`OrganizationAccountAccessRole`** 的 IAM 角色。AWS 文档说明，该角色使管理账户中的用户和角色能够对成员账户行使完全的管理控制权，但受适用 SCP 的约束。文档还说明，除了该角色和账户的根用户上下文之外，AWS Organizations 默认不会创建任何其他用户或角色。

要访问成员账户，管理账户中的 IAM 主体必须具有调用 `sts:AssumeRole` 的权限，然后可以使用账户 ID 和角色名称切换角色进入成员账户。在使用该角色时，操作会以该角色授予的权限执行；对于通过 Organizations 创建的账户中的 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`，默认具有管理权限。

因此，正确做法是以管理账户 IAM 用户身份登录，并在新的成员账户中**切换角色/代入 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`**，然后在其中创建所需的 IAM 用户。

官方文档支持：

- AWS Organizations 会为新创建的成员账户自动创建 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`，并赋予其从管理账户进行完全管理控制的权限：[Creating a member account in an organization with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html)。
- 要使用该角色，请以具有代入该角色权限的管理账户用户身份登录，然后使用成员账户 ID 和角色名称切换角色：[Accessing a member account that has OrganizationAccountAccessRole with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_access-cross-account-role.html)。
- AWS Organizations 不会自动创建其他 IAM 用户或角色，并且账户之间的访问需要 `sts:AssumeRole`：[Accessing member accounts in an organization with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_access.html)。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用初始 Organizations 电子邮件中的 64 字符密码

这是不正确的。在 AWS Organizations 中创建的新成员账户，正常管理访问并不依赖通过电子邮件发送的 64 字符根密码。AWS 文档说明，新的 Organizations 成员账户默认没有根用户凭证，并且不建议将根用户访问用于日常管理任务。预期的管理机制是自动创建的 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`。

### C. 使用管理账户根密码以新账户根用户身份登录

这是不正确的。新的成员账户有自己的根身份，与其账户电子邮件地址关联；它不使用管理账户的根密码。此外，使用根凭证并不是管理新创建的 Organizations 成员账户的正确或推荐方式。

### D. 使用新账户 ID 和 `Support1` IAM 凭证登录

这是不正确的。`Support1` IAM 用户存在于**管理账户**中，而不会自动存在于新的成员账户中。AWS Organizations 不会在新账户中创建 IAM 用户。`Support1` 管理新账户的方式是代入 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`，而不是使用相同的 IAM 凭证直接登录成员账户。

## 结论

正确答案是 **B**，因为 AWS Organizations 会在新创建的成员账户中创建 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`，其专门用途是允许来自管理账户的授权主体代入该角色并管理成员账户。

en.question: A car rental company has built a serverless REST API to provide data to its mobile app. The app consists of an Amazon API Gateway API with a Regional endpoint, AWS Lambda functions, and an Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless DB cluster. The company recently opened the API to mobile apps of partners. A significant increase in the number of requests resulted, causing sporadic database memory errors. Analysis of the API traffic indicates that clients are making multiple HTTP GET requests for the same queries in a short period of time. Traffic is concentrated during business hours, with spikes around holidays and other events. The company needs to improve its ability to support the additional usage while minimizing the increase in costs associated with the solution. Which strategy meets these requirements?

options.A: Convert the API Gateway Regional endpoint to an edge-optimized endpoint. Enable caching in the production stage.
options.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache to store the results of the database calls. Modify the Lambda functions to use the cache.
options.C: Modify the Aurora Serverless DB cluster configuration to increase the maximum amount of available memory.
options.D: Enable throttling in the API Gateway production stage. Set the rate and burst values to limit the incoming calls.

en.explanation:
The company has a REST API backed by Lambda functions and an Aurora MySQL Serverless cluster. The important traffic pattern is that clients are making many repeated HTTP `GET` requests for the same queries within short time periods. The best strategy is to reduce redundant calls before they reach Lambda and Aurora while keeping the solution cost-effective.

**Correct answer: A. Convert the API Gateway Regional endpoint to an edge-optimized endpoint. Enable caching in the production stage.**

API Gateway caching directly addresses the repeated-request pattern. For REST APIs, API Gateway can cache endpoint responses so that it can respond from the cache instead of making another request to the backend endpoint. This reduces calls to the Lambda integration and therefore reduces repeated reads against Aurora. AWS also notes that when caching is enabled for a stage, `GET` methods have caching enabled by default, which matches the scenario’s repeated HTTP `GET` requests. See [Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html).

Changing to an edge-optimized endpoint is also appropriate for mobile and partner clients that may be geographically distributed. Edge-optimized REST API endpoints route requests to the nearest CloudFront point of presence, which can help for geographically distributed clients. See [API endpoint types for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-endpoint-types.html). The primary database load reduction, however, comes from enabling API Gateway stage caching.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Implement ElastiCache for Redis and modify the Lambda functions to use the cache.** ElastiCache query caching can help read-heavy applications where the same queries are executed repeatedly, as described in [Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html). However, this option adds a separate caching service and requires Lambda application changes. Because the repeated traffic consists of duplicate API `GET` responses, API Gateway caching is the simpler and more cost-conscious fit.

- **C. Modify the Aurora Serverless DB cluster configuration to increase the maximum amount of available memory.** Increasing the database capacity addresses the symptom but not the cause. The same duplicate requests would still invoke Lambda and query Aurora repeatedly, increasing database cost during spikes instead of avoiding redundant work.

- **D. Enable throttling in the API Gateway production stage.** Throttling can protect an API from too many requests, but when requests exceed the configured rate and burst limits, clients can receive `429 Too Many Requests` responses. See [Throttle requests to your REST APIs for better throughput in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html). This would limit or reject partner traffic rather than improve the API’s ability to serve the additional usage efficiently.

Therefore, **Option A** is the best answer because API Gateway caching reduces redundant backend calls for repeated `GET` requests, helping relieve Aurora memory pressure while minimizing additional cost and implementation effort.

zh.question: 一家汽车租赁公司构建了一个无服务器 REST API，用于向其移动应用提供数据。该应用由一个带有 Regional endpoint 的 Amazon API Gateway API、AWS Lambda 函数以及一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless DB 集群组成。该公司最近向合作伙伴的移动应用开放了该 API。结果请求数量显著增加，导致偶发性的数据库内存错误。对 API 流量的分析表明，客户端会在短时间内针对相同查询发出多个 HTTP GET 请求。流量集中在工作时间，并在节假日和其他活动前后出现峰值。公司需要提升其支持额外使用量的能力，同时尽量降低与该解决方案相关的成本增长。哪种策略满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 API Gateway Regional endpoint 转换为 edge-optimized endpoint。在生产阶段启用缓存。
options.B: 实施 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 缓存来存储数据库调用的结果。修改 Lambda 函数以使用该缓存。
options.C: 修改 Aurora Serverless DB 集群配置，以增加可用内存的最大量。
options.D: 在 API Gateway 生产阶段启用限流。设置速率和突发值以限制传入调用。

zh.explanation:
该公司有一个由 Lambda 函数和 Aurora MySQL Serverless 集群支撑的 REST API。重要的流量模式是，客户端会在短时间内针对相同查询发出许多重复的 HTTP `GET` 请求。最佳策略是在这些请求到达 Lambda 和 Aurora 之前减少冗余调用，同时保持解决方案的成本效益。

**正确答案：A. 将 API Gateway Regional endpoint 转换为 edge-optimized endpoint。在生产阶段启用缓存。**

API Gateway 缓存直接解决了重复请求模式。对于 REST API，API Gateway 可以缓存端点响应，从而从缓存中响应，而不是再次向后端端点发出请求。这会减少对 Lambda 集成的调用，因此减少针对 Aurora 的重复读取。AWS 还指出，当为某个阶段启用缓存时，`GET` 方法默认启用缓存，这与场景中的重复 HTTP `GET` 请求相匹配。请参阅 [Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)。

改为 edge-optimized endpoint 也适用于可能在地理上分布的移动和合作伙伴客户端。Edge-optimized REST API 端点会将请求路由到最近的 CloudFront point of presence，这有助于服务地理分布的客户端。请参阅 [API endpoint types for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-endpoint-types.html)。不过，主要的数据库负载降低来自启用 API Gateway 阶段缓存。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 实施 ElastiCache for Redis 并修改 Lambda 函数以使用该缓存。** ElastiCache 查询缓存可以帮助那些重复执行相同查询的读密集型应用程序，如 [Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html) 中所述。然而，该选项增加了一个单独的缓存服务，并且需要修改 Lambda 应用程序。由于重复流量由重复的 API `GET` 响应组成，API Gateway 缓存是更简单且更注重成本的选择。

- **C. 修改 Aurora Serverless DB 集群配置，以增加可用内存的最大量。** 增加数据库容量处理的是症状，而不是原因。相同的重复请求仍然会调用 Lambda 并反复查询 Aurora，在流量峰值期间增加数据库成本，而不是避免冗余工作。

- **D. 在 API Gateway 生产阶段启用限流。** 限流可以保护 API 免受过多请求的影响，但当请求超过配置的速率和突发限制时，客户端可能会收到 `429 Too Many Requests` 响应。请参阅 [Throttle requests to your REST APIs for better throughput in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)。这会限制或拒绝合作伙伴流量，而不是提升 API 高效服务额外使用量的能力。

因此，**选项 A** 是最佳答案，因为 API Gateway 缓存减少了重复 `GET` 请求的冗余后端调用，有助于缓解 Aurora 内存压力，同时尽量降低额外成本和实施工作。

en.question: A company is migrating an on-premises application and a MySQL database to AWS. The application processes highly sensitive data, and new data is constantly updated in the database. The data must not be transferred over the internet. The company also must encrypt the data in transit and at rest. The database is 5 TB in size. The company already has created the database schema in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company has set up a 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection to AWS. The company also has set up a public VIF and a private VIF. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that will migrate the data to AWS with the least possible downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Perform a database backup. Copy the backup files to an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Import the backup to Amazon S3. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) for encryption at rest. Use TLS for encryption in transit. Import the data from Amazon S3 to the DB instance.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the data to AWS. Create a DMS replication instance in a private subnet. Create VPC endpoints for AWS DMS. Configure a DMS task to copy data from the on-premises database to the DB instance by using full load plus change data capture (CDC). Use the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) default key for encryption at rest. Use TLS for encryption in transit.
options.C: Perform a database backup. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the backup files to Amazon S3. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) for encryption at rest. Use TLS for encryption in transit. Import the data from Amazon S3 to the DB instance.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway. Set up a private connection to Amazon S3 by using AWS PrivateLink. Perform a database backup. Copy the backup files to Amazon S3. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) for encryption at rest. Use TLS for encryption in transit. Import the data from Amazon S3 to the DB instance.

en.explanation:
The scenario requires migrating a large (5 TB), continuously changing on-premises MySQL database to an already-created Amazon RDS for MySQL schema, without transferring data over the internet, while encrypting data in transit and at rest, and with the least possible downtime.

**Correct answer: B. Use AWS DMS with full load plus CDC, private networking, KMS at rest, and TLS in transit.**

AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) is designed for this exact type of migration. AWS DMS supports ongoing replication/change data capture (CDC), and the documentation states that a **full load plus CDC** task migrates existing data and then updates the target database based on ongoing changes from the source database. For MySQL sources, AWS DMS reads changes from row-based binary logs and migrates those changes to the target ([AWS DMS CDC documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)). This minimizes downtime because the application can continue writing to the source database while AWS DMS performs the initial load and then catches up with changes before cutover.

The network requirement is also satisfied. A Direct Connect **private virtual interface** is used to access VPC resources using private IP addresses, while a public VIF is for AWS public services ([Direct Connect VIF types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). Placing the DMS replication instance in a private subnet and routing traffic over the private VIF allows database traffic between on premises and the RDS target to avoid the public internet. AWS DMS also supports VPC endpoints to help maintain end-to-end network security, and the documentation notes that using VPC endpoints for source and target endpoints helps ensure traffic remains within the VPC and under your control ([DMS VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_VPC_Endpoints.html)).

The encryption requirements are met as well. AWS DMS supports encryption in transit using SSL/TLS for task connections to source and target endpoints, and supports default or custom AWS KMS keys to encrypt replication storage and connection information ([DMS data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Security.DataProtection.html)). Therefore, using the AWS KMS default key for DMS encryption at rest and TLS for endpoint connections satisfies the security requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Snowball Edge backup/restore through S3** — Snowball can move large data sets offline, but it is a backup-and-restore approach. The source database is constantly changing, and this option does not provide ongoing CDC to keep the RDS target synchronized. It would require more downtime during final backup, transfer, restore, and reconciliation. It also introduces S3 as an intermediate step and does not provide the least possible downtime.

- **C. DataSync backup files to S3** — AWS DataSync can transfer files, but this option still depends on taking database backups and importing them into RDS. It does not continuously replicate database changes from MySQL binary logs, so it cannot minimize downtime for a constantly updated transactional database the way AWS DMS full load plus CDC can.

- **D. S3 File Gateway with PrivateLink and backup files** — This is also a file-based backup-and-restore workflow. It may avoid internet transfer to S3, but it does not address ongoing database changes or provide CDC. Additionally, for this use case the key problem is database migration with minimal downtime, not file gateway storage access.

Therefore, **B** is the best solution because it directly migrates the database to RDS, supports full load plus CDC for minimal downtime, can use private connectivity over Direct Connect/private VIF, and supports KMS encryption at rest and TLS encryption in transit.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将本地应用程序和一个 MySQL 数据库迁移到 AWS。该应用程序处理高度敏感的数据，并且数据库中的新数据会不断更新。数据不得通过互联网传输。公司还必须对传输中和静态存储的数据进行加密。数据库大小为 5 TB。公司已经在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例中创建了数据库架构。公司已设置一条到 AWS 的 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。公司还设置了一个 public VIF 和一个 private VIF。解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案，以尽可能少的停机时间将数据迁移到 AWS。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 执行数据库备份。将备份文件复制到 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将备份导入 Amazon S3。使用带有 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）对静态数据进行加密。使用 TLS 对传输中的数据进行加密。将数据从 Amazon S3 导入到数据库实例。
options.B: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据迁移到 AWS。在私有子网中创建 DMS 复制实例。为 AWS DMS 创建 VPC endpoints。配置 DMS 任务，使用全量加载加变更数据捕获（CDC）将数据从本地数据库复制到数据库实例。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 默认密钥对静态数据进行加密。使用 TLS 对传输中的数据进行加密。
options.C: 执行数据库备份。使用 AWS DataSync 将备份文件传输到 Amazon S3。使用带有 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）对静态数据进行加密。使用 TLS 对传输中的数据进行加密。将数据从 Amazon S3 导入到数据库实例。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 File Gateway。使用 AWS PrivateLink 设置到 Amazon S3 的私有连接。执行数据库备份。将备份文件复制到 Amazon S3。使用带有 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密（SSE-S3）对静态数据进行加密。使用 TLS 对传输中的数据进行加密。将数据从 Amazon S3 导入到数据库实例。

zh.explanation:
该场景要求将一个大型（5 TB）、持续变化的本地 MySQL 数据库迁移到已创建架构的 Amazon RDS for MySQL，同时不能通过互联网传输数据，需要对传输中和静态存储的数据进行加密，并且要求尽可能少的停机时间。

**正确答案：B。使用 AWS DMS，结合全量加载加 CDC、私有网络、静态 KMS 加密以及传输中 TLS 加密。**

AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 正是为这种类型的迁移而设计的。AWS DMS 支持持续复制/变更数据捕获（CDC），文档说明，**全量加载加 CDC** 任务会迁移现有数据，然后根据源数据库的持续变更更新目标数据库。对于 MySQL 源，AWS DMS 会从基于行的二进制日志中读取更改，并将这些更改迁移到目标（[AWS DMS CDC documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)）。这可以最大限度减少停机时间，因为应用程序可以在 AWS DMS 执行初始加载时继续写入源数据库，然后在切换前追上变更。

网络要求也得到满足。Direct Connect **private virtual interface** 用于通过私有 IP 地址访问 VPC 资源，而 public VIF 用于 AWS 公共服务（[Direct Connect VIF types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。将 DMS 复制实例放在私有子网中，并通过 private VIF 路由流量，可以使本地与 RDS 目标之间的数据库流量避免经过公共互联网。AWS DMS 还支持 VPC endpoints，以帮助保持端到端网络安全，并且文档指出，对源端点和目标端点使用 VPC endpoints 有助于确保流量保留在 VPC 内并受您控制（[DMS VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_VPC_Endpoints.html)）。

加密要求也得到满足。AWS DMS 支持使用 SSL/TLS 对到源端点和目标端点的任务连接进行传输中加密，并支持默认或自定义 AWS KMS 密钥来加密复制存储和连接信息（[DMS data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Security.DataProtection.html)）。因此，使用 AWS KMS 默认密钥对 DMS 进行静态加密，并对端点连接使用 TLS，满足安全要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 通过 S3 使用 Snowball Edge 备份/还原** — Snowball 可以离线移动大型数据集，但这是一种备份和还原方法。源数据库不断变化，而此选项不提供持续 CDC 来保持 RDS 目标同步。它会在最终备份、传输、还原和核对期间需要更多停机时间。它还引入了 S3 作为中间步骤，并不能提供尽可能少的停机时间。

- **C. 使用 DataSync 将备份文件传输到 S3** — AWS DataSync 可以传输文件，但此选项仍然依赖于进行数据库备份并将其导入 RDS。它不会从 MySQL 二进制日志持续复制数据库更改，因此无法像 AWS DMS 全量加载加 CDC 那样为持续更新的事务型数据库最大限度减少停机时间。

- **D. 使用 PrivateLink 和备份文件的 S3 File Gateway** — 这同样是基于文件的备份和还原工作流。它可能避免向 S3 的互联网传输，但没有解决持续的数据库更改，也不提供 CDC。此外，对于此使用案例，关键问题是以最短停机时间进行数据库迁移，而不是文件网关存储访问。

因此，**B** 是最佳解决方案，因为它可以直接将数据库迁移到 RDS，支持全量加载加 CDC 以实现最短停机时间，可以使用通过 Direct Connect/private VIF 的私有连接，并支持静态 KMS 加密和传输中 TLS 加密。

en.question: Accompany is deploying a new cluster for big data analytics on AWS. The cluster will run across many Linux Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. All of the nodes in the cluster must have read and write access to common underlying file storage. The file storage must be highly available, must be resilient, must be compatible with the Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX), and must accommodate high levels of throughput. Which storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway NFS file share that is attached to an Amazon S3 bucket. Mount the NFS file share on each EC2 instance in the cluster.
options.B: Provision a new Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that uses General Purpose performance mode. Mount the EFS file system on each EC2 instance in the cluster.
options.C: Provision a new Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that uses the io2 volume type. Attach the EBS volume to all of the EC2 instances in the cluster.
options.D: Provision a new Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that uses Max I/O performance mode. Mount the EFS file system on each EC2 instance in the cluster.

en.explanation:
The cluster needs a shared file system that many Linux EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones can mount concurrently with read/write access. It also needs high availability, resilience, POSIX-compatible file semantics, and high aggregate throughput for a big data analytics workload.

**Correct answer: D. Provision a new Amazon EFS file system that uses Max I/O performance mode. Mount the EFS file system on each EC2 instance in the cluster.**

Amazon EFS is the appropriate AWS service because it provides shared file storage that can be mounted by multiple Linux clients over NFS. AWS documentation states that an EFS file system can be accessed concurrently from multiple NFS clients, and that EC2 instances running in multiple Availability Zones in the same Region can access the same file system as a common data source ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). Regional EFS file systems store data redundantly across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones and provide continuous availability even if one or more Availability Zones are unavailable ([Availability and durability of EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)).

The Max I/O performance mode is the best match among the choices because the workload is a big data analytics cluster with many EC2 instances performing highly parallel access. Amazon EFS documentation describes Max I/O mode as designed for highly parallelized workloads that can tolerate higher latencies than General Purpose mode ([Amazon EFS performance modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)). Therefore, EFS with Max I/O addresses the shared, multi-AZ, POSIX-compatible, high-throughput file storage requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Storage Gateway file gateway backed by S3** is not the best fit for this in-cloud EC2 analytics cluster. File Gateway provides file access to objects in Amazon S3, but the requirement is for common underlying POSIX-compatible shared file storage mounted by many EC2 instances across Availability Zones. Amazon EFS is the native shared file system service for this pattern.

- **B. EFS with General Purpose performance mode** provides shared EFS storage, but it is not the best answer for the workload described. General Purpose mode is optimized for the lowest per-operation latency. The question emphasizes a highly parallel big data analytics cluster and high throughput across many nodes, which aligns with EFS Max I/O mode.

- **C. EBS io2 volume attached to all EC2 instances** does not meet the requirements. Amazon EBS is block storage, not a managed shared POSIX file system. EBS Multi-Attach for io1/io2 volumes is limited to multiple instances in the **same Availability Zone**, with a maximum of 16 Nitro-based instances, and AWS notes that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). This fails the requirement for many EC2 instances spread across multiple Availability Zones using common shared file storage.

Therefore, **D** is the storage solution that meets the stated requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上部署一个新的大数据分析集群。该集群将在许多分布在多个可用区的 Linux Amazon EC2 实例上运行。集群中的所有节点都必须对共同的底层文件存储具有读取和写入访问权限。该文件存储必须具有高可用性、弹性，必须与 Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX) 兼容，并且必须能够承载高水平的吞吐量。哪种存储解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关 NFS 文件共享，并将其附加到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在集群中的每个 EC2 实例上挂载该 NFS 文件共享。
options.B: 预置一个新的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，使用 General Purpose 性能模式。在集群中的每个 EC2 实例上挂载该 EFS 文件系统。
options.C: 预置一个新的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，使用 io2 卷类型。将该 EBS 卷附加到集群中的所有 EC2 实例。
options.D: 预置一个新的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，使用 Max I/O 性能模式。在集群中的每个 EC2 实例上挂载该 EFS 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
该集群需要一个共享文件系统，使多个可用区中的许多 Linux EC2 实例能够并发挂载并具有读/写访问权限。它还需要为大数据分析工作负载提供高可用性、弹性、POSIX 兼容的文件语义以及高聚合吞吐量。

**正确答案：D. 预置一个新的 Amazon EFS 文件系统，使用 Max I/O 性能模式。在集群中的每个 EC2 实例上挂载该 EFS 文件系统。**

Amazon EFS 是合适的 AWS 服务，因为它提供可由多个 Linux 客户端通过 NFS 挂载的共享文件存储。AWS 文档指出，一个 EFS 文件系统可以被多个 NFS 客户端并发访问，并且在同一 Region 中运行于多个可用区的 EC2 实例可以访问同一个文件系统，将其作为共同的数据源（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。Regional EFS 文件系统将数据冗余存储在多个地理位置分离的可用区中，即使一个或多个可用区不可用，也能提供持续可用性（[Availability and durability of EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。

Max I/O 性能模式是这些选项中最匹配的，因为该工作负载是一个大数据分析集群，有许多 EC2 实例执行高度并行访问。Amazon EFS 文档将 Max I/O 模式描述为适用于高度并行化、且能够容忍比 General Purpose 模式更高延迟的工作负载（[Amazon EFS performance modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。因此，采用 Max I/O 的 EFS 满足共享、多 AZ、POSIX 兼容、高吞吐量文件存储的要求。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. 由 S3 支持的 Storage Gateway 文件网关** 不最适合这个云内 EC2 分析集群。File Gateway 提供对 Amazon S3 中对象的文件访问，但需求是由许多 EC2 实例跨可用区挂载的通用底层 POSIX 兼容共享文件存储。Amazon EFS 是适用于这种模式的原生共享文件系统服务。

- **B. 使用 General Purpose 性能模式的 EFS** 提供共享 EFS 存储，但不是所述工作负载的最佳答案。General Purpose 模式针对最低的每次操作延迟进行了优化。题目强调高度并行的大数据分析集群以及跨许多节点的高吞吐量，这与 EFS Max I/O 模式相匹配。

- **C. 附加到所有 EC2 实例的 EBS io2 卷** 不满足要求。Amazon EBS 是块存储，而不是托管的共享 POSIX 文件系统。适用于 io1/io2 卷的 EBS Multi-Attach 仅限于**同一可用区**中的多个实例，最多支持 16 个基于 Nitro 的实例，并且 AWS 指出，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多个服务器同时访问而设计（[EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。这不满足许多分布在多个可用区的 EC2 实例使用共同共享文件存储的要求。

因此，**D** 是满足所述要求的存储解决方案。

en.question: A company hosts a software as a service (SaaS) solution on AWS. The solution has an Amazon API Gateway API that serves an HTTPS endpoint. The API uses AWS Lambda functions for compute. The Lambda functions store data in an Amazon Aurora Serverless v1 database. The company used the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to deploy the solution. The solution extends across multiple Availability Zones and has no disaster recovery (DR) plan. A solutions architect must design a DR strategy that can recover the solution in another AWS Region. The solution has an RTO of 5 minutes and an RPO of 1 minute. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a read replica of the Aurora Serverless v1 database in the target Region. Use AWS SAM to create a runbook to deploy the solution to the target Region. Promote the read replica to primary in case of disaster.
options.B: Change the Aurora Serverless v1 database to a standard Aurora MySQL global database that extends across the source Region and the target Region. Use AWS SAM to create a runbook to deploy the solution to the target Region.
options.C: Create an Aurora Serverless v1 DB cluster that has multiple writer instances in the target Region. Launch the solution in the target Region. Configure the two Regional solutions to work in an active- passive configuration.
options.D: Change the Aurora Serverless v1 database to a standard Aurora MySQL global database that extends across the source Region and the target Region. Launch the solution in the target Region. Configure the two Regional solutions to work in an active-passive configuration.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The workload is serverless at the application tier: API Gateway exposes an HTTPS API, Lambda provides compute, and the persistent data tier is Aurora Serverless v1. The architect must create a **multi-Region disaster recovery strategy** with **RTO = 5 minutes** and **RPO = 1 minute**.

The key point is that those objectives are aggressive. The target Region must already have the critical application stack available or nearly available, and the database must have continuous cross-Region replication with very low lag.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Change the Aurora Serverless v1 database to a standard Aurora MySQL global database that extends across the source Region and the target Region. Launch the solution in the target Region. Configure the two Regional solutions to work in an active-passive configuration.**

This is the best fit because:

* **Aurora Global Database is designed for cross-Region DR.** AWS states that an Aurora global database has one primary Region and one or more read-only secondary Regions, and that Aurora replicates data to secondary Regions with latency typically under a second ([Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)).
* AWS also states that Aurora Global Database provides recovery from Region-wide outages with **lower RTO and lower RPO** than traditional replication, and that for Aurora Global Database, **RTO can be in the order of minutes** and **RPO is typically measured in seconds** ([Aurora Global Database DR planning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)). These values align with the required 5-minute RTO and 1-minute RPO.
* The application tier must be ready in the target Region. AWS DR guidance describes active/passive strategies as having an active site serving traffic and a passive site used for recovery; the passive site does not serve traffic until failover ([AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)). Launching the API Gateway/Lambda/SAM-deployed solution in the target Region ahead of time provides a warm standby/active-passive posture and avoids relying on control-plane provisioning during a disaster.

Therefore, converting away from Aurora Serverless v1 to a provisioned Aurora MySQL global database and keeping the target Region application stack launched is the option most likely to meet both the **5-minute RTO** and **1-minute RPO**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create a read replica of Aurora Serverless v1 and deploy by SAM runbook during disaster

This option is not suitable. Aurora Serverless v1 is not the right database mode for this type of cross-Region replica/global DR design, and relying on a SAM runbook to deploy the application stack only after a disaster adds provisioning time and control-plane dependency. AWS DR guidance explicitly warns that for maximum resiliency, failover should rely as much as possible on **data plane operations**, because control planes are used to configure environments and generally have different availability characteristics ([AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)). This makes it risky for a 5-minute RTO.

### B. Use Aurora Global Database but deploy the solution to the target Region by SAM runbook

This option correctly chooses Aurora Global Database for the database layer, but it does **not** launch the application tier in the target Region in advance. With only a runbook, the company would still need to create or update API Gateway, Lambda functions, integrations, permissions, environment variables, networking, and other regional resources during the DR event. That is a control-plane-heavy recovery approach and is less reliable for a 5-minute RTO than having the passive regional solution already launched.

### C. Create an Aurora Serverless v1 DB cluster with multiple writer instances in the target Region

This is technically inconsistent with the required architecture. Aurora Global Database uses a single primary Region for writes and read-only secondary Regions; AWS states that only the primary cluster performs write operations in an Aurora global database ([Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). Creating multiple writer instances in the target Region is not the described Aurora Serverless v1 DR pattern and does not solve cross-Region replication from the source Region with the required RPO.

## Conclusion

Option **D** is correct because it combines:

1. **Aurora MySQL Global Database** for seconds-level RPO and minutes-level cross-Region database failover.
2. A **pre-launched passive regional application stack** for a realistic 5-minute RTO.
3. An **active-passive multi-Region DR architecture**, which is appropriate for a SaaS solution that must recover quickly in another AWS Region.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个软件即服务 (SaaS) 解决方案。该解决方案有一个 Amazon API Gateway API，用于提供 HTTPS 端点。该 API 使用 AWS Lambda 函数进行计算。Lambda 函数将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora Serverless v1 数据库中。该公司使用 AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) 部署该解决方案。该解决方案跨多个可用区，但没有灾难恢复 (DR) 计划。解决方案架构师必须设计一种 DR 策略，使该解决方案能够在另一个 AWS 区域中恢复。该解决方案的 RTO 为 5 分钟，RPO 为 1 分钟。解决方案架构师应如何做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 在目标区域中创建 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库的只读副本。使用 AWS SAM 创建一个运行手册，将解决方案部署到目标区域。在发生灾难时，将只读副本提升为主数据库。
options.B: 将 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库更改为标准 Aurora MySQL global database，使其跨源区域和目标区域。使用 AWS SAM 创建一个运行手册，将解决方案部署到目标区域。
options.C: 在目标区域中创建具有多个写入器实例的 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库集群。将解决方案启动到目标区域。将两个区域解决方案配置为以主动-被动配置工作。
options.D: 将 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库更改为标准 Aurora MySQL global database，使其跨源区域和目标区域。将解决方案启动到目标区域。将两个区域解决方案配置为以主动-被动配置工作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该工作负载在应用层是 serverless 的：API Gateway 公开 HTTPS API，Lambda 提供计算，持久数据层是 Aurora Serverless v1。架构师必须创建一个**多区域灾难恢复策略**，其 **RTO = 5 分钟**，**RPO = 1 分钟**。

关键点在于这些目标非常激进。目标区域必须已经具备关键应用程序堆栈，或几乎可用，并且数据库必须具备持续的跨区域复制且延迟非常低。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 将 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库更改为标准 Aurora MySQL global database，使其跨源区域和目标区域。将解决方案启动到目标区域。将两个区域解决方案配置为以主动-被动配置工作。**

这是最合适的选择，因为：

* **Aurora Global Database 专为跨区域 DR 而设计。** AWS 表示，Aurora global database 有一个主区域和一个或多个只读辅助区域，Aurora 会将数据复制到辅助区域，延迟通常低于一秒（[Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。
* AWS 还表示，与传统复制相比，Aurora Global Database 可在区域级中断时提供**更低的 RTO 和更低的 RPO**，并且对于 Aurora Global Database，**RTO 可以达到分钟级**，**RPO 通常以秒计**（[Aurora Global Database DR planning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)）。这些数值与所需的 5 分钟 RTO 和 1 分钟 RPO 相符。
* 应用层必须在目标区域中就绪。AWS DR 指南将主动/被动策略描述为：一个主动站点提供流量服务，一个被动站点用于恢复；被动站点在故障转移前不提供流量服务（[AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。提前在目标区域启动 API Gateway/Lambda/SAM 部署的解决方案，可提供 warm standby/active-passive 状态，并避免在灾难期间依赖控制平面预置。

因此，从 Aurora Serverless v1 转换为预置的 Aurora MySQL global database，并保持目标区域应用程序堆栈已启动，是最有可能同时满足 **5 分钟 RTO** 和 **1 分钟 RPO** 的选项。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 创建 Aurora Serverless v1 的只读副本，并在灾难期间通过 SAM runbook 部署

此选项不适合。Aurora Serverless v1 不是适用于此类跨区域副本/global DR 设计的正确数据库模式，并且仅在灾难发生后才依赖 SAM runbook 部署应用程序堆栈，会增加预置时间和控制平面依赖。AWS DR 指南明确警告，为了获得最大弹性，故障转移应尽可能依赖**数据平面操作**，因为控制平面用于配置环境，通常具有不同的可用性特征（[AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。这使其对于 5 分钟 RTO 来说存在风险。

### B. 使用 Aurora Global Database，但通过 SAM runbook 将解决方案部署到目标区域

此选项为数据库层正确选择了 Aurora Global Database，但它没有提前在目标区域启动应用层。如果只有 runbook，公司在 DR 事件期间仍需要创建或更新 API Gateway、Lambda 函数、集成、权限、环境变量、网络和其他区域资源。这是一种大量依赖控制平面的恢复方法，相比让被动区域解决方案已启动，对于 5 分钟 RTO 的可靠性更低。

### C. 在目标区域中创建具有多个写入器实例的 Aurora Serverless v1 数据库集群

此选项在技术上与所需架构不一致。Aurora Global Database 使用单个主区域进行写入，并使用只读辅助区域；AWS 表示，在 Aurora global database 中，只有主集群执行写入操作（[Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。在目标区域创建多个写入器实例并不是所描述的 Aurora Serverless v1 DR 模式，也无法解决从源区域进行跨区域复制以满足所需 RPO 的问题。

## 结论

选项 **D** 正确，因为它结合了：

1. **Aurora MySQL Global Database**，用于实现秒级 RPO 和分钟级跨区域数据库故障转移。
2. **预先启动的被动区域应用程序堆栈**，用于实现现实可行的 5 分钟 RTO。
3. **主动-被动多区域 DR 架构**，适合必须在另一个 AWS 区域中快速恢复的 SaaS 解决方案。

en.question: A company owns a chain of travel agencies and is running an application in the AWS Cloud. Company employees use the application to search for information about travel destinations. Destination content is updated four times each year. Two fixed Amazon EC2 instances serve the application. The company uses an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone with a multivalue record of travel.example.com that returns the Elastic IP addresses for the EC2 instances. The application uses Amazon DynamoDB as its primary data store. The company uses a self-hosted Redis instance as a caching solution. During content updates, the load on the EC2 instances and the caching solution increases drastically. This increased load has led to downtime on several occasions. A solutions architect must update the application so that the application is highly available and can handle the load that is generated by the content updates. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) as in-memory cache. Update the application to use DAX. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Set the Auto Scaling group as a target for the ALB. Update the Route 53 record to use a simple routing policy that targets the ALB's DNS alias. Configure scheduled scaling for the EC2 instances before the content updates.
options.B: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Update the application to use ElastiCache. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution, and set the Auto Scaling group as an origin for the distribution. Update the Route 53 record to use a simple routing policy that targets the CloudFront distribution’s DNS alias. Manually scale up EC2 instances before the content updates.
options.C: Set up Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached. Update the application to use ElastiCache. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Set the Auto Scaling group as a target for the ALB. Update the Route 53 record to use a simple routing policy that targets the ALB's DNS alias. Configure scheduled scaling for the application before the content updates.
options.D: Set up DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) as in-memory cache. Update the application to use DAX. Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution, and set the Auto Scaling group as an origin for the distribution. Update the Route 53 record to use a simple routing policy that targets the CloudFront distribution's DNS alias. Manually scale up EC2 instances before the content updates.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application currently has two fixed EC2 instances behind a Route 53 multivalue record that returns Elastic IP addresses, uses DynamoDB as the primary data store, and uses a self-hosted Redis cache. During predictable quarterly content updates, load spikes on both the EC2 tier and the cache, causing downtime. The solution must improve high availability and handle the predictable update-time load.

## Correct answer: A

Option **A** is the best fit:

* **DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)** is purpose-built as an in-memory cache for DynamoDB. AWS documents that DAX provides eventually consistent access to DynamoDB tables with microsecond latency, can serve millions of requests per second in a Multi-AZ cluster, and is ideal for read-intensive applications and hot-key/read-spike patterns where read activity can be offloaded to a cache ([DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). This directly addresses the DynamoDB-backed destination search workload and replaces the self-hosted Redis cache with a managed DynamoDB-focused caching layer.
* **EC2 Auto Scaling group + Application Load Balancer** improves availability and elasticity for the application tier. AWS documents that an Auto Scaling group can be attached to an Application Load Balancer target group, and instances are automatically registered with the load balancer after the group is created ([Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)).
* **Scheduled scaling** is appropriate because the content updates occur four times each year and are therefore predictable. AWS documents that scheduled scaling uses scheduled actions to change desired, minimum, and maximum capacity at specified times, scaling out or in based on those capacity values ([Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)).
* **Route 53 alias to the ALB** is the right DNS pattern. AWS documents that Route 53 can route traffic to an ELB load balancer by creating an alias record to an Application Load Balancer DNS name ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)). This is better than returning individual EC2 Elastic IPs because the ALB integrates with the Auto Scaling group and distributes traffic only to registered targets.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. ElastiCache for Redis + CloudFront + manual scaling

ElastiCache for Redis is a managed cache, but the primary data store is DynamoDB and the question is focused on DynamoDB-backed read/search load; DAX is the DynamoDB-specific accelerator. More importantly, this option says to **manually scale up EC2 instances** before the updates. The requirement is for a highly available solution that can reliably handle predictable load spikes; scheduled scaling is a better operational fit than manual intervention. Also, setting an Auto Scaling group itself as a CloudFront origin is not the appropriate application-tier design; CloudFront origins are typically DNS endpoints such as an ALB, not an Auto Scaling group directly.

### C. ElastiCache for Memcached + ALB + scheduled scaling

This option improves the EC2 tier with an Auto Scaling group, ALB, and scheduled scaling, but it chooses **ElastiCache for Memcached** instead of DAX. Because the backing store is DynamoDB and the workload is read-heavy destination lookup traffic, DAX is the service specifically designed to accelerate DynamoDB reads and offload DynamoDB read activity. Memcached is a generic cache and does not provide the DynamoDB-integrated caching behavior that DAX provides.

### D. DAX + CloudFront + manual scaling

This option correctly chooses DAX, but it uses **manual scaling** rather than scheduled scaling for a known quarterly load event. Manual scaling introduces operational risk and does not best meet the requirement for reliable handling of predictable content-update spikes. It also uses CloudFront rather than an ALB integrated with the Auto Scaling group; the problem is application-tier and cache/database read load during updates, not primarily global edge content delivery.

## Conclusion

**A** is correct because it addresses all failure points with managed, highly available, and event-appropriate services: DAX for DynamoDB read caching, an Auto Scaling group behind an ALB for the EC2 application tier, a Route 53 alias to the ALB, and scheduled scaling before the predictable quarterly content updates.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一家连锁旅行社，并在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个应用程序。公司员工使用该应用程序搜索有关旅行目的地的信息。目的地内容每年更新四次。两台固定的 Amazon EC2 实例为该应用程序提供服务。该公司使用 Amazon Route 53 公有托管区域，其中 travel.example.com 的多值记录会返回这些 EC2 实例的 Elastic IP 地址。该应用程序使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为其主要数据存储。该公司使用自托管的 Redis 实例作为缓存解决方案。在内容更新期间，EC2 实例和缓存解决方案上的负载会急剧增加。这种负载增加已多次导致停机。解决方案架构师必须更新该应用程序，使其具有高可用性，并且能够处理内容更新所产生的负载。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 作为内存缓存。更新应用程序以使用 DAX。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。创建 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 Auto Scaling 组设置为 ALB 的目标。更新 Route 53 记录以使用以 ALB 的 DNS 别名为目标的简单路由策略。在内容更新之前为 EC2 实例配置计划扩缩。
options.B: 设置 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。更新应用程序以使用 ElastiCache。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 Auto Scaling 组设置为该分配的源站。更新 Route 53 记录以使用以 CloudFront 分配的 DNS 别名为目标的简单路由策略。在内容更新之前手动扩展 EC2 实例。
options.C: 设置 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached。更新应用程序以使用 ElastiCache。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。创建 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 Auto Scaling 组设置为 ALB 的目标。更新 Route 53 记录以使用以 ALB 的 DNS 别名为目标的简单路由策略。在内容更新之前为应用程序配置计划扩缩。
options.D: 设置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 作为内存缓存。更新应用程序以使用 DAX。为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling 组。创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 Auto Scaling 组设置为该分配的源站。更新 Route 53 记录以使用以 CloudFront 分配的 DNS 别名为目标的简单路由策略。在内容更新之前手动扩展 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序目前在一个 Route 53 多值记录后面运行两台固定的 EC2 实例，该记录返回 Elastic IP 地址；它使用 DynamoDB 作为主要数据存储，并使用自托管的 Redis 缓存。在可预测的季度内容更新期间，EC2 层和缓存上的负载都会激增，导致停机。该解决方案必须提高高可用性，并处理可预测的更新时间负载。

## 正确答案：A

选项 **A** 最合适：

* **DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)** 是专为 DynamoDB 设计的内存缓存。AWS 文档说明，DAX 为 DynamoDB 表提供最终一致性访问，并具有微秒级延迟；在 Multi-AZ 集群中可每秒处理数百万个请求；非常适合读密集型应用程序以及可将读取活动卸载到缓存的热键/读取峰值模式（[DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。这直接解决了由 DynamoDB 支撑的目的地搜索工作负载，并用托管的、面向 DynamoDB 的缓存层替换自托管 Redis 缓存。
* **EC2 Auto Scaling 组 + Application Load Balancer** 可提高应用程序层的可用性和弹性。AWS 文档说明，可以将 Auto Scaling 组附加到 Application Load Balancer 目标组，并且在组创建后，实例会自动向负载均衡器注册（[Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)）。
* **计划扩缩** 是合适的，因为内容更新每年发生四次，因此是可预测的。AWS 文档说明，计划扩缩使用计划操作在指定时间更改所需容量、最小容量和最大容量，并根据这些容量值进行扩展或缩减（[Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。
* **Route 53 指向 ALB 的别名** 是正确的 DNS 模式。AWS 文档说明，Route 53 可以通过创建指向 Application Load Balancer DNS 名称的别名记录，将流量路由到 ELB 负载均衡器（[Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)）。这比返回各个 EC2 Elastic IP 更好，因为 ALB 可与 Auto Scaling 组集成，并且只将流量分发到已注册目标。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. ElastiCache for Redis + CloudFront + 手动扩展

ElastiCache for Redis 是一种托管缓存，但主要数据存储是 DynamoDB，并且题目关注的是由 DynamoDB 支撑的读取/搜索负载；DAX 是 DynamoDB 专用加速器。更重要的是，此选项要求在更新之前**手动扩展 EC2 实例**。要求是一个高可用解决方案，能够可靠地处理可预测的负载峰值；与手动干预相比，计划扩缩在运维上更合适。此外，将 Auto Scaling 组本身设置为 CloudFront 源站并不是合适的应用程序层设计；CloudFront 源站通常是 DNS 端点，例如 ALB，而不是直接使用 Auto Scaling 组。

### C. ElastiCache for Memcached + ALB + 计划扩缩

此选项通过 Auto Scaling 组、ALB 和计划扩缩改进了 EC2 层，但它选择了 **ElastiCache for Memcached** 而不是 DAX。由于后端存储是 DynamoDB，并且工作负载是读密集型的目的地查找流量，因此 DAX 才是专门设计用于加速 DynamoDB 读取并卸载 DynamoDB 读取活动的服务。Memcached 是通用缓存，不提供 DAX 所提供的 DynamoDB 集成缓存行为。

### D. DAX + CloudFront + 手动扩展

此选项正确选择了 DAX，但对于已知的季度负载事件，它使用的是**手动扩展**而不是计划扩缩。手动扩展会引入运营风险，并且不能最好地满足可靠处理可预测内容更新峰值的要求。它还使用 CloudFront，而不是与 Auto Scaling 组集成的 ALB；问题在于更新期间的应用程序层和缓存/数据库读取负载，而不是主要的全球边缘内容分发。

## 结论

**A** 正确，因为它使用托管、高可用且适合事件特性的服务解决了所有故障点：使用 DAX 进行 DynamoDB 读取缓存，将 EC2 应用程序层置于 ALB 后的 Auto Scaling 组中，使用指向 ALB 的 Route 53 别名，并在可预测的季度内容更新之前进行计划扩缩。

en.question: A company needs to store and process image data that will be uploaded from mobile devices using a custom mobile app. Usage peaks between 8 AM and 5 PM on weekdays, with thousands of uploads per minute. The app is rarely used at any other time. A user is notified when image processing is complete. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to ensure image processing can scale to handle the load? (Choose three.)

options.A: Upload files from the mobile software directly to Amazon S3. Use S3 event notifications to create a message in an Amazon MQ queue.
options.B: Upload files from the mobile software directly to Amazon S3. Use S3 event notifications to create a message in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue.
options.C: Invoke an AWS Lambda function to perform image processing when a message is available in the queue.
options.D: Invoke an S3 Batch Operations job to perform image processing when a message is available in the queue.
options.E: Send a push notification to the mobile app by using Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) when processing is complete.
options.F: Send a push notification to the mobile app by using Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) when processing is complete.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The workload has bursty uploads from a mobile app: thousands of images per minute during business hours and little usage otherwise. The design should decouple ingestion from processing, absorb spikes, automatically scale consumers, and notify the mobile user when processing completes.

## Correct answers: B, C, E

### B. Upload files directly to Amazon S3 and use S3 event notifications to create a message in an Amazon SQS standard queue

This is the right ingestion and decoupling pattern. Mobile clients can upload image objects to S3, and S3 can publish event notifications for new object creation. The official S3 documentation lists supported S3 event notification destinations as **Amazon SNS topics, Amazon SQS queues, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon EventBridge** ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).

Using an SQS **standard** queue buffers the burst of upload events and decouples image upload from image processing. This allows the processing layer to scale independently and protects it from traffic spikes.

### C. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to perform image processing when a message is available in the queue

This is the right scalable processing mechanism. AWS Lambda supports Amazon SQS event source mappings: Lambda polls the SQS queue, invokes the function synchronously with batches of messages, and deletes messages after successful processing ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)).

For a variable workload with peaks only during certain hours, Lambda is a good fit because it can scale out during bursts and scale down when there is little or no traffic. The SQS queue provides backpressure and durability if processing temporarily lags behind uploads.

### E. Send a push notification to the mobile app by using Amazon SNS when processing is complete

This is the right notification service for mobile push notifications. Amazon SNS supports sending push notifications to mobile devices through push notification services such as APNs and FCM, using device tokens and SNS mobile endpoints ([Sending mobile push notifications with Amazon SNS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-mobile-application-as-subscriber.html)).

After Lambda completes image processing, it can publish a completion notification through SNS to the relevant mobile endpoint or topic.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Use S3 event notifications to create a message in an Amazon MQ queue

Amazon MQ is not a supported direct destination for S3 event notifications. The S3 documentation lists SNS, SQS, Lambda, and EventBridge as supported event notification destinations, not Amazon MQ ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). Amazon MQ would also be a less natural fit than SQS for highly elastic, serverless buffering of S3 object-created events.

### D. Invoke an S3 Batch Operations job to perform image processing when a message is available in the queue

S3 Batch Operations is for large-scale batch operations on specified lists of S3 objects. The documentation explains that a Batch Operations job runs an operation against objects in a manifest/list ([Performing object operations in bulk with Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)). That is not the best fit for near-real-time per-upload image processing triggered by queue messages. Lambda consuming SQS messages is the appropriate event-driven option.

### F. Send a push notification to the mobile app by using Amazon SES

Amazon SES is for email, not mobile push notifications. The SES documentation describes using SES to send email through AWS SDKs and requires email identity verification ([Sending email through Amazon SES using an AWS SDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-an-email-using-sdk-programmatically.html)). For push notifications to a mobile app, SNS is the AWS service designed for that purpose.

## Conclusion

The best scalable serverless architecture is: mobile app uploads images to S3, S3 sends object-created events to an SQS standard queue, Lambda processes images from the queue, and SNS sends mobile push notifications when processing completes.

**Answer: B, C, E**

zh.question: 一家公司需要存储并处理将通过自定义移动应用从移动设备上传的图像数据。使用高峰出现在工作日的上午 8 点到下午 5 点，每分钟有数千次上传。该应用在其他时间很少被使用。图像处理完成后会通知用户。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来确保图像处理能够扩展以处理该负载？（选择三项。）

options.A: 从移动软件将文件直接上传到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 事件通知在 Amazon MQ 队列中创建一条消息。
options.B: 从移动软件将文件直接上传到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 事件通知在 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列中创建一条消息。
options.C: 当队列中有消息可用时，调用 AWS Lambda 函数执行图像处理。
options.D: 当队列中有消息可用时，调用 S3 Batch Operations 作业执行图像处理。
options.E: 处理完成后，使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 向移动应用发送推送通知。
options.F: 处理完成后，使用 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 向移动应用发送推送通知。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该工作负载来自移动应用的上传具有突发性：在工作时间每分钟有数千张图像上传，而其他时间使用量很少。该设计应将摄取与处理解耦，吸收流量峰值，自动扩展消费者，并在处理完成时通知移动用户。

## 正确答案：B、C、E

### B. 将文件直接上传到 Amazon S3，并使用 S3 事件通知在 Amazon SQS 标准队列中创建一条消息

这是正确的摄取和解耦模式。移动客户端可以将图像对象上传到 S3，S3 可以为新对象创建发布事件通知。官方 S3 文档列出的受支持 S3 事件通知目标包括 **Amazon SNS topics、Amazon SQS queues、AWS Lambda functions 和 Amazon EventBridge**（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。

使用 SQS **standard** 队列可以缓冲上传事件的突发流量，并将图像上传与图像处理解耦。这允许处理层独立扩展，并保护其免受流量峰值影响。

### C. 当队列中有消息可用时，调用 AWS Lambda 函数执行图像处理

这是正确的可扩展处理机制。AWS Lambda 支持 Amazon SQS 事件源映射：Lambda 轮询 SQS 队列，以消息批次同步调用函数，并在成功处理后删除消息（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。

对于仅在特定时段出现高峰的可变工作负载，Lambda 非常适合，因为它可以在突发期间向外扩展，并在流量很少或没有流量时缩减。SQS 队列在处理暂时落后于上传时提供背压和持久性。

### E. 处理完成后，使用 Amazon SNS 向移动应用发送推送通知

这是用于移动推送通知的正确通知服务。Amazon SNS 支持通过 APNs 和 FCM 等推送通知服务，使用设备令牌和 SNS 移动端点向移动设备发送推送通知（[Sending mobile push notifications with Amazon SNS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-mobile-application-as-subscriber.html)）。

Lambda 完成图像处理后，可以通过 SNS 向相关移动端点或主题发布完成通知。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用 S3 事件通知在 Amazon MQ 队列中创建一条消息

Amazon MQ 不是 S3 事件通知支持的直接目标。S3 文档列出的受支持事件通知目标包括 SNS、SQS、Lambda 和 EventBridge，而不是 Amazon MQ（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。与 SQS 相比，Amazon MQ 也不太适合作为 S3 对象创建事件的高度弹性、无服务器缓冲机制。

### D. 当队列中有消息可用时，调用 S3 Batch Operations 作业执行图像处理

S3 Batch Operations 用于对指定 S3 对象列表执行大规模批处理操作。文档说明，Batch Operations 作业会对清单/列表中的对象运行操作（[Performing object operations in bulk with Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)）。这并不最适合由队列消息触发的近实时逐次上传图像处理。由 Lambda 消费 SQS 消息才是适当的事件驱动选项。

### F. 使用 Amazon SES 向移动应用发送推送通知

Amazon SES 用于电子邮件，而不是移动推送通知。SES 文档描述了使用 SES 通过 AWS SDK 发送电子邮件，并要求验证电子邮件身份（[Sending email through Amazon SES using an AWS SDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-an-email-using-sdk-programmatically.html)）。对于向移动应用发送推送通知，SNS 是专为此目的设计的 AWS 服务。

## 结论

最佳可扩展无服务器架构是：移动应用将图像上传到 S3，S3 将对象创建事件发送到 SQS 标准队列，Lambda 从队列处理图像，并在处理完成时由 SNS 发送移动推送通知。

**答案：B、C、E**

en.question: A company is building an application on AWS. The application sends logs to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster for analysis. All data must be stored within a VPC. Some of the company’s developers work from home. Other developers work from three different company office locations. The developers need to access OpenSearch Service to analyze and visualize logs directly from their local development machines. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure and set up an AWS Client VPN endpoint. Associate the Client VPN endpoint with a subnet in the VPC. Configure a Client VPN self-service portal. Instruct the developers to connect by using the client for Client VPN.
options.B: Create a transit gateway, and connect it to the VPC. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN. Create an attachment to the transit gateway. Instruct the developers to connect by using an OpenVPN client.
options.C: Create a transit gateway, and connect it to the VPOrder an AWS Direct Connect connection. Set up a public VIF on the Direct Connect connection. Associate the public VIF with the transit gateway. Instruct the developers to connect to the Direct Connect connection.
options.D: Create and configure a bastion host in a public subnet of the VPC. Configure the bastion host security group to allow SSH access from the company CIDR ranges. Instruct the developers to connect by using SSH.

en.explanation:
The application’s Amazon OpenSearch Service domain must remain private in a VPC, but individual developers need to reach it directly from their local machines, including from home and from multiple office locations. This is a remote-user, client-to-VPC access requirement.

**Correct answer: A. Configure AWS Client VPN.**

AWS Client VPN is specifically a managed **client-based VPN service** that lets users securely access AWS resources “from any location” using an OpenVPN-based VPN client, and it integrates with Amazon VPC through target network/subnet associations ([AWS Client VPN: What is AWS Client VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)). This matches developers working from home and from multiple offices because each developer can connect from the local machine through the Client VPN endpoint into the VPC. The self-service portal is also appropriate because, when enabled, users can log in and download the Client VPN endpoint configuration file and the AWS provided client ([AWS Client VPN self-service portal](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/cvpn-self-service-portal.html)).

This is also consistent with OpenSearch Service VPC domains: AWS documentation states that public domains are accessible from internet-connected devices, but **VPC domains require some form of VPN or proxy**, and a computer must be able to connect to the VPC to access the VPC endpoint ([OpenSearch Service VPC domains](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/vpc.html)). Client VPN provides that private connectivity without exposing the OpenSearch domain publicly.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Transit Gateway + Site-to-Site VPN + OpenVPN client** — AWS Site-to-Site VPN is intended to connect a VPC to an **on-premises network** through customer gateway equipment/software, not to provide individual remote-user VPN access from home laptops. The AWS documentation defines a Site-to-Site VPN connection as a connection between a VPC and the customer’s on-premises network, with concepts such as customer gateway devices and VPN tunnels ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). It would not directly solve work-from-home developer access unless additional remote-access infrastructure were built.
- **C. Transit Gateway + Direct Connect public VIF** — Direct Connect is for dedicated connectivity between on-premises networks and AWS, not for individual developers connecting directly from home or arbitrary office machines. Also, a public virtual interface is not the right construct for attaching to a transit gateway; transit gateway integration uses a transit virtual interface, not a public VIF. This option is both mismatched to the user-access requirement and architecturally incorrect.
- **D. Bastion host in a public subnet** — A bastion host could support SSH tunneling or administrative access, but it does not provide the requested direct private connectivity from each developer’s local machine to OpenSearch. It also requires exposing and managing a public EC2 entry point and, as written, allows SSH only from company CIDR ranges, which does not cover developers working from home. It is less suitable than a managed client VPN for broad remote developer access.

Therefore, **Option A** is the solution that meets the requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个应用程序。该应用程序将日志发送到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群进行分析。所有数据都必须存储在 VPC 内。公司的一些开发人员在家办公。其他开发人员在三个不同的公司办公地点工作。开发人员需要直接从其本地开发计算机访问 OpenSearch Service，以分析和可视化日志。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置并设置 AWS Client VPN 端点。将 Client VPN 端点与 VPC 中的一个子网关联。配置 Client VPN 自助服务门户。指示开发人员使用 Client VPN 的客户端进行连接。
options.B: 创建一个 transit gateway，并将其连接到 VPC。创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN。创建到 transit gateway 的连接挂载。指示开发人员使用 OpenVPN 客户端进行连接。
options.C: 创建一个 transit gateway，并将其连接到 VPOrder an AWS Direct Connect connection。设置 Direct Connect 连接上的公有 VIF。将公有 VIF 与 transit gateway 关联。指示开发人员连接到 Direct Connect 连接。
options.D: 在 VPC 的公有子网中创建并配置一个堡垒主机。配置堡垒主机安全组，以允许来自公司 CIDR 范围的 SSH 访问。指示开发人员使用 SSH 进行连接。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序的 Amazon OpenSearch Service 域必须保持在 VPC 中私有，但各个开发人员需要直接从其本地计算机访问它，包括从家中和多个办公地点访问。这是一个远程用户、客户端到 VPC 访问的需求。

**正确答案：A. 配置 AWS Client VPN。**

AWS Client VPN 专门是一项托管的**基于客户端的 VPN 服务**，允许用户使用基于 OpenVPN 的 VPN 客户端“从任何位置”安全访问 AWS 资源，并且它通过目标网络/子网关联与 Amazon VPC 集成（[AWS Client VPN: What is AWS Client VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)）。这与在家办公以及在多个办公室工作的开发人员场景相匹配，因为每个开发人员都可以从本地计算机通过 Client VPN 端点连接到 VPC。自助服务门户也很合适，因为启用后，用户可以登录并下载 Client VPN 端点配置文件以及 AWS 提供的客户端（[AWS Client VPN self-service portal](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/cvpn-self-service-portal.html)）。

这也与 OpenSearch Service VPC 域一致：AWS 文档说明，公有域可从连接互联网的设备访问，但 **VPC 域需要某种形式的 VPN 或代理**，并且计算机必须能够连接到 VPC 才能访问 VPC 端点（[OpenSearch Service VPC domains](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/vpc.html)）。Client VPN 提供了这种私有连接，而无需将 OpenSearch 域公开暴露。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. Transit Gateway + Site-to-Site VPN + OpenVPN 客户端** — AWS Site-to-Site VPN 旨在通过客户网关设备/软件将 VPC 连接到**本地网络**，而不是为来自家庭笔记本电脑的单个远程用户提供 VPN 访问。AWS 文档将 Site-to-Site VPN 连接定义为 VPC 与客户本地网络之间的连接，涉及客户网关设备和 VPN 隧道等概念（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。除非构建额外的远程访问基础设施，否则它无法直接解决在家办公开发人员的访问问题。
- **C. Transit Gateway + Direct Connect 公有 VIF** — Direct Connect 用于本地网络与 AWS 之间的专用连接，而不是用于单个开发人员从家中或任意办公机器直接连接。此外，公有虚拟接口并不是挂载到 transit gateway 的正确构造；transit gateway 集成使用 transit virtual interface，而不是公有 VIF。该选项既不符合用户访问需求，在架构上也不正确。
- **D. 公有子网中的堡垒主机** — 堡垒主机可以支持 SSH 隧道或管理访问，但它不能提供题目要求的、从每个开发人员本地计算机到 OpenSearch 的直接私有连接。它还需要暴露和管理一个公有 EC2 入口点，并且按题目所述，仅允许来自公司 CIDR 范围的 SSH，这不包括在家办公的开发人员。对于广泛的远程开发人员访问而言，它不如托管的 client VPN 合适。

因此，**选项 A** 是满足要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its website from an on-premises data center onto AWS. At the same time, it wants to migrate the website to a containerized microservice-based architecture to improve the availability and cost efficiency. The company’s security policy states that privileges and network permissions must be configured according to best practice, using least privilege. A solutions architect must create a containerized architecture that meets the security requirements and has deployed the application to an Amazon ECS cluster. What steps are required after the deployment to meet the requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create tasks using the bridge network mode.
options.B: Create tasks using the awsvpc network mode.
options.C: Apply security groups to Amazon EC2 instances, and use IAM roles for EC2 instances to access other resources.
options.D: Apply security groups to the tasks, and pass IAM credentials into the container at launch time to access other resources.
options.E: Apply security groups to the tasks, and use IAM roles for tasks to access other resources.

en.explanation:
The company has already deployed the application to an Amazon ECS cluster and now needs to configure **network permissions** and **AWS privileges** according to least privilege for a containerized microservice architecture.

Correct answers: **B and E**.

- **B. Create tasks using the `awsvpc` network mode.**  
  ECS `awsvpc` task networking gives ECS tasks networking properties similar to EC2 instances. AWS documentation states that `awsvpc` provides greater security by allowing security groups and network monitoring at a more granular level within tasks. It also creates a task ENI and associates the specified security groups with that ENI when the task or service is run. This is the required network mode for applying security groups at the task level. The ECS IAM role best practices documentation also explicitly recommends using `awsvpc` because it provides task-level network isolation and is the only network mode that can assign a security group to tasks ([Allocate a network interface for an Amazon ECS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-networking-awsvpc.html), [Best practices for IAM roles in Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-roles.html)).

- **E. Apply security groups to the tasks, and use IAM roles for tasks to access other resources.**  
  This matches least privilege for both network and AWS API access. Security groups at the task ENI level restrict traffic per task or service. For AWS permissions, AWS recommends assigning a **task role** because it is separate from the EC2 instance role, aligns with least privilege, and gives more granular control over actions and resources. The ECS documentation further states that if applications need to call AWS APIs, they should use IAM roles for tasks instead of relying on instance-level credentials ([Best practices for IAM roles in Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-roles.html)). AWS also recommends scoping policies to least privileged access ([IAM best practices for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-bestpractices.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Create tasks using the bridge network mode.**  
  Bridge mode does not provide the same task-level network isolation and does not allow assigning security groups directly to individual tasks. AWS specifically recommends `awsvpc` for restricting traffic between tasks and for assigning security groups to tasks.

- **C. Apply security groups to Amazon EC2 instances, and use IAM roles for EC2 instances to access other resources.**  
  This applies controls at the container instance level, not at the ECS task or microservice level. That is too coarse for least privilege in a microservice architecture. AWS recommends task roles because they are distinct from the EC2 instance role and provide more granular permissions.

- **D. Apply security groups to the tasks, and pass IAM credentials into the container at launch time to access other resources.**  
  Applying security groups to tasks is correct only when using `awsvpc`, but passing IAM credentials into containers is not a best practice. ECS task roles are designed to provide temporary, automatically rotated credentials to containers. Therefore, task IAM roles are the appropriate least-privilege mechanism, not manually passing credentials at launch time.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其网站从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。同时，该公司希望将网站迁移到基于容器化微服务的架构，以提高可用性和成本效率。该公司的安全策略规定，权限和网络许可必须按照最佳实践并使用最小权限原则进行配置。解决方案架构师必须创建一个满足安全要求的容器化架构，并且已经将应用程序部署到 Amazon ECS 集群。部署之后需要执行哪些步骤才能满足要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 bridge 网络模式创建任务。
options.B: 使用 awsvpc 网络模式创建任务。
options.C: 将安全组应用到 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色来访问其他资源。
options.D: 将安全组应用到任务，并在启动时将 IAM 凭证传入容器以访问其他资源。
options.E: 将安全组应用到任务，并使用任务的 IAM 角色来访问其他资源。

zh.explanation:
该公司已经将应用程序部署到 Amazon ECS 集群，现在需要根据最小权限原则为容器化微服务架构配置 **网络权限** 和 **AWS 权限**。

正确答案：**B 和 E**。

- **B. 使用 `awsvpc` 网络模式创建任务。**  
  ECS `awsvpc` 任务网络为 ECS 任务提供类似于 EC2 实例的网络属性。AWS 文档指出，`awsvpc` 通过允许在任务内以更细粒度使用安全组和网络监控来提供更高的安全性。它还会创建任务 ENI，并在运行任务或服务时将指定的安全组与该 ENI 关联。这是在任务级别应用安全组所需的网络模式。ECS IAM 角色最佳实践文档也明确建议使用 `awsvpc`，因为它提供任务级网络隔离，并且是唯一可以为任务分配安全组的网络模式（[Allocate a network interface for an Amazon ECS task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-networking-awsvpc.html)、[Best practices for IAM roles in Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-roles.html)）。

- **E. 将安全组应用到任务，并使用任务的 IAM 角色来访问其他资源。**  
  这符合网络和 AWS API 访问两方面的最小权限原则。任务 ENI 级别的安全组可按任务或服务限制流量。对于 AWS 权限，AWS 建议分配 **任务角色**，因为它与 EC2 实例角色分离，符合最小权限原则，并且可以对操作和资源进行更细粒度的控制。ECS 文档进一步指出，如果应用程序需要调用 AWS API，应使用任务的 IAM 角色，而不是依赖实例级凭证（[Best practices for IAM roles in Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-roles.html)）。AWS 还建议将策略范围限定为最小权限访问（[IAM best practices for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/security-iam-bestpractices.html)）。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. 使用 bridge 网络模式创建任务。**  
  Bridge 模式不能提供同样的任务级网络隔离，也不允许将安全组直接分配给单个任务。AWS 特别建议使用 `awsvpc` 来限制任务之间的流量并为任务分配安全组。

- **C. 将安全组应用到 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色来访问其他资源。**  
  这会在容器实例级别应用控制，而不是在 ECS 任务或微服务级别。对于微服务架构中的最小权限来说，这种粒度过粗。AWS 建议使用任务角色，因为任务角色不同于 EC2 实例角色，并且可提供更细粒度的权限。

- **D. 将安全组应用到任务，并在启动时将 IAM 凭证传入容器以访问其他资源。**  
  只有在使用 `awsvpc` 时，将安全组应用到任务才是正确的，但将 IAM 凭证传入容器并不是最佳实践。ECS 任务角色旨在向容器提供临时的、自动轮换的凭证。因此，任务 IAM 角色才是合适的最小权限机制，而不是在启动时手动传递凭证。

en.question: A company is running a serverless application that consists of several AWS Lambda functions and Amazon DynamoDB tables. The company has created new functionality that requires the Lambda functions to access an Amazon Neptune DB cluster. The Neptune DB cluster is located in three subnets in a VPC. Which of the possible solutions will allow the Lambda functions to access the Neptune DB cluster and DynamoDB tables? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create three public subnets in the Neptune VPC, and route traffic through an internet gateway. Host the Lambda functions in the three new public subnets.
options.B: Create three private subnets in the Neptune VPC, and route internet traffic through a NAT gateway. Host the Lambda functions in the three new private subnets.
options.C: Host the Lambda functions outside the VPUpdate the Neptune security group to allow access from the IP ranges of the Lambda functions.
options.D: Host the Lambda functions outside the VPC. Create a VPC endpoint for the Neptune database, and have the Lambda functions access Neptune over the VPC endpoint.
options.E: Create three private subnets in the Neptune VPC. Host the Lambda functions in the three new isolated subnets. Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB, and route DynamoDB traffic to the VPC endpoint.

en.explanation:
The application’s Lambda functions must reach two different targets: an Amazon Neptune DB cluster that is in subnets inside a VPC, and DynamoDB tables, which are a regional AWS service normally reached through public service endpoints unless you provide a VPC endpoint.

The correct answers are **B and E**.

- **B is correct.** To access the Neptune cluster, the Lambda functions must be configured for the VPC that contains the Neptune cluster. AWS states that a Neptune DB cluster is created in a VPC and its endpoints are accessible within that VPC. If the VPC-connected Lambda functions also need to reach DynamoDB through normal public AWS service endpoints, the private subnets need outbound internet access through a NAT gateway. AWS Lambda documentation also states that when a Lambda function is attached to a VPC, it can access only resources available within that VPC unless the VPC has internet access, and that private subnets can access the internet through a NAT gateway. See [Securing your Amazon Neptune database with Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/security-vpc.html) and [Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html).

- **E is correct.** This is the private-network alternative to B. The Lambda functions are placed in private/isolated subnets in the same VPC as Neptune, so they can access the Neptune DB cluster privately. Because isolated private subnets do not have NAT internet access, the solution adds a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. AWS documents that DynamoDB supports VPC endpoints, including gateway endpoints that are specified in a route table to access DynamoDB from an Amazon VPC over the AWS network. See [AWS PrivateLink for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html).

Incorrect options:

- **A is incorrect.** Placing Lambda functions in public subnets is not the right way to give them internet access. AWS explicitly notes that connecting a Lambda function to a public subnet does not give it internet access. Without a NAT gateway or a DynamoDB VPC endpoint, the Lambda functions would not reliably reach DynamoDB. See [Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html).

- **C is incorrect.** Hosting Lambda outside the VPC does not provide private connectivity to the Neptune DB cluster. Neptune cluster endpoints are accessible within the VPC unless public endpoint functionality is explicitly configured, which this option does not do. Also, relying on “IP ranges of Lambda functions” is not a valid stable access-control pattern for default Lambda internet egress.

- **D is incorrect.** A Neptune interface VPC endpoint is for **Amazon Neptune API operations**, not for connecting to the Neptune database cluster endpoint from Lambda functions outside the VPC. The Neptune documentation says PrivateLink can be used to create a private connection to **Amazon Neptune API endpoints**; that does not make the Neptune database endpoint accessible to a Lambda function running outside the VPC. See [Amazon Neptune and interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/vpc-interface-endpoints.html).

Therefore, **B** and **E** are the two viable standalone solutions: either use private subnets with NAT for DynamoDB access, or use private/isolated subnets with a DynamoDB VPC endpoint.

zh.question: 一家公司正在运行一个无服务器应用程序，该应用程序由多个 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon DynamoDB 表组成。该公司创建了新功能，需要 Lambda 函数访问 Amazon Neptune DB 集群。Neptune DB 集群位于一个 VPC 中的三个子网内。以下哪些可能的解决方案将允许 Lambda 函数访问 Neptune DB 集群和 DynamoDB 表？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 Neptune VPC 中创建三个公有子网，并通过互联网网关路由流量。在这三个新的公有子网中托管 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 Neptune VPC 中创建三个私有子网，并通过 NAT 网关路由互联网流量。在这三个新的私有子网中托管 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 在 VPC 外部托管 Lambda 函数。更新 Neptune 安全组，允许来自 Lambda 函数 IP 范围的访问。
options.D: 在 VPC 外部托管 Lambda 函数。为 Neptune 数据库创建 VPC 端点，并让 Lambda 函数通过 VPC 端点访问 Neptune。
options.E: 在 Neptune VPC 中创建三个私有子网。在这三个新的隔离子网中托管 Lambda 函数。为 DynamoDB 创建 VPC 端点，并将 DynamoDB 流量路由到该 VPC 端点。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序的 Lambda 函数必须访问两个不同的目标：位于 VPC 内子网中的 Amazon Neptune DB 集群，以及 DynamoDB 表。DynamoDB 表是区域级 AWS 服务，通常通过公有服务端点访问，除非你提供 VPC 端点。

正确答案是 **B 和 E**。

- **B 正确。** 要访问 Neptune 集群，必须将 Lambda 函数配置到包含 Neptune 集群的 VPC 中。AWS 说明，Neptune DB 集群是在 VPC 中创建的，其端点可在该 VPC 内访问。如果连接到 VPC 的 Lambda 函数还需要通过普通的公有 AWS 服务端点访问 DynamoDB，则私有子网需要通过 NAT 网关获得出站互联网访问。AWS Lambda 文档还说明，当 Lambda 函数附加到 VPC 时，除非该 VPC 具有互联网访问权限，否则它只能访问该 VPC 内可用的资源；并且私有子网可以通过 NAT 网关访问互联网。请参阅 [Securing your Amazon Neptune database with Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/security-vpc.html) 和 [Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html)。

- **E 正确。** 这是 B 的私有网络替代方案。Lambda 函数被放置在与 Neptune 相同 VPC 中的私有/隔离子网中，因此它们可以私有地访问 Neptune DB 集群。由于隔离的私有子网没有 NAT 互联网访问权限，该解决方案为 DynamoDB 添加了一个 VPC 端点。AWS 文档说明 DynamoDB 支持 VPC 端点，包括在路由表中指定的网关端点，用于通过 AWS 网络从 Amazon VPC 访问 DynamoDB。请参阅 [AWS PrivateLink for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)。

错误选项：

- **A 错误。** 将 Lambda 函数放在公有子网中并不是为其提供互联网访问权限的正确方式。AWS 明确指出，将 Lambda 函数连接到公有子网不会为其提供互联网访问权限。如果没有 NAT 网关或 DynamoDB VPC 端点，Lambda 函数将无法可靠地访问 DynamoDB。请参阅 [Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html)。
