The company needs to give only a specific list of users the ability to access the application from the internet. The company cannot change the application and cannot integrate the application with an identity provider. All users must be authenticated through multi-factor authentication (MFA). Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a user pool in Amazon Cognito. Configure the pool for the application. Populate the pool with the required users. Configure the pool to require MFConfigure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through the Amazon Cognito hosted UI.
options.B: Configure the users in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach a resource policy to the Fargate service to require users to use MFA. Configure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through IAM.
options.C: Configure the users in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Configure resource protection for the ALB. Create a resource protection rule to require users to use MFA.
options.D: Create a user pool in AWS Amplify. Configure the pool for the application. Populate the pool with the required users. Configure the pool to require MFA. Configure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through the Amplify hosted UI.

en.explanation:
The company needs to protect an internet-facing third-party containerized web application **without modifying the application** and require that only a defined set of users can access it with MFA. The appropriate place to enforce authentication is therefore **in front of the application**, at the Application Load Balancer.

**Correct answer: A. Create an Amazon Cognito user pool, add the required users, require MFA, and configure an ALB listener rule to authenticate through the Cognito hosted UI.**

AWS documentation states that an Application Load Balancer can authenticate users before forwarding requests to applications, which lets you offload authentication to the load balancer so the application can focus on business logic. For Cognito integration, AWS instructs you to create a Cognito user pool, user pool client, and user pool domain, and then configure an ALB listener rule with an `authenticate-cognito` action followed by a forward action. The same ALB documentation says the supported authentication action types are `authenticate-cognito` and `authenticate-oidc` for HTTPS listeners. See [Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html).

Amazon Cognito user pools can also enforce MFA. The Cognito documentation describes the **Require MFA** setting: all users in the user pool must sign in with an additional SMS, email, or TOTP code. See [Adding MFA to a user pool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/user-pool-settings-mfa.html).

Therefore, option A satisfies all requirements: no application change, defined user list in a Cognito user pool, MFA enforcement in Cognito, and ALB-level authentication before traffic reaches the ECS/Fargate service.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**B. IAM users + Fargate resource policy + ALB authentication through IAM** — Incorrect. IAM users are for AWS resource access, not end-user web application authentication through an ALB. ALB listener authentication supports Cognito and OIDC authentication actions, not an IAM-based web login flow. Also, a Fargate service resource policy would not provide internet user authentication for a third-party web application.

**C. IAM users + IAM Identity Center + ALB resource protection rule** — Incorrect. IAM Identity Center is used for workforce access to AWS accounts and applications, but this option describes non-existent or unsuitable ALB “resource protection” rules for enforcing user MFA on web requests. The documented ALB user-authentication mechanisms are Cognito and OIDC listener authentication actions, not IAM Identity Center resource protection rules.

**D. AWS Amplify user pool + Amplify hosted UI + ALB listener rule** — Incorrect. Amplify can help configure front-end application authentication, often backed by Cognito, but ALB listener authentication integrates directly with **Amazon Cognito user pools** or an OIDC IdP. There is no ALB listener rule action to authenticate through an “Amplify hosted UI.”

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上部署一个第三方 Web 应用程序。该应用程序被打包为 Docker 镜像。公司已将该 Docker 镜像作为 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中的 AWS Fargate 服务进行部署。Application Load Balancer (ALB) 将流量定向到该应用程序。公司需要只允许特定用户列表中的用户从互联网访问该应用程序。公司无法更改该应用程序，也无法将该应用程序与身份提供商集成。所有用户都必须通过多重身份验证 (MFA) 进行身份验证。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon Cognito 中创建一个用户池。为该应用程序配置该用户池。将所需用户填充到该用户池中。配置该用户池以要求 MFA。配置 ALB 上的监听器规则，以要求通过 Amazon Cognito 托管 UI 进行身份验证。
options.B: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中配置这些用户。将资源策略附加到 Fargate 服务，以要求用户使用 MFA。配置 ALB 上的监听器规则，以要求通过 IAM 进行身份验证。
options.C: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中配置这些用户。启用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。为 ALB 配置资源保护。创建资源保护规则以要求用户使用 MFA。
options.D: 在 AWS Amplify 中创建一个用户池。为该应用程序配置该用户池。将所需用户填充到该用户池中。配置该用户池以要求 MFA。配置 ALB 上的监听器规则，以要求通过 Amplify 托管 UI 进行身份验证。

zh.explanation:
公司需要保护一个面向互联网的第三方容器化 Web 应用程序，且**不修改该应用程序**，并要求只有一组已定义的用户能够通过 MFA 访问它。因此，实施身份验证的适当位置是在**应用程序前端**，即 Application Load Balancer。

**正确答案：A. 创建 Amazon Cognito 用户池，添加所需用户，要求 MFA，并配置 ALB 监听器规则以通过 Cognito 托管 UI 进行身份验证。**

AWS 文档说明，Application Load Balancer 可以在将请求转发到应用程序之前对用户进行身份验证，这使你可以将身份验证卸载到负载均衡器，让应用程序专注于业务逻辑。对于 Cognito 集成，AWS 指示你创建 Cognito 用户池、用户池客户端和用户池域，然后配置带有 `authenticate-cognito` 操作且后跟转发操作的 ALB 监听器规则。同一 ALB 文档还说明，HTTPS 监听器支持的身份验证操作类型是 `authenticate-cognito` 和 `authenticate-oidc`。请参阅 [Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)。

Amazon Cognito 用户池也可以强制执行 MFA。Cognito 文档描述了 **Require MFA** 设置：用户池中的所有用户都必须使用额外的 SMS、电子邮件或 TOTP 代码登录。请参阅 [Adding MFA to a user pool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/user-pool-settings-mfa.html)。

因此，选项 A 满足所有要求：无需更改应用程序，在 Cognito 用户池中定义用户列表，在 Cognito 中强制执行 MFA，并在流量到达 ECS/Fargate 服务之前进行 ALB 级别身份验证。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. IAM 用户 + Fargate 资源策略 + 通过 IAM 进行 ALB 身份验证** — 不正确。IAM 用户用于访问 AWS 资源，而不是通过 ALB 对最终用户 Web 应用程序进行身份验证。ALB 监听器身份验证支持 Cognito 和 OIDC 身份验证操作，而不支持基于 IAM 的 Web 登录流程。此外，Fargate 服务资源策略无法为第三方 Web 应用程序提供互联网用户身份验证。

**C. IAM 用户 + IAM Identity Center + ALB 资源保护规则** — 不正确。IAM Identity Center 用于员工访问 AWS 账户和应用程序，但此选项描述的是不存在或不适合的 ALB “资源保护”规则，用于在 Web 请求上强制用户使用 MFA。文档记录的 ALB 用户身份验证机制是 Cognito 和 OIDC 监听器身份验证操作，而不是 IAM Identity Center 资源保护规则。

**D. AWS Amplify 用户池 + Amplify 托管 UI + ALB 监听器规则** — 不正确。Amplify 可以帮助配置前端应用程序身份验证，通常由 Cognito 支持，但 ALB 监听器身份验证直接与 **Amazon Cognito 用户池**或 OIDC IdP 集成。不存在通过“Amplify 托管 UI”进行身份验证的 ALB 监听器规则操作。

en.question: A solutions architect is preparing to deploy a new security tool into several previously unused AWS Regions. The solutions architect will deploy the tool by using an AWS CloudFormation stack set. The stack set's template contains an IAM role that has a custom name. Upon creation of the stack set, no stack instances are created successfully. What should the solutions architect do to deploy the stacks successfully?

options.A: Enable the new Regions in all relevant accounts. Specify the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.
options.B: Use the Service Quotas console to request a quota increase for the number of CloudFormation stacks in each new Region in all relevant accounts. Specify the CAPABILITY_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.
options.C: Specify the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability and the SELF_MANAGED permissions model during the creation of the stack set.
options.D: Specify an administration role ARN and the CAPABILITY_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.

en.explanation:
The StackSet is being deployed into AWS Regions that have not been used before, and the StackSet template creates an IAM role with a **custom name**. Two prerequisites are relevant: the target Regions must be enabled in the accounts involved, and CloudFormation must be explicitly allowed to create named IAM resources.

**Correct answer: A. Enable the new Regions in all relevant accounts. Specify the `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` capability during the creation of the stack set.**

AWS CloudFormation StackSets documentation states that Regions disabled by default must be enabled before they can be used. For StackSets to successfully create or update a stack instance, the target account must have the Region enabled, and the StackSet administrator account or AWS Organizations management account must have the same Region enabled as the target account ([CloudFormation StackSets opt-in Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-opt-in-regions.html)).

In addition, the CloudFormation `CreateStackSet` API documentation says that templates containing IAM resources require `CAPABILITY_IAM` or `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`; however, if the IAM resources have **custom names**, you **must** specify `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`. If neither capability is specified, CloudFormation returns an `InsufficientCapabilities` error ([CreateStackSet API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStackSet.html)). Because the template contains an IAM role with a custom name, `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` is required.

Therefore, option A addresses both likely blockers: the unused/new Regions must be enabled, and the named IAM role requires `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Request a CloudFormation stack quota increase and specify `CAPABILITY_IAM`.**  
  There is no indication that the failure is caused by a CloudFormation stack quota. More importantly, `CAPABILITY_IAM` is not sufficient when IAM resources have custom names; `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` is required.

- **C. Specify `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` and the `SELF_MANAGED` permissions model.**  
  This includes the correct IAM capability, but it does not address the fact that the StackSet is being deployed into previously unused/possibly disabled Regions. Also, choosing `SELF_MANAGED` is not inherently required by the scenario; StackSets can use self-managed or service-managed permissions depending on the deployment model.

- **D. Specify an administration role ARN and `CAPABILITY_IAM`.**  
  An administration role ARN is relevant only for self-managed StackSets with customized administrator roles, and it is not the issue described. Also, `CAPABILITY_IAM` is insufficient for IAM resources with custom names; `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` is required.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正准备将一个新的安全工具部署到多个以前未使用过的 AWS 区域中。解决方案架构师将使用 AWS CloudFormation stack set 来部署该工具。该 stack set 的模板包含一个具有自定义名称的 IAM 角色。在创建 stack set 时，没有任何 stack instances 成功创建。解决方案架构师应如何做才能成功部署这些 stacks？

options.A: 在所有相关账户中启用这些新区域。在创建 stack set 时指定 CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM 能力。
options.B: 使用 Service Quotas 控制台请求提高所有相关账户中每个新区域的 CloudFormation stacks 数量配额。在创建 stack set 时指定 CAPABILITY_IAM 能力。
options.C: 在创建 stack set 时指定 CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM 能力和 SELF_MANAGED 权限模型。
options.D: 在创建 stack set 时指定 administration role ARN 和 CAPABILITY_IAM 能力。

zh.explanation:
该 StackSet 正在部署到以前未使用过的 AWS 区域，并且 StackSet 模板会创建一个具有**自定义名称**的 IAM 角色。这里有两个相关的先决条件：目标区域必须在相关账户中启用，并且必须明确允许 CloudFormation 创建具名 IAM 资源。

**正确答案：A. 在所有相关账户中启用这些新区域。在创建 stack set 时指定 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` 能力。**

AWS CloudFormation StackSets 文档说明，默认禁用的区域必须先启用后才能使用。对于 StackSets 要成功创建或更新 stack instance，目标账户必须启用该区域，并且 StackSet 管理员账户或 AWS Organizations 管理账户必须启用与目标账户相同的区域（[CloudFormation StackSets opt-in Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-opt-in-regions.html)）。

此外，CloudFormation `CreateStackSet` API 文档说明，包含 IAM 资源的模板需要 `CAPABILITY_IAM` 或 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`；但是，如果 IAM 资源具有**自定义名称**，则**必须**指定 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`。如果未指定任何一种能力，CloudFormation 会返回 `InsufficientCapabilities` 错误（[CreateStackSet API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStackSet.html)）。由于该模板包含一个具有自定义名称的 IAM 角色，因此需要 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`。

因此，选项 A 同时解决了两个可能的阻碍因素：未使用过/新的区域必须启用，并且具名 IAM 角色需要 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B. 请求提高 CloudFormation stack 配额并指定 `CAPABILITY_IAM`。**  
  没有迹象表明失败是由 CloudFormation stack 配额导致的。更重要的是，当 IAM 资源具有自定义名称时，`CAPABILITY_IAM` 不足够；需要 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`。

- **C. 指定 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM` 和 `SELF_MANAGED` 权限模型。**  
  这包含了正确的 IAM 能力，但没有解决 StackSet 正在部署到以前未使用过/可能已禁用的区域这一事实。此外，场景本身并不要求选择 `SELF_MANAGED`；StackSets 可以根据部署模型使用 self-managed 或 service-managed permissions。

- **D. 指定 administration role ARN 和 `CAPABILITY_IAM`。**  
  administration role ARN 仅与使用自定义管理员角色的 self-managed StackSets 相关，并不是题目描述的问题。此外，对于具有自定义名称的 IAM 资源，`CAPABILITY_IAM` 不足够；需要 `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`。

en.question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster for the application's database. The DB cluster contains one small primary instance and three larger replica instances. The application runs on an AWS Lambda function. The application makes many short-lived connections to the database's replica instances to perform read-only operations. During periods of high traffic, the application becomes unreliable and the database reports that too many connections are being established. The frequency of high-traffic periods is unpredictable. Which solution will improve the reliability of the application?

options.A: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.
options.B: Increase the max_connections setting on the DB cluster's parameter group. Reboot all the instances in the DB cluster. Update the Lambda function to connect to the DB cluster endpoint.
options.C: Configure instance scaling for the DB cluster to occur when the DatabaseConnections metric is close to the max connections setting. Update the Lambda function to connect to the Aurora reader endpoint.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API on the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application is an AWS Lambda-based workload that performs many short-lived, read-only connections to an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster's reader instances. During unpredictable spikes, the database reports too many connections. The problem is not primarily a lack of read capacity; it is connection churn and connection-limit exhaustion from a serverless application pattern.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.**

This is the best fit. AWS specifically identifies serverless and event-driven applications such as Lambda as workloads that can create many short-lived database connections, causing degraded database performance or connection-limit errors. RDS Proxy provides connection pooling and multiplexing, translating many client connections into fewer backend database connections and handling connection surges more gracefully. The AWS documentation states that RDS Proxy can help when Lambda-backed applications create many short-lived requests and can reduce connection overhead for PostgreSQL workloads by pooling and multiplexing connections ([Common usage scenarios for RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)).

Because the workload is read-only and should use the larger replica instances, the proxy should use a **read-only endpoint**. AWS documentation for creating proxy endpoints states that read-only endpoints can only perform queries and that RDS Proxy can use reader instances for each connection, allowing query-intensive applications to use the cluster's read capacity without adding overhead to the primary instance ([Creating a proxy endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.CreatingEndpoint.html)). The documentation also notes that RDS Proxy read-only endpoints route connections across available replicas using least outstanding connections logic, which is better than DNS-based reader endpoints for uneven utilization caused by DNS caching ([Common usage scenarios for RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

**B. Increase `max_connections` and reboot all instances.**  
This might temporarily raise the connection ceiling, but it does not address the root cause: Lambda is creating many short-lived connections. Higher `max_connections` also consumes more database memory and can increase contention. AWS recommends RDS Proxy for exactly this connection churn scenario because it reuses pooled connections and protects the database from oversubscription ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). Also, connecting the Lambda function to the **DB cluster endpoint** would target the writer, not the reader replicas, which is the wrong target for this read-only workload.

**C. Configure instance scaling based on `DatabaseConnections` and use the Aurora reader endpoint.**  
Scaling instances may increase compute capacity, but it is not a reliable response to unpredictable, short-lived traffic spikes and does not directly solve rapid connection churn. The Aurora reader endpoint is DNS-based and can suffer from uneven replica utilization because of DNS caching; AWS notes that clients can pin to a particular replica or fail to recognize topology changes. RDS Proxy read-only endpoints are designed to improve replica connection distribution and connection handling ([Common usage scenarios for RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)).

**D. Use RDS Proxy with a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API on the proxy.**  
This combines two different mechanisms incorrectly. RDS Proxy endpoints are database proxy endpoints with target roles such as `READ_WRITE` or `READ_ONLY`; the documented proxy endpoint creation process does not configure an “Aurora Data API endpoint on the proxy” ([Creating a proxy endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.CreatingEndpoint.html)). The correct RDS Proxy solution is to create a read-only proxy endpoint and connect the Lambda function to that proxy endpoint using normal database connectivity.

Therefore, **A** is the correct solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群作为应用程序的数据库。该 DB 集群包含一个较小的主实例和三个较大的副本实例。该应用程序运行在 AWS Lambda 函数上。该应用程序会与数据库的副本实例建立许多短生命周期连接，以执行只读操作。在高流量期间，应用程序变得不可靠，数据库报告正在建立过多连接。高流量期间的出现频率不可预测。哪种解决方案将提高应用程序的可靠性？

options.A: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 为 DB 集群创建代理。为该代理配置只读端点。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到该代理端点。
options.B: 增加 DB 集群参数组中的 max_connections 设置。重启 DB 集群中的所有实例。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到 DB 集群端点。
options.C: 配置 DB 集群的实例扩展，使其在 DatabaseConnections 指标接近最大连接数设置时发生。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到 Aurora 读取器端点。
options.D: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 为 DB 集群创建代理。在代理上为 Aurora Data API 配置只读端点。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到该代理端点。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序是一个基于 AWS Lambda 的工作负载，会对 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群的读取器实例执行许多短生命周期的只读连接。在不可预测的流量峰值期间，数据库报告连接过多。问题主要不是读取容量不足；而是来自无服务器应用程序模式的连接抖动和连接限制耗尽。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 为 DB 集群创建代理。为该代理配置只读端点。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到该代理端点。**

这是最合适的方案。AWS 明确指出，Lambda 等无服务器和事件驱动型应用程序可能会创建大量短生命周期数据库连接，从而导致数据库性能下降或连接限制错误。RDS Proxy 提供连接池和多路复用，将许多客户端连接转换为更少的后端数据库连接，并能更平稳地处理连接激增。AWS 文档说明，当 Lambda 支持的应用程序创建许多短生命周期请求时，RDS Proxy 可以提供帮助，并且可以通过池化和多路复用连接来减少 PostgreSQL 工作负载的连接开销（[RDS Proxy 的常见使用场景](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)）。

由于该工作负载是只读的，并且应使用较大的副本实例，因此代理应使用**只读端点**。AWS 关于创建代理端点的文档指出，只读端点只能执行查询，并且 RDS Proxy 可以为每个连接使用读取器实例，从而允许查询密集型应用程序使用集群的读取容量，而不会给主实例增加额外开销（[创建代理端点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.CreatingEndpoint.html)）。该文档还指出，RDS Proxy 只读端点会使用最少未完成连接逻辑在可用副本之间路由连接，这比基于 DNS 的读取器端点更适合处理由 DNS 缓存导致的不均衡利用率（[RDS Proxy 的常见使用场景](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. 增加 `max_connections` 并重启所有实例。**  
这可能会临时提高连接上限，但不能解决根本原因：Lambda 正在创建许多短生命周期连接。更高的 `max_connections` 还会消耗更多数据库内存，并可能增加争用。AWS 针对这种连接抖动场景推荐 RDS Proxy，因为它会重用池化连接，并保护数据库免受过度订阅影响（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。此外，将 Lambda 函数连接到 **DB 集群端点** 会指向写入器，而不是读取器副本，这对于此只读工作负载而言是错误目标。

**C. 基于 `DatabaseConnections` 配置实例扩展并使用 Aurora 读取器端点。**  
扩展实例可能会增加计算容量，但对于不可预测、短生命周期的流量峰值而言，这不是可靠的响应方式，也不能直接解决快速连接抖动。Aurora 读取器端点基于 DNS，可能会因 DNS 缓存而出现副本利用率不均；AWS 指出，客户端可能会固定到特定副本，或者无法识别拓扑变化。RDS Proxy 只读端点旨在改进副本连接分布和连接处理（[RDS Proxy 的常见使用场景](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)）。

**D. 将 RDS Proxy 与代理上的 Aurora Data API 只读端点一起使用。**  
这错误地组合了两种不同机制。RDS Proxy 端点是数据库代理端点，具有诸如 `READ_WRITE` 或 `READ_ONLY` 的目标角色；文档化的代理端点创建流程不会配置“代理上的 Aurora Data API 端点”（[创建代理端点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.CreatingEndpoint.html)）。正确的 RDS Proxy 解决方案是创建只读代理端点，并使用正常数据库连接方式将 Lambda 函数连接到该代理端点。

因此，**A** 是正确的解决方案。

en.question: A retail company is mounting IoT sensors in all of its stores worldwide. During the manufacturing of each sensor, the company’s private certificate authority (CA) issues an X.509 certificate that contains a unique serial number. The company then deploys each certificate to its respective sensor. A solutions architect needs to give the sensors the ability to send data to AWS after they are installed. Sensors must not be able to send data to AWS until they are installed. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning template. Include the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Add the Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook. During manufacturing, call the RegisterThing API operation and specify the template and parameters.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning template. Include the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Specify the Step Functions state machine to validate parameters. Call the StartThingRegistrationTask API operation during installation.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning template. Include the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Add the Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook. Register the CA with AWS IoT Core, specify the provisioning template, and set the allow-auto-registration parameter.
options.D: Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning template. Include the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Include parameter validation in the template. Provision a claim certificate and a private key for each device that uses the CA. Grant AWS IoT Core service permissions to update AWS IoT things during provisioning.

en.explanation:
The company already manufactures each sensor with a unique X.509 certificate issued by its own private CA, and the certificate contains a unique serial number. The requirement is to let devices become usable in AWS IoT only after installation, not during manufacturing. This maps to AWS IoT Core just-in-time provisioning (JITP) with a registered CA and a provisioning template, plus a Lambda pre-provisioning hook to approve or reject provisioning based on the serial number/installation state.

**Correct answer: C**

Option C is correct because registering the company's CA certificate with AWS IoT Core and enabling auto-registration lets AWS IoT provision devices when they first connect with a certificate signed by that registered CA. The AWS IoT JITP documentation states that when a device attempts to connect using a certificate signed by a registered CA, AWS IoT loads the template from the CA certificate and uses it to call `RegisterThing`; the workflow registers the certificate and activates it when provisioning completes. The JITP template can reference certificate-derived parameters including `AWS::IoT::Certificate::SerialNumber`, which matches the certificate serial number requirement in the question. AWS also shows CA registration with `--allow-auto-registration` and a registration configuration/provisioning template for JITP. See [Just-in-time provisioning - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/jit-provisioning.html).

The Lambda pre-provisioning hook provides the necessary control point. AWS recommends pre-provisioning hook functions to control which devices are onboarded; these hooks are Lambda functions that validate parameters before allowing provisioning, and provisioning proceeds only if the function returns `allowProvisioning: true`. The hook input includes the provisioning parameters passed in the `RegisterThing` request, so the function can validate the serial number against an installation/authorized-devices system before allowing the thing, certificate, and policy to be created/activated. See [Pre-provisioning hooks - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/pre-provisioning-hook.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **A is incorrect.** It uses a Lambda pre-provisioning hook and a provisioning template, but it calls `RegisterThing` **during manufacturing**. That would provision/register the device before it is installed, which violates the requirement that sensors must not be able to send data to AWS until after installation.

- **B is incorrect.** AWS IoT Core provisioning templates support Lambda pre-provisioning hooks, not Step Functions state machines as a direct provisioning-template parameter validator. The documented hook mechanism is a Lambda function called during `RegisterThing`, and provisioning proceeds only if that Lambda response allows it.

- **D is incorrect.** This describes claim-certificate-based fleet provisioning. AWS documentation states that devices can be manufactured with a provisioning claim certificate and private key, and AWS IoT can exchange them for unique device certificates. However, this does not use the already-issued per-device private-CA certificate and serial number as the onboarding identity, and the option does not include a Lambda pre-provisioning hook or equivalent installation-state validation. Claim provisioning is more appropriate for devices that do not already have their final unique device certificates. See [Provisioning devices that don't have device certificates using fleet provisioning - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/provision-wo-cert.html).

zh.question: 一家零售公司正在其全球所有门店安装 IoT 传感器。在每个传感器制造期间，该公司的私有证书颁发机构（CA）会颁发一个包含唯一序列号的 X.509 证书。然后公司将每个证书部署到对应的传感器上。解决方案架构师需要让传感器在安装后能够向 AWS 发送数据。传感器在安装之前不得向 AWS 发送数据。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个可以验证序列号的 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一个 AWS IoT Core provisioning template。在 Parameters 部分中包含 SerialNumber 参数。将该 Lambda 函数添加为 pre-provisioning hook。在制造期间，调用 RegisterThing API operation 并指定模板和参数。
options.B: 创建一个可以验证序列号的 AWS Step Functions state machine。创建一个 AWS IoT Core provisioning template。在 Parameters 部分中包含 SerialNumber 参数。指定 Step Functions state machine 来验证参数。在安装期间调用 StartThingRegistrationTask API operation。
options.C: 创建一个可以验证序列号的 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一个 AWS IoT Core provisioning template。在 Parameters 部分中包含 SerialNumber 参数。将该 Lambda 函数添加为 pre-provisioning hook。向 AWS IoT Core 注册 CA，指定 provisioning template，并设置 allow-auto-registration 参数。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS IoT Core provisioning template。在 Parameters 部分中包含 SerialNumber 参数。在模板中包含参数验证。为使用该 CA 的每台设备预置一个 claim certificate 和一个 private key。授予 AWS IoT Core 服务在预置期间更新 AWS IoT things 的权限。

zh.explanation:
该公司已经为每个传感器在制造时安装了由其自有私有 CA 颁发的唯一 X.509 证书，并且该证书包含唯一序列号。要求是在安装之后才让设备能够在 AWS IoT 中使用，而不是在制造期间。这对应于 AWS IoT Core just-in-time provisioning (JITP)：使用已注册的 CA 和 provisioning template，并结合 Lambda pre-provisioning hook，根据序列号/安装状态批准或拒绝预置。

**正确答案：C**

选项 C 正确，因为将公司的 CA 证书注册到 AWS IoT Core 并启用 auto-registration，可以让 AWS IoT 在设备首次使用由该注册 CA 签名的证书连接时预置设备。AWS IoT JITP 文档说明，当设备尝试使用由注册 CA 签名的证书进行连接时，AWS IoT 会从 CA 证书加载模板，并使用该模板调用 `RegisterThing`；该工作流会注册证书，并在预置完成时激活证书。JITP 模板可以引用从证书派生的参数，包括 `AWS::IoT::Certificate::SerialNumber`，这与题目中的证书序列号要求相匹配。AWS 还展示了使用 `--allow-auto-registration` 以及用于 JITP 的注册配置/provisioning template 进行 CA 注册。请参阅 [Just-in-time provisioning - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/jit-provisioning.html)。

Lambda pre-provisioning hook 提供了必要的控制点。AWS 建议使用 pre-provisioning hook functions 来控制哪些设备可以入网；这些 hook 是 Lambda 函数，会在允许预置之前验证参数，并且只有在函数返回 `allowProvisioning: true` 时才会继续预置。hook 输入包含 `RegisterThing` 请求中传入的预置参数，因此该函数可以先根据安装/授权设备系统验证序列号，然后再允许创建/激活 thing、certificate 和 policy。请参阅 [Pre-provisioning hooks - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/pre-provisioning-hook.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **A 不正确。** 它使用 Lambda pre-provisioning hook 和 provisioning template，但它在**制造期间**调用 `RegisterThing`。这会在设备安装之前预置/注册设备，违反了传感器必须在安装之后才能向 AWS 发送数据的要求。

- **B 不正确。** AWS IoT Core provisioning templates 支持 Lambda pre-provisioning hooks，而不是将 Step Functions state machines 作为直接的 provisioning-template 参数验证器。文档化的 hook 机制是在 `RegisterThing` 期间调用 Lambda 函数，并且只有该 Lambda 响应允许时才会继续预置。

- **D 不正确。** 这描述的是基于 claim certificate 的 fleet provisioning。AWS 文档说明，设备可以在制造时带有 provisioning claim certificate 和 private key，并且 AWS IoT 可以将其交换为唯一设备证书。但是，这没有使用已经颁发的每设备私有 CA 证书和序列号作为入网身份，而且该选项也不包含 Lambda pre-provisioning hook 或等效的安装状态验证。claim provisioning 更适用于尚未拥有最终唯一设备证书的设备。请参阅 [Provisioning devices that don't have device certificates using fleet provisioning - AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/provision-wo-cert.html)。

en.question: A startup company recently migrated a large ecommerce website to AWS. The website has experienced a 70% increase in sales. Software engineers are using a private GitHub repository to manage code. The DevOps team is using Jenkins for builds and unit testing. The engineers need to receive notifications for bad builds and zero downtime during deployments. The engineers also need to ensure any changes to production are seamless for users and can be rolled back in the event of a major issue. The software engineers have decided to use AWS CodePipeline to manage their build and deployment process. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use GitHub websockets to trigger the CodePipeline pipeline. Use the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to conduct unit testing. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in an in-place, all-at-once deployment configuration using AWS CodeDeploy.
options.B: Use GitHub webhooks to trigger the CodePipeline pipeline. Use the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to conduct unit testing. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in a blue/green deployment using AWS CodeDeploy.
options.C: Use GitHub websockets to trigger the CodePipeline pipeline. Use AWS X-Ray for unit testing and static code analysis. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in a blue/green deployment using AWS CodeDeploy.
options.D: Use GitHub webhooks to trigger the CodePipeline pipeline. Use AWS X-Ray for unit testing and static code analysis. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in an in-place, all- at-once deployment configuration using AWS CodeDeploy.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company wants CodePipeline to orchestrate a CI/CD flow from a private GitHub repository, continue using Jenkins-oriented build/test workflows, notify engineers on bad builds, and deploy production changes with minimal/no user impact and a fast rollback path.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Use GitHub webhooks to trigger the CodePipeline pipeline. Use the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to conduct unit testing. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in a blue/green deployment using AWS CodeDeploy.**

This is the best fit:

* **GitHub-triggered CodePipeline:** CodePipeline supports automated pipeline starts from source events such as Git push events for GitHub-connected source actions. The CodePipeline trigger documentation states that triggers can start a pipeline when a change on a branch or pull request is detected, and notes that this trigger type uses automated change detection as the **Webhook** trigger type for providers including GitHub ([CodePipeline triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-triggers.html)).
* **Jenkins integration with CodeBuild:** AWS provides a Jenkins plugin for CodeBuild. The documentation states that you can use the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to integrate CodeBuild with Jenkins build jobs, sending Jenkins build jobs to CodeBuild instead of Jenkins build nodes ([Use AWS CodeBuild with Jenkins](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/jenkins-plugin.html)). CodeBuild buildspec files define build commands and phases, so unit test commands can be run as part of the build ([CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)).
* **Notifications through SNS:** CodePipeline notification rules can specify events and an **Amazon SNS topic** as the notification target ([Create a notification rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/notification-rule-create.html)). This supports alerting engineers about failed/bad builds or pipeline failures.
* **Zero-downtime/seamless deployment and rollback:** CodeDeploy blue/green deployments are designed to minimize interruptions by provisioning/running the new version alongside the old version before rerouting production traffic. The CodeDeploy documentation also states that blue/green provides faster and more reliable rollback for EC2/On-Premises because traffic can be routed back to the original instances if they have not been terminated ([CodeDeploy deployment types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)). This directly satisfies zero downtime, seamless user experience, and rollback requirements.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

A uses **GitHub websockets** and an **in-place, all-at-once deployment**. CodePipeline's relevant integration is based on source triggers/webhook-style change detection, not "websockets". More importantly, an in-place all-at-once deployment is not the best choice for zero downtime or seamless rollback. CodeDeploy in-place deployments stop/update/start the application on instances, whereas blue/green deploys the new revision to a replacement environment and reroutes traffic when ready ([CodeDeploy deployment types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)).

### C

C uses **GitHub websockets** and **AWS X-Ray for unit testing and static code analysis**. X-Ray is not a unit testing or static analysis service. X-Ray collects request trace data and helps view, filter, and analyze application request behavior to identify issues and optimization opportunities ([What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)). The blue/green deployment part is good, but the source trigger and testing tool choices are wrong.

### D

D correctly mentions GitHub webhooks, but it uses **AWS X-Ray for unit testing/static code analysis** and an **in-place, all-at-once deployment**. X-Ray is for tracing/observability, not unit testing or static analysis ([What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)). The in-place all-at-once deployment also does not meet the stated zero-downtime and seamless rollback requirements as well as blue/green deployment.

Therefore, **B** is the correct answer.

zh.question: 一家初创公司最近将一个大型电子商务网站迁移到了 AWS。该网站的销售额增长了 70%。软件工程师正在使用私有 GitHub 存储库来管理代码。DevOps 团队正在使用 Jenkins 进行构建和单元测试。工程师需要在构建异常时收到通知，并且在部署期间实现零停机。工程师还需要确保对生产环境的任何更改对用户来说都是无缝的，并且在发生重大问题时可以回滚。软件工程师已决定使用 AWS CodePipeline 来管理其构建和部署流程。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 GitHub websockets 触发 CodePipeline 管道。使用 AWS CodeBuild 的 Jenkins 插件进行单元测试。针对任何异常构建向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 以就地、一次性全部部署配置进行部署。
options.B: 使用 GitHub webhooks 触发 CodePipeline 管道。使用 AWS CodeBuild 的 Jenkins 插件进行单元测试。针对任何异常构建向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 进行蓝/绿部署。
options.C: 使用 GitHub websockets 触发 CodePipeline 管道。使用 AWS X-Ray 进行单元测试和静态代码分析。针对任何异常构建向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 进行蓝/绿部署。
options.D: 使用 GitHub webhooks 触发 CodePipeline 管道。使用 AWS X-Ray 进行单元测试和静态代码分析。针对任何异常构建向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 以就地、一次性全部部署配置进行部署。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司希望 CodePipeline 从私有 GitHub 存储库编排 CI/CD 流程，继续使用面向 Jenkins 的构建/测试工作流，在构建异常时通知工程师，并以最小或无用户影响以及快速回滚路径来部署生产环境更改。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 使用 GitHub webhooks 触发 CodePipeline 管道。使用 AWS CodeBuild 的 Jenkins 插件进行单元测试。针对任何异常构建向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 进行蓝/绿部署。**

这是最合适的方案：

* **GitHub 触发的 CodePipeline：** CodePipeline 支持从源事件（例如 GitHub 连接的源操作的 Git push 事件）自动启动管道。CodePipeline 触发器文档说明，当检测到分支或拉取请求发生更改时，触发器可以启动管道，并指出对于包括 GitHub 在内的提供商，此触发器类型使用自动更改检测作为 **Webhook** 触发器类型（[CodePipeline triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-triggers.html)）。
* **Jenkins 与 CodeBuild 集成：** AWS 为 CodeBuild 提供 Jenkins 插件。文档说明，你可以使用 AWS CodeBuild 的 Jenkins 插件将 CodeBuild 与 Jenkins 构建作业集成，将 Jenkins 构建作业发送到 CodeBuild，而不是 Jenkins 构建节点（[Use AWS CodeBuild with Jenkins](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/jenkins-plugin.html)）。CodeBuild buildspec 文件定义构建命令和阶段，因此可以在构建过程中运行单元测试命令（[CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)）。
* **通过 SNS 发送通知：** CodePipeline 通知规则可以指定事件，并将 **Amazon SNS topic** 作为通知目标（[Create a notification rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/notification-rule-create.html)）。这支持向工程师提醒构建失败/异常或管道失败。
* **零停机/无缝部署和回滚：** CodeDeploy 蓝/绿部署旨在通过在重新路由生产流量之前并行预置/运行新版本与旧版本来最大限度减少中断。CodeDeploy 文档还说明，对于 EC2/On-Premises，蓝/绿部署可提供更快且更可靠的回滚，因为如果原始实例尚未终止，可以将流量路由回原始实例（[CodeDeploy deployment types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)）。这直接满足零停机、无缝用户体验和回滚要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A

A 使用 **GitHub websockets** 和 **就地、一次性全部部署**。CodePipeline 的相关集成基于源触发器/webhook 风格的更改检测，而不是“websockets”。更重要的是，就地一次性全部部署不是实现零停机或无缝回滚的最佳选择。CodeDeploy 就地部署会在实例上停止/更新/启动应用程序，而蓝/绿部署会将新修订版本部署到替换环境，并在就绪后重新路由流量（[CodeDeploy deployment types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)）。

### C

C 使用 **GitHub websockets** 和 **AWS X-Ray 进行单元测试和静态代码分析**。X-Ray 不是单元测试或静态分析服务。X-Ray 收集请求跟踪数据，并帮助查看、筛选和分析应用程序请求行为，以识别问题和优化机会（[What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)）。蓝/绿部署部分是好的，但源触发器和测试工具选择错误。

### D

D 正确提到了 GitHub webhooks，但它使用 **AWS X-Ray 进行单元测试/静态代码分析** 和 **就地、一次性全部部署**。X-Ray 用于跟踪/可观测性，而不是单元测试或静态分析（[What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)）。与蓝/绿部署相比，就地一次性全部部署也不能很好地满足所述零停机和无缝回滚要求。

因此，**B** 是正确答案。

en.question: A software as a service (SaaS) company has developed a multi-tenant environment. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB tables that the tenants share for the storage layer. The company uses AWS Lambda functions for the application services. The company wants to offer a tiered subscription model that is based on resource consumption by each tenant. Each tenant is identified by a unique tenant ID that is sent as part of each request to the Lambda functions. The company has created an AWS Cost and Usage Report (AWS CUR) in an AWS account. The company wants to allocate the DynamoDB costs to each tenant to match that tenant's resource consumption. Which solution will provide a granular view of the DynamoDB cost for each tenant with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Associate a new tag that is named tenant ID with each table in DynamoDB. Activate the tag as a cost allocation tag in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console. Deploy new Lambda function code to log the tenant ID in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use the AWS CUR to separate DynamoDB consumption cost for each tenant ID.
options.B: Configure the Lambda functions to log the tenant ID and the number of RCUs and WCUs consumed from DynamoDB for each transaction to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Deploy another Lambda function to calculate the tenant costs by using the logged capacity units and the overall DynamoDB cost from the AWS Cost Explorer API. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the calculation Lambda function on a schedule.
options.C: Create a new partition key that associates DynamoDB items with individual tenants. Deploy a Lambda function to populate the new column as part of each transaction. Deploy another Lambda function to calculate the tenant costs by using Amazon Athena to calculate the number of tenant items from DynamoDB and the overall DynamoDB cost from the AWS CUR. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the calculation Lambda function on a schedule.
options.D: Deploy a Lambda function to log the tenant ID, the size of each response, and the duration of the transaction call as custom metrics to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to query the custom metrics for each tenant. Use AWS Pricing Calculator to obtain the overall DynamoDB costs and to calculate the tenant costs.

en.explanation:
The company has a shared-table, multi-tenant DynamoDB design and needs to allocate DynamoDB spend to each tenant according to actual resource consumption. Because the tables are shared, tenant-level allocation cannot be obtained just by tagging whole DynamoDB tables; the application must record tenant-specific consumption at request/transaction level.

**Correct answer: B.**

Option B is the best fit because DynamoDB can return the capacity consumed by an individual operation when the request specifies `ReturnConsumedCapacity`. The DynamoDB API documentation states that `ReturnConsumedCapacity` can return aggregate consumed capacity, and the response includes fields such as `CapacityUnits`, `ReadCapacityUnits`, and `WriteCapacityUnits`; `ConsumedCapacity` is returned when `ReturnConsumedCapacity` is specified ([DynamoDB PutItem API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_PutItem.html)). DynamoDB read and write costs are fundamentally based on read/write capacity unit consumption and item size/consistency behavior, as described in the DynamoDB read/write operations documentation ([DynamoDB read and write operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/read-write-operations.html)).

By logging the tenant ID with the actual RCUs/WCUs consumed per DynamoDB transaction, the company gets a granular tenant-level usage signal without redesigning the table schema or creating per-tenant tables. A scheduled Lambda function can then allocate the overall DynamoDB cost proportionally by tenant consumption. The Cost Explorer `GetCostAndUsage` API can programmatically retrieve cost and usage metrics, filter/group cost data, and return metrics such as `UnblendedCost`, `AmortizedCost`, or `UsageQuantity` ([GetCostAndUsage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/latest/APIReference/API_GetCostAndUsage.html)). This provides granular per-tenant cost visibility with relatively low operational effort compared with schema changes or manual calculations.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect.** Cost allocation tags are applied to AWS resources. AWS documentation explains that a tag is a label assigned to an AWS resource, and after activation AWS uses cost allocation tags to organize resource costs in cost allocation reports and Cost Explorer ([AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). In this scenario, tenants share the same DynamoDB tables. A single table tag cannot represent multiple tenants' actual per-request consumption. Even if a `tenant ID` tag were added to a table, a tag key can have only one value per resource, so this would not provide granular allocation among tenants sharing the table.

- **C is incorrect.** Adding a new partition key or tenant attribute and backfilling/populating it is a data model change with significant operational effort. Also, counting items per tenant with Athena does not measure actual DynamoDB resource consumption. DynamoDB capacity consumption depends on operation type, item size, read consistency, transactional behavior, and evaluated items, not merely the number of stored items ([DynamoDB read and write operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/read-write-operations.html)).

- **D is incorrect.** Response size and Lambda transaction duration are not equivalent to DynamoDB RCUs/WCUs and therefore do not provide accurate DynamoDB cost allocation. AWS Pricing Calculator is for estimating costs, not for automated allocation of actual incurred costs. This option is less accurate and more manual than using actual consumed capacity and Cost Explorer cost data.

Therefore, **B** provides the required granular tenant-level DynamoDB cost view with the least operational effort among the viable options.

zh.question: 一家软件即服务（SaaS）公司开发了一个多租户环境。该公司使用由各租户共享的 Amazon DynamoDB 表作为存储层。该公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数提供应用程序服务。该公司希望提供一种分层订阅模型，该模型基于每个租户的资源消耗。每个租户由一个唯一的租户 ID 标识，该 ID 作为每个请求的一部分发送到 Lambda 函数。该公司已在一个 AWS 账户中创建了 AWS Cost and Usage Report (AWS CUR)。该公司希望将 DynamoDB 成本分摊到每个租户，以匹配该租户的资源消耗。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维工作量提供每个租户 DynamoDB 成本的精细视图？

options.A: 在 DynamoDB 中为每个表关联一个名为 tenant ID 的新标签。在 AWS Billing and Cost Management 控制台中将该标签激活为成本分配标签。部署新的 Lambda 函数代码，将租户 ID 记录到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。使用 AWS CUR 按每个租户 ID 分离 DynamoDB 消耗成本。
options.B: 配置 Lambda 函数，将每笔事务从 DynamoDB 消耗的租户 ID 以及 RCU 和 WCU 数量记录到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。部署另一个 Lambda 函数，使用已记录的容量单位以及来自 AWS Cost Explorer API 的总体 DynamoDB 成本来计算租户成本。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，按计划调用该计算 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 创建一个新的分区键，将 DynamoDB 项与各个租户关联起来。部署一个 Lambda 函数，在每笔事务中填充这个新列。部署另一个 Lambda 函数，使用 Amazon Athena 计算 DynamoDB 中的租户项目数量，并结合 AWS CUR 中的总体 DynamoDB 成本来计算租户成本。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，按计划调用该计算 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 部署一个 Lambda 函数，将租户 ID、每个响应的大小以及事务调用的持续时间作为自定义指标记录到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询每个租户的自定义指标。使用 AWS Pricing Calculator 获取总体 DynamoDB 成本并计算租户成本。

zh.explanation:
该公司采用共享表的多租户 DynamoDB 设计，需要根据实际资源消耗将 DynamoDB 支出分摊到每个租户。由于这些表是共享的，仅通过给整个 DynamoDB 表打标签无法获得租户级分摊；应用程序必须在请求/事务级别记录特定租户的消耗。

**正确答案：B。**

选项 B 最符合要求，因为当请求指定 `ReturnConsumedCapacity` 时，DynamoDB 可以返回单个操作所消耗的容量。DynamoDB API 文档说明，`ReturnConsumedCapacity` 可以返回聚合的已消耗容量，并且响应包含 `CapacityUnits`、`ReadCapacityUnits` 和 `WriteCapacityUnits` 等字段；当指定 `ReturnConsumedCapacity` 时会返回 `ConsumedCapacity`（[DynamoDB PutItem API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_PutItem.html)）。DynamoDB 读写成本从根本上基于读/写容量单位消耗以及项目大小/一致性行为，如 DynamoDB 读写操作文档所述（[DynamoDB read and write operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/read-write-operations.html)）。

通过记录每笔 DynamoDB 事务实际消耗的 RCUs/WCUs 以及租户 ID，该公司无需重新设计表架构或创建按租户划分的表，就能获得精细的租户级使用量信号。然后，按计划运行的 Lambda 函数可以按租户消耗比例分摊总体 DynamoDB 成本。Cost Explorer `GetCostAndUsage` API 可以以编程方式检索成本和使用量指标，筛选/分组成本数据，并返回 `UnblendedCost`、`AmortizedCost` 或 `UsageQuantity` 等指标（[GetCostAndUsage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/latest/APIReference/API_GetCostAndUsage.html)）。与更改架构或手动计算相比，这种方案能以相对较低的运维工作量提供精细的每租户成本可见性。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 不正确。** 成本分配标签应用于 AWS 资源。AWS 文档解释说，标签是分配给 AWS 资源的标记；激活后，AWS 使用成本分配标签在成本分配报告和 Cost Explorer 中组织资源成本（[AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。在此场景中，租户共享相同的 DynamoDB 表。单个表标签无法表示多个租户的实际按请求消耗。即使为表添加了 `tenant ID` 标签，一个标签键在每个资源上也只能有一个值，因此无法在共享该表的租户之间提供精细分摊。

- **C 不正确。** 添加新的分区键或租户属性并回填/填充它，是一种数据模型变更，会带来显著的运维工作量。此外，使用 Athena 按租户统计项目数量并不能衡量实际的 DynamoDB 资源消耗。DynamoDB 容量消耗取决于操作类型、项目大小、读取一致性、事务行为以及评估的项目，而不仅仅是存储项目的数量（[DynamoDB read and write operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/read-write-operations.html)）。

- **D 不正确。** 响应大小和 Lambda 事务持续时间并不等同于 DynamoDB RCUs/WCUs，因此无法提供准确的 DynamoDB 成本分配。AWS Pricing Calculator 用于估算成本，而不是自动分摊实际产生的成本。与使用实际消耗容量和 Cost Explorer 成本数据相比，该选项准确性较低且更偏手动。

因此，在可行选项中，**B** 能以最少的运维工作量提供所需的精细租户级 DynamoDB 成本视图。

en.question: A company has an application that stores data in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The company must keep all data for 1 year. The company’s security team is concerned that an attacker could gain access to the AWS account through leaked long-term credentials. Which solution will ensure that existing and future objects in the S3 bucket are protected?

options.A: Create a new AWS account that is accessible only to the security team through an assumed role. Create an S3 bucket in the new account. Enable S3 Versioning and S3 Object Lock. Configure a default retention period of 1 year. Set up replication from the existing S3 bucket to the new S3 bucket. Create an S3 Batch Replication job to copy all existing data.
options.B: Use the s3-bucket-versioning-enabled AWS Config managed rule. Configure an automatic remediation action that uses an AWS Lambda function to enable S3 Versioning and MFA Delete on noncompliant resources. Add an S3 Lifecycle rule to delete objects after 1 year.
options.C: Explicitly deny bucket creation from all users and roles except for an AWS Service Catalog launch constraint role. Define a Service Catalog product for the creation of the S3 bucket to force S3 Versioning and MFA Delete to be enabled. Authorize users to launch the product when they need to create an S3 bucket.
options.D: Enable Amazon GuardDuty with the S3 protection feature for the account and the AWS Region. Add an S3 Lifecycle rule to delete objects after 1 year.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company stores all data in one S3 bucket and must retain **all data for 1 year**. The risk is that leaked long-term credentials in the existing AWS account could allow an attacker to delete or overwrite S3 objects. The best solution must protect both **future objects** and **existing objects**.

## Correct answer: A

**A is correct** because it combines account isolation, S3 Versioning, S3 Object Lock, live replication, and Batch Replication:

- **S3 Object Lock retention** protects object versions for a fixed time. AWS states that a retention period protects an object version for a fixed amount of time, and when a bucket-level retention period is configured, every object version placed in the bucket is automatically protected for that duration. In compliance mode, a protected object version cannot be overwritten or deleted by any user, including the root user, during the retention period ([S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)).
- **S3 Versioning** ensures that new writes create separate versions rather than simply replacing data. AWS notes that when versioning is enabled, all new objects receive unique version IDs, while pre-existing objects are not changed until future requests modify them ([S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)).
- **Replication to a separate AWS account** reduces the blast radius of compromised credentials in the original account. AWS documents that S3 replication can maintain object copies under different ownership, allowing the destination account to own replicas and restrict access to them ([S3 Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).
- **S3 Batch Replication** is specifically appropriate for existing objects. AWS states that Batch Replication can replicate objects that were added before replication was configured and can replicate existing objects to newly added destinations ([S3 Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).

Therefore, creating a security-team-controlled destination account and bucket with Versioning and Object Lock, configuring a 1-year default retention period, using live replication for future objects, and using Batch Replication for existing data is the only option that addresses both existing and future data retention protection.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. AWS Config remediation to enable Versioning and MFA Delete, plus Lifecycle deletion

This is not sufficient:

- AWS Config remediation is reactive and runs in the same compromised account. An attacker with sufficient access could disable or modify controls before remediation occurs.
- MFA Delete provides extra protection for changing bucket versioning state and permanently deleting object versions, but AWS states that **only the bucket owner root account can enable MFA Delete**, and it cannot be enabled through the console ([MFA Delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)). This makes automated Lambda remediation impractical or impossible as described.
- AWS also states that **MFA Delete cannot be used with lifecycle configurations** ([MFA Delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)), so combining MFA Delete with a lifecycle rule to delete objects after 1 year is problematic.
- This option does not provide cross-account isolation from the compromised account.

### C. Service Catalog controls for creating future buckets

This option controls how **new buckets** are created, but the question is about protecting data in an **existing single S3 bucket**. It does not copy or protect the current bucket’s existing objects. It also relies on MFA Delete rather than Object Lock and does not provide Batch Replication for existing data.

### D. GuardDuty S3 Protection plus Lifecycle deletion

GuardDuty S3 Protection is detection, not prevention. AWS states that GuardDuty S3 Protection helps detect potential security risks such as data exfiltration and destruction by monitoring CloudTrail S3 data events, and when it detects a potential threat, it generates a security finding ([GuardDuty S3 Protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/s3-protection.html)). It does not prevent an attacker from deleting or overwriting objects. A lifecycle rule also does not protect objects; it eventually deletes them according to lifecycle policy.

## Final answer

**A**

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序将数据存储在单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司必须将所有数据保留 1 年。公司的安全团队担心攻击者可能会通过泄露的长期凭证获得对 AWS 账户的访问权限。哪种解决方案可以确保 S3 存储桶中的现有对象和未来对象都受到保护？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS 账户，仅允许安全团队通过担任角色访问该账户。在新账户中创建一个 S3 存储桶。启用 S3 Versioning 和 S3 Object Lock。配置默认保留期为 1 年。设置从现有 S3 存储桶到新 S3 存储桶的复制。创建一个 S3 Batch Replication 作业以复制所有现有数据。
options.B: 使用 s3-bucket-versioning-enabled AWS Config 托管规则。配置一个自动修复操作，使用 AWS Lambda 函数在不合规资源上启用 S3 Versioning 和 MFA Delete。添加一条 S3 Lifecycle 规则，在 1 年后删除对象。
options.C: 显式拒绝除 AWS Service Catalog 启动约束角色之外的所有用户和角色创建存储桶。定义一个用于创建 S3 存储桶的 Service Catalog 产品，以强制启用 S3 Versioning 和 MFA Delete。授权用户在需要创建 S3 存储桶时启动该产品。
options.D: 为该账户和 AWS Region 启用带 S3 保护功能的 Amazon GuardDuty。添加一条 S3 Lifecycle 规则，在 1 年后删除对象。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和需求

公司将所有数据存储在一个 S3 存储桶中，并且必须将**所有数据保留 1 年**。风险在于，现有 AWS 账户中泄露的长期凭证可能允许攻击者删除或覆盖 S3 对象。最佳解决方案必须同时保护**未来对象**和**现有对象**。

## 正确答案：A

**A 正确**，因为它结合了账户隔离、S3 Versioning、S3 Object Lock、实时复制和 Batch Replication：

- **S3 Object Lock retention** 可在固定时间内保护对象版本。AWS 表示，保留期会在固定时间内保护对象版本；当配置了存储桶级保留期时，放入该存储桶的每个对象版本都会自动在该持续时间内受到保护。在 compliance mode 下，受保护的对象版本在保留期内不能被任何用户覆盖或删除，包括 root user（[S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。
- **S3 Versioning** 确保新的写入会创建单独的版本，而不是简单替换数据。AWS 指出，启用版本控制后，所有新对象都会获得唯一的版本 ID，而预先存在的对象在未来请求修改它们之前不会发生变化（[S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。
- **复制到单独的 AWS 账户**可降低原始账户中凭证被泄露后的爆炸半径。AWS 文档说明，S3 复制可以在不同所有权下维护对象副本，允许目标账户拥有副本并限制对这些副本的访问（[S3 Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。
- **S3 Batch Replication** 特别适用于现有对象。AWS 表示，Batch Replication 可以复制在配置复制之前添加的对象，也可以将现有对象复制到新添加的目标位置（[S3 Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。

因此，创建一个由安全团队控制的目标账户和存储桶，启用 Versioning 和 Object Lock，配置 1 年默认保留期，对未来对象使用实时复制，并对现有数据使用 Batch Replication，是唯一能够同时解决现有数据和未来数据保留保护的选项。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. AWS Config 修复以启用 Versioning 和 MFA Delete，以及 Lifecycle 删除

这还不够：

- AWS Config 修复是被动的，并且在同一个已被攻破的账户中运行。拥有足够访问权限的攻击者可能在修复发生之前禁用或修改控制措施。
- MFA Delete 为更改存储桶版本控制状态和永久删除对象版本提供额外保护，但 AWS 表示，**只有存储桶所有者 root 账户可以启用 MFA Delete**，并且不能通过控制台启用（[MFA Delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)）。这使得所描述的自动 Lambda 修复不切实际或无法实现。
- AWS 还表示，**MFA Delete 不能与生命周期配置一起使用**（[MFA Delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)），因此将 MFA Delete 与在 1 年后删除对象的生命周期规则结合使用存在问题。
- 此选项没有提供与被攻破账户的跨账户隔离。

### C. 用于创建未来存储桶的 Service Catalog 控制

此选项控制**新存储桶**的创建方式，但题目要求保护**现有单个 S3 存储桶**中的数据。它不会复制或保护当前存储桶中的现有对象。它还依赖 MFA Delete 而不是 Object Lock，并且没有为现有数据提供 Batch Replication。

### D. GuardDuty S3 Protection 加 Lifecycle 删除

GuardDuty S3 Protection 是检测，而不是预防。AWS 表示，GuardDuty S3 Protection 通过监控 CloudTrail S3 数据事件，帮助检测潜在安全风险，例如数据外泄和破坏；当它检测到潜在威胁时，会生成安全发现（[GuardDuty S3 Protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/s3-protection.html)）。它不能阻止攻击者删除或覆盖对象。生命周期规则也不会保护对象；它最终会按照生命周期策略删除对象。

## 最终答案

**A**

en.question: A company needs to improve the security of its web-based application on AWS. The application uses Amazon CloudFront with two custom origins. The first custom origin routes requests to an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. The second custom origin routes traffic to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application integrates with an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP) for user management. A security audit shows that a JSON Web Token (JWT) authorizer provides access to the API. The security audit also shows that the ALB accepts requests from unauthenticated users. A solutions architect must design a solution to ensure that all backend services respond to only authenticated users. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure the ALB to enforce authentication and authorization by integrating the ALB with the IdP. Allow only authenticated users to access the backend services.
options.B: Modify the CloudFront configuration to use signed URLs. Implement a permissive signing policy that allows any request to access the backend services.
options.C: Create an AWS WAF web ACL that filters out unauthenticated requests at the ALB level. Allow only authenticated traffic to reach the backend services.
options.D: Enable AWS CloudTrail to log all requests that come to the ALB. Create an AWS Lambda function to analyze the logs and block any requests that come from unauthenticated users.

en.explanation:
The application has two CloudFront custom origins: an API Gateway HTTP API and an ALB. The audit already shows the API path is protected by a JWT authorizer, but the ALB origin accepts unauthenticated requests. The requirement is to ensure that backend services respond only to authenticated users, so the gap to close is authentication in front of the ALB-backed application.

**Correct answer: A. Configure the ALB to enforce authentication by integrating the ALB with the IdP.**

AWS supports user authentication directly on an Application Load Balancer. The Elastic Load Balancing documentation states that you can configure an ALB to authenticate users as they access applications, offloading authentication to the load balancer, and that supported use cases include authentication through an OIDC-compliant IdP. Authentication is configured by creating an `authenticate-oidc` or `authenticate-cognito` action for HTTPS listener rules. This directly addresses the audit finding: unauthenticated requests to the ALB can be challenged or denied before they reach the backend targets. When CloudFront is in front of the ALB, AWS also documents required forwarding settings for headers, query strings, and cookies so the ALB can complete OIDC authentication correctly ([Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)).

The API Gateway origin is already protected by a JWT authorizer. API Gateway HTTP API JWT authorizers validate the token signature and claims such as issuer, audience/client ID, expiration, and scopes, and API Gateway denies the request if validation fails ([Control access to HTTP APIs with JWT authorizers in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-jwt-authorizer.html)). Therefore, adding ALB authentication closes the remaining unauthenticated backend path.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. CloudFront signed URLs with a permissive signing policy** — CloudFront signed URLs are for controlling access to CloudFront content, but the option explicitly says to implement a permissive policy that allows any request. That would not ensure only authenticated users can access backend services, and it would not integrate with the existing OIDC IdP for user authentication.
* **C. AWS WAF web ACL filters unauthenticated requests at the ALB level** — AWS WAF can inspect and filter HTTP requests based on rules, but it is not an OIDC authentication mechanism and does not validate user identity through the IdP in the same way an ALB authenticate action does. WAF alone is not the appropriate service to enforce OIDC user authentication for an ALB-backed application.
* **D. CloudTrail logs plus Lambda analysis** — CloudTrail is for auditing API activity, not inline request authentication for application traffic to an ALB. An asynchronous log-analysis Lambda function would not reliably prevent unauthenticated requests from reaching the backend in real time.

Therefore, **A** is the best solution because it uses the ALB's native OIDC authentication capability to ensure the ALB-backed backend only responds to authenticated users, complementing the existing API Gateway JWT authorizer.

zh.question: 一家公司需要提高其在 AWS 上基于 Web 的应用程序的安全性。该应用程序使用 Amazon CloudFront，并配置了两个自定义源。第一个自定义源将请求路由到 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API。第二个自定义源将流量路由到 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该应用程序与 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 身份提供商 (IdP) 集成，用于用户管理。安全审计显示，JSON Web Token (JWT) 授权方为 API 提供访问控制。安全审计还显示，ALB 接受来自未认证用户的请求。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，以确保所有后端服务只响应已认证用户。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 通过将 ALB 与 IdP 集成，配置 ALB 强制执行身份验证和授权。仅允许已认证用户访问后端服务。
options.B: 修改 CloudFront 配置以使用签名 URL。实施一个宽松的签名策略，允许任何请求访问后端服务。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS WAF Web ACL，在 ALB 级别过滤掉未认证的请求。仅允许已认证的流量到达后端服务。
options.D: 启用 AWS CloudTrail 以记录所有到达 ALB 的请求。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来分析日志，并阻止任何来自未认证用户的请求。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序有两个 CloudFront 自定义源：一个 API Gateway HTTP API 和一个 ALB。审计已经显示 API 路径受 JWT 授权方保护，但 ALB 源接受未认证请求。要求是确保后端服务只响应已认证用户，因此需要弥补的缺口是在 ALB 支持的应用程序前面进行身份验证。

**正确答案：A. 通过将 ALB 与 IdP 集成，配置 ALB 强制执行身份验证。**

AWS 支持直接在 Application Load Balancer 上进行用户身份验证。Elastic Load Balancing 文档指出，可以配置 ALB 在用户访问应用程序时对其进行身份验证，将身份验证卸载到负载均衡器，并且支持的用例包括通过符合 OIDC 的 IdP 进行身份验证。身份验证通过为 HTTPS 侦听器规则创建 `authenticate-oidc` 或 `authenticate-cognito` 操作来配置。这直接解决了审计发现的问题：到 ALB 的未认证请求可以在到达后端目标之前被质询或拒绝。当 CloudFront 位于 ALB 前面时，AWS 还记录了标头、查询字符串和 Cookie 所需的转发设置，以便 ALB 能够正确完成 OIDC 身份验证（[使用 Application Load Balancer 对用户进行身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)）。

API Gateway 源已经受 JWT 授权方保护。API Gateway HTTP API JWT 授权方会验证令牌签名以及诸如颁发者、受众/客户端 ID、过期时间和范围等声明，如果验证失败，API Gateway 会拒绝该请求（[在 API Gateway 中使用 JWT 授权方控制对 HTTP API 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-jwt-authorizer.html)）。因此，添加 ALB 身份验证可以关闭剩余的未认证后端路径。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **B. CloudFront 签名 URL 和宽松的签名策略** — CloudFront 签名 URL 用于控制对 CloudFront 内容的访问，但该选项明确表示要实施允许任何请求的宽松策略。这无法确保只有已认证用户可以访问后端服务，也不会与现有 OIDC IdP 集成来进行用户身份验证。
* **C. AWS WAF Web ACL 在 ALB 级别过滤未认证请求** — AWS WAF 可以基于规则检查和过滤 HTTP 请求，但它不是 OIDC 身份验证机制，也不会像 ALB 身份验证操作那样通过 IdP 验证用户身份。仅靠 WAF 并不是为 ALB 支持的应用程序强制执行 OIDC 用户身份验证的合适服务。
* **D. CloudTrail 日志加 Lambda 分析** — CloudTrail 用于审计 API 活动，而不是对发送到 ALB 的应用程序流量进行内联请求身份验证。异步日志分析 Lambda 函数无法可靠地实时阻止未认证请求到达后端。

因此，**A** 是最佳解决方案，因为它使用 ALB 的原生 OIDC 身份验证功能，确保 ALB 支持的后端只响应已认证用户，并补充了现有的 API Gateway JWT 授权方。

en.question: A company creates an AWS Control Tower landing zone to manage and govern a multi-account AWS environment. The company's security team will deploy preventive controls and detective controls to monitor AWS services across all the accounts. The security team needs a centralized view of the security state of all the accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: From the AWS Control Tower management account, use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy an AWS Config conformance pack to all accounts in the organization.
options.B: Enable Amazon Detective for the organization in AWS Organizations. Designate one AWS account as the delegated administrator for Detective.
options.C: From the AWS Control Tower management account, deploy an AWS CloudFormation stack set that uses the automatic deployment option to enable Amazon Detective for the organization.
options.D: Enable AWS Security Hub for the organization in AWS Organizations. Designate one AWS account as the delegated administrator for Security Hub.

en.explanation:
The question asks for the best way, in an AWS Control Tower / AWS Organizations multi-account environment, to give the security team a **centralized view of the security state across all accounts**, while using preventive and detective controls.

**Correct answer: D. Enable AWS Security Hub for the organization in AWS Organizations. Designate one AWS account as the delegated administrator for Security Hub.**

AWS Security Hub is the AWS service designed to centralize security posture and security findings. The AWS documentation states that Security Hub CSPM provides a **consolidated view of findings across accounts and providers**, and that it helps monitor compliance and security posture across the AWS environment by collecting, prioritizing, and correlating findings from AWS services and partner products ([Security Hub benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)). In an AWS Organizations environment, Security Hub supports designating a **delegated Security Hub administrator account**, and AWS recommends using a separate delegated administrator account for security management rather than the organization management account ([Security Hub delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/designate-orgs-admin-account.html)). This directly matches the requirement for centralized security visibility across all accounts.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Deploy an AWS Config conformance pack to all accounts.**  
AWS Config conformance packs are useful for deploying collections of AWS Config rules and remediation actions across an account, Region, or organization ([AWS Config conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-packs.html)). However, this option focuses on Config compliance checks, not a centralized security state view that aggregates findings across AWS security services and accounts. It also does not identify Security Hub, which is the purpose-built service for centralized security findings and posture management.

**B. Enable Amazon Detective for the organization and designate a delegated administrator.**  
Amazon Detective is primarily an investigation and analysis service. AWS describes Detective as helping with security triage, scoping, and root-cause analysis using behavior graph visualizations ([Detective investigations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)). It is not the primary service for a centralized security posture dashboard across accounts. Detective can help investigate findings, but Security Hub is the service that consolidates and displays security findings across accounts.

**C. Deploy a CloudFormation StackSet to enable Amazon Detective.**  
This has the same core issue as option B: Amazon Detective is for investigation, not centralized security posture management. In addition, using StackSets to enable Detective is an implementation mechanism, not the service choice that meets the central security-state visibility requirement.

Therefore, **Security Hub with AWS Organizations integration and a delegated administrator account** is the correct solution.

zh.question: 一家公司创建了一个 AWS Control Tower 登录区，用于管理和治理多账户 AWS 环境。该公司的安全团队将部署预防性控制和检测性控制，以监控所有账户中的 AWS 服务。安全团队需要集中查看所有账户的安全状态。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 AWS Control Tower 管理账户中，使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 将 AWS Config 合规包部署到组织中的所有账户。
options.B: 在 AWS Organizations 中为组织启用 Amazon Detective。指定一个 AWS 账户作为 Detective 的委派管理员。
options.C: 从 AWS Control Tower 管理账户中，部署一个使用自动部署选项的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈集，以便为组织启用 Amazon Detective。
options.D: 在 AWS Organizations 中为组织启用 AWS Security Hub。指定一个 AWS 账户作为 Security Hub 的委派管理员。

zh.explanation:
本题询问的是，在 AWS Control Tower / AWS Organizations 多账户环境中，在使用预防性控制和检测性控制的同时，为安全团队提供**跨所有账户的安全状态集中视图**的最佳方式。

**正确答案：D. 在 AWS Organizations 中为组织启用 AWS Security Hub。指定一个 AWS 账户作为 Security Hub 的委派管理员。**

AWS Security Hub 是专为集中管理安全态势和安全发现而设计的 AWS 服务。AWS 文档指出，Security Hub CSPM 提供**跨账户和提供商的发现的整合视图**，并且通过收集、确定优先级和关联来自 AWS 服务及合作伙伴产品的发现，帮助监控整个 AWS 环境的合规性和安全态势（[Security Hub benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)）。在 AWS Organizations 环境中，Security Hub 支持指定**委派的 Security Hub 管理员账户**，并且 AWS 建议使用单独的委派管理员账户进行安全管理，而不是使用组织管理账户（[Security Hub delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/designate-orgs-admin-account.html)）。这直接符合跨所有账户集中查看安全状态的要求。

### 其他选项为何不正确

**A. 将 AWS Config 合规包部署到所有账户。**  
AWS Config 合规包可用于在账户、区域或组织中部署 AWS Config 规则和修复操作的集合（[AWS Config conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-packs.html)）。但是，此选项侧重于 Config 合规性检查，而不是一个聚合跨 AWS 安全服务和账户发现的集中式安全状态视图。它也没有指出 Security Hub，而 Security Hub 才是专为集中式安全发现和态势管理而构建的服务。

**B. 为组织启用 Amazon Detective 并指定委派管理员。**  
Amazon Detective 主要是一项调查和分析服务。AWS 将 Detective 描述为通过行为图可视化帮助进行安全分诊、范围界定和根本原因分析（[Detective investigations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)）。它不是用于跨账户集中式安全态势控制面板的主要服务。Detective 可以帮助调查发现，但 Security Hub 才是整合并显示跨账户安全发现的服务。

**C. 部署 CloudFormation StackSet 以启用 Amazon Detective。**  
这与选项 B 存在相同的核心问题：Amazon Detective 用于调查，而不是集中式安全态势管理。此外，使用 StackSets 启用 Detective 是一种实施机制，而不是满足集中式安全状态可见性要求的服务选择。

因此，**集成 AWS Organizations 并使用委派管理员账户的 Security Hub** 是正确的解决方案。

en.question: A company that develops consumer electronics with offices in Europe and Asia has 60 TB of software images stored on premises in Europe. The company wants to transfer the images to an Amazon S3 bucket in the ap-northeast-1 Region. New software images are created daily and must be encrypted in transit. The company needs a solution that does not require custom development to automatically transfer all existing and new software images to Amazon S3. What is the next step in the transfer process?

options.A: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent and configure a task to transfer the images to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transfer the images using S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.C: Use an AWS Snowball device to transfer the images with the S3 bucket as the target.
options.D: Transfer the images over a Site-to-Site VPN connection using the S3 API with multipart upload.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has 60 TB of existing on-premises software images in Europe and will create new images daily. It needs a managed, no-custom-development way to transfer both existing and new data to an Amazon S3 bucket in `ap-northeast-1`, with encryption in transit.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Deploy an AWS DataSync agent and configure a task to transfer the images to the S3 bucket.**

AWS DataSync is designed for this exact migration pattern. The documentation describes DataSync as a secure, reliable, high-speed service for transferring file or object data to, from, and between AWS storage services, and explicitly lists both **on-premises storage transfers** and **Amazon S3** as supported targets ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)). AWS also documents that DataSync can transfer files and objects between on-premises or self-managed storage systems and Amazon S3 ([Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)).

DataSync also satisfies the encryption-in-transit requirement: for the transfer between locations, DataSync encrypts all network traffic with mutual TLS 1.3 ([AWS DataSync encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/encryption-in-transit.html)). For ongoing images created daily, DataSync task schedules can periodically transfer data between storage locations, using hourly, daily, weekly, cron, or rate expressions ([Scheduling when your AWS DataSync task runs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)). Therefore, deploying a DataSync agent and configuring a task to the S3 bucket is the best next step.

## Why the other options are incorrect

**B. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transfer the images using S3 Transfer Acceleration.**  
Kinesis Data Firehose is a streaming ingestion service, not a managed bulk file migration/synchronization service for 60 TB of existing on-premises software images. It also would not automatically scan and transfer existing files from on-premises storage without additional custom development.

**C. Use an AWS Snowball device to transfer the images with the S3 bucket as the target.**  
Snowball can be useful for large offline one-time data migrations, but the requirement includes **new software images created daily** and an automatic ongoing transfer process. A physical device workflow is not appropriate for continuously transferring new daily files without operational overhead.

**D. Transfer the images over a Site-to-Site VPN connection using the S3 API with multipart upload.**  
This could technically upload objects to S3, but it requires building or operating custom upload logic, including scanning for new files, retry handling, multipart upload management, and scheduling. The question explicitly asks for a solution that does **not require custom development**. DataSync provides these managed transfer capabilities directly.

zh.question: 一家开发消费电子产品的公司在欧洲和亚洲设有办公室，并在欧洲本地存储了 60 TB 的软件映像。该公司希望将这些映像传输到 ap-northeast-1 区域中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。每天都会创建新的软件映像，并且必须在传输过程中加密。该公司需要一种不需要自定义开发即可自动将所有现有和新的软件映像传输到 Amazon S3 的解决方案。传输过程的下一步是什么？

options.A: 部署 AWS DataSync agent，并配置一个任务将映像传输到 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose，使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 传输映像。
options.C: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备传输映像，并将 S3 存储桶作为目标。
options.D: 使用 S3 API 通过 Site-to-Site VPN 连接和分段上传来传输映像。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司在欧洲有 60 TB 的现有本地软件映像，并且每天都会创建新的映像。它需要一种托管式、无需自定义开发的方式，将现有数据和新数据传输到 `ap-northeast-1` 中的 Amazon S3 存储桶，并在传输过程中加密。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 部署 AWS DataSync agent，并配置一个任务将映像传输到 S3 存储桶。**

AWS DataSync 正是为这种迁移模式而设计的。文档将 DataSync 描述为一种安全、可靠、高速的服务，用于向 AWS 存储服务传输文件或对象数据、从 AWS 存储服务传输文件或对象数据，以及在 AWS 存储服务之间传输文件或对象数据，并明确列出支持 **本地存储传输** 和 **Amazon S3** 作为支持的目标（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。AWS 还记录了 DataSync 可以在本地或自托管存储系统与 Amazon S3 之间传输文件和对象（[Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)）。

DataSync 还满足传输中加密的要求：对于位置之间的传输，DataSync 使用双向 TLS 1.3 加密所有网络流量（[AWS DataSync encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/encryption-in-transit.html)）。对于每天创建的持续性映像，DataSync 任务计划可以使用 hourly、daily、weekly、cron 或 rate 表达式，在存储位置之间定期传输数据（[Scheduling when your AWS DataSync task runs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)）。因此，部署 DataSync agent 并配置一个到 S3 存储桶的任务是最佳的下一步。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. 配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose，使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 传输映像。**  
Kinesis Data Firehose 是一种流式摄取服务，而不是用于 60 TB 现有本地软件映像的托管式批量文件迁移/同步服务。它也无法在没有额外自定义开发的情况下自动扫描并传输本地存储中的现有文件。

**C. 使用 AWS Snowball 设备传输映像，并将 S3 存储桶作为目标。**  
Snowball 可用于大型离线一次性数据迁移，但要求包括 **每天创建的新软件映像** 以及自动的持续传输流程。物理设备工作流不适合在没有运营开销的情况下持续传输每日新增文件。

**D. 使用 S3 API 通过 Site-to-Site VPN 连接和分段上传来传输映像。**  
从技术上讲，这可以将对象上传到 S3，但需要构建或运行自定义上传逻辑，包括扫描新文件、重试处理、分段上传管理和计划任务。题目明确要求解决方案**不需要自定义开发**。DataSync 直接提供这些托管式传输能力。

en.question: A company has a web application that uses Amazon API Gateway. AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. A recent marketing campaign has increased demand. Monitoring software reports that many requests have significantly longer response times than before the marketing campaign. A solutions architect enabled Amazon CloudWatch Logs for API Gateway and noticed that errors are occurring on 20% of the requests. In CloudWatch, the Lambda function Throttles metric represents 1% of the requests and the Errors metric represents 10% of the requests. Application logs indicate that, when errors occur, there is a call to DynamoDB. What change should the solutions architect make to improve the current response times as the web application becomes more popular?

options.A: Increase the concurrency limit of the Lambda function.
options.B: Implement DynamoDB auto scaling on the table.
options.C: Increase the API Gateway throttle limit.
options.D: Re-create the DynamoDB table with a better-partitioned primary index.

en.explanation:
The application is receiving more traffic after a marketing campaign. API Gateway shows errors on 20% of requests, but Lambda throttling accounts for only 1% and Lambda function errors account for 10%. The application logs correlate failures with calls to DynamoDB, so the most likely bottleneck is DynamoDB capacity/throttling under increased demand rather than API Gateway or Lambda concurrency.

**Correct answer: B. Implement DynamoDB auto scaling on the table.**

DynamoDB auto scaling is designed for exactly this type of growing or variable workload when a table uses provisioned capacity. AWS documentation states that DynamoDB publishes consumed capacity metrics to CloudWatch, CloudWatch alarms invoke Application Auto Scaling, and Application Auto Scaling issues `UpdateTable` to dynamically increase or decrease the table's provisioned throughput capacity so utilization approaches the configured target ([Managing throughput capacity automatically with DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)). AWS also documents that when table read/write consumption exceeds provisioned capacity, mitigation includes enabling Auto Scaling for the affected read or write capacity if using provisioned mode ([Provisioned throughput exceeded mitigation measures](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/throttling-provisioned-capacity-exceeded-mitigation.html)). This addresses the errors and latency caused by DynamoDB being unable to keep up with sustained higher demand.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Increase the concurrency limit of the Lambda function.** Lambda throttling is only 1% of requests, so Lambda concurrency is not the primary source of the 20% API Gateway errors.
