- **A. 创建一个 Transit Gateway 并附加公司的 VPC/子网。** AWS Transit Gateway 被设计为网络传输中心，用于互连 VPC 和本地网络。文档指出，一个 transit gateway 可以附加一个或多个 VPC，并且随着云基础设施在全球扩展，跨区域对等连接可以将 transit gateway 连接在一起（[AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。它还支持通过 AWS Resource Access Manager 对 VPC 附件进行跨账户共享（[Shared transit gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/working-with-transit-gateways.html)）。随着 VPC 数量持续增长，这比构建和维护全互联 VPC 对等连接网状拓扑的运营开销低得多。对于多区域部署，实际实现是在相关区域中使用 transit gateway 并进行 transit gateway peering，因为 AWS 文档说明 transit gateway 可以在区域内和区域间建立对等连接，并且可以位于同一账户或其他账户中（[Transit gateway peering attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-peering.html)）。

- **C. 使用由 NLB 支持的 endpoint service 通过 AWS PrivateLink 发布许可证验证资源。** AWS PrivateLink 在 VPC 与其他 AWS 账户托管的服务之间提供私有连接，而不需要 internet gateway、NAT 设备、Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。AWS 还在文档中说明，PrivateLink endpoint service 需要 Network Load Balancer 或 Gateway Load Balancer，并且该负载均衡器接收来自服务使用者的请求并将其路由到服务（[Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)）。这符合从客户 VPC 到管理 VPC 的许可证验证服务进行单向、特定服务访问的要求，而不会授予进入管理 VPC 的通用网络级访问权限。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 在所有 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接。** VPC peering 可以私下连接两个 VPC，包括跨账户/区域连接，但每个对等连接都需要将路由手动添加到相关路由表中（[How VPC peering connections work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。对于 50 个 VPC 以及之后的增长，全网状拓扑将需要大量对等连接和路由表更新，从而产生很高的运营开销。与 Transit Gateway 相比，它不是开销最低的设计。

- **D. 在每个客户 VPC 中创建 VPN 设备并使用 Site-to-Site VPN。** 这会为每个客户 VPC 引入客户侧 VPN 设备以及 VPN 配置和生命周期管理。对于暴露单个许可证验证服务而言，它比 PrivateLink 的运营负担更重，并且不能直接解决公司 VPC 之间可扩展的全互联通信。

- **E. 在管理 VPC 与每个客户 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接。** 这将提供比许可证验证所需更广泛的 VPC-to-VPC 连接，并且需要为每个客户持续管理对等连接和路由。它也无法提供所有公司 VPC 之间所需的全互联连接。对于到许可证验证资源的单向、仅服务级访问，PrivateLink 更合适。

因此，运营开销最低的组合是 **A + C**：使用 Transit Gateway 实现可扩展的公司 VPC 连接，并使用 PrivateLink 与由 NLB 支持的 endpoint service 来控制客户对许可证验证服务的访问。

en.question: A company has multiple lines of business (LOBs) that roll up to the parent company. The company has asked its solutions architect to develop a solution with the following requirements: • Produce a single AWS invoice for all of the AWS accounts used by its LOBs. • The costs for each LOB account should be broken out on the invoice. • Provide the ability to restrict services and features in the LOB accounts, as defined by the company's governance policy. • Each LOB account should be delegated full administrator permissions, regardless of the governance policy. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Organizations to create an organization in the parent account for each LOB. Then invite each LOB account to the appropriate organization.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations to create a single organization in the parent account. Then, invite each LOB's AWS account to join the organization.
options.C: Implement service quotas to define the services and features that are permitted and apply the quotas to each LOB. as appropriate.
options.D: Create an SCP that allows only approved services and features, then apply the policy to the LOB accounts.
options.E: Enable consolidated billing in the parent account's billing console and link the LOB accounts.

en.explanation:
The company needs centralized multi-account management for multiple LOB AWS accounts: one payer invoice, per-account cost visibility, and governance guardrails that still allow each LOB to administer everything that remains permitted inside its account.

**Correct answers: B and D.**

- **B. Use AWS Organizations to create a single organization in the parent account. Then invite each LOB's AWS account to join the organization.** AWS Organizations is designed as a collection of AWS accounts managed centrally under one management account. In **all features** mode, Organizations lets you “manage and organize your accounts under a single bill” and also includes the administrative policy capabilities needed for governance. The management account is responsible for paying for usage by member accounts, which provides the single consolidated invoice model. AWS also documents inviting existing AWS accounts to join an organization. See [AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html), [Billing and pricing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/pricing.html), and [Sending account invitations with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invite-account.html).
- **D. Create an SCP that allows only approved services and features, then apply the policy to the LOB accounts.** Service control policies are the Organizations mechanism for setting governance guardrails. AWS states that SCPs specify the **maximum available permissions** for IAM users and roles in member accounts and that a member-account administrator with `AdministratorAccess` still cannot use permissions blocked by an SCP. Therefore, each LOB can be delegated full administrator permissions within its account, while the SCP enforces the company governance boundary. See [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create an organization in the parent account for each LOB.** This is not the right structure. The requirement is a single parent-company rollup with a single invoice for all LOB accounts. A single AWS account cannot be the management account for multiple separate organizations in the way implied here, and separate organizations would not provide one unified organization-wide management boundary for all LOBs. Use one organization and add the LOB accounts as members.
- **C. Implement service quotas to define permitted services and features.** Service Quotas are for viewing and requesting quota increases or managing numerical limits for AWS service usage; they are not the Organizations governance mechanism to allow or deny services/actions across accounts. SCPs are the correct mechanism for restricting which services and actions are available to member accounts.
- **E. Enable consolidated billing in the parent account's billing console and link the LOB accounts.** Consolidated billing is a feature set of AWS Organizations, but the question also requires service/feature restriction by governance policy. AWS documents that the consolidated billing-only feature set does **not** include using policies to restrict what users and roles in different accounts can do. Creating the organization with all features satisfies consolidated billing and enables SCPs; a separate legacy-style “enable consolidated billing and link accounts” step is not the best answer when only two steps are allowed. See [AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html).

zh.question: 一家公司拥有多个业务线（LOB），这些业务线都汇总到母公司。该公司要求其解决方案架构师开发一个满足以下要求的解决方案：• 为其 LOB 使用的所有 AWS 账户生成一张统一的 AWS 发票。• 每个 LOB 账户的成本应在发票上单独列出。• 根据公司的治理策略，提供限制 LOB 账户中服务和功能的能力。• 无论治理策略如何，每个 LOB 账户都应被委派完全管理员权限。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Organizations 在父账户中为每个 LOB 创建一个组织。然后邀请每个 LOB 账户加入相应的组织。
options.B: 使用 AWS Organizations 在父账户中创建一个单一组织。然后邀请每个 LOB 的 AWS 账户加入该组织。
options.C: 实施服务配额来定义允许使用的服务和功能，并根据需要将配额应用到每个 LOB。
options.D: 创建一个 SCP，仅允许已批准的服务和功能，然后将该策略应用到 LOB 账户。
options.E: 在父账户的账单控制台中启用整合账单，并关联 LOB 账户。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要针对多个 LOB AWS 账户进行集中式多账户管理：一个付款方发票、按账户的成本可见性，以及治理护栏，同时仍允许每个 LOB 管理其账户内仍被允许的一切内容。

**正确答案：B 和 D。**

- **B. Use AWS Organizations to create a single organization in the parent account. Then invite each LOB's AWS account to join the organization.** AWS Organizations 被设计为在一个管理账户下集中管理的一组 AWS 账户。在 **all features** 模式下，Organizations 允许你“在一张账单下管理和组织你的账户”，并且还包含治理所需的管理策略能力。管理账户负责支付成员账户产生的使用费用，从而提供单一整合发票模型。AWS 还记录了如何邀请现有 AWS 账户加入组织。请参阅 [AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)、[Billing and pricing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/pricing.html) 和 [Sending account invitations with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invite-account.html)。
- **D. Create an SCP that allows only approved services and features, then apply the policy to the LOB accounts.** Service control policies 是 Organizations 中用于设置治理护栏的机制。AWS 说明，SCP 为成员账户中的 IAM 用户和角色指定**最大可用权限**，并且拥有 `AdministratorAccess` 的成员账户管理员仍然无法使用被 SCP 阻止的权限。因此，每个 LOB 可以在其账户内被委派完全管理员权限，同时 SCP 强制执行公司的治理边界。请参阅 [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Create an organization in the parent account for each LOB.** 这不是正确的结构。要求是对所有 LOB 账户进行单一母公司汇总，并生成一张统一发票。单个 AWS 账户不能以这里暗示的方式作为多个独立组织的管理账户，而且独立组织无法为所有 LOB 提供一个统一的组织范围管理边界。应使用一个组织，并将 LOB 账户作为成员添加进去。
- **C. Implement service quotas to define permitted services and features.** Service Quotas 用于查看和请求配额增加，或管理 AWS 服务使用的数值限制；它们不是 Organizations 中用于跨账户允许或拒绝服务/操作的治理机制。SCP 才是限制成员账户可用服务和操作的正确机制。
- **E. Enable consolidated billing in the parent account's billing console and link the LOB accounts.** 整合账单是 AWS Organizations 的一个功能集，但题目还要求按治理策略限制服务/功能。AWS 文档说明，仅整合账单功能集**不**包括使用策略来限制不同账户中的用户和角色可以执行的操作。使用所有功能创建组织既满足整合账单，又启用 SCP；当只允许选择两个步骤时，单独的旧式“启用整合账单并关联账户”步骤不是最佳答案。请参阅 [AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)。

en.question: A solutions architect has deployed a web application that serves users across two AWS Regions under a custom domain. The application uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing. The solutions architect has associated weighted record sets with a pair of web servers in separate Availability Zones for each Region. The solutions architect runs a disaster recovery scenario. When all the web servers in one Region are stopped, Route 53 does not automatically redirect users to the other Region. Which of the following are possible root causes of this issue? (Choose two.)

options.A: The weight for the Region where the web servers were stopped is higher than the weight for the other Region.
options.B: One of the web servers in the secondary Region did not pass its HTTP health check.
options.C: Latency resource record sets cannot be used in combination with weighted resource record sets.
options.D: The setting to evaluate target health is not turned on for the latency alias resource record set that is associated with the domain in the Region where the web servers were stopped.
options.E: An HTTP health check has not been set up for one or more of the weighted resource record sets associated with the stopped web servers.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and what is being asked

The application uses a **complex Route 53 routing configuration**: latency-based alias records at the top level route users to the best Region, and each Regional alias points to weighted records for web servers in different Availability Zones. During a DR test, all servers in one Region are stopped, but Route 53 continues to return that Region instead of failing over to the other Region. The question asks for two possible root causes.

## Correct answers: D and E

### D. The setting to evaluate target health is not turned on for the latency alias resource record set that is associated with the domain in the Region where the web servers were stopped.

This is correct. AWS explicitly describes this exact pattern: latency alias records at the top of the tree, with weighted records in each Region as alias targets. For this configuration, AWS says that for both latency alias records, **Evaluate Target Health** should be set to **Yes**. This causes Route 53 to determine whether there are healthy resources in a Region before routing traffic there; if there are not, Route 53 chooses a healthy resource in the other Region.

AWS also states that if **Evaluate Target Health** is set to **No** for an alias record, Route 53 continues to route traffic to the records that the alias record refers to even if health checks for those records are failing. Therefore, if Evaluate Target Health is disabled on the latency alias record for the failed Region, Route 53 might not back out of that Regional branch and fail over to the other Region. See [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html).

### E. An HTTP health check has not been set up for one or more of the weighted resource record sets associated with the stopped web servers.

This is correct. In this complex configuration, the weighted records point to the individual web servers. AWS states that it is important to associate health checks with all non-alias records. If a weighted record has no health check, Route 53 has no way to know whether that resource is healthy, so Route 53 assumes that the resource is healthy and can continue returning it in DNS responses. This would explain why traffic is not redirected when the servers in a Region are stopped. See [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. The weight for the Region where the web servers were stopped is higher than the weight for the other Region.

This is incorrect. In the described design, weighted records are used within each Region for the web servers, while latency records choose the Region. More importantly, if health checks and Evaluate Target Health are configured correctly, Route 53 should exclude unhealthy weighted records regardless of their weights. A higher weight does not cause Route 53 to treat stopped, unhealthy resources as healthy.

### B. One of the web servers in the secondary Region did not pass its HTTP health check.

This is not a sufficient root cause. The secondary Region has a pair of web servers. If only one secondary server fails its health check, Route 53 can still route to the other healthy weighted record in that Region. The documented failover logic depends on whether there is at least one healthy resource in the target branch, not whether every resource in the secondary Region is healthy.

### C. Latency resource record sets cannot be used in combination with weighted resource record sets.

This is incorrect. AWS documentation explicitly gives this as a supported complex configuration: latency alias records can route to Regional groups of weighted records. Therefore, the combination itself is not the cause of the failed failover. See [Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html) and [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师部署了一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序通过自定义域名为两个 AWS 区域的用户提供服务。该应用程序使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由。解决方案架构师为每个区域中位于不同可用区的一对 Web 服务器关联了加权记录集。解决方案架构师运行灾难恢复场景。当某个区域中的所有 Web 服务器都停止时，Route 53 不会自动将用户重定向到另一个区域。以下哪些是此问题的可能根本原因？（选择两个。）

options.A: Web 服务器停止所在区域的权重高于另一个区域的权重。
options.B: 辅助区域中的一台 Web 服务器未通过其 HTTP 运行状况检查。
options.C: 延迟资源记录集不能与加权资源记录集结合使用。
options.D: 与 Web 服务器停止所在区域中的域名关联的延迟别名资源记录集未开启评估目标运行状况设置。
options.E: 尚未为与已停止的 Web 服务器关联的一个或多个加权资源记录集设置 HTTP 运行状况检查。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和考查内容

该应用程序使用一种 **复杂的 Route 53 路由配置**：顶层的基于延迟的别名记录将用户路由到最佳区域，每个区域别名再指向不同可用区中 Web 服务器的加权记录。在 DR 测试期间，某个区域中的所有服务器都已停止，但 Route 53 仍继续返回该区域，而不是故障转移到另一个区域。本题要求找出两个可能的根本原因。

## 正确答案：D 和 E

### D. The setting to evaluate target health is not turned on for the latency alias resource record set that is associated with the domain in the Region where the web servers were stopped.

这是正确的。AWS 明确描述了这种确切模式：树顶层是延迟别名记录，每个区域中的加权记录作为别名目标。对于这种配置，AWS 表示，对于两个延迟别名记录，**Evaluate Target Health** 都应设置为 **Yes**。这会使 Route 53 在将流量路由到某个区域之前确定该区域中是否有正常的资源；如果没有，Route 53 会选择另一个区域中的正常资源。

AWS 还指出，如果某个别名记录的 **Evaluate Target Health** 设置为 **No**，即使这些记录的运行状况检查失败，Route 53 也会继续将流量路由到该别名记录所引用的记录。因此，如果失败区域的延迟别名记录上禁用了 Evaluate Target Health，Route 53 可能不会退出该区域分支并故障转移到另一个区域。请参阅 [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html)。

### E. An HTTP health check has not been set up for one or more of the weighted resource record sets associated with the stopped web servers.

这是正确的。在这种复杂配置中，加权记录指向各个 Web 服务器。AWS 表示，将运行状况检查与所有非别名记录关联非常重要。如果某个加权记录没有运行状况检查，Route 53 就无法知道该资源是否正常，因此 Route 53 会假定该资源是正常的，并可能继续在 DNS 响应中返回它。这可以解释为什么当某个区域中的服务器停止时，流量没有被重定向。请参阅 [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. The weight for the Region where the web servers were stopped is higher than the weight for the other Region.

这是不正确的。在所描述的设计中，加权记录在每个区域内部用于 Web 服务器，而延迟记录用于选择区域。更重要的是，如果正确配置了运行状况检查和 Evaluate Target Health，Route 53 应该排除不正常的加权记录，而不考虑其权重。更高的权重不会导致 Route 53 将已停止且不正常的资源视为正常。

### B. One of the web servers in the secondary Region did not pass its HTTP health check.

这不是充分的根本原因。辅助区域有一对 Web 服务器。如果只有一台辅助服务器未通过其运行状况检查，Route 53 仍可路由到该区域中另一个正常的加权记录。文档化的故障转移逻辑取决于目标分支中是否至少有一个正常资源，而不是辅助区域中的每个资源是否都正常。

### C. Latency resource record sets cannot be used in combination with weighted resource record sets.

这是不正确的。AWS 文档明确将其作为受支持的复杂配置给出：延迟别名记录可以路由到区域性的加权记录组。因此，这种组合本身并不是故障转移失败的原因。请参阅 [Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html) 和 [How health checks work in complex Amazon Route 53 configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-complex-configs.html)。

en.question: A flood monitoring agency has deployed more than 10,000 water-level monitoring sensors. Sensors send continuous data updates, and each update is less than 1 MB in size. The agency has a fleet of on- premises application servers. These servers receive updates from the sensors, convert the raw data into a human readable format, and write the results to an on-premises relational database server. Data analysts then use simple SQL queries to monitor the data. The agency wants to increase overall application availability and reduce the effort that is required to perform maintenance tasks. These maintenance tasks, which include updates and patches to the application servers, cause downtime. While an application server is down, data is lost from sensors because the remaining servers cannot handle the entire workload. The agency wants a solution that optimizes operational overhead and costs. A solutions architect recommends the use of AWS IoT Core to collect the sensor data. What else should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Send the sensor data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Use an AWS Lambda function to read the Kinesis Data Firehose data, convert it to .csv format, and insert it into an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Instruct the data analysts to query the data directly from the DB instance.
options.B: Send the sensor data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Use an AWS Lambda function to read the Kinesis Data Firehose data, convert it to Apache Parquet format, and save it to an Amazon S3 bucket. Instruct the data analysts to query the data by using Amazon Athena.
options.C: Send the sensor data to an Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) application to convert the data to .csv format and store it in an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Instruct the data analysts to query the data directly from the DB instance.
options.D: Send the sensor data to an Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) application to convert the data to Apache Parquet format and store it in an Amazon S3 bucket. Instruct the data analysts to query the data by using Amazon Athena.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The agency needs to replace on-premises application servers and a relational database workflow that loses sensor data during maintenance. The recommended foundation is AWS IoT Core for sensor ingestion. The remaining design should minimize operational overhead and cost while preserving availability and allowing analysts to run simple SQL queries.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Send sensor data to Amazon Data Firehose, transform/convert it, store it in Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet, and query with Amazon Athena.**

This is the best fit because it uses serverless/managed ingestion, storage, and query services:

* AWS IoT Core can route MQTT messages to an Amazon Data Firehose stream. The IoT Firehose rule action requires a Firehose delivery stream name and an IAM role that permits `firehose:PutRecord`, confirming that IoT Core can send device data directly to Firehose ([AWS IoT Core Firehose rule action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/kinesis-firehose-rule-action.html)).
* Amazon Data Firehose is designed to deliver streaming data to destinations such as Amazon S3. For S3 destinations, Firehose delivers streaming data to the S3 bucket, and if data transformation is enabled, Firehose invokes Lambda synchronously on buffered batches before delivery ([Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html), [Firehose Lambda transformation flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)).
* Firehose supports record format conversion to **Apache Parquet** or ORC for S3 destinations, and AWS notes that the resulting data can be queried in Athena ([Firehose record format conversion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/enable-record-format-conversion.html)).
* Athena is appropriate for analysts who need SQL over S3 data. Athena tables describe the schema and S3 location for read-time querying; Athena stores schema in the AWS Glue Data Catalog and reads the S3 data when SQL queries run ([Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)).
* Parquet is preferable to CSV for analytics cost/performance. Athena documentation states that columnar formats such as Parquet are designed for distributed analytics, reduce the amount of data loaded, improve compression, and enable metadata-based skipping of unneeded data ([Athena data optimization: columnar formats](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/performance-tuning-data-optimization-techniques.html)).

This removes the on-premises application server maintenance problem, avoids a managed relational database where it is not required, stores data durably in S3, and lets analysts continue using SQL through Athena.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Firehose + Lambda + Aurora MySQL + direct DB queries

This does not optimize operational overhead or cost. It introduces and maintains an Aurora relational database even though the analysts only need simple SQL over sensor data. It also stores data in CSV rather than an analytics-optimized columnar format. More importantly, Firehose's documented transformation flow is that Firehose invokes Lambda to transform buffered records and then delivers transformed records to the configured destination; the option's pattern of using Lambda to read Firehose data and insert into Aurora is not the natural Firehose delivery model ([Firehose Lambda transformation flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)).

### C. Managed Service for Apache Flink + CSV in S3 + import to Aurora

This adds unnecessary complexity and cost. A Flink application is useful for custom stream processing and real-time analytics, but the requirement is simple ingestion, transformation to a queryable format, and SQL querying. Importing into Aurora reintroduces database operational considerations and is not necessary when Athena can query S3 directly using schema-on-read ([Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)). CSV is also less efficient than Parquet for Athena analytics.

### D. Managed Service for Apache Flink + Parquet in S3 + Athena

This is closer than A or C because it stores Parquet in S3 and uses Athena. However, it introduces a custom Flink streaming application when Firehose already supports serverless delivery to S3, Lambda transformation, and Parquet/ORC record format conversion for S3 destinations ([Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html), [Firehose record format conversion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/enable-record-format-conversion.html)). For the stated goal of optimizing operational overhead and costs, Firehose + Lambda + S3 + Athena is the simpler managed pipeline.

zh.question: 一家洪水监测机构部署了 10,000 多个水位监测传感器。传感器会持续发送数据更新，并且每次更新的大小都小于 1 MB。该机构拥有一组本地应用程序服务器。这些服务器接收来自传感器的更新，将原始数据转换为人类可读格式，并将结果写入本地关系数据库服务器。然后，数据分析师使用简单的 SQL 查询来监控数据。该机构希望提高整体应用程序可用性，并减少执行维护任务所需的工作量。这些维护任务包括应用程序服务器的更新和补丁，会导致停机。当某台应用程序服务器停机时，由于剩余服务器无法处理全部工作负载，来自传感器的数据会丢失。该机构希望获得一种能够优化运维开销和成本的解决方案。解决方案架构师建议使用 AWS IoT Core 来收集传感器数据。为满足这些要求，解决方案架构师还应建议什么？

options.A: 将传感器数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。使用 AWS Lambda 函数读取 Kinesis Data Firehose 数据，将其转换为 .csv 格式，并将其插入 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例。指示数据分析师直接从该数据库实例查询数据。
options.B: 将传感器数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。使用 AWS Lambda 函数读取 Kinesis Data Firehose 数据，将其转换为 Apache Parquet 格式，并将其保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶。指示数据分析师使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.C: 将传感器数据发送到 Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink（以前称为 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics）应用程序，以将数据转换为 .csv 格式并存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。将数据导入 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例。指示数据分析师直接从该数据库实例查询数据。
options.D: 将传感器数据发送到 Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink（以前称为 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics）应用程序，以将数据转换为 Apache Parquet 格式并存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。指示数据分析师使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该机构需要替换本地应用程序服务器和关系数据库工作流，因为该工作流会在维护期间丢失传感器数据。建议的基础是使用 AWS IoT Core 进行传感器摄取。其余设计应在保持可用性并允许分析师运行简单 SQL 查询的同时，最大限度地减少运维开销和成本。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 将传感器数据发送到 Amazon Data Firehose，进行转换，将其以 Apache Parquet 格式存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 Amazon Athena 查询。**

这是最佳选择，因为它使用无服务器/托管的摄取、存储和查询服务：

* AWS IoT Core 可以将 MQTT 消息路由到 Amazon Data Firehose 流。IoT Firehose 规则操作需要 Firehose 传输流名称以及允许 `firehose:PutRecord` 的 IAM 角色，这确认了 IoT Core 可以将设备数据直接发送到 Firehose（[AWS IoT Core Firehose rule action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/kinesis-firehose-rule-action.html)）。
* Amazon Data Firehose 旨在将流数据交付到 Amazon S3 等目标。对于 S3 目标，Firehose 会将流数据交付到 S3 存储桶；如果启用了数据转换，Firehose 会在交付前对缓冲批次同步调用 Lambda（[Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)，[Firehose Lambda transformation flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)）。
* Firehose 支持针对 S3 目标进行记录格式转换为 **Apache Parquet** 或 ORC，AWS 指出生成的数据可以在 Athena 中查询（[Firehose record format conversion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/enable-record-format-conversion.html)）。
* Athena 适用于需要对 S3 数据执行 SQL 的分析师。Athena 表描述用于读取时查询的架构和 S3 位置；Athena 将架构存储在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中，并在运行 SQL 查询时读取 S3 数据（[Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。
* 对于分析成本/性能，Parquet 优于 CSV。Athena 文档指出，Parquet 等列式格式专为分布式分析而设计，可减少加载的数据量、提高压缩率，并能够基于元数据跳过不需要的数据（[Athena data optimization: columnar formats](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/performance-tuning-data-optimization-techniques.html)）。

这消除了本地应用程序服务器维护问题，避免了在不需要时使用托管关系数据库，将数据持久存储在 S3 中，并让分析师继续通过 Athena 使用 SQL。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Firehose + Lambda + Aurora MySQL + 直接数据库查询

这无法优化运维开销或成本。即使分析师只需要对传感器数据执行简单 SQL，它仍引入并维护一个 Aurora 关系数据库。它还将数据存储为 CSV，而不是针对分析优化的列式格式。更重要的是，Firehose 文档所述的转换流程是：Firehose 调用 Lambda 来转换缓冲记录，然后将转换后的记录交付到配置的目标；该选项中使用 Lambda 读取 Firehose 数据并插入 Aurora 的模式并不是自然的 Firehose 交付模型（[Firehose Lambda transformation flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)）。

### C. Managed Service for Apache Flink + S3 中的 CSV + 导入 Aurora

这增加了不必要的复杂性和成本。Flink 应用程序适用于自定义流处理和实时分析，但要求只是简单摄取、转换为可查询格式以及 SQL 查询。导入 Aurora 会重新引入数据库运维方面的考虑，并且在 Athena 可以使用读取时架构直接查询 S3 时并不必要（[Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。对于 Athena 分析，CSV 的效率也低于 Parquet。

### D. Managed Service for Apache Flink + S3 中的 Parquet + Athena

这比 A 或 C 更接近，因为它将 Parquet 存储在 S3 中并使用 Athena。但是，当 Firehose 已经支持无服务器交付到 S3、Lambda 转换以及针对 S3 目标的 Parquet/ORC 记录格式转换时，它引入了自定义 Flink 流式应用程序（[Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)，[Firehose record format conversion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/enable-record-format-conversion.html)）。对于题目所述的优化运维开销和成本目标，Firehose + Lambda + S3 + Athena 是更简单的托管管道。

en.question: A public retail web application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of Amazon EC2 instances running across multiple Availability Zones (AZs) in a Region backed by an Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ deployment. Target group health checks are configured to use HTTP and pointed at the product catalog page. Auto Scaling is configured to maintain the web fleet size based on the ALB health check. Recently, the application experienced an outage. Auto Scaling continuously replaced the instances during the outage. A subsequent investigation determined that the web server metrics were within the normal range, but the database tier was experiencing high load, resulting in severely elevated query response times. Which of the following changes together would remediate these issues while improving monitoring capabilities for the availability and functionality of the entire application stack for future growth? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure read replicas for Amazon RDS MySQL and use the single reader endpoint in the web application to reduce the load on the backend database tier.
options.B: Configure the target group health check to point at a simple HTML page instead of a product catalog page and the Amazon Route 53 health check against the product page to evaluate full application functionality. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify administrators when the site fails.
options.C: Configure the target group health check to use a TCP check of the Amazon EC2 web server and the Amazon Route 53 health check against the product page to evaluate full application functionality. Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to notify administrators when the site fails.
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for Amazon RDS with an action to recover a high-load, impaired RDS instance in the database tier.
options.E: Configure an Amazon ElastiCache cluster and place it between the web application and RDS MySQL instances to reduce the load on the backend database tier.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The outage was caused by the database tier being overloaded and responding slowly, while the EC2 web servers themselves were healthy. Because the ALB target group health check was pointed at the product catalog page, the health check depended on database responsiveness. When the database slowed down, the catalog page health checks could fail, causing Auto Scaling to replace otherwise healthy web instances. The question asks for two changes that both remediate the issue and improve end-to-end monitoring for future growth.

## Correct answers: B and E

### B. Use a simple ALB target health check page, and use Route 53 health checks/CloudWatch alarms for full application functionality

This separates two different monitoring purposes:

* **ALB target group health checks** should determine whether an individual target can receive traffic. AWS documentation states that an ALB periodically sends health check requests to registered targets and routes traffic only to healthy targets. For ALBs, health checks use HTTP/HTTPS and a configurable `HealthCheckPath` destination ([AWS ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)). Pointing this path to a lightweight static HTML page avoids making target health depend on the database-backed product catalog page.
* **Full-stack functional monitoring** should still test the real product catalog page. Route 53 health checks can be monitored with CloudWatch metrics, and CloudWatch alarms/SNS notifications can notify administrators when the health check becomes unhealthy or when latency metrics such as time to first byte exceed thresholds ([Route 53 health check monitoring with CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/monitoring-health-checks.html)).

This directly fixes the Auto Scaling replacement loop while improving visibility into real application availability.

### E. Add Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and RDS MySQL

The database is overloaded by product catalog queries. A product catalog is a classic cacheable workload: frequently accessed product data can be served from an in-memory cache instead of repeatedly querying RDS. AWS describes ElastiCache as commonly used to cache data from other databases and data stores, accelerate access to an existing primary database, and handle high read throughput instead of scaling the underlying database ([ElastiCache related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/related-services-choose-between-memorydb-and-redis.html)). AWS also emphasizes monitoring cache performance and cache efficiency with CloudWatch metrics in the ElastiCache Well-Architected performance guidance ([ElastiCache Performance Efficiency Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/PerformanceEfficiencyPillar.html)).

This reduces load and query latency on RDS while supporting future read growth.

## Incorrect options

### A. RDS MySQL read replicas with a single reader endpoint

RDS read replicas can help with **read-heavy** workloads. AWS says you can direct excess read traffic to one or more read replicas, and that applications connect to a read replica as they do to any DB instance ([RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). However, this option is not the best answer here for two reasons:

1. The option specifies a **single reader endpoint**, which is characteristic of services such as Aurora or RDS Proxy patterns, not standard RDS MySQL DB instance read replicas. Standard RDS DB instance read replicas are separate DB instances that applications connect to individually.
2. It does not address the faulty ALB health check design that caused Auto Scaling to replace healthy web servers.

### C. Use a TCP health check for the ALB target group

This is not appropriate for an Application Load Balancer target group. AWS documentation states that for Application Load Balancers, the health check protocols are **HTTP and HTTPS**, and the health checks use HTTP GET requests ([AWS ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)). A TCP check would also be too shallow because it would only validate that a port is reachable, not that the web server can serve HTTP content.

### D. CloudWatch alarm action to recover a high-load impaired RDS instance

CloudWatch alarms can notify and can trigger certain actions, but AWS lists EC2 actions such as stop, terminate, reboot, and recover as **EC2 actions**, not RDS recovery actions ([CloudWatch alarm actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-actions.html)). Also, the database was under high load, not necessarily infrastructure-impaired. Recovering an RDS instance is not a valid remediation for database query load or elevated query response time.

zh.question: 一个面向公众的零售 Web 应用在一个 Region 内跨多个可用区 (AZ) 运行的 Amazon EC2 实例前使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，后端由 Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ 部署提供支持。目标组运行状况检查配置为使用 HTTP，并指向产品目录页面。Auto Scaling 配置为根据 ALB 运行状况检查来维持 Web 实例组规模。最近，该应用发生了一次中断。中断期间，Auto Scaling 持续替换实例。随后调查确定，Web 服务器指标处于正常范围内，但数据库层负载很高，导致查询响应时间严重升高。以下哪些变更组合可以修复这些问题，同时为未来增长改进对整个应用程序栈的可用性和功能性的监控能力？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为 Amazon RDS MySQL 配置只读副本，并在 Web 应用程序中使用单一读取器端点，以减少后端数据库层的负载。
options.B: 将目标组运行状况检查配置为指向一个简单的 HTML 页面，而不是产品目录页面；并针对产品页面配置 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查，以评估完整的应用程序功能。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，在站点失败时通知管理员。
options.C: 将目标组运行状况检查配置为对 Amazon EC2 Web 服务器使用 TCP 检查；并针对产品页面配置 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查，以评估完整的应用程序功能。配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，在站点失败时通知管理员。
options.D: 为 Amazon RDS 配置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，并设置操作来恢复数据库层中高负载且受损的 RDS 实例。
options.E: 配置一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群，并将其置于 Web 应用程序和 RDS MySQL 实例之间，以减少后端数据库层的负载。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

此次中断是由数据库层过载且响应缓慢导致的，而 EC2 Web 服务器本身是健康的。由于 ALB 目标组运行状况检查指向产品目录页面，因此该运行状况检查依赖数据库响应能力。当数据库变慢时，目录页面的运行状况检查可能失败，导致 Auto Scaling 替换本来健康的 Web 实例。题目要求选择两个变更，既能修复该问题，又能为未来增长改进端到端监控。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

### B. 使用简单的 ALB 目标运行状况检查页面，并使用 Route 53 运行状况检查/CloudWatch 警报监控完整应用程序功能

这将两种不同的监控目的分离开来：

* **ALB 目标组运行状况检查** 应确定单个目标是否能够接收流量。AWS 文档说明，ALB 会定期向已注册目标发送运行状况检查请求，并且只将流量路由到健康目标。对于 ALB，运行状况检查使用 HTTP/HTTPS 以及可配置的 `HealthCheckPath` 目标（[AWS ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)）。将此路径指向轻量级静态 HTML 页面，可以避免使目标健康状况依赖由数据库支持的产品目录页面。
* **全栈功能监控** 仍应测试真实的产品目录页面。Route 53 运行状况检查可以通过 CloudWatch 指标进行监控，并且 CloudWatch 警报/SNS 通知可以在运行状况检查变为不健康时，或在 time to first byte 等延迟指标超过阈值时通知管理员（[Route 53 health check monitoring with CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/monitoring-health-checks.html)）。

这直接修复了 Auto Scaling 替换循环，同时提升了对真实应用程序可用性的可见性。

### E. 在 Web 应用程序和 RDS MySQL 之间添加 Amazon ElastiCache

数据库被产品目录查询压垮。产品目录是典型的可缓存工作负载：频繁访问的产品数据可以从内存缓存提供，而不是反复查询 RDS。AWS 将 ElastiCache 描述为常用于缓存来自其他数据库和数据存储的数据、加速对现有主数据库的访问，以及处理高读取吞吐量而不是扩展底层数据库（[ElastiCache related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/related-services-choose-between-memorydb-and-redis.html)）。AWS 还在 ElastiCache Well-Architected 性能效率指南中强调使用 CloudWatch 指标监控缓存性能和缓存效率（[ElastiCache Performance Efficiency Pillar](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/PerformanceEfficiencyPillar.html)）。

这会降低 RDS 的负载和查询延迟，同时支持未来读取增长。

## 错误选项

### A. RDS MySQL 只读副本与单一读取器端点

RDS 只读副本可以帮助处理 **读取密集型** 工作负载。AWS 表示，你可以将过量读取流量定向到一个或多个只读副本，并且应用程序连接到只读副本的方式与连接到任何 DB 实例相同（[RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。但是，此选项在这里不是最佳答案，原因有两点：

1. 该选项指定了 **单一读取器端点**，这是 Aurora 或 RDS Proxy 模式等服务的特征，而不是标准 RDS MySQL DB 实例只读副本的特征。标准 RDS DB 实例只读副本是独立的 DB 实例，应用程序需要分别连接到它们。
2. 它没有解决导致 Auto Scaling 替换健康 Web 服务器的错误 ALB 运行状况检查设计。

### C. 对 ALB 目标组使用 TCP 运行状况检查

这不适用于 Application Load Balancer 目标组。AWS 文档说明，对于 Application Load Balancer，运行状况检查协议是 **HTTP 和 HTTPS**，并且运行状况检查使用 HTTP GET 请求（[AWS ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)）。TCP 检查也过于浅层，因为它只会验证端口是否可达，而不能验证 Web 服务器是否能提供 HTTP 内容。

### D. 使用 CloudWatch 警报操作恢复高负载且受损的 RDS 实例

CloudWatch 警报可以发送通知并触发某些操作，但 AWS 列出的停止、终止、重启和恢复等 EC2 操作是 **EC2 操作**，不是 RDS 恢复操作（[CloudWatch alarm actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-actions.html)）。此外，数据库处于高负载状态，并不一定是基础设施受损。恢复 RDS 实例并不是针对数据库查询负载或查询响应时间升高的有效修复措施。

en.question: A company has an on-premises data center and is using Kubernetes to develop a new solution on AWS. The company uses Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) clusters for its development and test environments. The EKS control plane and data plane for production workloads must reside on premises. The company needs an AWS managed solution for Kubernetes management. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Install an AWS Outposts server in the on-premises data center. Deploy Amazon EKS by using a local cluster configuration on the Outposts server for the production workloads.
options.B: Install Amazon EKS Anywhere on the company's hardware in the on-premises data center. Deploy the production workloads on an EKS Anywhere cluster.
options.C: Install an AWS Outposts server in the on-premises data center. Deploy Amazon EKS by using an extended cluster configuration on the Outposts server for the production workloads.
options.D: Install an AWS Outposts server in the on-premises data center. Install Amazon EKS Anywhere on the Outposts server. Deploy the production workloads on an EKS Anywhere cluster.

en.explanation:
The company needs production Kubernetes workloads to run on premises with both the Kubernetes control plane and worker nodes located on premises, while still using an AWS-managed Kubernetes solution with the least operational overhead.

**Correct answer: A. Install an AWS Outposts server in the on-premises data center. Deploy Amazon EKS by using a local cluster configuration on the Outposts server for the production workloads.**

Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts supports two deployment models: **extended clusters** and **local clusters**. In a local cluster, Amazon EKS runs both the Kubernetes control plane and the nodes on the Outpost. The AWS documentation also states that, for Amazon EKS on Outposts deployment options, the Kubernetes control plane is fully managed by AWS and can be managed with the same Amazon EKS APIs, tools, and console used for Amazon EKS in the cloud. This directly satisfies the requirement for an on-premises control plane, an on-premises data plane, and AWS-managed Kubernetes management. See [Deploy Amazon EKS on-premises with AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-outposts.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Install Amazon EKS Anywhere on the company's hardware in the on-premises data center.** Amazon EKS Anywhere can run Kubernetes clusters in on-premises environments, but it is not the same as an AWS-managed Amazon EKS control plane. AWS states that, unlike Amazon EKS, Amazon EKS Anywhere is a **customer-managed** product and customers are responsible for cluster lifecycle operations and maintenance. This adds operational overhead and does not meet the requirement for an AWS-managed solution. See [Deploy Amazon EKS clusters across cloud and on-premises environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-deployment-options.html).

- **C. Install an AWS Outposts server and deploy Amazon EKS by using an extended cluster configuration.** With an extended cluster, the Kubernetes control plane runs in an AWS Region and only the nodes run on the Outpost. This violates the requirement that the EKS control plane for production workloads must reside on premises.

- **D. Install Amazon EKS Anywhere on the Outposts server.** This still uses Amazon EKS Anywhere, which is customer-managed. Placing it on Outposts does not make the Kubernetes control plane AWS-managed, and it would introduce more operational responsibility than using an Amazon EKS local cluster on Outposts.

Therefore, **Option A** is the best choice because an Amazon EKS local cluster on AWS Outposts places both the control plane and data plane on premises while retaining AWS-managed Kubernetes control plane operations.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有本地数据中心，并正在使用 Kubernetes 在 AWS 上开发新解决方案。该公司在开发和测试环境中使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。生产工作负载的 EKS 控制平面和数据平面必须位于本地。该公司需要一个用于 Kubernetes 管理的 AWS 托管解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在本地数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 服务器。使用 Outposts 服务器上的本地集群配置部署 Amazon EKS，以承载生产工作负载。
options.B: 在本地数据中心的公司硬件上安装 Amazon EKS Anywhere。在 EKS Anywhere 集群上部署生产工作负载。
options.C: 在本地数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 服务器。使用 Outposts 服务器上的扩展集群配置部署 Amazon EKS，以承载生产工作负载。
options.D: 在本地数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 服务器。在 Outposts 服务器上安装 Amazon EKS Anywhere。在 EKS Anywhere 集群上部署生产工作负载。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要生产 Kubernetes 工作负载在本地运行，并且 Kubernetes 控制平面和工作节点都位于本地，同时仍使用 AWS 托管的 Kubernetes 解决方案，并具有最少的运营开销。

**正确答案：A. 在本地数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 服务器。使用 Outposts 服务器上的本地集群配置部署 Amazon EKS，以承载生产工作负载。**

AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EKS 支持两种部署模型：**扩展集群** 和 **本地集群**。在本地集群中，Amazon EKS 会在 Outpost 上同时运行 Kubernetes 控制平面和节点。AWS 文档还指出，对于 Outposts 上 Amazon EKS 的部署选项，Kubernetes 控制平面由 AWS 完全托管，并且可以使用与云中 Amazon EKS 相同的 Amazon EKS API、工具和控制台进行管理。这直接满足了本地控制平面、本地数据平面以及 AWS 托管 Kubernetes 管理的要求。请参阅 [使用 AWS Outposts 在本地部署 Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-outposts.html)。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. 在本地数据中心的公司硬件上安装 Amazon EKS Anywhere。** Amazon EKS Anywhere 可以在本地环境中运行 Kubernetes 集群，但它不同于 AWS 托管的 Amazon EKS 控制平面。AWS 声明，与 Amazon EKS 不同，Amazon EKS Anywhere 是**客户管理**的产品，客户负责集群生命周期操作和维护。这会增加运营开销，并且不满足对 AWS 托管解决方案的要求。请参阅 [跨云和本地环境部署 Amazon EKS 集群](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-deployment-options.html)。

- **C. 安装 AWS Outposts 服务器并使用扩展集群配置部署 Amazon EKS。** 使用扩展集群时，Kubernetes 控制平面在 AWS 区域中运行，只有节点在 Outpost 上运行。这违反了生产工作负载的 EKS 控制平面必须位于本地的要求。

- **D. 在 Outposts 服务器上安装 Amazon EKS Anywhere。** 这仍然使用 Amazon EKS Anywhere，而它是客户管理的。将其放在 Outposts 上并不会使 Kubernetes 控制平面变为 AWS 托管，并且会比在 Outposts 上使用 Amazon EKS 本地集群引入更多运营责任。

因此，**选项 A** 是最佳选择，因为 AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EKS 本地集群会将控制平面和数据平面都放在本地，同时保留 AWS 托管的 Kubernetes 控制平面运维。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its development environment. Each development team at the company has its own AWS account. Each account has a single VPC and CIDR blocks that do not overlap. The company has an Amazon Aurora DB cluster in a shared services account. All the development teams need to work with live data from the DB cluster. Which solution will provide the required connectivity to the DB cluster with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) resource share for the DB cluster. Share the DB cluster with all the development accounts.
options.B: Create a transit gateway in the shared services account. Create an AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) resource share for the transit gateway. Share the transit gateway with all the development accounts. Instruct the developers to accept the resource share. Configure networking.
options.C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that points to the IP address of the DB cluster. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service that uses the ALB. Add permissions to allow each development account to connect to the endpoint service.
options.D: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection in the shared services account. Configure networking. Use AWS Marketplace VPN software in each development account to connect to the Site-to-Site VPN connection.

en.explanation:
The company has many development accounts, each with its own non-overlapping VPC, and a single Amazon Aurora DB cluster in a shared services account. The requirement is **network connectivity to the existing live DB cluster** with the least operational overhead across many accounts.

**Correct answer: B. Create and share a transit gateway, then configure networking.**

A transit gateway is designed for hub-and-spoke connectivity across many VPCs and accounts. AWS documentation states that a transit gateway lets you attach VPCs and VPN connections and route traffic between them, works across AWS accounts, and can be shared with other accounts by using AWS RAM; after sharing, the other account owner can attach their VPCs to the transit gateway ([Transit gateways in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)). The AWS RAM shareable resources documentation also lists **Transit gateways** as shareable resources and describes the use case as centrally managing a transit gateway so multiple AWS accounts can route traffic between their VPCs and on-premises networks through the shared transit gateway ([Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)).

Because each development VPC has a non-overlapping CIDR block, the VPCs can be attached to the shared transit gateway and routed to the shared services VPC where the Aurora cluster resides. This provides live network access to the existing DB cluster without building and maintaining many individual VPC peering or VPN connections.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Share the DB cluster with AWS RAM.**  
This is tempting because Aurora DB clusters are listed as shareable with AWS RAM. However, that sharing is for **cross-account cloning**, not for giving other accounts live network access to the same running DB cluster. The RAM documentation states that sharing Aurora DB clusters lets multiple AWS accounts **clone** a shared, centrally managed DB cluster ([Shareable AWS resources - Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)). The Aurora documentation explains that an Aurora clone is a **separate and independent volume**, even though it initially shares data pages through copy-on-write ([Cloning a volume for an Amazon Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)). That does not satisfy the requirement for all development teams to work with **live data from the DB cluster**.

**C. Use an ALB with AWS PrivateLink.**  
This is not valid as written. AWS PrivateLink endpoint services require either a **Network Load Balancer** or a **Gateway Load Balancer**, not an Application Load Balancer ([Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)). Additionally, an ALB is a Layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS load balancer and is not an appropriate front end for direct Aurora database protocol connectivity.

**D. Use Site-to-Site VPN and marketplace VPN software in every development account.**  
This would require deploying, configuring, and operating VPN software in every development account and managing VPN connectivity at scale. It is much higher operational overhead than a shared transit gateway and is not the standard AWS-native solution for connecting many VPCs across accounts.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer because it provides centralized, scalable, live network connectivity from all development VPCs to the Aurora DB cluster with the least operational overhead among the valid options.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其开发环境。公司中的每个开发团队都有自己的 AWS 账户。每个账户都有一个 VPC，并且 CIDR 块互不重叠。公司在一个共享服务账户中有一个 Amazon Aurora DB 集群。所有开发团队都需要使用来自该 DB 集群的实时数据。哪种解决方案能以最少的运维开销提供到该 DB 集群所需的连接？

options.A: 为该 DB 集群创建一个 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 资源共享。将该 DB 集群共享给所有开发账户。
options.B: 在共享服务账户中创建一个 Transit Gateway。为该 Transit Gateway 创建一个 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 资源共享。将该 Transit Gateway 共享给所有开发账户。指示开发人员接受该资源共享。配置网络。
options.C: 创建一个指向该 DB 集群 IP 地址的 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。创建一个使用该 ALB 的 AWS PrivateLink 终端节点服务。添加权限以允许每个开发账户连接到该终端节点服务。
options.D: 在共享服务账户中创建一个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。配置网络。在每个开发账户中使用 AWS Marketplace VPN 软件连接到该 Site-to-Site VPN 连接。

zh.explanation:
该公司有许多开发账户，每个账户都有自己的非重叠 VPC，并且在一个共享服务账户中有一个 Amazon Aurora DB 集群。要求是以最少的运维开销，在多个账户中提供到现有实时 DB 集群的**网络连接**。

**正确答案：B。创建并共享 Transit Gateway，然后配置网络。**

Transit Gateway 专为跨多个 VPC 和账户的中心辐射型连接而设计。AWS 文档说明，Transit Gateway 允许你附加 VPC 和 VPN 连接并在它们之间路由流量，可跨 AWS 账户工作，并且可以使用 AWS RAM 与其他账户共享；共享后，其他账户所有者可以将其 VPC 附加到该 Transit Gateway（[Transit gateways in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-transit-gateways.html)）。AWS RAM 可共享资源文档也将 **Transit gateways** 列为可共享资源，并将其用例描述为集中管理一个 Transit Gateway，使多个 AWS 账户可以通过共享的 Transit Gateway 在其 VPC 与本地网络之间路由流量（[Shareable AWS resources - Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)）。

由于每个开发 VPC 都有一个非重叠的 CIDR 块，因此可以将这些 VPC 附加到共享的 Transit Gateway，并路由到 Aurora 集群所在的共享服务 VPC。这为现有 DB 集群提供实时网络访问，而无需构建和维护许多个单独的 VPC 对等连接或 VPN 连接。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 使用 AWS RAM 共享 DB 集群。**  
这很有迷惑性，因为 Aurora DB 集群被列为可通过 AWS RAM 共享。但是，这种共享用于**跨账户克隆**，而不是让其他账户获得对同一个正在运行的 DB 集群的实时网络访问。RAM 文档说明，共享 Aurora DB 集群允许多个 AWS 账户**克隆**一个共享的、集中管理的 DB 集群（[Shareable AWS resources - Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)）。Aurora 文档解释说，Aurora 克隆是一个**独立的单独卷**，即使它最初通过写时复制共享数据页（[Cloning a volume for an Amazon Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)）。这不满足让所有开发团队使用来自该 DB 集群的**实时数据**的要求。

**C. 将 ALB 与 AWS PrivateLink 结合使用。**  
按题面描述这是无效的。AWS PrivateLink 终端节点服务需要 **Network Load Balancer** 或 **Gateway Load Balancer**，而不是 Application Load Balancer（[Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)）。此外，ALB 是第 7 层 HTTP/HTTPS 负载均衡器，不适合作为直接 Aurora 数据库协议连接的前端。

**D. 在每个开发账户中使用 Site-to-Site VPN 和 marketplace VPN 软件。**  
这需要在每个开发账户中部署、配置和运维 VPN 软件，并大规模管理 VPN 连接。与共享 Transit Gateway 相比，其运维开销要高得多，而且它不是用于跨账户连接多个 VPC 的标准 AWS 原生解决方案。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案，因为它在所有有效选项中，以最少的运维开销，为所有开发 VPC 到 Aurora DB 集群提供集中式、可扩展的实时网络连接。

en.question: A company used AWS CloudFormation to create all new infrastructure in its AWS member accounts. The resources rarely change and are properly sized for the expected load. The monthly AWS bill is consistent. Occasionally, a developer creates a new resource for testing and forgets to remove the resource when the test is complete. Most of these tests last a few days before the resources are no longer needed. The company wants to automate the process of finding unused resources. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that determines whether the cost in the AWS bill is increasing. The solution must help identify resources that cause an increase in cost and must automatically notify the company's operations team. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Turn on billing alerts. Use AWS Cost Explorer to determine the costs for the past month. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for total estimated charges. Specify a cost threshold that is higher than the costs that Cost Explorer determined. Add a notification to alert the operations team if the alarm threshold is breached.
options.B: Turn on billing alerts. Use AWS Cost Explorer to determine the average monthly costs for the past 3 months. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for total estimated charges. Specify a cost threshold that is higher than the costs that Cost Explorer determined. Add a notification to alert the operations team if the alarm threshold is breached.
options.C: Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to create a cost monitor that has a monitor type of Linked account. Create a subscription to send daily AWS cost summaries to the operations team. Specify a threshold for cost variance.
options.D: Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to create a cost monitor that has a monitor type of AWS services. Create a subscription to send daily AWS cost summaries to the operations team. Specify a threshold for cost variance.

en.explanation:
The company has a normally stable bill and wants an automated way to detect unexpected increases caused by temporary test resources that developers forget to delete. The solution must both alert the operations team and help identify what is driving the increase.

**Correct answer: D. Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection with a monitor type of AWS services and a daily-summary alert subscription with a cost-variance threshold.**

AWS Cost Anomaly Detection is designed for this use case: it uses machine learning to detect anomalous spend patterns in deployed AWS services, can send email or SNS alerts, and can investigate root causes ranked by dollar impact across dimensions such as AWS service, account, Region, and usage type ([AWS Cost Management User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/manage-ad.html)). The Cost Anomaly Detection setup also supports alert subscriptions, including **daily summaries**, and thresholds based on absolute or percentage cost impact; notifications are sent when an anomaly reaches or exceeds the threshold ([Getting started with AWS Cost Anomaly Detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/getting-started-ad.html)).

The key distinction is the monitor dimension. An **AWS services** monitor "automatically evaluates all AWS services used by your account for anomalies" and starts evaluating new AWS services when they are used. This provides service-level visibility, which is the best fit for identifying the service area where forgotten test resources are increasing cost ([Monitor types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/getting-started-ad.html)). The anomaly view can show top root cause information such as service, account, Region, and usage type, which helps the operations team investigate the offending resources.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. CloudWatch billing alarm based on the past month** – A CloudWatch billing alarm can notify when total estimated charges exceed a static threshold, but it is a coarse total-charge alarm. It does not use anomaly detection or automatically identify root causes. AWS documentation describes creating a billing alarm on the `EstimatedCharges` metric with a fixed threshold and SNS notification ([CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)). This would alert only after total spend crosses the chosen threshold and would not reliably identify the cost driver.
* **B. CloudWatch billing alarm based on a 3-month average** – This has the same limitation as option A. Using a 3-month average may make the static threshold more stable, but the alarm still monitors estimated charges against a manually selected threshold and does not provide Cost Anomaly Detection root-cause analysis.
* **C. Cost Anomaly Detection with monitor type of Linked account** – This uses the right service, but the monitor dimension is less suitable for the stated requirement. A linked-account monitor is useful for detecting unusual spending by member account. However, the question emphasizes identifying the resources/services causing the increase. The AWS services monitor provides more direct service-level anomaly detection, whereas linked-account monitoring is primarily account-level spend monitoring.

Therefore, **D** is the best answer because it uses the purpose-built anomaly detection service, alerts automatically with a threshold, and provides the most relevant service-level visibility for investigating forgotten test resources.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 在其 AWS 成员账户中创建所有新基础设施。这些资源很少变化，并且已按预期负载合理配置大小。每月 AWS 账单保持一致。偶尔，开发人员会创建一个新资源用于测试，并在测试完成后忘记删除该资源。大多数此类测试会持续几天，之后这些资源就不再需要。公司希望自动化查找未使用资源的过程。解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案，用于判断 AWS 账单中的成本是否正在增加。该解决方案必须帮助识别导致成本增加的资源，并且必须自动通知公司的运维团队。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 开启账单提醒。使用 AWS Cost Explorer 确定过去一个月的成本。为总预估费用创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。指定一个高于 Cost Explorer 所确定成本的成本阈值。如果超过警报阈值，则添加通知以提醒运维团队。
options.B: 开启账单提醒。使用 AWS Cost Explorer 确定过去 3 个月的平均月度成本。为总预估费用创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。指定一个高于 Cost Explorer 所确定成本的成本阈值。如果超过警报阈值，则添加通知以提醒运维团队。
options.C: 使用 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 创建一个成本监控器，其监控类型为 Linked account。创建一个订阅，将每日 AWS 成本摘要发送给运维团队。指定成本差异阈值。
options.D: 使用 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 创建一个成本监控器，其监控类型为 AWS services。创建一个订阅，将每日 AWS 成本摘要发送给运维团队。指定成本差异阈值。

zh.explanation:
该公司的账单通常保持稳定，并希望通过自动化方式检测由开发人员忘记删除的临时测试资源导致的意外成本增加。解决方案必须既能提醒运维团队，又能帮助识别成本增加的驱动因素。

**正确答案：D。使用监控类型为 AWS services 的 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection，并配置带成本差异阈值的每日摘要警报订阅。**

AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 正是为此类用例而设计的：它使用机器学习来检测已部署 AWS 服务中的异常支出模式，可以发送电子邮件或 SNS 警报，并且可以按美元影响程度对根因进行排序，跨 AWS 服务、账户、区域和使用类型等维度进行调查（[AWS Cost Management User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/manage-ad.html)）。Cost Anomaly Detection 设置还支持警报订阅，包括**每日摘要**，以及基于绝对成本影响或百分比成本影响的阈值；当异常达到或超过阈值时会发送通知（[Getting started with AWS Cost Anomaly Detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/getting-started-ad.html)）。

关键区别在于监控维度。**AWS services** 监控器会“自动评估你的账户使用的所有 AWS 服务是否存在异常”，并在使用新的 AWS 服务时开始评估这些新服务。这提供了服务级别的可见性，最适合用于识别被遗忘的测试资源正在增加成本的服务领域（[Monitor types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/getting-started-ad.html)）。异常视图可以显示最高级别的根因信息，例如服务、账户、区域和使用类型，这有助于运维团队调查有问题的资源。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A. 基于过去一个月的 CloudWatch 账单警报** – CloudWatch 账单警报可以在总预估费用超过静态阈值时发出通知，但它是粗粒度的总费用警报。它不使用异常检测，也不会自动识别根因。AWS 文档描述了如何基于 `EstimatedCharges` 指标创建带固定阈值和 SNS 通知的账单警报（[CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)）。这只会在总支出超过所选阈值后发出警报，并且无法可靠地识别成本驱动因素。
* **B. 基于 3 个月平均值的 CloudWatch 账单警报** – 这与选项 A 具有相同的限制。使用 3 个月平均值可能会使静态阈值更稳定，但该警报仍然是将预估费用与手动选择的阈值进行比较监控，并不提供 Cost Anomaly Detection 根因分析。
* **C. 使用监控类型为 Linked account 的 Cost Anomaly Detection** – 该选项使用了正确的服务，但监控维度不太适合题目要求。linked-account 监控器适用于检测成员账户的异常支出。但是，题目强调要识别导致成本增加的资源/服务。AWS services 监控器提供更直接的服务级别异常检测，而 linked-account 监控主要是账户级别支出监控。

因此，**D** 是最佳答案，因为它使用了专门构建的异常检测服务，能够基于阈值自动发出警报，并提供最相关的服务级别可见性，以便调查被遗忘的测试资源。

en.question: A company is deploying a new web-based application and needs a storage solution for the Linux application servers. The company wants to create a single location for updates to application data for all instances. The active dataset will be up to 100 GB in size. A solutions architect has determined that peak operations will occur for 3 hours daily and will require a total of 225 MiBps of read throughput. The solutions architect must design a Multi-AZ solution that makes a copy of the data available in another AWS Region for disaster recovery (DR). The DR copy has an RPO of less than 1 hour. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a new Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Multi-AZ file system. Configure the file system for 75 MiBps of provisioned throughput. Implement replication to a file system in the DR Region.
options.B: Deploy a new Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Configure Bursting Throughput mode for the file system. Use AWS Backup to back up the file system to the DR Region.
options.C: Deploy a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with 225 MiBps of throughput. Enable Multi-Attach for the EBS volume. Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery to replicate the EBS volume to the DR Region.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system in both the production Region and the DR Region. Create an AWS DataSync scheduled task to replicate the data from the production file system to the DR file system every 10 minutes.

en.explanation:
The application needs shared storage for multiple Linux application servers, a single place to update application data, Multi-AZ availability in the production Region, and a DR copy in another Region with RPO < 1 hour. The key details are that the peak requirement is **225 MiBps of read throughput** for 3 hours/day, not necessarily 225 MiBps of write or metered throughput.

**Correct answer: A. Deploy a new Amazon EFS Multi-AZ file system with 75 MiBps provisioned throughput and EFS replication to the DR Region.**

Amazon EFS is the best fit for shared Linux application data because a **Regional EFS file system** can be mounted by multiple EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones; AWS shows Regional EFS file systems with mount targets in multiple AZs and multiple EC2 instances accessing the same file system ([How Amazon EFS works with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). EFS also provides native replication to another Region. After the initial sync, EFS replication maintains an **RPO of 15 minutes for most file systems**, which satisfies the requirement of less than 1 hour ([Replicating EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/efs-replication.html)).

The 75 MiBps provisioned throughput is sufficient for the stated **225 MiBps read** requirement because EFS discounts read throughput: the documentation states that read operations are metered up to **one-third** the rate of write operations, allowing higher read throughput than write throughput ([Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)). Therefore, 75 MiBps of provisioned/metered throughput can support approximately 225 MiBps of read throughput.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. FSx for Lustre with AWS Backup** — This does not meet the RPO requirement as stated. AWS Backup snapshot backups can be scheduled **as frequently as hourly**, not less than hourly, so a cross-Region backup-based DR approach cannot guarantee an RPO of less than 1 hour ([AWS Backup plan options and configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/plan-options-and-configuration.html)). Also, FSx for Lustre is typically used for high-performance compute workloads, not as the simplest shared web application data store with native sub-hour cross-Region replication.
* **C. gp3 EBS volume with Multi-Attach** — This is invalid because EBS Multi-Attach is supported only for Provisioned IOPS SSD **io1/io2** volumes, not gp3. The documentation also notes that Multi-Attach volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, which does not provide the required Multi-AZ shared storage pattern ([Attach an EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances using Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
* **D. FSx for OpenZFS with DataSync every 10 minutes** — The option depends on scheduling DataSync every 10 minutes, but AWS DataSync scheduled tasks have a **minimum interval of 1 hour** and cannot be scheduled faster than 1 hour ([Scheduling when your AWS DataSync task runs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)). Therefore, this option as written cannot meet the sub-hour RPO requirement.

Because EFS provides shared Multi-AZ file storage, can support the read throughput with 75 MiBps provisioned throughput due to read metering, and has native cross-Region replication with a typical 15-minute RPO, **A is the only option that satisfies all requirements.**

zh.question: 一家公司正在部署一个新的基于 Web 的应用程序，并且需要为 Linux 应用程序服务器提供一个存储解决方案。该公司希望为所有实例创建一个用于更新应用程序数据的单一位置。活动数据集的大小最多为 100 GB。解决方案架构师已确定，每天的峰值操作将持续 3 小时，并且总共需要 225 MiBps 的读取吞吐量。解决方案架构师必须设计一个 Multi-AZ 解决方案，使数据副本可在另一个 AWS Region 中用于灾难恢复 (DR)。DR 副本的 RPO 小于 1 小时。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署一个新的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Multi-AZ 文件系统。将该文件系统配置为 75 MiBps 的预置吞吐量。实施复制到 DR Region 中的文件系统。
options.B: 部署一个新的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。为该文件系统配置 Bursting Throughput 模式。使用 AWS Backup 将该文件系统备份到 DR Region。
options.C: 部署一个吞吐量为 225 MiBps 的 General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。为该 EBS 卷启用 Multi-Attach。使用 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 将该 EBS 卷复制到 DR Region。
options.D: 在生产 Region 和 DR Region 中都部署 Amazon FSx for OpenZFS 文件系统。创建一个 AWS DataSync 计划任务，每 10 分钟将数据从生产文件系统复制到 DR 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序需要为多个 Linux 应用程序服务器提供共享存储、一个用于更新应用程序数据的单一位置、生产 Region 中的 Multi-AZ 可用性，以及另一个 Region 中 RPO < 1 小时的 DR 副本。关键细节是峰值需求为每天 3 小时的 **225 MiBps 读取吞吐量**，而不一定是 225 MiBps 的写入吞吐量或计量吞吐量。

**正确答案：A。部署一个新的 Amazon EFS Multi-AZ 文件系统，配置 75 MiBps 预置吞吐量，并将 EFS 复制到 DR Region。**

Amazon EFS 最适合共享 Linux 应用程序数据，因为 **Regional EFS 文件系统**可以由多个 Availability Zone 中的多个 EC2 实例挂载；AWS 展示了在多个 AZ 中具有挂载目标、并由多个 EC2 实例访问同一文件系统的 Regional EFS 文件系统（[Amazon EFS 如何与 Amazon EC2 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。EFS 还提供到另一个 Region 的原生复制。初始同步后，对于大多数文件系统，EFS replication 会维持 **15 分钟的 RPO**，这满足小于 1 小时的要求（[复制 EFS 文件系统](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/efs-replication.html)）。

75 MiBps 的预置吞吐量足以满足所述的 **225 MiBps 读取**要求，因为 EFS 会对读取吞吐量进行折算：文档说明读取操作按写入操作速率的最多 **三分之一** 计量，从而允许比写入吞吐量更高的读取吞吐量（[Amazon EFS 性能规格](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。因此，75 MiBps 的预置/计量吞吐量可以支持约 225 MiBps 的读取吞吐量。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B. 使用 AWS Backup 的 FSx for Lustre** — 这不满足所述 RPO 要求。AWS Backup 快照备份可以计划为**最频繁每小时一次**，而不是低于每小时一次，因此基于跨 Region 备份的 DR 方法无法保证小于 1 小时的 RPO（[AWS Backup 计划选项和配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/plan-options-and-configuration.html)）。此外，FSx for Lustre 通常用于高性能计算工作负载，而不是作为具有原生亚小时级跨 Region 复制的最简单共享 Web 应用程序数据存储。
* **C. 带 Multi-Attach 的 gp3 EBS 卷** — 这是无效的，因为 EBS Multi-Attach 仅支持 Provisioned IOPS SSD **io1/io2** 卷，不支持 gp3。文档还指出，Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到**同一个 Availability Zone** 中的实例，这无法提供所需的 Multi-AZ 共享存储模式（[使用 Multi-Attach 将 EBS 卷附加到多个 EC2 实例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
* **D. 每 10 分钟使用 DataSync 的 FSx for OpenZFS** — 该选项依赖于每 10 分钟调度 DataSync，但 AWS DataSync 计划任务的**最小间隔为 1 小时**，不能以快于 1 小时的频率调度（[计划 AWS DataSync 任务的运行时间](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)）。因此，该选项按其描述无法满足亚小时级 RPO 要求。

由于 EFS 提供共享 Multi-AZ 文件存储，能够凭借读取计量机制以 75 MiBps 预置吞吐量支持读取吞吐量，并且具有原生跨 Region 复制且典型 RPO 为 15 分钟，**A 是唯一满足所有要求的选项。**

en.question: A company needs to gather data from an experiment in a remote location that does not have internet connectivity. During the experiment, sensors that are connected to a local network will generate 6 TB of data in a proprietary format over the course of 1 week. The sensors can be configured to upload their data files to an FTP server periodically, but the sensors do not have their own FTP server. The sensors also do not support other protocols. The company needs to collect the data centrally and move the data to object storage in the AWS Cloud as soon as possible after the experiment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized device. Connect the device to the local network. Configure AWS DataSync with a target bucket name, and unload the data over NFS to the device. After the experiment, return the device to AWS so that the data can be loaded into Amazon S3.
options.B: Order an AWS Snowcone device, including an Amazon Linux 2 AMI. Connect the device to the local network. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on the device. Create a shell script that periodically downloads data from each sensor. After the experiment, return the device to AWS so that the data can be loaded as an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume.
options.C: Order an AWS Snowcone device, including an Amazon Linux 2 AMI. Connect the device to the local network. Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on the device. Install and configure an FTP server on the EC2 instance. Configure the sensors to upload data to the EC2 instance. After the experiment, return the device to AWS so that the data can be loaded into Amazon S3.
options.D: Order an AWS Snowcone device. Connect the device to the local network. Configure the device to use Amazon FSx. Configure the sensors to upload data to the device. Configure AWS DataSync on the device to synchronize the uploaded data with an Amazon S3 bucket. Return the device to AWS so that the data can be loaded as an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume.

en.explanation:
The company has an offline remote site, 6 TB of data to collect over a week, and sensors that can only upload files by FTP. Therefore, the solution must provide a local FTP server at the site and must support physical import of the collected data into Amazon S3 after the experiment.

**Correct answer: C. Order an AWS Snowcone device with an Amazon Linux 2 AMI, launch an EC2 instance on the device, install an FTP server, configure the sensors to upload to it, and return the device so the data is loaded into Amazon S3.**

This option satisfies the key protocol and connectivity requirements. AWS Snow Family devices with compute capability can run EC2-compatible instances from AMIs that are added to the device, and AWS documentation lists **Amazon Linux 2 for Snowball Edge** as a supported Linux AMI for EC2-compatible compute on Snow devices ([Using an Amazon EC2-compatible AMI on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/using-ami.html)). Running Amazon Linux locally allows the company to install and configure an FTP server, which gives the sensors the exact upload target they require.

After the files are collected on the local instance, the data can be placed into storage on the Snow device for import. AWS documents that data can be transferred between EC2-compatible compute instances and Amazon S3 buckets on the same Snowball Edge device by using AWS CLI commands against the local S3-compatible endpoint ([Transferring data from EC2-compatible compute instances to S3 buckets on the same Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/data-transfer-ec2-s3-edge.html)). AWS also documents that files on the device are transferred to Amazon S3 when the device is returned to AWS for an import job ([Managing the NFS interface on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/shared-using-nfs.html)). This provides offline local collection followed by physical import into S3 object storage.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect** because it does not provide an FTP server. The sensors only support FTP uploads, so they cannot directly unload data over NFS. The option also relies on AWS DataSync, but DataSync requires network connectivity between the agent and the DataSync service endpoint; AWS lists connectivity options such as Direct Connect, VPN, or public internet ([Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)). The remote site has no internet connectivity.

- **B is incorrect** because it assumes a shell script can download data from the sensors. The question states that the sensors can upload to an FTP server; it does not state that the sensors expose an FTP server or any other service from which data can be pulled. In addition, this option says the data will be loaded as an Amazon EBS volume, but the requirement is to move the data to object storage in Amazon S3.

- **D is incorrect** because it does not provide the required FTP server for FTP-only sensors. It also proposes synchronizing to Amazon S3 with DataSync from a location without internet connectivity, which does not meet DataSync networking requirements to communicate with the DataSync service endpoint ([Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)). Finally, it states that the data is loaded as an EBS volume rather than into Amazon S3 object storage.

Therefore, **C** is the only option that provides a local FTP endpoint for the sensors, works without internet connectivity during the experiment, and enables the collected data to be imported into Amazon S3 afterward.

zh.question: 一家公司需要从一个没有互联网连接的偏远地点的实验中收集数据。在实验期间，连接到本地网络的传感器将在 1 周内以专有格式生成 6 TB 数据。这些传感器可以配置为定期将其数据文件上传到 FTP 服务器，但传感器本身没有 FTP 服务器。传感器也不支持其他协议。公司需要集中收集这些数据，并在实验结束后尽快将数据移动到 AWS 云中的对象存储。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized 设备。将该设备连接到本地网络。使用目标存储桶名称配置 AWS DataSync，并通过 NFS 将数据卸载到该设备。实验结束后，将设备返还给 AWS，以便将数据加载到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备，包括一个 Amazon Linux 2 AMI。将该设备连接到本地网络。在设备上启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。创建一个 shell 脚本，定期从每个传感器下载数据。实验结束后，将设备返还给 AWS，以便将数据作为 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷加载。
options.C: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备，包括一个 Amazon Linux 2 AMI。将该设备连接到本地网络。在设备上启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。在该 EC2 实例上安装并配置 FTP 服务器。配置传感器将数据上传到该 EC2 实例。实验结束后，将设备返还给 AWS，以便将数据加载到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备。将该设备连接到本地网络。配置该设备使用 Amazon FSx。配置传感器将数据上传到该设备。配置设备上的 AWS DataSync，将上传的数据与 Amazon S3 存储桶同步。将设备返还给 AWS，以便将数据作为 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷加载。

zh.explanation:
该公司有一个离线的偏远站点，需要在一周内收集 6 TB 数据，并且传感器只能通过 FTP 上传文件。因此，该解决方案必须在站点本地提供 FTP 服务器，并且必须支持在实验结束后将收集到的数据物理导入到 Amazon S3。

**正确答案：C。订购一台带有 Amazon Linux 2 AMI 的 AWS Snowcone 设备，在该设备上启动 EC2 实例，安装 FTP 服务器，配置传感器将数据上传到该服务器，并返还设备以便将数据加载到 Amazon S3。**

此选项满足关键的协议和连接要求。具有计算能力的 AWS Snow Family 设备可以运行从添加到设备的 AMI 启动的 EC2 兼容实例，并且 AWS 文档将 **Amazon Linux 2 for Snowball Edge** 列为 Snow 设备上用于 EC2 兼容计算的受支持 Linux AMI（[Using an Amazon EC2-compatible AMI on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/using-ami.html)）。在本地运行 Amazon Linux 允许公司安装并配置 FTP 服务器，从而为传感器提供它们所需的精确上传目标。

文件在本地实例上收集完成后，可以将数据放入 Snow 设备上的存储中以进行导入。AWS 文档说明，可以使用针对本地 S3 兼容端点的 AWS CLI 命令，在 EC2 兼容计算实例与同一 Snowball Edge 设备上的 Amazon S3 存储桶之间传输数据（[Transferring data from EC2-compatible compute instances to S3 buckets on the same Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/data-transfer-ec2-s3-edge.html)）。AWS 还说明，当设备作为导入作业返还给 AWS 时，设备上的文件会传输到 Amazon S3（[Managing the NFS interface on Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/shared-using-nfs.html)）。这提供了离线本地收集，随后通过物理导入进入 S3 对象存储的能力。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 不正确**，因为它没有提供 FTP 服务器。传感器只支持 FTP 上传，因此它们无法直接通过 NFS 卸载数据。该选项还依赖 AWS DataSync，但 DataSync 要求代理与 DataSync 服务端点之间具有网络连接；AWS 列出了 Direct Connect、VPN 或公网互联网等连接选项（[Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。该偏远站点没有互联网连接。

- **B 不正确**，因为它假设 shell 脚本可以从传感器下载数据。题目说明传感器可以上传到 FTP 服务器；并未说明传感器暴露了 FTP 服务器或任何其他可从中拉取数据的服务。此外，该选项称数据将作为 Amazon EBS 卷加载，但要求是将数据移动到 Amazon S3 中的对象存储。

- **D 不正确**，因为它没有为仅支持 FTP 的传感器提供所需的 FTP 服务器。它还建议从一个没有互联网连接的位置使用 DataSync 同步到 Amazon S3，这不满足 DataSync 与 DataSync 服务端点通信的网络要求（[Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。最后，它说明数据将作为 EBS 卷加载，而不是加载到 Amazon S3 对象存储中。

因此，**C** 是唯一提供传感器所需的本地 FTP 端点、在实验期间无需互联网连接即可工作，并且能够在之后将收集到的数据导入 Amazon S3 的选项。

en.question: A company that has multiple business units is using AWS Organizations with all features enabled. The company has implemented an account structure in which each business unit has its own AWS account. Administrators in each AWS account need to view detailed cost and utilization data for their account by using Amazon Athena. Each business unit can have access to only its own cost and utilization data. The IAM policies that govern the ability to set up AWS Cost and Usage Reports are in place. A central Cost and Usage Report that contains all data for the organization is already available in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational complexity?

options.A: In the organization's management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Cost and Usage Report data with each member account.
options.B: In the organization's management account, configure an S3 event to invoke an AWS Lambda function each time a new file arrives in the S3 bucket that contains the central Cost and Usage Report. Configure the Lambda function to extract each member account’s data and to place the data in Amazon S3 under a separate prefix. Modify the S3 bucket policy to allow each member account to access its own prefix.
options.C: In each member account, access AWS Cost Explorer. Create a new report that contains relevant cost information for the account. Save the report in Cost Explorer. Provide instructions that the account administrators can use to access the saved report.
options.D: In each member account, create a new S3 bucket to store Cost and Usage Report data. Set up a Cost and Usage Report to deliver the data to the new S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
The company needs each business unit account to query detailed cost and usage data with Amazon Athena, while ensuring that each business unit can access only its own data. The correct answer is **D: In each member account, create a new S3 bucket to store Cost and Usage Report data, and set up a Cost and Usage Report to deliver the data to that bucket.**

AWS Cost and Usage Reports (AWS CUR) are delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket and can be configured for analysis with Athena.
