该公司正在使用 AWS Direct Connect，并结合 **transit virtual interface（transit VIF）**、**Direct Connect gateway** 和 **transit gateway**，在本地网络与附加到中转网关的多个 VPC 之间提供私有连接。问题询问需要哪两个步骤，才能使本地基础设施通过 transit VIF 连接到 VPC 资源。

### 正确答案：B 和 C

**B. 通过 transit VIF 通告本地网络前缀。**  
这是必需的，这样 AWS 才知道如何将来自 VPC/transit gateway 环境的返回流量路由回本地网络。AWS Direct Connect 文档说明，在使用 Direct Connect 访问私有 AWS 资源时，客户必须指定要通过 BGP 为 private 或 transit virtual interfaces 通告的 IPv4 或 IPv6 前缀（[Direct Connect routing policies and BGP communities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/routing-and-bgp.html)）。

**C. 通过 transit VIF 将 VPC 前缀从 Direct Connect 网关通告到本地网络。**  
这是必需的，这样本地网络才能获知可通过 Direct Connect gateway 和 transit gateway 到达的 AWS 侧路由。AWS 文档解释说，Direct Connect gateway 可以通过 **transit virtual interface** 将 Direct Connect 连接连接到附加到 transit gateway 的 VPC 或 VPN（[Direct Connect gateways and transit gateway associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-transit-gateways.html)）。对于 transit gateway 关联，Direct Connect gateway 使用 **allowed prefixes** 列表，并通过 BGP 将这些前缀通告到本地网络；对于 transit gateway 关联，只会将输入的 allowed prefixes 通告到本地（[Allowed prefixes interactions for Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/allowed-to-prefixes.html)）。

B 和 C 共同建立双向路由：本地前缀被通告到 AWS，而 AWS/VPC 侧前缀被通告到本地。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 将 1 Gbps Direct Connect 连接更新为 10 Gbps。**  
仅为了将 transit VIF 与 Direct Connect gateway 和 transit gateway 一起使用，并不需要 10 Gbps 连接。Direct Connect 支持 1 Gbps 专用连接，而 transit VIF 连接是虚拟接口/路由配置问题，不是强制的 10 Gbps 端口速率要求。此外，AWS 指出，专用连接的端口速度在连接请求后无法更改；若要更改速度，必须创建新连接（[Dedicated Direct Connect connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/dedicated_connection.html)）。

**D. 将 Direct Connect 连接的 MACsec 加密模式属性更新为 `must_encrypt`。**  
MACsec 是可选的第 2 层加密功能，与通过 transit VIF 在本地和 VPC 资源之间启用路由交换无关。它不会建立所需的 BGP 路由通告。此外，MACsec 仅在选定接入点的 10 Gbps、100 Gbps 和 400 Gbps 专用 Direct Connect 连接上受支持，不支持题目所述的 1 Gbps 连接（[MAC Security in Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/MACsec.html)）。

**E. 将 MACsec CKN/CAK 对与 Direct Connect 连接关联。**  
关联 MACsec 密钥对也是可选 MACsec 加密设置的一部分，并不是通过 transit VIF 实现 VPC 可达性的要求。它不会通告本地前缀或 AWS 侧 allowed prefixes。如上所述，1 Gbps 专用 Direct Connect 连接不支持 MACsec（[MAC Security in Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/MACsec.html)）。

因此，所需组合是 **B 和 C**。

en.question: A company wants to use Amazon WorkSpaces in combination with thin client devices to replace aging desktops. Employees use the desktops to access applications that work with Clinical trial data. Corporate security policy states that access to the applications must be restricted to only company branch office locations. The company is considering adding an additional branch office in the next 6 months. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an IP access control group rule with the list of public addresses from the branch offices. Associate the IP access control group with the WorkSpaces directory.
options.B: Use AWS Firewall Manager to create a web ACL rule with an IPSet with the list of public addresses from the branch office locations. Associate the web ACL with the WorkSpaces directory.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue trusted device certificates to the machines deployed in the branch office locations. Enable restricted access on the WorkSpaces directory.
options.D: Create a custom WorkSpace image with Windows Firewall configured to restrict access to the public addresses of the branch offices. Use the image to deploy the WorkSpaces.

en.explanation:
The company needs to ensure that users can connect to Amazon WorkSpaces only from known corporate branch office networks, while keeping operations simple when a new branch office is added later.

**Correct answer: A. Create an IP access control group rule with the list of public addresses from the branch offices. Associate the IP access control group with the WorkSpaces directory.**

Amazon WorkSpaces has a native feature specifically for this requirement: **IP access control groups**. The WorkSpaces documentation states that you can define trusted IP addresses and allow users to access their WorkSpaces only when they are connected to a trusted network. An IP access control group acts as a virtual firewall, and you add CIDR rules for trusted networks and associate the group with the WorkSpaces directory. AWS also explicitly says that associating an IP access control group with a directory ensures WorkSpaces are accessed only from trusted networks ([WorkSpaces IP access control groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces-ip-access-control-groups.html)).

This is the most operationally efficient solution because the control is managed centrally at the WorkSpaces directory level. When the company adds another branch office, administrators only need to add the new branch office public IP address range to the IP access control group.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Use AWS Firewall Manager with a web ACL and IPSet** — Incorrect. AWS WAF web ACLs protect HTTP/S web requests for supported resources such as CloudFront, API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, AppSync, Cognito, App Runner, Amplify, CloudWatch, and Verified Access; WorkSpaces directories are not listed as supported protected resources ([AWS WAF web ACL documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)). AWS Firewall Manager is therefore not the right mechanism to associate a web ACL with a WorkSpaces directory.

- **C. Use ACM trusted device certificates and enable restricted access** — Incorrect for this requirement. WorkSpaces does support restricting access to trusted devices using certificates, but that controls **which devices** can access WorkSpaces, not whether users are connecting from only the branch office public IP ranges. The documentation describes device access control as specifying device types and using certificates to restrict access to trusted managed devices ([WorkSpaces device access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/control-device-access.html)). The stated requirement is location/network-based access, not device trust.

- **D. Create a custom WorkSpace image with Windows Firewall restrictions** — Incorrect and operationally inefficient. This would place access-control logic inside each WorkSpace image or instance, requiring image management and updates whenever branch office IPs change. It also does not use the native WorkSpaces directory-level feature intended for trusted network restrictions.

Therefore, **A** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将 Amazon WorkSpaces 与瘦客户端设备结合使用，以替换老旧的台式机。员工使用这些台式机访问处理临床试验数据的应用程序。公司安全策略规定，必须将对这些应用程序的访问限制为仅来自公司分支办公室位置。该公司正在考虑在未来 6 个月内增加一个新的分支办公室。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 IP 访问控制组规则，其中包含分支办公室的公网地址列表。将该 IP 访问控制组与 WorkSpaces 目录关联。
options.B: 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 创建一个 web ACL 规则，其中包含一个 IPSet，IPSet 中包含分支办公室位置的公网地址列表。将该 web ACL 与 WorkSpaces 目录关联。
options.C: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 向部署在分支办公室位置的机器签发受信任设备证书。在 WorkSpaces 目录上启用受限访问。
options.D: 创建一个自定义 WorkSpace 映像，并将 Windows Firewall 配置为限制仅允许来自分支办公室公网地址的访问。使用该映像部署 WorkSpaces。

zh.explanation:
公司需要确保用户只能从已知的公司分支办公室网络连接到 Amazon WorkSpaces，同时在以后添加新的分支办公室时保持运维简单。

**正确答案：A. 创建一个 IP 访问控制组规则，其中包含分支办公室的公网地址列表。将该 IP 访问控制组与 WorkSpaces 目录关联。**

Amazon WorkSpaces 有一个专门满足此要求的原生功能：**IP 访问控制组**。WorkSpaces 文档说明，你可以定义受信任的 IP 地址，并仅允许用户在连接到受信任网络时访问其 WorkSpaces。IP 访问控制组充当虚拟防火墙，你可以为受信任网络添加 CIDR 规则，并将该组与 WorkSpaces 目录关联。AWS 还明确说明，将 IP 访问控制组与目录关联可确保 WorkSpaces 只能从受信任网络访问（[WorkSpaces IP 访问控制组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/amazon-workspaces-ip-access-control-groups.html)）。

这是运营效率最高的解决方案，因为控制是在 WorkSpaces 目录级别集中管理的。当公司添加另一个分支办公室时，管理员只需要将新的分支办公室公网 IP 地址范围添加到 IP 访问控制组。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 配合 web ACL 和 IPSet** — 不正确。AWS WAF web ACL 保护的是受支持资源的 HTTP/S Web 请求，例如 CloudFront、API Gateway、Application Load Balancer、AppSync、Cognito、App Runner、Amplify、CloudWatch 和 Verified Access；WorkSpaces 目录未被列为受支持的受保护资源（[AWS WAF web ACL 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)）。因此，AWS Firewall Manager 不是将 web ACL 与 WorkSpaces 目录关联的正确机制。

- **C. 使用 ACM 受信任设备证书并启用受限访问** — 对于此要求不正确。WorkSpaces 确实支持使用证书限制受信任设备访问，但这控制的是**哪些设备**可以访问 WorkSpaces，而不是用户是否仅从分支办公室公网 IP 范围连接。文档将设备访问控制描述为指定设备类型并使用证书限制对受信任托管设备的访问（[WorkSpaces 设备访问控制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workspaces/latest/adminguide/control-device-access.html)）。题目所述要求是基于位置/网络的访问，而不是设备信任。

- **D. 创建带有 Windows Firewall 限制的自定义 WorkSpace 映像** — 不正确且运营效率低。这会将访问控制逻辑放在每个 WorkSpace 映像或实例内部，每当分支办公室 IP 发生变化时都需要进行映像管理和更新。它也没有使用专为受信任网络限制设计的原生 WorkSpaces 目录级功能。

因此，**A** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations. The company runs two firewall appliances in a centralized networking account. Each firewall appliance runs on a manually configured highly available Amazon EC2 instance. A transit gateway connects the VPC from the centralized networking account to VPCs of member accounts. Each firewall appliance uses a static private IP address that is then used to route traffic from the member accounts to the internet. During a recent incident, a badly configured script initiated the termination of both firewall appliances. During the rebuild of the firewall appliances, the company wrote a new script to configure the firewall appliances at startup. The company wants to modernize the deployment of the firewall appliances. The firewall appliances need the ability to scale horizontally to handle increased traffic when the network expands. The company must continue to use the firewall appliances to comply with company policy. The provider of the firewall appliances has confirmed that the latest version of the firewall code will work with all AWS services. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the centralized networking account. Set up an endpoint service that uses AWS PrivateLink.
options.B: Deploy a Network Load Balancer in the centralized networking account. Set up an endpoint service that uses AWS PrivateLink.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group and a launch template that uses the new script as user data to configure the firewall appliances. Create a target group that uses the instance target type.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group. Configure an AWS Launch Wizard deployment that uses the new script as user data to configure the firewall appliances. Create a target group that uses the IP target type.
options.E: Create VPC endpoints in each member account. Update the route tables to point to the VPC endpoints.
options.F: Create VPC endpoints in the centralized networking account. Update the route tables in each member account to point to the VPC endpoints.

en.explanation:
The company needs to replace manually managed firewall EC2 instances that use static private IP addresses with a resilient, horizontally scalable, centralized inspection architecture. Because the existing design already uses a transit gateway to connect member VPCs to a centralized networking account, the most cost-effective solution is to keep the inspection layer centralized and place the firewall appliance fleet behind Gateway Load Balancer.

The correct answers are **A, C, and F**.

**A. Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the centralized networking account. Set up an endpoint service that uses AWS PrivateLink.**  
Gateway Load Balancer is the ELB type designed for this use case. AWS describes Gateway Load Balancers as enabling customers to deploy, scale, and manage virtual appliances such as firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, and deep packet inspection systems. Gateway Load Balancer also uses Gateway Load Balancer endpoints to exchange traffic across VPC boundaries, with the Gateway Load Balancer deployed in the same VPC as the virtual appliances and the appliances registered in a target group. This directly fits the requirement to continue using the company’s firewall appliances while modernizing and scaling the deployment. See [What is a Gateway Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html) and [Access virtual appliances through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpce-gateway-load-balancer.html).

**C. Create an Auto Scaling group and a launch template that uses the new script as user data to configure the firewall appliances. Create a target group that uses the instance target type.**  
The firewall appliances are EC2-based and now have a startup configuration script. EC2 user data is intended to run scripts or perform automated configuration tasks when an instance launches. An Auto Scaling group can attach to target groups for Application Load Balancers, Network Load Balancers, and Gateway Load Balancers, and the instances in the Auto Scaling group are automatically registered with the load balancer target group. Gateway Load Balancer target groups support the `instance` target type, where targets are specified by instance ID. This provides the required horizontal scaling and automated replacement of appliance instances. See [Run commands when you launch an EC2 instance with user data input](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html), [Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html), and [Target groups for your Gateway Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/target-groups.html).

**F. Create VPC endpoints in the centralized networking account. Update the route tables in each member account to point to the VPC endpoints.**  
In a centralized inspection design with Transit Gateway, the Gateway Load Balancer, Gateway Load Balancer endpoints, and virtual appliances are placed in a centralized security or networking VPC. AWS describes this pattern for centralized network security: Gateway Load Balancer is deployed in a separate security VPC with the virtual appliances, Gateway Load Balancer endpoints are routable targets, and traffic moving to and from Transit Gateway can be routed to the appliance fleet. The same documentation states that each spoke VPC has a Transit Gateway-associated route table with the default route to the security VPC attachment as the next hop, and that the centralized security VPC contains the Gateway Load Balancer endpoints and virtual appliances. This keeps the inspection endpoints centralized instead of duplicating endpoints across all member accounts, which is more cost-effective for an organization that already uses Transit Gateway. See [Using Gateway Load Balancer with Transit Gateway for centralized network security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/using-gwlb-with-tg-for-cns.html).

The other options are not the best choices:

**B. Deploy a Network Load Balancer in the centralized networking account. Set up an endpoint service that uses AWS PrivateLink.**  
A Network Load Balancer can be used with PrivateLink for exposing services, but it is not the purpose-built service for transparent inline inspection with third-party firewall appliances. Gateway Load Balancer is specifically designed to distribute traffic to virtual appliances such as firewalls and uses GENEVE encapsulation on port 6081 for appliance traffic. Therefore, Gateway Load Balancer is the correct load balancer type, not Network Load Balancer.

**D. Create an Auto Scaling group. Configure an AWS Launch Wizard deployment that uses the new script as user data to configure the firewall appliances. Create a target group that uses the IP target type.**  
The required scaling mechanism is an Auto Scaling group using a launch template and user data to configure each EC2 firewall appliance at launch. Launch Wizard is not needed for this appliance fleet and adds unnecessary complexity. Also, for EC2 instances launched and managed by an Auto Scaling group, using an `instance` target group is the straightforward integration because targets are registered by instance ID. The IP target type is not the most appropriate choice for this ASG-managed EC2 appliance deployment.

**E. Create VPC endpoints in each member account. Update the route tables to point to the VPC endpoints.**  
Creating Gateway Load Balancer endpoints in every member account is a distributed endpoint model. It can support inspection, but it is less cost-effective in this scenario because the company already has a centralized networking account connected to member VPCs through Transit Gateway. The centralized Transit Gateway inspection pattern places the Gateway Load Balancer endpoints in the centralized security VPC with the appliances and routes member VPC traffic through that centralized inspection path, avoiding unnecessary endpoint duplication across member accounts.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations。该公司在一个集中式网络账户中运行两个防火墙设备。每个防火墙设备都运行在一个手动配置的高可用 Amazon EC2 实例上。一个 transit gateway 将集中式网络账户中的 VPC 连接到成员账户的 VPC。每个防火墙设备使用一个静态私有 IP 地址，随后成员账户使用该地址将流量路由到互联网。在最近的一次事件中，一个配置不当的脚本启动了两个防火墙设备的终止。在重建防火墙设备期间，该公司编写了一个新脚本，用于在启动时配置防火墙设备。该公司希望对防火墙设备的部署进行现代化改造。当网络扩展时，防火墙设备需要能够水平扩展以处理增加的流量。该公司必须继续使用这些防火墙设备以符合公司策略。防火墙设备提供商已确认，最新版本的防火墙代码可与所有 AWS 服务配合使用。解决方案架构师应推荐哪一组步骤，以最高成本效益满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在集中式网络账户中部署 Gateway Load Balancer。设置一个使用 AWS PrivateLink 的 endpoint service。
options.B: 在集中式网络账户中部署 Network Load Balancer。设置一个使用 AWS PrivateLink 的 endpoint service。
options.C: 创建一个 Auto Scaling group 和一个 launch template，使用新脚本作为 user data 来配置防火墙设备。创建一个使用 instance 目标类型的 target group。
options.D: 创建一个 Auto Scaling group。配置一个 AWS Launch Wizard 部署，使用新脚本作为 user data 来配置防火墙设备。创建一个使用 IP 目标类型的 target group。
options.E: 在每个成员账户中创建 VPC endpoints。更新路由表，使其指向 VPC endpoints。
options.F: 在集中式网络账户中创建 VPC endpoints。更新每个成员账户中的路由表，使其指向 VPC endpoints。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要将手动管理、使用静态私有 IP 地址的防火墙 EC2 实例，替换为一个具有弹性、可水平扩展的集中式检查架构。由于现有设计已经使用 transit gateway 将成员 VPC 连接到集中式网络账户，因此成本效益最高的解决方案是保持检查层集中化，并将防火墙设备队列放在 Gateway Load Balancer 后面。

正确答案是 **A、C 和 F**。

**A. 在集中式网络账户中部署 Gateway Load Balancer。设置一个使用 AWS PrivateLink 的 endpoint service。**  
Gateway Load Balancer 是专为此用例设计的 ELB 类型。AWS 将 Gateway Load Balancers 描述为可让客户部署、扩展和管理虚拟设备，例如防火墙、入侵检测和防御系统以及深度数据包检查系统。Gateway Load Balancer 还使用 Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 跨 VPC 边界交换流量，其中 Gateway Load Balancer 与虚拟设备部署在同一 VPC 中，并且这些设备注册到一个 target group 中。这直接符合继续使用公司防火墙设备、同时对部署进行现代化改造并实现扩展的要求。请参阅 [What is a Gateway Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html) 和 [Access virtual appliances through AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpce-gateway-load-balancer.html)。

**C. 创建一个 Auto Scaling group 和一个 launch template，使用新脚本作为 user data 来配置防火墙设备。创建一个使用 instance 目标类型的 target group。**  
防火墙设备基于 EC2，并且现在有一个启动配置脚本。EC2 user data 用于在实例启动时运行脚本或执行自动化配置任务。Auto Scaling group 可以附加到 Application Load Balancers、Network Load Balancers 和 Gateway Load Balancers 的 target groups，并且 Auto Scaling group 中的实例会自动注册到负载均衡器 target group。Gateway Load Balancer target groups 支持 `instance` 目标类型，其中目标由实例 ID 指定。这提供了所需的水平扩展以及设备实例的自动化替换。请参阅 [Run commands when you launch an EC2 instance with user data input](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)、[Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html) 和 [Target groups for your Gateway Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/target-groups.html)。

**F. 在集中式网络账户中创建 VPC endpoints。更新每个成员账户中的路由表，使其指向 VPC endpoints。**  
在使用 Transit Gateway 的集中式检查设计中，Gateway Load Balancer、Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 和虚拟设备被放置在集中式安全或网络 VPC 中。AWS 针对集中式网络安全描述了这种模式：Gateway Load Balancer 与虚拟设备一起部署在一个单独的安全 VPC 中，Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 是可路由目标，进出 Transit Gateway 的流量可以路由到设备队列。同一文档还说明，每个 spoke VPC 都有一个与 Transit Gateway 关联的路由表，默认路由的下一跳是安全 VPC attachment，并且集中式安全 VPC 包含 Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 和虚拟设备。这使检查 endpoints 保持集中化，而不是在所有成员账户中重复创建 endpoints；对于已经使用 Transit Gateway 的组织来说，这更具成本效益。请参阅 [Using Gateway Load Balancer with Transit Gateway for centralized network security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/using-gwlb-with-tg-for-cns.html)。

其他选项不是最佳选择：

**B. 在集中式网络账户中部署 Network Load Balancer。设置一个使用 AWS PrivateLink 的 endpoint service。**  
Network Load Balancer 可与 PrivateLink 一起用于公开服务，但它不是专为第三方防火墙设备进行透明内联检查而构建的服务。Gateway Load Balancer 专门设计用于将流量分发到防火墙等虚拟设备，并在端口 6081 上使用 GENEVE 封装来传输设备流量。因此，正确的负载均衡器类型是 Gateway Load Balancer，而不是 Network Load Balancer。

**D. 创建一个 Auto Scaling group。配置一个 AWS Launch Wizard 部署，使用新脚本作为 user data 来配置防火墙设备。创建一个使用 IP 目标类型的 target group。**  
所需的扩展机制是使用 launch template 和 user data 的 Auto Scaling group，以便在每个 EC2 防火墙设备启动时进行配置。此设备队列不需要 Launch Wizard，并且它会增加不必要的复杂性。此外，对于由 Auto Scaling group 启动和管理的 EC2 实例，使用 `instance` target group 是直接的集成方式，因为目标按实例 ID 注册。对于这种由 ASG 管理的 EC2 设备部署，IP 目标类型不是最合适的选择。

**E. 在每个成员账户中创建 VPC endpoints。更新路由表，使其指向 VPC endpoints。**  
在每个成员账户中创建 Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 是一种分布式 endpoint 模型。它可以支持检查，但在此场景中成本效益较低，因为该公司已经有一个通过 Transit Gateway 连接到成员 VPC 的集中式网络账户。集中式 Transit Gateway 检查模式将 Gateway Load Balancer endpoints 放在集中式安全 VPC 中并与设备放在一起，然后通过该集中式检查路径路由成员 VPC 流量，从而避免在各成员账户中不必要地重复创建 endpoints。

en.question: A solutions architect must implement a multi-Region architecture for an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database that supports a web application. The database launches from an AWS CloudFormation template that includes AWS services and features that are present in both the primary and secondary Regions. The database is configured for automated backups, and it has an RTO of 15 minutes and an RPO of 2 hours. The web application is configured to use an Amazon Route 53 record to route traffic to the database. Which combination of steps will result in a highly available architecture that meets all the requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a cross-Region read replica of the database in the secondary Region. Configure an AWS Lambda function in the secondary Region to promote the read replica during a failover event.
options.B: In the primary Region, create a health check on the database that will invoke an AWS Lambda function when a failure is detected. Program the Lambda function to recreate the database from the latest database snapshot in the secondary Region and update the Route 53 host records for the database.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy the latest automated backup to the secondary Region every 2 hours.
options.D: Create a failover routing policy in Route 53 for the database DNS record. Set the primary and secondary endpoints to the endpoints in each Region.
options.E: Create a hot standby database in the secondary Region. Use an AWS Lambda function to restore the secondary database to the latest RDS automatic backup in the event that the primary database fails.

en.explanation:
The requirement is a multi-Region disaster-recovery design for an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database, with a relatively short RTO of 15 minutes and an RPO of 2 hours. The solution therefore needs both (1) a continuously maintained database copy in the secondary Region and (2) a way for the application’s database DNS name to move to the secondary Region during failover.

**Correct answers: A and D.**

- **A. Create a cross-Region read replica and promote it during failover — Correct.** Amazon RDS read replicas are asynchronously updated from the primary DB instance, and AWS explicitly lists disaster recovery as a use case: you can promote a read replica to a standalone instance if the primary DB instance fails. RDS also supports read replicas in a different AWS Region, where RDS sets up the secure replication channel between the primary and replica Regions. For PostgreSQL specifically, a read replica is read-only until promoted; after promotion, it becomes a writable standalone RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. This is the best fit for the RPO and RTO because the secondary database is already running and continuously receiving changes, so failover mainly requires promotion and application endpoint redirection. See [Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html) and [Working with read replicas for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.html).

- **D. Create a Route 53 failover routing policy with primary and secondary endpoints — Correct.** Route 53 supports active-passive failover by using the failover routing policy. With one primary and one secondary resource, Route 53 answers DNS queries with the primary record when it is healthy and with the secondary record when the primary is unhealthy. This matches the requirement that the web application uses a Route 53 record to route traffic to the database, and it provides the DNS-level redirection needed after the read replica is promoted. See [Active-active and active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html) and [Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect.** Recreating the database from the latest snapshot in the secondary Region is a restore-based DR approach. Even if it could meet an RPO of 2 hours depending on snapshot timing, it is unlikely to meet a 15-minute RTO because a new RDS instance must be restored and become available before DNS can be updated. It also does not provide a continuously running secondary database.

- **C is incorrect.** Copying the latest automated backup every 2 hours addresses only backup availability/RPO. It does not create a ready-to-use secondary DB instance and does not include promotion or DNS failover. Restoring from backups would add recovery time and is not appropriate for a 15-minute RTO.

- **E is incorrect.** A “hot standby” that is restored from the latest automatic backup during failure is internally inconsistent and incomplete for this requirement. Restoring a database from backup during the failover event is slower than promoting a pre-existing replica and does not describe continuous cross-Region replication or DNS failover. It is therefore less likely to meet the 15-minute RTO.

Therefore, the highly available multi-Region architecture is to use a **cross-Region RDS for PostgreSQL read replica promoted during failover** plus **Route 53 failover records** for application connectivity: **A and D**.

zh.question: 解决方案架构师必须为支持 Web 应用程序的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实施多区域架构。该数据库通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板启动，该模板包含在主区域和辅助区域中都存在的 AWS 服务和功能。数据库已配置自动备份，并且其 RTO 为 15 分钟，RPO 为 2 小时。Web 应用程序配置为使用 Amazon Route 53 记录将流量路由到数据库。哪组步骤组合将形成满足所有要求的高可用架构？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在辅助区域中创建该数据库的跨区域只读副本。配置辅助区域中的 AWS Lambda 函数，以便在故障转移事件期间提升该只读副本。
options.B: 在主区域中，对数据库创建运行状况检查，在检测到故障时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其从辅助区域中的最新数据库快照重新创建数据库，并更新该数据库的 Route 53 主机记录。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 2 小时将最新的自动备份复制到辅助区域。
options.D: 在 Route 53 中为数据库 DNS 记录创建故障转移路由策略。将主端点和辅助端点设置为各区域中的端点。
options.E: 在辅助区域中创建一个热备用数据库。使用 AWS Lambda 函数在主数据库发生故障时将辅助数据库还原到最新的 RDS 自动备份。

zh.explanation:
要求是为 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库设计多区域灾难恢复方案，并且 RTO 相对较短，为 15 分钟，RPO 为 2 小时。因此，该解决方案需要同时具备：(1) 在辅助区域持续维护的数据库副本；以及 (2) 在故障转移期间让应用程序的数据库 DNS 名称切换到辅助区域的方法。

**正确答案：A 和 D。**

- **A. 创建跨区域只读副本并在故障转移期间提升它 — 正确。** Amazon RDS 只读副本会从主数据库实例异步更新，AWS 明确将灾难恢复列为一个使用场景：如果主数据库实例发生故障，可以将只读副本提升为独立实例。RDS 还支持位于不同 AWS 区域的只读副本，在这种情况下，RDS 会在主区域和副本区域之间建立安全复制通道。具体到 PostgreSQL，只读副本在提升之前是只读的；提升之后，它会成为可写的独立 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例。这最符合 RPO 和 RTO 要求，因为辅助数据库已经在运行并持续接收更改，所以故障转移主要需要提升和应用程序端点重定向。请参阅 [Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html) 和 [Working with read replicas for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.html)。

- **D. 使用主端点和辅助端点创建 Route 53 故障转移路由策略 — 正确。** Route 53 支持使用故障转移路由策略实现主动-被动故障转移。对于一个主资源和一个辅助资源，当主记录运行状况良好时，Route 53 会使用主记录响应 DNS 查询；当主记录运行状况不佳时，会使用辅助记录响应。这符合 Web 应用程序使用 Route 53 记录将流量路由到数据库的要求，并提供了在提升只读副本后所需的 DNS 级别重定向。请参阅 [Active-active and active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html) 和 [Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B 不正确。** 从辅助区域中的最新快照重新创建数据库是一种基于还原的灾难恢复方法。即使根据快照时间点它可能满足 2 小时的 RPO，也不太可能满足 15 分钟的 RTO，因为必须先还原新的 RDS 实例并使其可用，然后才能更新 DNS。它也没有提供持续运行的辅助数据库。

- **C 不正确。** 每 2 小时复制最新的自动备份只解决备份可用性/RPO 问题。它不会创建可立即使用的辅助数据库实例，也不包含提升或 DNS 故障转移。从备份还原会增加恢复时间，不适合 15 分钟的 RTO。

- **E 不正确。** 在故障期间从最新自动备份还原的“热备用”数据库对于此要求而言存在内部矛盾且不完整。在故障转移事件期间从备份还原数据库比提升预先存在的副本更慢，并且没有描述持续的跨区域复制或 DNS 故障转移。因此，它不太可能满足 15 分钟的 RTO。

因此，该高可用多区域架构应使用**在故障转移期间提升的跨区域 RDS for PostgreSQL 只读副本**，并结合用于应用程序连接的 **Route 53 故障转移记录**：**A 和 D**。

en.question: An ecommerce company runs an application on AWS. The application has an Amazon API Gateway API that invokes an AWS Lambda function. The data is stored in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. During the company’s most recent flash sale, a sudden increase in API calls negatively affected the application's performance. A solutions architect reviewed the Amazon CloudWatch metrics during that time and noticed a significant increase in Lambda invocations and database connections. The CPU utilization also was high on the DB instance. What should the solutions architect recommend to optimize the application's performance?

options.A: Increase the memory of the Lambda function. Modify the Lambda function to close the database connections when the data is retrieved.
options.B: Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to store the frequently accessed data from the RDS database.
options.C: Create an RDS proxy by using the Lambda console. Modify the Lambda function to use the proxy endpoint.
options.D: Modify the Lambda function to connect to the database outside of the function's handler. Check for an existing database connection before creating a new connection.

en.explanation:
The application is a typical API Gateway → Lambda → Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL architecture. During a flash sale, API traffic caused many more concurrent Lambda invocations, and CloudWatch showed a corresponding spike in database connections plus high DB CPU. The question asks for the best performance optimization for Lambda functions that create many short-lived database connections to RDS.

**Correct answer: C. Create an RDS proxy by using the Lambda console. Modify the Lambda function to use the proxy endpoint.**

Amazon RDS Proxy is designed for this exact Lambda-to-RDS scaling problem. AWS documentation states that Lambda functions often make frequent, short database connections that benefit from the connection pooling offered by RDS Proxy, and that connecting through RDS Proxy can improve database performance and resiliency ([AWS RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)). RDS Proxy terminates client connections at the proxy and manages database connections within the proxy, reducing the pressure of connection storms on the database ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)).

The wording about creating the proxy from the Lambda console is also valid. The RDS documentation notes that from the Lambda console, you can open the function, go to **Configuration → RDS databases → Connect to RDS database**, and after connecting the function to a database, create a proxy by choosing **Add proxy** ([AWS RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)). The Lambda function should then use the proxy endpoint instead of connecting directly to the RDS DB instance.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Increase Lambda memory and close DB connections after retrieving data** — Increasing Lambda memory can improve Lambda CPU allocation, but the bottleneck observed is the RDS database: high DB CPU and a large increase in database connections. Closing connections after every request can actually increase connection churn and does not provide pooling. This does not address the core issue of many concurrent Lambda environments opening many database connections.

* **B. Add ElastiCache for Redis for frequently accessed data** — Caching can be useful if the workload repeatedly reads the same data and if the application is changed to read from the cache. However, the question specifically highlights a spike in Lambda invocations and database connections. ElastiCache does not directly solve the database connection scaling problem. There is no information that the workload is predominantly cacheable or that frequently accessed data is the main bottleneck.

* **D. Connect outside the Lambda handler and reuse an existing connection** — This is a valid Lambda best practice: AWS recommends initializing SDK clients and database connections outside the handler so that subsequent invocations in the same execution environment can reuse them ([Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)). However, Lambda scales by creating multiple concurrent execution environments. Each environment can still maintain its own database connection, so under a flash sale this can still result in a large number of concurrent DB connections. RDS Proxy is the more complete and purpose-built solution because it provides managed connection pooling between Lambda and RDS.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司在 AWS 上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序有一个 Amazon API Gateway API，会调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。数据存储在一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库实例中。在该公司最近一次限时抢购期间，API 调用量突然增加，对应用程序性能产生了负面影响。解决方案架构师查看了当时的 Amazon CloudWatch 指标，注意到 Lambda 调用次数和数据库连接数显著增加。数据库实例上的 CPU 利用率也很高。解决方案架构师应建议什么来优化应用程序性能？

options.A: 增加 Lambda 函数的内存。修改 Lambda 函数，在检索到数据后关闭数据库连接。
options.B: 添加一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群，用于存储来自 RDS 数据库的频繁访问数据。
options.C: 使用 Lambda 控制台创建一个 RDS proxy。修改 Lambda 函数以使用该 proxy endpoint。
options.D: 修改 Lambda 函数，使其在函数 handler 之外连接数据库。在创建新连接之前检查是否已有数据库连接。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序是典型的 API Gateway → Lambda → Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 架构。在限时抢购期间，API 流量导致更多并发 Lambda 调用，CloudWatch 显示数据库连接数也随之激增，并且数据库 CPU 很高。该问题询问的是，对于会创建大量短生命周期数据库连接到 RDS 的 Lambda 函数，最佳的性能优化方案是什么。

**正确答案：C. 使用 Lambda 控制台创建一个 RDS proxy。修改 Lambda 函数以使用该 proxy endpoint。**

Amazon RDS Proxy 正是为这种 Lambda 到 RDS 的扩展问题而设计的。AWS 文档说明，Lambda 函数通常会建立频繁且短暂的数据库连接，这类连接可以从 RDS Proxy 提供的 connection pooling 中受益；通过 RDS Proxy 连接可以提高数据库性能和弹性（[AWS RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)）。RDS Proxy 会在 proxy 处终止客户端连接，并在 proxy 内管理数据库连接，从而减少连接风暴对数据库造成的压力（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。

关于从 Lambda 控制台创建 proxy 的表述也是有效的。RDS 文档指出，可以在 Lambda 控制台中打开函数，进入 **Configuration → RDS databases → Connect to RDS database**，在将函数连接到数据库后，通过选择 **Add proxy** 来创建 proxy（[AWS RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)）。随后 Lambda 函数应使用 proxy endpoint，而不是直接连接到 RDS DB instance。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

* **A. 增加 Lambda 内存并在检索数据后关闭 DB 连接** — 增加 Lambda 内存可以提升 Lambda CPU 分配，但观察到的瓶颈在 RDS 数据库：DB CPU 很高，且数据库连接数大量增加。每次请求后关闭连接实际上可能会增加连接抖动，并且不提供 pooling。这没有解决许多并发 Lambda 执行环境打开大量数据库连接的核心问题。

* **B. 为频繁访问的数据添加 ElastiCache for Redis** — 如果工作负载重复读取相同数据，并且应用程序被修改为从缓存读取，那么缓存可能有用。但是，题目特别强调的是 Lambda 调用和数据库连接激增。ElastiCache 并不能直接解决数据库连接扩展问题。也没有信息表明该工作负载主要是可缓存的，或频繁访问的数据是主要瓶颈。

* **D. 在 Lambda handler 之外连接并复用现有连接** — 这是有效的 Lambda 最佳实践：AWS 建议在 handler 之外初始化 SDK client 和数据库连接，以便同一执行环境中的后续调用可以复用它们（[Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)）。但是，Lambda 通过创建多个并发执行环境来扩展。每个环境仍然可以维护自己的数据库连接，因此在限时抢购期间，这仍可能导致大量并发 DB 连接。RDS Proxy 是更完整且专门构建的解决方案，因为它在 Lambda 和 RDS 之间提供托管式 connection pooling。

en.question: A retail company wants to improve its application architecture. The company's applications register new orders, handle returns of merchandise, and provide analytics. The applications store retail data in a MySQL database and an Oracle OLAP analytics database. All the applications and databases are hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. Each application consists of several components that handle different parts of the order process. These components use incoming data from different sources. A separate ETL job runs every week and copies data from each application to the analytics database. A solutions architect must redesign the architecture into an event-driven solution that uses serverless services. The solution must provide updated analytics in near real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the individual applications as microservices to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) containers that use AWS Fargate. Keep the retail MySQL database on Amazon EC2. Move the analytics database to Amazon Neptune. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to send all the incoming data to the microservices and the analytics database.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group for each application. Specify the necessary number of EC2 instances in each Auto Scaling group. Migrate the retail MySQL database and the analytics database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send all the incoming data to the correct EC2 instances and the analytics database.
options.C: Migrate the individual applications as microservices to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) containers that use AWS Fargate. Migrate the retail MySQL database to Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL. Migrate the analytics database to Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon EventBridge to send all the incoming data to the microservices and the analytics database.
options.D: Migrate the individual applications as microservices to Amazon AppStream 2.0. Migrate the retail MySQL database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Migrate the analytics database to Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use AWS IoT Core to send all the incoming data to the microservices and the analytics database.

en.explanation:
The company wants to move from EC2-hosted applications and databases plus a weekly ETL batch into an **event-driven, serverless architecture** that can update analytics **near real time**. The selected option must therefore modernize compute, the transactional MySQL database, the analytics database, and the event routing layer.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Migrate the individual applications as microservices to Amazon EKS containers that use AWS Fargate. Migrate the retail MySQL database to Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL. Migrate the analytics database to Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon EventBridge to send all the incoming data to the microservices and the analytics database.**

This option best matches all requirements:

* **Serverless container compute:** Amazon EKS can run Kubernetes Pods on AWS Fargate. AWS documentation states that with Fargate, you do not need to provision, configure, or scale groups of virtual machines to run containers, and EKS schedules Pods onto Fargate infrastructure ([Amazon EKS on AWS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)).
* **Serverless MySQL-compatible transactional database:** Aurora Serverless is appropriate for variable application workloads and automatically scales database capacity. The Aurora documentation describes Aurora Serverless as useful for e-commerce-style spikes and says it scales capacity to meet peak load without needing to provision for peak capacity ([Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)).
* **Serverless analytics warehouse:** Amazon Redshift Serverless lets users access and analyze data without configuring a provisioned data warehouse, automatically provisions resources, and intelligently scales data warehouse capacity ([Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). This is the appropriate modernization target for an Oracle OLAP analytics database.
* **Event-driven routing:** EventBridge event buses receive events and deliver them to targets. Rules route incoming events to the appropriate targets based on event patterns ([EventBridge event buses, rules, and targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-what-is-how-it-works-concepts.html)). This supports decoupling the order-processing microservices and delivering order/return events to analytics processing in near real time instead of waiting for a weekly ETL job.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. ECS Fargate + MySQL on EC2 + Neptune + SQS

This option is not the best fit. Although ECS on Fargate can be serverless container compute, the **retail MySQL database remains on EC2**, so the overall solution is not fully serverless. Also, **Amazon Neptune is a graph database**, not a replacement for an Oracle OLAP analytics database or a general-purpose analytics data warehouse; AWS describes Neptune as a managed graph database for use cases such as fraud detection, knowledge graphs, and recommendation engines ([Amazon Neptune](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)). SQS is useful for queuing, but this option does not provide the full event-routing and serverless analytics modernization required.

### B. Auto Scaling groups + Aurora MySQL + SNS

This option still runs the applications on **EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups**, so it does not satisfy the requirement to use serverless services for the application architecture. It also migrates both the transactional and analytics databases to Aurora MySQL, which is not an OLAP analytics warehouse replacement like Redshift Serverless. SNS can support pub/sub messaging, but this design keeps EC2-based application hosting and does not provide the requested serverless analytics architecture.

### D. AppStream 2.0 + Aurora MySQL + Redshift Serverless + IoT Core

AppStream 2.0 is not a microservices runtime. AWS documentation describes it as a managed streaming service for delivering desktop applications through browsers ([Amazon AppStream 2.0 / WorkSpaces Applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-appstream.html)). AWS IoT Core is intended for IoT device connectivity and messaging, not as the general event bus for retail order-processing microservices. This option uses inappropriate services for the application modernization requirement.

Therefore, **C** is the only option that combines serverless containers, a serverless MySQL-compatible operational database, serverless analytics, and event-driven routing for near-real-time updates.

zh.question: 一家零售公司希望改进其应用程序架构。该公司的应用程序会登记新订单、处理商品退货并提供分析功能。这些应用程序将零售数据存储在一个 MySQL 数据库和一个 Oracle OLAP 分析数据库中。所有应用程序和数据库都托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。每个应用程序由多个组件组成，这些组件处理订单流程的不同部分。这些组件使用来自不同来源的传入数据。一个单独的 ETL 作业每周运行一次，并将数据从每个应用程序复制到分析数据库。解决方案架构师必须将该架构重新设计为使用无服务器服务的事件驱动型解决方案。该解决方案必须提供近实时更新的分析。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将各个应用程序作为微服务迁移到使用 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 容器。将零售 MySQL 数据库保留在 Amazon EC2 上。将分析数据库迁移到 Amazon Neptune。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 将所有传入数据发送到微服务和分析数据库。
options.B: 为每个应用程序创建一个 Auto Scaling 组。在每个 Auto Scaling 组中指定所需数量的 EC2 实例。将零售 MySQL 数据库和分析数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 将所有传入数据发送到正确的 EC2 实例和分析数据库。
options.C: 将各个应用程序作为微服务迁移到使用 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 容器。将零售 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL。将分析数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift Serverless。使用 Amazon EventBridge 将所有传入数据发送到微服务和分析数据库。
options.D: 将各个应用程序作为微服务迁移到 Amazon AppStream 2.0。将零售 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL。将分析数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift Serverless。使用 AWS IoT Core 将所有传入数据发送到微服务和分析数据库。

zh.explanation:
该公司希望从托管在 EC2 上的应用程序和数据库以及每周 ETL 批处理，迁移到一种**事件驱动的无服务器架构**，能够**近实时**更新分析。因此，所选选项必须对计算、事务性 MySQL 数据库、分析数据库和事件路由层进行现代化改造。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 将各个应用程序作为微服务迁移到使用 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon EKS 容器。将零售 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL。将分析数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift Serverless。使用 Amazon EventBridge 将所有传入数据发送到微服务和分析数据库。**

此选项最符合所有要求：

* **无服务器容器计算：** Amazon EKS 可以在 AWS Fargate 上运行 Kubernetes Pods。AWS 文档说明，使用 Fargate 时，您无需预置、配置或扩展虚拟机组来运行容器，并且 EKS 会将 Pods 调度到 Fargate 基础设施上（[Amazon EKS on AWS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)）。
* **兼容 MySQL 的无服务器事务性数据库：** Aurora Serverless 适用于可变的应用程序工作负载，并会自动扩展数据库容量。Aurora 文档将 Aurora Serverless 描述为适用于电子商务式流量峰值，并表示它会扩展容量以满足峰值负载，而无需为峰值容量进行预置（[Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。
* **无服务器分析数据仓库：** Amazon Redshift Serverless 允许用户在无需配置预置数据仓库的情况下访问和分析数据，会自动预置资源，并智能扩展数据仓库容量（[Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。这是 Oracle OLAP 分析数据库的合适现代化目标。
* **事件驱动路由：** EventBridge 事件总线接收事件并将其交付给目标。规则会根据事件模式将传入事件路由到相应目标（[EventBridge event buses, rules, and targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-what-is-how-it-works-concepts.html)）。这支持解耦订单处理微服务，并将订单/退货事件近实时交付给分析处理，而不是等待每周 ETL 作业。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. ECS Fargate + MySQL on EC2 + Neptune + SQS

此选项不是最佳选择。虽然 ECS on Fargate 可以作为无服务器容器计算，但**零售 MySQL 数据库仍保留在 EC2 上**，因此整体解决方案并非完全无服务器。此外，**Amazon Neptune 是图数据库**，不能替代 Oracle OLAP 分析数据库或通用分析数据仓库；AWS 将 Neptune 描述为一种托管图数据库，适用于欺诈检测、知识图谱和推荐引擎等用例（[Amazon Neptune](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。SQS 对排队很有用，但此选项没有提供所需的完整事件路由和无服务器分析现代化能力。

### B. Auto Scaling groups + Aurora MySQL + SNS

此选项仍在 **Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例**上运行应用程序，因此不满足应用程序架构使用无服务器服务的要求。它还将事务性数据库和分析数据库都迁移到 Aurora MySQL，而 Aurora MySQL 并不是像 Redshift Serverless 那样的 OLAP 分析数据仓库替代方案。SNS 可以支持发布/订阅消息传递，但此设计保留了基于 EC2 的应用程序托管，并没有提供所请求的无服务器分析架构。

### D. AppStream 2.0 + Aurora MySQL + Redshift Serverless + IoT Core

AppStream 2.0 不是微服务运行时。AWS 文档将其描述为一种托管流式传输服务，用于通过浏览器交付桌面应用程序（[Amazon AppStream 2.0 / WorkSpaces Applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appstream2/latest/developerguide/what-is-appstream.html)）。AWS IoT Core 旨在用于 IoT 设备连接和消息传递，而不是作为零售订单处理微服务的通用事件总线。此选项为应用程序现代化需求使用了不合适的服务。

因此，**C** 是唯一结合了无服务器容器、兼容 MySQL 的无服务器运营数据库、无服务器分析和事件驱动路由以实现近实时更新的选项。

en.question: A company is planning a migration from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The company plans to use multiple AWS accounts that are managed in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company will create a small number of accounts initially and will add accounts as needed. A solutions architect must design a solution that turns on AWS CloudTrail in all AWS accounts. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that creates a new CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Invoke the Lambda function daily by using a scheduled action in Amazon EventBridge.
options.B: Create a new CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Configure the trail to log all events for all AWS accounts in the organization.
options.C: Create a new CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Create new trails whenever a new account is created. Define an SCP that prevents deletion or modification of trails. Apply the SCP to the root OU.
options.D: Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook that creates a CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Invoke the automation by using Systems Manager State Manager.

en.explanation:
The company will use AWS Organizations and will add accounts over time. The most operationally efficient design is to use a CloudTrail **organization trail**, rather than deploying and maintaining separate trails or custom automation in every account.

**Correct answer: B. Create a new CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Configure the trail to log all events for all AWS accounts in the organization.**

AWS CloudTrail supports creating a trail that logs events for **all AWS accounts in an AWS Organizations organization**. The documentation calls this an **organization trail** and states that the management account can create or apply a trail to the organization so that it logs events for the management account and all member accounts. It also states that when a new AWS account is added to the organization, the organization trail and service-linked role are added automatically and logging starts automatically for that account. This directly satisfies the requirement to turn on CloudTrail across current and future accounts with the least ongoing operational effort. See [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Lambda function invoked daily by EventBridge** — This is unnecessary custom automation. It would introduce operational overhead, delay coverage until the next scheduled run, and require maintaining code and permissions. CloudTrail organization trails already handle current and newly added member accounts automatically.

- **C. Create a new trail in all accounts and use an SCP to prevent changes** — This is more complex than necessary. It requires per-account trail creation and lifecycle management whenever accounts are added. An SCP may help protect resources, but the native organization trail already prevents member accounts from modifying or deleting the organization trail; the documentation states member account users can see organization trails but cannot delete them, turn logging on or off, or otherwise change them.

- **D. Systems Manager Automation and State Manager** — This is also custom orchestration to reproduce functionality that CloudTrail already provides natively. It would require maintaining runbooks, associations, cross-account permissions, and account onboarding logic, making it less operationally efficient than an organization trail.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司正在计划从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司计划使用多个 AWS 账户，这些账户在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中进行管理。公司最初会创建少量账户，并会根据需要添加账户。解决方案架构师必须设计一个在所有 AWS 账户中启用 AWS CloudTrail 的解决方案。满足这些要求的最具运营效率的解决方案是什么？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中创建新的 CloudTrail 跟踪。使用 Amazon EventBridge 中的计划操作每天调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在组织的管理账户中创建一个新的 CloudTrail 跟踪。将该跟踪配置为记录组织中所有 AWS 账户的所有事件。
options.C: 在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中创建新的 CloudTrail 跟踪。每当创建新账户时创建新的跟踪。定义一个 SCP，防止删除或修改跟踪。将该 SCP 应用于根 OU。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册，在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中创建 CloudTrail 跟踪。使用 Systems Manager State Manager 调用该自动化。

zh.explanation:
该公司将使用 AWS Organizations，并会随着时间推移添加账户。最具运营效率的设计是使用 CloudTrail **组织跟踪**，而不是在每个账户中部署和维护单独的跟踪或自定义自动化。

**正确答案：B. 在组织的管理账户中创建一个新的 CloudTrail 跟踪。将该跟踪配置为记录组织中所有 AWS 账户的所有事件。**

AWS CloudTrail 支持创建一个跟踪，用于记录 **AWS Organizations 组织中所有 AWS 账户** 的事件。文档将其称为 **组织跟踪**，并说明管理账户可以为组织创建或应用一个跟踪，使其记录管理账户和所有成员账户的事件。文档还说明，当新的 AWS 账户添加到组织时，组织跟踪和服务相关角色会自动添加，并且该账户的日志记录会自动开始。这直接满足了以最少的持续运营工作量在当前和未来账户中启用 CloudTrail 的要求。请参阅 [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Lambda function invoked daily by EventBridge** — 这是不必要的自定义自动化。它会引入运营开销，导致覆盖范围延迟到下一次计划运行，并且需要维护代码和权限。CloudTrail 组织跟踪已经可以自动处理当前和新添加的成员账户。

- **C. Create a new trail in all accounts and use an SCP to prevent changes** — 这比必要的方案更复杂。它需要在每个账户中创建跟踪，并在添加账户时进行生命周期管理。SCP 可能有助于保护资源，但原生组织跟踪已经可以防止成员账户修改或删除组织跟踪；文档说明成员账户用户可以看到组织跟踪，但不能删除它们、打开或关闭日志记录，也不能以其他方式更改它们。

- **D. Systems Manager Automation and State Manager** — 这同样是自定义编排，用来复制 CloudTrail 已经原生提供的功能。它需要维护运行手册、关联、跨账户权限和账户加入逻辑，因此其运营效率低于组织跟踪。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A software development company has multiple engineers who are working remotely. The company is running Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) on an Amazon EC2 instance. The company's security policy states that all internal, nonpublic services that are deployed in a VPC must be accessible through a VPN. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be used for access to a VPN. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Configure integration between a VPN and AD DS. Use an Amazon WorkSpaces client with MFA support enabled to establish a VPN connection.
options.B: Create an AWS Client VPN endpoint. Create an AD Connector directory for integration with AD DS. Enable MFA for AD Connector. Use AWS Client VPN to establish a VPN connection.
options.C: Create multiple AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections by using AWS VPN CloudHub. Configure integration between AWS VPN CloudHub and AD DS. Use AWS Copilot to establish a VPN connection.
options.D: Create an Amazon WorkLink endpoint. Configure integration between Amazon WorkLink and AD DS. Enable MFA in Amazon WorkLink. Use AWS Client VPN to establish a VPN connection.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs **remote engineers** to access **internal, nonpublic services in a VPC** through a VPN, and the VPN access must use **MFA**. The existing identity source is **Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) running on an EC2 instance**.

The correct solution is to use **AWS Client VPN** for user-based remote access, integrate it with Active Directory via AWS Directory Service, and enable MFA on that directory integration.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Create an AWS Client VPN endpoint. Create an AD Connector directory for integration with AD DS. Enable MFA for AD Connector. Use AWS Client VPN to establish a VPN connection.**

This matches the requirements exactly:

* AWS Client VPN is a **managed client-based VPN service** that allows users to securely access AWS resources and on-premises resources from any location by using an OpenVPN-based VPN client. The documentation states that Client VPN enables secure access to AWS resources from any location and supports Active Directory integration as an authentication method ([AWS Client VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)).
* Client VPN supports **Active Directory authentication** by integrating with AWS Directory Service. The documentation specifically says Client VPN can connect to existing Active Directories **provisioned in AWS or on-premises**, which covers AD DS running on an EC2 instance in AWS ([Active Directory authentication in Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/ad.html)).
* Client VPN supports **MFA** when MFA is enabled for **AWS Managed Microsoft AD or AD Connector**. If MFA is enabled, users must provide a username, password, and MFA code when connecting to the Client VPN endpoint ([Active Directory authentication in Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/ad.html)).

Therefore, creating a Client VPN endpoint, using AD Connector to integrate with the existing AD DS, and enabling MFA for AD Connector satisfies both the VPN and MFA requirements.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Site-to-Site VPN with WorkSpaces client

AWS Site-to-Site VPN is intended to connect networks, such as an on-premises network to a VPC, not to provide individual remote engineers with client-based VPN access. AWS documentation describes Site-to-Site VPN as an IPsec VPN connection between a VPC and on-premises networks ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). Also, an Amazon WorkSpaces client is for accessing WorkSpaces desktops, not for establishing an AWS VPN connection for arbitrary VPC services.

### C. AWS VPN CloudHub with AWS Copilot

AWS VPN CloudHub is used with multiple Site-to-Site VPN connections, typically for connecting multiple networks or branch locations. It is not the right pattern for individual remote engineers needing client VPN access. AWS Copilot is a tool for building, releasing, and operating containerized applications; it is not a VPN client and cannot establish VPN connectivity for users.

### D. Amazon WorkLink endpoint with Client VPN

Amazon WorkLink was for secure access to internal websites and web apps from mobile devices, not for general VPN access to internal VPC services. The requirement is specifically for VPN-based access with MFA. The appropriate AWS service for remote-user VPN access is AWS Client VPN, not WorkLink.

## Conclusion

The best answer is **B** because AWS Client VPN provides remote-user VPN access, supports Active Directory authentication through AWS Directory Service/AD Connector, and supports MFA when MFA is enabled for AD Connector.

zh.question: 一家软件开发公司有多名工程师在远程工作。该公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行 Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)。公司的安全策略规定，部署在 VPC 中的所有内部非公开服务都必须通过 VPN 访问。访问 VPN 必须使用多重身份验证 (MFA)。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。配置 VPN 与 AD DS 之间的集成。使用启用了 MFA 支持的 Amazon WorkSpaces 客户端来建立 VPN 连接。
options.B: 创建 AWS Client VPN 终端节点。创建 AD Connector 目录以与 AD DS 集成。为 AD Connector 启用 MFA。使用 AWS Client VPN 建立 VPN 连接。
options.C: 使用 AWS VPN CloudHub 创建多个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。配置 AWS VPN CloudHub 与 AD DS 之间的集成。使用 AWS Copilot 建立 VPN 连接。
options.D: 创建 Amazon WorkLink 终端节点。配置 Amazon WorkLink 与 AD DS 之间的集成。在 Amazon WorkLink 中启用 MFA。使用 AWS Client VPN 建立 VPN 连接。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要让**远程工程师**通过 VPN 访问 **VPC 中的内部非公开服务**，并且 VPN 访问必须使用 **MFA**。现有身份源是**运行在 EC2 实例上的 Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)**。

正确的解决方案是使用 **AWS Client VPN** 进行基于用户的远程访问，通过 AWS Directory Service 将其与 Active Directory 集成，并在该目录集成上启用 MFA。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 创建 AWS Client VPN 终端节点。创建 AD Connector 目录以与 AD DS 集成。为 AD Connector 启用 MFA。使用 AWS Client VPN 建立 VPN 连接。**

这完全符合要求：

* AWS Client VPN 是一项**托管的基于客户端的 VPN 服务**，允许用户使用基于 OpenVPN 的 VPN 客户端，从任意位置安全地访问 AWS 资源和本地资源。文档说明 Client VPN 支持从任意位置安全访问 AWS 资源，并支持将 Active Directory 集成作为一种身份验证方法（[AWS Client VPN 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)）。
* Client VPN 通过与 AWS Directory Service 集成来支持 **Active Directory 身份验证**。文档明确说明 Client VPN 可以连接到**在 AWS 中预置或在本地预置**的现有 Active Directory，这涵盖了运行在 AWS 中 EC2 实例上的 AD DS（[Client VPN 中的 Active Directory 身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/ad.html)）。
* 当为 **AWS Managed Microsoft AD 或 AD Connector** 启用 MFA 时，Client VPN 支持 **MFA**。如果启用了 MFA，用户在连接到 Client VPN 终端节点时必须提供用户名、密码和 MFA 代码（[Client VPN 中的 Active Directory 身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/ad.html)）。

因此，创建 Client VPN 终端节点，使用 AD Connector 与现有 AD DS 集成，并为 AD Connector 启用 MFA，可以同时满足 VPN 和 MFA 要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. Site-to-Site VPN with WorkSpaces client

AWS Site-to-Site VPN 旨在连接网络，例如将本地网络连接到 VPC，而不是为单个远程工程师提供基于客户端的 VPN 访问。AWS 文档将 Site-to-Site VPN 描述为 VPC 与本地网络之间的 IPsec VPN 连接（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。此外，Amazon WorkSpaces 客户端用于访问 WorkSpaces 桌面，而不是为任意 VPC 服务建立 AWS VPN 连接。

### C. AWS VPN CloudHub with AWS Copilot

AWS VPN CloudHub 与多个 Site-to-Site VPN 连接一起使用，通常用于连接多个网络或分支机构。它不适合需要客户端 VPN 访问的单个远程工程师。AWS Copilot 是用于构建、发布和运营容器化应用程序的工具；它不是 VPN 客户端，无法为用户建立 VPN 连接。

### D. Amazon WorkLink endpoint with Client VPN

Amazon WorkLink 曾用于从移动设备安全访问内部网站和 Web 应用，而不是用于对内部 VPC 服务进行通用 VPN 访问。要求明确是使用 MFA 的基于 VPN 的访问。适用于远程用户 VPN 访问的 AWS 服务是 AWS Client VPN，而不是 WorkLink。

## 结论

最佳答案是 **B**，因为 AWS Client VPN 提供远程用户 VPN 访问，支持通过 AWS Directory Service/AD Connector 进行 Active Directory 身份验证，并且在为 AD Connector 启用 MFA 时支持 MFA。

en.question: A company is running a three-tier web application in an on-premises data center. The frontend is served by an Apache web server, the middle tier is a monolithic Java application, and the storage tier is a PostgreSQL database. During a recent marketing promotion, customers could not place orders through the application because the application crashed. An analysis showed that all three tiers were overloaded. The application became unresponsive, and the database reached its capacity limit because of read operations. The company already has several similar promotions scheduled in the near future. A solutions architect must develop a plan for migration to AWS to resolve these issues. The solution must maximize scalability and must minimize operational effort Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Refactor the frontend so that static assets can be hosted on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend to customers. Connect the frontend to the Java application.
options.B: Rehost the Apache web server of the frontend on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. Use a load balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) to host the static assets that the Apache web server needs.
options.C: Rehost the Java application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment that includes auto scaling.
options.D: Refactor the Java application, Develop a Docker container to run the Java application. Use AWS Fargate to host the container.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replatform the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. Use Aurora Auto Scaling for read replicas.
options.F: Rehost the PostgreSQL database on an Amazon EC2 instance that has twice as much memory as the on-premises server.

en.explanation:
The application has three overloaded tiers: static/frontend delivery, a monolithic Java middle tier, and a PostgreSQL database that is saturated by read operations. The best migration plan should offload static content, add managed application-tier scaling, and move the database to a managed PostgreSQL-compatible platform with scalable read capacity.

## Correct answers: A, C, E

### A. Refactor the frontend so that static assets can be hosted on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend to customers.
This is correct. Static frontend assets should be moved away from Apache servers and served from highly scalable managed services. Amazon S3 can host static website content, and CloudFront can accelerate delivery of static content such as images, style sheets, and JavaScript from edge locations. AWS documentation states that a simple approach for storing and delivering static content is to use an S3 bucket with CloudFront, and that CloudFront speeds up delivery of static content globally ([CloudFront static website content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html); [S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). This reduces load on the web tier and minimizes operational effort compared with managing Apache servers.

### C. Rehost the Java application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment that includes auto scaling.
This is correct. The middle tier is a monolithic Java application. Elastic Beanstalk supports Java applications and automatically provisions infrastructure, configures load balancing, sets up health monitoring, and dynamically scales the environment ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). Elastic Beanstalk environments include Auto Scaling groups; in load-balanced environments, Auto Scaling adds or removes instances as needed based on load ([Auto Scaling your Elastic Beanstalk environment instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)). This directly addresses the overloaded application tier while keeping operational effort low.

### E. Use AWS DMS to replatform PostgreSQL to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Use Aurora Auto Scaling for read replicas.
This is correct. The database reached capacity because of read operations, so a managed PostgreSQL-compatible database with scalable read replicas is appropriate. AWS DMS can migrate an on-premises PostgreSQL source to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Aurora PostgreSQL target ([AWS DMS PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL migration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html)). Aurora Auto Scaling dynamically adjusts the number of Aurora Replicas for an Aurora DB cluster and helps the cluster handle sudden increases in connectivity or workload; it is available for Aurora PostgreSQL ([Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)). This specifically addresses read-scaling pressure with low database administration overhead.

## Incorrect options

### B. Rehost Apache on EC2 Auto Scaling with EFS for static assets.
This would improve scalability compared with a single on-premises Apache server, but it is not the best fit for minimizing operational effort. The company would still need to operate Apache servers, EC2 instances, AMIs, OS patching, web server configuration, and EFS integration. For static assets, S3 plus CloudFront is more scalable and more managed than an EC2/EFS-based web tier.

### D. Refactor the Java application into a Docker container and use AWS Fargate.
Fargate can reduce server management, but this option requires containerizing/refactoring the monolithic Java application and does not explicitly include an ECS service, load balancing, or service auto scaling. By contrast, Elastic Beanstalk directly supports Java applications and explicitly provides load balancing, health monitoring, and dynamic scaling. For this question’s combination of near-term migration, maximum scalability, and minimum operational effort, C is the stronger answer.

### F. Rehost PostgreSQL on a larger EC2 instance.
This is vertical scaling and does not solve read-scaling limits well. It also increases operational effort because the company would manage the database on EC2, including patching, backups, high availability, monitoring, and future scaling. Aurora PostgreSQL with read replicas and Aurora Auto Scaling is the managed, scalable option for the read-heavy database tier.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心运行一个三层 Web 应用程序。前端由 Apache Web 服务器提供服务，中间层是一个单体 Java 应用程序，存储层是 PostgreSQL 数据库。在最近的一次营销促销活动中，由于应用程序崩溃，客户无法通过应用程序下订单。分析显示，所有三个层都过载了。应用程序变得无响应，并且数据库因读取操作而达到容量限制。该公司已经在近期安排了几个类似的促销活动。解决方案架构师必须制定迁移到 AWS 的计划来解决这些问题。该解决方案必须最大化可扩展性并最小化运维工作量。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 重构前端，使静态资产可以托管在 Amazon S3 上。使用 Amazon CloudFront 向客户提供前端服务。将前端连接到 Java 应用程序。
options.B: 在位于 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上重新托管前端的 Apache Web 服务器。在 Auto Scaling 组前使用负载均衡器。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 托管 Apache Web 服务器所需的静态资产。
options.C: 在包含自动扩展的 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境中重新托管 Java 应用程序。
options.D: 重构 Java 应用程序。开发一个 Docker 容器来运行 Java 应用程序。使用 AWS Fargate 托管该容器。
options.E: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将 PostgreSQL 数据库重新平台化到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库。对只读副本使用 Aurora Auto Scaling。
options.F: 在内存为本地服务器两倍的 Amazon EC2 实例上重新托管 PostgreSQL 数据库。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序有三个过载的层：静态/前端交付层、单体 Java 中间层，以及一个被读取操作压垮的 PostgreSQL 数据库。最佳迁移计划应卸载静态内容，增加托管的应用程序层扩展能力，并将数据库迁移到具有可扩展读取容量的托管 PostgreSQL 兼容平台。

## 正确答案：A、C、E

### A. 重构前端，使静态资产可以托管在 Amazon S3 上。使用 Amazon CloudFront 向客户提供前端服务。
这是正确的。静态前端资产应从 Apache 服务器迁移出去，并由高度可扩展的托管服务提供。Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站内容，CloudFront 可以从边缘站点加速交付图像、样式表和 JavaScript 等静态内容。AWS 文档指出，存储和交付静态内容的一种简单方法是使用带有 CloudFront 的 S3 存储桶，并且 CloudFront 可以加速全球范围内静态内容的交付（[CloudFront static website content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)；[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。与管理 Apache 服务器相比，这可以减少 Web 层负载并最小化运维工作量。

### C. 在包含自动扩展的 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境中重新托管 Java 应用程序。
这是正确的。中间层是一个单体 Java 应用程序。Elastic Beanstalk 支持 Java 应用程序，并会自动预置基础设施、配置负载均衡、设置运行状况监控，并动态扩展环境（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。Elastic Beanstalk 环境包含 Auto Scaling 组；在负载均衡环境中，Auto Scaling 会根据负载按需添加或移除实例（[Auto Scaling your Elastic Beanstalk environment instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)）。这直接解决了应用程序层过载问题，同时保持较低的运维工作量。

### E. 使用 AWS DMS 将 PostgreSQL 重新平台化到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。对只读副本使用 Aurora Auto Scaling。
这是正确的。数据库因读取操作而达到容量限制，因此适合使用具有可扩展只读副本的托管 PostgreSQL 兼容数据库。AWS DMS 可以将本地 PostgreSQL 源迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 或 Aurora PostgreSQL 目标（[AWS DMS PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL migration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html)）。Aurora Auto Scaling 会动态调整 Aurora DB 集群的 Aurora Replicas 数量，并帮助集群处理连接数或工作负载的突然增加；它可用于 Aurora PostgreSQL（[Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)）。这以较低的数据库管理开销专门解决了读取扩展压力。

## 错误选项

### B. 在 EC2 Auto Scaling 上重新托管 Apache，并使用 EFS 存放静态资产。
与单个本地 Apache 服务器相比，这会提高可扩展性，但它并不是最适合最小化运维工作量的方案。公司仍然需要运维 Apache 服务器、EC2 实例、AMI、操作系统补丁、Web 服务器配置以及 EFS 集成。对于静态资产，S3 加 CloudFront 比基于 EC2/EFS 的 Web 层更具可扩展性且更托管化。

### D. 将 Java 应用程序重构为 Docker 容器并使用 AWS Fargate。
Fargate 可以减少服务器管理，但此选项需要对单体 Java 应用程序进行容器化/重构，并且没有明确包括 ECS service、负载均衡或 service auto scaling。相比之下，Elastic Beanstalk 直接支持 Java 应用程序，并明确提供负载均衡、运行状况监控和动态扩展。对于本题关于近期迁移、最大化可扩展性和最小化运维工作量的组合要求，C 是更有力的答案。

### F. 在更大的 EC2 实例上重新托管 PostgreSQL。
这是垂直扩展，并不能很好地解决读取扩展限制。它还会增加运维工作量，因为公司需要在 EC2 上管理数据库，包括补丁、备份、高可用性、监控和未来扩展。带有只读副本和 Aurora Auto Scaling 的 Aurora PostgreSQL 是面向读取密集型数据库层的托管式、可扩展选项。

en.question: A company is deploying a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster and an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. The EKS cluster has an AWS managed node group. The company's security guidelines state that all resources on AWS must be continuously scanned for security vulnerabilities. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Activate AWS Security Hub. Configure Security Hub to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.
options.B: Activate Amazon Inspector to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.
options.C: Launch a new Amazon EC2 instance and install a vulnerability scanning tool from AWS Marketplace. Configure the EC2 instance to scan the EKS nodes. Configure Amazon ECR to perform a basic scan on push.
options.D: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EKS nodes. Configure the CloudWatch agent to scan continuously. Configure Amazon ECR to perform a basic scan on push.

en.explanation:
The application uses an Amazon EKS cluster with an AWS managed node group and an Amazon ECR repository. The requirement is continuous vulnerability scanning with the least operational overhead.

**Correct answer: B. Activate Amazon Inspector to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.**

Amazon Inspector is the AWS managed vulnerability scanning service for this use case. The Amazon Inspector documentation states that it can **continuously scan your environment** and automatically discovers eligible resources, rescanning when changes or new CVEs could introduce vulnerabilities ([Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)). For EKS worker nodes, the EKS documentation specifically says that you can use Amazon Inspector to check for unintended network accessibility of nodes and vulnerabilities on the underlying Amazon EC2 instances ([Analyze vulnerabilities in Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/configuration-vulnerability-analysis.html)). This fits an EKS managed node group because the nodes are EC2 instances managed as part of the node group.

Amazon Inspector also supports ECR image scanning. The Inspector ECR scanning documentation states that, with continuous scanning enabled, Inspector initiates new scans when a new image is pushed, when a new relevant CVE is added, or when an archived image becomes active again ([Scanning Amazon ECR container images with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ecr.html)). Security Hub’s own controls also identify Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning and Amazon Inspector ECR scanning as the scanning capabilities to enable ([Security Hub controls for Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/inspector-controls.html)). Therefore, Inspector provides the native, managed, low-overhead solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Activate AWS Security Hub. Configure Security Hub to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.**  
  Security Hub is primarily an aggregation, posture management, and findings/compliance service. It can check whether Inspector scanning is enabled and can ingest Inspector findings, but it is not the service that performs the vulnerability scans. The Security Hub Inspector controls explicitly check whether **Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning** and **Amazon Inspector ECR scanning** are enabled, which confirms that Inspector is the scanner, not Security Hub itself.

- **C. Launch a new EC2 instance and install a vulnerability scanning tool from AWS Marketplace... Configure Amazon ECR to perform a basic scan on push.**  
  This has significantly more operational overhead because the company must deploy, operate, maintain, patch, and configure a separate scanner. Also, ECR basic scan-on-push is not equivalent to Inspector continuous scanning. Inspector continuous scanning can rescan images when new relevant CVEs are added, whereas scan-on-push scans only when an image is pushed.

- **D. Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EKS nodes. Configure the CloudWatch agent to scan continuously...**  
  The CloudWatch agent is for metrics and logs collection, not vulnerability scanning. ECR basic scan-on-push also does not satisfy the continuous scanning requirement as well as Inspector enhanced/continuous scanning.

Because Amazon Inspector natively and continuously scans both the EC2-based EKS nodes and ECR container images with minimal setup and management, **B** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上部署一个新应用程序。该应用程序由一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群和一个 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库组成。EKS 集群有一个 AWS 托管节点组。该公司的安全准则规定，AWS 上的所有资源都必须持续扫描安全漏洞。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足此要求？

options.A: 激活 AWS Security Hub。配置 Security Hub 以扫描 EKS 节点和 ECR 存储库。
options.B: 激活 Amazon Inspector 以扫描 EKS 节点和 ECR 存储库。
options.C: 启动一个新的 Amazon EC2 实例，并从 AWS Marketplace 安装一个漏洞扫描工具。配置该 EC2 实例以扫描 EKS 节点。配置 Amazon ECR 在推送时执行基本扫描。
options.D: 在 EKS 节点上安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent。配置 CloudWatch agent 以持续扫描。配置 Amazon ECR 在推送时执行基本扫描。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序使用一个带有 AWS 托管节点组的 Amazon EKS 集群和一个 Amazon ECR 存储库。要求是在运营开销最少的情况下进行持续漏洞扫描。

**正确答案：B. 激活 Amazon Inspector 以扫描 EKS 节点和 ECR 存储库。**

Amazon Inspector 是适用于此用例的 AWS 托管漏洞扫描服务。Amazon Inspector 文档说明，它可以**持续扫描你的环境**，并自动发现符合条件的资源，在发生变更或新的 CVE 可能引入漏洞时重新扫描（[Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。对于 EKS 工作节点，EKS 文档明确说明，你可以使用 Amazon Inspector 检查节点是否存在意外的网络可访问性，以及底层 Amazon EC2 实例上的漏洞（[Analyze vulnerabilities in Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/configuration-vulnerability-analysis.html)）。这适用于 EKS 托管节点组，因为这些节点是作为节点组一部分进行管理的 EC2 实例。

Amazon Inspector 还支持 ECR 映像扫描。Inspector ECR 扫描文档说明，启用持续扫描后，当推送新映像、添加新的相关 CVE，或归档映像再次变为活动状态时，Inspector 会启动新的扫描（[Scanning Amazon ECR container images with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ecr.html)）。Security Hub 自身的控制项也将 Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning 和 Amazon Inspector ECR scanning 标识为要启用的扫描功能（[Security Hub controls for Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/inspector-controls.html)）。因此，Inspector 提供了原生、托管、低开销的解决方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 激活 AWS Security Hub。配置 Security Hub 以扫描 EKS 节点和 ECR 存储库。**  
  Security Hub 主要是一个聚合、安全态势管理以及发现结果/合规性服务。它可以检查 Inspector 扫描是否已启用，并可以摄取 Inspector 发现结果，但它不是执行漏洞扫描的服务。Security Hub Inspector controls 明确检查是否启用了 **Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning** 和 **Amazon Inspector ECR scanning**，这证实 Inspector 才是扫描器，而不是 Security Hub 本身。

- **C. 启动一个新的 EC2 实例，并从 AWS Marketplace 安装一个漏洞扫描工具……配置 Amazon ECR 在推送时执行基本扫描。**  
  这会带来显著更多的运营开销，因为公司必须部署、运营、维护、修补和配置一个单独的扫描器。此外，ECR basic scan-on-push 并不等同于 Inspector continuous scanning。Inspector continuous scanning 可以在添加新的相关 CVE 时重新扫描映像，而 scan-on-push 只在推送映像时扫描。

- **D. 在 EKS 节点上安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent。配置 CloudWatch agent 以持续扫描……**  
  CloudWatch agent 用于收集指标和日志，而不是进行漏洞扫描。ECR basic scan-on-push 也不像 Inspector enhanced/continuous scanning 那样满足持续扫描要求。

由于 Amazon Inspector 能够以最少的设置和管理原生且持续地扫描基于 EC2 的 EKS 节点和 ECR 容器映像，**B** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company needs to improve the reliability of its ticketing application. The application runs on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The company uses Amazon CloudFront to serve the application. A single ECS service of the ECS cluster is the CloudFront distribution’s origin. The application allows only a specific number of active users to enter a ticket purchasing flow. These users are identified by an encrypted attribute in their JSON Web Token (JWT). All other users are redirected to a waiting room module until there is available capacity for purchasing. The application is experiencing high loads. The waiting room module is working as designed, but load on the waiting room is disrupting the applications availability. This disruption is negatively affecting the application's ticket sale transactions. Which solution will provide the MOST reliability for ticket sale transactions during periods of high load?

options.A: Create a separate service in the ECS cluster for the waiting room. Use a separate scaling configuration. Ensure that the ticketing service uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room service.
options.B: Move the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Split the waiting room module into a pod that is separate from the ticketing pod. Make the ticketing pod part of a StatefulSet. Ensure that the ticketing pod uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room pod.
options.C: Create a separate service in the ECS cluster for the waiting room. Use a separate scaling configuration. Create a CloudFront function that inspects the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the ticketing service or the waiting room service.
options.D: Move the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Split the waiting room module into a pod that is separate from the ticketing pod. Use AWS App Mesh by provisioning the App Mesh controller for Kubernetes. Enable mTLS authentication and service-to- service authentication for communication between the ticketing pod and the waiting room pod. Ensure that the ticketing pod uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room pod.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application currently has a single ECS service as the CloudFront origin. During ticket-sale peaks, users who are not allowed into the purchasing flow are redirected to a waiting room. The waiting room itself is receiving high load and is disrupting the availability of the ticket-purchasing transactions. The goal is to maximize reliability for the transaction path under high load.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Create a separate service in the ECS cluster for the waiting room. Use a separate scaling configuration. Create a CloudFront function that inspects the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the ticketing service or the waiting room service.**
