The videos are mostly over 100 MB, so they are well above the 128 KB minimum-size billing concern for Standard-IA. S3 Lifecycle is intended to store objects cost effectively by transitioning them to lower-cost storage classes. See [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html) and [Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html).

Incorrect options:

**A. Configure the S3 bucket to be a Requester Pays bucket. — Incorrect**  
Requester Pays shifts request and data download charges to authenticated requesters, but the bucket owner still pays for storage. More importantly, the scenario says both named users and **anonymous users** access the videos. AWS states that if Requester Pays is enabled, anonymous access is not allowed and all requests must be authenticated. Therefore, this would break a stated access pattern and does not optimize storage cost. See [Using Requester Pays general purpose buckets for storage transfers and usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/RequesterPaysBuckets.html).

**B. Use S3 Transfer Acceleration to upload the videos to the S3 bucket. — Incorrect**  
S3 Transfer Acceleration is a performance feature for faster transfers over long distances or when customers cannot use all available bandwidth over the internet. It can help upload performance in some globally distributed scenarios, but the requirement is to optimize **S3 costs**, and this option does not reduce S3 storage costs or remove incomplete multipart-upload parts. See [Configuring fast, secure file transfers using Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html).

**D. Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 day. — Incorrect**  
S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is intended for long-term data that is rarely accessed but requires milliseconds retrieval. The videos are accessed frequently for the first 180 days, so transitioning them after only 1 day would place frequently accessed objects into a storage class designed for rarely accessed data and could increase retrieval-related costs. The correct timing is after the frequent-access period ends. See [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，会将用户上传的视频存储在使用 S3 Standard 存储的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。用户在视频上传后的前 180 天会频繁访问这些视频。180 天之后很少访问。具名用户和匿名用户都会访问这些视频。大多数视频大小超过 100 MB。用户上传视频时经常因互联网连接较差而导致上传失败。该公司对视频使用分段上传。解决方案架构师需要优化该应用程序的 S3 成本。哪一组操作组合将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 S3 存储桶配置为 Requester Pays 存储桶。
options.B: 使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 将视频上传到 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在启动 7 天后使未完成的分段上传过期。
options.D: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 1 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。
options.E: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 180 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序将用户上传的大型视频存储在 S3 Standard 中。视频在前 180 天会被频繁访问，之后很少访问。上传使用分段上传，并且有时会失败。题目要求选择 **两个 S3 成本优化操作**。

正确答案：**C 和 E**。

**C. 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在启动 7 天后使未完成的分段上传过期。— 正确**  
失败的分段上传可能会留下已上传的分段存储在 S3 中，而这些分段会持续产生存储费用。AWS 明确建议配置带有 `AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload` 的生命周期规则以最大限度降低存储成本；文档示例使用 `DaysAfterInitiation` 为 7 天，并说明 S3 会在指定时间范围后删除与未完成分段上传关联的分段。这直接解决了因连接较差导致的上传失败问题，同时优化成本。请参阅 [Configuring a bucket lifecycle configuration to delete incomplete multipart uploads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpu-abort-incomplete-mpu-lifecycle-config.html)。

**E. 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 180 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access。— 正确**  
视频在 180 天内被频繁访问，之后很少访问。S3 Standard-IA 专为长期保存、不频繁访问的数据而设计，同时仍提供毫秒级访问；AWS 给出的示例是将数据上传到 S3 Standard，然后使用生命周期配置在之后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-IA 或 One Zone-IA。视频大多超过 100 MB，因此远高于 Standard-IA 的 128 KB 最小大小计费相关限制。S3 Lifecycle 旨在通过将对象转换到成本更低的存储类来经济高效地存储对象。请参阅 [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html) 和 [Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)。

错误选项：

**A. 将 S3 存储桶配置为 Requester Pays 存储桶。— 错误**  
Requester Pays 会将请求和数据下载费用转移给经过身份验证的请求者，但存储桶拥有者仍需支付存储费用。更重要的是，场景说明具名用户和 **匿名用户** 都会访问这些视频。AWS 表示，如果启用 Requester Pays，则不允许匿名访问，所有请求都必须经过身份验证。因此，这会破坏已说明的访问模式，并且不能优化存储成本。请参阅 [Using Requester Pays general purpose buckets for storage transfers and usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/RequesterPaysBuckets.html)。

**B. 使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 将视频上传到 S3 存储桶。— 错误**  
S3 Transfer Acceleration 是一项性能功能，用于在长距离传输或客户无法通过互联网使用全部可用带宽时实现更快传输。它可以在某些全球分布场景中帮助提升上传性能，但要求是优化 **S3 成本**，而此选项不会降低 S3 存储成本，也不会移除未完成的分段上传分段。请参阅 [Configuring fast, secure file transfers using Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)。

**D. 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 1 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。— 错误**  
S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 适用于很少访问但需要毫秒级检索的长期数据。视频在前 180 天会被频繁访问，因此仅 1 天后就转换，会将频繁访问的对象放入专为很少访问数据设计的存储类，并可能增加与检索相关的成本。正确的时间点是在频繁访问期结束之后。请参阅 [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)。

en.question: A company runs an ecommerce web application on AWS. The web application is hosted as a static website on Amazon S3 with Amazon CloudFront for content delivery. An Amazon API Gateway API invokes AWS Lambda functions to handle user requests and order processing for the web application The Lambda functions store data in an Amazon ROS for MySQL DB cluster that uses On- Demand instances. The DB cluster usage has been consistent in the past 12 months. Recently, the website has experienced SQL injection and web exploit attempts. Customers also report that order processing time has increased during periods of peak usage. During these periods, the Lambda functions often have cold starts. As the company grows, the company needs to ensure scalability and low-latency access during traffic peaks. The company also must optimize the database costs and add protection against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Lambda functions to have an increased timeout value during peak periods. Use RDS Reserved Instances for the database. Use CloudFront and subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to protect against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts.
options.B: Increase the memory of the Lambda functions, Transition to Amazon Redshift for the database. Integrate Amazon Inspector with CloudFront to protect against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts.
options.C: Use Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency for compute during peak periods, Transition to Amazon Aurora Serverless for the database. Use CloudFront and subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to protect against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts.
options.D: Use Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency for compute during peak periods. Use RDS Reserved Instances for the database. Integrate AWS WAF with CloudFront to protect against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application is a CloudFront-fronted static S3 ecommerce site with API Gateway and Lambda for requests/order processing, and an RDS for MySQL database currently paid with On-Demand instances. The company needs to:

1. Reduce Lambda cold-start latency during peak periods.
2. Optimize database costs for a workload whose DB usage has been consistent for 12 months.
3. Protect against SQL injection and web exploit attempts at the web edge.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Use Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency for compute during peak periods. Use RDS Reserved Instances for the database. Integrate AWS WAF with CloudFront to protect against the SQL injection and web exploit attempts.**

This option matches all requirements:

- **Lambda provisioned concurrency** directly addresses cold starts and latency. AWS documentation states that provisioned concurrency allocates pre-initialized Lambda execution environments that are ready to respond immediately, and that it is useful for reducing cold-start latency for interactive workloads such as web applications ([AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)).
- **RDS Reserved DB Instances** are appropriate for stable, predictable database usage. AWS states that reserved DB instances provide a significant discount compared with On-Demand DB instance pricing and are a billing discount for matching On-Demand DB instance usage ([Reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)). Since the DB usage has been consistent for 12 months, this is the cost-optimized choice.
- **AWS WAF with CloudFront** is the correct service for SQL injection and web exploit protection. AWS WAF can be associated with CloudFront distributions and inspects web requests according to web ACL rules ([Using AWS WAF with Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html)). AWS WAF also has SQL injection rule statements that inspect web request components for malicious SQL code ([SQL injection attack rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Increase Lambda timeout, use RDS Reserved Instances, subscribe to Shield Advanced

This option partially addresses database cost with RDS Reserved Instances, but it fails on two key requirements:

- Increasing the Lambda timeout does **not** reduce cold starts or improve startup latency. It only allows a function invocation to run longer.
- AWS Shield Advanced is primarily for DDoS protection. AWS documentation describes Shield Advanced as protection against DDoS attacks at layers 3, 4, and 7 ([What are AWS WAF and AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)). It is not the targeted control for SQL injection protection; AWS WAF is.

### B. Increase Lambda memory, transition to Redshift, integrate Amazon Inspector with CloudFront

This option is incorrect because:

- Increasing Lambda memory can improve CPU allocation and runtime performance in some cases, but it does not specifically keep execution environments pre-initialized to avoid cold starts like provisioned concurrency does.
- Amazon Redshift is an analytics data warehouse, not a direct replacement for an ecommerce transactional RDS for MySQL database.
- Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability management service and does not integrate with CloudFront as a web application firewall for SQL injection/web exploit filtering. AWS WAF is the appropriate service.

### C. Provisioned concurrency, Aurora Serverless, Shield Advanced

This option correctly uses Lambda provisioned concurrency, but it is still not the best answer:

- The question explicitly says the database usage has been consistent for the past 12 months and asks to optimize database costs. For predictable RDS instance usage, Reserved DB Instances provide significant discounts compared with On-Demand pricing ([Reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)). Moving to Aurora Serverless is not required by the facts given and may not be the most cost-optimized choice for steady usage.
- It uses Shield Advanced for SQL injection/web exploit attempts. Shield Advanced is for DDoS protection, whereas AWS WAF is the web application firewall that can inspect requests and apply SQL injection rules ([What are AWS WAF and AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html), [SQL injection attack rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)).

Therefore, **D** is the only option that addresses latency, database cost optimization, and SQL injection/web exploit protection together.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个电子商务 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序作为静态网站托管在 Amazon S3 上，并使用 Amazon CloudFront 进行内容分发。Amazon API Gateway API 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理该 Web 应用程序的用户请求和订单处理。Lambda 函数将数据存储在使用 On-Demand 实例的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 集群中。该 DB 集群在过去 12 个月的使用量一直很稳定。最近，该网站遭遇了 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。客户还报告称，在使用高峰期订单处理时间有所增加。在这些时段，Lambda 函数经常发生冷启动。随着公司的发展，公司需要确保在流量高峰期间具备可扩展性和低延迟访问。公司还必须优化数据库成本，并增加针对 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试的防护。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数配置为在高峰期具有更长的超时值。对数据库使用 RDS Reserved Instances。使用 CloudFront 并订阅 AWS Shield Advanced，以防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。
options.B: 增加 Lambda 函数的内存。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift。将 Amazon Inspector 与 CloudFront 集成，以防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。
options.C: 在高峰期使用具有 provisioned concurrency 的 Lambda 函数进行计算。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless。使用 CloudFront 并订阅 AWS Shield Advanced，以防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。
options.D: 在高峰期使用具有 provisioned concurrency 的 Lambda 函数进行计算。对数据库使用 RDS Reserved Instances。将 AWS WAF 与 CloudFront 集成，以防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序是一个由 CloudFront 前置的静态 S3 电子商务网站，使用 API Gateway 和 Lambda 处理请求/订单处理，并使用 RDS for MySQL 数据库，目前按 On-Demand 实例付费。公司需要：

1. 降低高峰期 Lambda 冷启动延迟。
2. 针对 DB 使用量已稳定 12 个月的工作负载优化数据库成本。
3. 在 Web 边缘防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 在高峰期使用具有 provisioned concurrency 的 Lambda 函数进行计算。对数据库使用 RDS Reserved Instances。将 AWS WAF 与 CloudFront 集成，以防护 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用尝试。**

此选项符合所有要求：

- **Lambda provisioned concurrency** 直接解决冷启动和延迟问题。AWS 文档指出，provisioned concurrency 会分配预初始化的 Lambda 执行环境，这些环境已准备好立即响应，并且它适用于降低 Web 应用程序等交互式工作负载的冷启动延迟（[AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。
- **RDS Reserved DB Instances** 适用于稳定、可预测的数据库使用量。AWS 表示，与 On-Demand DB instance 定价相比，reserved DB instances 可提供显著折扣，并且是针对匹配的 On-Demand DB instance 使用量的账单折扣（[Reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)）。由于 DB 使用量已稳定 12 个月，因此这是成本优化的选择。
- **AWS WAF with CloudFront** 是用于 SQL 注入和 Web 漏洞利用防护的正确服务。AWS WAF 可以与 CloudFront distributions 关联，并根据 Web ACL 规则检查 Web 请求（[Using AWS WAF with Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-features.html)）。AWS WAF 还具有 SQL injection rule statements，可检查 Web 请求组件中是否存在恶意 SQL 代码（[SQL injection attack rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 增加 Lambda timeout，使用 RDS Reserved Instances，订阅 Shield Advanced

此选项通过 RDS Reserved Instances 部分解决了数据库成本问题，但在两个关键要求上失败：

- 增加 Lambda timeout **不会**减少冷启动或改善启动延迟。它只允许函数调用运行更长时间。
- AWS Shield Advanced 主要用于 DDoS 防护。AWS 文档将 Shield Advanced 描述为在第 3、4 和 7 层防护 DDoS 攻击（[What are AWS WAF and AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。它不是针对 SQL 注入防护的目标控制；AWS WAF 才是。

### B. 增加 Lambda memory，迁移到 Redshift，将 Amazon Inspector 与 CloudFront 集成

此选项不正确，因为：

- 增加 Lambda memory 在某些情况下可以改善 CPU 分配和运行时性能，但它不像 provisioned concurrency 那样专门保持执行环境预初始化以避免冷启动。
- Amazon Redshift 是分析型数据仓库，不是电子商务事务型 RDS for MySQL 数据库的直接替代品。
- Amazon Inspector 是一项漏洞管理服务，不会作为 Web 应用程序防火墙与 CloudFront 集成以进行 SQL 注入/Web 漏洞利用过滤。AWS WAF 才是合适的服务。

### C. Provisioned concurrency，Aurora Serverless，Shield Advanced

此选项正确使用了 Lambda provisioned concurrency，但仍不是最佳答案：

- 题目明确说明数据库使用量在过去 12 个月一直稳定，并要求优化数据库成本。对于可预测的 RDS 实例使用量，Reserved DB Instances 相比 On-Demand 定价可提供显著折扣（[Reserved DB instances for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)）。根据给出的事实，不需要迁移到 Aurora Serverless，而且对于稳定使用量来说，它可能不是最具成本优化的选择。
- 它使用 Shield Advanced 来应对 SQL 注入/Web 漏洞利用尝试。Shield Advanced 用于 DDoS 防护，而 AWS WAF 才是可以检查请求并应用 SQL 注入规则的 Web 应用程序防火墙（[What are AWS WAF and AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)、[SQL injection attack rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)）。

因此，**D** 是唯一同时解决延迟、数据库成本优化以及 SQL 注入/Web 漏洞利用防护的选项。

en.question: A company runs a web application on a single Amazon EC2 instance. End users experience slow application performance during times of peak usage, when CPU utilization is consistently more than 95%. A user data script installs required custom packages on the EC2 instance. The process of launching the instance takes several minutes. The company is creating an Auto Scaling group that has mixed instance groups, varied CPUs, and a maximum capacity limit. The Auto Scaling group will use a launch template for various configuration options. The company needs to decrease application latency when new instances are launched during auto scaling. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a predictive scaling policy. Use an instance maintenance policy to run the user data script. Set the default instance warmup time to 0 seconds.
options.B: Use a dynamic scaling policy. Use lifecycle hooks to run the user data script. Set the default instance warmup time to 0 seconds.
options.C: Use a predictive scaling policy. Enable warm pools for the Auto Scaling group. Use an instance maintenance policy to run the user data script.
options.D: Use a dynamic scaling policy. Enable warm pools for the Auto Scaling group. Use lifecycle hooks to run the user data script.

en.explanation:
The application is CPU-bound during peak periods, and the main delay during scale-out is that each new EC2 instance takes several minutes to initialize because user data installs custom packages. The correct solution is **D: Use a dynamic scaling policy, enable warm pools for the Auto Scaling group, and use lifecycle hooks to run the user data script.**

**Why D is correct:**

- **Dynamic scaling** is appropriate because the scaling signal is current demand: CPU utilization is consistently above 95%. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling dynamic scaling adjusts group capacity as traffic changes occur, and target tracking policies can use metrics such as average CPU utilization to scale in proportion to actual load ([Dynamic scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html)).
- **Warm pools** directly address the several-minute instance startup delay. A warm pool is a pool of pre-initialized EC2 instances that the Auto Scaling group can draw from during scale-out, helping instances quickly start serving traffic and reducing latency for applications with long boot times ([Decrease latency for applications with long boot times using warm pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pools.html)).
- **Lifecycle hooks** are the correct mechanism to perform initialization before an instance receives traffic. AWS specifically describes using a lifecycle hook during scale-out so a newly launched instance enters a wait state, runs a script to download and install required software packages, and then completes the lifecycle action when it is ready. Lifecycle hooks can also ensure bootstrap scripts complete before instances are registered with a load balancer ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Predictive scaling + instance maintenance policy + default warmup of 0 seconds** is incorrect. Predictive scaling is designed to forecast future capacity needs from historical metric patterns, not primarily to react to an immediate CPU utilization threshold ([How predictive scaling works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-policy-overview.html)). An instance maintenance policy controls replacement behavior for events such as health check failures, instance refreshes, maximum instance lifetime, and rebalancing; it is not used to run initialization scripts ([Instance maintenance policy for Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-maintenance-policy-overview-and-considerations.html)). Setting warmup to 0 seconds also does not reduce the actual package installation time.
- **B. Dynamic scaling + lifecycle hooks + default warmup of 0 seconds** is incomplete. Dynamic scaling and lifecycle hooks are useful, but without warm pools, new instances still must be launched and initialized during the scale-out event. That does not solve the latency caused by the several-minute bootstrapping process.
- **C. Predictive scaling + warm pools + instance maintenance policy** includes warm pools, but it uses the wrong scaling approach for the stated CPU-driven demand and the wrong mechanism for bootstrapping. Predictive scaling is for forecasted patterns, and an instance maintenance policy does not run the user data script or hold instances until custom package installation completes.

Therefore, **D** is the best choice because it reacts to real-time CPU demand, keeps pre-initialized capacity ready with warm pools, and uses lifecycle hooks to ensure initialization completes before instances serve application traffic.

zh.question: 一家公司在单个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行 Web 应用程序。最终用户在使用高峰期遇到应用程序性能缓慢的问题，此时 CPU 利用率持续超过 95%。一个用户数据脚本会在该 EC2 实例上安装所需的自定义软件包。启动实例的过程需要几分钟。该公司正在创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，该组具有混合实例组、不同的 CPU 和最大容量限制。Auto Scaling 组将使用启动模板来配置各种选项。公司需要在自动扩缩期间启动新实例时降低应用程序延迟。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用预测性扩展策略。使用实例维护策略运行用户数据脚本。将默认实例预热时间设置为 0 秒。
options.B: 使用动态扩展策略。使用生命周期挂钩运行用户数据脚本。将默认实例预热时间设置为 0 秒。
options.C: 使用预测性扩展策略。为 Auto Scaling 组启用暖池。使用实例维护策略运行用户数据脚本。
options.D: 使用动态扩展策略。为 Auto Scaling 组启用暖池。使用生命周期挂钩运行用户数据脚本。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序在高峰期受 CPU 限制，而扩展时的主要延迟是每个新的 EC2 实例都需要几分钟来初始化，因为用户数据会安装自定义软件包。正确的解决方案是 **D：使用动态扩展策略，为 Auto Scaling 组启用暖池，并使用生命周期挂钩运行用户数据脚本。**

**为什么 D 正确：**

- **动态扩展** 是合适的，因为扩展信号来自当前需求：CPU 利用率持续高于 95%。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 动态扩展会随着流量变化调整组容量，而目标跟踪策略可以使用平均 CPU 利用率等指标，按实际负载成比例地扩展（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 的动态扩展](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html)）。
- **暖池** 直接解决了需要几分钟的实例启动延迟。暖池是一组预初始化的 EC2 实例，Auto Scaling 组可以在横向扩展期间从中取用，这有助于实例快速开始提供流量服务，并降低长启动时间应用程序的延迟（[使用暖池降低长启动时间应用程序的延迟](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pools.html)）。
- **生命周期挂钩** 是在实例接收流量之前执行初始化的正确机制。AWS 明确描述了在横向扩展期间使用生命周期挂钩，使新启动的实例进入等待状态，运行脚本以下载并安装所需的软件包，然后在实例准备就绪后完成生命周期操作。生命周期挂钩还可以确保引导脚本在实例注册到负载均衡器之前完成（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 预测性扩展 + 实例维护策略 + 默认预热时间 0 秒** 不正确。预测性扩展旨在根据历史指标模式预测未来容量需求，而不是主要用于对即时的 CPU 利用率阈值做出反应（[预测性扩展的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-policy-overview.html)）。实例维护策略控制健康检查失败、实例刷新、最大实例生命周期和再平衡等事件的替换行为；它不用于运行初始化脚本（[Auto Scaling 组的实例维护策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-maintenance-policy-overview-and-considerations.html)）。将预热时间设置为 0 秒也不会减少实际的软件包安装时间。
- **B. 动态扩展 + 生命周期挂钩 + 默认预热时间 0 秒** 不完整。动态扩展和生命周期挂钩很有用，但如果没有暖池，新实例仍然必须在横向扩展事件期间启动并初始化。这无法解决由数分钟引导过程导致的延迟。
- **C. 预测性扩展 + 暖池 + 实例维护策略** 包含暖池，但对于题述由 CPU 驱动的需求，它使用了错误的扩展方法，并且用于引导的机制也错误。预测性扩展用于预测性模式，而实例维护策略不会运行用户数据脚本，也不会保持实例等待直到自定义软件包安装完成。

因此，**D** 是最佳选择，因为它响应实时 CPU 需求，通过暖池保持预初始化容量随时可用，并使用生命周期挂钩确保初始化完成后实例才为应用程序流量提供服务。

en.question: A company needs to migrate its on-premises database fleet to Amazon RDS. The company is currently using a mixture of Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and Oracle databases. Some of the databases have custom schemas and stored procedures. Which combination of steps should the company take for the migration? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Migration Evaluator Quick Insights to analyze the source databases and to identify the stored procedures that need to be migrated.
options.B: Use AWS Application Migration Service to analyze the source databases and to identify the stored procedures that need to be migrated.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to analyze the source databases for changes that are required
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the source databases to Amazon RDS.
options.E: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the source databases to Amazon RDS.

en.explanation:
The company is migrating a mixed database fleet (SQL Server, MySQL, and Oracle) to Amazon RDS, and some databases include custom schemas and stored procedures. The right migration approach is to assess/convert schemas and database code where needed, then migrate the data/database contents to RDS.

**Correct answers: C and D**

- **C. Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to analyze the source databases for changes that are required.**  
  AWS SCT is designed for schema assessment and conversion. The AWS SCT documentation says it can automatically convert a source database schema into a format compatible with a target Amazon RDS instance, and if conversion cannot be done automatically, it provides guidance for equivalent target schema creation ([AWS SCT overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)). AWS SCT also provides a Database Migration Assessment Report that summarizes schema action items that cannot be converted automatically and estimates the effort to write equivalent code for the target RDS DB instance ([AWS SCT assessment report](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_UserInterface.AssessmentReport.html)). This directly addresses custom schemas and stored procedures; AWS SCT getting-started guidance also notes that it can convert SQL stored procedures and other application code ([AWS SCT getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_GettingStarted.html)).

- **D. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the source databases to Amazon RDS.**  
  AWS DMS is the managed service for database migration. AWS documentation states that AWS DMS can help move databases to managed database services such as Amazon RDS and supports heterogeneous migrations between supported engines ([What is AWS DMS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). AWS also documents DMS homogeneous data migrations specifically for migrating self-managed on-premises databases to their Amazon RDS equivalents ([Migrating databases to Amazon RDS equivalents with AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/data-migrations.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect**

- **A. Use Migration Evaluator Quick Insights...**  
  Migration Evaluator/Quick Insights is not the correct tool for detailed database schema and stored procedure conversion analysis. The schema/code assessment function for RDS migrations is AWS SCT, which creates assessment reports and identifies conversion action items.

- **B. Use AWS Application Migration Service...**  
  AWS Application Migration Service is for application/server migration, not for analyzing database schemas or identifying stored procedure conversion requirements. For this database-specific requirement, AWS SCT is the appropriate assessment/conversion tool and AWS DMS is the migration service.

- **E. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the source databases to Amazon RDS.**  
  AWS DataSync transfers files and objects between on-premises/self-managed storage systems and AWS storage services such as Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, and Amazon FSx; it is not the managed database migration tool for relational database engines to RDS ([AWS DataSync on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)). Database migration to RDS should use AWS DMS, with AWS SCT for schema/code assessment and conversion.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其本地数据库群迁移到 Amazon RDS。该公司目前混合使用 Microsoft SQL Server、MySQL 和 Oracle 数据库。部分数据库具有自定义架构和存储过程。该公司应采取哪一组步骤来完成迁移？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Migration Evaluator Quick Insights 分析源数据库，并识别需要迁移的存储过程。
options.B: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service 分析源数据库，并识别需要迁移的存储过程。
options.C: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 分析源数据库以确定所需的更改
options.D: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将源数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。
options.E: 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从源数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。

zh.explanation:
该公司正在将混合数据库群（SQL Server、MySQL 和 Oracle）迁移到 Amazon RDS，并且部分数据库包含自定义架构和存储过程。正确的迁移方法是根据需要评估/转换架构和数据库代码，然后将数据/数据库内容迁移到 RDS。

**正确答案：C 和 D**

- **C. 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 分析源数据库以确定所需的更改。**  
  AWS SCT 专为架构评估和转换而设计。AWS SCT 文档说明，它可以自动将源数据库架构转换为与目标 Amazon RDS 实例兼容的格式；如果无法自动完成转换，它会为创建等效目标架构提供指导（[AWS SCT overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Welcome.html)）。AWS SCT 还提供 Database Migration Assessment Report，用于汇总无法自动转换的架构操作项，并估算为目标 RDS DB 实例编写等效代码所需的工作量（[AWS SCT assessment report](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_UserInterface.AssessmentReport.html)）。这直接解决了自定义架构和存储过程的问题；AWS SCT 入门指南还指出，它可以转换 SQL 存储过程和其他应用程序代码（[AWS SCT getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_GettingStarted.html)）。

- **D. 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将源数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。**  
  AWS DMS 是用于数据库迁移的托管服务。AWS 文档指出，AWS DMS 可以帮助将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS 等托管数据库服务，并支持受支持引擎之间的异构迁移（[What is AWS DMS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。AWS 还记录了 DMS homogeneous data migrations，专门用于将自管理的本地数据库迁移到其 Amazon RDS 等效项（[Migrating databases to Amazon RDS equivalents with AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/data-migrations.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确**

- **A. 使用 Migration Evaluator Quick Insights...**  
  Migration Evaluator/Quick Insights 不是用于详细数据库架构和存储过程转换分析的正确工具。用于 RDS 迁移的架构/代码评估功能是 AWS SCT，它会创建评估报告并识别转换操作项。

- **B. 使用 AWS Application Migration Service...**  
  AWS Application Migration Service 用于应用程序/服务器迁移，而不是用于分析数据库架构或识别存储过程转换要求。对于此数据库特定需求，AWS SCT 是合适的评估/转换工具，AWS DMS 是迁移服务。

- **E. 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从源数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。**  
  AWS DataSync 在本地/自管理存储系统与 Amazon S3、Amazon EFS 和 Amazon FSx 等 AWS 存储服务之间传输文件和对象；它不是用于将关系数据库引擎迁移到 RDS 的托管数据库迁移工具（[AWS DataSync on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)）。迁移数据库到 RDS 应使用 AWS DMS，并结合 AWS SCT 进行架构/代码评估和转换。

en.question: A company is migrating its blog platform to AWS. The company's on-premises servers connect to AWS through an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. The blog content is updated several times a day by multiple authors and is served from a file share on a network-attached storage (NAS) server. The company needs to migrate the blog platform without delaying the content updates. The company has deployed Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones to run the blog platform behind an Application Load Balancer. The company also needs to move 200 TB of archival data from its on-premises servers to Amazon S3 as soon as possible. Which combination of stops will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a weekly cron job in Amazon EventBridge. Use the cron job to invoke an AWS Lambda function to update the EC2 instances from the NAS server.
options.B: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach volume for the EC2 instances to share for content access. Write code to synchronize the EBS volume with the NAS server weekly.
options.C: Mount an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to the on-premises servers to act as the NAS server. Copy the blog data to the EFS file system. Mount the EFS file system to the C2 instances to serve the content.
options.D: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Copy the static data artifacts to the device. Ship the device to AWS.
options.E: Order an AWS Snowcons SSD device. Copy the static data artifacts to the device. Ship the device to AWS.

en.explanation:
The workload has two separate requirements: (1) the active blog content is a frequently updated shared file workload that must be available to EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones without delaying authors' updates, and (2) 200 TB of archival/static data must be moved to Amazon S3 as quickly as possible.

**Correct answers: C and D.**

- **C is correct** because Amazon EFS provides shared NFS file storage that can be mounted by EC2 instances, and AWS documents that EFS can also be mounted from on-premises Linux clients when the on-premises environment is connected to the VPC with Direct Connect or **VPN**. The question already has an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. By copying the blog data to EFS and mounting the same EFS file system from the on-premises side and the EC2 instances, the company gets a shared file system for the active content, avoiding a delayed batch synchronization model. AWS also documents that EFS supports NFSv4 when mounting on EC2 instances. See [Mounting with on-premises Linux clients](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-direct.html) and [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html).
- **D is correct** because AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized is designed for large offline data transfers, and the current Snowball Edge Storage Optimized configuration provides **210 TB of usable storage capacity**, which fits the 200 TB archival data transfer requirement. Shipping the Snowball Edge device to AWS is the fastest practical option compared with transferring 200 TB over a Site-to-Site VPN. See [AWS Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect** because a weekly EventBridge/Lambda synchronization would delay content updates. The requirement explicitly says the migration must occur **without delaying content updates**, and blog content is updated several times a day by multiple authors. A weekly copy process would not keep the EC2-hosted blog content current.
- **B is incorrect** because EBS Multi-Attach is not a good fit for a multi-AZ shared web content file system. AWS documents that Multi-Attach volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, whereas the blog EC2 instances are deployed across multiple Availability Zones. AWS also warns that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers and that clustered file systems are required for production shared access. See [Attach an EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances using Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html).
- **E is incorrect** because Snowcone/Snowcone SSD is not the appropriate choice for transferring 200 TB as soon as possible. The Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 210 TB device in option D directly matches the 200 TB requirement in a single high-capacity device; Snowcone-class devices are much smaller and would require many devices and more operational overhead.

Therefore, the best combination is **C and D**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其博客平台迁移到 AWS。该公司的本地服务器通过 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接到 AWS。博客内容由多名作者每天更新多次，并从网络附加存储（NAS）服务器上的文件共享提供服务。公司需要在不延迟内容更新的情况下迁移博客平台。公司已在多个可用区中部署 Amazon EC2 实例，以在 Application Load Balancer 后面运行博客平台。公司还需要尽快将 200 TB 的归档数据从其本地服务器移动到 Amazon S3。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中创建一个每周 cron 作业。使用该 cron 作业调用 AWS Lambda 函数，从 NAS 服务器更新 EC2 实例。
options.B: 为 EC2 实例配置一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store（Amazon EBS）Multi-Attach 卷，以共享内容访问。编写代码，每周将 EBS 卷与 NAS 服务器同步。
options.C: 将 Amazon Elastic File System（Amazon EFS）文件系统挂载到本地服务器，以充当 NAS 服务器。将博客数据复制到 EFS 文件系统。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到 C2 实例以提供内容。
options.D: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将静态数据工件复制到该设备。将设备寄送到 AWS。
options.E: 订购一台 AWS Snowcons SSD 设备。将静态数据工件复制到该设备。将设备寄送到 AWS。

zh.explanation:
该工作负载有两个独立的要求：(1) 活跃的博客内容是频繁更新的共享文件工作负载，必须可供多个可用区中的 EC2 实例使用，且不能延迟作者的更新；(2) 必须尽快将 200 TB 的归档/静态数据移动到 Amazon S3。

**正确答案：C 和 D。**

- **C 正确**，因为 Amazon EFS 提供共享 NFS 文件存储，可由 EC2 实例挂载，并且 AWS 文档说明，当本地环境通过 Direct Connect 或 **VPN** 连接到 VPC 时，也可以从本地 Linux 客户端挂载 EFS。题目中已经有 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。通过将博客数据复制到 EFS，并从本地侧和 EC2 实例挂载同一个 EFS 文件系统，公司可为活跃内容获得一个共享文件系统，避免延迟的批量同步模型。AWS 还记录了在 EC2 实例上挂载时 EFS 支持 NFSv4。请参阅 [Mounting with on-premises Linux clients](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-direct.html) 和 [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)。
- **D 正确**，因为 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 专为大型离线数据传输而设计，并且当前 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 配置提供 **210 TB 的可用存储容量**，符合 200 TB 归档数据传输要求。与通过 Site-to-Site VPN 传输 200 TB 相比，将 Snowball Edge 设备寄送到 AWS 是最快的实用选项。请参阅 [AWS Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 不正确**，因为每周一次的 EventBridge/Lambda 同步会延迟内容更新。要求明确说明迁移必须在**不延迟内容更新**的情况下进行，而博客内容由多名作者每天更新多次。每周复制流程无法使 EC2 托管的博客内容保持最新。
- **B 不正确**，因为 EBS Multi-Attach 不适合跨多个可用区的共享 Web 内容文件系统。AWS 文档说明，Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到**同一可用区**中的实例，而博客 EC2 实例部署在多个可用区中。AWS 还警告，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多台服务器同时访问而设计，生产共享访问需要集群文件系统。请参阅 [Attach an EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances using Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)。
- **E 不正确**，因为 Snowcone/Snowcone SSD 不适合作为尽快传输 200 TB 的选择。选项 D 中的 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 210 TB 设备可用单台高容量设备直接满足 200 TB 要求；Snowcone 类设备要小得多，需要许多设备并带来更多操作开销。

因此，最佳组合是 **C 和 D**。

en.question: A company plans to migrate a legacy on-premises application to AWS. The application is a Java web application that runs on Apache Tomcat with a PostgreSQL database. The company does not have access to the source code but can deploy the application Java Archive (JAR) files. The application has increased traffic at the end of each month. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Deploy Tomcat and PostgreSQL to all the instances by using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) mount points. Use AWS Step Functions to deploy additional EC2 instances to scale for increased traffic.
options.B: Provision Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) in an Auto Scaling group across multiple AWS Regions. Deploy Tomcat and PostgreSQL in the container images. Use a Network Load Balancer to scale for increased traffic.
options.C: Refactor the Java application into Python-based containers. Use AWS Lambda functions for the application logic. Store application data in Amazon DynamoDB global tables. Use AWS Storage Gateway and Lambda concurrency to scale for increased traffic.
options.D: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the Tomcat servers with auto scaling in multiple Availability Zones. Store application data in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. Deploy Amazon CloudFront and an Application Load Balancer to scale for increased traffic.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company is migrating an existing Java web application that runs on Apache Tomcat and uses PostgreSQL. It cannot refactor the application because it does not have source code access, but it can deploy the packaged Java application artifacts. The application also needs to handle predictable traffic increases at month end. The key requirement is **least operational overhead**.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the Tomcat servers with auto scaling in multiple Availability Zones. Store application data in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. Deploy Amazon CloudFront and an Application Load Balancer to scale for increased traffic.**

This is the best fit because it uses managed AWS services that match the existing application architecture:

* **Elastic Beanstalk supports Java and Tomcat**. AWS documentation states that Elastic Beanstalk makes it easy to deploy, manage, and scale Java web applications, and that its Java platform includes a **Tomcat** platform based on Apache Tomcat for Java servlet/JSP web applications ([Deploying Java applications with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/create_deploy_Java.html)). This avoids source-code refactoring and allows deployment of packaged Java application artifacts.
* **Elastic Beanstalk reduces operational overhead** by provisioning EC2 instances, configuring load balancing, setting up health monitoring, and dynamically scaling the environment ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).
* **Elastic Beanstalk supports Auto Scaling**. In a load-balanced environment, Elastic Beanstalk uses an Auto Scaling group and can add or remove instances based on load ([Auto Scaling your Elastic Beanstalk environment instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)). This directly addresses increased end-of-month traffic.
* **Elastic Beanstalk can use an Application Load Balancer** to distribute requests among environment instances ([Configuring an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-alb.html)).
* **Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL** is the managed database choice that matches the existing PostgreSQL database. RDS for PostgreSQL supports PostgreSQL DB instances, backups, point-in-time restores, Multi-AZ deployments, read replicas, and other managed capabilities ([Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_PostgreSQL.html)).
* **CloudFront** can improve performance and absorb some request load by delivering static and dynamic web content through edge locations with low latency ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

Together, Elastic Beanstalk + ALB + Auto Scaling + RDS for PostgreSQL + CloudFront provides the closest lift-and-shift path with managed scaling and minimal operational management.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EC2 instances with Tomcat and PostgreSQL on EFS, Step Functions for scaling

This option has high operational overhead. The company would need to install, patch, monitor, and operate Tomcat and PostgreSQL on EC2 instances. Running PostgreSQL across multiple EC2 instances using EFS mount points is not an appropriate managed relational database architecture and would introduce complexity and reliability risks. Step Functions is also not the right mechanism for routine web tier scaling; Auto Scaling groups or a managed platform such as Elastic Beanstalk are more appropriate.

### B. EKS across multiple Regions with Tomcat and PostgreSQL in containers

Amazon EKS introduces significantly more operational overhead than Elastic Beanstalk for this use case. The company would need to containerize the application, operate Kubernetes, manage cluster scaling, and manage database containers. Running PostgreSQL inside application container images is not a low-overhead production database strategy compared with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. Also, the requirement does not ask for multi-Region deployment.

### C. Refactor into Python containers, Lambda, DynamoDB global tables, Storage Gateway

This violates the migration constraint. The company does not have source code access and needs to deploy the existing Java application artifacts. Refactoring a Java/Tomcat/PostgreSQL application into Python, Lambda, and DynamoDB would be a major modernization project, not a least-operational-overhead migration. DynamoDB global tables also do not directly match the existing PostgreSQL relational database model.

## Conclusion

Option **D** is correct because it preserves the existing Java/Tomcat/PostgreSQL architecture while using managed AWS services for deployment, load balancing, scaling, database operations, and content delivery.

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个旧版本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序是一个运行在 Apache Tomcat 上的 Java Web 应用程序，并使用 PostgreSQL 数据库。该公司无法访问源代码，但可以部署应用程序的 Java Archive (JAR) 文件。该应用程序在每个月月底流量会增加。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在多个可用区中启动 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 挂载点将 Tomcat 和 PostgreSQL 部署到所有实例。使用 AWS Step Functions 部署额外的 EC2 实例，以便针对增加的流量进行扩展。
options.B: 在跨多个 AWS 区域的 Auto Scaling 组中预置 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。在容器镜像中部署 Tomcat 和 PostgreSQL。使用 Network Load Balancer 针对增加的流量进行扩展。
options.C: 将 Java 应用程序重构为基于 Python 的容器。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理应用程序逻辑。将应用程序数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 全局表中。使用 AWS Storage Gateway 和 Lambda 并发来针对增加的流量进行扩展。
options.D: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在多个可用区中部署具有自动扩展功能的 Tomcat 服务器。将应用程序数据存储在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库中。部署 Amazon CloudFront 和 Application Load Balancer，以便针对增加的流量进行扩展。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司正在迁移一个现有的 Java Web 应用程序，该应用程序运行在 Apache Tomcat 上并使用 PostgreSQL。由于无法访问源代码，因此不能重构应用程序，但可以部署已打包的 Java 应用程序构件。该应用程序还需要处理月底可预测的流量增加。关键要求是**最少的运营开销**。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在多个可用区中部署具有自动扩展功能的 Tomcat 服务器。将应用程序数据存储在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库中。部署 Amazon CloudFront 和 Application Load Balancer，以便针对增加的流量进行扩展。**

这是最合适的选择，因为它使用的 AWS 托管服务与现有应用程序架构相匹配：

* **Elastic Beanstalk 支持 Java 和 Tomcat**。AWS 文档说明，Elastic Beanstalk 可让部署、管理和扩展 Java Web 应用程序变得简单，并且其 Java 平台包含一个基于 Apache Tomcat 的 **Tomcat** 平台，适用于 Java servlet/JSP Web 应用程序（[使用 Elastic Beanstalk 部署 Java 应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/create_deploy_Java.html)）。这避免了源代码重构，并允许部署已打包的 Java 应用程序构件。
* **Elastic Beanstalk 通过预置 EC2 实例、配置负载均衡、设置运行状况监控以及动态扩展环境来降低运营开销**（[什么是 AWS Elastic Beanstalk？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。
* **Elastic Beanstalk 支持 Auto Scaling**。在负载均衡环境中，Elastic Beanstalk 使用 Auto Scaling 组，并可以根据负载添加或移除实例（[自动扩展 Elastic Beanstalk 环境实例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)）。这直接解决了月底流量增加的问题。
* **Elastic Beanstalk 可以使用 Application Load Balancer** 在环境实例之间分发请求（[配置 Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-alb.html)）。
* **Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL** 是与现有 PostgreSQL 数据库匹配的托管数据库选择。RDS for PostgreSQL 支持 PostgreSQL 数据库实例、备份、时间点还原、多可用区部署、只读副本以及其他托管功能（[Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_PostgreSQL.html)）。
* **CloudFront** 可以通过边缘站点以低延迟交付静态和动态 Web 内容，从而提高性能并吸收部分请求负载（[什么是 Amazon CloudFront？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

综合来看，Elastic Beanstalk + ALB + Auto Scaling + RDS for PostgreSQL + CloudFront 提供了最接近直接迁移（lift-and-shift）的路径，同时具备托管扩展能力并将运营管理降至最低。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用 EFS 上的 Tomcat 和 PostgreSQL 的 EC2 实例，并使用 Step Functions 进行扩展

此选项运营开销很高。公司需要在 EC2 实例上安装、修补、监控和运维 Tomcat 与 PostgreSQL。使用 EFS 挂载点在多个 EC2 实例上运行 PostgreSQL 并不是合适的托管关系数据库架构，并且会引入复杂性和可靠性风险。Step Functions 也不是常规 Web 层扩展的正确机制；Auto Scaling 组或 Elastic Beanstalk 等托管平台更合适。

### B. 跨多个区域的 EKS，并在容器中运行 Tomcat 和 PostgreSQL

对于此用例，Amazon EKS 比 Elastic Beanstalk 引入的运营开销要高得多。公司需要将应用程序容器化、运维 Kubernetes、管理集群扩展，并管理数据库容器。与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 相比，在应用程序容器镜像中运行 PostgreSQL 并不是低开销的生产数据库策略。此外，要求并未要求多区域部署。

### C. 重构为 Python 容器、Lambda、DynamoDB 全局表和 Storage Gateway

这违反了迁移约束。公司无法访问源代码，并且需要部署现有 Java 应用程序构件。将 Java/Tomcat/PostgreSQL 应用程序重构为 Python、Lambda 和 DynamoDB 将是一个重大的现代化项目，而不是运营开销最低的迁移。DynamoDB 全局表也无法直接匹配现有 PostgreSQL 关系数据库模型。

## 结论

选项 **D** 正确，因为它保留了现有 Java/Tomcat/PostgreSQL 架构，同时使用 AWS 托管服务进行部署、负载均衡、扩展、数据库运维和内容交付。

en.question: A company is migrating its on-premises IoT platform to AWS. The platform consists of the following components: • A MongoDB cluster as a data store for all collected and processed IoT data. • An application that uses Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) to connect to IoT devices every 5 minutes to collect data. • An application that runs jobs periodically to generate reports from the IoT data. The jobs take 120-600 seconds to finish running. • A web application that runs on a web server. End users use the web application to generate reports that are accessible to the general public. The company needs to migrate the platform to AWS to reduce operational overhead while maintaining performance. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create AWS Step Functions state machines with AUS Lambda tasks to prepare the reports and to write the reports to Amazon S3. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has an S3 origin to serve the reports
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to connect to the IoT devices. process the data, and write the data to the data store. Configure a Lambda layer to temporarily store messages for processing.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster with Amazon EC2 instances to prepare the reports. Create an ingress controller on the EKS cluster to serve the reports.
options.D: Connect the IoT devices to AWS IoT Core to publish messages. Create an AWS IoT rule that runs when a message is received. Configure the rule to call an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to parse, transform, and store device message data to the data store.
options.E: Migrate the MongoDB cluster to Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility).
options.F: Migrate the MongoDB cluster to Amazon EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company is moving an IoT platform that currently uses MQTT device communication, a MongoDB data store, periodic report-generation jobs that run for 120–600 seconds, and a web server that exposes generated reports publicly. The key requirement is to reduce operational overhead while maintaining performance, so managed/serverless services are preferred over self-managed compute, Kubernetes, or databases on EC2.

## Correct answers: A, D, E

### A. Use Step Functions with Lambda tasks, write reports to S3, and serve through CloudFront

This is appropriate for the periodic report-generation jobs. AWS Step Functions can orchestrate a workflow whose `Task` states invoke Lambda functions; the Step Functions documentation states that a `Task` state can perform work by using an AWS Lambda function and shows the `arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke` integration pattern ([AWS Step Functions Task workflow state](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-task.html)).

The jobs run for 120–600 seconds, which is within the Lambda maximum timeout of 900 seconds, or 15 minutes ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). Writing generated report artifacts to Amazon S3 and distributing them through CloudFront is also a low-operations pattern. CloudFront documentation describes using an Amazon S3 bucket as an origin, where the objects to deliver are placed in S3 ([Use various origins with CloudFront distributions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)).

This avoids running and managing web servers or container clusters for public report delivery.

### D. Connect devices to AWS IoT Core, use IoT rules, and invoke Lambda for message processing

This is the best replacement for the on-premises MQTT collection application. AWS IoT Core supports device and application access through device SDKs that send and receive messages with AWS IoT ([What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)). AWS IoT rules are specifically designed to act on MQTT topic streams and can invoke Lambda functions to extract or process data ([Rules for AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rules.html)).

Using IoT Core for MQTT connectivity and IoT rules plus Lambda for parsing, transformation, and storage removes the need to operate a custom polling/connection application.

### E. Migrate MongoDB to Amazon DocumentDB with MongoDB compatibility

Amazon DocumentDB is the managed AWS service designed for MongoDB-compatible workloads. The documentation describes Amazon DocumentDB as a fast, reliable, fully managed database service that makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale MongoDB-compatible databases, while allowing use of the same application code, drivers, and tools used with MongoDB ([What is Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html)).

This directly addresses the existing MongoDB cluster while reducing operational overhead compared with self-managed MongoDB.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Use one Lambda function to connect to IoT devices and temporarily store messages in a Lambda layer

This is not the best fit. A custom Lambda polling application that connects to IoT devices every 5 minutes still requires custom connection and collection logic, rather than using the managed MQTT broker and rules engine in AWS IoT Core. Also, Lambda layers are for packaging shared libraries or dependencies, not for temporarily storing message queues. For MQTT-based ingestion with least operational overhead, IoT Core plus rules and Lambda is the managed pattern.

### C. Use Amazon EKS on EC2 to prepare and serve reports

Amazon EKS with EC2 worker nodes introduces Kubernetes cluster, node, ingress controller, scaling, patching, and operational management. This is more operational overhead than Step Functions, Lambda, S3, and CloudFront. It also uses compute infrastructure to serve static/generated reports, whereas S3 plus CloudFront is simpler and more managed.

### F. Migrate MongoDB to Amazon EC2 instances

Running MongoDB on EC2 would preserve the database engine but would not minimize operational overhead. The company would still need to manage EC2 instances, MongoDB installation, patching, backups, replication, failover, monitoring, and scaling. Amazon DocumentDB is the managed MongoDB-compatible alternative and therefore better satisfies the requirement.

## Final answer

**A, D, and E** are the correct choices because they replace the custom MQTT ingestion layer, MongoDB cluster, report-processing jobs, and public report-serving web server with managed/serverless AWS services while preserving the required functionality and performance characteristics.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其本地 IoT 平台迁移到 AWS。该平台包含以下组件：• 一个 MongoDB 集群，用作所有已收集和已处理 IoT 数据的数据存储。• 一个应用程序，使用 Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) 每 5 分钟连接到 IoT 设备以收集数据。• 一个应用程序，定期运行作业以根据 IoT 数据生成报告。这些作业需要 120-600 秒才能运行完成。• 一个在 Web 服务器上运行的 Web 应用程序。最终用户使用该 Web 应用程序生成可供公众访问的报告。公司需要将该平台迁移到 AWS，以在保持性能的同时降低运营开销。哪组步骤的组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建带有 AUS Lambda 任务的 AWS Step Functions 状态机，以准备报告并将报告写入 Amazon S3。配置一个以 S3 为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配来提供报告
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。编写该 Lambda 函数，使其连接到 IoT 设备、处理数据并将数据写入数据存储。配置一个 Lambda layer 以临时存储待处理消息。
options.C: 配置一个带有 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群来准备报告。在 EKS 集群上创建一个 ingress controller 来提供报告。
options.D: 将 IoT 设备连接到 AWS IoT Core 以发布消息。创建一条在收到消息时运行的 AWS IoT 规则。配置该规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写该 Lambda 函数，以解析、转换设备消息数据并将其存储到数据存储中。
options.E: 将 MongoDB 集群迁移到 Amazon DocumentDB（兼容 MongoDB）。
options.F: 将 MongoDB 集群迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司正在迁移一个 IoT 平台，该平台目前使用 MQTT 设备通信、MongoDB 数据存储、运行 120–600 秒的定期报告生成作业，以及一个公开提供已生成报告的 Web 服务器。关键要求是在保持性能的同时降低运营开销，因此托管/无服务器服务优于自管理计算、Kubernetes 或 EC2 上的数据库。

## 正确答案：A、D、E

### A. 使用带有 Lambda 任务的 Step Functions，将报告写入 S3，并通过 CloudFront 提供服务

这适用于定期报告生成作业。AWS Step Functions 可以编排一个工作流，其 `Task` 状态调用 Lambda 函数；Step Functions 文档说明，`Task` 状态可以通过使用 AWS Lambda 函数来执行工作，并展示了 `arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke` 集成模式（[AWS Step Functions Task workflow state](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-task.html)）。

这些作业运行 120–600 秒，处于 Lambda 最大超时时间 900 秒（即 15 分钟）以内（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。将生成的报告构件写入 Amazon S3 并通过 CloudFront 分发，也是一种低运维模式。CloudFront 文档描述了将 Amazon S3 存储桶用作源站，其中要交付的对象放置在 S3 中（[Use various origins with CloudFront distributions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)）。

这避免了为公开报告交付运行和管理 Web 服务器或容器集群。

### D. 将设备连接到 AWS IoT Core，使用 IoT 规则，并调用 Lambda 进行消息处理

这是替代本地 MQTT 收集应用程序的最佳方案。AWS IoT Core 支持设备和应用程序通过设备 SDK 进行访问，这些 SDK 与 AWS IoT 发送和接收消息（[What is AWS IoT?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-iot.html)）。AWS IoT 规则专门设计用于对 MQTT 主题流执行操作，并且可以调用 Lambda 函数来提取或处理数据（[Rules for AWS IoT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/iot-rules.html)）。

使用 IoT Core 进行 MQTT 连接，并结合 IoT 规则和 Lambda 进行解析、转换和存储，可以消除运行自定义轮询/连接应用程序的需要。

### E. 将 MongoDB 迁移到兼容 MongoDB 的 Amazon DocumentDB

Amazon DocumentDB 是专为兼容 MongoDB 的工作负载设计的 AWS 托管服务。文档将 Amazon DocumentDB 描述为一种快速、可靠、完全托管的数据库服务，使设置、运行和扩展兼容 MongoDB 的数据库变得简单，同时允许使用与 MongoDB 相同的应用程序代码、驱动程序和工具（[What is Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html)）。

这直接解决了现有 MongoDB 集群的问题，同时相比自管理 MongoDB 降低了运营开销。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 使用一个 Lambda 函数连接到 IoT 设备，并在 Lambda layer 中临时存储消息

这不是最佳匹配。每 5 分钟连接到 IoT 设备的自定义 Lambda 轮询应用程序仍然需要自定义连接和收集逻辑，而不是使用 AWS IoT Core 中的托管 MQTT broker 和规则引擎。此外，Lambda layers 用于打包共享库或依赖项，而不是用于临时存储消息队列。对于以最少运营开销进行基于 MQTT 的摄取，IoT Core 加规则和 Lambda 才是托管模式。

### C. 使用 EC2 上的 Amazon EKS 来准备和提供报告

带有 EC2 工作节点的 Amazon EKS 会引入 Kubernetes 集群、节点、ingress controller、扩展、修补和运营管理。与 Step Functions、Lambda、S3 和 CloudFront 相比，这会带来更多运营开销。它还使用计算基础设施来提供静态/已生成报告，而 S3 加 CloudFront 更简单且更托管。

### F. 将 MongoDB 迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例

在 EC2 上运行 MongoDB 会保留数据库引擎，但不会最大限度地减少运营开销。公司仍需要管理 EC2 实例、MongoDB 安装、修补、备份、复制、故障转移、监控和扩展。Amazon DocumentDB 是托管的 MongoDB 兼容替代方案，因此更好地满足该要求。

## 最终答案

**A、D 和 E** 是正确选项，因为它们使用托管/无服务器 AWS 服务替代了自定义 MQTT 摄取层、MongoDB 集群、报告处理作业和公开报告服务的 Web 服务器，同时保留所需的功能和性能特征。

en.question: A company creates an Amazon API Gateway API and shares the API with an external development team. The API uses AWS Lambda functions and is deployed to a stage that is named Production. The external development team is the sole consumer of the API. The API experiences sudden increases of usage at specific times, leading to concerns about increased costs. The company needs to limit cost and usage without reworking the Lambda functions. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the API to send requests to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues instead of directly to the Lambda functions. Update the Lambda functions to consume messages from the queues and to process the requests. Set up the queues to invoke the Lambda functions when new messages arrive.
options.B: Configure provisioned concurrency for each Lambda function. Use AWS Application Auto Scaling to register the Lambda functions as targets. Set up scaling schedules to increase and decrease capacity to match changes in API usage.
options.C: Create an API Gateway API key and an AWS WAF Regional web ACL. Associate the web ACL with the Production stage. Add a rate-based rule to the web ACL. In the rule, specify the rate limit and a custom request aggregation that uses the X-API-Key header. Share the API key with the external development team.
options.D: Create an API Gateway API Key and usage plan. Define throttling limits and quotas in the usage plan. Associate the usage plan with the Production stage and the API key. Share the API key with the external development team.

en.explanation:
The scenario has a REST API in Amazon API Gateway integrated with Lambda, with one external consumer. The requirement is to reduce sudden usage spikes and associated API/Lambda invocation costs **without changing the Lambda functions or redesigning the integration**.

**Correct answer: D. Create an API Gateway API key and usage plan with throttling limits and quotas.**

API Gateway usage plans are designed for exactly this type of consumer-level usage control. AWS states that a usage plan specifies who can access deployed API stages and methods and can set request-rate throttling; the plan uses API keys to identify API clients. AWS also defines a throttling limit as the point where request throttling starts and a quota limit as the target maximum number of requests for a given API key in a specified interval ([Usage plans and API keys for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)). By associating the Production stage and the external team's API key with a usage plan, the company can limit the team's request rate and total request volume, thereby reducing downstream Lambda invocations. This requires no Lambda code changes and has no additional architectural component, making it the most cost-effective option.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. SQS between API Gateway and Lambda** — This would require changing the API integration and updating Lambda functions to consume queue messages. It violates the requirement to avoid reworking Lambda functions and adds operational complexity and SQS costs. It also smooths processing but does not directly enforce consumer quotas.

- **B. Lambda provisioned concurrency with scheduled scaling** — Provisioned concurrency is intended to reduce cold starts and reserve ready execution capacity, not to limit API consumption. It would likely increase cost because provisioned concurrency is billed even when traffic is low, and it does not prevent sudden spikes in the number of requests reaching the API.

- **C. API key plus AWS WAF rate-based rule** — AWS WAF rate-based rules can count and rate-limit web requests based on aggregation criteria ([Using rate-based rule statements in AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html)). However, this adds a WAF web ACL and rule-management layer and does not provide API Gateway usage-plan quotas. For a single known external API consumer, API Gateway usage plans are the more direct and cost-effective mechanism for API client throttling and quota control.

Therefore, **D** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司创建了一个 Amazon API Gateway API，并将该 API 共享给一个外部开发团队。该 API 使用 AWS Lambda 函数，并部署到一个名为 Production 的阶段。外部开发团队是该 API 的唯一使用者。该 API 在特定时间会出现使用量突然增加的情况，从而引发了成本增加的担忧。公司需要在不重做 Lambda 函数的情况下限制成本和使用量。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 API 配置为把请求发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，而不是直接发送到 Lambda 函数。更新 Lambda 函数以从队列中消费消息并处理请求。设置队列在新消息到达时调用 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 为每个 Lambda 函数配置预置并发。使用 AWS Application Auto Scaling 将 Lambda 函数注册为目标。设置扩缩计划，以增加和减少容量来匹配 API 使用量的变化。
options.C: 创建一个 API Gateway API key 和一个 AWS WAF Regional web ACL。将该 web ACL 与 Production 阶段关联。向 web ACL 添加一条基于速率的规则。在规则中，指定速率限制以及使用 X-API-Key 标头的自定义请求聚合。将 API key 共享给外部开发团队。
options.D: 创建一个 API Gateway API Key 和使用计划。在使用计划中定义节流限制和配额。将使用计划与 Production 阶段和 API key 关联。将 API key 共享给外部开发团队。

zh.explanation:
该场景中有一个 Amazon API Gateway 中的 REST API 与 Lambda 集成，并且只有一个外部使用者。要求是在**不更改 Lambda 函数或重新设计集成**的情况下，减少突然的使用量峰值以及相关的 API/Lambda 调用成本。

**正确答案：D. 创建一个带有节流限制和配额的 API Gateway API key 和使用计划。**

API Gateway 使用计划正是为这种使用者级别的使用控制而设计的。AWS 表示，使用计划指定谁可以访问已部署的 API 阶段和方法，并且可以设置请求速率节流；该计划使用 API keys 来标识 API 客户端。AWS 还将节流限制定义为请求节流开始的点，并将配额限制定义为在指定时间间隔内给定 API key 的目标最大请求数（[API Gateway 中 REST API 的使用计划和 API keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)）。通过将 Production 阶段和外部团队的 API key 与使用计划关联，公司可以限制该团队的请求速率和总请求量，从而减少下游 Lambda 调用。这不需要更改 Lambda 代码，也不需要额外的架构组件，因此是最具成本效益的选项。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. 在 API Gateway 和 Lambda 之间使用 SQS** — 这需要更改 API 集成，并更新 Lambda 函数以消费队列消息。它违反了避免重做 Lambda 函数的要求，并增加了运营复杂性和 SQS 成本。它还只是平滑处理过程，但并不直接强制执行使用者配额。

- **B. Lambda 预置并发与计划扩缩** — 预置并发旨在减少冷启动并预留就绪执行容量，而不是限制 API 消费。它很可能会增加成本，因为即使流量很低也会对预置并发计费，并且它无法阻止到达 API 的请求数量突然激增。

- **C. API key 加 AWS WAF 基于速率的规则** — AWS WAF 基于速率的规则可以根据聚合条件统计并限速 Web 请求（[在 AWS WAF 中使用基于速率的规则语句](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html)）。但是，这会增加 WAF web ACL 和规则管理层，并且不提供 API Gateway 使用计划配额。对于单个已知的外部 API 使用者，API Gateway 使用计划是用于 API 客户端节流和配额控制的更直接且更具成本效益的机制。

因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: An entertainment company hosts a ticketing service on a fleet of Linux Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The ticketing service uses a pricing file. The pricing file is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that has S3 Standard storage. A central pricing solution that is hosted by a third party updates the pricing file. The pricing file is updated every 1-15 minutes and has several thousand line items. The pricing file is downloaded to each EC2 instance when the instance launches. The EC2 instances occasionally use outdated pricing information that can result in incorrect charges for customers. Which solution will resolve this problem MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to update an Amazon DynamoDB table with new prices each time the pricing file is updated. Update the ticketing service to use DynramoDB to look up pricing
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to update an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file share with the pricing file each time the file is updated. Update the ticketing service to use Amazon EFS to access the pricing file.
options.C: Load Mountpoint for Amazon S3 onto the AMI of the EC2 instances. Configure Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to mount the S3 bucket that contains the pricing file. Update the ticketing service to point to the mount point and path to access the $3 object,
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use EBS Multi-Attach to attach the volume to every EC2 instance. When a new EC2 instance launches, configure the new instance to update the pricing file on the EBS volume. Update the ticketing service to point to the new local source.

en.explanation:
The ticketing service is running on Linux EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The pricing file already exists in Amazon S3 Standard and is updated frequently, but each instance downloads the file only when the instance launches. The stale data problem occurs because long-running instances continue to use an old local copy.

**Correct answer: C. Load Mountpoint for Amazon S3 onto the AMI of the EC2 instances, mount the S3 bucket, and update the service to read the pricing file from the mount point.**

[Mountpoint for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html) is an open source file client that mounts an S3 bucket as a local file system. It lets applications access S3 objects through file operations such as `open` and `read`, and it translates those operations into S3 object API calls. The same documentation states that Mountpoint is available for Linux operating systems and can access S3 objects in all storage classes except archive-oriented classes such as S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive. This matches the Linux EC2 fleet and the S3 Standard pricing file.

This solution is the most cost-effective because it keeps S3 as the source of truth and avoids introducing a new database, shared file system, or block storage synchronization design. Instead of reading a launch-time copy, the application reads the S3 object through a file path. Amazon S3 provides [strong read-after-write consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html) for PUT requests, including overwrites of existing objects, and a GET or LIST request after a successful PUT returns the data written by that PUT. Therefore, after the third-party system successfully updates the pricing file in S3, subsequent reads through the mounted S3 path can retrieve the current object rather than an outdated local file.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Lambda + DynamoDB**: This could be made to work by transforming the pricing file into database records, but it requires an ingestion process, a DynamoDB table, and application changes to perform database lookups. The requirement is to resolve stale access to an existing file in S3 in the most cost-effective way, not to redesign the pricing system into a database-backed lookup service.

- **B. Lambda + Amazon EFS**: Amazon EFS can be mounted by multiple EC2 instances and accessed concurrently from multiple NFS clients, as described in [How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html). However, this option adds a managed file system and a Lambda-based copy process from S3 to EFS. Because the authoritative file is already in S3, using EFS as an additional synchronized copy is more complex and less cost-effective than reading the S3 object directly through Mountpoint.

- **D. EBS Multi-Attach**: This is not an appropriate shared file solution for an Auto Scaling fleet. [EBS Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html) is limited to Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes, can attach a volume only to instances in the same Availability Zone, and supports attachment to up to 16 Nitro-based instances. The documentation also notes that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed to be accessed simultaneously by multiple servers. In addition, updating the file only when a new instance launches would not address updates that occur every 1–15 minutes.

Therefore, **option C** is the best answer because it directly fixes the stale launch-time download problem, uses the existing S3 Standard object as the source of truth, fits the Linux EC2 environment, and avoids the extra cost and operational complexity of DynamoDB, EFS, or EBS Multi-Attach.

zh.question: 一家娱乐公司在一组位于 Auto Scaling 组中的 Linux Amazon EC2 实例上托管票务服务。该票务服务使用一个定价文件。该定价文件存储在使用 S3 Standard 存储的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。一个由第三方托管的集中式定价解决方案会更新该定价文件。定价文件每 1-15 分钟更新一次，并包含数千个行项目。每个 EC2 实例启动时都会下载该定价文件。EC2 实例有时会使用过时的定价信息，这可能导致向客户收取错误费用。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式解决此问题？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在每次定价文件更新时用新价格更新 Amazon DynamoDB 表。更新票务服务以使用 DynramoDB 查询定价。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在每次文件更新时将定价文件更新到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件共享。更新票务服务以使用 Amazon EFS 访问定价文件。
options.C: 将 Mountpoint for Amazon S3 加载到 EC2 实例的 AMI 上。配置 Mountpoint for Amazon S3 以挂载包含定价文件的 S3 存储桶。更新票务服务，使其指向挂载点和路径以访问 $3 对象。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。使用 EBS Multi-Attach 将该卷附加到每个 EC2 实例。当新的 EC2 实例启动时，配置新实例更新 EBS 卷上的定价文件。更新票务服务，使其指向新的本地来源。

zh.explanation:
票务服务运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Linux EC2 实例上。定价文件已经存在于 Amazon S3 Standard 中，并且会频繁更新，但每个实例只在实例启动时下载该文件。陈旧数据问题的出现，是因为长期运行的实例会继续使用旧的本地副本。

**正确答案：C. 将 Mountpoint for Amazon S3 加载到 EC2 实例的 AMI 上，挂载 S3 存储桶，并更新服务以从挂载点读取定价文件。**

[Mountpoint for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html) 是一个开源文件客户端，可将 S3 存储桶挂载为本地文件系统。它让应用程序可以通过文件操作（例如 `open` 和 `read`）访问 S3 对象，并将这些操作转换为 S3 对象 API 调用。同一文档说明，Mountpoint 适用于 Linux 操作系统，并且可以访问所有存储类中的 S3 对象，但面向归档的存储类（如 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive）除外。这与 Linux EC2 机群和 S3 Standard 定价文件相匹配。

此解决方案最具成本效益，因为它将 S3 保持为事实来源，并避免引入新的数据库、共享文件系统或块存储同步设计。应用程序不再读取启动时的副本，而是通过文件路径读取 S3 对象。Amazon S3 对 PUT 请求提供[强读后写一致性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)，包括覆盖现有对象，并且成功 PUT 后的 GET 或 LIST 请求会返回该 PUT 写入的数据。因此，在第三方系统成功更新 S3 中的定价文件后，后续通过已挂载 S3 路径进行的读取可以检索当前对象，而不是过时的本地文件。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. Lambda + DynamoDB**：通过将定价文件转换为数据库记录，此方案可以实现，但它需要摄取流程、DynamoDB 表，以及将应用程序更改为执行数据库查询。需求是以最具成本效益的方式解决对 S3 中现有文件的陈旧访问问题，而不是将定价系统重新设计为由数据库支持的查询服务。

- **B. Lambda + Amazon EFS**：Amazon EFS 可以由多个 EC2 实例挂载，并可由多个 NFS 客户端并发访问，如 [How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html) 中所述。但是，此选项会增加一个托管文件系统，以及一个从 S3 到 EFS 的基于 Lambda 的复制流程。由于权威文件已经在 S3 中，使用 EFS 作为额外的同步副本比通过 Mountpoint 直接读取 S3 对象更复杂且成本效益更低。

- **D. EBS Multi-Attach**：这不是适合 Auto Scaling 机群的共享文件解决方案。[EBS Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html) 仅限于 Provisioned IOPS SSD 卷，只能将一个卷附加到同一 Availability Zone 中的实例，并支持最多附加到 16 个基于 Nitro 的实例。文档还指出，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非设计用于由多台服务器同时访问。此外，仅在新实例启动时更新文件，并不能处理每 1–15 分钟发生一次的更新。

因此，**选项 C** 是最佳答案，因为它直接解决了启动时下载导致的陈旧数据问题，使用现有的 S3 Standard 对象作为事实来源，适合 Linux EC2 环境，并避免了 DynamoDB、EFS 或 EBS Multi-Attach 带来的额外成本和运营复杂性。

en.question: A company has an application that uses Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The quality assurance (QA) department needs to launch a large number of short-lived environments to test the application. The application environments are currently launched by the manager of the department using an AWS CloudFormation template. To launch the stack, the manager uses a role with permission to use CloudFormation, EC2, and Auto Scaling APIs. The manager wants to allow testers to launch their own environments, but does not want to grant broad permissions to each user. Which set up would achieve these goals?

options.A: Upload the AWS CloudFormation template to Amazon S3. Give users in the QA department permission to assume the manager’s role and add a policy that restricts the permissions to the template and the resources it creates. Train users to launch the template from the CloudFormation console.
options.B: Create an AWS Service Catalog product from the environment template. Add a launch constraint to the product with the existing role. Give users in the QA department permission to use AWS Service Catalog APIs only. Train users to launch the template from the AWS Service Catalog console.
options.C: Upload the AWS CloudFormation template to Amazon S3. Give users in the QA department permission to use CloudFormation and S3 APIs, with conditions that restrict the permissions to the template and the resources it creates. Train users to launch the template from the CloudFormation console.
options.D: Create an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application from the environment template. Give users in the QA department permission to use Elastic Beanstalk permissions only. Train users to launch Elastic Beanstalk environments with the Elastic Beanstalk CLI, passing the existing role to the environment as a service role.

en.explanation:
The company needs a **self-service provisioning** mechanism for QA testers to launch approved, short-lived application environments, while avoiding broad direct permissions to CloudFormation, EC2, and Auto Scaling.

**Correct answer: B. Create an AWS Service Catalog product from the environment template and add a launch constraint with the existing role.**

AWS Service Catalog is designed for exactly this pattern: administrators publish approved products, and end users can launch only the products they are allowed to access. The AWS documentation states that Service Catalog provides **self-service discovery and launch**, where users can browse products they have access to and launch them themselves, and also provides **fine-grained access control** through portfolios, constraints, and IAM access grants ([What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)).

A Service Catalog **launch constraint** specifies the IAM role that AWS Service Catalog assumes when an end user launches, updates, or terminates a product. The documentation specifically explains that, without a launch constraint, end users must have permissions for CloudFormation, the AWS services used by the product, and Service Catalog. However, by using a launch role, administrators can limit end-user permissions to the minimum required for that product ([AWS Service Catalog Launch Constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/constraints-launch.html)). Therefore, testers can be granted only the required Service Catalog end-user permissions, while Service Catalog uses the existing role to create the CloudFormation, EC2, and Auto Scaling resources.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Upload the template to S3 and let users assume the manager’s role.**  
This would expose the manager’s role to many testers. Even if additional restrictions are attempted, this is more complex and less aligned with least privilege than using Service Catalog launch constraints. The requirement is to avoid broad permissions for each user; allowing users to assume the existing operational role risks granting broader capabilities than needed.

**C. Give users CloudFormation and S3 permissions with conditions.**  
This still requires users to interact directly with CloudFormation and potentially with the underlying template and stack resources. AWS documentation notes that without a Service Catalog launch constraint, end users must have permissions for CloudFormation and the services used by the product. That is exactly what the company wants to avoid.

**D. Create an Elastic Beanstalk application from the environment template.**  
Elastic Beanstalk is not the appropriate control mechanism here. The application is already defined as a CloudFormation-based environment with EC2 instances and an Auto Scaling group. The requirement is not to migrate the application platform, but to provide controlled self-service provisioning of the existing template. Service Catalog is purpose-built for publishing approved CloudFormation products with launch constraints.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。质量保证（QA）部门需要启动大量短生命周期环境来测试该应用程序。目前，这些应用程序环境由该部门经理使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板启动。为了启动该堆栈，经理使用一个具有使用 CloudFormation、EC2 和 Auto Scaling API 权限的角色。经理希望允许测试人员启动自己的环境，但不想向每个用户授予广泛权限。哪种设置可以实现这些目标？

options.A: 将 AWS CloudFormation 模板上传到 Amazon S3。授予 QA 部门的用户代入经理角色的权限，并添加一项策略，将权限限制为该模板及其创建的资源。培训用户从 CloudFormation 控制台启动该模板。
options.B: 从环境模板创建一个 AWS Service Catalog 产品。为该产品添加使用现有角色的启动约束。仅授予 QA 部门的用户使用 AWS Service Catalog API 的权限。培训用户从 AWS Service Catalog 控制台启动该模板。
options.C: 将 AWS CloudFormation 模板上传到 Amazon S3。授予 QA 部门的用户使用 CloudFormation 和 S3 API 的权限，并使用条件将权限限制为该模板及其创建的资源。培训用户从 CloudFormation 控制台启动该模板。
options.D: 从环境模板创建一个 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序。仅授予 QA 部门的用户使用 Elastic Beanstalk 的权限。培训用户使用 Elastic Beanstalk CLI 启动 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，并将现有角色作为服务角色传递给该环境。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一种 **自助式预置** 机制，使 QA 测试人员能够启动已获批准的、短生命周期的应用程序环境，同时避免直接授予对 CloudFormation、EC2 和 Auto Scaling 的广泛权限。

**正确答案：B. 从环境模板创建一个 AWS Service Catalog 产品，并添加使用现有角色的启动约束。**

AWS Service Catalog 正是为这种模式而设计的：管理员发布已批准的产品，最终用户只能启动其有权访问的产品。AWS 文档说明，Service Catalog 提供 **自助式发现和启动**，用户可以浏览他们有权访问的产品并自行启动这些产品；同时还通过组合、约束和 IAM 访问授权提供 **细粒度访问控制**（[What Is Service Catalog?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。

Service Catalog **启动约束** 指定 AWS Service Catalog 在最终用户启动、更新或终止产品时所代入的 IAM 角色。文档明确解释说，如果没有启动约束，最终用户必须拥有 CloudFormation、产品所使用的 AWS 服务以及 Service Catalog 的权限。但是，通过使用启动角色，管理员可以将最终用户权限限制为该产品所需的最低权限（[AWS Service Catalog Launch Constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/constraints-launch.html)）。因此，可以只向测试人员授予所需的 Service Catalog 最终用户权限，而 Service Catalog 使用现有角色来创建 CloudFormation、EC2 和 Auto Scaling 资源。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 将模板上传到 S3，并让用户代入经理角色。**  
这会将经理角色暴露给许多测试人员。即使尝试添加额外限制，这也比使用 Service Catalog 启动约束更复杂，并且更不符合最小权限原则。要求是避免为每个用户授予广泛权限；允许用户代入现有运维角色会带来授予超出所需能力的风险。

**C. 使用条件授予用户 CloudFormation 和 S3 权限。**  
这仍然要求用户直接与 CloudFormation 交互，并可能直接接触底层模板和堆栈资源。AWS 文档指出，如果没有 Service Catalog 启动约束，最终用户必须拥有 CloudFormation 以及产品所使用服务的权限。这正是该公司想要避免的情况。

**D. 从环境模板创建一个 Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序。**  
Elastic Beanstalk 不是这里合适的控制机制。该应用程序已经被定义为一个基于 CloudFormation 的环境，其中包含 EC2 实例和 Auto Scaling 组。要求不是迁移应用程序平台，而是为现有模板提供受控的自助式预置。Service Catalog 专为发布带有启动约束的已批准 CloudFormation 产品而构建。

en.question: A company is using a single AWS Region for its ecommerce website. The website includes a web application that runs on several Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website also includes an Amazon DynamoDB table. A custom domain name in Amazon Route 53 is linked to the ALB. The company created an SSL/TLS certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) and attached the certificate to the ALB. The company is not using a content delivery network as part of its design.
