The company wants to replicate its entire application stack in a second Region to provide disaster recovery, plan for future growth, and provide improved access time to users. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that achieves these goals and minimizes administrative overhead. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS CloudFormation template for the current infrastructure design. Use parameters for important system values, including Region. Use the CloudFormation template to create the new infrastructure in the second Region.
options.B: Use the AWS Management Console to document the existing infrastructure design in the first Region and to create the new infrastructure in the second Region.
options.C: Update the Route 53 hosted zone record for the application to use weighted routing. Send 50% of the traffic to the ALB in each Region.
options.D: Update the Route 53 hosted zone record for the application to use latency-based routing. Send traffic to the ALB in each Region.
options.E: Update the configuration of the existing DynamoDB table by enabling DynamoDB Streams. Add the second Region to create a global table.
options.F: Create a new DynamoDB table. Enable DynamoDB Streams for the new table. Add the second Region to create a global table. Copy the data from the existing DynamoDB table to the new table as a one-time operation.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company has a single-Region ecommerce stack: EC2 web tier behind an ALB, Route 53 custom domain, ACM certificate on the ALB, and a DynamoDB table. It wants to replicate the stack into a second Region for disaster recovery, future growth, and better access time for users, while minimizing administrative overhead.

## Correct answers: A, D, E

### A. Create an AWS CloudFormation template for the current infrastructure design and use parameters, including Region

This is correct. CloudFormation is the right tool to define infrastructure as code and deploy the same stack consistently in another Region. AWS documentation explicitly states that you can reuse a CloudFormation template to replicate resources across multiple Regions in a consistent and repeatable manner, and that CloudFormation helps manage collections of resources as a single unit ([CloudFormation: Simplify infrastructure management / Quickly replicate your infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Using parameters for values that differ by Region or environment reduces manual work and supports future growth.

### D. Update Route 53 to use latency-based routing to send traffic to the ALB in each Region

This is correct. The company wants improved access time to users, not merely an arbitrary traffic split. Route 53 latency-based routing is designed for applications hosted in multiple AWS Regions and routes users to the Region that provides the lowest latency ([Route 53 latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)).

This also supports an active/active multi-Region design when both regional ALBs are healthy and available.

### E. Enable DynamoDB Streams on the existing table and add the second Region to create a global table

This is correct. DynamoDB global tables provide fully managed multi-Region replication and fast local read/write performance for globally scaled applications. AWS documentation states that global tables automatically replicate DynamoDB table data across AWS Regions and are suitable for business continuity and high availability through multi-Region deployment ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). Same-account global tables also automatically replicate data across chosen Regions and provide higher availability during regional isolation or degradation ([DynamoDB same-account global table](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/globaltables-SameAccount.html)).

The existing table can have DynamoDB Streams enabled; AWS documentation states that streams can be enabled on an existing table ([DynamoDB Streams: Enabling a stream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)). This avoids building and maintaining a custom replication process and minimizes administrative overhead.

## Incorrect options

### B. Use the AWS Management Console to document and manually create the infrastructure in the second Region

This is incorrect because it increases administrative overhead and risk of configuration drift or human error. The requirement is to minimize administrative overhead. CloudFormation is specifically intended to define resources once and provision them repeatedly and consistently, including in multiple Regions ([CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

### C. Use weighted routing and send 50% of traffic to each Region

This is incorrect because weighted routing splits traffic according to configured weights. A 50/50 split does not necessarily improve user access time because users might be routed to a farther Region. The stated requirement includes improved access time, which aligns with latency-based routing, where Route 53 selects the Region with the lowest latency for the user ([Route 53 latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)).

### F. Create a new DynamoDB table, enable Streams, create a global table, and copy data one time

This is incorrect because a one-time data copy does not provide continuous replication from the existing production table. It also adds migration complexity and administrative overhead. DynamoDB global tables are the managed mechanism for automatic multi-Region replication of table data ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)), and the existing table can be updated by enabling Streams rather than replacing the table ([DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为其电子商务网站使用单个 AWS Region。该网站包含一个运行在多个 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 应用程序，这些实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。该网站还包含一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。Amazon Route 53 中的自定义域名已链接到 ALB。公司在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中创建了 SSL/TLS 证书，并将该证书附加到 ALB。公司在其设计中没有使用内容分发网络。公司希望在第二个 Region 中复制其整个应用程序堆栈，以提供灾难恢复、为未来增长做准备，并为用户提供更好的访问时间。解决方案架构师需要实施一个满足这些目标并最大限度减少管理开销的解决方案。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为当前基础设施设计创建 AWS CloudFormation 模板。为重要的系统值使用参数，包括 Region。使用该 CloudFormation 模板在第二个 Region 中创建新的基础设施。
options.B: 使用 AWS Management Console 记录第一个 Region 中现有的基础设施设计，并在第二个 Region 中创建新的基础设施。
options.C: 更新应用程序的 Route 53 托管区域记录，以使用加权路由。将 50% 的流量发送到每个 Region 中的 ALB。
options.D: 更新应用程序的 Route 53 托管区域记录，以使用基于延迟的路由。将流量发送到每个 Region 中的 ALB。
options.E: 通过启用 DynamoDB Streams 来更新现有 DynamoDB 表的配置。添加第二个 Region 以创建全局表。
options.F: 创建一个新的 DynamoDB 表。为新表启用 DynamoDB Streams。添加第二个 Region 以创建全局表。将现有 DynamoDB 表中的数据作为一次性操作复制到新表。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司拥有一个单 Region 的电子商务堆栈：位于 ALB 后面的 EC2 Web 层、Route 53 自定义域名、ALB 上的 ACM 证书，以及一个 DynamoDB 表。公司希望将该堆栈复制到第二个 Region，用于灾难恢复、未来增长，并为用户提供更好的访问时间，同时最大限度减少管理开销。

## 正确答案：A、D、E

### A. 为当前基础设施设计创建 AWS CloudFormation 模板并使用参数，包括 Region

这是正确的。CloudFormation 是将基础设施定义为代码并在另一个 Region 中一致部署相同堆栈的合适工具。AWS 文档明确说明，你可以重复使用 CloudFormation 模板，以一致且可重复的方式跨多个 Region 复制资源，并且 CloudFormation 可帮助将资源集合作为单个单元进行管理（[CloudFormation: Simplify infrastructure management / Quickly replicate your infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

为因 Region 或环境而不同的值使用参数，可以减少手动工作并支持未来增长。

### D. 更新 Route 53 以使用基于延迟的路由，将流量发送到每个 Region 中的 ALB

这是正确的。公司希望改善用户访问时间，而不仅仅是任意拆分流量。Route 53 基于延迟的路由专为托管在多个 AWS Region 中的应用程序而设计，会将用户路由到提供最低延迟的 Region（[Route 53 latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)）。

当两个区域性 ALB 都健康且可用时，这也支持 active/active 多 Region 设计。

### E. 在现有表上启用 DynamoDB Streams，并添加第二个 Region 以创建全局表

这是正确的。DynamoDB global tables 提供完全托管的多 Region 复制，并为全球扩展的应用程序提供快速的本地读/写性能。AWS 文档说明，global tables 会自动跨 AWS Region 复制 DynamoDB 表数据，适用于通过多 Region 部署实现业务连续性和高可用性（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。同一账户的 global tables 还会自动跨所选 Region 复制数据，并在区域隔离或性能下降期间提供更高可用性（[DynamoDB same-account global table](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/globaltables-SameAccount.html)）。

可以为现有表启用 DynamoDB Streams；AWS 文档说明，可以在现有表上启用流（[DynamoDB Streams: Enabling a stream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。这避免了构建和维护自定义复制流程，并最大限度减少管理开销。

## 错误选项

### B. 使用 AWS Management Console 记录并在第二个 Region 中手动创建基础设施

这是不正确的，因为它会增加管理开销以及配置漂移或人为错误的风险。要求是最大限度减少管理开销。CloudFormation 专门用于一次定义资源，并以可重复且一致的方式预置这些资源，包括在多个 Region 中（[CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

### C. 使用加权路由并将 50% 的流量发送到每个 Region

这是不正确的，因为加权路由会根据配置的权重拆分流量。50/50 拆分不一定能改善用户访问时间，因为用户可能会被路由到更远的 Region。题目要求包括改善访问时间，这与基于延迟的路由相一致，在该路由中 Route 53 会为用户选择延迟最低的 Region（[Route 53 latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)）。

### F. 创建新的 DynamoDB 表，启用 Streams，创建全局表，并一次性复制数据

这是不正确的，因为一次性数据复制无法从现有生产表提供持续复制。它还会增加迁移复杂性和管理开销。DynamoDB global tables 是用于自动进行表数据多 Region 复制的托管机制（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)），并且可以通过启用 Streams 来更新现有表，而不是替换该表（[DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to create a single Amazon S3 bucket for its data scientists to store work-related documents. The company uses AWS IAM Identity Center to authenticate all users. A group for the data scientists was created. The company wants to give the data scientists access to only their own work. The company also wants to create monthly reports that show which documents each user accessed. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a custom IAM Identity Center permission set to grant the data scientists access to an S3 bucket prefix that matches their username tag. Use a policy to limit access to paths with the ${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}/* condition.
options.B: Create an IAM Identity Center role for the data scientists group that has Amazon S3 read access and write access. Add an S3 bucket policy that allows access to the IAM Identity Center role.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to log S3 data events and deliver the logs to an S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to run queries on the CloudTrail logs in Amazon S3 and generate reports.
options.D: Configure AWS CloudTrail to log S3 management events to CloudWatch. Use Amazon Athena’s CloudWatch connector to query the logs and generate reports.
options.E: Enable S3 access logging to EMR File System (EMRFS). Use Amazon S3 Select to query logs and generate reports.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs two capabilities for one shared S3 bucket:

1. **Per-user isolation**: each data scientist can access only the objects under that user's own prefix.
2. **Monthly access reporting**: the company can determine which S3 documents each user accessed.

The correct combination is **A and C**.

## Correct answers

### A. Create a custom IAM Identity Center permission set using a user attribute/principal tag for the S3 prefix

IAM Identity Center supports attribute-based access control (ABAC). AWS documentation states that IAM Identity Center passes selected user attributes to the target AWS account as session tags, and those tags can be referenced in IAM policies with the `aws:PrincipalTag/tag-key` condition key ([IAM Identity Center attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/attributesforaccesscontrol.html)). The ABAC configuration documentation also notes that the key name used in IAM Identity Center must match the `aws:PrincipalTag` key used in policies ([Select your attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/configure-abac-attributes.html)).

For S3, AWS provides the same general pattern for isolating each user to a folder/prefix: a single policy can use a policy variable in the S3 object ARN and `s3:prefix` conditions so that each requester is limited to that requester's own folder ([S3 identity-based policy example: allowing each IAM user access to a folder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-policies-s3.html)). In this scenario, because users authenticate through IAM Identity Center, the user-specific value should be provided as an IAM Identity Center session tag, such as `${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}`, rather than relying on an IAM user name.

Therefore, a custom IAM Identity Center permission set with an S3 policy scoped to a prefix such as `bucket/${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}/*` meets the per-user isolation requirement.

### C. Configure CloudTrail S3 data events and query the logs with Athena

CloudTrail **data events** are required to record S3 object-level activity. AWS documentation explicitly lists Amazon S3 object-level API activity such as `GetObject`, `DeleteObject`, and `PutObject` as CloudTrail data events ([CloudTrail logging data events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/logging-data-events-with-cloudtrail.html)). These are the events needed to determine which documents each user accessed.

Athena can query CloudTrail log files that CloudTrail stores in Amazon S3. The Athena documentation states that CloudTrail records AWS API calls, stores encrypted log files in S3, and that Athena can query those log files directly from S3 for analysis by attributes such as user and activity ([Query AWS CloudTrail logs with Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/cloudtrail-logs.html)). This supports generating monthly reports of document access.

## Incorrect answers

### B. Create an IAM Identity Center role with broad S3 read/write access and allow it in the bucket policy

This does not restrict users to only their own work. If the group role has general S3 read/write access and the bucket policy allows that role, all data scientists using that role could access the same permitted objects. It lacks the per-user prefix isolation provided by ABAC/session tags.

### D. Log S3 management events to CloudWatch and query with Athena’s CloudWatch connector

S3 document access is object-level activity, such as `GetObject`, not merely S3 management activity. CloudTrail data events, not management events, are the correct event type for S3 object access logging. Also, the standard Athena pattern for this use case is querying CloudTrail logs delivered to S3.

### E. Enable S3 access logging to EMRFS and use S3 Select

S3 server access logging is not described here in a valid architecture: EMRFS is not a log delivery destination for S3 server access logs, and S3 Select is not an appropriate reporting/query engine for aggregating monthly user access reports across CloudTrail-style audit logs. CloudTrail data events plus Athena is the AWS-native audit and analytics solution for object-level API access reporting.

## Final answer

**A and C**

zh.question: 一家公司希望创建一个单独的 Amazon S3 存储桶，供其数据科学家存储与工作相关的文档。该公司使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 对所有用户进行身份验证。已为数据科学家创建了一个组。该公司希望只允许数据科学家访问他们自己的工作内容。该公司还希望创建月度报告，显示每个用户访问了哪些文档。哪两个步骤的组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个自定义 IAM Identity Center 权限集，授予数据科学家访问与其用户名标签匹配的 S3 存储桶前缀的权限。使用策略通过 ${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}/* 条件限制对路径的访问。
options.B: 为数据科学家组创建一个具有 Amazon S3 读取和写入访问权限的 IAM Identity Center 角色。添加一个允许该 IAM Identity Center 角色访问的 S3 存储桶策略。
options.C: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 记录 S3 数据事件，并将日志传送到 S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Athena 对 Amazon S3 中的 CloudTrail 日志运行查询并生成报告。
options.D: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 将 S3 管理事件记录到 CloudWatch。使用 Amazon Athena 的 CloudWatch 连接器查询日志并生成报告。
options.E: 启用到 EMR File System (EMRFS) 的 S3 访问日志记录。使用 Amazon S3 Select 查询日志并生成报告。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要为一个共享的 S3 存储桶实现两项功能：

1. **按用户隔离**：每位数据科学家只能访问其自己前缀下的对象。
2. **月度访问报告**：公司可以确定每个用户访问了哪些 S3 文档。

正确组合是 **A 和 C**。

## 正确答案

### A. 使用用于 S3 前缀的用户属性/主体标签创建自定义 IAM Identity Center 权限集

IAM Identity Center 支持基于属性的访问控制 (ABAC)。AWS 文档说明，IAM Identity Center 会将选定的用户属性作为会话标签传递到目标 AWS 账户，并且这些标签可以在 IAM 策略中通过 `aws:PrincipalTag/tag-key` 条件键引用（[IAM Identity Center attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/attributesforaccesscontrol.html)）。ABAC 配置文档还指出，在 IAM Identity Center 中使用的键名称必须与策略中使用的 `aws:PrincipalTag` 键匹配（[Select your attributes for access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/configure-abac-attributes.html)）。

对于 S3，AWS 提供了相同的一般模式，用于将每个用户隔离到一个文件夹/前缀：单个策略可以在 S3 对象 ARN 和 `s3:prefix` 条件中使用策略变量，使每个请求者仅限于访问该请求者自己的文件夹（[S3 identity-based policy example: allowing each IAM user access to a folder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-policies-s3.html)）。在此场景中，由于用户通过 IAM Identity Center 进行身份验证，因此用户特定值应作为 IAM Identity Center 会话标签提供，例如 `${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}`，而不是依赖 IAM 用户名。

因此，使用范围限定到某个前缀（例如 `bucket/${aws:PrincipalTag/userName}/*`）的 S3 策略创建自定义 IAM Identity Center 权限集，可以满足按用户隔离的要求。

### C. 配置 CloudTrail S3 数据事件并使用 Athena 查询日志

需要使用 CloudTrail **数据事件** 来记录 S3 对象级活动。AWS 文档明确将 Amazon S3 对象级 API 活动（例如 `GetObject`、`DeleteObject` 和 `PutObject`）列为 CloudTrail 数据事件（[CloudTrail logging data events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/logging-data-events-with-cloudtrail.html)）。这些事件正是确定每个用户访问了哪些文档所需的事件。

Athena 可以查询 CloudTrail 存储在 Amazon S3 中的 CloudTrail 日志文件。Athena 文档说明，CloudTrail 会记录 AWS API 调用，将加密日志文件存储在 S3 中，并且 Athena 可以直接从 S3 查询这些日志文件，以便按用户和活动等属性进行分析（[Query AWS CloudTrail logs with Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/cloudtrail-logs.html)）。这支持生成文档访问的月度报告。

## 错误答案

### B. 创建具有广泛 S3 读/写访问权限的 IAM Identity Center 角色，并在存储桶策略中允许该角色

这不会限制用户只能访问自己的工作内容。如果组角色具有通用 S3 读/写访问权限，并且存储桶策略允许该角色，则所有使用该角色的数据科学家都可以访问相同的被允许对象。它缺少 ABAC/会话标签所提供的按用户前缀隔离。

### D. 将 S3 管理事件记录到 CloudWatch，并使用 Athena 的 CloudWatch 连接器查询

S3 文档访问是对象级活动，例如 `GetObject`，而不仅仅是 S3 管理活动。对于 S3 对象访问日志记录，正确的事件类型是 CloudTrail 数据事件，而不是管理事件。此外，此使用案例的标准 Athena 模式是查询传送到 S3 的 CloudTrail 日志。

### E. 启用 S3 访问日志记录到 EMRFS，并使用 S3 Select

此处的 S3 服务器访问日志记录并不是一个有效架构：EMRFS 不是 S3 服务器访问日志的日志传送目标，并且 S3 Select 也不是适合跨 CloudTrail 风格审计日志聚合月度用户访问报告的报告/查询引擎。CloudTrail 数据事件加 Athena 是用于对象级 API 访问报告的 AWS 原生审计和分析解决方案。

## 最终答案

**A 和 C**

en.question: A company hosts a data-processing application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application polls an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for newly uploaded files. When a new file is detected, the application extracts data from the file and runs logic to select a Docker container image to process the file. The application starts the appropriate container image and passes the file location as a parameter. The data processing that the container performs can take up to 2 hours. When the processing is complete, the code that runs inside the container writes the file back to Amazon EFS and exits. The company needs to refactor the application to eliminate the EC2 instances that are running the containers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Configure the processing to run as AWS Fargate tasks. Extract the container selection logic to run as an Amazon EventBridge rule that starts the appropriate Fargate task. Configure the EventBridge rule to run when files are added to the EFS file system.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Configure the processing to run as AWS Fargate tasks. Update and containerize the container selection logic to run as a Fargate service that starts the appropriate Fargate task. Configure an EFS event notification to invoke the Fargate service when files are added to the EFS file system.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. Configure the processing to run as AWS Fargate tasks. Extract the container selection logic to run as an AWS Lambda function that starts the appropriate Fargate task. Migrate the storage of file uploads to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the processing code to use Amazon S3. Configure an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function when objects are created.
options.D: Create AWS Lambda container images for the processing. Configure Lambda functions to use the container images. Extract the container selection logic to run as a decision Lambda function that invokes the appropriate Lambda processing function. Migrate the storage of file uploads to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the processing code to use Amazon S3. Configure an S3 event notification to invoke the decision Lambda function when objects are created.

en.explanation:
The application currently uses EC2 instances mainly to poll storage, choose a container image, and run a Docker container for a long-running file-processing job. The requirement is to eliminate the EC2 instances that run the containers while still supporting processing jobs that can run for up to 2 hours and triggering processing when new files arrive.

**Correct answer: C.**

Option C replaces the polling/EFS model with an event-driven S3 model. Amazon S3 supports **new object created** event notifications and can send those notifications directly to an **AWS Lambda function** as a destination ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). The Lambda function can contain the lightweight container-selection logic and call Amazon ECS `RunTask` to start the selected processing task. Amazon ECS tasks can run on **AWS Fargate**, where AWS manages the underlying infrastructure, so the company does not need to provision or manage EC2 container instances ([Amazon ECS standalone tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/standalone-tasks.html)). This also keeps the long-running, up-to-2-hour processing outside Lambda and inside ECS/Fargate, which is appropriate for containerized batch processing.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect.** EventBridge can use ECS tasks as targets and pass parameters through to `ecs.RunTask` ([EventBridge ECS tasks as targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)), but the option depends on an EventBridge rule that runs when files are added to an EFS file system. Amazon EFS EventBridge integration is for EFS service/API events delivered through CloudTrail, such as EFS API calls, not per-file creation notifications inside the file system ([Amazon EFS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/ref/events-ref-elasticfilesystem.html)). Therefore, this does not provide the required event trigger for newly uploaded files.

- **B is incorrect.** It assumes an “EFS event notification” that invokes a Fargate service when files are added. EFS does not provide S3-like object-created/file-created event notifications. The official EventBridge reference for EFS describes EFS service events via CloudTrail/API events, not file-level notifications ([Amazon EFS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/ref/events-ref-elasticfilesystem.html)).

- **D is incorrect.** Lambda container images only change the packaging format for Lambda functions; they do not remove the Lambda execution-time limit. Lambda functions can run for a maximum of **900 seconds / 15 minutes** ([Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). Because the processing can take up to **2 hours**, using Lambda functions for the processing containers would not meet the requirement.

Therefore, **C** is the only option that provides event-driven ingestion, eliminates EC2-based container execution, and supports long-running containerized processing by using ECS tasks on Fargate.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个数据处理应用程序。该应用程序轮询 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，以查找新上传的文件。当检测到新文件时，应用程序会从文件中提取数据，并运行逻辑来选择用于处理该文件的 Docker 容器镜像。应用程序启动相应的容器镜像，并将文件位置作为参数传递。容器执行的数据处理最多可能需要 2 小时。处理完成后，在容器内运行的代码会将文件写回 Amazon EFS 并退出。公司需要重构该应用程序，以消除正在运行容器的 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。将处理配置为作为 AWS Fargate 任务运行。将容器选择逻辑提取出来，作为 Amazon EventBridge 规则运行，该规则会启动相应的 Fargate 任务。将 EventBridge 规则配置为在文件添加到 EFS 文件系统时运行。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。将处理配置为作为 AWS Fargate 任务运行。更新容器选择逻辑并将其容器化，使其作为 Fargate 服务运行，该服务会启动相应的 Fargate 任务。配置一个 EFS 事件通知，在文件添加到 EFS 文件系统时调用该 Fargate 服务。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。将处理配置为作为 AWS Fargate 任务运行。将容器选择逻辑提取出来，作为 AWS Lambda 函数运行，该函数会启动相应的 Fargate 任务。将文件上传的存储迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新处理代码以使用 Amazon S3。配置一个 S3 事件通知，在创建对象时调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 为处理创建 AWS Lambda 容器镜像。配置 Lambda 函数以使用这些容器镜像。将容器选择逻辑提取出来，作为决策 Lambda 函数运行，该函数会调用相应的 Lambda 处理函数。将文件上传的存储迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新处理代码以使用 Amazon S3。配置一个 S3 事件通知，在创建对象时调用该决策 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序当前主要使用 EC2 实例来轮询存储、选择容器镜像，并为长时间运行的文件处理作业运行 Docker 容器。要求是消除运行容器的 EC2 实例，同时仍支持最长可运行 2 小时的处理作业，并在新文件到达时触发处理。

**正确答案：C。**

选项 C 将轮询/EFS 模型替换为事件驱动的 S3 模型。Amazon S3 支持 **new object created** 事件通知，并且可以将这些通知直接发送到作为目标的 **AWS Lambda 函数**（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。Lambda 函数可以包含轻量级的容器选择逻辑，并调用 Amazon ECS `RunTask` 来启动所选的处理任务。Amazon ECS 任务可以在 **AWS Fargate** 上运行，由 AWS 管理底层基础设施，因此公司无需预置或管理 EC2 容器实例（[Amazon ECS standalone tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/standalone-tasks.html)）。这也将最长 2 小时的长时间运行处理保留在 Lambda 之外，并放在 ECS/Fargate 中，这适合容器化批处理。

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A 不正确。** EventBridge 可以使用 ECS 任务作为目标，并将参数传递给 `ecs.RunTask`（[EventBridge ECS tasks as targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)），但该选项依赖于一个 EventBridge 规则，该规则在文件添加到 EFS 文件系统时运行。Amazon EFS EventBridge 集成用于通过 CloudTrail 传递的 EFS 服务/API 事件，例如 EFS API 调用，而不是文件系统内按文件创建的通知（[Amazon EFS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/ref/events-ref-elasticfilesystem.html)）。因此，这无法为新上传文件提供所需的事件触发器。

- **B 不正确。** 它假设存在一种“EFS 事件通知”，可在文件添加时调用 Fargate 服务。EFS 不提供类似 S3 的对象创建/文件创建事件通知。EFS 的官方 EventBridge 参考文档描述的是通过 CloudTrail/API 事件提供的 EFS 服务事件，而不是文件级通知（[Amazon EFS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/ref/events-ref-elasticfilesystem.html)）。

- **D 不正确。** Lambda 容器镜像只改变 Lambda 函数的打包格式；它们不会取消 Lambda 执行时间限制。Lambda 函数最长可运行 **900 秒 / 15 分钟**（[Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。由于处理最长可能需要 **2 小时**，使用 Lambda 函数来运行处理容器无法满足要求。

因此，**C** 是唯一能够提供事件驱动摄取、消除基于 EC2 的容器执行，并通过在 Fargate 上使用 ECS 任务来支持长时间运行的容器化处理的选项。

en.question: A media company has a 30-T8 repository of digital news videos. These videos are stored on tape in an on-premises tape library and referenced by a Media Asset Management (MAM) system. The company wants to enrich the metadata for these videos in an automated fashion and put them into a searchable catalog by using a MAM feature. The company must be able to search based on information in the video, such as objects, scenery items, or people’s faces. A catalog is available that contains faces of people who have appeared in the videos that include an image of each person. The company would like to migrate these videos to AWS. The company has a high-speed AWS Direct Connect connection with AWS and would like to move the MAM solution video content directly from its current file system. How can these requirements be met by using the LEAST amount of ongoing management overhead and causing MINIMAL disruption to the existing system?

options.A: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway, file gateway appliance on-premises. Use the MAM solution to extract the videos from the current archive and push them into the file gateway. Use the catalog of faces to build a collection in Amazon Rekognition. Build an AWS Lambda function that invokes the Rekognition Javascript SDK to have Rekognition pull the video from the Amazon S3 files backing the file gateway, retrieve the required metadata, and push the metadata into the MAM solution.
options.B: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway, tape gateway appliance on-premises. Use the MAM solution to extract the videos from the current archive and push them into the tape gateway. Use the catalog of faces to build a collection in Amazon Rekognition. Build an AWS Lambda function that invokes the Rekognition Javascript SDK to have Amazon Rekognition process the video in the tape gateway, retrieve the required metadata, and push the metadata into the MAM solution.
options.C: Configure a video ingestion stream by using Amazon Kinesis Video Streams. Use the catalog of faces to build a collection in Amazon Rekognition. Stream the videos from the MAM solution into Kinesis Video Streams. Configure Amazon Rekognition to process the streamed videos. Then, use a stream consumer to retrieve the required metadata, and push the metadata into the MAM solution. Configure the stream to store the videos in Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the OpenCV libraries. Copy the videos, images, and face catalog from the on-premises library into an Amazon EBS volume mounted on this EC2 instance. Process the videos to retrieve the required metadata, and push the metadata into the MAM solution, while also copying the video files to an Amazon S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
### Scenario and requirement

The company has archived video assets on an on-premises tape library, but the MAM workflow needs to migrate video content into AWS from the current file-based workflow with minimal disruption, then enrich metadata automatically for searchable objects/scenery/people.

### Correct answer: A

**A is the best fit** because Amazon S3 File Gateway provides a file interface to Amazon S3 while preserving a familiar file-share workflow for existing applications. AWS documentation states that S3 File Gateway lets applications store and retrieve objects in S3 using standard file protocols such as NFS and SMB, and that AWS cloud applications and services can access the data directly in Amazon S3 ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). This matches the requirement to move content directly from the current file system with minimal disruption.

After the MAM extracts videos from the tape archive and writes them to the File Gateway share, the files are backed by S3 objects. Amazon Rekognition Video is designed to analyze videos stored in an S3 bucket; the `Video` input specifies the S3 bucket and object name, and the service returns results asynchronously through SNS/SQS or Lambda-driven processing ([Calling Amazon Rekognition Video operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/api-video.html)). Rekognition collections are also the right mechanism for using the existing catalog of known faces: collections store face vectors, are populated with `IndexFaces`, and `StartFaceSearch` can search for faces in a stored video ([Searching faces in a collection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/collections.html)).

This combination minimizes ongoing management overhead by using managed services: Storage Gateway for hybrid transfer into S3, Rekognition for video/face/object analysis, and Lambda for orchestration and pushing metadata back into the MAM.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**B. Tape Gateway**  
Tape Gateway is not the best solution for active metadata processing. AWS describes Tape Gateway as cloud-backed virtual tape storage for archiving backup data in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or S3 Glacier Deep Archive and for eliminating the burden of physical tape infrastructure ([What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). It is intended to replace or augment tape backup/archive workflows, not to expose video files as S3 objects for direct Rekognition processing. Rekognition Video analyzes videos stored in S3 by bucket and object key, not videos “in the tape gateway.” This option also introduces more workflow disruption than a file gateway because the MAM would need to interact with virtual tape semantics rather than a file share.

**C. Kinesis Video Streams**  
Kinesis Video Streams is more appropriate for live or streaming video ingestion. The requirement is to migrate a 30-TB repository of archived video files from an existing MAM/tape system and process stored videos. Rekognition already supports stored-video analysis from S3, so streaming every archived video through Kinesis Video Streams adds unnecessary complexity and management overhead.

**D. EC2 with OpenCV**  
Running OpenCV on EC2 requires managing compute instances, libraries, scaling, fault tolerance, and custom computer-vision logic. It is more operationally intensive than using Rekognition’s managed APIs. It also does not provide the low-disruption file-interface migration path that File Gateway provides.

Therefore, **A** satisfies the migration, searchable metadata enrichment, face catalog matching, low disruption, and low ongoing management overhead requirements.

zh.question: 一家媒体公司有一个 30-TB 的数字新闻视频存储库。这些视频存储在本地磁带库中的磁带上，并由一个媒体资产管理（MAM）系统引用。该公司希望以自动化方式丰富这些视频的元数据，并使用 MAM 的一项功能将它们放入可搜索目录中。公司必须能够根据视频中的信息进行搜索，例如物体、场景物品或人物面孔。现有一个目录，其中包含曾出现在这些视频中的人员面孔，并且包含每个人的一张图像。公司希望将这些视频迁移到 AWS。公司与 AWS 之间有一条高速 AWS Direct Connect 连接，并希望直接从当前文件系统移动 MAM 解决方案的视频内容。如何使用最少的持续管理开销并对现有系统造成最小中断来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在本地设置一个 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway 设备。使用 MAM 解决方案从当前归档中提取视频，并将它们推送到 file gateway。使用面孔目录在 Amazon Rekognition 中构建一个集合。构建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，调用 Rekognition Javascript SDK，让 Rekognition 从支撑 file gateway 的 Amazon S3 文件中拉取视频，检索所需元数据，并将元数据推送到 MAM 解决方案。
options.B: 在本地设置一个 AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway 设备。使用 MAM 解决方案从当前归档中提取视频，并将它们推送到 tape gateway。使用面孔目录在 Amazon Rekognition 中构建一个集合。构建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，调用 Rekognition Javascript SDK，让 Amazon Rekognition 处理 tape gateway 中的视频，检索所需元数据，并将元数据推送到 MAM 解决方案。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Video Streams 配置一个视频摄取流。使用面孔目录在 Amazon Rekognition 中构建一个集合。将视频从 MAM 解决方案流式传输到 Kinesis Video Streams。配置 Amazon Rekognition 处理流式视频。然后，使用流消费者检索所需元数据，并将元数据推送到 MAM 解决方案。配置该流将视频存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.D: 设置一个运行 OpenCV 库的 Amazon EC2 实例。将视频、图像和面孔目录从本地库复制到挂载在该 EC2 实例上的 Amazon EBS 卷中。处理视频以检索所需元数据，并将元数据推送到 MAM 解决方案，同时还将视频文件复制到 Amazon S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
### 场景和要求

该公司在本地磁带库中归档了视频资产，但 MAM 工作流需要以最小中断从当前基于文件的工作流将视频内容迁移到 AWS，然后自动丰富元数据，以便按物体/场景/人物进行搜索。

### 正确答案：A

**A 是最佳选择**，因为 Amazon S3 File Gateway 为 Amazon S3 提供文件接口，同时为现有应用程序保留熟悉的文件共享工作流。AWS 文档指出，S3 File Gateway 使应用程序能够使用 NFS 和 SMB 等标准文件协议在 S3 中存储和检索对象，并且 AWS 云应用程序和服务可以直接访问 Amazon S3 中的数据（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。这符合直接从当前文件系统移动内容并将中断降至最低的要求。

在 MAM 从磁带归档中提取视频并将其写入 File Gateway 共享后，这些文件由 S3 对象支撑。Amazon Rekognition Video 旨在分析存储在 S3 存储桶中的视频；`Video` 输入指定 S3 存储桶和对象名称，并且该服务通过 SNS/SQS 或 Lambda 驱动的处理异步返回结果（[Calling Amazon Rekognition Video operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/api-video.html)）。Rekognition collections 也是使用现有已知面孔目录的正确机制：collections 存储面孔向量，通过 `IndexFaces` 填充，并且 `StartFaceSearch` 可以在存储的视频中搜索面孔（[Searching faces in a collection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/collections.html)）。

这种组合通过使用托管服务最大限度减少持续管理开销：Storage Gateway 用于混合传输到 S3，Rekognition 用于视频/面孔/物体分析，Lambda 用于编排并将元数据推送回 MAM。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. Tape Gateway**  
Tape Gateway 不是主动元数据处理的最佳解决方案。AWS 将 Tape Gateway 描述为云支持的虚拟磁带存储，用于将备份数据归档到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 或 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并用于消除物理磁带基础设施的负担（[What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。它旨在替代或增强磁带备份/归档工作流，而不是将视频文件作为 S3 对象暴露给 Rekognition 直接处理。Rekognition Video 通过存储桶和对象键分析存储在 S3 中的视频，而不是分析“tape gateway 中”的视频。此选项还比 file gateway 引入更多工作流中断，因为 MAM 需要与虚拟磁带语义交互，而不是与文件共享交互。

**C. Kinesis Video Streams**  
Kinesis Video Streams 更适用于实时或流式视频摄取。要求是从现有 MAM/磁带系统迁移 30-TB 的归档视频文件存储库并处理已存储的视频。Rekognition 已经支持从 S3 进行存储视频分析，因此通过 Kinesis Video Streams 流式传输每个归档视频会增加不必要的复杂性和管理开销。

**D. EC2 with OpenCV**  
在 EC2 上运行 OpenCV 需要管理计算实例、库、扩展、容错和自定义计算机视觉逻辑。与使用 Rekognition 的托管 API 相比，它的运维强度更高。它也不提供 File Gateway 所提供的低中断文件接口迁移路径。

因此，**A** 满足迁移、可搜索元数据丰富、面孔目录匹配、低中断和低持续管理开销的要求。

en.question: A company needs to optimize the cost of an AWS environment that contains multiple accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company conducted cost optimization activities 3 years ago and purchased Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances that recently expired. The company needs EC2 instances for 3 more years. Additionally, the company has deployed a new serverless workload. Which strategy will provide the company with the MOST cost savings?

options.A: Purchase the same Reserved Instances for an additional 3-year term with All Upfront payment. Purchase a 3-year Compute Savings Plan with All Upfront payment in the management account to cover any additional compute costs
options.B: Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan with No Upfront payment in each member account. Use the Savings Plans recommendations in the AWS Cost Management console to choose the Compute Savings Plan.
options.C: Purchase a 3-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with No Upfront payment in the management account to cover EC2 costs in each AWS Region. Purchase a 3-year Compute Savings Plan with No Upfront payment in the management account to cover any additional compute costs.
options.D: Purchase a 3-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with All Upfront payment in each member account. Use the Savings Plans recommendations in the AWS Cost Management console to choose the EC2 Instance Savings Plan.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company has a multi-account AWS Organizations environment. Its previous 3-year EC2 Standard Reserved Instances have expired, and the EC2 workload is still needed for another 3 years. It has also added a new serverless workload. The question asks for the strategy that gives the **most cost savings**, not the most flexibility.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Purchase the same Reserved Instances for an additional 3-year term with All Upfront payment. Purchase a 3-year Compute Savings Plan with All Upfront payment in the management account to cover any additional compute costs.**

This is the best cost-savings strategy because:

* For the existing EC2 workload, the company already determined 3 years ago that **Standard Reserved Instances** matched the workload. The workload is still needed for another 3 years, so buying the same RIs again is appropriate. AWS documentation states that RIs can be purchased for **1-year or 3-year commitments**, and that **3-year commitments offer a bigger discount**. It also states that RIs do not renew automatically, and when they expire, the customer returns to On-Demand rates until purchasing new matching RIs ([Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)).
* The **All Upfront** payment option gives the greatest savings among RI payment options. AWS states that, generally, customers can save more by making a higher upfront payment for Reserved Instances ([Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)).
* Standard RIs provide the most significant RI discount, although with less flexibility than Convertible RIs ([Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)).
* For the new serverless workload, a **Compute Savings Plan** is the right Savings Plan type because Compute Savings Plans apply to **EC2, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda** usage and can provide up to 66% off On-Demand rates ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
* Purchasing in the management account is suitable for a multi-account organization because consolidated billing combines usage across accounts and shares Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discounts across the organization ([Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)).

Therefore, option A combines the highest-discount approach for the known, steady EC2 workload with a flexible Compute Savings Plan for additional compute/serverless usage across the organization.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan with No Upfront payment in each member account

This provides less savings because it uses a **1-year** term and **No Upfront** payment. AWS Savings Plans support 1-year and 3-year terms, and the question explicitly says the EC2 instances are needed for 3 more years ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)). Also, Compute Savings Plans are flexible but provide up to 66% off, while EC2-specific commitments such as EC2 Instance Savings Plans can provide up to 72% off; Standard RIs are also designed for significant EC2 savings. Buying separate plans in each member account is also less aligned with the organization-wide billing benefit because consolidated billing can share Savings Plans across accounts.

### C. Purchase a 3-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with No Upfront payment in the management account and a 3-year Compute Savings Plan with No Upfront payment

This is closer, but it still does not provide the **most** savings because both plans use **No Upfront** payment. For cost minimization, All Upfront generally gives greater savings than No Upfront. Also, EC2 Instance Savings Plans are tied to a specific instance family in a chosen Region, while the question states the company previously optimized with specific Standard RIs and still needs those EC2 instances for another 3 years. Option A better matches the known steady EC2 workload and uses All Upfront commitments.

### D. Purchase a 3-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with All Upfront payment in each member account

This option uses a strong EC2 discount model, but it does **not** address the new serverless workload. EC2 Instance Savings Plans apply to EC2 usage within a specific instance family and Region; they do not cover Lambda or Fargate. Compute Savings Plans are the Savings Plan type that applies to Lambda and Fargate ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). Additionally, purchasing in each member account is unnecessary for organization-wide discount sharing under consolidated billing.

## Conclusion

Option **A** provides the most savings: renew the stable EC2 commitment with 3-year All Upfront Standard RIs, and use a 3-year All Upfront Compute Savings Plan in the management account for additional compute usage, including serverless workloads such as Lambda.

zh.question: 一家公司需要优化一个 AWS 环境的成本，该环境在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中包含多个账户。该公司 3 年前开展过成本优化活动，并购买了最近已到期的 Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances。公司还需要使用 EC2 实例 3 年。此外，公司还部署了一个新的无服务器工作负载。哪种策略将为公司提供最多的成本节省？

options.A: 以 All Upfront 付款方式再次购买相同的 Reserved Instances，期限为 3 年。在管理账户中以 All Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 Compute Savings Plan，以覆盖任何额外的计算成本。
options.B: 在每个成员账户中以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 1 年期 Compute Savings Plan。使用 AWS Cost Management 控制台中的 Savings Plans 建议来选择 Compute Savings Plan。
options.C: 在管理账户中以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，以覆盖每个 AWS 区域中的 EC2 成本。在管理账户中以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 Compute Savings Plan，以覆盖任何额外的计算成本。
options.D: 在每个成员账户中以 All Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。使用 AWS Cost Management 控制台中的 Savings Plans 建议来选择 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司拥有一个多账户 AWS Organizations 环境。其之前的 3 年期 EC2 Standard Reserved Instances 已经到期，并且 EC2 工作负载仍需要再使用 3 年。它还新增了一个无服务器工作负载。问题询问的是能带来**最多成本节省**的策略，而不是最灵活的策略。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 以 All Upfront 付款方式再次购买相同的 Reserved Instances，期限为 3 年。在管理账户中以 All Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 Compute Savings Plan，以覆盖任何额外的计算成本。**

这是最佳的成本节省策略，因为：

* 对于现有 EC2 工作负载，公司 3 年前已经确定 **Standard Reserved Instances** 与该工作负载匹配。该工作负载仍需要再使用 3 年，因此再次购买相同的 RI 是合适的。AWS 文档说明，RI 可以购买 **1 年或 3 年承诺期**，并且 **3 年承诺期提供更大的折扣**。文档还说明 RI 不会自动续订，到期后，客户会恢复为 On-Demand 费率，直到购买新的匹配 RI（[Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)）。
* **All Upfront** 付款选项在 RI 付款选项中提供最大的节省。AWS 表示，一般来说，客户通过为 Reserved Instances 支付更高的预付款可以节省更多成本（[Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)）。
* Standard RIs 提供最显著的 RI 折扣，尽管其灵活性低于 Convertible RIs（[Reserved Instances payment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/reserved-instances-payment-options.html)）。
* 对于新的无服务器工作负载，**Compute Savings Plan** 是正确的 Savings Plan 类型，因为 Compute Savings Plans 适用于 **EC2、AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda** 用量，并且可提供相对于 On-Demand 费率最高 66% 的折扣（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
* 在管理账户中购买适用于多账户组织，因为合并账单会汇总各账户的使用量，并在整个组织中共享 Reserved Instance 和 Savings Plans 折扣（[Consolidating billing for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html)）。

因此，选项 A 将适用于已知稳定 EC2 工作负载的最高折扣方式，与适用于整个组织中额外计算/无服务器用量的灵活 Compute Savings Plan 相结合。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### B. 在每个成员账户中以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 1 年期 Compute Savings Plan

这提供的节省较少，因为它使用 **1 年**期限和 **No Upfront** 付款。AWS Savings Plans 支持 1 年和 3 年期限，而题目明确说明 EC2 实例还需要使用 3 年（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。此外，Compute Savings Plans 很灵活，但最高只提供 66% 的折扣；而 EC2 专用承诺（例如 EC2 Instance Savings Plans）最高可提供 72% 的折扣；Standard RIs 也是为显著节省 EC2 成本而设计的。在每个成员账户中单独购买计划也不太符合组织范围账单优势，因为合并账单可以在账户之间共享 Savings Plans。

### C. 在管理账户中以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，并以 No Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 Compute Savings Plan

这个选项更接近，但仍然不能提供**最多**节省，因为两个计划都使用 **No Upfront** 付款。对于成本最小化，All Upfront 通常比 No Upfront 提供更大的节省。此外，EC2 Instance Savings Plans 绑定到所选区域中的特定实例系列，而题目说明公司之前已使用特定 Standard RIs 进行了优化，并且仍需要这些 EC2 实例再运行 3 年。选项 A 更好地匹配已知稳定的 EC2 工作负载，并使用 All Upfront 承诺。

### D. 在每个成员账户中以 All Upfront 付款方式购买 3 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan

此选项使用了强力的 EC2 折扣模型，但它**没有**处理新的无服务器工作负载。EC2 Instance Savings Plans 适用于特定实例系列和区域内的 EC2 用量；它们不覆盖 Lambda 或 Fargate。Compute Savings Plans 是适用于 Lambda 和 Fargate 的 Savings Plan 类型（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。此外，在每个成员账户中购买对于合并账单下的组织范围折扣共享来说并非必要。

## 结论

选项 **A** 提供最多节省：使用 3 年期 All Upfront Standard RIs 续订稳定的 EC2 承诺，并在管理账户中使用 3 年期 All Upfront Compute Savings Plan 来覆盖额外计算用量，包括 Lambda 等无服务器工作负载。

en.question: A company operates a static content distribution platform that serves customers globally. The customers consume content from their own AWS accounts. The company serves its content from an Amazon S3 bucket. The company uploads the content from its on-premises environment to the S3 bucket by using an S3 File Gateway. The company wants to improve the platform’s performance and reliability by serving content from the AWS Region that is geographically closest to customers. The company must route the on-premises data to Amazon S3 with minimal latency and without public internet exposure. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Implement S3 Multi-Region Access Points
options.B: Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to copy content to different Regions
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that tracks the routing of clients to Regions
options.D: Use an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to connect to a Multi-Region Access Point.
options.E: Use AWS PrivateLink and AWS Direct Connect to connect to a Multi-Region Access Point.

en.explanation:
The company needs a managed way to route S3 requests to the best AWS Region for global consumers, and it also needs a private, low-latency hybrid network path from the on-premises environment to Amazon S3. The correct choices are **A. Implement S3 Multi-Region Access Points** and **E. Use AWS PrivateLink and AWS Direct Connect to connect to a Multi-Region Access Point**.

**A is correct** because Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points provide a single global endpoint for requests to S3 buckets in multiple AWS Regions. AWS states that requests to a Multi-Region Access Point use AWS Global Accelerator to route over the AWS global network to the closest S3 bucket with an active routing status, and that S3 can serve requests to a replicated data set from the closest available Region. This directly addresses the requirement to improve global performance and reliability with the least operational overhead. See [Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html).

**E is correct** because the on-premises upload path must have minimal latency and must not use public internet exposure. AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3 supports interface VPC endpoints that are accessible from on-premises applications over AWS Direct Connect, and requests to S3 over interface endpoints stay on the Amazon network. AWS also provides the `com.amazonaws.s3-global.accesspoint` endpoint type specifically for connecting to S3 Multi-Region Access Points through AWS PrivateLink. Direct Connect provides the private, dedicated network connectivity needed for the lowest-latency hybrid path among the available options. See [AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html) and [Configuring a Multi-Region Access Point for use with AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPointsPrivateLink.html).

**B is incorrect** because S3 Cross-Region Replication copies objects between buckets, but it does not provide the global request-routing endpoint or the private on-premises connectivity required by the scenario. Replication can be part of the underlying data synchronization for buckets used with a Multi-Region Access Point, but the two required design steps here are the managed multi-Region access layer and the private Direct Connect/PrivateLink connectivity path.

**C is incorrect** because a Lambda function to track client routing would add custom operational overhead. S3 Multi-Region Access Points already provide AWS-managed routing to the closest active Region, so a custom routing function is unnecessary.

**D is incorrect** because AWS Site-to-Site VPN does not provide the same minimal-latency, private dedicated connectivity as AWS Direct Connect. The question requires minimal latency and no public internet exposure for on-premises traffic to S3, making Direct Connect with AWS PrivateLink the better fit.

zh.question: 一家公司运营一个面向全球客户提供服务的静态内容分发平台。客户从其自己的 AWS 账户中使用这些内容。该公司从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶提供其内容。该公司使用 S3 File Gateway 将内容从本地环境上传到 S3 存储桶。该公司希望通过从地理位置上最接近客户的 AWS 区域提供内容，来提升平台的性能和可靠性。该公司必须以最低延迟将本地数据路由到 Amazon S3，并且不能暴露在公有互联网中。哪两个步骤的组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 实施 S3 Multi-Region Access Points
options.B: 使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 将内容复制到不同区域
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于跟踪客户端到区域的路由
options.D: 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接来连接到 Multi-Region Access Point。
options.E: 使用 AWS PrivateLink 和 AWS Direct Connect 连接到 Multi-Region Access Point。

zh.explanation:
该公司需要一种托管方式，将 S3 请求路由到最适合全球消费者的 AWS 区域；同时还需要从本地环境到 Amazon S3 的私有、低延迟混合网络路径。正确选项是 **A. 实施 S3 Multi-Region Access Points** 和 **E. 使用 AWS PrivateLink 和 AWS Direct Connect 连接到 Multi-Region Access Point**。

**A 是正确的**，因为 Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points 为位于多个 AWS 区域中的 S3 存储桶提供单一全局端点。AWS 表示，对 Multi-Region Access Point 的请求会使用 AWS Global Accelerator，通过 AWS 全球网络路由到具有活动路由状态的最近 S3 存储桶，并且 S3 可以从最近的可用区域为复制的数据集提供请求服务。这直接满足了以最少运营开销提升全球性能和可靠性的要求。请参阅 [Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)。

**E 是正确的**，因为本地上传路径必须具备最低延迟，并且不得暴露于公有互联网。AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3 支持接口 VPC 端点，本地应用程序可以通过 AWS Direct Connect 访问这些端点，并且通过接口端点发往 S3 的请求会留在 Amazon 网络中。AWS 还提供专门用于通过 AWS PrivateLink 连接到 S3 Multi-Region Access Points 的 `com.amazonaws.s3-global.accesspoint` 端点类型。Direct Connect 提供了在可选方案中实现最低延迟混合路径所需的私有专用网络连接。请参阅 [AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html) 和 [Configuring a Multi-Region Access Point for use with AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPointsPrivateLink.html)。

**B 是错误的**，因为 S3 Cross-Region Replication 会在存储桶之间复制对象，但它不提供场景所需的全局请求路由端点，也不提供私有本地连接。复制可以作为与 Multi-Region Access Point 配合使用的存储桶底层数据同步的一部分，但此处所需的两个设计步骤是托管的多区域访问层，以及私有 Direct Connect/PrivateLink 连接路径。

**C 是错误的**，因为使用 Lambda 函数来跟踪客户端路由会增加自定义运营开销。S3 Multi-Region Access Points 已经提供由 AWS 托管的路由，可将请求路由到最近的活动区域，因此不需要自定义路由函数。

**D 是错误的**，因为 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 无法提供与 AWS Direct Connect 相同的最低延迟私有专用连接。该问题要求本地到 S3 的流量具备最低延迟且不暴露于公有互联网，因此 Direct Connect 与 AWS PrivateLink 的组合更合适。

en.question: A company is migrating its data center to the AWS Cloud and needs to complete the migration as quickly as possible. The company has many applications that are running on hundreds of VMware VMs in the data center. Each VM is configured with a shared Windows folder that contains common shared files. The file share is larger than 100 GB in size. The company’s compliance team requires a change request to be fled and approved for every software installation and modification to each VM. The company has an AWS Direct Connect connection with 10 GB of bandwidth between AWS and the data center. Which set of steps should the company take to complete the migration in the LEAST amount of time?

options.A: Use VM ImporvExport to create images of each VM. Use AWS Application Migration Service to manage and view the images. Copy the Windows file share data to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. After migration, remap the file share to the EFS file system.
options.B: Deploy the AWS Application Discovery Service agentless appliance to VMware vCenter. Review the portfolio of discovered VMs in AWS Migration Hub.
options.C: Deploy the AWS Application Migration Service agentless appliance to VMware vCenter. Copy the Windows file share data to a new Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. After migration, remap the file share on each VM to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.D: Create and review a portfolio in AWS Migration Hub. Order an AWS Snowcone device. Deploy AWS Application Migration Service to VMware vCenter and export all the VMs to the Snowcone device. Copy all Windows file share data to the Snowcone device. Ship the Snowcone device to AWS. Use Application Migration Service to deploy all the migrated instances.
options.E: Deploy the AWS Application Discovery Service Agent and the AWS Application Migration Service Agent onto each VMware hypervisor directly. Review the portfolio in AWS Migration Hub. Copy each VM’s file share data to a new Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. After migration, remap the file share on each VM to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs the fastest migration of **hundreds of VMware VMs** while avoiding per-VM software installation or modification because each such change requires compliance approval. The VMs also use a **shared Windows folder** larger than 100 GB that should remain a Windows-compatible shared file service after migration. The company already has a **10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect** link, so online transfer to AWS is practical.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Deploy the AWS Application Migration Service agentless appliance to VMware vCenter. Copy the Windows file share data to a new Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. After migration, remap the file share on each VM to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.**

This is the best fit because:

* **AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) supports agentless replication for vCenter environments.** The AWS documentation states that agentless snapshot-based replication lets you replicate source servers in a vCenter environment into AWS **without installing the AWS Replication Agent**. It uses an MGN vCenter Client installed on a dedicated VM to discover suitable VMs and perform replication through snapshot shipping, Changed Block Tracking, VDDK, and EBS snapshots. This avoids installing software on every migrated VM, which directly addresses the compliance constraint. See [Agentless replication overview - Application Migration Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/installing-vcenter-overview-mgn.html).
* **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is the correct target for a shared Windows file share.** FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers, uses a native Windows file system, and supports the SMB protocol for network file access. AWS also states that Windows applications and tools can continue to work unchanged with FSx for Windows File Server. See [What is FSx for Windows File Server?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html).
* The file share can be remapped after migration. FSx documentation explains that clients access FSx for Windows File Server file shares using SMB and that Windows instances can map a drive letter to the Amazon FSx file share. See [Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html).

Therefore, option C minimizes per-server changes, supports large-scale VMware migration, and preserves Windows-native SMB file sharing.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. VM Import/Export + Application Migration Service + EFS

This is not the fastest or best approach for hundreds of VMs. VM Import/Export imports VM images as AMIs, which is a more manual image-based process than continuous MGN replication for large-scale server migration. Also, Amazon EFS is not the right replacement for a native Windows SMB file share. EFS is mounted with the EFS mount helper or standard Linux NFS client, and AWS states that EFS supports NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1. See [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html). FSx for Windows File Server is the Windows SMB file-share service.

### B. Application Discovery Service agentless appliance only

Application Discovery Service is for **migration planning and discovery**, not performing the actual migration. AWS describes it as a service that helps plan migration by collecting usage and configuration data, and integrates with Migration Hub for grouping and tracking. Its agentless discovery via VMware vCenter identifies VMs and collects configuration/utilization data, but this option does not migrate the VMs or move the shared files. See [What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html).

### D. Snowcone-based export/import

This adds unnecessary logistics and delay. The company already has a 10 Gbps Direct Connect connection, and MGN agentless replication can replicate the VMware VMs directly from vCenter to AWS. Shipping a Snowcone device introduces ordering, copying, shipping, and import time. The option also describes exporting all VMs to Snowcone through Application Migration Service, which is not the standard MGN agentless vCenter replication workflow described in the MGN documentation.

### E. Install Application Discovery and Application Migration agents onto each VMware hypervisor

This conflicts with the compliance and speed requirements. Installing agents broadly would introduce additional installation/change approvals. Also, MGN agentless replication is performed through the MGN vCenter Client on a dedicated VM in the vCenter environment, not by installing the AWS Replication Agent on every server or on each hypervisor. The documented agentless model exists specifically to replicate vCenter VMs without installing the AWS Replication Agent on each source server. See [Agentless replication overview - Application Migration Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/installing-vcenter-overview-mgn.html).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud，并且需要尽快完成迁移。该公司有许多应用程序运行在数据中心的数百台 VMware VM 上。每台 VM 都配置了一个共享 Windows 文件夹，其中包含通用共享文件。该文件共享的大小超过 100 GB。该公司的合规团队要求对每次软件安装以及对每台 VM 的每项修改都提交并批准变更请求。该公司在 AWS 与数据中心之间有一条带宽为 10 GB 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接。该公司应采取哪组步骤来以最短时间完成迁移？

options.A: 使用 VM Import/Export 为每台 VM 创建映像。使用 AWS Application Migration Service 管理和查看这些映像。将 Windows 文件共享数据复制到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。迁移后，将文件共享重新映射到 EFS 文件系统。
options.B: 将 AWS Application Discovery Service 无代理设备部署到 VMware vCenter。查看 AWS Migration Hub 中发现的 VM 组合。
options.C: 将 AWS Application Migration Service 无代理设备部署到 VMware vCenter。将 Windows 文件共享数据复制到新的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。迁移后，将每台 VM 上的文件共享重新映射到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
options.D: 在 AWS Migration Hub 中创建并查看组合。订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备。将 AWS Application Migration Service 部署到 VMware vCenter，并将所有 VM 导出到 Snowcone 设备。将所有 Windows 文件共享数据复制到 Snowcone 设备。将 Snowcone 设备寄送到 AWS。使用 Application Migration Service 部署所有已迁移的实例。
options.E: 将 AWS Application Discovery Service Agent 和 AWS Application Migration Service Agent 直接部署到每个 VMware hypervisor 上。查看 AWS Migration Hub 中的组合。将每台 VM 的文件共享数据复制到新的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。迁移后，将每台 VM 上的文件共享重新映射到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要最快迁移 **数百台 VMware VM**，同时避免逐 VM 的软件安装或修改，因为每次此类变更都需要合规审批。这些 VM 还使用一个大于 100 GB 的 **共享 Windows 文件夹**，迁移后应继续作为兼容 Windows 的共享文件服务。该公司已有一条 **10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect** 链路，因此在线传输到 AWS 是可行的。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 将 AWS Application Migration Service 无代理设备部署到 VMware vCenter。将 Windows 文件共享数据复制到新的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。迁移后，将每台 VM 上的文件共享重新映射到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。**

这是最合适的选择，原因如下：

* **AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) 支持 vCenter 环境的无代理复制。** AWS 文档说明，基于快照的无代理复制允许你在 **不安装 AWS Replication Agent** 的情况下，将 vCenter 环境中的源服务器复制到 AWS。它使用安装在专用 VM 上的 MGN vCenter Client 来发现合适的 VM，并通过快照传送、Changed Block Tracking、VDDK 和 EBS 快照执行复制。这避免了在每台已迁移的 VM 上安装软件，直接满足了合规约束。请参阅 [Agentless replication overview - Application Migration Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/installing-vcenter-overview-mgn.html)。
* **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是共享 Windows 文件共享的正确目标。** FSx for Windows File Server 提供完全托管的 Microsoft Windows 文件服务器，使用原生 Windows 文件系统，并支持 SMB 协议进行网络文件访问。AWS 还说明，Windows 应用程序和工具可以继续与 FSx for Windows File Server 配合工作而无需更改。请参阅 [What is FSx for Windows File Server?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)。
* 文件共享可以在迁移后重新映射。FSx 文档解释说，客户端使用 SMB 访问 FSx for Windows File Server 文件共享，并且 Windows 实例可以将驱动器号映射到 Amazon FSx 文件共享。请参阅 [Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)。

因此，选项 C 最大限度减少了每台服务器的变更，支持大规模 VMware 迁移，并保留了 Windows 原生 SMB 文件共享。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. VM Import/Export + Application Migration Service + EFS

对于数百台 VM，这不是最快或最佳的方法。VM Import/Export 将 VM 映像导入为 AMI，相比用于大规模服务器迁移的连续 MGN 复制，这是一种更手动的基于映像的过程。此外，Amazon EFS 并不是原生 Windows SMB 文件共享的合适替代方案。EFS 通过 EFS mount helper 或标准 Linux NFS 客户端挂载，AWS 说明 EFS 支持 NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1。请参阅 [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)。FSx for Windows File Server 才是 Windows SMB 文件共享服务。

### B. 仅使用 Application Discovery Service 无代理设备

Application Discovery Service 用于**迁移规划和发现**，而不是执行实际迁移。AWS 将其描述为一种通过收集使用情况和配置数据来帮助规划迁移的服务，并与 Migration Hub 集成以进行分组和跟踪。它通过 VMware vCenter 进行无代理发现，识别 VM 并收集配置/利用率数据，但此选项不会迁移 VM，也不会移动共享文件。请参阅 [What is AWS Application Discovery Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html)。

### D. 基于 Snowcone 的导出/导入

这会增加不必要的物流和延迟。该公司已经有一条 10 Gbps Direct Connect 连接，MGN 无代理复制可以将 VMware VM 直接从 vCenter 复制到 AWS。寄送 Snowcone 设备会引入订购、复制、运输和导入时间。该选项还描述了通过 Application Migration Service 将所有 VM 导出到 Snowcone，但这不是 MGN 文档中描述的标准 MGN 无代理 vCenter 复制工作流。

### E. 将 Application Discovery 和 Application Migration 代理安装到每个 VMware hypervisor 上

这与合规和速度要求相冲突。广泛安装代理会引入额外的安装/变更审批。此外，MGN 无代理复制是通过 vCenter 环境中专用 VM 上的 MGN vCenter Client 执行的，而不是通过在每台服务器或每个 hypervisor 上安装 AWS Replication Agent 来执行的。文档中的无代理模型专门用于在不在每台源服务器上安装 AWS Replication Agent 的情况下复制 vCenter VM。请参阅 [Agentless replication overview - Application Migration Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/installing-vcenter-overview-mgn.html)。

en.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts that are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to store AWS account activity and query the data from a central location by using SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS CloudTraii trail in each account. Specify CloudTrail management events for the trail. Configure CloudTrail to send the events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure CloudWatch cross- account observability. Query the data in CloudWatch Logs Insights.
options.B: Use a delegated administrator account to create an AWS CloudTrail Lake data store. Specify CloudTrail management events for the data store. Enable the data store for all accounts in the organization. Query the data in CloudTrail Lake.
options.C: Use a delegated administrator account to create an AWS CloudTral trail. Specify CloudTrail management events for the trail. Enable the trail for all accounts in the organization. Keep all other settings as default. Query the CloudTrail data from the CloudTrail event history page.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy AWS CloudTrail Lake data stores in each account. Specify CloudTrail management events for the data stores. Keep all other settings as default, Query the data in CloudTrail Lake.

en.explanation:
The company has multiple AWS accounts in AWS Organizations and wants account activity stored and queried centrally using SQL. The best fit is an organization-enabled CloudTrail Lake event data store.

**Correct answer: B. Use a delegated administrator account to create an AWS CloudTrail Lake data store, specify management events, enable it for all accounts in the organization, and query it in CloudTrail Lake.**

AWS CloudTrail Lake is specifically designed to store CloudTrail events in event data stores and run **SQL-based queries** on those events. The documentation states that CloudTrail Lake lets you run SQL-based queries on events, and that an event data store can store events from an AWS Organizations organization, including multiple accounts and Regions ([Working with AWS CloudTrail Lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-lake.html)). For organizational collection, the management account or a delegated administrator account can create an **organization event data store** to collect CloudTrail management or data events, and the console option is to **Enable for all accounts in my organization**. The CLI example also shows `--organization-enabled` creating a data store that collects all management events ([Understanding organization event data stores](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-lake-organizations.html)). This directly satisfies central storage and SQL querying.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudTrail trails in each account + CloudWatch Logs Insights**: This is not the best centralized CloudTrail Lake solution. It requires per-account trail configuration and sends logs to CloudWatch Logs. CloudWatch Logs Insights uses its own query language, not CloudTrail Lake SQL, and the option is more operationally complex than a single organization event data store.

- **C. Organization trail + Event history page**: An organization trail can centralize delivery of CloudTrail logs, but the proposed query mechanism is the CloudTrail **Event history** page. Event history has significant limitations: it is limited to the past 90 days, does not provide organization-level aggregation, and searches are limited to a single AWS account and Region. The documentation explicitly says that to query across multiple accounts in an AWS Organizations organization, use CloudTrail Lake ([Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)). It also does not provide SQL querying.

- **D. CloudFormation StackSets to deploy CloudTrail Lake data stores in each account**: This creates separate data stores in each account, not a central organization event data store. Although CloudTrail Lake supports SQL queries, deploying independent per-account data stores does not meet the requirement to store and query account activity from a central location as cleanly as an organization event data store enabled for all accounts.

Therefore, **B** is the solution that meets both requirements: centralized organization-wide CloudTrail event storage and SQL-based querying.

zh.question: 一家公司有多个 AWS 账户，这些账户位于 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内。该公司需要存储 AWS 账户活动，并使用 SQL 从中心位置查询数据。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个账户中创建一个 AWS CloudTraii 跟踪。为该跟踪指定 CloudTrail 管理事件。配置 CloudTrail 将事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。配置 CloudWatch 跨账户可观测性。在 CloudWatch Logs Insights 中查询数据。
options.B: 使用委派管理员账户创建一个 AWS CloudTrail Lake 数据存储。为该数据存储指定 CloudTrail 管理事件。为组织中的所有账户启用该数据存储。在 CloudTrail Lake 中查询数据。
options.C: 使用委派管理员账户创建一个 AWS CloudTral 跟踪。为该跟踪指定 CloudTrail 管理事件。为组织中的所有账户启用该跟踪。其他所有设置保持默认。在 CloudTrail 事件历史记录页面查询 CloudTrail 数据。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 在每个账户中部署 AWS CloudTrail Lake 数据存储。为这些数据存储指定 CloudTrail 管理事件。其他所有设置保持默认，在 CloudTrail Lake 中查询数据。

zh.explanation:
该公司在 AWS Organizations 中有多个 AWS 账户，并希望集中存储账户活动并使用 SQL 进行查询。最适合的方案是启用组织级别的 CloudTrail Lake 事件数据存储。

**正确答案：B。使用委派管理员账户创建 AWS CloudTrail Lake 数据存储，指定管理事件，为组织中的所有账户启用它，并在 CloudTrail Lake 中查询。**

AWS CloudTrail Lake 专门用于将 CloudTrail 事件存储在事件数据存储中，并对这些事件运行**基于 SQL 的查询**。文档说明 CloudTrail Lake 允许你对事件运行基于 SQL 的查询，并且事件数据存储可以存储来自 AWS Organizations 组织的事件，包括多个账户和区域（[使用 AWS CloudTrail Lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-lake.html)）。对于组织级收集，管理账户或委派管理员账户可以创建一个**组织事件数据存储**来收集 CloudTrail 管理事件或数据事件，控制台选项是 **Enable for all accounts in my organization**。CLI 示例还展示了 `--organization-enabled` 创建一个收集所有管理事件的数据存储（[了解组织事件数据存储](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-lake-organizations.html)）。这直接满足集中存储和 SQL 查询的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 每个账户中的 CloudTrail 跟踪 + CloudWatch Logs Insights**：这不是最佳的集中式 CloudTrail Lake 解决方案。它需要逐账户配置跟踪，并将日志发送到 CloudWatch Logs。CloudWatch Logs Insights 使用自己的查询语言，而不是 CloudTrail Lake SQL，并且该选项在运维上比单个组织事件数据存储更复杂。

- **C. 组织跟踪 + 事件历史记录页面**：组织跟踪可以集中交付 CloudTrail 日志，但所提出的查询机制是 CloudTrail **事件历史记录**页面。事件历史记录有显著限制：它仅限过去 90 天，不提供组织级聚合，并且搜索仅限单个 AWS 账户和区域。文档明确说明，要在 AWS Organizations 组织中的多个账户之间查询，请使用 CloudTrail Lake（[使用 CloudTrail 事件历史记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)）。它也不提供 SQL 查询。

- **D. 使用 CloudFormation StackSets 在每个账户中部署 CloudTrail Lake 数据存储**：这会在每个账户中创建单独的数据存储，而不是中心化的组织事件数据存储。虽然 CloudTrail Lake 支持 SQL 查询，但部署独立的逐账户数据存储，并不像为所有账户启用的组织事件数据存储那样干净利落地满足从中心位置存储和查询账户活动的要求。

因此，**B** 是同时满足这两项要求的解决方案：集中式组织范围 CloudTrail 事件存储和基于 SQL 的查询。

en.question: A company is using AWS to develop and manage its production web application. The application includes an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API that invokes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function processes and then stores data in a database. The company wants to implement user authorization for the web application in an integrated way. The company already uses a third-party identity provider that issues OAuth tokens for the company’s other applications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Integrate the company’s third-party identity provider with API Gateway. Configure an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to validate tokens from the identity provider. Require the Lambda authorizer on all API routes. Update the web application to get tokens from the identity provider and include the tokens in the Authorization header when calling the API Gateway HTTP API.
options.B: Integrate the company's third-party identity provider with AWS Directory Service. Configure Directory Service as an API Gateway authorizer to validate tokens from the identity provider. Require the Directory Service authorizer on all API routes. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center as a SAML 2.0 identity Provider. Configure the web application as a custom SAML 2.0 application.
options.C: Integrate the company’s third-party identity provider with AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure API Gateway to use IAM Identity Center for zero-configuration authentication and authorization. Update the web application to retrieve AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) tokens from IAM Identity Center and include the tokens in the Authorization header when calling the API Gateway HTTP API.
options.D: Integrate the company’s third-party identity provider with AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure IAM users with permissions to call the API Gateway HTTP API. Update the web application to extract request parameters from the IAM users and include the parameters in the Authorization header when calling the API Gateway HTTP API.

en.explanation:
The application uses an Amazon API Gateway **HTTP API** in front of Lambda, and the company already has a third-party identity provider that issues OAuth tokens. The requirement is to add user authorization in an integrated way while continuing to use those existing tokens.

**Correct answer: A**

Option A is correct because API Gateway can use a **Lambda authorizer** to control access to API routes based on identity information supplied by the client. For HTTP APIs, AWS documentation shows that a Lambda authorizer can use an identity source such as `$request.header.Authorization`, and after the authorizer is created, the route is updated with `authorization-type CUSTOM` to use that authorizer ([Control access to HTTP APIs with AWS Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-lambda-authorizer.html)). AWS also documents the Lambda authorizer workflow where the client passes a bearer token or request parameters, API Gateway invokes the authorizer, and the authorizer authenticates the caller, including by using an OAuth provider; API Gateway then allows or denies invocation based on the authorizer response ([Use API Gateway Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)).

Therefore, configuring a Lambda authorizer to validate OAuth tokens from the existing third-party identity provider, requiring it on all routes, and sending the token in the `Authorization` header matches the requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect** because AWS Directory Service is not an API Gateway authorizer for validating OAuth bearer tokens on HTTP API routes. This option adds Directory Service, IAM Identity Center, and SAML configuration unnecessarily and does not match API Gateway's documented Lambda authorizer/JWT-style authorization model for HTTP APIs.

- **C is incorrect** because API Gateway does not provide a generic “zero-configuration” IAM Identity Center authorizer for HTTP APIs. Also, the application already receives OAuth tokens from the third-party identity provider; requiring AWS STS tokens from IAM Identity Center is not the appropriate user authorization pattern for this scenario.

- **D is incorrect** because IAM users are not an appropriate user authorization mechanism for a production web application’s end users. IAM authorization is for AWS principals and SigV4-signed requests, not for extracting request parameters from IAM users and placing them in an `Authorization` header. This option also fails to use the existing OAuth-token-based identity provider integration.

Because the stated answer is supported by the documented API Gateway Lambda authorizer behavior, the answer is **A**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS 开发和管理其生产 Web 应用程序。该应用程序包括一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API，该 API 调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。Lambda 函数处理数据，然后将数据存储在数据库中。公司希望以集成的方式为该 Web 应用程序实现用户授权。公司已经使用一个第三方身份提供商，该提供商为公司的其他应用程序颁发 OAuth 令牌。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将公司的第三方身份提供商与 API Gateway 集成。配置 API Gateway Lambda authorizer，以验证来自该身份提供商的令牌。要求所有 API 路由都使用该 Lambda authorizer。更新 Web 应用程序，使其从身份提供商获取令牌，并在调用 API Gateway HTTP API 时将令牌包含在 Authorization 标头中。
options.B: 将公司的第三方身份提供商与 AWS Directory Service 集成。将 Directory Service 配置为 API Gateway authorizer，以验证来自该身份提供商的令牌。要求所有 API 路由都使用该 Directory Service authorizer。将 AWS IAM Identity Center 配置为 SAML 2.0 身份提供商。将 Web 应用程序配置为自定义 SAML 2.0 应用程序。
options.C: 将公司的第三方身份提供商与 AWS IAM Identity Center 集成。配置 API Gateway 使用 IAM Identity Center 进行零配置身份验证和授权。更新 Web 应用程序，使其从 IAM Identity Center 检索 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 令牌，并在调用 API Gateway HTTP API 时将令牌包含在 Authorization 标头中。
options.D: 将公司的第三方身份提供商与 AWS IAM Identity Center 集成。配置具有调用 API Gateway HTTP API 权限的 IAM 用户。更新 Web 应用程序，使其从 IAM 用户中提取请求参数，并在调用 API Gateway HTTP API 时将这些参数包含在 Authorization 标头中。

zh.explanation:
该应用程序在 Lambda 前使用 Amazon API Gateway **HTTP API**，并且公司已经有一个颁发 OAuth 令牌的第三方身份提供商。要求是在继续使用这些现有令牌的同时，以集成方式添加用户授权。

**正确答案：A**

选项 A 正确，因为 API Gateway 可以使用 **Lambda authorizer** 根据客户端提供的身份信息来控制对 API 路由的访问。对于 HTTP API，AWS 文档显示 Lambda authorizer 可以使用诸如 `$request.header.Authorization` 之类的身份源；创建 authorizer 后，路由会使用 `authorization-type CUSTOM` 进行更新，以使用该 authorizer（[使用 AWS Lambda authorizers 控制对 HTTP APIs 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-lambda-authorizer.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Lambda authorizer 工作流：客户端传递 bearer token 或请求参数，API Gateway 调用 authorizer，authorizer 对调用方进行身份验证（包括使用 OAuth provider）；然后 API Gateway 根据 authorizer 响应允许或拒绝调用（[使用 API Gateway Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)）。

因此，配置 Lambda authorizer 来验证来自现有第三方身份提供商的 OAuth 令牌，要求所有路由都使用它，并在 `Authorization` 标头中发送令牌，符合这些要求。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B 不正确**，因为 AWS Directory Service 不是用于在 HTTP API 路由上验证 OAuth bearer tokens 的 API Gateway authorizer。此选项不必要地添加了 Directory Service、IAM Identity Center 和 SAML 配置，并且不符合 API Gateway 文档中针对 HTTP APIs 的 Lambda authorizer/JWT 风格授权模型。

- **C 不正确**，因为 API Gateway 不为 HTTP APIs 提供通用的“零配置”IAM Identity Center authorizer。此外，该应用程序已经从第三方身份提供商接收 OAuth 令牌；要求从 IAM Identity Center 获取 AWS STS 令牌并不是此场景下合适的用户授权模式。

- **D 不正确**，因为 IAM 用户不是生产 Web 应用程序最终用户的合适用户授权机制。IAM 授权用于 AWS 主体和 SigV4 签名请求，而不是从 IAM 用户提取请求参数并将其放入 `Authorization` 标头。此选项也未能使用现有的基于 OAuth 令牌的身份提供商集成。

由于所给答案受到文档中 API Gateway Lambda authorizer 行为的支持，因此答案是 **A**。

en.question: A company has deployed applications to thousands of Amazon EC2 instances in an AWS account. A security audit discovers that several unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes are attached to the EC2 instances. The company’s security policy requires the EBS volumes to be encrypted. The company needs to implement an automated solution to encrypt the EBS volumes. The solution also must prevent development teams from creating unencrypted EBS volumes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the AWS Config managed rule that identifies unencrypted EBS volumes. Configure an automatic remediation action.
